verses.ASV: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora as terras costeiras se estremecerão no dia de tua queda; e as ilhas que estão no mar se espantarão com o teu fim.
verses.RVR09: Ahora se estremecerán las islas en el día de tu caída, sí, las islas que están en la mar se espantarán de tu éxito.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.WEB: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters shall cover thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando eu te tornar uma cidade desolada, como as cidades que não se habitam; quando eu fizer subir sobre ti um abismo, e muitas águas te cobrirem,
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Yo te tornaré ciudad asolada, como las ciudades que no se habitan; haré subir sobre ti el abismo, y las muchas aguas te cubrirán.

verses.KJV: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.WEB: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
verses.ASV: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu te farei descer com os que descem à cova, junto dos povos do passado; e te porei nas profundezas da terra, como os lugares desertos antigos, com os que descem à cova, para que não sejas habitada; então darei glória na terra dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: Y te haré descender con los que descienden al sepulcro, con el pueblo del siglo: y te pondré en lo más bajo de la tierra, como los desiertos antiguos, con los que descienden al sepulcro, para que nunca más seas poblada; y yo daré gloria en la tierra de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”
verses.ASV: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt no more have any being; though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te tonarei em espanto, e não mais existirás; e ainda que te busquem, nunca mais serás achada,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Yo te tornaré en espanto, y no serás: y serás buscada, y nunca más serás hallada, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.WEB: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, pois, filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Tiro.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, levanta endechas sobre Tiro.

verses.KJV: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord God; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.WEB: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.ASV: and say unto Tyre, O thou that dwellest at the entry of the sea, that art the merchant of the peoples unto many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, O Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize a Tiro, que habita nas entradas do mar, e faz comércio com dos povos em muitas terras costeiras: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ó Tiro, tu dizes: Eu sou perfeita em beleza.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás á Tiro, que está asentada á las entradas de la mar, mercadera de los pueblos de muchas islas: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Tiro, tú has dicho: Yo soy de perfecta hermosura.

verses.KJV: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.WEB: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.ASV: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus limites estão no coração dos mares; os que te edificaram aperfeiçoaram a tua beleza.
verses.RVR09: En el corazón de las mares están tus términos: los que te edificaron completaron tu belleza.

verses.KJV: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.WEB: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.ASV: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fabricaram todos os teus conveses com faias de Senir; trouxeram cedros do Líbano para fazerem mastros para ti.
verses.RVR09: De hayas del monte Senir te fabricaron todas las tillas: tomaron cedros del Líbano para hacerte el mástil.

verses.KJV: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.WEB: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.
verses.ASV: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; they have made thy benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the isles of Kittim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram teus remos [com] carvalhos de Basã; fizeram teus bancos com ciprestes das ilhas do Chipre, unidos com marfim.
verses.RVR09: De castaños de Basán hicieron tus remos: compañía de Asirios hicieron tus bancos de marfil de las islas de Chittim.

verses.KJV: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.WEB: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
verses.ASV: Of fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, that it might be to thee for an ensign; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Linho bordado do Egito era tua cortina, para te servir de vela; de azul e púrpura das ilhas de Elisá era teu toldo.
verses.RVR09: De fino lino bordado de Egipto fué tu cortina, para que te sirviese de vela; de cárdeno y grana de las islas de Elisah fué tu pabellón.

verses.KJV: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.WEB: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
verses.ASV: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os moradores de Sidom e de Arvade eram teus remadores; teus sábios, ó Tiro, [que] estavam em ti, eles foram teus pilotos.
verses.RVR09: Los moradores de Sidón y de Arvad fueron tus remeros: tus sabios, oh Tiro, estaban en ti; ellos fueron tus pilotos.

verses.KJV: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.WEB: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.
verses.ASV: The old men of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to deal in thy merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os anciãos de Gebal e seus sábios eram em ti os que reparavam tuas fendas; todos os navios do mar e seus marinheiros delas foram em ti para negociar tuas mercadorias.
verses.RVR09: Los ancianos de Gebal y sus sabios repararon tus hendiduras: todas las galeras de la mar y los remeros de ellas fueron en ti para negociar tus negocios.

verses.KJV: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.WEB: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.
verses.ASV: Persia and Lud and Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persas e lídios, e os de Pute, eram em teu exército teus soldados; escudos e capacetes penduraram em ti; eles te deram tua pompa.
verses.RVR09: Persas y Lidios, y los de Phut, fueron en tu ejército tus hombres de guerra: escudos y capacetes colgaron en ti; ellos te dieron tu honra.

verses.KJV: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.WEB: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.
verses.ASV: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and valorous men were in thy towers; they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have perfected thy beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Arvade e teu exército estavam sobre teus muros ao redor, e os gamaditas em tuas torres; penduravam seus escudos sobre teus muros ao redor; eles aperfeiçoavam tua beleza.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Arvad con tu ejército estuvieron sobre tus muros alrededor, y los Gammadeos en tus torres: sus escudos colgaron sobre tus muros alrededor; ellos completaron tu hermosura.

verses.KJV: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.WEB: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
verses.ASV: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded for thy wares.
verses.ALMEIDA: Társis negociava contigo, por causa da abundância de todas as variedades de riquezas; com prata, ferro, estanho, e chumbo, negociavam [em] tuas feiras.
verses.RVR09: Tarsis tu mercadera á causa de la multitud de todas riquezas en plata, hierro, estaño, y plomo, dió en tus ferias.

verses.KJV: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.WEB: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
verses.ASV: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Javã, Tubal, e Meseque eram teus mercadores; com almas humanas e com vasos de metal, fizeram negócios contigo.
verses.RVR09: Grecia, Tubal, y Mesec, tus mercaderes, con hombres y con vasos de metal, dieron en tus ferias.

verses.KJV: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.WEB: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
verses.ASV: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da casa de Togarma traziam cavalos, cavaleiros e mulos, para tuas feiras.
verses.RVR09: De la casa de Togarma, caballos y caballeros y mulos, dieron en tu mercado.

verses.KJV: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.WEB: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
verses.ASV: The men of Dedan were thy traffickers; many isles were the mart of thy hand: they brought thee in exchange horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Dedã eram teus mercadores; muitas ilhas eram o comércio sob teu controle; chifres de marfim e madeira de ébano te deram como presente.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Dedán eran tus negociantes: muchas islas tomaban mercadería de tu mano; cuernos de marfil y pavos te dieron en presente.

verses.KJV: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.WEB: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
verses.ASV: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of thy handiworks: they traded for thy wares with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Síria negociava contigo por causa da abundância de tuas obras; turquesas, púrpura, materiais bordados, linhos finos, corais, e rubis, traziam em tuas feiras.
verses.RVR09: Siria fué tu mercadera por la multitud de tus labores: con perlas, y púrpura, y vestidos bordados, y linos finos, y corales, y rubíes, dió en tus ferias.

verses.KJV: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.WEB: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
verses.ASV: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy traffickers: they traded for thy merchandise wheat of Minnith, and pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, Judá e a terra de Israel, eram teus mercadores; com trigo de Minite, e panague, mel, e azeite, e resina, fizeram negócios contigo.
verses.RVR09: Judá, y la tierra de Israel, eran tus mercaderes: con trigos de Minith, y pannah, y miel, y aceite, y resina, dieron en tu mercado.

verses.KJV: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.WEB: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.ASV: Damascus was thy merchant for the multitude of thy handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Damasco negociava contigo, por causa da abundância de tuas obras, pela abundância de todas as variedades de bens; com vinho de Helbom, e lã branca.
verses.RVR09: Damasco, tu mercadera por la multitud de tus labores, por la abundancia de todas riquezas, con vino de Helbón, y lana blanca.

verses.KJV: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.WEB: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
verses.ASV: Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for thy wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were among thy merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Dã e Javã de Uzal comercializavam em tuas feiras; ferro lavrado, cássia, e cana aromática havia em teu comércio.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo Dan y el errante Javán dieron en tus ferias, para negociar en tu mercado de hierro labrado, mirra destilada, y caña aromática.

verses.KJV: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.WEB: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.
verses.ASV: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious cloths for riding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dedã negociava contigo, com panos preciosos para carros.
verses.RVR09: Dedán fué tu mercadera con paños preciosos para carros.

verses.KJV: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
verses.WEB: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
verses.ASV: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they were the merchants of thy hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these were they thy merchants.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Arábia, e todos os príncipes de Quedar, eles eram mercadores sob teu controle; com cordeiros, carneiros, e bodes; nestas coisas negociavam contigo.
verses.RVR09: Arabia y todos los príncipes de Cedar, mercaderes de tu mano en corderos, y carneros, y machos cabríos: en estas cosas fueron tus mercaderes.

verses.KJV: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.WEB: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.
verses.ASV: The traffickers of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy traffickers; they traded for thy wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os mercadores de Sabá e de Raamá eram teus mercadores; com toda especiaria importante, toda pedra preciosa, e ouro, comercializavam em tuas feiras.
verses.RVR09: Los mercaderes de Seba y de Raama fueron tus mercaderes: con lo principal de toda especiería, y toda piedra preciosa, y oro, dieron en tus ferias.

verses.KJV: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
verses.WEB: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
verses.ASV: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur [and] Chilmad, were thy traffickers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Harã, Cané, e Éden, os mercadores de Sabá, da Assíria, e Quilmade negociavam contigo.
verses.RVR09: Harán, y Canneh, y Edén, los mercaderes de Seba, de Asiria, y Chilmad, contigo contrataban.

verses.KJV: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.WEB: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.
verses.ASV: These were thy traffickers in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes negociavam contigo em toda variedade de mercadorias: com tecidos azuis, com bordados, e com caixas de roupas preciosas, amarradas com cordões, e [postos] em cedro, em teu comércio.
verses.RVR09: Estos tus mercaderes negociaban contigo en varias cosas: en mantos de jacinto, y bordados, y en cajas de ropas preciosas, enlazadas con cordones, y en madera de cedro.

verses.KJV: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.WEB: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
verses.ASV: The ships of Tarshish were thy caravans for thy merchandise: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os navios de Társis transportavam os artigos do teu negócio; e te encheste, e te tornaste muito pesada no meio dos mares.
verses.RVR09: Las naves de Tarsis, tus cuadrillas, fueron en tu negociación: y fuiste llena, y fuiste multiplicada en gran manera en medio de los mares.

verses.KJV: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.WEB: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
verses.ASV: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus remadores te trouxeram a muitas águas; o vento oriental te quebrou no meio dos mares.
verses.RVR09: En muchas aguas te engolfaron tus remeros: viento solano te quebrantó en medio de los mares.

verses.KJV: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.WEB: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.
verses.ASV: Thy riches, and thy wares, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the dealers in thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, with all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas riquezas, tuas feiras, teu negócio, teus marinheiros, teus pilotos; os que reparavam tuas fendas, teus comerciantes, e todos teus soldados que há em ti, com toda a tua companhia que está no meio de ti, cairão no meio dos mares, no dia de tua queda.
verses.RVR09: Tus riquezas, y tus mercaderías, y tu negociación, tus remeros, y tus pilotos, los reparadores de tus hendiduras, y los agentes de tus negocios, y todos tus hombres de guerra que hay en ti, con toda tu compañía que en medio de ti se halla, caerán en medio de los mares el día de tu caída.

verses.KJV: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.WEB: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
verses.ASV: At the sound of the cry of thy pilots the suburbs shall shake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao estrondo das vozes de teus marinheiros tremerão os arredores.
verses.RVR09: Al estrépito de las voces de tus marineros temblarán los arrabales.

verses.KJV: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.WEB: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,
verses.ASV: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, [and] all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land,
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que usam remo; marinheiros, e todos os pilotos do mar descerão de seus navios, e pararão na terra:
verses.RVR09: Y descenderán de sus naves todos los que toman remo; remeros, y todos los pilotos de la mar se pararán en tierra:

verses.KJV: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.WEB: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.
verses.ASV: and shall cause their voice to be heard over thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads; they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.ALMEIDA: E farão ouvir sua voz sobre ti; gritarão amargamente, lançarão pó sobre suas cabeças, e se revolverão na cinza.
verses.RVR09: Y harán oir su voz sobre ti, y gritarán amargamente, y echarán polvo sobre sus cabezas, y se revolcarán en la ceniza.

verses.KJV: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.WEB: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
verses.ASV: and they shall make themselves bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se farão calvos por causa de ti, se vestirão de sacos, e chorarão por ti com amargura da alma, com amarga lamentação.
verses.RVR09: Y haránse por ti calva, y se ceñirán de sacos, y endecharán por ti endechas amargas, con amargura de alma.

verses.KJV: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.WEB: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’
verses.ASV: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, [saying], Who is there like Tyre, like her that is brought to silence in the midst of the sea?
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantarão lamentação sobre em seu pranto, e lamentarão sobre ti dizendo: Quem foi como Tiro, como a [que agora está] silenciada no meio do mar?
verses.RVR09: Y levantarán sobre ti endechas en sus lamentaciones, y endecharán sobre ti diciendo: ¿Quién como Tiro, como la destruída en medio de la mar?

verses.KJV: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.WEB: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
verses.ASV: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many peoples; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando tuas mercadorias vinham dos mares, fartaste muitos povos; enriqueceste os reis da terra com a abundância de tuas riquezas e de teus negócios.
verses.RVR09: Cuando tus mercaderías salían de las naves, hartabas muchos pueblos: los reyes de la tierra enriqueciste con la multitud de tus riquezas y de tus contrataciones.

verses.KJV: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.WEB: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.
verses.ASV: In the time that thou wast broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, thy merchandise and all thy company did fall in the midst of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora foste quebrada dos mares, nas profundezas das águas; caíram teu negócio e toda a tua companhia no meio de ti.
verses.RVR09: En el tiempo que serás quebrantada de los mares en los profundos de las aguas, tu comercio y toda tu compañía caerán en medio de ti.

verses.KJV: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.WEB: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.
verses.ASV: All the inhabitants of the isles are astonished at thee, and their kings are horribly afraid; they are troubled in their countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os moradores dos litorais foram espantados por causa de ti, e seus reis ficaram horrorizados; seus rostos se conturbaram.
verses.RVR09: Todos los moradores de las islas se maravillarán sobre ti, y sus reyes temblarán de espanto: inmutaránse en sus rostros.

verses.KJV: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
verses.WEB: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”
verses.ASV: The merchants among the peoples hiss at thee; thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os mercadores nos povos assoviam por causa de ti; tu te tornaste em motivo de espanto, e nunca mais voltarás a existir.
verses.RVR09: Los mercaderes en los pueblos silbarán sobre ti: vendrás á ser espanto, y dejarás de ser para siempre.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—
verses.ASV: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art man, and not God, though thou didst set thy heart as the heart of God;—
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dize ao príncipe de Tiro: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que teu coração se exalta, e dizes: Eu sou um deus; no trono de de Deus me sento no meio dos mares (sendo tu homem e não Deus); e consideras teu coração como coração de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, di al príncipe de Tiro: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto se enalteció tu corazón, y dijiste: Yo soy un dios; en la silla de Dios estoy sentado en medio de los mares (siendo tú hombre y no Dios); y has puesto tu corazón como corazón de Dios:

verses.KJV: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.WEB: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.
verses.ASV: behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: (Eis que tu és mais sábio que Daniel; não há segredo algum que possa se esconder de ti;
verses.RVR09: He aquí que tú eres más sabio que Daniel; no hay secreto que te sea oculto;

verses.KJV: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.WEB: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.
verses.ASV: by thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures;
verses.ALMEIDA: Com tua sabedoria e teu entendimento obtiveste riquezas, e adquiriste ouro e prata em teus tesouros;
verses.RVR09: Con tu sabiduría y con tu prudencia te has juntado riquezas, y has adquirido oro y plata en tus tesoros;

verses.KJV: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.WEB: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”
verses.ASV: by thy great wisdom [and] by thy traffic hast thou increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches;—
verses.ALMEIDA: Com a tua grande sabedoria aumentaste tuas riquezas em teu comércio; e por causa de tuas riquezas teu coração tem se exaltado).
verses.RVR09: Con la grandeza de tu sabiduría en tu contratación has multiplicado tus riquezas; y á causa de tus riquezas se ha enaltecido tu corazón.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.WEB: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que consideras teu coração como coração [se fosse] de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto pusiste tu corazón como corazón de Dios,

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que eu trarei sobre ti estrangeiros, os mais violentos das nações, os quais desembainharão suas espadas contra a beleza de tua sabedoria, e contaminarão o teu resplendor.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí yo traigo sobre ti extraños, los fuertes de las gentes, que desenvainarán su espadas contra la hermosura de tu sabiduría, y ensuciarán tu esplendor.

verses.KJV: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.WEB: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
verses.ASV: They shall bring thee down to the pit; and thou shalt die the death of them that are slain, in the heart of the seas.
verses.ALMEIDA: À cova te farão descer, e morrerás da morte dos que morrem no meio dos mares.
verses.RVR09: A la huesa te harán descender, y morirás de las muertes de los que mueren en medio de los mares.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.WEB: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
verses.ASV: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou art man, and not God, in the hand of him that woundeth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso dirás: Eu sou Deus, diante de teu matador? Tu és homem, e não Deus, nas mãos de quem te matar.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hablarás delante de tu matador, diciendo: Yo soy Dios? Tú, hombre eres, y no Dios, en la mano de tu matador.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: Thou shalt die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: De morte de incircuncisos morrerás, pela mão de estrangeiros; porque [assim] eu falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: De muerte de incircuncisos morirás por mano de extraños: porque yo he hablado, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.ASV: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre o rei de Tiro, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tu eras o carimbo da perfeição, cheio de sabedoria, e perfeito em formosura.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, levanta endechas sobre el rey de Tiro, y dile: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Tú echas el sello á la proporción, lleno de sabiduría, y acabado de hermosura.

verses.KJV: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.WEB: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.
verses.ASV: Thou wast in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was in thee; in the day that thou wast created they were prepared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estiveste no Éden, o jardim de Deus; toda pedra preciosa era tua cobertura; sárdio, topázio, diamante, turquesa, ônix, jaspe, safira, carbúnculo, e esmeralda; e [de] ouro era a obra de tuas molduras e de teus engastes em ti; no dia em que foste criado estavam preparados.
verses.RVR09: En Edén, en el huerto de Dios estuviste: toda piedra preciosa fué tu vestidura; el sardio, topacio, diamante, crisólito, onique, y berilo, el zafiro, carbunclo, y esmeralda, y oro, los primores de tus tamboriles y pífanos estuvieron apercibidos para ti en el día de tu creación.

verses.KJV: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.WEB: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.
verses.ASV: Thou wast the anointed cherub that covereth: and I set thee, [so that] thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu eras querubim ungido, cobridor; e eu te estabeleci, no santo monte de Deus estavas; no meio de pedras de fogo tu andavas.
verses.RVR09: Tú, querubín grande, cubridor: y yo te puse; en el santo monte de Dios estuviste; en medio de piedras de fuego has andado.

verses.KJV: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.WEB: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
verses.ASV: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till unrighteousness was found in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Íntegro eras em teus caminhos, desde o dia em que foste criado, até que se achou maldade em ti.
verses.RVR09: Perfecto eras en todos tus caminos desde el día que fuiste criado, hasta que se halló en ti maldad.

verses.KJV: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.WEB: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.
verses.ASV: By the abundance of thy traffic they filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore have I cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela abundância de teu comércio encheram o meio de ti de violência; por isso eu te expulsei como profanado do monte de Deus, e te farei perecer, ó querubim cobridor, do meio das pedras de fogo.
verses.RVR09: A causa de la multitud de tu contratación fuiste lleno de iniquidad, y pecaste: por lo que yo te eché del monte de Dios, y te arrojé de entre las piedras del fuego, oh querubín cubridor.

verses.KJV: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.WEB: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.
verses.ASV: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty; thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I have cast thee to the ground; I have laid thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu coração se exaltou por causa de tua formosura, corrompeste tua sabedoria por causa de teu resplendor; eu te lancei por terra; diante dos reis eu te pus, para que olhem para ti.
verses.RVR09: Enaltecióse tu corazón á causa de tu hermosura, corrompiste tu sabiduría á causa de tu resplandor: yo te arrojaré por tierra; delante de los reyes te pondré para que miren en ti.

verses.KJV: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.WEB: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.
verses.ASV: By the multitude of thine iniquities, in the unrighteousness of thy traffic, thou hast profaned thy sanctuaries; therefore have I brought forth a fire from the midst of thee; it hath devoured thee, and I have turned thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da multidão de tuas maldades e da perversidade de teu comércio, profanaste teus santuários; por isso eu fiz sair um fogo do meio de ti, o qual te consumiu; e te tornei em cinza sobre a terra, diante dos olhos de todos quantos te veem.
verses.RVR09: Con la multitud de tus maldades, y con la iniquidad de tu contratación ensuciaste tu santuario: yo pues saqué fuego de en medio de ti, el cual te consumió, y púsete en ceniza sobre la tierra á los ojos de todos los que te miran.

verses.KJV: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
verses.WEB: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”
verses.ASV: All they that know thee among the peoples shall be astonished at thee: thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que te conhecem entre os povos estão espantados por causa de ti; em grande horror te tornaste, e nunca mais voltarás a existir.
verses.RVR09: Todos los que te conocieron de entre los pueblos, se maravillarán sobre ti: en espanto serás, y para siempre dejarás de ser.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto contra Sidom, e profetiza contra ela;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro hacia Sidón, y profetiza contra ella;

verses.KJV: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.WEB: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.
verses.ASV: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Sidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó Sidom, e serei glorificado no meio de ti; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando nela fizer juízos, e nela me santificar.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo contra ti, oh Sidón, y en medio de ti seré glorificado: y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando hiciere en ella juicios, y en ella me santificare.

verses.KJV: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall in the midst of her, with the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois enviarei a ela pestilência e sangue em suas ruas; e mortos cairão no meio dela pela espada que está contra ela ao redor; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y enviaré á ella pestilencia y sangre en sus plazas; y caerán muertos en medio de ella, con espada contra ella alrededor; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
verses.ASV: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are round about them, that did despite unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa de Israel nunca mais terá espinho que a fira, nem abrolho que cause dor, de todos os que desprezam ao redor deles; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y nunca más será á la casa de Israel espino que le punce, ni espanto que le dé dolor, en todos los alrededores de los que los menosprecian; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando eu ajuntar a casa de Israel dos povos entre os quais estão dispersos, e eu me santificar entre eles diante dos olhos das nações, então habitarão em sua terra, que dei a meu servo Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Cuando juntaré la casa de Israel de los pueblos entre los cuales están esparcidos, entonces me santificaré en ellos á los ojos de las gentes, y habitarán en su tierra, la cual dí á mi siervo Jacob.

verses.KJV: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God.
verses.WEB: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”
verses.ASV: And they shall dwell securely therein; yea, they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall dwell securely, when I have executed judgments upon all those that do them despite round about them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitarão nela em segurança, edificarão casas, e plantarão vinhas; e habitarão em segurança, quando eu fizer juízos contra todos os que os desprezam ao redor deles; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, o Deus deles.
verses.RVR09: Y habitarán en ella seguros, y edificarán casas, y plantarán viñas, y habitarán confiadamente, cuando yo haré juicios en todos los que los despojan en sus alrededores; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová su Dios.

verses.KJV: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], in the twelfth [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No décimo ano, no décimo mês, aos doze do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el año décimo, en el mes décimo, á los doce del mes, fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto contra Faraó, rei do Egito; e profetiza contra ele e contra todo o Egito.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro contra Faraón rey de Egipto, y profetiza contra él y contra todo Egipto.

verses.KJV: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.WEB: Speak and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has said, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’
verses.ASV: speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lieth in the midst of his rivers, that hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, Faraó rei do Egito, o grande dragão que jaz no meio de seus rios, que diz: Meu rio é meu, eu [o] fiz para mim.
verses.RVR09: Habla, y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo contra ti, Faraón rey de Egipto, el gran dragón que yace en medio de sus ríos, el cual dijo: Mío es mi río, y yo me lo hice.

verses.KJV: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
verses.WEB: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales.
verses.ASV: And I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales; and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, with all the fish of thy rivers which stick unto thy scales.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu porei anzóis em teus queixos, e apegarei os peixes de teus rios a tuas escamas, e te tirarei do meio de teus rios, e todos os peixes de teus rios se apegarão a tuas escamas.
verses.RVR09: Yo pues, pondré anzuelos en tus mejillas, y pegaré los peces de tus ríos á tus escamas, y te sacaré de en medio de tus ríos, y todos los peces de tus ríos saldrán pegados á tus escamas.

verses.KJV: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.WEB: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.
verses.ASV: And I will cast thee forth into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open field; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered; I have given thee for food to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te deixarei no deserto, a ti e a todos os peixes de teus rios; sobre a face do campo aberto cairás; não serás recolhido, nem ajuntado; para os animais da terra e para as aves do céu te dei por alimento.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaréte en el desierto, á ti y á todos los peces de tus ríos: sobre la haz del campo caerás; no serás recogido, ni serás juntado: á las bestias de la tierra y á las aves del cielo te he dado por comida.

verses.KJV: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.ASV: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os moradores do Egito saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, pois foram um bordão de cana para a casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán todos los moradores de Egipto que yo soy Jehová, por cuanto fueron bordón de caña á la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.WEB: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”
verses.ASV: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and didst rend all their shoulders; and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eles te tomaram pela mão, te quebraste, e lhes rompeste todo os ombros; e quando se recostaram a ti, te quebraste, e lhes fizeste instáveis todos os lombos.
verses.RVR09: Cuando te tomaron con la mano, te quebraste, y les rompiste todo el hombro: y cuando se recostaron sobre ti, te quebraste, y los deslomaste enteramente.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and will cut off from thee man and beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor o SENHOR: Eis que eu trarei contra ti espada, e destruirei de ti homens e animais.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí que yo traigo contra ti espada, y talaré de ti hombres y bestias.

verses.KJV: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the Lord: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
verses.WEB: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD. “‘“Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’
verses.ASV: And the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste; and they shall know that I am Jehovah. Because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra do Egito se tornará desolada e deserta; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR; porque ela disse: O rio é meu, eu o fiz.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra de Egipto será asolada y desierta: y sabrán que yo soy Jehová: porque dijo: Mi río, y yo lo hice.

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que eu sou contra ti, e contra teus rios; e tornarei a terra do Egito em desertas e assoladas solidões, desde Migdol e Sevene, até o limite de Cuxe.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí yo contra ti, y contra tus ríos; y pondré la tierra de Egipto en asolamientos de la soledad del desierto, desde Migdol hasta Seveneh, hasta el término de Etiopía.

verses.KJV: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.WEB: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.
verses.ASV: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não passará por ela pé de homem, nem pata de animal passará por ela; nem será habitada por quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: No pasará por ella pie de hombre, ni pie de bestia pasará por ella; ni será habitada por cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.WEB: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”
verses.ASV: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be a desolation forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tornarei a terra do Egito em desolação, em meio a terras desoladas; e suas cidades no meio das cidades desertas ficarão desoladas por quarenta anos; e espalharei os egípcios entre as nações, e os dispersarei pelas terras.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré á la tierra de Egipto en soledad entre las tierras asoladas, y sus ciudades entre las ciudades destruídas estarán asoladas por cuarenta años: y esparciré á Egipto entre las gentes, y aventarélos por las tierras.

verses.KJV: Yet thus saith the Lord God; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.WEB: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples whither they were scattered;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ao fim de quarenta anos ajuntarei os egípcios dos povos entre os quais forem espalhados;
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Al fin de cuarenta años juntaré á Egipto de los pueblos entre los cuales fueren esparcidos:

verses.KJV: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.WEB: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
verses.ASV: and I will bring back the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E restaurarei o Egito de seu infortúnio, e os trarei de volta à terra de Patros, à terra de seu nascimento; e ali serão um reino inferior.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaré á traer los cautivos de Egipto, y los volveré á la tierra de Patros, á la tierra de su habitación; y allí serán un reino bajo.

verses.KJV: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.WEB: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.
verses.ASV: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it any more lift itself up above the nations: and I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será mais inferior que os [outros] reinos; e nunca mais se erguerá sobre as nações; porque eu os diminuirei, para que não dominem as nações.
verses.RVR09: En comparación de los otros reinos será humilde; ni más se alzará sobre las gentes: porque yo los disminuiré, para que no se enseñoreen en las gentes.

verses.KJV: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.WEB: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”’”
verses.ASV: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they turn to look after them: and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não será mais motivo de confiança para a casa de Israel, para fazê-la lembrar de [sua] maldade, quando olharam para eles; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y no será más á la casa de Israel por confianza, que haga acordar el pecado, mirando en pos de ellos; y sabrán que yo soy el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first [month], in the first [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu no ano vinte e sete, no primeiro [mês] ,no primeiro [dia] do mês, que veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en el año veinte y siete, en el mes primero, al primero del mes, que fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
verses.ASV: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet had he no wages, nor his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia mobilizou seu exército para uma grande campanha contra Tiro. Toda cabeça se tornou calva, e todo ombro se despelou; porém não houve ganho para ele nem para seu exército pela campanha que executou contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia hizo á su ejército prestar grande servicio contra Tiro. Toda cabeza se encalveció, y pelóse todo hombro; y ni para él ni para su ejército hubo paga de Tiro, por el servicio que prestó contra ella.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu darei a Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, a terra do Egito; e ele levará sua riqueza, tomará seus despojos, e saqueará sua presa, e [isto] será o ganho para seu exército.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí que yo doy á Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, la tierra de Egipto; y él tomará su multitud, y cogerá sus despojos, y arrebatará su presa, y habrá paga para su ejército.

verses.KJV: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como pagamento por seu trabalho que executou contra ela, eu lhe dei a terra do Egito; porque trabalharam por mim,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Por su trabajo con que sirvió contra ella le he dado la tierra de Egipto: porque trabajaron por mí, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: In that day will I cause a horn to bud forth unto the house of Israel, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia farei crescer o poder da casa de Israel, e te darei abertura de boca no meio deles; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo haré reverdecer el cuerno á la casa de Israel, y te daré apertura de boca en medio de ellos; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
verses.WEB: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’
verses.ASV: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Gritai: Ai daquele dia!
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, profetiza, y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Aullad: ¡Ay del día!

verses.KJV: For the day is near, even the day of the Lord is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
verses.WEB: For the day is near, even the LORD’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
verses.ASV: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque perto está o dia, perto está o dia do Senhor; dia de nuvens; será o tempo das nações.
verses.RVR09: Porque cerca está el día, cerca está el día del Señor; día de nublado, día de las gentes será.

verses.KJV: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.WEB: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.
verses.ASV: And a sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a espada virá ao Egito, e haverá grande dor em Cuxe, quando caírem os mortos no Egito; e tomarão sua multidão, e serão destruídos seus fundamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrá espada á Egipto, y habrá miedo en Etiopía, cuando caerán heridos en Egipto; y tomarán su multitud, y serán destruídos sus fundamentos.

verses.KJV: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.WEB: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”
verses.ASV: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Cub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuxe, Pute, Lude, e todo o povo misturado, e Cube, e os filhos da terra do pacto cairão com eles à espada.
verses.RVR09: Etiopía, y Libia, y Lidia, y todo el conjunto de pueblo, y Chûb, y los hijos de la tierra de la liga, caerán con ellos á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “‘The LORD says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Seveneh shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Também cairão os que sustentam ao Egito, e a soberba de sua força irá abaixo; desde Migdol e Sevene cairão nele à espada, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: También caerán los que sostienen á Egipto, y la altivez de su fortaleza caerá: desde Migdol hasta Seveneh caerán en él á cuchillo, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.WEB: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.
verses.ASV: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serão assolados no meio das terras assoladas, e suas cidades estarão no meio das cidades desertas.
verses.RVR09: Y serán asolados entre las tierras asoladas, y sus ciudades serán entre las ciudades desiertas.

verses.KJV: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
verses.WEB: They will know that I am the LORD when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
verses.ASV: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando puser fogo ao Egito, e forem destruídos todos os que o ajudavam.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando pusiere fuego á Egipto, y fueren quebrantados todos sus ayudadores.

verses.KJV: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
verses.WEB: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
verses.ASV: In that day shall messengers go forth from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there shall be anguish upon them, as in the day of Egypt; for, lo, it cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia sairão de diante de mim mensageiros em navios, para espantarem a confiante Cuxe, e haverá grandes dores neles, como no dia do Egito; porque eis que está vindo.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo saldrán mensajeros de delante de mí en navíos, á espantar á Etiopía la confiada, y tendrán espanto como en el día de Egipto: porque he aquí viene.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei cessar a multidão do Egito pela mão de Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Haré cesar la multitud de Egipto por mano de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.WEB: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.ASV: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, e com ele seu povo, os mais terríveis das nações, serão trazidos para destruir a terra; e desembainharão suas espadas contra o Egito, e encherão a terra de mortos.
verses.RVR09: El, y con él su pueblo, los más fuertes de las gentes, serán traídos á destruir la tierra: y desenvainarán sus espadas sobre Egipto, y henchirán la tierra de muertos.

verses.KJV: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.WEB: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”
verses.ASV: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E secarei os rios, entregarei a terra em mãos de malignos, e destruirei a terra e tudo o que ela contém pela mão de estrangeiros; eu, o SENHOR falei.
verses.RVR09: Y secaré los ríos, y entregaré la tierra en manos de malos, y destruiré la tierra y su plenitud por mano de extranjeros: yo Jehová he hablado.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Também destruirei aos ídolos, e darei fim às imagens idolátricas de Mênfis; não haverá mais príncipe da terra do Egito, e porei medo na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Destruiré también las imágenes, y haré cesar los ídolos de Memphis; y no habrá más príncipe de la tierra de Egipto, y en la tierra de Egipto pondré temor.

verses.KJV: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
verses.WEB: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.
verses.ASV: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments upon No.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desolarei a Patros, porei fogo a Zoã, e farei juízos em Nô.
verses.RVR09: Y asolaré á Patros, y pondré fuego á Zoán, y haré juicios en No.

verses.KJV: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.WEB: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.ASV: And I will pour my wrath upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
