verses.RVR09: Y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando pusiere la tierra en soledad y desierto, por todas las abominaciones que han hecho.

verses.KJV: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the Lord.
verses.WEB: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’
verses.ASV: And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people talk of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, ó filho do homem, os filhos de teu povo falam de ti junto às paredes e às portas das casas, e um fala com o outro, cada um com seu irmão, dizendo: Vinde, pois, e ouvi que palavra vem do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, los hijos de tu pueblo se mofan de ti junto á las paredes y á las puertas de las casas, y habla el uno con el otro, cada uno con su hermano, diciendo: Venid ahora, y oid qué palabra sale de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
verses.WEB: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
verses.ASV: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but do them not; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goeth after their gain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles vem a ti, como o povo costuma vir, e se sentam diante de ti [como se fosse] meu povo, e ouvem tuas palavras, mas não as praticam; em vez disso lisonjeiam com suas bocas, [porém] seus corações buscam o interesse próprio.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán á ti como viene el pueblo, y se estarán delante de ti como mi pueblo, y oirán tus palabras, y no las pondrán por obra: antes hacen halagos con sus bocas, y el corazón de ellos anda en pos de su avaricia.

verses.KJV: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verses.WEB: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
verses.ASV: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que tu és para eles como um cantor de amores, de bela voz e que canta bem; então ouvem tuas palavras, mas não as praticam.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí que tú eres á ellos como cantor de amores, gracioso de voz y que canta bien: y oirán tus palabras, mas no las pondrán por obra.

verses.KJV: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
verses.WEB: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
verses.ASV: And when this cometh to pass (behold, it cometh), then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando isso vier a acontecer (eis que virá) saberão que houve profeta no meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando ello viniere (he aquí viene) sabrán que hubo profeta entre ellos.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
verses.WEB: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.ASV: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, even to the shepherds, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe unto the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, profetiza contra os pastores de Israel; profetiza, e dize-lhes, aos pastores: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai dos pastores de Israel, que se apascentam a si mesmos! Por acaso não devem os pastores apascentarem as ovelhas?
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, profetiza contra los pastores de Israel; profetiza, y diles á los pastores: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ay de los pastores de Israel, que se apacientan á sí mismos! ¿No apacientan los pastores los rebaños?

verses.KJV: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
verses.WEB: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
verses.ASV: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill the fatlings; but ye feed not the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comeis a gordura, e vos vestis da lã; degolais o cevado, [porém] não apascentais as ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Coméis la leche, y os vestís de la lana: la gruesa degolláis, no apacentáis las ovejas.

verses.KJV: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
verses.WEB: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
verses.ASV: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought back that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with rigor have ye ruled over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não fortaleceis as fracas, nem curais a doente; não pondes curativo na que está ferida; não trazeis de volta a desgarrada, e a perdida não buscais; porém dominais sobre elas com rigor e dureza.
verses.RVR09: No corroborasteis las flacas, ni curasteis la enferma: no ligasteis la perniquebrada, ni tornasteis la amontada, ni buscasteis la perdida; sino que os habéis enseñoreado de ellas con dureza y con violencia;

verses.KJV: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
verses.WEB: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
verses.ASV: And they were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and they became food to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se espalharam, porque não há pastor; e se tornaram alimento para toda fera do campo, porque se espalharam.
verses.RVR09: Y están derramadas por falta de pastor; y fueron para ser comidas de toda bestia del campo, y fueron esparcidas.

verses.KJV: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
verses.WEB: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
verses.ASV: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my sheep were scattered upon all the face of the earth; and there was none that did search or seek [after them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas ovelhas andaram sem rumo por todos os montes, e em todo morro alto; minhas ovelhas foram espalhadas por toda a face da terra, e ninguém há que as procure, ninguém que as busque.
verses.RVR09: Y anduvieron perdidas mis ovejas por todos los montes, y en todo collado alto: y en toda la haz de la tierra fueron derramadas mis ovejas, y no hubo quien buscase, ni quien requiriese.

verses.KJV: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
verses.ASV: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, ó pastores, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pastores, oid palabra de Jehová:

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
verses.WEB: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
verses.ASV: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely forasmuch as my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the beasts of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my sheep;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que dado que minhas ovelhas foram [entregues] ao saque, e minhas ovelhas serviram de alimento para toda fera do campo, por não haver pastor; e meus pastores não procuram minhas ovelhas, ao invés disso apascentaram a si mesmos, e não apascentam minhas ovelhas,
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, ha dicho el Señor Jehová, que por cuanto mi rebaño fué para ser robado, y mis ovejas fueron para ser comidas de toda bestia del campo, sin pastor; ni mis pastores buscaron mis ovejas, sino que los pastores se apacentaron á sí mismos, y no apacentaron mis ovejas;

verses.KJV: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;
verses.WEB: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
verses.ASV: therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, ó pastores, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, oh pastores, oid palabra de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra os pastores; exigirei deles minhas ovelhas, e farei com que cessem de apascentar as ovelhas; e os pastores não apascentarão mais a si mesmos; pois eu livrarei minhas ovelhas da boca deles, e elas não [mais] lhes servirão de alimento.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí, yo á los pastores; y requeriré mis ovejas de su mano, y haréles dejar de apacentar las ovejas: ni los pastores se apacentarán más á sí mismos; pues yo libraré mis ovejas de sus bocas, y no les serán más por comida.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
verses.WEB: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu, eu mesmo, procurarei minhas ovelhas, e as buscarei.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí, yo, yo requeriré mis ovejas, y las reconoceré.

verses.KJV: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.WEB: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.ASV: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como o pastor busca seu rebanho no dia em que está em meio de suas ovelhas espalhadas, assim buscarei minhas ovelhas, e as livrarei de todos os lugares por onde foram espalhadas, no dia de nuvem e de escuridão.
verses.RVR09: Como reconoce su rebaño el pastor el día que está en medio de sus ovejas esparcidas, así reconoceré mis ovejas, y las libraré de todos los lugares en que fueron esparcidas el día del nublado y de la oscuridad.

verses.KJV: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.WEB: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.ASV: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu as tirarei dos povos, e as ajuntarei das terras; eu as trarei para sua terra, e as apascentarei nos montes de Israel, junto às correntes de águas, e em todas as habitações daquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y yo las sacaré de los pueblos, y las juntaré de las tierras: y las meteré en su tierra, y las apacentaré en los montes de Israel por las riberas, y en todas las habitaciones del país.

verses.KJV: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.WEB: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.ASV: I will feed them with good pasture; and upon the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em bons pastos eu as apascentarei, e nos altos montes de Israel será sua pastagem; ali se deitarão em boa pastagem, e em prósperos pastos serão apascentadas sobre os montes de Israel.
verses.RVR09: En buenos pastos las apacentaré, y en los altos montes de Israel será su majada: allí dormirán en buena majada, y en pastos gruesos serán apacentadas sobre los montes de Israel.

verses.KJV: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu apascentarei minhas ovelhas, e eu farei elas se deitarem [em segurança] , diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Yo apacentaré mis ovejas, y yo les haré tener majada, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verses.WEB: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
verses.ASV: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu buscarei a perdida, e trarei de volta a desgarrada; porei curativo na que estiver ferida, e fortalecerei a enferma; mas a gorda e a forte destruirei. Eu as apascentarei com julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Yo buscaré la perdida, y tornaré la amontada, y ligaré la perniquebrada, y corroboraré la enferma: mas á la gruesa y á la fuerte destruiré. Yo las apacentaré en juicio.

verses.KJV: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
verses.WEB: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
verses.ASV: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the he-goats.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a vós, ovelhas minhas, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu julgarei entre ovelha e ovelha, entre carneiros e bodes.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotras, ovejas mías, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo juzgo entre oveja y oveja, entre carneros y machos cabríos.

verses.KJV: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.WEB: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
verses.ASV: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have fed upon the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? and to have drunk of the clear waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não vos basta que comais o bom pasto, para terdes que pisotear com vossos pés o resto de vossos pastos? E não vos basta as águas limpas, para sujardes o resto [das águas] com vossos pés?
verses.RVR09: ¿Os es poco que comáis los buenos pastos, sino que holléis con vuestros pies lo que de vuestros pastos queda; y que bebiendo las aguas sentadas, holléis además con vuestros pies las que quedan?

verses.KJV: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
verses.WEB: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
verses.ASV: And as for my sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas ovelhas terão de comer o que foi pisoteado por vossos pés, e beber o que foi sujo por vossos pés.
verses.RVR09: Y mis ovejas comen lo hollado de vuestros pies, y beben lo que con vuestros pies habéis hollado.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
verses.WEB: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim lhes diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu, eu mesmo, julgarei entre a ovelha gorda e a ovelha magra,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así les dice el Señor Jehová: He aquí, yo, yo juzgaré entre la oveja gruesa y la oveja flaca,

verses.KJV: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
verses.WEB: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
verses.ASV: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque empurrais com o lado e com o ombro, e com vossos chifres chifrais todas as fracas, até que as espalhais para fora.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto rempujasteis con el lado y con el hombro, y acorneasteis con vuestros cuernos á todas las flacas, hasta que las esparcisteis fuera.

verses.KJV: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
verses.WEB: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verses.ASV: therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu salvarei minhas ovelhas, para que nunca mais sirvam de saque; e julgarei entre ovelha e ovelha.
verses.RVR09: Yo salvaré á mis ovejas, y nunca más serán en rapiña; y juzgaré entre oveja y oveja.

verses.KJV: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.WEB: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
verses.ASV: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantarei sobre elas um pastor, e ele as apascentará: a meu servo Davi; ele as apascentará, e ele será o pastor delas.
verses.RVR09: Y despertaré sobre ellas un pastor, y él las apacentará; á mi siervo David: él las apacentará, y él les será por pastor.

verses.KJV: And I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.WEB: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.
verses.ASV: And I, Jehovah, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o SENHOR serei o Deus delas, e meu servo Davi será príncipe no meio delas. Eu, o SENHOR, falei.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová les seré por Dios, y mi siervo David príncipe en medio de ellos. Yo Jehová he hablado.

verses.KJV: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.WEB: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
verses.ASV: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei com elas um pacto de paz, e farei cessar os maus animais da terra; e habitarão no deserto em segurança, e dormirão nos bosques.
verses.RVR09: Y estableceré con ellos pacto de paz, y haré cesar de la tierra las malas bestias; y habitarán en el desierto seguramente, y dormirán en los bosques.

verses.KJV: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.WEB: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
verses.ASV: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei com que elas e os lugares ao redor de meu monte sejam bênção; e farei descer a chuva em seu tempo; chuvas de bênção serão.
verses.RVR09: Y daré á ellas, y á los alrededores de mi collado, bendición; y haré descender la lluvia en su tiempo, lluvias de bendición serán.

verses.KJV: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
verses.WEB: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
verses.ASV: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those that made bondmen of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as árvores do campo darão seu fruto, e a terra dará seu produto, e estarão em segurança sobre sua terra; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando quebrar as varas de seu jugo, e as livrar da mão dos que se servem delas.
verses.RVR09: Y el árbol del campo dará su fruto, y la tierra dará su fruto, y estarán sobre su tierra seguramente; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando quebrare las coyundas de su yugo, y los librare de mano de los que se sirven de ellos.

verses.KJV: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.WEB: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
verses.ASV: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beasts of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não [mais] servirão de presa às nações, nem as feras da terra as devorarão; pois habitarão em segurança, e não haverá quem [as] espante;
verses.RVR09: Y no serán más presa de las gentes, ni las bestias de la tierra las devorarán; sino que habitarán seguramente, y no habrá quien espante;

verses.KJV: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
verses.WEB: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
verses.ASV: And I will raise up unto them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes despertarei uma plantação de renome, e não mais serão consumidos de fome na terra, nem serão mais envergonhadas pelas nações.
verses.RVR09: Y despertaréles una planta por nombre, y no más serán consumidos de hambre en la tierra, ni serán más avergonzados de las gentes.

verses.KJV: Thus shall they know that I the Lord their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim saberão que eu, o SENHOR, seu Deus, estou com elas, e elas são o meu povo, a casa de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán que yo su Dios Jehová soy con ellos, y ellos son mi pueblo, la casa de Israel, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”
verses.ASV: And ye my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós, ovelhas minhas, sois ovelhas humanas do meu pasto; eu sou vosso Deus, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotras, ovejas mías, ovejas de mi pasto, hombres sois, y yo vuestro Dios, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto contra o monte de Seir, e profetiza contra ele,
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro hacia el monte de Seir, y profetiza contra él,

verses.KJV: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
verses.WEB: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
verses.ASV: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó monte de Seir; estenderei minha mão contra ti, e te tornarei em desolação e devastação.
verses.RVR09: Y dile: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo contra ti, oh monte de Seir, y extenderé mi mano contra ti, y te pondré en asolamiento y en soledad.

verses.KJV: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornarei as tuas cidades em ruínas, e tu serás desolado; e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: A tus ciudades asolaré, y tú serás asolado; y sabrás que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
verses.WEB: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
verses.ASV: Because thou hast had a perpetual enmity, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tiveste inimizade perpétua, e fizeste os filhos de Israel serem dispersos pelo poder da espada no tempo de sua aflição, no tempo do castigo final.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto tuviste enemistades perpetuas, y esparciste los hijos de Israel á poder de espada en el tiempo de su aflicción, en el tiempo extremadamente malo;

verses.KJV: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
verses.WEB: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.
verses.ASV: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que eu te preparei para o sangue, e o sangue te perseguirá; dado que não odiaste o sangue, o sangue te perseguirá.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, que á sangre te diputaré, y sangre te perseguirá: y pues la sangre no aborreciste, sangre te perseguirá.

verses.KJV: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
verses.WEB: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
verses.ASV: Thus will I make mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tornarei o monte de Seir em extrema desolação, e exterminarei quem passar [por ele] ,e quem voltar [por ele] .
verses.RVR09: Y pondré al monte de Seir en asolamiento y en soledad, y cortaré de él pasante y volviente.

verses.KJV: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.WEB: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
verses.ASV: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E encherei seus montes de seus mortos; em teus morros, em teus vales, e em todas as tuas correntes de águas, cairão os mortos à espada.
verses.RVR09: Y henchiré sus montes de sus muertos: en tus collados, y en tus valles, y en todos tus arroyos, caerán ellos muertos á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te tornarei em desolações perpétuas, e tuas cidades nunca mais serão habitadas; assim sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Yo te pondré en asolamientos perpetuos, y tus ciudades nunca más se restaurarán; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there:
verses.WEB: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,
verses.ASV: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Jehovah was there:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dado que disseste: As duas nações, as duas terras serão minhas, e delas tomaremos posse, ainda que o SENHOR ali estivesse;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto dijiste: Las dos naciones y las dos tierras serán mías, y las poseeremos, estando allí Jehová;

verses.KJV: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
verses.WEB: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.ASV: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast showed out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que agirei conforme tua ira e conforme tua inveja com que agiste, por causa de teu ódio contra eles; e serei conhecido por entre eles, quando eu te julgar.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, yo haré conforme á tu ira, y conforme á tu celo con que procediste, á causa de tus enemistades con ellos: y seré conocido en ellos, cuando te juzgaré.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
verses.WEB: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
verses.ASV: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saberás que eu, o SENHOR, ouvi todas as tuas blasfêmias que disseste contra os montes de Israel, dizendo: Já estão destruídos; já nos foram entregues para que os devoremos.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrás que yo Jehová he oído todas tus injurias que proferiste contra los montes de Israel, diciendo: Destruídos son, nos son dados á devorar.

verses.KJV: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
verses.WEB: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
verses.ASV: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim vos engradecestes contra mim com vossa boca, e multiplicastes vossas palavras contra mim. Eu ouvi.
verses.RVR09: Y os engrandecisteis contra mí con vuestra boca, y multiplicasteis contra mí vuestras palabras. Yo lo oí.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Enquanto toda a terra se alegrará, eu te tornarei em desolação.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Alegrándose toda la tierra, yo te haré soledad.

verses.KJV: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como te alegraste sobre a herança da casa de Israel, porque foi desolada, assim eu também farei a ti; o monte de Seir, e todo o Edom se tornarão em desolação; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Como te alegraste sobre la heredad de la casa de Israel, porque fué asolada, así te haré á ti: asolado será el monte de Seir, y toda Idumea, toda ella; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.WEB: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, profetiza ao os montes de Israel, e dize: Ó montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y TÚ, hijo del hombre, profetiza sobre los montes de Israel, y di: Montes de Israel, oid palabra de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que o inimigo disse sobre vós: Ha, ha! Até os antigos lugares altos se tornaram propriedade nossa!
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto el enemigo dijo sobre vosotros: ¡Ea! también las alturas perpetuas nos han sido por heredad;

verses.KJV: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
verses.WEB: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”
verses.ASV: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Por isso, por terem vos desolado e devorado desde o redor, para que fôsseis possuídos pelo resto das nações, e fostes trazidos aos lábios dos fofoqueiros, à infâmia do povo,
verses.RVR09: Profetiza por tanto, y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Pues por cuanto asolándoos y tragándoos de todas partes, para que fueseis heredad á las otras gentes, se os ha hecho andar en boca de lenguas, y ser el oprobio de los pueblos,

verses.KJV: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
verses.WEB: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
verses.ASV: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are round about;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, ó montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do Senhor DEUS: assim diz o Senhor DEUS aos montes e aos morros, às correntes e aos vales, às ruínas, aos lugares devastados, e às cidades abandonadas, que foram saqueadas e escarnecidas pelo resto das nações que há ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, montes de Israel, oid palabra del Señor Jehová: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová á los montes y á los collados, á los arroyos y á los valles, á las ruinas y asolamientos, y á las ciudades desamparadas, que fueron puestas á saco y en escarnio á las otras gentes alrededor;

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.WEB: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Certamente no fogo do meu zelo falei contra o resto das nações, e contra todo Edom, que se apropriaram de minha terra por herança, com alegria de todo coração, com desprezo na alma, para que fosse saqueada.
verses.RVR09: Por eso, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He hablado por cierto en el fuego de mi celo contra las demás gentes, y contra toda Idumea, que se disputaron mi tierra por heredad con alegría de todo corazón, con enconamiento de ánimo, para que sus expelidos fuesen presa.

verses.KJV: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
verses.WEB: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”
verses.ASV: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because ye have borne the shame of the nations:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto profetiza sobre a terra de Israel, e dize aos montes, aos morros, às correntes, e aos vales: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que falei em meu zelo e em meu furor, porque levastes sobre vós a humilhação das nações.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, profetiza sobre la tierra de Israel, y di á los montes y á los collados, y á los arroyos y á los valles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí, en mi celo y en mi furor he hablado, por cuanto habéis llevado el oprobio de las gentes.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have sworn, [saying], Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu prometo que as nações que estão ao redor de vós levarão sua humilhação sobre si mesmas.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Yo he alzado mi mano, que las gentes que os están alrededor han de llevar su afrenta.

verses.KJV: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.WEB: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.ASV: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vós, ó montes de Israel, produzireis vossos ramos, e dareis vosso fruto a meu povo Israel; porque logo virão.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros, oh montes de Israel, daréis vuestros ramos, y llevaréis vuestro fruto á mi pueblo Israel; porque cerca están para venir.

verses.KJV: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
verses.WEB: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.
verses.ASV: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que estou convosco; e me voltarei a vós, e sereis lavrados e semeados.
verses.RVR09: Porque heme aquí á vosotros, y á vosotros me volveré, y seréis labrados y sembrados.

verses.KJV: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
verses.WEB: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
verses.ASV: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded;
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei multiplicar homens sobre vós, a toda a casa de Israel, a ela toda; e as cidades serão habitadas, e as ruínas serão reedificadas.
verses.RVR09: Y haré multiplicar sobre vosotros hombres, á toda la casa de Israel, toda ella; y las ciudades han de ser habitadas, y serán edificadas las ruinas.

verses.KJV: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: and I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and will do better [unto you] than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E multiplicarei homens e animais sobre vós; e se multiplicarão, e crescerão; e vos farei habitar como no passado, e vos farei melhor que em vossos princípios; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y multiplicaré sobre vosotros hombres y bestias, y serán multiplicados y crecerán: y os haré morar como solíais antiguamente, y os haré más bien que en vuestros principios; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
verses.WEB: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”
verses.ASV: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei andar homens sobre vós: o meu povo Israel; e eles te possuirão, e tu lhes serás sua herança, e nunca mais exterminarás seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y haré andar hombres sobre vosotros, á mi pueblo Israel; y te poseerán, y les serás por heredad, y nunca más les matarás los hijos.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations:
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because they say unto you, Thou [land] art a devourer of men, and hast been a bereaver of thy nation;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que dizem de vós: Tu és devoradora de homens, e exterminadora dos filhos de teu povo,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto dicen de vosotros: Comedora de hombres, y matadora de los hijos de tus gentes has sido:

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nation any more, saith the Lord Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, não devorarás mais homens, e nem mais exterminarás os filhos de teus povos, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no devorarás más hombres, y nunca más matarás los hijos á tus gentes, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: neither will I let thee hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to stumble any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nunca mais te deixarei ouvir a vergonha dos povos, e nunca mais levarás sobre ti a humilhação das nações, nem mais exterminarás os filhos de teu povo, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y nunca más te haré oir injuria de gentes, ni más llevarás denuestos de pueblos, ni harás más morir los hijos á tus gentes, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.ASV: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, quando a casa de Israel morava em sua terra, eles a contaminaram com seus caminhos e com suas ações; o caminho deles diante de mim foi como imundície de menstruada.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, morando en su tierra la casa de Israel, la contaminaron con sus caminos y con sus obras: como inmundicia de menstruosa fué su camino delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
verses.WEB: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood which they had poured out upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso derramei minha ira sobre eles, por causa do sangue que derramaram sobre a terra, e por causa de seus ídolos com que a contaminaram.
verses.RVR09: Y derramé mi ira sobre ellos por las sangres que derramaron sobre la tierra; porque con sus ídolos la contaminaron.

verses.KJV: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.WEB: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
verses.ASV: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dispersei pelas nações, e foram espalhados pelas terras; eu os julguei conforme seus caminhos e conforme seus atos.
verses.RVR09: Y esparcílos por las gentes, y fueron aventados por las tierras: conforme á sus caminos y conforme á sus obras los juzgué.

verses.KJV: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.WEB: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
verses.ASV: And when they came unto the nations, whither they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, These are the people of Jehovah, and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram às nações para onde foram, profanaram meu santo nome, pois deles se dizia: Estes são povo do SENHOR, e da terra dele saíram.
verses.RVR09: Y entrados á las gentes á donde fueron, profanaron mi santo nombre, diciéndose de ellos: Estos son pueblo de Jehová, y de su tierra de él han salido.

verses.KJV: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
verses.WEB: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
verses.ASV: But I had regard for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu [os] poupei em favor a meu santo nome, o qual a casa de Israel profanou entre as nações para onde foram.
verses.RVR09: Y he tenido lástima en atención á mi santo nombre, el cual profanó la casa de Israel entre las gentes á donde fueron.

verses.KJV: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
verses.WEB: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
verses.ASV: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I do not [this] for your sake, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu não faço [isso] por vós, ó casa de Israel, mas sim por causa de meu santo nome, o qual vós profanastes entre as nações para onde fostes.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, di á la casa de Israel: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: No lo hago por vosotros, oh casa de Israel, sino por causa de mi santo nombre, el cual profanasteis vosotros entre las gentes á donde habéis llegado.

verses.KJV: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.WEB: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
verses.ASV: And I will sanctify my great name, which hath been profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am Jehovah, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois santificarei meu grande nome, que foi profanado entre as nações, o qual vós profanastes no meio delas; e as nações saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, diz o Senhor DEUS, quando eu for santificado em vós, diante de olhos delas.
verses.RVR09: Y santificaré mi grande nombre profanado entre las gentes, el cual profanasteis vosotros en medio de ellas; y sabrán las gentes que yo soy Jehová, dice el Señor Jehová, cuando fuere santificado en vosotros delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.WEB: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.ASV: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu vos tomarei das nações, e vos ajuntarei de todas as terras, e vos trarei para vossa própria terra.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os tomaré de las gentes, y os juntaré de todas las tierras, y os traeré á vuestro país.

verses.KJV: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.WEB: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
verses.ASV: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aspergirei água pura sobre vós, e sereis purificados; eu vos purificarei de todas vossas imundícies, e de todos os vossos ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Y esparciré sobre vosotros agua limpia, y seréis limpiados de todas vuestras inmundicias; y de todos vuestros ídolos os limpiaré.

verses.KJV: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.WEB: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
verses.ASV: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos darei um novo coração, e porei um novo espírito dentro de vós; e tirarei de vossa carne o coração de pedra, e vos darei um coração de carne.
verses.RVR09: Y os daré corazón nuevo, y pondré espíritu nuevo dentro de vosotros; y quitaré de vuestra carne el corazón de piedra, y os daré corazón de carne.

verses.KJV: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
verses.WEB: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
verses.ASV: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep mine ordinances, and do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei meu Espírito dentro de vós, e farei com que andeis em meus estatutos, guardeis meus juízos, e [os] pratiqueis.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré dentro de vosotros mi espíritu, y haré que andéis en mis mandamientos, y guardéis mis derechos, y los pongáis por obra.

verses.KJV: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.WEB: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.ASV: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitareis na terra que dei a vossos pais; e vós sereis meu povo, e eu serei vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y habitaréis en la tierra que dí á vuestros padres; y vosotros me seréis por pueblo, y yo seré á vosotros por Dios.

verses.KJV: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.WEB: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
verses.ASV: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos livrarei de todas as vossas imundícies; e chamarei ao trigo, e o multiplicarei, e não vos darei fome.
verses.RVR09: Y os guardaré de todas vuestras inmundicias; y llamaré al trigo, y lo multiplicaré, y no os daré hambre.

verses.KJV: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
verses.WEB: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.ASV: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também multiplicarei o fruto dos árvores, e o produto do campo, para que nunca mais recebais a humilhação da fome entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Multiplicaré asimismo el fruto de los árboles, y el fruto de los campos, porque nunca más recibáis oprobio de hambre entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.WEB: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.ASV: Then shall ye remember your evil ways, and your doings that were not good; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vos lembrareis de vossos maus caminhos, e de vossos atos que não foram bons; e tereis nojo de vós mesmos por vossas maldades, e por vossas abominações.
verses.RVR09: Y os acordaréis de vuestros malos caminos, y de vuestras obras que no fueron buenas; y os avergonzaréis de vosotros mismos por vuestras iniquidades, y por vuestras abominaciones.

verses.KJV: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
verses.WEB: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”
verses.ASV: Nor for your sake do I [this], saith the Lord Jehovah, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não faço [isto] por vós, diz o Senhor DEUS, notório vos seja; envergonhai-vos e humilhai-vos de vossos caminhos, ó casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: No lo hago por vosotros, dice el Señor Jehová, séaos notorio: avergonzaos y confundíos de vuestras iniquidades, casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia que vos purificar de todas as vossas maldades, então farei as cidades serem habitadas, e as ruínas serão reedificadas.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: El día que os limpiaré de todas vuestras iniquidades, haré también habitar las ciudades, y las asoladas serán edificadas.

verses.KJV: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.WEB: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
verses.ASV: And the land that was desolate shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra assolada será lavrada, em lugar de ser assolada diante dos olhos de todos os que passavam;
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra asolada será labrada, en lugar de haber sido asolada en ojos de todos los que pasaron;

verses.KJV: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.WEB: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
verses.ASV: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirão: Esta terra que era assolada ficou como o jardim do Éden; e as cidades abandonadas, assoladas e arruinadas estão fortalecidas [e] habitadas.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales dijeron: Esta tierra asolada fué como huerto de Edén; y estas ciudades desiertas y asoladas y arruinadas, fortalecidas estuvieron.

verses.KJV: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.WEB: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”
verses.ASV: Then the nations that are left round about you shall know that I, Jehovah, have builded the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate: I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então as nações que restarem ao vosso redor saberão que eu, o SENHOR, reedifico as [cidades] destruídas, e replanto as assoladas; eu, o SENHOR, falei e farei.
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes que fueron dejadas en vuestros alrededores, sabrán que yo edifiqué las derribadas, y planté las asoladas: yo Jehová he hablado, y harélo.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda permitirei serei buscado pela casa de Israel para lhes fazer isto: eu os multiplicarei de pessoas como a ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Aun seré solicitado de la casa de Israel, para hacerles esto: multiplicarélos de hombres á modo de rebaños.

verses.KJV: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como as ovelhas santificadas, como as ovelhas de Jerusalém em suas solenidades, assim também as cidades desertas serão cheias de rebanhos de pessoas; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Como las ovejas santas, como las ovejas de Jerusalem en sus solemnidades, así las ciudades desiertas serán llenas de rebaños de hombres; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.ASV: The hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me out in the Spirit of Jehovah, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mão do SENHOR veio sobre mim, e me tirou por meio do Espírito do SENHOR, e me pôs no meio de um vale que estava cheio de ossos.
verses.RVR09: Y LA mano de Jehová fué sobre mí, y sacóme en espíritu de Jehová, y púsome en medio de un campo que estaba lleno de huesos.

verses.KJV: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.WEB: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
verses.ASV: And he caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me fez passar perto deles ao redor; e eis que havia muitos sobre a face do vale, e eis que estavam sequíssimos.
verses.RVR09: E hízome pasar cerca de ellos por todo alrededor: y he aquí que eran muy muchos sobre la haz del campo, y por cierto secos en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, thou knowest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntou-me: Filho do homem, por acaso viverão estes ossos? E eu respondi: Senhor DEUS, tu [o] sabes.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: Hijo del hombre, ¿vivirán estos huesos? Y dije: Señor Jehová, tú lo sabes.

verses.KJV: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: Again he said unto me, Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse-me: Profetiza sobre estes ossos, e dize-lhes: Ossos secos, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Díjome entonces: Profetiza sobre estos huesos, y diles: Huesos secos, oid palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a estes ossos: Eis que eu farei entrar espírito em vós, e vivereis.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová á estos huesos: He aquí, yo hago entrar espíritu en vosotros, y viviréis.

verses.KJV: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
verses.ASV: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei nervos sobre vós, farei subir carne sobre vós, cobrirei de pele sobre vós, porei espírito em vós, e vivereis; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré nervios sobre vosotros, y haré subir sobre vosotros carne, y os cubriré de piel, y pondré en vosotros espíritu, y viviréis; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.WEB: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.ASV: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and, behold, an earthquake; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então profetizei como havia me sido mandado; e houve um ruído enquanto eu profetizava, e eis [que se fez] um tremor, e os ossos se aproximaram, cada osso a seu osso.
verses.RVR09: Profeticé pues, como me fué mandado; y hubo un ruido mientras yo profetizaba, y he aquí un temblor, y los huesos se llegaron cada hueso á su hueso.

verses.KJV: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
verses.WEB: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.ASV: And I beheld, and, lo, there were sinews upon them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhei, e eis que [havia] nervos sobre eles, e a carne subiu, e a pele cobriu por cima deles; porém não havia espírito neles.
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y he aquí nervios sobre ellos, y la carne subió, y la piel cubrió por encima de ellos: mas no había en ellos espíritu.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.WEB: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
verses.ASV: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me disse: Profetiza ao espírito, profetiza, ó filho do homem, e dize ao espírito: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vem dos quatro ventos, ó espírito, e sopra sobre estes mortos, para que vivam.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: Profetiza al espíritu, profetiza, hijo del hombre, y di al espíritu: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Espíritu, ven de los cuatro vientos, y sopla sobre estos muertos, y vivirán.

verses.KJV: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.WEB: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.ASV: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.ALMEIDA: E profetizei como havia me sido mandado; então o espírito entrou neles, e viveram, e se puseram de pé, um exército extremamente grande.
