verses.ASV: And he brought me back unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward (for the forefront of the house was toward the east); and the waters came down from under, from the right side of the house, on the south of the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto ele me fez voltar à entrada da casa; e eis que águas saíam de debaixo do umbral da casa para o oriente, pois a fachada da casa estava para o oriente; e as águas desciam de debaixo, desde o lado direito da casa, do lado sul do altar.
verses.RVR09: HÍZOME tornar luego á la entrada de la casa; y he aquí aguas que salían de debajo del umbral de la casa hacia el oriente: porque la fachada de la casa estaba al oriente: y las aguas descendían de debajo, hacia el lado derecho de la casa, al mediodía del altar.

verses.KJV: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.WEB: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.
verses.ASV: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me round by the way without unto the outer gate, by the way of [the gate] that looketh toward the east; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me tirou [pelo] caminho da porta do norte, e me fez rodear pelo caminho de fora, até a porta externa, pelo caminho voltado ao oriente; e eis que águas corriam do lado direito.
verses.RVR09: Y sacóme por el camino de la puerta del norte, é hízome rodear por el camino fuera de la puerta, por de fuera al camino de la que mira al oriente: y he aquí las aguas que salían al lado derecho.

verses.KJV: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
verses.WEB: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
verses.ASV: When the man went forth eastward with the line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando aquele homem saiu para o oriente, tinha em sua mão um cordel de medir; ele mediu mil côvados, e me fez passar pelas águas, que [chegavam] aos tornozelos.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo el varón hacia el oriente, tenía un cordel en su mano; y midió mil codos, é hízome pasar por las aguas hasta los tobillos.

verses.KJV: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.WEB: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.
verses.ASV: Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through [the waters], waters that were to the loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mediu mil [côvados] , e me fez passar pelas águas, que [chegavam] aos joelhos. Mediu [mais] mil, e me fez passar pelas águas, que [chegavam] à cintura.
verses.RVR09: Y midió otros mil, é hízome pasar por las aguas hasta las rodillas. Midió luego otros mil, é hízome pasar por las aguas hasta los lomos.

verses.KJV: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.WEB: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.
verses.ASV: Afterward he measured a thousand; [and it was] a river that I could not pass through; for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed through.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mediu [mais] mil, e já era um rio que eu não podia passar, porque as águas eram tão profundas que o rio não se podia atravessar a pé, somente a nado.
verses.RVR09: Y midió otros mil, é iba ya el arroyo que yo no podía pasar: porque las aguas se habían alzado, y el arroyo no se podía pasar sino á nado.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen [this]? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me disse: “Viste [isto] , filho do homem?” Depois ele me levou e trouxe-me de volta à margem do rio.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: ¿Has visto, hijo del hombre? Después me llevó, é hízome tornar por la ribera del arroyo.

verses.KJV: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.WEB: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.ASV: Now when I had returned, behold, upon the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando voltei, eis que na margem do rio havia muitíssimas árvores, de um lado e do outro.
verses.RVR09: Y tornando yo, he aquí en la ribera del arroyo había árboles muy muchos de la una parte y de la otra.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.WEB: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
verses.ASV: Then said he unto me, These waters issue forth toward the eastern region, and shall go down into the Arabah; and they shall go toward the sea; into the sea [shall the waters go] which were made to issue forth; and the waters shall be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me disse: “Estas águas saem para a região do oriente, descem à planície, e entram no mar; e quando chegarem ao mar, tornarão saudáveis as águas.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: Estas aguas salen á la región del oriente, y descenderán á la llanura, y entrarán en la mar: y entradas en la mar, recibirán sanidad las aguas.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.WEB: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that every living creature which swarmeth, in every place whither the rivers come, shall live; and there shall be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters are come thither, and [the waters of the sea] shall be healed, and everything shall live whithersoever the river cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que toda alma vivente que se move por onde quer que estes rio passar, viverá; e haverá muitíssimos peixes por ali terem passado estas águas, e ficarão saudáveis; e tudo viverá por onde quer que este este rio passar.
verses.RVR09: Y será que toda alma viviente que nadare por donde quiera que entraren estos dos arroyos, vivirá: y habrá muy muchos peces por haber entrado allá estas aguas, y recibirán sanidad; y vivirá todo lo que entrare en este arroyo.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.WEB: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that fishers shall stand by it: from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim shall be a place for the spreading of nets; their fish shall be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será também que pescadores estarão junto a ele; desde En-Gedi até En-Eglaim haverá [lugares para] se estender redes; seus peixes serão segundo suas espécies, como os peixes do grande mar, em muitíssima quantidade.
verses.RVR09: Y será que junto á él estarán pescadores; y desde En-gadi hasta En-eglaim será tendedero de redes: en su clase será su pescado como el pescado de la gran mar, mucho en gran manera.

verses.KJV: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.WEB: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.
verses.ASV: But the miry places thereof, and the marshes thereof, shall not be healed; they shall be given up to salt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém seus charcos e seus pântanos não ficarão saudáveis; estarão salgados.
verses.RVR09: Sus charcos y sus lagunas no se sanarán; quedarán para salinas.

verses.KJV: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.WEB: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”
verses.ASV: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow every tree for food, whose leaf shall not wither, neither shall the fruit thereof fail: it shall bring forth new fruit every month, because the waters thereof issue out of the sanctuary; and the fruit thereof shall be for food, and the leaf thereof for healing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto do rio, em suas margens de um lado e do outro, crescerá toda árvore de comer; sua folha nunca cairá, nem seu fruto faltará; em [todos os] seus meses produzirá frutos, porque suas águas saem do santuário; e seu fruto servirá de alimento, e sua folha de remédio.”
verses.RVR09: Y junto al arroyo, en su ribera de una parte y de otra, crecerá todo árbol de comer: su hoja nunca caerá, ni faltará su fruto: á sus meses madurará, porque sus aguas salen del santuario: y su fruto será para comer, y su hoja para medicina.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This shall be the border, whereby ye shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph [shall have two] portions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: “Este é o limite em que tomareis a terra em herança segundo as doze tribos de Israel: José [terá] duas partes.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Este es el término en que partiréis la tierra en heredad entre las doce tribus de Israel: José dos partes.

verses.KJV: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.WEB: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.
verses.ASV: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I sware to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a herdareis igualmente, um como o outro; [terra] a qual jurei de mão levantada que daria aos vossos pais; portanto esta terra será a vossa herança.
verses.RVR09: Y la heredaréis así los unos como los otros: por ella alcé mi mano que la había de dar á vuestros padres: por tanto, esta tierra os caerá en heredad.

verses.KJV: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.WEB: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;
verses.ASV: And this shall be the border of the land: On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, unto the entrance of Zedad;
verses.ALMEIDA: E este será o limite da terra para o lado norte: desde o mar Grande, a caminho de Hetlom, e indo por Lebo-Hamate até Zedade;
verses.RVR09: Y este será el término de la tierra hacia la parte del norte; desde la gran mar, camino de Hethlon viniendo á Sedad;

verses.KJV: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.WEB: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
verses.ASV: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer-hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Berota, Sibraim (que está entre o limite de Damasco e o limite de Hamate); Hazer-Haticom, que está junto ao limite de Haurã.
verses.RVR09: Hamath, Berotha, Sibrahim, que está entre el término de Damasco y el término de Hamath; Haser-hatticon, que es el término de Hauran.

verses.KJV: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.WEB: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.ASV: And the border from the sea, shall be Hazar-enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o limite será do mar [até] Haser-Enom, ao limite de Damasco ao norte, e ao limite de Hamate; [este será] o lado norte.
verses.RVR09: Y será el término del norte desde la mar de Haser-enon al término de Damasco al norte, y al término de Hamath al lado del norte.

verses.KJV: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.WEB: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.
verses.ASV: And the east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the [north] border, unto the east sea shall ye measure. This is the east side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao lado do oriente, passando entre Haurã e Damasco, e entre Gileade e a terra de Israel, junto ao Jordão; medireis desde o limite até do mar do oriente; [este será] o lado do oriente.
verses.RVR09: Al lado del oriente, por medio de Hauran y de Damasco, y de Galaad, y de la tierra de Israel, al Jordán: esto mediréis de término hasta la mar del oriente.

verses.KJV: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.WEB: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.
verses.ASV: And the south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, to the brook [of Egypt], unto the great sea. This is the south side southward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao lado sul, ao sul, será desde Tamar até as águas de Meribá-Cades, indo ao longo do ribeiro até o grande mar; e [este será] o lado sul, ao sul.
verses.RVR09: Y al lado del mediodía, hacia el mediodía, desde Tamar hasta las aguas de las rencillas; desde Cades y el arroyo hasta la gran mar: y esto será el lado austral, al mediodía.

verses.KJV: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.WEB: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.ASV: And the west side shall be the great sea, from the [south] border as far as over against the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o lado do ocidente será o grande mar, desde o limite até Lebo-Hamate; este será o lado do ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Y al lado del occidente la gran mar será el término hasta en derecho para venir á Hamath: este será el lado del occidente.

verses.KJV: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Repartireis, pois, esta terra entre vós, segundo as tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Partiréis, pues, esta tierra entre vosotros por las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you and to the strangers that sojourn among you, who shall beget children among you; and they shall be unto you as the home-born among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que a sorteareis em herança para vós, e para os estrangeiros que peregrinam entre vós, que tiverem gerado filhos entre vós; e vos serão como nativos entre os filhos de Israel; repartirão herança convosco, entre as tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y será que echaréis sobre ella suertes por herencia para vosotros, y para los extranjeros que peregrinan entre vosotros, que entre vosotros han engendrado hijos: y los tendréis como naturales entre los hijos de Israel; echarán suertes con vosotros para heredarse entre las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que na tribo onde o estrangeiro peregrinar, ali [lhe] dareis sua herança”, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y será que en la tribu en que peregrinare el extranjero, allí le daréis su heredad, ha dicho el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
verses.WEB: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.
verses.ASV: Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east [and] west), Dan, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes das tribos: Desde o extremo norte, do lado do caminho de Hetlom, vindo para Hamate, Hazar-Enom, ao limite de Damasco, para o norte, ao lado de Hamate; sendo seus extremos do oriente e do ocidente: esta é a porção de Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y ESTOS son los nombres de las tribus: Desde la extremidad septentrional por la vía de Hethlon viniendo á Hamath, Haser-enon, al término de Damasco, al norte, al término de Hamath: tendrá Dan una parte, siendo sus extremidades al oriente y al occidente.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, Asher, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Dã, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Aser.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Dan, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Aser una parte.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, Naphtali, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Aser, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Aser, desde el lado oriental hasta la parte de la mar, Nephtalí, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, Manasseh, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Naftali, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Nephtalí, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Manasés, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, Ephraim, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Manassés, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Manasés, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Ephraim, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, Reuben, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Efraim, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Rúben.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Ephraim, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Rubén, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, Judah, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto ao limite de Rúben, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Rubén, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Judá, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the oblation which ye shall offer, five and twenty thousand [reeds] in breadth, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Judá, desde o lado do oriente até o lado do ocidente, será a oferta que reservareis, de vinte e cinco mil [canas] de largura, e de comprimento, como uma das [demais] partes, desde o lado do oriente até o lado do ocidente; e o santuário estará no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Judá, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, será la suerte que apartaréis de veinticinco mil cañas de anchura, y de longitud como cualquiera de las otras partes, es á saber, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar; y el santuario estará en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the Lord shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.WEB: “The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.
verses.ASV: The oblation that ye shall offer unto Jehovah shall be five and twenty thousand [reeds] in length, and ten thousand in breadth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A oferta que reservareis ao SENHOR será de vinte e cinco mil [canas] de comprimento e dez mil de largura.
verses.RVR09: La suerte que apartaréis para Jehová, será de longitud de veinticinco mil cañas, y de diez mil de ancho.

verses.KJV: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.
verses.ASV: And for these, even for the priests, shall be the holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand [in length], and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Jehovah shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali será a oferta santa dos sacerdotes, de vinte e cinco mil [canas] ao norte, dez mil de largura ao ocidente, dez mil de largura ao oriente, e de vinte e cinco mil de comprimento ao sul; e o santuário do SENHOR estará no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Y allí será la suerte santa de los sacerdotes, de veinticinco mil cañas al norte, y de diez mil de anchura al occidente, y de diez mil de ancho al oriente, y de veinticinco mil de longitud al mediodía: y el santuario de Jehová estará en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.WEB: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.ASV: [It shall be] for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, that have kept my charge, that went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será para os sacerdotes santificados dos filhos de Zadoque, que guardaram minha ordem, que não se desviaram quando os filhos de Israel se desviaram, como se desviaram os [outros] levitas.
verses.RVR09: Los sacerdotes santificados de los hijos de Sadoc, que guardaron mi observancia, que no erraron cuando erraron los hijos de Israel, como erraron los Levitas,

verses.KJV: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.WEB: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
verses.ASV: And it shall be unto them an oblation from the oblation of the land, a thing most holy, by the border of the Levites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles terão uma oferta da oferta da terra, a parte santíssima, junto ao limite dos levitas.
verses.RVR09: Ellos tendrán por suerte, apartada en la partición de la tierra, la parte santísima, junto al término de los Levitas.

verses.KJV: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.WEB: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.
verses.ASV: And answerable unto the border of the priests, the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Levitas terão na vizinhança do limite dos sacerdotes vinte e cinco mil [canas] de comprimento e de dez mil de largura; todo o comprimento será vinte e cinco mil, e a largura dez mil.
verses.RVR09: Y la de los Levitas, al lado del término de los sacerdotes, será de veinticinco mil cañas de longitud, y de diez mil de anchura: toda la longitud de veinticinco mil, y la anchura de diez mil.

verses.KJV: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first-fruits of the land be alienated; for it is holy unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não venderão disto, nem trocarão, nem transferirão as primícias da terra, pois é coisa consagrada ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No venderán de ello, ni permutarán, ni traspasarán las primicias de la tierra: porque es cosa consagrada á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.
verses.ASV: And the five thousand that are left in the breadth, in front of the five and twenty thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for suburbs; and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cinco mil [canas] de largura que restam das vinte e cinco mil, serão de uso comum para a cidade, para habitação e arredores; e a cidade estará no meio delas.
verses.RVR09: Y las cinco mil cañas de anchura que quedan de las veinticinco mil, serán profanas, para la ciudad, para habitación y para ejido; y la ciudad estará en medio.

verses.KJV: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.WEB: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.ASV: And these shall be the measures thereof: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas serão suas medidas: o lado norte quatro mil e quinhentas [canas] , o lado sul quatro mil e quinhentas, o lado do oriente quatro mil e quinhentas, e o lado do ocidente quatro mil e quinhentas.
verses.RVR09: Y estas serán sus medidas: á la parte del norte cuatro mil y quinientas cañas, y á la parte del mediodía cuatro mil y quinientas, y á la parte del oriente cuatro mil y quinientas, y á la parte del occidente cuatro mil y quinientas.

verses.KJV: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.WEB: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.
verses.ASV: And the city shall have suburbs: toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o arrebaldes da cidade serão ao norte de duzentas e cinquenta [canas] , ao sul de duzentas e cinquenta, ao oriente de duzentas e cinquenta, e ao ocidente de duzentas e cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Y el ejido de la ciudad será al norte de doscientas y cincuenta cañas, y al mediodía de doscientas y cincuenta, y al oriente de doscientas y cincuenta, y de doscientas y cincuenta al occidente.

verses.KJV: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.WEB: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.
verses.ASV: And the residue in the length, answerable unto the holy oblation, shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward; and it shall be answerable unto the holy oblation; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that labor in the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto ao que restar do comprimento, na vizinhança da oferta santa, será dez mil [canas] ao oriente e dez mil ao ocidente, que será vizinho à oferta santa; sua produção será alimento dos trabalhadores da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que quedare de longitud delante de la suerte santa, diez mil cañas al oriente y diez mil al occidente, que será lo que quedará de la suerte santa, será para sembrar para los que sirven á la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
verses.ASV: And they that labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os trabalhadores da cidade, de todas as tribos de Israel, trabalharão nela.
verses.RVR09: Y los que servirán á la ciudad, serán de todas las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.WEB: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.
verses.ASV: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda a oferta será de vinte e cinco mil [canas] por vinte e cinco mil, em quadrado; reservareis a oferta santa, com a propriedade da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Todo el apartado de veinticinco mil cañas por veinticinco mil en cuadro, apartaréis por suerte para el santuario, y para la posesión de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.
verses.ASV: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation and of the possession of the city; in front of the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward in front of the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, answerable unto the portions, it shall be for the prince: and the holy oblation and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que restar será para o príncipe, de um lado e do outro da oferta santa, e da propriedade da cidade, desde a distância de vinte e cinco mil [canas] da oferta, até o extremo oriente, e ao ocidente desde a distância de vinte e cinco mil [canas] da oferta até o extremo ocidente, na vizinhança das porções [das tribos] , será para o príncipe; e a oferta santa, e o santuário da casa será no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Y del príncipe será lo que quedare de la una parte y de la otra de la suerte santa, y de la posesión de la ciudad, es á saber, delante de las veinticinco mil cañas de la suerte hasta el término oriental, y al occidente delante de las veinticinco mil hasta el término occidental, delante de las partes dichas será del príncipe: y suerte santa será; y el santuario de la casa estará en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.WEB: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.ASV: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, it shall be for the prince.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde a propriedade dos Levitas, e desde a propriedade da cidade, [será] no meio daquilo que pertencerá ao príncipe. Entre o limite de Judá e o limite de Benjamim será para o príncipe.
verses.RVR09: Y desde la posesión de los Levitas, y desde la posesión de la ciudad, en medio estará lo que pertenecerá al príncipe. Entre el término de Judá y el término de Benjamín estará la suerte del príncipe.

verses.KJV: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
verses.WEB: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
verses.ASV: And as for the rest of the tribes: from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto às demais tribos: desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto á las demás tribus, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, tendrá Benjamín una parte.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Benjamim, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Simeão.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Benjamín, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Simeón, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Simeão, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Issacar.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Simeón, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Issachâr, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Issacar, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Zebulom.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Issachâr, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Zabulón, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad, one [portion].
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Zebulom, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Gade.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Zabulón, desde la parte del oriente hasta la parte de la mar, Gad, otra.

verses.KJV: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
verses.WEB: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.
verses.ASV: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the brook [of Egypt], unto the great sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E junto ao limite de Gade, ao sul, no lado sul, será o limite desde Tamar até as águas das inimizades de Cades, junto ao ribeiro, até o grande mar.
verses.RVR09: Y junto al término de Gad, á la parte del austro, al mediodía, será el término desde Tamar hasta las aguas de las rencillas, y desde Cades y el arroyo hasta la gran mar.

verses.KJV: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a terra que repartireis em herança às tribos de Israel, e estas são suas porções,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la tierra que partiréis por suertes en heredad á las tribus de Israel, y estas son sus porciones, ha dicho el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.WEB: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;
verses.ASV: And these are the egresses of the city: On the north side four thousand and five hundred [reeds] by measure;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as saídas da cidade: ao lado norte quatro mil e quinhentos [côvados] de medida.
verses.RVR09: Y estas son las salidas de la ciudad á la parte del norte, cuatro mil y quinientas cañas por medida.

verses.KJV: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
verses.WEB: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
verses.ASV: and the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as portas da cidade serão conforme os nomes das tribos de Israel; três portas ao norte: uma porta de Rúben, uma porta de Judá, [e] uma porta de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Y las puertas de la ciudad serán según los nombres de las tribus de Israel: tres puertas al norte: la puerta de Rubén, una; la puerta de Judá, otra; la puerta de Leví, otra.

verses.KJV: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.WEB: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.
verses.ASV: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred [reeds], and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao lado do oriente quatro mil e quinhentos [côvados] , e três portas: uma porta de José, uma porta de Benjamim, [e] uma porta de Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte del oriente cuatro mil y quinientas cañas, y tres puertas: la puerta de José, una; la puerta de Benjamín, otra; la puerta de Dan, otra.

verses.KJV: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.WEB: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
verses.ASV: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred [reeds] by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao lado sul quatro mil e quinhentos [côvados] de medida, e três portas: uma porta de Simeão, uma porta de Issacar, [e] uma porta de Zebulom.
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte del mediodía, cuatro mil y quinientas cañas por medida, y tres puertas: la puerta de Simeón, una; la puerta de Issachâr, otra; la puerta de Zabulón, otra.

verses.KJV: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.WEB: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
verses.ASV: At the west side four thousand and five hundred [reeds], with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao lado do ocidente quatro mil e quinhentos [côvados] ,[e] suas três portas: uma porta de Gade, uma porta de Aser, [e] uma porta de Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte del occidente cuatro mil y quinientas cañas, y sus tres puertas: la puerta de Gad, una; la puerta de Aser, otra; la puerta de Nephtalí, otra.

verses.KJV: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The Lord is there.
verses.WEB: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘The LORD is there.’
verses.ASV: It shall be eighteen thousand [reeds] round about: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Jehovah is there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao redor terá dezoito mil [côvados] . E o nome da cidade desde [aquele] dia será: O SENHOR Está Ali.
verses.RVR09: En derredor tendrá dieciocho mil cañas. Y el nombre de la ciudad desde aquel día será JEHOVÁ-SHAMMA.

verses.KJV: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
verses.WEB: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.ASV: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano terceiro do reinado de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, veio a Jerusalém, e a cercou.
verses.RVR09: EN el año tercero del reinado de Joacim rey de Judá, vino Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia á Jerusalem, y cercóla.

verses.KJV: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
verses.WEB: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
verses.ASV: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god: and he brought the vessels into the treasure-house of his god.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor entregou em suas mãos a Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e uma parte dos vasos da casa de Deus, e os trouxe à terra de Sinar, para a casa de seu deus; e pôs os vasos na casa do tesouro de seu deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el Señor entregó en sus manos á Joacim rey de Judá, y parte de los vasos de la casa de Dios, y trájolos á tierra de Sinar, á la casa de su dios: y metió los vasos en la casa del tesoro de su dios.

verses.KJV: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;
verses.WEB: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
verses.ASV: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in [certain] of the children of Israel, even of the seed royal and of the nobles;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse a Aspenaz, chefe de seus eunucos, que trouxesse [alguns] dos filhos de Israel, da família real, e dos príncipes,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey á Aspenaz, príncipe de sus eunucos, que trajese de los hijos de Israel, del linaje real de los príncipes,

verses.KJV: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
verses.WEB: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.
verses.ASV: youths in whom was no blemish, but well-favored, and skilful in all wisdom, and endued with knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rapazes em quem não houvesse defeito físico algum, de boa aparência, entendidos em toda sabedoria, sábios em conhecimento, de boa inteligência, e que tivessem habilidade em prestar assistência no palácio do rei; e que os ensinassem as letras e a língua dos caldeus.
verses.RVR09: Muchachos en quienes no hubiese tacha alguna, y de buen parecer, y enseñados en toda sabiduría, y sabios en ciencia, y de buen entendimiento, é idóneos para estar en el palacio del rey; y que les enseñase las letras y la lengua de los Caldeos.

verses.KJV: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king's meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
verses.WEB: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
verses.ASV: And the king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s dainties, and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years; that at the end thereof they should stand before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhes determinou uma porção diária de alimento, da comida do rei, e do vinho que bebia; e que [assim] fossem tratados por três anos, para que ao fim eles estivessem diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y señalóles el rey ración para cada día de la ración de la comida del rey, y del vino de su beber: que los criase tres años, para que al fin de ellos estuviesen delante del rey.

verses.KJV: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.WEB: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
verses.ASV: Now among these were, of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram entre eles, dos filhos de Judá, Daniel, Ananias, Misael e Azarias,
verses.RVR09: Y fueron entre ellos, de los hijos de Judá, Daniel, Ananías, Misael y Azarías:

verses.KJV: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
verses.WEB: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
verses.ASV: And the prince of the eunuchs gave names unto them: unto Daniel he gave [the name of] Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, [of] Shadrach; and to Mishael, [of] Meshach; and to Azariah, [of] Abed-nego.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais o chefe dos eunucos pôs [outros] nomes: a Daniel, Beltessazar; a Ananias, Sadraque; a Misael, Mesaque; e a Azarias, Abednego.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales el príncipe de los eunucos puso nombres: y puso á Daniel, Beltsasar; y á Ananías, Sadrach; y á Misael, Mesach; y á Azarías, Abed-nego.

verses.KJV: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.WEB: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.ASV: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s dainties, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Daniel propôs em seu coração de não se contaminar com a porção diária de alimento da comida do rei, nem no vinho que ele bebia; então pediu ao chefe dos eunucos para não se contaminar.
verses.RVR09: Y Daniel propuso en su corazón de no contaminarse en la ración de la comida del rey, ni en el vino de su beber: pidió por tanto al príncipe de los eunucos de no contaminarse.

verses.KJV: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.WEB: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.ASV: Now God made Daniel to find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois Deus concedeu a Daniel o agrado e o favor do chefe dos eunucos.)
verses.RVR09: (Y puso Dios á Daniel en gracia y en buena voluntad con el príncipe de los eunucos.)

verses.KJV: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
verses.WEB: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
verses.ASV: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your food and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths that are of your own age? so would ye endanger my head with the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o chefe dos eunucos a Daniel: Tenho medo de meu senhor o rei, que determinou vossa comida e vossa bebida; pois, e se ele perceber que vossos rostos estão com pior aparência que os dos rapazes que são semelhantes a vós? Assim poríeis minha cabeça em risco diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el príncipe de los eunucos á Daniel: Tengo temor de mi señor el rey, que señaló vuestra comida y vuestra bebida; pues luego que él habrá visto vuestros rostros más tristes que los de los muchachos que son semejantes á vosotros, condenaréis para con el rey mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.WEB: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.ASV: Then said Daniel to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Daniel a Melsar, a quem o chefe dos eunucos havia ordenado sobre Daniel, Ananias, Misael, e Azarias:
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Daniel á Melsar, que estaba puesto por el príncipe de los eunucos sobre Daniel, Ananías, Misael, y Azarías:

verses.KJV: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
verses.WEB: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.ASV: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze um teste, eu te peço, com teus servos por dez dias, e dê-nos legumes para comer, e água para beber.
verses.RVR09: Prueba, te ruego, tus siervos diez días, y dennos legumbres á comer, y agua á beber.

verses.KJV: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
verses.WEB: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”
verses.ASV: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the youths that eat of the king’s dainties; and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se vejam diante de ti nossos rostos, e os rostos dos rapazes que comem da porção de alimento da comida do rei; e faze com teus servos conforme o que vires.
verses.RVR09: Parezcan luego delante de ti nuestros rostros, y los rostros de los muchachos que comen de la ración de la comida del rey; y según que vieres, harás con tus siervos.

verses.KJV: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
verses.WEB: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
verses.ASV: So he hearkened unto them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele consentiu-lhes nisto, e fez teste com eles por dez dias.
verses.RVR09: Consintió pues con ellos en esto, y probó con ellos diez días.

verses.KJV: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
verses.WEB: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.
verses.ASV: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer, and they were fatter in flesh, than all the youths that did eat of the king’s dainties.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao fim dos dez dias foi visto que eles estavam com rostos de melhor aparência e mais bem nutridos que os outros rapazes que comiam da porção de alimento do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y al cabo de los diez días pareció el rostro de ellos mejor y más nutrido de carne, que los otros muchachos que comían de la ración de la comida del rey.

verses.KJV: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
verses.WEB: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.
verses.ASV: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they should drink, and gave them pulse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi assim que Melsar lhes tirou a porção de alimento deles, e o vinho que deviam beber, e continuou a lhes dar legumes.
verses.RVR09: Así fué que Melsar tomaba la ración de la comida de ellos, y el vino de su beber, y dábales legumbres.

verses.KJV: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.WEB: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.ASV: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a estes quatro rapazes, Deus lhes deu conhecimento e inteligência em todas as letras e sabedoria; Daniel, porém, teve entendimento em toda visão e sonhos.
verses.RVR09: Y á estos cuatro muchachos dióles Dios conocimiento é inteligencia en todas letras y ciencia: mas Daniel tuvo entendimiento en toda visión y sueños.

verses.KJV: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.WEB: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.ASV: And at the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando terminaram os dias dos quais o rei tinha dito que os trouxessem, o chefe dos eunucos os trouxe diante de Nabucodonosor.
verses.RVR09: Pasados pues los días al fin de los cuales había dicho el rey que los trajesen, el príncipe de los eunucos los trajo delante de Nabucodonosor.

verses.KJV: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
verses.WEB: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.
verses.ASV: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei falou com eles, e entre todos eles não foi achado [alguém] como Daniel, Ananias, Misael, e Azarias; e assim se tornaram assistentes diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey habló con ellos, y no fué hallado entre todos ellos otro como Daniel, Ananías, Misael, y Azarías: y así estuvieron delante del rey.

verses.KJV: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
verses.WEB: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.
verses.ASV: And in every matter of wisdom and understanding, concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters that were in all his realm.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em todo negócio de sabedoria [e] inteligência que o rei lhes demandou, achou-os dez vezes melhores que todos os magos e astrólogos que havia em todo o seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Y en todo negocio de sabiduría é inteligencia que el rey les demandó, hallólos diez veces mejores que todos los magos y astrólogos que había en todo su reino.

verses.KJV: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
verses.WEB: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.
verses.ASV: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Daniel esteve até o primeiro ano do rei Ciro.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Daniel hasta el año primero del rey Ciro.

verses.KJV: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
verses.WEB: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
verses.ASV: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no segundo ano do reinado de Nabucodonosor, sonhou Nabucodonosor sonhos, e seu espírito se perturbou, de modo que perdeu o sono.
verses.RVR09: Y EN el segundo año del reinado de Nabucodonosor, soñó Nabucodonosor sueños, y perturbóse su espíritu, y su sueño se huyó de él.

verses.KJV: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.WEB: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
verses.ASV: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the enchanters, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei mandou chamar magos, astrólogos, encantadores, e sábios dos caldeus, para que explicassem ao rei seus sonhos. Eles vieram, e se apresentaram diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó el rey llamar magos, astrólogos, y encantadores, y Caldeos, para que mostrasen al rey sus sueños. Vinieron pues, y se presentaron delante del rey.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
verses.WEB: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhes disse: Sonhei um sonho, e meu espírito está perturbado para saber o sonho.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey les dijo: He soñado un sueño, y mi espíritu se ha perturbado por saber del sueño.

verses.KJV: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
verses.WEB: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
verses.ASV: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in the Syrian language, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os caldeus falaram ao rei em língua aramaica: Ó rei, vive para sempre vive! Dize o sonho a teus servos, e mostraremos a interpretação.
verses.RVR09: Entonces hablaron los Caldeos al rey en lengua aramea: Rey, para siempre vive: di el sueño á tus siervos, y mostraremos la declaración.

verses.KJV: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.WEB: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.
verses.ASV: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye make not known unto me the dream and the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei respondeu aos caldeus, e disse: Minha decisão é firme: se não me mostrardes o sonho e sua interpretação, sereis despedaçados, e vossas casas se tornarão em monturos.
verses.RVR09: Respondió el rey y dijo á los Caldeos: El negocio se me fué: si no me mostráis el sueño y su declaración, seréis hechos cuartos, y vuestras casas serán puestas por muladares.

verses.KJV: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.WEB: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”
verses.ASV: But if ye show the dream and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honor: therefore show me the dream and the interpretation thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se mostrardes o sonho e sua interpretação, recebereis de mim presentes, recompensas e grande honra; portanto, mostrai-me o sonho e sua interpretação.
verses.RVR09: Y si mostrareis el sueño y su declaración, recibiréis de mí dones y mercedes y grande honra: por tanto, mostradme el sueño y su declaración.

verses.KJV: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
verses.WEB: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
verses.ASV: They answered the second time and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam pela segunda vez, e disseram: Diga o rei o sonho a seus servos, e mostraremos sua interpretação.
verses.RVR09: Respondieron la segunda vez, y dijeron: Diga el rey el sueño á sus siervos, y mostraremos su declaración.

verses.KJV: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
verses.WEB: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.
verses.ASV: The king answered and said, I know of a certainty that ye would gain time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei respondeu, e disse: Eu bem sei que vós quereis ganhar tempo; porque sabeis que minha decisão é firme.
verses.RVR09: El rey respondió, y dijo: Yo conozco ciertamente que vosotros ponéis dilaciones, porque veis que el negocio se me ha ido.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
verses.WEB: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”
verses.ASV: But if ye make not known unto me the dream, there is but one law for you; for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can show me the interpretation thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se não me mostrardes o sonho, haverá uma única sentença para vós. Pois preparastes uma resposta mentirosa e perversa para dizer diante de mim, até que o tempo se mude; portanto, dizei-me o sonho, para que eu tenha certeza de que podeis me mostrar sua interpretação.
verses.RVR09: Si no me mostráis el sueño, una sola sentencia será de vosotros. Ciertamente preparáis respuesta mentirosa y perversa que decir delante de mí, entre tanto que se muda el tiempo: por tanto, decidme el sueño, para que yo entienda que me podéis mostrar su declaración.

verses.KJV: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king's matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.WEB: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.
verses.ASV: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can show the king’s matter, forasmuch as no king, lord, or ruler, hath asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os caldeus responderam diante do rei, e disseram: Ninguém há sobre a terra que possa mostrar a palavra do rei; pois nenhum rei, príncipe, nem governante, jamais exigiu coisa semelhante a algum mago, astrólogo, ou caldeu.
verses.RVR09: Los Caldeos respondieron delante del rey, y dijeron: No hay hombre sobre la tierra que pueda declarar el negocio del rey: demás de esto, ningún rey, príncipe, ni señor, preguntó cosa semejante á ningún mago, ni astrólogo, ni Caldeo.

verses.KJV: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.WEB: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”
verses.ASV: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is no other that can show it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a coisa que o rei exige é tão difícil que não há quem a possa revelar diante do rei, a não ser os deuses, cuja morada não é entre a raça humana.
verses.RVR09: Finalmente, el negocio que el rey demanda, es singular, ni hay quien lo pueda declarar delante del rey, salvo los dioses cuya morada no es con la carne.

verses.KJV: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.WEB: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.
verses.ASV: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o rei se irou muito e se enfureceu; então mandou matar a todos os sábios da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Por esto el rey con ira y con grande enojo, mandó que matasen á todos los sabios de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
verses.WEB: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
verses.ASV: So the decree went forth, and the wise men were to be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E publicou-se o decreto, e os sábios foram condenados à morte; e buscaram a Daniel e a seus companheiros para serem mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y publicóse el mandamiento, y los sabios eran llevados á la muerte; y buscaron á Daniel y á sus compañeros para matarlos.

verses.KJV: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:
verses.WEB: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.
verses.ASV: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Daniel falou de forma cautelosa e prudente a Arioque, capitão dos da guarda do rei, que tinha saído para matar os sábios de Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Daniel habló avisada y prudentemente á Arioch, capitán de los de la guarda del rey, que había salido para matar los sabios de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.WEB: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.ASV: he answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Wherefore is the decree so urgent from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele respondeu e disse a Arioque, capitão do rei: Por que houve este mandamento do rei tão repentinamente? Então Arioque explicou o ocorrido a Daniel.
verses.RVR09: Habló y dijo á Arioch capitán del rey: ¿Qué es la causa que este mandamiento se publica de parte del rey tan apresuradamente? Entonces Arioch declaró el negocio á Daniel.

verses.KJV: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
verses.WEB: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
verses.ASV: And Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Daniel entrou, e pediu ao rei que lhe desse tempo para que ele mostrasse a interpretação ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Y Daniel entró, y pidió al rey que le diese tiempo, y que él mostraría al rey la declaración.

verses.KJV: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
verses.WEB: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
