verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Go again, love a woman beloved of [her] friend, and an adulteress, even as Jehovah loveth the children of Israel, though they turn unto other gods, and love cakes of raisins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: Vai, ama a mulher amada por [seu] companheiro, apesar de ser adúltera, assim como SENHOR ama os filhos de Israel, que dão atenção a outros deuses, e amam os bolos de uvas [dedicados aos ídolos] .
verses.RVR09: Y DÍJOME otra vez Jehová: Ve, ama una mujer amada de su compañero, aunque adúltera, como el amor de Jehová para con los hijos de Israel; los cuales miran á dioses ajenos, y aman frascos de vino.

verses.KJV: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.WEB: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
verses.ASV: So I bought her to me for fifteen [pieces] of silver, and a homer of barley, and a half-homer of barley;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu a comprei para mim por quinze peças de prata, e um ômer e meio de cevada;
verses.RVR09: Compréla entonces para mí por quince dineros de plata, y un homer y medio de cebada;

verses.KJV: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
verses.WEB: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”
verses.ASV: and I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be any man’s wife: so will I also be toward thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a ela: Tu viverás comigo por muitos dias; não te prostituirás, nem serás de outro homem; nem e eu [esperarei] por ti.
verses.RVR09: Y díjele: Tú estarás por mía muchos días: no fornicarás, ni tomarás otro varón; ni tampoco yo vendré á ti.

verses.KJV: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
verses.WEB: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
verses.ASV: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without pillar, and without ephod or teraphim:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os filhos de Israel viverão muitos dias sem rei e sem príncipe; sem sacrifício e sem estátua; sem éfode e sem ídolo.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos días estarán los hijos de Israel sin rey, y sin príncipe, y sin sacrificio, y sin estatua, y sin ephod, y sin teraphim.

verses.KJV: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.WEB: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
verses.ASV: afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek Jehovah their God, and David their king, and shall come with fear unto Jehovah and to his goodness in the latter days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois os filhos de Israel voltarão e buscarão ao SENHOR seu Deus, e a Davi seu rei; e temendo virão ao SENHOR e à sua bondade no fim dos dias.
verses.RVR09: Después volverán los hijos de Israel, y buscarán á Jehová su Dios, y á David su rey; y temerán á Jehová y á su bondad en el fin de los días.

verses.KJV: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.WEB: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.ASV: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye children of Israel; for Jehovah hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó filhos de Israel; porque o SENHOR briga com os moradores da terra; porque não há fidelidade, nem misericórdia, nem conhecimento de Deus na terra.
verses.RVR09: OID palabra de Jehová, hijos de Israel, porque Jehová pleitea con los moradores de la tierra; porque no hay verdad, ni misericordia, ni conocimiento de Dios en la tierra.

verses.KJV: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.WEB: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
verses.ASV: There is nought but swearing and breaking faith, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery; they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perjúrio, mentira, matança, roubo e adultério prevalecem; derramamentos de sangue se acumulam.
verses.RVR09: Perjurar, y mentir, y matar, y hurtar y adulterar prevalecieron, y sangres se tocaron con sangres.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.WEB: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso a terra lamentará, e qualquer um que morar nela desfalecerá, com os animais do campo e as aves do céu; e até os peixes do mar morrerão.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, se enlutará la tierra, y extenuaráse todo morador de ella, con las bestias del campo, y las aves del cielo: y aun los peces de la mar fallecerán.

verses.KJV: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.WEB: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
verses.ASV: Yet let no man strive, neither let any man reprove; for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ninguém brigue nem repreenda a alguém, porque teu povo é como os que brigam com o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente hombre no contienda ni reprenda á hombre, porque tu pueblo es como los que resisten al sacerdote.

verses.KJV: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.WEB: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt stumble in the day, and the prophet also shall stumble with thee in the night; and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso cairás de dia, e o profeta cairá contigo de noite; e destruirei tua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Caerás por tanto en el día, y caerá también contigo el profeta de noche; y á tu madre talaré.

verses.KJV: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.WEB: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
verses.ASV: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu povo é destruído por falta de conhecimento. Porque tu rejeitaste o conhecimento, eu também te rejeitei do meu sacerdócio; e visto que te esqueceste a lei de teu Deus, também eu me esquecerei de teus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Mi pueblo fué talado, porque le faltó sabiduría. Porque tú desechaste la sabiduría, yo te echaré del sacerdocio: y pues que olvidaste la ley de tu Dios, también yo me olvidaré de tus hijos.

verses.KJV: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.WEB: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
verses.ASV: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto mais eles se multiplicaram, mais pecaram contra mim; tornarei sua honra em vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á su grandeza así pecaron contra mí: trocaré su honra en afrenta.

verses.KJV: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.WEB: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.ASV: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Os sacerdotes] comem do pecado de meu povo, e desejam a maldade das pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Comen del pecado de mi pueblo, y en su maldad levantan su alma.

verses.KJV: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.WEB: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
verses.ASV: And it shall be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will requite them their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto tal como o povo, assim será com o sacerdote; e punirei contra ele seus caminhos, e lhe retribuirei conforme seus atos.
verses.RVR09: Tal será el pueblo como el sacerdote: y visitaré sobre él sus caminos, y pagaréle conforme á sus obras.

verses.KJV: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.
verses.WEB: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they shall eat, and not have enough; they shall play the harlot, and shall not increase; because they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comerão, mas não se fartarão; eles se prostituirão, mas não se multiplicarão, porque abandonaram ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y comerán, mas no se hartarán; fornicarán, mas no se aumentarán: porque dejaron de atender á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.WEB: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
verses.ASV: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para buscarem a prostituição, o vinho, e o mosto, que tiram o entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Fornicación, y vino, y mosto quitan el corazón.

verses.KJV: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.WEB: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
verses.ASV: My people ask counsel at their stock, and their staff declareth unto them; for the spirit of whoredom hath caused them to err, and they have played the harlot, [departing] from under their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu povo consulta a seu pedaço de madeira, e seu bastão lhes dá resposta, porque o espírito de prostituições o engana, para se prostituírem contra o Deus deles.
verses.RVR09: Mi pueblo á su madero pregunta, y su palo le responde: porque espíritu de fornicaciones lo engañó, y fornicaron debajo de sus dioses.

verses.KJV: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.WEB: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
verses.ASV: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters play the harlot, and your brides commit adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os topos dos montes sacrificam, e queimam incenso sobre os morros, debaixo de carvalhos, álamos, e olmeiros que tenham boa sombra; por isso vossas filhas se prostituem, e vossas noras cometem adultério.
verses.RVR09: Sobre las cabezas de los montes sacrificaron, é incensaron sobre los collados, debajo de encinas, y álamos, y olmos que tuviesen buena sombra: por tanto, vuestras hijas fornicarán, y adulterarán vuestras nueras.

verses.KJV: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.WEB: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
verses.ASV: I will not punish your daughters when they play the harlot, nor your brides when they commit adultery; for [the men] themselves go apart with harlots, and they sacrifice with the prostitutes; and the people that doth not understand shall be overthrown.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não punirei vossas filhas que se prostituem, nem vossas noras que cometem adultério; porque os próprios homens se juntam com as mulheres promíscuas, e fazem sacrifícios com as prostitutas de ritos idólatras; de fato, o povo sem entendimento se arruína.
verses.RVR09: No visitaré sobre vuestras hijas cuando fornicaren, ni sobre vuestras nueras cuando adulteraren: porque ellos ofrecen con las rameras, y con las malas mujeres sacrifican: por tanto, el pueblo sin entendimiento caerá.

verses.KJV: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The Lord liveth.
verses.WEB: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’
verses.ASV: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, As Jehovah liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu, Israel, queres te prostituir, [ao menos] não faças Judá culpado. Não venhais a Gilgal, nem subais a Bete-Áven; nem jureis: Vive o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Si fornicares tú, Israel, á lo menos no peque Judá: y no entréis en Gilgal, ni subáis á Beth-aven; ni juréis, Vive Jehová.

verses.KJV: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.WEB: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
verses.ASV: For Israel hath behaved himself stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer: now will Jehovah feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Israel se rebelou como bezerra teimosa; agora o SENHOR os apascentará como a um cordeiro num campo extenso.
verses.RVR09: Porque como becerra cerrera se apartó Israel: ¿apacentarálos ahora Jehová como á carneros en anchura?

verses.KJV: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.WEB: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
verses.ASV: Ephraim is joined to idols; let him alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim se associou a ídolos; deixa-o.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim es dado á ídolos; déjalo.

verses.KJV: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.WEB: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
verses.ASV: Their drink is become sour; they play the harlot continually; her rulers dearly love shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando sua bebida se acaba, eles se voltam à prostituição; seus líderes amam a vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Su bebida se corrompió; fornicaron pertinazmente: sus príncipes amaron las dádivas, afrenta de ellos.

verses.KJV: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.WEB: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
verses.ASV: The wind hath wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be put to shame because of their sacrifices.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um vento os atou em suas asas, e se envergonharão por causa de seus sacrifícios.
verses.RVR09: Atóla el viento en sus alas, y de sus sacrificios serán avergonzados.

verses.KJV: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.WEB: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
verses.ASV: Hear this, O ye priests, and hearken, O house of Israel, and give ear, O house of the king; for unto you pertaineth the judgment; for ye have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi isto, ó sacerdotes, prestai atenção, ó casa de Israel; escutai, ó casa do rei; porque contra vós é este julgamento; pois tendes sido um laço em Mispá, e uma rede estendida sobre Tabor.
verses.RVR09: SACERDOTES, oid esto, y estad atentos, casa de Israel; y casa del rey, escuchad: porque á vosotros es el juicio, pues habéis sido lazo en Mizpa, y red extendida sobre Tabor.

verses.KJV: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.WEB: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.
verses.ASV: And the revolters are gone deep in making slaughter; but I am a rebuker of them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os rebeldes têm se aprofundado na matança, mas eu repreenderei a todos eles.
verses.RVR09: Y haciendo víctimas han bajado hasta el profundo: por tanto yo seré la corrección de todos ellos.

verses.KJV: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
verses.WEB: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
verses.ASV: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me; for now, O Ephraim, thou hast played the harlot, Israel is defiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu conheço a Efraim, e Israel não está oculto para mim; pois agora, ó Efraim, te prostituis, [e] Israel está contaminado.
verses.RVR09: Yo conozco á Ephraim, é Israel no me es desconocido: porque ahora, oh Ephraim, has fornicado, y se ha contaminado Israel.

verses.KJV: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord.
verses.WEB: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.
verses.ASV: Their doings will not suffer them to turn unto their God; for the spirit of whoredom is within them, and they know not Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus atos não lhe permitem se converterem a seu Deus, porque o espírito de prostituições está no meio deles, e não conhecem ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No pondrán sus pensamientos en volverse á su Dios, porque espíritu de fornicación está en medio de ellos, y no conocen á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity: Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.WEB: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
verses.ASV: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore Israel and Ephraim shall stumble in their iniquity; Judah also shall stumble with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a soberba de Israel dará testemunho contra ele. Israel e Efraim cairão em sua maldade, e Judá cairá juntamente com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y la soberbia de Israel le desmentirá en su cara: é Israel y Ephraim tropezarán en su pecado: tropezará también Judá con ellos.

verses.KJV: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.WEB: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
verses.ASV: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Jehovah; but they shall not find him: he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com suas ovelhas e com suas vacas irão buscar o SENHOR, mas não o encontrarão; ele se retirou deles.
verses.RVR09: Con sus ovejas y con sus vacas andarán buscando á Jehová, y no le hallarán; apartóse de ellos.

verses.KJV: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.WEB: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
verses.ASV: They have dealt treacherously against Jehovah; for they have borne strange children: now shall the new moon devour them with their fields.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agiram traiçoeiramente contra o SENHOR, porque geraram filhos estrangeiros; agora a lua nova os consumirá com suas propriedades.
verses.RVR09: Contra Jehová prevaricaron, porque hijos extraños han engendrado: ahora los devorará un mes con sus heredades.

verses.KJV: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.WEB: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
verses.ASV: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: sound an alarm at Beth-aven; behind thee, O Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocai a corneta em Gibeá, a trombeta em Ramá; gritai em Bete-Áven; atrás de ti, ó Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Tocad bocina en Gabaa, trompeta en Ramá: sonad tambor en Beth-aven: tras ti, oh Benjamín.

verses.KJV: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.WEB: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
verses.ASV: Ephraim shall become a desolation in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim será desolado no dia do castigo; nas tribos de Israel eu fiz saber o que certamente [acontecerá] .
verses.RVR09: Ephraim será asolado el día del castigo: en las tribus de Israel hice conocer verdad.

verses.KJV: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.WEB: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
verses.ASV: The princes of Judah are like them that remove the landmark: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os príncipes de Judá são como os mudam os limites; derramarei como água meu furor sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Los príncipes de Judá fueron como los que traspasan mojones: derramaré sobre ellos como agua mi ira.

verses.KJV: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.WEB: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
verses.ASV: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; because he was content to walk after [man’s] command.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim é oprimido, e quebrantado no julgamento, porque quis seguir regras inúteis.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim es vejado, quebrantado en juicio, porque quiso andar en pos de mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.WEB: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
verses.ASV: Therefore am I unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu serei como traça a Efraim, e como podridão à casa de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Yo pues seré como polilla á Ephraim, y como carcoma á la casa de Judá.

verses.KJV: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.WEB: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
verses.ASV: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah [saw] his wound, then went Ephraim to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Efraim viu sua enfermidade, e Judá a sua ferida, então Efraim subiu à Assíria, e procurou o grande rei; porém ele não poderá vos sarar, nem curar vossa ferida.
verses.RVR09: Y verá Ephraim su enfermedad, y Judá su llaga: irá entonces Ephraim al Assur, y enviará al rey Jareb; mas él no os podrá sanar, ni os curará la llaga.

verses.KJV: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.WEB: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
verses.ASV: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will carry off, and there shall be none to deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu serei como leão a Efraim, e como leão jovem à casa de Judá; eu mesmo a despedaçarei, e irei embora; eu a levarei, e não haverá quem a livre.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo seré como león á Ephraim, y como cachorro de león á la casa de Judá: yo, yo arrebataré, y andaré; tomaré, y no habrá quien liberte.

verses.KJV: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.WEB: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
verses.ASV: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me earnestly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irei, [e] voltarei a meu lugar, até que se reconheçam culpados, e busquem minha face. Em sua angústia, eles me buscarão ansiosamente.
verses.RVR09: Andaré, y tornaré á mi lugar hasta que conozcan su pecado, y busquen mi rostro. En su angustia madrugarán á mí.

verses.KJV: Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.WEB: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
verses.ASV: Come, and let us return unto Jehovah; for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, e voltemo-nos ao SENHOR; porque ele despedaçou, mas nos curará; ele feriu, mas nos porá curativo.
verses.RVR09: VENID y volvámonos á Jehová: que él arrebató, y nos curará; hirió, y nos vendará.

verses.KJV: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.WEB: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
verses.ASV: After two days will he revive us: on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de dois dias ele nos dará vida; ao terceiro dia nos ressuscitará, e diante dele viveremos.
verses.RVR09: Darános vida después de dos días: al tercer día nos resucitará, y viviremos delante de él.

verses.KJV: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.WEB: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
verses.ASV: And let us know, let us follow on to know Jehovah: his going forth is sure as the morning; and he will come unto us as the rain, as the latter rain that watereth the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conheçamos, e prossigamos em conhecer ao SENHOR; sua vinda está preparada como o nascer do sol; ele virá a nós como a chuva, como a chuva da primavera, que rega a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y conoceremos, y proseguiremos en conocer á Jehová: como el alba está aparejada su salida, y vendrá á nosotros como la lluvia, como la lluvia tardía y temprana á la tierra.

verses.KJV: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.WEB: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
verses.ASV: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the dew that goeth early away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que farei a ti, ó Efraim? Que farei a ti, ó Judá? Vossa bondade é como a neblina da manhã, como o orvalho da madrugada, que logo desaparece.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué haré á ti, Ephraim? ¿Qué haré á ti, oh Judá? La piedad vuestra es como la nube de la mañana, y como el rocío que de madrugada viene.

verses.KJV: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
verses.WEB: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
verses.ASV: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are [as] the light that goeth forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu os cortei com os profetas; pelas palavras de minha boca os matei; e teus juízos sairão como a luz.
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa corté con los profetas, con las palabras de mi boca los maté; y tus juicios serán como luz que sale.

verses.KJV: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.WEB: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.ASV: For I desire goodness, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu quero misericórdia, e não sacrifício; e conhecimento de Deus mais do que holocaustos.
verses.RVR09: Porque misericordia quise, y no sacrificio; y conocimiento de Dios más que holocaustos.

verses.KJV: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.WEB: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.
verses.ASV: But they like Adam have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles, assim como Adão, transgrediram o pacto; ali agiram traiçoeiramente contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos, cual Adam, traspasaron el pacto: allí prevaricaron contra mí.

verses.KJV: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.WEB: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
verses.ASV: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gileade é a cidade dos que praticam a injustiça; manchada está de sangue.
verses.RVR09: Galaad, ciudad de obradores de iniquidad, ensuciada de sangre.

verses.KJV: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.WEB: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
verses.ASV: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way toward Shechem; yea, they have committed lewdness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como um bando de assaltantes à espera de um homem, assim é o grupo de sacerdotes; matam no caminho para Siquém; eles praticam abominações.
verses.RVR09: Y como ladrones que esperan á algún hombre, así junta de sacerdotes mancomunadamente mata en el camino: porque ponen en efecto la abominación.

verses.KJV: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.WEB: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
verses.ASV: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: there whoredom is [found] in Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na casa de Israel tenho visto coisa detestável; ali Efraim se prostitui, Israel se contamina.
verses.RVR09: En la casa de Israel he visto suciedad: allí fornicó Ephraim, se contaminó Israel:

verses.KJV: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.WEB: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
verses.ASV: Also, O Judah, there is a harvest appointed for thee, when I bring back the captivity of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também para ti, ó Judá, há uma ceifa, quando eu restaurar o meu povo de seu infortúnio.
verses.RVR09: También Judá puso en ti una planta, habiendo yo vuelto la cautividad de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.WEB: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
verses.ASV: When I would heal Israel, then is the iniquity of Ephraim uncovered, and the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief entereth in, and the troop of robbers ravageth without.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu esteja [disposto] a curar Israel, expostas estão a perversidade de Efraim e as maldades de Samaria, porque praticam a falsidade; o ladrão vem, e o bando de assaltantes despoja do lado de fora.
verses.RVR09: ESTANDO yo curando á Israel, descubrióse la iniquidad de Ephraim, y las maldades de Samaria; porque obraron engaño: y viene el ladrón, y el salteador despoja de fuera.

verses.KJV: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.WEB: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
verses.ASV: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now have their own doings beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nem percebem em seus corações eu me lembro de toda a maldade deles; agora seus atos os cercam; diante de mim estão.
verses.RVR09: Y no dicen en su corazón que tengo en la memoria toda su maldad: ahora los rodearán sus obras; delante de mí están.

verses.KJV: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.WEB: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.ASV: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com sua maldade alegram ao rei, e com suas mentiras aos príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Con su maldad alegran al rey, y á los príncipes con sus mentiras.

verses.KJV: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.WEB: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
verses.ASV: They are all adulterers; they are as an oven heated by the baker; he ceaseth to stir [the fire], from the kneading of the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles cometem adultério; semelhantes são ao forno aceso pelo padeiro, que deixa de atiçar depois da massa estar feita, até que esteja levedada.
verses.RVR09: Todos ellos adúlteros; son como horno encendido por el hornero, el cual cesará de avivar después que esté hecha la masa, hasta que esté leuda.

verses.KJV: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.WEB: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
verses.ASV: On the day of our king the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand with scoffers.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia do nosso rei, os príncipes ficam doentes pelo calor do vinho; ele estende sua mão com os zombadores.
verses.RVR09: El día de nuestro rey los príncipes lo hicieron enfermar con vasos de vino: extendió su mano con los escarnecedores.

verses.KJV: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.WEB: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
verses.ASV: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque preparam seus corações para suas ciladas como a um forno; toda a noite seu padeiro dorme, pela manhã arde como fogo flamejante.
verses.RVR09: Porque aplicaron su corazón, semejante á un horno, á sus artificios: toda la noche duerme su hornero; á la mañana está encendido como llama de fuego.

verses.KJV: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.WEB: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
verses.ASV: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles se aquecem como um forno, e devoraram os seus juízes; todos os seus reis caem; ninguém há entre eles que clame a mim.
verses.RVR09: Todos ellos arden como un horno, y devoraron á sus jueces: cayeron todos sus reyes: no hay entre ellos quien á mí clame.

verses.KJV: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.WEB: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
verses.ASV: Ephraim, he mixeth himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim se mistura com os povos; Efraim é um bolo que não foi virado.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim se envolvió con los pueblos; Ephraim fué torta no vuelta.

verses.KJV: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.WEB: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
verses.ASV: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth [it] not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, and he knoweth [it] not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estrangeiros devoram sua riqueza, sem que ele perceba; e até o cabelo grisalho se espalha por ele, e ele não percebeu.
verses.RVR09: Comieron extraños su sustancia, y él no lo supo; y aun vejez se ha esparcido por él, y él no lo entendió.

verses.KJV: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.WEB: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.
verses.ASV: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: yet they have not returned unto Jehovah their God, nor sought him, for all this.
verses.ALMEIDA: A soberba de Israel dá testemunho contra ele, porém não se convertem ao SENHOR seu Deus, nem o buscam, apesar de tudo isto.
verses.RVR09: Y la soberbia de Israel testificará contra él en su cara: y no se tornaron á Jehová su Dios, ni lo buscaron con todo esto.

verses.KJV: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.WEB: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
verses.ASV: And Ephraim is like a silly dove, without understanding: they call unto Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Efraim como pomba imprudente, sem inteligência; chamam ao Egito, vão à Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Ephraim como paloma incauta, sin entendimiento: llamarán á Egipto, acudirán al Asirio.

verses.KJV: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.WEB: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
verses.ASV: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the birds of the heavens; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando forem, estenderei minha rede sobre eles; eu os farei cair como as aves do céu. Eu os castigarei conforme o que se tem ouvido quando eles se reúnem.
verses.RVR09: Cuando fueren, extenderé sobre ellos mi red, hacerlos he caer como aves del cielo; castigarélos conforme á lo que se ha oído en sus congregaciones.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.WEB: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.ASV: Woe unto them! for they have wandered from me; destruction unto them! for they have trespassed against me: though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai deles, porque se afastaram de mim; destruição sobre eles, porque se rebelaram contra mim; eu os livraria, porém falam mentiras contra mim.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ellos! porque se apartaron de mí: destrucción sobre ellos, porque contra mí se rebelaron; yo los redimí, y ellos hablaron contra mí mentiras.

verses.KJV: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.WEB: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
verses.ASV: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, but they howl upon their beds: they assemble themselves for grain and new wine; they rebel against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não clamam a mim com seus corações quando gemem sobre suas camas; eles se reúnem para o trigo e o vinho, [porém] de mim se afastam.
verses.RVR09: Y no clamaron á mí con su corazón cuando aullaron sobre sus camas, para el trigo y el mosto se congregaron, rebeláronse contra mí.

verses.KJV: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.WEB: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
verses.ASV: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet do they devise mischief against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os treinei, [e] fortalecei seus braços, porém pensam o mal contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Y yo los ceñí, esforcé sus brazos, y contra mí pensaron mal.

verses.KJV: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: They return, but not to [him that is] on high; they are like a deceitful bow; their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se voltam, [mas] não para o Altíssimo. Eles são como um arco defeituoso; seus príncipes caem à espada por causa da insolência de suas línguas; por isso serão escarnecidos na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Tornáronse, mas no al Altísimo: fueron como arco engañoso: cayeron sus príncipes á cuchillo por la soberbia de su lengua: éste será su escarnio en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.WEB: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
verses.ASV: [Set] the trumpet to thy mouth. As an eagle [he cometh] against the house of Jehovah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Põe] a trombeta em tua boca. [O inimigo vem] como uma águia contra a casa do SENHOR, porque violaram meu pacto, e transgrediram minha lei.
verses.RVR09: PON á tu boca trompeta. Vendrá como águila contra la casa de Jehová, porque traspasaron mi pacto, y se rebelaron contra mi ley.

verses.KJV: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
verses.WEB: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’
verses.ASV: They shall cry unto me, My God, we Israel know thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] clamarão a mim: Deus meu, nós, Israel, te conhecemos.
verses.RVR09: A mí clamará Israel: Dios mío, te hemos conocido.

verses.KJV: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.WEB: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
verses.ASV: Israel hath cast off that which is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Israel rejeitou o bem; o inimigo o perseguirá.
verses.RVR09: Israel desamparó el bien: enemigo lo perseguirá.

verses.KJV: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.WEB: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.ASV: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles fizeram reis, mas não de mim; constituíram príncipes, porém sem que eu soubesse; de sua prata e de seu ouro fizeram ídolos para si, para que sejam exterminados.
verses.RVR09: Ellos hicieron reyes, mas no por mí; constituyeron príncipes, mas yo no lo supe: de su plata y de su oro hicieron ídolos para sí, para ser talados.

verses.KJV: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.WEB: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
verses.ASV: He hath cast off thy calf, O Samaria; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.ALMEIDA: O teu bezerro foi rejeitado, ó Samaria; minha ira está acesa contra eles; até quando não suportarão a pureza?
verses.RVR09: Tu becerro, oh Samaria, te hizo alejar; encendióse mi enojo contra ellos, hasta que no pudieron alcanzar inocencia.

verses.KJV: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.WEB: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.ASV: For from Israel is even this; the workman made it, and it is no God; yea, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque isso procede de Israel, um artífice o fez; isso não é Deus; por isso o bezerro de Samaria será desfeito em pedaços.
verses.RVR09: Porque de Israel es, y artífice lo hizo; que no es Dios: por lo que en pedazos será deshecho el becerro de Samaria.

verses.KJV: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk; the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.WEB: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
verses.ASV: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: he hath no standing grain; the blade shall yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque semearam vento, colherão tempestade; não haverá colheita, nem a produção dará farinha; mesmo se a der, estrangeiros a tragarão.
verses.RVR09: Porque sembraron viento, y torbellino segarán: no tendrán mies, ni el fruto hará harina; si la hiciere, extraños la tragarán.

verses.KJV: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
verses.WEB: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
verses.ASV: Israel is swallowed up: now are they among the nations as a vessel wherein none delighteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Israel é tragado; agora são como um vaso que ninguém dá valor entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Será tragado Israel: presto serán entre las gentes como vaso en que no hay contentamiento.

verses.KJV: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.WEB: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
verses.ASV: For they are gone up to Assyria, [like] a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles subiram à Assíria, [como] um jumento selvagem solitário; Efraim se vendeu aos amantes.
verses.RVR09: Porque ellos subieron á Assur, asno montés para sí solo: Ephraim con salario alquiló amantes.

verses.KJV: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.WEB: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
verses.ASV: Yea, though they hire among the nations, now will I gather them; and they begin to be diminished by reason of the burden of the king of princes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que tenham se vendido às nações, agora eu as ajuntarei; e começarão a ser reduzidos pela opressão do rei de príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Aunque alquilen á las gentes, ahora las juntaré; y serán un poco afligidos por la carga del rey y de los príncipes.

verses.KJV: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.WEB: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
verses.ASV: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars for sinning, altars have been unto him for sinning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Efraim multiplicou os altares para pecar, os altares feitos para cometer pecado.
verses.RVR09: Porque multiplicó Ephraim altares para pecar, tuvo altares para pecar.

verses.KJV: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.WEB: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
verses.ASV: I wrote for him the ten thousand things of my law; but they are counted as a strange thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu lhe escrevi as grandezas de minha lei, mas foram consideradas coisa estranha.
verses.RVR09: Escribíle las grandezas de mi ley, y fueron tenidas por cosas ajenas.

verses.KJV: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the Lord accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.WEB: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
verses.ASV: As for the sacrifices of mine offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; but Jehovah accepteth them not: now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins; they shall return to Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos sacrifícios de ofertas a mim, eles sacrificam a carne, e a comem; porém o SENHOR não os aceita. Agora ele se lembrará de sua perversidade, e punirá seus pecados; eles voltarão ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: En los sacrificios de mis dones sacrificaron carne, y comieron: no los quiso Jehová: ahora se acordará de su iniquidad, y visitará su pecado; ellos se tornarán á Egipto.

verses.KJV: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.WEB: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
verses.ASV: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and builded palaces; and Judah hath multiplied fortified cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the castles thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Israel se esqueceu de seu Criador, e edificou templos; Judá multiplicou cidades fortificadas; porém mandarei fogo em suas cidades, que consumirá seus palácios.
verses.RVR09: Olvidó pues Israel á su Hacedor, y edificó templos, y Judá multiplicó ciudades fuertes: mas yo meteré fuego en sus ciudades, el cual devorará sus palacios.

verses.KJV: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.WEB: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
verses.ASV: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, like the peoples; for thou hast played the harlot, [departing] from thy God; thou hast loved hire upon every grain-floor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te alegres tanto, ó Israel, como os [outros] povos, pois tu te prostituis, afastando-te de teu Deus; tu amas o salário de prostituta em todas as eiras de trigo.
verses.RVR09: NO te alegres, oh Israel, hasta saltar de gozo como los pueblos, pues has fornicado apartándote de tu Dios: amaste salario por todas las eras de trigo.

verses.KJV: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.WEB: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
verses.ASV: The threshing-floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail her.
verses.ALMEIDA: A eira e a prensa de uvas não os manterão; e o vinho novo lhes faltará.
verses.RVR09: La era y el lagar no los mantendrán; les fallará el mosto.

verses.KJV: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.WEB: They won’t dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.ASV: They shall not dwell in Jehovah’s land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não permanecerão na terra do SENHOR; em vez disso, Efraim voltará ao Egito, e na Assíria comerão coisa imunda.
verses.RVR09: No quedarán en la tierra de Jehová, sino que volverá Ephraim á Egipto, y á Asiria, donde comerán vianda inmunda.

verses.KJV: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: They won’t pour out wine offerings to the LORD, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: They shall not pour out wine-[offerings] to Jehovah, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted; for their bread shall be for their appetite; it shall not come into the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não derramarão ofertas de bebida ao SENHOR, nem seus sacrifícios lhe serão agradáveis; [seu pão] será para eles como pão de lamento; todos os que comerem dele, serão imundos; porque o pão deles será para saciar sua própria fome, e não virá para a casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No derramarán vino á Jehová, ni él tomará contento en sus sacrificios; como pan de enlutados les serán á ellos: todos los que comieren de él, serán inmundos. Será pues el pan de ellos para sí mismos; no entrará en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the Lord?
verses.WEB: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.ASV: What will ye do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que fareis no dia solene, no dia festa do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué haréis el día de la solemnidad, y el día de la fiesta de Jehová?

verses.KJV: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.WEB: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
verses.ASV: For, lo, they are gone away from destruction; [yet] Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them; their pleasant things of silver, nettles shall possess them; thorns shall be in their tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que eles vão embora por causa da destruição; o Egito os recolherá, Mênfis os sepultará; urtigas herdarão sua prata, espinhos [crescerão] em suas tendas.
verses.RVR09: Porque, he aquí se fueron ellos á causa de la destrucción: Egipto los recogerá, Memphis los enterrará: espino poseerá por heredad lo deseable de su plata, ortiga crecerá en sus moradas.

verses.KJV: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.WEB: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
verses.ASV: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompense are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the man that hath the spirit is mad, for the abundance of thine iniquity, and because the enmity is great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegaram os dias da punição, chegaram os dias da retribuição; os israelitas saberão; o profeta é [considerado] louco, o homem espiritual [é visto como] tolo, por causa da grandeza de tua maldade e do grande ódio.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron los días de la visitación, vinieron los días de la paga; conocerálo Israel: necio el profeta, insensato el varón de espíritu, á causa de la multitud de tu maldad, y grande odio.

verses.KJV: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
verses.WEB: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
verses.ASV: Ephraim [was] a watchman with my God: as for the prophet, a fowler’s snare is in all his ways, [and] enmity in the house of his God.
verses.ALMEIDA: O profeta é um guarda de Efraim para meu Deus; [mas para ele há] laços de caçador em todos os seus caminhos, e ódio na casa de seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Atalaya es Ephraim para con mi Dios: el profeta es lazo de cazador en todos sus caminos, odio en la casa de su Dios.

verses.KJV: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.WEB: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
verses.ASV: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Corromperam-se profundamente, como nos dias de Gibeá: [Deus] se lembrará de suas perversidades, seus pecados punirá.
verses.RVR09: Llegaron al profundo, corrompiéronse, como en los días de Gabaa: ahora se acordará de su iniquidad; visitará su pecado.

verses.KJV: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.WEB: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
verses.ASV: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the first-ripe in the fig-tree at its first season: but they came to Baal-peor, and consecrated themselves unto the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu achei a Israel como uvas no deserto; eu vi a vossos pais como a primeira fruta da figueira em seu princípio. [Porém] eles foram a Baal-Peor, dedicaram-se a esta vergonha, e se tornaram tão abomináveis quanto aquilo que amaram.
verses.RVR09: Como uvas en el desierto hallé á Israel: como la fruta temprana de la higuera en su principio vi á vuestros padres. Ellos entraron á Baal-peor, y se apartaron para vergüenza, é hiciéronse abominables como aquello que amaron.

verses.KJV: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.WEB: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
verses.ASV: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird: there shall be no birth, and none with child, and no conception.
verses.ALMEIDA: A glória de Efraim voará como ave; não haverá nascimento, nem gravidez, nem concepção.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim, cual ave volará su gloria desde el nacimiento, aun desde el vientre y desde la concepción.

verses.KJV: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.WEB: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.ASV: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, so that not a man shall be left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que venham a criar seus filhos, contudo eu os privarei deles, de modo que reste nenhum. Ai deles quando deles eu me afastar!
verses.RVR09: Y si llegaren á grandes sus hijos, quitarélos de entre los hombres, porque ¡ay de ellos también, cuando de ellos me apartare!

verses.KJV: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.WEB: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
verses.ASV: Ephraim, like as I have seen Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring out his children to the slayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi que Efraim era como Tiro, plantada num lugar agradável; mas Efraim trará seus filhos ao matador.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim, según veo, es semejante á Tiro, asentada en lugar delicioso: mas Ephraim sacará sus hijos al matador.

verses.KJV: Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.WEB: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.ASV: Give them, O Jehovah—what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-lhes, SENHOR, o que lhes darás? Dá-lhes ventre que aborte, e seios sem leite.
verses.RVR09: Dales, oh Jehová, lo que les has de dar: dales matriz expeliente, y enjutos pechos.

verses.KJV: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.WEB: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
verses.ASV: All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them: because of the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house; I will love them no more; all their princes are revolters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de toda a sua malícia em Gilgal, ali eu os odiei; por causa da malícia de suas obras eu os expulsarei de minha casa; eu não mais os amarei; todos os seus príncipes são rebeldes.
verses.RVR09: Toda la maldad de ellos fué en Gilgal; allí, pues, les tomé aversión: por la malicia de sus obras echarélos de mi casa; no los amaré más; todos sus príncipes son desleales.

verses.KJV: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.WEB: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
verses.ASV: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim foi ferido, sua raiz se secou, não darão fruto; e que ainda que gerem, eu matarei os desejáveis [frutos] de seu ventre.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim fué herido, secóse su cepa, no hará más fruto: aunque engendren, yo mataré lo deseable de su vientre.

verses.KJV: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.WEB: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.ASV: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu Deus os rejeitará porque não o ouviram; e andarão sem rumo entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Mi Dios los desechará, porque ellos no le oyeron; y andarán errantes entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.WEB: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
verses.ASV: Israel is a luxuriant vine, that putteth forth his fruit: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied his altars; according to the goodness of their land they have made goodly pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Israel era uma vinha fértil, que dava frutos para si mesma; quanto mais se multiplicavam seus frutos, mais multiplicou altares, quanto mais a sua terra prosperava, mais adornaram suas colunas pagãs.
verses.RVR09: ES Israel una frondosa viña, haciendo fruto para sí: conforme á la multiplicación de su fruto multiplicó altares, conforme á la bondad de su tierra aumentaron sus estatuas.

verses.KJV: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.WEB: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
verses.ASV: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will smite their altars, he will destroy their pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração deles está dividido, agora serão culpados; ele quebrará seus altares e destruirá suas colunas pagãs.
verses.RVR09: Dividióse su corazón. Ahora serán hallados culpables: él quebrantará sus altares, asolará sus estatuas.

verses.KJV: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the Lord; what then should a king do to us?
verses.WEB: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear the LORD; and the king, what can he do for us?”
verses.ASV: Surely now shall they say, We have no king; for we fear not Jehovah; and the king, what can he do for us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dirão agora: Não temos rei porque não tivemos temor ao SENHOR; mas o que um rei faria por nós?
verses.RVR09: Porque dirán ahora: No tenemos rey, porque no temimos á Jehová: ¿y qué haría el rey por nosotros?

verses.KJV: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.WEB: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
verses.ASV: They speak [vain] words, swearing falsely in making covenants: therefore judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falaram palavras jurando falsamente ao fazerem pactos; por isso que a disputa judicial brota como erva venenosa nos sulcos dos campos.
verses.RVR09: Han hablado palabras jurando en vano al hacer alianza: por tanto, el juicio florecerá como ajenjo en los surcos del campo.

verses.KJV: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.WEB: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
verses.ASV: The inhabitants of Samaria shall be in terror for the calves of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced over it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os moradores de Samaria estarão atemorizados por causa do bezerro Bete-Áven; pois seu povo por causa dele lamentará, e seus sacerdotes, que nele se alegravam, [lamentarão] por sua glória, que se foi dele.
verses.RVR09: Por las becerras de Beth-aven serán atemorizados los moradores de Samaria: porque su pueblo lamentará á causa del becerro, y sus sacerdotes que en él se regocijaban por su gloria, la cual será disipada.

verses.KJV: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.WEB: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.ASV: It also shall be carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, ele será levado à Assíria como presente ao grande rei; Efraim receberá vergonha, Israel será envergonhado por causa de seu conselho.
verses.RVR09: Y aun será él llevado á Asiria en presente al rey Jareb: Ephraim será avergonzado, é Israel será confuso de su consejo.

verses.KJV: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.WEB: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
verses.ASV: [As for] Samaria, her king is cut off, as foam upon the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei de Samaria será eliminado como um graveto sobre a superfície das águas.
verses.RVR09: De Samaria fué cortado su rey como la espuma sobre la superficie de las aguas.

verses.KJV: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.WEB: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
verses.ASV: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os altos cultuais de Áven, o pecado de Israel, serão destruídos; espinhos e cardos crescerão sobre seus altares. E dirão aos montes: Cobri-nos; e aos morros: Caí sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Y los altares de Avén serán destruídos, el pecado de Israel; crecerá sobre sus altares espino y cardo. Y dirán á los montes: Cubridnos; y á los collados: Caed sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.WEB: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
verses.ASV: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood; the battle against the children of iniquity doth not overtake them in Gibeah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde os dias de Gibeá tu tens cometido pecado, ó Israel; ali continuaram; por acaso a guerra em Gibeá não alcançou os filhos da perversidade?
verses.RVR09: Desde los días de Gabaa has pecado, oh Israel: allí estuvieron: no los tomó la batalla en Gabaa contra los inicuos.

verses.KJV: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.WEB: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.
verses.ASV: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the peoples shall be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu quiser, eu os castigarei; e povos se reunirão contra eles, para que sejam presos por causa de sua dupla transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Y los castigaré como deseo: y pueblos se juntarán sobre ellos cuando serán atados en sus dos surcos.

verses.KJV: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.WEB: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.
verses.ASV: And Ephraim is a heifer that is taught, that loveth to tread out [the grain]; but I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will set a rider on Ephraim; Judah shall plow, Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim é uma bezerra domada, que amava trilhar; mas eu porei [um jugo] sobre seu belo pescoço; farei com que Efraim seja montado; Judá lavrará, Jacó fará sulcos na terra.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim es becerra domada, amadora del trillar; mas yo pasaré sobre su lozana cerviz: yo haré llevar yugo á Ephraim; arará Judá, quebrará sus terrones Jacob.

verses.KJV: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.WEB: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
verses.ASV: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness; break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semeai para vós justiça, colhei para vós bondade; lavrai para vós lavoura; porque é o tempo de buscar ao SENHOR, até que ele venha, e faça chover justiça sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Sembrad para vosotros en justicia, segad para vosotros en misericordia; arad para vosotros barbecho: porque es el tiempo de buscar á Jehová, hasta que venga y os enseñe justicia.

verses.KJV: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.WEB: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
verses.ASV: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavrastes maldade, colhestes perversidade; comestes o fruto de mentira; porque confiaste em teu caminho, na multidão de teus guerreiros.
verses.RVR09: Habéis arado impiedad, segasteis iniquidad: comeréis fruto de mentira: porque confiaste en tu camino, en la multitud de tus fuertes.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.WEB: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
