verses.ASV: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto entre teu povo se levantará tumulto, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão destruídas, assim como Salmã destruiu a Bete-Arbel no dia da batalha; ali a mãe foram despedaçada com [seus] filhos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, en tus pueblos se levantará alboroto, y todas tus fortalezas serán destruídas, como destruyó Salmán á Beth-arbel el día de la batalla: la madre fué arrojada sobre los hijos.

verses.KJV: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.WEB: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
verses.ASV: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: at daybreak shall the king of Israel be utterly cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Betel fará convosco, por causa de vossa grande malícia; ao amanhecer o rei de Israel será exterminado.
verses.RVR09: Así hará á vosotros Beth-el por la maldad de vuestra maldad: en la mañana será del todo cortado el rey de Israel.

verses.KJV: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.ASV: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Israel era menino, eu o amei, e do Egito chamei a meu filho.
verses.RVR09: CUANDO Israel era muchacho, yo lo amé, y de Egipto llamé á mi hijo.

verses.KJV: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.WEB: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
verses.ASV: The more [the prophets] called them, the more they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto mais os chamavam, mais eles se afastavam de sua presença; sacrificavam aos Baalins, e ofereciam incenso às imagens de escultura.
verses.RVR09: Como los llamaban, así ellos se iban de su presencia; á los Baales sacrificaban, y á las esculturas ofrecían sahumerios.

verses.KJV: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.WEB: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
verses.ASV: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, todavia, ensinei Efraim a andar, tomando-os pelos seus braços; porém não reconheceram que eu os curava.
verses.RVR09: Yo con todo eso guiaba en pies al mismo Ephraim, tomándolos de sus brazos; y no conocieron que yo los cuidaba.

verses.KJV: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.WEB: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
verses.ASV: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as they that lift up the yoke on their jaws; and I laid food before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com cordas humanas eu os puxei, com cordas de amor; e fui para eles como os que levantam o jugo de sobre suas cabeças, e lhes dei alimento.
verses.RVR09: Con cuerdas humanas los traje, con cuerdas de amor: y fuí para ellos como los que alzan el yugo de sobre sus mejillas, y llegué hacia él la comida.

verses.KJV: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, and the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.WEB: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
verses.ASV: They shall not return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian shall be their king, because they refused to return [to me].
verses.ALMEIDA: [Israel] não voltará à terra do Egito, mas o assírio será seu rei, porque recusam se converter.
verses.RVR09: No tornará á tierra de Egipto, antes el mismo Assur será su rey, porque no se quisieron convertir.

verses.KJV: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.WEB: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
verses.ASV: And the sword shall fall upon their cities, and shall consume their bars, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a espada moverá sobre suas cidades; destruirá os ferrolhos de seus portões, e acabará com seus planos.
verses.RVR09: Y caerá espada sobre sus ciudades, y consumirá sus aldeas; consumirálas á causa de sus consejos.

verses.KJV: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
verses.WEB: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
verses.ASV: And my people are bent on backsliding from me: though they call them to [him that is] on high, none at all will exalt [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meu povo insiste em se desviar de mim; ainda que chamem ao Altíssimo, ninguém de fato o exalta.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto, está mi pueblo adherido á la rebelión contra mí: aunque lo llaman al Altísimo, ninguno absolutamente quiere ensalzarle.

verses.KJV: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.WEB: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
verses.ASV: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? [how] shall I cast thee off, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboiim? my heart is turned within me, my compassions are kindled together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como posso te abandonar, ó Efraim? Como posso te entregar, ó Israel? Como posso fazer de ti como Admá, [ou] te tornar como a Zeboim? Meu coração se comove dentro de mim, todas as minhas compaixões estão acesas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo tengo de dejarte, oh Ehpraim? ¿he de entregarte yo, Israel? ¿cómo podré yo hacerte como Adma, ni ponerte como á Zeboim? Mi corazón se revuelve dentro de mí, inflámanse todas mis conmiseraciones.

verses.KJV: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.WEB: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
verses.ASV: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee; and I will not come in wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não executarei o furor de minha ira, não voltarei a destruir Efraim; porque eu sou Deus, e não homem, o Santo no meio de ti; e não entrarei na cidade.
verses.RVR09: No ejecutaré el furor de mi ira, no volveré para destruir á Ephraim: porque Dios soy, y no hombre; el Santo en medio de ti: y no entraré en la ciudad.

verses.KJV: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.WEB: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
verses.ASV: They shall walk after Jehovah, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children shall come trembling from the west.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao SENHOR seguirão; ele rugirá como leão; quando ele rugir os filhos virão tremendo desde o ocidente.
verses.RVR09: En pos de Jehová caminarán: él bramará como león: cual león rugirá él de cierto, y los hijos se moverán azorados del occidente.

verses.KJV: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will make them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tremendo virão do Egito como um pássaro, e da terra da Assíria como uma pomba; e eu os farei habitar em suas casas, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Como ave se moverán velozmente de Egipto, y de la tierra de Asiria como paloma; y pondrélos en sus casas, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
verses.WEB: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
verses.ASV: Ephraim compasseth me about with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the Holy One.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim me cercou com mentira, e a casa de Israel com engano; mas Judá ainda andava com Deus, e era é fiel ao Santo.

verses.KJV: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.WEB: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.ASV: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he continually multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim se alimenta de vento, e persegue o vento oriental o dia todo; multiplica a mentira e a destruição; e fazem aliança com a Assíria, e azeite se leva ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: CERCÓME Ephraim con mentira, y la casa de Israel con engaño: mas Judá aun domina con Dios, y es fiel con los santos.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.WEB: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR também tem uma briga judicial com Judá, e punirá Jacó conforme seus caminhos; ele lhe retribuirá conforme seus atos.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim se apacienta del viento, y sigue al solano: mentira y destrucción aumenta continuamente; porque hicieron alianza con los Asirios, y aceite se lleva á Egipto.

verses.KJV: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
verses.WEB: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
verses.ASV: In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he had power with God:
verses.ALMEIDA: No ventre [da mãe] pegou pelo calcanhar de seu irmão, e em sua força lutou com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pleito tiene Jehová con Judá para visitar á Jacob conforme á sus caminos: pagarále conforme á sus obras.

verses.KJV: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
verses.WEB: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—
verses.ASV: yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him at Beth-el, and there he spake with us,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lutou com o anjo, e prevaleceu; chorou, e lhe suplicou; [em] Betel o achou, e ali falou conosco.
verses.RVR09: En el vientre tomó por el calcañar á su hermano, y con su fortaleza venció al ángel.

verses.KJV: Even the Lord God of hosts; the Lord is his memorial.
verses.WEB: even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!
verses.ASV: even Jehovah, the God of hosts; Jehovah is his memorial [name].
verses.ALMEIDA: O próprio SENHOR, Deus dos exércitos; o SENHOR é seu memorial.
verses.RVR09: Venció al ángel, y prevaleció; lloró, y rogóle: en Beth-el le halló, y allí habló con nosotros.

verses.KJV: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment and wait on thy God continually.
verses.WEB: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
verses.ASV: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep kindness and justice, and wait for thy God continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu pois, converte-te a teu Deus; guarda tu a misericórdia e a justiça, e espera em teu Deus continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová es Dios de los ejércitos: Jehová es su memorial.

verses.KJV: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.WEB: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
verses.ASV: [He is] a trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mercador tem balança enganosa em sua mão, pois ama oprimir.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, conviértete á tu Dios: guarda misericordia y juicio, y en tu Dios espera siempre.

verses.KJV: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.WEB: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”
verses.ASV: And Ephraim said, Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth: in all my labors they shall find in me no iniquity that were sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Efraim diz: Certamente eu sou rico; tenho obtido para mim muitos bens; [em] todo o meu trabalho ninguém pode achar em mim perversidade que seja pecado.
verses.RVR09: Es mercader que tiene en su mano peso falso, amador de opresión.

verses.KJV: And I that am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.WEB: “But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.ASV: But I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, desde a terra do Egito; eu ainda te farei morar em tendas, como nos dias solenes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Ephraim: Ciertamente yo he enriquecido, hallado he riquezas para mí: nadie hallará en mí iniquidad, ni pecado en todos mis trabajos.

verses.KJV: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.WEB: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
verses.ASV: I have also spoken unto the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falei aos profetas, e eu multipliquei a visão profética; e por meio dos profetas propus parábolas.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo soy Jehová tu Dios desde la tierra de Egipto: aun te haré morar en tiendas, como en los días de la fiesta.

verses.KJV: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.WEB: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.
verses.ASV: Is Gilead iniquity? they are altogether false; in Gilgal they sacrifice bullocks; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que Gileade é injusta, certamente [seus moradores] são inúteis. Em Gilgal sacrificam bois, e até seus altares são como amontoados [de pedras] nos sulcos dos campos.
verses.RVR09: Y hablado he á los profetas, y yo aumenté la profecía, y por mano de los profetas puse semejanzas.

verses.KJV: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.WEB: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
verses.ASV: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jacó fugiu à terra de Arã, e Israel serviu em troca de uma mulher, e por uma mulher apascentou [ovelhas] .
verses.RVR09: ¿Es Galaad iniquidad? Ciertamente vanidad han sido: en Gilgal sacrificaron bueyes: y aun son sus altares como montones en los surcos del campo.

verses.KJV: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.WEB: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
verses.ASV: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR por um profeta fez subir a Israel do Egito, e por um profeta foi preservado.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jacob huyó á tierra de Aram, y sirvió Israel por mujer, y por mujer fué pastor.

verses.KJV: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.WEB: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
verses.ASV: Ephraim hath provoked to anger most bitterly: therefore shall his blood be left upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] Efraim o ofendeu amargamente; por isso deixará [a culpa de] seus sangues sobre ele, e seu Senhor lhe retribuirá sua desonra.
verses.RVR09: Y por profeta hizo subir Jehová á Israel de Egipto, y por profeta fué guardado. Enojado ha Ephraim á Dios con amarguras; por tanto, sus sangres se derramarán sobre él, y su Señor le pagará su oprobio.

verses.KJV: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.WEB: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
verses.ASV: When Ephraim spake, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Efraim falava, havia tremor; ele era exaltado em Israel; mas se tornou culpado por causa de Baal, e morreu.
verses.RVR09: CUANDO Ephraim hablaba, hubo temor; fué ensalzado en Israel; mas pecó en Baal, y murió.

verses.KJV: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.WEB: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’
verses.ASV: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pecam cada vez mais, e de sua prata fizeram para si uma imagem de fundição, ídolos segundo seu entendimento, todos eles obra de artesãos; acerca dos quais dizem: As pessoas que sacrificam beijam bezerros!
verses.RVR09: Y ahora añadieron á su pecado, y de su plata se han hecho según su entendimiento, estatuas de fundición, ídolos, toda obra de artífices; acerca de los cuales dicen á los hombres que sacrifican, que besen los becerros.

verses.KJV: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.WEB: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.ASV: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the dew that passeth early away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing-floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso serão como a névoa da manhã, como o orvalho da madrugada que passa; como a palha que o vento leva da eira, e como a fumaça que sai da chaminé.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto serán como la niebla de la mañana, y como el rocío de la madrugada que se pasa; como el tamo que la tempestad arroja de la era, y como el humo que de la chimenea sale.

verses.KJV: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
verses.WEB: “Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.
verses.ASV: Yet I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; and thou shalt know no god but me, and besides me there is no saviour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, desde a terra do Egito; portanto não conhecerás a Deus algum a não ser a mim, porque não há Salvador além de mim.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo soy Jehová tu Dios desde la tierra de Egipto: no conocerás pues Dios fuera de mí, ni otro Salvador sino á mí.

verses.KJV: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.WEB: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.ASV: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te conheci no deserto, na terra seca.
verses.RVR09: Yo te conocí en el desierto, en tierra seca.

verses.KJV: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.WEB: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.
verses.ASV: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted: therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois se fartaram em seus pastos; quando ficaram fartos, seus corações se exaltaram; por isso se esqueceram de mim.
verses.RVR09: En sus pastos se hartaron, hartáronse, y ensoberbecióse su corazón: por esta causa se olvidaron de mí.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
verses.WEB: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
verses.ASV: Therefore am I unto them as a lion; as a leopard will I watch by the way;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu serei para eles como leão; como leopardo os espiarei no caminho.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, yo seré para ellos como león; como un leopardo en el camino los espiaré.

verses.KJV: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.WEB: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.
verses.ASV: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart; and there will I devour them like a lioness; the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como ursa de quem tomaram os filhotes os encontrarei, e rasgareis os peitorais de seu coração; e ali os devorarei como leão; os animais do campo os despedaçarão.
verses.RVR09: Como oso que ha perdido los hijos los encontraré, y romperé las telas de su corazón, y allí los devoraré como león: bestia del campo los despedazará.

verses.KJV: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
verses.WEB: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
verses.ASV: It is thy destruction, O Israel, that [thou art] against me, against thy help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estás perdido, ó Israel, porque é em mim que está tua ajuda.
verses.RVR09: Te perdiste, oh Israel, mas en mí está tu ayuda.

verses.KJV: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.WEB: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
verses.ASV: Where now is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges, of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está agora o teu rei, para que te proteja em todas as tuas cidades? E teus juízes, dos quais disseste: Dá-me um rei e príncipes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde está tu rey, para que te guarde con todas tus ciudades? ¿y tus jueces, de los cuales dijiste: Dame rey y príncipes?

verses.KJV: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
verses.WEB: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
verses.ASV: I have given thee a king in mine anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te dei um rei em minha ira, e [o] tirei em meu furor.
verses.RVR09: Díte rey en mi furor, y quitélo en mi ira.

verses.KJV: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
verses.WEB: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.
verses.ASV: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid up in store.
verses.ALMEIDA: A maldade de Efraim está registrada; seu pecado está guardado.
verses.RVR09: Atada está la maldad de Ephraim; su pecado está guardado.

verses.KJV: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.WEB: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.
verses.ASV: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for it is time he should not tarry in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dores de parto lhe virão; ele é um filho insensato, pois não deveria permanecer dentro na hora do parto.
verses.RVR09: Dolores de mujer de parto le vendrán: es un hijo ignorante, que de otra manera no estuviera tanto tiempo en el rompimiento de los hijos.

verses.KJV: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.WEB: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.
verses.ASV: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from death: O death, where are thy plagues? O Sheol, where is thy destruction? repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os resgatarei do poder do Xeol e os livrarei da morte. Onde estão, Ó morte, tuas pestilências? Onde está, ó Xeol, tua perdição? A compaixão será escondida de meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: De la mano del sepulcro los redimiré, librarélos de la muerte. Oh muerte, yo seré tu muerte; y seré tu destrucción, oh sepulcro; arrepentimiento será escondido de mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.WEB: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of the LORD coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.
verses.ASV: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the breath of Jehovah coming up from the wilderness; and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall make spoil of the treasure of all goodly vessels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que ele frutifique entre os irmãos, virá o vento oriental, vento do SENHOR, subindo do deserto, e sua fonte se secará, sua nascente se secará; ele saqueará o tesouro de tudo o que for precioso.
verses.RVR09: Aunque él fructificará entre los hermanos, vendrá el solano, viento de Jehová, subiendo de la parte del desierto, y secarse ha su vena, y secaráse su manadero: él saqueará el tesoro de todas las preciosas alhajas.

verses.KJV: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.WEB: Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”
verses.ASV: Samaria shall bear her guilt; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword; their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Samaria levará sua culpa, porque se rebelou contra o seu Deus. Cairão a espada; suas crianças serão despedaçadas, e suas grávidas terão seus ventres abertos.
verses.RVR09: Samaria será asolada, porque se rebeló contra su Dios: caerán á cuchillo: sus niños serán estrellados, y sus preñadas serán abiertas.

verses.KJV: O israel, return unto the Lord thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.WEB: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
verses.ASV: O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Converte-te, ó Israel, ao SENHOR teu Deus; pois caíste por tua maldade.
verses.RVR09: CONVIÉRTETE, oh Israel, á Jehová tu Dios: porque por tu pecado has caído.

verses.KJV: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.WEB: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.
verses.ASV: Take with you words, and return unto Jehovah: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and accept that which is good: so will we render [as] bullocks [the offering of] our lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai convosco palavras, e convertei-vos ao SENHOR; dizei-lhe: Tira toda a maldade, e aceita o que é bom; então ofereceremos nossos lábios como bezerros.
verses.RVR09: Tomad con vosotros palabras, y convertíos á Jehová, y decidle: Quita toda iniquidad, y acepta el bien, y daremos becerros de nuestros labios.

verses.KJV: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.WEB: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
verses.ASV: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, [Ye are] our gods; for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os assírios não nos salvarão; não cavalgaremos sobre cavalos, e nunca mais chamaremos à obra de nossas mãos de nossos deuses; porque em ti o órfão alcançará misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: No nos librará Assur; no subiremos sobre caballos, ni nunca más diremos á la obra de nuestras manos: Dioses nuestros: porque en ti el huérfano alcanzará misericordia.

verses.KJV: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.WEB: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
verses.ASV: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu curarei sua rebelião, eu os amarei voluntariamente, porque minha ira terá se afastado deles.
verses.RVR09: Yo medicinaré su rebelión, amarélos de voluntad: porque mi furor se apartó de ellos.

verses.KJV: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.WEB: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
verses.ASV: I will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu serei a Israel como o orvalho; ele florescerá como lírio, e estenderá suas raízes como o [cedro do] Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Yo seré á Israel como rocío; él florecerá como lirio, y extenderá sus raíces como el Líbano.

verses.KJV: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.WEB: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.ASV: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus ramos se estenderão; sua beleza como a da oliveira, e sua fragrância como o [cedro do] Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Extenderse han sus ramos, y será su gloria como la de la oliva, y olerá como el Líbano.

verses.KJV: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.WEB: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.ASV: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive [as] the grain, and blossom as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltarão, e habitarão abaixo de sua sombra: serão vivificados [como] o trigo, e florescerão como a videira; sua fama será como o vinho do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Volverán, y se sentarán bajo de su sombra: serán vivificados como trigo, y florecerán como la vid: su olor, como de vino del Líbano.

verses.KJV: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.WEB: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
verses.ASV: Ephraim [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols? I have answered, and will regard him: I am like a green fir-tree; from me is thy fruit found.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Efraim, o que mais eu tenho a ver com os ídolos? Eu o responderei, e dele cuidarei; serei a ele como a faia verde; de mim vem o teu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim dirá: ¿Qué más tendré ya con los ídolos? Yo lo oiré, y miraré; yo seré á él como la haya verde: de mí será hallado tu fruto.

verses.KJV: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.WEB: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
verses.ASV: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? prudent, that he may know them? for the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é sábio entenda estas coisas, e o prudente as reconheça; porque os caminhos do SENHOR são retos, e os justos andarão neles; mas os transgressores neles cairão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es sabio para que entienda esto, y prudente para que lo sepa? Porque los caminos de Jehová son derechos, y los justos andarán por ellos: mas los rebeldes en ellos caerán.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra do SENHOR que veio a Joel, filho de Petuel.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA de Jehová que fué á Joel hijo de Pethuel.

verses.KJV: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.WEB: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
verses.ASV: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi isto, anciãos, e escutai, todos os moradores desta terra. Por acaso isto aconteceu em vossos dias, ou nos dias dos vossos pais?
verses.RVR09: Oid esto, viejos, y escuchad, todos los moradores de la tierra. ¿Ha acontecido esto en vuestros días, ó en los días de vuestros padres?

verses.KJV: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
verses.WEB: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
verses.ASV: Tell ye your children of it, and [let] your children [tell] their children, and their children another generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contai disso aos vossos filhos, e vossos filhos aos seus filhos, e seus filhos à outra geração.
verses.RVR09: De esto contaréis á vuestros hijos, y vuestros hijos á sus hijos, y sus hijos á la otra generación.

verses.KJV: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
verses.WEB: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
verses.ASV: That which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the canker-worm eaten; and that which the canker-worm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que restou do gafanhoto cortador o gafanhoto comedor comeu; e o que restou do gafanhoto comedor o gafanhoto devorador comeu, e o que restou do gafanhoto devorador o gafanhoto destruidor comeu.
verses.RVR09: Lo que quedó de la oruga comió la langosta, y lo que quedó de la langosta comió el pulgón; y el revoltón comió lo que del pulgón había quedado.

verses.KJV: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.WEB: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.ASV: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and wail, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Despertai, vós bêbados, e chorai; gemei todos vós que bebeis vinho, por causa do suco de uva, porque foi tirado de vossa boca.
verses.RVR09: Despertad, borrachos, y llorad; aullad todos los que bebéis vino, á causa del mosto, porque os es quitado de vuestra boca.

verses.KJV: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.WEB: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
verses.ASV: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number; his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the jaw-teeth of a lioness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque uma nação subiu sobre minha terra, poderosa e sem número; seus dentes são dentes de leão, e têm presas de leoa.
verses.RVR09: Porque gente subió á mi tierra, fuerte y sin número; sus dientes, dientes de león, y sus muelas, de león.

verses.KJV: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.WEB: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.
verses.ASV: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig-tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assolou minha videira, e devastou minha figueira; desnudou-a por completo e a derrubou; seus ramos ficaram brancos.
verses.RVR09: Asoló mi vid, y descortezó mi higuera: del todo la desnudó y derribó: sus ramas quedaron blancas.

verses.KJV: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.WEB: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!
verses.ASV: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chora tu como a virgem vestida de saco por causa do marido de sua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Llora tú como moza vestida de saco por el marido de su juventud.

verses.KJV: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's ministers, mourn.
verses.WEB: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.
verses.ASV: The meal-offering and the drink-offering are cut off from the house of Jehovah; the priests, Jehovah’s ministers, mourn.
verses.ALMEIDA: As ofertas de cereais e de bebidas se acabaram da casa do SENHOR; os sacerdotes, servos do SENHOR, estão de luto.
verses.RVR09: Pereció el presente y la libación de la casa de Jehová: los sacerdotes ministros de Jehová hicieron luto.

verses.KJV: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.WEB: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
verses.ASV: The field is laid waste, the land mourneth; for the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O campo foi assolado, a terra está de luto; porque o trigo foi destruído, o suco de uva se secou, o azeite está em falta.
verses.RVR09: El campo fué destruído, enlutóse la tierra; porque el trigo fué destruído, se secó el mosto, perdióse el aceite.

verses.KJV: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.WEB: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
verses.ASV: Be confounded, O ye husbandmen, wail, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonhai-vos, trabalhadores; gemei, plantadores de vinhas, pelo trigo e pela a cevada; porque a colheita do campo pereceu.
verses.RVR09: Confundíos, labradores, aullad, viñeros, por el trigo y la cebada; porque se perdió la mies del campo.

verses.KJV: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.WEB: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.
verses.ASV: The vine is withered, and the fig-tree languisheth; the pomegranate-tree, the palm-tree also, and the apple-tree, even all the trees of the field are withered: for joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vide se secou, a figueira definhou, assim como a romeira, a palmeira, e a macieira; todas as árvores do campo se secaram; por isso a alegria se secou entre os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Secóse la vid, y pereció la higuera, el granado también, la palma, y el manzano; secáronse todos los árboles del campo; por lo cual se secó el gozo de los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
verses.WEB: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
verses.ASV: Gird yourselves [with sackcloth], and lament, ye priests; wail, ye ministers of the altar; come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meal-offering and the drink-offering are withholden from the house of your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cingi-vos e lamentai, sacerdotes; gemei, ministros do altar; vinde e deitai em sacos, trabalhadores de meu Deus; porque as ofertas de alimentos e de bebidas foram tiradas da casa de vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ceñíos y lamentad, sacerdotes; aullad, ministros del altar; venid, dormid en sacos, ministros de mi Dios: porque quitado es de la casa de vuestro Dios el presente y la libación.

verses.KJV: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the Lord your God, and cry unto the Lord,
verses.WEB: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the old men [and] all the inhabitants of the land unto the house of Jehovah your God, and cry unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Santificai um jejum; convocai uma reunião solene; congregai os anciãos e todos os moradores desta terra na casa do SENHOR vosso Deus, e clamai ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Pregonad ayuno, llamad á congregación; congregad los ancianos y todos los moradores de la tierra en la casa de Jehová vuestro Dios, y clamad á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.WEB: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.ASV: Alas for the day! for the day of Jehovah is at hand, and as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele dia! Porque perto está o dia do SENHOR, e virá do Todo-Poderoso como destruição.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del día! porque cercano está el día de Jehová, y vendrá como destrucción por el Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.WEB: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.ASV: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, [yea], joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não foi tirado o alimento de diante de nossos olhos, a alegria e o prazer da casa de nosso Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es quitado el mantenimiento de delante de nuestros ojos, la alegría y el placer de la casa de nuestro Dios?

verses.KJV: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.WEB: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.
verses.ASV: The seeds rot under their clods; the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the grain is withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: As sementes se apodreceram debaixo de seus torrões, os celeiros foram assolados, os depósitos foram derrubados; porque o trigo se secou.
verses.RVR09: El grano se pudrió debajo de sus terrones, los bastimentos fueron asolados, los alfolíes destruídos; porque se secó el trigo.

verses.KJV: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.WEB: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.ASV: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como geme o gado! As manadas dos vacas estão confusas, porque não têm pasto! Os rebanhos das ovelhas estão desolados.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuánto gimieron las bestias! ¡cuán turbados anduvieron los hatos de los bueyes, porque no tuvieron pastos! también fueron asolados los rebaños de las ovejas.

verses.KJV: O Lord, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
verses.WEB: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, to thee do I cry; for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ti, ó SENHOR, eu clamo; porque o fogo consumiu os pastos do deserto, e chama incendiou todas as árvores do campo.
verses.RVR09: A ti, oh Jehová, clamaré: porque fuego consumió los pastos del desierto, y llama abrasó todos los árboles del campo.

verses.KJV: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto thee; for the water brooks are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até os animais do campo clamam a ti, porque os rios de águas se secaram, e o fogo consumiu os pastos do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Las bestias del campo bramarán también á ti; porque se secaron los arroyos de las aguas, y fuego consumió las praderías del desierto.

verses.KJV: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.WEB: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD comes, for it is close at hand:
verses.ASV: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain; let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of Jehovah cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocai a trombeta em Sião, e alertai em alta voz no meu santo monte; perturbem-se todos os moradores desta terra; porque o dia do SENHOR vem, porque perto está.
verses.RVR09: TOCAD trompeta en Sión, y pregonad en mi santo monte: tiemblen todos los moradores de la tierra; porque viene el día de Jehová, porque está cercano.

verses.KJV: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
verses.WEB: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
verses.ASV: a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness, as the dawn spread upon the mountains; a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dia de trevas e de escuridão, dia de nuvens e densas trevas, como a madrugada espalhada sobre os montes; um povo grande e poderoso, como nunca houve desde a antiguidade, nem depois dele jamais haverá, de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Día de tinieblas y de oscuridad, día de nube y de sombra, que sobre los montes se derrama como el alba: un pueblo grande y fuerte: nunca desde el siglo fué semejante, ni después de él será jamás en años de generación en generación.

verses.KJV: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.WEB: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.
verses.ASV: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and none hath escaped them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante dele o fogo consome, e atrás dele a chama arde; a terra adiante dele é como o jardim do Éden, mas atrás dele como deserto devastado; nada há que dele possa escapar.
verses.RVR09: Delante de él consumirá fuego, tras de él abrasará llama; como el huerto de Edén será la tierra delante de él, y detrás de él como desierto asolado; ni tampoco habrá quien de él escape.

verses.KJV: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.WEB: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.
verses.ASV: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so do they run.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua aparência é como a aparência de cavalos, e correrão como cavaleiros.
verses.RVR09: Su parecer, como parecer de caballos; y como gente de á caballo correrán.

verses.KJV: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.WEB: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.
verses.ASV: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains do they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saltarão como estrondo de carruagens sobre as topos dos montes, como som de chama de fogo que consome a palha, como povo poderoso, em posição de combate.
verses.RVR09: Como estruendo de carros saltarán sobre las cumbres de los montes; como sonido de llama de fuego que consume hojarascas, como fuerte pueblo aparejado para la batalla.

verses.KJV: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.WEB: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
verses.ASV: At their presence the peoples are in anguish; all faces are waxed pale.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante dele os povos se angustiarão, todos os rostos se afligirão.
verses.RVR09: Delante de él temerán los pueblos, pondránse mustios todos los semblantes.

verses.KJV: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.WEB: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.
verses.ASV: They run like mighty men; they climb the wall like men of war; and they march every one on his ways, and they break not their ranks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como guerreiros correrão, como homens de guerra subirão a muralha; e cada um irá em seus caminhos, e não torcerão suas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Como valientes correrán, como hombres de guerra subirán la muralla; y cada cual irá en sus caminos, y no torcerán sus sendas.

verses.KJV: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.WEB: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.
verses.ASV: Neither doth one thrust another; they march every one in his path; and they burst through the weapons, and break not off [their course].
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum apertará ao outro; irão cada um em seu percurso; irrompem sem desfazerem suas fileiras.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno apretará á su compañero, cada uno irá por su carrera; y aun cayendo sobre la espada no se herirán.

verses.KJV: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.WEB: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
verses.ASV: They leap upon the city; they run upon the wall; they climb up into the houses; they enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irão pela cidade, correrão pela muralha, subirão nas casas, entrarão pelas janelas como ladrão.
verses.RVR09: Irán por la ciudad, correrán por el muro, subirán por las casas, entrarán por las ventanas á manera de ladrones.

verses.KJV: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.WEB: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.ASV: The earth quaketh before them; the heavens tremble; the sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra se abala diante deles, o céu se estremece; o sol e a lua se escurecem, e as estrelas retiram seu brilho.
verses.RVR09: Delante de él temblará la tierra, se estremecerán los cielos: el sol y la luna se oscurecerán, y las estrellas retraerán su resplandor.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.WEB: The LORD thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of the LORD is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah uttereth his voice before his army; for his camp is very great; for he is strong that executeth his word; for the day of Jehovah is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR levanta sua voz diante de seu exército; porque suas tropas são muito grandes; porque forte é aquele que cumpre sua palavra; porque o dia do SENHOR é grande, e muito terrível; quem poderá o suportar?
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dará su voz delante de su ejército: porque muchos son sus reales y fuertes, que ponen en efecto su palabra: porque grande es el día de Jehová, y muy terrible; ¿y quién lo podrá sufrir?

verses.KJV: Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.WEB: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
verses.ASV: Yet even now, saith Jehovah, turn ye unto me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso agora o SENHOR diz: Convertei-vos a mim com todo o vosso coração, com jejum, choro e pranto.
verses.RVR09: Por eso pues ahora, dice Jehová, convertíos á mí con todo vuestro corazón, con ayuno y lloro y llanto.

verses.KJV: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.WEB: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
verses.ASV: and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Jehovah your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rasgai vosso coração, e não vossas vestes.Convertei-vos ao SENHOR vosso Deus, porque ele é piedoso e misericordioso, que demora para se irar, e é grande em bondade, e que se arrepende de castigar.
verses.RVR09: Y lacerad vuestro corazón, y no vuestros vestidos; y convertíos á Jehová vuestro Dios; porque misericordioso es y clemente, tardo para la ira, y grande en misericordia, y que se arrepiente del castigo.

verses.KJV: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the Lord your God?
verses.WEB: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God.
verses.ASV: Who knoweth whether he will not turn and repent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal-offering and a drink-offering unto Jehovah your God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem sabe talvez ele volte atrás e se arrependa, e deixe após si uma bênção, uma oferta de alimento de de bebida ao SENHOR vosso Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién sabe si volverá, y se apiadará, y dejará bendición tras de él, presente y libación para Jehová Dios vuestro?

verses.KJV: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.WEB: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
verses.ASV: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocai a trombeta em Sião, santificai um jejum, convocai uma reunião solene.
verses.RVR09: Tocad trompeta en Sión, pregonad ayuno, llamad á congregación.

verses.KJV: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.WEB: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.
verses.ASV: gather the people, sanctify the assembly, assemble the old men, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts; let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reuni o povo, santificai a congregação, juntai os anciãos, reuni as crianças e os que mamam; saia o noivo de seu cômodo, e a noiva de seu quarto.
verses.RVR09: Reunid el pueblo, santificad la reunión, juntad los viejos, congregad los niños y los que maman: salga de su cámara el novio, y de su tálamo la novia.

verses.KJV: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
verses.WEB: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, LORD, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
verses.ASV: Let the priests, the ministers of Jehovah, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Jehovah, and give not thy heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the peoples, Where is their God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sacerdotes, trabalhadores do SENHOR, chorem entre o pórtico e o altar, e digam: Poupa a teu povo, SENHOR, e não entregues tua herança à humilhação, para que as nações a dominem. Por que entre os povos diriam: Onde está o Deus deles?
verses.RVR09: Entre la entrada y el altar, lloren los sacerdotes, ministros de Jehová, y digan: Perdona, oh Jehová, á tu pueblo, y no pongas en oprobio tu heredad, para que las gentes se enseñoreen de ella. ¿Por qué han de decir entre los pueblos: Dónde está su Dios?

verses.KJV: Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
verses.ASV: Then was Jehovah jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR terá zelo por sua terra, e poupará a seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová celará su tierra, y perdonará su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.WEB: The LORD answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah answered and said unto his people, Behold, I will send you grain, and new wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR responderá e dirá a seu povo: Eis que eu vos envio pão, suco de uva, e azeite, e deles sereis saciados; e nunca mais vos entregarei à humilhação entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y responderá Jehová, y dirá á su pueblo: He aquí yo os envío pan, y mosto, y aceite, y seréis saciados de ellos: y nunca más os pondré en oprobio entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
verses.WEB: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.
verses.ASV: but I will remove far off from you the northern [army], and will drive it into a land barren and desolate, its forepart into the eastern sea, and its hinder part into the western sea; and its stench shall come up, and its ill savor shall come up, because it hath done great things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E afastarei de vós o [exército] do norte, e o lançarei na terra seca e deserta; sua frente será para o mar oriental, e sua retaguarda para o mar ocidental, e exalará seu mau cheiro; subirá sua podridão, porque fez grandes coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y haré alejar de vosotros al del aquilón, y echarélo en la tierra seca y desierta: su faz será hacia el mar oriental, y su fin al mar occidental, y exhalará su hedor; y subirá su pudrición, porque hizo grandes cosas.

verses.KJV: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.
verses.WEB: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things.
verses.ASV: Fear not, O land, be glad and rejoice; for Jehovah hath done great things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, ó terra; alegra-te e encha-te de alegria, porque o SENHOR tem feito grandes coisas.
verses.RVR09: Tierra, no temas; alégrate y gózate: porque Jehová ha de hacer grandes cosas.

verses.KJV: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
verses.ASV: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth its fruit, the fig-tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temais, vós animais do campo; porque os pastos do deserto voltarão a ficar verdes, porque as árvores darão seu fruto, a figueira e a videira mostrarão seu vigor.
verses.RVR09: Animales del campo, no temáis; porque los pastos del desierto reverdecerán, porque los árboles llevarán su fruto, la higuera y la vid darán sus frutos.

verses.KJV: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
verses.WEB: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
verses.ASV: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in Jehovah your God; for he giveth you the former rain in just measure, and he causeth to come down for you the rain, the former rain and the latter rain, in the first [month].
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós, filhos de Sião, alegrai-vos e enchei-vos de alegria no SENHOR vosso Deus; porque ele vos dará a primeira chuva com justiça, e fará descer sobre vós as primeiras e últimas chuvas do ano, assim como era antes.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros también, hijos de Sión, alegraos y gozaos en Jehová vuestro Dios; porque os ha dado la primera lluvia arregladamente, y hará descender sobre vosotros lluvia temprana y tardía como al principio.

verses.KJV: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.WEB: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
verses.ASV: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as eiras se encherão de trigo, e as prensas transbordarão de suco de uva e azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y las eras se henchirán de trigo, y los lagares rebosarán de vino y aceite.

verses.KJV: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.WEB: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.
verses.ASV: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the canker-worm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer-worm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim vos restituirei dos anos em que comeram o cortador, o comedor, o devorador e o destruidor, o meu grande exército que enviei contra vós.
verses.RVR09: Y os restituiré los años que comió la oruga, la langosta, el pulgón, y el revoltón; mi grande ejército que envié contra vosotros.

verses.KJV: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.WEB: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
verses.ASV: And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and shall praise the name of Jehovah your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you; and my people shall never be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comereis abundantemente até vos saciar; e louvareis o nome do SENHOR vosso Deus, que fez maravilhas convosco; e nunca mais meu povo será envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: Y comeréis hasta saciaros, y alabaréis el nombre de Jehová vuestro Dios, el cual hizo maravillas con vosotros: y nunca jamás será mi pueblo avergonzado.

verses.KJV: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.WEB: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am the LORD, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.
verses.ASV: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am Jehovah your God, and there is none else; and my people shall never be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabereis que eu estou no meio de Israel, e que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, e não há outro; e meu povo nunca mais será envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: Y conoceréis que en medio de Israel estoy yo, y que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios, y no hay otro: y mi pueblo nunca jamás será avergonzado.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.WEB: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será depois que derramarei meu Espírito sobre toda carne; e vossos filhos e vossas filhas profetizarão; vossos velhos terão sonhos, e vossos jovens terão visões.
verses.RVR09: Y será que después de esto, derramaré mi Espíritu sobre toda carne, y profetizarán vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas; vuestros viejos soñarán sueños, y vuestros mancebos verán visiones.

verses.KJV: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.WEB: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
verses.ASV: and also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também sobre os servos e sobre as servas, naqueles dias derramarei o meu Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Y aun también sobre los siervos y sobre las siervas derramaré mi Espíritu en aquellos días.

verses.KJV: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.WEB: I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.ASV: And I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mostrarei maravilhas no céu e na terra; sangue, fogo, e colunas de fumaça.
verses.RVR09: Y daré prodigios en el cielo y en la tierra, sangre, y fuego, y columnas de humo.

verses.KJV: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the Lord come.
verses.WEB: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.
verses.ASV: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Jehovah cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol se tornará em trevas, e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o grande e temível dia do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El sol se tornará en tinieblas, y la luna en sangre, antes que venga el día grande y espantoso de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.
verses.WEB: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the remnant, those whom the LORD calls.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of Jehovah shall be delivered; for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, as Jehovah hath said, and among the remnant those whom Jehovah doth call.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que todo aquele que invocar o nome do SENHOR será salvo; porque no monte de Sião e em Jerusalém haverá livramento, assim como o SENHOR disse, entre os que restarem, aos quais o SENHOR chamar.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cualquiera que invocare el nombre de Jehová, será salvo: porque en el monte de Sión y en Jerusalem habrá salvación, como Jehová ha dicho, y en los que quedaren, á los cuales Jehová habrá llamado.

verses.KJV: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.WEB: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.ASV: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que naqueles dias e naquele tempo eu restaurarei Judá e Jerusalém de seu infortúnio.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE he aquí que en aquellos días, y en aquel tiempo en que haré tornar la cautividad de Judá y de Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.WEB: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
verses.ASV: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment upon them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations: and they have parted my land,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ajuntarei todas as nações, e as farei descer ao vale de Josafá; e ali entrarei em juízo com elas por causa do meu povo, e de minha herança Israel, aos quais dispersaram entre as nações, e repartiram minha terra;
verses.RVR09: Juntaré todas las gentes, y harélas descender al valle de Josaphat, y allí entraré en juicio con ellos á causa de mi pueblo, y de Israel mi heredad, á los cuales esparcieron entre las naciones, y partieron mi tierra:

verses.KJV: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.WEB: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
verses.ASV: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançaram sortes sobre meu povo, e deram os rapazes em troca de prostitutas, e venderam as moças em troca de vinho para beberem.
verses.RVR09: Y echaron suertes sobre mi pueblo, y á los niños dieron por una ramera, y vendieron las niñas por vino para beber.

verses.KJV: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.WEB: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
verses.ASV: Yea, and what are ye to me, O Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? will ye render me a recompense? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompense upon your own head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, o que tendes a ver comigo vós, Tiro e Sidom, e todas as regiões da Filístia? Quereis vos vingar de mim? E se quereis vos vingar de mim, apressadamente eu vos retribuirei o pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.
