verses.RVR09: Y también, ¿qué tengo yo con vosotras, Tiro y Sidón, y todos los términos de Palestina? ¿Queréis vengaros de mí? Y si de mí os vengáis, bien pronto haré yo recaer la paga sobre vuestra cabeza.

verses.KJV: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.WEB: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
verses.ASV: Forasmuch as ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly precious things,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois levastes minha prata e meu ouro, e minhas coisas valiosas e boas pusestes em vossos templos,
verses.RVR09: Porque habéis llevado mi plata y mi oro, y mis cosas preciosas y hermosas metisteis en vuestros templos:

verses.KJV: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
verses.WEB: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
verses.ASV: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem unto the sons of the Grecians, that ye may remove them far from their border;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendestes os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Jerusalém aos filhos dos gregos, para os distanciar de sua pátria.
verses.RVR09: Y vendisteis los hijos de Judá y los hijos de Jerusalem á los hijos de los Griegos, por alejarlos de sus términos.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.WEB: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
verses.ASV: behold, I will stir them up out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompense upon your own head;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu os levantarei do lugar para onde os vendestes, e retribuirei vosso pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.
verses.RVR09: He aquí los levantaré yo del lugar donde los vendisteis, y volveré vuestra paga sobre vuestra cabeza:

verses.KJV: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.ASV: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the men of Sheba, to a nation far off: for Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E venderei vossos filhos e vossas filhas na mão dos filhos de Judá, e eles os venderão aos sabeus, uma nação distante; porque o SENHOR falou.
verses.RVR09: Y venderé vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas en la mano de los hijos de Judá, y ellos los venderán á los Sabeos, nación apartada; porque Jehová ha hablado.

verses.KJV: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.WEB: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
verses.ASV: Proclaim ye this among the nations; prepare war; stir up the mighty men; let all the men of war draw near, let them come up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Proclamai isto entre as nações, convocai uma guerra; despertai aos guerreiros, acheguem-se, venham todos os homens de guerra.
verses.RVR09: Pregonad esto entre las gentes, proclamad guerra, despertad á los valientes, lléguense, vengan todos los hombres de guerra.

verses.KJV: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.WEB: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’
verses.ASV: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning-hooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei espadas de vossas enxadas, e lanças de vossas foices; diga o fraco: Sou forte.
verses.RVR09: Haced espadas de vuestros azadones, lanzas de vuestras hoces; diga el flaco: Fuerte soy.

verses.KJV: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, LORD.
verses.ASV: Haste ye, and come, all ye nations round about, and gather yourselves together: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-vos e vinde, todas as nações ao redor, e reuni-vos. (Ó SENHOR, faze vir ali os teus fortes!)
verses.RVR09: Juntaos y venid, gentes todas de alrededor, y congregaos: haz venir allí, oh Jehová, tus fuertes.

verses.KJV: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.WEB: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.ASV: Let the nations bestir themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the nations round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantem-se as nações, e subam ao vale de Josafá; porque ali eu me sentarei para julgar todas as nações ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Las gentes se despierten, y suban al valle de Josaphat: porque allí me sentaré para juzgar todas las gentes de alrededor.

verses.KJV: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.WEB: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
verses.ASV: Put ye in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe: come, tread ye; for the winepress is full, the vats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lançai a foice, porque a colheita já está madura. Vinde, descei; porque a prensa de uvas está cheia, os tanques transbordam; porque a maldade deles é grande.
verses.RVR09: Echad la hoz, porque la mies está ya madura. Venid, descended; porque el lagar está lleno, rebosan las lagaretas: porque mucha es la maldad de ellos.

verses.KJV: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.WEB: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.ASV: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! for the day of Jehovah is near in the valley of decision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Multidões! Multidões no vale da decisão! Porque perto está o dia do SENHOR no vale da decisão.
verses.RVR09: Muchos pueblos en el valle de la decisión: porque cercano está el día de Jehová en el valle de la decisión.

verses.KJV: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.WEB: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.ASV: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol e a lua se escurecerão, e as estrelas recolherão seu brilho.
verses.RVR09: El sol y la luna se oscurecerán, y las estrellas retraerán su resplandor.

verses.KJV: The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but Jehovah will be a refuge unto his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR bramará desde Sião, e dará sua voz desde Jerusalém, e os céus e a terra tremerão; mas o SENHOR será o refúgio de seu povo, e a fortaleza dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová bramará desde Sión, y dará su voz desde Jerusalem, y temblarán los cielos y la tierra: mas Jehová será la esperanza de su pueblo, y la fortaleza de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.WEB: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
verses.ASV: So shall ye know that I am Jehovah your God, dwelling in Zion my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que habito em Sião, o meu santo monte; e Jerusalém será santa, e estrangeiros não mais passarão mais por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y conoceréis que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios, que habito en Sión, monte de mi santidad: y será Jerusalem santa, y extraños no pasarán más por ella.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth out of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the brooks of Judah shall flow with waters; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of Jehovah, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele tempo, que os montes destilarão suco de uva, e os morros fluirão leite, e por todos os ribeiros de Judá correrão águas; e sairá uma fonte da casa do SENHOR, que regará o vale de Sitim.
verses.RVR09: Y será en aquel tiempo, que los montes destilarán mosto, y los collados fluirán leche, y por todos los arroyos de Judá correrán aguas: y saldrá una fuente de la casa de Jehová, y regará el valle de Sittim.

verses.KJV: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.WEB: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.ASV: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Egito será uma assolação, e Edom se tornará um deserto assolado, por causa da violência que fizeram aos filhos de Judá, em cuja terra derramaram sangue inocente.
verses.RVR09: Egipto será destruído, y Edom será vuelto en asolado desierto, por la injuria hecha á los hijos de Judá: porque derramaron en su tierra la sangre inocente.

verses.KJV: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.WEB: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.ASV: But Judah shall abide for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Judá permanecerá para sempre, e Jerusalém de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Mas Judá para siempre será habitada, y Jerusalem en generación y generación.

verses.KJV: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the Lord dwelleth in Zion.
verses.WEB: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for the LORD dwells in Zion.”
verses.ASV: And I will cleanse their blood, that I have not cleansed: for Jehovah dwelleth in Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E purificarei o sangue que não tinha purificado; e o SENHOR habitará em Sião.
verses.RVR09: Y limpiaré la sangre de los que no limpié; y Jehová morará en Sión.

verses.KJV: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.WEB: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.ASV: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras de Amós, que estava entre os pastores de Tecoa, as quais ele viu sobre Israel nos dias de Uzias rei de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel, dois anos antes do terremoto.
verses.RVR09: LAS palabras de Amós, que fué entre los pastores de Tecoa, las cuales vió acerca de Israel en días de Uzzía rey de Judá, y en días de Jeroboam hijo de Joas rey de Israel, dos años antes del terremoto.

verses.KJV: And he said, The Lord will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.WEB: He said: “The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Jehovah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: O SENHOR bramará desde Sião, e dará sua voz desde Jerusalém; e as habitações dos pastores se prantearão, e o topo do Carmelo se secará.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Jehová bramará desde Sión, y dará su voz desde Jerusalem; y las estancias de los pastores se enlutarán, y secaráse la cumbre del Carmelo.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Damasco, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque trilharam a Gileade com trilhos de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Damasco, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque trillaron á Galaad con trillos de hierro.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo na casa de Hazael, que consumirá os palácios de Ben-Hadade.
verses.RVR09: Y meteré fuego en la casa de Hazael, y consumirá los palacios de Benhadad.

verses.KJV: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quebrarei o ferrolho de Damasco, e exterminarei o morador do vale de Áven, e o dono do cetro de de Bete-Éden; e o povo da Síria será levado em cativeiro a Quir, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y quebraré la barra de Damasco, y talaré los moradores de Bicath-aven, y los gobernadores de Beth-eden: y el pueblo de Aram será trasportado á Chîr, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gaza, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole people, to deliver them up to Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Gaza, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; pois levaram a todos do povo em cativeiro, para os entregar a Edom.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Gaza, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque llevó cautiva toda la cautividad, para entregarlos á Edom.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo no muro de Gaza, que consumirá seus palácios.
verses.RVR09: Y meteré fuego en el muro de Gaza, y quemará sus palacios.

verses.KJV: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E exterminarei o morador de Asdode, e o dono do cetro de Asquelom; e tornarei minha mão contra Ecrom, e o resto dos filisteus perecerá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y talaré los moradores de Azoto, y los gobernadores de Ascalón: y tornaré mi mano sobre Ecrón, y las reliquias de los Palestinos perecerán, ha dicho el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole people to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Tiro, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque entregaram todo o povo em cativeiro a Edom, e não se lembraram do pacto de irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Tiro, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque entregaron la cautividad entera á Edom, y no se acordaron del concierto de hermanos.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo no muro de Tiro, que consumirá seus palácios.
verses.RVR09: Y meteré fuego en el muro de Tiro, y consumirá sus palacios.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Edom, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque perseguiu seu irmão à espada, e extinguiu suas misericórdias; e sua ira [o] despedaçou continuamente, e mantém sua indignação eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Edom, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque persiguió á cuchillo á su hermano, y rompió sus conmiseraciones; y con su furor le ha robado siempre, y ha perpetuamente guardado el enojo.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo em Temã, que consumirá os palácios de Bosra.
verses.RVR09: Y meteré fuego en Temán, y consumirá los palacios de Bosra.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões dos filhos de Amom, e pelo quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque rasgaram o ventre das grávidas de Gileade, para expandirem seus territórios.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de los hijos de Ammón, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque abrieron las preñadas de Galaad, para ensanchar su término.

verses.KJV: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
verses.WEB: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;
verses.ASV: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso acenderei fogo no muro de Rabá, que consumirá seus palácios com grito no dia de batalha, com tempestade no dia do vento forte.
verses.RVR09: Y encenderé fuego en el muro de Rabba, y consumirá sus palacios con estruendo en día de batalla, con tempestad en día tempestuoso:

verses.KJV: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu rei irá ao cativeiro, e junto dele seus príncipes, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y su rey irá en cautiverio, él y sus príncipes todos, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Moabe, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque queimou os ossos do rei de Edom até os tornar em cal.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Moab, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque quemó los huesos del rey de Idumea hasta tornarlos en cal.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo em Moabe, que consumirá os palácios de Queriote; e Moabe morrerá em tumulto, com grito e som de trombeta.
verses.RVR09: Y meteré fuego en Moab, y consumirá los palacios de Chêrioth: y morirá Moab en alboroto, en estrépito y sonido de trompeta.

verses.KJV: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E exterminarei o juiz do meio dele, e matarei a todos seus príncipes com ele,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y quitaré el juez de en medio de él, y mataré con él á todos sus príncipes, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the Lord, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have caused them to err, after which their fathers did walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Judá, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque rejeitaram a lei do SENHOR, e não guardaram seus estatutos; e foram enganados por suas mentiras, as quais seus pais seguiam.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Judá, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque menospreciaron la ley de Jehová, y no guardaron sus ordenanzas; é hiciéronlos errar sus mentiras, en pos de las cuales anduvieron sus padres.

verses.KJV: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meterei fogo em Judá, que consumirá os palácios de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Meteré por tanto fuego en Judá, el cual consumirá los palacios de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes—
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Israel, e pela quarta, não desviarei [seu castigo] ; porque vendem o justo em troca de dinheiro, e o pobre por um par de sapatos;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Por tres pecados de Israel, y por el cuarto, no desviaré su castigo; porque vendieron por dinero al justo, y al pobre por un par de zapatos:

verses.KJV: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.WEB: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.
verses.ASV: they that pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father go unto the [same] maiden, to profane my holy name:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles pisam a cabeça dos pobres no pó da terra, e distorcem o caminho dos humildes; um homem e seu pai vão a uma [mesma] moça, para profanarem o meu santo nome.
verses.RVR09: Que anhelan porque haya polvo de tierra sobre la cabeza de los pobres, y tuercen el camino de los humildes: y el hombre y su padre entraron á la misma moza, profanando mi santo nombre.

verses.KJV: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.WEB: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
verses.ASV: and they lay themselves down beside every altar upon clothes taken in pledge; and in the house of their God they drink the wine of such as have been fined.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se deitam junto a qualquer altar com roupas tomadas em penhor, e bebem vinho tomado como multa da casa de seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre las ropas empeñadas se acuestan junto á cualquier altar; y el vino de los penados beben en la casa de sus dioses.

verses.KJV: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.WEB: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.ASV: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, pelo contrário, destruí diante deles os amorreus, cuja altura era como a altura dos cedros, e eram fortes como carvalhos; e destruí seu fruto acima, e suas raízes abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Y yo destruí delante de ellos al Amorrheo, cuya altura era como la altura de los cedros, y fuerte como un alcornoque; y destruí su fruto arriba, sus raíces abajo.

verses.KJV: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.WEB: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.ASV: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vos fiz a vós subir da terra do Egito, e por quarenta anos vos conduzi pelo deserto, para que possuísseis a terra dos amorreus.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os hice á vosotros subir de la tierra de Egipto, y os traje por el desierto cuarenta años, para que poseyeseis la tierra del Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantei [alguns] de vossos filhos para profetas, e de vossos rapazes para que fossem nazireus. Não é isto assim, filhos de Israel?Diz o SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y levanté de vuestros hijos para profetas, y de vuestros mancebos para que fuesen Nazareos. ¿No es esto así, dice Jehová, hijos de Israel?

verses.KJV: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.WEB: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
verses.ASV: But ye gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos nazireus destes de beber vinho; e aos profetas mandastes, dizendo: Não profetizeis.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros disteis de beber vino á los Nazareos; y á los profetas mandasteis, diciendo: No profeticéis.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will press [you] in your place, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eis que eu vos esmagarei em vosso lugar, tal como uma carroça cheia de feixes esmaga;
verses.RVR09: Pues he aquí, yo os apretaré en vuestro lugar, como se aprieta el carro lleno de haces;

verses.KJV: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.WEB: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.
verses.ASV: And flight shall perish from the swift; and the strong shall not strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
verses.ALMEIDA: De modo que o veloz não conseguirá escapar, nem o forte conseguirá usar de sua força, nem o guerreiro livrará sua vida;
verses.RVR09: Y la huída perecerá del ligero, y el fuerte no esforzará su fuerza, ni el valiente librará su vida;

verses.KJV: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.WEB: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.
verses.ASV: neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver [himself]; neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que maneja o arco não subsistirá, nem o veloz de pés se livrará, nem o que monta em cavalo livrará sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Y el que toma el arco no resistirá, ni escapará el ligero de pies, ni el que cabalga en caballo salvará su vida.

verses.KJV: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mais corajoso entre os guerreiros fugirá nu naquele dia, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El esforzado entre esforzados huirá desnudo aquel día, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.WEB: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.ASV: Hear this word that Jehovah hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi esta palavra que o SENHOR fala contra vós, ó filhos de Israel, contra toda família que eu fiz subir da terra do Egito:
verses.RVR09: OID esta palabra que ha hablado Jehová contra vosotros, hijos de Israel, contra toda la familia que hice subir de la tierra de Egipto. Dice así:

verses.KJV: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.WEB: “I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
verses.ASV: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente reconheci a vós mesmos de todas as famílias da terra; por isso punirei contra vós todas as vossas injustiças.
verses.RVR09: A vosotros solamente he conocido de todas las familias de la tierra; por tanto visitaré contra vosotros todas vuestras maldades.

verses.KJV: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.WEB: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
verses.ASV: Shall two walk together, except they have agreed?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso irão dois juntos, se não estiverem de acordo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Andarán dos juntos, si no estuvieren de concierto?

verses.KJV: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.WEB: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
verses.ASV: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.ALMEIDA: Rugirá o leão no bosque se não houver presa? Dará o leãozinho seu som desde sua cova, se nada tiver capturado?
verses.RVR09: ¿Bramará el león en el monte sin hacer presa? ¿dará el leoncillo su bramido desde su morada, si no prendiere?

verses.KJV: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.WEB: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
verses.ASV: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is [set] for him? shall a snare spring up from the ground, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.ALMEIDA: Cairá o ave no laço na terra, se não houver armadilha para ela? Se levantará o laço da terra, se nada houver prendido?
verses.RVR09: ¿Caerá el ave en el lazo en la tierra, sin haber armador? ¿alzaráse el lazo de la tierra, si no se ha prendido algo?

verses.KJV: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?
verses.WEB: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?
verses.ASV: Shall the trumpet be blown in a city, and the people not be afraid? shall evil befall a city, and Jehovah hath not done it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocará a trombeta na cidade, e o povo não se estremecerá? Haverá alguma calamidade na cidade que o SENHOR não tenha feito?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tocaráse la trompeta en la ciudad, y no se alborotará el pueblo? ¿habrá algún mal en la ciudad, el cual Jehová no haya hecho?

verses.KJV: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.WEB: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
verses.ASV: Surely the Lord Jehovah will do nothing, except he reveal his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente o Senhor DEUS não fará coisa alguma sem ter revelado seu segredo a seus servos os profetas.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hará nada el Señor Jehová, sin que revele su secreto á sus siervos los profetas.

verses.KJV: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
verses.WEB: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
verses.ASV: The lion hath roared; who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken; who can but prophesy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o leão ruge, quem não temerá? Quando o Senhor DEUS fala, quem não profetizará?
verses.RVR09: Bramando el león, ¿quién no temerá? hablando el Señor Jehová, ¿quién no profetizará?

verses.KJV: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
verses.ASV: Publish ye in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold what great tumults are therein, and what oppressions in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anunciai nos palácios de Asdode e nos palácios da terra do Egito, e dizei: Reuni-vos sobre os montes de Samaria, e vede os grandes tumultos no meio dela, e as opressões no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Haced pregonar sobre los palacios de Azoto, y sobre los palacios de tierra de Egipto, y decid: Reuníos sobre los montes de Samaria, y ved muchas opresiones en medio de ella, y violencias en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.WEB: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
verses.ASV: For they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não sabem fazer o que é correto, diz o SENHOR; em seus palácios acumulam bens [obtidos] por violência e destruição.
verses.RVR09: Y no saben hacer lo recto, dice Jehová, atesorando rapiñas y despojos en sus palacios.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An adversary [there shall be], even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be plundered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto o Senhor DEUS diz assim: Um inimigo! Ele está ao redor da terra, e derrubará de ti a tua fortaleza, e teus palácios serão saqueados.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, el Señor Jehová ha dicho así: Un enemigo habrá aún por todos lados de la tierra, y derribará de ti tu fortaleza, y tus palacios serán saqueados.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: As the shepherd rescueth out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued that sit in Samaria in the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Tal como o pastor livra da boca do leão duas pernas ou a ponta de uma orelha, assim os filhos de Israel que moram em Samaria serão livrados, com um canto da cama, e um pedaço do leito.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: De la manera que el pastor libra de la boca del león dos piernas, ó la punta de una oreja, así escaparán los hijos de Israel que moran en Samaria en el rincón de la cama, y al canto del lecho.

verses.KJV: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,
verses.WEB: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
verses.ASV: Hear ye, and testify against the house of Jacob, saith the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi e testemunhai contra a casa de Jacó, diz o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos;
verses.RVR09: Oid y protestad en la casa de Jacob, ha dicho Jehová Dios de los ejércitos:

verses.KJV: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.WEB: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.ASV: For in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also visit the altars of Beth-el; and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que no dia em que eu punir as transgressões de Israel sobre ele, também farei punição sobre os altares de Betel; e as pontas do altar serão cortadas, e cairão por terra.
verses.RVR09: Que el día que visitaré las rebeliones de Israel sobre él, visitaré también sobre los altares de Beth-el; y serán cortados los cuernos del altar, y caerán á tierra.

verses.KJV: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ferirei a casa do inverno com a casa do verão, e as casas de marfim se acabarão; e muitas casas terão fim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y heriré la casa del invierno con la casa del verano, y las casas de marfil perecerán; y muchas casas serán arruinadas, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.WEB: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
verses.ASV: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, that oppress the poor, that crush the needy, that say unto their lords, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi esta palavra, vós vacas de Basã, que estais no monte de Samaria; que oprimis os pobres, que quebrantais os necessitados, que dizeis a seus senhores: Trazei nossa bebida.
verses.RVR09: OID esta palabra, vacas de Basán, que estáis en el monte de Samaria, que oprimís los pobres, que quebrantáis los menesterosos, que decís á sus señores: Traed, y beberemos.

verses.KJV: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.
verses.ASV: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that they shall take you away with hooks, and your residue with fish-hooks.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor DEUS jurou por sua santidade: Eis que vêm dias sobre vós em que vos levarão em ganchos, e a vossos descendentes em anzóis de pesca.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová juró por su santidad: He aquí, vienen días sobre vosotros en que os llevará en anzuelos, y á vuestros descendientes en barquillos de pescador.

verses.KJV: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every one straight before her; and ye shall cast [yourselves] into Harmon, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saireis pelas brechas cada uma atrás da outra, e sereis lançadas para Harmom, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrán por los portillos la una en pos de la otra, y seréis echadas del palacio, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
verses.WEB: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,
verses.ASV: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; to Gilgal, [and] multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, [and] your tithes every three days;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide a Betel, e transgredi; em Gilgal aumentai as transgressões, e de manhã trazei vossos sacrifícios, vossos dízimos ao terceiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Id á Beth-el, y prevaricad; en Gilgal aumentad la rebelión, y traed de mañana vuestros sacrificios, y vuestros diezmos cada tres años;

verses.KJV: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: and offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim freewill-offerings and publish them: for this pleaseth you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecei sacrifício de louvores com lêvedo, e anunciai ofertas voluntárias; pois é assim que quereis, ó filhos de Israel,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y ofreced sacrificio de alabanza con leudo, y pregonad, publicad voluntarias ofrendas; pues que así lo queréis, hijos de Israel, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places; yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também vos dei bocas vazias em todas vossas cidades, e falta de pão em todos os vossos lugares, contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Yo también os dí limpieza de dientes en todas vuestras ciudades, y falta de pan en todos vuestros pueblos: mas no os tornasteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.WEB: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.
verses.ASV: And I also have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso eu vos retive a chuva três meses antes da colheita; e fiz chover sobre uma cidade, e sobre outra cidade não fiz chover; sobre um campo choveu; mas o outro campo sobre o qual não choveu, se secou;
verses.RVR09: Y también yo os detuve la lluvia tres meses antes de la siega: é hice llover sobre una ciudad, y sobre otra ciudad no hice llover: sobre una parte llovió; la parte sobre la cual no llovió, secóse.

verses.KJV: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: So two or three cities wandered unto one city to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: De modo que [os moradores de] duas ou três cidades perambulavam até uma cidade para beberem água, mas não se saciavam; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y venían dos ó tres ciudades á una ciudad para beber agua, y no se hartaban: con todo no os tornasteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: the multitude of your gardens and your vineyards and your fig-trees and your olive-trees hath the palmer-worm devoured: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos feri com ferrugem e doenças nas plantas; a multidão de vossos jardins e vossas vinhas, vossas figueiras e vossas oliveiras o gafanhoto comeu; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Os herí con viento solano y oruga; vuestros muchos huertos y vuestras viñas, y vuestros higuerales y vuestros olivares comió la langosta: pero nunca os tornasteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have carried away your horses; and I have made the stench of your camp to come up even into your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviei entre vós a pestilência, à maneira do Egito; matei à espada vossos rapazes, e deixei que capturassem vossos cavalos; e fiz subir o mau cheiro de vossos exércitos até vossas narinas; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Envié entre vosotros mortandad al modo que en Egipto: maté á cuchillo vuestros mancebos, con cautiverio de vuestros caballos; é hice subir el hedor de vuestros reales hasta vuestras narices: empero no os tornasteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I have overthrown [cities] among you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a brand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Transtornei a alguns dentre vós, como quando Deus transtornou a Sodoma e a Gomorra, e fostes como tição escapado do fogo; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Trastornéos, como cuando Dios trastornó á Sodoma y á Gomorra, y fuisteis como tizón escapado del fuego: mas no os tornasteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.WEB: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel; [and] because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim farei a ti, ó Israel; e visto que te farei isto, ó Israel, prepara-te para te encontrares com teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, de esta manera haré á ti, oh Israel: y porque te he de hacer esto, aparéjate para venir al encuentro á tu Dios, oh Israel.

verses.KJV: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The Lord, The God of hosts, is his name.
verses.WEB: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: The LORD, the God of Armies, is his name.”
verses.ASV: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought; that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth—Jehovah, the God of hosts, is his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que ele é que forma os montes, cria o vento, e informa seu pensamento ao ser humano; ele é o que torna a manhã em trevas, e pisa sobre as alturas da terra; EU-SOU, o Deus dos exércitos, é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, el que forma los montes, y cría el viento, y denuncia al hombre su pensamiento; el que hace á las tinieblas mañana, y pasa sobre las alturas de la tierra; Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos, es su nombre.

verses.KJV: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
verses.WEB: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
verses.ASV: Hear ye this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi esta palavra que eu levanto sobre vós, uma lamentação, ó casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: OID esta palabra, porque yo levanto endecha sobre vosotros, casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
verses.WEB: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
verses.ASV: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
verses.ALMEIDA: A virgem Israel caiu, não poderá mais se levantar; abandonada está sobre sua terra, ninguém há que a levante.
verses.RVR09: Cayó la virgen de Israel, no más podrá levantarse; dejada fué sobre su tierra, no hay quien la levante.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, to the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: A cidade que enviou mil [soldados] sobrará com cem; e a que enviou cem sobrará com dez, na casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: La ciudad que sacaba mil, quedará con ciento; y la que sacaba ciento, quedará con diez, en la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
verses.WEB: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR à casa de Israel: Buscai-me, e vivereis;
verses.RVR09: Empero así dice Jehová á la casa de Israel: Buscadme, y viviréis;

verses.KJV: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
verses.WEB: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
verses.ASV: but seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não busqueis a Betel nem venhais a Gilgal, nem passeis a Berseba; porque Gilgal será levada em cativeiro, e Betel será reduzida a nada.
verses.RVR09: Y no busquéis á Beth-el ni entréis en Gilgal, ni paséis á Beer-seba: porque Gilgal será llevada en cautiverio, y Beth-el será deshecha.

verses.KJV: Seek the Lord, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
verses.WEB: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.
verses.ASV: Seek Jehovah, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai ao SENHOR, e vivereis; para que não aconteça que surja como fogo à casa de José, e a consuma, sem haver em Betel quem o apague.
verses.RVR09: Buscad á Jehová, y vivid; no sea que hienda, como fuego, á la casa de José, y la consuma, sin haber en Beth-el quien lo apague.

verses.KJV: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
verses.WEB: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
verses.ASV: Ye who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós perverteis o juízo em absinto, e abandonam a justiça no chão.
verses.RVR09: Los que convierten en ajenjo el juicio, y dejan en tierra la justicia,

verses.KJV: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name:
verses.WEB: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,
verses.ASV: [seek him] that maketh the Pleiades and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night; that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth (Jehovah is his name);
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que fez as Plêiades e o Órion, e torna as trevas em manhã, e faz escurecer o dia em noite; ele chama as águas do mar, e as derrama sobre a face da terra; EU-SOU é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Miren al que hace el Arcturo y el Orión, y las tinieblas vuelve en mañana, y hace oscurecer el día en noche; el que llama á las aguas de la mar, y las derrama sobre la haz de la tierra: Jehová es su nombre:

verses.KJV: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
verses.WEB: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.
verses.ASV: that bringeth sudden destruction upon the strong, so that destruction cometh upon the fortress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele causa súbita destruição sobre o forte, e torna em ruínas a fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Que da esfuerzo al despojador sobre el fuerte, y que el despojador venga contra la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
verses.WEB: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
verses.ASV: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na porta da cidade eles odeiam ao que repreende, e abominam ao que fala com justiça.
verses.RVR09: Ellos aborrecieron en la puerta al reprensor, y al que hablaba lo recto abominaron.

verses.KJV: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
verses.WEB: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
verses.ASV: Forasmuch therefore as ye trample upon the poor, and take exactions from him of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink the wine thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, visto que pisoteais ao pobre e tomais dele um carga de trigo; assim edificastes casas de pedras lavradas, mas não habitareis nelas; plantastes belas vinhas, mas não bebereis o vinho delas.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pues que vejáis al pobre y recibís de él carga de trigo; edificasteis casas de sillares, mas no las habitaréis; plantasteis hermosas viñas, mas no beberéis el vino de ellas.

verses.KJV: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
verses.WEB: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.
verses.ASV: For I know how manifold are your transgressions, and how mighty are your sins—ye that afflict the just, that take a bribe, and that turn aside the needy in the gate [from their right].
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sei que vossas transgressões são muitas e vossos pecados são grandes; afligis o justo, e recebeis suborno, e negam o direito dos necessitados na porta da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabido he vuestras muchas rebeliones, y vuestros grandes pecados: que afligen al justo, y reciben cohecho, y á los pobres en la puerta hacen perder su causa.

verses.KJV: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
verses.WEB: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
verses.ASV: Therefore he that is prudent shall keep silence in such a time; for it is an evil time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o prudente em tal tempo fica calado, porque é um tempo mau.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, el prudente en tal tiempo calla, porque el tiempo es malo.

verses.KJV: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
verses.WEB: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
verses.ASV: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be with you, as ye say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai o bem, e não o mal, para que vivais; e assim o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos estará convosco, como dizeis.
verses.RVR09: Buscad lo bueno, y no lo malo, para que viváis; porque así Jehová Dios de los ejércitos será con vosotros, como decís.

verses.KJV: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.WEB: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
verses.ASV: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish justice in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Odiai o mal, amai o bem, e praticai justiça na porta da cidade; talvez o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos tenha piedade do restante [do povo] de José.
verses.RVR09: Aborreced el mal, y amad el bien, y poned juicio en la puerta: quizá Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos, tendrá piedad del remanente de José.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, the Lord: Wailing shall be in all the broad ways; and they shall say in all the streets, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful in lamentation to wailing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, o Senhor: Em todas as praças haverá pranto, e em todas as ruas dirão: Ai! ai! E chamarão o lavrador ao choro, e os que sabem prantear ao lamento.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, el Señor: En todas las plazas habrá llanto, y en todas las calles dirán, ¡Ay! ¡ay! y al labrador llamarán á lloro, y á endecha á los que endechar supieren.

verses.KJV: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And in all vineyards shall be wailing; for I will pass through the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em todas as vinhas haverá pranto, porque passarei por meio de ti,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y en todas las viñas habrá llanto; porque pasaré por medio de ti, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you? the day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.
verses.WEB: “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.
verses.ASV: Woe unto you that desire the day of Jehovah! Wherefore would ye have the day of Jehovah? It is darkness, and not light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que desejam o dia do SENHOR! Para que quereis este dia do SENHOR? Será trevas, e não luz.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que desean el día de Jehová! ¿para qué queréis este día de Jehová? Será de tinieblas, y no luz:

verses.KJV: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.WEB: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.
verses.ASV: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será como se alguém fugisse do leão, e o urso se encontrasse com ele; ou como se entrasse em alguma casa e apoiasse sua mão à parede, e fosse picado por uma cobra.
verses.RVR09: Como el que huye de delante del león, y se topa con el oso; ó si entrare en casa y arrimare su mano á la pared, y le muerda la culebra.

verses.KJV: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.WEB: Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.ASV: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não será o dia do SENHOR trevas e não luz, uma escuridão sem claridade alguma?
verses.RVR09: ¿No será el día de Jehová tinieblas, y no luz; oscuridad, que no tiene resplandor?

verses.KJV: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
verses.WEB: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
verses.ASV: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu odeio, desprezo vossas solenidades, e não aguento vossas reuniões religiosas.
verses.RVR09: Aborrecí, abominé vuestras solemnidades, y no me darán buen olor vuestras asambleas.

verses.KJV: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.WEB: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
verses.ASV: Yea, though ye offer me your burnt-offerings and meal-offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que me ofereçais holocaustos e vossas ofertas de alimentos, não os aceitarei; nem darei atenção a vossas ofertas de gratidão de vossos animais cevados.
verses.RVR09: Y si me ofreciereis holocaustos y vuestros presentes, no los recibiré; ni miraré á los pacíficos de vuestros engordados.

verses.KJV: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
verses.WEB: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
verses.ASV: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta de mim os teus muitos cânticos; também não ouvirei as melodias de teus instrumentos.
verses.RVR09: Quita de mí la multitud de tus cantares, que no escucharé las salmodias de tus instrumentos.

verses.KJV: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.WEB: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
verses.ASV: But let justice roll down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, corra o juízo como as águas, e a justiça como um ribeiro impetuoso.
verses.RVR09: Antes corra el juicio como las aguas, y la justicia como impetuoso arroyo.

verses.KJV: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.WEB: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
verses.ASV: Did ye bring unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso vós oferecestes a mim sacrifícios e ofertas de alimento no deserto durante os quarenta anos, ó casa de Israel?
verses.RVR09: ¿Habéisme ofrecido sacrificios y presentes en el desierto en cuarenta años, casa de Israel?

verses.KJV: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
verses.WEB: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
verses.ASV: Yea, ye have borne the tabernacle of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, levastes as imagens de vosso rei Sicute, e de Quium, a estrela de vossos deus, que fizestes para vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Mas llevabais el tabernáculo de vuestro Moloch y Chiún, ídolos vuestros, la estrella de vuestros dioses que os hicisteis.

verses.KJV: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, whose name is The God of hosts.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
verses.ASV: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith Jehovah, whose name is the God of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos levarei cativos, para além de Damasco, diz o SENHOR, cujo nome é Deus dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Hareos pues trasportar más allá de Damasco, ha dicho Jehová, cuyo nombre es Dios de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verses.WEB: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
verses.ASV: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and to them that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que estão tranquilos em Sião, e dos que se sentem seguros no monte de Samaria, que são os príncipes da principal das nações, aos quais o povo de Israel vem!
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de los reposados en Sión, y de los confiados en el monte de Samaria, nombrados principales entre las mismas naciones, las cuales vendrán sobre ellos, oh casa de Israel!

verses.KJV: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
verses.WEB: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?
verses.ASV: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?
verses.ALMEIDA: Passai a Calné, e vede; e dali ide à grande Hamate; depois descei a Gate dos filisteus; por acaso são aqueles reinos melhores que estes, ou seu território maior que vosso território?
verses.RVR09: Pasad á Calne, y mirad; y de allí id á la gran Hamath; descended luego á Gath de los Palestinos: ved si son aquellos reinos mejores que estos reinos, si su término es mayor que vuestro término.
