verses.KJV: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.WEB: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,
verses.ASV: —ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que pensais estar distante o dia mau, e aproximais o assento da violência;
verses.RVR09: Vosotros que dilatáis el día malo, y acercáis la silla de iniquidad;

verses.KJV: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.WEB: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,
verses.ASV: that lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se deitam em camas de marfim, e se estendem sobre seus leitos; comem os cordeiros do rebanho, e os bezerros de em meio do curral;
verses.RVR09: Duermen en camas de marfil, y se extienden sobre sus lechos; y comen los corderos del rebaño, y los becerros de en medio del engordadero;

verses.KJV: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
verses.WEB: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
verses.ASV: that sing idle songs to the sound of the viol; that invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantam ao som da harpa, e inventam para si instrumentos musicais, como Davi;
verses.RVR09: Gorjean al son de la flauta, é inventan instrumentos músicos, como David;

verses.KJV: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.WEB: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.ASV: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bebem vinho em tigelas, e se ungem com o óleo mais valioso; mas não se afligem pela ruína de José.
verses.RVR09: Beben vino en tazones, y se ungen con los ungüentos más preciosos; y no se afligen por el quebrantamiento de José.

verses.KJV: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
verses.WEB: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall they now go captive with the first that go captive; and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso agora serão os primeiros a serem levados presos ao cativeiro, e o banquete dos que vivem no conforto se acabará.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, ahora pasarán en el principio de los que á cautividad pasaren, y se acercará el clamor de los extendidos.

verses.KJV: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, saith the Lord the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.WEB: “The Lord GOD has sworn by himself,” says the LORD, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
verses.ASV: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by himself, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts: I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces; therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor DEUS jurou por si mesmo; o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos diz: Eu abomino a arrogância de Jacó, e odeio seus palácios; por isso entregarei a cidade e tudo que ela tem [ao inimigo] .
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová juró por su alma, Jehová Dios de los ejércitos ha dicho: Tengo en abominación la grandeza de Jacob, y aborrezco sus palacios: y la ciudad y su plenitud entregaré al enemigo.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.WEB: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá que, se dez homens restarem em uma casa, mesmo eles morrerão.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá que si diez hombres quedaren en una casa, morirán.

verses.KJV: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention the LORD’s name.’
verses.ASV: And when a man’s uncle shall take him up, even he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is in the innermost parts of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No; then shall he say, Hold thy peace; for we may not make mention of the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando seu parente vier para queimar [os cadáveres] ,para tirar os ossos de casa, então dirá ao que estiver dentro da da casa: Há ainda alguém contigo? E ele responderá: Não. Então aquele dirá: Cala-te! Não menciones o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y su tío tomará á cada uno, y quemarále para sacar los huesos de casa; y dirá al que estará en los rincones de la casa: ¿Hay aún alguno contigo? Y dirá: No. Y dirá aquél: Calla, que no podemos hacer mención del nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: For, behold, the Lord commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.WEB: “For, behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
verses.ASV: For, behold, Jehovah commandeth, and the great house shall be smitten with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que o SENHOR mandará, e ferirá a casa maior com quebrantamento, e a casa menor com despedaçamento.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, Jehová mandará, y herirá con hendiduras la casa mayor, y la casa menor con aberturas.

verses.KJV: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
verses.WEB: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,
verses.ASV: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow [there] with oxen? that ye have turned justice into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso correm os cavalos pelos rochedos? Pode-se arar [ali] com bois? Porém vós pervertestes o juízo em veneno, e o fruto da justiça no amargo absinto.
verses.RVR09: ¿Correrán los caballos por las peñas? ¿ararán en ellas con vacas? ¿por qué habéis vosotros tornado el juicio en veneno, y el fruto de justicia en ajenjo?

verses.KJV: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.WEB: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
verses.ASV: ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que vos alegrais por nada, que dizeis: Não conquistamos Carnaim por nossa própria força?
verses.RVR09: Vosotros que os alegráis en nada, que decís: ¿No nos hemos adquirido potencia con nuestra fortaleza?

verses.KJV: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the Lord the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says the LORD, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
verses.ASV: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entrance of Hamath unto the brook of the Arabah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diz o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos: Pois eis que eu levantarei contra vós, ó casa de Israel, uma nação que vos oprimirá desde a entrada de Hamate até o ribeiro de Arabá.
verses.RVR09: Pues he aquí, levantaré yo sobre vosotros, oh casa de Israel, dice Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, gente que os oprimirá desde la entrada de Hamath hasta el arroyo del desierto.

verses.KJV: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
verses.WEB: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.
verses.ASV: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o Senhor DEUS me fez ver: eis que ele formava gafanhotos, no começo do crescimento da plantação tardia; e eis que era a plantação tardia, depois da colheita do rei.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ me ha mostrado el Señor Jehová: y he aquí, él criaba langostas al principio que comenzaba á crecer el heno tardío; y he aquí, era el heno tardío después de las siegas del rey.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.WEB: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord GOD, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass that, when they made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I beseech thee: how shall Jacob stand? for he is small.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando eles terminaram de comer a plantação da terra, eu disse: Senhor DEUS, perdoa, por favor; como Jacó poderá sobreviver? Pois é pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que como acabó de comer la hierba de la tierra, yo dije: Señor Jehová, perdona ahora; ¿quién levantará á Jacob? porque es pequeño.

verses.KJV: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Jehovah repented concerning this: It shall not be, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] o SENHOR se arrependeu disso: Isto não acontecerá,disse o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Arrepintióse Jehová de esto: No será, dijo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
verses.WEB: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.
verses.ASV: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, the Lord Jehovah called to contend by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and would have eaten up the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o Senhor DEUS me fez ver: eis que o Senhor DEUS pretendeu executar juízo com fogo; e consumiu um grande abismo, assim como consumiu uma parte da terra.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová me mostró así: y he aquí, llamaba para juzgar por fuego el Señor Jehová; y consumió un gran abismo, y consumió una parte de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Lord GOD, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee: how shall Jacob stand? for he is small.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Senhor DEUS, cessa, por favor; como Jacó poderá sobreviver? Pois é pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: Señor Jehová, cesa ahora; ¿quién levantará á Jacob? porque es pequeño.

verses.KJV: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: The LORD relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Jehovah repented concerning this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: [E] o SENHOR se arrependeu disso: Isto também não acontecerá, disse o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Arrepintióse Jehová de esto: No será esto tampoco, dijo el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
verses.WEB: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
verses.ASV: Thus he showed me: and, behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim ele me fez ver: Eis que o Senhor estava sobre um muro que havia sido feito conforme o prumo, e havia um prumo em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Enseñóme así: he aquí, el Señor estaba sobre un muro hecho á plomo, y en su mano una plomada de albañil.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumb-line. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumb-line in the midst of my people Israel; I will not again pass by them any more;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me disse: O que vês, Amós? E eu disse: Um prumo. Então o Senhor disse: Eis que eu porei um prumo no meio de meu povo Israel; não mais o tolerarei.
verses.RVR09: Jehová entonces me dijo: ¿Qué ves, Amós? Y dije: Una plomada de albañil. Y el Señor dijo: He aquí, yo pongo plomada de albañil en medio de mi pueblo Israel: no le pasaré más:

verses.KJV: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.WEB: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
verses.ASV: and the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os altos de idolatria de Isaque serão arruinados, e os santuários de Israel serão arruinados; e me levantarei com espada contra a casa de Jeroboão.
verses.RVR09: Y los altares de Isaac serán destruídos, y los santuarios de Israel serán asolados; y levantaréme con espada sobre la casa de Jeroboam.

verses.KJV: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.WEB: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.ASV: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Amazias, o sacerdote de Betel, mandou mensagem a Jeroboão, rei de Israel, dizendo: Amós tem conspirado contra ti no meio da casa de Israel; esta terra não poderá suportar todas as suas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Amasías sacerdote de Beth-el envió á decir á Jeroboam, rey de Israel: Amós se ha conjurado contra ti en medio de la casa de Israel: la tierra no puede sufrir todas sus palabras.

verses.KJV: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
verses.WEB: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
verses.ASV: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz Amós: Jeroboão morrerá a espada, e Israel certamente será levado de sua terra em cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Amós: Jeroboam morirá á cuchillo, é Israel pasará de su tierra en cautiverio.

verses.KJV: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
verses.WEB: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,
verses.ASV: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thou away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Amazias disse a Amós: Vidente, vai embora, e foge para a terra de Judá, e ali come o teu pão, e ali profetiza;
verses.RVR09: Y Amasías dijo á Amós: Vidente, vete, y huye á tierra de Judá, y come allá tu pan, y profetiza allí:

verses.KJV: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
verses.WEB: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
verses.ASV: but prophesy not again any more at Beth-el; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não profetizes mais em Betel, porque ali estão o santuário do rei, e o palácio real.
verses.RVR09: Y no profetices más en Beth-el, porque es santuario del rey, y cabecera del reino.

verses.KJV: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
verses.WEB: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;
verses.ASV: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdsman, and a dresser of sycomore-trees:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Amós respondeu a Amazias: Eu não era profeta, nem filho de profeta; mas eu era criador de gado, e colhedor de frutos de sicômoros.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Amós, y dijo á Amasías: No soy profeta, ni soy hijo de profeta, sino que soy boyero, y cogedor de cabrahigos:

verses.KJV: And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
verses.WEB: and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
verses.ASV: and Jehovah took me from following the flock, and Jehovah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR me tomou do trabalho com o gado, e o SENHOR me disse: Vai, e profetiza a meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová me tomó de tras el ganado, y díjome Jehová: Ve, y profetiza á mi pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
verses.WEB: Now therefore listen to the LORD’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’
verses.ASV: Now therefore hear thou the word of Jehovah: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not [thy word] against the house of Isaac;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, ouve a palavra do SENHOR. Tu dizes: Não profetizes contra Israel, nem fales contra a casa de Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, oye palabra de Jehová. Tú dices: No profetices contra Israel, ni hables contra la casa de Isaac:

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou thyself shalt die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, assim diz o SENHOR: Tua mulher se prostituirá na cidade, teus filhos e tuas filhas cairão à espada, e tua terra será repartida; tu morrerás em uma terra impura, e Israel será levado cativo de sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: Tu mujer fornicará en la ciudad, y tus hijos y tus hijas caerán á cuchillo, y tu tierra será partida por suertes; y tú morirás en tierra inmunda, é Israel será traspasado de su tierra.

verses.KJV: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
verses.WEB: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.
verses.ASV: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, a basket of summer fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o SENHOR me fez ver: eis um cesto com frutos de verão.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ me ha mostrado Jehová: y he aquí un canastillo de fruta de verano.

verses.KJV: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.WEB: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.ASV: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said Jehovah unto me, The end is come upon my people Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: O que vês, Amós? E eu disse: Um cesto com frutos de verão. Então o SENHOR me disse: Chegou o fim sobre meu povo Israel; não mais o tolerarei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿Qué ves, Amós? Y dije: Un canastillo de fruta de verano. Y díjome Jehová: Venido ha el fin sobre mi pueblo Israel; no le pasaré más.

verses.KJV: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord God: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
verses.WEB: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord GOD. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.
verses.ASV: And the songs of the temple shall be wailings in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah: the dead bodies shall be many; in every place shall they cast them forth with silence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cânticos do templo serão gemidos naquele dia,diz o Senhor DEUS; os cadáveres serão muitos, em todo lugar serão lançados. Silêncio!
verses.RVR09: Y los cantores del templo aullarán en aquel día, dice el Señor Jehová; muchos serán los cuerpos muertos; en todo lugar echados serán en silencio.

verses.KJV: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
verses.WEB: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
verses.ASV: Hear this, O ye that would swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi isto, vós que tragais os necessitados, e arruinais os pobres da terra,
verses.RVR09: Oid esto, los que tragáis á los menesterosos, y arruináis los pobres de la tierra,

verses.KJV: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
verses.WEB: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;
verses.ASV: saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Quando passará a lua nova, para vendermos o alimento? E o sábado, para abriremos os depósitos de trigo, e diminuirmos a medida, aumentarmos o preço, e fraudarmos com balanças enganosas,
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Cuándo pasará el mes, y venderemos el trigo; y la semana, y abriremos los alfolíes del pan, y achicaremos la medida, y engrandeceremos el precio, y falsearemos el peso engañoso;

verses.KJV: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
verses.WEB: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”
verses.ASV: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para comprarmos os pobres por dinheiro, e os necessitados por um par de sapatos, e venderemos os refugos do trigo?
verses.RVR09: Para comprar los pobres por dinero, y los necesitados por un par de zapatos, y venderemos las aechaduras del trigo?

verses.KJV: The Lord hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.WEB: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR jurou pela glória de Jacó: Eu nunca me esquecerei das obras deles.
verses.RVR09: Jehová juró por la gloria de Jacob: No me olvidaré para siempre de todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.
verses.ASV: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? yea, it shall rise up wholly like the River; and it shall be troubled and sink again, like the River of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra não se abalará por causa disto, e todo habitante dela não chorará? Certamente ela se levantará como um rio, se agitará, e se afundará como o rio do Egito.
verses.RVR09: ¿No se ha de estremecer la tierra sobre esto? ¿y todo habitador de ella no llorará? y subirá toda como un río, y será arrojada, y hundiráse como el río de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia,diz o Senhor DEUS, que farei o sol se pôr ao meio-dia, e escurecerei a terra no dia claro.
verses.RVR09: Y acaecerá en aquel día, dice el Señor Jehová, que haré se ponga el sol al mediodía, y la tierra cubriré de tinieblas en el día claro.

verses.KJV: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.WEB: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.
verses.ASV: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning for an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tornarei vossas festas em luto, e todas as vossas canções em pranto; e farei com que todos se vistam de saco, e se façam calvas sobre todas as cabeças; e farei com que haja luto como de um filho único, e seu fim será como um dia amargo.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaré vuestras fiestas en lloro, y todos vuestros cantares en endechas; y haré poner saco sobre todos lomos, y peladura sobre toda cabeza; y tornaréla como en llanto de unigénito, y su postrimería como día amargo.

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord:
verses.WEB: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the LORD’s words.
verses.ASV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vêm dias,diz o Senhor DEUS, nos quais enviarei fome à terra; fome não de pão, nem sede de água, mas sim de ouvir as palavras do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí vienen días, dice el Señor Jehová, en los cuales enviaré hambre á la tierra, no hambre de pan, ni sed de agua, sino de oir palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.
verses.WEB: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD’s word, and will not find it.
verses.ASV: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, and shall not find it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irão sem rumo de mar a mar, do norte até o oriente; correrão de um lado para o outro em busca da palavra do SENHOR, mas não a encontrarão.
verses.RVR09: E irán errantes de mar á mar: desde el norte hasta el oriente discurrirán buscando palabra de Jehová, y no la hallarán.

verses.KJV: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
verses.WEB: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.
verses.ASV: In that day shall the fair virgins and the young men faint for thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo as belas virgens e os rapazes desmaiarão de sede.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo las doncellas hermosas y los mancebos desmayarán de sed.

verses.KJV: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.WEB: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”
verses.ASV: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, As thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, As the way of Beer-sheba liveth; they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos que juram pelo pecado de Samaria, e dizem: Vive o teu deus de Dã; e: Vive o caminho de Berseba; esses cairão, e nunca mais se levantarão.
verses.RVR09: Los que juran por el pecado de Samaria, y dicen, Vive tu Dios de Dan: y, Vive el camino de Beer-seba: caerán, y nunca más se levantarán.

verses.KJV: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
verses.WEB: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.
verses.ASV: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar: and he said, Smite the capitals, that the thresholds may shake; and break them in pieces on the head of all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: there shall not one of them flee away, and there shall not one of them escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi o Senhor que estava sobre o altar, e disse: Fere o topo das colunas, para que se estremeçam os umbrais; despedaça-os sobre as cabeça de todos; e os últimos deles matarei à espada; não haverá entre eles que fuja, nem quem se livre.
verses.RVR09: VI al Señor que estaba sobre el altar, y dijo: Hiere el umbral, y estremézcanse las puertas: y córtales en piezas la cabeza de todos; y el postrero de ellos mataré á cuchillo: no habrá de ellos quien se fugue, ni quien escape.

verses.KJV: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
verses.WEB: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
verses.ASV: Though they dig into Sheol, thence shall my hand take them; and though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que cavassem até o Xeol, dali minha mão os tirará; e se subissem até o céu, dali os farei descer.
verses.RVR09: Aunque cavasen hasta el infierno, de allá los tomará mi mano; y si subieren hasta el cielo, de allá los haré descender.

verses.KJV: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
verses.WEB: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.
verses.ASV: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and it shall bite them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se se escondessem no topo do Carmelo, ali eu os buscaria e os tomaria; e ainda que se escondessem de diante de meus olhos no fundo do mar, até ali mandia uma serpente para os morder.
verses.RVR09: Y si se escondieren en la cumbre del Carmelo, allí los buscaré y los tomaré; y aunque se escondieren de delante de mis ojos en el profundo de la mar, allí mandaré á la culebra, y morderálos.

verses.KJV: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
verses.WEB: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.
verses.ASV: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se forem levados em cativeiro diante de seus inimigos, ali mandarei a espada que os matará; e porei meus olhos sobre eles para o mal, e não para o bem.
verses.RVR09: Y si fueren en cautiverio, delante de sus enemigos, allí mandaré al cuchillo, y los matará; y pondré sobre ellos mis ojos para mal, y no para bien.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.WEB: For the Lord, the GOD of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
verses.ASV: For the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, [is] he that toucheth the land and it melteth, and all that dwell therein shall mourn; and it shall rise up wholly like the River, and shall sink again, like the River of Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos é o que toca a terra, e ela se derrete, e choram todos os que nela moram; ela toda subirá como um rio, e se afundará como o rio do Egito.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová de los ejércitos es el que toca la tierra, y se derretirá, y llorarán todos los que en ella moran: y subirá toda como un río, y hundiráse luego como el río de Egipto.

verses.KJV: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.
verses.WEB: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—the LORD is his name.
verses.ASV: [it is] he that buildeth his chambers in the heavens, and hath founded his vault upon the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth; Jehovah is his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele edificou suas câmaras no céu, e fundou seu alicerce sobre a terra; ele chama as águas do mar e as derrama sobre a terra. EU-SOU é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: El edificó en el cielo sus gradas, y ha establecido su expansión sobre la tierra: él llama las aguas de la mar, y sobre la haz de la tierra las derrama: Jehová es su nombre.

verses.KJV: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.WEB: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says the LORD. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.ASV: Are ye not as the children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith Jehovah. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, filhos de Israel, por acaso não sois para mim como os filhos de Etíopes? Diz o SENHOR. Por acaso eu não fiz subir a Israel desde a terra do Egito, assim como os filisteus desde Caftor, e os sírios desde Quir?
verses.RVR09: Hijos de Israel, ¿no me sois vosotros, dice Jehová, como hijos de Etiopes? ¿no hice yo subir á Israel de la tierra de Egipto, y á los Palestinos de Caphtor, y de Chîr á los Arameos?

verses.KJV: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; save that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os olhos do Senhor DEUS estão contra este reino pecador, e eu o exterminarei da face da terra; mas não exterminarei por completo a casa de Jacó, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí los ojos del Señor Jehová están contra el reino pecador, y yo lo asolaré de la haz de la tierra: mas no destruiré del todo la casa de Jacob, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
verses.WEB: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.
verses.ASV: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, like as [grain] is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least kernel fall upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que dou ordem para que a casa de Israel seja cirandada entre todas as nações, assim como [o grão] é cirandado na peneira, e nenhum grão cairá na terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí yo mandaré, y haré que la casa de Israel sea zarandeada entre todas las gentes, como se zarandea el grano en un harnero, y no cae un granito en la tierra.

verses.KJV: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
verses.WEB: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
verses.ASV: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, The evil shall not overtake nor meet us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Morrerão à espada todos os pecadores de meu povo, que dizem: O mal não chegará a nós, nem nos encontrará.
verses.RVR09: A cuchillo morirán todos los pecadores de mi pueblo, que dicen: No se acercará, ni nos alcanzará el mal.

verses.KJV: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
verses.WEB: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,
verses.ASV: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia voltarei a levantar a caída tenda de Davi; fecharei seus brechas, repararei suas ruínas, e a reconstruirei como nos dias antigos,
verses.RVR09: En aquel día yo levantaré el tabernáculo de David, caído, y cerraré sus portillos, y levantaré sus ruinas, y edificarélo como en el tiempo pasado;

verses.KJV: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord that doeth this.
verses.WEB: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says the LORD who does this.
verses.ASV: that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and all the nations that are called by my name, saith Jehovah that doeth this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que tomem posse do restante de Edom, e todas as nações que se chamam pelo meu nome, diz o SENHOR, que faz isto.
verses.RVR09: Para que aquellos sobre los cuales es llamado mi nombre, posean el resto de Idumea, y á todas las naciones, dice Jehová que hace esto.

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
verses.WEB: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.
verses.ASV: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que o que ara alcançará ao que colhe, e o que pisa as uvas ao que leva a semente; e os montes destilarão suco de uva, e todos os morros se derreterão.
verses.RVR09: He aquí vienen días, dice Jehová, en que el que ara alcanzará al segador, y el pisador de las uvas al que lleva la simiente; y los montes destilarán mosto, y todos los collados se derretirán.

verses.KJV: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.WEB: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.
verses.ASV: And I will bring back the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E restaurarei meu povo Isarael de seu infortúnio; então reconstruirão as cidades assoladas, e nelas habitarão; e plantarão vinhas, e beberão o vinho delas; e farão jardins, e comerão o fruto deles.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaré el cautiverio de mi pueblo Israel, y edificarán ellos las ciudades asoladas, y las habitarán; y plantarán viñas, y beberán el vino de ellas; y harán huertos, y comerán el fruto de ellos.

verses.KJV: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them, saith Jehovah thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu os plantarei em sua terra, e nunca mais serão arrancados de sua terra, que eu lhes dei, diz o SENHOR, teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pues los plantaré sobre su tierra, y nunca más serán arrancados de su tierra que yo les dí, ha dicho Jehová Dios tuyo.

verses.KJV: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
verses.WEB: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
verses.ASV: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning Edom: We have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visão de Obadias. Assim diz o Senhor DEUS quanto a Edom: Temos ouvido notícias do SENHOR, e mensageiro foi enviado entre as nações; levantai-vos, e nos levantaremos em batalha contra ela.
verses.RVR09: VISIÓN de Abdías. El Señor Jehová ha dicho así cuanto á Edom: Oído hemos el pregón de Jehová, y mensajero es enviado á las gentes. Levantaos, y levantémonos contra ella en batalla.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have made thee small among the nations: thou art greatly despised.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu te faço pequeno entre as nações; tu és muito desprezado.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, pequeño te he hecho entre las gentes; abatido eres tú en gran manera.

verses.KJV: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verses.WEB: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
verses.ASV: The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verses.ALMEIDA: A arrogância de teu coração te enganou, tu que habitas nas fendas das rochas, em teu alta morada; que dizes em teu coração: Quem me derrubará ao chão?
verses.RVR09: La soberbia de tu corazón te ha engañado, tú que moras en las hendiduras de las peñas, en tu altísima morada; que dices en tu corazón: ¿Quién me derribará á tierra?

verses.KJV: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Though thou mount on high as the eagle, and though thy nest be set among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se te elevares como a águia, e se puseres teu ninho entre as estrelas, dali eu te derrubarei,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Si te encaramares como águila, y si entre las estrellas pusieres tu nido, de ahí te derribaré, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?
verses.WEB: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
verses.ASV: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night (how art thou cut off!), would they not steal [only] till they had enough? if grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ladrões viessem a ti, ou assaltantes de noite, não furtariam [apenas] o que lhes bastasse? Se vindimadores viessem a ti, por acaso eles não deixariam algumas sobras? [Porém tu] , como estás arrasado!
verses.RVR09: Si ladrones vinieran á ti, ó robadores de noche (¡cómo has sido destruído!) ¿no hurtaran lo que les bastase? Pues si entraran á ti vendimiadores, aun dejaran algún rebusco.

verses.KJV: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
verses.WEB: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
verses.ASV: How are [the things of] Esau searched! how are his hidden treasures sought out!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como Esaú foi saqueado! Como seus tesouros foram tomados!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cómo fueron escudriñadas las cosas de Esaú! sus cosas escondidas fueron buscadas.

verses.KJV: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
verses.WEB: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
verses.ASV: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee on thy way, even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; [they that eat] thy bread lay a snare under thee: there is no understanding in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os teus aliados te moveram até as fronteiras; os que têm acordo de paz contigo te enganaram, prevaleceram contra ti; [os que comem] do teu pão porão armadilha para ti, (nele não há entendimento).
verses.RVR09: Hasta el término te hicieron llegar todos tus aliados; te han engañado tus pacíficos, prevalecieron contra ti; los que comían tu pan, pusieron el lazo debajo de ti: no hay en él entendimiento.

verses.KJV: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
verses.WEB: “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
verses.ASV: Shall I not in that day, saith Jehovah, destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não será naquele dia,diz o SENHOR, que farei perecer os sábios de Edom, e o entendimento da montanha de Esaú?
verses.RVR09: ¿No haré que perezcan en aquel día, dice Jehová, los sabios de Edom, y la prudencia del monte de Esaú?

verses.KJV: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
verses.WEB: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
verses.ASV: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teus guerreiros, ó Temã, ficarão atemorizados; para que cada um da montanha de Esaú seja exterminado pela matança.
verses.RVR09: Y tus valientes, oh Temán, serán quebrantados; porque todo hombre será talado del monte de Esaú por el estrago.

verses.KJV: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
verses.WEB: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
verses.ASV: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da violência feita a teu irmão Jacó, a vergonha te cobrirá; e serás exterminado para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Por la injuria de tu hermano Jacob te cubrirá vergüenza, y serás talado para siempre.

verses.KJV: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
verses.WEB: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
verses.ASV: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia em que estavas diante [dele] , no dia em que estrangeiros levavam cativo seu exército, e estranhos entravam por suas portas e repartiam a posse de Jerusalém, tu também eras como um deles.
verses.RVR09: El día que estando tú delante, llevaban extraños cautivo su ejército, y los extraños entraban por sus puertas, y echaban suertes sobre Jerusalem, tú también eras como uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
verses.WEB: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
verses.ASV: But look not thou on the day of thy brother in the day of his disaster, and rejoice not over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither speak proudly in the day of distress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu não devias olhar com prazer para o dia de teu irmão, o dia em que ele foi exilado; não devias te alegrar dos filhos de Judá no dia da ruína deles, nem falar com arrogância no dia da angústia;
verses.RVR09: Pues no debiste tú estar mirando en el día de tu hermano, el día en que fué extrañado: no te habías de haber alegrado de los hijos de Judá en el día que se perdieron, ni habías de ensanchar tu boca en el día de la angustia:

verses.KJV: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
verses.WEB: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
verses.ASV: Enter not into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, look not thou on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither lay ye [hands] on their substance in the day of their calamity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem devias ter entrado pela porta de meu povo no dia de sua calamidade; não devias ter olhado seu mal no dia de sua calamidade, nem ter roubado seus bens no dia de sua calamidade.
verses.RVR09: No habías de haber entrado por la puerta de mi pueblo en el día de su quebrantamiento; no, no habías tú de haber mirado su mal el día de su quebranto, ni haber echado mano á sus bienes el día de su calamidad.

verses.KJV: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
verses.WEB: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
verses.ASV: And stand thou not in the crossway, to cut off those of his that escape; and deliver not up those of his that remain in the day of distress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem devias ter ficado parado nas encruzilhadas, para exterminar os que dela escapassem; nem devias ter entregue os sobreviventes no dia da angústia.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco habías de haberte parado en las encrucijadas, para matar los que de ellos escapasen; ni habías tú de haber entregado los que quedaban en el día de angustia.

verses.KJV: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
verses.WEB: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
verses.ASV: For the day of Jehovah is near upon all the nations: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; thy dealing shall return upon thine own head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque perto está o dia do SENHOR sobre todas as nações; como tu fizeste, assim se fará a ti; o pagamento devido voltará sobre tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Porque cercano está el día de Jehová sobre todas las gentes: como tú hiciste se hará contigo: tu galardón volverá sobre tu cabeza.

verses.KJV: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
verses.WEB: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
verses.ASV: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the nations drink continually; yea, they shall drink, and swallow down, and shall be as though they had not been.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tal como vós bebestes no meu santo monte, assim também todas as nações beberão continuamente; beberão, e engolirão, e serão como se nunca tivessem existido.
verses.RVR09: De la manera que vosotros bebisteis en mi santo monte, beberán todas las gentes de continuo; beberán, y engullirán, y serán como si no hubieran sido.

verses.KJV: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.WEB: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
verses.ASV: But in mount Zion there shall be those that escape, and it shall be holy; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no monte de Sião haverá livramento, e ele voltará a ser santo; e a casa de Jacó tomará posse de suas propriedades.
verses.RVR09: Mas en el monte de Sión habrá salvamento, y será santidad, y la casa de Jacob, poseerá sus posesiones.

verses.KJV: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
verses.ASV: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall burn among them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining to the house of Esau; for Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa de Jacó será fogo, a casa de José será chama, e os da casa de Esaú serão palha; e se incendiarão contra eles, e os consumirão, de modo que não haverá sobrevivente na casa de Esaú, porque o SENHOR falou.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa de Jacob será fuego, y la casa de José será llama, y la casa de Esaú estopa, y los quemarán, y los consumirán; ni aun reliquia quedará en la casa de Esaú, porque Jehová lo habló.

verses.KJV: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
verses.WEB: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
verses.ASV: And they of the South shall possess the mount of Esau, and they of the lowland the Philistines; and they shall possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria; and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os do Negueve possuirão a montanha de Esaú, e os da planície [tomarão posse da terra dos] filisteus; possuirão também os campos de Efraim, e os campos de Samaria; e Benjamim [tomará posse de] Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y los del mediodía poseerán el monte de Esaú, y los llanos de los Palestinos; poseerán también los campos de Ephraim, y los campos de Samaria; y Benjamín á Galaad.

verses.KJV: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
verses.WEB: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.
verses.ASV: And the captives of this host of the children of Israel, that are [among] the Canaanites, [shall possess] even unto Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, that are in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the South.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cativos deste exército dos filhos de Israel [possuirão] o que era dos cananeus até Sarepta; e os cativos de Jerusalém, que estão em Sefarade, possuirão as cidades do Negueve.
verses.RVR09: Y los cautivos de aqueste ejército de los hijos de Israel poseerán lo de los Cananeos hasta Sarepta; y los cautivos de Jerusalem, que están en Sepharad, poseerán las ciudades del mediodía.

verses.KJV: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's.
verses.WEB: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.
verses.ASV: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E salvadores se levantarão no monte de Sião, para julgarem ao monte de Esaú; e o reino pertencerá ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán salvadores al monte de Sión para juzgar al monte de Esaú; y el reino será de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.WEB: Now the LORD’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.ASV: Now the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jonas, filho de Amitai, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ palabra de Jehová á Jonás, hijo de Amittai, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
verses.WEB: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
verses.ASV: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, vai à grande cidade de Nínive, e prega contra ela; porque sua maldade subiu diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, y ve á Nínive, ciudad grande, y pregona contra ella; porque su maldad ha subido delante de mí.

verses.KJV: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
verses.ASV: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah; and he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jonas se levantou para fugir da presença do SENHOR a Társis, e desceu a Jope; e achou um navio que partia para Társis. Então pagou sua passagem e entrou nele, para ir com eles a Társis [a fim de se distanciar] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonás se levantó para huir de la presencia de Jehová á Tarsis, y descendió á Joppe; y halló un navío que partía para Tarsis; y pagando su pasaje entró en él, para irse con ellos á Tarsis de delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verses.WEB: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah sent out a great wind upon the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR fez levantar um grande vento no mar; e fez-se uma tempestade tão grande no mar, que o navio estava a ponto de se quebrar.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová hizo levantar un gran viento en la mar, é hízose una tan gran tempestad en la mar, que pensóse se rompería la nave.

verses.KJV: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verses.WEB: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
verses.ASV: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god; and they cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it unto them. But Jonah was gone down into the innermost parts of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os marinheiros tiveram medo, e cada um clamava a seu deus; e lançaram no mar os objetos que havia no navio, para com eles diminuir o peso. Jonas, porém, havia descido ao interior do navio, e se pôs a dormir profundamente.
verses.RVR09: Y los marineros tuvieron miedo, y cada uno llamaba á su dios: y echaron á la mar los enseres que había en la nave, para descargarla de ellos. Jonás empero se había bajado á los lados del buque, y se había echado á dormir.

verses.KJV: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
verses.WEB: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”
verses.ASV: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o capitão do navio se aproximou dele, e lhe disse: Que há contigo, dorminhoco? Levanta-te, e clama a teu deus; talvez ele se lembre de nós, para que não pereçamos.
verses.RVR09: Y el maestre de la nave se llegó á él, y le dijo: ¿Qué tienes, dormilón? Levántate, y clama á tu Dios; quizá él tendrá compasión de nosotros, y no pereceremos.

verses.KJV: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
verses.WEB: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.ASV: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram cada um a seu companheiro: Vinde, e lancemos sortes, para sabermos por causa de quem este mal [veio] sobre nós. Então lançaram sortes, e a sorte caiu sobre Jonas.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron cada uno á su compañero: Venid, y echemos suertes, para saber por quién nos ha venido este mal. Y echaron suertes, y la suerte cayó sobre Jonás.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
verses.WEB: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”
verses.ASV: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; what is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles lhe disseram: Conta-nos, por favor, por que nos este mal nos [veio] . Qual é a tua profissão, e de onde vens? Qual é a tua terra, e de que povo és?
verses.RVR09: Entonces le dijeron ellos: Decláranos ahora por qué nos ha venido este mal. ¿Qué oficio tienes, y de dónde vienes? ¿cuál es tu tierra, y de qué pueblo eres?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, I am a Hebrew; and I fear Jehovah, the God of heaven, who hath made the sea and the dry land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Sou hebreu, e temo ao SENHOR, o Deus dos céu, que fez o mar e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y él les respondió: Hebreo soy, y temo á Jehová, Dios de los cielos, que hizo la mar y la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him. Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
verses.WEB: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
verses.ASV: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, What is this that thou hast done? For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Jehovah, because he had told them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aqueles homens tiveram um grande medo, e lhe disseram: Por que fizeste isto? Pois aqueles homens sabiam que ele estava fugindo do SENHOR, porque ele já havia lhes dito.
verses.RVR09: Y aquellos hombres temieron sobremanera, y dijéronle: ¿Por qué has hecho esto? Porque ellos entendieron que huía de delante de Jehová, porque se lo había declarado.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
verses.WEB: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
verses.ASV: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea grew more and more tempestuous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe disseram: O que faremos contigo, para que o mar se nos aquiete?Porque o mar cada vez mais se embravecia.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: ¿Qué te haremos, para que la mar se nos quiete? porque la mar iba á más, y se embravecía.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Tomai-me, e lançai-me ao mar, e o mar se vos aquietará; porque eu sei que foi por minha causa que esta grande tempestade [veio] sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: El les respondió: Tomadme, y echadme á la mar, y la mar se os quietará: porque yo sé que por mí ha venido esta grande tempestad sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not: for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os homens se esforçavam para remar, tentando voltar à terra firme; porém não conseguiam, porque o mar cada vez mais se embravecia sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y aquellos hombres trabajaron por tornar la nave á tierra; mas no pudieron, porque la mar iba á más, y se embravecía sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore they cried unto the Lord, and said, We beseech thee, O Lord, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O Lord, hast done as it pleased thee.
verses.WEB: Therefore they cried to the LORD, and said, “We beg you, LORD, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, LORD, have done as it pleased you.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore they cried unto Jehovah, and said, We beseech thee, O Jehovah, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood; for thou, O Jehovah, hast done as it pleased thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamaram ao SENHOR, e disseram: Ó SENHOR, nós te pedimos para não perecermos por causa da alma deste homem, nem ponhas sangue inocente sobre nós; porque, tu, SENHOR, fizeste como te agradou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces clamaron á Jehová, y dijeron: Rogámoste ahora, Jehová, que no perezcamos nosotros por la vida de aqueste hombre, ni pongas sobre nosotros la sangre inocente: porque tú, Jehová, has hecho como has querido.

verses.KJV: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
verses.WEB: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
verses.ASV: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea; and the sea ceased from its raging.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomaram a Jonas, e o lançaram ao mar; e o mar se aquietou de seu furor.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron á Jonás, y echáronlo á la mar; y la mar se quietó de su furia.

verses.KJV: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the Lord, and made vows.
verses.WEB: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows.
verses.ASV: Then the men feared Jehovah exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice unto Jehovah, and made vows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso aqueles homens temeram ao SENHOR [com] grande temor; e ofereceram sacrifício ao SENHOR, e prometeram votos.
verses.RVR09: Y temieron aquellos hombres á Jehová con gran temor; y ofrecieron sacrificio á Jehová, y prometieron votos.

verses.KJV: Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.WEB: The LORD prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah; and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR havia preparado um grande peixe para que tragasse a Jonas; e Jonas esteve três dias e três noites no ventre do peixe.

verses.KJV: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish's belly,
verses.WEB: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
verses.ASV: Then Jonah prayed unto Jehovah his God out of the fish’s belly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jonas orou ao SENHOR seu Deus, desde as entranhas do peixe,
verses.RVR09: MAS Jehová había prevenido un gran pez que tragase á Jonás: y estuvo Jonás en el vientre del pez tres días y tres noches.

verses.KJV: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
verses.WEB: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
verses.ASV: And he said, I called by reason of mine affliction unto Jehovah, And he answered me; Out of the belly of Sheol cried I, [And] thou heardest my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Clamei da minha angústia ao SENHOR, e ele me respondeu; do ventre do Xeol gritei, [e] tu ouviste minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Y oró Jonás desde el vientre del pez á Jehová su Dios,

verses.KJV: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
verses.WEB: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
verses.ASV: For thou didst cast me into the depth, in the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me; All thy waves and thy billows passed over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu me lançaste no profundo, no meio dos mares, e a correnteza me cercou; todas as tuas ondas e tuas vagas passaram sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Clamé de mi tribulación á Jehová, y él me oyó; del vientre del sepulcro clamé, y mi voz oiste.

verses.KJV: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
verses.WEB: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
verses.ASV: And I said, I am cast out from before thine eyes; Yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
