verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Lançado estou de diante de teus olhos; porém voltarei a ver o teu santo templo.
verses.RVR09: Echásteme en el profundo, en medio de los mares, y rodeóme la corriente; todas tus ondas y tus olas pasaron sobre mí.

verses.KJV: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.WEB: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
verses.ASV: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas me cercaram até a alma, o abismo me rodeou; as algas se enrolaram à minha cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: Echado soy de delante de tus ojos: mas aun veré tu santo templo.

verses.KJV: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.
verses.WEB: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.
verses.ASV: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with its bars [closed] upon me for ever: Yet hast thou brought up my life from the pit, O Jehovah my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desci aos fundamentos dos montes; a terra trancou suas fechaduras a mim para sempre; porém tu tiraste minha vida da destruição, ó SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Las aguas me rodearon hasta el alma, rodeóme el abismo; la ova se enredó á mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
verses.WEB: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
verses.ASV: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Jehovah; And my prayer came in unto thee, into thy holy temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando minha alma desfalecia em mim, eu me lembrei do SENHOR; e minha oração chegou a ti em teu santo templo.
verses.RVR09: Descendí á las raíces de los montes; la tierra echó sus cerraduras sobre mí para siempre: mas tú sacaste mi vida de la sepultura, oh Jehová Dios mío.

verses.KJV: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
verses.WEB: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
verses.ASV: They that regard lying vanities Forsake their own mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que dão atenção a coisas inúteis e ilusórias abandonam sua própria misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Cuando mi alma desfallecía en mí, acordéme de Jehová; y mi oración entró hasta ti en tu santo templo.

verses.KJV: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”
verses.ASV: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu porém sacrificarei a ti com voz de gratidão; pagarei o que prometi. A salvação [vem] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Los que guardan las vanidades ilusorias, su misericordia abandonan.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou ao peixe, e este vomitou a Jonas em terra firme.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero con voz de alabanza te sacrificaré; pagaré lo que prometí. La salvación pertenece á Jehová. Y mandó Jehová al pez, y vomitó á Jonás en tierra.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR veio pela segunda vez a Jonas, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ palabra de Jehová segunda vez á Jonás, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
verses.WEB: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
verses.ASV: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, e vai à grande cidade de Nínive, e prega contra ela a pregação que eu te falo.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, y ve á Nínive, aquella gran ciudad, y publica en ella el pregón que yo te diré.

verses.KJV: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.
verses.WEB: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to the LORD’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
verses.ASV: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of Jehovah. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city, of three days’ journey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jonas se levantou, e foi a Nínive, conforme a palavra do SENHOR. E Nínive era cidade extremamente grande, de três dias de caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Jonás, y fué á Nínive, conforme á la palabra de Jehová. Y era Nínive ciudad sobremanera grande, de tres días de camino.

verses.KJV: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
verses.WEB: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
verses.ASV: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jonas começou a entrar pela cidade, caminho de um dia, e pregava dizendo: Daqui a quarenta dias Nínive será destruída.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó Jonás á entrar por la ciudad, camino de un día, y pregonaba diciendo: De aquí á cuarenta días Nínive será destruída.

verses.KJV: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verses.WEB: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
verses.ASV: And the people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens de Nínive creram em Deus; e convocaram um jejum, e se vestiram de sacos, desde o maior até o menor deles.
verses.RVR09: Y los hombres de Nínive creyeron á Dios, y pregonaron ayuno, y vistiéronse de sacos desde el mayor de ellos hasta el menor de ellos.

verses.KJV: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.WEB: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.ASV: And the tidings reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando esta palavra chegou ao rei de Nínive, ele se levantou de seu trono, e lançou de si sua roupa, e cobriu-se de saco, e se sentou em cinzas.
verses.RVR09: Y llegó el negocio hasta el rey de Nínive, y levantóse de su silla, y echó de sí su vestido, y cubrióse de saco, y se sentó sobre ceniza.

verses.KJV: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
verses.WEB: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
verses.ASV: And he made proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
verses.ALMEIDA: E convocou e anunciou em Nínive, por mandado do rei e de seus maiorais, dizendo: Nem pessoas nem animais, nem bois nem ovelhas, provem coisa alguma, nem se lhes dê alimento, nem bebam água;
verses.RVR09: E hizo pregonar y anunciar en Nínive, por mandado del rey y de sus grandes, diciendo: Hombres y animales, bueyes y ovejas, no gusten cosa alguna, no se les dé alimento, ni beban agua:

verses.KJV: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
verses.WEB: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
verses.ASV: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and beast, and let them cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que as pessoas e os animais se cubram de saco, e clamem fortemente a Deus; e convertam- se cada um de seu mau caminho, e da violência que está em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y que se cubran de saco los hombres y los animales, y clamen á Dios fuertemente: y conviértase cada uno de su mal camino, de la rapiña que está en sus manos.

verses.KJV: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
verses.WEB: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
verses.ASV: Who knoweth whether God will not turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem sabe Deus mude de ideia e se arrependa, e se afaste do ardor de sua ira, para não perecermos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién sabe si se volverá y arrepentirá Dios, y se apartará del furor de su ira, y no pereceremos?

verses.KJV: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
verses.WEB: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
verses.ASV: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil which he said he would do unto them; and he did it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus viu a atitude deles, que se converteram de seu mau caminho; então Deus se arrependeu do mal que tinha dito que lhes faria, e não o fez.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Dios lo que hicieron, que se convirtieron de su mal camino: y arrepintióse del mal que había dicho les había de hacer, y no lo hizo.

verses.KJV: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
verses.WEB: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
verses.ASV: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jonas se desgostou muito, e se encheu de ira.
verses.RVR09: PERO Jonás se apesadumbró en extremo, y enojóse.

verses.KJV: And he prayed unto the Lord, and said, I pray thee, O Lord, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
verses.WEB: He prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please, LORD, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.
verses.ASV: And he prayed unto Jehovah, and said, I pray thee, O Jehovah, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I hasted to flee unto Tarshish; for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E orou ao SENHOR, e disse: Ah, SENHOR, não foi isto o que eu dizia enquanto ainda estava em minha terra? Por isso me preveni fugindo a Társis; porque sabia eu que tu és Deus gracioso e misericordioso, que demoras a te irar, tens grande misericórdia, e te arrependes do mal.
verses.RVR09: Y oró á Jehová, y dijo: Ahora, oh Jehová, ¿no es esto lo que yo decía estando aún en mi tierra? Por eso me precaví huyendo á Tarsis: porque sabía yo que tú eres Dios clemente y piadoso, tardo á enojarte, y de grande misericordia, y que te arrepientes del mal.

verses.KJV: Therefore now, O Lord, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
verses.WEB: Therefore now, LORD, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
verses.ASV: Therefore now, O Jehovah, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, ó SENHOR, peço-te que me mates, porque é melhor para mim morrer do que viver.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, oh Jehová, ruégote que me mates; porque mejor me es la muerte que la vida.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord, Doest thou well to be angry?
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Doest thou well to be angry?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR lhe disse: É correta essa tua ira?
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová le dijo: ¿Haces tú bien en enojarte tanto?

verses.KJV: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.WEB: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
verses.ASV: Then Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shade, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jonas saiu da cidade, e se sentou ao oriente da cidade, e fez para si ali uma barraca, e se sentou debaixo dela à sombra, até ver o que seria da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y salióse Jonás de la ciudad, y asentó hacia el oriente de la ciudad, é hízose allí una choza, y se sentó debajo de ella á la sombra, hasta ver qué sería de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
verses.WEB: The LORD God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his evil case. So Jonah was exceeding glad because of the gourd.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR Deus preparou uma planta, e a fez crescer sobre Jonas para que fizesse sombra sobre sua cabeça, e lhe aliviasse de seu mal-estar; e Jonas se alegrou grandemente por causa da planta.
verses.RVR09: Y preparó Jehová Dios una calabacera, la cual creció sobre Jonás para que hiciese sombra sobre su cabeza, y le defendiese de su mal: y Jonás se alegró grandemente por la calabacera.

verses.KJV: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
verses.WEB: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.
verses.ASV: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus preparou uma lagarta no dia seguinte ao amanhecer, a qual feriu a planta, e ela se secou.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios preparó un gusano al venir la mañana del día siguiente, el cual hirió á la calabacera, y secóse.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verses.WEB: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the sun arose, that God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and requested for himself that he might die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, ao levantar do sol, Deus preparou um quente vento oriental; e o sol feriu a Jonas na cabeça, de modo que ele se desmaiava, e desejava a morte, dizendo: Melhor é para mim morrer do que viver.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que al salir el sol, preparó Dios un recio viento solano; y el sol hirió á Jonás en la cabeza, y desmayábase, y se deseaba la muerte, diciendo: Mejor sería para mí la muerte que mi vida.

verses.KJV: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
verses.WEB: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
verses.ASV: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Deus disse a Jonas: É correta a tua ira pela planta?E ele respondeu: É correto eu me irar até a morte.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Dios á Jonás: ¿Tanto te enojas por la calabacera? Y él respondió: Mucho me enojo, hasta la muerte.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Thou hast had regard for the gourd, for which thou hast not labored, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse: Tu tiveste pena da planta, na qual não trabalhaste, nem tu a fizeste crescer, que em uma noite nasceu, e em outra noite pereceu;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: Tuviste tú lástima de la calabacera, en la cual no trabajaste, ni tú la hiciste crecer; que en espacio de una noche nació, y en espacio de otra noche pereció:

verses.KJV: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
verses.WEB: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”
verses.ASV: and should not I have regard for Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
verses.ALMEIDA: E não teria eu pena de Nínive, aquela grande cidade onde há mais de cem e vinte mil pessoas que não sabem a diferença entre sua mão direita e a esquerda, e muitos animais?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y no tendré yo piedad de Nínive, aquella grande ciudad donde hay más de ciento y veinte mil personas que no conocen su mano derecha ni su mano izquierda, y muchos animales?

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra do SENHOR que veio a Miqueias, o morastita, nos dias de Jotão, Acaz, [e] Ezequias, reis de Judá; que ele viu sobre Samaria e Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA de Jehová que fué á Miqueas de Morasti en días de Jotham, Achâz, y Ezechîas, reyes de Judá: lo que vió sobre Samaria y Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.WEB: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.ASV: Hear, ye peoples, all of you; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord Jehovah be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi vós todos os povos; presta atenção tu, ó terra, e tudo o que nela há; pois o Senhor DEUS será testemunha contra vós, o Senhor desde seu santo templo.
verses.RVR09: Oid, pueblos todos: está atenta, tierra, y todo lo que en ella hay: y el Señor Jehová, el Señor desde su santo templo sea testigo contra vosotros.

verses.KJV: For, behold, the Lord cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.WEB: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
verses.ASV: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que SENHOR está saindo de seu lugar, e descerá, e pisará os lugares altos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, Jehová sale de su lugar, y descenderá, y hollará sobre las alturas de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.WEB: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.ASV: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, as waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os montes debaixo dele se derreterão, e os vales se fenderão como a cera diante do fogo, como as águas se derramam por um precipício.
verses.RVR09: Y debajo de él se derretirán los montes, y los valles se hendirán como la cera delante del fuego, como las aguas que corren por un precipicio.

verses.KJV: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.WEB: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
verses.ASV: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto é por causa da transgressão de Jacó e dos pecados da casa de Israel. Qual é a transgressão de Jacó? Não é Samaria? E quais são os altos de Judá? Não é Jerusalém?
verses.RVR09: Todo esto por la rebelión de Jacob, y por los pecados de la casa de Israel. ¿Cuál es la rebelión de Jacob? ¿no es Samaria? ¿Y cuáles son los excelsos de Judá? ¿no es Jerusalem?

verses.KJV: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will make Samaria as a heap of the field, [and] as places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will uncover the foundations thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tornarei a Samaria em amontoado de pedras no campo, em plantação de vinhas; e derrubarei suas pedras no vale, e descobrirei seus fundamentos.
verses.RVR09: Pondré pues á Samaria en majanos de heredad, en tierra de viñas; y derramaré sus piedras por el valle, y descubriré sus fundamentos.

verses.KJV: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
verses.WEB: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
verses.ASV: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her hires shall be burned with fire, and all her idols will I lay desolate; for of the hire of a harlot hath she gathered them, and unto the hire of a harlot shall they return.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas suas imagens de escultura serão esmigalhadas, e todos seus salários de prostituta serão queimados com fogo, e destruirei todos os seus ídolos; porque do salário de prostituta os ajuntou, e para salário de prostituta voltarão.
verses.RVR09: Y todas sus estatuas serán despedazadas, y todos sus dones serán quemados en fuego, y asolaré todos sus ídolos; porque de dones de rameras los juntó, y á dones de rameras volverán.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
verses.WEB: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
verses.ASV: For this will I lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, and a lamentation like the ostriches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto lamentarei e uivarei, e andarei descalço e nu; farei uivos como de chacais, e lamentos como de filhotes de avestruzes.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto lamentaré y aullaré, y andaré despojado y desnudo; haré gemido como de chacales, y lamento como de avestruces.

verses.KJV: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: For her wounds are incurable; for it is come even unto Judah; it reacheth unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque suas feridas são incuráveis, que já chegaram até Judá; [isto] já chegou até a porta do meu povo, até Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Porque su llaga es dolorosa, que llegó hasta Judá; llegó hasta la puerta de mi pueblo, hasta Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.WEB: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
verses.ASV: Tell it not in Gath, weep not at all: at Beth-le-aphrah have I rolled myself in the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não anunciai [isto] em Gate, nem choreis tanto; revolve-te no pó em Bete-Le-Afra.
verses.RVR09: No lo digáis en Gath, ni lloréis mucho: revuélcate en el polvo de Beth-le-aphrah.

verses.KJV: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Bethezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
verses.WEB: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
verses.ASV: Pass away, O inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame: the inhabitant of Zaanan is not come forth; the wailing of Beth-ezel shall take from you the stay thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passa-te com vergonha descoberta, ó moradora de Safir; a moradora de Zaanã não sai; pranto há em Bete-Ezel; seu apoio foi tomado de vós.
verses.RVR09: Pásate desnuda con vergüenza, oh moradora de Saphir: la moradora de Saanán no salió al llanto de Beth-esel: tomará de vosotros su tardanza.

verses.KJV: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the Lord unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: For the inhabitant of Maroth waiteth anxiously for good, because evil is come down from Jehovah unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a moradora de Marote anseiam à espera do bem; pois um mal desceu do SENHOR até a porta de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Porque la moradora de Maroth tuvo dolor por el bien; por cuanto el mal descendió de Jehová hasta la puerta de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
verses.WEB: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
verses.ASV: Bind the chariot to the swift steed, O inhabitant of Lachish: she was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Liga os cavalos à carruagem, ó moradora de Laquis (ela é o princípio do pecado à filha de Sião), porque em ti foram achadas as transgressões de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Unce al carro dromedarios, oh moradora de Lachîs, que fuiste principio de pecado á la hija de Sión; porque en ti se inventaron las rebeliones de Israel.

verses.KJV: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moreshethgath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
verses.WEB: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
verses.ASV: Therefore shalt thou give a parting gift to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing unto the kings of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, tu darás presentes de despedida a Moresete-Gate; as casas de Aczibe serão enganosas aos reis de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, tú darás dones á Moreseth-gath: las casas de Achzib serán en mentira á los reyes de Israel.

verses.KJV: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
verses.WEB: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
verses.ASV: I will yet bring unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah, him that shall possess thee: the glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda trarei a ti um conquistador, ó moradora de Maressa; a glória de Israel virá até Adulão.
verses.RVR09: Aun te traeré heredero, oh moradora de Maresah: la gloria de Israel vendrá hasta Adullam.

verses.KJV: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.WEB: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
verses.ASV: Make thee bald, and cut off thy hair for the children of thy delight: enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faz em ti calva, e rapa-te por causa dos filhos a quem gostavas; aumenta tua calva como a águia; porque foram levados de ti em cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Mésate y trasquílate por los hijos de tus delicias: ensancha tu calva como águila; porque fueron trasportados de ti.

verses.KJV: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.WEB: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.ASV: Woe to them that devise iniquity and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que planejam injustiça, e dos que tramam o mal em suas camas! Quando vem a manhã o efetuam, porque têm o poder em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de los que piensan iniquidad, y de los que fabrican el mal en sus camas! Cuando viene la mañana lo ponen en obra, porque tienen en su mano el poder.

verses.KJV: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.WEB: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.ASV: And they covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobiçam campos, e os roubam; cobiçam casas, e as tomam; oprimem ao homem e a sua casa, ao homem e a sua propriedade.
verses.RVR09: Y codiciaron las heredades, y robáronlas: y casas, y las tomaron: oprimieron al hombre y á su casa, al hombre y á su heredad.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks, neither shall ye walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu planejo um mal contra esta família, da qual não conseguireis livrar vossos pescoços, nem andareis erguidos; porque o tempo será mau.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí, yo pienso sobre esta familia un mal, del cual no sacaréis vuestros cuellos, ni andaréis erguidos; porque el tiempo será malo.

verses.KJV: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
verses.WEB: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
verses.ASV: In that day shall they take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, [and] say, We are utterly ruined: he changeth the portion of my people: how doth he remove [it] from me! to the rebellious he divideth our fields.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo surgirá um provérbio sobre vós, e se lamentará um pranto de lamentação, dizendo: Fomos arruinados por completo; trocada foi a porção de meu povo. Como fomos saqueados! Nossos campos foram repartidos, passados a outros.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo se levantará sobre vosotros refrán, y se endechará endecha de lamentación, diciendo: Del todo fuimos destruídos; ha cambiado la parte de mi pueblo. ¡Cómo nos quitó nuestros campos! dió, repartiólos á otros.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
verses.ASV: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the line by lot in the assembly of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto a ninguém terás que delimite a propriedade de terra por meio de sortes na congregação do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no tendrás quien eche cordel para suerte en la congregación de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
verses.WEB: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
verses.ASV: Prophesy ye not, [thus] they prophesy. They shall not prophesy to these: reproaches shall not depart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não profetizeis! Falam eles. Não lhes profetizarão, [mas] a vergonha não se desviará deles.
verses.RVR09: No profeticéis, dicen á los que profetizan; no les profeticen que los ha de comprender vergüenza.

verses.KJV: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the Lord straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
verses.WEB: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
verses.ASV: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, Is the Spirit of Jehovah straitened? are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso se dirá, ó casa de Jacó: O espírito do SENHOR perdeu a paciência? São estas as suas obras? Por acaso minhas palavras não fazem bem ao que age corretamente?
verses.RVR09: La que te dices casa de Jacob, ¿hase acortado el espíritu de Jehová? ¿son éstas sus obras? ¿Mis palabras no hacen bien al que camina derechamente?

verses.KJV: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
verses.WEB: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
verses.ASV: But of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye strip the robe from off the garment from them that pass by securely [as men] averse from war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas recentemente meu povo se levantou como inimigo; tomastes da roupa a capa daqueles que passavam confiantes, voltando da batalha.
verses.RVR09: El que ayer era mi pueblo, se ha levantado como enemigo: tras las vestiduras quitasteis las capas atrevidamente á los que pasaban, como los que vuelven de la guerra.

verses.KJV: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
verses.WEB: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
verses.ASV: The women of my people ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their young children ye take away my glory for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós expulsais as mulheres de meu povo de suas queridas casas; de suas crianças tirastes minha glória para sempre.
verses.RVR09: A las mujeres de mi pueblo echasteis fuera de las casas de sus delicias: á sus niños quitasteis mi perpetua alabanza.

verses.KJV: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
verses.WEB: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
verses.ASV: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your resting-place; because of uncleanness that destroyeth, even with a grievous destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, e ide embora, porque esta [terra] não serve mais para descanso; pois está contaminada, ela se destruirá, com grande destruição.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, y andad, que no es ésta la holganza; porque está contaminada, corrompióse, y de grande corrupción.

verses.KJV: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
verses.WEB: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
verses.ASV: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood do lie, [saying], I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se houver alguém que siga o vento, e fale mentiras e falsidade, dizendo: Eu te profetizarei vinho e de bebida alcoólica, este tal será o profeta deste povo.
verses.RVR09: Si hubiere alguno que ande con el viento, y finja mentiras diciendo: Yo te profetizaré de vino y de sidra; este tal será profeta á este pueblo.

verses.KJV: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
verses.WEB: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
verses.ASV: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture; they shall make great noise by reason of [the multitude of] men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente eu te ajuntarei por completo, ó Jacó; reunirei o restante de Israel; eu o porei junto, como ovelhas de Bosra, como rebanho no meio de seu curral farão estrondo de [multidão de] pessoas.
verses.RVR09: De cierto te reuniré todo, oh Jacob: recogeré ciertamente el resto de Israel: pondrélo junto como ovejas de Bosra, como rebaño en mitad de su majada: harán estruendo por la multitud de los hombres.

verses.KJV: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the Lord on the head of them.
verses.WEB: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
verses.ASV: The breaker is gone up before them: they have broken forth and passed on to the gate, and are gone out thereat; and their king is passed on before them, and Jehovah at the head of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que rompe [obstáculos] subirá adiante deles; eles romperão, e passarão pela porta, e sairão por ela; e seu rei irá adiante deles, e o SENHOR estará em sua dianteira.
verses.RVR09: Subirá rompedor delante de ellos; romperán y pasarán la puerta, y saldrán por ella: y su rey pasará delante de ellos, y á la cabeza de ellos Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
verses.WEB: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
verses.ASV: And I said, Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: is it not for you to know justice?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Ouvi agora, vós líderes de Jacó, e governantes da casa de Israel; por acaso não é vossa responsabilidade saber o que é justo?
verses.RVR09: Y DIJE: Oid ahora, príncipes de Jacob, y cabezas de la casa de Israel: ¿No pertenecía á vosotros saber el derecho?

verses.KJV: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.WEB: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.ASV: ye who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós odiais o bem e amais o mal; vós roubais a pele dos outros, e a carne de seus ossos;
verses.RVR09: Que aborrecen lo bueno y aman lo malo, que les quitan su piel y su carne de sobre los huesos;

verses.KJV: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.WEB: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
verses.ASV: who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois os que comeis a carne de meu povo, e lhes tirais sua pele, e lhes quebrais seus ossos; e os despedaçais como para a panela, como carne dentro do caldeirão.
verses.RVR09: Que comen asimismo la carne de mi pueblo, y les desuellan su piel de sobre ellos, y les quebrantan sus huesos y los rompen, como para el caldero, y como carnes en olla.

verses.KJV: Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
verses.WEB: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
verses.ASV: Then shall they cry unto Jehovah, but he will not answer them; yea, he will hide his face from them at that time, according as they have wrought evil in their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamareis ao SENHOR, mas ele não vos responderá; ao invés disso esconderá sua face diante de vós naquele tempo, pois praticastes maus atos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces clamarán á Jehová y no les responderá; antes esconderá de ellos su rostro en aquel tiempo, por cuanto hicieron malvadas obras.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
verses.WEB: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that make my people to err; that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and whoso putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR contra os profetas que fazem o meu povo errar, que quando recebem comida proclamam paz, mas declaram guerra contra quem não lhes dá de comer;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová acerca de los profetas que hacen errar á mi pueblo, que muerden con sus dientes, y claman, Paz, y al que no les diere que coman, aplazan contra él batalla:

verses.KJV: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
verses.WEB: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
verses.ASV: Therefore it shall be night unto you, that ye shall have no vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto se vos fará noite por causa da profecia, e trevas por causa da adivinhação; e o sol se porá sobre estes profetas, e o dia se escurecerá sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, de la profecía se os hará noche, y oscuridad del adivinar; y sobre los profetas se pondrá el sol, y el día se entenebrecerá sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
verses.WEB: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
verses.ASV: And the seers shall be put to shame, and the diviners confounded; yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os videntes se envergonharão, e os adivinhos serão humilhados; todos cobrirão o lábio, porque não haverá resposta de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y serán avergonzados los profetas, y confundiránse los adivinos; y ellos todos cubrirán su labio, porque no hay respuesta de Dios.

verses.KJV: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.WEB: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
verses.ASV: But as for me, I am full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu estou cheio do poder do Espírito do SENHOR, e de juízo, e de força, para anunciar a Jacó sua transgressão, e a Israel seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero estoy lleno de fuerza del espíritu de Jehová, y de juicio, y de fortaleza, para denunciar á Jacob su rebelión, y á Israel su pecado.

verses.KJV: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
verses.WEB: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
verses.ASV: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, that abhor justice, and pervert all equity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi agora isto, vós líderes da casa de Jacó, e governantes da casa de Israel, que abominais a justiça, e perverteis tudo o que é justo;
verses.RVR09: Oid ahora esto, cabezas de la casa de Jacob, y capitanes de la casa de Israel, que abomináis el juicio, y pervertís todo el derecho;

verses.KJV: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.WEB: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.ASV: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós edificais a Sião com sangue, e a Jerusalém com injustiça;
verses.RVR09: Que edificáis á Sión con sangre, y á Jerusalem con injusticia;

verses.KJV: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.
verses.WEB: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
verses.ASV: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet they lean upon Jehovah, and say, Is not Jehovah in the midst of us? no evil shall come upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus líderes julgam por suborno, seus sacerdotes ensinam por salário, e seus profetas adivinham por dinheiro; e se apoiam no SENHOR dizendo: Por acaso o SENHOR não está entre nós? Nenhum mal virá sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Sus cabezas juzgan por cohecho, y sus sacerdotes enseñan por precio, y sus profetas adivinan por dinero; y apóyanse en Jehová diciendo: ¿No está Jehová entre nosotros? No vendrá mal sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
verses.WEB: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto por causa de vós Sião será arada como campo, e Jerusalém se tornará um amontoado de pedras, e o monte do templo como os lugares altos de um bosque.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, á causa de vosotros será Sión arada como campo, y Jerusalem será majanos, y el monte de la casa como cumbres de breñal.

verses.KJV: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
verses.WEB: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
verses.ASV: But in the latter days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of Jehovah’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and peoples shall flow unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas acontecerá nos últimos dias que o monte da casa do SENHOR será firmado no cume de montes, e será mais elevado que os morros; e os povos correrão a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECERÁ en los postreros tiempos, que el monte de la casa de Jehová será constituído por cabecera de montes, y más alto que los collados, y correrán á él pueblos.

verses.KJV: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;
verses.ASV: And many nations shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths. For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas nações virão e dirão: Vinde, e subamos ao monte do SENHOR, à casa do Deus de Jacó; e ele nos ensinará seus caminhos, e nós andaremos em suas veredas; porque a lei virá de Sião, e a palavra do SENHOR de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán muchas gentes, y dirán: Venid, y subamos al monte de Jehová, y á la casa del Dios de Jacob; y enseñarános en sus caminos, y andaremos por sus veredas: porque de Sión saldrá la ley, y de Jerusalem la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.WEB: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
verses.ASV: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele julgará entre muitos povos, e corrigirá poderosas nações até muito longe; e adaptarão suas espadas para enxadas, e suas lanças para foices; nação não erguerá espada contra nação, nem mais aprenderão a [fazer] guerra.
verses.RVR09: Y juzgará entre muchos pueblos, y corregirá fuertes gentes hasta muy lejos: y martillarán sus espadas para azadones, y sus lanzas para hoces: no alzará espada gente contra gente, ni más se ensayarán para la guerra.

verses.KJV: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.
verses.ASV: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig-tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of Jehovah of hosts hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada um se sentará debaixo de sua videira e debaixo de sua figueira, e não haverá quem lhes cause medo; porque a boca do SENHOR dos exércitos assim falou.
verses.RVR09: Y cada uno se sentará debajo de su vid y debajo de su higuera, y no habrá quien amedrente: porque la boca de Jehová de los ejércitos lo ha hablado.

verses.KJV: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
verses.ASV: For all the peoples walk every one in the name of his god; and we will walk in the name of Jehovah our God for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos os povos andam cada um no nome de seus deuses; nós, porém, andaremos no nome do SENHOR nosso Deus para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Bien que todos los pueblos anduvieren cada uno en el nombre de sus dioses, nosotros con todo andaremos en el nombre de Jehová nuestro Dios para siempre y eternalmente.

verses.KJV: In that day, saith the Lord, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
verses.WEB: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
verses.ASV: In that day, saith Jehovah, will I assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia,diz o SENHOR, reunirei a que mancava, e ajuntarei a que havia sido expulsa, e a que eu tinha maltratado.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día, dice Jehová, juntaré la coja, y recogeré la amontada, y á la que afligí;

verses.KJV: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
verses.WEB: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
verses.ASV: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Jehovah will reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth even for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei da que mancava um [povo] restante, da que havia sido expulsa uma nação poderosa; e o SENHOR reinará sobre eles no monte de Sião desde agora para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré á la coja para sucesión, y á la descarriada para nación robusta: y Jehová reinará sobre ellos en el monte de Sión desde ahora para siempre.

verses.KJV: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And thou, O tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, yea, the former dominion shall come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, ó torre de vigilância do rebanho, tu fortaleza da filha de Sião, virá a ti o primeiro domínio; o reino chegará à filha de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, oh torre del rebaño, la fortaleza de la hija de Sión vendrá hasta ti: y el señorío primero, el reino vendrá á la hija de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
verses.WEB: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?
verses.ASV: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee, is thy counsellor perished, that pangs have taken hold of thee as of a woman in travail?
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora por que gritas tanto? Não há rei em ti? Pereceu teu conselheiro, para que tenhas sido tomada por dores como as de parto?
verses.RVR09: Ahora ¿por qué gritas tanto? ¿No hay rey en ti? ¿Pereció tu consejero, que te ha tomado dolor como de mujer de parto?

verses.KJV: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
verses.WEB: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
verses.ASV: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and shalt dwell in the field, and shalt come even unto Babylon: there shalt thou be rescued; there will Jehovah redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sofre dores e contorce-te, ó filha de Sião, como mulher em trabalho de parto; porque agora sairás da cidade, e morarás no campo, e virás até a Babilônia; [porém] ali tu serás livrada, ali o SENHOR te redimirá da mão de teus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Duélete y gime, hija de Sión, como mujer de parto; porque ahora saldrás de la ciudad, y morarás en el campo, y llegarás hasta Babilonia: allí serás librada, allí te redimirá Jehová de la mano de tus enemigos.

verses.KJV: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
verses.WEB: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
verses.ASV: And now many nations are assembled against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye see [our desire] upon Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora muitas nações se reuniram contra ti, e dizem: Seja profanada, e nossos olhos vejam a desgraça de Sião.
verses.RVR09: Ahora empero se han juntado muchas gentes contra ti, y dicen: Sea profanada, y vean nuestros ojos su deseo sobre Sión.

verses.KJV: But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
verses.WEB: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.ASV: But they know not the thoughts of Jehovah, neither understand they his counsel; for he hath gathered them as the sheaves to the threshing-floor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas elas não sabem os pensamentos do SENHOR, nem entendem seu conselho; de que ele as ajuntou como a feixes para a eira.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no conocieron los pensamientos de Jehová, ni entendieron su consejo: por lo cual los juntó como gavillas en la era.

verses.KJV: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.WEB: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to the LORD, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.ASV: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; for I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass; and thou shalt beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain unto Jehovah, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te e trilha, ó filha de Sião, porque tornarei teu chifre de ferro, e tuas unhas de bronze, e esmiuçarás muitos povos; e consagrarás ao SENHOR seus ganhos, e seus bens ao Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Levántate y trilla, hija de Sión, porque tu cuerno tornaré de hierro, y tus uñas de metal, y desmenuzarás muchos pueblos; y consagrarás á Jehová sus robos, y sus riquezas al Señor de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.WEB: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
verses.ASV: Now shalt thou gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us; they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora ajunta-te em tropas, ó filha de tropas; fazem cerco ao nosso redor; ferirão ao juiz de Israel com vara no rosto.
verses.RVR09: REÚNETE ahora en bandas, oh hija de bandas: nos han sitiado: con vara herirán sobre la quijada al juez de Israel.

verses.KJV: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
verses.WEB: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
verses.ASV: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephrathah, which art little to be among the thousands of Judah, out of thee shall one come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, Belém Efrata, [ainda que] sejas pequena entre as famílias de Judá, de ti me sairá o que será governador em Israel; e suas saídas são desde o princípio, desde os dias antigos.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Beth-lehem Ephrata, pequeña para ser en los millares de Judá, de ti me saldrá el que será Señor en Israel; y sus salidas son desde el principio, desde los días del siglo.

verses.KJV: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she who travaileth hath brought forth: then the residue of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele os entregará até o tempo em que a que estiver de parto der à luz; então o resto de seus irmãos voltarão a estar com os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Empero los dejará hasta el tiempo que para la que ha de parir; y el resto de sus hermanos se tornará con los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
verses.ASV: And he shall stand, and shall feed [his flock] in the strength of Jehovah, in the majesty of the name of Jehovah his God: and they shall abide; for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles se levantará, e governará com a força do SENHOR, com a grandeza do nome do SENHOR seu Deus; e eles habitarão [seguros] ,porque agora ele será engrandecido até os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y estará, y apacentará con fortaleza de Jehová, con grandeza del nombre de Jehová su Dios: y asentarán; porque ahora será engrandecido hasta los fines de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
verses.WEB: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
verses.ASV: And this [man] shall be [our] peace. When the Assyrian shall come into our land, and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este será nossa paz; quando a Assíria vier a nossa terra, e quando pisar nossos palácios, então levantaremos contra ela sete pastores, e oito príncipes dentre os homens;
verses.RVR09: Y éste será nuestra paz. Cuando Assur viniere á nuestra tierra, y cuando pisare nuestros palacios, entonces levantaremos contra él siete pastores, y ocho hombres principales;

verses.KJV: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
verses.WEB: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
verses.ASV: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: and he shall deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dominarão a terra da Assíria pela espada, e a terra de Ninrode em suas entradas; assim ele [nos] livrará do assírios, quando vierem contra nossa terra e invadirem nossas fronteiras.
verses.RVR09: Y comerán la tierra de Assur á cuchillo, y la tierra de Nimrod con sus espadas: y nos librará del Asirio, cuando viniere contra nuestra tierra y hollare nuestros términos.

verses.KJV: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
verses.WEB: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.
verses.ASV: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples as dew from Jehovah, as showers upon the grass, that tarry not for man, nor wait for the sons of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o restante de Jacó estará no meio de muitos povos, como o orvalho do SENHOR, como gotas sobre a erva, que não esperam ao homem, nem aguardam os filhos de homens.
verses.RVR09: Y será el residuo de Jacob en medio de muchos pueblos, como el rocío de Jehová, como las lluvias sobre la hierba, las cuales no esperan varón, ni aguardan á hijos de hombres.

verses.KJV: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
verses.WEB: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
verses.ASV: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he go through, treadeth down and teareth in pieces, and there is none to deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o restante de Jacó estará entre as nações, no meio de muitos povos, como o leão entre os animais do bosque, como o leão jovem entre os rebanhos de ovelhas, o qual quando passa, atropela e despedaça, de modo que ninguém há que possa livrar.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo será el resto de Jacob entre las gentes, en medio de muchos pueblos, como el león entre las bestias de la montaña, como el cachorro del león entre las manadas de las ovejas, el cual si pasare, y hollare, y arrebatare, no hay quien escape.

verses.KJV: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
verses.WEB: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
verses.ASV: Let thy hand be lifted up above thine adversaries, and let all thine enemies be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua mão se erguerá sobre teus adversários, e todos os teus inimigos serão exterminados.
verses.RVR09: Tu mano se alzará sobre tus enemigos, y todos tus adversarios serán talados.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
verses.WEB: “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and will destroy thy chariots:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia,diz o SENHOR, que destruirei teus cavalos do meio de ti, e acabarei com tuas carruagens.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel día, dice Jehová, que haré matar tus caballos de en medio de ti, y haré destruir tus carros.

verses.KJV: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
verses.WEB: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.
verses.ASV: and I will cut off the cities of thy land, and will throw down all thy strongholds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também destruirei as cidades da tua terra, e derrubarei todas as tuas fortalezas.
verses.RVR09: Haré también destruir las ciudades de tu tierra, y arruinaré todas tus fortalezas.

verses.KJV: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
verses.WEB: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
verses.ASV: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thy hand; and thou shalt have no [more] soothsayers:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também destruirei as feitiçarias de tua mão, e não terás mais adivinhadores.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo destruiré de tu mano las hechicerías, y no se hallarán en ti agoreros.

verses.KJV: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
verses.WEB: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
verses.ASV: and I will cut off thy graven images and thy pillars out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thy hands;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também destruirei as tuas imagens de escultura e tuas colunas de idolatria do meio de ti, e nunca mais te encurvarás diante da obra de tuas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Y haré destruir tus esculturas y tus imágenes de en medio de ti, y nunca más te inclinarás á la obra de tus manos;

verses.KJV: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
verses.WEB: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
verses.ASV: and I will pluck up thine Asherim out of the midst of thee; and I will destroy thy cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também arrancarei teus bosques do meio de ti, e arruinarei tuas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y arrancaré tus bosques de en medio de ti, y destruiré tus ciudades.

verses.KJV: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
verses.WEB: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
verses.ASV: And I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations which hearkened not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com ira e com furor farei vingança das nações que não [me] deram ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Y con ira y con furor haré venganza en las gentes que no escucharon.

verses.KJV: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.WEB: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
verses.ASV: Hear ye now what Jehovah saith: Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi agora o que o SENHOR diz: Levanta-te, briga com os montes, e ouçam os morros a tua voz.
verses.RVR09: OID ahora lo que dice Jehová: Levántate, pleitea con los montes, y oigan los collados tu voz.

verses.KJV: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
verses.WEB: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
verses.ASV: Hear, O ye mountains, Jehovah’s controversy, and ye enduring foundations of the earth; for Jehovah hath a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi vós, montes, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra, a briga do SENHOR; porque o SENHOR tem uma briga judicial com seu povo, e disputará judicialmente com Israel.
verses.RVR09: Oid, montes, y fuertes fundamentos de la tierra, el pleito de Jehová: porque tiene Jehová pleito con su pueblo, y altercará con Israel.

verses.KJV: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
verses.WEB: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
verses.ASV: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó povo meu, o que eu tenho feito a ti? Em que eu te incomodei? Responde-me.
verses.RVR09: Pueblo mío, ¿qué te he hecho, ó en qué te he molestado? Responde contra mí.

verses.KJV: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.WEB: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.ASV: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu te fiz subir da terra do Egito, e da casa de escravidão eu te livrei; e enviei diante de ti a Moisés, Arão, e Miriã.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto, y de la casa de siervos te redimí; y envié delante de ti á Moisés, y á Aarón, y á María.

verses.KJV: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.
verses.WEB: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
verses.ASV: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him; [remember] from Shittim unto Gilgal, that ye may know the righteous acts of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó povo meu, lembra-te agora do Balaque, rei de Moabe, planejou, e do que Balaão, filho de Beor, lhe respondeu, [e do que aconteceu] desde Sitim até Gilgal, para que conheças as justiças do SENHOR.
