verses.RVR09: Pueblo mío, acuérdate ahora qué aconsejó Balac rey de Moab, y qué le respondió Balaam, hijo de Beor, desde Sittim hasta Gilgal, para que conozcas las justicias de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
verses.WEB: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.ASV: Wherewith shall I come before Jehovah, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt-offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.ALMEIDA: Com que me encontrarei com o SENHOR, [e] adorarei ao alto Deus? Virei diante ele com holocaustos, com bezerros de um ano?
verses.RVR09: ¿Con qué prevendré á Jehová, y adoraré al alto Dios? ¿vendré ante él con holocaustos, con becerros de un año?

verses.KJV: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.WEB: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.ASV: will Jehovah be pleased with thousands of rams, [or] with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my first-born for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se agradará de milhares de carneiros, [ou] de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? Darei meu primogênito por minha transgressão, o fruto de meu ventre pelo pecado de minha alma?
verses.RVR09: ¿Agradaráse Jehová de millares de carneros, ó de diez mil arroyos de aceite? ¿daré mi primogénito por mi rebelión, el fruto de mi vientre por el pecado de mi alma?

verses.KJV: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.WEB: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verses.ASV: He hath showed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth Jehovah require of thee, but to do justly, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele já declarou a ti, ó ser humano, o que é bom; e que mais o SENHOR pede de ti, a não ser fazer o que é justo, amar a bondade, e andar humildemente com teu Deus?
verses.RVR09: Oh hombre, él te ha declarado qué sea lo bueno, y qué pida de ti Jehová: solamente hacer juicio, y amar misericordia, y humillarte para andar con tu Dios.

verses.KJV: The Lord's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah crieth unto the city, and [the man of] wisdom will see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR clama à cidade (e sábio é temer o teu nome): Ouvi a vara, e a quem a estabeleceu.
verses.RVR09: La voz de Jehová clama á la ciudad, y el sabio mirará á tu nombre. Oid la vara, y á quien la establece.

verses.KJV: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.WEB: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
verses.ASV: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a scant measure that is abominable?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há ainda na casa do perverso riquezas da perversidade, e medida enganosamente menor, o que é abominável?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hay aún en casa del impío tesoros de impiedad, y medida escasa que es detestable?

verses.KJV: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.WEB: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
verses.ASV: Shall I be pure with wicked balances, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
verses.ALMEIDA: Posso eu tolerar [quem tem] balanças falsas e bolsa de pesos enganosos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Seré limpio con peso falso, y con bolsa de engañosas pesas?

verses.KJV: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.WEB: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
verses.ASV: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois seus ricos estão cheios de violência, e seus moradores falaram mentiras, e suas línguas são enganosas em suas bocas.
verses.RVR09: Con lo cual sus ricos se hinchieron de rapiña, y sus moradores hablaron mentira, y su lengua engañosa en su boca.

verses.KJV: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.WEB: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
verses.ASV: Therefore I also have smitten thee with a grievous wound; I have made thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu também [te] enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por teus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Por eso yo también te enflaqueceré hiriéndote, asolándote por tus pecados.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
verses.WEB: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy humiliation shall be in the midst of thee: and thou shalt put away, but shalt not save; and that which thou savest will I give up to the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu comerás, mas não te saciarás; e fome haverá no meio de ti; tu pegarás, mas não levarás [contigo] ; e o que levares, eu [o] entregarei à espada.
verses.RVR09: Tú comerás, y no te hartarás; y tu abatimiento será en medio de ti: tú cogerás, mas no salvarás; y lo que salvares, lo entregaré yo á la espada.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
verses.WEB: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt sow, but shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but shalt not anoint thee with oil; and the vintage, but shalt not drink the wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu semearás, mas não colherás; pisarás azeitonas, mas não te ungirás com óleo; [pisarás] uvas, mas não beberás vinho.
verses.RVR09: Tú sembrarás, mas no segarás: pisarás aceitunas, mas no te ungirás con el aceite; y mosto, mas no beberás el vino.

verses.KJV: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.WEB: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”
verses.ASV: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I may make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof a hissing: and ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois são os mandamentos de Onri, e todas as obras da casa de Acabe, que são obedecidos; e vós praticais seus conselhos. Por isso eu te tornarei desolada, e teus moradores serão motivo de assovio. Assim levareis a humilhação de meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque los mandamientos de Omri se han guardado, y toda obra de la casa de Achâb; y en los consejos de ellos anduvisteis, para que yo te diese en asolamiento, y tus moradores para ser silbados. Llevaréis por tanto el oprobio de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
verses.WEB: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
verses.ASV: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grape gleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat; my soul desireth the first-ripe fig.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de mim! Porque sou como quando os frutos do verão são colhidos, como quando são tiradas as sobras das uvas da vindima, de modo que não resta cacho de uvas para comer; minha alma deseja frutos.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de mí! que he venido á ser como cuando han cogido los frutos del verano, como cuando han rebuscado después de la vendimia, que no queda racimo para comer; mi alma deseó primeros frutos.

verses.KJV: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.WEB: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
verses.ASV: The godly man is perished out of the earth, and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já pereceu o misericordioso da terra, e não há quem seja justo entre os seres humanos; todos armam ciladas em busca de sangue; cada um arma rede de caça a seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Faltó el misericordioso de la tierra, y ninguno hay recto entre los hombres: todos acechan á la sangre; cada cual arma red á su hermano.

verses.KJV: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
verses.WEB: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
verses.ASV: Their hands are upon that which is evil to do it diligently; the prince asketh, and the judge [is ready] for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth the evil desire of his soul: thus they weave it together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas mãos são habilidosas em fazer o mal; o príncipe dá ordens e o juiz julga por propina; e o grande fala o mau desejo de sua alma, e colaboram com ele.
verses.RVR09: Para completar la maldad con sus manos, el príncipe demanda, y el juez juzga por recompensa; y el grande habla el antojo de su alma, y lo confirman.

verses.KJV: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
verses.WEB: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
verses.ASV: The best of them is as a brier; the most upright is [worse] than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen, even thy visitation, is come; now shall be their perplexity.
verses.ALMEIDA: O melhor dentre eles é como o espinho; o mais justo é como o espinheiro. O dia de teus vigilantes, teu castigo, vem; agora será sua confusão.
verses.RVR09: El mejor de ellos es como el cambrón; el más recto, como zarzal: el día de tus atalayas, tu visitación, viene; ahora será su confusión.

verses.KJV: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
verses.WEB: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
verses.ASV: Trust ye not in a neighbor; put ye not confidence in a friend; keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não creiais em amigo, nem confieis em príncipe; guardas as portas de tua boca daquela que dorme ao teu lado.
verses.RVR09: No creáis en amigo, ni confiéis en príncipe: de la que duerme á tu lado, guarda, no abras tu boca.

verses.KJV: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.WEB: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.ASV: For the son dishonoreth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o filho despreza o pai, a filha se levanta contra sua mãe, a nora contra sua sogra; e os inimigos do homem são os de sua própria casa.
verses.RVR09: Porque el hijo deshonra al padre, la hija se levanta contra la madre, la nuera contra su suegra: y los enemigos del hombre son los de su casa.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verses.WEB: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
verses.ASV: But as for me, I will look unto Jehovah; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, observarei ao SENHOR, esperarei ao Deus de minha salvação; meu Deus me ouvirá.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero á Jehová esperaré, esperaré al Dios de mi salud: el Dios mío me oirá.

verses.KJV: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.
verses.WEB: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
verses.ASV: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Jehovah will be a light unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó minha inimiga, não te alegres de mim; pois ainda que tenha caído, eu me levantarei; ainda que eu esteja assentado em trevas, o SENHOR será minha luz.
verses.RVR09: Tú, enemiga mía, no te huelgues de mí: porque aunque caí, he de levantarme; aunque more en tinieblas, Jehová será mi luz.

verses.KJV: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
verses.WEB: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
verses.ASV: I will bear the indignation of Jehovah, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, [and] I shall behold his righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suportarei a ira do SENHOR, porque pequei contra ele; [suportarei] até que ele julgue minha causa e execute meu direito; ele me trará para a luz; eu verei sua justiça.
verses.RVR09: La ira de Jehová soportaré, porque pequé contra él, hasta que juzgue mi causa y haga mi juicio; él me sacará á luz; veré su justicia.

verses.KJV: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
verses.WEB: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
verses.ASV: Then mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her who said unto me, Where is Jehovah thy God? Mine eyes shall see [my desire] upon her; now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha inimiga verá [isso] ,e a vergonha a cobrirá; ela que me dizia: Onde está o SENHOR teu Deus? Meus olhos a verão; agora ela será pisada como a lama das ruas.
verses.RVR09: Y mi enemiga verá, y la cubrirá vergüenza: la que me decía: ¿Dónde está Jehová tu Dios? Mis ojos la verán; ahora será hollada como lodo de las calles.

verses.KJV: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
verses.WEB: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
verses.ASV: A day for building thy walls! in that day shall the decree be far removed.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia em que teus muros forem reconstruídos, naquele dia as fronteiras se ampliarão para longe.
verses.RVR09: El día en que se edificarán tus muros, aquel día será alejado el mandamiento.

verses.KJV: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
verses.WEB: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
verses.ASV: In that day shall they come unto thee from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and [from] mountain to mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia virão a ti da Assíria até as cidades fortes, das cidades fortes até o rio, e de mar a mar, e de monte a monte.
verses.RVR09: En ese día vendrán hasta ti desde Asiria y las ciudades fuertes, y desde las ciudades fuertes hasta el Río, y de mar á mar, y de monte á monte.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.WEB: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.ASV: Yet shall the land be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém esta terra será desolada por causa de seus moradores, por causa do fruto de suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra con sus moradores será asolada por el fruto de sus obras.

verses.KJV: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.WEB: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.ASV: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thy heritage, which dwell solitarily, in the forest in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apascenta teu povo com teu cajado, o rebanho de tua herança, que mora só no bosque, no meio do campo fértil; que se alimentem em Basã e Gileade, como nos dias antigos.
verses.RVR09: Apacienta tu pueblo con tu cayado, el rebaño de tu heredad, que mora solo en la montaña, en medio del Carmelo: pazcan en Basán y Galaad, como en el tiempo pasado.

verses.KJV: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
verses.WEB: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
verses.ASV: As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt will I show unto them marvellous things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu lhes farei ver maravilhas, como nos dias em que saíste da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Yo les mostraré maravillas como el día que saliste de Egipto.

verses.KJV: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
verses.WEB: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
verses.ASV: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; they shall lay their hand upon their mouth; their ears shall be deaf.
verses.ALMEIDA: As nações verão, e se envergonharão de todo o seu poder; porão a mão sobre a boca, ensurdecerão seus ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Las gentes verán, y se avergonzarán de todas sus valentías; pondrán la mano sobre su boca, ensordecerán sus oídos.

verses.KJV: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the Lord our God, and shall fear because of thee.
verses.WEB: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.
verses.ASV: They shall lick the dust like a serpent; like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their close places; they shall come with fear unto Jehovah our God, and shall be afraid because of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lamberão o pó como a serpente; como os répteis da terra sairão tremendo de seus esconderijos; eles ficarão apavorados com o SENHOR nosso Deus, e temerão a ti.
verses.RVR09: Lamerán el polvo como la culebra; como las serpientes de la tierra, temblarán en sus encierros: despavorirse han de Jehová nuestro Dios, y temerán de ti.

verses.KJV: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
verses.WEB: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth over the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é Deus como tu, que perdoa a maldade, e ignora a transgressão do restante de sua herança? Ele não retém para sempre sua ira, porque ele tem prazer na bondade.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué Dios como tú, que perdonas la maldad, y olvidas el pecado del resto de su heredad? No retuvo para siempre su enojo, porque es amador de misericordia.

verses.KJV: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.WEB: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.ASV: He will again have compassion upon us; he will tread our iniquities under foot; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele voltará a ter misericórdia de nós; ele esmagará nossas maldades. Tu lançarás os pecados deles nas profundezas do mar.
verses.RVR09: El tornará, él tendrá misericordia de nosotros; él sujetará nuestras iniquidades, y echará en los profundos de la mar todos nuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.WEB: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, [and] the lovingkindness to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu concederás a Jacó a fidelidade, e a Abraão a bondade, que juraste a nossos pais desde os dias antigos.
verses.RVR09: Otorgarás á Jacob la verdad, y á Abraham la misericordia, que tú juraste á nuestros padres desde tiempos antiguos.

verses.KJV: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.WEB: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.ASV: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre Nínive. Livro da visão de Naum o elcosita.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Nínive. Libro de la visión de Nahum de El-kosh.

verses.KJV: God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth; the Lord revengeth, and is furious; the Lord will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is a jealous God and avengeth; Jehovah avengeth and is full of wrath; Jehovah taketh vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth [wrath] for his enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é Deus zeloso e vingador; o SENHOR é vingador e furioso; o SENHOR se vinga de seus adversários, e que guarda [ira] contra seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Dios celoso y vengador es Jehová; vengador es Jehová, y Señor de ira; Jehová, que se venga de sus adversarios, y que guarda enojo para sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: The Lord is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the Lord hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.WEB: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means clear [the guilty]: Jehovah hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é tardio para se irar, porém grande em poder; e não terá [ao culpado] por inocente. O SENHOR caminha entre a tempestade e o turbilhão, e as nuvens são o pó de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es tardo para la ira, y grande en poder, y no tendrá al culpado por inocente. Jehová marcha entre la tempestad y turbión, y las nubes son el polvo de sus pies.

verses.KJV: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
verses.WEB: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.
verses.ASV: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele repreende o mar, e o faz secar; e deixa secos todos os rios. Basã e o Carmelo se definham, e a flor do Líbano murcha.
verses.RVR09: El amenaza á la mar, y la hace secar, y agosta todos los ríos: Basán fué destruído, y el Carmelo, y la flor del Líbano fué destruída.

verses.KJV: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
verses.ASV: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt; and the earth is upheaved at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes tremem diante dele, e os morros se derretem; e a terra se abala em sua presença, e o mundo, e todos os que nele habitam.
verses.RVR09: Los montes tiemblan de él, y los collados se deslíen; y la tierra se abrasa á su presencia, y el mundo, y todos los que en él habitan.

verses.KJV: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
verses.WEB: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
verses.ASV: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken asunder by him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pode subsistir diante de seu furor? E quem pode persistir diante do ardor de sua ira? Seu furor se derrama como fogo, e as rochas se partem diante dele.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién permanecerá delante de su ira? ¿y quién quedará en pié en el furor de su enojo? Su ira se derrama como fuego, y por él se hienden las peñas.

verses.KJV: The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
verses.WEB: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that take refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é bom, é fortaleza no dia da angústia; ele conhece os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es Jehová para fortaleza en el día de la angustia; y conoce á los que en él confían.

verses.KJV: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
verses.WEB: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
verses.ASV: But with an over-running flood he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas com inundação impetuosa ele acabará com Nínive, e perseguirá seus inimigos até às trevas.
verses.RVR09: Mas con inundación impetuosa hará consumación de su lugar, y tinieblas perseguirán á sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: What do ye imagine against the Lord? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
verses.WEB: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
verses.ASV: What do ye devise against Jehovah? he will make a full end; affliction shall not rise up the second time.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que vós tramais contra o SENHOR, ele mesmo destruirá; a angústia não se levantará duas vezes.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pensáis contra Jehová? El hará consumación: la tribulación no se levantará dos veces.

verses.KJV: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
verses.WEB: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
verses.ASV: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly as dry stubble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo estando entretecidos como espinhos, e embriagados como beberrões, eles serão consumidos como a palha seca.
verses.RVR09: Porque como espinas entretegidas, mientras se embriagarán los borrachos, serán consumidos como las estopas llenas de sequedad.

verses.KJV: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, a wicked counsellor.
verses.WEB: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
verses.ASV: There is one gone forth out of thee, that deviseth evil against Jehovah, that counselleth wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ti saiu um que trama o mal contra o SENHOR, um conselheiro maligno.
verses.RVR09: De ti salió el que pensó mal contra Jehová, un consultor impío.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so shall they be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Ainda que sejam prósperos, e muitos em número, mesmo assim eles serão exterminados, e passarão. Eu te afligi, [Judá] , porém não te afligirei mais.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Aunque reposo tengan, y sean tantos, así serán talados, y él pasará. Bien que te he afligido, no más te afligiré.

verses.KJV: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
verses.WEB: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”
verses.ASV: And now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora quebrarei seu jugo de sobre ti, e romperei tuas amarras.
verses.RVR09: Porque ahora quebraré su yugo de sobre ti, y romperé tus coyundas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
verses.WEB: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hath given commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image; I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém contra ti, [assírio] , o SENHOR mandou que nunca mais seja gerado alguém de teu nome; da casa de teu deus arrancarei as imagens de escultura e de fundição. Farei para ti um sepulcro, porque tu és desprezível.
verses.RVR09: Mas acerca de ti mandará Jehová, que nunca más sea sembrado alguno de tu nombre: de la casa de tu dios talaré escultura y estatua de fundición, haréla tu sepulcro; porque fuiste vil.

verses.KJV: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
verses.WEB: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
verses.ASV: Behold, upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! Keep thy feasts, O Judah, perform thy vows; for the wicked one shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que sobre os montes estão os pés daquele que anuncia boas novas, do que faz ouvir a paz. Celebra tuas festas, Judá; cumpre os teus votos, porque nunca mais o maligno passará por ti; ele foi exterminado por completo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí sobre los montes los pies del que trae buenas nuevas, del que pregona la paz. Celebra, oh Judá, tus fiestas, cumple tus votos: porque nunca más pasará por ti el malvado; pereció del todo.

verses.KJV: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
verses.WEB: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!
verses.ASV: He that dasheth in pieces is come up against thee: keep the fortress, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
verses.ALMEIDA: O despedaçador está subindo contra ti; guarda a fortaleza, olha para o caminho, prepara os lombos, junta o poder de tuas forças.
verses.RVR09: SUBIÓ destruidor contra ti: guarda la fortaleza, mira el camino, fortifica los lomos, fortalece mucho la fuerza.

verses.KJV: For the Lord hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
verses.WEB: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah restoreth the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the emptiers have emptied them out, and destroyed their vine-branches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR restituirá a glória de Jacó, como a glória de Israel, ainda que saqueadores tenham os saqueado, e destruído os seus ramos de videira.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová restituirá la gloria de Jacob como la gloria de Israel; porque vaciadores los vaciaron, y estropearon sus mugrones.

verses.KJV: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
verses.WEB: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
verses.ASV: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the cypress [spears] are brandished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os escudos de seus guerreiros são vermelhos, os homens valentes andam vestidos de escarlate; as carruagens brilham no dia em que são preparadas, as lanças se sacodem.
verses.RVR09: El escudo de sus valientes será bermejo, los varones de su ejército vestidos de grana: el carro como fuego de hachas; el día que se aparejará, temblarán las hayas.

verses.KJV: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
verses.WEB: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
verses.ASV: The chariots rage in the streets; they rush to and fro in the broad ways: the appearance of them is like torches; they run like the lightnings.
verses.ALMEIDA: As carruagens se movem furiosamente pelas ruas, percorrem as vias; sua aparência é como tochas, correm como relâmpagos.
verses.RVR09: Los carros se precipitarán á las plazas, discurrirán por las calles: su aspecto como hachas encendidas; correrán como relámpagos.

verses.KJV: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
verses.WEB: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
verses.ASV: He remembereth his nobles: they stumble in their march; they make haste to the wall thereof, and the mantelet is prepared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus nobres são convocados, porém tropeçam enquanto marcham; eles se apressam ao seu muro, e a proteção é preparada.
verses.RVR09: Acordaráse él de sus valientes; andando tropezarán; se apresurarán á su muro, y la cubierta se aparejará.

verses.KJV: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
verses.WEB: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
verses.ASV: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
verses.ALMEIDA: As comportas dos rios são abertas, e o palácio é arruinado.
verses.RVR09: Las puertas de los ríos se abrirán, y el palacio será destruído.

verses.KJV: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
verses.WEB: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
verses.ASV: And it is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating upon their breasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Está decretado: ela será levada cativa, e suas criadas a acompanharão com voz de pombas, batendo seus peitos.
verses.RVR09: Y la reina fué cautiva; mandarle han que suba, y sus criadas la llevarán gimiendo como palomas, batiendo sus pechos.

verses.KJV: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
verses.WEB: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.
verses.ASV: But Nineveh hath been from of old like a pool of water: yet they flee away. Stand, stand, [they cry]; but none looketh back.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nínive é como um antigo tanque, cujas águas estão fugindo. [Dizem] : Parai, parai; porém ninguém sequer olha para trás.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Nínive de tiempo antiguo como estanque de aguas; mas ellos huyen: Parad, parad; y ninguno mira.

verses.KJV: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
verses.WEB: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
verses.ASV: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold; for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saqueai prata, saqueai ouro; não há fim das riquezas e do luxo, de todo tipo de objetos valiosos.
verses.RVR09: Saquead plata, saquead oro: no hay fin de las riquezas y suntuosidad de todo ajuar de codicia.

verses.KJV: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
verses.WEB: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
verses.ASV: She is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and anguish is in all loins, and the faces of them all are waxed pale.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela está esvaziada, devastada e arruinada; os corações desmaiam, os joelhos tremem, os lombos doem, e os rostos deles todos ficam abatidos.
verses.RVR09: Vacía, y agotada, y despedazada está, y el corazón derretido: batimiento de rodillas, y dolor en todos riñones, y los rostros de todos tomarán negrura.

verses.KJV: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
verses.WEB: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
verses.ASV: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion [and] the lioness walked, the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está a morada dos leões, e o lugar onde os leões jovens se alimentavam, onde o leão, a leoa, e os filhotes de leão passeavam, e não havia quem os espantasse?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué es de la morada de los leones, y de la majada de los cachorros de los leones, donde se recogía el león, y la leona, y los cachorros del león, y no había quien les pusiese miedo?

verses.KJV: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
verses.WEB: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
verses.ASV: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with prey, and his dens with ravin.
verses.ALMEIDA: O leão caçava o suficiente para seus filhotes, e estrangulava para as suas leoas, e enchia suas cavernas de presa, e suas moradas de coisas capturadas.
verses.RVR09: El león arrebataba en abundancia para sus cachorros, y ahogaba para sus leonas, y henchía de presa sus cavernas, y de robo sus moradas.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
verses.ASV: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions; and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu sou contra ti,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos. Queimarei as tuas carruagens em fumaça, e espada consumirá teus jovens leões; exterminarei a tua presa da terra, e nunca mais a voz de teus mensageiros será ouvida.
verses.RVR09: Heme aquí contra ti, dice Jehová de los ejércitos. Encenderé y reduciré á humo tus carros, y espada devorará tus leoncillos; y raeré de la tierra tu robo, y nunca más se oirá voz de tus embajadores.

verses.KJV: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
verses.WEB: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.
verses.ASV: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and rapine; the prey departeth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da cidade sanguinária, toda cheia de mentiras e de saques; o roubo não cessa.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de la ciudad de sangres, toda llena de mentira y de rapiña, sin apartarse de ella el pillaje!

verses.KJV: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
verses.WEB: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
verses.ASV: The noise of the whip, and the noise of the rattling of wheels, and prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ali há] o som de açoite, e o estrondo do mover de rodas; os cavalos atropelam, e as carruagens vão se sacudindo.
verses.RVR09: Sonido de látigo, y estruendo de movimiento de ruedas; y caballo atropellador, y carro saltador;

verses.KJV: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
verses.WEB: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies
verses.ASV: the horseman mounting, and the flashing sword, and the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies; they stumble upon their bodies;—
verses.ALMEIDA: O cavaleiro ataca, a espada brilha, e a lança resplandece; e [ali haverá] muitos mortos, e multidão de cadáveres; haverá corpos sem fim, e tropeçarão nos corpos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Caballero enhiesto, y resplandor de espada, y resplandor de lanza; y multitud de muertos, y multitud de cadáveres; y de sus cadáveres no habrá fin, y en sus cadáveres tropezarán:

verses.KJV: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
verses.WEB: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
verses.ASV: because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da multidão das prostituições da prostituta muito charmosa, mestra de feitiçarias, que vende os povos com suas prostituições, e as famílias com suas feitiçarias.
verses.RVR09: A causa de la multitud de las fornicaciones de la ramera de hermosa gala, maestra de brujerías, que vende las gentes con sus fornicaciones, y los pueblos con sus hechizos.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will uncover thy skirts upon thy face; and I will show the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estou contra ti,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, e descobrirei tuas saias sobre tua face, e mostrarei tua nudez às nações, tua vergonha aos reinos.
verses.RVR09: Heme aquí contra ti, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y descubriré tus faldas en tu cara, y mostraré á las gentes tu desnudez, y á los reinos tu vergüenza.

verses.KJV: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
verses.WEB: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
verses.ASV: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazing-stock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançarei sobre ti coisas abomináveis, e te envergonharei, e te tornarei em ridículo público.
verses.RVR09: Y echaré sobre ti suciedades, y te afrentaré, y te pondré como estiércol.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
verses.WEB: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que todos os que te virem fugirão de ti, e dirão: Nínive está destruída; quem terá compaixão dela? Onde buscarei para ti consoladores?
verses.RVR09: Y será que todos los que te vieren, se apartarán de ti, y dirán: Nínive es asolada: ¿quién se compadecerá de ella? ¿dónde te buscaré consoladores?

verses.KJV: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
verses.WEB: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
verses.ASV: Art thou better than No-amon, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about her; whose rampart was the sea, [and] her wall was of the sea?
verses.ALMEIDA: És tu melhor que Nô-Amom, que estava situada entre os rios, cercada de águas, cuja fortificação era o mar, e o rio como muralha?
verses.RVR09: ¿Eres tú mejor que No-amón, que estaba asentada entre ríos, cercada de aguas, cuyo baluarte era la mar, y del mar su muralla?

verses.KJV: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
verses.WEB: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.
verses.ASV: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuxe e Egito era sua fortaleza sem limites; Pute e Líbia estavam para tua ajuda.
verses.RVR09: Etiopía era su fortaleza, y Egipto sin límite; Put y Libia fueron en tu ayuda.

verses.KJV: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.WEB: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.ASV: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity; her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ela foi levada em cativeiro; também suas crianças foram despedaçadas nas esquinas de todas as ruas; e sobre seus nobres lançaram sortes, e todos seus maiorais foram aprisionados com grilhões.
verses.RVR09: También ella fué llevada en cautiverio: también sus chiquitos fueron estrellados en las encrucijadas de todas las calles; y sobre sus varones echaron suertes, y todos sus magnates fueron aprisionados con grillos.

verses.KJV: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
verses.WEB: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
verses.ASV: Thou also shalt be drunken; thou shalt be hid; thou also shalt seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu também estarás bêbada, [e] te esconderás; tu também buscarás fortaleza por causa do inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Tú también serás embriagada, serás encerrada; tú también buscarás fortaleza á causa del enemigo.

verses.KJV: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.WEB: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.ASV: All thy fortresses shall be [like] fig-trees with the first-ripe figs: if they be shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as tuas fortalezas são [como] figueiras com os primeiros figos, que ao serem sacudidas, caem na boca de quem quer comer.
verses.RVR09: Todas tus fortalezas cual higueras con brevas; que si las sacuden, caen en la boca del que las ha de comer.

verses.KJV: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
verses.WEB: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.
verses.ASV: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women; the gates of thy land are set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire hath devoured thy bars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que teu exército será como mulheres no meio de ti; as portas de tua terra se abrirão a teus inimigos; fogo consumirá teus ferrolhos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, tu pueblo será como mujeres en medio de ti: las puertas de tu tierra se abrirán de par en par á tus enemigos: fuego consumirá tus barras.

verses.KJV: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
verses.WEB: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
verses.ASV: Draw thee water for the siege; strengthen thy fortresses; go into the clay, and tread the mortar; make strong the brickkiln.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reserva para ti água para o cerco, fortifica as tuas fortalezas; entra na lama, pisa o barro, conserta o forno.
verses.RVR09: Provéete de agua para el cerco, fortifica tus fortalezas; entra en el lodo, pisa el barro, fortifica el horno.

verses.KJV: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
verses.WEB: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.
verses.ASV: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off; it shall devour thee like the canker-worm: make thyself many as the canker-worm; make thyself many as the locust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali o fogo te consumirá, a espada te cortará, te consumirá como o inseto devorador. Multiplica-te como o inseto devorador; multiplica-te como o gafanhoto.
verses.RVR09: Allí te consumirá el fuego, te talará la espada, te devorará como pulgón: multiplícate como langosta, multiplícate como langosta.

verses.KJV: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
verses.WEB: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
verses.ASV: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the canker-worm ravageth, and fleeth away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Multiplicaste teus mercadores mais que as estrelas do céu; o inseto devorador estende as asas, e sai voando.
verses.RVR09: Multiplicaste tus mercaderes más que las estrellas del cielo: el pulgón hizo presa, y voló.

verses.KJV: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.WEB: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.ASV: Thy princes are as the locusts, and thy marshals as the swarms of grasshoppers, which encamp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus oficiais são como gafanhotos, e teus capitães como enxames de gafanhotos que pousam em nas paredes nos dias de frio; quando o sol se levanta eles voam, de modo que não se pode saber seu lugar onde estiveram.
verses.RVR09: Tus príncipes serán como langostas, y tus grandes como langostas de langostas que se sientan en vallados en día de frío: salido el sol se mudan, y no se conoce el lugar donde estuvieron.

verses.KJV: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
verses.WEB: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
verses.ASV: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; thy nobles are at rest; thy people are scattered upon the mountains, and there is none to gather them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus pastores cochilam, ó rei da Assíria, teus nobres descansam; teu povo se espalhou pelos montes, e ninguém o ajuntará.
verses.RVR09: Durmieron tus pastores, oh rey de Asiria, reposaron tus valientes: tu pueblo se derramó por los montes, y no hay quien lo junte.

verses.KJV: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
verses.WEB: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?
verses.ASV: There is no assuaging of thy hurt; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the report of thee clap their hands over thee; for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há cura para tua ferida; tua chaga é fatal; todos os que ouviram tua fama baterão palmas por causa de ti, pois sobre quem tua maldade não passou continuamente?
verses.RVR09: No hay cura para tu quebradura; tu herida se encrudeció: todos los que oyeron tu fama, batirán las manos sobre ti, porque ¿sobre quién no pasó continuamente tu malicia?

verses.KJV: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.WEB: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
verses.ASV: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação que o profeta Habacuque viu.
verses.RVR09: LA carga que vió Habacuc profeta.

verses.KJV: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
verses.WEB: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando, SENHOR, eu clamarei, e tu não ouvirás? [Até quando] gritarei a ti: Violência!, e tu não salvarás?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh Jehová, clamaré, y no oirás; y daré voces á ti á causa de la violencia, y no salvarás?

verses.KJV: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
verses.WEB: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
verses.ASV: Why dost thou show me iniquity, and look upon perverseness? for destruction and violence are before me; and there is strife, and contention riseth up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que me fazes ver a injustiça, e vês a opressão? Pois assolação e violência estão em frente de mim, há brigas, e disputas se levantam.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué me haces ver iniquidad, y haces que mire molestia, y saco y violencia delante de mí, habiendo además quien levante pleito y contienda?

verses.KJV: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
verses.WEB: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
verses.ASV: Therefore the law is slacked, and justice doth never go forth; for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore justice goeth forth perverted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que a lei é enfraquecida, e o juízo nunca se cumpre: porque o perverso cerca o justo, por o juízo é distorcido.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual la ley es debilitada, y el juicio no sale verdadero: por cuanto el impío asedia al justo, por eso sale torcido el juicio.

verses.KJV: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
verses.WEB: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
verses.ASV: Behold ye among the nations, and look, and wonder marvellously; for I am working a work in your days, which ye will not believe though it be told you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede entre as nações, e prestai atenção, e espantai-vos, espantai-vos; porque uma obra será feita em vossos dias, que quando for contada, não acreditareis.
verses.RVR09: Mirad en las gentes, y ved, y maravillaos pasmosamente; porque obra será hecha en vuestros días, que aun cuando se os contare, no la creeréis.

verses.KJV: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not their's.
verses.WEB: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
verses.ASV: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que eu levanto os caldeus, uma nação amarga e veloz, que caminha pelas larguras da terra para tomar posse de moradas que não são suas.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, yo levanto los Caldeos, gente amarga y presurosa, que camina por la anchura de la tierra para poseer las habitaciones ajenas.

verses.KJV: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
verses.WEB: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
verses.ASV: They are terrible and dreadful; their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela é espantosa é e terrível; que impõe seu próprio julgamento e sua própria honra.
verses.RVR09: Espantosa es y terrible: de ella misma saldrá su derecho y su grandeza.

verses.KJV: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
verses.WEB: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
verses.ASV: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves; and their horsemen press proudly on: yea, their horsemen come from far; they fly as an eagle that hasteth to devour.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus cavalos são mais rápidos que os leopardos, e mais ferozes que lobos de tarde; e seus cavaleiros avançam; seus cavaleiros virão de longe, e voarão como águias que se apressam para devorar.
verses.RVR09: Y serán sus caballos más ligeros que tigres, y más agudos que lobos de tarde; y sus jinetes se multiplicarán: vendrán de lejos sus caballeros, y volarán como águilas que se apresuran á la comida.

verses.KJV: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
verses.WEB: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.
verses.ASV: They come all of them for violence; the set of their faces is forwards; and they gather captives as the sand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles vêm para [fazer] violência; seus rostos estão orientados; e juntarão cativos como areia.
verses.RVR09: Toda ella vendrá á la presa: delante de sus caras viento solano; y juntará cautivos como arena.

verses.KJV: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
verses.WEB: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.
verses.ASV: Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a derision unto him; he derideth every stronghold; for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escarnecerão dos reis, e zombarão dos príncipes; rirão de todas as fortalezas, porque amontoarão terra, e as tomarão.
verses.RVR09: Y escarnecerá de los reyes, y de los príncipes hará burla: reiráse de toda fortaleza, y amontonará polvo, y la tomará.

verses.KJV: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
verses.WEB: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
verses.ASV: Then shall he sweep by [as] a wind, and shall pass over, and be guilty, [even] he whose might is his god.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo mudarão, e passarão adiante como o vento; porém culpado será quem confiar na força de seu deus.
verses.RVR09: Luego mudará espíritu, y pasará adelante, y ofenderá atribuyendo esta su potencia á su dios.

verses.KJV: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
verses.WEB: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
verses.ASV: Art not thou from everlasting, O Jehovah my God, my Holy One? we shall not die. O Jehovah, thou hast ordained him for judgment; and thou, O Rock, hast established him for correction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não és tu desde o princípio, ó SENHOR, meu Deus, meu Santo? Não morreremos. Ó SENHOR, tu os puseste para [executar] o julgamento; e tu, ó Rocha, os estabeleceste para castigar.
verses.RVR09: ¿No eres tú desde el principio, oh Jehová, Dios mío, Santo mío? No moriremos. Oh Jehová, para juicio lo pusiste; y tú, oh Roca, lo fundaste para castigar.

verses.KJV: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
verses.WEB: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
verses.ASV: Thou that art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and that canst not look on perverseness, wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy peace when the wicked swalloweth up the man that is more righteous than he;
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus olhos são puros demais para veres o mal, e não podes observar a opressão; ora, por que olharias aos enganadores, e calarias quando o perverso devora ao mais justo que ele?
verses.RVR09: Muy limpio eres de ojos para ver el mal, ni puedes ver el agravio: ¿por qué ves los menospreciadores, y callas cuando destruye el impío al más justo que él,

verses.KJV: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.WEB: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
verses.ASV: and makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornarias as pessoas como como os peixes do mar, como répteis que não têm quem os governe?
verses.RVR09: Y haces que sean los hombres como los peces de la mar, como reptiles que no tienen señor?

verses.KJV: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.WEB: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
verses.ASV: He taketh up all of them with the angle, he catcheth them in his net, and gathereth them in his drag: therefore he rejoiceth and is glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tira a todos com anzol, em sua malha os ajunta, e os colhe em seu rede; por isso ele se alegra e tem prazer.
verses.RVR09: Sacará á todos con anzuelo, cogerálos con su red, y juntarálos en su aljerife: por lo cual se holgará y hará alegrías.

verses.KJV: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
verses.WEB: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
verses.ASV: Therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; because by them his portion is fat, and his food plenteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele faz sacrifícios à sua malha, e oferece incensos à sua rede; porque com elas enriqueceu sua porção, e engordou sua comida.
verses.RVR09: Por esto hará sacrificios á su red, y ofrecerá sahumerios á su aljerife: porque con ellos engordó su porción, y engrasó su comida.

verses.KJV: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
verses.WEB: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
verses.ASV: Shall he therefore empty his net, and spare not to slay the nations continually?
verses.ALMEIDA: Continuará ele, pois, a esvaziar a sua malha, e a matar as nações continuamente sem ter compaixão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Vaciará por eso su red, ó tendrá piedad de matar gentes continuamente?

verses.KJV: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.WEB: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
verses.ASV: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will look forth to see what he will speak with me, and what I shall answer concerning my complaint.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre o meu posto de guarda estarei, e sobre a fortaleza ficarei e vigiarei, para ver o que ele me falará, e o que eu responderei à minha queixa.
verses.RVR09: SOBRE mi guarda estaré, y sobre la fortaleza afirmaré el pie, y atalayaré para ver qué hablará en mí, y qué tengo de responder á mi pregunta.

verses.KJV: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.WEB: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR me respondeu, e disse: Escreve a visão, e a põe claramente em tábuas, para que mesmo quem esteja correndo consiga ler.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová me respondió, y dijo: Escribe la visión, y declárala en tablas, para que corra el que leyere en ella.

verses.KJV: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.WEB: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
verses.ASV: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hasteth toward the end, and shall not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not delay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a visão ainda é para um tempo determinado, mas ao fim ela dará testemunho, e não mentirá; se tardar, espera, porque virá; não se atrasará.
verses.RVR09: Aunque la visión tardará aún por tiempo, mas al fin hablará, y no mentirá: aunque se tardare, espéralo, que sin duda vendrá; no tardará.

verses.KJV: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
verses.WEB: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
verses.ASV: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright in him; but the righteous shall live by his faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o soberbo não tem a alma correta em si; mas o justo viverá por sua fé.
verses.RVR09: He aquí se enorgullece aquel cuya alma no es derecha en él: mas el justo en su fe vivirá.

verses.KJV: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.WEB: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.
verses.ASV: Yea, moreover, wine is treacherous, a haughty man, that keepeth not at home; who enlargeth his desire as Sheol, and he is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois também o vinho é enganador, [é como] um homem arrogante, que não fica quieto em casa; sua avidez se alarga como o Xeol, e se assemelha à morte, que não se farta; e ajunta para si todas as nações, e reúne para si todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Y también, por cuanto peca por el vino, es un hombre soberbio, y no permanecerá: que ensanchó como el infierno su alma, y es como la muerte, que no se hartará: antes reunió á sí todas las gentes, y amontonó á sí todos los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.WEB: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
verses.ASV: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and that ladeth himself with pledges!
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso todos estes não levantarão um insulto e provérbios de zombaria contra ele? E dirão: Ai daquele que acumula o que não era seu, e daquele de se enriquece por meio de extorsão! Até quando?
verses.RVR09: ¿No han de levantar todos estos sobre él parábola, y sarcasmos contra él? Y dirán: ¡Ay del que multiplicó lo que no era suyo! ¿Y hasta cuándo había de amontonar sobre sí espeso lodo?

verses.KJV: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.WEB: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
verses.ASV: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booty unto them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não se levantarão de repente seus credores, e se despertarão os que te fazem tremer? Tu serás despojado por eles.
verses.RVR09: ¿No se levantarán de repente los que te han de morder, y se despertarán los que te han de quitar de tu lugar, y serás á ellos por rapiña?

verses.KJV: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
verses.ASV: Because thou hast plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples shall plunder thee, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que tu despojaste muitas nações, todos os povos restantes te despojarão; por causa do sangue das pessoas, e da violência contra a terra, as cidades e todos os seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú has despojado muchas gentes, todos los otros pueblos te despojarán; á causa de las sangres humanas, y robos de la tierra, de las ciudades y de todos los que moraban en ellas.

verses.KJV: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.WEB: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
verses.ASV: Woe to him that getteth an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que obtém [riquezas] para sua casa por meios malignos, para pôr no alto seu ninho, para tentar se livrar do poder da calamidade.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que codicia maligna codicia para su casa, por poner en alto su nido, por escaparse del poder del mal!

verses.KJV: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.WEB: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
verses.ASV: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, by cutting off many peoples, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tramaste plano vergonhoso para tua casa, exterminaste muitos povos, e pecaste contra tua vida.
verses.RVR09: Tomaste consejo vergonzoso para tu casa, asolaste muchos pueblos, y has pecado contra tu vida.

verses.KJV: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.WEB: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
