verses.ASV: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a pedra clamará desde a parede, e a trave desde a estrutura de madeiras lhe responderá.
verses.RVR09: Porque la piedra clamará desde el muro, y la tabla del enmaderado le responderá.

verses.KJV: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.WEB: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
verses.ASV: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que edifica a cidade com sangues, e do que estabelece a vila com perversidade!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que edifica la ciudad con sangres, y del que funda la villa con iniquidad!

verses.KJV: Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.WEB: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
verses.ASV: Behold, is it not of Jehovah of hosts that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que isto não vem da parte do SENHOR dos exércitos, que os povos trabalham para o fogo, e as nações se cansam em vão?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es esto de Jehová de los ejércitos? Los pueblos pues trabajarán para el fuego, y las gentes se fatigarán en vano.

verses.KJV: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.WEB: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.ASV: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a terra se encherá de conhecimento da glória do SENHOR, como as águas cobrem o mar.
verses.RVR09: Porque la tierra será llena de conocimiento de la gloria de Jehová, como las aguas cubren la mar.

verses.KJV: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.WEB: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
verses.ASV: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbor drink, [to thee] that addest thy venom, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que dá bebidas a seu próximo, tu que embebedas com teu furor, para que possas vê-los nus.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que da de beber á sus compañeros, que les acercas tu hiel y embriagas, para mirar sus desnudeces!

verses.KJV: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
verses.WEB: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
verses.ASV: Thou art filled with shame, and not glory: drink thou also, and be as one uncircumcised; the cup of Jehovah’s right hand shall come round unto thee, and foul shame shall be upon thy glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te encherás de vergonha no lugar de honra; bebe tu também, e descobre o prepúcio; o cálice da mão direita do SENHOR voltará sobre ti, e haverá vergonha sobre a tua glória.
verses.RVR09: Haste llenado de deshonra más que de honra: bebe tú también, y serás descubierto; el cáliz de la mano derecha de Jehová volverá sobre ti, y vómito de afrenta sobre tu gloria.

verses.KJV: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
verses.ASV: For the violence done to Lebanon shall cover thee, and the destruction of the beasts, which made them afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a violência cometida contra o Líbano te cobrirá, e a destruição dos animais selvagens o assombrará; por causa dos sangues das pessoas, e da violência contra a terra, as cidades, e todos os seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: Porque la rapiña del Líbano caerá sobre ti, y la destrucción de las fieras lo quebrantará; á causa de las sangres humanas, y del robo de la tierra, de las ciudades, y de todos los que en ellas moraban.

verses.KJV: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.WEB: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
verses.ASV: What profiteth the graven image, that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he that fashioneth its form trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que proveito há na imagem de escultura, que seu formador a esculpiu? E na imagem de fundição, que ensina mentiras? Quem a formou nela confia, tendo feito ídolos mudos.
verses.RVR09: ¿De qué sirve la escultura que esculpió el que la hizo? ¿la estatua de fundición, que enseña mentira, para que haciendo imágenes mudas confíe el hacedor en su obra?

verses.KJV: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.WEB: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
verses.ASV: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise! Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que diz ao pedaço de madeira: Desperta-te; e à pedra muda: Levanta-te! Poderá essa coisa ensinar? Eis que está coberta de ouro e prata, mas não há dentro dela espírito algum.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que dice al palo: Despiértate; y á la piedra muda: Levántate! ¿Podrá él enseñar? He aquí él está cubierto de oro y plata, y no hay dentro de él espíritu.

verses.KJV: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.WEB: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
verses.ASV: But Jehovah is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR está em seu santo templo; que toda a terra se cale diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová está en su santo templo: calle delante de él toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
verses.WEB: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
verses.ASV: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, set to Shigionoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oração do profeta Habacuque, conforme “Siguionote”.
verses.RVR09: ORACIÓN de Habacuc profeta, sobre Sigionoth.

verses.KJV: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.WEB: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, I have heard the report of thee, and am afraid: O Jehovah, revive thy work in the midst of the years; In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, ouvido tenho tua fama; temi, Ó SENHOR, a tua obra; renova-a no meio dos anos; faze-a conhecida no meio dos anos; na ira lembra-te da misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, oído he tu palabra, y temí: oh Jehová, aviva tu obra en medio de los tiempos, en medio de los tiempos hazla conocer; en la ira acuérdate de la misericordia.

verses.KJV: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.WEB: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
verses.ASV: God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. [Selah His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of his praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus veio de Temã, o Santo do monte de Parã (Selá). Sua glória cobriu os céus, e a terra se encheu de seu louvor.
verses.RVR09: Dios vendrá de Temán, y el Santo del monte de Parán. (Selah.) Su gloria cubrió los cielos, y la tierra se llenó de su alabanza.

verses.KJV: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
verses.WEB: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
verses.ASV: And [his] brightness was as the light; He had rays [coming forth] from his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve resplendor como o da luz; raios brilhantes saíam de sua mão; e ali sua força estava escondida.
verses.RVR09: Y el resplandor fué como la luz; rayos brillantes salían de su mano; y allí estaba escondida su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
verses.WEB: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
verses.ASV: Before him went the pestilence, And fiery bolts went forth at his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: A praga ia adiante dele, e a pestilência seguia seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Delante de su rostro iba mortandad, y á sus pies salían carbones encendidos.

verses.KJV: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
verses.WEB: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
verses.ASV: He stood, and measured the earth; He beheld, and drove asunder the nations; And the eternal mountains were scattered; The everlasting hills did bow; His goings were [as] of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele parou, e sacudiu a terra; ele olhou, e abalou as nações; e os montes antigos foram despedaçados, os morros antigos caíram. Seus caminhos são eternos.
verses.RVR09: Paróse, y midió la tierra: miró, é hizo temblar las gentes; y los montes antiguos fueron desmenuzados, los collados antiguos se humillaron á él. Sus caminos son eternos.

verses.KJV: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.WEB: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
verses.ASV: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi as tendas de Cusã em aflição; as cortinas da terra de Midiã tremeram.
verses.RVR09: He visto las tiendas de Cushán en aflicción; las tiendas de la tierra de Madián temblaron.

verses.KJV: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
verses.WEB: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
verses.ASV: Was Jehovah displeased with the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers, Or thy wrath against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thy horses, Upon thy chariots of salvation?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o SENHOR se irritou contra os rios? Foi tua ira contra os ribeiros? Foi tua ira contra o mar, quando cavalgaste sobre teus cavalos, e tuas carruagens de vitória?
verses.RVR09: ¿Airóse Jehová contra los ríos? ¿contra los ríos fué tu enojo? ¿tu ira contra la mar, cuando subiste sobre tus caballos, y sobre tus carros de salud?

verses.KJV: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.WEB: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
verses.ASV: Thy bow was made quite bare; The oaths to the tribes were a [sure] word. [Selah Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu arco foi descoberto, as flechas foram preparadas pela [tua] palavra (Selá). Fendeste a terra com rios.
verses.RVR09: Descubrióse enteramente tu arco, los juramentos á las tribus, palabra segura. (Selah.) Hendiste la tierra con ríos.

verses.KJV: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
verses.WEB: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
verses.ASV: The mountains saw thee, and were afraid; The tempest of waters passed by; The deep uttered its voice, And lifted up its hands on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes te viram, e tiveram dores; a inundação das águas passou. O abismo deu sua voz, e levantou suas mãos ao alto.
verses.RVR09: Viéronte, y tuvieron temor los montes: pasó la inundación de las aguas: el abismo dió su voz, la hondura alzó sus manos.

verses.KJV: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
verses.WEB: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
verses.ASV: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation, At the light of thine arrows as they went, At the shining of thy glittering spear.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol e a lua pararam em suas moradas; à luz de tuas flechas passaram, com o resplendor de tua lança relampejante.
verses.RVR09: El sol y la luna se pararon en su estancia: á la luz de tus saetas anduvieron, y al resplandor de tu fulgente lanza.

verses.KJV: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
verses.WEB: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.
verses.ASV: Thou didst march through the land in indignation; Thou didst thresh the nations in anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com indignação marchaste pela terra, com ira trilhaste as nações.
verses.RVR09: Con ira hollaste la tierra, con furor trillaste las gentes.

verses.KJV: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
verses.WEB: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked man, Laying bare the foundation even unto the neck. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Saíste para a salvar o teu povo, para salvar o teu ungido. Feriste o líder da casa do ímpio, descobrindo-o dos pés ao pescoço. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Saliste para salvar tu pueblo, para salvar con tu ungido. Traspasaste la cabeza de la casa del impío, desnudando el cimiento hasta el cuello. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.WEB: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
verses.ASV: Thou didst pierce with his own staves the head of his warriors: They came as a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perfuraste com suas próprias lanças os líderes de suas tropas, que vieram impetuosamente para me dispersarem. A alegria deles era como a de devorarem os pobres às escondidas.
verses.RVR09: Horadaste con sus báculos las cabezas de sus villas, que como tempestad acometieron para derramarme: su orgullo era como para devorar al pobre encubiertamente.

verses.KJV: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
verses.WEB: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
verses.ASV: Thou didst tread the sea with thy horses, The heap of mighty waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pisaste pelo mar com teus cavalos, pela turbulência de grandes águas.
verses.RVR09: Hiciste camino en la mar á tus caballos, por montón de grandes aguas.

verses.KJV: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
verses.WEB: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
verses.ASV: I heard, and my body trembled, My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entereth into my bones, and I tremble in my place; Because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, For the coming up of the people that invadeth us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu ouvi, meu ventre se perturbou; por causa do ruído meus lábios tremeram; podridão veio em meus ossos, e em meu lugar me perturbei; descansarei até o dia da angústia, quando virá contra o povo que nos ataca.
verses.RVR09: Oí, y tembló mi vientre; á la voz se batieron mis labios; pudrición se entró en mis huesos, y en mi asiento me estremecí; si bien estaré quieto en el día de la angustia, cuando suba al pueblo el que lo invadirá con sus tropas.

verses.KJV: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.WEB: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,
verses.ASV: For though the fig-tree shall not flourish, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labor of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que a figueira não floresça, nem haja fruto nas vides, e falte o produto da oliveira, os campos não produzam alimento, as ovelhas sejam arrebatadas, e não haja vacas nos currais,
verses.RVR09: Aunque la higuera no florecerá, ni en las vides habrá frutos; mentirá la obra de la oliva, y los labrados no darán mantenimiento, y las ovejas serán quitadas de la majada, y no habrá vacas en los corrales;

verses.KJV: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.WEB: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
verses.ASV: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo assim eu me alegrarei no SENHOR, terei prazer no Deus de minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: Con todo, yo me alegraré en Jehová, y me gozaré en el Dios de mi salud.

verses.KJV: The Lord God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.WEB: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength; And he maketh my feet like hinds’ [feet], And will make me to walk upon my high places. For the Chief Musician, on my stringed instruments.
verses.ALMEIDA: DEUS, o Senhor, é minha fortaleza; ele fará meus pés como os das corças, e me fará andar sobre meus lugares altos.(Para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas).
verses.RVR09: Jehová el Señor es mi fortaleza, el cual pondrá mis pies como de ciervas, y me hará andar sobre mis alturas. Al jefe de los cantores sobre mis instrumentos de cuerdas.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra do SENHOR que veio a Sofonias filho de Cuxi, filho de Gedalias, filho de Amarias, filho de Ezequias, nos dias de Josias filho de Amom, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA de Jehová que fué á Sofonías hijo de Cushi, hijo de Gedalías, hijo de Amarías, hijo de Ezechîas, en días de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I will utterly consume all things from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destruirei tudo de sobre a face da terra,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Destruiré del todo todas las cosas de sobre la haz de la tierra, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the birds of the heavens, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destruirei as pessoas e os animais; destruirei as aves do céu, e os peixes do mar, e as pedras de tropeço com os perversos; e exterminarei os seres humanos de sobre a face da terra,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Destruiré los hombres y las bestias; destruiré las aves del cielo, y los peces de la mar, y las piedras de tropiezo con los impíos; y talaré los hombres de sobre la haz de la tierra, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
verses.WEB: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
verses.ASV: And I will stretch out my hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, [and] the name of the Chemarim with the priests;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estenderei minha mão contra Judá, e contra todos os moradores de Jerusalém; e exterminarei deste lugar o restante de Baal, [e] o nome dos idólatras com os sacerdotes;
verses.RVR09: Y extenderé mi mano sobre Judá, y sobre todos los moradores de Jerusalem, y exterminaré de este lugar el remanente de Baal, y el nombre de los Chemarim con los sacerdotes;

verses.KJV: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham;
verses.WEB: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,
verses.ASV: and them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship, that swear to Jehovah and swear by Malcam;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que se encurvam sobre os terraços ao exército do céu; e aos que se encurvam jurando pelo SENHOR, mas também jurando por Milcom;
verses.RVR09: Y á los que se inclinan sobre los terrados al ejército del cielo; y á los que se inclinan jurando por Jehová y jurando por su rey;

verses.KJV: And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor enquired for him.
verses.WEB: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.
verses.ASV: and them that are turned back from following Jehovah; and those that have not sought Jehovah, nor inquired after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos que dão as costas ao SENHOR, aos que não buscam ao SENHOR, nem perguntam por ele.
verses.RVR09: Y á los que tornan atrás de en pos de Jehová; y á los que no buscaron á Jehová, ni preguntaron por él.

verses.KJV: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is at hand: for the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
verses.WEB: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
verses.ASV: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord Jehovah; for the day of Jehovah is at hand: for Jehovah hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath consecrated his guests.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cala-te na presença do Senhor DEUS, porque o dia do SENHOR está perto; porque o SENHOR tem preparado um sacrifício, [e] santificou a seus convidados.
verses.RVR09: Calla en la presencia del Señor Jehová, porque el día de Jehová está cercano; porque Jehová ha aparejado sacrificio, prevenido ha sus convidados.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
verses.WEB: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in the day of Jehovah’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s sons, and all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, no dia do sacrifício do SENHOR, punirei os príncipes, os filhos do rei, e todos os que vestem roupas estrangeiras.
verses.RVR09: Y será que en el día del sacrificio de Jehová, haré visitación sobre los príncipes, y sobre los hijos del rey, y sobre todos los que visten vestido extranjero.

verses.KJV: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.
verses.WEB: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
verses.ASV: And in that day I will punish all those that leap over the threshold, that fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também punirei naquele dia todos os que saltam sobre o umbral, os que enchem as casas de seus senhores de [produtos de] violência e de engano.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo haré visitación en aquel día sobre todos los que saltan la puerta, los que hinchen de robo y de engaño las casas de sus señores.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.WEB: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.ASV: And in that day, saith Jehovah, there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia,diz o SENHOR, haverá voz de clamor desde a porta dos peixes, lamentação desde a segunda parte [da cidade] ,e grande quebrantamento desde os morros.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá en aquel día, dice Jehová, voz de clamor desde la puerta del pescado, y aullido desde la segunda, y grande quebrantamiento desde los collados.

verses.KJV: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
verses.WEB: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
verses.ASV: Wail, ye inhabitants of Maktesh; for all the people of Canaan are undone; all they that were laden with silver are cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lamentai, vós moradores do vale, porque todo o povo mercador está destruído; todos os que pesavam dinheiro são exterminados.
verses.RVR09: Aullad, moradores de Mactes, porque todo el pueblo mercader es destruído; talados son todos los que traían dinero.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.WEB: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps; and I will punish the men that are settled on their lees, that say in their heart, Jehovah will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele tempo, que farei busca em Jerusalém com lâmpadas, e punirei os homens que estão acomodados como sedimentos de vinho, os quais dizem em seu coração: O SENHOR nem fará bem nem mal.
verses.RVR09: Y será en aquel tiempo, que yo escudriñaré á Jerusalem con candiles, y haré visitación sobre los hombres que están sentados sobre sus heces, los cuales dicen en su corazón: Jehová ni hará bien ni mal.

verses.KJV: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
verses.WEB: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
verses.ASV: And their wealth shall become a spoil, and their houses a desolation: yea, they shall build houses, but shall not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but shall not drink the wine thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso a riqueza deles será despojada, e suas casas serão arruinadas; edificarão casas, mas não habitarão nelas; e plantarão vinhas, mas não beberão seu vinho.
verses.RVR09: Será por tanto saqueada su hacienda, y sus casas asoladas: y edificarán casas, mas no las habitarán; y plantarán viñas, mas no beberán el vino de ellas.

verses.KJV: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
verses.WEB: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
verses.ASV: The great day of Jehovah is near, it is near and hasteth greatly, [even] the voice of the day of Jehovah; the mighty man crieth there bitterly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perto está o grande dia do SENHOR; perto está, e com muita pressa se aproxima; a voz do Dia do SENHOR; ali o guerreiro gritará amargamente.
verses.RVR09: Cercano está el día grande de Jehová, cercano y muy presuroso; voz amarga del día de Jehová; gritará allí el valiente.

verses.KJV: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.WEB: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
verses.ASV: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele dia será dia de fúria; dia de angústia e de aflição, dia de devastação e de ruína; dia de trevas e de escuridão, dia de nuvens e de espessa obscuridade.
verses.RVR09: Día de ira aquel día, día de angustia y de aprieto, día de alboroto y de asolamiento, día de tiniebla y de oscuridad, día de nublado y de entenebrecimiento,

verses.KJV: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
verses.WEB: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.
verses.ASV: a day of the trumpet and alarm, against the fortified cities, and against the high battlements.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dia de trombeta e de alarme contra as cidades forte e contra as torres as altas.
verses.RVR09: Día de trompeta y de algazara, sobre las ciudades fuertes, y sobre las altas torres.

verses.KJV: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
verses.WEB: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
verses.ASV: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Jehovah; and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as dung.
verses.ALMEIDA: E angustiarei as pessoas, que andarão como cegas, porque pecaram contra o SENHOR; e o sangue delas será derramado como pó, e sua carne será como esterco.
verses.RVR09: Y atribularé los hombres, y andarán como ciegos, porque pecaron contra Jehová: y la sangre de ellos será derramada como polvo, y su carne como estiércol.

verses.KJV: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.WEB: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
verses.ASV: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of Jehovah’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he will make an end, yea, a terrible end, of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem sua prata nem seu ouro poderá os livrar no dia do furor do SENHOR; pois toda esta terra será consumida pelo fogo de seu zelo; porque ele certamente fará destruição repentina com todos os moradores da terra.
verses.RVR09: Ni su plata ni su oro podrá librarlos en el día de la ira de Jehová; pues toda la tierra será consumida con el fuego de su celo: porque ciertamente consumación apresurada hará con todos los moradores de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
verses.WEB: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
verses.ASV: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation that hath no shame;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-vos, ajuntai-vos, ó nação desagradável,
verses.RVR09: CONGREGAOS y meditad, gente no amable,

verses.KJV: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord's anger come upon you.
verses.WEB: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.
verses.ASV: before the decree bring forth, [before] the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Jehovah come upon you, before the day of Jehovah’s anger come upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que o decreto se concretize, e o dia se passe como a palha; antes que o ardor da ira do SENHOR venha sobre vós, antes que o dia da ira do SENHOR venha sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Antes que pára el decreto, y el día se pase como el tamo; antes que venga sobre vosotros el furor de la ira de Jehová, antes que el día de la ira de Jehová venga sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger.
verses.WEB: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.
verses.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah, all ye meek of the earth, that have kept his ordinances; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye will be hid in the day of Jehovah’s anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai ao SENHOR todos vós mansos da terra, que praticam seu juízo; buscai justiça, buscai mansidão; talvez sejais preservados no dia da ira do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Buscad á Jehová todos los humildes de la tierra, que pusisteis en obra su juicio; buscad justicia, buscad mansedumbre: quizás seréis guardados en el día del enojo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.WEB: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.
verses.ASV: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation; they shall drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Gaza será desamparada, e Asquelom desolada; Asdode será expelida ao meio dia, e Ecrom será arrancada.
verses.RVR09: Porque Gaza será desamparada, y Ascalón asolada: saquearán á Asdod en el medio día, y Ecrón será desarraigada.

verses.KJV: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.WEB: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.
verses.ASV: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea-coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of Jehovah is against you, O Canaan, the land of the Philistines; I will destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que moram à margem do mar, da nação dos quereteus! A palavra do SENHOR é contra vós, ó Canaã, terra dos filisteus; e eu vos destruirei, até que não haja morador.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que moran á la parte de la mar, de la gente de Cheretim! La palabra de Jehová es contra vosotros, oh Canaán, tierra de Palestinos, que te haré destruir hasta no quedar morador.

verses.KJV: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.WEB: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.ASV: And the sea-coast shall be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a margem do mar se tornará pastagens, com abrigos de pastores, e currais de rebanhos.
verses.RVR09: Y será la parte de la mar por moradas de cabañas de pastores, y corrales de ovejas.

verses.KJV: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
verses.WEB: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.
verses.ASV: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed [their flocks] thereupon; in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening; for Jehovah their God will visit them, and bring back their captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquela região será para o restante da casa de Judá, para que nela apascentem; ao anoitecer se deitarão nas casas de Asquelom, porque o SENHOR, seu Deus, os visitará, e os restaurará de seu infortúnio.
verses.RVR09: Y será aquella parte para el resto de la casa de Judá; allí apacentarán: en las casas de Ascalón dormirán á la noche; porque Jehová su Dios los visitará, y tornará sus cautivos.

verses.KJV: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.WEB: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.ASV: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ouvi os escárnios de Moabe, e os insultos dos filhos de Amom com que escarneceram a meu povo, e se engrandeceram contra suas fronteiras.
verses.RVR09: Yo he oído las afrentas de Moab, y los denuestos de los hijos de Ammón con que deshonraron á mi pueblo, y se engrandecieron sobre su término.

verses.KJV: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
verses.WEB: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.
verses.ASV: Therefore as I live, saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall make a prey of them, and the remnant of my nation shall inherit them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto vivo eu,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, que Moabe será como Sodoma, e os filhos de Amom como Gomorra; campo de urtigas, e mina de sal, e desolação perpétua; o restante de meu povo os saqueará, e o restante de minha nação tomará posse daquilo que era deles.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, vivo yo, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, que Moab será como Sodoma, y los hijos de Ammón como Gomorra; campo de ortigas, y mina de sal, y asolamiento perpetuo: el resto de mi pueblo los saqueará, y el resto de mi gente los heredará.

verses.KJV: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto terão por sua soberba, porque escarneceram e se engrandeceram contra o povo do SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Esto les vendrá por su soberbia, porque afrentaron, y se engrandecieron contra el pueblo de Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
verses.WEB: The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will be terrible unto them; for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR será terrível contra eles, porque ele consumirá a todos os deuses da terra; e cada um desde seu lugar o adorará, todas as regiões costeiras das nações.
verses.RVR09: Terrible será Jehová contra ellos, porque enervará á todos los dioses de la tierra; y cada uno desde su lugar se inclinará á él, todas las islas de las gentes.

verses.KJV: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
verses.WEB: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.
verses.ASV: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vós cuxitas sereis mortos pela minha espada.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros también los de Etiopía seréis muertos con mi espada.

verses.KJV: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
verses.WEB: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele estenderá sua mão contra o norte, e destruirá a Assíria, e tornará Nínive em desolação e em secura como deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y extenderá su mano sobre el aquilón, y destruirá al Assur, y pondrá á Nínive en asolamiento, y en secadal como un desierto.

verses.KJV: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds; for he shall uncover the cedar work.
verses.WEB: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.
verses.ASV: And herds shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the pelican and the porcupine shall lodge in the capitals thereof; [their] voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he hath laid bare the cedar-work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no meio dela os rebanhos de gado se deitarão, todas os animais das nações; também o corvo a coruja passarão a noite em seus pilares; sua voz se ouvirá nas janelas; assolação será nos umbrais, porque sua estrutura de cedro estará descoberta.
verses.RVR09: Y rebaños de ganado harán en ella majada, todas las bestias de las gentes; el onocrótalo también y el erizo dormirán en sus umbrales: su voz cantará en las ventanas; asolación será en las puertas, porque su enmaderamiento de cedro será descubierto.

verses.KJV: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.WEB: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
verses.ASV: This is the joyous city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none besides me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a cidade alegre que habita segura, que diz em seu coração: Nenhuma outra há como eu sou. Como ela se tornará em desolação, [em] repouso de animais! Qualquer um que passar perto dela assoviará [e] sacudirá sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ciudad alegre que estaba confiada, la que decía en su corazón: Yo, y no más. ¡Cómo fué en asolamiento, en cama de bestias! Cualquiera que pasare junto á ella silbará, meneará su mano.

verses.KJV: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
verses.WEB: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
verses.ASV: Woe to her that is rebellious and polluted! to the oppressing city!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da suja e contaminada, da cidade opressora!
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de la ciudad ensuciada y contaminada y opresora!

verses.KJV: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.
verses.WEB: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.
verses.ASV: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Jehovah; she drew not near to her God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela não ouve a voz, nem aceita o castigo; não confia no SENHOR, não se achega a seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: No escuchó la voz, ni recibió la disciplina: no se confió en Jehová, no se acercó á su Dios.

verses.KJV: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
verses.WEB: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
verses.ASV: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they leave nothing till the morrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus príncipes no meio dela são leões que rugem; seus juízes são lobos da noite que nada deixam para a manhã [seguinte] .
verses.RVR09: Sus príncipes en medio de ella son leones bramadores: sus jueces, lobos de tarde que no dejan hueso para la mañana:

verses.KJV: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
verses.WEB: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
verses.ASV: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons; her priests have profaned the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus profetas são levianos, homens enganadores; seus sacerdotes profanam o santuário, [e] violentam a lei.
verses.RVR09: Sus profetas, livianos, hombres prevaricadores: sus sacerdotes contaminaron el santuario, falsearon la ley.

verses.KJV: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
verses.WEB: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
verses.ASV: Jehovah in the midst of her is righteous; he will not do iniquity; every morning doth he bring his justice to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é justo em meio dela, não faz perversidade; de manhã ele tira seu juízo à luz, nunca falha; mas o injusto não conhece a vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Jehová justo en medio de ella, no hará iniquidad: de mañana sacará á luz su juicio, nunca falta: mas el perverso no tiene vergüenza.

verses.KJV: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
verses.WEB: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
verses.ASV: I have cut off nations; their battlements are desolate; I have made their streets waste, so that none passeth by; their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exterminei as nações; suas muralhas estão arruinadas, suas ruas estão desertas, de maneira que ninguém passe por elas; suas cidades estão desoladas de maneira que ninguém restou, nenhum morador sequer.
verses.RVR09: Hice talar gentes; sus castillos están asolados; hice desiertas sus calles, hasta no quedar quien pase: sus ciudades están asoladas hasta no quedar hombre, hasta no quedar morador.

verses.KJV: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
verses.WEB: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
verses.ASV: I said, Only fear thou me; receive correction; so her dwelling shall not be cut off, [according to] all that I have appointed concerning her: but they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dizia: Certamente me temerás, aceitarás a correção; para que assim sua morada não seja destruída [por] tudo aquilo que eu havia determinado sobre ela. Porém eles se levantaram de manhã e corromperam todos os seus atos.
verses.RVR09: Dije: Ciertamente me temerás, recibirás corrección; y no será su habitación derruída por todo aquello sobre que los visité. Mas ellos se levantaron de mañana, y corrompieron todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.WEB: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.ASV: Therefore wait ye for me, saith Jehovah, until the day that I rise up to the prey; for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger; for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto esperai em mim,diz o SENHOR, pelo dia em que me levantarei para o despojo; porque minha determinação é ajuntar as nações, reunir os reinos, para derramar sobre eles minha indignação, todo o ardor de minha ira; pois toda a terra será consumida pelo o fogo do meu zelo.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, esperadme, dice Jehová, al día que me levantaré al despojo: porque mi determinación es reunir las gentes, juntar los reinos, para derramar sobre ellos mi enojo, todo el furor de mi ira; porque del fuego de mi celo será consumida toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.
verses.WEB: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
verses.ASV: For then will I turn to the peoples of a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então certamente darei lábio puro aos povos, para que todos invoquem o nome do SENHOR, para que lhe sirvam em unidade.
verses.RVR09: Por entonces volveré yo á los pueblos el labio limpio, para que todos invoquen el nombre de Jehová, para que de un consentimiento le sirvan.

verses.KJV: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
verses.WEB: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
verses.ASV: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dalém dos rios de Cuxe, meus adoradores, a filha de meus dispersos, me trarão oferta.
verses.RVR09: De esa parte de los ríos de Etiopía, mis suplicantes, la hija de mis esparcidos, me traerán ofrenda.

verses.KJV: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
verses.WEB: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
verses.ASV: In that day shalt thou not be put to shame for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of the midst of thee thy proudly exulting ones, and thou shalt no more be haughty in my holy mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia não serás envergonhada por nenhum de teus atos com que transgrediste contra mim; porque então tirarei do meio de ti os que se alegram por tua soberba, e nunca mais te exaltarás por causa do meu monte santo.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día no serás avergonzada por ninguna de tus obras con que te rebelaste contra mí; porque entonces quitaré de en medio de ti los que se alegran en tu soberbia, y nunca más te ensoberbecerás del monte de mi santidad.

verses.KJV: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: But I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall take refuge in the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas farei restar no meio de ti um povo humilde e pobre; e eles confiarão no nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaré en medio de ti un pueblo humilde y pobre, los cuales esperarán en el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.WEB: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
verses.ASV: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: O restante de Israel não cometerá perversidade, nem falarão mentiras, nem se achará em suas bocas língua enganosa; em vez disso eles serão apascentados e se deitarão, e não haverá quem os espante.
verses.RVR09: El resto de Israel no hará iniquidad, ni dirá mentira, ni en boca de ellos se hallará lengua engañosa: porque ellos serán apacentados y dormirán, y no habrá quien los espante.

verses.KJV: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Canta alegremente, ó filha de Sião; grita de alegria, ó Israel; alegra-te e anima-te de todo coração, ó filha de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Canta, oh hija de Sión: da voces de júbilo, oh Israel; gózate y regocíjate de todo corazón, hija de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
verses.WEB: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the King of Israel, even Jehovah, is in the midst of thee; thou shalt not fear evil any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR afastou os julgamentos contra ti, exterminou teu inimigo; o SENHOR, Rei de Israel, está no meio de ti; nunca mais verás mal algum.
verses.RVR09: Jehová ha apartado tus juicios, ha echado fuera tus enemigos: Jehová es Rey de Israel en medio de ti; nunca más verás mal.

verses.KJV: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
verses.WEB: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
verses.ASV: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia se dirá a Jerusalém: Não temas, Sião, não se enfraqueçam tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo se dirá á Jerusalem: No temas: Sión, no se debiliten tus manos.

verses.KJV: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
verses.WEB: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verses.ASV: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está no meio de ti, guerreiro que salva; ele terá prazer em ti com alegria; ele [te] aquietará em seu amor, se encherá de alegria por causa de ti com júbilo.
verses.RVR09: Jehová en medio de ti, poderoso, él salvará; gozaráse sobre ti con alegría, callará de amor, se regocijará sobre ti con cantar.

verses.KJV: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
verses.WEB: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
verses.ASV: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assembly, who were of thee; [to whom] the burden upon her was a reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntarei aos que se entristecem [de saudade] das reuniões solenes; eles eram teus; para eles a humilhação dela era uma peso.
verses.RVR09: Reuniré á los fastidiados por causa del largo tiempo; tuyos fueron; para quienes el oprobio de ella era una carga.

verses.KJV: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
verses.WEB: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
verses.ASV: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; and I will save that which is lame, and gather that which was driven away; and I will make them a praise and a name, whose shame hath been in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que naquele tempo acabarei com todos os teus opressores; e salvarei a manca, e ajuntarei a expulsa; e os tornarei louvor e renome em toda terra em que foram envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, en aquel tiempo yo apremiaré á todos tus opresores; y salvaré la coja, y recogeré la descarriada; y pondrélos por alabanza y por renombre en todo país de confusión.

verses.KJV: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
verses.ASV: At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo eu vos trarei de volta, naquele tempo eu vos ajuntarei; pois vos tornarei renome e louvor entre todos os povos da terra, quando eu vos resutaurar de vosso infortúnio diante de vossos olhos, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo yo os traeré, en aquel tiempo os reuniré yo; pues os daré por renombre y por alabanza entre todos los pueblos de la tierra, cuando tornaré vuestros cautivos delante de vuestros ojos, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
verses.WEB: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.ASV: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No segundo ano segundo do rei Dario, no sexto mês, no primeiro dia do mês, veio a palavra do SENHOR, por meio do profeta Ageu, a Zorobabel filho de Sealtiel, governador de Judá, e a Josué filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el año segundo del rey Darío en el mes sexto, en el primer día del mes, fué palabra de Jehová, por mano del profeta Haggeo, á Zorobabel hijo de Sealtiel, gobernador de Judá, y á Josué hijo de Josadac, gran sacerdote, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord's house should be built.
verses.WEB: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
verses.ASV: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, saying, This people say, It is not the time [for us] to come, the time for Jehovah’s house to be built.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fala o SENHOR dos exércitos: Este povo diz: O tempo não chegou, o tempo da casa do SENHOR ser reconstruída.
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos habla así, diciendo: Este pueblo dice: No es aún venido el tiempo, el tiempo de que la casa de Jehová sea reedificada.

verses.KJV: Then came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: Then came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, a palavra do SENHOR por meio do profeta Ageu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Fué pues palabra de Jehová por mano del profeta Haggeo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?
verses.WEB: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
verses.ASV: Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your ceiled houses, while this house lieth waste?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso é para vós tempo de morar em vossas casas com telhado, e esta casa ficar deserta?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es para vosotros tiempo, para vosotros, de morar en vuestras casas enmaderadas, y esta casa está desierta?

verses.KJV: Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.
verses.WEB: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.ASV: Now therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Considerai vossos caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Pues así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Pensad bien sobre vuestros caminos.

verses.KJV: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
verses.WEB: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
verses.ASV: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages [to put it] into a bag with holes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semeais muito, mas colheis pouco; comeis, mas não vos fartais; bebeis, mas não vos satisfazeis; vós vos vestis, mas não vos aqueceis; e o assalariado recebe seu salário em bolsa furada.
verses.RVR09: Sembráis mucho, y encerráis poco; coméis, y no os hartáis; bebéis, y no os saciáis; os vestís, y no os calentáis; y el que anda á jornal recibe su jornal en trapo horadado.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.
verses.WEB: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Considerai vossos caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Meditad sobre vuestros caminos.

verses.KJV: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subi vós à montanha, trazei madeira, e reconstruí a casa; e dela me agradarei, e serei glorificado,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Subid al monte, y traed madera, y reedificad la casa; y pondré en ella mi voluntad, y seré honrado, ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ye looked for much, and, lo it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.
verses.WEB: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
verses.ASV: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith Jehovah of hosts. Because of my house that lieth waste, while ye run every man to his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esperastes por muito, e alcançastes pouco; e quando o trouxestes para casa, eu soprei nisso. Por que isto?,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos. Porque minha casa está deserta, e cada um de vós corre para sua própria casa.
verses.RVR09: Buscáis mucho, y halláis poco; y encerráis en casa, y soplo en ello. ¿Por qué? dice Jehová de los ejércitos. Por cuanto mi casa está desierta, y cada uno de vosotros corre á su propia casa.

verses.KJV: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
verses.WEB: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
verses.ASV: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholdeth its fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que os céus detêm o orvalho de vós, e a terra detém seus frutos.
verses.RVR09: Por eso se detuvo de los cielos sobre vosotros la lluvia, y la tierra detuvo sus frutos.

verses.KJV: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
verses.WEB: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
verses.ASV: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the grain, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labor of the hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamei a seca sobre a terra, sobre os montes, sobre o trigo, sobre o suco de uva, sobre o azeite, e sobre tudo o que a terra produz, e sobre os homens sobre e os animais, e sobre todo trabalho manual.
verses.RVR09: Y llamé la sequedad sobre esta tierra, y sobre los montes, y sobre el trigo, y sobre el vino, y sobre el aceite, y sobre todo lo que la tierra produce, y sobre los hombres y sobre las bestias, y sobre todo trabajo de manos.

verses.KJV: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.
verses.ASV: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of Jehovah their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Jehovah their God had sent him; and the people did fear before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Zorobabel filho de Sealtiel, Josué filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e todo o resto do povo, ouviram a voz do SENHOR seu Deus, e as palavras do profeta Ageu, como o SENHOR Deus deles havia o enviado; e o povo temeu diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Zorobabel hijo de Sealtiel, y Josué hijo de Josadac, gran sacerdote, y todo el demás pueblo, la voz de Jehová su Dios, y las palabras del profeta Haggeo, como lo había enviado Jehová el Dios de ellos; y temió el pueblo delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then spake Haggai the Lord's messenger in the Lord's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Then spake Haggai Jehovah’s messenger in Jehovah’s message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ageu, mensageiro do SENHOR, falou mensagem do SENHOR ao povo, dizendo: Eu estou convosco, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Haggeo, enviado de Jehová, habló por mandado de Jehová, al pueblo, diciendo: Yo soy con vosotros, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,
verses.WEB: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work on the house of Jehovah of hosts, their God,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR despertou o espírito de Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, governador de Judá, e o espírito de Josué filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e o espírito de todo o resto do povo; e vieram e começaram a obra na casa do SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus deles,
verses.RVR09: Y despertó Jehová el espíritu de Zorobabel hijo de Sealtiel, gobernador de Judá, y el espíritu de Josué hijo de Josadac, gran sacerdote, y el espíritu de todo el resto del pueblo; y vinieron é hicieron obra en la casa de Jehová de los ejércitos, su Dios,

verses.KJV: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.WEB: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.ASV: in the four and twentieth day of the month, in the sixth [month], in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: No vigésimo quarto dia do sexto mês, no segundo ano do rei Dario.
verses.RVR09: En el día veinte y cuatro del mes sexto, en el segundo año del rey Darío.

verses.KJV: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,
verses.WEB: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: In the seventh [month], in the one and twentieth [day] of the month, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No sétimo mês, no vigésimo primeiro [dia] mês, veio a palavra do SENHOR por meio do profeta Ageu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el mes séptimo, á los veinte y uno del mes, fué palabra de Jehová por mano del profeta Haggeo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
verses.WEB: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.ASV: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala agora a Zorobabel filho de Sealtiel, governador de Judá, e a Josué filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e ao resto do povo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Habla ahora á Zorobabel hijo de Sealtiel, gobernador de Judá, y á Josué hijo de Josadac, gran sacerdote, y al resto del pueblo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
verses.WEB: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
verses.ASV: Who is left among you that saw this house in its former glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes as nothing?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem restou dentre vós que tenha visto esta casa em sua primeira glória? E como a vedes agora? Não é esta como nada diante de vossos olhos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién ha quedado entre vosotros que haya visto esta casa en su primera gloria, y cual ahora la veis? ¿No es ella como nada delante de vuestros ojos?

verses.KJV: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts:
