verses.WEB: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith Jehovah; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith Jehovah, and work: for I am with you, saith Jehovah of hosts,
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, esforça-te, Zorobabel, diz o SENHOR; esforça-te também Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, sumo sacerdote; e esforça-te, todo o povo da terra, diz o SENHOR, e trabalhai; porque eu estou convosco, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Pues ahora, Zorobabel, esfuérzate, dice Jehová; esfuérzate también Josué, hijo de Josadac, gran sacerdote; y cobra ánimo, pueblo todo de la tierra, dice Jehová, y obrad: porque yo soy con vosotros, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
verses.WEB: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
verses.ASV: [according to] the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, and my Spirit abode among you: fear ye not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme o pacto que estabeleci convosco quando saístes do Egito, assim meu Espírito está em meio de vós; não temais.
verses.RVR09: Según el pacto que concerté con vosotros á vuestra salida de Egipto, así mi espíritu estará en medio de vosotros: no temáis.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
verses.WEB: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Ainda uma vez, daqui a pouco, eu farei tremer os céus e a terra, o mar e a terra seca;
verses.RVR09: Porque así dice Jehová de los ejércitos: De aquí á poco aun haré yo temblar los cielos y la tierra, y la mar y la seca:

verses.KJV: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: and I will shake all nations; and the precious things of all nations shall come; and I will fill this house with glory, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei tremer a todas as nações, e virá as coisas preciosas de todas as nações; e encherei esta casa de glória, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y haré temblar á todas las gentes, y vendrá el Deseado de todas las gentes; y henchiré esta casa de gloria, ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha é a prata, e meu é o ouro, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Mía es la plata, y mío el oro, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
verses.ASV: The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former, saith Jehovah of hosts; and in this place will I give peace, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: A glória desta última casa será maior que a da primeira, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos; e neste lugar darei paz, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: La gloria de aquesta casa postrera será mayor que la de la primera, ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos; y daré paz en este lugar, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: In the four and twentieth [day] of the ninth [month], in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao vigésimo quarto [dia] do nono mês, no segundo ano de Dario, veio a palavra do SENHOR por mão do profeta Ageu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: A veinticuatro del noveno mes, en el segundo año de Darío, fué palabra de Jehová por mano del profeta Haggeo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Pergunta agora aos sacerdotes acerca da lei, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Pregunta ahora á los sacerdotes acerca de la ley, diciendo:

verses.KJV: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
verses.WEB: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”
verses.ASV: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any food, shall it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém levar carnes santas na borda de sua veste, e com sua borda tocar o pão, a comida, o vinho, o azeite, ou qualquer [outra] comida, por acaso isso será santificado?E os sacerdotes responderam: Não.
verses.RVR09: Si llevare alguno las carnes sagradas en la falda de su ropa, y con el vuelo de ella tocare el pan, ó la vianda, ó el vino, ó el aceite, ú otra cualquier comida, ¿será santificado? Y respondieron los sacerdotes, y dijeron: No.

verses.KJV: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
verses.ASV: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ageu disse: Se um impuro por causa de um corpo morto tocar alguma destas coisas, ela será impura? E os sacerdotes responderam: Impura será.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Haggeo: Si un inmundo á causa de cuerpo muerto tocare alguna cosa de éstas, ¿será inmunda? Y respondieron los sacerdotes, y dijeron: Inmunda será.

verses.KJV: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
verses.WEB: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
verses.ASV: Then answered Haggai and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith Jehovah; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ageu respondeu: Assim é este povo, esta nação, diante de mim, diz o SENHOR; e assim é toda obra de suas mãos; e todo o que ali oferecem é impuro.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Haggeo y dijo: Así es este pueblo, y esta gente, delante de mí, dice Jehová; y asimismo toda obra de sus manos; y todo lo que aquí ofrecen es inmundo.

verses.KJV: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:
verses.WEB: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.
verses.ASV: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, considerai desde este dia em diante, antes que se ponha pedra sobre pedra no templo do SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, poned vuestro corazón desde este día en adelante, antes que pusiesen piedra sobre piedra en el templo de Jehová,

verses.KJV: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
verses.WEB: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
verses.ASV: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty [measures], there were but ten; when one came to the winevat to draw out fifty [vessels], there were but twenty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que fossem estas coisas, vinham ao amontoado de grãos [buscar] vinte [medidas] , conseguiam[apenas] dez; vinham à prensa de uvas para tirar dali cinquenta [vasos] mas ali havia[somente] vinte.
verses.RVR09: Antes que fuesen estas cosas, venían al montón de veinte hanegas, y había diez; venían al lagar para sacar cincuenta cántaros del lagar, y había veinte.

verses.KJV: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the work of your hands; yet ye [turned] not to me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos feri com ferrugem, mofo, e granizo em toda obra de vossas mãos; mas não vos [convertestes] a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Os herí con viento solano, y con tizoncillo, y con granizo en toda obra de vuestras manos; mas no os convertisteis á mí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the Lord's temple was laid, consider it.
verses.WEB: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.
verses.ASV: Consider, I pray you, from this day and backward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth [month], since the day that the foundation of Jehovah’s temple was laid, consider it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai, pois, isto, desde este dia em diante, desde o dia vigésimo quatro [dia] do nono mês, desde o dia em o fundamento do templo do SENHOR foi posto; considerai.
verses.RVR09: Pues poned ahora vuestro corazón desde este día en adelante, desde el día veinticuatro del noveno mes, desde el día que se echó el cimiento al templo de Jehová; poned vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
verses.WEB: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”
verses.ASV: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, the vine, and the fig-tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive-tree have not brought forth; from this day will I bless [you].
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda há semente no celeiro? A videira, a figueira, a romeira, e oliveira ainda não têm dado frutos; mas a partir de hoje eu [vos] abençoarei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Aun no está la simiente en el granero? Ni la vid, ni la higuera, ni el granado, ni el árbol de la oliva ha todavía florecido: mas desde aqueste día daré bendición.

verses.KJV: And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came the second time unto Haggai in the four and twentieth [day] of the month, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR veio pela segunda vez a Ageu, ao vigésimo quarto [dia] do mês, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué segunda vez palabra de Jehová á Haggeo, á los veinticuatro del mismo mes, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
verses.WEB: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.
verses.ASV: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Zorobabel, governador de Judá, dizendo: Eu farei tremer os céus e a terra;
verses.RVR09: Habla á Zorobabel, gobernador de Judá, diciendo: Yo haré temblar los cielos y la tierra;

verses.KJV: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.WEB: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
verses.ASV: and I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms; and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E transtornarei o trono dos reinos, e destruirei a força dos reinos das nações; e transtornarei as carruagens, e os que nelas se sentam; e os cavalos e os que neles montam cairão, cada um pela espada de seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y trastornaré el trono de los reinos, y destruiré la fuerza del reino de las gentes; y trastornaré el carro, y los que en él suben; y vendrán abajo los caballos, y los que en ellos montan, cada cual por la espada de su hermano.

verses.KJV: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
verses.ASV: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith Jehovah, and will make thee as a signet; for I have chosen thee, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, eu te tomarei, Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, servo meu, diz o SENHOR, e te porei como anel de selar; porque eu te escolhi, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, te tomaré, oh Zorobabel, hijo de Sealtiel, siervo mío, dice Jehová, y ponerte he como anillo de sellar: porque yo te escogí, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
verses.ASV: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah unto Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No oitavo mês do segundo ano de Dario, a palavra do SENHOR veio ao profeta Zacarias, filho de Berequias, filho de Ido, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el mes octavo, en el año segundo de Darío, fué palabra de Jehová á Zacarías profeta, hijo de Berechîas, hijo de Iddo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.WEB: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.
verses.ASV: Jehovah was sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se irou muito contra vossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Enojóse Jehová con ira contra vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Return unto me, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will return unto you, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Voltai-vos a mim, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, e eu me voltarei a vós, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Les dirás pues: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Volveos á mí, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y yo me volveré á vosotros, ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets cried, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Return ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não sejais como vossos pais, aos quais os profetas antigos clamavam, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Convertei-vos de vossos maus caminhos e de vossos maus atos; porém não escutaram, nem me deram ouvidos, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No seáis como vuestros padres, á los cuales dieron voces los primeros profetas, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Volveos ahora de vuestros malos caminos, y de vuestras malas obras: y no atendieron, ni me escucharon, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.WEB: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
verses.ASV: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde estão vossos pais? E os profetas, vivem eles para sempre?
verses.RVR09: Vuestros padres, ¿dónde están? y los profetas ¿han de vivir para siempre?

verses.KJV: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
verses.WEB: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”
verses.ASV: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? and they turned and said, Like as Jehovah of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quanto às minhas palavras e meus estatutos que havia mandado a meus servos os profetas, não alcançaram a vossos pais? Assim eles, arrependendo-se, diziam: Tal como o SENHOR dos exércitos planejou fazer segundo nossos caminhos e nossos antos, assim ele fez conosco.
verses.RVR09: Empero mis palabras y mis ordenanzas que mandé á mis siervos los profetas, ¿no alcanzaron á vuestros padres? Por eso se volvieron ellos y dijeron: Como Jehová de los ejércitos pensó tratarnos conforme á nuestros caminos, y conforme á nuestras obras, así lo hizo con nosotros.

verses.KJV: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
verses.ASV: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah unto Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No vigésimo quarto dia do décimo primeiro mês (que é o mês de Sebate), no ano segundo de Dario, a palavra do SENHOR veio ao profeta Zacarias, filho de Berequias, filho de Ido, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: A los veinticuatro del mes undécimo, que es el mes de Sebath, en el año segundo de Darío, fué palabra de Jehová á Zacarías profeta, hijo de Berechîas, hijo de Iddo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
verses.WEB: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.
verses.ASV: I saw in the night, and, behold, a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle-trees that were in the bottom; and behind him there were horses, red, sorrel, and white.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi de noite, e eis um homem montado sobre um cavalo vermelho, parado entre as murtas que estavam num vale profundo; e atrás dele estavam cavalos vermelhos, castanhos, e brancos.
verses.RVR09: Vi de noche, y he aquí un varón que cabalgaba sobre un caballo bermejo, el cual estaba entre los mirtos que había en la hondura; y detrás de él había caballos bermejos, overos, y blancos.

verses.KJV: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
verses.WEB: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will show thee what these are.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Meu senhor, o que são estes? E o anjo que falava comigo me disse: Eu te mostrarei o que estes são.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije: ¿Qué son éstos, señor mío? Y díjome el ángel que hablaba conmigo: Yo te enseñaré qué son éstos.

verses.KJV: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the Lord hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
verses.WEB: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”
verses.ASV: And the man that stood among the myrtle-trees answered and said, These are they whom Jehovah hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o homem que estava entre os murtas respondeu, dizendo: Estes são os que o SENHOR enviou para andarem pela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel varón que estaba entre los mirtos respondió, y dijo: Estos son los que Jehová ha enviado á recorrer la tierra.

verses.KJV: And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
verses.WEB: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
verses.ASV: And they answered the angel of Jehovah that stood among the myrtle-trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam ao anjo do SENHOR que estava entre os murtas, e disseram: Nós já andamos pela terra, e eis que toda a terra está tranquila e quieta.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos hablaron á aquel ángel de Jehová que estaba entre los mirtos, y dijeron: Hemos recorrido la tierra, y he aquí, toda la tierra está reposada y quieta.

verses.KJV: Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”
verses.ASV: Then the angel of Jehovah answered and said, O Jehovah of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o anjo do SENHOR disse: Ó SENHOR dos exércitos, até quando não terás compaixão de Jerusalém e das cidades de Judá, contra as quais ficaste irado estes setenta anos?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió el ángel de Jehová, y dijo: Oh Jehová de los ejércitos, ¿hasta cuándo no tendrás piedad de Jerusalem, y de las ciudades de Judá, con las cuales has estado airado por espacio de setenta años?

verses.KJV: And the Lord answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
verses.WEB: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah answered the angel that talked with me with good words, [even] comfortable words.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR respondeu ao anjo que falava comigo palavras boas, palavras de consolo.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová respondió buenas palabras, palabras consolatorias á aquel ángel que hablaba conmigo.

verses.KJV: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.WEB: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.ASV: So the angel that talked with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo que falava comigo me disse: Fala em voz alta, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Tenho grande zelo por Jerusalém e por Sião;
verses.RVR09: Y díjome el ángel que hablaba conmigo: Clama diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Celé á Jerusalem y á Sión con gran celo:

verses.KJV: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
verses.WEB: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
verses.ASV: And I am very sore displeased with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tenho muito grande ira contra as nações tranquilas; porque eu estava pouco irado, porém elas pioraram o mal.
verses.RVR09: Y con grande enojo estoy airado contra las gentes que están reposadas; porque yo estaba enojado un poco, y ellos ayudaron para el mal.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the Lord of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies; my house shall be built in it, saith Jehovah of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth over Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Eu me voltarei a Jerusalém com misericórdia; minha casa será reconstruída nela, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, e a corda de medir será estendida sobre Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: Yo me he tornado á Jerusalem con miseraciones; en ella será edificada mi casa, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y la plomada será tendida sobre Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”
verses.ASV: Cry yet again, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: My cities shall yet overflow with prosperity; and Jehovah shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala em voz alta mais, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Minhas cidades novamente transbordarão de prosperidade; porque o SENHOR novamente consolará a Sião, e novamente escolherá a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Clama aún, diciendo: Así dice Jehová de los ejércitos: Aun serán ensanchadas mis ciudades por la abundancia del bien; y aun consolará Jehová á Sión, y escogerá todavía á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
verses.WEB: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.
verses.ASV: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, four horns.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois levantei meus olhos, e olhei, e eis que havia quatro chifres.
verses.RVR09: Después alcé mis ojos, y miré, y he aquí cuatro cuernos.

verses.KJV: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntei ao anjo que falava comigo: O que são estes? E ele me disse: Estes são os chifres que dissiparam Judá, a Israel, e Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y dije al ángel que hablaba conmigo: ¿Qué son éstos? Y respondióme: Estos son los cuernos que aventaron á Judá, á Israel, y á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shewed me four carpenters.
verses.WEB: The LORD showed me four craftsmen.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah showed me four smiths.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me mostrou quatro ferreiros.
verses.RVR09: Mostróme luego Jehová cuatro carpinteros.

verses.KJV: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
verses.WEB: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head; but these are come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations, which lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: O que estes vêm a fazer? E ele falou, dizendo: Estes são os chifres que dispersaram Judá, de modo que ninguém levantava sua cabeça. Estes [ferreiros] vieram para derrubar os chifres das nações, que levantaram [seus] chifres contra a terra de Judá para dispersá-la.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: ¿Qué vienen éstos á hacer? Y respondióme, diciendo: Estos son los cuernos que aventaron á Judá, tanto que ninguno alzó su cabeza; mas éstos han venido para hacerlos temblar, para derribar los cuernos de las gentes, que alzaron el cuerno sobre la tierra de Judá para aventarla.

verses.KJV: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.WEB: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.ASV: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltei a levantar meus olhos, e olhei, e eis um homem que tinha em sua mão uma corda de medir.
verses.RVR09: ALCÉ después mis ojos, y miré y he aquí un varón que tenía en su mano un cordel de medir.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.WEB: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu perguntei: Para onde vais? E ele me respondeu: Vou medir a Jerusalém, para ver quanta é sua largura e quanto é o seu comprimento.
verses.RVR09: Y díjele: ¿A dónde vas? Y él me respondió: A medir á Jerusalem, para ver cuánta es su anchura, y cuánta su longitud.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.WEB: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.ASV: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que o anjo que falava comigo saiu, e outro anjo veio ao seu encontro,
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, salía aquel ángel que hablaba conmigo, y otro ángel le salió al encuentro,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
verses.WEB: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
verses.ASV: and said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as villages without walls, by reason of the multitude of men and cattle therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Corre, fala a este rapaz, dizendo: Jerusalém será habitada sem muros por causa da multidão de pessoas e de animais que estarão no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Corre, habla á este mozo, diciendo: Sin muros será habitada Jerusalem á causa de la multitud de los hombres, y de las bestias en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.WEB: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
verses.ASV: For I, saith Jehovah, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, diz o SENHOR, serei seu muro de fogo ao redor, e serei [sua] glória no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Yo seré para ella, dice Jehová, muro de fuego en derredor, y seré por gloria en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ho, ho, flee from the land of the north, saith Jehovah; for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heavens, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ei! Ei! Fugi agora da terra do norte, diz o SENHOR, Porque eu vos espalhei pelos quatro ventos dos céu, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Eh, eh, huid de la tierra del aquilón, dice Jehová, pues por los cuatro vientos de los cielos os esparcí, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.WEB: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
verses.ASV: Ho Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ei Sião! Escapa-te tu, que habitas com a filha da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Oh Sión, la que moras con la hija de Babilonia, escápate.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: After glory hath he sent me unto the nations which plundered you; for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Foi por causa da glória que ele me enviou às nações que vos despojaram; porque quem vos toca, toca a menina de seu olho.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Después de la gloria me enviará él á las gentes que os despojaron: porque el que os toca, toca á la niña de su ojo.

verses.KJV: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.
verses.WEB: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.
verses.ASV: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they shall be a spoil to those that served them; and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eis que levantarei minha mão contra eles, e serão saqueados por seus [próprios] servos, e sabereis que o SENHOR dos exércitos me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí yo alzo mi mano sobre ellos, y serán despojo á sus siervos, y sabréis que Jehová de los ejércitos me envió.

verses.KJV: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion; for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Canta e alegra-te, ó filha de Sião; porque eis que venho, e habitarei no meio de ti, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Canta y alégrate, hija de Sión: porque he aquí vengo, y moraré en medio de tí, ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.WEB: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
verses.ASV: And many nations shall join themselves to Jehovah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia muitas nações se ajuntarão ao SENHOR, e serão meu povo, e habitarei no meio de ti; e saberás que o SENHOR dos exércitos me enviou a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y uniránse muchas gentes á Jehová en aquel día, y me serán por pueblo, y moraré en medio de ti; y entonces conocerás que Jehová de los ejércitos me ha enviado á ti.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.WEB: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR herdará a Judá como sua propriedade na terra santa, e novamente escolherá a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová poseerá á Judá su heredad en la tierra santa, y escogerá aún á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
verses.WEB: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
verses.ASV: Be silent, all flesh, before Jehovah; for he is waked up out of his holy habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Calem-se todos diante do SENHOR, porque ele se levantou de sua santa morada.
verses.RVR09: Calle toda carne delante de Jehová; porque él se ha despertado de su santa morada.

verses.KJV: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
verses.WEB: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
verses.ASV: And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Jehovah, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois ele me mostrou o sumo sacerdote Josué, que estava diante do anjo do SENHOR; e Satanás estava à sua direita para o acusar.
verses.RVR09: Y MOSTRÓME á Josué, el gran sacerdote, el cual estaba delante del ángel de Jehová; y Satán estaba á su mano derecha para serle adversario.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Jehovah rebuke thee, O Satan; yea, Jehovah that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR disse a Satanás: O SENHOR te repreenda, Satanás; o SENHOR, que escolheu a Jerusalém, te repreenda. Não é este [homem] um tição tirado do fogo?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Satán: Jehová te reprenda, oh Satán; Jehová, que ha escogido á Jerusalem, te reprenda. ¿No es éste tizón arrebatado del incendio?

verses.KJV: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
verses.WEB: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
verses.ASV: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué estava vestido com roupas impuras enquanto estava diante do anjo.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué estaba vestido de vestimentas viles, y estaba delante del ángel.

verses.KJV: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
verses.WEB: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”
verses.ASV: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take the filthy garments from off him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with rich apparel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [o anjo] falou aos que estavam diante de dele, dizendo: Tirai dele essas roupas impuras. E a ele disse: Eis que tirei de ti tua perversidade, e te vestirei de roupas refinadas.
verses.RVR09: Y habló el ángel, é intimó á los que estaban delante de sí, diciendo: Quitadle esas vestimentas viles. Y á él dijo: Mira que he hecho pasar tu pecado de ti, y te he hecho vestir de ropas de gala.

verses.KJV: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.
verses.WEB: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.
verses.ASV: And I said, Let them set a clean mitre upon his head. So they set a clean mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments; and the angel of Jehovah was standing by.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse: Ponham um turbante limpo sobre sua cabeça. E puseram um turbante limpo sobre sua cabeça, e puseram-lhe roupas, enquanto o anjo do SENHOR estava [junto] .
verses.RVR09: Después dijo: Pongan mitra limpia sobre su cabeza. Y pusieron una mitra limpia sobre su cabeza, y vistiéronle de ropas. Y el ángel de Jehová estaba en pie.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah protested unto Joshua, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR exortou a Josué, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová protestó al mismo Josué, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou also shalt judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee a place of access among these that stand by.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Se andares em meus caminhos, e guardares minha ordenança, também tu julgarás minha casa e guardarás meus pátios; e te darei passagem entre os que [aqui] estão.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová de los ejércitos: Si anduvieres por mis caminos, y si guardares mi ordenanza, también tú gobernarás mi casa, también tú guardarás mis atrios, y entre estos que aquí están te daré plaza.

verses.KJV: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.
verses.WEB: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.
verses.ASV: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou and thy fellows that sit before thee; for they are men that are a sign: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, pois, Josué sumo sacerdote, tu, e teus colegas que se sentam diante de ti; porque são um sinal; pois eis que eu trarei a meu servo, o Renovo.
verses.RVR09: Escucha pues ahora, Josué gran sacerdote, tú, y tus amigos que se sientan delante de ti; porque son varones simbólicos: He aquí, yo traigo á mi siervo, el Pimpollo.

verses.KJV: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.ASV: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua; upon one stone are seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que, quanto à pedra que pus diante de Josué, sobre esta pedra há sete olhos; eis que gravarei nela uma inscrição, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, e tirarei a injustiça desta terra em um dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí aquella piedra que puse delante de Josué; sobre esta única piedra hay siete ojos: he aquí, yo grabaré su escultura, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y quitaré el pecado de la tierra en un día.

verses.KJV: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
verses.WEB: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
verses.ASV: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall ye invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig-tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, cada um de vós convidará a seu próximo para debaixo da videira, e para debaixo da figueira.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, cada uno de vosotros llamará á su compañero debajo de la vid, y debajo de la higuera.

verses.KJV: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.WEB: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.ASV: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo que falava comigo voltou e me despertou, tal como se desperta um homem de seu sono.
verses.RVR09: Y VOLVIÓ el ángel que hablaba conmigo, y despertóme como un hombre que es despertado de su sueño.

verses.KJV: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
verses.WEB: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have seen, and, behold, a candlestick all of gold, with its bowl upon the top of it, and its seven lamps thereon; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps, which are upon the top thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me disse: O que vês? E eu respondi: Eis que vejo um castiçal de ouro maciço, com um recipiente de azeite sobre seu topo, e sete lâmpadas sobre ele; e cada uma das sete lâmpadas tinha um tubo em seu topo;
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: ¿Qué ves? Y respondí: He mirado, y he aquí un candelero todo de oro, con su vaso sobre su cabeza, y sus siete lámparas encima del candelero; y siete canales para las lámparas que están encima de él;

verses.KJV: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.WEB: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
verses.ASV: and two olive-trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E duas oliveiras junto a ele, uma à direita do recipiente, e uma à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre él dos olivas, la una á la derecha del vaso, y la otra á su izquierda.

verses.KJV: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.WEB: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”
verses.ASV: And I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu perguntei ao anjo que falava comigo, dizendo: Meu senhor, o que é isto?
verses.RVR09: Proseguí, y hablé á aquel ángel que hablaba conmigo, diciendo: ¿Qué es esto, señor mío?

verses.KJV: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.WEB: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
verses.ASV: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these are? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo que falava comigo respondeu dizendo: Tu não sabes que é isto? E eu disse: Não, meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel que hablaba conmigo respondió, y díjome: ¿No sabes qué es esto? Y dije: No, señor mío.

verses.KJV: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Jehovah unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele falou comigo, dizendo: Esta é palavra do SENHOR a Zorobabel, que diz: Não [se fará] por força, nem por violência, mas sim por meu espírito, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió y hablóme, diciendo: Esta es palabra de Jehová á Zorobabel, en que se dice: No con ejército, ni con fuerza, sino con mi espíritu, ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verses.WEB: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
verses.ASV: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel [thou shalt become] a plain; and he shall bring forth the top stone with shoutings of Grace, grace, unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem és tu, montanha grande? Diante de Zorobabel se tornarás em planície; ele trará a pedra angular com gritos de: Graça! graça seja!
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién eres tú, oh gran monte? Delante de Zorobabel serás reducido á llanura: él sacará la primera piedra con aclamaciones de Gracia, gracia á ella.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué palabra de Jehová á mí, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.WEB: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
verses.ASV: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: As mãos de Zorobabel fundaram esta casa; também suas mãos a completarão, para que saibais que o SENHOR dos exércitos me enviou até vós.
verses.RVR09: Las manos de Zorobabel echarán el fundamento á esta casa, y sus manos la acabarán; y conocerás que Jehová de los ejércitos me envió á vosotros.

verses.KJV: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.WEB: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
verses.ASV: For who hath despised the day of small things? for these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel; [these are] the eyes of Jehovah, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem despreza o dia das pequenas coisas? Pois esses sete se alegrarão ao verem o prumo na mão de Zorobabel (esses são os olhos do SENHOR, que percorrem toda a terra).
verses.RVR09: Porque los que menospreciaron el día de las pequeñeces se alegrarán, y verán la plomada en la mano de Zorobabel. Aquellas siete son los ojos de Jehová que recorren por toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.WEB: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
verses.ASV: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive-trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu respondi, perguntando: O que são as duas oliveiras à direita e à esquerda do castiçal?
verses.RVR09: Hablé más, y díjele: ¿Qué significan estas dos olivas á la derecha del candelero, y á su izquierda?

verses.KJV: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
verses.WEB: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
verses.ASV: And I answered the second time, and said unto him, What are these two olive-branches, which are beside the two golden spouts, that empty the golden [oil] out of themselves?
verses.ALMEIDA: E também lhe perguntei: O que são aqueles dois ramos de oliveiras que estão de lado dos dois tubos de ouro que derramam [azeite] dourado?
verses.RVR09: Hablé aún de nuevo, y díjele: ¿Qué significan las dos ramas de olivas que por medio de dos tubos de oro vierten de sí aceite como oro?

verses.KJV: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.WEB: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
verses.ASV: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these are? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele falou comigo, dizendo: Tu não sabes o que é isto? E eu disse: Não, meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióme, diciendo: ¿No sabes qué es esto? Y dije: Señor mío, no.

verses.KJV: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.WEB: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
verses.ASV: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Estes são os dois ungidos que estão diante do Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Estos dos hijos de aceite son los que están delante del Señor de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
verses.WEB: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
verses.ASV: Then again I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a flying roll.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez levantei meus olhos, e olhei, e eis um rolo que voava.
verses.RVR09: Y TORNÉME, y alcé mis ojos, y miré, y he aquí un rollo que volaba.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me perguntou: O que vês? E eu disse: Vejo um rolo que voa, cujo comprimento é de vinte, e sua largura de dez côvados.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: ¿Qué ves? Y respondí: Veo un rollo que vuela, de veinte codos de largo, y diez codos de ancho.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
verses.WEB: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
verses.ASV: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole land: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off on the one side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off on the other side according to it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me disse: Esta é a maldição que sairá por toda a face da terra, porque qualquer um que furtar (conforme está de um lado do [rolo] ) será removido; e todo aquele que jura [falsamente] , (conforme está do outro lado do [rolo] ) será removido.
verses.RVR09: Díjome entonces: Esta es la maldición que sale sobre la haz de toda la tierra; porque todo aquel que hurta, (como está de la una parte del rollo) será destruído; y todo aquel que jura, (como está de la otra parte del rollo) será destruído.

verses.KJV: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
verses.WEB: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
verses.ASV: I will cause it to go forth, saith Jehovah of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name; and it shall abide in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu a mando,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, para que venha à casa do ladrão, e à casa do que jura falsamente pelo meu nome; e fique no meio de sua casa, e a destrua com suas colunas e suas pedras.
verses.RVR09: Yo la saqué, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y vendrá á la casa del ladrón, y á la casa del que jura falsamente en mi nombre; y permanecerá en medio de su casa, y consumirála, con sus enmaderamientos y sus piedras.

verses.KJV: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
verses.WEB: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”
verses.ASV: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo que falava comigo veio e me disse: Levanta agora teus olhos, e vê o que é que está chegando.
verses.RVR09: Y salió aquel ángel que hablaba conmigo, y díjome: Alza ahora tus ojos, y mira qué es esto que sale.

verses.KJV: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
verses.WEB: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—
verses.ASV: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is the ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their appearance in all the land
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu perguntei: O que é isto? E ele disse: Isto é um cesto de medir que está saindo.E disse mais: Este é o olho deles em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: ¿Qué es? Y él dijo: Este es un epha que sale. Además dijo: Este es el ojo de ellos en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
verses.WEB: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
verses.ASV: (and, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead); and this is a woman sitting in the midst of the ephah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uma tampa de chumbo foi levantada, e uma mulher estava sentada no meio do cesto.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, traían un talento de plomo, y una mujer estaba asentada en medio de aquel epha.

verses.KJV: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.WEB: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.
verses.ASV: And he said, This is Wickedness: and he cast her down into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Esta é a Perversidade. E a lançou dentro do cesto, e lançou o peso de chumbo em sua abertura.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Esta es la Maldad; y echóla dentro del epha, y echó la masa de plomo en su boca.

verses.KJV: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
verses.WEB: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
verses.ASV: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there came forth two women, and the wind was in their wings; now they had wings like the wings of a stork; and they lifted up the ephah between earth and heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantei meus olhos, e vi, e eis que duas mulheres saíram, e havia vento sob suas asas (pois tinham asas como de cegonha), e levantaram o cesto entre a terra e o céu.
verses.RVR09: Alcé luego mis ojos, y miré, y he aquí dos mujeres que salían, y traían viento en sus alas, y tenían alas como de cigüeña, y alzaron el epha entre la tierra y los cielos.

verses.KJV: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
verses.WEB: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
verses.ASV: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse ao anjo que falava comigo: Para onde elas estão levando o cesto?
verses.RVR09: Y dije al ángel que hablaba conmigo: ¿A dónde llevan el epha?

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, To build her a house in the land of Shinar: and when it is prepared, she shall be set there in her own place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me respondeu: Para lhe edificarem uma casa na terra de Sinar e, quando estiver pronta, e seja posto em sua base.
verses.RVR09: Y él me respondió: Para que le sea edificada casa en tierra de Shinar: y será asentado y puesto allá sobre su asiento.

verses.KJV: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.WEB: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
verses.ASV: And again I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez levantei meus olhos, e vi, e eis que quatro carruagens saíram dentre dois montes, e estes montes eram montes de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y TORNÉME, y alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí cuatro carros que salían de entre dos montes; y aquellos montes eran de metal.

verses.KJV: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.WEB: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.
verses.ASV: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.ALMEIDA: Na primeira carruagem havia cavalos vermelhos, e na segunda carruagem cavalos pretos,
verses.RVR09: En el primer carro había caballos bermejos, y en el segundo carro caballos negros,

verses.KJV: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
verses.WEB: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.
verses.ASV: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grizzled strong horses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na terceira carruagem cavalos brancos, e na quarto carruagem cavalos malhados. E [os cavalos] eram fortes.
verses.RVR09: Y en el tercer carro caballos blancos, y en el cuarto carro caballos overos ruciorodados.

verses.KJV: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
verses.WEB: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
verses.ASV: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntei ao anjo que falava comigo: O que é isto, meu senhor?
verses.RVR09: Respondí entonces, y dije al ángel que conmigo hablaba: Señor mío, ¿qué es esto?

verses.KJV: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.WEB: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.ASV: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four winds of heaven, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo me respondeu: Estes são os quatro espíritos dos céus, que saem de onde estavam diante do Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel me respondió, y díjome: Estos son los cuatro vientos de los cielos, que salen de donde están delante del Señor de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
verses.WEB: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
verses.ASV: [The chariot] wherein are the black horses goeth forth toward the north country; and the white went forth after them; and the grizzled went forth toward the south country.
verses.ALMEIDA: A [carruagem] em que estão os cavalos pretos vai para a terra do norte; os brancos vão atrás deles, e os malhados vão para a terra do sul.
verses.RVR09: En el que estaban los caballos negros, salieron hacia la tierra del aquilón; y los blancos salieron tras ellos; y lo overos salieron hacia la tierra del mediodía.

verses.KJV: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.WEB: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
verses.ASV: And the strong went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os fortes [cavalos] saíram, e procuraram ir a andarem pela terra. E ele disse: Ide, andai pela terra. E eles andaram pela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y los rucios salieron, y se afanaron por ir á recorrer la tierra. Y dijo: Id, recorred la tierra. Y recorrieron la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.WEB: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
verses.ASV: Then cried he to me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, they that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me chamou, e falou comigo, dizendo: Eis que aqueles que foram para a terra do norte fizeram descansar meu Espírito na terra do norte.
verses.RVR09: Luego me llamó, y hablóme diciendo: Mira, los que salieron hacia la tierra del aquilón hicieron reposar mi espíritu en la tierra del aquilón.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.WEB: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
verses.ASV: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, whither they are come from Babylon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma dos que foram levados cativos: Heldai, e de Tobias, e de Jedaías, que voltaram da Babilônia; e naquele mesmo dia vem, e entra na casa de Josias, filho de Sofonias;
verses.RVR09: Toma de los del cautiverio, de Heldai, y de Tobías, y de Jedaía, los cuales volvieron de Babilonia; y vendrás tú en aquel día, y entrarás en casa de Josías hijo de Sefanías;

verses.KJV: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
verses.WEB: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
verses.ASV: yea, take [of them] silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma prata e ouro, e faze coroas, e põe sobre a cabeça do sumo sacerdote Josué, filho de Jeozadaque;
verses.RVR09: Tomarás pues plata y oro, y harás coronas, y las pondrás en la cabeza del gran sacerdote Josué, hijo de Josadac;

verses.KJV: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The Branch; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord:
verses.WEB: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.
verses.ASV: and speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, saying, Behold, the man whose name is the Branch: and he shall grow up out of his place; and he shall build the temple of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E fala com ele, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis aqui o homem cujo nome é Renovo; ele brotará de seu lugar, e edificará o templo do SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Y le hablarás, diciendo: Así ha hablado Jehová de los ejércitos, diciendo: He aquí el varón cuyo nombre es Pimpollo, el cual germinará de su lugar, y edificará el templo de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.WEB: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
verses.ASV: even he shall build the temple of Jehovah; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne; and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mesmo edificará o templo do SENHOR, e levará sobre si majestade; e se sentará e dominará em seu trono, e será sacerdote em seu trono; e haverá conselho de paz entre ambos.
verses.RVR09: El edificará el templo de Jehová, y él llevará gloria, y se sentará y dominará en su trono, y será sacerdote en su solio; y consejo de paz será entre ambos á dos.

verses.KJV: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.
verses.ASV: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as coroas serão para Helem, Tobias, e Jedaías, e Hem, filho de Sofonias, como memorial no templo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Helem, y Tobías, y Jedaía, y Hen, hijo de Sefanías, tendrán coronas por memorial en el templo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”
verses.ASV: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of Jehovah; and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto you. And [this] shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estão longe virão e participarão da construção do templo do SENHOR, e vós sabereis que o SENHOR dos exércitos me enviou a vós. Isto acontecerá se verdadeiramente ouvirdes à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y los que están lejos vendrán y edificarán en el templo de Jehová, y conoceréis que Jehová de los ejércitos me ha enviado á vosotros. Y será esto, si oyereis obedientes la voz de Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
verses.WEB: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Jehovah came unto Zechariah in the fourth [day] of the ninth month, even in Chislev.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aconteceu, pois, no quarto ano do rei Dario, que a palavra do SENHOR veio a Zacarias noquarto [dia] do nono mês, [que é] Quisleu,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en el año cuarto del rey Darío, que fué palabra de Jehová á Zacarías á los cuatro del mes noveno, que es Chisleu;

verses.KJV: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,
