verses.WEB: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,
verses.ASV: Now [they of] Beth-el had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to entreat the favor of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os de Betel enviaram Sarezer e Regém-Meleque e seus homens, para suplicarem o favor do SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Cuando fué enviado á la casa de Dios, Saraser, con Regem-melech y sus hombres, á implorar el favor de Jehová,

verses.KJV: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.WEB: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
verses.ASV: [and] to speak unto the priests of the house of Jehovah of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.ALMEIDA: E para dizerem aos sacerdotes que estavam na casa do SENHOR dos exércitos e aos profetas o seguinte: Devemos chorar e jejuar no quinto mês, como já temos feito há tantos anos?
verses.RVR09: Y á hablar á los sacerdotes que estaban en la casa de Jehová de los ejércitos, y á los profetas, diciendo: ¿Lloraremos en el mes quinto? ¿haremos abstinencia como hemos hecho ya algunos años?

verses.KJV: Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Then came the word of Jehovah of hosts unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a palavra do SENHOR dos exércitos veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Fué pues á mí palabra de Jehová de los ejércitos, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
verses.WEB: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
verses.ASV: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh [month], even these seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a todo o povo desta terra, e aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Quando jejuastes e chorastes no quinto e no sétimo [mês] durante estes setenta anos, por acaso jejuastes verdadeiramente para mim?
verses.RVR09: Habla á todo el pueblo del país, y á los sacerdotes, diciendo: Cuando ayunasteis y llorasteis en el quinto y en el séptimo mes estos setenta años, ¿habéis ayunado para mí?

verses.KJV: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
verses.WEB: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
verses.ASV: And when ye eat, and when ye drink, do not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando comeis e bebeis, não foi para vós que comeis e bebeis?
verses.RVR09: Y cuando coméis y bebéis, ¿no coméis y bebéis para vosotros?

verses.KJV: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
verses.WEB: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
verses.ASV: [Should ye] not [hear] the words which Jehovah cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não são estas as palavras que o SENHOR pregou por meio dos antigos profetas, quando Jerusalém estava habitada e tranquila, com suas cidades ao seu redor, e o Sul e a campina eram habitadas?
verses.RVR09: ¿No son estas las palabras que publicó Jehová por mano de los profetas primeros, cuando Jerusalem estaba habitada y quieta, y sus ciudades en sus alrededores, y el mediodía y la campiña se habitaban?

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR veio a Zacarias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué palabra de Jehová á Zacarías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
verses.WEB: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
verses.ASV: Thus hath Jehovah of hosts spoken, saying, Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim falou o SENHOR dos exércitos, dizendo: Julgai juízo verdadeiro, e praticai piedade e misericórdia cada um com seu irmão;
verses.RVR09: Así habló Jehová de los ejércitos, diciendo: Juzgad juicio verdadero, y haced misericordia y piedad cada cual con su hermano:

verses.KJV: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.WEB: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
verses.ASV: and oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the sojourner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não oprimais à viúva, nem ao órfão, nem ao estrangeiro, nem ao pobre; e ninguém planeje o mal em seu coração contra seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: No agraviéis á la viuda, ni al huérfano, ni al extranjero, ni al pobre; ni ninguno piense mal en su corazón contra su hermano.

verses.KJV: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
verses.WEB: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
verses.ASV: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não quiseram prestar atenção; ao invés disso deram as costas e taparam suas orelhas para não ouvirem.
verses.RVR09: Empero no quisieron escuchar, antes dieron hombro rebelado, y agravaron sus oídos para no oir:

verses.KJV: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which Jehovah of hosts had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets: therefore there came great wrath from Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram seus corações duros como diamante, para não ouvirem a Lei nem as palavras que o SENHOR dos exércitos enviou por seu Espírito através dos antigos profetas; por isso veio grande ira da parte do SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron su corazón como diamante, para no oir la ley ni las palabras que Jehová de los ejércitos enviaba por su espíritu, por mano de los profetas primeros: fué, por tanto, hecho grande castigo por Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:
verses.WEB: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;
verses.ASV: And it is come to pass that, as he cried, and they would not hear, so they shall cry, and I will not hear, said Jehovah of hosts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa disso, tal como eles não ouviram quando eu clamei, assim tamb em quando eles clamaram eu não ouvi,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como él clamó, y no escucharon, así ellos clamaron, y yo no escuché, dice Jehová de los ejércitos;

verses.KJV: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.WEB: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
verses.ASV: but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu os espalhei com turbilhão entre todas as nações, que eles não conheciam, e a terra foi assolada atrás deles, de maneira que ninguém passava por ela, nem voltava; porque tornaram a terra desejada em ruínas.
verses.RVR09: Antes los esparcí con torbellino por todas las gentes que ellos no conocían, y la tierra fué desolada tras de ellos, sin quedar quien fuese ni viniese; pues tornaron en asolamiento el país deseable.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.WEB: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah of hosts came [to me], saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois veio a palavra do SENHOR dos exércitos, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová de los ejércitos, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Tenho grande zelo por Sião, e com grande furor zelo por ela.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Yo he celado á Sión con grande celo, y con grande ira la celé.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called The city of truth; and the mountain of Jehovah of hosts, The holy mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eu voltarei a Sião, e habitarei no meio de Jerusalém. E Jerusalém será chamada Cidade da Verdade, e o monte do SENHOR dos exércitos, Monte Santo.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová: Yo he restituído á Sión, y moraré en medio de Jerusalem: y Jerusalem se llamará Ciudad de Verdad, y el monte de Jehová de los ejércitos, Monte de Santidad.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Novamente idosos e idosas se sentarão nas praças de Jerusalém, e cada um terá seu bordão em sua mão, por causa da abundância de dias.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Aun han de morar viejos y viejas en las plazas de Jerusalem, y cada cual con bordón en su mano por la multitud de los días.

verses.KJV: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.WEB: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
verses.ASV: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as ruas da cidade se encherão de meninos e meninas, brincando em suas ruas.
verses.RVR09: Y las calles de la ciudad serán llenas de muchachos y muchachas, que jugarán en las calles.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Se isto era extraordinário demais aos olhos do restante do povo naqueles dias, seria também extraordinário demais aos meus olhos? Diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová de los ejércitos: Si esto parecerá dificultoso á los ojos del resto de este pueblo en aquellos días, ¿también será dificultoso delante de mis ojos? dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim disse o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que salvarei o meu povo da terra do oriente, e da terra do ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: He aquí, yo salvo mi pueblo de la tierra del oriente, y de la tierra donde se pone el sol;

verses.KJV: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.WEB: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”
verses.ASV: and I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os trarei, e habitarão no meio de Jerusalém; e eles serão meu povo, e eu serei o Deus deles em verdade e em justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y traerélos, y habitarán en medio de Jerusalem; y me serán por pueblo, y yo seré á ellos por Dios con verdad y con justicia.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets that were in the day that the foundation of the house of Jehovah of hosts was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Sejam fortes vossas mãos, vós que nestes dias ouvistes estas palavras da boca dos profetas que estiveram no dia em que foi posto o fundamento da casa do SENHOR dos exércitos, para que o templo fosse edificado.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Esfuércense vuestras manos, de vosotros los que oís en estos días estas palabras de la boca de los profetas, desde el día que se echó el cimiento á la casa de Jehová de los ejércitos, para edificar el templo.

verses.KJV: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.WEB: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.
verses.ASV: For before those days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in, because of the adversary: for I set all men every one against his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque antes daqueles dias não houve salário para homem, nem salário para animal, e o que entrava e o que saía não tinha paz por causa do inimigo, porque eu mandei a todos, cada um contra seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Porque antes de estos días no ha habido paga de hombre, ni paga de bestia, ni hubo paz alguna para entrante ni para saliente, á causa del enemigo: y yo dejé todos los hombres, cada cual contra su compañero.

verses.KJV: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: But now I will not be unto the remnant of this people as in the former days, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora com o resto deste povo não farei como nos dias passados, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora no lo haré con el resto de este pueblo como en aquellos días pasados, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
verses.WEB: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
verses.ASV: For [there shall be] the seed of peace; the vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a semente será próspera, a vide dará seu fruto, a terra dará seu produto, e os céus darão seu orvalho; e farei o resto deste povo herdar tudo isto.
verses.RVR09: Porque habrá simiente de paz; la vid dará su fruto, y dará su producto la tierra, y los cielos darán su rocío; y haré que el resto de este pueblo posea todo esto.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verses.WEB: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass that, as ye were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing. Fear not, [but] let your hands be strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será, ó casa de Judá e casa de Israel, que, assim como fostes maldição entre as nações, assim também eu vos salvarei, e sereis bênção. Não temais, fortaleçam-se vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y será que como fuisteis maldición entre las gentes, oh casa de Judá y casa de Israel, así os salvaré, y seréis bendición. No temáis, mas esfuércense vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: As I thought to do evil unto you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I repented not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Assim como eu pensei vos fazer o mal quando vossos pais me provocaram à ira, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, e não me arrependi;
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Como pensé haceros mal cuando vuestros padres me provocaron á ira, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y no me arrepentí;

verses.KJV: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
verses.WEB: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.
verses.ASV: so again have I thought in these days to do good unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também voltei a pensar em fazer o bem a Jerusalém e à casa de Judá nestes dias; não temais.
verses.RVR09: Así tornando he pensado de hacer bien á Jerusalem y á la casa de Judá en estos días: no temáis.

verses.KJV: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
verses.WEB: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,
verses.ASV: These are the things that ye shall do: Speak ye every man the truth with his neighbor; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as coisas que deveis fazer: falai verdade cada qual com seu próximo; julgai em vossas portas verdade e juízo de paz:
verses.RVR09: Estas son las cosas que habéis de hacer: Hablad verdad cada cual con su prójimo; juzgad en vuestras puertas verdad y juicio de paz:

verses.KJV: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém planeje o mal em seu coração contra seu próximo, nem ameis o juramento falso; porque eu odeio todas estas coisas, diz o SENHOR
verses.RVR09: Y ninguno de vosotros piense mal en su corazón contra su prójimo, ni améis juramento falso: porque todas estas son cosas que aborrezco, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah of hosts came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR dos exércitos veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová de los ejércitos, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The fast of the fourth [month], and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love truth and peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: O jejum do quarto, do quinto, do sétimo, e do décimo mês, se voltarão à casa de Judá serão para prazer e alegria, e para festividades solenes. Amai, pois, a verdade e a paz.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: El ayuno del cuarto mes, y el ayuno del quinto, y el ayuno del séptimo, y el ayuno del décimo, se tornarán á la casa de Judá en gozo y alegría, y en festivas solemnidades. Amad pues verdad y paz.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: [It shall] yet [come to pass], that there shall come peoples, and the inhabitants of many cities;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Ainda será que povos e moradores de muitas cidades virão,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Aun vendrán pueblos, y moradores de muchas ciudades;

verses.KJV: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.
verses.WEB: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies. I will go also.’
verses.ASV: and the inhabitants of one [city] shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to entreat the favor of Jehovah, and to seek Jehovah of hosts: I will go also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irão os moradores de uma [cidade] à outra, dizendo: Vamos suplicar o favor do SENHOR, e buscar ao SENHOR dos exércitos. Eu também irei.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán los moradores de la una á la otra, y dirán: Vamos á implorar el favor de Jehová, y á buscar á Jehová de los ejércitos. Yo también iré.

verses.KJV: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD.”
verses.ASV: Yea, many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek Jehovah of hosts in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favor of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim muitos povos e poderosas nações virão para buscar ao SENHOR dos exércitos em Jerusalém, e suplicar o favor do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán muchos pueblos y fuertes naciones á buscar á Jehová de los ejércitos en Jerusalem, y á implorar el favor de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: In those days [it shall come to pass], that ten men shall take hold, out of all the languages of the nations, they shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Naqueles dias será que dez homens de todas as línguas das nações, pegarão na orla da veste de um judeu, dizendo: Iremos convosco, porque temos ouvido que Deus está convosco.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: En aquellos días acontecerá que diez hombres de todas las lenguas de las gentes, trabarán de la falda de un Judío, diciendo: Iremos con vosotros, porque hemos oído que Dios está con vosotros.

verses.KJV: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.
verses.WEB: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—
verses.ASV: The burden of the word of Jehovah upon the land of Hadrach, and Damascus [shall be] its resting-place (for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Jehovah);
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação da palavra do SENHOR contra terra de Hadraque e de Damasco, seu repouso; porque os olhos da humanidade e de todas as tribos de Israel [estão voltados] ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de la palabra de Jehová contra tierra de Hadrach, y de Damasco su reposo: porque á Jehová están vueltos los ojos de los hombres, y de todas las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.WEB: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
verses.ASV: and Hamath, also, which bordereth thereon; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também [contra] Hamate que faz fronteira com ela; Tiro e Sidom, ainda que seja muito sábia.
verses.RVR09: Y también Hamath tendrá término en ella; Tiro y Sidón, aunque muy sabia sea.

verses.KJV: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.WEB: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
verses.ASV: And Tyre did build herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tiro edificou para si fortalezas, e amontoou prata como pó da terra, e ouro como lama das ruas.
verses.RVR09: Bien que Tiro se edificó fortaleza, y amontonó plata como polvo, y oro como lodo de las calles,

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.WEB: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
verses.ASV: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o Senhor a desapossará, e no mar ferirá sua fortaleza, e ela será consumida pelo fogo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, el Señor la empobrecerá, y herirá en la mar su fortaleza, y ella será consumida de fuego.

verses.KJV: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.WEB: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
verses.ASV: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also, and shall be sore pained; and Ekron, for her expectation shall be put to shame; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Asquelom verá, e temerá; Gaza também, e terá grande dor; assim como Ecrom, pois aquilo em que confiavam se envergonhará; o rei de Gaza perecerá, e Asquelom não será habitada.
verses.RVR09: Ascalón verá, y temerá; Gaza también, y se dolerá en gran manera: asimismo Ecrón, porque su esperanza será confundida; y de Gaza perecerá el rey, y Ascalón no será habitada.

verses.KJV: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.ASV: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um povo misturado habitará em Asdode, e eu acabarei com a arrogância dos filisteus;
verses.RVR09: Y habitará en Asdod un extranjero, y yo talaré la soberbia de los Palestinos;

verses.KJV: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.WEB: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.ASV: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also shall be a remnant for our God; and he shall be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirarei seu sangue de sua boca, e suas abominações dentre seus dentes; porém os que restarem serão para nosso Deus, e serão como príncipes em Judá; e Ecrom será como o jebuseu.
verses.RVR09: Y quitaré sus sangres de su boca, y sus abominaciones de sus dientes, y quedarán ellos también para nuestro Dios, y serán como capitanes en Judá, y Ecrón como el Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
verses.WEB: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
verses.ASV: And I will encamp about my house against the army, that none pass through or return; and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me acamparei ao redor de minha casa [contra] o exército [inimigo] ,para que não passe nem volte; para que o opressor não passe mais por eles; porque agora eu vi com meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y seré real de ejército á mi casa, á causa del que va y del que viene: y no pasará más sobre ellos angustiador; porque ahora miré con mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.WEB: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.ASV: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy king cometh unto thee; he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, even upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegra-te muito, ó filha de Sião; dá vozes de júbilo, ó filha de Jerusalém; eis que teu rei virá a ti, justo e salvador, humilde, e montado sobre um asno, sobre um jumentinho, filho de jumenta.
verses.RVR09: Alégrate mucho, hija de Sión; da voces de júbilo, hija de Jerusalem: he aquí, tu rey vendrá á ti, justo y salvador, humilde, y cabalgando sobre un asno, así sobre un pollino hijo de asna.

verses.KJV: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.ASV: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off; and he shall speak peace unto the nations: and his dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destruirei as carruagens de Efraim, e os cavalos de Jerusalém; os arcos de guerra também serão quebrados; e ele falará paz às nações; e seu domínio será de mar a mar, e desde o rio até os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y de Ephraim destruiré los carros, y los caballos de Jerusalem; y los arcos de guerra serán quebrados: y hablará paz á las gentes; y su señorío será de mar á mar, y desde el río hasta los fines de la tierra.

verses.KJV: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
verses.WEB: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
verses.ASV: As for thee also, because of the blood of thy covenant I have set free thy prisoners from the pit wherein is no water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a ti, pelo sangue de teu pacto, eu libertei teus prisioneiros da cova em que não havia água.
verses.RVR09: Y tú también por la sangre de tu pacto serás salva; yo he sacado tus presos del aljibe en que no hay agua.

verses.KJV: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verses.WEB: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
verses.ASV: Turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope: even to-day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltai-vos à fortaleza, ó prisioneiros que tendes esperança; hoje também vos anuncio que vos recompensarei em dobro.
verses.RVR09: Tornaos á la fortaleza, oh presos de esperanza: hoy también os anuncio que os daré doblado.

verses.KJV: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.WEB: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
verses.ASV: For I have bent Judah for me, I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I will stir up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and will make thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois encurvarei a Judá para mim como arco, porei a Efraim como flecha; e despertarei teus filhos, ó Sião, contra teus filhos, ó Grécia; e farei de ti, [Sião] , como espada de guerreiro.
verses.RVR09: Porque entesado he para mí á Judá como arco, henchí á Ephraim; y despertaré tus hijos, oh Sión, contra tus hijos, oh Grecia, y te pondré como espada de valiente.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.WEB: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah shall be seen over them; and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning; and the Lord Jehovah will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR será visto acima deles, e sua flecha sairá como relâmpago; o Senhor DEUS tocará trombeta, e irá como os turbilhões do sul.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová será visto sobre ellos, y su dardo saldrá como relámpago: y el Señor Jehová tocará trompeta, é irá como torbellinos del austro.

verses.KJV: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts will defend them; and they shall devour, and shall tread down the sling-stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dos exércitos os protegerá, e eles consumirão, e sujeitarão [com] pedras da funda; também beberão e farão gritarias como [bêbados de] vinho; e se encherão como a bacia de sacrifício, ou como os cantos do altar.
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos los amparará, y ellos devorarán, y sujetarán á las piedras de la honda, y beberán, y harán estrépito como tomados del vino; y se llenarán como cuenco, ó como los lados del altar.

verses.KJV: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.WEB: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for [they shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR, Deus deles, os salvará naquele dia como o rebanho de seu povo; porque serão como pedras de coroa, erguidas na terra dele.
verses.RVR09: Y los salvará en aquel día Jehová su Dios como á rebaño de su pueblo: porque serán engrandecidos en su tierra como piedras de corona.

verses.KJV: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
verses.WEB: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
verses.ASV: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois como será grande sua prosperidade, e tamanha sua beleza! O trigo fortalecerá os rapazes, e o suco de uva as virgens.
verses.RVR09: Porque ¡cuánta es su bondad, y cuánta su hermosura! El trigo alegrará á los mancebos, y el vino á las doncellas.

verses.KJV: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.WEB: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
verses.ASV: Ask ye of Jehovah rain in the time of the latter rain, [even of] Jehovah that maketh lightnings; and he will give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedi, vós, ao SENHOR chuva no tempo da chuva tardia; o SENHOR faz relâmpagos, e lhes dará chuva abundante, e erva no campo a cada um.
verses.RVR09: PEDID á Jehová lluvia en la sazón tardía: Jehová hará relámpagos, y os dará lluvia abundante, y hierba en el campo á cada uno.

verses.KJV: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
verses.WEB: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
verses.ASV: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams, they comfort in vain: therefore they go their way like sheep, they are afflicted, because there is no shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os ídolos falam ilusão, e os adivinhos veem falsidade, e falado sonhos ilusórios; com ilusão consolam; por isso eles foram embora como ovelhas, humilhadas, porque não havia pastor.
verses.RVR09: Porque las imágenes han hablado vanidad, y los adivinos han visto mentira, y han hablado sueños vanos, en vano consuelan: por lo cual se fueron ellos como ovejas, fueron humillados porque no tuvieron pastor.

verses.KJV: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.WEB: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
verses.ASV: Mine anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the he-goats; for Jehovah of hosts hath visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha ira se acendeu contra os pastores, e castigarei os bodes; mas o SENHOR dos exércitos visitará seu rebanho, a casa de Judá, e fará com que sejam como seu cavalo de honra na batalha.
verses.RVR09: Contra los pastores se ha encendido mi enojo, y castigaré los machos de cabrío: mas Jehová de los ejércitos visitará su rebaño, la casa de Judá, y tornarálos como su caballo de honor en la guerra.

verses.KJV: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.WEB: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
verses.ASV: From him shall come forth the corner-stone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ele [sairá] a pedra angular, a estaca, e o arco da guerra; dele juntamente sairá todo dominador.
verses.RVR09: De él saldrá el ángulo, de él la clavija, de él el arco de la guerra, de él también todo apremiador.

verses.KJV: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.WEB: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.
verses.ASV: And they shall be as mighty men, treading down [their enemies] in the mire of the streets in the battle; and they shall fight, because Jehovah is with them; and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serão como guerreiros que pisam [o inimigo] na lama das ruas na batalha; e lutarão, porque o SENHOR estará com eles; e envergonharão aos que montam em cavalos.
verses.RVR09: Y serán como valientes, que en la batalla pisan al enemigo en el lodo de las calles; y pelearán, porque Jehová será con ellos; y los que cabalgan en caballos serán avergonzados.

verses.KJV: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and will hear them.
verses.WEB: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.
verses.ASV: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back; for I have mercy upon them; and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Jehovah their God, and I will hear them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu fortalecerei a casa de Judá, e salvarei a casa de José; e voltarei a estabelecê-los, porque me compadeci deles; e serão como se eu não tivesse os rejeitado, porque eu sou o SENHOR, Deus deles, que os ouvirei.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo fortificaré la casa de Judá, y guardaré la casa de José; y harélos volver, porque de ellos tendré piedad; y serán como si no los hubiera desechado; porque yo soy Jehová su Dios, que los oiré.

verses.KJV: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.
verses.ASV: And [they of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine; yea, their children shall see it, and rejoice; their heart shall be glad in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Efraim será como guerreiro, e seu coração se alegrará como de vinho; seus filhos verão, e ficarão contentes; seus corações se alegrarão no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y será Ephraim como valiente, y alegraráse su corazón como de vino: sus hijos también verán y se alegrarán; su corazón se gozará en Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.WEB: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.
verses.ASV: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them; and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu assoviarei a eles, e os ajuntarei, porque eu os resgatarei; e serão muitos assim como eram muitos [no passado] .
verses.RVR09: Yo les silbaré y los juntaré, porque los he redimido; y serán multiplicados como fueron multiplicados.

verses.KJV: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.WEB: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.
verses.ASV: And I will sow them among the peoples; and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and shall return.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu os semearei entre os povos, e se lembrarão de mim em lugares remotos; e viverão com seus filhos, e voltarão.
verses.RVR09: Bien que los sembraré entre los pueblos, aun en lejanos países se acordarán de mí; y vivirán con sus hijos, y tornarán.

verses.KJV: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
verses.WEB: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
verses.ASV: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and [place] shall not be found for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os trarei de volta da terra do Egito, e os recolherei da Assíria; e os trarei à terra de Gileade e do Líbano, mas não será [espaço] suficiente para eles.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo los tornaré de la tierra de Egipto, y los recogeré de la Asiria; y traerélos á la tierra de Galaad y del Líbano, y no les bastará.

verses.KJV: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.WEB: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
verses.ASV: And he will pass through the sea of affliction, and will smite the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile shall dry up; and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele passará pela mar da aflição, ferirá as ondas do mar, e todas as profundezas do rio se secarão; e a arrogância dos assírios será derrubada, e o cetro do Egito será tomado.
verses.RVR09: Y la tribulación pasará por la mar, y en la mar herirá las ondas, y se secarán todas las honduras del río: y la soberbia del Assur será derribada, y se perderá el cetro de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will strengthen them in Jehovah; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu os fortificarei no SENHOR, e andarão em seu nome, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y yo los fortificaré en Jehová, y caminarán en su nombre, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.WEB: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
verses.ASV: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre tuas portas, ó Líbano, para que o fogo consuma teus cedros.
verses.RVR09: OH Líbano, abre tus puertas, y queme fuego tus cedros.

verses.KJV: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
verses.WEB: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.
verses.ASV: Wail, O fir-tree, for the cedar is fallen, because the goodly ones are destroyed: wail, O ye oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest is come down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lamenta, ó cipreste, porque o cedro caiu, porque os maiorais foram destruídos. Lamentai, ó carvalhos de Basã, porque o forte bosque foi derrubado.
verses.RVR09: Aulla, oh haya, porque el cedro cayó, porque los magníficos son talados. Aullad, alcornoques de Basán, porque el fuerte monte es derribado.

verses.KJV: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
verses.WEB: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
verses.ASV: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! for their glory is destroyed: a voice of the roaring of young lions! for the pride of the Jordan is laid waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ouve-se] voz de lamentação de pastores, porque sua glória foi destruída; [ouve-se] voz dos bramidos de leões jovens, porque a arrogância do Jordão foi destruída.
verses.RVR09: Voz de aullido de pastores, porque su magnificencia es asolada; estruendo de bramidos de cachorros de leones, porque la soberbia del Jordán es destruída.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
verses.WEB: The LORD my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
verses.ASV: Thus said Jehovah my God: Feed the flock of slaughter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR meu Deus: Apascenta as ovelhas da matança,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová mi Dios: Apacienta las ovejas de la matanza;

verses.KJV: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.WEB: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.
verses.ASV: whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty; and they that sell them say, Blessed be Jehovah, for I am rich; and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujos compradores as matam, e ninguém os considera culpados; e os que as vendem dizem: Bendito seja o SENHOR, porque estou rico; nem seus pastores se compadecem delas.
verses.RVR09: A las cuales mataban sus compradores, y no se tenían por culpables; y el que las vendía, decía: Bendito sea Jehová, que he enriquecido; ni sus pastores tenían piedad de ellas.

verses.KJV: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
verses.WEB: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says the LORD; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”
verses.ASV: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah; but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbor’s hand, and into the hand of his king; and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente não mais pouparei os moradores da terra,diz o SENHOR; mas eis que eu entregarei os homens, cada um na mão de seu próximo, e em mão de seu rei; e despedaçarão esta terra, e eu não [os] livrarei de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no más tendré piedad de los moradores de la tierra, dice Jehová: porque he aquí, yo entregaré los hombres, cada cual en mano de su compañero, y en mano de su rey; y quebrantarán la tierra, y yo no libraré de sus manos.

verses.KJV: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.WEB: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.
verses.ASV: So I fed the flock of slaughter, verily the poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu apascentei as ovelhas da matança, as pobres do rebanho. E tomei para mim duas varas; a uma chamei Agrado e à outra chamei União; e apascentei as ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Apacenté pues las ovejas de la matanza, es á saber, los pobres del rebaño. Y me tomé dos cayados; al uno puse por nombre Suavidad, y al otro Ataduras; y apacenté las ovejas.

verses.KJV: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.WEB: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
verses.ASV: And I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acabei com três pastores em um mês, pois minha alma estava impaciente com eles, e também a almas deles me odiavam.
verses.RVR09: E hice matar tres pastores en un mes, y mi alma se angustió por ellos, y también el alma de ellos me aborreció á mí.

verses.KJV: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, I will not feed you: that which dieth, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let them that are left eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Não vos apascentarei; a que morrer, morra; e a que se perder, se perca; e as que restarem, que uma devore a carne da outra.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: No os apacentaré; la que muriere, muera; y la que se perdiere, se pierda; y las que quedaren, que cada una coma la carne de su compañera.

verses.KJV: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
verses.WEB: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
verses.ASV: And I took my staff Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E peguei minha vara Agrado, e a quebrei, para desfazer meu pacto que tinha estabelecido com todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Tomé luego mi cayado Suavidad, y quebrélo, para deshacer mi pacto que concerté con todos los pueblos.

verses.KJV: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: And it was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that gave heed unto me knew that it was the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foi desfeito naquele dia, e assim as pobres do rebanho que me observavam reconheceram que isto era palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y fué deshecho en ese día, y así conocieron los pobres del rebaño que miran á mí, que era palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
verses.WEB: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
verses.ASV: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my hire; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my hire thirty [pieces] of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu havia lhes dito: Se vos parece bem aos vossos olhos, dai-me meu salário; e se não, deixai-o. E pesaram meu salário: trinta [moedas] de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y díjeles: Si os parece bien, dadme mi salario; y si no, dejadlo. Y pesaron para mi salario treinta piezas de plata.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Cast it unto the potter, the goodly price that I was prized at by them. And I took the thirty [pieces] of silver, and cast them unto the potter, in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR, pois, me disse: Lança-as ao oleiro, este belo preço que me avaliaram.E tomei as trinta [moedas] de prata, e as lancei na casa do SENHOR ao oleiro.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: Echalo al tesorero, hermoso precio con que me han apreciado. Y tomé las treinta piezas de plata, y echélas en la casa de Jehová al tesorero.

verses.KJV: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.WEB: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.ASV: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então quebrei logo minha segunda vara União, rompendo a fraternidade entre Judá e Israel.
verses.RVR09: Quebré luego el otro mi cayado Ataduras, para romper la hermandad entre Judá é Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Take unto thee yet again the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me disse mais: Toma ainda para ti os instrumentos de um pastor insensato;
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: Toma aún el hato de un pastor insensato;

verses.KJV: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
verses.WEB: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.
verses.ASV: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not visit those that are cut off, neither will seek those that are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the flesh of the fat [sheep], and will tear their hoofs in pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que eu levantarei um pastor na terra, que não cuidará das perdidas, não buscará a pequena, não tratará de curar a que estiver machucada, nem apascentará a sã; em vez disso, ele comerá a carne da que estiver gorda, e quebrará suas unhas.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, yo levanto pastor en la tierra, que no visitará las perdidas, no buscará la pequeña, no curará la perniquebrada, ni llevará la cansada á cuestas; sino que se comerá la carne de la gruesa, y romperá sus uñas.

verses.KJV: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.WEB: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
verses.ASV: Woe to the worthless shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai do pastor inútil, que desampara o rebanho! Espada [virá] contra seu braço, e contra seu olho direito; seu braço se secará por completo, e seu olho direito será obscurecido.
verses.RVR09: Mal haya el pastor de nada, que deja el ganado. Espada sobre su brazo, y sobre su ojo derecho: del todo se secará su brazo, y enteramente será su ojo derecho oscurecido.

verses.KJV: The burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.WEB: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:
verses.ASV: The burden of the word of Jehovah concerning Israel. [Thus] saith Jehovah, who stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação da palavra do SENHOR sobre Israel: O SENHOR, que estende o céu, e funda a terra, e forma o espírito do ser humano em seu interior, diz:
verses.RVR09: CARGA de la palabra de Jehová acerca de Israel. Jehová, que extiende los cielos, y funda la tierra, y forma el espíritu del hombre dentro de él, ha dicho:

verses.KJV: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling unto all the peoples round about, and upon Judah also shall it be in the siege against Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu farei de Jerusalém um copo de cambalear a todos os povos de ao redor; e também será sobre Judá, durante o cerco contra Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo pongo á Jerusalem por vaso de temblor á todos los pueblos de alrededor cuando estén en el sitio contra Judá y contra Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples; all that burden themselves with it shall be sore wounded; and all the nations of the earth shall be gathered together against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que farei de Jerusalém uma pedra pesada a todos os povos; todos os que a carregarem serão seriamente feridos, ainda que todas as nações da terra se ajuntarão contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Y será en aquel día, que yo pondré á Jerusalem por piedra pesada á todos los pueblos: todos los que se la cargaren, serán despedazados, bien que todas las gentes de la tierra se juntarán contra ella.

verses.KJV: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.WEB: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.ASV: In that day, saith Jehovah, I will smite every horse with terror, and his rider with madness; and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia,diz o SENHOR, ferirei com espanto a todo cavalo, e com loucura ao cavaleiro; mas sobre a casa de Judá abrirei meus olhos, e a todo cavalo dos povos ferirei com cegueira.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día, dice Jehová, heriré con aturdimiento á todo caballo, y con locura al que en él sube; mas sobre la casa de Judá abriré mis ojos, y á todo caballo de los pueblos heriré con ceguera.

verses.KJV: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the Lord of hosts their God.
verses.WEB: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’
verses.ASV: And the chieftains of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Jehovah of hosts their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os líderes de Judá dirão em seu coração: Os moradores de Jerusalém serão minha força no SENHOR dos exércitos seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y los capitanes de Judá dirán en su corazón: Mi fuerza son los moradores de Jerusalem en Jehová de los ejércitos su Dios.

verses.KJV: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: In that day will I make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves; and they shall devour all the peoples round about, on the right hand and on the left; and [they of] Jerusalem shall yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia farei dos líderes de Judá como um braseiro de fogo debaixo da lenha, e como tocha de fogo debaixo de gravetos; e consumirão todos os povos ao redor à direita e à esquerda; e Jerusalém continuará habitada em seu lugar, em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día pondré los capitanes de Judá como un brasero de fuego en leña, y como una hacha de fuego en gavillas; y consumirán á diestra y á siniestra todos los pueblos alrededor: y Jerusalem será otra vez habitada en su lugar, en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
verses.WEB: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
verses.ASV: Jehovah also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem be not magnified above Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR salvará primeiramente as tendas de Judá, para que a glória da casa de Davi e a glória dos moradores de Jerusalém não se exaltem sobre Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y librará Jehová las tiendas de Judá primero, porque la gloria de la casa de David y del morador de Jerusalem no se engrandezca sobre Judá.

verses.KJV: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.
verses.WEB: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.
verses.ASV: In that day shall Jehovah defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of Jehovah before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia o SENHOR defenderá os moradores de Jerusalém; e o que mais fraco dentre eles, naquele dia será como Davi; e a casa de Davi será como Deus, como o anjo do SENHOR diante deles.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día Jehová defenderá al morador de Jerusalem: y el que entre ellos fuere flaco, en aquel tiempo será como David; y la casa de David como ángeles, como el ángel de Jehová delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia que eu buscarei destruir todas as nações que vierem contra Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Y será que en aquel día yo procuraré quebrantar todas las gentes que vinieren contra Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verses.WEB: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.
verses.ASV: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplication; and they shall look unto me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his first-born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém sobre a casa de Davi e sobre os moradores de Jerusalém derramarei o Espírito de graça e de orações; e olharão a mim, a quem traspassaram; e farão pranto sobre ele, como pranto [da morte] de filho único; e chorarão amargamente por causa dele, tal como se chora pelo primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Y derramaré sobre la casa de David, y sobre los moradores de Jerusalem, espíritu de gracia y de oración; y mirarán á mí, á quien traspasaron, y harán llanto sobre él, como llanto sobre unigénito, afligiéndose sobre él como quien se aflige sobre primogénito.

verses.KJV: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.WEB: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.ASV: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia haverá grande pranto em Jerusalém, como o pranto de Hadade-Rimom no vale de Megido.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día habrá gran llanto en Jerusalem, como el llanto de Adadrimón en el valle de Megiddo.

verses.KJV: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.WEB: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.ASV: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra prateará, cada família por si só; a família da casa de Davi por si, e suas mulheres por si; a família da casa de Natã por si, e suas mulheres por si;
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra lamentará, cada linaje de por sí; el linaje de la casa de David por sí, y sus mujeres por sí; el linaje de la casa de Nathán por sí, y sus mujeres por sí;

verses.KJV: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.WEB: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
verses.ASV: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
verses.ALMEIDA: A família da casa de Levi por si, e suas mulheres por si; a família de Simei por si, e suas mulheres por si;
verses.RVR09: El linaje de la casa de Leví por sí, y sus mujeres por sí; el linaje de Simei por sí, y sus mujeres por sí;

verses.KJV: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.WEB: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.ASV: all the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos as demais famílias, cada família por si, e suas mulheres por si.
verses.RVR09: Todos los otros linajes, los linajes por sí, y sus mujeres por sí.

verses.KJV: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.WEB: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.ASV: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia haverá uma fonte aberta para a casa de Davi e para os moradores de Jerusalém, contra o pecado e a impureza.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo habrá manantial abierto para la casa de David y para los moradores de Jerusalem, para el pecado y la inmundicia.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.WEB: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered; and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
