verses.ASV: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ezequias gerou a Manassés; e Manassés gerou a Amom; e Amom gerou a Josias.
verses.RVR09: Y Ezechîas engendró á Manasés: y Manasés engendró á Amón: y Amón engendró á Josías:

verses.KJV: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.WEB: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
verses.ASV: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josias gerou a Jeconias, e a seus irmãos no [tempo do] exílio babilônico.
verses.RVR09: Y Josías engendró á Jechônías y á sus hermanos, en la transmigración de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.WEB: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
verses.ASV: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois do exílio babilônico Jeconias gerou a Salatiel; e Salatiel gerou a Zorobabel.
verses.RVR09: Y después de la transmigración de Babilonia, Jechônías engendró á Salathiel: y Salathiel engendró á Zorobabel:

verses.KJV: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.WEB: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
verses.ASV: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zorobabel gerou a Abiúde; e Abiúde gerou a Eliaquim; e Eliaquim gerou a Azor.
verses.RVR09: Y Zorobabel engendró á Abiud: y Abiud engendró á Eliachîm: y Eliachîm engendró á Azor:

verses.KJV: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.WEB: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
verses.ASV: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azor gerou a Sadoque; e Sadoque gerou a Aquim; e Aquim gerou a Eliúde.
verses.RVR09: Y Azor engendró á Sadoc: y Sadoc engendró á Achîm: y Achîm engendró á Eliud:

verses.KJV: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.WEB: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
verses.ASV: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eliúde gerou a Eleazar; e Eleazar gerou a Matã; e Matã gerou a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y Eliud engendró á Eleazar: y Eleazar engendró á Mathán: y Mathán engendró á Jacob:

verses.KJV: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.WEB: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.ASV: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó gerou a José, o marido de Maria, da qual nasceu Jesus, chamado o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob engendró á José, marido de María, de la cual nació Jesús, el cual es llamado el Cristo.

verses.KJV: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.WEB: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
verses.ASV: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que todas as gerações desde Abraão até Davi são catorze gerações; e desde Davi até o exílio babilônico catorze gerações; e desde o exílio babilônico até Cristo catorze gerações.
verses.RVR09: De manera que todas las generaciones desde Abraham hasta David son catorce generaciones: y desde David hasta la transmigración de Babilonia, catorce generaciones: y desde la transmigración de Babilonia hasta Cristo, catorce generaciones.

verses.KJV: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nascimento de Jesus Cristo foi assim: estando sua mãe Maria desposada com José, antes que se ajuntassem, ela foi achada grávida do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y el nacimiento de Jesucristo fué así: Que siendo María su madre desposada con José, antes que se juntasen, se halló haber concebido del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.WEB: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
verses.ASV: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então José, seu marido, sendo justo, e não querendo a expor à infâmia, pensou em deixá-la secretamente.
verses.RVR09: Y José su marido, como era justo, y no quisiese infamarla, quiso dejarla secretamente.

verses.KJV: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, pretendendo isto, eis que um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu em sonho, dizendo: José, filho de Davi, não temas receber Maria, tua mulher, porque o que nela está concebido é do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y pensando él en esto, he aquí el ángel del Señor le aparece en sueños, diciendo: José, hijo de David, no temas de recibir á María tu mujer, porque lo que en ella es engendrado, del Espíritu Santo es.

verses.KJV: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.WEB: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
verses.ASV: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela dará à luz um filho, e tu chamarás seu nome Jesus; porque ele salvará seu povo de seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y parirá un hijo, y llamarás su nombre JESUS, porque él salvará á su pueblo de sus pecados.

verses.KJV: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: Now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo Senhor por meio do profeta, que disse:
verses.RVR09: Todo esto aconteció para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el Señor, por el profeta que dijo:

verses.KJV: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.WEB: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
verses.ASV: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a virgem conceberá, e dará à luz um filho, e chamarão seu nome Emanuel, que traduzido é: Deus conosco.
verses.RVR09: He aquí la virgen concebirá y parirá un hijo, y llamarás su nombre Emmanuel, que declarado, es: Con nosotros Dios.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.WEB: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
verses.ASV: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
verses.ALMEIDA: E despertando José do sonho, fez como o anjo do Senhor tinha lhe mandado, e recebeu sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y despertando José del sueño, hizo como el ángel del Señor le había mandado, y recibió á su mujer.

verses.KJV: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.
verses.WEB: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
verses.ASV: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele não a conheceu [intimamente] ,até que ela deu à luz o filho dela, o primogênito, e lhe pôs por nome JESUS.
verses.RVR09: Y no la conoció hasta que parió á su hijo primogénito: y llamó su nombre JESUS.

verses.KJV: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
verses.WEB: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
verses.ASV: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judæa in the days of Herod the king, behold, Wise-men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sendo Jesus já nascido em Belém da Judeia, nos dias do rei Herodes, eis que vieram uns magos do oriente a Jerusalém,
verses.RVR09: Y COMO fué nacido Jesús en Bethlehem de Judea en días del rey Herodes, he aquí unos magos vinieron del oriente á Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.WEB: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
verses.ASV: Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we saw his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Onde está o Rei nascido dos Judeus? Porque vimos sua estrela no oriente, e viemos adorá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Dónde está el Rey de los Judíos, que ha nacido? porque su estrella hemos visto en el oriente, y venimos á adorarle.

verses.KJV: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.WEB: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.ASV: And when Herod the king heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Herodes, ao ouvir [isto] , ficou perturbado, e com ele toda Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto el rey Herodes, se turbó, y toda Jerusalem con él.

verses.KJV: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
verses.WEB: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
verses.ASV: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ should be born.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo reunido todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e escribas do povo, perguntou-lhes onde o Cristo havia de nascer.
verses.RVR09: Y convocados todos los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los escribas del pueblo, les preguntó dónde había de nacer el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
verses.WEB: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judæa: for thus it is written through the prophet,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe disseram: Em Belém da Judeia, porque assim está escrito pelo profeta:
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le dijeron: En Bethlehem de Judea; porque así está escrito por el profeta:

verses.KJV: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
verses.WEB: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
verses.ASV: And thou Bethlehem, land of Judah, Art in no wise least among the princes of Judah: For out of thee shall come forth a governor, Who shall be shepherd of my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu Belém, terra de Judá, de maneira nenhuma és a menor entre as lideranças de Judá, porque de ti sairá o Guia que apascentará meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Bethlehem, de tierra de Judá, no eres muy pequeña entre los príncipes de Judá; porque de ti saldrá un guiador, que apacentará á mi pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.WEB: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
verses.ASV: Then Herod privily called the Wise-men, and learned of them exactly what time the star appeared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Herodes, chamando secretamente os magos, perguntou-lhes com precisão sobre o tempo em que a estrela havia aparecido.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Herodes, llamando en secreto á los magos, entendió de ellos diligentemente el tiempo del aparecimiento de la estrella;

verses.KJV: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.WEB: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
verses.ASV: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search out exactly concerning the young child; and when ye have found [him], bring me word, that I also may come and worship him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviando-os a Belém, disse: Ide, e investigai cuidadosamente pelo menino; e quando o achardes, avisai-me, para que também eu venha e o adore.
verses.RVR09: Y enviándolos á Bethlehem, dijo: Andad allá, y preguntad con diligencia por el niño; y después que le hallareis, hacédmelo saber, para que yo también vaya y le adore.

verses.KJV: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.WEB: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.ASV: And they, having heard the king, went their way; and lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de ouvirem o rei, eles foram embora. E eis que a estrela que tinham visto no oriente ia adiante deles, até que ela chegou, e ficou parada sobre onde o menino estava.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, habiendo oído al rey, se fueron: y he aquí la estrella que habían visto en el oriente, iba delante de ellos, hasta que llegando, se puso sobre donde estaba el niño.

verses.KJV: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.WEB: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
verses.ASV: And when they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, vendo a estrela, jubilaram muito com grande alegria.
verses.RVR09: Y vista la estrella, se regocijaron con muy grande gozo.

verses.KJV: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.
verses.WEB: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.ASV: And they came into the house and saw the young child with Mary his mother; and they fell down and worshipped him; and opening their treasures they offered unto him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando na casa, acharam o menino com sua mãe Maria, e prostrando-se o adoraram. E abrindo seus tesouros, ofereceram-lhe presentes: ouro, incenso, e mirra.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando en la casa, vieron al niño con su madre María, y postrándose, le adoraron; y abriendo sus tesoros, le ofrecieron dones, oro é incienso y mirra.

verses.KJV: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.WEB: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
verses.ASV: And being warned [of God] in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sendo por divina revelação avisados em sonho que não voltassem a Herodes, partiram para sua terra por outro caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y siendo avisados por revelación en sueños que no volviesen á Herodes, se volvieron á su tierra por otro camino.

verses.KJV: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.WEB: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
verses.ASV: Now when they were departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I tell thee: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo eles partido, eis que um anjo do Senhor apareceu a José em sonho, dizendo: Levanta-te, toma o menino e sua mãe, e foge para o Egito; e fica lá até que eu te diga, porque Herodes buscará o menino para o matar.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos ellos, he aquí el ángel del Señor aparece en sueños á José, diciendo: Levántate, y toma al niño y á su madre, y huye á Egipto, y estáte allá hasta que yo te lo diga; porque ha de acontecer, que Herodes buscará al niño para matarlo.

verses.KJV: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
verses.WEB: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
verses.ASV: And he arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele se despertou, tomou o menino e sua mãe de noite, e foi para o Egito;
verses.RVR09: Y él despertando, tomó al niño y á su madre de noche, y se fué á Egipto;

verses.KJV: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
verses.WEB: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
verses.ASV: and was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt did I call my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esteve lá até a morte de Herodes, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo Senhor por meio do profeta, que disse: Do Egito chamei o meu Filho.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvo allá hasta la muerte de Herodes: para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el Señor, por el profeta que dijo: De Egipto llamé á mi Hijo.

verses.KJV: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.
verses.WEB: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
verses.ASV: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the Wise-men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the male children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the borders thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had exactly learned of the Wise-men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Herodes, ao ver que tinha sido enganado pelos magos, irou-se muito, e mandou matar todos os meninos em Belém e em todos os limites de sua região, [da idade] de dois anos e abaixo, conforme o tempo que tinha perguntado com precisão dos magos.
verses.RVR09: Herodes entonces, como se vió burlado de los magos, se enojó mucho, y envió, y mató á todos los niños que había en Bethlehem y en todos sus términos, de edad de dos años abajo, conforme al tiempo que había entendido de los magos.

verses.KJV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
verses.ASV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que disse:
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué cumplido lo que se había dicho por el profeta Jeremías, que dijo:

verses.KJV: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.WEB: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
verses.ASV: A voice was heard in Ramah, Weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; And she would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma voz se ouviu em Ramá, lamentação, choro, e grande pranto; Raquel chorava por seus filhos, e não quis ser consolada, pois já não existem.
verses.RVR09: Voz fué oída en Ramá, grande lamentación, lloro y gemido: Rachêl que llora sus hijos; y no quiso ser consolada, porque perecieron.

verses.KJV: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.WEB: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
verses.ASV: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas depois de Herodes ter morrido, eis que um anjo do Senhor apareceu no Egito a José em sonho,
verses.RVR09: Mas muerto Herodes, he aquí el ángel del Señor aparece en sueños á José en Egipto,

verses.KJV: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
verses.WEB: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
verses.ASV: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead that sought the young child’s life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Levanta-te, toma o menino e sua mãe, e vai para a terra de Israel, porque já morreram os que procuravam a morte do menino.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Levántate, y toma al niño y á su madre, y vete á tierra de Israel; que muertos son los que procuraban la muerte del niño.

verses.KJV: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.WEB: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.ASV: And he arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele se levantou, tomou o menino e sua mãe, e veio para a terra de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se levantó, y tomó al niño y á su madre, y se vino á tierra de Israel.

verses.KJV: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.WEB: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
verses.ASV: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judæa in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither; and being warned [of God] in a dream, he withdrew into the parts of Galilee,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ao ouvir que Arquelau reinava na Judeia em lugar de seu pai Herodes, ele teve medo de ir para lá; mas avisado por divina revelação em sonho, foi para a região da Galileia,
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo que Archelao reinaba en Judea en lugar de Herodes su padre, temió ir allá: mas amonestado por revelación en sueños, se fué á las partes de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
verses.WEB: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
verses.ASV: and came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets, that he should be called a Nazarene.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a habitar na cidade chamada Nazaré, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelos profetas, que: Ele será chamado de Nazareno.
verses.RVR09: Y vino, y habitó en la ciudad que se llama Nazaret: para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por los profetas, que había de ser llamado Nazareno.

verses.KJV: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.WEB: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
verses.ASV: And in those days cometh John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judæa, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E naqueles dias veio João Batista, pregando no deserto da Judeia,
verses.RVR09: Y EN aquellos días vino Juan el Bautista predicando en el desierto de Judea,

verses.KJV: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.WEB: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
verses.ASV: Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo: Arrependei-vos, porque perto está o Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: Arrepentíos, que el reino de los cielos se ha acercado.

verses.KJV: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.WEB: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
verses.ASV: For this is he that was spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este é aquele que foi declarado pelo profeta Isaías, que disse: Voz do que clama no deserto: “Preparai o caminho do Senhor; endireitai suas veredas”.
verses.RVR09: Porque éste es aquel del cual fué dicho por el profeta Isaías, que dijo: Voz de uno que clama en el desierto: Aparejad el camino del Señor, enderezad sus veredas.

verses.KJV: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.WEB: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.ASV: Now John himself had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este João tinha sua roupa de pelos de camelo e um cinto de couro ao redor de sua cintura, e seu alimento era gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía Juan su vestido de pelos de camellos, y una cinta de cuero alrededor de sus lomos; y su comida era langostas y miel silvestre.

verses.KJV: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.WEB: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
verses.ASV: Then went out unto him Jerusalem, and all Judæa, and all the region round about the Jordan;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vinham até ele [moradores] de Jerusalém, de toda a Judeia, e de toda a região próxima do Jordão;
verses.RVR09: Entonces salía á él Jerusalem, y toda Judea, y toda la provincia de alrededor del Jordán;

verses.KJV: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.WEB: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.ASV: and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eram por ele batizados no Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y eran bautizados de él en el Jordán, confesando sus pecados.

verses.KJV: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.WEB: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.ASV: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said unto them, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando ele viu muitos dos fariseus e dos saduceus que vinham ao seu batismo, disse-lhes: Ninhada de víboras! Quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira futura?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo él muchos de los Fariseos y de los Saduceos, que venían á su bautismo, decíales: Generación de víboras, ¿quién os ha enseñado á huir de la ira que vendrá?

verses.KJV: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.WEB: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
verses.ASV: Bring forth therefore fruit worthy of repentance:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai, pois, frutos condizentes com o arrependimento.
verses.RVR09: Haced pues frutos dignos de arrepentimiento,

verses.KJV: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.WEB: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
verses.ASV: and think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não imagineis, dizendo em vós mesmos: “Temos por pai a Abraão”, porque eu vos digo que até destas pedras Deus pode fazer surgir filhos a Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y no penséis decir dentro de vosotros: A Abraham tenemos por padre: porque yo os digo, que puede Dios despertar hijos á Abraham aun de estas piedras.

verses.KJV: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.WEB: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
verses.ASV: And even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora mesmoo machado está posto à raiz das árvores; portanto toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, ya también la segur está puesta á la raíz de los árboles; y todo árbol que no hace buen fruto, es cortado y echado en el fuego.

verses.KJV: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
verses.WEB: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: I indeed baptize you in water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and [in] fire:
verses.ALMEIDA: Realmente eu vos batizo com água para arrependimento, mas aquele que vem após mim é mais poderoso do que eu; suas sandálias não sou digno de levar. Ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.
verses.RVR09: Yo á la verdad os bautizo en agua para arrepentimiento; mas el que viene tras mí, más poderoso es que yo; los zapatos del cual yo no soy digno de llevar; él os bautizará en Espíritu Santo y en fuego.

verses.KJV: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.WEB: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
verses.ASV: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor; and he will gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tem sua pá na mão; limpará sua eira, e recolherá seu trigo no celeiro; mas queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Su aventador en su mano está, y aventará su era: y allegará su trigo en el alfolí, y quemará la paja en fuego que nunca se apagará.

verses.KJV: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
verses.ASV: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus veio da Galileia ao Jordão até João para ser por ele batizado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús vino de Galilea á Juan al Jordán, para ser bautizado de él.

verses.KJV: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.WEB: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
verses.ASV: But John would have hindered him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas João lhe impedia, dizendo: Eu preciso ser batizado por ti, e tu vens a mim?
verses.RVR09: Mas Juan lo resistía mucho, diciendo: Yo he menester ser bautizado de ti, ¿y tú vienes á mí?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.WEB: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
verses.ASV: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer [it] now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus lhe respondeu: Permite por agora, porque assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça. Então ele o permitiu.
verses.RVR09: Empero respondiendo Jesús le dijo: Deja ahora; porque así nos conviene cumplir toda justicia. Entonces le dejó.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.WEB: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
verses.ASV: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway from the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Jesus sido batizado, subiu logo da água. E eis que os céus se lhe abriram, e ele viu o Espírito de Deus descendo como uma pomba, vindo sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, después que fué bautizado, subió luego del agua; y he aquí los cielos le fueron abiertos, y vió al Espíritu de Dios que descendía como paloma, y venía sobre él.

verses.KJV: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.WEB: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
verses.ASV: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis uma voz dos céus, dizendo: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me agrado.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí una voz de los cielos que decía: Este es mi Hijo amado, en el cual tengo contentamiento.

verses.KJV: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.ASV: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus foi levado pelo Espírito ao deserto para ser tentado pelo diabo.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Jesús fué llevado del Espíritu al desierto, para ser tentado del diablo.

verses.KJV: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.WEB: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
verses.ASV: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he afterward hungered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de jejuar quarenta dias e quarenta noites, teve fome.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo ayunado cuarenta días y cuarenta noches, después tuvo hambre.

verses.KJV: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.WEB: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
verses.ASV: And the tempter came and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o tentador se aproximou dele, e disse: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, dize que estas pedras se tornem pães.
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose á él el tentador, dijo: Si eres Hijo de Dios, di que estas piedras se hagan pan.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.WEB: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] respondeu: Está escrito: Não só de pão viverá o ser humano, mas de toda palavra que sai da boca de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas él respondiendo, dijo: Escrito está: No con solo el pan vivirá el hombre, mas con toda palabra que sale de la boca de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.WEB: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.ASV: Then the devil taketh him into the holy city; and he set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o diabo o levou consigo à santa cidade, e o pôs sobre o ponto mais alto do Templo,
verses.RVR09: Entonces el diablo le pasa á la santa ciudad, y le pone sobre las almenas del templo,

verses.KJV: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.WEB: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
verses.ASV: and saith unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and, On their hands they shall bear thee up, Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te abaixo, porque está escrito que: Mandará a seus anjos acerca de ti, e te tomarão pelas mãos, para que nunca com teu pé tropeces em pedra alguma.
verses.RVR09: Y le dice: Si eres Hijo de Dios, échate abajo; que escrito está: A sus ángeles mandará por ti, y te alzarán en las manos, para que nunca tropieces con tu pie en piedra.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto him, Again it is written, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: Também está escrito: Não tentarás o Senhor teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dijo: Escrito está además: No tentarás al Señor tu Dios.

verses.KJV: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.WEB: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
verses.ASV: Again, the devil taketh him unto an exceeding high mountain, and showeth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra vez o diabo o levou consigo a um monte muito alto, e lhe mostrou todos os reinos do mundo, e a glória deles,
verses.RVR09: Otra vez le pasa el diablo á un monte muy alto, y le muestra todos los reinos del mundo, y su gloria,

verses.KJV: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
verses.ASV: and he said unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Tudo isto te darei se, prostrado, me adorares.
verses.RVR09: Y dícele: Todo esto te daré, si postrado me adorares.

verses.KJV: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
verses.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus disse: Vai embora, Satanás! Porque está escrito: Ao Senhor teu Deus adorarás, e só a ele cultuarás.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús le dice: Vete, Satanás, que escrito está: Al Señor tu Dios adorarás y á él solo servirás.

verses.KJV: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.WEB: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
verses.ASV: Then the devil leaveth him; and behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o diabo o deixou; e eis que chegaram anjos, e o serviram.
verses.RVR09: El diablo entonces le dejó: y he aquí los ángeles llegaron y le servían.

verses.KJV: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.WEB: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
verses.ASV: Now when he heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando Jesus ouviu que João estava preso, voltou para a Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Mas oyendo Jesús que Juan era preso, se volvió á Galilea;

verses.KJV: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.WEB: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.ASV: and leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali:
verses.ALMEIDA: E deixando Nazaré, veio a morar em Cafarnaum, [cidade] marítima, nos limites de Zebulom e Naftali,
verses.RVR09: Y dejando á Nazaret, vino y habitó en Capernaum, ciudad marítima, en los confines de Zabulón y de Nephtalim:

verses.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: para que se cumprisse o que foi anunciado pelo profeta Isaías, que disse:
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el profeta Isaías, que dijo:

verses.KJV: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
verses.WEB: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
verses.ASV: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, Toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra de Zebulom e a terra de Naftali, caminho do mar, além do Jordão, a Galileia dos gentios;
verses.RVR09: La tierra de Zabulón, y la tierra de Nephtalim, camino de la mar, de la otra parte del Jordán, Galilea de los Gentiles;

verses.KJV: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.WEB: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
verses.ASV: The people that sat in darkness Saw a great light, And to them that sat in the region and shadow of death, To them did light spring up.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo sentado em trevas viu uma grande luz; aos sentados em região e sombra da morte, a luz lhes apareceu.
verses.RVR09: El pueblo asentado en tinieblas, vió gran luz; y á los sentados en región y sombra de muerte, luz les esclareció.

verses.KJV: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.WEB: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
verses.ASV: From that time began Jesus to preach, and to say, Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde então Jesus começou a pregar e a dizer: Arrependei-vos, porque perto está o Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Desde entonces comenzó Jesús á predicar, y á decir: Arrepentíos, que el reino de los cielos se ha acercado.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.WEB: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.ASV: And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto Jesus andava junto ao mar da Galileia, viu dois irmãos: Simão, chamado Pedro, e seu irmão André, lançarem a rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores.
verses.RVR09: Y andando Jesús junto á la mar de Galilea, vió á dos hermanos, Simón, que es llamado Pedro, y Andrés su hermano, que echaban la red en la mar; porque eran pescadores.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Vinde após mim, e eu vos farei pescadores de gente.
verses.RVR09: Y díceles: Venid en pos de mí, y os haré pescadores de hombres.

verses.KJV: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.WEB: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
verses.ASV: And they straightway left the nets, and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles logo deixaram as redes e o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces, dejando luego las redes, le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.WEB: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
verses.ASV: And going on from thence he saw two other brethren, James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando dali, viu outros dois irmãos: Tiago, [filho] de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João, em um barco, com seu pai Zebedeu, que estavam consertando suas redes; e ele os chamou.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando de allí vió otros dos hermanos, Jacobo, hijo de Zebedeo, y Juan su hermano, en el barco con Zebedeo, su padre, que remendaban sus redes; y los llamó.

verses.KJV: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.WEB: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
verses.ASV: And they straightway left the boat and their father, and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles logo deixaram o barco e seu pai, e o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, dejando luego el barco y á su padre, le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.WEB: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of disease and all manner of sickness among the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus rodeava toda a Galileia, ensinando em suas sinagogas, pregando o Evangelho do Reino, e curando toda enfermidade e toda doença no povo.
verses.RVR09: Y rodeó Jesús toda Galilea, enseñando en las sinagogas de ellos, y predicando el evangelio del reino, y sanando toda enfermedad y toda dolencia en el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.WEB: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
verses.ASV: And the report of him went forth into all Syria: and they brought unto him all that were sick, holden with divers diseases and torments, possessed with demons, and epileptic, and palsied; and he healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua fama corria por toda a Síria, e traziam-lhe todos que sofriam de algum mal, tendo diversas enfermidades e tormentos, e os endemoninhados, epiléticos, e paralíticos; e ele os curava.
verses.RVR09: Y corría su fama por toda la Siria; y le trajeron todos los que tenían mal: los tomados de diversas enfermedades y tormentos, y los endemoniados, y lunáticos, y paralíticos, y los sanó.

verses.KJV: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.WEB: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
verses.ASV: And there followed him great multitudes from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judæa and [from] beyond the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas multidões da Galileia, de Decápolis, de Jerusalém, da Judeia, e dalém do Jordão o seguiam.
verses.RVR09: Y le siguieron muchas gentes de Galilea y de Decápolis y de Jerusalem y de Judea y de la otra parte del Jordán.

verses.KJV: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.WEB: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
verses.ASV: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into the mountain: and when he had sat down, his disciples came unto him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando [Jesus] viu as multidões, subiu a um monte; e sentando-se, achegaram-se a ele os seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y VIENDO las gentes, subió al monte; y sentándose, se llegaron á él sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.WEB: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
verses.ASV: and he opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele abriu sua boca e lhes ensinou, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y abriendo su boca, les enseñaba, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.ASV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os humildes de espírito, porque deles é o Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los pobres en espíritu: porque de ellos es el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os que choram, porque eles serão consolados.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que lloran: porque ellos recibirán consolación.

verses.KJV: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.WEB: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.ASV: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los mansos: porque ellos recibirán la tierra por heredad.

verses.KJV: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os que têm fome e sede de justiça, porque eles serão saciados.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que tienen hambre y sed de justicia: porque ellos serán hartos.

verses.KJV: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.WEB: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.ASV: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los misericordiosos: porque ellos alcanzarán misericordia.

verses.KJV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.WEB: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.ASV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os limpos de coração, porque eles verão a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los de limpio corazón: porque ellos verán á Dios.

verses.KJV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.WEB: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
verses.ASV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os pacíficos, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los pacificadores: porque ellos serán llamados hijos de Dios.

verses.KJV: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os que sofrem perseguição por causa da justiça, porque deles é o Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que padecen persecución por causa de la justicia: porque de ellos es el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.WEB: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.ASV: Blessed are ye when [men] shall reproach you, and persecute you, and say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos sois vós, quando vos insultarem, perseguirem, e mentirem, falando contra vós todo mal por minha causa.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados sois cuando os vituperaren y os persiguieren, y dijeren de vosotros todo mal por mi causa, mintiendo.

verses.KJV: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.WEB: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.ASV: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets that were before you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jubilai e alegrai-vos, porque grande é vossa recompensa nos céus; pois assim perseguiram aos profetas que foram antes de vós.
verses.RVR09: Gozaos y alegraos; porque vuestra merced es grande en los cielos: que así persiguieron á los profetas que fueron antes de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.WEB: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
verses.ASV: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois o sal da terra; mas se o sal perder seu sabor, com que se salgará? Para nada mais presta, a não ser para se lançar fora, e ser pisado pelas pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois la sal de la tierra: y si la sal se desvaneciere ¿con qué será salada? no vale más para nada, sino para ser echada fuera y hollada de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.WEB: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
verses.ASV: Ye are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois a luz do mundo; não se pode esconder uma cidade fundada sobre o monte;
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois la luz del mundo: una ciudad asentada sobre un monte no se puede esconder.

verses.KJV: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.WEB: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
verses.ASV: Neither do [men] light a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but on the stand; and it shineth unto all that are in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem se acende a lâmpada para se pôr debaixo de um cesto, mas sim na luminária, e ilumina a todos quantos estão na casa.
verses.RVR09: Ni se enciende una lámpara y se pone debajo de un almud, mas sobre el candelero, y alumbra á todos los que están en casa.

verses.KJV: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: Even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim brilhe vossa luz diante das pessoas, para que vejam vossas boas obras, e glorifiquem ao vosso Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Así alumbre vuestra luz delante de los hombres, para que vean vuestras obras buenas, y glorifiquen á vuestro Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.WEB: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
verses.ASV: Think not that I came to destroy the law or the prophets: I came not to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não penseis que vim para revogar a Lei ou os Profetas; não vim para revogar, mas sim para cumprir.
verses.RVR09: No penséis que he venido para abrogar la ley ó los profetas: no he venido para abrogar, sino á cumplir.

verses.KJV: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
verses.ASV: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass away from the law, till all things be accomplished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em verdade vos digo que, até que o céu e a terra passem, nem um jota nem um til passará da Lei até que tudo se cumpra.
verses.RVR09: Porque de cierto os digo, que hasta que perezca el cielo y la tierra, ni una jota ni un tilde perecerá de la ley, hasta que todas las cosas sean hechas.

verses.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.ASV: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto qualquer um que desobedecer a um destes menores mandamentos, e assim ensinar às pessoas, será chamado o menor no Reino dos céus; porém qualquer que [os] cumprir e ensinar, esse será chamado grande no Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: De manera que cualquiera que infringiere uno de estos mandamientos muy pequeños, y así enseñare á los hombres, muy pequeño será llamado en el reino de los cielos: mas cualquiera que hiciere y enseñare, éste será llamado grande en el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.ASV: For I say unto you, that except your righteousness shall exceed [the righteousness] of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu vos digo que se a vossa justiça não for maior que a dos escribas e dos fariseus, de maneira nenhuma entrareis no Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Porque os digo, que si vuestra justicia no fuere mayor que la de los escribas y de los Fariseos, no entraréis en el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Ye have heard that it was said of them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.WEB: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
verses.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvistes o que foi dito aos antigos: “Não cometerás homicídio”; “mas qualquer um que cometer homicídio será réu do julgamento”.
verses.RVR09: Oísteis que fué dicho á los antiguos: No matarás; mas cualquiera que matare, será culpado del juicio.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.WEB: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one who is angry with his brother shall be in danger of the judgment; and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council; and whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of the hell of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se irar contra seu irmão sem razão será réu do julgamento. E qualquer um que disser a seu irmão: “Idiota!” será réu do tribunal. E qualquer que [lhe] disser: “Louco!” será réu do fogo do inferno.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo, que cualquiera que se enojare locamente con su hermano, será culpado del juicio; y cualquiera que dijere á su hermano, Raca, será culpado del concejo; y cualquiera que dijere, Fatuo, será culpado del infierno del fuego.

verses.KJV: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.WEB: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
verses.ASV: If therefore thou art offering thy gift at the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath aught against thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se trouxeres tua oferta ao altar, e ali te lembrares que teu irmão tem algo contra ti,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, si trajeres tu presente al altar, y allí te acordares de que tu hermano tiene algo contra ti,

verses.KJV: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.WEB: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.ASV: leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way, first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixa ali tua oferta diante do altar e vai primeiro reconciliar-te com teu irmão, e então vem oferecer a tua oferta.
verses.RVR09: Deja allí tu presente delante del altar, y vete, vuelve primero en amistad con tu hermano, y entonces ven y ofrece tu presente.

verses.KJV: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.WEB: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
verses.ASV: Agree with thine adversary quickly, while thou art with him in the way; lest haply the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze acordo depressa com teu adversário, enquanto estás com ele no caminho, para não acontecer que o adversário te entregue ao juiz, e o juiz te entregue ao oficial, e te lancem na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Concíliate con tu adversario presto, entre tanto que estás con él en el camino; porque no acontezca que el adversario te entregue al juez, y el juez te entregue al alguacil, y seas echado en prisión.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the last farthing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade te digo que não sairás dali enquanto não pagares a última moeda.
verses.RVR09: De cierto te digo, que no saldrás de allí, hasta que pagues el último cuadrante.

verses.KJV: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
verses.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvistes o que foi dito aos antigos: “Não adulterarás”.
verses.RVR09: Oísteis que fué dicho: No adulterarás:

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.WEB: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one that looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que olhar para uma mulher para a cobiçar, em seu coração já adulterou com ela.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo, que cualquiera que mira á una mujer para codiciarla, ya adulteró con ella en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.WEB: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.ASV: And if thy right eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body be cast into hell.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o teu olho direito te faz pecar, arranca-o e lança-o de ti; porque é melhor para ti que um dos teus membros se perca do que o teu corpo todo seja lançado no inferno.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, si tu ojo derecho te fuere ocasión de caer, sácalo, y échalo de ti: que mejor te es que se pierda uno de tus miembros, que no que todo tu cuerpo sea echado al infierno.

verses.KJV: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.WEB: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.ASV: And if thy right hand causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body go into hell.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a tua mão direita te faz pecar, corta-a e lança-a de ti; porque é melhor para ti que um dos teus membros se perca do que o teu corpo todo seja lançado no inferno.
verses.RVR09: Y si tu mano derecha te fuere ocasión de caer, córtala, y échala de ti: que mejor te es que se pierda uno de tus miembros, que no que todo tu cuerpo sea echado al infierno.

verses.KJV: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.WEB: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
verses.ASV: It was said also, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também foi dito: “Qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, dê a ela carta de divórcio.
verses.RVR09: También fué dicho: Cualquiera que repudiare á su mujer, déle carta de divorcio:

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.WEB: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one that putteth away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, maketh her an adulteress: and whosoever shall marry her when she is put away committeth adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, a menos que seja por causa de pecado sexual, faz com que ela adultere; e qualquer um que se casar com a divorciada comete adultério.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo, que el que repudiare á su mujer, fuera de causa de fornicación, hace que ella adultere; y el que se casare con la repudiada, comete adulterio.

verses.KJV: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.WEB: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
verses.ASV: Again, ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: “Não jurarás falsamente”, “mas cumprirás ao Senhor os teus juramentos”.
verses.RVR09: Además habéis oído que fué dicho á los antiguos: No te perjurarás; mas pagarás al Señor tus juramentos.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
verses.WEB: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by the heaven, for it is the throne of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que de maneira nenhuma jureis; nem pelo céu, porque é o trono de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo: No juréis en ninguna manera: ni por el cielo, porque es el trono de Dios;

verses.KJV: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.WEB: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.ASV: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem pela terra, porque é o suporte de seus pés; nem por Jerusalém, porque é a cidade do grande Rei.
verses.RVR09: Ni por la tierra, porque es el estrado de sus pies; ni por Jerusalem, porque es la ciudad del gran Rey.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.WEB: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, for thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem por tua cabeça jurarás, pois nem sequer um cabelo podes tornar branco ou preto.
verses.RVR09: Ni por tu cabeza jurarás, porque no puedes hacer un cabello blanco ó negro.

verses.KJV: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.WEB: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
verses.ASV: But let your speech be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: and whatsoever is more than these is of the evil [one].
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seja vosso falar: “sim”, “sim”, “não”, “não”; porque o que disso passa procede do maligno.
verses.RVR09: Mas sea vuestro hablar: Sí, sí; No, no; porque lo que es más de esto, de mal procede.

verses.KJV: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvistes o que foi dito: “Olho por olho, e dente por dente”.
verses.RVR09: Oísteis que fué dicho á los antiguos: Ojo por ojo, y diente por diente.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.WEB: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, Resist not him that is evil: but whosoever smiteth thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu vos digo que não resistais a quem for mau; em vez disso, a qualquer um que te bater à tua face direita, apresenta-lhe também a outra.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo: No resistáis al mal; antes á cualquiera que te hiriere en tu mejilla diestra, vuélvele también la otra;

verses.KJV: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
verses.WEB: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
verses.ASV: And if any man would go to law with thee, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao que quiser disputar contigo, e te tomar tua túnica, deixa-lhe também a capa.
verses.RVR09: Y al que quisiere ponerte á pleito y tomarte tu ropa, déjale también la capa;

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.WEB: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.ASV: And whosoever shall compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se qualquer um te obrigar a caminhar uma milha, vai com ele duas.
