verses.RVR09: Y á cualquiera que te cargare por una milla, ve con él dos.

verses.KJV: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.WEB: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
verses.ASV: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá a quem te pedir; e não te desvies de quem quiser de ti tomar emprestado.
verses.RVR09: Al que te pidiere, dale; y al que quisiere tomar de ti prestado, no se lo rehuses.

verses.KJV: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, Thou shalt love thy neighbor, and hate thine enemy:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvistes o que foi dito: “Amarás teu próximo”, e “odiarás teu inimigo”.
verses.RVR09: Oísteis que fué dicho: Amarás á tu prójimo, y aborrecerás á tu enemigo.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.WEB: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, Love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo: amai vossos inimigos, bendizei os que vos maldizem, fazei bem aos que vos odeiam, e orai pelos que vos maltratam e vos perseguem,
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo: Amad á vuestros enemigos, bendecid á los que os maldicen, haced bien á los que os aborrecen, y orad por los que os ultrajan y os persiguen;

verses.KJV: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.WEB: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
verses.ASV: that ye may be sons of your Father who is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sendeth rain on the just and the unjust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que sejais filhos de vosso Pai que está nos céus; porque ele faz seu sol sair sobre maus e bons, e chover sobre justos e injustos.
verses.RVR09: Para que seáis hijos de vuestro Padre que está en los cielos: que hace que su sol salga sobre malos y buenos, y llueve sobre justos é injustos.

verses.KJV: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.WEB: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.ASV: For if ye love them that love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se amardes os que vos amam, que recompensa tereis? Não fazem os publicanos também o mesmo?
verses.RVR09: Porque si amareis á los que os aman, ¿qué recompensa tendréis? ¿no hacen también lo mismo los publicanos?

verses.KJV: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.WEB: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.ASV: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more [than others]? do not even the Gentiles the same?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se saudardes somente os vossos irmãos, o que fazeis de mais? Não fazem os publicanos também assim?
verses.RVR09: Y si abrazareis á vuestros hermanos solamente, ¿qué hacéis de más? ¿no hacen también así los Gentiles?

verses.KJV: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.WEB: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
verses.ASV: Ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sede vós perfeitos, assim como vosso Pai que está nos céus é perfeito.
verses.RVR09: Sed, pues, vosotros perfectos, como vuestro Padre que está en los cielos es perfecto.

verses.KJV: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: Take heed that ye do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else ye have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ficai atentos para que não façais vossa esmola diante das pessoas a fim de que sejais vistos por elas; de outra maneira não tereis recompensa de vosso Pai que está nos céus.
verses.RVR09: MIRAD que no hagáis vuestra justicia delante de los hombres, para ser vistos de ellos: de otra manera no tendréis merced de vuestro Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.WEB: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.ASV: When therefore thou doest alms, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quando fizeres esmola, não faças tocar trombeta diante de ti, como fazem os hipócritas nas sinagogas e nas ruas, para serem honrados pelas pessoas; em verdade vos digo que já receberam sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Cuando pues haces limosna, no hagas tocar trompeta delante de ti, como hacen los hipócritas en las sinagogas y en las plazas, para ser estimados de los hombres: de cierto os digo, que ya tienen su recompensa.

verses.KJV: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verses.WEB: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
verses.ASV: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando tu fizeres esmola, não saiba tua mão esquerda o que faz a tua direita;
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando tú haces limosna, no sepa tu izquierda lo que hace tu derecha;

verses.KJV: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.WEB: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.ASV: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a tua esmola seja em segredo, e teu Pai, que vê em segredo, ele te recompensará em público.
verses.RVR09: Para que sea tu limosna en secreto: y tu Padre que ve en secreto, él te recompensará en público.

verses.KJV: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.WEB: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.ASV: And when ye pray, ye shall not be as the hypocrites: for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando orares, não sejas como os hipócritas; porque eles amam orar em pé nas sinagogas e nas esquinas das ruas para serem vistos pelas pessoas. Em verdade vos digo que já receberam sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando oras, no seas como los hipócritas; porque ellos aman el orar en las sinagogas, y en los cantones de las calles en pie, para ser vistos de los hombres: de cierto os digo, que ya tienen su pago.

verses.KJV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.WEB: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.ASV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, quando orares, entra em teu quarto, fecha tua porta, e ora a teu Pai, que está em segredo; e teu Pai, que vê em segredo, ele te recompensará em público.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, cuando oras, éntrate en tu cámara, y cerrada tu puerta, ora á tu Padre que está en secreto; y tu Padre que ve en secreto, te recompensará en público.

verses.KJV: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.WEB: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
verses.ASV: And in praying use not vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando orardes, não façais repetições inúteis como os gentios, que pensam que por muito falarem serão ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Y orando, no seáis prolijos, como los Gentiles; que piensan que por su parlería serán oídos.

verses.KJV: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
verses.ASV: Be not therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejais, pois, semelhantes a eles; porque vosso Pai sabe o que necessitais, antes que vós peçais a ele.
verses.RVR09: No os hagáis, pues, semejantes á ellos; porque vuestro Padre sabe de qué cosas tenéis necesidad, antes que vosotros le pidáis.

verses.KJV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.WEB: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
verses.ASV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, portanto, orareis assim: Pai nosso, que estás nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros pues, oraréis así: Padre nuestro que estás en los cielos, santificado sea tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.WEB: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
verses.ASV: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Venha o teu Reino. Seja feita a tua vontade, tanto na terra, assim como no céu.
verses.RVR09: Venga tu reino. Sea hecha tu voluntad, como en el cielo, así también en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.WEB: Give us today our daily bread.
verses.ASV: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pão nosso de cada dia nos dá hoje.
verses.RVR09: Danos hoy nuestro pan cotidiano.

verses.KJV: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.WEB: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
verses.ASV: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perdoa-nos nossas dívidas, assim como nós também perdoamos aos nossos devedores.
verses.RVR09: Y perdónanos nuestras deudas, como también nosotros perdonamos á nuestros deudores.

verses.KJV: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
verses.ASV: And bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil [one].
verses.ALMEIDA: E não nos conduzas à tentação, mas livra-nos do mal; porque teu é o Reino, o poder, e a glória, para sempre, Amém.
verses.RVR09: Y no nos metas en tentación, mas líbranos del mal: porque tuyo es el reino, y el poder, y la gloria, por todos los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.WEB: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.ASV: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se perdoardes às pessoas suas ofensas, vosso Pai celestial também vos perdoará;
verses.RVR09: Porque si perdonareis á los hombres sus ofensas, os perdonará también á vosotros vuestro Padre celestial.

verses.KJV: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.WEB: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.ASV: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não perdoardes às pessoas suas ofensas, também vosso Pai não vos perdoará vossas ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no perdonareis á los hombres sus ofensas, tampoco vuestro Padre os perdonará vuestras ofensas.

verses.KJV: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.WEB: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.ASV: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen of men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando jejuardes, não vos mostreis tristonhos, como os hipócritas; porque eles desfiguram seus rostos, para parecerem aos outros que jejuam. Em verdade vos digo que eles já receberam sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando ayunáis, no seáis como los hipócritas, austeros; porque ellos demudan sus rostros para parecer á los hombres que ayunan: de cierto os digo, que ya tienen su pago.

verses.KJV: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
verses.WEB: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.ASV: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, quando jejuares, unge a tua cabeça e lava o teu rosto,
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, cuando ayunas, unge tu cabeza y lava tu rostro;

verses.KJV: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.WEB: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
verses.ASV: that thou be not seen of men to fast, but of thy Father who is in secret: and thy Father, who seeth in secret, shall recompense thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para não pareceres às pessoas que jejuas, mas sim ao teu Pai, que está em segredo; e teu Pai, que vê em segredo, ele te recompensará em público.
verses.RVR09: Para no parecer á los hombres que ayunas, sino á tu Padre que está en secreto: y tu Padre que ve en secreto, te recompensará en público.

verses.KJV: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.WEB: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
verses.ASV: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não ajunteis para vós tesouros na terra, onde e a traça e a ferrugem gastam, e onde os ladrões invadem e roubam;
verses.RVR09: No os hagáis tesoros en la tierra, donde la polilla y el orín corrompe, y donde ladrones minan y hurtan;

verses.KJV: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.WEB: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
verses.ASV: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth consume, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ajuntai para vós tesouros no céu, onde nem a traça nem a ferrugem gastam, e onde os ladrões não invadem nem roubam.
verses.RVR09: Mas haceos tesoros en el cielo, donde ni polilla ni orín corrompe, y donde ladrones no minan ni hurtan:

verses.KJV: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.WEB: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.ASV: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque onde estiver o vosso tesouro, ali estará também o vosso coração.
verses.RVR09: Porque donde estuviere vuestro tesoro, allí estará vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.WEB: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
verses.ASV: The lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.ALMEIDA: A lâmpada do corpo é o olho; portanto, se o teu olho for puro, todo o teu corpo será cheio de luz.
verses.RVR09: La lámpara del cuerpo es el ojo: así que, si tu ojo fuere sincero, todo tu cuerpo será luminoso:

verses.KJV: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.WEB: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.ASV: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se o teu olho for maligno, todo o teu corpo será cheio de trevas. Assim, se a luz que há em ti são trevas, como são grandes [essas] trevas!
verses.RVR09: Mas si tu ojo fuere malo, todo tu cuerpo será tenebroso. Así que, si la lumbre que en ti hay son tinieblas, ¿cuántas serán las mismas tinieblas?

verses.KJV: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.WEB: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
verses.ASV: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém pode servir a dois senhores; pois ou odiará um e amará outro; ou se apegará a um, e desprezará o outro. Não podeis servir a Deus e às riquezas.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno puede servir á dos señores; porque ó aborrecerá al uno y amará al otro, ó se llegará al uno y menospreciará al otro: no podéis servir á Dios y á Mammón.

verses.KJV: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.WEB: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
verses.ASV: Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso vos digo: não andeis ansiosos por vossa vida, sobre o que haveis de comer, ou que haveis de beber; nem por vosso corpo, sobre com que vos haveis de vestir. Não é a vida mais que o alimento, e o corpo [mais] que a roupa?
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os digo: No os congojéis por vuestra vida, qué habéis de comer, ó qué habéis de beber; ni por vuestro cuerpo, qué habéis de vestir: ¿no es la vida más que el alimento, y el cuerpo que el vestido?

verses.KJV: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.WEB: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
verses.ASV: Behold the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; and your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are not ye of much more value than they?
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai para as aves do céu, que não semeiam, nem ceifam, nem ajuntam em celeiros; e contudo vosso Pai celestial as alimenta. Não sois vós muito mais importantes que elas?
verses.RVR09: Mirad las aves del cielo, que no siembran, ni siegan, ni allegan en alfolíes; y vuestro Padre celestial las alimenta. ¿No sois vosotros mucho mejores que ellas?

verses.KJV: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.WEB: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
verses.ASV: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E qual de vós poderá, por sua ansiedade, acrescentar um côvado à sua estatura?
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿quién de vosotros podrá, congojándose, añadir á su estatura un codo?

verses.KJV: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.WEB: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
verses.ASV: And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que andais ansiosos pela roupa? Prestai atenção aos lírios do campo, como crescem; eles nem trabalham nem fiam.
verses.RVR09: Y por el vestido ¿por qué os congojáis? Reparad los lirios del campo, cómo crecen; no trabajan ni hilan;

verses.KJV: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.WEB: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
verses.ASV: yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu vos digo que nem mesmo Salomão, em toda a sua glória, se vestiu como um deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas os digo, que ni aun Salomón con toda su gloria fué vestido así como uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.WEB: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
verses.ASV: But if God doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, [shall he] not much more [clothe] you, O ye of little faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se Deus veste desta maneira a erva do campo, que hoje existe, e amanhã é lançada no forno, não [vestirá] ele muito mais a vós, que tendes pouca fé?
verses.RVR09: Y si la hierba del campo que hoy es, y mañana es echada en el horno, Dios la viste así, ¿no hará mucho más á vosotros, hombres de poca fe?

verses.KJV: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.WEB: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
verses.ASV: Be not therefore anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não andeis, pois, ansiosos, dizendo: “Que comeremos?” Ou “Que beberemos?” Ou “Com que nos vestiremos?”
verses.RVR09: No os congojéis pues, diciendo: ¿Qué comeremos, ó qué beberemos, ó con qué nos cubriremos?

verses.KJV: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.WEB: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.ASV: For after all these things do the Gentiles seek; for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os gentios buscam todas estas coisas, e vosso Pai celestial sabe que necessitais destas coisas, todas elas.
verses.RVR09: Porque los Gentiles buscan todas estas cosas: que vuestro Padre celestial sabe que de todas estas cosas habéis menester.

verses.KJV: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.WEB: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
verses.ASV: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas buscai primeiramente o Reino de Deus e a sua justiça, e todas estas coisas vos serão acrescentadas.
verses.RVR09: Mas buscad primeramente el reino de Dios y su justicia, y todas estas cosas os serán añadidas.

verses.KJV: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
verses.ASV: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não andeis, pois, ansiosos pelo dia de amanhã, porque o amanhã cuidará de si mesmo. Basta a cada dia o seu mal.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no os congojéis por el día de mañana; que el día de mañana traerá su fatiga: basta al día su afán.

verses.KJV: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.WEB: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
verses.ASV: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não julgueis, para que não sejais julgados.
verses.RVR09: NO juzguéis, para que no seáis juzgados.

verses.KJV: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.WEB: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
verses.ASV: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque com o juízo que julgardes sereis julgados; e com a medida que medirdes vos medirão de volta.
verses.RVR09: Porque con el juicio con que juzgáis, seréis juzgados; y con la medida con que medís, os volverán á medir.

verses.KJV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.WEB: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.ASV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, por que vês o cisco que está no olho de teu irmão e não enxergas a trave que está em teu próprio olho?
verses.RVR09: Y ¿por qué miras la mota que está en el ojo de tu hermano, y no echas de ver la viga que está en tu ojo?

verses.KJV: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.WEB: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
verses.ASV: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me cast out the mote out of thine eye; and lo, the beam is in thine own eye?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou como dirás a teu irmão: “Deixa-me tirar o cisco do teu olho”, se eis que há uma trave em teu próprio olho?
verses.RVR09: O ¿cómo dirás á tu hermano: Espera, echaré de tu ojo la mota, y he aquí la viga en tu ojo?

verses.KJV: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
verses.WEB: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
verses.ASV: Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Hipócrita! Tira primeiro a trave do teu olho, e então verás claramente para tirar o cisco do olho de teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: ¡Hipócrita! echa primero la viga de tu ojo, y entonces mirarás en echar la mota del ojo de tu hermano.

verses.KJV: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.WEB: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
verses.ASV: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast your pearls before the swine, lest haply they trample them under their feet, and turn and rend you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não deis o que é santo aos cães, nem lanceis vossas pérolas diante dos porcos, para não acontecer de as pisarem com os pés e, virando-se, vos despedacem.
verses.RVR09: No deis lo santo á los perros, ni echéis vuestras perlas delante de los puercos; porque no las rehuellen con sus pies, y vuelvan y os despedacen.

verses.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.WEB: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
verses.ASV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedi, e vos será dado; buscai, e achareis; batei, e vos será aberto;
verses.RVR09: Pedid, y se os dará; buscad, y hallaréis; llamad, y se os abrirá.

verses.KJV: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.WEB: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.ASV: for every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qualquer um que pede recebe; e quem busca acha; e ao que bate lhe é aberto.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que pide, recibe; y el que busca, halla; y al que llama, se abrirá.

verses.KJV: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.WEB: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.ASV: Or what man is there of you, who, if his son shall ask him for a loaf, will give him a stone;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem há dentre vós que, se seu filho pedir pão, lhe dará uma pedra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué hombre hay de vosotros, á quien si su hijo pidiere pan, le dará una piedra?

verses.KJV: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.WEB: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
verses.ASV: or if he shall ask for a fish, will give him a serpent?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se pedir peixe, lhe dará uma serpente?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y si le pidiere un pez, le dará una serpiente?

verses.KJV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.WEB: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.ASV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father who is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar bons presentes a vossos filhos, quanto mais o vosso Pai, que está nos céus, dará coisas boas aos que lhe pedirem!
verses.RVR09: Pues si vosotros, siendo malos, sabéis dar buenas dádivas á vuestros hijos, ¿cuánto más vuestro Padre que está en los cielos, dará buenas cosas á los que le piden?

verses.KJV: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.WEB: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.ASV: All things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto tudo o que quiserdes que os outros vos façam, fazei-lhes vós também assim; porque esta é a Lei e os Profetas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, todas las cosas que quisierais que los hombres hiciesen con vosotros, así también haced vosotros con ellos; porque esta es la ley y los profetas.

verses.KJV: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.WEB: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
verses.ASV: Enter ye in by the narrow gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many are they that enter in thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrai pela porta estreita; porque larga é a porta, e espaçoso o caminho que leva à perdição; e muitos são os que por ela entram.
verses.RVR09: Entrad por la puerta estrecha: porque ancha es la puerta, y espacioso el camino que lleva á perdición, y muchos son los que entran por ella.

verses.KJV: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.WEB: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
verses.ASV: For narrow is the gate, and straitened the way, that leadeth unto life, and few are they that find it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estreita é a porta, e apertado o caminho que leva à vida; e são poucos os que a acham.
verses.RVR09: Porque estrecha es la puerta, y angosto el camino que lleva á la vida, y pocos son los que la hallan.

verses.KJV: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.WEB: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
verses.ASV: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tende cuidado, porém, com os falsos profetas, que vêm a vós com roupa de ovelhas, mas por dentro são lobos vorazes.
verses.RVR09: Y guardaos de los falsos profetas, que vienen á vosotros con vestidos de ovejas, mas de dentro son lobos rapaces.

verses.KJV: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.WEB: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
verses.ASV: By their fruits ye shall know them. Do [men] gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos. Por acaso se colhem uvas dos espinheiros, ou figos dos cardos?
verses.RVR09: Por sus frutos los conoceréis. ¿Cógense uvas de los espinos, ó higos de los abrojos?

verses.KJV: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.WEB: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
verses.ASV: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but the corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim toda boa árvore dá bons frutos, mas a arvore má dá frutos maus.
verses.RVR09: Así, todo buen árbol lleva buenos frutos; mas el árbol maleado lleva malos frutos.

verses.KJV: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.WEB: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
verses.ASV: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boa árvore não pode dar frutos maus, nem a árvore má dar bons frutos.
verses.RVR09: No puede el buen árbol llevar malos frutos, ni el árbol maleado llevar frutos buenos.

verses.KJV: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.WEB: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.ASV: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Todo árbol que no lleva buen fruto, córtase y échase en el fuego.

verses.KJV: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.WEB: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
verses.ASV: Therefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos.
verses.RVR09: Así que, por sus frutos los conoceréis.

verses.KJV: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é qualquer um que me diz: “Senhor, Senhor” que entrará no Reino dos céus; mas sim aquele que faz a vontade do meu Pai que está nos céus.
verses.RVR09: No todo el que me dice: Señor, Señor, entrará en el reino de los cielos: mas el que hiciere la voluntad de mi Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.WEB: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
verses.ASV: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy by thy name, and by thy name cast out demons, and by thy name do many mighty works?
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos me dirão naquele dia: “Senhor, Senhor! Não profetizamos em teu nome? E em teu nome não expulsamos os demônios? E em teu nome não fizemos muitas maravilhas?”
verses.RVR09: Muchos me dirán en aquel día: Señor, Señor, ¿no profetizamos en tu nombre, y en tu nombre lanzamos demonios, y en tu nombre hicimos muchos milagros?

verses.KJV: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.WEB: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
verses.ASV: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então claramente lhes direi: “Nunca vos conheci. Afastai-vos de mim, transgressores!”
verses.RVR09: Y entonces les protestaré: Nunca os conocí; apartaos de mí, obradores de maldad.

verses.KJV: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.WEB: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
verses.ASV: Every one therefore that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them, shall be likened unto a wise man, who built his house upon the rock:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e as pratica, eu o compararei ao homem prudente, que construiu sua casa sobre a rocha.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera, pues, que me oye estas palabras, y las hace, le compararé á un hombre prudente, que edificó su casa sobre la peña;

verses.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.WEB: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.ASV: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon the rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela não caiu, porque estava fundada sobre a rocha.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió lluvia, y vinieron ríos, y soplaron vientos, y combatieron aquella casa; y no cayó: porque estaba fundada sobre la peña.

verses.KJV: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.WEB: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
verses.ASV: And every one that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e não as pratica, eu o compararei ao homem tolo, que construiu sua casa sobre a areia.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que me oye estas palabras, y no las hace, le compararé á un hombre insensato, que edificó su casa sobre la arena;

verses.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.WEB: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
verses.ASV: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and smote upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela caiu, e sua queda foi grande.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió lluvia, y vinieron ríos, y soplaron vientos, é hicieron ímpetu en aquella casa; y cayó, y fué grande su ruina.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.WEB: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these words, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus terminou estas palavras, as multidões estavam admiradas de sua doutrina,
verses.RVR09: Y fué que, como Jesús acabó estas palabras, las gentes se admiraban de su doctrina;

verses.KJV: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.WEB: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
verses.ASV: for he taught them as [one] having authority, and not as their scribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque ele os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os escribas.
verses.RVR09: Porque les enseñaba como quien tiene autoridad, y no como los escribas.

verses.KJV: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.WEB: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.ASV: And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele desceu do monte, muitas multidões o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO descendió del monte, le seguían muchas gentes.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.WEB: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.ASV: And behold, there came to him a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um leproso veio e prostrou-se diante dele, dizendo: Senhor, se quiseres, podes me limpar.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un leproso vino, y le adoraba, diciendo: Señor, si quisieres, puedes limpiarme.

verses.KJV: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.WEB: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.ASV: And he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou made clean. And straightway his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus estendeu a mão e o tocou, dizendo: Quero, sê limpo. E logo ele ficou limpo de sua lepra.
verses.RVR09: Y extendiendo Jesús su mano, le tocó, diciendo: Quiero; sé limpio. Y luego su lepra fué limpiada.

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhe disse: Tem o cuidado de dizeres a ninguém; mas vai mostrar-te ao sacerdote, e oferece a oferta que Moisés ordenou, para que lhes haja testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús le dijo: Mira, no lo digas á nadie; mas ve, muéstrate al sacerdote, y ofrece el presente que mandó Moisés, para testimonio á ellos.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.WEB: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
verses.ASV: And when he was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus entrou em Cafarnaum, veio a ele um centurião, rogando-lhe,
verses.RVR09: Y entrando Jesús en Capernaum, vino á él un centurión, rogándole,

verses.KJV: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.WEB: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
verses.ASV: and saying, Lord, my servant lieth in the house sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo: Senhor, o meu servo jaz em casa, paralítico, e gravemente atormentado.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: Señor, mi mozo yace en casa paralítico, gravemente atormentado.

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Eu irei, e o curarei.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Yo iré y le sanaré.

verses.KJV: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.WEB: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.ASV: And the centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o centurião respondeu: Senhor, não sou digno de que entres sob meu telhado; mas dize somente uma palavra, e o meu servo sarará.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió el centurión, y dijo: Señor, no soy digno de que entres debajo de mi techado; mas solamente di la palabra, y mi mozo sanará.

verses.KJV: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.WEB: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.ASV: For I also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu também sou homem debaixo de autoridade, e tenho debaixo de meu comando soldados; e digo a este: “Vai”, e ele vai; e ao outro: “Vem”, e vem; e a meu servo: “Faze isto”, e ele faz.
verses.RVR09: Porque también yo soy hombre bajo de potestad, y tengo bajo de mí soldados: y digo á éste: Ve, y va; y al otro: Ven, y viene; y á mi siervo: Haz esto, y lo hace.

verses.KJV: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
verses.ASV: And when Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus ouviu [isto] , maravilhou-se, e disse aos que o seguiam: Em verdade vos digo que nem mesmo em Israel encontrei tanta fé.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Jesús, se maravilló, y dijo á los que le seguían: De cierto os digo, que ni aun en Israel he hallado fe tanta.

verses.KJV: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu vos digo que muitos virão do oriente e do ocidente, e se sentarão à mesa com Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, no Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y os digo que vendrán muchos del oriente y del occidente, y se sentarán con Abraham, é Isaac, y Jacob, en el reino de los cielos:

verses.KJV: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
verses.ASV: but the sons of the kingdom shall be cast forth into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos do reino, porém, serão lançados nas trevas de fora; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
verses.RVR09: Mas los hijos del reino serán echados á las tinieblas de afuera: allí será el lloro y el crujir de dientes.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; as thou hast believed, [so] be it done unto thee. And the servant was healed in that hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus disse ao centurião: Vai, e assim como creste, a ti seja feito.E naquela mesma hora o servo dele foi sarado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo al centurión: Ve, y como creiste te sea hecho. Y su mozo fué sano en el mismo momento.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.WEB: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
verses.ASV: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick of a fever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Jesus veio à casa de Pedro, viu a sogra dele, deitada e com febre.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Jesús á casa de Pedro, y vió á su suegra echada en cama, y con fiebre.

verses.KJV: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.WEB: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
verses.ASV: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose, and ministered unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tocou a mão dela, e a febre a deixou. Então ela se levantou e começou a servi-los.
verses.RVR09: Y tocó su mano, y la fiebre la dejó: y ella se levantó, y les servía.

verses.KJV: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.WEB: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
verses.ASV: And when even was come, they brought unto him many possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando chegou o anoitecer, trouxeram-lhe muitos endemoninhados. Ele expulsou-lhes os espíritos com a palavra, e curou todos os que estavam doentes,
verses.RVR09: Y como fué ya tarde, trajeron á él muchos endemoniados; y echó los demonios con la palabra, y sanó á todos los enfermos;

verses.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
verses.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our diseases.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que se cumprisse o que havia sido dito pelo profeta Isaías, que disse: Ele tomou sobre si as nossas enfermidades, e levou as nossas doenças.
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el profeta Isaías, que dijo: El mismo tomó nuestras enfermedades, y llevó nuestras dolencias.

verses.KJV: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.WEB: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
verses.ASV: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus, ao ver muitas multidões ao redor de si, mandou que passassem para a outra margem.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Jesús muchas gentes alrededor de sí, mandó pasar á la otra parte del lago.

verses.KJV: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.WEB: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
verses.ASV: And there came a scribe, and said unto him, Teacher, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então um escriba se aproximou, e disse-lhe: Mestre, eu te seguirei aonde quer que fores.
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose un escriba, le dijo: Maestro, te seguiré á donde quiera que fueres.

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven [have] nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe respondeu: As raposas têm covis, e as aves do céu ninhos; mas o Filho do homem não tem onde recostar a cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Las zorras tienen cavernas, y las aves del cielo nidos; mas el Hijo del hombre no tiene donde recueste su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.WEB: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
verses.ASV: And another of the disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outro dos seus discípulos lhe disse: Senhor, permite-me ir primeiro enterrar meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y otro de sus discípulos le dijo: Señor, dame licencia para que vaya primero, y entierre á mi padre.

verses.KJV: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus saith unto him, Follow me; and leave the dead to bury their own dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus lhe disse: Segue-me, e deixa aos mortos enterrarem seus mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Sígueme; deja que los muertos entierren á sus muertos.

verses.KJV: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.WEB: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
verses.ASV: And when he was entered into a boat, his disciples followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele entrou no barco, e seus discípulos o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando él en el barco, sus discípulos le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.WEB: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
verses.ASV: And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que se levantou no mar uma tormenta tão grande que o barco era coberto pelas ondas; porém ele dormia.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, fué hecho en la mar un gran movimiento, que el barco se cubría de las ondas; mas él dormía.

verses.KJV: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.WEB: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
verses.ASV: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Save, Lord; we perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus discípulos se aproximaram para acordá-lo, dizendo: Senhor, salva-nos! Estamos sendo destruídos!
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose sus discípulos, le despertaron, diciendo: Señor, sálvanos, que perecemos.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Por que temeis, [homens] de pouca fé? Então ele se levantou e repreendeu os ventos e o mar. E houve grande calmaria.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dice: ¿Por qué teméis, hombres de poca fe? Entonces, levantándose, reprendió á los vientos y á la mar; y fué grande bonanza.

verses.KJV: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.WEB: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
verses.ASV: And the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aqueles homens se maravilharam, dizendo: Quem é este, que até os ventos e o mar lhe obedecem?
verses.RVR09: Y los hombres se maravillaron, diciendo: ¿Qué hombre es éste, que aun los vientos y la mar le obedecen?

verses.KJV: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.WEB: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
verses.ASV: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gadarenes, there met him two possessed with demons, coming forth out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man could pass by that way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegou à outra margem, à terra dos gergesenos, vieram-lhe ao encontro dois endemoninhados que tinham saído dos sepulcros. Eles eram tão ferozes que ninguém podia passar por aquele caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y como él hubo llegado en la otra ribera al país de los Gergesenos, le vinieron al encuentro dos endemoniados que salían de los sepulcros, fieros en gran manera, que nadie podía pasar por aquel camino.

verses.KJV: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.WEB: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
verses.ASV: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que gritaram, dizendo: Que temos contigo, Jesus, Filho de Deus? Vieste aqui nos atormentar antes do tempo?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí clamaron, diciendo: ¿Qué tenemos contigo, Jesús, Hijo de Dios? ¿has venido acá á molestarnos antes de tiempo?

verses.KJV: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.WEB: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
verses.ASV: Now there was afar off from them a herd of many swine feeding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto isso longe deles estava uma manada de muitos porcos pastando.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba lejos de ellos un hato de muchos puercos paciendo.

verses.KJV: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.WEB: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
verses.ASV: And the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os demônios rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Se nos expulsares, permite-nos entrar naquela manada de porcos.
verses.RVR09: Y los demonios le rogaron, diciendo: Si nos echas, permítenos ir á aquel hato de puercos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Go. And they came out, and went into the swine: and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ide. Então eles saíram, e entraram na manada de porcos; e eis que toda aquela manada de porcos se lançou de um precipício ao mar, e morreram nas águas.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Id. Y ellos salieron, y se fueron á aquel hato de puercos: y he aquí, todo el hato de los puercos se precipitó de un despeñadero en la mar, y murieron en las aguas.

verses.KJV: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.WEB: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
verses.ASV: And they that fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, and what was befallen to them that were possessed with demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que cuidavam dos porcos fugiram; e ao chegarem à cidade, anunciaram todas [estas] coisas, inclusive o que [havia acontecido] aos endemoninhados.
verses.RVR09: Y los porqueros huyeron, y viniendo á la ciudad, contaron todas las cosas, y lo que había pasado con los endemoniados.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.WEB: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
verses.ASV: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought [him] that he would depart from their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que toda aquela cidade saiu ao encontro de Jesus; e quando o viram, rogaram-lhe que se retirasse do território deles.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, toda la ciudad salió á encontrar á Jesús: y cuando le vieron, le rogaban que saliese de sus términos.

verses.KJV: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.WEB: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
verses.ASV: And he entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele entrou no barco, passou para a outra margem, e veio à sua própria cidade.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES entrando en el barco, pasó á la otra parte, y vino á su ciudad.

verses.KJV: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.WEB: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.ASV: And behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, be of good cheer; thy sins are forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que lhe trouxeram um paralítico, deitado em um leito. Quando Jesus viu a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: Tem bom ânimo, filho! Teus pecados são perdoados.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí le trajeron un paralítico, echado en una cama: y viendo Jesús la fe de ellos, dijo al paralítico: Confía, hijo; tus pecados te son perdonados.

verses.KJV: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.WEB: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
verses.ASV: And behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que alguns dos escribas disseram entre si: Ele blasfema.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, algunos de los escribas decían dentro de sí: Este blasfema.

verses.KJV: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.WEB: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.ASV: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, conhecendo seus pensamentos, disse: “Por que pensais o mal em vossos corações?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Jesús sus pensamientos, dijo: ¿Por qué pensáis mal en vuestros corazones?

verses.KJV: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.WEB: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
verses.ASV: For which is easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o que é mais fácil? Dizer: ‘Teus pecados estão perdoados’, ou dizer: ‘Levanta-te, e anda’?
verses.RVR09: Porque, ¿qué es más fácil, decir: Los pecados te son perdonados; ó decir: Levántate, y anda?

verses.KJV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.WEB: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.ASV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (then saith he to the sick of the palsy), Arise, and take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem autoridade na terra para perdoar pecados”, (Ele, então, disse ao paralítico): Levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e vai para tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Pues para que sepáis que el Hijo del hombre tiene potestad en la tierra de perdonar pecados, (dice entonces al paralítico): Levántate, toma tu cama, y vete á tu casa.

verses.KJV: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.WEB: He arose and departed to his house.
verses.ASV: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este se levantou e foi para sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se levantó y se fué á su casa.

verses.KJV: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.WEB: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.ASV: But when the multitudes saw it, they were afraid, and glorified God, who had given such authority unto men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando as multidões viram [isto] , ficaram maravilhadas, e glorificaram a Deus, que tinha dado tal autoridade aos homens.
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes, viéndolo, se maravillaron, y glorificaron á Dios, que había dado tal potestad á los hombres.

verses.KJV: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.WEB: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
verses.ASV: And as Jesus passed by from thence, he saw a man, called Matthew, sitting at the place of toll: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus, ao passar dali, viu um homem sentado na coletoria de impostos, chamado Mateus; e disse-lhe: Segue-me. Então este se levantou e o seguiu.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando Jesús de allí, vió á un hombre que estaba sentado al banco de los públicos tributos, el cual se llamaba Mateo; y dícele: Sígueme. Y se levantó, y le siguió.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.WEB: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto [Jesus] estava reclinado à mesa na casa [de Mateus] , eis que muitos publicanos e pecadores vieram e se reclinaram à mesa juntamente com Jesus e seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando él sentado á la mesa en casa, he aquí que muchos publicanos y pecadores, que habían venido, se sentaron juntamente á la mesa con Jesús y sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.WEB: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.ASV: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Teacher with the publicans and sinners?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os fariseus viram [isto] , perguntaram aos seus discípulos: Por que o vosso Mestre come com publicanos e pecadores?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto los Fariseos, dijeron á sus discípulos: ¿Por qué come vuestro Maestro con los publicanos y pecadores?

verses.KJV: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
verses.ASV: But when he heard it, he said, They that are whole have no need of a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus ouviu, e respondeu-lhes: Os que têm saúde não precisam de médico, mas sim os que estão doentes.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Jesús, les dijo: Los que están sanos no tienen necesidad de médico, sino los enfermos.

verses.KJV: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.WEB: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.ASV: But go ye and learn what [this] meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice: for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ide aprender o que significa: ‘Quero misericórdia, e não sacrifício’. Porque eu não vim chamar os justos, mas sim, os pecadores, ao arrependimento.
verses.RVR09: Andad pues, y aprended qué cosa es: Misericordia quiero, y no sacrificio: porque no he venido á llamar justos, sino pecadores á arrepentimiento.

verses.KJV: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.WEB: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
verses.ASV: Then come to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os discípulos de João vieram a ele, e perguntaram: Por que nós e os fariseus jejuamos muitas vezes, mas os teus discípulos não jejuam?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los discípulos de Juan vienen á él, diciendo: ¿Por qué nosotros y los Fariseos ayunamos muchas veces, y tus discípulos no ayunan?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then will they fast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Podem, por acaso, os convidados do casamento andar tristes enquanto o noivo está com eles? Mas dias virão, quando o noivo lhes for tirado, e então jejuarão.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: ¿Pueden los que son de bodas tener luto entre tanto que el esposo está con ellos? mas vendrán días cuando el esposo será quitado de ellos, y entonces ayunarán.

verses.KJV: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.WEB: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
verses.ASV: And no man putteth a piece of undressed cloth upon an old garment; for that which should fill it up taketh from the garment, and a worse rent is made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém põe remendo de pano novo em roupa velha; porque tal remendo rasga a roupa, e o rompimento se torna pior.
verses.RVR09: Y nadie echa remiendo de paño recio en vestido viejo; porque el tal remiendo tira del vestido, y se hace peor la rotura.

verses.KJV: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.WEB: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
verses.ASV: Neither do [men] put new wine into old wine-skins: else the skins burst, and the wine is spilled, and the skins perish: but they put new wine into fresh wine-skins, and both are preserved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem põem vinho novo em odres velhos; pois senão os odres se rompem, o vinho se derrama, e os odres se perdem; mas põem o vinho novo em odres novos, e ambos juntamente se conservam.
verses.RVR09: Ni echan vino nuevo en cueros viejos: de otra manera los cueros se rompen, y el vino se derrama, y se pierden los cueros; mas echan el vino nuevo en cueros nuevos, y lo uno y lo otro se conserva juntamente.

verses.KJV: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.WEB: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
verses.ASV: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ele lhes dizia estas coisas, eis que um chefe [de sinagoga] veio prostrar-se diante dele, e disse: Minha filha faleceu ainda agora; mas vem, e põe tua mão sobre ela, e ela viverá.
verses.RVR09: Hablando él estas cosas á ellos, he aquí vino un principal, y le adoraba, diciendo: Mi hija es muerta poco ha: mas ven y pon tu mano sobre ella, y vivirá.

verses.KJV: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.WEB: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
verses.ASV: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and [so did] his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus se levantou e o seguiu com seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y se levantó Jesús, y le siguió, y sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.WEB: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
verses.ASV: And behold, a woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the border of his garment:
verses.ALMEIDA: (Eis, porém, que uma mulher enferma de um fluxo de sangue havia doze anos veio por detrás [dele] , e tocou a borda de sua roupa;
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí una mujer enferma de flujo de sangre doce años había, llegándose por detrás, tocó la franja de su vestido:

verses.KJV: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.WEB: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
verses.ASV: for she said within herself, If I do but touch his garment, I shall be made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque dizia consigo mesma: Se eu tão-somente tocar a roupa dele, serei curada.
verses.RVR09: Porque decía entre sí: Si tocare solamente su vestido, seré salva.
