verses.KJV: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.WEB: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
verses.ASV: But Jesus turning and seeing her said, Daughter, be of good cheer; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus se virou e a viu. Então disse: Tem bom ânimo, filha, a tua fé te sarou. E desde aquela hora a mulher ficou com saúde.)
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús volviéndose, y mirándola, dijo: Confía, hija, tu fe te ha salvado. Y la mujer fué salva desde aquella hora.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.WEB: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
verses.ASV: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute-players, and the crowd making a tumult,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus chegou à casa daquele chefe, viu os tocadores de flauta e a multidão que fazia alvoroço,
verses.RVR09: Y llegado Jesús á casa del principal, viendo los tañedores de flautas, y la gente que hacía bullicio,

verses.KJV: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.WEB: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
verses.ASV: he said, Give place: for the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Retirai-vos, porque a menina não está morta, mas sim dormindo. E riram dele.
verses.RVR09: Díceles: Apartaos, que la muchacha no es muerta, mas duerme. Y se burlaban de él.

verses.KJV: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.WEB: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
verses.ASV: But when the crowd was put forth, he entered in, and took her by the hand; and the damsel arose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando a multidão foi expulsa, ele entrou, pegou a mão dela, e a menina se levantou.
verses.RVR09: Y como la gente fué echada fuera, entró, y tomóla de la mano, y se levantó la muchacha.

verses.KJV: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.WEB: The report of this went out into all that land.
verses.ASV: And the fame hereof went forth into all that land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta notícia se espalhou por toda aquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y salió esta fama por toda aquella tierra.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.WEB: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
verses.ASV: And as Jesus passed by from thence, two blind men followed him, crying out, and saying, Have mercy on us, thou son of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo Jesus dali, dois cegos o seguiram, gritando: Tem compaixão de nós, Filho de Davi!
verses.RVR09: Y pasando Jesús de allí, le siguieron dos ciegos, dando voces y diciendo: Ten misericordia de nosotros, Hijo de David.

verses.KJV: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.WEB: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.ASV: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele entrou em casa, os cegos vieram a ele. Jesus lhes perguntou: Credes que posso fazer isto? Eles lhe responderam: Sim, Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y llegado á la casa, vinieron á él los ciegos; y Jesús les dice: ¿Creéis que puedo hacer esto? Ellos dicen: Sí, Señor.

verses.KJV: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.WEB: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
verses.ASV: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it done unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tocou os olhos deles, dizendo: Seja feito convosco conforme a vossa fé.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tocó los ojos de ellos, diciendo: Conforme á vuestra fe os sea hecho.

verses.KJV: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.WEB: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
verses.ASV: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os olhos deles se abriram. Então Jesus os advertiu severamente, dizendo: Tende o cuidado de que ninguém saiba disso.
verses.RVR09: Y los ojos de ellos fueron abiertos. Y Jesús les encargó rigurosamente, diciendo: Mirad que nadie lo sepa.

verses.KJV: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.WEB: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
verses.ASV: But they went forth, and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles saíram e divulgaram a notícia acerca dele por toda aquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos salidos, divulgaron su fama por toda aquella tierra.

verses.KJV: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.WEB: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
verses.ASV: And as they went forth, behold, there was brought to him a dumb man possessed with a demon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto eles saíam, eis que lhe trouxeram um homem mudo e endemoninhado.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo ellos, he aquí, le trajeron un hombre mudo, endemoniado.

verses.KJV: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.WEB: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
verses.ASV: And when the demon was cast out, the dumb man spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o demônio foi expulso, o mudo passou a falar. Então as multidões ficaram maravilhadas, e disseram: Nunca se viu algo assim em Israel!
verses.RVR09: Y echado fuera el demonio, el mudo habló; y las gentes se maravillaron, diciendo: Nunca ha sido vista cosa semejante en Israel.

verses.KJV: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.WEB: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
verses.ASV: But the Pharisees said, By the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os fariseus diziam: É pelo chefe dos demônios que ele expulsa os demônios.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Fariseos decían: Por el príncipe de los demonios echa fuera los demonios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.WEB: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of disease and all manner of sickness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus percorria todas as cidades e aldeias, ensinando em suas sinagogas, pregando o Evangelho do Reino, e curando toda enfermidade e toda doença entre o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y rodeaba Jesús por todas las ciudades y aldeas, enseñando en las sinagogas de ellos, y predicando el evangelio del reino, y sanando toda enfermedad y todo achaque en el pueblo.

verses.KJV: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.WEB: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.ASV: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were distressed and scattered, as sheep not having a shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele viu as multidões, teve compaixão delas, porque andavam cansadas e desamparadas, como ovelhas que não têm pastor.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo las gentes, tuvo compasión de ellas; porque estaban derramadas y esparcidas como ovejas que no tienen pastor.

verses.KJV: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.WEB: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
verses.ASV: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse aos seus discípulos: Em verdade a colheita é grande, porém os trabalhadores são poucos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dice á sus discípulos: A la verdad la mies es mucha, mas los obreros pocos.

verses.KJV: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.WEB: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
verses.ASV: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto rogai ao Senhor da colheita que envie trabalhadores à sua colheita.
verses.RVR09: Rogad, pues, al Señor de la mies, que envíe obreros á su mies.

verses.KJV: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.WEB: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
verses.ASV: And he called unto him his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of disease and all manner of sickness.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] chamou a si os seus doze discípulos, e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos, para os expulsarem, e curarem toda enfermidade e toda doença.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES llamando á sus doce discípulos, les dió potestad contra los espíritus inmundos, para que los echasen fuera, y sanasen toda enfermedad y toda dolencia.

verses.KJV: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.WEB: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
verses.ASV: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os nomes dos doze apóstolos são estes: o primeiro, Simão, chamado Pedro, e seu irmão André; Tiago, [filho] de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João;
verses.RVR09: Y los nombres de los doce apóstoles son estos: el primero, Simón, que es dicho Pedro, y Andrés su hermano; Jacobo, hijo de Zebedeo, y Juan su hermano;

verses.KJV: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.WEB: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
verses.ASV: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the [son] of Alphæus, and Thaddæus;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filipe e Bartolomeu; Tomé, e Mateus o publicano; Tiago, [filho] de Alfeu; e Lebeu, por sobrenomeTadeu;
verses.RVR09: Felipe, y Bartolomé; Tomás, y Mateo el publicano; Jacobo hijo de Alfeo, y Lebeo, por sobrenombre Tadeo;

verses.KJV: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.WEB: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.ASV: Simon the Cananæan, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão o zeloso, e Judas Iscariotes, o mesmo que o traiu.
verses.RVR09: Simón el Cananita y Judas Iscariote, que también le entregó.

verses.KJV: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.WEB: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
verses.ASV: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and charged them, saying, Go not into [any] way of the Gentiles, and enter not into any city of the Samaritans:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus enviou esses doze, e lhes mandou, dizendo: Não ireis pelo caminho dos gentios, nem entrareis em cidade de samaritanos.
verses.RVR09: A estos doce envió Jesús, á los cuales dió mandamiento, diciendo: Por el camino de los Gentiles no iréis, y en ciudad de Samaritanos no entréis;

verses.KJV: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.ASV: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, ide às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas id antes á las ovejas perdidas de la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.WEB: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
verses.ASV: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando fordes, proclamai, dizendo: ‘Perto está o Reino dos céus’.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo, predicad, diciendo: El reino de los cielos se ha acercado.

verses.KJV: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.WEB: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
verses.ASV: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons: freely ye received, freely give.
verses.ALMEIDA: Curai os doentes, limpai os leprosos, ressuscitai os mortos, expulsai os demônios; recebestes de graça, dai de graça.
verses.RVR09: Sanad enfermos, limpiad leprosos, resucitad muertos, echad fuera demonios: de gracia recibisteis, dad de gracia.

verses.KJV: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.WEB: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
verses.ASV: Get you no gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomeis convosco ouro, nem prata, nem cobre em vossos cintos;
verses.RVR09: No aprestéis oro, ni plata, ni cobre en vuestras bolsas;

verses.KJV: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.WEB: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
verses.ASV: no wallet for [your] journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem bolsas para o caminho, nem duas túnicas, nem sandálias, nem bordão; pois o trabalhador é digno de seu alimento.
verses.RVR09: Ni alforja para el camino, ni dos ropas de vestir, ni zapatos, ni bordón; porque el obrero digno es de su alimento.

verses.KJV: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.WEB: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
verses.ASV: And into whatsoever city or village ye shall enter, search out who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em qualquer cidade ou aldeia que entrardes, informai-vos de quem nela seja digno, e ficai ali até que saiais.
verses.RVR09: Mas en cualquier ciudad, ó aldea donde entrareis, investigad quién sea en ella digno, y reposad allí hasta que salgáis.

verses.KJV: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.WEB: As you enter into the household, greet it.
verses.ASV: And as ye enter into the house, salute it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando entrardes na casa, saudai-a.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando en la casa, saludadla.

verses.KJV: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.WEB: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.ASV: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se a casa for digna, venha sobre ela a vossa paz; mas se ela não for digna, volte para vós a vossa paz.
verses.RVR09: Y si la casa fuere digna, vuestra paz vendrá sobre ella; mas si no fuere digna, vuestra paz se volverá á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.WEB: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
verses.ASV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, as ye go forth out of that house or that city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem quer que não vos receber, nem ouvir vossas palavras, quando sairdes daquela casa ou cidade, sacudi o pó de vossos pés.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que no os recibiere, ni oyere vuestras palabras, salid de aquella casa ó ciudad, y sacudid el polvo de vuestros pies.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que no dia do julgamento mais tolerável será para a região de Sodoma e Gomorra do que para aquela cidade.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que el castigo será más tolerable á la tierra de los de Sodoma y de los de Gomorra en el día del juicio, que á aquella ciudad.

verses.KJV: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
verses.ASV: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu vos envio como ovelhas em meio de lobos; portanto, sede prudentes como as serpentes e inofensivos como pombas.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo os envío como á ovejas en medio de lobos: sed pues prudentes como serpientes, y sencillos como palomas.

verses.KJV: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.WEB: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
verses.ASV: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tende cuidado com as pessoas; porque vos entregarão em tribunais, e vos açoitarão em suas sinagogas;
verses.RVR09: Y guardaos de los hombres: porque os entregarán en concilios, y en sus sinagogas os azotarán;

verses.KJV: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
verses.ASV: yea and before governors and kings shall ye be brought for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até perante governadores e reis sereis levados por causa de mim, para que haja testemunho a eles e aos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Y aun á príncipes y á reyes seréis llevados por causa de mí, por testimonio á ellos y á los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.WEB: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
verses.ASV: But when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that hour what ye shall speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando vos entregarem, não estejais ansiosos de como ou que falareis; porque naquela mesma hora vos será dado o que deveis falar.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando os entregaren, no os apuréis por cómo ó qué hablaréis; porque en aquella hora os será dado qué habéis de hablar.

verses.KJV: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.WEB: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
verses.ASV: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaketh in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não sois vós os que falais, mas sim o Espírito do vosso Pai que fala em vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque no sois vosotros los que habláis, sino el Espíritu de vuestro Padre que habla en vosotros.

verses.KJV: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.WEB: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
verses.ASV: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child: and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irmão entregará irmão à morte, e pai ao filho; e filhos se levantarão contra os pais, e os matarão.
verses.RVR09: Y el hermano entregará al hermano á la muerte, y el padre al hijo; y los hijos se levantarán contra los padres, y los harán morir.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.WEB: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sereis odiados por todos por causa de meu nome; mas aquele que perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.
verses.RVR09: Y seréis aborrecidos de todos por mi nombre; mas el que soportare hasta el fin, éste será salvo.

verses.KJV: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.WEB: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
verses.ASV: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone through the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, então, vos perseguirem nesta cidade, fugi para outra; porque em verdade vos digo que não acabareis de [percorrer] as cidades de Israel, até que venha o Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando os persiguieren en esta ciudad, huid á la otra: porque de cierto os digo, que no acabaréis de andar todas las ciudades de Israel, que no venga el Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.WEB: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
verses.ASV: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: O discípulo não é superior ao mestre, nem o servo superior ao seu senhor.
verses.RVR09: El discípulo no es más que su maestro, ni el siervo más que su señor.

verses.KJV: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.WEB: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
verses.ASV: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more them of his household!
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja suficiente ao discípulo ser como o seu mestre, e ao servo como o seu senhor; se ao chefe da casa chamaram de Belzebu, quanto mais aos membros de sua casa!
verses.RVR09: Bástale al discípulo ser como su maestro, y al siervo como su señor. Si al padre de la familia llamaron Beelzebub, ¿cuánto más á los de su casa?

verses.KJV: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
verses.ASV: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não os temais; porque nada há encoberto que não se revelará, [nada] oculto que não se saberá.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no los temáis; porque nada hay encubierto, que no haya de ser manifestado; ni oculto, que no haya de saberse.

verses.KJV: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.WEB: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
verses.ASV: What I tell you in the darkness, speak ye in the light; and what ye hear in the ear, proclaim upon the house-tops.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que eu vos digo em trevas, dizei na luz; e o que ouvis ao ouvido, proclamai sobre os telhados.
verses.RVR09: Lo que os digo en tinieblas, decidlo en la luz; y lo que oís al oído predicadlo desde los terrados.

verses.KJV: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
verses.ASV: And be not afraid of them that kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não temais os que matam o corpo, mas não podem matar a alma; temei mais aquele que pode destruir tanto a alma como o corpo no inferno.
verses.RVR09: Y no temáis á los que matan el cuerpo, mas al alma no pueden matar: temed antes á aquel que puede destruir el alma y el cuerpo en el infierno.

verses.KJV: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.WEB: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
verses.ASV: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? and not one of them shall fall on the ground without your Father:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se vendem dois pardais por uma pequena moeda? Mas nem um deles cairá em terra contra a vontade de vosso Pai.
verses.RVR09: ¿No se venden dos pajarillos por un cuarto? Con todo, ni uno de ellos cae á tierra sin vuestro Padre.

verses.KJV: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.WEB: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.ASV: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até os cabelos de vossas cabeças estão todos contados.
verses.RVR09: Pues aun vuestros cabellos están todos contados.

verses.KJV: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.ASV: Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, não tenhais medo; mais valeis vós que muitos pardais.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no temáis: más valéis vosotros que muchos pajarillos.

verses.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: Every one therefore who shall confess me before men, him will I also confess before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, todo aquele que me der reconhecimento diante das pessoas, também eu o reconhecerei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera pues, que me confesare delante de los hombres, le confesaré yo también delante de mi Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém qualquer um que me negar diante das pessoas, também eu o negarei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que me negare delante de los hombres, le negaré yo también delante de mi Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.WEB: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
verses.ASV: Think not that I came to send peace on the earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não penseis que vim trazer paz à terra. Não vim trazer paz, mas sim espada.
verses.RVR09: No penséis que he venido para meter paz en la tierra: no he venido para meter paz, sino espada.

verses.KJV: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.WEB: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
verses.ASV: For I came to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu vim pôr em discórdia ‘o homem contra seu pai, a filha contra sua mãe, e a nora contra sua sogra.
verses.RVR09: Porque he venido para hacer disensión del hombre contra su padre, y de la hija contra su madre, y de la nuera contra su suegra.

verses.KJV: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.WEB: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
verses.ASV: and a man’s foes [shall be] they of his own household.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os inimigos do homem serão os de sua própria casa’.
verses.RVR09: Y los enemigos del hombre serán los de su casa.

verses.KJV: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.WEB: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
verses.ASV: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ama pai ou mãe mais que a mim não é digno de mim; e quem ama filho ou filha mais que a mim não é digno de mim;
verses.RVR09: El que ama padre ó madre más que á mí, no es digno de mí; y el que ama hijo ó hija más que á mí, no es digno de mí.

verses.KJV: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.WEB: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.
verses.ASV: And he that doth not take his cross and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem não toma sua cruz e segue após mim não é digno de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y el que no toma su cruz, y sigue en pos de mí, no es digno de mí.

verses.KJV: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.WEB: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
verses.ASV: He that findeth his life shall lose it; and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem achar sua vida a perderá; e quem, por causa de mim, perder sua vida, a achará.
verses.RVR09: El que hallare su vida, la perderá; y el que perdiere su vida por causa de mí, la hallará.

verses.KJV: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.WEB: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
verses.ASV: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem vos recebe, recebe a mim; e quem me recebe, recebe aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: El que os recibe á vosotros, á mí recibe; y el que á mí recibe, recibe al que me envió.

verses.KJV: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.WEB: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.ASV: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward: and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem recebe um profeta por reconhecê-lo como profeta receberá recompensa de profeta; e quem recebe um justo por reconhecê-lo como justo receberá recompensa de justo.
verses.RVR09: El que recibe profeta en nombre de profeta, merced de profeta recibirá; y el que recibe justo en nombre de justo, merced de justo recibirá.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.WEB: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”
verses.ASV: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que der ainda que somente um copo de [água] fria a um destes pequenos por reconhecê-lo como discípulo, em verdade vos digo que de maneira nenhuma perderá sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que diere á uno de estos pequeñitos un vaso de agua fría solamente, en nombre de discípulo, de cierto os digo, que no perderá su recompensa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.WEB: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and preach in their cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus acabou de dar as ordens aos seus doze discípulos, partiu dali para ensinar e para pregar em suas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ, que acabando Jesús de dar mandamientos á sus doce discípulos, se fué de allí á enseñar y á predicar en las ciudades de ellos.

verses.KJV: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.WEB: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
verses.ASV: Now when John heard in the prison the works of the Christ, he sent by his disciples
verses.ALMEIDA: E João, ao ouvir na prisão as obras de Cristo, enviou [-lhe] dois de seus discípulos,
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Juan en la prisión los hechos de Cristo, le envió dos de sus discípulos,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.WEB: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
verses.ASV: and said unto him, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntando-lhe: És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Eres tú aquél que había de venir, ó esperaremos á otro?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye hear and see:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Ide anunciar a João as coisas que ouvis e vedes:
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Id, y haced saber á Juan las cosas que oís y veis:

verses.KJV: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.WEB: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
verses.ASV: the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have good tidings preached to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os cegos veem, e os mancos andam; os leprosos são limpos, e os surdos ouvem; os mortos são ressuscitados, e aos pobres é anunciado o Evangelho;
verses.RVR09: Los ciegos ven, y los cojos andan; los leprosos son limpiados, y los sordos oyen; los muertos son resucitados, y á los pobres es anunciado el evangelio.

verses.KJV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.WEB: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
verses.ASV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bendito é aquele que não se ofender em mim.
verses.RVR09: Y bienaventurado es el que no fuere escandalizado en mí.

verses.KJV: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.WEB: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.ASV: And as these went their way, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que eles se foram, Jesus começou a dizer às multidões acerca de João: Que saístes ao deserto para ver? Uma cana que se move pelo vento?
verses.RVR09: E idos ellos, comenzó Jesús á decir de Juan á las gentes: ¿Qué salisteis á ver al desierto? ¿una caña que es meneada del viento?

verses.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
verses.WEB: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
verses.ASV: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft [raiment]? Behold, they that wear soft [raiment] are in kings’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que saístes para ver? Um homem vestido com roupas delicadas? Eis que os que usam roupas delicadas estão nas casas dos reis.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué salisteis á ver? ¿un hombre cubierto de delicados vestidos? He aquí, los que traen vestidos delicados, en las casas de los reyes están.

verses.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.WEB: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.ASV: But wherefore went ye out? to see a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que saístes para ver? Um profeta? Sim, eu vos digo, e muito mais que um profeta;
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué salisteis á ver? ¿un profeta? También os digo, y más que profeta.

verses.KJV: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.WEB: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
verses.ASV: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este é aquele sobre o qual está escrito: ‘Eis que diante de tua face envio o meu mensageiro, que preparará o teu caminho diante de ti.’
verses.RVR09: Porque éste es de quien está escrito: He aquí, yo envío mi mensajero delante de tu faz, que aparejará tu camino delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not arisen a greater than John the Baptist: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que, dentre os nascidos de mulheres, não se levantou [outro] maior que João Batista; porém o menor no Reino dos céus é maior que ele.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que no se levantó entre los que nacen de mujeres otro mayor que Juan el Bautista; mas el que es muy más pequeño en el reino de los cielos, mayor es que él.

verses.KJV: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.WEB: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.ASV: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and men of violence take it by force.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde os dias de João Batista até agora, o Reino dos céus está sujeito à violência, e os que usam de violência se apoderam dele.
verses.RVR09: Desde los días de Juan el Bautista hasta ahora, al reino de los cielos se hace fuerza, y los valientes lo arrebatan.

verses.KJV: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.WEB: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.ASV: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos os profetas e a Lei profetizaram até João.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los profetas y la ley hasta Juan profetizaron.

verses.KJV: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.WEB: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
verses.ASV: And if ye are willing to receive [it], this is Elijah, that is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se estais dispostos a aceitar, este é o Elias que havia de vir.
verses.RVR09: Y si queréis recibir, él es aquel Elías que había de venir.

verses.KJV: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ASV: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.WEB: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
verses.ASV: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the marketplaces, who call unto their fellows
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas com quem compararei esta geração? Semelhante é às crianças que se sentam nas praças, e chamam aos seus colegas,
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿á quién compararé esta generación? Es semejante á los muchachos que se sientan en las plazas, y dan voces á sus compañeros,

verses.KJV: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.WEB: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
verses.ASV: and say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not mourn.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizem: ‘Tocamos flauta para vós, mas não dançastes; cantamos lamentações para vós, mas não chorastes.’
verses.RVR09: Y dicen: Os tañimos flauta, y no bailasteis; os endechamos, y no lamentasteis.

verses.KJV: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.WEB: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.ASV: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a demon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque veio João, sem comer nem beber, e dizem: ‘Ele tem demônio.’
verses.RVR09: Porque vino Juan, que ni comía ni bebía, y dicen: Demonio tiene.

verses.KJV: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.WEB: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
verses.ASV: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold, a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners! And wisdom is justified by her works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio o Filho do homem, que come e bebe, e dizem: ‘Eis aqui um homem comilão e beberrão, amigo de publicanos e pecadores!’ Mas a sabedoria prova-se justa por meio de seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Vino el Hijo del hombre, que come y bebe, y dicen: He aquí un hombre comilón, y bebedor de vino, amigo de publicanos y de pecadores. Mas la sabiduría es justificada por sus hijos.

verses.KJV: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.WEB: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
verses.ASV: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele começou a repreender as cidades em que a maioria de seus milagres haviam sido feitos, por não terem se arrependido:
verses.RVR09: Entonces comenzó á reconvenir á las ciudades en las cuales habían sido hechas muy muchas de sus maravillas, porque no se habían arrepentido, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.WEB: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.ASV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti Corazim! Ai de ti Betsaida! Porque se em Tiro e em Sidom tivessem sido feitos os milagres que em vós foram feitos, há muito tempo teriam se arrependido com saco e com cinza!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ti, Corazín! ¡Ay de ti, Bethsaida! porque si en Tiro y en Sidón fueran hechas las maravillas que han sido hechas en vosotras, en otro tiempo se hubieran arrepentido en saco y en ceniza.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.WEB: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
verses.ASV: But I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que mais tolerável será para Tiro e Sidom, no dia do juízo, que para vós.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os digo, que á Tiro y á Sidón será más tolerable el castigo en el día del juicio, que á vosotras.

verses.KJV: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.WEB: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.
verses.ASV: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt go down unto Hades: for if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in thee, it would have remained until this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, Cafarnaum, que estás exaltada até o céu, ao Xeol serás derrubada! Pois se em Sodoma tivessem sido feitos os milagres que foram feitos em ti, ela teria permanecido até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Capernaum, que eres levantada hasta el cielo, hasta los infiernos serás abajada; porque si en los de Sodoma fueran hechas las maravillas que han sido hechas en ti, hubieran quedado hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.WEB: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”
verses.ASV: But I say unto you that it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que mais tolerável será para os da região de Sodoma, no dia de juízo, que para ti.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os digo, que á la tierra de los de Sodoma será más tolerable el castigo en el día del juicio, que á ti.

verses.KJV: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.WEB: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
verses.ASV: At that season Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes:
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo Jesus pronunciou: Graças te dou, Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra, porque escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e entendidos, e as revelaste às crianças.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo, respondiendo Jesús, dijo: Te alabo, Padre, Señor del cielo y de la tierra, que hayas escondido estas cosas de los sabios y de los entendidos, y las hayas revelado á los niños.

verses.KJV: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.WEB: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
verses.ASV: yea, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sim, Pai, porque assim foi agradável a ti.
verses.RVR09: Así, Padre, pues que así agradó en tus ojos.

verses.KJV: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
verses.WEB: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
verses.ASV: All things have been delivered unto me of my Father: and no one knoweth the Son, save the Father; neither doth any know the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son willeth to reveal [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as coisas me foram entregues pelo meu Pai; e ninguém conhece o Filho, a não ser o Pai; nem ninguém conhece o Pai, a não ser o Filho, e a quem o Filho [o] quiser revelar.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas me son entregadas de mi Padre: y nadie conoció al Hijo, sino el Padre; ni al Padre conoció alguno, sino el Hijo, y aquel á quien el Hijo lo quisiere revelar.

verses.KJV: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.WEB: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
verses.ASV: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde a mim todos vós que estais cansados e sobrecarregados, e eu vos farei descansar.
verses.RVR09: Venid á mí todos los que estáis trabajados y cargados, que yo os haré descansar.

verses.KJV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.WEB: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.ASV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai sobre vós o meu jugo e aprendei de mim, porque sou manso e humilde de coração; e encontrareis descanso para as vossas almas.
verses.RVR09: Llevad mi yugo sobre vosotros, y aprended de mí, que soy manso y humilde de corazón; y hallaréis descanso para vuestras almas.

verses.KJV: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.WEB: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
verses.ASV: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o meu jugo é suave, e minha carga é leve.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi yugo es fácil, y ligera mi carga.

verses.KJV: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.
verses.WEB: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verses.ASV: At that season Jesus went on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples were hungry and began to pluck ears and to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo Jesus estava indo pelas plantações de cereais no sábado. Seus discípulos tinham fome, e começaram a arrancar espigas e a comer.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo iba Jesús por los sembrados en sábado; y sus discípulos tenían hambre, y comenzaron á coger espigas, y á comer.

verses.KJV: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do upon the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os fariseus viram, disseram-lhe: Eis que os teus discípulos fazem o que não é lícito fazer no sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y viéndolo los Fariseos, le dijeron: He aquí tus discípulos hacen lo que no es lícito hacer en sábado.

verses.KJV: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
verses.ASV: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, and they that were with him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não lestes o que Davi fez quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam,
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿No habéis leído qué hizo David, teniendo él hambre y los que con él estaban:

verses.KJV: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.WEB: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.ASV: how he entered into the house of God, and ate the showbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them that were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como ele entrou na casa de Deus, e comeu os pães da proposição, que a ele não era lícito comer, nem também aos que com ele estavam, a não ser somente aos sacerdotes?
verses.RVR09: Cómo entró en la casa de Dios, y comió los panes de la proposición, que no le era lícito comer, ni á los que estaban con él, sino á solos los sacerdotes?

verses.KJV: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.WEB: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
verses.ASV: Or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are guiltless?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou não lestes na Lei que, nos sábados, os sacerdotes no Templo profanam o sábado, sem se tornarem culpados?
verses.RVR09: O ¿no habéis leído en la ley, que los sábados en el templo los sacerdotes profanan el sábado, y son sin culpa?

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.WEB: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
verses.ASV: But I say unto you, that one greater than the temple is here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, vos digo que o maior que o Templo está aqui.
verses.RVR09: Pues os digo que uno mayor que el templo está aquí.

verses.KJV: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.WEB: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
verses.ASV: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se vós soubésseis o que significa: ‘Quero misericórdia, e não sacrifício’, não condenaríeis os inocentes.
verses.RVR09: Mas si supieseis qué es: Misericordia quiero y no sacrificio, no condenaríais á los inocentes:

verses.KJV: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: For the Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Filho do homem é Senhor até do sábado.
verses.RVR09: Porque Señor es del sábado el Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.WEB: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
verses.ASV: And he departed thence, and went into their synagogue:
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo dali, [Jesus] entrou na sinagoga deles.
verses.RVR09: Y partiéndose de allí, vino á la sinagoga de ellos.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.WEB: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
verses.ASV: and behold, a man having a withered hand. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day? that they might accuse him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que havia ali um homem que tinha uma mão definhada; e eles, a fim de o acusarem, perguntaram-lhe: É lícito curar nos sábados?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí había allí uno que tenía una mano seca: y le preguntaron, diciendo: ¿Es lícito curar en sábado? por acusarle.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What man shall there be of you, that shall have one sheep, and if this fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Qual de vós será a pessoa que, caso tenha uma ovelha, e se a tal cair em uma cova no sábado, não usará de sua força para a levantar?
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Qué hombre habrá de vosotros, que tenga una oveja, y si cayere ésta en una fosa en sábado, no le eche mano, y la levante?

verses.KJV: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.WEB: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
verses.ASV: How much then is a man of more value than a sheep! Wherefore it is lawful to do good on the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, quanto mais vale um ser humano que uma ovelha! Assim, pois, é lícito fazer o bem nos sábados.
verses.RVR09: Pues ¿cuánto más vale un hombre que una oveja? Así que, lícito es en los sábados hacer bien.

verses.KJV: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.WEB: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
verses.ASV: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, as the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse para aquele homem: Estende a tua mão. Ele a estendeu, e foi-lhe restaurada, sã como a outra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo á aquel hombre: Extiende tu mano. Y él la extendió, y fué restituída sana como la otra.

verses.KJV: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.WEB: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.ASV: But the Pharisees went out, and took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os fariseus saíram e se reuniram para planejar contra ele, como o matariam.
verses.RVR09: Y salidos los Fariseos, consultaron contra él para destruirle.

verses.KJV: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.WEB: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
verses.ASV: And Jesus perceiving [it] withdrew from thence: and many followed him; and he healed them all,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, sabendo disso, retirou-se dali. Muitas multidões o seguiram, e ele curou a todos.
verses.RVR09: Mas sabiéndolo Jesús, se apartó de allí: y le siguieron muchas gentes, y sanaba á todos.

verses.KJV: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.WEB: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
verses.ASV: and charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes ordenava que não o tornassem conhecido;
verses.RVR09: Y él les encargaba eficazmente que no le descubriesen:

verses.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta Isaías:
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese lo que estaba dicho por el profeta Isaías, que dijo:

verses.KJV: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
verses.ASV: Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; My beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit upon him, And he shall declare judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui meu servo a quem escolhi, meu amado em quem minha alma se agrada; sobre ele porei o meu Espírito, e ele anunciará justiça às nações.
verses.RVR09: He aquí mi siervo, al cual he escogido; mi Amado, en el cual se agrada mi alma: pondré mi Espíritu sobre él, y á los Gentiles anunciará juicio.

verses.KJV: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.WEB: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
verses.ASV: He shall not strive, nor cry aloud; Neither shall any one hear his voice in the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não fará brigas, nem gritará; ninguém ouvirá pelas ruas a sua voz.
verses.RVR09: No contenderá, ni voceará: ni nadie oirá en las calles su voz.

verses.KJV: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.WEB: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
verses.ASV: A bruised reed shall he not break, And smoking flax shall he not quench, Till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.ALMEIDA: A cana rachada ele não quebrará, o pavio que fumega ele não apagará, até que conduza a justiça à vitória.
verses.RVR09: La caña cascada no quebrará, y el pábilo que humea no apagará, hasta que saque á victoria el juicio.

verses.KJV: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.WEB: In his name, the nations will hope.”
verses.ASV: And in his name shall the Gentiles hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em seu nome as nações terão esperança.
verses.RVR09: Y en su nombre esperarán los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.WEB: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
verses.ASV: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the dumb man spake and saw.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe trouxeram um endemoninhado cego e mudo; e ele o curou de tal maneira que o cego e mudo passou a falar e a ver.
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué traído á él un endemoniado, ciego y mudo, y le sanó; de tal manera, que el ciego y mudo hablaba y veía.

verses.KJV: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.WEB: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
verses.ASV: And all the multitudes were amazed, and said, Can this be the son of David?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as multidões se admiravam e diziam: Não é este o Filho de Davi?
verses.RVR09: Y todas las gentes estaban atónitas, y decían: ¿Será éste aquel Hijo de David?

verses.KJV: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.WEB: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
verses.ASV: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando os fariseus ouviam isso, diziam: Ele não expulsa os demônios, a não ser por Belzebu, o chefe dos demônios.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Fariseos, oyéndolo, decían: Este no echa fuera los demonios, sino por Beelzebub, príncipe de los demonios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.WEB: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
verses.ASV: And knowing their thoughts he said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus, entendendo os pensamentos deles, disse-lhes: Todo reino dividido contra si mesmo é destruído; e toda cidade ou casa dividida contra si mesma não permanecerá.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, como sabía los pensamientos de ellos, les dijo: Todo reino dividido contra sí mismo, es desolado; y toda ciudad ó casa dividida contra sí misma, no permanecerá.

verses.KJV: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.WEB: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
verses.ASV: and if Satan casteth out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se Satanás expulsa a Satanás, contra si mesmo está dividido; como, pois, permanecerá o seu reino?
verses.RVR09: Y si Satanás echa fuera á Satanás, contra sí mismo está dividido; ¿cómo, pues, permanecerá su reino?

verses.KJV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.WEB: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
verses.ASV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, então por quem vossos filhos os expulsam? Portanto, eles mesmos serão vossos juízes.
verses.RVR09: Y si yo por Beelzebub echo fuera los demonios, ¿vuestros hijos por quién los echan? Por tanto, ellos serán vuestros jueces.

verses.KJV: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.WEB: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
verses.ASV: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se eu pelo Espírito de Deus expulso os demônios, logo o Reino de Deus já chegou sobre vos.
verses.RVR09: Y si por espíritu de Dios yo echo fuera los demonios, ciertamente ha llegado á vosotros el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.WEB: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
verses.ASV: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong [man], and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong [man]? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou como pode alguém entrar na casa do valente, e saquear seus bens, sem primeiro amarrar ao valente? Depois disso saqueará sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Porque, ¿cómo puede alguno entrar en la casa del valiente, y saquear sus alhajas, si primero no prendiere al valiente? y entonces saqueará su casa.

verses.KJV: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.WEB: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
verses.ASV: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem não é comigo é contra mim; e quem não ajunta comigo, espalha.
verses.RVR09: El que no es conmigo, contra mí es; y el que conmigo no recoge, derrama.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.WEB: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
verses.ASV: Therefore I say unto you, Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men; but the blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu vos digo: todo pecado e blasfêmia serão perdoados aos seres humanos; mas a blasfêmia contra o Espírito não será perdoada aos seres humanos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os digo: Todo pecado y blasfemia será perdonado á los hombres: mas la blasfemia contra el Espíritu no será perdonada á los hombres.

verses.KJV: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.WEB: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.
verses.ASV: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him; but whosoever shall speak against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, nor in that which is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que falar palavra contra o Filho do homem lhe será perdoado; mas qualquer um que falar contra o Espírito Santo, não lhe será perdoado, nem na era presente, nem na futura.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que hablare contra el Hijo del hombre, le será perdonado: mas cualquiera que hablare contra el Espíritu Santo, no le será perdonado, ni en este siglo, ni en el venidero.

verses.KJV: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.WEB: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
verses.ASV: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou fazei a árvore boa, e seu fruto bom; ou fazei a árvore má, e seu fruto mau; pois pelo fruto se conhece a árvore.
verses.RVR09: O haced el árbol bueno, y su fruto bueno, ó haced el árbol corrompido, y su fruto dañado; porque por el fruto es conocido el árbol.

verses.KJV: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.WEB: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
verses.ASV: Ye offspring of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninhada de víboras, como podeis vós falar boas coisas, sendo maus? Pois a boca fala do que o coração tem em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Generación de víboras, ¿cómo podéis hablar bien, siendo malos? porque de la abundancia del corazón habla la boca.

verses.KJV: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.WEB: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
verses.ASV: The good man out of his good treasure bringeth forth good things: and the evil man out of his evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.ALMEIDA: A pessoa boa tira coisas boas do bom tesouro do coração, e a pessoa má tira coisas más do tesouro mau.
verses.RVR09: El hombre bueno del buen tesoro del corazón saca buenas cosas: y el hombre malo del mal tesoro saca malas cosas.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.WEB: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, that every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, vos digo que de toda palavra imprudente que as pessoas falarem, dela prestarão contas no dia do juízo.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os digo, que toda palabra ociosa que hablaren los hombres, de ella darán cuenta en el día del juicio.

verses.KJV: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.WEB: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
verses.ASV: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque por tuas palavras serás justificado, e por tuas palavras serás condenado.
verses.RVR09: Porque por tus palabras serás justificado, y por tus palabras serás condenado.

verses.KJV: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.WEB: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
verses.ASV: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying, Teacher, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então responderam uns dos escribas e dos fariseus, dizendo: Mestre, queremos ver de ti algum sinal.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondieron algunos de los escribas y de los Fariseos, diciendo: Maestro, deseamos ver de ti señal.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.WEB: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes deu a seguinte resposta: Uma geração má e adúltera pede sinal; mas não lhe será dado, exceto o sinal do profeta Jonas.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió, y les dijo: La generación mala y adulterina demanda señal; mas señal no le será dada, sino la señal de Jonás profeta.

verses.KJV: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.WEB: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.ASV: for as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como Jonas esteve três dias e três noites no ventre da baleia, assim também o Filho do homem estará três dias e três noites no coração da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque como estuvo Jonás en el vientre de la ballena tres días y tres noches, así estará el Hijo del hombre en el corazón de la tierra tres días y tres noches.

verses.KJV: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.WEB: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
