verses.ASV: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os de Nínive se levantarão no Juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão; porque se arrependeram com a pregação de Jonas. E eis aqui quem é maior que Jonas.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres de Nínive se levantarán en el juicio con esta generación, y la condenarán; porque ellos se arrepintieron á la predicación de Jonás; y he aquí más que Jonás en este lugar.

verses.KJV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.WEB: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
verses.ASV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.ALMEIDA: A rainha do sul se levantará no Juízo com esta geração, e a condenará; porque veio dos confins da terra para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão. E eis aqui quem é maior que Salomão.
verses.RVR09: La reina del Austro se levantará en el juicio con esta generación, y la condenará; porque vino de los fines de la tierra para oir la sabiduría de Salomón: y he aquí más que Salomón en este lugar.

verses.KJV: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.WEB: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
verses.ASV: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and findeth it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o espírito imundo sai de alguém, anda por lugares secos buscando repouso, e não o acha.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el espíritu inmundo ha salido del hombre, anda por lugares secos, buscando reposo, y no lo halla.

verses.KJV: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.WEB: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
verses.ASV: Then he saith, I will return into my house whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então diz: ‘Voltarei para a minha casa, de onde saí.’ E quando chega, a encontra desocupada, varrida, e arrumada.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dice: Me volveré á mi casa de donde salí: y cuando viene, la halla desocupada, barrida y adornada.

verses.KJV: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.WEB: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
verses.ASV: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this evil generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vai, e toma consigo outros sete espíritos piores que ele; eles entram, e moram ali; e a última [condição] de tal pessoa se torna pior que a primeira. Assim também acontecerá com esta geração má.
verses.RVR09: Entonces va, y toma consigo otros siete espíritus peores que él, y entrados, moran allí; y son peores las cosas últimas del tal hombre que las primeras: así también acontecerá á esta generación mala.

verses.KJV: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.WEB: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, seeking to speak to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ele ainda estava falando às multidões, eis que sua mãe e seus irmãos estavam fora, querendo falar com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y estando él aún hablando á las gentes, he aquí su madre y sus hermanos estaban fuera, que le querían hablar.

verses.KJV: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.WEB: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
verses.ASV: And one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, seeking to speak to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguém lhe disse: Eis que tua mãe e teus irmãos estão fora, querendo falar contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo uno: He aquí tu madre y tus hermanos están fuera, que te quieren hablar.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.WEB: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele disse em resposta ao que o avisou: Quem é minha mãe? E quem são meus irmãos?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él al que le decía esto, dijo: ¿Quién es mi madre y quiénes son mis hermanos?

verses.KJV: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.WEB: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
verses.ASV: And he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
verses.ALMEIDA: Então estendeu sua mão para os seus discípulos, e disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos;
verses.RVR09: Y extendiendo su mano hacia sus discípulos, dijo: He aquí mi madre y mis hermanos.

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.WEB: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qualquer um que fizer a vontade do meu Pai, que está nos céus, esse é meu irmão, e irmã, e mãe.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo aquel que hiciere la voluntad de mi Padre que está en los cielos, ese es mi hermano, y hermana, y madre.

verses.KJV: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.WEB: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
verses.ASV: On that day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, Jesus saiu de casa e se sentou junto ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y AQUEL día, saliendo Jesús de casa, se sentó junto á la mar.

verses.KJV: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.WEB: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
verses.ASV: And there were gathered unto him great multitudes, so that he entered into a boat, and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ajuntaram-se perto dele tantas multidões, de maneira que ele entrou num barco e se sentou; e toda a multidão ficou na praia,
verses.RVR09: Y se allegaron á él muchas gentes; y entrándose él en el barco, se sentó, y toda la gente estaba á la ribera.

verses.KJV: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.WEB: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
verses.ASV: And he spake to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, the sower went forth to sow;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes falou muitas coisas por parábolas. Ele disse: Eis que o semeador saiu a semear.
verses.RVR09: Y les habló muchas cosas por parábolas, diciendo: He aquí el que sembraba salió á sembrar.

verses.KJV: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.WEB: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.ASV: and as he sowed, some [seeds] fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto semeava, caiu parte [das sementes] junto ao caminho, e vieram as aves e a comeram.
verses.RVR09: Y sembrando, parte de la simiente cayó junto al camino; y vinieron las aves, y la comieron.

verses.KJV: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.WEB: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
verses.ASV: and others fell upon the rocky places, where they had not much earth: and straightway they sprang up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu entre pedras, onde não havia muita terra, e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra funda.
verses.RVR09: Y parte cayó en pedregales, donde no tenía mucha tierra; y nació luego, porque no tenía profundidad de tierra:

verses.KJV: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.WEB: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.ASV: and when the sun was risen, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o sol surgiu, queimou-se; e por não ter raiz, secou-se.
verses.RVR09: Mas en saliendo el sol, se quemó; y secóse, porque no tenía raíz.

verses.KJV: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.WEB: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
verses.ASV: And others fell upon the thorns; and the thorns grew up and choked them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu entre espinhos, e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram.
verses.RVR09: Y parte cayó en espinas; y las espinas crecieron, y la ahogaron.

verses.KJV: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.WEB: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
verses.ASV: and others fell upon the good ground, and yielded fruit, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu em boa terra, e rendeu fruto: um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.
verses.RVR09: Y parte cayó en buena tierra, y dió fruto, cuál á ciento, cuál á sesenta, y cuál á treinta.

verses.KJV: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.ASV: He that hath ears, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Quien tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.WEB: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
verses.ASV: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os discípulos se aproximaram, e lhe perguntaram: Por que falas a eles por parábolas?
verses.RVR09: Entonces, llegándose los discípulos, le dijeron: ¿Por qué les hablas por parábolas?

verses.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Porque a vós é dado saber os mistérios do Reino dos céus, mas a eles não é dado.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, les dijo: Por que á vosotros es concedido saber los misterios del reino de los cielos; mas á ellos no es concedido.

verses.KJV: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.WEB: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
verses.ASV: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a quem tem, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; mas a quem não tem, até aquilo que tem lhe será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Porque á cualquiera que tiene, se le dará, y tendrá más; pero al que no tiene, aun lo que tiene le será quitado.

verses.KJV: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.WEB: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
verses.ASV: Therefore speak I to them in parables; because seeing they see not, and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso falo a eles por parábolas; porque vendo, não veem; e ouvindo, não ouvem, nem entendem.
verses.RVR09: Por eso les hablo por parábolas; porque viendo no ven, y oyendo no oyen, ni entienden.

verses.KJV: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.WEB: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;
verses.ASV: And unto them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall in no wise understand; And seeing ye shall see, and shall in no wise perceive:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim neles se cumpre a profecia de Isaías, que diz: De fato ouvireis, mas não entendereis; De fato vereis, mas não percebereis.
verses.RVR09: De manera que se cumple en ellos la profecía de Isaías, que dice: De oído oiréis, y no entenderéis; y viendo veréis, y no miraréis.

verses.KJV: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.WEB: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
verses.ASV: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, And their ears are dull of hearing, And their eyes they have closed; Lest haply they should perceive with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And should turn again, And I should heal them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o coração deste povo está insensível; Com seus ouvidos dificilmente ouvem, e seus olhos fecharam; A fim de não haver que seus olhos vejam, seus ouvidos ouçam, Seus corações entendam, e se arrependam, E eu os cure.
verses.RVR09: Porque el corazón de este pueblo está engrosado, y de los oídos oyen pesadamente, y de sus ojos guiñan: para que no vean de los ojos, y oigan de los oídos, y del corazón entiendan, y se conviertan, y yo los sane.

verses.KJV: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.WEB: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
verses.ASV: But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas benditos são os vossos olhos, porque veem; e os vossos ouvidos, porque ouvem.
verses.RVR09: Mas bienaventurados vuestros ojos, porque ven; y vuestros oídos, porque oyen.

verses.KJV: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.WEB: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
verses.ASV: For verily I say unto you, that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois em verdade vos digo que muitos profetas e justos desejaram ver o que vós vedes, mas não viram; e [desejaram] ouvir o que vós ouvis, mas não ouviram.
verses.RVR09: Porque de cierto os digo, que muchos profetas y justos desearon ver lo que veis, y no lo vieron: y oir lo que oís, y no lo oyeron.

verses.KJV: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.WEB: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
verses.ASV: Hear then ye the parable of the sower.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ouvi vós a parábola do semeador:
verses.RVR09: Oid, pues, vosotros la parábola del que siembra:

verses.KJV: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.WEB: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
verses.ASV: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, [then] cometh the evil [one], and snatcheth away that which hath been sown in his heart. This is he that was sown by the way side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando alguém ouve a palavra do Reino e não a entende, o maligno vem e arranca o que foi semeado em seu coração; este é o que foi semeado junto ao caminho.
verses.RVR09: Oyendo cualquiera la palabra del reino, y no entendiéndola, viene el malo, y arrebata lo que fué sembrado en su corazón: éste es el que fué sembrado junto al camino.

verses.KJV: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.WEB: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
verses.ASV: And he that was sown upon the rocky places, this is he that heareth the word, and straightway with joy receiveth it;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que foi semeado entre as pedras é o que ouve a palavra, e logo a recebe com alegria,
verses.RVR09: Y el que fué sembrado en pedregales, éste es el que oye la palabra, y luego la recibe con gozo.

verses.KJV: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.WEB: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
verses.ASV: yet hath he not root in himself, but endureth for a while; and when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway he stumbleth.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas não tem raiz em si mesmo. Em vez disso, dura um pouco, mas quando vem a aflição ou a perseguição pela palavra, logo tropeça na fé.
verses.RVR09: Mas no tiene raíz en sí, antes es temporal: que venida la aflicción ó la persecución por la palabra, luego se ofende.

verses.KJV: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.WEB: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.ASV: And he that was sown among the thorns, this is he that heareth the word; and the care of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que foi semeado entre os espinhos é o que ouve a palavra, mas a ansiedade com o tempo presente e a sedução das riquezas sufocam a palavra, e fica sem dar fruto.
verses.RVR09: Y el que fué sembrado en espinas, éste es el que oye la palabra; pero el afán de este siglo y el engaño de las riquezas, ahogan la palabra, y hácese infructuosa.

verses.KJV: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.WEB: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
verses.ASV: And he that was sown upon the good ground, this is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; who verily beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que foi semeado em boa terra, este é o que ouve e entende a palavra, e o que dá e produz fruto, um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que fué sembrado en buena tierra, éste es el que oye y entiende la palabra, y el que lleva fruto: y lleva uno á ciento, y otro á sesenta, y otro á treinta.

verses.KJV: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.WEB: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
verses.ASV: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man that sowed good seed in his field:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes declarou outra parábola, dizendo: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem que semeia boa semente em seu campo,
verses.RVR09: Otra parábola les propuso, diciendo: El reino de los cielos es semejante al hombre que siembra buena simiente en su campo:

verses.KJV: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.WEB: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
verses.ASV: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares also among the wheat, and went away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, enquanto as pessoas dormiam, o inimigo dele veio, semeou joio entre o trigo, e foi embora.
verses.RVR09: Mas durmiendo los hombres, vino su enemigo, y sembró cizaña entre el trigo, y se fué.

verses.KJV: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.WEB: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
verses.ASV: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, quando a erva cresceu e produziu fruto, então apareceu também o joio.
verses.RVR09: Y como la hierba salió é hizo fruto, entonces apareció también la cizaña.

verses.KJV: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.WEB: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
verses.ASV: And the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? whence then hath it tares?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os servos do dono da propriedade chegaram, e lhe perguntaram: “Senhor, não semeaste boa semente no teu campo? De onde, pois, veio o joio?”
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose los siervos del padre de la familia, le dijeron: Señor, ¿no sembraste buena simiente en tu campo? ¿de dónde, pues, tiene cizaña?

verses.KJV: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.WEB: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, An enemy hath done this. And the servants say unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: “Um inimigo fez isto”. Em seguida, os servos lhe perguntaram: “Queres, pois, que vamos e o tiremos?”
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Un hombre enemigo ha hecho esto. Y los siervos le dijeron: ¿Quieres, pues, que vayamos y la cojamos?

verses.KJV: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.WEB: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
verses.ASV: But he saith, Nay; lest haply while ye gather up the tares, ye root up the wheat with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, porém, lhes respondeu: “Não, para não haver que, enquanto tirais o joio, arranqueis com ele também o trigo.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: No; porque cogiendo la cizaña, no arranquéis también con ella el trigo.

verses.KJV: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.WEB: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
verses.ASV: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather up first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixai-os crescer ambos juntos até a colheita; e no tempo da colheita direi aos que colhem: ‘Recolhei primeiro o joio, e amarrai-o em molhos, para o queimarem; mas ao trigo ajuntai no meu celeiro’.”
verses.RVR09: Dejad crecer juntamente lo uno y lo otro hasta la siega; y al tiempo de la siega yo diré á los segadores: Coged primero la cizaña, y atadla en manojos para quemarla; mas recoged el trigo en mi alfolí.

verses.KJV: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.WEB: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,
verses.ASV: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes propôs outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um grão de mostarda que alguém tomou e semeou no seu campo.
verses.RVR09: Otra parábola les propuso, diciendo: El reino de los cielos es semejante al grano de mostaza, que tomándolo alguno lo sembró en su campo:

verses.KJV: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.WEB: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
verses.ASV: which indeed is less than all seeds; but when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the heaven come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato, dentre todas as sementes, esta é a menor. Mas quando cresce, é a maior das hortaliças; e se torna [tamanha] árvore, que as aves do céu vêm e se aninham em seus ramos.
verses.RVR09: El cual á la verdad es la más pequeña de todas las simientes; mas cuando ha crecido, es la mayor de las hortalizas, y se hace árbol, que vienen las aves del cielo y hacen nidos en sus ramas.

verses.KJV: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.WEB: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
verses.ASV: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes disse outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante ao fermento que uma mulher tomou e misturou em três medidas de farinha, até que tudo ficasse fermentado.
verses.RVR09: Otra parábola les dijo: El reino de los cielos es semejante á la levadura que tomó una mujer, y escondió en tres medidas de harina, hasta que todo quedó leudo.

verses.KJV: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.WEB: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
verses.ASV: All these things spake Jesus in parables unto the multitudes; and without a parable spake he nothing unto them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto Jesus falou por parábolas às multidões. Sem parábolas ele não lhes falava,
verses.RVR09: Todo esto habló Jesús por parábolas á las gentes, y sin parábolas no les hablaba:

verses.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
verses.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que se cumprisse o que foi falado pelo profeta, que disse: Abrirei a minha boca em parábolas; Pronunciarei coisas escondidas desde a fundação do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el profeta, que dijo: Abriré en parábolas mi boca; rebosaré cosas escondidas desde la fundación del mundo.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
verses.ASV: Then he left the multitudes, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Explain unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus despediu as multidões, e foi para casa. Seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: Explica-nos a parábola do joio do campo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, despedidas las gentes, Jesús se vino á casa; y llegándose á él sus discípulos, le dijeron: Decláranos la parábola de la cizaña del campo.

verses.KJV: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.WEB: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: O que semeia a boa semente é o Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: El que siembra la buena simiente es el Hijo del hombre;

verses.KJV: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.WEB: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
verses.ASV: and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the tares are the sons of the evil [one];
verses.ALMEIDA: E o campo é o mundo; e a boa semente, estes são os filhos do Reino; e o joio são os filhos do maligno.
verses.RVR09: Y el campo es el mundo; y la buena simiente son los hijos del reino, y la cizaña son los hijos del malo;

verses.KJV: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.WEB: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
verses.ASV: and the enemy that sowed them is the devil: and the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are angels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o inimigo, que o semeou, é o diabo; e a colheita é o fim da era; e os que colhem são os anjos.
verses.RVR09: Y el enemigo que la sembró, es el diablo; y la siega es el fin del mundo, y los segadores son los ángeles.

verses.KJV: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.WEB: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
verses.ASV: As therefore the tares are gathered up and burned with fire; so shall it be in the end of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, como o joio é colhido e queimado no fogo, assim também será no fim desta era.
verses.RVR09: De manera que como es cogida la cizaña, y quemada al fuego, así será en el fin de este siglo.

verses.KJV: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.WEB: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,
verses.ASV: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and them that do iniquity,
verses.ALMEIDA: O Filho do homem enviará seus anjos, e eles recolherão do seu Reino todas as causas do pecado, assim como os que praticam injustiça,
verses.RVR09: Enviará el Hijo del hombre sus ángeles, y cogerán de su reino todos los escándalos, y los que hacen iniquidad,

verses.KJV: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.ASV: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.
verses.RVR09: Y los echarán en el horno de fuego: allí será el lloro y el crujir de dientes.

verses.KJV: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ASV: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He that hath ears, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os justos brilharão como o sol, no Reino de seu Pai. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los justos resplandecerán como el sol en el reino de su Padre: el que tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
verses.ASV: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in the field; which a man found, and hid; and in his joy he goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a um tesouro escondido num campo, que um homem, depois de achá-lo, escondeu. Então, em sua alegria, vai, vende tudo quanto tem, e compra aquele campo.
verses.RVR09: Además, el reino de los cielos es semejante al tesoro escondido en el campo; el cual hallado, el hombre lo encubre, y de gozo de ello va, y vende todo lo que tiene, y compra aquel campo.

verses.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
verses.ASV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a merchant seeking goodly pearls:
verses.ALMEIDA: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a um homem negociante, que buscava boas pérolas.
verses.RVR09: También el reino de los cielos es semejante al hombre tratante, que busca buenas perlas;

verses.KJV: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.WEB: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
verses.ASV: and having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando este achou uma pérola de grande valor, foi, vendeu tudo quanto tinha, e a comprou.
verses.RVR09: Que hallando una preciosa perla, fué y vendió todo lo que tenía, y la compró.

verses.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
verses.ASV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.ALMEIDA: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a uma rede lançada ao mar, que colhe toda espécie [de peixes] .
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el reino de los cielos es semejante á la red, que echada en la mar, coge de todas suertes de peces:

verses.KJV: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.WEB: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
verses.ASV: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach; and they sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but the bad they cast away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando está cheia, [os pescadores] puxam-na à praia, sentam-se, e recolhem os bons em cestos, mas os ruins lançam fora.
verses.RVR09: La cual estando llena, la sacaron á la orilla; y sentados, cogieron lo bueno en vasos, y lo malo echaron fuera.

verses.KJV: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.WEB: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
verses.ASV: So shall it be in the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the righteous,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim será ao fim da era; os anjos sairão, e separarão dentre os justos os maus,
verses.RVR09: Así será al fin del siglo: saldrán los ángeles, y apartarán á los malos de entre los justos,

verses.KJV: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
verses.ASV: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.
verses.RVR09: Y los echarán en el horno del fuego: allí será el lloro y el crujir de dientes.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.ASV: Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes perguntou: Entendestes todas estas coisas?Eles lhe responderam: Sim, Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: ¿Habéis entendido todas estas cosas? Ellos responden: Sí, Señor.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Therefore every scribe who hath been made a disciple to the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a householder, who bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Portanto todo escriba que se tornou discípulo no Reino dos céus é semelhante a um chefe de casa, que do seu tesouro tira coisas novas e velhas.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Por eso todo escriba docto en el reino de los cielos, es semejante á un padre de familia, que saca de su tesoro cosas nuevas y cosas viejas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.WEB: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou essas parábolas, retirou-se dali.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que acabando Jesús estas parábolas, pasó de allí.

verses.KJV: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.WEB: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
verses.ASV: And coming into his own country he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo à sua terra, ensinava-os na sinagoga deles, de tal maneira que ficavam admirados, e diziam: De onde [vêm] a este tal sabedoria, e os milagres?
verses.RVR09: Y venido á su tierra, les enseñaba en la sinagoga de ellos, de tal manera que ellos estaban atónitos, y decían: ¿De dónde tiene éste esta sabiduría, y estas maravillas?

verses.KJV: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.WEB: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
verses.ASV: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joseph, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é este o filho do carpinteiro? E não se chama sua mãe Maria, e seus irmãos Tiago, José, Simão, e Judas?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es éste el hijo del carpintero? ¿no se llama su madre María, y sus hermanos Jacobo y José, y Simón, y Judas?

verses.KJV: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.WEB: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
verses.ASV: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não estão todas as suas irmãs conosco? Ora, de onde [vem] a este tudo isto?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y no están todas sus hermanas con nosotros? ¿De dónde, pues, tiene éste todas estas cosas?

verses.KJV: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.WEB: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
verses.ASV: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ofenderam-se por causa dele. Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não há profeta sem honra, a não ser em sua terra, e em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y se escandalizaban en él. Mas Jesús les dijo: No hay profeta sin honra sino en su tierra y en su casa.

verses.KJV: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.WEB: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.ASV: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não fez ali muitos milagres por causa da incredulidade deles.
verses.RVR09: Y no hizo allí muchas maravillas, á causa de la incredulidad de ellos.

verses.KJV: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
verses.WEB: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
verses.ASV: At that season Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo Herodes, o tetrarca, ouviu relato a respeito de Jesus,
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo Herodes el tetrarca oyó la fama de Jesús,

verses.KJV: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.WEB: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
verses.ASV: and said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore do these powers work in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: e disse aos seus servos: Este é João Batista; ele ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso os milagres operam nele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á sus criados: Este es Juan el Bautista: él ha resucitado de los muertos, y por eso virtudes obran en él.

verses.KJV: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
verses.WEB: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.ASV: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Herodes havia prendido a João, acorrentado-o, e posto na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe;
verses.RVR09: Porque Herodes había prendido á Juan, y le había aprisionado y puesto en la cárcel, por causa de Herodías, mujer de Felipe su hermano;

verses.KJV: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.WEB: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
verses.ASV: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois João lhe dizia: Não te lícito que a tenhas.
verses.RVR09: Porque Juan le decía: No te es lícito tenerla.

verses.KJV: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.WEB: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.ASV: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Herodes] queria matá-lo, mas tinha medo do povo, pois o consideravam profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y quería matarle, mas temía al pueblo; porque le tenían como á profeta.

verses.KJV: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.WEB: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
verses.ASV: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced in the midst, and pleased Herod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, enquanto era celebrado o aniversário de Herodes, a filha de Herodias dançou no meio [das pessoas] , e agradou a Herodes.
verses.RVR09: Mas celebrándose el día del nacimiento de Herodes, la hija de Herodías danzó en medio, y agradó á Herodes.

verses.KJV: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.WEB: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
verses.ASV: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she should ask.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso prometeu a ela dar tudo o que pedisse.
verses.RVR09: Y prometió él con juramento de darle todo lo que pidiese.

verses.KJV: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
verses.WEB: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
verses.ASV: And she, being put forward by her mother, saith, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela, tendo sido induzida por sua mãe, disse: Dá-me aqui num prato a cabeça de João Batista.
verses.RVR09: Y ella, instruída primero de su madre, dijo: Dame aquí en un plato la cabeza de Juan el Bautista.

verses.KJV: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
verses.WEB: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
verses.ASV: And the king was grieved; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat with him, he commanded it to be given;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei se entristeceu; mas devido ao juramento, e aos que estavam presentes, ordenou que isso fosse concedido.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey se entristeció; mas por el juramento, y por los que estaban juntamente á la mesa, mandó que se le diese.

verses.KJV: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.WEB: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.ASV: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então mandou degolarem João na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Y enviando, degolló á Juan en la cárcel.

verses.KJV: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.WEB: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
verses.ASV: And his head was brought on a platter, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua cabeça foi trazida num prato, e dada à garota, e ela a levou à sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Y fué traída su cabeza en un plato, y dada á la muchacha; y ella la presentó á su madre.

verses.KJV: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.WEB: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
verses.ASV: And his disciples came, and took up the corpse, and buried him; and they went and told Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus discípulos vieram, tomaram o corpo, e o enterraram; e foram avisar a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegaron sus discípulos, y tomaron el cuerpo, y lo enterraron; y fueron, y dieron las nuevas á Jesús.

verses.KJV: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.WEB: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
verses.ASV: Now when Jesus heard [it], he withdrew from thence in a boat, to a desert place apart: and when the multitudes heard [thereof], they followed him on foot from the cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de Jesus ouvir, retirou-se dali num barco, a um lugar deserto, sozinho; mas assim que as multidões ouviram acerca disso, seguiram-no a pé das cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Jesús, se apartó de allí en un barco á un lugar descierto, apartado: y cuando las gentes lo oyeron, le siguieron á pie de las ciudades.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.WEB: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
verses.ASV: And he came forth, and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus saiu, viu uma grande multidão. Ele se compadeceu deles, e curou dentre eles os enfermos.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo Jesús, vió un gran gentío, y tuvo compasión de ellos, y sanó á los que de ellos había enfermos.

verses.KJV: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.WEB: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
verses.ASV: And when even was come, the disciples came to him, saying, The place is desert, and the time is already past; send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando o entardecer, os seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: O lugar é deserto, e já é tarde. Despede as multidões, para irem às aldeias, e comprarem para si de comer.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fué la tarde del día, se llegaron á él sus discípulos, diciendo: El lugar es desierto, y el tiempo es ya pasado: despide las gentes, para que se vayan por las aldeas, y compren para sí de comer.

verses.KJV: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus said unto them, They have no need to go away; give ye them to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus lhes respondeu: Eles não precisam ir. Vós mesmos, dai-lhes de comer.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: No tienen necesidad de irse: dadles vosotros de comer.

verses.KJV: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.WEB: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
verses.ASV: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe disseram: Nada temos aqui além de cinco pães e dois peixes.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: No tenemos aquí sino cinco panes y dos peces.

verses.KJV: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.WEB: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse: Trazei-os aqui a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Traédmelos acá.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.WEB: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
verses.ASV: And he commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mandou às multidões que se sentassem sobre a grama. Então tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, e [os] abençoou. Em seguida partiu os pães, deu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos às multidões.
verses.RVR09: Y mandando á las gentes recostarse sobre la hierba, tomando los cinco panes y los dos peces, alzando los ojos al cielo, bendijo, y partió y dió los panes á los discípulos, y los discípulos á las gentes.

verses.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.WEB: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
verses.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, twelve baskets full.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos comeram, e se fartaram. E do que sobrou dos pedaços levantaram doze cestos cheios.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron todos, y se hartaron; y alzaron lo que sobró de los pedazos, doce cestas llenas.

verses.KJV: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.WEB: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
verses.ASV: And they that did eat were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que comeram foram quase cinco mil homens, sem contar as mulheres e as crianças.
verses.RVR09: Y los que comieron fueron como cinco mil hombres, sin las mujeres y los niños.

verses.KJV: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.WEB: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.ASV: And straightway he constrained the disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side, till he should send the multitudes away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo Jesus mandou os seus discípulos entrarem no barco, e que fossem adiante dele para a outra margem, enquanto ele despedia as multidões.
verses.RVR09: Y luego Jesús hizo á sus discípulos entrar en el barco, é ir delante de él á la otra parte del lago, entre tanto que él despedía á las gentes.

verses.KJV: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.WEB: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
verses.ASV: And after he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain apart to pray: and when even was come, he was there alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de despedir as multidões, subiu ao monte, à parte, para orar. Tendo chegado a noite, ele estava ali sozinho.
verses.RVR09: Y despedidas las gentes, subió al monte, apartado, á orar: y como fué la tarde del día, estaba allí solo.

verses.KJV: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.WEB: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
verses.ASV: But the boat was now in the midst of the sea, distressed by the waves; for the wind was contrary.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o barco já estava no meio do mar, atormentado pelas ondas, porque o vento era contrário.
verses.RVR09: Y ya el barco estaba en medio de la mar, atormentado de las ondas; porque el viento era contrario.

verses.KJV: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.WEB: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
verses.ASV: And in the fourth watch of the night he came unto them, walking upon the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas à quarta vigília da noite Jesus foi até eles, andando sobre o mar.
verses.RVR09: Mas á la cuarta vela de la noche, Jesús fué á ellos andando sobre la mar.

verses.KJV: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.WEB: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
verses.ASV: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a ghost; and they cried out for fear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os discípulos o viram andar sobre o mar, apavoraram-se, dizendo: É um fantasma! E gritaram de medo.
verses.RVR09: Y los discípulos, viéndole andar sobre la mar, se turbaron, diciendo: Fantasma es. Y dieron voces de miedo.

verses.KJV: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.WEB: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
verses.ASV: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus logo lhes falou, dizendo: Tende coragem! Sou eu, não tenhais medo.
verses.RVR09: Mas luego Jesús les habló, diciendo: Confiad, yo soy; no tengáis miedo.

verses.KJV: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.WEB: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
verses.ASV: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee upon the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe respondeu, dizendo: Senhor, se és tu, manda-me vir a ti sobre as águas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le respondió Pedro, y dijo: Señor, si tú eres, manda que yo vaya á ti sobre las aguas.

verses.KJV: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.WEB: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
verses.ASV: And he said, Come. And Peter went down from the boat, and walked upon the waters to come to Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Vem. Então Pedro desceu do barco e andou sobre as águas, para vir em direção a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Ven. Y descendiendo Pedro del barco, andaba sobre las aguas para ir á Jesús.

verses.KJV: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.WEB: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
verses.ASV: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando viu o vento forte, teve medo; e começando a afundar, gritou: Senhor, salva-me!
verses.RVR09: Mas viendo el viento fuerte, tuvo miedo; y comenzándose á hundir, dió voces, diciendo: Señor, sálvame.

verses.KJV: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.WEB: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
verses.ASV: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and took hold of him, and saith unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.ALMEIDA: Imediatamente Jesus estendeu a mão, segurou-o, e disse-lhe: [Homem] de pouca fé, por que duvidaste?
verses.RVR09: Y luego Jesús, extendiendo la mano, trabó de él, y le dice: Oh hombre de poca fe, ¿por qué dudaste?

verses.KJV: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.WEB: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
verses.ASV: And when they were gone up into the boat, the wind ceased.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando subiram no barco, o vento se aquietou.
verses.RVR09: Y como ellos entraron en el barco, sosegóse el viento.

verses.KJV: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.WEB: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
verses.ASV: And they that were in the boat worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os que estavam no barco vieram e o adoraram, dizendo: Verdadeiramente tu és o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los que estaban en el barco, vinieron y le adoraron, diciendo: Verdaderamente eres Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.WEB: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
verses.ASV: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land, unto Gennesaret.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo passado para a outra margem, chegaram à terra de Genesaré.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando á la otra parte, vinieron á la tierra de Genezaret.

verses.KJV: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.WEB: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;
verses.ASV: And when the men of that place knew him, they sent into all that region round about, and brought unto him all that were sick;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os homens daquele lugar o reconheceram, deram aviso por toda aquela região em redor, e lhe trouxeram todos os que estavam enfermos.
verses.RVR09: Y como le conocieron los hombres de aquel lugar, enviaron por toda aquella tierra alrededor, y trajeron á él todos los enfermos;

verses.KJV: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.WEB: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
verses.ASV: and they besought him that they might only touch the border of his garment: and as many as touched were made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rogavam-lhe que tão somente tocassem a borda de sua roupa; e todos os que tocavam ficaram curados.
verses.RVR09: Y le rogaban que solamente tocasen el borde de su manto; y todos los que tocaron, quedaron sanos.

verses.KJV: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.WEB: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
verses.ASV: Then there come to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [alguns] escribas e fariseus de Jerusalém se aproximaram de Jesus, e perguntaram:
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES llegaron á Jesús ciertos escribas y Fariseos de Jerusalem, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.WEB: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
verses.ASV: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que os teus discípulos transgridem a tradição dos anciãos? Pois não lavam suas mãos quando comem pão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué tus discípulos traspasan la tradición de los ancianos? porque no se lavan las manos cuando comen pan.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
verses.WEB: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes respondeu: E vós, por que transgredis o mandamento de Deus por vossa tradição?
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, les dijo: ¿Por qué también vosotros traspasáis el mandamiento de Dios por vuestra tradición?

verses.KJV: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.WEB: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
verses.ASV: For God said, Honor thy father and thy mother: and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus mandou, dizendo: Honra ao teu pai e à [tua] mãe; e quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe seja sentenciado à morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios mandó, diciendo: Honra al padre y á la madre, y, El que maldijere al padre ó á la madre, muera de muerte.

verses.KJV: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
verses.WEB: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
verses.ASV: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is given [to God];
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós dizeis: “Qualquer um que disser ao pai ou à mãe: ‘Todo o proveito que terias de mim é oferta exclusiva [para Deus] ’, não [precisa] honrar seu pai ou à sua mãe”.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros decís: Cualquiera que dijere al padre ó á la madre: Es ya ofrenda mía á Dios todo aquello con que pudiera valerte;

verses.KJV: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
verses.WEB: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
verses.ASV: he shall not honor his father. And ye have made void the word of God because of your tradition.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [assim] invalidastes o mandamento de Deus por vossa tradição.
verses.RVR09: No deberá honrar á su padre ó á su madre con socorro. Así habéis invalidado el mandamiento de Dios por vuestra tradición.

verses.KJV: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.WEB: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
verses.ASV: Ye hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hipócritas! Isaías bem profetizou sobre vós, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Hipócritas, bien profetizó de vosotros Isaías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.WEB: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.ASV: This people honoreth me with their lips; But their heart is far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este povo com sua boca se aproxima de mim, e com os lábios me honra; mas o seu coração está longe de mim.
verses.RVR09: Este pueblo de labios me honra; mas su corazón lejos está de mí.

verses.KJV: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.WEB: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
verses.ASV: But in vain do they worship me, Teaching [as their] doctrines the precepts of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vão, porém, me veneram, ensinando doutrinas que são regras humanas.
verses.RVR09: Mas en vano me honran, enseñando doctrinas y mandamientos de hombres.

verses.KJV: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.WEB: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
verses.ASV: And he called to him the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim chamou a multidão para si, e disse-lhes: Ouvi e entendei.
verses.RVR09: Y llamando á sí las gentes, les dijo: Oid, y entended:

verses.KJV: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
verses.WEB: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
verses.ASV: Not that which entereth into the mouth defileth the man; but that which proceedeth out of the mouth, this defileth the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é o que entra na boca que contamina o ser humano; mas sim o que sai da boca, isso contamina o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: No lo que entra en la boca contamina al hombre; mas lo que sale de la boca, esto contamina al hombre.

verses.KJV: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.WEB: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”
verses.ASV: Then came the disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os seus discípulos aproximaram-se dele, e lhe perguntaram: Tu sabes que os fariseus se ofenderam quando ouviram essa palavra?
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegándose sus discípulos, le dijeron: ¿Sabes que los Fariseos oyendo esta palabra se ofendieron?

verses.KJV: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.WEB: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
verses.ASV: But he answered and said, Every plant which my heavenly Father planted not, shall be rooted up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele respondeu: Toda planta que meu Pai celestial não plantou será arrancada pela raiz.
verses.RVR09: Mas respondiendo él, dijo: Toda planta que no plantó mi Padre celestial, será desarraigada.

verses.KJV: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.WEB: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
verses.ASV: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixai-os, são guias cegos de cegos. E se o cego guiar [outro] cego, ambos cairão na cova.
verses.RVR09: Dejadlos: son ciegos guías de ciegos; y si el ciego guiare al ciego, ambos caerán en el hoyo.

verses.KJV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.WEB: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
verses.ASV: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe disse: Explica-nos esta parábola.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Pedro, le dijo: Decláranos esta parábola.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
verses.WEB: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
verses.ASV: And he said, Are ye also even yet without understanding?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus disse: Até vós ainda estais sem entender?
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús dijo: ¿Aun también vosotros sois sin entendimiento?

verses.KJV: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.WEB: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?
verses.ASV: Perceive ye not, that whatsoever goeth into the mouth passeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não percebeis ainda que tudo o que entra na boca vai ao ventre, mas [depois] é lançado na privada?
verses.RVR09: ¿No entendéis aún, que todo lo que entra en la boca, va al vientre, y es echado en la letrina?

verses.KJV: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.WEB: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.
verses.ASV: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém as coisas que saem da boca procedem do coração; e elas contaminam o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Mas lo que sale de la boca, del corazón sale; y esto contamina al hombre.

verses.KJV: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.WEB: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
verses.ASV: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois do coração procedem maus pensamentos, mortes, adultérios, pecados sexuais, furtos, falsos testemunhos, blasfêmias.
verses.RVR09: Porque del corazón salen los malos pensamientos, muertes, adulterios, fornicaciones, hurtos, falsos testimonios, blasfemias.

verses.KJV: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
verses.WEB: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
verses.ASV: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas são as que contaminam o ser humano; mas comer sem lavar as mãos não contamina o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas son las que contaminan al hombre: que comer con las manos por lavar no contamina al hombre.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.WEB: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, tendo Jesus partido dali, foi para as partes de Tiro e de Sidom.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo Jesús de allí, se fué á las partes de Tiro y de Sidón.

verses.KJV: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.WEB: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
verses.ASV: And behold, a Canaanitish woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uma mulher Cananeia, que tinha saído daquela região, clamou-lhe: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim! Minha filha está miseravelmente endemoninhada.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí una mujer Cananea, que había salido de aquellos términos, clamaba, diciéndole: Señor, Hijo de David, ten misericordia de mí; mi hija es malamente atormentada del demonio.

verses.KJV: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.WEB: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
verses.ASV: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele não lhe respondeu palavra. Então seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Manda-a embora, porque ela está gritando atrás de nós.
verses.RVR09: Mas él no le respondió palabra. Entonces llegándose sus discípulos, le rogaron, diciendo: Despáchala, pues da voces tras nosotros.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said, I was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Não fui enviado para ninguém além das ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, dijo: No soy enviado sino á las ovejas perdidas de la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.WEB: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
verses.ASV: But she came and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ela veio e se prostrou diante dele, dizendo: Senhor, socorre-me.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ella vino, y le adoró, diciendo: Señor, socórreme.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
verses.WEB: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread and cast it to the dogs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele respondeu: Não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, dijo: No es bien tomar el pan de los hijos, y echarlo á los perrillos.
