verses.KJV: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
verses.WEB: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
verses.ASV: But she said, Yea, Lord: for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela, porém, disse: Sim, Senhor. Porém os cachorrinhos também comem, das migalhas que caem da mesa dos seus senhores.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Sí, Señor; mas los perrillos comen de las migajas que caen de la mesa de sus señores.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
verses.ASV: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it done unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhe respondeu: Ó mulher, grande [é] a tua fé. A ti seja feito como tu queres. E desde aquela hora sua filha ficou curada.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Jesús, dijo: Oh mujer, grande es tu fe; sea hecho contigo como quieres. Y fué sana su hija desde aquella hora.

verses.KJV: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.WEB: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.
verses.ASV: And Jesus departed thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Jesus partido dali, veio ao mar da Galileia. Ele subiu a um monte, e ali se sentou.
verses.RVR09: Y partido Jesús de allí, vino junto al mar de Galilea: y subiendo al monte, se sentó allí.

verses.KJV: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
verses.WEB: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
verses.ASV: And there came unto him great multitudes, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they cast them down at his feet; and he healed them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a ele muitas multidões, que tinham consigo mancos, cegos, mudos, aleijados, e muitos outros; e os lançaram aos pés de Jesus, e ele os curou.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron á él muchas gentes, que tenían consigo cojos, ciegos, mudos, mancos, y otros muchos enfermos: y los echaron á los pies de Jesús, y los sanó:

verses.KJV: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.WEB: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb speaking, the maimed whole, and the lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta maneira, as multidões se maravilhavam quando viam os mudos falarem, os aleijados ficarem sãos, os mancos andarem, e os cegos verem; então glorificaram ao Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: De manera que se maravillaban las gentes, viendo hablar los mudos, los mancos sanos, andar los cojos, y ver los ciegos: y glorificaron al Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.WEB: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus called unto him his disciples, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat: and I would not send them away fasting, lest haply they faint on the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus chamou a si os seus discípulos, e disse: Estou compadecido com a multidão, porque já há três dias que estão comigo, e não têm o que comer. E não quero os deixar ir em jejum, para que não desmaiem no caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús llamando á sus discípulos, dijo: Tengo lástima de la gente, que ya hace tres días que perseveran conmigo, y no tienen qué comer; y enviarlos ayunos no quiero, porque no desmayen en el camino.

verses.KJV: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.WEB: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
verses.ASV: And the disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so many loaves in a desert place as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os seus discípulos lhe responderam: De onde conseguiremos tantos pães no deserto, para saciar tão grande multidão?
verses.RVR09: Entonces sus discípulos le dicen: ¿Dónde tenemos nosotros tantos panes en el desierto, que hartemos á tan gran compañía?

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes perguntou: Quantos pães tendes? E eles disseram: Sete; e uns poucos peixinhos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dice: ¿Cuántos panes tenéis? Y ellos dijeron: Siete, y unos pocos pececillos.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.WEB: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
verses.ASV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então mandou as multidões que se sentassem pelo chão.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó á las gentes que se recostasen sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.WEB: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
verses.ASV: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes; and he gave thanks and brake, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou os sete pães e os peixes, deu graças e os partiu. Em seguida, ele os deu aos seus discípulos, e os discípulos à multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando los siete panes y los peces, haciendo gracias, partió y dió á sus discípulos; y los discípulos á la gente.

verses.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
verses.WEB: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
verses.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos comeram e se saciaram; e levantaram dos pedaços que sobraram sete cestos cheios.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron todos, y se hartaron: y alzaron lo que sobró de los pedazos, siete espuertas llenas.

verses.KJV: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.WEB: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
verses.ASV: And they that did eat were four thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os que comeram quatro mil homens, sem contar as mulheres e as crianças.
verses.RVR09: Y eran los que habían comido, cuatro mil hombres, sin las mujeres y los niños.

verses.KJV: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.WEB: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
verses.ASV: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de despedir as multidões, [Jesus] entrou em um barco, e veio à região de Magdala.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, despedidas las gentes, subió en el barco: y vino á los términos de Magdalá.

verses.KJV: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and trying him asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os fariseus e os saduceus se aproximaram dele e, a fim de tentá-lo, pediram-lhe que lhes mostrasse algum sinal do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y LLEGÁNDOSE los Fariseos y los Saduceos para tentarle, le pedían que les mostrase señal del cielo.

verses.KJV: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.WEB: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, [It will be] fair weather: for the heaven is red.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes respondeu: Quando chega a tarde, dizeis: “ [Haverá] tempo bom, pois o céu está vermelho”.
verses.RVR09: Mas él respondiendo, les dijo: Cuando es la tarde del día, decís: Sereno; porque el cielo tiene arreboles.

verses.KJV: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowering. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
verses.WEB: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
verses.ASV: And in the morning, [It will be] foul weather to-day: for the heaven is red and lowering. Ye know how to discern the face of the heaven; but ye cannot [discern] the signs of the times.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela manhã: “Hoje [haverá] tempestade, pois o céu está de um vermelho sombrio”. Hipócritas! Vós bem sabeis distinguir a aparência do céu, mas os sinais dos tempos não podeis?
verses.RVR09: Y á la mañana: Hoy tempestad; porque tiene arreboles el cielo triste. Hipócritas, que sabéis hacer diferencia en la faz del cielo; ¿y en las señales de los tiempos no podéis?

verses.KJV: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.WEB: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.
verses.ASV: An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of Jonah. And he left them, and departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma geração má e adúltera pede um sinal; mas nenhum sinal lhe será dado, a não ser o sinal do profeta Jonas. Então os deixou, e foi embora.
verses.RVR09: La generación mala y adulterina demanda señal; mas señal no le será dada, sino la señal de Jonás profeta. Y dejándolos, se fué.

verses.KJV: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.WEB: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
verses.ASV: And the disciples came to the other side and forgot to take bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os seus discípulos vieram para a outra margem, esqueceram-se de tomar pão.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo sus discípulos de la otra parte del lago, se habían olvidado de tomar pan.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes disse: Ficai atentos, e tende cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e saduceus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: Mirad, y guardaos de la levadura de los Fariseos y de los Saduceos.

verses.KJV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
verses.WEB: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
verses.ASV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, We took no bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles argumentaram entre si, dizendo: É porque não tomamos pão.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos pensaban dentro de sí, diciendo: Esto dice porque no tomamos pan.

verses.KJV: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
verses.WEB: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?
verses.ASV: And Jesus perceiving it said, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have no bread?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus percebeu, e disse-lhes: Por que estais argumentando entre vós mesmos, ó [homens] de pouca fé, que não tomastes pão?
verses.RVR09: Y entendiéndolo Jesús, les dijo: ¿Por qué pensáis dentro de vosotros, hombres de poca fe, que no tomasteis pan?

verses.KJV: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.WEB: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,
verses.ASV: Do ye not yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda não entendeis, nem vos lembrais dos cinco pães dos cinco mil, e quantos cestos levantastes?
verses.RVR09: ¿No entendéis aún, ni os acordáis de los cinco panes entre cinco mil hombres, y cuántos cestos alzasteis?

verses.KJV: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.WEB: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
verses.ASV: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem dos sete pães dos quatro mil, e quantos cestos levantastes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Ni de los siete panes entre cuatro mil, y cuántas espuertas tomasteis?

verses.KJV: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.WEB: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
verses.ASV: How is it that ye do not perceive that I spake not to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como não entendeis que não foi pelo pão que eu vos disse para tomardes cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e saduceus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo es que no entendéis que no por el pan os dije, que os guardaseis de la levadura de los Fariseos y de los Saduceos?

verses.KJV: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.WEB: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.ASV: Then understood they that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entenderam que ele não havia dito que tomassem cuidado com o fermento de pão, mas sim, com a doutrina dos fariseus e saduceus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces entendieron que no les había dicho que se guardasen de la levadura de pan, sino de la doctrina de los Fariseos y de los Saduceos.

verses.KJV: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
verses.WEB: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
verses.ASV: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that the Son of man is?
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Jesus vindo às partes da Cesareia de Filipe, perguntou aos seus discípulos: Quem as pessoas dizem que eu, o Filho do homem, sou?
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo Jesús á las partes de Cesarea de Filipo, preguntó á sus discípulos, diciendo: ¿Quién dicen los hombres que es el Hijo del hombre?

verses.KJV: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.WEB: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Some [say] John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Alguns João Batista, outros Elias, e outros Jeremias ou algum dos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: Unos, Juan el Bautista; y otros, Elías; y otros, Jeremías, ó alguno de los profetas.

verses.KJV: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
verses.ASV: He saith unto them, But who say ye that I am?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes disse: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou?
verses.RVR09: El les dice: Y vosotros, ¿quién decís que soy?

verses.KJV: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.ASV: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simão Pedro respondeu: Tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivo!
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Simón Pedro, dijo: Tú eres el Cristo, el Hijo del Dios viviente.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-Jonah: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe replicou: Bendito és tu, Simão, filho de Jonas; pois não foi carne e sangue que o revelou a ti, mas sim meu Pai, que [está] nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, respondiendo Jesús, le dijo: Bienaventurado eres, Simón, hijo de Jonás; porque no te lo reveló carne ni sangre, mas mi Padre que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.WEB: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
verses.ASV: And I also say unto thee, that thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu também te digo que tu és Pedro, e sobre esta pedra edificarei a minha igreja; e as portas do Xeol não prevalecerão contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo también te digo, que tú eres Pedro, y sobre esta piedra edificaré mi iglesia; y las puertas del infierno no prevalecerán contra ella.

verses.KJV: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.WEB: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
verses.ASV: I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a ti darei as chaves do Reino dos céus; e tudo o que ligares na terra terá sido ligado nos céus; e tudo o que desligares na terra terá sido desligado nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y á ti daré las llaves del reino de los cielos; y todo lo que ligares en la tierra será ligado en los cielos; y todo lo que desatares en la tierra será desatado en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.WEB: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.ASV: Then charged he the disciples that they should tell no man that he was the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então mandou aos seus discípulos que a ninguém dissessem que ele era Jesus, o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces mandó á sus discípulos que á nadie dijesen que él era Jesús el Cristo.

verses.KJV: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.WEB: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
verses.ASV: From that time began Jesus to show unto his disciples, that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde então Jesus começou a mostrar a seus discípulos que ele tinha que ir a Jerusalém, e sofrer muito pelos anciãos, pelos chefes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas, e ser morto, e ser ressuscitado ao terceiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Desde aquel tiempo comenzó Jesús á declarar á sus discípulos que le convenía ir á Jerusalem, y padecer mucho de los ancianos, y de los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y de los escribas; y ser muerto, y resucitar al tercer día.

verses.KJV: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
verses.WEB: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
verses.ASV: And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall never be unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo, dizendo: Misericórdia de ti, Senhor! De maneira nenhuma isso te aconteça.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro, tomándolo aparte, comenzó á reprenderle, diciendo: Señor, ten compasión de ti: en ninguna manera esto te acontezca.

verses.KJV: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
verses.WEB: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
verses.ASV: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art a stumbling-block unto me: for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele se virou, e disse a Pedro: Para trás de mim, Satanás! Tu és um meio de tropeço, porque não compreendes as coisas de Deus, mas sim as humanas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él, volviéndose, dijo á Pedro: Quítate de delante de mí, Satanás; me eres escándalo; porque no entiendes lo que es de Dios sino lo que es de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.ASV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus disse a seus discípulos: Se alguém quiser vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, tome sobre si a sua cruz, e siga-me.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo á sus discípulos: Si alguno quiere venir en pos de mí, niéguese á sí mismo, y tome su cruz, y sígame.

verses.KJV: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.WEB: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
verses.ASV: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qualquer um que quiser salvar a sua vida a perderá; porém qualquer um que por causa de mim perder a sua vida, [este] a achará.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que quisiere salvar su vida, la perderá, y cualquiera que perdiere su vida por causa de mí, la hallará.

verses.KJV: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.WEB: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.ASV: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que proveito há para alguém, se ganhar o mundo todo, mas perder a sua alma? Ou que dará alguém em resgate da sua alma?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿de qué aprovecha al hombre, si granjeare todo el mundo, y perdiere su alma? O ¿qué recompensa dará el hombre por su alma?

verses.KJV: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.WEB: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.
verses.ASV: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then shall he render unto every man according to his deeds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o Filho do homem virá na glória do seu Pai com os seus anjos, e então recompensará a cada um segundo as suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Hijo del hombre vendrá en la gloria de su Padre con sus ángeles, y entonces pagará á cada uno conforme á sus obras.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, There are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que há alguns, dos que aqui estão, que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o Filho do homem vir em seu Reino.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo: hay algunos de los que están aquí, que no gustarán la muerte, hasta que hayan visto al Hijo del hombre viniendo en su reino.

verses.KJV: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.WEB: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
verses.ASV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart:
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias depois, Jesus tomou consigo Pedro, Tiago, e seu irmão João, e os levou a sós a um monte alto.
verses.RVR09: Y DESPUÉS de seis días, Jesús toma á Pedro, y á Jacobo, y á Juan su hermano, y los lleva aparte á un monte alto:

verses.KJV: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.WEB: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
verses.ASV: and he was transfigured before them; and his face did shine as the sun, and his garments became white as the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então transfigurou-se diante deles; seu rosto brilhou como o sol, e suas roupas se tornaram brancas como a luz.
verses.RVR09: Y se transfiguró delante de ellos; y resplandeció su rostro como el sol, y sus vestidos fueron blancos como la luz.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.WEB: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
verses.ASV: And behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elijah talking with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que lhes apareceram Moisés e Elias, falando com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí les aparecieron Moisés y Elías, hablando con él.

verses.KJV: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.WEB: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.ASV: And Peter answered, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, I will make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro, então, disse a Jesus: Senhor, bom é para nós estarmos aqui. Se queres, façamos aqui três tendas: uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Pedro, dijo á Jesús: Señor, bien es que nos quedemos aquí: si quieres, hagamos aquí tres pabellones: para ti uno, y para Moisés otro, y otro para Elías.

verses.KJV: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold, a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ele ainda estava falando, eis que uma nuvem brilhante os cobriu. E eis que uma voz da nuvem disse: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me agrado; a ele ouvi.
verses.RVR09: Y estando aún él hablando, he aquí una nube de luz que los cubrió; y he aquí una voz de la nube, que dijo: Este es mi Hijo amado, en el cual tomo contentamiento: á él oid.

verses.KJV: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.WEB: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
verses.ASV: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os discípulos ouviram, caíram sobre seus rostos, e tiveram muito medo.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto los discípulos, cayeron sobre sus rostros, y temieron en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.WEB: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus came and touched them and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus se aproximou deles, tocou-os, e disse: Levantai-vos, e não tenhais medo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús llegando, los tocó, y dijo: Levantaos, y no temáis.

verses.KJV: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.WEB: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
verses.ASV: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, save Jesus only.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eles levantaram seus olhos, não viram a ninguém, a não ser a Jesus somente.
verses.RVR09: Y alzando ellos sus ojos, á nadie vieron, sino á solo Jesús.

verses.KJV: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.WEB: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
verses.ASV: And as they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto desciam do monte, Jesus lhes disse a seguinte ordem: Não conteis a visão a ninguém, até que o Filho do homem seja ressuscitado dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y como descendieron del monte, les mandó Jesús, diciendo: No digáis á nadie la visión, hasta que el Hijo del hombre resucite de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.WEB: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
verses.ASV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os seus discípulos lhe perguntaram: Por que, então, os escribas dizem que Elias tem que vir primeiro?
verses.RVR09: Entonces sus discípulos le preguntaron, diciendo: ¿Por qué dicen pues los escribas que es menester que Elías venga primero?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, Elijah indeed cometh, and shall restore all things:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Em verdade Elias virá primeiro, e restaurará todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: A la verdad, Elías vendrá primero, y restituirá todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.WEB: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
verses.ASV: but I say unto you, that Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but did unto him whatsoever they would. Even so shall the Son of man also suffer of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo-vos, porém, que Elias já veio, mas não o reconheceram. Em vez disso fizeram dele tudo o que quiseram. Assim também o Filho do homem sofrerá por meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas os digo, que ya vino Elías, y no le conocieron; antes hicieron en él todo lo que quisieron: así también el Hijo del hombre padecerá de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.WEB: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
verses.ASV: Then understood the disciples that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os discípulos entenderam que ele lhes falara a respeito de João Batista.
verses.RVR09: Los discípulos entonces entendieron, que les habló de Juan el Bautista.

verses.KJV: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.WEB: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
verses.ASV: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling to him, and saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram à multidão, veio a ele um homem, que se ajoelhou diante dele, e disse:
verses.RVR09: Y como ellos llegaron al gentío, vino á él un hombre hincándosele de rodillas,

verses.KJV: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.WEB: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
verses.ASV: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is epileptic, and suffereth grievously; for oft-times he falleth into the fire, and oft-times into the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhor, tem misericórdia do meu filho, que é epilético, e sofre muito mal; porque cai muitas vezes no fogo, e muitas vezes na água.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: Señor, ten misericordia de mi hijo, que es lunático, y padece malamente; porque muchas veces cae en el fuego, y muchas en el agua.

verses.KJV: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.WEB: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
verses.ASV: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu o trouxe aos teus discípulos, mas não o puderam curar.
verses.RVR09: Y le he presentado á tus discípulos, y no le han podido sanar.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

verses.RVR09: Entonces aquel siervo, postrado, le adoraba, diciendo: Señor, ten paciencia conmigo, y yo te lo pagaré todo.

verses.KJV: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.WEB: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
verses.ASV: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow-servants, who owed him a hundred shillings: and he laid hold on him, and took [him] by the throat, saying, Pay what thou owest.
verses.ALMEIDA: O senhor daquele servo compadeceu-se dele, então o soltou e lhe perdoou a dívida.
verses.RVR09: El señor, movido á misericordia de aquel siervo, le soltó y le perdonó la deuda.

verses.KJV: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
verses.WEB: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
verses.ASV: So his fellow-servant fell down and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia, depois daquele servo sair, achou um companheiro de serviço seu, que lhe devia cem denários; então o agarrou e o sufocou, dizendo: “Paga-me o que [me] deves!”
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo aquel siervo, halló á uno de sus consiervos, que le debía cien denarios; y trabando de él, le ahogaba, diciendo: Págame lo que debes.

verses.KJV: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.WEB: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
verses.ASV: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay that which was due.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o seu colega se prostrou diante dos seus pés, e lhe suplicou, dizendo: “Tem paciência comigo, e tudo te pagarei”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces su consiervo, postrándose á sus pies, le rogaba, diciendo: Ten paciencia conmigo, y yo te lo pagaré todo.

verses.KJV: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.WEB: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
verses.ASV: So when his fellow-servants saw what was done, they were exceeding sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele não quis. Em vez disso foi lançá-lo na prisão até que pagasse a dívida.
verses.RVR09: Mas él no quiso; sino fué, y le echó en la cárcel hasta que pagase la deuda.

verses.KJV: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.WEB: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
verses.ASV: Then his lord called him unto him, and saith to him, Thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou besoughtest me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os seus companheiros de serviço viram o que se passava, entristeceram-se muito. Então vieram denunciar ao seu senhor tudo o que havia se passado.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo sus consiervos lo que pasaba, se entristecieron mucho, y viniendo, declararon á su señor todo lo que había pasado.

verses.KJV: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
verses.WEB: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
verses.ASV: shouldest not thou also have had mercy on thy fellow-servant, even as I had mercy on thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o seu senhor o chamou, e lhe disse: “Servo mau! Toda aquela dívida te perdoei, porque me suplicaste.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llamándole su señor, le dice: Siervo malvado, toda aquella deuda te perdoné, porque me rogaste:

verses.KJV: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
verses.WEB: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
verses.ASV: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tinhas tu a obrigação de ter tido misericórdia do sevo colega teu, assim como eu tive misericórdia de ti?”
verses.RVR09: ¿No te convenía también á ti tener misericordia de tu consiervo, como también yo tuve misericordia de ti?

verses.KJV: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.WEB: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
verses.ASV: So shall also my heavenly Father do unto you, if ye forgive not every one his brother from your hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, enfurecido, o seu senhor o entregou aos torturadores até que pagasse tudo o que lhe devia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces su señor, enojado, le entregó á los verdugos, hasta que pagase todo lo que le debía.

verses.KJV: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.WEB: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também meu Pai celestial vos fará, se não perdoardes de coração cada um ao seu irmão suas ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Así también hará con vosotros mi Padre celestial, si no perdonareis de vuestros corazones cada uno á su hermano sus ofensas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.WEB: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judæa beyond the Jordan;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou essas palavras, partiu da Galileia, e veio para a região da Judeia, além do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que acabando Jesús estas palabras, se pasó de Galilea, y vino á los términos de Judea, pasado el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.WEB: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
verses.ASV: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas multidões o seguiram, e ele os curou ali.
verses.RVR09: Y le siguieron muchas gentes, y los sanó allí.

verses.KJV: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.WEB: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
verses.ASV: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful [for a man] to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os fariseus se aproximaram dele e, provando-o, perguntaram-lhe: É lícito ao homem se divorciar da sua mulher por qualquer causa?
verses.RVR09: Entonces se llegaron á él los Fariseos, tentándole, y diciéndole: ¿Es lícito al hombre repudiar á su mujer por cualquiera causa?

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.WEB: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, Have ye not read, that he who made [them] from the beginning made them male and female,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes respondeu: Não tendes lido que aquele que [os] fez no princípio, macho e fêmea os fez,
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, les dijo: ¿No habéis leído que el que los hizo al principio, macho y hembra los hizo,

verses.KJV: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.WEB: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
verses.ASV: and said, For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?
verses.ALMEIDA: e disse: Portanto o homem deixará pai e mãe, e se unirá a sua mulher, e os dois serão uma única carne?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Por tanto, el hombre dejará padre y madre, y se unirá á su mujer, y serán dos en una carne?

verses.KJV: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.WEB: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
verses.ASV: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eles já não são mais dois, mas sim uma única carne; portanto, o que Deus juntou, o ser humano não separe.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no son ya más dos, sino una carne: por tanto, lo que Dios juntó, no lo aparte el hombre.

verses.KJV: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
verses.ASV: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put [her] away?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhe disseram: Por que, pois, Moisés mandou [lhe] dar carta de separação, e divorciar-se dela?
verses.RVR09: Dícenle: ¿Por qué, pues, Moisés mandó dar carta de divorcio, y repudiarla?

verses.KJV: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
verses.ASV: He saith unto them, Moses for your hardness of heart suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it hath not been so.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] lhes disse: Por causa da dureza dos vossos corações Moisés vos permitiu divorciardes de vossas mulheres; mas no princípio não foi assim.
verses.RVR09: Díceles: Por la dureza de vuestro corazón Moisés os permitió repudiar á vuestras mujeres: mas al principio no fué así.

verses.KJV: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.WEB: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, a não ser por causa de pecado sexual, e se casar com outra, adultera; e o que se casar com a divorciada [também] adultera.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os digo que cualquiera que repudiare á su mujer, si no fuere por causa de fornicación, y se casare con otra, adultera: y el que se casare con la repudiada, adultera.

verses.KJV: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.WEB: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
verses.ASV: The disciples say unto him, If the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os seus discípulos lhe disseram: Se assim é a condição do homem com a mulher, não convém se casar.
verses.RVR09: Dícenle sus discípulos: Si así es la condición del hombre con su mujer, no conviene casarse.

verses.KJV: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
verses.ASV: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes disse: Nem todos recebem esta palavra, a não ser aqueles a quem é dado;
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dijo: No todos reciben esta palabra, sino aquellos á quienes es dado.

verses.KJV: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.WEB: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
verses.ASV: For there are eunuchs, that were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are eunuchs, that were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, that made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois há castrados que nasceram assim do ventre da mãe; e há castrados que foram castrados pelos homens; e há castrados que castraram a si mesmos por causa do Reino dos céus. Quem pode receber [isto] ,receba.
verses.RVR09: Porque hay eunucos que nacieron así del vientre de su madre; y hay eunucos, que son hechos eunucos por los hombres; y hay eunucos que se hicieron á sí mismos eunucos por causa del reino de los cielos; el que pueda ser capaz de eso, séalo.

verses.KJV: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.WEB: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.ASV: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should lay his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe trouxeram crianças, para que pusesse as mãos sobre elas e orasse, mas os discípulos os repreendiam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le fueron presentados unos niños, para que pusiese las manos sobre ellos, y orase; y los discípulos les riñeron.

verses.KJV: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus said, Suffer the little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for to such belongeth the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus disse: Deixai as crianças, e não as impeçais de vir a mim, porque delas é o Reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús dijo: Dejad á los niños, y no les impidáis de venir á mí; porque de los tales es el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.WEB: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
verses.ASV: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pôs as mãos sobre elas, e depois partiu-se dali.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo puesto sobre ellos las manos, se partió de allí.

verses.KJV: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.WEB: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
verses.ASV: And behold, one came to him and said, Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que alguém se aproximou, e perguntou-lhe: “Bom Mestre, que bem farei para eu ter a vida eterna?”
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, uno llegándose le dijo: Maestro bueno, ¿qué bien haré para tener la vida eterna?

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: “Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém há bom, a não ser um: Deus. Porém, se queres entrar na vida, guarda os mandamentos.”
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: ¿Por qué me llamas bueno? Ninguno es bueno sino uno, es á saber, Dios: y si quieres entrar en la vida, guarda los mandamientos.

verses.KJV: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
verses.ASV: He saith unto him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntou-lhe ele: “Quais?” E Jesus respondeu: “Não cometerás homicídio, não adulterarás, não furtarás, não darás falso testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Dícele: ¿Cuáles? Y Jesús dijo: No matarás: No adulterarás: No hurtarás: No dirás falso testimonio:

verses.KJV: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.WEB: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
verses.ASV: Honor thy father and thy mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: honra ao teu pai e à [tua] mãe; e amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.”
verses.RVR09: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre: y, Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo.

verses.KJV: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.WEB: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
verses.ASV: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?
verses.ALMEIDA: O rapaz lhe disse: “Tenho guardado tudo isso desde a minha juventude. Que me falta ainda?”
verses.RVR09: Dícele el mancebo: Todo esto guardé desde mi juventud: ¿qué más me falta?

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell that which thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: “Se queres ser completo, vai, vende o que tens, e dá aos pobres. Assim terás um tesouro no céu. Então vem, segue-me.”
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Si quieres ser perfecto, anda, vende lo que tienes, y dalo á los pobres, y tendrás tesoro en el cielo; y ven, sígueme.

verses.KJV: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.WEB: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
verses.ASV: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sorrowful; for he was one that had great possessions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o rapaz ouviu essa palavra, foi embora triste, porque tinha muitos bens.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo el mancebo esta palabra, se fué triste, porque tenía muchas posesiones.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, It is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, então, disse aos seus discípulos: “Em verdade vos digo que dificilmente um rico entrará no reino dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo á sus discípulos: De cierto os digo, que un rico difícilmente entrará en el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aliás, eu vos digo que é mais fácil um camelo passar pela abertura de uma agulha do que o rico entrar no reino de Deus.”
verses.RVR09: Mas os digo, que más liviano trabajo es pasar un camello por el ojo de una aguja, que entrar un rico en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.WEB: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
verses.ASV: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os seus discípulos ouviram [isso] , espantaram-se muito, e disseram: “Quem, pois, pode se salvar?”
verses.RVR09: Mas sus discípulos, oyendo estas cosas, se espantaron en gran manera, diciendo: ¿Quién pues podrá ser salvo?

verses.KJV: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.WEB: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus looking upon [them] said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus olhou [para eles] ,e lhes respondeu: Para os seres humanos, isto é impossível; mas para Deus tudo é possível.
verses.RVR09: Y mirándolos Jesús, les dijo: Para con los hombres imposible es esto; mas para con Dios todo es posible.

verses.KJV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.WEB: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”
verses.ASV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pedro se pôs a falar, e lhe perguntou: Eis que deixamos tudo, e te seguimos; o que, pois, conseguiremos ter?
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Pedro, le dijo: He aquí, nosotros hemos dejado todo, y te hemos seguido: ¿qué pues tendremos?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo que vós que me seguistes, na regeneração, quando o Filho do homem se sentar no trono de sua glória, vós também vos sentareis sobre doze tronos, para julgar as doze tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: De cierto os digo, que vosotros que me habéis seguido, en la regeneración, cuando se sentará el Hijo del hombre en el trono de su gloria, vosotros también os sentaréis sobre doce tronos, para juzgar á las doce tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.WEB: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
verses.ASV: And every one that hath left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que houver deixado casas, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou mulher, ou filhos, ou terras por causa do meu nome, receberá cem vezes tanto, e herdará a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que dejare casas, ó hermanos, ó hermanas, ó padre, ó madre, ó mujer, ó hijos, ó tierras, por mi nombre, recibirá cien veces tanto, y heredará la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
verses.WEB: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
verses.ASV: But many shall be last [that are] first; and first [that are] last.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém muitos primeiros serão últimos; e últimos, primeiros.
verses.RVR09: Mas muchos primeros serán postreros, y postreros primeros.

verses.KJV: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.WEB: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
verses.ASV: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that was a householder, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem, dono de propriedade, que saiu de madrugada para empregar trabalhadores para a sua vinha.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE el reino de los cielos es semejante á un hombre, padre de familia, que salió por la mañana á ajustar obreros para su viña.

verses.KJV: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.WEB: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.ASV: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a shilling a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele entrou em acordo com os trabalhadores por um denário ao dia, e os mandou à sua vinha.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndose concertado con los obreros en un denario al día, los envió á su viña.

verses.KJV: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.WEB: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
verses.ASV: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing in the marketplace idle;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando saiu perto da hora terceira, viu outros que estavam desocupados na praça.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo cerca de la hora de las tres, vió otros que estaban en la plaza ociosos;

verses.KJV: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.WEB: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
verses.ASV: and to them he said, Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse-lhes: “Ide vós também à vinha, e vos darei o que for justo”. E eles foram.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Id también vosotros á mi viña, y os daré lo que fuere justo. Y ellos fueron.

verses.KJV: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.WEB: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.ASV: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saindo novamente perto da hora sexta e nona, fez o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Salió otra vez cerca de las horas sexta y nona, é hizo lo mismo.

verses.KJV: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.WEB: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
verses.ASV: And about the eleventh [hour] he went out, and found others standing; and he saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando saiu perto da décima primeira hora, achou outros que estavam desocupados, e lhes perguntou: “Por que estais aqui o dia todo desocupados?”
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo cerca de la hora undécima, halló otros que estaban ociosos; y díceles: ¿Por qué estáis aquí todo el día ociosos?

verses.KJV: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
verses.WEB: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
verses.ASV: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhe disseram: “Porque ninguém nos empregou”. Ele lhes respondeu: “Ide vós também à vinha, e recebereis o que for justo”.
verses.RVR09: Dícenle: Porque nadie nos ha ajustado. Díceles: Id también vosotros á la viña, y recibiréis lo que fuere justo.

verses.KJV: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.WEB: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
verses.ASV: And when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the laborers, and pay them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando o anoitecer, o senhor da vinha disse ao seu mordomo: “Chama aos trabalhadores, e paga-lhes o salário, começando dos últimos, até os primeiros”.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fué la tarde del día, el señor de la viña dijo á su mayordomo: Llama á los obreros y págales el jornal, comenzando desde los postreros hasta los primeros.

verses.KJV: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.WEB: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
verses.ASV: And when they came that [were hired] about the eleventh hour, they received every man a shilling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vieram os de cerca da hora décima primeira, e receberam um denário cada um.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo los que habían ido cerca de la hora undécima, recibieron cada uno un denario.

verses.KJV: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.WEB: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
verses.ASV: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received every man a shilling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os primeiros vieram, pensavam que receberiam mais; porém eles também receberam um denário cada um.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo también los primeros, pensaron que habían de recibir más; pero también ellos recibieron cada uno un denario.

verses.KJV: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.WEB: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
verses.ASV: And when they received it, they murmured against the householder,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, ao receberem, murmuraram contra o chefe de casa,
verses.RVR09: Y tomándolo, murmuraban contra el padre de la familia,

verses.KJV: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.WEB: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
verses.ASV: saying, These last have spent [but] one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: “Estes últimos trabalharam uma única hora, e tu os igualaste conosco, que suportamos a carga e o calor do dia”.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Estos postreros sólo han trabajado una hora, y los has hecho iguales á nosotros, que hemos llevado la carga y el calor del día.

verses.KJV: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.WEB: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
verses.ASV: But he answered and said to one of them, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a shilling?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, porém, respondeu a um deles: “Amigo, nada de errado estou fazendo contigo. Não concordaste tu comigo por um denário?
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, dijo á uno de ellos: Amigo, no te hago agravio; ¿no te concertaste conmigo por un denario?

verses.KJV: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.WEB: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
verses.ASV: Take up that which is thine, and go thy way; it is my will to give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma o que é teu, e vai embora; e quero dar a este último tanto quanto a ti.
verses.RVR09: Toma lo que es tuyo, y vete; mas quiero dar á este postrero, como á ti.

verses.KJV: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.WEB: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
verses.ASV: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? or is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso não me é lícito fazer do que é meu o que eu quiser? Ou o teu olho é mau, porque eu sou bom?”
verses.RVR09: ¿No me es lícito á mí hacer lo que quiero con lo mío? ó ¿es malo tu ojo, porque yo soy bueno?

verses.KJV: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.WEB: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
verses.ASV: So the last shall be first, and the first last.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os últimos serão primeiros; e os primeiros, últimos; pois muitos são chamados, mas poucos escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Así los primeros serán postreros, y los postreros primeros: porque muchos son llamados, mas pocos escogidos.

verses.KJV: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.WEB: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
verses.ASV: And as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples apart, and on the way he said unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto Jesus subia a Jerusalém, tomou consigo os doze discípulos à parte no caminho, e lhes disse:
verses.RVR09: Y subiendo Jesús á Jerusalem, tomó sus doce discípulos aparte en el camino, y les dijo:

verses.KJV: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.WEB: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
verses.ASV: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and scribes; and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estamos subindo a Jerusalém, e o Filho do homem será entregue aos chefes dos sacerdotes e aos escribas, e o condenarão à morte.
verses.RVR09: He aquí subimos á Jerusalem, y el Hijo del hombre será entregado á los príncipes de los sacerdotes y á los escribas, y le condenarán á muerte;

verses.KJV: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.WEB: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
verses.ASV: and shall deliver him unto the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify: and the third day he shall be raised up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o entregarão aos gentios, para que dele escarneçam, e o açoitem, e crucifiquem; mas ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.
verses.RVR09: Y le entregarán á los Gentiles para que le escarnezcan, y azoten, y crucifiquen; mas al tercer día resucitará.

verses.KJV: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.WEB: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
verses.ASV: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, worshipping [him], and asking a certain thing of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se aproximou dele a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu, com os seus filhos. Ela o adorou para lhe pedir algo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se llegó á él la madre de los hijos de Zebedeo con sus hijos, adorándole, y pidiéndole algo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, What wouldest thou? She saith unto him, Command that these my two sons may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe perguntou: O que queres? Ela lhe disse: Dá ordem para que estes meus dois filhos se sentem, um à tua direita e outro à tua esquerda, no teu Reino.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: ¿Qué quieres? Ella le dijo: Di que se sienten estos dos hijos míos, el uno á tu mano derecha, y el otro á tu izquierda, en tu reino.

verses.KJV: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.WEB: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink the cup that I am about to drink? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus respondeu: Não sabeis o que pedis. Podeis vós beber o cálice que eu beberei, e ser batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado? Eles lhe disseram: Podemos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús respondiendo, dijo: No sabéis lo que pedís: ¿podéis beber el vaso que yo he de beber, y ser bautizados del bautismo de que yo soy bautizado? Y ellos le dicen: Podemos.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
verses.ASV: He saith unto them, My cup indeed ye shall drink: but to sit on my right hand, and on [my] left hand, is not mine to give; but [it is for them] for whom it hath been prepared of my Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: De fato meu cálice bebereis, e com o batismo com que eu sou batizado sereis batizados; mas sentar-se à minha direita, e à minha esquerda, não me cabe concedê-lo, mas [será] para os que por meu Pai está preparado.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dice: A la verdad mi vaso beberéis, y del bautismo de que yo soy bautizado, seréis bautizados; mas el sentaros á mi mano derecha y á mi izquierda, no es mío darlo, sino á aquellos para quienes está aparejado de mi Padre.

verses.KJV: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.WEB: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
verses.ASV: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation concerning the two brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os dez ouviram [isso] ,indignaram-se contra os dois irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y como los diez oyeron esto, se enojaron de los dos hermanos.

verses.KJV: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.WEB: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.ASV: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus os chamou a si, e disse: Vós bem sabeis que os chefes dos gentios os dominam, e os grandes usam de autoridade sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús llamándolos, dijo: Sabéis que los príncipes de los Gentiles se enseñorean sobre ellos, y los que son grandes ejercen sobre ellos potestad.
