verses.KJV: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.WEB: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
verses.ASV: Not so shall it be among you: but whosoever would become great among you shall be your minister;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não será assim entre vós. Ao contrário, quem quiser se tornar grande entre vós seja o vosso assistente;
verses.RVR09: Mas entre vosotros no será así; sino el que quisiere entre vosotros hacerse grande, será vuestro servidor;

verses.KJV: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.WEB: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
verses.ASV: and whosoever would be first among you shall be your servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: e quem quiser ser o primeiro entre vós seja o vosso servo;
verses.RVR09: Y el que quisiere entre vosotros ser el primero, será vuestro siervo:

verses.KJV: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.WEB: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.ASV: even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim como o Filho do homem não veio para ser servido, mas sim para servir, e para dar a sua vida em resgate por muitos.
verses.RVR09: Como el Hijo del hombre no vino para ser servido, sino para servir, y para dar su vida en rescate por muchos.

verses.KJV: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.WEB: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.ASV: And as they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eles saíram de Jericó, uma grande multidão o seguiu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces saliendo ellos de Jericó, le seguía gran compañía.

verses.KJV: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.WEB: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
verses.ASV: And behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que dois cegos assentados junto ao caminho, ao ouvirem que Jesus passava, clamaram: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí dos ciegos sentados junto al camino, como oyeron que Jesús pasaba, clamaron, diciendo: Señor, Hijo de David, ten misericordia de nosotros.

verses.KJV: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.WEB: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
verses.ASV: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried out the more, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão os repreendia, para que se calassem, mas eles clamavam ainda mais: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
verses.RVR09: Y la gente les reñía para que callasen; mas ellos clamaban más, diciendo: Señor, Hijo de David, ten misericordia de nosotros.

verses.KJV: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.WEB: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I should do unto you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus parou, chamou-os, e perguntou: Que quereis que eu vos faça?
verses.RVR09: Y parándose Jesús, los llamó, y dijo: ¿Qué queréis que haga por vosotros?

verses.KJV: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.WEB: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”
verses.ASV: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhe responderam: Senhor, que nossos olhos sejam abertos.
verses.RVR09: Ellos le dicen: Señor, que sean abiertos nuestros ojos.

verses.KJV: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.WEB: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
verses.ASV: And Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and straightway they received their sight, and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus, compadecido deles, tocou-lhes os olhos. E logo os olhos deles enxergaram, e o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús, teniendo misericordia de ellos, les tocó los ojos, y luego sus ojos recibieron la vista; y le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.WEB: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.ASV: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and came unto Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se aproximaram de Jerusalém, e chegaram a Betfagé, ao monte das Oliveiras, então Jesus mandou dois discípulos, dizendo-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Y COMO se acercaron á Jerusalem, y vinieron á Bethfagé, al monte de las Olivas, entonces Jesús envió dos discípulos,

verses.KJV: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
verses.WEB: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
verses.ASV: saying unto them, Go into the village that is over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose [them], and bring [them] unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide à aldeia em vossa frente, e logo achareis uma jumenta amarrada, e um jumentinho com ela; desamarra-a, e trazei-os a mim.
verses.RVR09: Diciéndoles: Id á la aldea que está delante de vosotros, y luego hallaréis una asna atada, y un pollino con ella: desatadla, y traédmelos.

verses.KJV: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.WEB: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
verses.ASV: And if any one say aught unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém vos disser algo, direis: “O Senhor precisa deles, mas logo os devolverá”.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno os dijere algo, decid: El Señor los ha menester. Y luego los dejará.

verses.KJV: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.WEB: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
verses.ASV: Now this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta, que disse:
verses.RVR09: Y todo esto fué hecho, para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el profeta, que dijo:

verses.KJV: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.WEB: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
verses.ASV: Tell ye the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, Meek, and riding upon an ass, And upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizei à filha de Sião: “Eis que o teu rei vem a ti, manso, e sentado sobre um jumento; um jumentinho, filho de uma animal de carga”.
verses.RVR09: Decid á la hija de Sión: He aquí, tu Rey viene á ti, manso, y sentado sobre una asna, y sobre un pollino, hijo de animal de yugo.

verses.KJV: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.WEB: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
verses.ASV: And the disciples went, and did even as Jesus appointed them,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os discípulos foram, e fizeram como Jesus havia lhes mandado;
verses.RVR09: Y los discípulos fueron, é hicieron como Jesús les mandó;

verses.KJV: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
verses.WEB: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
verses.ASV: and brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their garments; and he sat thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então trouxeram a jumenta e o jumentinho, puseram as suas capas sobre eles, e fizeram [-no] montar sobre elas.
verses.RVR09: Y trajeron el asna y el pollino, y pusieron sobre ellos sus mantos; y se sentó sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.WEB: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.ASV: And the most part of the multitude spread their garments in the way; and others cut branches from the trees, and spread them in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma grande multidão estendia suas roupas pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos das árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y la compañía, que era muy numerosa, tendía sus mantos en el camino: y otros cortaban ramos de los árboles, y los tendían por el camino.

verses.KJV: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.WEB: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.ASV: And the multitudes that went before him, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as multidões que iam adiante, e as que seguiam, clamavam: Hosana ao Filho de Davi! Bendito o que vem no nome do Senhor! Hosana nas alturas!
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes que iban delante, y las que iban detrás, aclamaban diciendo: ¡Hosanna al Hijo de David! ¡Bendito el que viene en el nombre del Señor! ¡Hosanna en las alturas!

verses.KJV: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.WEB: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
verses.ASV: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, Who is this?
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ele entrava em Jerusalém, toda a cidade se alvoroçou, perguntando: Quem é este?
verses.RVR09: Y entrando él en Jerusalem, toda la ciudad se alborotó, diciendo: ¿Quién es éste?

verses.KJV: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.WEB: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
verses.ASV: And the multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as multidões respondiam: Este é Jesus, o Profeta de Nazaré de Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes decían: Este es Jesús, el profeta, de Nazaret de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.WEB: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
verses.ASV: And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus entrou no Templo de Deus; então expulsou todos os que estavam vendendo e comprando no Templo, e virou as mesas dos cambistas e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Jesús en el templo de Dios, y echó fuera todos los que vendían y compraban en el templo, y trastornó las mesas de los cambiadores, y las sillas de los que vendían palomas;

verses.KJV: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”
verses.ASV: and he saith unto them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer: but ye make it a den of robbers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Está escrito: “Minha casa será chamada casa de oração”; mas vós a tornastes em covil de ladrões!
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Escrito está: Mi casa, casa de oración será llamada; mas vosotros cueva de ladrones la habéis hecho.

verses.KJV: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.WEB: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
verses.ASV: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cegos e mancos vieram a ele no Templo, e ele os curou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vinieron á él ciegos y cojos en el templo, y los sanó.

verses.KJV: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.WEB: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,
verses.ASV: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children that were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were moved with indignation,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas viram as maravilhas que ele fazia, e as crianças gritando no Templo: “Hosana ao Filho de Davi!”, eles ficaram indignados.
verses.RVR09: Mas los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los escribas, viendo las maravillas que hacía, y á los muchachos aclamando en el templo y diciendo: ¡Hosanna al Hijo de David! se indignaron,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.WEB: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”
verses.ASV: and said unto him, Hearest thou what these are saying? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea: did ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntaram-lhe: Ouves o que estas [crianças] dizem? E Jesus lhes respondeu: Sim. Nunca lestes: “Da boca das crianças e dos bebês providenciaste o louvor?”
verses.RVR09: Y le dijeron: ¿Oyes lo que éstos dicen? Y Jesús les dice: Sí: ¿nunca leísteis: De la boca de los niños y de los que maman perfeccionaste la alabanza?

verses.KJV: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.WEB: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.
verses.ASV: And he left them, and went forth out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele os deixou, e saiu da cidade para Betânia, e ali passou a noite.
verses.RVR09: Y dejándolos, se salió fuera de la ciudad, á Bethania; y posó allí.

verses.KJV: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.WEB: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
verses.ASV: Now in the morning as he returned to the city, he hungered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela manhã, enquanto voltava para a cidade, teve fome.
verses.RVR09: Y por la mañana volviendo á la ciudad, tuvo hambre.

verses.KJV: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.WEB: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.
verses.ASV: And seeing a fig tree by the way side, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only; and he saith unto it, Let there be no fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele viu uma figueira perto do caminho, veio a ela, mas nada nela achou, a não ser somente folhas. E disse-lhe: Nunca de ti nasça fruto, jamais!E imediatamente a figueira se secou.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo una higuera cerca del camino, vino á ella, y no halló nada en ella, sino hojas solamente; y le dijo: Nunca más para siempre nazca de ti fruto. Y luego se secó la higuera.

verses.KJV: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.WEB: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
verses.ASV: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os discípulos viram, e ficaram maravilhados, dizendo: Como a figueira se secou de imediato?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto los discípulos, maravillados decían: ¿Cómo se secó luego la higuera?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do what is done to the fig tree, but even if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea, it shall be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus lhes respondeu: Em verdade vos digo: se tiverdes fé, e não duvidardes, vós não somente fareis isto à figueira, mas até se disserdes a este monte: “Levanta-te, e lança-te no mar”, isso se fará.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús les dijo: De cierto os digo, que si tuviereis fe, y no dudareis, no sólo haréis esto de la higuera: mas si á este monte dijereis: Quítate y échate en la mar, será hecho.

verses.KJV: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.WEB: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
verses.ASV: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo o que pedirdes em oração, crendo, recebereis.
verses.RVR09: Y todo lo que pidiereis en oración, creyendo, lo recibiréis.

verses.KJV: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.WEB: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
verses.ASV: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de entrar no templo, quando ele estava ensinando, os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo se aproximaram dele, perguntando: Com que autoridade fazes isto? E quem te deu esta autoridade?
verses.RVR09: Y como vino al templo, llegáronse á él cuando estaba enseñando, los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo, diciendo: ¿Con qué autoridad haces esto? ¿y quién te dió esta autoridad?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one question, which if ye tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Eu também vos farei uma pergunta. Se vós a responderdes a mim, também eu vos responderei com que autoridade faço isto.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Yo también os preguntaré una palabra, la cual si me dijereis, también yo os diré con qué autoridad hago esto.

verses.KJV: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.WEB: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.ASV: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.ALMEIDA: De onde era o batismo de João? Do céu, ou dos seres humanos?E eles pensaram entre si mesmos, dizendo: Se dissermos: “Do céu”, ele nos dirá: “Por que, então, não crestes nele?
verses.RVR09: El bautismo de Juan, ¿de dónde era? ¿del cielo, ó de los hombres? Ellos entonces pensaron entre sí, diciendo: Si dijéremos, del cielo, nos dirá: ¿Por qué pues no le creísteis?

verses.KJV: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.WEB: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
verses.ASV: But if we shall say, From men; we fear the multitude; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se dissermos: “Dos seres humanos”, temos medo da multidão, pois todos consideram João como profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijéremos, de los hombres, tememos al pueblo; porque todos tienen á Juan por profeta.

verses.KJV: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.WEB: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ASV: And they answered Jesus, and said, We know not. He also said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então responderam a Jesus: Não sabemos. E ele lhes disse: Nem eu vos digo com que autoridade faço isto.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo á Jesús, dijeron: No sabemos. Y él también les dijo: Ni yo os digo con qué autoridad hago esto.

verses.KJV: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.WEB: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
verses.ASV: But what think ye? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to-day in the vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que vos parece? Um homem tinha dois filhos. Aproximando-se do primeiro, disse: “Filho, vai hoje trabalhar na minha vinha.”
verses.RVR09: Mas, ¿qué os parece? Un hombre tenía dos hijos, y llegando al primero, le dijo: Hijo, ve hoy á trabajar en mi viña.

verses.KJV: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.WEB: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented himself, and went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele respondeu: “Não quero”; mas depois se arrependeu, e foi.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, dijo: No quiero; mas después, arrepentido, fué.

verses.KJV: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
verses.WEB: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
verses.ASV: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I [go], sir: and went not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, aproximando-se do segundo, disse da mesma maneira. E ele respondeu: “Eu [vou] , senhor”, mas não foi.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando al otro, le dijo de la misma manera; y respondiendo él, dijo: Yo, señor, voy. Y no fué.

verses.KJV: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.WEB: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
verses.ASV: Which of the two did the will of his father? They say, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual dos dois fez a vontade do pai? Eles lhe responderam: O primeiro. Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo que os publicanos e as prostitutas estão indo adiante de vós ao Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuál de los dos hizo la voluntad de su padre? Dicen ellos: El primero. Díceles Jesús: De cierto os digo, que los publicanos y las rameras os van delante al reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.WEB: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
verses.ASV: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye saw it, did not even repent yourselves afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois João veio a vós mesmos no caminho de justiça, mas não crestes nele; enquanto que os publicanos e as prostitutas nele creram. Vós, porém, mesmo tendo visto [isto] , nem assim vos arrependestes, a fim de nele crer.
verses.RVR09: Porque vino á vosotros Juan en camino de justicia, y no le creísteis; y los publicanos y las rameras le creyeron; y vosotros, viendo esto, no os arrepentisteis después para creerle.

verses.KJV: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.WEB: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
verses.ASV: Hear another parable: There was a man that was a householder, who planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi outra parábola. Havia um homem, dono de uma propriedade. Ele plantou uma vinha, cercou-a, fundou nela uma prensa de uvas, e construiu uma torre. Depois a arrendou a uns lavradores, e partiu-se para um lugar distante.
verses.RVR09: Oid otra parábola: Fué un hombre, padre de familia, el cual plantó una viña; y la cercó de vallado, y cavó en ella un lagar, y edificó una torre, y la dió á renta á labradores, y se partió lejos.

verses.KJV: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.WEB: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
verses.ASV: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, to receive his fruits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando chegou o tempo dos frutos, enviou seus servos aos lavradores, para receberem os frutos que a ele pertenciam.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando se acercó el tiempo de los frutos, envió sus siervos á los labradores, para que recibiesen sus frutos.

verses.KJV: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.WEB: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
verses.ASV: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os lavradores tomaram os seus servos, e feriram um, mataram outro, e apedrejaram outro.
verses.RVR09: Mas los labradores, tomando á los siervos, al uno hirieron, y al otro mataron, y al otro apedrearon.

verses.KJV: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.WEB: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
verses.ASV: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them in like manner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra vez enviou outros servos, em maior número que os primeiros, mas fizeram-lhes o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Envió de nuevo otros siervos, más que los primeros; é hicieron con ellos de la misma manera.

verses.KJV: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.WEB: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.ASV: But afterward he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por último lhes enviou o seu filho, dizendo: “Respeitarão ao meu filho”.
verses.RVR09: Y á la postre les envió su hijo, diciendo: Tendrán respeto á mi hijo.

verses.KJV: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.WEB: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
verses.ASV: But the husbandmen, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and take his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando os lavradores viram o filho, disseram entre si: “Este é o herdeiro. Venhamos matá-lo, e tomemos a sua herança”.
verses.RVR09: Mas los labradores, viendo al hijo, dijeron entre sí: Este es el heredero; venid, matémosle, y tomemos su heredad.

verses.KJV: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
verses.WEB: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
verses.ASV: And they took him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o agarraram, lançaram-no para fora da vinha, e o mataram.
verses.RVR09: Y tomado, le echaron fuera de la viña, y le mataron.

verses.KJV: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.WEB: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
verses.ASV: When therefore the lord of the vineyard shall come, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, quando o senhor da vinha chegar, o que fará com aqueles lavradores?
verses.RVR09: Pues cuando viniere el señor de la viña, ¿qué hará á aquellos labradores?

verses.KJV: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.WEB: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
verses.ASV: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will let out the vineyard unto other husbandmen, who shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhe responderam: Aos maus dará uma morte má, e arrendará a vinha a outros lavradores, que lhe deem os frutos em seus tempos [de colheita] .
verses.RVR09: Dícenle: á los malos destruirá miserablemente, y su viña dará á renta á otros labradores, que le paguen el fruto á sus tiempos.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner; This was from the Lord, And it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes disse: Nunca lestes nas Escrituras: “A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa se tornou cabeça da esquina. Isto foi feito pelo Senhor, e é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos”?
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: ¿Nunca leísteis en las Escrituras: La piedra que desecharon los que edificaban, ésta fué hecha por cabeza de esquina: por el Señor es hecho esto, y es cosa maravillosa en nuestros ojos?

verses.KJV: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.WEB: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
verses.ASV: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken away from you, and shall be given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos digo que o reino de Deus será tirado de vós, e será dado a um povo que produza os frutos dele.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os digo, que el reino de Dios será quitado de vosotros, y será dado á gente que haga los frutos de él.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.WEB: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
verses.ASV: And he that falleth on this stone shall be broken to pieces: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem cair sobre esta pedra será quebrado; mas sobre quem ela cair, ela o tornará em pó.
verses.RVR09: Y el que cayere sobre esta piedra, será quebrantado; y sobre quien ella cayere, le desmenuzará.

verses.KJV: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.WEB: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
verses.ASV: And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os chefes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus ouviram estas suas parábolas, entenderam que [Jesus] estava falando deles.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los Fariseos sus parábolas, entendieron que hablaba de ellos.

verses.KJV: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.WEB: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
verses.ASV: And when they sought to lay hold on him, they feared the multitudes, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E procuravam prendê-lo, mas temeram as multidões, pois elas o consideravam profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y buscando cómo echarle mano, temieron al pueblo; porque le tenían por profeta.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
verses.WEB: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and spake again in parables unto them, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus voltou a lhes falar por parábolas, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIENDO Jesús, les volvió á hablar en parábolas, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.WEB: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
verses.ASV: The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: O reino dos céus é semelhante a um rei que fez uma festa de casamento para o seu filho;
verses.RVR09: El reino de los cielos es semejante á un hombre rey, que hizo bodas á su hijo;

verses.KJV: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.WEB: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
verses.ASV: and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the marriage feast: and they would not come.
verses.ALMEIDA: e mandou a seus servos que chamassem os convidados para a festa de casamento, mas não quiseram vir.
verses.RVR09: Y envió sus siervos para que llamasen los llamados á las bodas; mas no quisieron venir.

verses.KJV: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.WEB: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
verses.ASV: Again he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them that are bidden, Behold, I have made ready my dinner; my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come to the marriage feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra vez ele mandou outros servos, dizendo: “Dizei aos convidados: ‘Eis que já preparei meu jantar: meus bois e animais cevados já foram mortos, e tudo está pronto. Vinde à festa de casamento’”.
verses.RVR09: Volvió á enviar otros siervos, diciendo: Decid á los llamados: He aquí, mi comida he aparejado; mis toros y animales engordados son muertos, y todo está prevenido: venid á las bodas.

verses.KJV: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.WEB: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
verses.ASV: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles não deram importância e foram embora, um ao seu campo, e outro ao seu comércio;
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no se cuidaron, y se fueron, uno á su labranza, y otro á sus negocios;

verses.KJV: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
verses.WEB: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
verses.ASV: and the rest laid hold on his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: e outros agarraram os servos dele, e os humilharam e os mataram.
verses.RVR09: Y otros, tomando á sus siervos, los afrentaron y los mataron.

verses.KJV: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.WEB: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
verses.ASV: But the king was wroth; and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o rei Então enviou os seus exércitos, destruiu aqueles homicidas, e incendiou a cidade deles.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey, oyendo esto, se enojó; y enviando sus ejércitos, destruyó á aquellos homicidas, y puso fuego á su ciudad.

verses.KJV: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.WEB: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
verses.ASV: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they that were bidden were not worthy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida, disse aos seus servos: “Certamente a festa de casamento está pronta, porém os convidados não eram dignos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dice á sus siervos: Las bodas á la verdad están aparejadas; mas los que eran llamados no eran dignos.

verses.KJV: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.WEB: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
verses.ASV: Go ye therefore unto the partings of the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide, pois, às saídas dos caminhos, e convidai à festa de casamento tantos quantos achardes.
verses.RVR09: Id pues á las salidas de los caminos, y llamad á las bodas á cuantos hallareis.

verses.KJV: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.WEB: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
verses.ASV: And those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was filled with guests.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aqueles servos saíram pelos caminhos, e ajuntaram todos quantos acharam, tanto maus como bons; e a festa de casamento se encheu de convidados.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo los siervos por los caminos, juntaron á todos los que hallaron, juntamente malos y buenos: y las bodas fueron llenas de convidados.

verses.KJV: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.WEB: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
verses.ASV: But when the king came in to behold the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a wedding-garment:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o rei entrou para ver os convidados, percebeu ali um homem que não estava vestido com roupa adequada para a festa de casamento.
verses.RVR09: Y entró el rey para ver los convidados, y vió allí un hombre no vestido de boda.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.WEB: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
verses.ASV: and he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding-garment? And he was speechless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe perguntou: “Amigo, como entraste aqui sem ter roupa para a festa?” E ele emudeceu.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo: Amigo, ¿cómo entraste aquí no teniendo vestido de boda? Mas él cerró la boca.

verses.KJV: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
verses.ASV: Then the king said to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and cast him out into the outer darkness; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei disse aos servos: “Amarrai-o nos pés e nas mãos, tomai-o, e lançai-o nas trevas de fora. Ali haverá pranto e o ranger de dentes”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey dijo á los que servían: Atado de pies y de manos tomadle, y echadle en las tinieblas de afuera: allí será el lloro y el crujir de dientes.

verses.KJV: For many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.WEB: For many are called, but few chosen.”
verses.ASV: For many are called, but few chosen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois muitos são chamados, porém poucos escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos son llamados, y pocos escogidos.

verses.KJV: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
verses.WEB: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
verses.ASV: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might ensnare him in [his] talk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os fariseus foram embora, e se reuniram para tramar como o apanhariam em cilada por algo que dissesse.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, idos los Fariseos, consultaron cómo le tomarían en alguna palabra.

verses.KJV: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.WEB: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
verses.ASV: And they send to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, and carest not for any one: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois lhe enviaram seus discípulos, juntamente com os apoiadores de Herodes, e perguntaram: Mestre, bem sabemos que tu és verdadeiro, e que com verdade ensinas o caminho de Deus, e que não te importas com a opinião de ninguém, porque não dás atenção à aparência humana.
verses.RVR09: Y envían á él los discípulos de ellos, con los Herodianos, diciendo: Maestro, sabemos que eres amador de la verdad, y que enseñas con verdad el camino de Dios, y que no te curas de nadie, porque no tienes acepción de persona de hombres.

verses.KJV: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.WEB: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
verses.ASV: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-nos, pois, o que te parece: é lícito dar tributo a César, ou não?
verses.RVR09: Dinos pues, ¿qué te parece? ¿es lícito dar tributo á César, ó no?

verses.KJV: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
verses.WEB: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
verses.ASV: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why make ye trial of me, ye hypocrites?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, entendendo a sua malícia, disse: Por que me tentais, hipócritas?
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús, entendida la malicia de ellos, les dice: ¿Por qué me tentáis, hipócritas?

verses.KJV: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.WEB: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
verses.ASV: Show me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a denarius.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mostrai-me a moeda do tributo.E eles lhe trouxeram um denário.
verses.RVR09: Mostradme la moneda del tributo. Y ellos le presentaron un denario.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.WEB: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes perguntou: De quem é esta imagem, e a inscrição?
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dice: ¿Cúya es esta figura, y lo que está encima escrito?

verses.KJV: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
verses.ASV: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhe responderam: De César. Então ele lhes disse: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Dícenle: De César. Y díceles: Pagad pues á César lo que es de César, y á Dios lo que es de Dios.

verses.KJV: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.WEB: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
verses.ASV: And when they heard it, they marvelled, and left him, and went away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ouviram isso, eles ficaram admirados; então o deixaram e se retiraram.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto, se maravillaron; y dejándole se fueron.

verses.KJV: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.WEB: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
verses.ASV: On that day there came to him Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection: and they asked him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele mesmo dia chegaram a ele os saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e perguntaram-lhe,
verses.RVR09: Aquel día llegaron á él los Saduceos, que dicen no haber resurrección, y le preguntaron,

verses.KJV: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.WEB: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
verses.ASV: saying, Teacher, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Mestre, Moisés disse: Se um homem morrer sem ter filhos, seu irmão se casará com sua mulher, e gerará descendência ao seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Maestro, Moisés dijo: Si alguno muriere sin hijos, su hermano se casará con su mujer, y despertará simiente á su hermano.

verses.KJV: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.WEB: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
verses.ASV: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first married and deceased, and having no seed left his wife unto his brother;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, havia entre nós sete irmãos. O primeiro se casou, e depois morreu; e sem ter tido filhos, deixou sua mulher ao seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Fueron pues, entre nosotros siete hermanos: y el primero tomó mujer, y murió; y no teniendo generación, dejó su mujer á su hermano.

verses.KJV: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.WEB: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
verses.ASV: in like manner the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da mesma maneira também foi com o segundo, o terceiro, até os sete.
verses.RVR09: De la misma manera también el segundo, y el tercero, hasta los siete.

verses.KJV: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.WEB: After them all, the woman died.
verses.ASV: And after them all, the woman died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por último, depois de todos, a mulher também morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y después de todos murió también la mujer.

verses.KJV: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.WEB: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
verses.ASV: In the resurrection therefore whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, na ressurreição, a mulher será de qual dos sete? Pois todos a tiveram.
verses.RVR09: En la resurrección pues, ¿de cuál de los siete será ella mujer? porque todos la tuvieron.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.WEB: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.ASV: But Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, porém, lhes respondeu: Errais, por não conhecerdes as Escrituras, nem o poder de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Erráis ignorando las Escrituras, y el poder de Dios.

verses.KJV: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.WEB: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
verses.ASV: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as angels in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque na ressurreição, nem se tomam, nem se dão em casamento; mas são como os anjos de Deus no céu.
verses.RVR09: Porque en la resurrección, ni los hombres tomarán mujeres, ni las mujeres maridos; mas son como los ángeles de Dios en el cielo.

verses.KJV: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.WEB: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
verses.ASV: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre a ressurreição dos mortos, não lestes o que Deus vos falou:
verses.RVR09: Y de la resurrección de los muertos, ¿no habéis leído lo que os es dicho por Dios, que dice:

verses.KJV: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.WEB: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
verses.ASV: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not [the God] of the dead, but of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó? Deus não é Deus dos mortos, mas sim dos vivos!
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el Dios de Abraham, y el Dios de Isaac, y el Dios de Jacob? Dios no es Dios de muertos, sino de vivos.

verses.KJV: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.WEB: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
verses.ASV: And when the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando as multidões ouviram [isto] ,ficaram admiradas de sua doutrina.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto las gentes, estaban atónitas de su doctrina.

verses.KJV: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.WEB: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
verses.ASV: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, gathered themselves together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os fariseus, ao ouvirem que ele havia feito os saduceus se calarem, reuniram-se.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Fariseos, oyendo que había cerrado la boca á los Saduceos, se juntaron á una.

verses.KJV: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.WEB: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
verses.ASV: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, trying him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E um deles, especialista da Lei, tentando-o, perguntou-lhe:
verses.RVR09: Y preguntó uno de ellos, intérprete de la ley, tentándole y diciendo:

verses.KJV: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.WEB: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
verses.ASV: Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mestre, qual é o grande mandamento na Lei?
verses.RVR09: Maestro, ¿cuál es el mandamiento grande en la ley?

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe respondeu: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração, com toda a tua alma, e com todo o teu entendimento:
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Amarás al Señor tu Dios de todo tu corazón, y de toda tu alma, y de toda tu mente.

verses.KJV: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.WEB: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.ASV: This is the great and first commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: este é o primeiro e grande mandamento.
verses.RVR09: Este es el primero y el grande mandamiento.

verses.KJV: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.WEB: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
verses.ASV: And a second like [unto it] is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o segundo, semelhante a este, [é] : Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y el segundo es semejante á éste: Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo.

verses.KJV: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.WEB: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
verses.ASV: On these two commandments the whole law hangeth, and the prophets.

verses.ASV: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

verses.RVR09: Y estando juntos los Fariseos, Jesús les preguntó,

verses.WEB: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
verses.ASV: saying, What think ye of the Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, [The son] of David.

verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Qué os parece del Cristo? ¿de quién es Hijo? Dícenle: De David.

verses.ASV: He saith unto them, How then doth David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

verses.ASV: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I put thine enemies underneath thy feet?

verses.RVR09: Dijo el Señor á mi Señor: Siéntate á mi diestra, entre tanto que pongo tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies?

verses.WEB: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
verses.ASV: If David then calleth him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se Davi o chama Senhor, como é seu filho?
verses.RVR09: Pues si David le llama Señor, ¿cómo es su Hijo?

verses.KJV: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.WEB: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
verses.ASV: And no one was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém podia lhe responder palavra; nem ninguém ousou desde aquele dia a mais lhe perguntar.
verses.RVR09: Y nadie le podía responder palabra; ni osó alguno desde aquel día preguntarle más.

verses.KJV: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.WEB: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
verses.ASV: Then spake Jesus to the multitudes and to his disciples,

verses.RVR09: ENTONCES habló Jesús á las gentes y á sus discípulos,

verses.KJV: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.WEB: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
verses.ASV: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat:

verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Sobre la cátedra de Moisés se sentaron los escribas y los Fariseos:

verses.KJV: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.WEB: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
verses.ASV: all things therefore whatsoever they bid you, [these] do and observe: but do not ye after their works; for they say, and do not.

verses.RVR09: Así que, todo lo que os dijeren que guardéis, guardadlo y hacedlo; mas no hagáis conforme á sus obras: porque dicen, y no hacen.

verses.KJV: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.WEB: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
verses.ASV: Yea, they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with their finger.

verses.RVR09: Porque atan cargas pesadas y difíciles de llevar, y las ponen sobre los hombros de los hombres; mas ni aun con su dedo las quieren mover.

verses.KJV: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.WEB: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
verses.ASV: But all their works they do to be seen of men: for they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders [of their garments],
verses.ALMEIDA: E fazem todas as suas obras a fim de serem vistos pelas pessoas: por isso alargam seus filactérios, ) e fazem compridas as franjas de suas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Antes, todas sus obras hacen para ser mirados de los hombres; porque ensanchan sus filacterias, y extienden los flecos de sus mantos;

verses.WEB: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
verses.ASV: and love the chief place at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles amam os primeiros assentos nas ceias, as primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas,
verses.RVR09: Y aman los primeros asientos en las cenas, y las primeras sillas en las sinagogas;

verses.KJV: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.WEB: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
verses.ASV: and the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called of men, Rabbi.

verses.RVR09: Y las salutaciones en las plazas, y ser llamados de los hombres Rabbí, Rabbí.

verses.KJV: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.WEB: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
verses.ASV: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your teacher, and all ye are brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós, não sejais chamados Rabi, porque o vosso Mestre é um: o Cristo; e todos vós sois irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros, no queráis ser llamados Rabbí; porque uno es vuestro Maestro, el Cristo; y todos vosotros sois hermanos.

verses.KJV: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

verses.RVR09: Y vuestro padre no llaméis á nadie en la tierra; porque uno es vuestro Padre, el cual está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.WEB: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
verses.ASV: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, [even] the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem sejais chamados mestres; porque o vosso mestre é um: o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Ni seáis llamados maestros; porque uno es vuestro Maestro, el Cristo.

verses.KJV: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.WEB: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
verses.ASV: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o maior de vós será vosso servo.
verses.RVR09: El que es el mayor de vosotros, sea vuestro siervo.

verses.RVR09: Porque el que se ensalzare, será humillado; y el que se humillare, será ensalzado.

verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de vosotros, escribas y Fariseos, hipócritas! porque cerráis el reino de los cielos delante de los hombres; que ni vosotros entráis, ni á los que están entrando dejáis entrar.

verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, escribas y Fariseos, hipócritas! porque coméis las casas de las viudas, y por pretexto hacéis larga oración: por esto llevaréis más grave juicio.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.WEB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
verses.ASV: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, that say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.

verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, escribas y Fariseos, hipócritas! porque rodeáis la mar y la tierra por hacer un prosélito; y cuando fuere hecho, le hacéis hijo del infierno doble más que vosotros.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

verses.KJV: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

verses.KJV: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
