verses.ASV: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of Abel the righteous unto the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom ye slew between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, eis que eu vos envio profetas, sábios, e escribas; a uns deles matareis e crucificareis, e a [outros] deles açoitareis em vossas sinagogas, e perseguireis de cidade em cidade;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí, yo envío á vosotros profetas, y sabios, y escribas: y de ellos, á unos mataréis y crucificaréis, y á otros de ellos azotaréis en vuestras sinagogas, y perseguiréis de ciudad en ciudad:

verses.KJV: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.WEB: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que venha sobre vós todo o sangue justo que foi derramado sobre a terra, desde o sangue do justo Abel, até o sangue de Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, ao qual matastes entre o templo e o altar.
verses.RVR09: Para que venga sobre vosotros toda la sangre justa que se ha derramado sobre la tierra, desde la sangre de Abel el justo, hasta la sangre de Zacarías, hijo de Barachîas, al cual matasteis entre el templo y el altar.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.ASV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que tudo isto virá sobre esta geração.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo que todo esto vendrá sobre esta generación.

verses.KJV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.WEB: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
verses.ASV: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas, e apedrejas os que te são enviados! Quantas vezes eu quis ajuntar os teus filhos, como a galinha ajunta os seus pintos debaixo das asas; porém não quisestes!
verses.RVR09: ¡Jerusalem, Jerusalem, que matas á los profetas, y apedreas á los que son enviados á ti! ¡cuántas veces quise juntar tus hijos, como la gallina junta sus pollos debajo de las alas, y no quisiste!

verses.KJV: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.WEB: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
verses.ASV: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vossa casa vos será deixada desolada.
verses.RVR09: He aquí vuestra casa os es dejada desierta.

verses.KJV: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu vos digo que a partir de agora não me vereis, até que digais: “Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor”.
verses.RVR09: Porque os digo que desde ahora no me veréis, hasta que digáis: Bendito el que viene en el nombre del Señor.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.WEB: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way; and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus saiu do templo, e se foi. Então seus discípulos se aproximaram dele para lhe mostrarem os edifícios do complexo do templo.
verses.RVR09: Y SALIDO Jesús, íbase del templo; y se llegaron sus discípulos, para mostrarle los edificios del templo.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.WEB: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não vedes tudo isto? Em verdade vos digo, que não será deixada aqui pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: ¿Veis todo esto? de cierto os digo, que no será dejada aquí piedra sobre piedra, que no sea destruída.

verses.KJV: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.WEB: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
verses.ASV: And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de se assentar no monte das Oliveiras, os discípulos se aproximaram dele reservadamente, perguntando: Dize-nos, quando serão estas coisas, e que sinal haverá da tua vinda, e do fim da era?
verses.RVR09: Y sentándose él en el monte de las Olivas, se llegaron á él los discípulos aparte, diciendo: Dinos, ¿cuándo serán estas cosas, y qué señal habrá de tu venida, y del fin del mundo?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Permanecei atentos, para que ninguém vos engane.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Mirad que nadie os engañe.

verses.KJV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.WEB: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
verses.ASV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and shall lead many astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: “Eu sou o Cristo”, e enganarão a muitos.
verses.RVR09: Porque vendrán muchos en mi nombre, diciendo: Yo soy el Cristo; y á muchos engañarán.

verses.KJV: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.WEB: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.ASV: And ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that ye be not troubled: for [these things] must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvireis de guerras, e de rumores de guerras. Olhai que não vos espanteis; porque é necessário, que tudo [isto] aconteça, mas ainda não é o fim.
verses.RVR09: Y oiréis guerras, y rumores de guerras: mirad que no os turbéis; porque es menester que todo esto acontezca; mas aún no es el fin.

verses.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.WEB: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
verses.ASV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there shall be famines and earthquakes in divers places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino; e haverá fomes, pestilências, e terremotos em diversos lugares.
verses.RVR09: Porque se levantará nación contra nación, y reino contra reino; y habrá pestilencias, y hambres, y terremotos por los lugares.

verses.KJV: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.WEB: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.ASV: But all these things are the beginning of travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todas estas coisas são o começo das dores.
verses.RVR09: Y todas estas cosas, principio de dolores.

verses.KJV: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
verses.WEB: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
verses.ASV: Then shall they deliver you up unto tribulation, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all the nations for my name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vos entregarão para serdes afligidos, e vos matarão; e sereis odiados por todas as nações, por causa do meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Entonces os entregarán para ser afligidos, y os matarán; y seréis aborrecidos de todas las gentes por causa de mi nombre.

verses.KJV: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.WEB: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
verses.ASV: And then shall many stumble, and shall deliver up one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos tropeçarão na fé; e trairão uns aos outros, e uns aos outros se odiarão.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos entonces serán escandalizados; y se entregarán unos á otros, y unos á otros se aborrecerán.

verses.KJV: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.WEB: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
verses.ASV: And many false prophets shall arise, and shall lead many astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos falsos profetas se levantarão, e enganarão a muitos.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos falsos profetas se levantarán y engañarán á muchos.

verses.KJV: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.WEB: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
verses.ASV: And because iniquity shall be multiplied, the love of the many shall wax cold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, por se multiplicar a injustiça, o amor de muitos se esfriará.
verses.RVR09: Y por haberse multiplicado la maldad, la caridad de muchos se resfriará.

verses.KJV: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.WEB: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.ASV: But he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que perseverare hasta el fin, éste será salvo.

verses.KJV: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.WEB: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
verses.ASV: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole world for a testimony unto all the nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este Evangelho do Reino será pregado em todo o mundo, como testemunho a todas as nações, e então virá o fim.
verses.RVR09: Y será predicado este evangelio del reino en todo el mundo, por testimonio á todos los Gentiles; y entonces vendrá el fin.

verses.KJV: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.WEB: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
verses.ASV: When therefore ye see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let him that readeth understand),
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quando virdes que a abominação da desolação, dita pelo profeta Daniel, está no lugar santo, (quem lê, entenda),
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, cuando viereis la abominación del asolamiento, que fué dicha por Daniel profeta, que estará en el lugar santo, (el que lee, entienda),

verses.KJV: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.WEB: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.ASV: then let them that are in Judæa flee unto the mountains:
verses.ALMEIDA: então os que estiveram na Judeia fujam para os montes;
verses.RVR09: Entonces los que están en Judea, huyan á los montes;

verses.KJV: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.WEB: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
verses.ASV: let him that is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house:
verses.ALMEIDA: o que estiver no sobre o telhado não desça para tirar alguma coisa de sua casa;
verses.RVR09: Y el que sobre el terrado, no descienda á tomar algo de su casa;

verses.KJV: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.WEB: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
verses.ASV: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o que estiver no campo não volte atrás para tomar as suas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Y el que en el campo, no vuelva atrás á tomar sus vestidos.

verses.KJV: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.WEB: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
verses.ASV: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ai das grávidas e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de las preñadas, y de las que crían en aquellos días!

verses.KJV: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.WEB: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,
verses.ASV: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on a sabbath:
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai, porém, para que a vossa fuga não aconteça no inverno, nem no sábado.
verses.RVR09: Orad, pues, que vuestra huída no sea en invierno ni en sábado;

verses.KJV: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.WEB: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
verses.ASV: for then shall be great tribulation, such as hath not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois haverá então grande aflição, como nunca houve desde o princípio do mundo até agora, nem jamais haverá.
verses.RVR09: Porque habrá entonces grande aflicción, cual no fué desde el principio del mundo hasta ahora, ni será.

verses.KJV: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.WEB: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
verses.ASV: And except those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se aqueles dias não fossem encurtados, ninguém se salvaria; mas por causa dos escolhidos, aqueles dias serão encurtados.
verses.RVR09: Y si aquellos días no fuesen acortados, ninguna carne sería salva; mas por causa de los escogidos, aquellos días serán acortados.

verses.KJV: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
verses.WEB: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.
verses.ASV: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ, or, Here; believe [it] not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, se alguém vos disser: “Olha o Cristo aqui”, ou “ [Olha ele] ali”, não creiais,
verses.RVR09: Entonces, si alguno os dijere: He aquí está el Cristo, ó allí, no creáis.

verses.KJV: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.WEB: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
verses.ASV: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois se levantarão falsos cristos e falsos profetas; e farão tão grandes sinais e prodígios que, se fosse possível, enganariam até os escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Porque se levantarán falsos Cristos, y falsos profetas, y darán señales grandes y prodigios; de tal manera que engañarán, si es posible, aun á los escogidos.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have told you beforehand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu tenho vos dito com antecedência.
verses.RVR09: He aquí os lo he dicho antes.

verses.KJV: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
verses.WEB: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
verses.ASV: If therefore they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the wilderness; go not forth: Behold, he is in the inner chambers; believe [it] not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se vos disserem: “Eis que ele está no deserto”, não saiais; “Eis que ele está em um recinto”, não creiais.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si os dijeren: He aquí en el desierto está; no salgáis: He aquí en las cámaras; no creáis.

verses.KJV: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.WEB: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.ASV: For as the lightning cometh forth from the east, and is seen even unto the west; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, assim como o relâmpago, que sai do oriente, e aparece até o ocidente, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque como el relámpago que sale del oriente y se muestra hasta el occidente, así será también la venida del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.WEB: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
verses.ASV: Wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois onde estiver o cadáver, ali se ajuntarão os abutres.
verses.RVR09: Porque donde quiera que estuviere el cuerpo muerto, allí se juntarán las águilas.

verses.KJV: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.WEB: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
verses.ASV: But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo depois da aflição daqueles dias, o sol se escurecerá, a lua não dará o seu brilho, as estrelas cairão do céu, e as forças dos céus se estremecerão.
verses.RVR09: Y luego después de la aflicción de aquellos días, el sol se obscurecerá, y la luna no dará su lumbre, y las estrellas caerán del cielo, y las virtudes de los cielos serán conmovidas.

verses.KJV: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.WEB: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
verses.ASV: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aparecerá no céu o sinal do Filho do homem. Naquela hora todas as tribos da terra lamentarão, e verão ao Filho do homem, que vem sobre as nuvens do céu, com poder e grande glória.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces se mostrará la señal del Hijo del hombre en el cielo; y entonces lamentarán todas las tribus de la tierra, y verán al Hijo del hombre que vendrá sobre las nubes del cielo, con grande poder y gloria.

verses.KJV: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.WEB: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
verses.ASV: And he shall send forth his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviará os seus anjos com grande som de trombeta, e ajuntarão os seus escolhidos desde os quatro ventos, de uma extremidade à outra dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y enviará sus ángeles con gran voz de trompeta, y juntarán sus escogidos de los cuatro vientos, de un cabo del cielo hasta el otro.

verses.KJV: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
verses.WEB: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
verses.ASV: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aprendei a parábola da figueira: “Quando os seus ramos já ficam verdes, e as folhas brotam, sabeis que o verão [está] perto”.
verses.RVR09: De la higuera aprended la parábola: Cuando ya su rama se enternece, y las hojas brotan, sabéis que el verano está cerca.

verses.KJV: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
verses.WEB: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.
verses.ASV: even so ye also, when ye see all these things, know ye that he is nigh, [even] at the doors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, quando virdes todas estas coisas, sabei que já está perto, às portas.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, cuando viereis todas estas cosas, sabed que está cercano, á las puertas.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all these things be accomplished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que esta geração não passará, até que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que no pasará esta generación, que todas estas cosas no acontezcan.

verses.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O céu e a terra passarão, mas minhas palavras de maneira nenhuma passarão.
verses.RVR09: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, mas mis palabras no pasarán.

verses.KJV: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.WEB: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.ASV: But of that day and hour knoweth no one, not even the angels of heaven, neither the Son, but the Father only.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém daquele dia e hora, ninguém sabe, nem os anjos do céu, a não ser meu Pai somente.
verses.RVR09: Empero del día y hora nadie sabe, ni aun los ángeles de los cielos, sino mi Padre solo.

verses.KJV: But as the days of Noah were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.WEB: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.ASV: And as [were] the days of Noah, so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como foram os dias de Noé, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Mas como los días de Noé, así será la venida del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.WEB: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
verses.ASV: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, assim como nos dias antes do dilúvio comiam, bebiam, casavam, e davam-se em casamento, até o dia em que Noé entrou na arca;
verses.RVR09: Porque como en los días antes del diluvio estaban comiendo y bebiendo, casándose y dando en casamiento, hasta el día que Noé entró en el arca,

verses.KJV: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.WEB: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.ASV: and they knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: e não sabiam, até que veio o dilúvio, e levou todos, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y no conocieron hasta que vino el diluvio y llevó á todos, así será también la venida del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.WEB: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.ASV: Then shall two men be in the field; one is taken, and one is left:
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela hora dois estarão no campo; um será tomado, e o outro será deixado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces estarán dos en el campo; el uno será tomado, y el otro será dejado:

verses.KJV: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.WEB: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.ASV: two women [shall be] grinding at the mill; one is taken, and one is left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Duas estarão moendo em um moinho; uma será tomada, e a outra será deixada.
verses.RVR09: Dos mujeres moliendo á un molinillo; la una será tomada, y la otra será dejada.

verses.KJV: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
verses.ASV: Watch therefore: for ye know not on what day your Lord cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai, pois, porque não sabeis em que hora o vosso Senhor virá.
verses.RVR09: Velad pues, porque no sabéis á qué hora ha de venir vuestro Señor.

verses.KJV: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.WEB: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.ASV: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém sabei isto: se o dono de casa soubesse a que hora da noite o ladrão viria, vigiaria, e não deixaria invadir a sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero sabed, que si el padre de la familia supiese á cuál vela el ladrón había de venir, velaría, y no dejaría minar su casa.

verses.KJV: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.WEB: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
verses.ASV: Therefore be ye also ready; for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto também vós estai prontos, porque o Filho do homem virá na hora que não esperais.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, también vosotros estad apercibidos; porque el Hijo del hombre ha de venir á la hora que no pensáis.

verses.KJV: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.WEB: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
verses.ASV: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem é o servo fiel e prudente, ao qual o seu senhor pôs sobre os seus trabalhadores, para [lhes] dar alimento no tempo devido?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién pues es el siervo fiel y prudente, al cual puso su señor sobre su familia para que les dé alimento á tiempo?

verses.KJV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.WEB: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
verses.ASV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Feliz será aquele servo a quem, quando o seu senhor vier, achar fazendo assim.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado aquel siervo, al cual, cuando su señor viniere, le hallare haciendo así.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que ele o porá sobre todos os seus bens.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que sobre todos sus bienes le pondrá.

verses.KJV: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.WEB: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
verses.ASV: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord tarrieth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se aquele servo mau disser em seu coração: “Meu senhor está demorando a chegar”,
verses.RVR09: Y si aquel siervo malo dijere en su corazón: Mi señor se tarda en venir:

verses.KJV: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.WEB: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
verses.ASV: and shall begin to beat his fellow-servants, and shall eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.ALMEIDA: e começar a espancar os [seus] companheiros de serviço, e a comer, e a beber com os beberrões,
verses.RVR09: Y comenzare á herir á sus consiervos, y aun á comer y á beber con los borrachos;

verses.KJV: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.WEB: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
verses.ASV: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not,
verses.ALMEIDA: o senhor daquele servo chegará num dia que ele não espera, e numa hora que ele não sabe,
verses.RVR09: Vendrá el señor de aquel siervo en el día que no espera, y á la hora que no sabe,

verses.KJV: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
verses.ASV: and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o despedaçará, e porá sua parte com os hipócritas; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
verses.RVR09: Y le cortará por medio, y pondrá su parte con los hipócritas: allí será el lloro y el crujir de dientes.

verses.KJV: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.WEB: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.ASV: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o Reino dos céus será semelhante a dez virgens, que tomaram suas lâmpadas, e saíram ao encontro do noivo.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES el reino de los cielos será semejante á diez vírgenes, que tomando sus lámparas, salieron á recibir al esposo.

verses.KJV: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.WEB: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.ASV: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cinco delas eram prudentes, e cinco tolas.
verses.RVR09: Y las cinco de ellas eran prudentes, y las cinco fatuas.

verses.KJV: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.WEB: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
verses.ASV: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:
verses.ALMEIDA: As tolas, quando tomaram as suas lâmpadas, não tomaram azeite consigo.
verses.RVR09: Las que eran fatuas, tomando sus lámparas, no tomaron consigo aceite;

verses.KJV: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.WEB: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.ASV: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as prudentes tomaram azeite nos seus frascos, com as suas lâmpadas.
verses.RVR09: Mas las prudentes tomaron aceite en sus vasos, juntamente con sus lámparas.

verses.KJV: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.WEB: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.ASV: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.ALMEIDA: O noivo demorou, por isso todas cochilaram e adormeceram.
verses.RVR09: Y tardándose el esposo, cabecearon todas, y se durmieron.

verses.KJV: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.WEB: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
verses.ASV: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas à meia-noite houve um grito: “Eis que vem o noivo! Ide ao seu encontro!”.
verses.RVR09: Y á la media noche fué oído un clamor: He aquí, el esposo viene; salid á recibirle.

verses.KJV: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.WEB: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.ASV: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todas aquelas virgens se levantaram, e prepararam suas lâmpadas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todas aquellas vírgenes se levantaron, y aderezaron sus lámparas.

verses.KJV: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.WEB: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.ASV: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as tolas disseram às prudentes: “Dai-nos do vosso azeite, porque as nossas lâmpadas estão se apagando”.
verses.RVR09: Y las fatuas dijeron á las prudentes: Dadnos de vuestro aceite; porque nuestras lámparas se apagan.

verses.KJV: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.WEB: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
verses.ASV: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as prudentes responderam: “ [Não] ,para que não falte a nós e a vós; em vez disso, ide aos vendedores, e comprai para vós mesmas”.
verses.RVR09: Mas las prudentes respondieron, diciendo: Porque no nos falte á nosotras y á vosotras, id antes á los que venden, y comprad para vosotras.

verses.KJV: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.WEB: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
verses.ASV: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto elas foram comprar, veio o noivo. As que estavam preparadas entraram com ele à festa do casamento, e fechou-se a porta.
verses.RVR09: Y mientras que ellas iban á comprar, vino el esposo; y las que estaban apercibidas, entraron con él á las bodas; y se cerró la puerta.

verses.KJV: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.WEB: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
verses.ASV: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois vieram também as outras virgens, dizendo: “Senhor, Senhor, abre-nos!”
verses.RVR09: Y después vinieron también las otras vírgenes, diciendo: Señor, Señor, ábrenos.

verses.KJV: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.WEB: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
verses.ASV: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele respondeu: “Em verdade vos digo que não vos conheço”.
verses.RVR09: Mas respondiendo él, dijo: De cierto os digo, que no os conozco.

verses.KJV: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
verses.ASV: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, vigiai, porque não sabeis o dia nem a hora em que o Filho do homem virá.
verses.RVR09: Velad, pues, porque no sabéis el día ni la hora en que el Hijo del hombre ha de venir.

verses.KJV: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.WEB: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
verses.ASV: For [it is] as [when] a man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois [é] como um homem, que partindo para fora do país, chamou seus servos, e lhes entregou os seus bens.
verses.RVR09: Porque el reino de los cielos es como un hombre que partiéndose lejos llamó á sus siervos, y les entregó sus bienes.

verses.KJV: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.WEB: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
verses.ASV: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a um deu cinco talentos, a outro dois, e ao terceiro um, a cada um conforme a sua habilidade, e logo depois partiu em viagem.
verses.RVR09: Y á éste dió cinco talentos, y al otro dos, y al otro uno: á cada uno conforme á su facultad; y luego se partió lejos.

verses.KJV: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.WEB: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
verses.ASV: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida, o que havia recebido cinco talentos foi fazer negócios com eles, e obteve outros cinco talentos.
verses.RVR09: Y el que había recibido cinco talentos se fué, y granjeó con ellos, é hizo otros cinco talentos.

verses.KJV: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.WEB: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
verses.ASV: In like manner he also that [received] the two gained other two.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, semelhantemente, o que [havia recebido] dois ganhou também outros dois.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el que había recibido dos, ganó también él otros dos.

verses.KJV: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
verses.WEB: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
verses.ASV: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que tinha recebido um foi cavar a terra, e escondeu o dinheiro do seu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que había recibido uno, fué y cavó en la tierra, y escondió el dinero de su señor.

verses.KJV: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.WEB: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
verses.ASV: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muito tempo depois, o senhor daqueles servos veio fazer contas com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y después de mucho tiempo, vino el señor de aquellos siervos, é hizo cuentas con ellos.

verses.KJV: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.WEB: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
verses.ASV: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que havia recebido cinco talentos chegou trazendo-lhe outros cinco talentos, e disse: ”Senhor, cinco talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros cinco talentos”.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando el que había recibido cinco talentos, trajo otros cinco talentos, diciendo: Señor, cinco talentos me entregaste; he aquí otros cinco talentos he ganado sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.WEB: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.ASV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o seu senhor lhe disse: “ [Muito] bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.
verses.RVR09: Y su señor le dijo: Bien, buen siervo y fiel; sobre poco has sido fiel, sobre mucho te pondré: entra en el gozo de tu señor.

verses.KJV: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.WEB: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
verses.ASV: And he also that [received] the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando-se também o que havia recebido dois talentos, disse: “Senhor, dois talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros dois talentos”.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando también el que había recibido dos talentos, dijo: Señor, dos talentos me entregaste; he aquí otros dos talentos he ganado sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.WEB: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.ASV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu senhor lhe disse: “ [Muito] bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.
verses.RVR09: Su señor le dijo: Bien, buen siervo y fiel; sobre poco has sido fiel, sobre mucho te pondré: entra en el gozo de tu señor.

verses.KJV: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.WEB: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
verses.ASV: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, chegando também o que havia recebido um talento, disse: “Senhor, eu te conhecia, que és homem duro, que colhes onde não semeaste, e ajuntas onde não espalhaste;
verses.RVR09: Y llegando también el que había recibido un talento, dijo: Señor, te conocía que eres hombre duro, que siegas donde no sembraste, y recoges donde no esparciste;

verses.KJV: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
verses.WEB: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
verses.ASV: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, atemorizado, fui e escondi o teu talento na terra; eis aqui tens o que é teu”.
verses.RVR09: Y tuve miedo, y fuí, y escondí tu talento en la tierra: he aquí tienes lo que es tuyo.

verses.KJV: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.WEB: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
verses.ASV: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém seu senhor lhe respondeu: “Servo mau e preguiçoso! Sabias que colho onde não semeei, e ajunto onde não espalhei.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo su señor, le dijo: Malo y negligente siervo, sabías que siego donde no sembré y que recojo donde no esparcí;

verses.KJV: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.WEB: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
verses.ASV: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Devias, portanto, ter depositado o meu dinheiro com os banqueiros e, quando eu voltasse, receberia o que é meu com juros.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto te convenía dar mi dinero á los banqueros, y viniendo yo, hubiera recibido lo que es mío con usura.

verses.KJV: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.WEB: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
verses.ASV: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, tirai dele o talento, e dai-o ao que tem dez talentos”.
verses.RVR09: Quitadle pues el talento, y dadlo al que tiene diez talentos.

verses.KJV: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.WEB: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
verses.ASV: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a todo aquele que tiver, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; porém ao que não tiver, até o que tem lhe será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Porque á cualquiera que tuviere, le será dado, y tendrá más; y al que no tuviere, aun lo que tiene le será quitado.

verses.KJV: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.WEB: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.ASV: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

verses.KJV: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

verses.KJV: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

verses.WEB: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

verses.RVR09: Entonces también ellos le responderán, diciendo: Señor, ¿cuándo te vimos hambriento, ó sediento, ó huésped, ó desnudo, ó enfermo, ó en la cárcel, y no te servimos?

verses.KJV: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
verses.WEB: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
verses.ASV: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.

verses.KJV: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.WEB: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que, como hubo acabado Jesús todas estas palabras, dijo á sus discípulos:

verses.KJV: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

verses.ASV: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the elders of the people, unto the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas;

verses.RVR09: Y entendiéndolo Jesús, les dijo: ¿Por qué dais pena á esta mujer? pues ha hecho conmigo buena obra.

verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que donde quiera que este evangelio fuere predicado en todo el mundo, también será dicho para memoria de ella, lo que ésta ha hecho.

verses.KJV: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

verses.ASV: and said, What are ye willing to give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they weighed unto him thirty pieces of silver.

verses.ASV: Now on the first [day] of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where wilt thou that we make ready for thee to eat the passover?

verses.RVR09: Y el primer día de la fiesta de los panes sin levadura, vinieron los discípulos á Jesús, diciéndole: ¿Dónde quieres que aderecemos para ti para comer la pascua?

verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Id á la ciudad á cierto hombre, y decidle: El Maestro dice: Mi tiempo está cerca; en tu casa haré la pascua con mis discípulos.

verses.KJV: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

verses.ASV: and as they were eating, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.ALMEIDA: De fato, o Filho do homem vai assim como dele está escrito; mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído! Bom seria a tal homem se não houvesse nascido.
verses.RVR09: A la verdad el Hijo del hombre va, como está escrito de él; mas ¡ay de aquel hombre por quien el Hijo del hombre es entregado! bueno le fuera al tal hombre no haber nacido.

verses.KJV: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
