verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Judas, que le entregaba, dijo: ¿Soy yo, Maestro? Dícele: Tú lo has dicho.

verses.KJV: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.WEB: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
verses.ASV: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it; and he gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto comiam, Jesus tomou o pão, abençoou-o, e o partiu. Então o deu aos discípulos, e disse: Tomai, comei; isto é o meu corpo.
verses.RVR09: Y comiendo ellos, tomó Jesús el pan, y bendijo, y lo partió, y dió á sus discípulos, y dijo: Tomad, comed: esto es mi cuerpo.

verses.KJV: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.WEB: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
verses.ASV: And he took a cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida tomou o cálice, deu graças, e o deu a eles, dizendo: Bebei dele todos,
verses.RVR09: Y tomando el vaso, y hechas gracias, les dió, diciendo: Bebed de él todos;

verses.KJV: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.WEB: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
verses.ASV: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many unto remission of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque este é o meu sangue, o [sangue] do novo testamento, o qual é derramado por muitos, para o perdão de pecados.
verses.RVR09: Porque esto es mi sangre del nuevo pacto, la cual es derramada por muchos para remisión de los pecados.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.WEB: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: But I say unto you, I shall not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos digo que desde agora não beberei deste fruto da vide, até aquele dia, quando convosco o beber, novo, no reino do meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Y os digo, que desde ahora no beberé más de este fruto de la vid, hasta aquel día, cuando lo tengo de beber nuevo con vosotros en el reino de mi Padre.

verses.KJV: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.WEB: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.ASV: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de cantarem um hino, saíram para o monte das Oliveiras.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo cantado el himno, salieron al monte de las Olivas.

verses.KJV: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended in me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhes disse: Todos vós falhareis comigo esta noite; porque está escrito: “Ferirei o pastor, e as ovelhas do rebanho serão dispersas”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dice: Todos vosotros seréis escandalizados en mí esta noche; porque escrito está: Heriré al Pastor, y las ovejas de la manada serán dispersas.

verses.KJV: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.WEB: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
verses.ASV: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, depois que eu for ressuscitado, irei adiante de vós para a Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Mas después que haya resucitado, iré delante de vosotros á Galilea.

verses.KJV: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.WEB: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
verses.ASV: But Peter answered and said unto him, If all shall be offended in thee, I will never be offended.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro, porém, respondeu-lhe: Ainda que todos falhem contigo, eu nunca falharei.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Pedro, le dijo: Aunque todos sean escandalizados en ti, yo nunca seré escandalizado.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: Em verdade te digo que, nesta mesma noite, antes do galo cantar, tu me negarás três vezes.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dice: De cierto te digo que esta noche, antes que el gallo cante, me negarás tres veces.

verses.KJV: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.WEB: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
verses.ASV: Peter saith unto him, Even if I must die with thee, [yet] will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro lhe respondeu: Ainda que eu tenha de morrer contigo, em nenhuma maneira te negarei. E todos os discípulos disseram o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Pedro: Aunque me sea menester morir contigo, no te negaré. Y todos los discípulos dijeron lo mismo.

verses.KJV: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
verses.ASV: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I go yonder and pray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus veio com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e disse aos discípulos: Ficai sentados aqui, enquanto eu vou ali orar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegó Jesús con ellos á la aldea que se llama Gethsemaní, y dice á sus discípulos: Sentaos aquí, hasta que vaya allí y ore.

verses.KJV: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.WEB: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
verses.ASV: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and sore troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto trazia consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, ele começou a se entristecer e a se angustiar muito.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando á Pedro, y á los dos hijos de Zebedeo, comenzó á entristecerse y á angustiarse en gran manera.

verses.KJV: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
verses.ASV: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: abide ye here, and watch with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhes disse: Minha alma está completamente triste até a morte. Ficai aqui, e vigiai comigo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dice: Mi alma está muy triste hasta la muerte; quedaos aquí, y velad conmigo.

verses.KJV: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.WEB: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
verses.ASV: And he went forward a little, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass away from me: nevertheless, not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo um pouco mais adiante, prostrou-se sobre o seu rosto, orando, e dizendo: Meu Pai, se é possível, passe de mim este cálice; porém, não [seja] como eu quero, mas sim como tu [queres] .
verses.RVR09: Y yéndose un poco más adelante, se postró sobre su rostro, orando, y diciendo: Padre mío, si es posible, pase de mí este vaso; empero no como yo quiero, sino como tú.

verses.KJV: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.WEB: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
verses.ASV: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou aos seus discípulos, e os encontrou dormindo; e disse a Pedro: Então, nem sequer uma hora pudestes vigiar comigo?
verses.RVR09: Y vino á sus discípulos, y los halló durmiendo, y dijo á Pedro: ¿Así no habéis podido velar conmigo una hora?

verses.KJV: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.WEB: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.ASV: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai e orai, para que não entreis em tentação. De fato, o espírito [está] pronto, mas a carne [é] fraca.
verses.RVR09: Velad y orad, para que no entréis en tentación: el espíritu á la verdad está presto, mas la carne enferma.

verses.KJV: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.WEB: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
verses.ASV: Again a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cannot pass away, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele foi orar pela segunda vez, dizendo: Meu Pai, se este cálice não pode passar de mim sem que eu o beba, faça-se a tua vontade.
verses.RVR09: Otra vez fué, segunda vez, y oró diciendo: Padre mío, si no puede este vaso pasar de mí sin que yo lo beba, hágase tu voluntad.

verses.KJV: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.WEB: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.ASV: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando voltou, achou-os outra vez dormindo, pois os seus olhos estavam pesados.
verses.RVR09: Y vino, y los halló otra vez durmiendo; porque los ojos de ellos estaban agravados.

verses.KJV: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.WEB: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
verses.ASV: And he left them again, and went away, and prayed a third time, saying again the same words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os deixou, e foi orar pela terceira vez, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y dejándolos fuése de nuevo, y oró tercera vez, diciendo las mismas palabras.

verses.KJV: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.WEB: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.ASV: Then cometh he to the disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois veio aos seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Agora dormi e descansai. Eis que chegou a hora em que o Filho do homem é entregue em mãos de pecadores.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vino á sus discípulos y díceles: Dormid ya, y descansad: he aquí ha llegado la hora, y el Hijo del hombre es entregado en manos de pecadores.

verses.KJV: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.WEB: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
verses.ASV: Arise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that betrayeth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, vamos! Eis que chegou o que me trai.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, vamos: he aquí ha llegado el que me ha entregado.

verses.KJV: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.ASV: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ele ainda estava falando, eis que veio Judas, um dos doze, e com ele uma grande multidão, com espadas e bastões, da parte dos chefes dos sacerdotes e dos anciãos do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y hablando aún él, he aquí Judas, uno de los doce, vino, y con él mucha gente con espadas y con palos, de parte de los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y de los ancianos del pueblo.

verses.KJV: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.WEB: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
verses.ASV: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he: take him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O seu traidor havia lhes dado sinal, dizendo: Aquele a quem eu beijar, é esse. Prendei-o.
verses.RVR09: Y el que le entregaba les había dado señal, diciendo: Al que yo besare, aquél es: prendedle.

verses.KJV: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.WEB: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
verses.ASV: And straightway he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, Rabbi; and kissed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo ele se aproximou de Jesus, e disse: Felicitações, Rabi! e o beijou.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que llegó á Jesús, dijo: Salve, Maestro. Y le besó.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, [do] that for which thou art come. Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, porém, lhe perguntou: Amigo, para que vieste? Então chegaram, agarraram Jesus, e o prenderam.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Amigo, ¿á qué vienes? Entonces llegaron, y echaron mano á Jesús, y le prendieron.

verses.KJV: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.WEB: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.ASV: And behold, one of them that were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um dos que [estavam] com Jesus estendeu a mão, puxou de sua espada, e feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe uma orelha.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, uno de los que estaban con Jesús, extendiendo la mano, sacó su espada, é hiriendo á un siervo del pontífice, le quitó la oreja.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
verses.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, então, lhe disse: Põe de volta tua espada ao seu lugar, pois todos os que pegarem espada, pela espada perecerão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús le dice: Vuelve tu espada á su lugar; porque todos los que tomaren espada, á espada perecerán.

verses.KJV: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.WEB: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.ASV: Or thinkest thou that I cannot beseech my Father, and he shall even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou, por acaso, pensas tu que eu não posso agora orar ao meu Pai, e ele me daria mais de doze legiões de anjos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Acaso piensas que no puedo ahora orar á mi Padre, y él me daría más de doce legiones de ángeles?

verses.KJV: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.WEB: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
verses.ASV: How then should the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como, pois, se cumpririam as Escrituras [que dizem] que assim tem que ser feito?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo, pues, se cumplirían las Escrituras, que así conviene que sea hecho?

verses.KJV: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.WEB: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
verses.ASV: In that hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a robber with swords and staves to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and ye took me not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela hora Jesus disse às multidões: Como a um ladrão saístes com espadas e bastões para me prender? Todo dia eu me sentava convosco, ensinando no templo, e não me prendestes.
verses.RVR09: En aquella hora dijo Jesús á las gentes: ¿Como á ladrón habéis salido con espadas y con palos á prenderme? Cada día me sentaba con vosotros enseñando en el templo, y no me prendisteis.

verses.KJV: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.WEB: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
verses.ASV: But all this is come to pass, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tudo isto aconteceu para que as Escrituras dos profetas se cumpram.Então todos os discípulos o abandonaram, e fugiram.
verses.RVR09: Mas todo esto se hace, para que se cumplan las Escrituras de los profetas. Entonces todos los discípulos huyeron, dejándole.

verses.KJV: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.WEB: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
verses.ASV: And they that had taken Jesus led him away to [the house of] Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que prenderam Jesus o trouxeram [à casa] de Caifás, o sumo sacerdote, onde os escribas e os anciãos estavam reunidos.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, prendido Jesús, le llevaron á Caifás pontífice, donde los escribas y los ancianos estaban juntos.

verses.KJV: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.WEB: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
verses.ASV: But Peter followed him afar off, unto the court of the high priest, and entered in, and sat with the officers, to see the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro o seguia de longe, até o pátio do sumo sacerdote; e entrou, e se assentou com os servos, para ver o fim.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pedro le seguía de lejos hasta el patio del pontífice; y entrando dentro, estábase sentado con los criados, para ver el fin.

verses.KJV: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.WEB: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
verses.ASV: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought false witness against Jesus, that they might put him to death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os chefes dos sacerdotes, os anciãos, e todo o supremo conselho buscavam falso testemunho contra Jesus, para poderem matá-lo,
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los ancianos, y todo el consejo, buscaban falso testimonio contra Jesús, para entregarle á la muerte;

verses.KJV: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.WEB: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
verses.ASV: and they found it not, though many false witnesses came. But afterward came two,
verses.ALMEIDA: mas não encontravam. E ainda que muitas falsas testemunhas se apresentavam, [contudo] não encontravam.
verses.RVR09: Y no lo hallaron, aunque muchos testigos falsos se llegaban; mas á la postre vinieron dos testigos falsos,

verses.KJV: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.WEB: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
verses.ASV: and said, This man said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, por fim, vieram duas falsas testemunhas, que disseram: Este disse: “Posso derrubar o Templo de Deus e reconstruí-lo em três dias”.
verses.RVR09: Que dijeron: Este dijo: Puedo derribar el templo de Dios, y en tres días reedificarlo.

verses.KJV: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.WEB: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
verses.ASV: And the high priest stood up, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sumo sacerdote se levantou, e lhe perguntou: Não respondes nada ao que eles testemunham contra ti?
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose el pontífice, le dijo: ¿No respondes nada? ¿qué testifican éstos contra ti?

verses.KJV: But Jesus held his peace, And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.WEB: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou art the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus ficava calado. Então o sumo sacerdote lhe disse: Ordeno-te pelo Deus vivo que nos digas se tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús callaba. Respondiendo el pontífice, le dijo: Te conjuro por el Dios viviente, que nos digas si eres tú el Cristo, Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Henceforth ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: Tu o disseste. Porém eu vos digo que, desde agora, vereis o Filho do homem, sentado à direita do Poderoso, e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dijo: Tú lo has dicho: y aun os digo, que desde ahora habéis de ver al Hijo del hombre sentado á la diestra de la potencia de Dios, y que viene en las nubes del cielo.

verses.KJV: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.WEB: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
verses.ASV: Then the high priest rent his garments, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy: what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard the blasphemy:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sumo sacerdote rasgou suas roupas, e disse: Ele blasfemou! Para que necessitamos mais de testemunhas? Eis que agora ouvistes a sua blasfêmia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pontífice rasgó sus vestidos, diciendo: Blasfemado ha: ¿qué más necesidad tenemos de testigos? He aquí, ahora habéis oído su blasfemia.

verses.KJV: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.WEB: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
verses.ASV: what think ye? They answered and said, He is worthy of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que vos parece?E eles responderam: Culpado de morte ele é.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué os parece? Y respondiendo ellos, dijeron: Culpado es de muerte.

verses.KJV: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.WEB: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
verses.ASV: Then did they spit in his face and buffet him: and some smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe cuspiram no rosto, e lhe deram socos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le escupieron en el rostro, y le dieron de bofetadas; y otros le herían con mojicones,

verses.KJV: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.WEB: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
verses.ASV: saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ: who is he that struck thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Outros lhe deram bofetadas, e diziam: Profetiza-nos, ó Cristo, quem é o que te feriu?
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Profetízanos tú, Cristo, quién es el que te ha herido.

verses.KJV: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.WEB: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
verses.ASV: Now Peter was sitting without in the court: and a maid came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus the Galilæan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro estava sentado fora no pátio. Uma serva aproximou-se dele, e disse: Também tu estavas com Jesus, o galileu.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro estaba sentado fuera en el patio: y se llegó á él una criada, diciendo: Y tú con Jesús el Galileo estabas.

verses.KJV: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.WEB: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
verses.ASV: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele o negou diante de todos, dizendo: Não sei o que dizes.
verses.RVR09: Mas él negó delante de todos, diciendo: No sé lo que dices.

verses.KJV: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.WEB: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.ASV: And when he was gone out into the porch, another [maid] saw him, and saith unto them that were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele saiu em direção à entrada, outra o viu, e disse aos que ali [estavam] : Também este estava com Jesus, o nazareno.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo él á la puerta, le vió otra, y dijo á los que estaban allí: También éste estaba con Jesús Nazareno.

verses.KJV: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.WEB: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
verses.ASV: And again he denied with an oath, I know not the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele o negou outra vez com um juramento: Não conheço [esse] homem.
verses.RVR09: Y negó otra vez con juramento: No conozco al hombre.

verses.KJV: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.WEB: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
verses.ASV: And after a little while they that stood by came and said to Peter, Of a truth thou also art [one] of them; for thy speech maketh thee known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pouco depois, os que ali estavam se aproximaram, e disseram a Pedro: Verdadeiramente também tu és um deles, pois a tua fala te denuncia.
verses.RVR09: Y un poco después llegaron los que estaban por allí, y dijeron á Pedro: Verdaderamente también tú eres de ellos, porque aun tu habla te hace manifiesto.

verses.KJV: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.WEB: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.ASV: Then began he to curse and to swear, I know not the man. And straightway the cock crew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele começou a amaldiçoar e a jurar: Não conheço [esse] homem!E imediatamente o galo cantou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces comenzó á hacer imprecaciones, y á jurar, diciendo: No conozco al hombre. Y el gallo cantó luego.

verses.KJV: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.WEB: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.ASV: And Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pedro se lembrou da palavra de Jesus, que lhe dissera: Antes do galo cantar, tu me negarás três vezes. Assim ele saiu, e chorou amargamente.
verses.RVR09: Y se acordó Pedro de las palabras de Jesús, que le dijo: Antes que cante el gallo, me negarás tres veces. Y saliéndose fuera, lloró amargamente.

verses.KJV: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.WEB: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
verses.ASV: Now when morning was come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinda a manhã, todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e anciãos do povo juntamente se aconselharam contra Jesus, para o matarem.
verses.RVR09: Y VENIDA la mañana, entraron en consejo todos los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los ancianos del pueblo, contra Jesús, para entregarle á muerte.

verses.KJV: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.WEB: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
verses.ASV: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pilate the governor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o levaram amarrado, e o entregaram a Pôncio Pilatos, o governador.
verses.RVR09: Y le llevaron atado, y le entregaron á Poncio Pilato presidente.

verses.KJV: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.WEB: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.ASV: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judas, o que o havia traído, ao ver que [Jesus] já estava condenado, devolveu, sentindo remorso, as trinta [moedas] de prata aos chefes dos sacerdotes e aos anciãos;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judas, el que le había entregado, viendo que era condenado, volvió arrepentido las treinta piezas de plata á los príncipes de los sacerdotes y á los ancianos,

verses.KJV: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
verses.WEB: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
verses.ASV: saying, I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood. But they said, What is that to us? see thou [to it].
verses.ALMEIDA: e disse: Pequei, traindo sangue inocente. Porém eles disseram: Que nos interessa? Isso é problema teu!
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Yo he pecado entregando la sangre inocente. Mas ellos dijeron: ¿Qué se nos da á nosotros? Viéraslo tú.

verses.KJV: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.WEB: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
verses.ASV: And he cast down the pieces of silver into the sanctuary, and departed; and he went away and hanged himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lançou as [moedas] de prata no templo, saiu, e foi enforcar-se.
verses.RVR09: Y arrojando las piezas de plata en el templo, partióse; y fué, y se ahorcó.

verses.KJV: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.WEB: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
verses.ASV: And the chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os chefes dos sacerdotes tomaram as [moedas] de prata, e disseram: Não é lícito pô-las no tesouro das ofertas, pois isto é preço de sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de los sacerdotes, tomando las piezas de plata, dijeron: No es lícito echarlas en el tesoro de los dones, porque es precio de sangre.

verses.KJV: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.WEB: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
verses.ASV: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então juntamente se aconselharam, e compraram com elas o campo do oleiro, para ser cemitério dos estrangeiros.
verses.RVR09: Mas habido consejo, compraron con ellas el campo del alfarero, por sepultura para los extranjeros.

verses.KJV: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.WEB: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
verses.ASV: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso aquele campo tem sido chamado campo de sangue até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual fué llamado aquel campo, Campo de sangre, hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.WEB: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
verses.ASV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was priced, whom [certain] of the children of Israel did price;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que disse: Tomaram as trinta [moedas] de prata, preço avaliado pelos filhos de Israel, o qual eles avaliaram;
verses.RVR09: Entonces se cumplió lo que fué dicho por el profeta Jeremías, que dijo: Y tomaron las treinta piezas de plata, precio del apreciado, que fué apreciado por los hijos de Israel;

verses.KJV: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.WEB: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
verses.ASV: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: e as deram pelo campo do oleiro, conforme o que o Senhor me mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y las dieron para el campo del alfarero, como me ordenó el Señor.

verses.KJV: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.WEB: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
verses.ASV: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus esteve diante do governador, e o governador lhe perguntou: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E Jesus lhe respondeu: Tu [o] dizes.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús estuvo delante del presidente; y el presidente le preguntó, diciendo: ¿Eres tú el Rey de los judíos? Y Jesús le dijo: Tú lo dices.

verses.KJV: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.WEB: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.ASV: And when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, sendo ele foi acusado pelos chefes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos, nada respondeu.
verses.RVR09: Y siendo acusado por los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y por los ancianos, nada respondió.

verses.KJV: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.WEB: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
verses.ASV: Then saith Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pilatos, então, lhe disse: Não ouves quantas coisas estão testemunhando contra ti?
verses.RVR09: Pilato entonces le dice: ¿No oyes cuántas cosas testifican contra ti?

verses.KJV: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.WEB: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
verses.ASV: And he gave him no answer, not even to one word: insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] não lhe respondeu uma só palavra, de maneira que o governador ficou muito maravilhado.
verses.RVR09: Y no le respondió ni una palabra; de tal manera que el presidente se maravillaba mucho.

verses.KJV: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.WEB: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.
verses.ASV: Now at the feast the governor was wont to release unto the multitude one prisoner, whom they would.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na festa o governador costuma soltar um preso ao povo, qualquer um que quisessem.
verses.RVR09: Y en el día de la fiesta acostumbraba el presidente soltar al pueblo un preso, cual quisiesen.

verses.KJV: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.WEB: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
verses.ASV: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinham então um preso bem conhecido, chamado Barrabás.
verses.RVR09: Y tenían entonces un preso famoso que se llamaba Barrabás.

verses.KJV: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.WEB: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
verses.ASV: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, se ajuntaram, Pilatos lhes perguntou: Qual quereis que vos solte? Barrabás, ou Jesus, que é chamado Cristo?
verses.RVR09: Y juntos ellos, les dijo Pilato: ¿Cuál queréis que os suelte? ¿á Barrabás, ó á Jesús que se dice el Cristo?

verses.KJV: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.WEB: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
verses.ASV: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele sabia que foi por inveja que o entregaram.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabía que por envidia le habían entregado.

verses.KJV: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.WEB: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
verses.ASV: And while he was sitting on the judgment-seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that righteous man; for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, enquanto ele estava sentado no assento de juiz, sua mulher lhe enviou a seguinte mensagem: Nada [faças] com aquele justo, pois hoje sofri muito em sonhos por causa dele.
verses.RVR09: Y estando él sentado en el tribunal, su mujer envió á él, diciendo: No tengas que ver con aquel justo; porque hoy he padecido muchas cosas en sueños por causa de él.

verses.KJV: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.WEB: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
verses.ASV: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos persuadiram as multidões a pedirem Barrabás, e a exigirem a morte de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Mas los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos, persuadieron al pueblo que pidiese á Barrabás, y á Jesús matase.

verses.KJV: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.WEB: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
verses.ASV: But the governor answered and said unto them, Which of the two will ye that I release unto you? And they said, Barabbas.
verses.ALMEIDA: O governador lhes perguntou: Qual destes dois quereis que vos solte? E responderam: Barrabás!
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el presidente les dijo: ¿Cuál de los dos queréis que os suelte? Y ellos dijeron: A Barrabás.

verses.KJV: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.WEB: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.ASV: Pilate saith unto them, What then shall I do unto Jesus who is called Christ? They all say, Let him be crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pilatos lhes disse: Que, pois, farei de Jesus, que é chamado Cristo? Todos lhe disseram: Seja crucificado!
verses.RVR09: Pilato les dijo: ¿Qué pues haré de Jesús que se dice el Cristo? Dícenle todos: Sea crucificado.

verses.KJV: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.WEB: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.ASV: And he said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o governador perguntou: Ora, que mal ele fez? Porém gritavam mais: Seja crucificado!
verses.RVR09: Y el presidente les dijo: Pues ¿qué mal ha hecho? Mas ellos gritaban más, diciendo: Sea crucificado.

verses.KJV: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
verses.WEB: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
verses.ASV: So when Pilate saw that he prevailed nothing, but rather that a tumult was arising, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this righteous man; see ye [to it].
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, Pilatos viu que nada adiantava, em vez disso se fazia mais tumulto, ele pegou água, lavou as mãos diante da multidão, e disse: Estou inocente do sangue deste justo. A responsabilidade é vossa.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Pilato que nada adelantaba, antes se hacía más alboroto, tomando agua se lavó las manos delante del pueblo, diciendo: Inocente soy yo de la sangre de este justo: veréislo vosotros.

verses.KJV: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
verses.WEB: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”
verses.ASV: And all the people answered and said, His blood [be] on us, and on our children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo respondeu: O sangue dele [venha] sobre nós, e sobre os nossos filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo todo el pueblo, dijo: Su sangre sea sobre nosotros, y sobre nuestros hijos.

verses.KJV: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.WEB: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
verses.ASV: Then released he unto them Barabbas; but Jesus he scourged and delivered to be crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então soltou-lhes Barrabás, enquanto que mandou açoitar Jesus, e o entregou para ser crucificado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les soltó á Barrabás: y habiendo azotado á Jesús, le entregó para ser crucificado.

verses.KJV: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
verses.WEB: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
verses.ASV: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Prætorium, and gathered unto him the whole band.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida, os soldados do governador levaram Jesus consigo ao pretório, ajuntaram-se a ele toda a unidade miltar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los soldados del presidente llevaron á Jesús al pretorio, y juntaron á él toda la cuadrilla;

verses.KJV: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.WEB: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
verses.ASV: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles o despiram e o cobriram com um manto vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Y desnudándole, le echaron encima un manto de grana;

verses.KJV: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.WEB: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.ASV: And they platted a crown of thorns and put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de tecerem uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-na sobre a sua cabeça, e uma cana em sua mão direita. Em seguida, puseram-se de joelhos diante dele, zombando-o, e diziam: Felicitações, Rei dos Judeus!
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron sobre su cabeza una corona tejida de espinas, y una caña en su mano derecha; é hincando la rodilla delante de él, le burlaban, diciendo: ¡Salve, Rey de los Judíos!

verses.KJV: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.WEB: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
verses.ASV: And they spat upon him, and took the reed and smote him on the head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cuspiram nele, tomaram a cana, e deram-lhe golpes na cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y escupiendo en él, tomaron la caña, y le herían en la cabeza.

verses.KJV: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.WEB: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.ASV: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the robe, and put on him his garments, and led him away to crucify him.

verses.RVR09: Y después que le hubieron escarnecido, le desnudaron el manto, y le vistieron de sus vestidos, y le llevaron para crucificarle.

verses.KJV: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.WEB: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
verses.ASV: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to go [with them], that he might bear his cross.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao saírem, encontraram um homem de Cirene, por nome Simão; e obrigaram-no a levar sua cruz.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo, hallaron á un Cireneo, que se llamaba Simón: á éste cargaron para que llevase su cruz.

verses.KJV: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.WEB: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
verses.ASV: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, The place of a skull,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram ao lugar chamado Gólgota, que significa “o lugar da caveira”,
verses.RVR09: Y como llegaron al lugar que se llama Gólgotha, que es dicho, El lugar de la calavera,

verses.KJV: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
verses.WEB: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
verses.ASV: they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted it, he would not drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: deram-lhe de beber vinagre misturado com fel. E, depois de provar, não quis beber.
verses.RVR09: Le dieron á beber vinagre mezclado con hiel; y gustando, no quiso beberlo.

verses.KJV: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.WEB: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
verses.ASV: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots;
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo-o crucificado, repartiram suas roupas, lançando sortes; para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta: Repartiram entre si minhas roupas, e sobre minha túnica lançaram sortes.
verses.RVR09: Y después que le hubieron crucificado, repartieron sus vestidos, echando suertes: para que se cumpliese lo que fué dicho por el profeta: Se repartieron mis vestidos, y sobre mi ropa echaron suertes.

verses.KJV: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.WEB: and they sat and watched him there.
verses.ASV: and they sat and watched him there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se sentaram, e ali o vigiavam.
verses.RVR09: Y sentados le guardaban allí.

verses.KJV: And set up over his head his accusation written, This Is Jesus The King Of The Jews.
verses.WEB: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.ASV: And they set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram, por cima de sua cabeça, sua acusação escrita: ESTE É JESUS, O REI DOS JUDEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron sobre su cabeza su causa escrita: ESTE ES JESUS EL REY DE LOS JUDIOS.

verses.KJV: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.WEB: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
verses.ASV: Then are there crucified with him two robbers, one on the right hand and one on the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então foram crucificados com ele dois criminosos, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Entonces crucificaron con él dos ladrones, uno á la derecha, y otro á la izquierda.

verses.KJV: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.WEB: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads
verses.ASV: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que passavam blasfemavam dele, balançando suas cabeças,
verses.RVR09: Y los que pasaban, le decían injurias, meneando sus cabezas,

verses.KJV: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.WEB: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
verses.ASV: and saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself: if thou art the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.ALMEIDA: e dizendo: Tu, que derrubas o Templo, e em três dias o reconstróis, salva a ti mesmo! Se és Filho de Deus, desce da cruz.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: Tú, el que derribas el templo, y en tres días lo reedificas, sálvate á ti mismo: si eres Hijo de Dios, desciende de la cruz.

verses.KJV: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.WEB: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
verses.ASV: In like manner also the chief priests mocking [him], with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E da mesma maneira também os chefes dos sacerdotes, com os escribas e os anciãos, escarnecendo [dele] ,diziam:
verses.RVR09: De esta manera también los príncipes de los sacerdotes, escarneciendo con los escribas y los Fariseos y los ancianos, decían:

verses.KJV: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.WEB: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
verses.ASV: He saved others; himself he cannot save. He is the King of Israel; let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salvou outros, a si mesmo não pode salvar. Se é Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, e creremos nele.
verses.RVR09: A otros salvó, á sí mismo no puede salvar: si es el Rey de Israel, descienda ahora de la cruz, y creeremos en él.

verses.KJV: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.WEB: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
verses.ASV: He trusteth on God; let him deliver him now, if he desireth him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confiou em Deus, livre-o agora, se lhe quer bem; pois disse: “Sou Filho de Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Confió en Dios: líbrele ahora si le quiere: porque ha dicho: Soy Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.WEB: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
verses.ASV: And the robbers also that were crucified with him cast upon him the same reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os ladrões que estavam crucificados com ele também lhe insultavam.
verses.RVR09: Lo mismo también le zaherían los ladrones que estaban crucificados con él.

verses.KJV: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.WEB: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.ASV: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde a hora sexta houve trevas sobre toda a terra até a hora nona.
verses.RVR09: Y desde la hora de sexta fueron tinieblas sobre toda la tierra hasta la hora de nona.

verses.KJV: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.WEB: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.ASV: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perto da hora nona, Jesus gritou em alta voz: Eli, Eli, lamá sabactâni?, Isto é: Deus meu, Deus meu, porque me desamparaste?
verses.RVR09: Y cerca de la hora de nona, Jesús exclamó con grande voz, diciendo: Eli, Eli, ¿lama sabachtani? Esto es: Dios mío, Dios mío, ¿por qué me has desamparado?

verses.KJV: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
verses.WEB: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
verses.ASV: And some of them that stood there, when they heard it, said, This man calleth Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos que ali estavam, quando ouviram, disseram: Ele está chamando Elias.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los que estaban allí, oyéndolo, decían: A Elías llama éste.

verses.KJV: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.WEB: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
verses.ASV: And straightway one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo um deles correu e tomou uma esponja. Então a encheu de vinagre, colocou-a em uma cana, e lhe dava de beber.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, corriendo uno de ellos, tomó una esponja, y la hinchió de vinagre, y poniéndola en una caña, dábale de beber.

verses.KJV: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.WEB: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
verses.ASV: And the rest said, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to save him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os outros disseram: Deixa, vejamos se Elias vem livrá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y los otros decían: Deja, veamos si viene Elías á librarle.

verses.KJV: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.WEB: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
verses.ASV: And Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus gritou outra vez em alta voz, e entregou o espírito.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús, habiendo otra vez exclamado con grande voz, dió el espíritu.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.WEB: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
verses.ASV: And behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake; and the rocks were rent;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que o véu do Templo se rasgou em dois, de cima até embaixo, a terra tremeu, e as pedras se fenderam.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, el velo del templo se rompió en dos, de alto á bajo: y la tierra tembló, y las piedras se hendieron;

verses.KJV: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.WEB: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.ASV: and the tombs were opened; and many bodies of the saints that had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sepulcros se abriram, e muitos corpos de santos que tinham morrido foram ressuscitados.
verses.RVR09: Y abriéronse los sepulcros, y muchos cuerpos de santos que habían dormido, se levantaron;

verses.KJV: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.WEB: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.ASV: and coming forth out of the tombs after his resurrection they entered into the holy city and appeared unto many.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de ressuscitarem, saíram dos sepulcros, vieram à santa cidade, e apareceram a muitos.
verses.RVR09: Y salidos de los sepulcros, después de su resurrección, vinieron á la santa ciudad, y aparecieron á muchos.

verses.KJV: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.WEB: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
verses.ASV: Now the centurion, and they that were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o centurião, e os que com ele vigiavam Jesus, ao verem o terremoto e as coisas que haviam sucedido, tiveram muito medo, e disseram: Verdadeiramente ele era Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el centurión, y los que estaban con él guardando á Jesús, visto el terremoto, y las cosas que habían sido hechas, temieron en gran manera, diciendo: Verdaderamente Hijo de Dios era éste.

verses.KJV: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.WEB: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
verses.ASV: And many women were there beholding from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas mulheres, que desde a Galileia haviam seguido Jesus, e o serviam, estavam ali, olhando de longe.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban allí muchas mujeres mirando de lejos, las cuales habían seguido de Galilea á Jesús, sirviéndole:

verses.KJV: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
verses.WEB: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.ASV: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre elas estavam Maria Madalena, e Maria mãe de Tiago e de José, e a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu.
verses.RVR09: Entre las cuales estaban María Magdalena, y María la madre de Jacobo y de José, y la madre de los hijos de Zebedeo.

verses.KJV: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.WEB: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.
verses.ASV: And when even was come, there came a rich man from Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegado o entardecer, veio um homem rico de Arimateia, por nome José, que também era discípulo de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y como fué la tarde del día, vino un hombre rico de Arimatea, llamado José, el cual también había sido discípulo de Jesús.

verses.KJV: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.WEB: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
verses.ASV: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele chegou a Pilatos, e pediu o corpo de Jesus. Então Pilatos mandou que o corpo [lhe] fosse entregue.
verses.RVR09: Este llegó á Pilato, y pidió el cuerpo de Jesús: entonces Pilato mandó que se le diese el cuerpo.

verses.KJV: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.WEB: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
verses.ASV: And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.ALMEIDA: José tomou o corpo, e o envolveu em um lençol limpo, de linho fino,
verses.RVR09: Y tomando José el cuerpo, lo envolvió en una sábana limpia,

verses.KJV: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.WEB: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.ASV: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o pôs em seu sepulcro novo, que tinha escavado numa rocha; em seguida rolou uma grande pedra à porta do sepulcro, e foi embora.
verses.RVR09: Y lo puso en su sepulcro nuevo, que había labrado en la peña: y revuelta una grande piedra á la puerta del sepulcro, se fué.

verses.KJV: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.WEB: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.ASV: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali estavam Maria Madalena e a outra Maria, sentadas de frente ao sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban allí María Magdalena, y la otra María, sentadas delante del sepulcro.

verses.KJV: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.WEB: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
verses.ASV: Now on the morrow, which is [the day] after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together unto Pilate,
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia seguinte, que é o depois da preparação, os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os fariseus se reuniram com Pilatos,
verses.RVR09: Y el siguiente día, que es después de la preparación, se juntaron los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los Fariseos á Pilato,

verses.KJV: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.WEB: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
verses.ASV: saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said while he was yet alive, After three days I rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: e disseram: Senhor, nos lembramos que aquele enganador, enquanto ainda vivia, disse: “Depois de três dias serei ressuscitado”.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Señor, nos acordamos que aquel engañador dijo, viviendo aún: Después de tres días resucitaré.

verses.KJV: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.WEB: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
verses.ASV: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest haply his disciples come and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, manda que o sepulcro esteja em segurança até o terceiro dia, para que não aconteça dos seus discípulos virem de noite, e o furtem, e digam ao povo que ele ressuscitou dos mortos; e [assim] o último engano será pior que o primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Manda, pues, que se asegure el sepulcro hasta el día tercero; porque no vengan sus discípulos de noche, y le hurten, y digan al pueblo: Resucitó de los muertos. Y será el postrer error peor que el primero.

verses.KJV: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
verses.WEB: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
verses.ASV: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a guard: go, make it [as] sure as ye can.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pilatos lhes disse: Vós tendes uma guarda. Ide fazer segurança como o entendeis.
verses.RVR09: Y Pilato les dijo: Tenéis una guardia: id, aseguradlo como sabéis.

verses.KJV: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.WEB: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
verses.ASV: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, the guard being with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles se foram, e fizeram segurança no sepulcro com a guarda, selando a pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo ellos, aseguraron el sepulcro, sellando la piedra, con la guardia.

verses.KJV: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.WEB: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
verses.ASV: Now late on the sabbath day, as it began to dawn toward the first [day] of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.ALMEIDA: No fim do sábado, quando já começava a clarear para o primeiro dia da semana, Maria Madalena, e a outra Maria vieram ver o sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y LA víspera de sábado, que amanece para el primer día de la semana, vino María Magdalena, y la otra María, á ver el sepulcro.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.WEB: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
verses.ASV: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que houve um grande terremoto; porque um anjo do Senhor desceu do céu, chegou, e moveu a pedra da entrada, e ficou sentado sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, fué hecho un gran terremoto: porque el ángel del Señor, descendiendo del cielo y llegando, había revuelto la piedra, y estaba sentado sobre ella.

verses.KJV: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.WEB: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.ASV: His appearance was as lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.ALMEIDA: A aparência dele era como um relâmpago, e sua roupa branca como neve.
verses.RVR09: Y su aspecto era como un relámpago, y su vestido blanco como la nieve.

verses.KJV: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
verses.WEB: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
verses.ASV: and for fear of him the watchers did quake, and became as dead men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de medo dele os guardas tremeram muito, e ficaram como mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y de miedo de él los guardas se asombraron, y fueron vueltos como muertos.

verses.KJV: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.WEB: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
verses.ASV: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o anjo disse às mulheres: Não vos atemorizeis, pois eu sei que buscais Jesus, o que foi crucificado.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el ángel, dijo á las mujeres: No temáis vosotras; porque yo sé que buscáis á Jesús, que fué crucificado.

verses.KJV: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.WEB: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
verses.ASV: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não está aqui, pois já ressuscitou, como ele disse. Vinde ver o lugar onde o Senhor jazia.
verses.RVR09: No está aquí; porque ha resucitado, como dijo. Venid, ved el lugar donde fué puesto el Señor.

verses.KJV: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.WEB: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
verses.ASV: And go quickly, and tell his disciples, He is risen from the dead; and lo, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide depressa dizer aos seus discípulos que ele ressuscitou dos mortos; e eis que vai adiante de vós para a Galileia; ali o vereis. Eis que eu tenho vos dito.
verses.RVR09: E id presto, decid á sus discípulos que ha resucitado de los muertos: y he aquí va delante de vosotros á Galilea; allí le veréis; he aquí, os lo he dicho.

verses.KJV: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.WEB: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
verses.ASV: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então elas saíram apressadamente do sepulcro, com temor e grande alegria, e correram para anunciar aos seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellas, saliendo del sepulcro con temor y gran gozo, fueron corriendo á dar las nuevas á sus discípulos. Y mientras iban á dar las nuevas á sus discípulos,

verses.KJV: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.WEB: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.ASV: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, enquanto elas iam anunciar aos seus discípulos, eis que Jesus veio ao encontro delas, e disse: Saudações. Elas se aproximaram, pegaram os pés dele, e o adoraram.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, Jesús les sale al encuentro, diciendo: Salve. Y ellas se llegaron y abrazaron sus pies, y le adoraron.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
verses.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, então, lhes disse: Não temais. Ide anunciar aos meus irmãos para eles irem à Galileia, e ali me verão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dice: No temáis: id, dad las nuevas á mis hermanos, para que vayan á Galilea, y allí me verán.

verses.KJV: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.WEB: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
verses.ASV: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto elas iam, eis que alguns da guarda vieram à cidade, e anunciaram aos chefes dos sacerdotes tudo o que havia acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo ellas, he aquí unos de la guardia vinieron á la ciudad, y dieron aviso á los príncipes de los sacerdotes de todas las cosas que habían acontecido.

verses.KJV: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.WEB: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
verses.ASV: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave much money unto the soldiers,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles se reuniram com os anciãos, depois de decidirem em conjunto, deram muito dinheiro aos soldados,
verses.RVR09: Y juntados con los ancianos, y habido consejo, dieron mucho dinero á los soldados,

verses.KJV: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.WEB: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
verses.ASV: saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Falai: “Os discípulos dele vieram de noite, e o furtaram enquanto estávamos dormindo”.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Decid: Sus discípulos vinieron de noche, y le hurtaron, durmiendo nosotros.

verses.KJV: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.WEB: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
verses.ASV: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se isto for ouvido pelo governador, nós o persuadiremos, e vos manteremos seguros.
