verses.RVR09: Y si esto fuere oído del presidente, nosotros le persuadiremos, y os haremos seguros.

verses.KJV: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.WEB: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
verses.ASV: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying was spread abroad among the Jews, [and continueth] until this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles tomaram o dinheiro e fizeram como foram instruídos. E este dito foi divulgado entre os judeus até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, tomando el dinero, hicieron como estaban instruídos: y este dicho fué divulgado entre los Judíos hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.WEB: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
verses.ASV: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os onze discípulos se foram para a Galileia, ao monte onde Jesus havia lhes ordenado.
verses.RVR09: Mas los once discípulos se fueron á Galilea, al monte donde Jesús les había ordenado.

verses.KJV: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.WEB: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
verses.ASV: And when they saw him, they worshipped [him]; but some doubted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o viram, o adoraram; porém alguns duvidaram.
verses.RVR09: Y como le vieron, le adoraron: mas algunos dudaban.

verses.KJV: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.WEB: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
verses.ASV: And Jesus came to them and spake unto them, saying, All authority hath been given unto me in heaven and on earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus se aproximou deles, e lhes falou: Todo o poder me é dado no céu e na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando Jesús, les habló, diciendo: Toda potestad me es dada en el cielo y en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.WEB: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.ASV: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto ide, fazei discípulos a todas as nações, batizando-os em nome do Pai, do Filho, e do Espírito Santo,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, id, y doctrinad á todos los Gentiles, bautizándolos en el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo:

verses.KJV: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.WEB: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
verses.ASV: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: ensinando-lhes a guardar todas as coisas que eu vos tenho mandado. E eis que eu estou convosco todos os dias, até o fim dos tempos. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Enseñándoles que guarden todas las cosas que os he mandado: y he aquí, yo estoy con vosotros todos los días, hasta el fin del mundo. Amén.

verses.KJV: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
verses.WEB: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.ASV: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Princípio do Evangelho de Jesus Cristo, Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: PRINCIPIO del evangelio de Jesucristo, Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.WEB: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
verses.ASV: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como está escrito nos profetas: Eis que eu envio o meu mensageiro diante de tua face, que preparará o teu caminho diante de ti .
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito en Isaías el profeta: He aquí yo envío á mi mensajero delante de tu faz, que apareje tu camino delante de ti.

verses.KJV: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.WEB: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
verses.ASV: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight;
verses.ALMEIDA: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai suas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Voz del que clama en el desierto: Aparejad el camino del Señor; enderezad sus veredas.

verses.KJV: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
verses.WEB: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
verses.ASV: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: João veio a batizar no deserto, e a pregar o batismo de arrependimento para perdão dos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Bautizaba Juan en el desierto, y predicaba el bautismo del arrepentimiento para remisión de pecados.

verses.KJV: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.WEB: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
verses.ASV: And there went out unto him all the country of Judæa, and all they of Jerusalem; and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a província da Judeia e os de Jerusalém saíam até ele; e eram todos batizados por ele no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y salía á él toda la provincia de Judea, y los de Jerusalem; y eran todos bautizados por él en el río de Jordán, confesando sus pecados.

verses.KJV: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
verses.WEB: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.ASV: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and [had] a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: João se vestia de pelos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em sua cintura; e comia gafanhotos e mel do campo.
verses.RVR09: Y Juan andaba vestido de pelos de camello, y con un cinto de cuero alrededor de sus lomos; y comía langostas y miel silvestre.

verses.KJV: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.WEB: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
verses.ASV: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pregava assim: Após mim vem aquele que é mais forte do que eu. A ele não sou digno de me abaixar para desatar a tira das suas sandálias.
verses.RVR09: Y predicaba, diciendo: Viene tras mí el que es más poderoso que yo, al cual no soy digno de desatar encorvado la correa de sus zapatos.

verses.KJV: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
verses.ASV: I baptized you in water; but he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato eu tenho vos batizado com água, porém ele vos batizará com Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Yo á la verdad os he bautizado con agua; mas él os bautizará con Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
verses.WEB: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, naqueles dias, Jesus de Nazaré da Galileia veio, e foi batizado por João no Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en aquellos días, que Jesús vino de Nazaret de Galilea, y fué bautizado por Juan en el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
verses.WEB: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
verses.ASV: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim que saiu da água, viu os céus se abrirem, e o Espírito, que como pomba descia sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, subiendo del agua, vió abrirse los cielos, y al Espíritu como paloma, que descendía sobre él.

verses.KJV: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.WEB: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
verses.ASV: and a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio uma voz dos céus: Tu és meu Filho amado, em quem me agrado.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo una voz de los cielos que decía: Tú eres mi Hijo amado; en ti tomo contentamiento.

verses.KJV: And immediately the spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo o Espírito o impeliu ao deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y luego el Espíritu le impele al desierto.

verses.KJV: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.WEB: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
verses.ASV: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; and he was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele esteve ali no deserto quarenta dias, tentado por Satanás. Ele estava com os animais selvagens, e os anjos o serviam.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvo allí en el desierto cuarenta días, y era tentado de Satanás; y estaba con las fieras; y los ángeles le servían.

verses.KJV: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
verses.WEB: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
verses.ASV: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que João foi preso, Jesus veio para a Galileia, pregando o Evangelho do Reino de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Mas después que Juan fué encarcelado, Jesús vino á Galilea predicando el evangelio del reino de Dios,

verses.KJV: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.WEB: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
verses.ASV: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: e dizendo: O tempo se cumpriu, e o Reino de Deus está perto; arrependei-vos, e crede no Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: El tiempo es cumplido, y el reino de Dios está cerca: arrepentíos, y creed al evangelio.

verses.KJV: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.WEB: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
verses.ASV: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto andava junto ao mar da Galileia, ele viu Simão e seu irmão André, que lançavam uma rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores;
verses.RVR09: Y pasando junto á la mar de Galilea, vió á Simón, y á Andrés su hermano, que echaban la red en la mar; porque eran pescadores.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes disse: Vinde após mim, e farei serdes pescadores de gente.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo Jesús: Venid en pos de mí, y haré que seáis pescadores de hombres.

verses.KJV: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
verses.WEB: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
verses.ASV: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então logo deixaram suas redes, e o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, dejadas sus redes, le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
verses.WEB: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
verses.ASV: And going on a little further, he saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando dali um pouco mais adiante, viu Tiago [filho] de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João, que estavam no barco, consertando as redes.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando de allí un poco más adelante, vió á Jacobo, hijo de Zebedeo, y á Juan su hermano, también ellos en el navío, que aderezaban las redes.

verses.KJV: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.WEB: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.ASV: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo os chamou; então eles deixaram o seu pai Zebedeu no barco com os empregados, foram após ele.
verses.RVR09: Y luego los llamó: y dejando á su padre Zebedeo en el barco con los jornaleros, fueron en pos de él.

verses.KJV: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
verses.WEB: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
verses.ASV: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles entraram em Cafarnaum; e assim que chegou o sábado, [Jesus] entrou na sinagoga e começou a ensinar.
verses.RVR09: Y entraron en Capernaum; y luego los sábados, entrando en la sinagoga, enseñaba.

verses.KJV: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.WEB: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.ASV: And they were astonished at his teaching: for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficavam admirados com o seu ensinamento, pois, diferentemente dos escribas, ele os ensinava como quem temautoridade.
verses.RVR09: Y se admiraban de su doctrina; porque les enseñaba como quien tiene potestad, y no como los escribas.

verses.KJV: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.WEB: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
verses.ASV: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia na sinagoga deles um homem com um espírito imundo, que gritou,
verses.RVR09: Y había en la sinagoga de ellos un hombre con espíritu inmundo, el cual dió voces,

verses.KJV: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.WEB: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
verses.ASV: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Ah, que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste para nos destruir? Bem sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¡Ah! ¿qué tienes con nosotros, Jesús Nazareno? ¿Has venido á destruirnos? Sé quién eres, el Santo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.WEB: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
verses.ASV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e sai dele.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le riñó, diciendo: Enmudece, y sal de él.

verses.KJV: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.WEB: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
verses.ASV: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito imundo, provocando convulsão nele, e gritando em alta voz, saiu dele.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu inmundo, haciéndole pedazos, y clamando á gran voz, salió de él.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
verses.WEB: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
verses.ASV: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim todos ficaram admirados, e perguntavam entre si: Que é isto? Que novo ensinamento é este que, com autoridade, ordena até aos espíritos imundos, e eles lhe obedecem?
verses.RVR09: Y todos se maravillaron, de tal manera que inquirían entre sí, diciendo: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Qué nueva doctrina es ésta, que con potestad aun á los espíritus inmundos manda, y le obedecen?

verses.KJV: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
verses.WEB: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
verses.ASV: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo sua fama se espalhou por toda a região da Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y vino luego su fama por toda la provincia alrededor de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.WEB: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.ASV: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo depois de saírem da sinagoga, vieram à casa de Simão e de André, com Tiago e João.
verses.RVR09: Y luego saliendo de la sinagoga, vinieron á casa de Simón y de Andrés, con Jacobo y Juan.

verses.KJV: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
verses.WEB: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
verses.ASV: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:
verses.ALMEIDA: A sogra de Simão estava deitada com febre, e logo falaram dela [a Jesus] .
verses.RVR09: Y la suegra de Simón estaba acostada con calentura; y le hablaron luego de ella.

verses.KJV: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.WEB: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
verses.ASV: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele aproximou-se dela, tomou-a pela mão, e a levantou; logo a febre a deixou, e ela começou a servi-los.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegando él, la tomó de su mano y la levantó; y luego la dejó la calentura, y les servía.

verses.KJV: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
verses.WEB: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
verses.ASV: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao entardecer, quando o sol já se punha, trouxeram-lhe todos os doentes e endemoninhados;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fué la tarde, luego que el sol se puso, traían á él todos los que tenían mal, y endemoniados;

verses.KJV: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.WEB: All the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.ASV: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.ALMEIDA: e toda a cidade se juntou à porta.
verses.RVR09: Y toda la ciudad se juntó á la puerta.

verses.KJV: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
verses.WEB: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
verses.ASV: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele curou muitos que se achavam mal de diversas enfermidades, e expulsou muitos demônios. Ele não deixava os demônios falarem, porque o conheciam.
verses.RVR09: Y sanó á muchos que estaban enfermos de diversas enfermedades, y echó fuera muchos demonios; y no dejaba decir á los demonios que le conocían.

verses.KJV: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.WEB: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
verses.ASV: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: De madrugada, ainda escuro, ele se levantou para sair, foi a um lugar deserto, e ali esteve a orar.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose muy de mañana, aun muy de noche, salió y se fué á un lugar desierto, y allí oraba.

verses.KJV: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
verses.WEB: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
verses.ASV: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão e os que estavam com ele o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y le siguió Simón, y los que estaban con él;

verses.KJV: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
verses.WEB: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
verses.ASV: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o acharam, disseram-lhe: Todos estão te procurando.
verses.RVR09: Y hallándole, le dicen: Todos te buscan.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] lhes respondeu: Vamos para as aldeias vizinhas, para que eu também pregue ali, pois vim para isso.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Vamos á los lugares vecinos, para que predique también allí; porque para esto he venido.

verses.KJV: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
verses.WEB: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
verses.ASV: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pregava em suas sinagogas por toda a Galileia, e expulsava os demônios.
verses.RVR09: Y predicaba en las sinagogas de ellos en toda Galilea, y echaba fuera los demonios.

verses.KJV: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.WEB: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.ASV: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um leproso aproximou-se dele, rogando-lhe, pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, e dizendo-lhe: Se quiseres, tu podes limpar-me.
verses.RVR09: Y un leproso vino á él, rogándole; é hincada la rodilla, le dice: Si quieres, puedes limpiarme.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verses.WEB: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
verses.ASV: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus , movido de compaixão, estendeu a mão, tocou-o, e disse-lhe: Quero; sê limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, teniendo misericordia de él, extendió su mano, y le tocó, y le dice: Quiero, sé limpio.

verses.KJV: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
verses.WEB: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
verses.ASV: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando disse isso, logo a lepra saiu dele, e ficou limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y así que hubo él hablado, la lepra se fué luego de aquél, y fué limpio.

verses.KJV: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
verses.WEB: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
verses.ASV: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] advertiu-o, e logo o despediu,
verses.RVR09: Entonces le apercibió, y despidióle luego,

verses.KJV: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.WEB: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
verses.ASV: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo-lhe: Cuidado, não digas nada a ninguém. Mas vai, mostra-te ao Sacerdote, e oferece por teres ficado limpo o que Moisés mandou, para lhes servir de testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y le dice: Mira, no digas á nadie nada; sino ve, muéstrate al sacerdote, y ofrece por tu limpieza lo que Moisés mandó, para testimonio á ellos.

verses.KJV: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
verses.WEB: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
verses.ASV: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to spread abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, quando ele saiu, começou a anunciar muitas coisas, e a divulgar a notícia, de maneira que [Jesus] já não podia entrar publicamente na cidade; em vez disso, ficava do lado de fora em lugares desertos, e [pessoas] de todas as partes vinham até ele.
verses.RVR09: Mas él salido, comenzó á publicarlo mucho, y á divulgar el hecho, de manera que ya Jesús no podía entrar manifiestamente en la ciudad, sino que estaba fuera en los lugares desiertos; y venían á él de todas partes.

verses.KJV: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
verses.WEB: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
verses.ASV: And when he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was noised that he was in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dias depois, [Jesus] entrou outra vez em Cafarnaum, e ouviu-se que estava em casa.
verses.RVR09: Y ENTRÓ otra vez en Capernaum después de algunos días, y se oyó que estaba en casa.

verses.KJV: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
verses.WEB: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
verses.ASV: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer room [for them], no, not even about the door: and he spake the word unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo juntaram-se tantos, que nem mesmo perto da porta cabiam; e ele lhes falava a palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y luego se juntaron á él muchos, que ya no cabían ni aun á la puerta; y les predicaba la palabra.

verses.KJV: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
verses.WEB: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
verses.ASV: And they come, bringing unto him a man sick of the palsy, borne of four.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a ele uns que traziam um paralítico carregado por quatro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vinieron á él unos trayendo un paralítico, que era traído por cuatro.

verses.KJV: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.WEB: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
verses.ASV: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed whereon the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como não podiam se aproximar dele por causa da multidão, descobriram o telhado onde ele estava, fizeram um buraco, e baixaram [por ele] o leito em que jazia o paralítico.
verses.RVR09: Y como no podían llegar á él á causa del gentío, descubrieron el techo de donde estaba, y haciendo abertura, bajaron el lecho en que yacía el paralítico.

verses.KJV: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.WEB: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus seeing their faith saith unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins are forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus viu a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: Filho, os teus pecados te são perdoados.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Jesús la fe de ellos, dice al paralítico: Hijo, tus pecados te son perdonados.

verses.KJV: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.WEB: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.ASV: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam ali sentados alguns escribas, que pensavam em seus corações:
verses.RVR09: Y estaban allí sentados algunos de los escribas, los cuales pensando en sus corazones,

verses.KJV: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
verses.WEB: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
verses.ASV: Why doth this man thus speak? he blasphemeth: who can forgive sins but one, [even] God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que este [homem] fala essas blasfêmias? Quem pode perdoar pecados, a não ser somente Deus?
verses.RVR09: Decían: ¿Por qué habla éste así? Blasfemias dice. ¿Quién puede perdonar pecados, sino solo Dios?

verses.KJV: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
verses.WEB: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
verses.ASV: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, saith unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
verses.ALMEIDA: Imediatamente Jesus percebeu em seu espírito que assim pensavam em si mesmos. Então perguntou-lhes: Por que pensais assim em vossos corações?
verses.RVR09: Y conociendo luego Jesús en su espíritu que pensaban así dentro de sí mismos, les dijo: ¿Por qué pensáis estas cosas en vuestros corazones?

verses.KJV: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.WEB: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
verses.ASV: Which is easier, to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é mais fácil? Dizer ao paralítico: “Os teus pecados estão perdoados”, ou dizer, “Levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e anda”?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué es más fácil, decir al paralítico: Tus pecados te son perdonados, ó decirle: Levántate, y toma tu lecho y anda?

verses.KJV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
verses.WEB: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
verses.ASV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (he saith to the sick of the palsy),
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem poder na terra para perdoar pecados,(disse ao paralítico):
verses.RVR09: Pues para que sepáis que el Hijo del hombre tiene potestad en la tierra de perdonar los pecados, (dice al paralítico):

verses.KJV: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
verses.WEB: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.ASV: I say unto thee, Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ti eu digo: levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e vai para a tua casa.
verses.RVR09: A ti te digo: Levántate, y toma tu lecho, y vete á tu casa.

verses.KJV: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.WEB: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
verses.ASV: And he arose, and straightway took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo ele se levantou, tomou o leito, e saiu na presença de todos, de tal maneira, que todos ficaram admirados, e glorificaram a Deus, dizendo: Nunca vimos algo assim.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se levantó luego, y tomando su lecho, se salió delante de todos, de manera que todos se asombraron, y glorificaron á Dios, diciendo: Nunca tal hemos visto.

verses.KJV: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
verses.WEB: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
verses.ASV: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] voltou a sair para o mar; toda a multidão veio até ele, e ele os ensinava.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á salir á la mar, y toda la gente venía á él, y los enseñaba.

verses.KJV: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
verses.WEB: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
verses.ASV: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the [son] of Alphæus sitting at the place of toll, and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto passava, ele viu Levi, [filho] de Alfeu, sentado no posto de coleta de impostos, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.Então [Levi] se levantou e o seguiu.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando, vió á Leví, hijo de Alfeo, sentado al banco de los públicos tributos, y le dice: Sígueme. Y levantándose le siguió.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.WEB: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that he was sitting at meat in his house, and many publicans and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que enquanto estava sentado à mesa na casa dele, muitos publicanos e pecadores também estavam assentados à mesa com Jesus e os seus discípulos; porque eram muitos, e o haviam seguido.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando Jesús á la mesa en casa de él, muchos publicanos y pecadores estaban también á la mesa juntamente con Jesús y con sus discípulos: porque había muchos, y le habían seguido.

verses.KJV: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
verses.WEB: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.ASV: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and publicans, said unto his disciples, [How is it] that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os escribas e os fariseus o viram comer com os publicanos e pecadores, disseram a seus discípulos: Por que é que ele come e bebe com os publicanos e os pecadores?
verses.RVR09: Y los escribas y los Fariseos, viéndole comer con los publicanos y con los pecadores, dijeron á sus discípulos: ¿Qué es esto, que él come y bebe con los publicanos y con los pecadores?

verses.KJV: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of a physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus ouviu e lhes respondeu: Os que têm saúde não precisam de médico, mas sim os que estão doentes. Eu não vim para chamar os justos, mas sim, os pecadores, ao arrependimento.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Jesús, les dice: Los sanos no tienen necesidad de médico, mas los que tienen mal. No he venido á llamar á los justos, sino á los pecadores.

verses.KJV: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.WEB: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
verses.ASV: And John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting: and they come and say unto him, Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os discípulos de João e os dos fariseus estavam jejuando; então vieram lhe perguntar: Por que os discípulos de João e os dos fariseus jejuam, e os teus discípulos não jejuam?
verses.RVR09: Y los discípulos de Juan, y de los Fariseos ayunaban; y vienen, y le dicen: ¿Por qué los discípulos de Juan y los de los Fariseos ayunan, y tus discípulos no ayunan?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Podem os convidados do casamento jejuar enquanto o noivo estiver com eles? Enquanto tiverem o noivo consigo, eles não podem jejuar.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dice: ¿Pueden ayunar los que están de bodas, cuando el esposo está con ellos? Entre tanto que tienen consigo al esposo no pueden ayunar.

verses.KJV: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.WEB: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
verses.ASV: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas dias virão, quando o noivo lhes for tirado; e então naqueles dias jejuarão.
verses.RVR09: Mas vendrán días, cuando el esposo les será quitado, y entonces en aquellos días ayunarán.

verses.KJV: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
verses.WEB: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
verses.ASV: No man seweth a piece of undressed cloth on an old garment: else that which should fill it up taketh from it, the new from the old, and a worse rent is made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém costura remendo de pano novo em roupa velha; senão o remendo novo rompe o velho, e se faz pior rasgo.
verses.RVR09: Nadie echa remiendo de paño recio en vestido viejo; de otra manera el mismo remiendo nuevo tira del viejo, y la rotura se hace peor.

verses.KJV: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
verses.WEB: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
verses.ASV: And no man putteth new wine into old wine-skins; else the wine will burst the skins, and the wine perisheth, and the skins: but [they put] new wine into fresh wine-skins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém põe vinho novo em odres velhos; senão o vinho novo rompe os odres, derrama-se o vinho, e os odres se danificam; mas o vinho novo deve ser posto em odres novos.
verses.RVR09: Ni nadie echa vino nuevo en odres viejos; de otra manera, el vino nuevo rompe los odres, y se derrama el vino, y los odres se pierden; mas el vino nuevo en odres nuevos se ha de echar.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
verses.WEB: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that he was going on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto [Jesus] passava pelas plantações no sábado, os seus discípulos, andando, começaram a arrancar espigas.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que pasando él por los sembrados en sábado, sus discípulos andando comenzaron á arrancar espigas.

verses.KJV: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
verses.WEB: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os fariseus lhe disseram: Olha! Por que estão fazendo o que não é lícito no sábado?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Fariseos le dijeron: He aquí, ¿por qué hacen en sábado lo que no es lícito?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Did ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and they that were with him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Nunca lestes o que fez Davi, quando teve necessidade e fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Nunca leísteis qué hizo David cuando tuvo necesidad, y tuvo hambre, él y los que con él estaban:

verses.KJV: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
verses.WEB: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
verses.ASV: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests, and gave also to them that were with him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como ele entrou na Casa de Deus, quando Abiatar era sumo sacerdote, e comeu os pães da proposição (dos quais não é lícito comer, a não ser aos sacerdotes), e também deu aos que com ele estavam?
verses.RVR09: Cómo entró en la casa de Dios, siendo Abiathar sumo pontífice, y comió los panes de la proposición, de los cuales no es lícito comer sino á los sacerdotes, y aun dió á los que con él estaban?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes mais: O sábado foi feito por causa do ser humano, não o ser humano por causa do sábado.
verses.RVR09: También les dijo: El sábado por causa del hombre es hecho; no el hombre por causa del sábado.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: so that the Son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Filho do homem é Senhor até do sábado.
verses.RVR09: Así que el Hijo del hombre es Señor aun del sábado.

verses.KJV: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
verses.WEB: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
verses.ASV: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had his hand withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] entrou outra vez na sinagoga; e estava ali um homem que tinha uma mão definhada.
verses.RVR09: Y OTRA vez entró en la sinagoga; y había allí un hombre que tenía una mano seca.

verses.KJV: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
verses.WEB: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
verses.ASV: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E prestavam atenção nele, se o curaria no sábado, para o acusarem.
verses.RVR09: Y le acechaban si en sábado le sanaría, para acusarle.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
verses.WEB: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto the man that had his hand withered, Stand forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jesus] disse ao homem que tinha a mão definhada: Levanta-te, e vem para o meio.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo al hombre que tenía la mano seca: Levántate en medio.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful on the sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes:É lícito no sábado fazer o bem, ou o mal? Salvar uma pessoa, ou matá-la? E mantiveram-se calados.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: ¿Es lícito hacer bien en sábado, ó hacer mal? ¿salvar la vida, ó quitarla? Mas ellos callaban.

verses.KJV: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.WEB: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
verses.ASV: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their heart, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and his hand was restored.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhando ao redor para eles com indignação, sentindo pena da dureza dos seus corações, disse ao homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele estendeu; e sua mão foi restaurada , sã como a outra.
verses.RVR09: Y mirándolos alrededor con enojo, condoleciéndose de la ceguedad de su corazón, dice al hombre: Extiende tu mano. Y la extendió, y su mano fué restituída sana.

verses.KJV: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees went out, and straightway with the Herodians took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que os fariseus saíram, tiveram reunião com os herodianos contra ele, para combinarem sobre como o matariam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces saliendo los Fariseos, tomaron consejo con los Herodianos contra él, para matarle.

verses.KJV: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
verses.WEB: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
verses.ASV: And Jesus with his disciples withdrew to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed; and from Judæa,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus retirou-se com os seus discípulos para o mar; e seguiu-o uma grande multidão da Galileia, da Judeia,
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús se apartó á la mar con sus discípulos: y le siguió gran multitud de Galilea, y de Judea,

verses.KJV: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
verses.WEB: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
verses.ASV: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumæa, and beyond the Jordan, and about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: de Jerusalém, da Idumeia, dalém do Jordão, e os das proximidades de Tiro e de Sidom; uma grande multidão, tendo ouvido quão grandes coisas fazia, vieram a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y de Jerusalem, y de Idumea, y de la otra parte del Jordán. Y los de alrededor de Tiro y de Sidón, grande multitud, oyendo cuán grandes cosas hacía, vinieron á él.

verses.KJV: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
verses.WEB: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
verses.ASV: And he spake to his disciples, that a little boat should wait on him because of the crowd, lest they should throng him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos seus discípulos que um barquinho ficasse continuamente perto dele, por causa das multidões; para que não o apertassem.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á sus discípulos que le estuviese siempre apercibida la barquilla, por causa del gentío, para que no le oprimiesen.

verses.KJV: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
verses.WEB: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
verses.ASV: for he had healed many; insomuch that as many as had plagues pressed upon him that they might touch him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois havia curado muitos, de maneira que todos quantos tinham algum mal lançavam-se sobre ele a fim de tocá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Porque había sanado á muchos; de manera que caían sobre él cuantos tenían plagas, por tocarle.

verses.KJV: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
verses.WEB: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
verses.ASV: And the unclean spirits, whensoever they beheld him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os espíritos imundos, quando o viam, prostravam-se diante dele, e exclamavam: Tu és o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y los espíritus inmundos, al verle, se postraban delante de él, y daban voces, diciendo: Tú eres el Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
verses.WEB: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
verses.ASV: And he charged them much that they should not make him known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] os repreendia muito, para que não manifestassem quem ele era.
verses.RVR09: Mas él les reñía mucho que no le manifestasen.

verses.KJV: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
verses.WEB: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
verses.ASV: And he goeth up into the mountain, and calleth unto him whom he himself would; and they went unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele subiu ao monte, e chamou para si os que quis; então vieram a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y subió al monte, y llamó á sí á los que él quiso; y vinieron á él.

verses.KJV: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
verses.WEB: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
verses.ASV: And he appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
verses.ALMEIDA: E constituiu doze para que estivessem com ele, para enviá-los a pregar,
verses.RVR09: Y estableció doce, para que estuviesen con él, y para enviarlos á predicar,

verses.KJV: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
verses.WEB: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
verses.ASV: and to have authority to cast out demons:
verses.ALMEIDA: para que tivessem poder de curar as enfermidades e expulsar os demônios.
verses.RVR09: Y que tuviesen potestad de sanar enfermedades, y de echar fuera demonios:

verses.KJV: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
verses.WEB: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
verses.ASV: and Simon he surnamed Peter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eram eles: Simão, a quem pôs por nome Pedro;
verses.RVR09: A Simón, al cual puso por nombre Pedro;

verses.KJV: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
verses.WEB: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
verses.ASV: and James the [son] of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and them he surnamed Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tiago [filho] de Zebedeu, e João, irmão de Tiago; e pôs-lhes por nome Boanerges, que significa “filhos do trovão”;
verses.RVR09: Y á Jacobo, hijo de Zebedeo, y á Juan hermano de Jacobo; y les apellidó Boanerges, que es, Hijos del trueno;

verses.KJV: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
verses.WEB: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
verses.ASV: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the [son] of Alphæus, and Thaddæus, and Simon the Cananæan,
verses.ALMEIDA: e André, Filipe, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tomé; Tiago [filho] de Alfeu; Tadeu; Simão o zelote;
verses.RVR09: Y á Andrés, y á Felipe, y á Bartolomé, y á Mateo, y á Tomás, y á Jacobo hijo de Alfeo, y á Tadeo, y á Simón el Cananita,

verses.KJV: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
verses.WEB: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
verses.ASV: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. And he cometh into a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: e Judas Iscariotes, o que o traiu.
verses.RVR09: Y á Judas Iscariote, el que le entregó. Y vinieron á casa.

verses.KJV: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.WEB: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.ASV: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando foram para uma casa, outra vez se ajuntou uma multidão, de maneira que nem sequer podiam comer pão.
verses.RVR09: Y agolpóse de nuevo la gente, de modo que ellos ni aun podían comer pan.

verses.KJV: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
verses.WEB: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
verses.ASV: And when his friends heard it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os seus [familiares] , ao ouvirem isso, saíram para detê-lo, porque diziam: “Ele stá fora de si”.
verses.RVR09: Y como lo oyeron los suyos, vinieron para prenderle: porque decían: Está fuera de sí.

verses.KJV: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
verses.WEB: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
verses.ASV: And the scribes that came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and, By the prince of the demons casteth he out the demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os escribas que haviam descido de Jerusalém diziam: Ele tem Belzebu, e é pelo chefe dos demônios que expulsa demônios.
verses.RVR09: Y los escribas que habían venido de Jerusalem, decían que tenía á Beelzebub, y que por el príncipe de los demonios echaba fuera los demonios.

verses.KJV: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.WEB: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.ASV: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Jesus] os chamou, e lhes disse por parábolas: Como pode Satanás expulsar Satanás?
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndolos llamado, les decía en parábolas: ¿Cómo puede Satanás echar fuera á Satanás?

verses.KJV: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.WEB: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.ASV: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se algum reino estiver dividido contra si mesmo, tal reino não pode durar;
verses.RVR09: Y si algún reino contra sí mismo fuere dividido, no puede permanecer el tal reino.

verses.KJV: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.WEB: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.ASV: And if a house be divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: e se alguma casa estiver dividida contra si mesma, tal casa não pode durar firme.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguna casa fuere dividida contra sí misma, no puede permanecer la tal casa.

verses.KJV: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
verses.WEB: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
verses.ASV: And if Satan hath risen up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se Satanás se levantar contra si mesmo, e for dividido, não pode durar, mas tem fim.
verses.RVR09: Y si Satanás se levantare contra sí mismo, y fuere dividido, no puede permanecer; antes tiene fin.

verses.KJV: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
verses.WEB: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
verses.ASV: But no one can enter into the house of the strong [man], and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong [man]; and then he will spoil his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém pode roubar os bens do valente, quando se entra na casa dele, se antes não amarrar ao valente; depois disso roubará a sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Nadie puede saquear las alhajas del valiente entrando en su casa, si antes no atare al valiente y entonces saqueará su casa.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
verses.WEB: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, All their sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and their blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que todos os pecados serão perdoados aos filhos dos homens, e todas as blasfêmias com que blasfemarem;
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo que todos los pecados serán perdonados á los hijos de los hombres, y las blasfemias cualesquiera con que blasfemaren;

verses.KJV: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.
verses.WEB: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
verses.ASV: but whosoever shall blaspheme against the Holy Spirit hath never forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin:
verses.ALMEIDA: mas quem blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo ficará sem perdão para sempre; em vez disso, é culpado do juízo eterno.
verses.RVR09: Mas cualquiera que blasfemare contra el Espíritu Santo, no tiene jamás perdón, mas está expuesto á eterno juicio.

verses.KJV: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
verses.WEB: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
verses.ASV: because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois diziam: “Ele tem espírito imundo”.
verses.RVR09: Porque decían: Tiene espíritu inmundo.

verses.KJV: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
verses.WEB: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
verses.ASV: And there come his mother and his brethren; and, standing without, they sent unto him, calling him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então chegaram os seus irmãos e a sua mãe ; e estando de fora, mandaram chamá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Vienen después sus hermanos y su madre, y estando fuera, enviaron á él llamándole.

verses.KJV: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verses.WEB: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
verses.ASV: And a multitude was sitting about him; and they say unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: A multidão estava sentada ao redor dele. Então disseram-lhe: Eis que a tua mãe e os teus irmãos estão lá fora a te procurar.
verses.RVR09: Y la gente estaba sentada alrededor de él, y le dijeron: He aquí, tu madre y tus hermanos te buscan fuera.

verses.KJV: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
verses.WEB: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
verses.ASV: And he answereth them, and saith, Who is my mother and my brethren?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes respondeu: Quem é a minha mãe ou os meus irmãos?
verses.RVR09: Y él les respondió, diciendo: ¿Quién es mi madre y mis hermanos?

verses.KJV: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.WEB: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
verses.ASV: And looking round on them that sat round about him, he saith, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
verses.ALMEIDA: E, olhando em redor aos que estavam sentados perto dele, disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y mirando á los que estaban sentados alrededor de él, dijo: He aquí mi madre y hermanos.

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
verses.WEB: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem fizer a vontade de Deus, esse é meu irmão, minha irmã, e mãe.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que hiciere la voluntad de Dios, éste es mi hermano, y mi hermana, y mi madre.

verses.KJV: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
verses.WEB: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
verses.ASV: And again he began to teach by the sea side. And there is gathered unto him a very great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat in the sea; and all the multitude were by the sea on the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] começou outra vez a ensinar junto ao mar, e uma grande multidão se ajuntou a ele, de maneira que ele entrou num barco e ficou sentado no mar; e toda a multidão estava em terra junto ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y OTRA vez comenzó á enseñar junto á la mar, y se juntó á él mucha gente; tanto, que entrándose él en un barco, se sentó en la mar: y toda la gente estaba en tierra junto á la mar.

verses.KJV: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
verses.WEB: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
verses.ASV: And he taught them many things in parables, and said unto them in his teaching,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinava-lhes muitas coisas por parábolas; e dizia-lhes em seu ensinamento:
verses.RVR09: Y les enseñaba por parábolas muchas cosas, y les decía en su doctrina:

verses.KJV: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
verses.WEB: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.
verses.ASV: Hearken: Behold, the sower went forth to sow:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi: eis que o semeador saiu a semear;
verses.RVR09: Oid: He aquí, el sembrador salió á sembrar.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
verses.WEB: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, as he sowed, some [seed] fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto semeava, uma [parte das sementes] caiu junto ao caminho, e os pássaros do céu vieram, e a comeram.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció sembrando, que una parte cayó junto al camino; y vinieron las aves del cielo, y la tragaron.

verses.KJV: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
verses.WEB: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
verses.ASV: And other fell on the rocky [ground], where it had not much earth; and straightway it sprang up, because it had no deepness of earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra caiu em pedregulhos, onde não havia muita terra; e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra profunda.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó en pedregales, donde no tenía mucha tierra; y luego salió, porque no tenía la tierra profunda:

verses.KJV: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.WEB: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.ASV: and when the sun was risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, quando saiu o sol, queimou-se; e porque não tinha raiz, secou-se.
verses.RVR09: Mas salido el sol, se quemó; y por cuanto no tenía raíz, se secó.

verses.KJV: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.WEB: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.ASV: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra caiu entre espinhos; e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram, e não deu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó en espinas; y subieron las espinas, y la ahogaron, y no dió fruto.

verses.KJV: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.WEB: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
verses.ASV: And others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing; and brought forth, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas outra caiu em boa terra, e deu fruto, que subiu, e cresceu; e um deu trinta, outro sessenta, e outro cem.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó en buena tierra, y dió fruto, que subió y creció: y llevó uno á treinta, y otro á sesenta, y otro á ciento.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes : Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dijo: El que tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
verses.WEB: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
verses.ASV: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parables.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando [Jesus] esteve só, os que estavam junto dele, com os doze, perguntaram-lhe acerca da parábola .
verses.RVR09: Y cuando estuvo solo, le preguntaron los que estaban cerca de él con los doce, sobre la parábola.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Unto you is given the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all things are done in parables:
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhes: A vós é concedido saber o mistério do Reino de Deus; mas aos que são de fora, todas estas coisas se fazem por meio de parábolas;
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: A vosotros es dado saber el misterio del reino de Dios; mas á los que están fuera, por parábolas todas las cosas;

verses.KJV: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
verses.WEB: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
verses.ASV: that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest haply they should turn again, and it should be forgiven them.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que vendo, vejam, e não percebam; e ouvindo, ouçam, e não entendam; para não haver de se converterem, e lhes sejam perdoados os pecados .
verses.RVR09: Para que viendo, vean y no echen de ver; y oyendo, oigan y no entiendan: porque no se conviertan, y les sean perdonados los pecados.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how shall ye know all the parables?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Não sabeis o significado desta parábola? Como, pois, entendereis todas as parábolas?
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: ¿No sabéis esta parábola? ¿Cómo, pues, entenderéis todas las parábolas?

verses.KJV: The sower soweth the word.
verses.WEB: The farmer sows the word.
verses.ASV: The sower soweth the word.
verses.ALMEIDA: O semeador semeia a palavra.
verses.RVR09: El que siembra es el que siembra la palabra.

verses.KJV: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
verses.WEB: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
verses.ASV: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; and when they have heard, straightway cometh Satan, and taketh away the word which hath been sown in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os de junto ao caminho: nos quais a palavra é semeada; mas depois de a ouvirem, Satanás logo vem, e tira a palavra que foi semeada nos seus corações .
verses.RVR09: Y éstos son los de junto al camino: en los que la palabra es sembrada: mas después que la oyeron, luego viene Satanás, y quita la palabra que fué sembrada en sus corazones.

verses.KJV: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
verses.WEB: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
verses.ASV: And these in like manner are they that are sown upon the rocky [places], who, when they have heard the word, straightway receive it with joy;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, semelhantemente, estes são os que se semeiam em pedregulhos: os que havendo ouvido a palavra, logo a recebem com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo éstos son los que son sembrados en pedregales: los que cuando han oído la palabra, luego la toman con gozo;

verses.KJV: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
verses.WEB: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
verses.ASV: and they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway they stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não têm raiz em si mesmos; em vez disso, são temporários. Depois, quando se levanta a tribulação ou a perseguição por causa da palavra, logo tropeçam na fé.
verses.RVR09: Mas no tienen raíz en sí, antes son temporales, que en levantándose la tribulación ó la persecución por causa de la palabra, luego se escandalizan.

verses.KJV: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
verses.WEB: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
verses.ASV: And others are they that are sown among the thorns; these are they that have heard the word,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os que se semeiam entre espinhos: os que ouvem a palavra;
verses.RVR09: Y éstos son los que son sembrados entre espinas: los que oyen la palabra;

verses.KJV: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
