verses.WEB: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.ASV: and the cares of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas as preocupações deste mundo, a sedução das riquezas, e as cobiças por outras coisas, entram, sufocam a palavra, e ela fica sem gerar fruto.
verses.RVR09: Mas los cuidados de este siglo, y el engaño de las riquezas, y las codicias que hay en las otras cosas, entrando, ahogan la palabra, y se hace infructuosa.

verses.KJV: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.WEB: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
verses.ASV: And those are they that were sown upon the good ground; such as hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os que foram semeados em boa terra: os que ouvem a palavra, recebem-na, e dão fruto, um trinta, e outro sessenta, e outro cem.
verses.RVR09: Y éstos son los que fueron sembrados en buena tierra: los que oyen la palabra, y la reciben, y hacen fruto, uno á treinta, otro á sesenta, y otro á ciento.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Is the lamp brought to be put under the bushel, or under the bed, [and] not to be put on the stand?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Por acaso a lâmpada vem a ser posta debaixo de uma caixa ou sob da cama? Não deve ela ser posta na luminária?
verses.RVR09: También les dijo: ¿Tráese la antorcha para ser puesta debajo del almud, ó debajo de la cama? ¿No es para ser puesta en el candelero?

verses.KJV: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verses.WEB: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
verses.ASV: For there is nothing hid, save that it should be manifested; neither was [anything] made secret, but that it should come to light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não há nada encoberto que não haja de ser revelado; e nada se faz [para ficar] encoberto, mas sim, para ser vir à luz.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay nada oculto que no haya de ser manifestado, ni secreto que no haya de descubrirse.

verses.KJV: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.ASV: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete it shall be measured unto you; and more shall be given unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Prestai atenção ao que ouvis: com a medida que medirdes a vós mesmos se medirá, e será acrescentado a vós que ouvis .
verses.RVR09: Les dijo también: Mirad lo que oís: con la medida que medís, os medirán otros, y será añadido á vosotros los que oís.

verses.KJV: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
verses.WEB: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
verses.ASV: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ao que tem, lhe será dado; e ao que não tem, até o que tem lhe será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Porque al que tiene, le será dado; y al que no tiene, aun lo que tiene le será quitado.

verses.KJV: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
verses.WEB: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
verses.ASV: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed upon the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia: Assim é o Reino de Deus, como se um homem lançasse semente na terra;
verses.RVR09: Decía más: Así es el reino de Dios, como si un hombre echa simiente en la tierra;

verses.KJV: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
verses.WEB: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
verses.ASV: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he knoweth not how.
verses.ALMEIDA: e dormisse, e se levantasse, de noite e de dia, e a semente brotasse, e crescesse, sem que ele saiba como.
verses.RVR09: Y duerme, y se levanta de noche y de día, y la simiente brota y crece como él no sabe.

verses.KJV: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
verses.WEB: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
verses.ASV: The earth beareth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a terra de si mesma frutifica, primeiro a erva, depois a espiga, depois o grão cheio na espiga.
verses.RVR09: Porque de suyo fructifica la tierra, primero hierba, luego espiga, después grano lleno en la espiga;

verses.KJV: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
verses.WEB: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
verses.ASV: But when the fruit is ripe, straightway he putteth forth the sickle, because the harvest is come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o fruto se mostra pronto, logo mete a foice, pois a colheita chegou.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el fruto fuere producido, luego se mete la hoz, porque la siega es llegada.

verses.KJV: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
verses.WEB: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
verses.ASV: And he said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God? or in what parable shall we set it forth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia: A que assemelharemos o Reino de Deus? Ou com que parábola o compararemos?
verses.RVR09: Y decía: ¿A qué haremos semejante el reino de Dios? ¿ó con qué parábola le compararemos?

verses.KJV: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
verses.WEB: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
verses.ASV: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown upon the earth, though it be less than all the seeds that are upon the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Com um grão da mostarda que, quando semeado na terra, é a menor de todas as sementes na terra.
verses.RVR09: Es como el grano de mostaza, que, cuando se siembra en tierra, es la más pequeña de todas las simientes que hay en la tierra;

verses.KJV: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
verses.WEB: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
verses.ASV: yet when it is sown, groweth up, and becometh greater than all the herbs, and putteth out great branches; so that the birds of the heaven can lodge under the shadow thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, depois de semeado, cresce, e se torna a maior de todas as hortaliças, e cria grandes ramos, de maneira que os pássaros do céu podem fazer ninhos sob a sua sombra.
verses.RVR09: Mas después de sembrado, sube, y se hace la mayor de todas las legumbres, y echa grandes ramas, de tal manera que las aves del cielo puedan morar bajo su sombra.

verses.KJV: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
verses.WEB: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
verses.ASV: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it;
verses.ALMEIDA: E com muitas parábolas como essas [Jesus ] lhes falava a palavra, conforme o que podiam ouvir.
verses.RVR09: Y con muchas tales parábolas les hablaba la palabra, conforme á lo que podían oir.

verses.KJV: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
verses.WEB: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
verses.ASV: and without a parable spake he not unto them: but privately to his own disciples he expounded all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não lhes falava sem parábola; mas aos seus discípulos explicava tudo em particular.
verses.RVR09: Y sin parábola no les hablaba; mas á sus discípulos en particular declaraba todo.

verses.KJV: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
verses.WEB: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
verses.ASV: And on that day, when even was come, he saith unto them, Let us go over unto the other side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, chegando o entardecer, disse-lhes: Passemos para o outro lado.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo aquel día cuando fué tarde: Pasemos de la otra parte.

verses.KJV: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
verses.WEB: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
verses.ASV: And leaving the multitude, they take him with them, even as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então despediram a multidão, e o levaram consigo assim como estava no barco; mas havia também outros barquinhos com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y despachando la multitud, le tomaron como estaba, en el barco; y había también con él otros barquitos.

verses.KJV: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verses.WEB: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
verses.ASV: And there ariseth a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, insomuch that the boat was now filling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se uma grande tempestade de vento; as ondas atingiam por cima do barco, de maneira que já se enchia.
verses.RVR09: Y se levantó una grande tempestad de viento, y echaba las olas en el barco, de tal manera que ya se henchía.

verses.KJV: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
verses.WEB: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
verses.ASV: And he himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion: and they awake him, and say unto him, Teacher, carest thou not that we perish?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] estava na popa dormindo sobre uma almofada. Então despertaram-no, e disseram-lhe: Mestre, não te importas que pereçamos?
verses.RVR09: Y él estaba en la popa, durmiendo sobre un cabezal, y le despertaron, y le dicen: ¿Maestro, no tienes cuidado que perecemos?

verses.KJV: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.WEB: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
verses.ASV: And he awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele se levantou, repreendeu o vento, e disse ao mar: Cala-te, aquieta-te! E o vento se aquietou, e fez-se grande bonança.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose, increpó al viento, y dijo á la mar: Calla, enmudece. Y cesó el viento, y fué hecha grande bonanza.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Why are ye fearful? have ye not yet faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntou-lhes: Por que sois tão covardes? Como não tendes fé?
verses.RVR09: Y á ellos dijo: ¿Por qué estáis así amedrentados? ¿Cómo no tenéis fe?

verses.KJV: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
verses.WEB: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
verses.ASV: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficaram muito atemorizados, e diziam uns aos outros: Quem é este, que até o vento e o mar lhe obedecem?
verses.RVR09: Y temieron con gran temor, y decían el uno al otro. ¿Quién es éste, que aun el viento y la mar le obedecen?

verses.KJV: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.WEB: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.ASV: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram ao outro lado do mar, à terra dos Gadarenos.
verses.RVR09: Y VINIERON de la otra parte de la mar á la provincia de los Gadarenos.

verses.KJV: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.WEB: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
verses.ASV: And when he was come out of the boat, straightway there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que [Jesus] saiu do barco, veio das sepulturas ao seu encontro um homem com um espírito imundo,
verses.RVR09: Y salido él del barco, luego le salió al encuentro, de los sepulcros, un hombre con un espíritu inmundo,

verses.KJV: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
verses.WEB: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
verses.ASV: who had his dwelling in the tombs: and no man could any more bind him, no, not with a chain;
verses.ALMEIDA: que morava nas sepulturas, e nem mesmo com correntes conseguiam prendê-lo;
verses.RVR09: Que tenía domicilio en los sepulcros, y ni aun con cadenas le podía alguien atar;

verses.KJV: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
verses.WEB: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
verses.ASV: because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been rent asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: and no man had strength to tame him.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois muitas vezes fora preso com grilhões e correntes; mas as correntes eram por ele feitas em pedaços, os grilhões eram esmigalhados, e ninguém o conseguia controlar.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchas veces había sido atado con grillos y cadenas, mas las cadenas habían sido hechas pedazos por él, y los grillos desmenuzados; y nadie le podía domar.

verses.KJV: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.WEB: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.ASV: And always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sempre dia e noite andava gritando pelos montes e pelas sepulturas, e ferindo-se com pedras.
verses.RVR09: Y siempre, de día y de noche, andaba dando voces en los montes y en los sepulcros, é hiriéndose con las piedras.

verses.KJV: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
verses.WEB: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
verses.ASV: And when he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshipped him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele viu Jesus de longe, correu e prostrou-se diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió á Jesús de lejos, corrió, y le adoró.

verses.KJV: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
verses.WEB: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
verses.ASV: and crying out with a loud voice, he saith, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the Most High God? I adjure thee by God, torment me not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E gritou em alta voz: Que tenho eu contigo Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Imploro-te por Deus que não me atormentes.
verses.RVR09: Y clamando á gran voz, dijo: ¿Qué tienes conmigo, Jesús, Hijo del Dios Altísimo? Te conjuro por Dios que no me atormentes.

verses.KJV: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
verses.WEB: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
verses.ASV: For he said unto him, Come forth, thou unclean spirit, out of the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois [Jesus] havia lhe dito: “Sai deste homem, espírito imundo”.)
verses.RVR09: Porque le decía: Sal de este hombre, espíritu inmundo.

verses.KJV: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
verses.WEB: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
verses.ASV: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he saith unto him, My name is Legion; for we are many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então perguntou-lhe: Qual é o teu nome? E respondeu: Legião é o meu nome, porque somos muitos.
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntó: ¿Cómo te llamas? Y respondió diciendo: Legión me llamo; porque somos muchos.

verses.KJV: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.WEB: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.ASV: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rogava-lhe muito que não os expulsasse daquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y le rogaba mucho que no le enviase fuera de aquella provincia.

verses.KJV: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.WEB: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
verses.ASV: Now there was there on the mountain side a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia ali perto dos montes uma grande manada de porcos pastando.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba allí cerca del monte una grande manada de puercos paciendo.

verses.KJV: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.WEB: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
verses.ASV: And they besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos [aqueles ] demônios rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Manda-nos para aqueles porcos, para que entremos neles.
verses.RVR09: Y le rogaron todos los demonios, diciendo: Envíanos á los puercos para que entremos en ellos.

verses.KJV: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
verses.WEB: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
verses.ASV: And he gave them leave. And the unclean spirits came out, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the sea, [in number] about two thousand; and they were drowned in the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Imediatamente Jesus lhes permitiu. Então aqueles espíritos imundos saíram para entrar nos porcos; e a manada lançou-se abaixo no mar; (eram quase dois mil) e afogaram-se no mar.
verses.RVR09: Y luego Jesús se lo permitió. Y saliendo aquellos espíritus inmundos, entraron en los puercos, y la manada cayó por un despeñadero en la mar; los cuales eran como dos mil; y en la mar se ahogaron.

verses.KJV: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
verses.WEB: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
verses.ASV: And they that fed them fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they came to see what it was that had come to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que apascentavam os porcos fugiram, e avisaram na cidade e nos campos; e [as pessoas] foram ver o que havia acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Y los que apacentaban los puercos huyeron, y dieron aviso en la ciudad y en los campos. Y salieron para ver qué era aquello que había acontecido.

verses.KJV: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.WEB: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
verses.ASV: And they come to Jesus, and behold him that was possessed with demons sitting, clothed and in his right mind, [even] him that had the legion: and they were afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aproximaram-se de Jesus, e viram o endemoninhado sentado, vestido, e em sã consciência o que tivera a legião; e ficaram apavorados.
verses.RVR09: Y vienen á Jesús, y ven al que había sido atormentado del demonio, y que había tenido la legión, sentado y vestido, y en su juicio cabal; y tuvieron miedo.

verses.KJV: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
verses.WEB: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
verses.ASV: And they that saw it declared unto them how it befell him that was possessed with demons, and concerning the swine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que haviam visto contaram-lhes o que acontecera ao endemoninhado, e sobre os porcos.
verses.RVR09: Y les contaron los que lo habían visto, cómo había acontecido al que había tenido el demonio, y lo de los puercos.

verses.KJV: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
verses.WEB: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
verses.ASV: And they began to beseech him to depart from their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então começaram a rogar-lhe que saísse do território deles.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzaron á rogarle que se fuese de los términos de ellos.

verses.KJV: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
verses.WEB: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
verses.ASV: And as he was entering into the boat, he that had been possessed with demons besought him that he might be with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando [Jesus] entrava no barco, o que fora endemoninhado rogou-lhe que estivesse com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando él en el barco, le rogaba el que había sido fatigado del demonio, para estar con él.

verses.KJV: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
verses.WEB: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
verses.ASV: And he suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go to thy house unto thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and [how] he had mercy on thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus se recusou, porém lhe disse: Vai para a tua casa, aos teus, e anuncia-lhes quão grandes coisas o Senhor fez contigo, e [como] teve misericórdia de ti.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús no le permitió, sino le dijo: Vete á tu casa, á los tuyos, y cuéntales cuán grandes cosas el Señor ha hecho contigo, y cómo ha tenido misericordia de ti.

verses.KJV: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
verses.WEB: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
verses.ASV: And he went his way, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men marvelled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele foi embora, e começou a anunciar em Decápolis quão grandes coisas Jesus havia feito com ele; e todos se admiravam.
verses.RVR09: Y se fué, y comenzó á publicar en Decápolis cuán grandes cosas Jesús había hecho con él: y todos se maravillaban.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
verses.WEB: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
verses.ASV: And when Jesus had crossed over again in the boat unto the other side, a great multitude was gathered unto him; and he was by the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de Jesus passar outra vez num barco para o outro lado, uma grande multidão se ajuntou a ele; e ele ficou junto ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando otra vez Jesús en un barco á la otra parte, se juntó á él gran compañía; y estaba junto á la mar.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
verses.WEB: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
verses.ASV: And there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jaïrus by name; and seeing him, he falleth at his feet,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que veio um dos líderes de sinagoga, por nome Jairo; e quando o viu, prostrou-se aos seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y vino uno de los príncipes de la sinagoga, llamado Jairo; y luego que le vió, se postró á sus pies,

verses.KJV: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
verses.WEB: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
verses.ASV: and beseecheth him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death: [I pray thee], that thou come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be made whole, and live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E implorava-lhe muito, dizendo: Minha filhinha está a ponto de morrer. [Rogo-te] que venhas pôr as mãos sobre ela, para que seja curada, e viva.
verses.RVR09: Y le rogaba mucho, diciendo: Mi hija está á la muerte: ven y pondrás las manos sobre ella para que sea salva, y vivirá.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
verses.WEB: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
verses.ASV: And he went with him; and a great multitude followed him, and they thronged him.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] foi com ele. Uma grande multidão o seguia, e o apertavam.
verses.RVR09: Y fué con él, y le seguía gran compañía, y le apretaban.

verses.KJV: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.WEB: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
verses.ASV: And a woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia uma certa mulher, que tinha um fluxo de sangue havia doze anos,
verses.RVR09: Y una mujer que estaba con flujo de sangre doce años hacía,

verses.KJV: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.WEB: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
verses.ASV: and had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.ALMEIDA: que tinha sofrido muito por meio de muitos médicos, e gastado tudo quanto possuía, e nada havia lhe dado bom resultado; ao invés disso, piorava.
verses.RVR09: Y había sufrido mucho de muchos médicos, y había gastado todo lo que tenía, y nada había aprovechado, antes le iba peor,

verses.KJV: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
verses.WEB: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
verses.ASV: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ela ouviu falar de Jesus, veio entre a multidão por detrás, e tocou a roupa dele.
verses.RVR09: Como oyó hablar de Jesús, llegó por detrás entre la compañía, y tocó su vestido.

verses.KJV: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
verses.WEB: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
verses.ASV: For she said, If I touch but his garments, I shall be made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dizia: Se tão somente tocar as suas roupas, serei curada.
verses.RVR09: Porque decía: Si tocare tan solamente su vestido, seré salva.

verses.KJV: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
verses.WEB: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
verses.ASV: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her plague.
verses.ALMEIDA: E imediatamente a fonte do seu sangue parou se secou; e sentiu no corpo que já havia sido curada daquele flagelo.
verses.RVR09: Y luego la fuente de su sangre se secó; y sintió en el cuerpo que estaba sana de aquel azote.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
verses.WEB: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
verses.ASV: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power [proceeding] from him had gone forth, turned him about in the crowd, and said, Who touched my garments?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus logo notou em si o poder que dele havia saído. Então virou-se na multidão, e perguntou: Quem tocou as minhas roupas?
verses.RVR09: Y luego Jesús, conociendo en sí mismo la virtud que había salido de él, volviéndose á la compañía, dijo: ¿Quién ha tocado mis vestidos?

verses.KJV: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.WEB: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
verses.ASV: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus discípulos lhe disseram: Eis que a multidão te aperta, e perguntas: Quem me tocou?
verses.RVR09: Y le dijeron sus discípulos: Ves que la multitud te aprieta, y dices: ¿Quién me ha tocado?

verses.KJV: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.WEB: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
verses.ASV: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele olhava em redor, para ver quem havia lhe feito isso.
verses.RVR09: Y él miraba alrededor para ver á la que había hecho esto.

verses.KJV: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.WEB: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.ASV: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher temendo, e tremendo, sabendo o que havia sido feito em si, veio, prostrou-se diante dele, e disse-lhe toda a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer, temiendo y temblando, sabiendo lo que en sí había sido hecho, vino y se postró delante de él, y le dijo toda la verdad.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Filha, a tua fé te salvou. Vai em paz, e estejas curada deste teu flagelo.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Hija, tu fe te ha hecho salva: ve en paz, y queda sana de tu azote.

verses.KJV: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
verses.ASV: While he yet spake, they come from the ruler of the synagogue’s [house], saying, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Teacher any further?
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando ele ainda falando, alguns vieram [da casa] do líder de sinagoga, e disseram: A tua filha já morreu; por que ainda estás incomodando o Mestre?
verses.RVR09: Hablando aún él, vinieron de casa del príncipe de la sinagoga, diciendo: Tu hija es muerta; ¿para qué fatigas más al Maestro?

verses.KJV: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
verses.WEB: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus, not heeding the word spoken, saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Fear not, only believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, assim que ouviu essa palavra que havia sido falada, disse ao líder de sinagoga: Não temas; crê somente.
verses.RVR09: Mas luego Jesús, oyendo esta razón que se decía, dijo al príncipe de la sinagoga: No temas, cree solamente.

verses.KJV: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
verses.WEB: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
verses.ASV: And he suffered no man to follow with him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não permitiu que ninguém o seguisse, a não ser Pedro, Tiago, e João irmão de Tiago.
verses.RVR09: Y no permitió que alguno viniese tras él sino Pedro, y Jacobo, y Juan hermano de Jacobo.

verses.KJV: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
verses.WEB: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
verses.ASV: And they come to the house of the ruler of the synagogue; and he beholdeth a tumult, and [many] weeping and wailing greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele chegou à casa do líder de sinagoga, e viu o alvoroço, os que choravam muito e pranteavam.
verses.RVR09: Y vino á casa del príncipe de la sinagoga, y vió el alboroto, los que lloraban y gemían mucho.

verses.KJV: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.WEB: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
verses.ASV: And when he was entered in, he saith unto them, Why make ye a tumult, and weep? the child is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao entrar, disse-lhes: Por que fazeis alvoroço e chorais? A menina não morreu, mas está dormindo.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando, les dice: ¿Por qué alborotáis y lloráis? La muchacha no es muerta, mas duerme.

verses.KJV: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
verses.WEB: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
verses.ASV: And they laughed him to scorn. But he, having put them all forth, taketh the father of the child and her mother and them that were with him, and goeth in where the child was.
verses.ALMEIDA: E riram dele. Porém ele, depois de pôr todos fora, tomou consigo o pai e a mãe da menina, e os que estavam com ele. Em seguida, entrou onde a menina estava deitada.
verses.RVR09: Y hacían burla de él: mas él, echados fuera todos, toma al padre y á la madre de la muchacha, y á los que estaban con él, y entra donde la muchacha estaba.

verses.KJV: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
verses.WEB: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
verses.ASV: And taking the child by the hand, he saith unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pegou a mão da menina, e lhe disse: “Talita cumi”, (que significa: “Menina, eu te digo, levanta-te”).
verses.RVR09: Y tomando la mano de la muchacha, le dice: Talitha cumi; que es, si lo interpretares: Muchacha, á ti digo, levántate.

verses.KJV: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
verses.WEB: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
verses.ASV: And straightway the damsel rose up, and walked; for she was twelve years old. And they were amazed straightway with a great amazement.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo a menina se levantou e andou, pois já tinha doze anos de idade. E ficaram grandemente espantados.
verses.RVR09: Y luego la muchacha se levantó, y andaba; porque tenía doce años. Y se espantaron de grande espanto.

verses.KJV: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
verses.WEB: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
verses.ASV: And he charged them much that no man should know this: and he commanded that [something] should be given her to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhes muito que ninguém o soubesse; e mandou que dessem a ela de comer.
verses.RVR09: Mas él les mandó mucho que nadie lo supiese, y dijo que le diesen de comer.

verses.KJV: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.WEB: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
verses.ASV: And he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] partiu-se dali, veio à sua terra, e seus discípulos o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y SALIÓ de allí, y vino á su tierra, y le siguieron sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.WEB: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
verses.ASV: And when the sabbath was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, Whence hath this man these things? and, What is the wisdom that is given unto this man, and [what mean] such mighty works wrought by his hands?
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando o sábado, começou a ensinar na sinagoga; e muitos, quando o ouviram, espantavam-se, dizendo: De onde lhe [vem] estas coisas? E que sabedoria é esta que lhe foi dada? E tais maravilhas feitas por suas mãos?
verses.RVR09: Y llegado el sábado, comenzó á enseñar en la sinagoga; y muchos oyéndole, estaban atónitos, diciendo: ¿De dónde tiene éste estas cosas? ¿Y qué sabiduría es ésta que le es dada, y tales maravillas que por sus manos son hechas?

verses.KJV: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verses.WEB: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.
verses.ASV: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, and Joses, and Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é este o carpinteiro, filho de Maria, e irmão de Tiago, de José, de Judas, e de Simão? E não estão aqui as suas irmãs conosco? E ofenderam-se nele.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es éste el carpintero, hijo de María, hermano de Jacobo, y de José, y de Judas, y de Simón? ¿No están también aquí con nosotros, sus hermanas? Y se escandalizaban en él.

verses.KJV: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes dizia: Todo profeta tem honra, menos em sua terra, entre os parentes, e em sua própria casa.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús les decía: No hay profeta deshonrado sino en su tierra, y entre sus parientes, y en su casa.

verses.KJV: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
verses.WEB: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
verses.ASV: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não pôde ali fazer milagre algum, a não ser somente para uns poucos enfermos, sobre os quais pôs as mãos e os curou.
verses.RVR09: Y no pudo hacer allí alguna maravilla; solamente sanó unos pocos enfermos, poniendo sobre ellos las manos.

verses.KJV: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.WEB: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
verses.ASV: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficou admirado da incredulidade deles. Ele percorreu as aldeias do redor, ensinando.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba maravillado de la incredulidad de ellos. Y rodeaba las aldeas de alrededor, enseñando.

verses.KJV: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.WEB: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
verses.ASV: And he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou a si os doze, e começou a enviar de dois em dois; e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó á los doce, y comenzó á enviarlos de dos en dos: y les dió potestad sobre los espíritus inmundos.

verses.KJV: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
verses.WEB: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
verses.ASV: and he charged them that they should take nothing for [their] journey, save a staff only; no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhes que não tomassem nada para o caminho, a não ser somente um bordão; nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro no cinto;
verses.RVR09: Y les mandó que no llevasen nada para el camino, sino solamente báculo; no alforja, ni pan, ni dinero en la bolsa;

verses.KJV: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.WEB: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
verses.ASV: but [to go] shod with sandals: and, [said he], put not on two coats.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas que calçassem sandálias, e não se vestissem de duas túnicas.
verses.RVR09: Mas que calzasen sandalias, y no vistiesen dos túnicas.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Wheresoever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia-lhes: Onde quer que entrardes em alguma casa, ficai ali até que dali saiais.
verses.RVR09: Y les decía: Donde quiera que entréis en una casa, posad en ella hasta que salgáis de allí.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.WEB: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
verses.ASV: And whatsoever place shall not receive you, and they hear you not, as ye go forth thence, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que não vos receberem, nem vos ouvirem, quando sairdes dali, sacudi o pó que estiver debaixo de vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles Em verdade vos digo, que mais tolerável será a [os de] Sodoma ou Gomorra no dia do juízo, do que a [os d] aquela cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y todos aquellos que no os recibieren ni os oyeren, saliendo de allí, sacudid el polvo que está debajo de vuestros pies, en testimonio á ellos. De cierto os digo que más tolerable será el castigo de los de Sodoma y Gomorra el día del juicio, que el de aquella ciudad.

verses.KJV: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.WEB: They went out and preached that people should repent.
verses.ASV: And they went out, and preached that [men] should repent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, então, se foram, e pregaram que [as pessoas] se arrependessem.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo, predicaban que los hombres se arrepintiesen.

verses.KJV: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
verses.WEB: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
verses.ASV: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles expulsaram muitos demônios, e a muitos enfermos ungiram com azeite, e os curaram.
verses.RVR09: Y echaban fuera muchos demonios, y ungían con aceite á muchos enfermos, y sanaban.

verses.KJV: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.WEB: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
verses.ASV: And king Herod heard [thereof]; for his name had become known: and he said, John the Baptizer is risen from the dead, and therefore do these powers work in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei Herodes ouviu falar disso (porque o nome de [Jesus] já era notório). E dizia: João Batista ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso estas maravilhas operam nele.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó el rey Herodes la fama de Jesús, porque su nombre se había hecho notorio; y dijo: Juan el que bautizaba, ha resucitado de los muertos, y por tanto, virtudes obran en él.

verses.KJV: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.WEB: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
verses.ASV: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, [It is] a prophet, [even] as one of the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outros diziam: É Elias; e outros diziam: É profeta, ou como algum dos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Otros decían: Elías es. Y otros decían: Profeta es, ó alguno de los profetas.

verses.KJV: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.WEB: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
verses.ASV: But Herod, when he heard [thereof], said, John, whom I beheaded, he is risen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, porém, Herodes ouviu falar disso, falou: Ele é João, de quem cortei a cabeça. Ele ressuscitou dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Herodes, dijo: Este es Juan el que yo degollé: él ha resucitado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
verses.WEB: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
verses.ASV: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife; for he had married her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o próprio Herodes havia mandado prender João, e acorrentá-lo na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe, porque havia se casado com ela.
verses.RVR09: Porque el mismo Herodes había enviado, y prendido á Juan, y le había aprisionado en la cárcel á causa de Herodías, mujer de Felipe su hermano; pues la había tomado por mujer.

verses.KJV: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
verses.WEB: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
verses.ASV: For John said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois João dizia a Herodes: Não te é lícito possuir a mulher do teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Porque Juan decía á Herodes: No te es lícito tener la mujer de tu hermano.

verses.KJV: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
verses.WEB: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
verses.ASV: And Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him; and she could not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Herodias o odiava, e queria matá-lo, mas não podia,
verses.RVR09: Mas Herodías le acechaba, y deseaba matarle, y no podía:

verses.KJV: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.WEB: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
verses.ASV: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. And when he heard him, he was much perplexed; and he heard him gladly.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois Herodes temia João, sabendo que era um homem justo e santo, e o estimava. E quando o ouvia, fazia muitas coisas, o ouvia de boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Porque Herodes temía á Juan, sabiendo que era varón justo y santo, y le tenía respeto: y oyéndole, hacía muchas cosas; y le oía de buena gana.

verses.KJV: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
verses.WEB: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
verses.ASV: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas veio um dia oportuno, em que Herodes, no dia do seu aniversário, dava uma ceia aos grandes de sua corte, aos comandantes militares, e aos principais da Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y venido un día oportuno, en que Herodes, en la fiesta de su nacimiento, daba una cena á sus príncipes y tribunos, y á los principales de Galilea;

verses.KJV: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
verses.WEB: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
verses.ASV: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and them that sat at meat with him; and the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a filha dessa Herodias entrou dançando, e agradou a Herodes e aos que estavam sentados com ele. O rei disse à garota: Pede-me quanto quiseres, que eu darei a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando la hija de Herodías, y danzando, y agradando á Herodes y á los que estaban con él á la mesa, el rey dijo á la muchacha: Pídeme lo que quisieres, que yo te lo daré.

verses.KJV: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.WEB: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
verses.ASV: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E jurou a ela: Tudo o que me pedirdes te darei, até a metade do meu reino.
verses.RVR09: Y le juró: Todo lo que me pidieres te daré, hasta la mitad de mi reino.

verses.KJV: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.WEB: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
verses.ASV: And she went out, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptizer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ela saiu, e perguntou à sua mãe: Que pedirei? E ela respondeu: A cabeça de João Batista.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo ella, dijo á su madre: ¿Qué pediré? Y ella dijo: La cabeza de Juan Bautista.

verses.KJV: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.WEB: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
verses.ASV: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou forthwith give me on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando ela logo apressadamente ao rei, pediu, dizendo: Quero que imediatamente me dês num prato a cabeça de João Batista.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ella entró prestamente al rey, y pidió, diciendo: Quiero que ahora mismo me des en un plato la cabeza de Juan Bautista.

verses.KJV: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.WEB: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
verses.ASV: And the king was exceeding sorry; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat, he would not reject her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei entristeceu-se muito; [mas] , por causa dos juramentos, e dos que estavam juntamente à mesa, não quis recusar a ela.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey se entristeció mucho; mas á causa del juramento, y de los que estaban con él á la mesa, no quiso desecharla.

verses.KJV: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.WEB: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.ASV: And straightway the king sent forth a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring his head: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então logo o rei enviou o executor com a ordem de trazer ali sua cabeça. Ele, foi, e o decapitou na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Y luego el rey, enviando uno de la guardia, mandó que fuese traída su cabeza;

verses.KJV: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.WEB: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
verses.ASV: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the damsel; and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida, trouxe a sua cabeça num prato, e o deu à garota; e a garota a deu à sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: El cual fué, y le degolló en la cárcel, y trajo su cabeza en un plato, y la dió á la muchacha, y la muchacha la dió á su madre.

verses.KJV: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.WEB: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
verses.ASV: And when his disciples heard [thereof], they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os discípulos dele ouviram isso, vieram, pegaram o seu cadáver, e o puseram num sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo sus discípulos, vinieron y tomaron su cuerpo, y le pusieron en un sepulcro.

verses.KJV: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.WEB: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
verses.ASV: And the apostles gather themselves together unto Jesus; and they told him all things, whatsoever they had done, and whatsoever they had taught.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os apóstolos juntaram-se [de volta] a Jesus, e contaram-lhe tudo, tanto o que haviam feito, como o que haviam ensinado.
verses.RVR09: Y los apóstoles se juntaron con Jesús, y le contaron todo lo que habían hecho, y lo que habían enseñado.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while. For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Vinde vós à parte a um lugar deserto, e descansai um pouco; pois havia muitos que iam e vinham, e não tinham tempo para comer.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Venid vosotros aparte al lugar desierto, y reposad un poco. Porque eran muchos los que iban y venían, que ni aun tenían lugar de comer.

verses.KJV: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.WEB: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
verses.ASV: And they went away in the boat to a desert place apart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram-se num barco a um lugar deserto à parte.
verses.RVR09: Y se fueron en un barco al lugar desierto aparte.

verses.KJV: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.WEB: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
verses.ASV: And [the people] saw them going, and many knew [them], and they ran together there on foot from all the cities, and outwent them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as multidões os viram ir, e muitos o reconheceram. Então correram para lá a pé de todas as cidades, chegaram antes deles, e vieram para perto dele.
verses.RVR09: Y los vieron ir muchos, y le conocieron; y concurrieron allá muchos á pie de las ciudades, y llegaron antes que ellos, y se juntaron á él.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.WEB: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
verses.ASV: And he came forth and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus saiu [do barco] , viu uma grande multidão, e teve compaixão deles porque eram como ovelhas que não têm pastor. Assim, começou a lhes ensinar muitas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo Jesús vió grande multitud, y tuvo compasión de ellos, porque eran como ovejas que no tenían pastor; y les comenzó á enseñar muchas cosas.

verses.KJV: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
verses.WEB: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
verses.ASV: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, The place is desert, and the day is now far spent;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando já era tarde, os seus discípulos vieram a ele, e disseram: O lugar é deserto, e a hora já é tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y como ya fuese el día muy entrado, sus discípulos llegaron á él, diciendo: El lugar es desierto, y el día ya muy entrado;

verses.KJV: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.WEB: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
verses.ASV: send them away, that they may go into the country and villages round about, and buy themselves somewhat to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Despede-os, para eles irem aos campos e aldeias circunvizinhos, e comprarem pão para si; pois não têm o que comer.
verses.RVR09: Envíalos para que vayan á los cortijos y aldeas de alrededor, y compren para sí pan; porque no tienen qué comer.

verses.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.WEB: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred shillings’ worth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele respondeu: Dai-lhes vós mesmos de comer. E eles lhe responderam: Iremos, e compraremos duzentos denários de pão, para lhes darmos de comer?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: Dadles de comer vosotros. Y le dijeron: ¿Que vayamos y compremos pan por doscientos denarios, y les demos de comer?

verses.KJV: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go [and] see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Quantos pães tendes? Ide ver. Quando souberam, disseram: Cinco, e dois peixes.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dice: ¿Cuántos panes tenéis? Id, y vedlo. Y sabiéndolo, dijeron: Cinco, y dos peces.

verses.KJV: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.WEB: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.ASV: And he commanded them that all should sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhes que fizessem sentar a todos em grupos sobre a grama verde.
verses.RVR09: Y les mandó que hiciesen recostar á todos por partidas sobre la hierba verde.

verses.KJV: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.WEB: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
verses.ASV: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sentaram-se repartidos de cem em cem, e de cinquenta em cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Y se recostaron por partidas, de ciento en ciento, y de cincuenta en cincuenta.

verses.KJV: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.WEB: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
verses.ASV: And he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake the loaves; and he gave to the disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, abençoou, e partiu os pães, e os deu aos seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E os dois peixes repartiu com todos.
verses.RVR09: Y tomados los cinco panes y los dos peces, mirando al cielo, bendijo, y partió los panes, y dió á sus discípulos para que los pusiesen delante: y repartió á todos los dos peces.

verses.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.WEB: They all ate and were filled.
verses.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos comeram e se saciaram.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron todos, y se hartaron.

verses.KJV: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.WEB: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
verses.ASV: And they took up broken pieces, twelve basketfuls, and also of the fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos pedaços de pão e dos peixes levantaram doze cestos cheios.
verses.RVR09: Y alzaron de los pedazos doce cofines llenos, y de los peces.

verses.KJV: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.WEB: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
verses.ASV: And they that ate the loaves were five thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que comeram os pães eram quase cinco mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y los que comieron eran cinco mil hombres.

verses.KJV: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
verses.WEB: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
verses.ASV: And straightway he constrained his disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before [him] unto the other side to Bethsaida, while he himself sendeth the multitude away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo depois, ordenou seus discípulos a subirem no barco, e ir adiante para o outro lado, em Betsaida, enquanto ele despedia a multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y luego dió priesa á sus discípulos á subir en el barco, é ir delante de él á Bethsaida de la otra parte, entre tanto que él despedía la multitud.

verses.KJV: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.WEB: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
verses.ASV: And after he had taken leave of them, he departed into the mountain to pray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de os despedir, foi ao monte para orar.
verses.RVR09: Y después que los hubo despedido, se fué al monte á orar.

verses.KJV: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.WEB: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
verses.ASV: And when even was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao anoitecer, o barco estava no meio do mar, e [Jesus] sozinho em terra.
verses.RVR09: Y como fué la tarde, el barco estaba en medio de la mar, y él solo en tierra.

verses.KJV: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.WEB: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
verses.ASV: And seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary unto them, about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu que se cansavam muito remando, porque o vento lhes era contrário. Então, perto da quarta vigília da noite, veio a eles andando sobre o mar, e queria passar por eles.
verses.RVR09: Y los vió fatigados bogando, porque el viento les era contrario: y cerca de la cuarta vigilia de la noche, vino á ellos andando sobre la mar, y quería precederlos.

verses.KJV: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.WEB: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
verses.ASV: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando eles o viram andando sobre o mar, pensaram que era uma fantasma, e gritaram,
verses.RVR09: Y viéndole ellos, que andaba sobre la mar, pensaron que era fantasma, y dieron voces;

verses.KJV: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.WEB: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
verses.ASV: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he straightway spake with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois todos o viam, e ficaram perturbados. Então logo falou com eles, dizendo: Tende coragem! Sou eu, não tenhais medo.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos le veían, y se turbaron. Mas luego habló con ellos, y les dijo: Alentaos; yo soy, no temáis.

verses.KJV: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.WEB: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
verses.ASV: And he went up unto them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves;
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu a eles no barco, e o vento se aquietou. Eles ficaram muito espantados e maravilhados entre si,
verses.RVR09: Y subió á ellos en el barco, y calmó el viento: y ellos en gran manera estaban fuera de sí, y se maravillaban:

verses.KJV: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.WEB: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
verses.ASV: for they understood not concerning the loaves, but their heart was hardened.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois não haviam entendido o que tinha acontecido com os pães, porque o coração deles estava endurecido.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun no habían considerado lo de los panes, por cuanto estaban ofuscados sus corazones.

verses.KJV: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.WEB: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
verses.ASV: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land unto Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles terminaram de atravessar o mar, chegaram à terra de Genesaré, e ali aportaram.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando estuvieron de la otra parte, vinieron á tierra de Genezaret, y tomaron puerto.

verses.KJV: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.WEB: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
verses.ASV: And when they were come out of the boat, straightway [the people] knew him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eles saíram do barco, logo [as pessoas] o reconheceram.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo ellos del barco, luego le conocieron.

verses.KJV: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.WEB: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.
verses.ASV: and ran round about that whole region, and began to carry about on their beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então gente de toda a região em redor veio correndo, e começaram a trazer em camas os doentes, aonde quer que ouviam que ele estava.
verses.RVR09: Y recorriendo toda la tierra de alrededor, comenzaron á traer de todas partes enfermos en lechos, á donde oían que estaba.

verses.KJV: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
verses.WEB: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
verses.ASV: And wheresoever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aonde quer que ele entrava, em povoados, cidades, ou aldeias, colocavam os enfermos nas praças, e rogavam-lhe que ao menos tocassem a borda de sua roupa; e todos os que o tocavam ficavam sarados.
verses.RVR09: Y donde quiera que entraba, en aldeas, ó ciudades, ó heredades, ponían en las calles á los que estaban enfermos, y le rogaban que tocasen siquiera el borde de su vestido; y todos los que le tocaban quedaban sanos.

verses.KJV: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And there are gathered together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who had come from Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os fariseus, e alguns dos escribas, que tinham vindo de Jerusalém, reuniram-se com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y SE juntaron á él los Fariseos, y algunos de los escribas, que habían venido de Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
verses.WEB: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
verses.ASV: and had seen that some of his disciples ate their bread with defiled, that is, unwashen, hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, quando viram que alguns dos discípulos dele comiam pão com mãos impuras, isto é, sem lavar, repreendiam-lhes.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales, viendo á algunos de sus discípulos comer pan con manos comunes, es á saber, no lavadas, los condenaban.

verses.KJV: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.WEB: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
verses.ASV: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands diligently, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders;
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois os fariseus, e todos os judeus, mantendo a tradição dos antigos, se não lavarem bastante as mãos, não comem.
verses.RVR09: (Porque los Fariseos y todos los Judíos, teniendo la tradición de los ancianos, si muchas veces no se lavan las manos, no comen.

verses.KJV: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
verses.WEB: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
verses.ASV: and [when they come] from the marketplace, except they bathe themselves, they eat not; and many other things there are, which they have received to hold, washings of cups, and pots, and brasen vessels.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E, quando voltam da rua, se não se lavarem, não comem; e há muitas outras coisas que se encarregam de guardar, [como] lavar os copos, as vasilhas, os utensílios de metal, e os leitos).
verses.RVR09: Y volviendo de la plaza, si no se lavaren, no comen. Y otras muchas cosas hay, que tomaron para guardar, como las lavaduras de los vasos de beber, y de los jarros, y de los vasos de metal, y de los lechos.)

verses.KJV: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
verses.WEB: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
