verses.ASV: And the Pharisees and the scribes ask him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with defiled hands?
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois os fariseus e os escribas lhe perguntaram: Por que os teus discípulos não andam conforme a tradição dos antigos, em vez de comerem pão com as mãos sem lavar?
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntaron los Fariseos y los escribas: ¿Por qué tus discípulos no andan conforme á la tradición de los ancianos, sino que comen pan con manos comunes?

verses.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoreth me with their lips, But their heart is far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Bem profetizou Isaías acerca de vós, hipócritas! Como está escrito: Este povo me honra com os lábios, mas o seu coração está longe de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: Hipócritas, bien profetizó de vosotros Isaías, como está escrito: Este pueblo con los labios me honra, mas su corazón lejos está de mí.

verses.KJV: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.WEB: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
verses.ASV: But in vain do they worship me, Teaching [as their] doctrines the precepts of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, porém, me honram em vão, ensinando como doutrinas mandamentos humanos.
verses.RVR09: Y en vano me honran, enseñando como doctrinas mandamientos de hombres.

verses.KJV: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
verses.WEB: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
verses.ASV: Ye leave the commandment of God, and hold fast the tradition of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós deixais o mandamento de Deus, e mantendes a tradição humana, [como] lavar as vasilhas e os copos; e fazeis muitas outras coisas semelhantes a estas.
verses.RVR09: Porque dejando el mandamiento de Dios, tenéis la tradición de los hombres; las lavaduras de los jarros y de los vasos de beber: y hacéis otras muchas cosas semejantes.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Full well do ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your tradition.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia-lhes: Vós dispensais o mandamento de Deus para guardardes a vossa tradição;
verses.RVR09: Les decía también: Bien invalidáis el mandamiento de Dios para guardar vuestra tradición.

verses.KJV: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.WEB: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
verses.ASV: For Moses said, Honor thy father and thy mother; and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.ALMEIDA: porque Moisés disse: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe. E quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe terá de morrer.
verses.RVR09: Porque Moisés dijo: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre, y: El que maldijere al padre ó á la madre, morirá de muerte.

verses.KJV: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
verses.WEB: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
verses.ASV: but ye say, If a man shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is Corban, that is to say, Given [to God];
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós dizeis: Se o homem disser ao pai ou à mãe: Tudo o que te puder aproveitar de mim é corbã (isto é, oferta),
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros decís: Basta si dijere un hombre al padre ó la madre: Es Corbán (quiere decir, don mío á Dios) todo aquello con que pudiera valerte;

verses.KJV: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
verses.WEB: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
verses.ASV: ye no longer suffer him to do aught for his father or his mother;
verses.ALMEIDA: então não lhe deixais mais nada fazer por seu pai ou por sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Y no le dejáis hacer más por su padre ó por su madre,

verses.KJV: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
verses.WEB: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
verses.ASV: making void the word of God by your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim invalidaias a palavra de Deus por vossa tradição, que ordenastes; e [fazeis] muitas coisas semelhantes a estas.
verses.RVR09: Invalidando la palabra de Dios con vuestra tradición que disteis: y muchas cosas hacéis semejantes á éstas.

verses.KJV: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
verses.WEB: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
verses.ASV: And he called to him the multitude again, and said unto them, Hear me all of you, and understand:
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamando para si toda a multidão, disse-lhes: Ouvi-me todos, e entendei:
verses.RVR09: Y llamando á toda la multitud, les dijo: Oidme todos, y entended:

verses.KJV: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
verses.WEB: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
verses.ASV: there is nothing from without the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nada há fora do ser humano que nele entre que o possa contaminar; mas o que dele sai, isso é o que contamina o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Nada hay fuera del hombre que entre en él, que le pueda contaminar: mas lo que sale de él, aquello es lo que contamina al hombre.

verses.KJV: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”
verses.ASV: And when he was entered into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked of him the parable.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
verses.WEB: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Perceive ye not, that whatsoever from without goeth into the man, [it] cannot defile him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando [Jesus] deixou a multidão e entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram sobre a parábola.
verses.RVR09: Y apartado de la multitud, habiendo entrado en casa, le preguntaron sus discípulos sobre la parábola.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
verses.ASV: because it goeth not into his heart, but into his belly, and goeth out into the draught? [This he said], making all meats clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Também vós estais assim sem entendimento? Não entendeis que tudo o que de fora entra no ser humano não o pode contaminar?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: ¿También vosotros estáis así sin entendimiento? ¿No entendéis que todo lo de fuera que entra en el hombre, no le puede contaminar;

verses.KJV: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
verses.WEB: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
verses.ASV: And he said, That which proceedeth out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não entra no seu coração, mas, sim, no ventre, e sai para a privada. (Assim, ele declarou como limpas todas as comidas).
verses.RVR09: Porque no entra en su corazón, sino en el vientre, y sale á la secreta? Esto decía, haciendo limpias todas las viandas.

verses.KJV: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.WEB: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
verses.ASV: For from within, out of the heart of men, evil thoughts proceed, fornications, thefts, murders, adulteries,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia: O que sai do ser humano, isso contamina o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Mas decía, que lo que del hombre sale, aquello contamina al hombre.

verses.KJV: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
verses.WEB: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
verses.ASV: covetings, wickednesses, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, railing, pride, foolishness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois é de dentro do coração humano que vêm os maus pensamentos, os adultérios, os pecados sexuais, os homicídios,
verses.RVR09: Porque de dentro, del corazón de los hombres, salen los malos pensamientos, los adulterios, las fornicaciones, los homicidios,

verses.KJV: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
verses.WEB: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
verses.ASV: all these evil things proceed from within, and defile the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: os roubos, as ganâncias, as maldades, o engano, a depravação, o olho malicioso, a blasfêmia, a soberba, a insensatez.
verses.RVR09: Los hurtos, las avaricias, las maldades, el engaño, las desvergüenzas, el ojo maligno, las injurias, la soberbia, la insensatez.

verses.KJV: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
verses.WEB: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
verses.ASV: And from thence he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And he entered into a house, and would have no man know it; and he could not be hid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes males procedem de dentro, e contaminam o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Todas estas maldades de dentro salen, y contaminan al hombre.

verses.KJV: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
verses.WEB: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
verses.ASV: But straightway a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] levantou-se dali e foi para a região de Tiro e de Sidom. Ele entrou numa casa, e não queria que ninguém soubesse disso, mas não pôde se esconder.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose de allí, se fué á los términos de Tiro y de Sidón; y entrando en casa, quiso que nadie lo supiese; mas no pudo esconderse.

verses.KJV: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
verses.WEB: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
verses.ASV: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. And she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois uma mulher, cuja filhinha tinha um espírito imundo, assim que ouviu falar dele, veio, e prostrou-se a seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Porque una mujer, cuya hija tenía un espíritu inmundo, luego que oyó de él, vino y se echó á sus pies.

verses.KJV: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
verses.WEB: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread and cast it to the dogs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta mulher era grega, de nacionalidade sirofenícia; e rogava-lhe que expulsasse o demônio de sua filha.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer era Griega, Sirofenisa de nación; y le rogaba que echase fuera de su hija al demonio.

verses.KJV: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.ASV: But she answered and saith unto him, Yea, Lord; even the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus lhe disse: Deixa primeiro que os filhos se fartem; porque não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos, e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús le dijo: Deja primero hartarse los hijos, porque no es bien tomar el pan de los hijos y echarlo á los perrillos.

verses.KJV: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
verses.WEB: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ela lhe respondeu: Sim Senhor; mas também os cachorrinhos comem debaixo da mesa, das migalhas que os filhos deixam.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió ella, y le dijo: Sí, Señor; pero aun los perrillos debajo de la mesa, comen de las migajas de los hijos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
verses.ASV: And she went away unto her house, and found the child laid upon the bed, and the demon gone out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhe disse: Por esta palavra, vai, o demônio já saiu da tua filha.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le dice: Por esta palabra, ve; el demonio ha salido de tu hija.

verses.KJV: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
verses.WEB: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
verses.ASV: And again he went out from the borders of Tyre, and came through Sidon unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the borders of Decapolis.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ela chegou à sua casa, encontrou que o demônio já havia saído, e a filha estava deitada sobre a cama.
verses.RVR09: Y como fué á su casa, halló que el demonio había salido, y á la hija echada sobre la cama.

verses.KJV: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
verses.WEB: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
verses.ASV: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to lay his hand upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Jesus] voltou a sair da região de Tiro e de Sidom, e veio para o mar da Galilea, por meio da região de Decápolis.
verses.RVR09: Y volviendo á salir de los términos de Tiro, vino por Sidón á la mar de Galilea, por mitad de los términos de Decápolis.

verses.KJV: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
verses.WEB: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
verses.ASV: And he took him aside from the multitude privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue;
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram-lhe um surdo que dificilmente falava, e rogaram-lhe que pusesse a mão sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y le traen un sordo y tartamudo, y le ruegan que le ponga la mano encima.

verses.KJV: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
verses.WEB: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
verses.ASV: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando-o em separado da multidão, pôs os seus dedos nos ouvidos dele, cuspiu, e tocou-lhe a língua.
verses.RVR09: Y tomándole aparte de la gente, metió sus dedos en las orejas de él, y escupiendo, tocó su lengua;

verses.KJV: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.WEB: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
verses.ASV: And his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois, levantando os olhos ao céu, suspirou, e disse: Efatá, (isto é, abre-te).
verses.RVR09: Y mirando al cielo, gimió, y le dijo: Ephphatha: que es decir: Sé abierto.

verses.KJV: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.WEB: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
verses.ASV: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Imediatamente os ouvidos dele se abriram, e o que prendia sua língua se soltou, e passou a falar bem.
verses.RVR09: Y luego fueron abiertos sus oídos, y fué desatada la ligadura de su lengua, y hablaba bien.

verses.KJV: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
verses.WEB: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
verses.ASV: And they were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well; he maketh even the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] lhes mandou que a ninguém dissessem; porém, quanto mais lhes mandava, mais divulgavam.
verses.RVR09: Y les mandó que no lo dijesen á nadie; pero cuanto más les mandaba, tanto más y más lo divulgaban.

verses.KJV: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.WEB: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficavam muito admirados, dizendo: Ele faz tudo bem! Aos surdos faz ouvir, e aos mudos falar.
verses.RVR09: Y en gran manera se maravillaban, diciendo: Bien lo ha hecho todo: hace á los sordos oir, y á los mudos hablar.

verses.KJV: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
verses.WEB: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
verses.ASV: In those days, when there was again a great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: Naqueles dias, quando havia uma multidão muito grande, e não tinham o que comer, Jesus chamou os seus discípulos a si, e disse-lhes:
verses.RVR09: EN aquellos días, como hubo gran gentío, y no tenían qué comer, Jesús llamó á sus discípulos, y les dijo:

verses.KJV: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.WEB: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.ASV: I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque já há três dias que estão comigo, e não têm o que comer.
verses.RVR09: Tengo compasión de la multitud, porque ya hace tres días que están conmigo, y no tienen qué comer:

verses.KJV: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
verses.WEB: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
verses.ASV: and if I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way; and some of them are come from far.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu os deixar ir sem comer para suas casas desmaiarão no caminho; porque alguns deles vieram de longe.
verses.RVR09: Y si los enviare en ayunas á sus casas, desmayarán en el camino; porque algunos de ellos han venido de lejos.

verses.KJV: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.WEB: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
verses.ASV: And his disciples answered him, Whence shall one be able to fill these men with bread here in a desert place?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os seus discípulos lhe responderam: De onde poderá alguém saciar estes de pão aqui no deserto?
verses.RVR09: Y sus discípulos le respondieron: ¿De dónde podrá alguien hartar á estos de pan aquí en el desierto?

verses.KJV: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.WEB: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.ASV: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] lhes perguntou: Quantos pães tendes? E eles disseram: Sete.
verses.RVR09: Y les preguntó: ¿Cuántos panes tenéis? Y ellos dijeron: Siete.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
verses.WEB: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
verses.ASV: And he commandeth the multitude to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks, he brake, and gave to his disciples, to set before them; and they set them before the multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então mandou à multidão que se sentassem no chão. Em seguida, tomou os sete pães, e tendo dado graças, partiu-os, e os deu a seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E eles os puseram diante da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces mandó á la multitud que se recostase en tierra; y tomando los siete panes, habiendo dado gracias, partió, y dió á sus discípulos que los pusiesen delante: y los pusieron delante á la multitud.

verses.KJV: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
verses.WEB: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
verses.ASV: And they had a few small fishes: and having blessed them, he commanded to set these also before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinham uns poucos peixinhos, e havendo dado graças, disse que também os pusessem diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Tenían también unos pocos pececillos: y los bendijo, y mandó que también los pusiesen delante.

verses.KJV: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
verses.WEB: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.ASV: And they ate, and were filled: and they took up, of broken pieces that remained over, seven baskets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles comeram, e se saciaram; e levantaram, do que sobrou dos pedaços, sete cestos.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron, y se hartaron: y levantaron de los pedazos que habían sobrado, siete espuertas.

verses.KJV: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.WEB: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
verses.ASV: And they were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que comeram eram quase quatro mil. Depois os despediu.
verses.RVR09: Y eran los que comieron, como cuatro mil: y los despidió.

verses.KJV: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.WEB: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.ASV: And straightway he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo entrou no barco com os seus discípulos, e veio para a região de Dalmanuta.
verses.RVR09: Y luego entrando en el barco con sus discípulos, vino á las partes de Dalmanutha.

verses.KJV: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, trying him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os fariseus vieram, e começaram a disputar com ele, pedindo-lhe sinal do céu, para o testar.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los Fariseos, y comenzaron á altercar con él, pidiéndole señal del cielo, tentándole.

verses.KJV: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.WEB: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
verses.ASV: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, suspirando profundamente em seu espírito, disse: Por que esta geração pede um sinal? Em verdade vos digo, que não se dará sinal a esta geração.
verses.RVR09: Y gimiendo en su espíritu, dice: ¿Por qué pide señal esta generación? De cierto os digo que no se dará señal á esta generación.

verses.KJV: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.WEB: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
verses.ASV: And he left them, and again entering into [the boat] departed to the other side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os deixou, voltou a entrar no barco , e foi para a outro lado [do mar] .
verses.RVR09: Y dejándolos, volvió á entrar en el barco, y se fué de la otra parte.

verses.KJV: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.WEB: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
verses.ASV: And they forgot to take bread; and they had not in the boat with them more than one loaf.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [os seus discípulos] haviam se esquecido de tomar pão, e nada tinham, a não ser um pão com eles no barco.
verses.RVR09: Y se habían olvidado de tomar pan, y no tenían sino un pan consigo en el barco.

verses.KJV: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
verses.WEB: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
verses.ASV: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jesus] lhes deu a seguinte ordem: Prestai atenção: tende cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e o fermento de Herodes.
verses.RVR09: Y les mandó, diciendo: Mirad, guardaos de la levadura de los Fariseos, y de la levadura de Herodes.

verses.KJV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
verses.WEB: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
verses.ASV: And they reasoned one with another, saying, We have no bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indagavam-se com os outros , dizendo: É porque não temos pão.
verses.RVR09: Y altercaban los unos con los otros diciendo: Pan no tenemos.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
verses.WEB: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
verses.ASV: And Jesus perceiving it saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? do ye not yet perceive, neither understand? have ye your heart hardened?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus soube e lhes disse: Por que indagais que não tendes pão? Não percebeis ainda, nem entendeis? Ainda tendes o vosso coração endurecido?
verses.RVR09: Y como Jesús lo entendió, les dice: ¿Qué altercáis, porque no tenéis pan? ¿no consideráis ni entendéis? ¿aun tenéis endurecido vuestro corazón?

verses.KJV: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.WEB: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
verses.ASV: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendes olhos, e não vedes? Tendes ouvidos, e não ouvis?
verses.RVR09: ¿Teniendo ojos no veis, y teniendo oídos no oís? ¿y no os acordáis?

verses.KJV: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.WEB: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
verses.ASV: When I brake the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não vos lembrais de, quando parti os cinco pães entre os cinco mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços levantastes?Responderam-lhe: Doze.
verses.RVR09: Cuando partí los cinco panes entre cinco mil, ¿cuántas espuertas llenas de los pedazos alzasteis? Y ellos dijeron: Doce.

verses.KJV: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
verses.WEB: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
verses.ASV: And when the seven among the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces took ye up? And they say unto him, Seven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando [parti] os sete entre os quatro mil, quantas cestas cheias de pedaços levantastes? Eles disseram: Sete.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando los siete panes entre cuatro mil, ¿cuántas espuertas llenas de los pedazos alzasteis? Y ellos dijeron: Siete.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
verses.WEB: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Do ye not yet understand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes perguntou: Como não entendeis?
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: ¿Cómo aun no entendéis?

verses.KJV: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
verses.WEB: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
verses.ASV: And they come unto Bethsaida. And they bring to him a blind man, and beseech him to touch him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a Betsaida. E trouxeram-lhe um cego, e rogaram-lhe que o tocasse.
verses.RVR09: Y vino á Bethsaida; y le traen un ciego, y le ruegan que le tocase.

verses.KJV: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
verses.WEB: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
verses.ASV: And he took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village; and when he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands upon him, he asked him, Seest thou aught?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tomou o cego pela mão e o tirou para fora da aldeia. Depois cuspiu nos olhos dele e, pondo as mãos encima dele, perguntou-lhe se via alguma coisa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, tomando la mano del ciego, le sacó fuera de la aldea; y escupiendo en sus ojos, y poniéndole las manos encima, le preguntó si veía algo.

verses.KJV: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.WEB: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”
verses.ASV: And he looked up, and said, I see men; for I behold [them] as trees, walking.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele levantou os olhos e disse: Vejo as pessoas; pois vejo como árvores que andam.
verses.RVR09: Y él mirando, dijo: Veo los hombres, pues veo que andan como árboles.

verses.KJV: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
verses.WEB: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
verses.ASV: Then again he laid his hands upon his eyes; and he looked stedfastly, and was restored, and saw all things clearly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Jesus] pôs de novo as mãos sobre os seus olhos, e o fez olhar para cima . Assim ele ficou restabelecido, e passou a ver todos claramente.
verses.RVR09: Luego le puso otra vez las manos sobre sus ojos, y le hizo que mirase; y fué restablecido, y vió de lejos y claramente á todos.

verses.KJV: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
verses.WEB: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
verses.ASV: And he sent him away to his home, saying, Do not even enter into the village.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o mandou para sua casa, dizendo: Não entres na aldeia, nem contes a ninguém da aldeia.
verses.RVR09: Y envióle á su casa, diciendo: No entres en la aldea, ni lo digas á nadie en la aldea.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
verses.WEB: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus went forth, and his disciples, into the villages of Cæsarea Philippi: and on the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Who do men say that I am?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus saiu com os seus discípulos para as aldeias de Cesareia de Filipe; e no caminho perguntou a seus discípulos: Quem as pessoas dizem que eu sou?
verses.RVR09: Y salió Jesús y sus discípulos por las aldeas de Cesarea de Filipo. Y en el camino preguntó á sus discípulos, diciéndoles: ¿Quién dicen los hombres que soy yo?

verses.KJV: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
verses.WEB: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”
verses.ASV: And they told him, saying, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles responderam: João Batista, e outros, Elias; e outros, algum dos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Juan Bautista; y otros, Elías; y otros, Alguno de los profetas.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
verses.ASV: And he asked them, But who say ye that I am? Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes perguntou: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? Pedro lhe respondeu: Tu és o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dice: Y vosotros, ¿quién decís que soy yo? Y respondiendo Pedro, le dice: Tú eres el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.WEB: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
verses.ASV: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes ordenou que a ninguém dissessem aquilo dele.
verses.RVR09: Y les apercibió que no hablasen de él á ninguno.

verses.KJV: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.WEB: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.ASV: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou a lhes ensinar que era necessário que o Filho do homem sofresse muito, e fosse rejeitado pelos anciãos e pelos chefes dos sacerdotes e escribas, e que fosse morto, e depois de três dias ressuscitasse.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á enseñarles, que convenía que el Hijo del hombre padeciese mucho, y ser reprobado de los ancianos, y de los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y de los escribas, y ser muerto, y resucitar después de tres días.

verses.KJV: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.WEB: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
verses.ASV: And he spake the saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele dizia essa palavra abertamente. Então Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y claramente decía esta palabra. Entonces Pedro le tomó, y le comenzó á reprender.

verses.KJV: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.WEB: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
verses.ASV: But he turning about, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and saith, Get thee behind me, Satan; for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] virou-se e, olhando para os seus discípulos, repreendeu Pedro, dizendo: Sai de diante de mim, satanás! Pois tu não compreendes as coisas de Deus, mas sim as humanas.
verses.RVR09: Y él, volviéndose y mirando á sus discípulos, riñó á Pedro, diciendo: Apártate de mí, Satanás; porque no sabes las cosas que son de Dios, sino las que son de los hombres.

verses.KJV: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.WEB: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.ASV: And he called unto him the multitude with his disciples, and said unto them, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então chamou a si a multidão com os seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Quem quiser vir após mim, negue a si mesmo, tome a sua cruz, e siga-me;
verses.RVR09: Y llamando á la gente con sus discípulos, les dijo: Cualquiera que quisiere venir en pos de mí, niéguese á sí mismo, y tome su cruz, y sígame.

verses.KJV: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
verses.WEB: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
verses.ASV: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s shall save it.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois quem quiser salvar a sua vida, a perderá; mas quem perder a sua vida por causa de mim e do Evangelho, esse a salvará.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que quisiere salvar su vida, la perderá; y el que perdiere su vida por causa de mí y del evangelio, la salvará.

verses.KJV: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.WEB: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
verses.ASV: For what doth it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que proveito teria alguém, se ganhasse o mundo todo, e perdesse a sua alma?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué aprovechará al hombre, si granjeare todo el mundo, y pierde su alma?

verses.KJV: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.WEB: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.ASV: For what should a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou que daria alguém em resgate de sua alma?
verses.RVR09: ¿O qué recompensa dará el hombre por su alma?

verses.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.WEB: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of man also shall be ashamed of him, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todo aquele que se envergonhar de mim e de minhas palavras nesta geração adúltera e pecadora, também o Filho do homem, quando vier na glória de seu Pai com os santos anjos, envergonhar-se-á dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que se avergonzare de mí y de mis palabras en esta generación adulterina y pecadora, el Hijo del hombre se avergonzará también de él, cuando vendrá en la gloria de su Padre con los santos ángeles.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There are some here of them that stand [by], who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes também: Em verdade vos digo, que há alguns dos que aqui estão, que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o reino de Deus vindo com poder.
verses.RVR09: TAMBIÉN les dijo: De cierto os digo que hay algunos de los que están aquí, que no gustarán la muerte hasta que hayan visto el reino de Dios que viene con potencia.

verses.KJV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.WEB: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
verses.ASV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias depois, Jesus tomou consigo Pedro, Tiago, e João, e os levou à parte, sozinhos, para um alto monte ; e transfigurou-se diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y seis días después tomó Jesús á Pedro, y á Jacobo, y á Juan, y los sacó aparte solos á un monte alto; y fué transfigurado delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.WEB: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
verses.ASV: and his garments became glistering, exceeding white, so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas roupas ficaram resplandescentes, muito brancas como a neve , como nenhum lavadeiro na terra seria capaz de branquear.
verses.RVR09: Y sus vestidos se volvieron resplandecientes, muy blancos, como la nieve; tanto que ningún lavador en la tierra los puede hacer tan blancos.

verses.KJV: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.WEB: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.ASV: And there appeared unto them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-lhes Elias com Moisés, e falavam com Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y les apareció Elías con Moisés, que hablaban con Jesús.

verses.KJV: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.WEB: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.ASV: And Peter answereth and saith to Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pedro disse a Jesus: Mestre, é bom para nós estarmos aqui; façamos três tendas: uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Pedro, dice á Jesús: Maestro, bien será que nos quedemos aquí, y hagamos tres pabellones: para ti uno, y para Moisés otro, y para Elías otro;

verses.KJV: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.WEB: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
verses.ASV: For he knew not what to answer; for they became sore afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele não sabia o que dizia, pois estavam assombrados.
verses.RVR09: Porque no sabía lo que hablaba; que estaban espantados.

verses.KJV: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.WEB: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
verses.ASV: And there came a cloud overshadowing them: and there came a voice out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então desceu uma nuvem, que os cobriu com a sua sombra, e veio uma voz da nuvem, que dizia: Este é meu Filho amado; a ele ouvi.
verses.RVR09: Y vino una nube que les hizo sombra, y una voz de la nube, que decía: Este es mi Hijo amado: á él oid.

verses.KJV: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.WEB: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
verses.ASV: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: De repente, quando olharam em redor, não viram mais ninguém, a não ser só Jesus com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, como miraron, no vieron más á nadie consigo, sino á Jesús solo.

verses.KJV: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.WEB: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.ASV: And as they were coming down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, save when the Son of man should have risen again from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto desciam do monte, [Jesus] lhes mandou que a ninguém contassem o que haviam visto, até que o Filho do homem ressuscitasse dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y descendiendo ellos del monte, les mandó que á nadie dijesen lo que habían visto, sino cuando el Hijo del hombre hubiese resucitado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.WEB: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
verses.ASV: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the rising again from the dead should mean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles guardaram o caso entre si, perguntando uns aos outros o que seria aquilo de “ressuscitar dos mortos”.
verses.RVR09: Y retuvieron la palabra en sí, altercando qué sería aquéllo: Resucitar de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.WEB: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
verses.ASV: And they asked him, saying, [How is it] that the scribes say that Elijah must first come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe perguntaram: Por que os escribas dizem que Elias tem que vir primeiro?
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntaron, diciendo: ¿Qué es lo que los escribas dicen, que es necesario que Elías venga antes?

verses.KJV: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Elijah indeed cometh first, and restoreth all things: and how is it written of the Son of man, that he should suffer many things and be set at nought?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: De fato Elias vem primeiro, e restaura todas as coisas. Então, como está escrito sobre o Filho do homem tem que sofrer muito, e ser desprezado?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: Elías á la verdad, viniendo antes, restituirá todas las cosas: y como está escrito del Hijo del hombre, que padezca mucho y sea tenido en nada.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.WEB: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
verses.ASV: But I say unto you, that Elijah is come, and they have also done unto him whatsoever they would, even as it is written of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos digo que Elias já veio, e fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram, como está escrito sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Empero os digo que Elías ya vino, y le hicieron todo lo que quisieron, como está escrito de él.

verses.KJV: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.WEB: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
verses.ASV: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great multitude about them, and scribes questioning with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando veio aos discípulos, ele viu uma grande multidão ao redor deles; e uns escribas estavam discutindo com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino á los discípulos, vió grande compañía alrededor de ellos, y escribas que disputaban con ellos.

verses.KJV: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.WEB: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
verses.ASV: And straightway all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo que toda a multidão o viu, ficou admirada. Então correram a ele, e o cumprimentaram.
verses.RVR09: Y luego toda la gente, viéndole, se espantó, y corriendo á él, le saludaron.

verses.KJV: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.WEB: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
verses.ASV: And he asked them, What question ye with them?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] perguntou aos escribas: O que estais discutindo com eles?
verses.RVR09: Y preguntóles: ¿Qué disputáis con ellos?

verses.KJV: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.WEB: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
verses.ASV: And one of the multitude answered him, Teacher, I brought unto thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: E um da multidão respondeu: Mestre, trouxe a ti o meu filho, que tem um espírito mudo.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo uno de la compañía, dijo: Maestro, traje á ti mi hijo, que tiene un espíritu mudo,

verses.KJV: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.WEB: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
verses.ASV: and wheresoever it taketh him, it dasheth him down: and he foameth, and grindeth his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast it out; and they were not able.
verses.ALMEIDA: E onde quer que o toma, faz-lhe ter convulsões, solta espuma, range os dentes, e vai ficando rígido. Eu disse aos teus discípulos que o expulsassem, mas não conseguiram.
verses.RVR09: El cual, donde quiera que le toma, le despedaza; y echa espumarajos, y cruje los dientes, y se va secando: y dije á tus discípulos que le echasen fuera, y no pudieron.

verses.KJV: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.WEB: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
verses.ASV: And he answereth them and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] lhe respondeu: Ó geração incrédula! Até quando estarei ainda convosco? Até quando vos suportarei? Trazei-o a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo él, les dijo: ¡Oh generación infiel! ¿hasta cuándo estaré con vosotros? ¿hasta cuándo os tengo de sufrir? Traédmele.

verses.KJV: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.WEB: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
verses.ASV: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him grievously; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então trouxeram-no a ele. E quando o viu, logo o espírito o fez ter uma convulsão e, caindo em terra, rolava, e espumava.
verses.RVR09: Y se le trajeron: y como le vió, luego el espíritu le desgarraba; y cayendo en tierra, se revolcaba, echando espumarajos.

verses.KJV: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.WEB: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
verses.ASV: And he asked his father, How long time is it since this hath come unto him? And he said, From a child.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntou ao seu pai: Quanto tempo há que isto lhe sobreveio? E ele lhe disse: Desde a infância.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús preguntó á su padre: ¿Cuánto tiempo há que le aconteció esto? Y él dijo: Desde niño:

verses.KJV: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.WEB: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
verses.ASV: And oft-times it hath cast him both into the fire and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas vezes o lançou também no fogo e na água para o destruir. Mas, se podes algo, tem compaixão de nós, e ajuda-nos.
verses.RVR09: Y muchas veces le echa en el fuego y en aguas, para matarle; mas, si puedes algo, ayúdanos, teniendo misericordia de nosotros.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Se podes crer, tudo é possível ao que crê.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Si puedes creer, al que cree todo es posible.

verses.KJV: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.WEB: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
verses.ASV: Straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo o pai do menino, clamando, com lágrimas, disse: Creio, Senhor! Ajuda-me na minha incredulidade.
verses.RVR09: Y luego el padre del muchacho dijo clamando: Creo, ayuda mi incredulidad.

verses.KJV: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.WEB: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I command thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus viu que a multidão corria e se ajuntava, repreendeu o espírito imundo, dizendo-lhe: Espírito mudo e surdo, eu te ordeno, sai dele, e nunca mais entres nele!
verses.RVR09: Y como Jesús vió que la multitud se agolpaba, reprendió al espíritu inmundo, diciéndole: Espíritu mudo y sordo, yo te mando, sal de él, y no entres más en él.

verses.KJV: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.WEB: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
verses.ASV: And having cried out, and torn him much, he came out: and [the boy] became as one dead; insomuch that the more part said, He is dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [o espírito] , gritando, e fazendo-o ter muita convulsão, saiu. E [o menino] ficou como morto, de maneira que muitos diziam que estava morto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el espíritu clamando y desgarrándole mucho, salió; y él quedó como muerto, de modo que muchos decían: Está muerto.

verses.KJV: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.WEB: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
verses.ASV: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus o tomou pela mão, e o ergueu; e ele se levantou.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús tomándole de la mano, enderezóle; y se levantó.

verses.KJV: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.WEB: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
verses.ASV: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, [How is it] that we could not cast it out?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram à parte: Por que nós não conseguimos o expulsar?
verses.RVR09: Y como él entró en casa, sus discípulos le preguntaron aparte: ¿Por qué nosotros no pudimos echarle fuera?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, This kind can come out by nothing, save by prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes respondeu: Este tipo não pode sair por coisa alguma, a não ser com oração e jejum.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Este género con nada puede salir, sino con oración y ayuno.

verses.KJV: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.WEB: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,
verses.ASV: And they went forth from thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois partiram dali, e caminharam pela Galileia. Mas [Jesus] não queria que ninguém soubesse,
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo salido de allí, caminaron por Galilea; y no quería que nadie lo supiese.

verses.KJV: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.WEB: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
verses.ASV: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered up into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and when he is killed, after three days he shall rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ensinava a seus discípulos, e lhes dizia: O Filho do homem será entregue em mãos de homens, e o matarão; e [estando] ele morto, ressuscitará ao terceiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque enseñaba á sus discípulos, y les decía: El Hijo del hombre será entregado en manos de hombres, y le matarán; mas muerto él, resucitará al tercer día.

verses.KJV: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.WEB: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.ASV: But they understood not the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, e temiam lhe perguntar.
verses.RVR09: Pero ellos no entendían esta palabra, y tenían miedo de preguntarle.

verses.KJV: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.WEB: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
verses.ASV: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house he asked them, What were ye reasoning on the way?
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a Cafarnaum, e entrando em casa, perguntou-lhes: Que indagais entre vós pelo caminho?
verses.RVR09: Y llegó á Capernaum; y así que estuvo en casa, les preguntó: ¿Qué disputabais entre vosotros en el camino?

verses.KJV: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
verses.WEB: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.
verses.ASV: But they held their peace: for they had disputed one with another on the way, who [was] the greatest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles se calaram; porque eles haviam discutido uns com os outros pelo caminho, qual [deles seria] o maior.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos callaron; porque los unos con los otros habían disputado en el camino quién había de ser el mayor.

verses.KJV: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.WEB: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
verses.ASV: And he sat down, and called the twelve; and he saith unto them, If any man would be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sentando-se ele, chamou aos doze, e disse-lhes: Se alguém quiser ser o primeiro, seja o últimos de todos, e servo de todos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces sentándose, llamó á los doce, y les dice: Si alguno quiere ser el primero, será el postrero de todos, y el servidor de todos.

verses.KJV: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.WEB: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
verses.ASV: And he took a little child, and set him in the midst of them: and taking him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando um menino, ele o pôs no meio deles, e tomando-o entre seus braços, disse-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Y tomando un niño, púsolo en medio de ellos; y tomándole en sus brazos, les dice:

verses.KJV: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.WEB: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
verses.ASV: Whosoever shall receive one of such little children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever receiveth me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer que em meu nome receber a um dos tais meninos, recebe a mim; e qualquer que me receber, não é a mim que recebe, mas, sim, àquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: El que recibiere en mi nombre uno de los tales niños, á mí recibe; y el que á mí recibe, no recibe á mí, mas al que me envió.

verses.KJV: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.WEB: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
verses.ASV: John said unto him, Teacher, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followed not us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe João, dizendo: Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava os demônios, e ele não nos segue. Então o proibimos, porque não nos segue.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Juan, diciendo: Maestro, hemos visto á uno que en tu nombre echaba fuera los demonios, el cual no nos sigue; y se lo prohibimos, porque no nos sigue.

verses.KJV: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
verses.ASV: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man who shall do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus disse: Não o proibais; porque ninguém há que faça milagre em meu nome, e logo possa falar mal de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús dijo: No se lo prohibáis; porque ninguno hay que haga milagro en mi nombre que luego pueda decir mal de mí.

verses.KJV: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.WEB: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
verses.ASV: For he that is not against us is for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem não é contra nós, é por nós.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que no es contra nosotros, por nosotros es.

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.WEB: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink, because ye are Christ’s, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qualquer que vos der um copo d'água para beber em meu nome, porque sois de Cristo, em verdade vos digo, que não perderá sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que os diere un vaso de agua en mi nombre, porque sois de Cristo, de cierto os digo que no perderá su recompensa.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.WEB: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
verses.ASV: And whosoever shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it were better for him if a great millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer que conduzir ao pecado um destes pequenos que creem em mim, melhor lhe fora que lhe pusesse ao pescoço uma grande pedra de moinho, e que fosse lançado no mar.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que escandalizare á uno de estos pequeñitos que creen en mí, mejor le fuera si se le atase una piedra de molino al cuello, y fuera echado en la mar.

verses.KJV: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.WEB: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
verses.ASV: And if thy hand cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed, rather than having thy two hands to go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a tua mão te faz pecar, corta-a; melhor te é entrar na vida mutilado, do que, tendo duas mãos, ir ao inferno, ao fogo que nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Y si tu mano te escandalizare, córtala: mejor te es entrar á la vida manco, que teniendo dos manos ir á la Gehenna, al fuego que no puede ser apagado;

verses.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.ASV: And if thy foot cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life halt, rather than having thy two feet to be cast into hell.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde seu verme não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Donde su gusano no muere, y el fuego nunca se apaga.

verses.KJV: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.WEB: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
verses.ASV: And if thine eye cause thee to stumble, cast it out: it is good for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se teu pé te faz pecar, corta-o; melhor te é entrar na vida manco, do que, tendo dois pés, ser lançado no inferno, no fogo que nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Y si tu pie te fuere ocasión de caer, córtalo: mejor te es entrar á la vida cojo, que teniendo dos pies ser echado en la Gehenna, al fuego que no puede ser apagado;

verses.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.ASV: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde seu verme não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Donde el gusano de ellos no muere, y el fuego nunca se apaga.

verses.KJV: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
verses.WEB: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
verses.ASV: For every one shall be salted with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se teu olho te faz pecar, lança-o fora; melhor te é entrar no Reino de Deus com um olho, do que, tendo dois olhos, ser lançado no fogo do inferno,
verses.RVR09: Y si tu ojo te fuere ocasión de caer, sácalo: mejor te es entrar al reino de Dios con un ojo, que teniendo dos ojos ser echado á la Gehenna;

verses.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.ASV: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost its saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.
verses.ALMEIDA: onde seu verme não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Donde el gusano de ellos no muere, y el fuego nunca se apaga.

verses.KJV: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.WEB: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cada um será salgado com fogo, e cada sacrifício será salgado com sal.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos serán salados con fuego, y todo sacrificio será salado con sal.

verses.KJV: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.WEB: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
verses.ALMEIDA: O sal é bom; mas se o sal se tornar insípido, com que o temperareis? Tende sal em vós mesmos, e paz uns com os outros.
verses.RVR09: Buena es la sal; mas si la sal fuere desabrida, ¿con qué la adobaréis? Tened en vosotros mismos sal; y tened paz los unos con los otros.

verses.KJV: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.WEB: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
verses.ASV: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the borders of Judæa and beyond the Jordan: and multitudes come together unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se dali, [Jesus] se foi aos limites da Judeia, por dalém do Jordão; e as multidões voltaram a se juntar a ele, e voltou a lhes ensinar, como tinha costume.
verses.RVR09: Y PARTIÉNDOSE de allí, vino á los términos de Judea y tras el Jordán: y volvió el pueblo á juntarse á él; y de nuevo les enseñaba como solía.

verses.KJV: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
verses.WEB: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
verses.ASV: And there came unto him Pharisees, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away [his] wife? trying him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo a ele os fariseus, perguntaram-lhe se era lícito ao homem deixar a [sua] mulher, testando-o.
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose los Fariseos, le preguntaron, para tentarle, si era lícito al marido repudiar á su mujer.

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.WEB: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes respondeu: O que Moisés vos mandou?
verses.RVR09: Mas él respondiendo, les dijo: ¿Qué os mandó Moisés?

verses.KJV: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.WEB: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles disseram: Moisés permitiu escrever carta de divórcio, e deixá-la.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: Moisés permitió escribir carta de divorcio, y repudiar.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
verses.ASV: But Jesus said unto them, For your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Foi pela dureza dos vossos corações que ele vos escreveu este mandamento.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Por la dureza de vuestro corazón os escribió este mandamiento;

verses.KJV: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.WEB: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
verses.ASV: But from the beginning of the creation, Male and female made he them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, desde o princípio da criação, macho e fêmea Deus os fez.
verses.RVR09: Pero al principio de la creación, varón y hembra los hizo Dios.

verses.KJV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.WEB: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
verses.ASV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, deixará o homem a seu pai e a [sua] mãe, e se unirá à sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Por esto dejará el hombre á su padre y á su madre, y se juntará á su mujer.

verses.KJV: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.WEB: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
verses.ASV: and the two shall become one flesh: so that they are no more two, but one flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dois serão uma [só] carne; assim, já não são dois, mas sim uma [só] carne.
verses.RVR09: Y los que eran dos, serán hechos una carne: así que no son más dos, sino una carne.

verses.KJV: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.WEB: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
verses.ASV: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, o que Deus juntou, não separe o homem.
verses.RVR09: Pues lo que Dios juntó, no lo aparte el hombre.

verses.KJV: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
