verses.WEB: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
verses.ASV: And in the house the disciples asked him again of this matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em casa seus discípulos voltaram a lhe perguntar sobre isto mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y en casa volvieron los discípulos á preguntarle de lo mismo.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Qualquer um que deixar a sua mulher, e se casar com outra, adultera contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Cualquiera que repudiare á su mujer, y se casare con otra, comete adulterio contra ella:

verses.KJV: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.WEB: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
verses.ASV: and if she herself shall put away her husband, and marry another, she committeth adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a mulher deixar o seu marido, e se casar com outro, adultera.
verses.RVR09: Y si la mujer repudiare á su marido y se casare con otro, comete adulterio.

verses.KJV: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
verses.WEB: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
verses.ASV: And they were bringing unto him little children, that he should touch them: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe traziam crianças para que ele as tocasse, mas os discípulos repreendiam aos que [as] traziam.
verses.RVR09: Y le presentaban niños para que los tocase; y los discípulos reñían á los que los presentaban.

verses.KJV: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
verses.ASV: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me; forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus, vendo, indignou-se, e lhe disse: Deixai vir as crianças a mim, e não as impeçais; porque delas é o Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y viéndolo Jesús, se enojó, y les dijo: Dejad los niños venir, y no se lo estorbéis; porque de los tales es el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que qualquer um que não receber o Reino de Deus como criança, em maneira nenhuma nele entrará.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que el que no recibiere el reino de Dios como un niño, no entrará en él.

verses.KJV: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.WEB: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
verses.ASV: And he took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, tomando-as entre seus braços, e pondo as mãos sobre elas, ele as abençoou.
verses.RVR09: Y tomándolos en los brazos, poniendo las manos sobre ellos, los bendecía.

verses.KJV: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.WEB: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
verses.ASV: And as he was going forth into the way, there ran one to him, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele saiu para caminhar, um [homem] correu até ele; e pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, perguntou-lhe: Bom Mestre, que farei para herdar a vida eterna?
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo él para ir su camino, vino uno corriendo, é hincando la rodilla delante de él, le preguntó: Maestro bueno, ¿qué haré para poseer la vida eterna?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good save one, [even] God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém é bom, a não ser um: Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: ¿Por qué me dices bueno? Ninguno hay bueno, sino sólo uno, Dios.

verses.KJV: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.WEB: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
verses.ASV: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not kill, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Do not defraud, Honor thy father and mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás; não matarás; não furtarás; não darás falso testemunho; não serás enganador; honra o teu pai e a [tua] mãe.
verses.RVR09: Los mandamientos sabes: No adulteres: No mates: No hurtes: No digas falso testimonio: No defraudes: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre.

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Teacher, all these things have I observed from my youth.

verses.ALMEIDA: Eles foram, e acharam o jumentinho amarrado à porta, do lado de fora em uma esquina, e o soltaram.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron, y hallaron el pollino atado á la puerta fuera, entre dos caminos; y le desataron.

verses.KJV: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.WEB: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
verses.ASV: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos que ali estavam lhes perguntaram: Que fazeis, soltando o jumentinho?
verses.RVR09: Y unos de los que estaban allí, les dijeron: ¿Qué hacéis desatando el pollino?

verses.KJV: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.WEB: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
verses.ASV: And they said unto them even as Jesus had said: and they let them go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles lhes disseram como Jesus [lhes] havia mandado, e os deixaram ir.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces les dijeron como Jesús había mandado: y los dejaron.

verses.KJV: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.WEB: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
verses.ASV: And they bring the colt unto Jesus, and cast on him their garments; and he sat upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então trouxeram o jumentinho a Jesus. Lançaram sobre ele suas roupas, e [Jesus] sentou-se sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y trajeron el pollino á Jesús, y echaron sobre él sus vestidos, y se sentó sobre él.

verses.KJV: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.WEB: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
verses.ASV: And many spread their garments upon the way; and others branches, which they had cut from the fields.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos estendiam suas roupas pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos das árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho..
verses.RVR09: Y muchos tendían sus vestidos por el camino, y otros cortaban hojas de los árboles, y las tendían por el camino.

verses.KJV: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.WEB: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
verses.ASV: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, Hosanna; Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que iam adiante, e os que seguiam, clamavam: Hosana, bendito o que vem no Nome do Senhor!
verses.RVR09: Y los que iban delante, y los que iban detrás, daban voces diciendo: ¡Hosanna! Bendito el que viene en el nombre del Señor.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.ASV: Blessed [is] the kingdom that cometh, [the kingdom] of our father David: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito o Reino que vem no Nome do Senhor, [o Reino] do nosso pai Davi! Hosana nas alturas!
verses.RVR09: Bendito el reino de nuestro padre David que viene: ¡Hosanna en las alturas!

verses.KJV: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.WEB: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
verses.ASV: And he entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and when he had looked round about upon all things, it being now eventide, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus entrou em Jerusalém, e no Templo. E depois que ter visto tudo em redor, e sendo já tarde, ele saiu para Betânia com os doze.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Jesús en Jerusalem, y en el templo: y habiendo mirado alrededor todas las cosas, y siendo ya tarde, salióse á Bethania con los doce.

verses.KJV: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.WEB: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
verses.ASV: And on the morrow, when they were come out from Bethany, he hungered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte, quando saíram de Betânia, ele teve fome.
verses.RVR09: Y el día siguiente, como salieron de Bethania, tuvo hambre.

verses.KJV: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
verses.WEB: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.ASV: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find anything thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for it was not the season of figs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo de longe uma figueira que tinha folhas, [veio ver] se acharia alguma coisa nela; mas ao chegar perto dela, nada achou, a não ser folhas, pois não era o tempo de figos.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo de lejos una higuera que tenía hojas, se acercó, si quizá hallaría en ella algo: y como vino á ella, nada halló sino hojas; porque no era tiempo de higos.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
verses.WEB: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And his disciples heard it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhe disse: Nunca mais ninguém coma fruto de ti! E seus discípulos ouviram isso.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús respondiendo, dijo á la higuera: Nunca más coma nadie fruto de ti para siempre. Y lo oyeron sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.WEB: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
verses.ASV: And they come to Jerusalem: and he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and them that bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois vieram a Jerusalém. E entrando Jesus no Templo, começou a expulsar os que vendiam e compravam no Templo; e revirou as mesas dos cambiadores, e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas.
verses.RVR09: Vienen, pues, á Jerusalem; y entrando Jesús en el templo, comenzó á echar fuera á los que vendían y compraban en el templo; y trastornó las mesas de los cambistas, y las sillas de los que vendían palomas;

verses.KJV: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
verses.WEB: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
verses.ASV: and he would not suffer that any man should carry a vessel through the temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não consentia que ninguém levasse vaso algum pelo Templo.
verses.RVR09: Y no consentía que alguien llevase vaso por el templo.

verses.KJV: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.WEB: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
verses.ASV: And he taught, and said unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations? but ye have made it a den of robbers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinava, dizendo-lhes: Não está escrito: Minha casa será chamada casa de oração de todas as nações? Mas vós fizestes dela esconderijo de ladrões!
verses.RVR09: Y les enseñaba diciendo: ¿No está escrito que mi casa, casa de oración será llamada por todas las gentes? Mas vosotros la habéis hecho cueva de ladrones.

verses.KJV: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.WEB: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
verses.ASV: And the chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, for all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os escribas e os chefes dos sacerdotes ouviram isso, e buscavam uma maneira de o matar; pois o temiam, porque toda a multidão estava admirada do ensino dele.
verses.RVR09: Y lo oyeron los escribas y los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y procuraban cómo le matarían; porque le tenían miedo, por cuanto todo el pueblo estaba maravillado de su doctrina.

verses.KJV: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.WEB: When evening came, he went out of the city.
verses.ASV: And every evening he went forth out of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como já era tarde, [Jesus] saiu fora da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Mas como fué tarde, Jesús salió de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.WEB: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
verses.ASV: And as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando pela manhã, viram que a figueira estava seca desde as raízes.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando por la mañana, vieron que la higuera se había secado desde las raíces.

verses.KJV: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.WEB: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
verses.ASV: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro se lembrou disso, e disse-lhe: Mestre, eis que a figueira que amaldiçoaste, se secou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro acordándose, le dice: Maestro, he aquí la higuera que maldijiste, se ha secado.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Tende fé em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dice: Tened fe en Dios.

verses.KJV: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.WEB: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he saith cometh to pass; he shall have it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em verdade vos digo que qualquer um que disser a este monte: Levanta-te, e lança-te no mar; e não duvidar em seu coração, mas crer que se fará o que diz, tudo o que disser lhe será feito.
verses.RVR09: Porque de cierto os digo que cualquiera que dijere á este monte: Quítate, y échate en la mar, y no dudare en su corazón, mas creyere que será hecho lo que dice, lo que dijere le será hecho.

verses.KJV: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.WEB: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
verses.ASV: Therefore I say unto you, All things whatsoever ye pray and ask for, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos digo que tudo o que pedirdes orando, crede que recebereis, e vós [o] tereis.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, os digo que todo lo que orando pidiereis, creed que lo recibiréis, y os vendrá.

verses.KJV: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.WEB: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
verses.ASV: And whensoever ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have aught against any one; that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando estiverdes orando, perdoai, se tendes algo contra alguém, para que o vosso Pai, que [está] nos céus, vos perdoe vossas ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando estuviereis orando, perdonad, si tenéis algo contra alguno, para que vuestro Padre que está en los cielos os perdone también á vosotros vuestras ofensas.

verses.KJV: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.WEB: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
verses.ASV: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se vós não perdoardes, também o vosso Pai, que [está] nos céus, não vos perdoará vossas ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Porque si vosotros no perdonareis, tampoco vuestro Padre que está en los cielos os perdonará vuestras ofensas.

verses.KJV: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.WEB: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
verses.ASV: and they said unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? or who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois voltaram a Jerusalém; e, enquanto ele andava pelo Templo, vieram a ele os chefes dos sacerdotes, os escribas, e os anciãos.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron á Jerusalem; y andando él por el templo, vienen á él los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los escribas, y los ancianos;

verses.KJV: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.WEB: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, I will ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram-lhe: Com que autoridade fazes estas coisas? E quem te deu esta autoridade, para fazerdes estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: Y le dicen: ¿Con qué facultad haces estas cosas? ¿y quién te ha dado esta facultad para hacer estas cosas?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ASV: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Também eu vos farei uma pergunta, e respondei-me; então vos direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús respondiendo entonces, les dice: Os preguntaré también yo una palabra; y respondedme, y os diré con qué facultad hago estas cosas:

verses.KJV: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.WEB: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
verses.ASV: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.ALMEIDA: O batismo de João era do céu ou dos homens? Respondei-me.
verses.RVR09: El bautismo de Juan, ¿era del cielo, ó de los hombres? Respondedme.

verses.KJV: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.WEB: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.ASV: But should we say, From men—they feared the people: for all verily held John to be a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles argumentavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos do céu, ele dirá: Por que, pois, não crestes nele?
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos pensaron dentro de sí, diciendo: Si dijéremos, del cielo, dirá: ¿Por qué, pues, no le creísteis?

verses.KJV: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.WEB: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
verses.ASV: And they answered Jesus and say, We know not. And Jesus saith unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se dissermos dos homens, tememos ao povo, porque todos consideravam que João era verdadeiramente profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijéremos, de los hombres, tememos al pueblo: porque todos juzgaban de Juan, que verdaderamente era profeta.

verses.KJV: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.WEB: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
verses.ALMEIDA: Então responderam a Jesus: Não sabemos. E Jesus lhes replicou: Também eu não vos direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo, dicen á Jesús: No sabemos. Entonces respondiendo Jesús, les dice: Tampoco yo os diré con qué facultad hago estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.WEB: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
verses.ASV: And he began to speak unto them in parables. A man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a pit for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Jesus] começou a lhes dizer por parábolas: Um homem plantou uma vinha, cercou-a, fundou [nela] uma prensa de uvas, edificou uma torre, e a arrendou a uns lavradores; e partiu-se daquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y COMENZÓ á hablarles por parábolas: Plantó un hombre una viña, y la cercó con seto, y cavó un lagar, y edificó una torre, y la arrendó á labradores, y se partió lejos.

verses.KJV: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.WEB: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.ASV: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruits of the vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, quando chegou o tempo, mandou um servo aos lavradores, para que recebesse dos lavradores do fruto da vinha.
verses.RVR09: Y envió un siervo á los labradores, al tiempo, para que tomase de los labradores del fruto de la viña.

verses.KJV: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.WEB: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.ASV: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles, tomando-o à força, feriram-no, e mandaram-no vazio.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos, tomándole, le hirieron, y le enviaron vacío.

verses.KJV: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.WEB: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
verses.ASV: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a lhes mandar outro servo; e eles, apedrejando-o, feriram-no na cabeça e voltaram a mandá-lo maltratado.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á enviarles otro siervo; mas apedreándole, le hirieron en la cabeza, y volvieron á enviarle afrentado.

verses.KJV: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.WEB: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
verses.ASV: And he sent another; and him they killed: and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a mandar outro, ao qual mataram, e [mandou] muitos outros, e a uns feriram, e a outros mataram.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á enviar otro, y á aquél mataron; y á otros muchos, hiriendo á unos y matando á otros.

verses.KJV: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.WEB: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.ASV: He had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo ele, pois, ainda um, o seu filho amado, mandou-lhes também por último a este, dizendo: Pelo menos respeitarão o meu filho.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo pues aún un hijo suyo amado, enviólo también á ellos el postrero, diciendo: Tendrán en reverencia á mi hijo.

verses.KJV: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.'
verses.WEB: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.ASV: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aqueles lavradores disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, e o matemos; então a herança será nossa.
verses.RVR09: Mas aquellos labradores dijeron entre sí: Este es el heredero; venid, matémosle, y la heredad será nuestra.

verses.KJV: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.WEB: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.ASV: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pegando dele, mataram[-no] , e lançaram[-no] fora da vinha.
verses.RVR09: Y prendiéndole, le mataron, y echaron fuera de la viña.

verses.KJV: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.WEB: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
verses.ASV: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que, pois, o senhor da vinha fará? Ele virá, destruirá aos lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué, pues, hará el señor de la viña? Vendrá, y destruirá á estos labradores, y dará su viña á otros.

verses.KJV: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.WEB: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.
verses.ASV: Have ye not read even this scripture: The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso ainda não lestes esta escritura: “A pedra que os edificadores rejeitaram, esta foi feita por cabeça de esquina.
verses.RVR09: ¿Ni aun esta Escritura habéis leído: La piedra que desecharon los que edificaban, ésta es puesta por cabeza de esquina;

verses.KJV: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.WEB: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”
verses.ASV: This was from the Lord, And it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo Senhor foi feito isto, e é maravilhoso em nossos olhos”?
verses.RVR09: Por el Señor es hecho esto, y es cosa maravillosa en nuestros ojos?

verses.KJV: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.WEB: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.
verses.ASV: And they sought to lay hold on him; and they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spake the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E buscavam prendê-lo, mas temiam a multidão; porque entendiam que era contra eles que dizia aquela parábola; então o deixaram e se retiraram.
verses.RVR09: Y procuraban prenderle, porque entendían que decía á ellos aquella parábola; mas temían á la multitud; y dejándole, se fueron.

verses.KJV: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.WEB: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
verses.ASV: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they might catch him in talk.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandaram-lhe alguns dos fariseus e dos herodianos, para que o apanhassem em [alguma] palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y envían á él algunos de los Fariseos y de los Herodianos, para que le sorprendiesen en alguna palabra.

verses.KJV: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.WEB: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
verses.ASV: And when they were come, they say unto him, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and carest not for any one; for thou regardest not the person of men, but of a truth teachest the way of God: Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se aproximaram e lhe disseram: Mestre, sabemos que és homem de verdade, e não te interessa [agradar] a ninguém, porque não te importas com a aparência humana, mas com verdade ensinas o caminho de Deus. É lícito pagar tributo a César, ou não? Devemos pagar, ou não devemos?
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo ellos, le dicen: Maestro, sabemos que eres hombre de verdad, y que no te cuidas de nadie; porque no miras á la apariencia de hombres, antes con verdad enseñas el camino de Dios: ¿Es lícito dar tributo á César, ó no? ¿Daremos, ó no daremos?

verses.KJV: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
verses.WEB: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
verses.ASV: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why make ye trial of me? bring me a denarius, that I may see it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, entendendo a hipocrisia deles, disse-lhes: Por que estais me tentando? Trazei-me uma moeda, para que eu a veja.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él, como entendía la hipocresía de ellos, les dijo: ¿Por qué me tentáis? Traedme la moneda para que la vea.

verses.KJV: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.WEB: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
verses.ASV: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram. E perguntou-lhes: De quem é esta imagem, e a inscrição? E eles lhe disseram: De César.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos se la trajeron y les dice: ¿Cúya es esta imagen y esta inscripción? Y ellos le dijeron: De César.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Render unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and unto God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled greatly at him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus, lhes respondeu: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus. E admiram-se dele.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Dad lo que es de César á César; y lo que es de Dios, á Dios. Y se maravillaron de ello.

verses.KJV: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.WEB: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,
verses.ASV: And there come unto him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a ele os saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e perguntaram-lhe:
verses.RVR09: Entonces vienen á él los Saduceos, que dicen que no hay resurrección, y le preguntaron, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.WEB: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
verses.ASV: Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave a wife behind him, and leave no child, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mestre, Moisés nos escreveu que, se o irmão de alguém morresse, e deixasse mulher, mas não filhos, que seu irmão se casasse com a viúva , e gerasse descendência ao seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Maestro, Moisés nos escribió, que si el hermano de alguno muriese, y dejase mujer, y no dejase hijos, que su hermano tome su mujer, y levante linaje á su hermano.

verses.KJV: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.WEB: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
verses.ASV: There were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve, pois, sete irmãos, e o primeiro casou-se com a mulher, e morrendo, não deixou descendente.
verses.RVR09: Fueron siete hermanos: y el primero tomó mujer, y muriendo, no dejó simiente;

verses.KJV: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.WEB: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
verses.ASV: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:
verses.ALMEIDA: Casou-se com ela também o segundo, e morreu; e nem este deixou descendente; e o terceiro da mesma maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y la tomó el segundo, y murió, y ni aquél tampoco dejó simiente; y el tercero, de la misma manera.

verses.KJV: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.WEB: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.ASV: and the seven left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sete casaram-se com ela, mas não deixaram descendente. Finalmente, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y la tomaron los siete, y tampoco dejaron simiente: á la postre murió también la mujer.

verses.KJV: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.WEB: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
verses.ASV: In the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na ressurreição, pois, quando ressuscitarem, ela será a mulher de qual deles? Porque os sete a tiveram por mulher.
verses.RVR09: En la resurrección, pues, cuando resucitaren, ¿de cuál de ellos será mujer? porque los siete la tuvieron por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto them, Is it not for this cause that ye err, that ye know not the scriptures, nor the power of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Acaso não é por isso que errais, por não conhecerdes as Escrituras, nem o poder de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Jesús, les dice: ¿No erráis por eso, porque no sabéis las Escrituras, ni la potencia de Dios?

verses.KJV: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.WEB: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.ASV: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, quando ressuscitarem dos mortos, nem se casarão, nem se darão em casamento; mas serão como os anjos que estão nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando resucitarán de los muertos, ni se casarán, ni serán dados en casamiento, mas son como los ángeles que están en los cielos.

verses.KJV: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.WEB: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.ASV: But as touching the dead, that they are raised; have ye not read in the book of Moses, in [the place concerning] the Bush, how God spake unto him, saying, I [am] the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto aos mortos que ressuscitarão, não lestes no livro de Moisés, como Deus lhe falou com a sarça, dizendo: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó?
verses.RVR09: Y de que los muertos hayan de resucitar, ¿no habéis leído en el libro de Moisés cómo le habló Dios en la zarza, diciendo: Yo soy el Dios de Abraham, y el Dios de Isaac, y el Dios de Jacob?

verses.KJV: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.WEB: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
verses.ASV: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: ye do greatly err.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus não é [Deus] de mortos, mas de vivos. Portanto errais muito.
verses.RVR09: No es Dios de muertos, mas Dios de vivos; así que vosotros mucho erráis.

verses.KJV: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.WEB: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
verses.ASV: And one of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, What commandment is the first of all?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aproximou-se dele um dos escribas, que os havia ouvido discutir. Como ele sabia que [Jesus] havia lhes respondido bem, perguntou-lhe: Qual é o primeiro mandamento de todos?
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose uno de los escribas, que los había oído disputar, y sabía que les había respondido bien, le preguntó: ¿Cuál es el primer mandamiento de todos?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, The first is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God, the Lord is one:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe respondeu: O primeiro de todos os mandamentos é: “Ouve Israel, o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor;
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le respondió: El primer mandamiento de todos es: Oye, Israel, el Señor nuestro Dios, el Señor uno es.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.WEB: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: amarás, pois, ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração, com toda a tua alma, com todo o teu entendimento, e com todas as tuas forças.” Este é o primeiro mandamento.
verses.RVR09: Amarás pues al Señor tu Dios de todo tu corazón, y de toda tu alma, y de toda tu mente, y de todas tus fuerzas; este es el principal mandamiento.

verses.KJV: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.WEB: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
verses.ASV: The second is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o segundo é semelhante: “Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo”. Não há outro mandamento maior que estes.
verses.RVR09: Y el segundo es semejante á él: Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo. No hay otro mandamiento mayor que éstos.

verses.KJV: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.WEB: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;
verses.ASV: And the scribe said unto him, Of a truth, Teacher, thou hast well said that he is one; and there is none other but he:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o escriba lhe disse: Muito bem, Mestre, com verdade disseste que há um só Deus, e não há outro além dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el escriba le dijo: Bien, Maestro, verdad has dicho, que uno es Dios, y no hay otro fuera de él;

verses.KJV: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.WEB: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
verses.ASV: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is much more than all whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que amá-lo com todo o coração, com todo o entendimento, com toda a alma, e com todas as forças; e amar ao próximo como a si mesmo, é mais de que todos os holocaustos e sacrifícios.
verses.RVR09: Y que amarle de todo corazón, y de todo entendimiento, y de toda el alma, y de todas las fuerzas, y amar al prójimo como á sí mismo, más es que todos los holocaustos y sacrificios.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.WEB: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
verses.ASV: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus viu que ele havia respondido sabiamente, e disse-lhe: Não estás longe do Reino de Deus. E ninguém mais ousou lhe perguntar.
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces, viendo que había respondido sabiamente, le dice: No estás lejos del reino de Dios. Y ya ninguno osaba preguntarle.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
verses.WEB: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus respondia e dizia, enquanto ensinava no templo: Como os escribas dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús decía, enseñando en el templo: ¿Cómo dicen los escribas que el Cristo es hijo de David?

verses.KJV: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.WEB: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.ASV: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o mesmo Davi disse pelo Espírito Santo: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor, senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos debaixo dos teus pés.
verses.RVR09: Porque el mismo David dijo por el Espíritu Santo: Dijo el Señor á mi Señor: Siéntate á mi diestra, hasta que ponga tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies.

verses.KJV: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.WEB: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
verses.ASV: David himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, [se] o próprio Davi o chama de Senhor, como, pois, é so eu filho?E a grande multidão o ouvia de boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Luego llamándole el mismo David Señor, ¿de dónde, pues, es su hijo? Y los que eran del común del pueblo le oían de buena gana.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.WEB: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
verses.ASV: And in his teaching he said, Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and [to have] salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia-lhes em seu ensino: Cuidado com os escribas, que gostam de andar com roupas compridas, das saudações nas praças,
verses.RVR09: Y les decía en su doctrina: Guardaos de los escribas, que quieren andar con ropas largas, y aman las salutaciones en las plazas,

verses.KJV: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.WEB: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,
verses.ASV: and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts:
verses.ALMEIDA: das primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas, e dos primeiros assentos nas ceias.
verses.RVR09: Y las primeras sillas en las sinagogas, y los primeros asientos en las cenas;

verses.KJV: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.WEB: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
verses.ASV: they that devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers; these shall receive greater condemnation.
verses.ALMEIDA: que devoram as casas das viúvas, com pretexto de longas orações. Esses receberão mais grave condenação.
verses.RVR09: Que devoran las casas de las viudas, y por pretexto hacen largas oraciones. Estos recibirán mayor juicio.

verses.KJV: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.WEB: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
verses.ASV: And he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus estava sentado de frente à arca do tesouro, observava como a multidão lançava dinheiro na arca do tesouro; e muitos ricos lançavam muito.
verses.RVR09: Y estando sentado Jesús delante del arca de la ofrenda, miraba cómo el pueblo echaba dinero en el arca: y muchos ricos echaban mucho.

verses.KJV: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.WEB: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
verses.ASV: And there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma pobre viúva veio, e lançou duas pequenas moedas, de pouco valor.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino una viuda pobre, echó dos blancas, que son un maravedí.

verses.KJV: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.WEB: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
verses.ASV: And he called unto him his disciples, and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than all they that are casting into the treasury:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Jesus] chamou a si os seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva lançou mais que todos os que lançaram na arca do tesouro;
verses.RVR09: Entonces llamando á sus discípulos, les dice: De cierto os digo que esta viuda pobre echó más que todos los que han echado en el arca:

verses.KJV: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.WEB: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
verses.ASV: for they all did cast in of their superfluity; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, [even] all her living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos lançaram daquilo que lhes sobra; mas esta, da sua pobreza lançou tudo o que tinha, todo o seu sustento.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos han echado de lo que les sobra; mas ésta, de su pobreza echó todo lo que tenía, todo su alimento.

verses.KJV: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.WEB: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
verses.ASV: And as he went forth out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Teacher, behold, what manner of stones and what manner of buildings!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele estava saindo do templo, um de seus discípulos lhe disse: Mestre, olha que pedras, e que edifícios!
verses.RVR09: Y SALIENDO del templo, le dice uno de sus discípulos: Maestro, mira qué piedras, y qué edificios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left here one stone upon another, which shall not be thrown down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus respondeu, dizendo-lhe: Vês estes grandes edifícios? Não será deixada pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús respondiendo, le dijo: ¿Ves estos grandes edificios? no quedará piedra sobre piedra que no sea derribada.

verses.KJV: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.WEB: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.ASV: And as he sat on the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois, sentando-se ele no monte das Oliveiras, de frente ao templo, Pedro, Tiago, João, e André perguntaram-lhe à parte:
verses.RVR09: Y sentándose en el monte de las Olivas delante del templo, le preguntaron aparte Pedro y Jacobo y Juan y Andrés:

verses.KJV: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.WEB: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
verses.ASV: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-nos, quando serão essas coisas? E que sinal haverá de quando todas essas coisas se cumprirão?
verses.RVR09: Dinos, ¿cuándo serán estas cosas? ¿y qué señal habrá cuando todas estas cosas han de cumplirse?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.WEB: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
verses.ASV: And Jesus began to say unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus, respondendo-lhes, começou a dizer: Cuidado! ninguém vos engane;
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús respondiéndoles, comenzó á decir: Mirad, que nadie os engañe;

verses.KJV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.WEB: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
verses.ASV: Many shall come in my name, saying, I am [he]; and shall lead many astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: “Sou eu”, e enganarão a muitos.
verses.RVR09: Porque vendrán muchos en mi nombre, diciendo: Yo soy el Cristo; y engañarán á muchos.

verses.KJV: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.WEB: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.ASV: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, be not troubled: [these things] must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ouvirdes de guerras e de rumores de guerras, não vos perturbeis; porque [assim] deve acontecer; mas ainda não será o fim.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando oyereis de guerras y de rumores de guerras no os turbéis, porque conviene hacerse así; mas aun no será el fin.

verses.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.WEB: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.ASV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there shall be earthquakes in divers places; there shall be famines: these things are the beginning of travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nação se levantará contra nação, e reino contra reino, e haverá terremotos em muitos lugares, e haverá fomes e tumultos. Estes serão os princípios das dores.
verses.RVR09: Porque se levantará nación contra nación, y reino contra reino; y habrá terremotos en muchos lugares, y habrá hambres y alborotos; principios de dolores serán estos.

verses.KJV: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.WEB: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
verses.ASV: But take ye heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in synagogues shall ye be beaten; and before governors and kings shall ye stand for my sake, for a testimony unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas cuidai de vós mesmos; porque vos entregarão em tribunais e em sinagogas; sereis açoitados, e sereis levados diante de governadores e reis, por causa de mim, para que lhes haja testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros mirad por vosotros: porque os entregarán en los concilios, y en sinagogas seréis azotados: y delante de presidentes y de reyes seréis llamados por causa de mí, en testimonio á ellos.

verses.KJV: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.WEB: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
verses.ASV: And the gospel must first be preached unto all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas antes o Evangelho deve ser pregado entre todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y á todas las gentes conviene que el evangelio sea predicado antes.

verses.KJV: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: And when they lead you [to judgment], and deliver you up, be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye; for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, quando vos levarem para vos entregar, não estejais ansiosos antecipadamente do que deveis dizer, nem o planejeis; mas o que naquela hora for dado, isso falai. Porque não sois vós os que falais, mas o Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando os trajeren para entregaros, no premeditéis qué habéis de decir, ni lo penséis: mas lo que os fuere dado en aquella hora, eso hablad; porque no sois vosotros los que habláis, sino el Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.WEB: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
verses.ASV: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o irmão entregará ao irmão à morte, e o pai ao filho; e os filhos se levantarão contra os pais, e os matarão.
verses.RVR09: Y entregará á la muerte el hermano al hermano, y el padre al hijo: y se levantarán los hijos contra los padres, y los matarán.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.WEB: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sereis odiados por todos por causa do meu nome; mas quem perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.
verses.RVR09: Y seréis aborrecidos de todos por mi nombre: mas el que perseverare hasta el fin, éste será salvo.

verses.KJV: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.WEB: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
verses.ASV: But when ye see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not (let him that readeth understand), then let them that are in Judæa flee unto the mountains:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando virdes a abominação da desolação, que foi dita pelo profeta Daniel, estar onde não deve, (quem lê, entenda), então os que estiverem na Judeia, fujam para os montes.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando viereis la abominación de asolamiento, que fué dicha por el profeta Daniel, que estará donde no debe (el que lee, entienda), entonces los que estén en Judea huyan á los montes;

verses.KJV: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.WEB: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
verses.ASV: and let him that is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem estiver sobre telhado, não desça para a casa, nem entre para tomar alguma coisa de sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y el que esté sobre el terrado, no descienda á la casa, ni entre para tomar algo de su casa;

verses.KJV: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.WEB: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
verses.ASV: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem estiver no campo, não volte atrás, para tomar sua roupa.
verses.RVR09: Y el que estuviere en el campo, no vuelva atrás á tomar su capa.

verses.KJV: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.WEB: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
verses.ASV: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ai das grávidas, e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de las preñadas, y de las que criaren en aquellos días!

verses.KJV: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.WEB: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.
verses.ASV: And pray ye that it be not in the winter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai, porém, para que a vossa fuga não aconteça no inverno.
verses.RVR09: Orad pues, que no acontezca vuestra huída en invierno.

verses.KJV: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.WEB: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
verses.ASV: For those days shall be tribulation, such as there hath not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never shall be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aqueles dias serão de tal aflição, qual nunca foi desde o princípio da criação das coisas, que Deus criou, até agora, nem jamais será.
verses.RVR09: Porque aquellos días serán de aflicción, cual nunca fué desde el principio de la creación que crió Dios, hasta este tiempo, ni será.

verses.KJV: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.WEB: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
verses.ASV: And except the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect’s sake, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o Senhor não encurtasse aqueles dias, ninguém se salvaria; mas por causa dos escolhidos, que escolheu, ele encurtou aqueles dias.
verses.RVR09: Y si el Señor no hubiese abreviado aquellos días, ninguna carne se salvaría; mas por causa de los escogidos que él escogió, abrevió aquellos días.

verses.KJV: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.WEB: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
verses.ASV: And then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ; or, Lo, there; believe [it] not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se alguém vos disser: “Eis aqui o Cristo”; ou “ei-lo ali”, não creiais nele.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces si alguno os dijere: He aquí, aquí está el Cristo; ó, He aquí, allí está, no le creáis.

verses.KJV: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.WEB: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
verses.ASV: for there shall arise false Christs and false prophets, and shall show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, the elect.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se levantarão falsos cristos, e falsos profetas, que farão sinais e prodígios, para enganar, se possível, até os escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Porque se levantarán falsos Cristos y falsos profetas, y darán señales y prodigios, para engañar, si se pudiese hacer, aun á los escogidos.

verses.KJV: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.WEB: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.ASV: But take ye heed: behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, porém, tende cuidado; eis que tenho vos dito tudo com antecedência.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros mirad; os lo he dicho antes todo.

verses.KJV: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.WEB: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
verses.ASV: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas naqueles dias, depois daquela aflição, o sol se escurecerá, e a lua não dará seu brilho;
verses.RVR09: Empero en aquellos días, después de aquella aflicción, el sol se obscurecerá, y la luna no dará su resplandor;

verses.KJV: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.WEB: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.ASV: and the stars shall be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens shall be shaken.
verses.ALMEIDA: as estrelas do céu cairão, e as forças que estão nos céus se abalarão.
verses.RVR09: Y las estrellas caerán del cielo, y las virtudes que están en los cielos serán conmovidas;

verses.KJV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.WEB: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.ASV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então verão o Filho do homem vir nas nuvens, com grande poder e glória.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces verán al Hijo del hombre, que vendrá en las nubes con mucha potestad y gloria.

verses.KJV: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.WEB: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
verses.ASV: And then shall he send forth the angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então enviará os seus anjos, e ajuntará os seus escolhidos dos quatro ventos, desde a extremidade da terra, até a extremidade do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces enviará sus ángeles, y juntará sus escogidos de los cuatro vientos, desde el cabo de la tierra hasta el cabo del cielo.

verses.KJV: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.WEB: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
verses.ASV: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aprendei a parábola da figueira: Quando o seu ramo já vai ficando tenro, e brota folhas, bem sabeis que o verão já está perto.
verses.RVR09: De la higuera aprended la semejanza: Cuando su rama ya se enternece, y brota hojas, conocéis que el verano está cerca:

verses.KJV: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.WEB: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
verses.ASV: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that he is nigh, [even] at the doors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, quando virdes suceder estas coisas, sabei que já está perto, às portas.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, cuando viereis hacerse estas cosas, conoced que está cerca, á las puertas.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, until all these things be accomplished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração, até que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo que no pasará esta generación, que todas estas cosas no sean hechas.

verses.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O céu e a terra passarão, mas as minhas palavras em maneira nenhuma passarão.
verses.RVR09: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, mas mis palabras no pasarán.

verses.KJV: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.WEB: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.ASV: But of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém daquele dia e hora ninguém sabe, nem os anjos que estão no céu, nem o Filho, a não ser somente o Pai.
verses.RVR09: Empero de aquel día y de la hora, nadie sabe; ni aun los ángeles que están en el cielo, ni el Hijo, sino el Padre.

verses.KJV: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.WEB: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
verses.ASV: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai, vigiai, e orai; porque não sabeis quando será o tempo.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, velad y orad: porque no sabéis cuándo será el tiempo.

verses.KJV: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.WEB: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
verses.ASV: [It is] as [when] a man, sojourning in another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, to each one his work, commanded also the porter to watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como o homem que, partindo-se para fora de sua terra, deixou sua casa, e deu autoridade aos seus servos, e a cada um o seu trabalho, e mandou ao porteiro que vigiasse,
verses.RVR09: Como el hombre que partiéndose lejos, dejó su casa, y dió facultad á sus siervos, y á cada uno su obra, y al portero mandó que velase:

verses.KJV: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
verses.ASV: Watch therefore: for ye know not when the lord of the house cometh, whether at even, or at midnight, or at cockcrowing, or in the morning;
verses.ALMEIDA: assim também vigiai, porque não sabeis quando virá o Senhor da casa; se à tarde, se à meia-noite, se ao cantar do galo, se pela manhã,
verses.RVR09: Velad pues, porque no sabéis cuándo el señor de la casa vendrá; si á la tarde, ó á la media noche, ó al canto del gallo, ó á la mañana;

verses.KJV: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.WEB: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
verses.ASV: lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que ele não venha de repente, e vos ache dormindo.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando viniere de repente, no os halle durmiendo.

verses.KJV: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.WEB: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
verses.ASV: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as coisas que vos digo, digo a todos: Vigiai.
verses.RVR09: Y las cosas que á vosotros digo, á todos las digo: Velad.

verses.KJV: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.WEB: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.
verses.ASV: Now after two days was [the feast of] the passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him with subtlety, and kill him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali a dois dias era a Páscoa, e [a festa] dos pães sem fermento; e os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas buscavam um meio de prendê-lo através de um engano, e o matarem.
verses.RVR09: Y DOS días después era la Pascua y los días de los panes sin levadura: y procuraban los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los escribas cómo le prenderían por engaño, y le matarían.

verses.KJV: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.WEB: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
verses.ASV: for they said, Not during the feast, lest haply there shall be a tumult of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diziam, porém: “Não na festa, para que não aconteça tumulto entre o povo.”
verses.RVR09: Y decían: No en el día de la fiesta, porque no se haga alboroto del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.WEB: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
verses.ASV: And while he was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster cruse of ointment of pure nard very costly; [and] she brake the cruse, and poured it over his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando ele em Betânia, na casa de Simão o Leproso, sentado [à mesa] , veio uma mulher, que tinha um vaso de alabastro, de óleo perfumado de nardo puro, de muito preço, e quebrando o vaso de alabastro, derramou-o sobre a cabeça dele.
