verses.RVR09: Y estando él en Bethania en casa de Simón el leproso, y sentado á la mesa, vino una mujer teniendo un alabastro de ungüento de nardo espique de mucho precio; y quebrando el alabastro, derramóselo sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.WEB: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
verses.ASV: But there were some that had indignation among themselves, [saying], To what purpose hath this waste of the ointment been made?
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve alguns que em si mesmos se indignaram, e disseram: “Para que foi feito este desperdício do óleo perfumado?
verses.RVR09: Y hubo algunos que se enojaron dentro de sí, y dijeron: ¿Para qué se ha hecho este desperdicio de ungüento?

verses.KJV: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.WEB: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.
verses.ASV: For this ointment might have been sold for above three hundred shillings, and given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque isto podia ter sido vendido por mais de trezentos denários, e seria dado aos pobres.” E reclamavam contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Porque podía esto ser vendido por más de trescientos denarios, y darse á los pobres. Y murmuraban contra ella.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
verses.ASV: But Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus disse: “Deixai-a; por que a incomodais? Ela me fez boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús dijo: Dejadla; ¿por qué la fatigáis? buena obra me ha hecho;

verses.KJV: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.WEB: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
verses.ASV: For ye have the poor always with you, and whensoever ye will ye can do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pobres sempre tendes convosco; e quando quiserdes, podeis lhes fazer bem; porém a mim, nem sempre me tendes.
verses.RVR09: Que siempre tendréis los pobres con vosotros, y cuando quisiereis les podréis hacer bien; mas á mí no siempre me tendréis.

verses.KJV: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.WEB: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
verses.ASV: She hath done what she could; she hath anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta fez o que podia; adiantou-se para ungir o meu corpo, para a sepultura.
verses.RVR09: Esta ha hecho lo que podía; porque se ha anticipado á ungir mi cuerpo para la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
verses.ASV: And verily I say unto you, Wheresoever the gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que onde quer que em todo o mundo este Evangelho for pregado, também o que esta fez será dito em sua memória.”
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo que donde quiera que fuere predicado este evangelio en todo el mundo, también esto que ha hecho ésta, será dicho para memoria de ella.

verses.KJV: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.WEB: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
verses.ASV: And Judas Iscariot, he that was one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests, that he might deliver him unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judas Iscariotes, um dos doze, foi aos chefes dos sacerdotes, para o entregar a eles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judas Iscariote, uno de los doce, vino á los príncipes de los sacerdotes, para entregársele.

verses.KJV: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.WEB: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
verses.ASV: And they, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently deliver him [unto them].
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles ouvindo, alegraram-se; e prometeram lhe dar dinheiro; e buscava como o entregaria em tempo oportuno.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos oyéndolo se holgaron, y prometieron que le darían dineros. Y buscaba oportunidad cómo le entregaría.

verses.KJV: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.WEB: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
verses.ASV: And on the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the passover, his disciples say unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and make ready that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o primeiro dia dos pães sem fermento, quando sacrificavam [o cordeiro da] Páscoa, seus discípulos lhe disseram: “Onde queres que vamos preparar para comerdes a Páscoa?”
verses.RVR09: Y el primer día de los panes sin levadura, cuando sacrificaban la pascua, sus discípulos le dicen: ¿Dónde quieres que vayamos á disponer para que comas la pascua?

verses.KJV: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.WEB: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,
verses.ASV: And he sendeth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou dois de seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: “Ide à cidade, e um homem que leva um cântaro de água vos encontrará, a ele segui.
verses.RVR09: Y envía dos de sus discípulos, y les dice: Id á la ciudad, y os encontrará un hombre que lleva un cántaro de agua; seguidle;

verses.KJV: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.WEB: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
verses.ASV: and wheresoever he shall enter in, say to the master of the house, The Teacher saith, Where is my guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.ALMEIDA: E onde quer que ele entrar, dizei ao senhor da casa: O Mestre diz: Onde está o cômodo onde comerei Páscoa com meus discípulos?
verses.RVR09: Y donde entrare, decid al señor de la casa: El Maestro dice: ¿Dónde está el aposento donde he de comer la pascua con mis discípulos?

verses.KJV: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.WEB: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
verses.ASV: And he will himself show you a large upper room furnished [and] ready: and there make ready for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele vos mostrará um grande salão, ornado e preparado; ali fazei os preparativos para nós.”
verses.RVR09: Y él os mostrará un gran cenáculo ya preparado: aderezad para nosotros allí.

verses.KJV: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.WEB: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.ASV: And the disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seusdiscípulos saíram, e vieram à cidade, e acharam como havia lhes dito, e prepararam a Páscoa.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron sus discípulos, y vinieron á la ciudad, y hallaron como les había dicho; y aderezaron la pascua.

verses.KJV: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.WEB: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
verses.ASV: And when it was evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegada a tarde, veio com os doze.
verses.RVR09: Y llegada la tarde, fué con los doce.

verses.KJV: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.WEB: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
verses.ASV: And as they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you shall betray me, [even] he that eateth with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se sentaram [à mesa] , e comeram, Jesus disse: “Em verdade vos digo, que um de vós, que está comendo comigo, me trairá.”
verses.RVR09: Y como se sentaron á la mesa y comiesen, dice Jesús: De cierto os digo que uno de vosotros, que come conmigo, me ha de entregar.

verses.KJV: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.WEB: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
verses.ASV: They began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles começaram a se entristecer, e a lhe dizer um após outro: “Por acaso sou eu?” E outro: “Por acaso sou eu?”
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos comenzaron á entristecerse, y á decirle cada uno por sí: ¿Seré yo? Y el otro: ¿Seré yo?

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, [It is] one of the twelve, he that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes respondeu: “[É] um dos doze, o que está molhando [a mão] comigo no prato.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo les dijo: Es uno de los doce que moja conmigo en el plato.

verses.KJV: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.WEB: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.ASV: For the Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade o Filho do homem vai, como está escrito sobre ele; mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído; bom lhe fosse ao tal homem não haver nascido.”
verses.RVR09: A la verdad el Hijo del hombre va, como está de él escrito; mas ¡ay de aquel hombre por quien el Hijo del hombre es entregado! bueno le fuera á aquel hombre si nunca hubiera nacido.

verses.KJV: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.WEB: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
verses.ASV: And as they were eating, he took bread, and when he had blessed, he brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take ye: this is my body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles comiam, Jesus tomou o pão; e bendizendo, partiu-o, deu-lhes, e disse: “Tomai, comei, isto é o meu corpo.”
verses.RVR09: Y estando ellos comiendo, tomó Jesús pan, y bendiciendo, partió y les dió, y dijo: Tomad, esto es mi cuerpo.

verses.KJV: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.WEB: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
verses.ASV: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando o copo, e dando graças, deu-lhes; e todos beberam dele.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando el vaso, habiendo hecho gracias, les dió: y bebieron de él todos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “Isto é o meu sangue, o do novo testamento, que é derramado por muitos.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Esto es mi sangre del nuevo pacto, que por muchos es derramada.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, I shall no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que não beberei mais do fruto da vide, até aquele dia, quando o beber novo no Reino de Deus.”
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo que no beberé más del fruto de la vid, hasta aquel día cuando lo beberé nuevo en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.WEB: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.ASV: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de cantarem um hino, saíram para o monte das Oliveiras.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubieron cantado el himno, se salieron al monte de las Olivas.

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
verses.ASV: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes disse: “Todos vós falhareis comigo esta noite; porque está escrito: Ferirei ao pastor, e as ovelhas serão dispersas.
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces les dice: Todos seréis escandalizados en mí esta noche; porque escrito está: Heriré al pastor, y serán derramadas las ovejas.

verses.KJV: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.WEB: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
verses.ASV: Howbeit, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas depois de eu haver ressuscitado, irei adiante de vós para a Galileia.”
verses.RVR09: Mas después que haya resucitado, iré delante de vosotros á Galilea.

verses.KJV: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.WEB: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
verses.ASV: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe disse: “Ainda que todos falhem, eu não [falharei] .”
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro le dijo: Aunque todos sean escandalizados, mas no yo.

verses.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that thou to-day, [even] this night, before the cock crow twice, shalt deny me thrice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: “Em verdade te digo, que hoje, nesta noite, antes que o galo cante duas vezes, me negarás três vezes.”
verses.RVR09: Y le dice Jesús: De cierto te digo que tú, hoy, en esta noche, antes que el gallo haya cantado dos veces, me negarás tres veces.

verses.KJV: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.WEB: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
verses.ASV: But he spake exceeding vehemently, If I must die with thee, I will not deny thee. And in like manner also said they all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Pedro] , insistindo, dizia: “Ainda que me seja necessário morrer contigo, em maneira nenhuma te negarei.” E todos diziam também da mesma maneira.
verses.RVR09: Mas él con mayor porfía decía: Si me fuere menester morir contigo, no te negaré. También todos decían lo mismo.

verses.KJV: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.WEB: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
verses.ASV: And they come unto a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I pray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram ao lugar, cujo nome era Getsêmani, e disse a seus discípulos: “Sentai-vos aqui, enquanto eu oro.”
verses.RVR09: Y vienen al lugar que se llama Gethsemaní, y dice á sus discípulos: Sentaos aquí, entre tanto que yo oro.

verses.KJV: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.WEB: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
verses.ASV: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly amazed, and sore troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou consigo Pedro, Tiago, e João, e começou a ficar muito apavorado e angustiado.
verses.RVR09: Y toma consigo á Pedro y á Jacobo y á Juan, y comenzó á atemorizarse, y á angustiarse.

verses.KJV: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful even unto death: abide ye here, and watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “Minha alma totalmente está triste até a morte; ficai-vos aqui, e vigiai.”
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Está muy triste mi alma, hasta la muerte: esperad aquí y velad.

verses.KJV: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.WEB: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
verses.ASV: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele foi um pouco mais adiante, e prostrou-se em terra. E orou, que se fosse possível, afastasse dele aquela hora.
verses.RVR09: Y yéndose un poco adelante, se postró en tierra, y oró que si fuese posible, pasase de él aquella hora.

verses.KJV: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.WEB: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; remove this cup from me: howbeit not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: “Aba, Pai, todas as coisas te são possíveis; passa de mim este copo; porém não [se faça] o que eu quero, mas sim o que tu [queres] .”
verses.RVR09: Y decía: Abba, Padre, todas las cosas son á ti posibles; traspasa de mí este vaso; empero no lo que yo quiero, sino lo que tú.

verses.KJV: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.WEB: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
verses.ASV: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest thou not watch one hour?
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois veio de volta, e os achou dormindo; e disse a Pedro: “Simão, estás dormindo? Não podes vigiar uma hora?
verses.RVR09: Y vino y los halló durmiendo; y dice á Pedro: ¿Simón, duermes? ¿No has podido velar una hora?

verses.KJV: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.WEB: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.ASV: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai, e orai, para que não entreis em tentação; o espírito em verdade [está] pronto, mas a carne [é] fraca.”
verses.RVR09: Velad y orad, para que no entréis en tentación: el espíritu á la verdad es presto, mas la carne enferma.

verses.KJV: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.WEB: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
verses.ASV: And again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que se foi novamente, orou, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y volviéndose á ir, oró, y dijo las mismas palabras.

verses.KJV: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.WEB: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
verses.ASV: And again he came, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they knew not what to answer him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando voltou, achou-os outra vez dormindo; porque os olhos deles estavam pesados, e não sabiam o que lhe responder.
verses.RVR09: Y vuelto, los halló otra vez durmiendo, porque los ojos de ellos estaban cargados; y no sabían qué responderle.

verses.KJV: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.WEB: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.ASV: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough; the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a terceira vez, e disse-lhes: “Ainda estais dormindo e descansando? Basta, chegada é a hora. Eis que o Filho do homem é entregue em mãos dos pecadores.
verses.RVR09: Y vino la tercera vez, y les dice: Dormid ya y descansad: basta, la hora es venida; he aquí, el Hijo del hombre es entregado en manos de los pecadores.

verses.KJV: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.WEB: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
verses.ASV: Arise, let us be going: behold, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, vamos; eis que o que me trai está perto.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, vamos: he aquí, el que me entrega está cerca.

verses.KJV: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.WEB: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
verses.ASV: And straightway, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo, enquanto ele ainda estava falando, veio Judas, que era um dos doze, e com ele uma grande multidão, com espadas e bastões, da parte dos chefes dos sacerdotes, dos escribas, dos anciãos.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, aun hablando él, vino Judas, que era uno de los doce, y con él una compañía con espadas y palos, de parte de los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y de los escribas y de los ancianos.

verses.KJV: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.WEB: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
verses.ASV: Now he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que o traía lhes tinha dado um sinal comum, dizendo: “Ao que eu beijar, é esse; prendei-o, e levai-o em segurança.”
verses.RVR09: Y el que le entregaba les había dado señal común, diciendo: Al que yo besare, aquél es: prendedle, y llevadle con seguridad.

verses.KJV: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.WEB: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
verses.ASV: And when he was come, straightway he came to him, and saith, Rabbi; and kissed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando veio, logo foi-se a ele, e disse-lhe: “Rabi, Rabi”, e o beijou.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino, se acercó luego á él, y le dice: Maestro, Maestro. Y le besó.

verses.KJV: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.WEB: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
verses.ASV: And they laid hands on him, and took him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o agarraram, e o prenderam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos echaron en él sus manos, y le prendieron.

verses.KJV: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.WEB: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.ASV: But a certain one of them that stood by drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos que estavam ali presentes puxou a espada, feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, e cortou-lhe a orelha.
verses.RVR09: Y uno de los que estaban allí, sacando la espada, hirió al siervo del sumo sacerdote, y le cortó la oreja.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves to seize me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus começou a lhes dizer: “Viestes me prender com espadas e bastões, como [se eu fosse] um bandido?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: ¿Como á ladrón habéis salido con espadas y con palos á tomarme?

verses.KJV: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
verses.ASV: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but [this is done] that the scriptures might be fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo dia eu estava convosco no templo, ensinando, e não me prendestes; mas [assim se faz] para que as Escrituras se cumpram.”
verses.RVR09: Cada día estaba con vosotros enseñando en el templo, y no me tomasteis; pero es así, para que se cumplan las Escrituras.

verses.KJV: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.WEB: They all left him, and fled.
verses.ASV: And they all left him, and fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todos o deixaram, e fugiram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dejándole todos sus discípulos, huyeron.

verses.KJV: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.WEB: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
verses.ASV: And a certain young man followed with him, having a linen cloth cast about him, over [his] naked [body]: and they lay hold on him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E certo rapaz o seguia, envolto num lençol sobre o [corpo] nu. E os rapazes o agarraram.
verses.RVR09: Empero un mancebillo le seguía cubierto de una sábana sobre el cuerpo desnudo; y los mancebos le prendieron:

verses.KJV: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.WEB: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
verses.ASV: but he left the linen cloth, and fled naked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele largou o lençol, e fugiu deles nu.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, dejando la sábana, se huyó de ellos desnudo.

verses.KJV: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.WEB: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
verses.ASV: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and there come together with him all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levaram Jesus ao sumo sacerdote; e ajuntaram-se a ele todos os chefes dos sacerdotes, os anciãos, e os escribas.
verses.RVR09: Y trajeron á Jesús al sumo sacerdote; y se juntaron á él todos los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos y los escribas.

verses.KJV: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.WEB: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
verses.ASV: And Peter had followed him afar off, even within, into the court of the high priest; and he was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light [of the fire].
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro o seguiu de longe até dentro do pátio do sumo sacerdote, e ficou sentado com os oficiais, esquentando-se ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Empero Pedro le siguió de lejos hasta dentro del patio del sumo sacerdote; y estaba sentado con los servidores, y calentándose al fuego.

verses.KJV: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.WEB: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
verses.ASV: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos sacerdotes, e todo o supremo conselho buscavam [algum] testemunho contra Jesus, para o matarem, e não [o] achavam.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de los sacerdotes y todo el concilio buscaban testimonio contra Jesús, para entregarle á la muerte; mas no lo hallaban.

verses.KJV: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.WEB: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
verses.ASV: For many bare false witness against him, and their witness agreed not together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muitos davam falso testemunho contra ele, mas os testemunhos não concordavam entre si.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos decían falso testimonio contra él; mas sus testimonios no concertaban.

verses.KJV: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.WEB: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
verses.ASV: And there stood up certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns se levantavam e davam falso testemunho contra ele, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces levantándose unos, dieron falso testimonio contra él, diciendo:

verses.KJV: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.WEB: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
verses.ASV: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Nós o ouvimos dizer: Eu derrubarei este templo feito por mãos, e em três dias construirei outro feito não por mãos.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros le hemos oído decir: Yo derribaré este templo que es hecho de mano, y en tres días edificaré otro echo sin mano.

verses.KJV: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.WEB: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
verses.ASV: And not even so did their witness agree together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nem assim o testemunho deles era concordante.
verses.RVR09: Mas ni aun así se concertaba el testimonio de ellos.

verses.KJV: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.WEB: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
verses.ASV: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sumo sacerdote levantou-se no meio, e perguntou a Jesus: “Não respondes nada? O que estes testemunham contra ti?”
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sumo sacerdote, levantándose en medio, preguntó á Jesús, diciendo: ¿No respondes algo? ¿Qué atestiguan éstos contra ti?

verses.KJV: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.WEB: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
verses.ASV: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and saith unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele ficou calado, e nada respondeu. O sumo sacerdote voltou a lhe perguntar: “És tu o Cristo, o Filho daquele que é Bendito?”
verses.RVR09: Mas él callaba, y nada respondía. El sumo sacerdote le volvió á preguntar, y le dice: ¿Eres tú el Cristo, el Hijo del Bendito?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.WEB: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus respondeu: “Eu sou. E vereis o Filho do homem sentado à direita do Poderoso , e vindo com as nuvens do céu.”
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Yo soy; y veréis al Hijo del hombre sentado á la diestra de la potencia de Dios, y viniendo en las nubes del cielo.

verses.KJV: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.WEB: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
verses.ASV: And the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What further need have we of witnesses?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sumo sacerdote, rasgando suas roupas, disse: “Para que mais necessitamos de testemunhas?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sumo sacerdote, rasgando sus vestidos, dijo: ¿Qué más tenemos necesidad de testigos?

verses.KJV: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.WEB: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
verses.ASV: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be worthy of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós ouvistes a blasfêmia. Que vos parece?” E todos o condenaram como culpado de morte.
verses.RVR09: Oído habéis la blasfemia: ¿qué os parece? Y ellos todos le condenaron ser culpado de muerte.

verses.KJV: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.WEB: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
verses.ASV: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the officers received him with blows of their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns começaram a cuspir nele, e a cobrir o rosto dele; e a dar-lhe de socos, e dizer-lhe: “Profetiza”. E os oficiais lhe davam bofetadas.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos comenzaron á escupir en él, y cubrir su rostro, y á darle bofetadas, y decirle: Profetiza. Y los servidores le herían de bofetadas.

verses.KJV: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.WEB: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
verses.ASV: And as Peter was beneath in the court, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, enquanto Pedro estava no pátio abaixo, veio uma das servas do sumo sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y estando Pedro abajo en el atrio, vino una de las criadas del sumo sacerdote;

verses.KJV: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.WEB: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
verses.ASV: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and saith, Thou also wast with the Nazarene, [even] Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ela viu Pedro, que estava sentado esquentando-se, olhou para ele, e disse: “Também tu estavas com Jesus, o Nazareno.”
verses.RVR09: Y como vió á Pedro que se calentaba, mirándole, dice: Y tú con Jesús el Nazareno estabas.

verses.KJV: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.WEB: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
verses.ASV: But he denied, saying, I neither know, nor understand what thou sayest: and he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele negou, dizendo: “Não [o] conheço, nem sei o que dizes.”; e saiu para o alpendre. Então o galo cantou.
verses.RVR09: Mas él negó, diciendo: No conozco, ni sé lo que dices. Y se salió fuera á la entrada; y cantó el gallo.

verses.KJV: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
verses.WEB: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
verses.ASV: And the maid saw him, and began again to say to them that stood by, This is [one] of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: A serva o viu outra vez, e começou a dizer aos que ali estavam: “Este é um deles”.
verses.RVR09: Y la criada viéndole otra vez, comenzó á decir á los que estaban allí: Este es de ellos.

verses.KJV: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
verses.WEB: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
verses.ASV: But he again denied it. And after a little while again they that stood by said to Peter, Of a truth thou art [one] of them; for thou art a Galilæan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele o negou de novo. E pouco depois, outra vez os que ali estavam disseram a Pedro: “Verdadeiramente tu és um deles; pois também és galileu”, e a tua fala é semelhante”.
verses.RVR09: Mas él negó otra vez. Y poco después, los que estaban allí dijeron otra vez á Pedro: Verdaderamente tú eres de ellos; porque eres Galileo, y tu habla es semejante.

verses.KJV: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.WEB: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
verses.ASV: But he began to curse, and to swear, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele começou a amaldiçoar e a jurar, [dizendo] : “Não conheço esse homem de quem dizeis.”
verses.RVR09: Y él comenzó á maldecir y á jurar: No conozco á este hombre de quien habláis.

verses.KJV: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.WEB: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
verses.ASV: And straightway the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word, how that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: O galo cantou a segunda vez. E Pedro se lembrou da palavra que Jesus havia lhe dito: “Antes que o galo cante duas vezes, tu me negarás três vezes.” Então ele retirou-se dali e chorou.
verses.RVR09: Y el gallo cantó la segunda vez: y Pedro se acordó de las palabras que Jesús le había dicho: Antes que el gallo cante dos veces, me negarás tres veces. Y pensando en esto, lloraba.

verses.KJV: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.WEB: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
verses.ASV: And straightway in the morning the chief priests with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo ao amanhecer, os chefes dos sacerdotes tiveram uma reunião com os anciãos, com os escribas, e com todo o supremo conselho; e, amarrando Jesus, levaram [-no] e [o] entregaram a Pilatos.
verses.RVR09: Y LUEGO por la mañana, habiendo tenido consejo los príncipes de los sacerdotes con los ancianos, y con los escribas, y con todo el concilio, llevaron á Jesús atado, y le entregaron á Pilato.

verses.KJV: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto them, Thou sayest it.
verses.WEB: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
verses.ASV: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering saith unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pilatos lhe perguntou: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E ele lhe respondeu: Tu o dizes.
verses.RVR09: Y Pilato le preguntó: ¿Eres tú el Rey de los Judíos? Y respondiendo él, le dijo: Tú lo dices.

verses.KJV: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.WEB: The chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.ASV: And the chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos sacerdotes o acusavam de muitas coisas, porém ele nada respondia.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de los sacerdotes le acusaban mucho.

verses.KJV: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.WEB: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
verses.ASV: And Pilate again asked him, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez Pilatos lhe perguntou: Não respondes nada? Olha quantas [coisas] testemunham contra ti!
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntó otra vez Pilato, diciendo: ¿No respondes algo? Mira de cuántas cosas te acusan.

verses.KJV: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.WEB: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
verses.ASV: But Jesus no more answered anything; insomuch that Pilate marvelled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus nada mais respondeu, de maneira que Pilatos ficou surpreso.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús ni aun con eso respondió; de modo que Pilato se maravillaba.

verses.KJV: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.WEB: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
verses.ASV: Now at the feast he used to release unto them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na festa, [Pilatos] lhes soltava um preso, qualquer um que pedissem.
verses.RVR09: Empero en el día de la fiesta les soltaba un preso, cualquiera que pidiesen.

verses.KJV: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.WEB: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
verses.ASV: And there was one called Barabbas, [lying] bound with them that had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um chamado Barrabás, preso com [outros] revoltosos, que numa rebelião havia cometido uma morte.
verses.RVR09: Y había uno, que se llamaba Barrabás, preso con sus compañeros de motín que habían hecho muerte en una revuelta.

verses.KJV: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
verses.WEB: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
verses.ASV: And the multitude went up and began to ask him [to do] as he was wont to do unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão, gritando, começou a pedir, como sempre lhes havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo la multitud, comenzó á pedir hiciese como siempre les había hecho.

verses.KJV: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.WEB: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.ASV: And Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pilatos lhes respondeu: Quereis que eu vos solte o Rei dos Judeus?
verses.RVR09: Y Pilato les respondió, diciendo: ¿Queréis que os suelte al Rey de los Judíos?

verses.KJV: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.WEB: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
verses.ASV: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque ele sabia que os chefes dos sacerdotes haviam o entregue por inveja).
verses.RVR09: Porque conocía que por envidia le habían entregado los príncipes de los sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.WEB: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
verses.ASV: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os chefes dos sacerdotes incitaram a multidão, para que, em vez disso, lhes soltasse Barrabás.
verses.RVR09: Mas los príncipes de los sacerdotes incitaron á la multitud, que les soltase antes á Barrabás.

verses.KJV: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.WEB: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
verses.ASV: And Pilate again answered and said unto them, What then shall I do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pilatos, respondendo, disse-lhes outra vez: Que, pois, quereis que eu faça com aquele a quem chamais Rei dos Judeus?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Pilato, les dice otra vez: ¿Qué pues queréis que haga del que llamáis Rey de los Judíos?

verses.KJV: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.WEB: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
verses.ASV: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles voltaram a clamar: Crucifica-o!
verses.RVR09: Y ellos volvieron á dar voces: Crucifícale.

verses.KJV: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.WEB: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
verses.ASV: And Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pilatos lhes disse: Por quê? Que mal ele fez? E eles gritavam ainda mais: Crucifica-o!
verses.RVR09: Mas Pilato les decía: ¿Pues qué mal ha hecho? Y ellos daban más voces: Crucifícale.

verses.KJV: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.WEB: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
verses.ASV: And Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them Barabbas, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pilatos, querendo satisfazer à multidão, soltou-lhes Barrabás; e entregou Jesus açoitado, para que fosse crucificado.
verses.RVR09: Y Pilato, queriendo satisfacer al pueblo, les soltó á Barrabás, y entregó á Jesús, después de azotarle, para que fuese crucificado.

verses.KJV: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.WEB: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
verses.ASV: And the soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os soldados o levaram para o pátio, que é o pretório; e convocaram toda a tropa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los soldados le llevaron dentro de la sala, es á saber, al Pretorio; y convocan toda la cohorte.

verses.KJV: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
verses.WEB: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
verses.ASV: And they clothe him with purple, and platting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o vestiram de púrpura; teceram uma coroa de espinhos, e puseram nele.
verses.RVR09: Y le visten de púrpura; y poniéndole una corona tejida de espinas,

verses.KJV: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.WEB: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.ASV: and they began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.ALMEIDA: E começaram a saudá-lo: Viva! Ó Rei dos Judeus!
verses.RVR09: Comenzaron luego á saludarle: ¡Salve, Rey de los Judíos!

verses.KJV: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.WEB: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
verses.ASV: And they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriram a sua cabeça com uma cana, cuspiram nele, e, ajoelhados, o adoraram.
verses.RVR09: Y le herían en la cabeza con una caña, y escupían en él, y le adoraban hincadas las rodillas.

verses.KJV: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.WEB: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
verses.ASV: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the purple, and put on him his garments. And they lead him out to crucify him.
