verses.ALMEIDA: E José também subiu da Galileia, da cidade de Nazaré à Judeia, à cidade de Davi, que se chama Belém; (porque [ele] era da casa e família de Davi.)
verses.RVR09: Y subió José de Galilea, de la ciudad de Nazaret, á Judea, á la ciudad de David, que se llama Bethlehem, por cuanto era de la casa y familia de David;

verses.KJV: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.WEB: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
verses.ASV: to enrol himself with Mary, who was betrothed to him, being great with child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para se registrar com Maria, sua mulher, com ele prometida em casamento, que estava grávida.
verses.RVR09: Para ser empadronado con María su mujer, desposada con él, la cual estaba en cinta.

verses.KJV: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.WEB: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, while they were there, the days were fulfilled that she should be delivered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles ali, completaram-se os dias em que ela havia de dar à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando ellos allí, se cumplieron los días en que ella había de parir.

verses.KJV: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.WEB: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.ASV: And she brought forth her firstborn son; and she wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu à luz seu filho primogênito, e o envolveu em panos, e o deitou numa manjedoura; porque não havia lugar para eles na hospedaria.
verses.RVR09: Y parió á su hijo primogénito, y le envolvió en pañales, y acostóle en un pesebre, porque no había lugar para ellos en el mesón.

verses.KJV: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.WEB: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
verses.ASV: And there were shepherds in the same country abiding in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquela mesma localidade havia pastores que estavam no campo, e vigiavam o seu rebanho durante as vigílias da noite.
verses.RVR09: Y había pastores en la misma tierra, que velaban y guardaban las vigilias de la noche sobre su ganado.

verses.KJV: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.WEB: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
verses.ASV: And an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu, e a glória do Senhor os cercou de resplendor. Então tiveram grande temor.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí el ángel del Señor vino sobre ellos, y la claridad de Dios los cercó de resplandor; y tuvieron gran temor.

verses.KJV: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.WEB: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
verses.ASV: And the angel said unto them, Be not afraid; for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which shall be to all the people:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo lhes disse: Não temais; pois eis que vos dou notícias de grande alegria, que será para todo o povo:
verses.RVR09: Mas el ángel les dijo: No temáis; porque he aquí os doy nuevas de gran gozo, que será para todo el pueblo:

verses.KJV: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.WEB: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
verses.ASV: for there is born to you this day in the city of David a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: que hoje na cidade de Davi vos nasceu o Salvador, que é Cristo, o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Que os ha nacido hoy, en la ciudad de David, un Salvador, que es CRISTO el Señor.

verses.KJV: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.WEB: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
verses.ASV: And this [is] the sign unto you: Ye shall find a babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, and lying in a manger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto vos será por sinal: achareis o menino envolto em panos, deitado numa manjedoura.
verses.RVR09: Y esto os será por señal: hallaréis al niño envuelto en pañales, echado en un pesebre.

verses.KJV: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.WEB: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
verses.ASV: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E no mesmo instante apareceu com o anjo uma multidão de exércitos celestiais, louvando a Deus, e dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y repentinamente fué con el ángel una multitud de los ejércitos celestiales, que alababan á Dios, y decían:

verses.KJV: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.WEB: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
verses.ASV: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Glória nas alturas a Deus, paz na terra, [e] aos seres humanos boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Gloria en las alturas á Dios, y en la tierra paz, buena voluntad para con los hombres.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.WEB: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the angels went away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing that is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando os anjos se ausentaram deles para o céu, os pastores disseram uns aos outros: Vamos, pois, até Belém, e vejamos isso que aconteceu, e o Senhor nos informou.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como los ángeles se fueron de ellos al cielo, los pastores dijeron los unos á los otros: Pasemos pues hasta Bethlehem, y veamos esto que ha sucedido, que el Señor nos ha manifestado.

verses.KJV: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.WEB: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
verses.ASV: And they came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então foram apressadamente, e acharam Maria, e José, e o menino deitado na manjedoura.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron apriesa, y hallaron á María, y á José, y al niño acostado en el pesebre.

verses.KJV: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.WEB: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
verses.ASV: And when they saw it, they made known concerning the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando [o] viram, contaram o que lhes havia sido dito sobre o menino.
verses.RVR09: Y viéndolo, hicieron notorio lo que les había sido dicho del niño.

verses.KJV: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.WEB: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
verses.ASV: And all that heard it wondered at the things which were spoken unto them by the shepherds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que ouviram se admiraram com o que os pastores lhes diziam.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que oyeron, se maravillaron de lo que los pastores les decían.

verses.KJV: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.WEB: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
verses.ASV: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Maria guardava todas essas palavras, considerando [-as] no seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Mas María guardaba todas estas cosas, confiriéndolas en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.WEB: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
verses.ASV: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, even as it was spoken unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pastores voltaram glorificando e louvando a Deus por tudo o que haviam ouvido e visto, como lhes havia sido dito.
verses.RVR09: Y se volvieron los pastores glorificando y alabando á Dios de todas las cosas que habían oído y visto, como les había sido dicho.

verses.KJV: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.WEB: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.ASV: And when eight days were fulfilled for circumcising him, his name was called JESUS, which was so called by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando se completaram os oito dias para circuncidar o menino, foi chamado o seu nome Jesus, o qual havia sido posto pelo anjo antes que fosse concebido.
verses.RVR09: Y pasados los ocho días para circuncidar al niño, llamaron su nombre JESÚS; el cual le fué puesto por el ángel antes que él fuese concebido en el vientre.

verses.KJV: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
verses.WEB: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
verses.ASV: And when the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se completaram os dias da purificação dela, segundo a Lei de Moisés, o levaram a Jerusalém, para o apresentarem ao Senhor,
verses.RVR09: Y como se cumplieron los días de la purificación de ella, conforme á la ley de Moisés, le trajeron á Jerusalem para presentarle al Señor,

verses.KJV: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.WEB: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
verses.ASV: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord),
verses.ALMEIDA: conforme o que está escrito na Lei do Senhor: Todo macho primogênito será consagrado ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: (Como está escrito en la ley del Señor: Todo varón que abriere la matriz, será llamado santo al Señor),

verses.KJV: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.WEB: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
verses.ASV: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para darem a oferta segundo o que se diz na Lei do Senhor: um par de rolinhas ou dois pombinhos.
verses.RVR09: Y para dar la ofrenda, conforme á lo que está dicho en la ley del Señor: un par de tórtolas, ó dos palominos.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.WEB: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
verses.ASV: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and this man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que havia em Jerusalém um homem de nome Simeão; e esse homem era justo e devoto, e esperava a consolação de Israel; e o Espírito Santo estava sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, había un hombre en Jerusalem, llamado Simeón, y este hombre, justo y pío, esperaba la consolación de Israel: y el Espíritu Santo era sobre él.

verses.KJV: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.WEB: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
verses.ASV: And it had been revealed unto him by the Holy Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia lhe sido revelado pelo Espírito Santo que ele não veria a morte antes de ter visto o Cristo do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y había recibido respuesta del Espíritu Santo, que no vería la muerte antes que viese al Cristo del Señor.

verses.KJV: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.WEB: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
verses.ASV: And he came in the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, that they might do concerning him after the custom of the law,
verses.ALMEIDA: E pelo Espírito foi ao Templo; e quando os pais trouxeram o menino Jesus, para fazerem com ele conforme o costume da Lei,
verses.RVR09: Y vino por Espíritu al templo. Y cuando metieron al niño Jesús sus padres en el templo, para hacer por él conforme á la costumbre de la ley,

verses.KJV: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.WEB: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,
verses.ASV: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele o tomou em seus braços, louvou a Deus, e disse:
verses.RVR09: Entonces él le tomó en sus brazos, y bendijo á Dios, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.WEB: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
verses.ASV: Now lettest thou thy servant depart, Lord, According to thy word, in peace;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, Senhor, despedes o teu servo em paz, conforme a tua palavra,
verses.RVR09: Ahora despides, Señor, á tu siervo, conforme á tu palabra, en paz;

verses.KJV: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.WEB: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
verses.ASV: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.ALMEIDA: pois os meus olhos viram a tua salvação,
verses.RVR09: Porque han visto mis ojos tu salvación,

verses.KJV: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.WEB: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
verses.ASV: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples;
verses.ALMEIDA: a qual preparaste diante de todos os povos;
verses.RVR09: La cual has aparejado en presencia de todos los pueblos;

verses.KJV: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.WEB: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
verses.ASV: A light for revelation to the Gentiles, And the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Luz para iluminar as gentios, e para a glória do teu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Luz para ser revelada á los Gentiles, y la gloria de tu pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.WEB: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
verses.ASV: And his father and his mother were marvelling at the things which were spoken concerning him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E José e sua mãe se admiraram das coisas que se diziam sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y José y su madre estaban maravillados de las cosas que se decían de él.

verses.KJV: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.WEB: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
verses.ASV: and Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this [child] is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel; and for a sign which is spoken against;
verses.ALMEIDA: Simeão os abençoou, e disse a Maria, sua mãe: Eis que este é posto para queda e levantamento de muitos em Israel; e para sinal que terá oposição,
verses.RVR09: Y los bendijo Simeón, y dijo á su madre María: He aquí, éste es puesto para caída y para levantamiento de muchos en Israel; y para señal á la que será contradicho;

verses.KJV: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.WEB: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
verses.ASV: yea and a sword shall pierce through thine own soul; that thoughts out of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.ALMEIDA: (também uma espada atravessará a tua própria alma) para que os pensamentos de muitos corações se manifestem.
verses.RVR09: Y una espada traspasará tu alma de ti misma, para que sean manifestados los pensamientos de muchos corazones.

verses.KJV: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.WEB: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
verses.ASV: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava ali a profetiza Ana, filha de Fanuel, da tribo de Aser. Ela já tinha idade avançada, e havia vivido com o marido sete anos desde sua virgindade.
verses.RVR09: Estaba también allí Ana, profetisa, hija de Phanuel, de la tribu de Aser; la cual había venido en grande edad, y había vivido con su marido siete años desde su virginidad;

verses.KJV: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.WEB: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
verses.ASV: and she had been a widow even unto fourscore and four years), who departed not from the temple, worshipping with fastings and supplications night and day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era viúva de cerca de oitenta e quatro anos, e não se afastava do Templo, servindo [a Deus] com jejuns e orações, de noite e de dia.
verses.RVR09: Y era viuda de hasta ochenta y cuatro años, que no se apartaba del templo, sirviendo de noche y de día con ayunos y oraciones.

verses.KJV: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And coming up at that very hour she gave thanks unto God, and spake of him to all them that were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela veio na mesma hora; ela agradeci ao Senhor, e falava dele a todos os que esperavam a redenção em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y ésta, sobreviniendo en la misma hora, juntamente confesaba al Señor, y hablaba de él á todos los que esperaban la redención en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.WEB: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
verses.ASV: And when they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando acabaram de cumprir tudo, segundo a Lei do Senhor, voltaram à Galileia, para a sua cidade de Nazaré.
verses.RVR09: Mas como cumplieron todas las cosas según la ley del Señor, se volvieron á Galilea, á su ciudad de Nazaret.

verses.KJV: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.WEB: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.ASV: And the child grew, and waxed strong, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o menino crescia e se fortalecia em espírito, e cheio de sabedoria; e a graça de Deus estava sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y el niño crecía, y fortalecíase, y se henchía de sabiduría; y la gracia de Dios era sobre él.

verses.KJV: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.WEB: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
verses.ASV: And his parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os anos, seus pais iam a Jerusalém, para a festa da Páscoa.
verses.RVR09: E iban sus padres todos los años á Jerusalem en la fiesta de la Pascua.

verses.KJV: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.WEB: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;
verses.ASV: And when he was twelve years old, they went up after the custom of the feast;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando [Jesus] tinha doze anos, subiram a Jerusalém, conforme o costume do festival;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fué de doce años, subieron ellos á Jerusalem conforme á la costumbre del día de la fiesta.

verses.KJV: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.WEB: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
verses.ASV: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and his parents knew it not;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando aqueles dias terminaram, eles partiram de volta, mas o menino Jesus ficou em Jerusalém sem que José e sua mãe soubessem.
verses.RVR09: Y acabados los días, volviendo ellos, se quedó el niño Jesús en Jerusalem, sin saberlo José y su madre.

verses.KJV: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.WEB: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.ASV: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they sought for him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, como pensavam que ele vinha pelo caminho entre os companheiros de viagem, eles andaram o caminho de um dia; e o procuraram entre os parentes e conhecidos.
verses.RVR09: Y pensando que estaba en la compañía, anduvieron camino de un día; y le buscaban entre los parientes y entre los conocidos:

verses.KJV: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.WEB: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
verses.ASV: and when they found him not, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como não o acharam, voltaram a Jerusalém em busca dele.
verses.RVR09: Mas como no le hallasen, volvieron á Jerusalem buscándole.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.WEB: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, três dias depois, o acharam no templo, sentado no meio dos mestres, ouvindo-os, e perguntando-lhes.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que tres días después le hallaron en el templo, sentado en medio de los doctores, oyéndoles y preguntándoles.

verses.KJV: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.WEB: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.ASV: and all that heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que o ouviam admiravam a sua inteligência e respostas;
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que le oían, se pasmaban de su entendimiento y de sus respuestas.

verses.KJV: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.WEB: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
verses.ASV: And when they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I sought thee sorrowing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eles o viram, ficarm surpresos. E sua mãe lhe disse: Filho, por que fizeste assim conosco? Eis que teu pai e eu com ansiedade te procurávamos.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando le vieron, se maravillaron; y díjole su madre: Hijo, ¿por qué nos has hecho así? He aquí, tu padre y yo te hemos buscado con dolor.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? knew ye not that I must be in my Father’s house?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes disse: Por que me procuráveis? Não sabeis que devo estar nos negócios de meu Pai?
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dice: ¿Qué hay? ¿por qué me buscabais? ¿No sabíais que en los negocios de mi Padre me conviene estar?

verses.KJV: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.WEB: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
verses.ASV: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles não entenderam as palavras que lhes dizia.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no entendieron las palabras que les habló.

verses.KJV: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.WEB: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.ASV: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth; and he was subject unto them: and his mother kept all [these] sayings in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então desceu com eles, e veio a Nazaré, e os obedecia. E a sua mãe guardava todas essas coisas no seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió con ellos, y vino á Nazaret, y estaba sujeto á ellos. Y su madre guardaba todas estas cosas en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
verses.WEB: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
verses.ASV: And Jesus advanced in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus crescia em sabedoria, em estatura, e em graça para com Deus e as pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús crecía en sabiduría, y en edad, y en gracia para con Dios y los hombres.

verses.KJV: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.WEB: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.ASV: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituræa and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano quinze do império de Tibério César, sendo Pôncio Pilatos o governador da Judeia, Herodes tetraca da Galileia, e seu irmão Filipe o tetrarca da Itureia e da província de Traconites, e Lisânias o tetrarca de Abilene;
verses.RVR09: Y EN el año quince del imperio de Tiberio César, siendo gobernador de Judea Poncio Pilato, y Herodes tetrarca de Galilea, y su hermano Felipe tetrarca de Iturea y de la provincia de Traconite, y Lisanias tetrarca de Abilinia,

verses.KJV: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: in the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: sendo Anás e Caifás os sumos sacerdotes, a palavra de Deus veio a João, filho de Zacarias, no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Siendo sumos sacerdotes Anás y Caifás, vino palabra del Señor sobre Juan, hijo de Zacarías, en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
verses.WEB: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
verses.ASV: And he came into all the region round about the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele percorreu toda a região ao redor do Jordão, pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para o perdão dos pecados;
verses.RVR09: Y él vino por toda la tierra al rededor del Jordán predicando el bautismo del arrepentimiento para la remisión de pecados;

verses.KJV: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.WEB: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
verses.ASV: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight.
verses.ALMEIDA: conforme o que está escrito no livro das palavras do profeta Isaías, que diz: “Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito en el libro de las palabras del profeta Isaías que dice: Voz del que clama en el desierto: Aparejad el camino del Señor, haced derechas sus sendas.

verses.KJV: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
verses.WEB: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
verses.ASV: Every valley shall be filled, And every mountain and hill shall be brought low; And the crooked shall become straight, And the rough ways smooth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo vale se encherá, e todo monte e colina se abaixará; os tortos serão endireitados, e os caminhos ásperos se suavizarão;
verses.RVR09: Todo valle se henchirá, y bajaráse todo monte y collado; y los caminos torcidos serán enderezados, y los caminos ásperos allanados;

verses.KJV: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.WEB: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
verses.ASV: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: e todos verão a salvação de Deus.”
verses.RVR09: Y verá toda carne la salvación de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.WEB: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.ASV: He said therefore to the multitudes that went out to be baptized of him, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.ALMEIDA: [João] dizia às multidões que vinham ser batizadas por ele: “Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira que está para chegar?
verses.RVR09: Y decía á las gentes que salían para ser bautizadas de él: ¡Oh generación de víboras, quién os enseñó á huir de la ira que vendrá?

verses.KJV: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.WEB: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
verses.ASV: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai, pois, frutos condizentes com o arrependimento, e não comeceis a dizer em vós mesmos: ‘Temos Abraão por pai’; pois eu vos digo que até destas pedras Deus pode produzir filhos a Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Haced, pues, frutos dignos de arrepentimiento, y no comencéis á decir en vosotros mismos: Tenemos á Abraham por padre: porque os digo que puede Dios, aun de estas piedras, levantar hijos á Abraham.

verses.KJV: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.WEB: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”
verses.ASV: And even now the axe also lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também o machado já está posto à raiz das árvores; portanto, toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y ya también el hacha está puesta á la raíz de los árboles: todo árbol pues que no hace buen fruto, es cortado, y echado en el fuego.

verses.KJV: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.WEB: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
verses.ASV: And the multitudes asked him, saying, What then must we do?
verses.ALMEIDA: E as multidões lhe perguntavam: Então o que devemos fazer?
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes le preguntaban, diciendo: ¿Pues qué haremos?

verses.KJV: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath food, let him do likewise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes respondeu: Quem tiver duas túnicas, reparta com o não tem; e quem tiver comida, faça da mesma maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo, les dijo: El que tiene dos túnicas, dé al que no tiene; y el que tiene qué comer, haga lo mismo.

verses.KJV: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.WEB: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
verses.ASV: And there came also publicans to be baptized, and they said unto him, Teacher, what must we do?
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram também uns publicanos, para serem batizados; e disseram-lhe: Mestre, que devemos fazer?
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron también publicanos para ser bautizados, y le dijeron: Maestro, ¿qué haremos?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Extort no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Não exijais mais do que vos está ordenado.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: No exijáis más de lo que os está ordenado.

verses.KJV: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.WEB: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
verses.ASV: And soldiers also asked him, saying, And we, what must we do? And he said unto them, Extort from no man by violence, neither accuse [any one] wrongfully; and be content with your wages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uns soldados também lhe perguntaram: E nós, que devemos fazer? E ele lhes disse: Não maltrateis nem defraudeis a ninguém; e contentai-vos com vossos salários.
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntaron también los soldados, diciendo: Y nosotros, ¿qué haremos? Y les dice: No hagáis extorsión á nadie, ni calumniéis; y contentaos con vuestras pagas.

verses.KJV: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.WEB: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
verses.ASV: And as the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether haply he were the Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, enquanto o povo estava em expectativa, e todos pensando em seus corações se talvez João seria o Cristo,
verses.RVR09: Y estando el pueblo esperando, y pensando todos de Juan en sus corazones, si él fuese el Cristo,

verses.KJV: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.WEB: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.ASV: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but there cometh he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and [in] fire:
verses.ALMEIDA: João respondeu a todos: De fato, eu vos batizo com água, mas vem um que é mais poderoso do que eu, de quem eu não sou digno de desatar a tira das sandálias; ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Juan, diciendo á todos: Yo, á la verdad, os bautizo en agua; mas viene quien es más poderoso que yo, de quien no soy digno de desatar la correa de sus zapatos: él os bautizará en Espíritu Santo y fuego;

verses.KJV: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.WEB: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
verses.ASV: whose fan is in his hand, thoroughly to cleanse his threshing-floor, and to gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua pá está na sua mão, e limpará sua eira, e juntará o trigo no seu celeiro; porém queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.
verses.RVR09: Cuyo bieldo está en su mano, y limpiará su era, y juntará el trigo en su alfolí, y la paja quemará en fuego que nunca se apagará.

verses.KJV: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.WEB: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
verses.ASV: With many other exhortations therefore preached he good tidings unto the people;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, exortando com muitas outras coisas, [João] anunciava a boa notícia ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y amonestando, otras muchas cosas también anunciaba al pueblo.

verses.KJV: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.WEB: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
verses.ASV: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, quando Herodes, o tetrarca, foi repreendido por ele por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe, e por todas as maldades que Herodes havia feito,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Herodes el tetrarca, siendo reprendido por él á causa de Herodías, mujer de Felipe su hermano, y de todas las maldades que había hecho Herodes,

verses.KJV: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.WEB: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.ASV: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: acrescentou a todas ainda esta: encarcerou João na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Añadió también esto sobre todo, que encerró á Juan en la cárcel.

verses.KJV: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.WEB: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized, that, Jesus also having been baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando todo o povo era batizado, Jesus [também] foi batizado, e enquanto orava, o céu se abriu,
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como todo el pueblo se bautizaba, también Jesús fué bautizado; y orando, el cielo se abrió,

verses.KJV: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.WEB: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
verses.ASV: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form, as a dove, upon him, and a voice came out of heaven, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o Espírito Santo desceu sobre ele em forma corpórea, como pomba; e veio do céu uma voz que dizia: Tu és o meu Filho amado, em ti me agrado.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió el Espíritu Santo sobre él en forma corporal, como paloma, y fué hecha una voz del cielo que decía: Tú eres mi Hijo amado, en ti me he complacido.

verses.RVR09: Que fué de Leví, que fué de Simeón, que fué de Judá, que fué de José, que fué de Jonán, que fué de Eliachîm,

verses.ASV: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led in the Spirit in the wilderness

verses.RVR09: Y JESÚS, lleno del Espíritu Santo, volvió del Jordán, y fué llevado por el Espíritu al desierto

verses.KJV: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.WEB: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
verses.ASV: during forty days, being tempted of the devil. And he did eat nothing in those days: and when they were completed, he hungered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por quarenta dias foi tentado pelo diabo; e não comeu coisa alguma naqueles dias; e terminados eles, depois teve fome.
verses.RVR09: Por cuarenta días, y era tentado del diablo. Y no comió cosa en aquellos días: los cuales pasados, tuvo hambre.

verses.KJV: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.WEB: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
verses.ASV: And the devil said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, command this stone that it become bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o diabo lhe disse: Se tu és Filho de Deus, diz a esta pedra que se transforme em pão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el diablo le dijo: Si eres Hijo de Dios, di á esta piedra que se haga pan.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered unto him, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe respondeu: Está escrito que não só de pão viverá o ser humano, mas de toda palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús respondiéndole, dijo: Escrito está: Que no con pan solo vivirá el hombre, mas con toda palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.WEB: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.ASV: And he led him up, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o diabo o levou a um alto monte, e lhe mostrou todos os reinos do mundo num instante.
verses.RVR09: Y le llevó el diablo á un alto monte, y le mostró en un momento de tiempo todos los reinos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.WEB: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.
verses.ASV: And the devil said unto him, To thee will I give all this authority, and the glory of them: for it hath been delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o diabo lhe disse: Darei a ti todo este poder e sua glória; pois a mim foram entregues, e os dou a quem quero.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo el diablo: A ti te daré toda esta potestad, y la gloria de ellos; porque á mí es entregada, y á quien quiero la doy:

verses.KJV: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.WEB: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
verses.ASV: If thou therefore wilt worship before me, it shall all be thine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se tu me adorares, tudo será teu.
verses.RVR09: Pues si tú adorares delante de mí, serán todos tuyos.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, It is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe respondeu: Para trás de mim, Satanás!Porque está escrito: Adorarás ao Senhor teu Deus, e só a ele servirás.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, le dijo: Vete de mí, Satanás, porque escrito está: A tu Señor Dios adorarás, y á él solo servirás.

verses.KJV: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.WEB: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
verses.ASV: And he led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o levou a Jerusalém, e o pôs sobre a parte mais alta do templo, e disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te daqui abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Y le llevó á Jerusalem, y púsole sobre las almenas del templo, y le dijo: Si eres Hijo de Dios, échate de aquí abajo:

verses.KJV: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.WEB: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
verses.ASV: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to guard thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque está escrito que: Mandará aos seus acerca de ti que te guardem.
verses.RVR09: Porque escrito está: Que á sus ángeles mandará de ti, que te guarden;

verses.KJV: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.WEB: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
verses.ASV: and, On their hands they shall bear thee up, Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que: te sustentarão pelas mãos, para que nunca tropeces com o teu pé em alguma pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y en las manos te llevarán, porque no dañes tu pie en piedra.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe respondeu: Dito está: Não tentes ao Senhor teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, le dijo: Dicho está: No tentarás al Señor tu Dios.

verses.KJV: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.WEB: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
verses.ASV: And when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o diabo acabou toda a tentação, ausentou-se dele por algum tempo.
verses.RVR09: Y acabada toda tentación, el diablo se fué de él por un tiempo.

verses.KJV: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.WEB: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
verses.ASV: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and a fame went out concerning him through all the region round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus, no poder do Espírito, voltou para a Galileia, e sua fama se espalhou por toda a região ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús volvió en virtud del Espíritu á Galilea, y salió la fama de él por toda la tierra de alrededor.

verses.KJV: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.WEB: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
verses.ASV: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele ensinava em suas sinagogas, e era recebido com honra por todos.
verses.RVR09: Y enseñaba en las sinagogas de ellos, y era glorificado de todos.

verses.KJV: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.WEB: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
verses.ASV: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and he entered, as his custom was, into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up to read.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele foi a Nazaré, onde havia sido criado, e entrou, conforme o seu costume, num dia de Sábado, na sinagoga; e levantou-se para ler.
verses.RVR09: Y vino á Nazaret, donde había sido criado; y entró, conforme á su costumbre, el día del sábado en la sinagoga, y se levantó á leer.

verses.KJV: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
verses.WEB: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
verses.ASV: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And he opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi-lhe dado o livro do profeta Isaías; e quando abriu o livro, achou o lugar onde estava escrito:
verses.RVR09: Y fuéle dado el libro del profeta Isaías; y como abrió el libro, halló el lugar donde estaba escrito:

verses.KJV: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.WEB: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
verses.ASV: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, Because he anointed me to preach good tidings to the poor: He hath sent me to proclaim release to the captives, And recovering of sight to the blind, To set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.ALMEIDA: O Espírito do Senhor [está] sobre mim, porque ele me ungiu para evangelizar os pobres, me enviou para curar os contritos de coração;
verses.RVR09: El Espíritu del Señor es sobre mí, por cuanto me ha ungido para dar buenas nuevas á los pobres: me ha enviado para sanar á los quebrantados de corazón; para pregonar á los cautivos libertad, y á los ciegos vista; para poner en libertad á los quebrantados:

verses.KJV: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.WEB: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
verses.ASV: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: para proclamar liberdade aos cativos e dar vista aos cegos, para pôr em liberdade os oprimidos, para proclamar o ano agradável do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Para predicar el año agradable del Señor.

verses.KJV: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.WEB: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.ASV: And he closed the book, and gave it back to the attendant, and sat down: and the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fechou o livro, e devolveu-o ao assistente, e se sentou. Os olhos de todos na sinagoga estavam fixos nele.
verses.RVR09: Y rollando el libro, lo dió al ministro, y sentóse: y los ojos de todos en la sinagoga estaban fijos en él.

verses.KJV: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.WEB: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
verses.ASV: And he began to say unto them, To-day hath this scripture been fulfilled in your ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele começou a lhes dizer: Hoje esta escritura se cumpriu em vossos ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á decirles: Hoy se ha cumplido esta Escritura en vuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.WEB: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
verses.ASV: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the words of grace which proceeded out of his mouth: and they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos davam testemunho dele, e se admiravam das palavras graciosas que saíam da sua boca; e diziam: Não é este o filho de José?
verses.RVR09: Y todos le daban testimonio, y estaban maravillados de las palabras de gracia que salían de su boca, y decían: ¿No es éste el hijo de José?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Doubtless ye will say unto me this parable, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in thine own country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Sem dúvida me direis este provérbio: Médico, cura a ti mesmo; faz também aqui na tua terra natal todas as coisas que ouvimos terem sido feitas em Cafarnaum.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Sin duda me diréis este refrán: Médico, cúrate á ti mismo: de tantas cosas que hemos oído haber sido hechas en Capernaum, haz también aquí en tu tierra.

verses.KJV: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.WEB: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
verses.ASV: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is acceptable in his own country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que nenhum profeta é bem recebido na sua terra natal.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: De cierto os digo, que ningún profeta es acepto en su tierra.

verses.KJV: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.WEB: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
verses.ASV: But of a truth I say unto you, There were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when there came a great famine over all the land;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém em verdade vos digo que hava muitas viúvas em Israel nos dias de Elias, quando o céu se fechou por três anos e seis meses, de modo que em toda [aquela] terra houve grande fome.
verses.RVR09: Mas en verdad os digo, que muchas viudas había en Israel en los días de Elías, cuando el cielo fué cerrado por tres años y seis meses, que hubo una grande hambre en toda la tierra;

verses.KJV: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.WEB: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
verses.ASV: and unto none of them was Elijah sent, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a nenhuma delas Elias foi enviado, a não ser a uma mulher viúva de Sarepta de Sidom.
verses.RVR09: Pero á ninguna de ellas fué enviado Elías, sino á Sarepta de Sidón, á una mujer viuda.

verses.KJV: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.WEB: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
verses.ASV: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, but only Naaman the Syrian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia muitos leprosos em Israel no tempo do profeta Eliseu; mas nenhum deles foi limpo, a não ser Naamã, o sírio.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos leprosos había en Israel en tiempo del profeta Eliseo; mas ninguno de ellos fué limpio, sino Naamán el Siro.

verses.KJV: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.WEB: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.
verses.ASV: And they were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos na sinagoga, quando ouviram essas coisas, encheram-se de ira.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos en la sinagoga fueron llenos de ira, oyendo estas cosas;

verses.KJV: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.WEB: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
verses.ASV: and they rose up, and cast him forth out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might throw him down headlong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se levantaram, expulsaram-no da cidade, e o levaram até o topo do monte em que sua cidade era construída, para dali o lançarem abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose, le echaron fuera de la ciudad, y le llevaron hasta la cumbre del monte sobre el cual la ciudad de ellos estaba edificada, para despeñarle.

verses.KJV: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.WEB: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
verses.ASV: But he passing through the midst of them went his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele passou por meio deles, e se retirou.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, pasando por medio de ellos, se fué.

verses.KJV: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.WEB: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
verses.ASV: And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. And he was teaching them on the sabbath day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele desceu a Cafarnaum, cidade de Galileia; e [ali] os ensinava nos sábados.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió á Capernaum, ciudad de Galilea. Y los enseñaba en los sábados.

verses.KJV: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.WEB: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
verses.ASV: and they were astonished at his teaching; for his word was with authority.
verses.ALMEIDA: E admiravam o seu ensino, pois a sua palavra era com autoridade.
verses.RVR09: Y se maravillaban de su doctrina, porque su palabra era con potestad.

verses.KJV: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.WEB: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.ASV: And in the synagogue there was a man, that had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava na sinagoga um homem que tinha um espírito de um demônio imundo, e gritou com alta voz,
verses.RVR09: Y estaba en la sinagoga un hombre que tenía un espíritu de un demonio inmundo, el cual exclamó á gran voz,

verses.KJV: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
verses.WEB: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
verses.ASV: Ah! what have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Ah, que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste para nos destruir? Sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Déjanos, ¿qué tenemos contigo, Jesús Nazareno? ¿has venido á destruirnos? Yo te conozco quién eres, el Santo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.WEB: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
verses.ASV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the demon had thrown him down in the midst, he came out of him, having done him no hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e, sai dele. E o demônio o derrubou no meio [do povo] , e saiu dele sem lhe fazer dano algum.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le increpó, diciendo: Enmudece, y sal de él. Entonces el demonio, derribándole en medio, salió de él, y no le hizo daño alguno.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.WEB: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
verses.ASV: And amazement came upon all, and they spake together, one with another, saying, What is this word? for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E espanto veio sobre todos; e falavam entre si uns aos outros, dizendo: Que palavra é esta, que até aos espíritos imundos ele manda com autoridade e poder, e eles saem?
verses.RVR09: Y hubo espanto en todos, y hablaban unos á otros, diciendo: ¿Qué palabra es ésta, que con autoridad y potencia manda á los espíritus inmundos, y salen?

verses.KJV: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.WEB: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
verses.ASV: And there went forth a rumor concerning him into every place of the region round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua fama era divulgada em todos os lugares em redor daquela região.
verses.RVR09: Y la fama de él se divulgaba de todas partes por todos los lugares de la comarca.

verses.KJV: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.WEB: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.
verses.ASV: And he rose up from the synagogue, and entered into the house of Simon. And Simon’s wife’s mother was holden with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] levantou-se da sinagoga, e entrou na casa de Simão. A sogra de Simão estava doente de uma grande febre, e rogaram-lhe por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose Jesús de la sinagoga, entró en casa de Simón: y la suegra de Simón estaba con una grande fiebre; y le rogaron por ella.

verses.KJV: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.WEB: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
verses.ASV: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she rose up and ministered unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se inclinou a ela, e repreendeu a febre, que a deixou. Ela imediatamente se levantou e começou a lhes servir.
verses.RVR09: E inclinándose hacia ella, riñó á la fiebre; y la fiebre la dejó; y ella levantándose luego, les servía.

verses.KJV: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.WEB: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.ASV: And when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o sol estava se pondo, troxeram-lhe todos os que estavam enfermos de varias doenças. Ele punha as mãos sobre cada um deles e os curava.
verses.RVR09: Y poniéndose el sol, todos los que tenían enfermos de diversas enfermedades, los traían á él; y él, poniendo las manos sobre cada uno de ellos, los sanaba.

verses.KJV: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
verses.WEB: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
verses.ASV: And demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, Thou art the Son of God. And rebuking them, he suffered them not to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também de muitos saíam demônios, gritando, e dizendo: Tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus. Ele os repreendia, e não os deixava falar, porque sabiam que ele era o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y salían también demonios de muchos, dando voces, y diciendo: Tú eres el Hijo de Dios. Mas riñéndolos no les dejaba hablar; porque sabían que él era el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.WEB: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
verses.ASV: And when it was day, he came out and went into a desert place: and the multitudes sought after him, and came unto him, and would have stayed him, that he should not go from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sendo já dia, ele saiu, e foi a um lugar deserto. As multidões o buscavam; então vieram a ele, e queriam detê-lo, para que não os deixasse.
verses.RVR09: Y siendo ya de día salió, y se fué á un lugar desierto: y las gentes le buscaban, y vinieron hasta él; y le detenían para que no se apartase de ellos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
verses.ASV: But he said unto them, I must preach the good tidings of the kingdom of God to the other cities also: for therefore was I sent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes disse: Também é necessário que eu anuncie a outras cidades o evangelho do Reino de Deus; pois para isso sou enviado.
verses.RVR09: Mas él les dijo: Que también á otras ciudades es necesario que anuncie el evangelio del reino de Dios; porque para esto soy enviado.

verses.KJV: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.WEB: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.ASV: And he was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele pregava nas sinagogas da Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y predicaba en las sinagogas de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.WEB: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass, while the multitude pressed upon him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que as multidões o comprimiam para ouvir a palavra de Deus, quando ele estava junto ao lago de Genesaré.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ, que estando él junto al lago de Genezaret, las gentes se agolpaban sobre él para oir la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.WEB: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
verses.ASV: and he saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele viu dois barcos que estavam próximos [da margem] do lago, e os pescadores haviam descido deles, e estavam lavando as redes.
verses.RVR09: Y vió dos barcos que estaban cerca de la orilla del lago: y los pescadores, habiendo descendido de ellos, lavaban sus redes.

verses.KJV: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.WEB: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
verses.ASV: And he entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. And he sat down and taught the multitudes out of the boat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele entrou num daqueles barcos, que era o de Simão, e lhe pediu que o afastasse um pouco da terra. Depois se sentou, e do barco ensinou às multidões.
verses.RVR09: Y entrado en uno de estos barcos, el cual era de Simón, le rogó que lo desviase de tierra un poco; y sentándose, enseñaba desde el barco á las gentes.

verses.KJV: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.WEB: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
verses.ASV: And when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando acabou de falar, disse a Simão: Vai à água profunda, e lançai as vossas redes para pescar.
verses.RVR09: Y como cesó de hablar, dijo á Simón: Tira á alta mar, y echad vuestras redes para pescar.

verses.KJV: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.WEB: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
verses.ASV: And Simon answered and said, Master, we toiled all night, and took nothing: but at thy word I will let down the nets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão lhe respondeu: Mestre, trabalhamos toda a noite, mas nada pegamos; mas pela tua palavra lançarei a rede.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Simón, le dijo: Maestro, habiendo trabajado toda la noche, nada hemos tomado; mas en tu palabra echaré la red.

verses.KJV: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.WEB: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
verses.ASV: And when they had done this, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes; and their nets were breaking;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles fizeram assim, e recolheram grande quantidade de peixes, e sua rede estava se rompendo.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndolo hecho, encerraron gran multitud de pescado, que su red se rompía.

verses.KJV: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.WEB: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
verses.ASV: and they beckoned unto their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então acenaram aos companheiros que estavam no outro barco, para que viessem os ajudar. Vieram, e encheram ambos os barcos, de tal maneira que quase afundavam.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron señas á los compañeros que estaban en el otro barco, que viniesen á ayudarles; y vinieron, y llenaron ambos barcos, de tal manera que se anegaban.

verses.KJV: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.WEB: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
verses.ASV: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Simão Pedro viu[isso] , prostrou-se aos pés de Jesus, dizendo: Afasta-te de mim, Senhor, porque sou um homem pecador.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual viendo Simón Pedro, se derribó de rodillas á Jesús, diciendo: Apártate de mí, Señor, porque soy hombre pecador.

verses.KJV: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.WEB: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
verses.ASV: For he was amazed, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele estava cheio de espanto, como todos os que estavam com ele, por causa da coleta de peixes que haviam feito.
verses.RVR09: Porque temor le había rodeado, y á todos los que estaban con él, de la presa de los peces que habían tomado;

verses.KJV: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.WEB: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
verses.ASV: and so were also James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semelhantemente, também, Tiago e João, filhos de Zebedeu, que eram colegas de Simão. E Jesus disse a Simão: Não temas, de agora em diante pescarás gente.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo á Jacobo y á Juan, hijos de Zebedeo, que eran compañeros de Simón. Y Jesús dijo á Simón: No temas: desde ahora pescarás hombres.

verses.KJV: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.WEB: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
verses.ASV: And when they had brought their boats to land, they left all, and followed him.
