verses.ALMEIDA: Eles levaram os barcos para a terra, deixaram tudo, e o seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegaron á tierra los barcos, dejándolo todo, le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.WEB: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, while he was in one of the cities, behold, a man full of leprosy: and when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando ele estava numa daquelas cidades, eis que um homem cheio de lepra viu Jesus; então prostrou-se sobre o rosto, e lhe rogou, dizendo: Senhor, se quiseres, podes me tornar limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando en una ciudad, he aquí un hombre lleno de lepra, el cual viendo á Jesús, postrándose sobre el rostro, le rogó, diciendo: Señor, si quieres, puedes limpiarme.

verses.KJV: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.WEB: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.ASV: And he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou made clean. And straightway the leprosy departed from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele estendeu a mão, e o tocou, dizendo: Quero; sê limpo. E logo a lepra desapareceu dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, extendiendo la mano, le tocó diciendo: Quiero: sé limpio. Y luego la lepra se fué de él.

verses.KJV: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.WEB: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
verses.ASV: And he charged him to tell no man: but go thy way, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhe que não o dissesse a ninguém: Mas vai, mostra-te ao sacerdote, e oferece por tua purificação, como Moisés mandou, para lhes dar testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y él le mandó que no lo dijese á nadie: Mas ve, díjole, muéstrate al sacerdote, y ofrece por tu limpieza, como mandó Moisés, para testimonio á ellos.

verses.KJV: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.WEB: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.ASV: But so much the more went abroad the report concerning him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed of their infirmities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a sua fama se espalhava ainda mais; e ajuntavam-se muitas multidões para o ouvir, e para serem por ele curadas de suas enfermidades.
verses.RVR09: Empero tanto más se extendía su fama: y se juntaban muchas gentes á oir y ser sanadas de sus enfermedades.

verses.KJV: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.WEB: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
verses.ASV: But he withdrew himself in the deserts, and prayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele se retirava para os desertos, e [ali] orava.
verses.RVR09: Mas él se apartaba á los desiertos, y oraba.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.WEB: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, who were come out of every village of Galilee and Judæa and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was with him to heal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu num daqueles dias que estava ensinando, e estavam [ali] sentados fariseus e instrutores da lei, que tinham vindo de todas as aldeias da Galileia, da Judeia, e de Jerusalém; e o poder do Senhor estava [ali] para os curar.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció un día, que él estaba enseñando, y los Fariseos y doctores de la ley estaban sentados, los cuales habían venido de todas las aldeas de Galilea, y de Judea y Jerusalem: y la virtud del Señor estaba allí para sanarlos.

verses.KJV: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.WEB: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
verses.ASV: And behold, men bring on a bed a man that was palsied: and they sought to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uns homens traziam numa cama um homem que estava paralítico; e procuravam levá-lo para dentro, a fim de o porem diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí unos hombres, que traían sobre un lecho un hombre que estaba paralítico; y buscaban meterle, y ponerle delante de él.

verses.KJV: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.WEB: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
verses.ASV: And not finding by what [way] they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como não acharam por onde pudessem levá-lo para dentro, por causa da multidão, subiram ao telhado, e pelas telhas o baixaram com o leito para o meio [do povo] , diante de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y no hallando por donde meterle á causa de la multitud, subieron encima de la casa, y por el tejado le bajaron con el lecho en medio, delante de Jesús;

verses.KJV: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.WEB: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.ASV: And seeing their faith, he said, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele viu a fé deles, e disse-lhe: Homem, teus pecados são perdoados.
verses.RVR09: El cual, viendo la fe de ellos, le dice: Hombre, tus pecados te son perdonados.

verses.KJV: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.WEB: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
verses.ASV: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this that speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os escribas e os fariseus começaram a questionar, dizendo: Quem é este que fala blasfêmias? Quem pode perdoar pecados, senão só Deus?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los escribas y los Fariseos comenzaron á pensar, diciendo: ¿Quién es éste que habla blasfemias? ¿Quién puede perdonar pecados sino sólo Dios?

verses.KJV: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.WEB: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
verses.ASV: But Jesus perceiving their reasonings, answered and said unto them, Why reason ye in your hearts?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus, conhecendo os seus pensamentos, respondeu-lhes: O que pensais em vossos corações?
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces, conociendo los pensamientos de ellos, respondiendo les dijo: ¿Qué pensáis en vuestros corazones?

verses.KJV: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.WEB: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
verses.ASV: Which is easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Arise and walk?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é mais fácil? Dizer: Teus pecados são perdoados? Ou dizer: Levanta-te, e anda?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué es más fácil, decir: Tus pecados te son perdonados, ó decir: Levántate y anda?

verses.KJV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.WEB: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
verses.ASV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (he said unto him that was palsied), I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go unto thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem poder sobre a terra para perdoar pecados, (disse ao paralítico:) Eu te digo, levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e vai para a tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Pues para que sepáis que el Hijo del hombre tiene potestad en la tierra de perdonar pecados, (dice al paralítico): A ti digo, levántate, toma tu lecho, y vete á tu casa.

verses.KJV: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.WEB: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
verses.ASV: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele levantou-se imediatamente diante deles, tomou o [leito] em que estava deitado, e foi para a sua casa, glorificando a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y luego, levantándose en presencia de ellos, y tomando aquel en que estaba echado, se fué á su casa, glorificando á Dios.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.WEB: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
verses.ASV: And amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God; and they were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to-day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos ficaram admirados, e glorificaram a Deus; e ficaram cheios de temor, dizendo: Hoje vimos maravilhas!
verses.RVR09: Y tomó espanto á todos, y glorificaban á Dios; y fueron llenos de temor, diciendo: Hemos visto maravillas hoy.

verses.KJV: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.WEB: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
verses.ASV: And after these things he went forth, and beheld a publican, named Levi, sitting at the place of toll, and said unto him, Follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas, ele saiu; e viu um publicano, chamado Levi, sentado na coletoria de tributos, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.
verses.RVR09: Y después de estas cosas salió, y vió á un publicano llamado Leví, sentado al banco de los públicos tributos, y le dijo: Sígueme.

verses.KJV: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.WEB: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
verses.ASV: And he forsook all, and rose up and followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele deixou tudo, levantou-se, e o seguiu.
verses.RVR09: Y dejadas todas las cosas, levantándose, le siguió.

verses.KJV: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.WEB: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
verses.ASV: And Levi made him a great feast in his house: and there was a great multitude of publicans and of others that were sitting at meat with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Levi lhe fez um grande banquete em sua casa; e havia [ali] uma grande multidão de publicanos e de outros que estavam sentados com eles [à mesa] .
verses.RVR09: E hizo Leví gran banquete en su casa; y había mucha compañía de publicanos y de otros, los cuales estaban á la mesa con ellos.

verses.KJV: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.WEB: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees and their scribes murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with the publicans and sinners?
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus escribas e fariseus murmuravam contra os seus discípulos, dizendo: Por que comeis e bebeis com publicanos e pecadores?
verses.RVR09: Y los escribas y los Fariseos murmuraban contra sus discípulos, diciendo: ¿Por qué coméis y bebéis con los publicanos y pecadores?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are in health have no need of a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Os que estão sãos não precisam de médico, mas sim os que estão doentes.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Los que están sanos no necesitan médico, sino los que están enfermos.

verses.KJV: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.WEB: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
verses.ASV: I am not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não vim para chamar os justos, mas sim, os pecadores, ao arrependimento.
verses.RVR09: No he venido á llamar justos, sino pecadores á arrepentimiento.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, The disciples of John fast often, and make supplications; likewise also the [disciples] of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles lhe disseram: Por que os discípulos de João jejuam muitas vezes, e fazem orações, como também os dos fariseus, mas os teus comem e bebem?
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos le dijeron: ¿Por qué los discípulos de Juan ayunan muchas veces y hacen oraciones, y asimismo los de los Fariseos, y tus discípulos comen y beben?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Can ye make the sons of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes disse: Podeis vós fazer jejuar os convidados do casamento, enquanto o noivo está com eles?
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Podéis hacer que los que están de bodas ayunen, entre tanto que el esposo está con ellos?

verses.KJV: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.WEB: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
verses.ASV: But the days will come; and when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, then will they fast in those days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém virão dias em que o esposo lhes será tirado; então naqueles dias jejuarão.
verses.RVR09: Empero vendrán días cuando el esposo les será quitado: entonces ayunarán en aquellos días.

verses.KJV: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.WEB: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
verses.ASV: And he spake also a parable unto them: No man rendeth a piece from a new garment and putteth it upon an old garment; else he will rend the new, and also the piece from the new will not agree with the old.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia-lhes também uma parábola: Ninguém põe remendo de pano novo em roupa velha; de outra maneira, o novo rompe, e o remendo do novo não será adequado ao velho.
verses.RVR09: Y les decía también una parábola: Nadie mete remiendo de paño nuevo en vestido viejo; de otra manera el nuevo rompe, y al viejo no conviene remiendo nuevo.

verses.KJV: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.WEB: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
verses.ASV: And no man putteth new wine into old wine-skins; else the new wine will burst the skins, and itself will be spilled, and the skins will perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém põe vinho novo em odres velhos; de outra maneira, o vinho novo romperá os odres, e se derramará, e os odres são destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Y nadie echa vino nuevo en cueros viejos; de otra manera el vino nuevo romperá los cueros, y el vino se derramará, y los cueros se perderán.

verses.KJV: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.WEB: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.
verses.ASV: But new wine must be put into fresh wine-skins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o vinho novo deve ser posto em odres novos, e ambos se conservam.
verses.RVR09: Mas el vino nuevo en cueros nuevos se ha de echar; y lo uno y lo otro se conserva.

verses.KJV: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.WEB: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
verses.ASV: And no man having drunk old [wine] desireth new; for he saith, The old is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém que beber do velho quer logo o novo; porque diz: O velho é melhor.
verses.RVR09: Y ninguno que bebiere del añejo, quiere luego el nuevo; porque dice: El añejo es mejor.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.WEB: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass on a sabbath, that he was going through the grainfields; and his disciples plucked the ears, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, no segundo sábadodepois do primeiro, [Jesus] passou pelas plantações, e seus discípulos iam arrancando espigas, e comiam, debulhando-as com as mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que pasando él por los sembrados en un sábado segundo del primero, sus discípulos arrancaban espigas, y comían, restregándolas con las manos.

verses.KJV: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.WEB: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
verses.ASV: But certain of the Pharisees said, Why do ye that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos fariseus lhes disseram: Por que fazeis o que não é lícito fazer nos sábados?
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los Fariseos les dijeron: ¿Por qué hacéis lo que no es lícito hacer en los sábados?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.WEB: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read even this, what David did, when he was hungry, he, and they that were with him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Nunca lestes isto, o que Davi fez quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús les dijo: ¿Ni aun esto habéis leído, qué hizo David cuando tuvo hambre, él, y los que con él estaban;

verses.KJV: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.WEB: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
verses.ASV: how he entered into the house of God, and took and ate the showbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests alone?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como entrou na casa de Deus, tomou, e comeu os pães da apresentação, e deu também aos que estavam com ele, [pães] que não é lícito comer, a não ser só os sacerdotes?
verses.RVR09: Cómo entró en la casa de Dios, y tomó los panes de la proposición, y comió, y dió también á los que estaban con él, los cuales no era lícito comer, sino á solos los sacerdotes?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, The Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia-lhes: O Filho do homem é Senhor até do sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y les decía: El Hijo del hombre es Señor aun del sábado.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.WEB: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu também em outro sábado que entrou na sinagoga, e estava ensinado; e ali estava um homem que tinha a mão direita definhada.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció también en otro sábado, que él entró en la sinagoga y enseñaba; y estaba allí un hombre que tenía la mano derecha seca.

verses.KJV: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.WEB: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.ASV: And the scribes and the Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find how to accuse him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os escribas e fariseus o observavam, se o curaria no sábado; para acharem de que o acusar.
verses.RVR09: Y le acechaban los escribas y los Fariseos, si sanaría en sábado, por hallar de qué le acusasen.

verses.KJV: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.WEB: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
verses.ASV: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man that had his hand withered, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele bem sabia dos seus pensamentos; e disse ao homem que tinha a mão definhada: Levanta-te, e põe-te em pé no meio. E ele se levantou e se pôs de pé.
verses.RVR09: Mas él sabía los pensamientos de ellos; y dijo al hombre que tenía la mano seca: Levántate, y ponte en medio. Y él levantándose, se puso en pie.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, I ask you, Is it lawful on the sabbath to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to destroy it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhes disse: Uma coisa vos perguntarei: É lícito nos sábados fazer bem, ou fazer mal? Salvar uma pessoa, ou matá-la?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dice: Os preguntaré una cosa: ¿Es lícito en sábados hacer bien, ó hacer mal? ¿salvar la vida, ó quitarla?

verses.KJV: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.WEB: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
verses.ASV: And he looked round about on them all, and said unto him, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did [so]: and his hand was restored.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, olhando para todos em redor, disse ao homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele assim o fez; e a mão foi lhe restituída sã como a outra.
verses.RVR09: Y mirándolos á todos alrededor, dice al hombre: Extiende tu mano. Y él lo hizo así, y su mano fué restaurada.

verses.KJV: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.WEB: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
verses.ASV: But they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então encheram-se de ira; e conversaram uns com os outros [sobre] o que fariam a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos se llenaron de rabia; y hablaban los unos á los otros qué harían á Jesús.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.WEB: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in these days, that he went out into the mountain to pray; and he continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que naqueles dias ele foi ao monte para orar; e passou a noite orando a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en aquellos días, que fué al monte á orar, y pasó la noche orando á Dios.

verses.KJV: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.WEB: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
verses.ASV: And when it was day, he called his disciples; and he chose from them twelve, whom also he named apostles:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando já era dia, chamou a si os seus discípulos, e escolheu doze deles, a quem também chamou de apóstolos:
verses.RVR09: Y como fué de día, llamó á sus discípulos, y escogió doce de ellos, á los cuales también llamó apóstoles:

verses.KJV: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.WEB: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
verses.ASV: Simon, whom he also named Peter, and Andrew his brother, and James and John, and Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão, a quem também chamou de Pedro, e seu irmão André; Tiago, e João; Filipe, e Bartolomeu.
verses.RVR09: A Simón, al cual también llamó Pedro, y á Andrés su hermano, Jacobo y Juan, Felipe y Bartolomé,

verses.KJV: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.WEB: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;
verses.ASV: and Matthew and Thomas, and James [the son] of Alphæus, and Simon who was called the Zealot,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mateus, Tomé; Tiago [filho] de Alfeu, e Simão chamado “o Zelote”.
verses.RVR09: Mateo y Tomás, Jacobo hijo de Alfeo, y Simón el que se llama Celador,

verses.KJV: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.WEB: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
verses.ASV: and Judas [the son] of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor;
verses.ALMEIDA: Judas de Tiago, e Judas Iscariotes, o mesmo que foi o traidor.
verses.RVR09: Judas hermano de Jacobo, y Judas Iscariote, que también fué el traidor.

verses.KJV: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.WEB: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
verses.ASV: and he came down with them, and stood on a level place, and a great multitude of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judæa and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele desceu com eles, parou num lugar plano, e também [com ele] uma grande quantidade dos seus discípulos, e grande multidão do povo de toda a Judeia, de Jerusalém, da costa marítima de Tiro, e de Sidom,
verses.RVR09: Y descendió con ellos, y se paró en un lugar llano, y la compañía de sus discípulos, y una grande multitud de pueblo de toda Judea y de Jerusalem, y de la costa de Tiro y de Sidón, que habían venido á oirle, y para ser sanados de sus enfermedades;

verses.KJV: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.WEB: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
verses.ASV: and they that were troubled with unclean spirits were healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: que tinham vindo para o ouvir, e para serem curados das suas enfermidades, como também os atormentados por espíritos imundos; e foram curados.
verses.RVR09: Y los que habían sido atormentados de espíritus inmundos: y estaban curados.

verses.KJV: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.WEB: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
verses.ASV: And all the multitude sought to touch him; for power came forth from him, and healed [them] all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a multidão procurava tocá-lo; porque dele saía poder, e curava a todos.
verses.RVR09: Y toda la gente procuraba tocarle; porque salía de él virtud, y sanaba á todos.

verses.KJV: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
verses.ASV: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed [are] ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele levantou os olhos aos seus discípulos, e disse: Benditos sois vós, os pobres, porque o Reino de Deus é vosso.
verses.RVR09: Y alzando él los ojos á sus discípulos, decía: Bienaventurados vosotros los pobres; porque vuestro es el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.WEB: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
verses.ASV: Blessed [are] ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed [are] ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos sois vós que agora tendes fome, porque sereis saciados. Benditos sois vós que agora chorais, porque rireis.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que ahora tenéis hambre; porque seréis saciados. Bienaventurados los que ahora lloráis, porque reiréis.

verses.KJV: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.WEB: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
verses.ASV: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you [from their company], and reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos sereis quando as pessoas vos odiarem, quando vos separarem, vos insultarem, e rejeitarem o vosso nome como mau, por causa do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados seréis, cuando los hombres os aborrecieren, y cuando os apartaren de sí, y os denostaren, y desecharen vuestro nombre como malo, por el Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.WEB: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
verses.ASV: Rejoice in that day, and leap [for joy]: for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for in the same manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contentai-vos nesse dia, e saltai de alegria, porque eis que grande é a vossa recompensa nos céus; pois assim os pais deles faziam aos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Gozaos en aquel día, y alegraos; porque he aquí vuestro galardón es grande en los cielos; porque así hacían sus padres á los profetas.

verses.KJV: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.WEB: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
verses.ASV: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ai de vós, ricos, porque já tendes a vossa consolação.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de vosotros, ricos! porque tenéis vuestro consuelo.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.WEB: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
verses.ASV: Woe unto you, ye that are full now! for ye shall hunger. Woe [unto you], ye that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós que estais saciados, porque tereis fome. Ai de vós que agora rides, porque lamentareis, e chorareis.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, los que estáis hartos! porque tendréis hambre. ¡Ay de vosotros, los que ahora reís! porque lamentaréis y lloraréis.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.WEB: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
verses.ASV: Woe [unto you], when all men shall speak well of you! for in the same manner did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós quando todas as pessoas falarem bem de vós; porque assim os pais deles faziam aos falsos profetas.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, cuando todos los hombres dijeren bien de vosotros! porque así hacían sus padres á los falsos profetas.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.WEB: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.ASV: But I say unto you that hear, Love your enemies, do good to them that hate you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a vós, que estais ouvindo, digo: amai os vossos inimigos; fazei bem aos que vos odeiam;
verses.RVR09: Mas á vosotros los que oís, digo: Amad á vuestros enemigos, haced bien á los que os aborrecen;

verses.KJV: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.WEB: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
verses.ASV: bless them that curse you, pray for them that despitefully use you.
verses.ALMEIDA: bendizei aos que vos maldizem, e orai pelos que vos maltratam.
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á los que os maldicen, y orad por los que os calumnian.

verses.KJV: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.WEB: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
verses.ASV: To him that smiteth thee on the [one] cheek offer also the other; and from him that taketh away thy cloak withhold not thy coat also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que te ferir numa face, oferece-lhe também a outra; e ao que te tirar a capa, não recuses a túnica.
verses.RVR09: Y al que te hiriere en la mejilla, dale también la otra; y al que te quitare la capa, ni aun el sayo le defiendas.

verses.KJV: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.WEB: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
verses.ASV: Give to every one that asketh thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá a quem te pedir; e ao que te tomar o [que é] teu, não o peças de volta.
verses.RVR09: Y á cualquiera que te pidiere, da; y al que tomare lo que es tuyo, no vuelvas á pedir.

verses.KJV: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.WEB: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
verses.ASV: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como vós quereis que as pessoas vos façam, fazei-lhes vós também da mesma maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y como queréis que os hagan los hombres, así hacedles también vosotros:

verses.KJV: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.WEB: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.ASV: And if ye love them that love you, what thank have ye? for even sinners love those that love them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se amardes aos que vos amam, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores amam os que os amam.
verses.RVR09: Porque si amáis á los que os aman, ¿qué gracias tendréis? porque también los pecadores aman á los que los aman.

verses.KJV: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.WEB: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
verses.ASV: And if ye do good to them that do good to you, what thank have ye? for even sinners do the same.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se fizerdes bem aos que vos fazem bem, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores fazem o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y si hiciereis bien á los que os hacen bien, ¿qué gracias tendréis? porque también los pecadores hacen lo mismo.

verses.KJV: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.WEB: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
verses.ASV: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? even sinners lend to sinners, to receive again as much.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se emprestardes àqueles de quem esperais receber de volta, que mérito tereis? Pois também os pecadores emprestam aos pecadores, para receberam de volta o tanto equivalente.
verses.RVR09: Y si prestareis á aquellos de quienes esperáis recibir, ¿qué gracias tendréis? porque también los pecadores prestan á los pecadores, para recibir otro tanto.

verses.KJV: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.WEB: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
verses.ASV: But love your enemies, and do [them] good, and lend, never despairing; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be sons of the Most High: for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, amai aos vossos inimigos, fazei o bem, e emprestai, sem nada esperar disso; e grande será a vossa recompensa, e sereis filhos do Altíssimo; porque é benigno [até] para com os ingratos e maus.
verses.RVR09: Amad, pues, á vuestros enemigos, y haced bien, y prestad, no esperando de ello nada; y será vuestro galardón grande, y seréis hijos del Altísimo: porque él es benigno para con los ingratos y malos.

verses.KJV: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.WEB: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
verses.ASV: Be ye merciful, even as your Father is merciful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sede misericordiosos, como também o vosso Pai é misericordioso.
verses.RVR09: Sed pues misericordiosos, como también vuestro Padre es misericordioso.

verses.KJV: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.WEB: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
verses.ASV: And judge not, and ye shall not be judged: and condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: release, and ye shall be released:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não julgueis, e não sereis julgados; não condeneis, e não sereis condenados; liberai, e vos liberarão.
verses.RVR09: No juzguéis, y no seréis juzgados: no condenéis, y no seréis condenados: perdonad, y seréis perdonados.

verses.KJV: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.WEB: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
verses.ASV: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai, e será vos dado; medida boa, comprimida, sacudida e transbordante vos darão no vosso colo; pois com a mesma medida que medirdes vos medirão de volta.
verses.RVR09: Dad, y se os dará; medida buena, apretada, remecida, y rebosando darán en vuestro seno: porque con la misma medida que midiereis, os será vuelto á medir.

verses.KJV: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.WEB: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
verses.ASV: And he spake also a parable unto them, Can the blind guide the blind? shall they not both fall into a pit?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhesuma parábola: Acaso pode o cego guiar [outro] cego? Não cairão ambos no buraco?
verses.RVR09: Y les decía una parábola: ¿Puede el ciego guiar al ciego? ¿No caerán ambos en el hoyo?

verses.KJV: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.WEB: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
verses.ASV: The disciple is not above his teacher: but every one when he is perfected shall be as his teacher.
verses.ALMEIDA: O discípulo não está acima do seu mestre; mas todo aquele que estiver completamente capacitado será como o seu mestre.
verses.RVR09: El discípulo no es sobre su maestro; mas cualquiera que fuere como el maestro, será perfecto.

verses.KJV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.WEB: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.ASV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que tu prestas atenção no cisco que está no olho do teu irmão, e não enxergas a trave que está no teu próprio olho?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué miras la paja que está en el ojo de tu hermano, y la viga que está en tu propio ojo no consideras?

verses.KJV: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.WEB: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.ASV: Or how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me cast out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou como podes dizer a teu irmão: “Irmão, deixa-me tirar o cisco que está no teu olho”, se tu mesmo não prestas atenção na trave que está no teu olho? Hipócrita, tira primeiro a trave de teu olho, e então verás bem para tirar o cisco que está no olho do teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: ¿O cómo puedes decir á tu hermano: Hermano, deja, echaré fuera la paja que está en tu ojo, no mirando tú la viga que está en tu ojo? Hipócrita, echa primero fuera de tu ojo la viga, y entonces verás bien para sacar la paja que está en el ojo de tu hermano.

verses.KJV: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.WEB: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
verses.ASV: For there is no good tree that bringeth forth corrupt fruit; nor again a corrupt tree that bringeth forth good fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não há boa árvore que dê mau fruto, nem árvore má que dê bom fruto.
verses.RVR09: Porque no es buen árbol el que da malos frutos; ni árbol malo el que da buen fruto.

verses.KJV: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.WEB: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
verses.ASV: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cada árvore se conhece pelo seu próprio fruto; pois não se colhem figos dos espinheiros, nem se tiram uvas dos cardos.
verses.RVR09: Porque cada árbol por su fruto es conocido: que no cogen higos de los espinos, ni vendimian uvas de las zarzas.

verses.KJV: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.WEB: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
verses.ASV: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and the evil [man] out of the evil [treasure] bringeth forth that which is evil: for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boa pessoa tira o bem do bom tesouro do seu coração, e a pessoa má tira o mal do mau tesouro do seu coração; pois a sua boca fala daquilo que o coração tem em abundância.
verses.RVR09: El buen hombre del buen tesoro de su corazón saca bien; y el mal hombre del mal tesoro de su corazón saca mal; porque de la abundancia del corazón habla su boca.

verses.KJV: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.WEB: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
verses.ASV: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que me chamais: “Senhor!”, “Senhor!”, e não fazeis o que eu digo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué me llamáis, Señor, Señor, y no hacéis lo que digo?

verses.KJV: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.WEB: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
verses.ASV: Every one that cometh unto me, and heareth my words, and doeth them, I will show you to whom he is like:
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que vem a mim, ouve as minhas palavras, e as pratica, eu vos mostrarei a quem é semelhante:
verses.RVR09: Todo aquel que viene á mí, y oye mis palabras, y las hace, os enseñaré á quién es semejante:

verses.KJV: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.WEB: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
verses.ASV: he is like a man building a house, who digged and went deep, and laid a foundation upon the rock: and when a flood arose, the stream brake against that house, and could not shake it: because it had been well builded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhante é ao homem que construiu uma casa, cavou, abriu bem fundo, e pôs o fundamento sobre a rocha; e quando veio a enchente, a corrente bateu com ímpeto naquela casa, e não a pôde abalar, porque estava fundada sobre a rocha.
verses.RVR09: Semejante es al hombre que edifica una casa, el cual cavó y ahondó, y puso el fundamento sobre la peña; y cuando vino una avenida, el río dió con ímpetu en aquella casa, mas no la pudo menear: porque estaba fundada sobre la peña.

verses.KJV: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.WEB: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
verses.ASV: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that built a house upon the earth without a foundation; against which the stream brake, and straightway it fell in; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que ouve e não pratica é semelhante ao homem que construiu uma casa sobre a terra, sem fundamento, na qual a corrente bateu com ímpeto, e logo caiu; e foi grande a queda daquela casa.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que oyó y no hizo, semejante es al hombre que edificó su casa sobre tierra, sin fundamento; en la cual el río dió con ímpetu, y luego cayó; y fué grande la ruina de aquella casa.

verses.KJV: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.WEB: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.ASV: After he had ended all his sayings in the ears of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de acabar todos os seus discursos aos ouvidos do povo, ele entrou em Cafarnaum.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO acabó todas sus palabras oyéndole el pueblo, entró en Capernaum.

verses.KJV: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.WEB: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
verses.ASV: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick and at the point of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o servo de um certo centurião, a quem muito estimava, que estava doente, e a ponto de morrer.
verses.RVR09: Y el siervo de un centurión, al cual tenía él en estima, estaba enfermo y á punto de morir.

verses.KJV: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.WEB: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
verses.ASV: And when he heard concerning Jesus, he sent unto him elders of the Jews, asking him that he would come and save his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando [o centurião] ouviu falar sobre Jesus, enviou-lhe uns anciãos dos judeus, rogando-lhe que viesse curar o seu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y como oyó hablar de Jesús, envió á él los ancianos de los Judíos, rogándole que viniese y librase á su siervo.

verses.KJV: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.WEB: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
verses.ASV: And they, when they came to Jesus, besought him earnestly, saying, He is worthy that thou shouldest do this for him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles vieram a Jesus, e rogaram-lhe com urgência, dizendo: Ele é digno de lhe concederes isto,
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo ellos á Jesús, rogáronle con diligencia, diciéndole: Porque es digno de concederle esto;

verses.KJV: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.WEB: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
verses.ASV: for he loveth our nation, and himself built us our synagogue.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque ele ama a nossa nação, e ele mesmo construiu a nossa sinagoga.
verses.RVR09: Que ama nuestra nación, y él nos edificó una sinagoga.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.WEB: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself; for I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus foi com eles; mas quando já não estava longe da casa, o centurião enviou-lhe uns amigos, dizendo-lhe: “Senhor, não te incomodes, porque não sou digno que entres abaixo do meu telhado.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús fué con ellos. Mas como ya no estuviesen lejos de su casa, envió el centurión amigos á él, diciéndole: Señor, no te incomodes, que no soy digno que entres debajo de mi tejado;

verses.KJV: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.WEB: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.ASV: wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que nem mesmo me considerei digno de vir a ti; mas diz uma palavra, e o meu servo sarará.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual ni aun me tuve por digno de venir á ti; mas di la palabra, y mi siervo será sano.

verses.KJV: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.WEB: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.ASV: For I also am a man set under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também eu sou homem subordinado à autoridade, e tenho soldados sob o meu comando, e digo a este: 'Vai', e ele vai; e a outro: 'Vem', e ele vem; e a meu servo: 'Faz isto', e ele faz”.
verses.RVR09: Porque también yo soy hombre puesto en potestad, que tengo debajo de mí soldados; y digo á éste: Ve, y va; y al otro: Ven, y viene; y á mi siervo: Haz esto, y lo hace.

verses.KJV: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.WEB: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned and said unto the multitude that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus ouviu isso, admirou-se dele; então se virou, e disse à multidão que o seguia: Digo-vos que nem mesmo em Israel achei tanta fé.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual oyendo Jesús, se maravilló de él, y vuelto, dijo á las gentes que le seguían: Os digo que ni aun en Israel he hallado tanta fe.

verses.KJV: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.WEB: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
verses.ASV: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os que foram enviados voltaram para casa, acharam com boa saúde o servo antes doente.
verses.RVR09: Y vueltos á casa los que habían sido enviados, hallaron sano al siervo que había estado enfermo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.WEB: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no dia seguinte, que [Jesus] ia a uma cidade chamada Naim, e com ele iam muitos de seus discípulos e uma grande multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció después, que él iba á la ciudad que se llama Naín, é iban con él muchos de sus discípulos, y gran compañía.

verses.KJV: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.WEB: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
verses.ASV: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, there was carried out one that was dead, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegou perto da porta da cidade, eis que levavam um defunto, filho único de sua mãe, que [era] viúva; e com ela [ia] grande multidão da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegó cerca de la puerta de la ciudad, he aquí que sacaban fuera á un difunto, unigénito de su madre, la cual también era viuda: y había con ella grande compañía de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.WEB: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
verses.ASV: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o Senhor a viu, comoveu-se de intima compaixão por ela, e disse-lhe: Não chores.
verses.RVR09: Y como el Señor la vió, compadecióse de ella, y le dice: No llores.

verses.KJV: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.WEB: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
verses.ASV: And he came nigh and touched the bier: and the bearers stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se aproximou, tocou o caixão (e os que a levavam, pararam), e disse: Jovem, a ti eu digo: levanta-te.
verses.RVR09: Y acercándose, tocó el féretro: y los que lo llevaban, pararon. Y dice: Mancebo, á ti digo, levántate.

verses.KJV: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.WEB: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
verses.ASV: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o defunto se sentou e começou a falar; e ele o entregou à sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se incorporó el que había muerto, y comenzó á hablar. Y dióle á su madre.

verses.KJV: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.WEB: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
verses.ASV: And fear took hold on all: and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet is arisen among us: and, God hath visited his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos se encheram de temor, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: “Um grande profeta se levantou entre nós, e Deus visitou o seu povo!”
verses.RVR09: Y todos tuvieron miedo, y glorificaban á Dios, diciendo: Que un gran profeta se ha levantado entre nosotros; y que Dios ha visitado á su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.WEB: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
verses.ASV: And this report went forth concerning him in the whole of Judæa, and all the region round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E essa sua fama correu por toda a Judeia, e por toda a região em redor.
verses.RVR09: Y salió esta fama de él por toda Judea, y por toda la tierra de alrededor.

verses.KJV: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.WEB: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
verses.ASV: And the disciples of John told him of all these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os discípulos de João lhe anunciaram essas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y sus discípulos dieron á Juan las nuevas de todas estas cosas: y llamó Juan á dos de sus discípulos,

verses.KJV: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.WEB: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
verses.ASV: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to the Lord, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então João chamou dois de seus discípulos, e os enviou a Jesus, dizendo: “És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?”
verses.RVR09: Y envió á Jesús, diciendo: ¿Eres tú aquél que había de venir, ó esperaremos á otro?

verses.KJV: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.WEB: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
verses.ASV: And when the men were come unto him, they said, John the Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando aqueles homens vieram a ele, disseram: “João Batista nos enviou a ti, dizendo: 'És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?'”
verses.RVR09: Y como los hombres vinieron á él, dijeron: Juan el Bautista nos ha enviado á ti, diciendo: ¿Eres tú aquél que había de venir, ó esperaremos á otro?

verses.KJV: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.WEB: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
verses.ASV: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and on many that were blind he bestowed sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquela mesma hora ele curou a muitos de enfermidades, males, e espíritos maus, e a deu vista a muitos cegos.
verses.RVR09: Y en la misma hora sanó á muchos de enfermedades y plagas, y de espíritus malos; y á muchos ciegos dió la vista.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye have seen and heard; the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, the poor have good tidings preached to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Ide, e anunciai a João as coisas que tendes visto e ouvido: que os cegos veem, os mancos andam, os leprosos são purificados, os surdos ouvem, os mortos ressuscitam, e aos pobres é anunciado o Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Id, dad las nuevas á Juan de lo que habéis visto y oído: que los ciegos ven, los cojos andan, los leprosos son limpiados, los sordos oyen, los muertos resucitan, á los pobres es anunciado el evangelio:

verses.KJV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.WEB: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
verses.ASV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bendito é aquele que não se ofender em mim.
verses.RVR09: Y bienaventurado es el que no fuere escandalizado en mí.

verses.KJV: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.WEB: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.ASV: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os mensageiros de João se foram, [Jesus] começou a dizer às multidões acerca de João: Que saístes para ver no deserto? Alguma cana sacudida pelo vento?
verses.RVR09: Y como se fueron los mensajeros de Juan, comenzó á hablar de Juan á las gentes: ¿Qué salisteis á ver al desierto? ¿una caña que es agitada por el viento?

verses.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.WEB: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
verses.ASV: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they that are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que saístes para ver? Um homem vestido de roupas delicadas? Eis que os que [vestem] roupas delicadas e vivem no luxo estão nos palácios reais.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué salisteis á ver? ¿un hombre cubierto de vestidos delicados? He aquí, los que están en vestido precioso, y viven en delicias, en los palacios de los reyes están.

verses.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.WEB: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.ASV: But what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que saístes para ver? Um profeta? Sim, vos digo, e muito mais que profeta.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué salisteis á ver? ¿un profeta? También os digo, y aun más que profeta.

verses.KJV: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.WEB: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
verses.ASV: This is he of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele de quem está escrito: Eis que envio o meu mensageiro adiante de tua face, o qual preparará o teu caminho diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Este es de quien está escrito: He aquí, envío mi mensajero delante de tu faz, el cual aparejará tu camino delante de ti.

verses.KJV: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.WEB: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
verses.ASV: I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there is none greater than John: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu vos digo, que dentre os nascidos de mulheres, não há profeta maior que João, o Batista; mas o menor no reino dos céus é maior que ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque os digo que entre los nacidos de mujeres, no hay mayor profeta que Juan el Bautista: mas el más pequeño en el reino de los cielos es mayor que él.

verses.KJV: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.WEB: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
verses.ASV: And all the people when they heard, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo e os publicanos ouviram, concordaram que Deus era justo, e foram batizados com o batismo de João.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo oyéndole, y los publicanos, justificaron á Dios, bautizándose con el bautismo de Juan.

verses.KJV: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.WEB: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
verses.ASV: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected for themselves the counsel of God, being not baptized of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os fariseus e os estudiosos da Lei rejeitaram o conselho de Deus contra si mesmos, e não foram batizados por ele.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Fariseos y los sabios de la ley, desecharon el consejo de Dios contra sí mismos, no siendo bautizados de él.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.WEB: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
verses.ASV: Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation, and to what are they like?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor disse: “A quem, pois, compararei as pessoas desta geração? E a quem são semelhantes?
verses.RVR09: Y dice el Señor: ¿A quién, pues, compararé los hombres de esta generación, y á qué son semejantes?

verses.KJV: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.WEB: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
verses.ASV: They are like unto children that sit in the marketplace, and call one to another; who say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not weep.
verses.ALMEIDA: São semelhantes às crianças sentadas na praça, que gritam umas às outras: 'Nós vos tocamos flautas, mas não dançastes; nós vos cantamos lamentações, mas não chorastes'.
verses.RVR09: Semejantes son á los muchachos sentados en la plaza, y que dan voces los unos á los otros, y dicen: Os tañimos con flautas, y no bailasteis: os endechamos, y no llorasteis.

verses.KJV: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.WEB: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.ASV: For John the Baptist is come eating no bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a demon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque veio João Batista, que não comia pão, nem bebia vinho, e dizeis: 'Ele tem demônio';
verses.RVR09: Porque vino Juan el Bautista, que ni comía pan, ni bebía vino, y decís: Demonio tiene.

verses.KJV: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.WEB: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
verses.ASV: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold, a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio o Filho do homem, que come e bebe, e dizeis: 'Eis um homem comilão e bebedor de vinho, amigo dos publicanos e dos pecadores'.
verses.RVR09: Vino el Hijo del hombre, que come y bebe, y decís: He aquí un hombre comilón, y bebedor de vino, amigo de publicanos y de pecadores.

verses.KJV: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
verses.ASV: And wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a sabedoria foi considerada justa por todos os seus filhos”.
verses.RVR09: Mas la sabiduría es justificada de todos sus hijos.

verses.KJV: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.WEB: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
verses.ASV: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos fariseus lhe pediu que comesse com ele; então entrou na casa do fariseu, e sentou-se [à mesa] .
verses.RVR09: Y le rogó uno de los Fariseos, que comiese con él. Y entrado en casa del Fariseo, sentóse á la mesa.

verses.KJV: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.WEB: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
verses.ASV: And behold, a woman who was in the city, a sinner; and when she knew that he was sitting at meat in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster cruse of ointment,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uma mulher da cidade, que era pecadora, quando soube que ele estava na casa do fariseu, trouxe um vaso de alabastro de óleo perfumado.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí una mujer que había sido pecadora en la ciudad, como entendió que estaba á la mesa en casa de aquel Fariseo, trajo un alabastro de ungüento,

verses.KJV: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.WEB: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.ASV: and standing behind at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando atrás, aos seus pés, chorando, começou a molhar-lhe os pés com lágrimas; e os enxugava com os cabelos da sua cabeça; e beijava-lhe os pés, e os ungia com o óleo perfumado.
verses.RVR09: Y estando detrás á sus pies, comenzó llorando á regar con lágrimas sus pies, y los limpiaba con los cabellos de su cabeza; y besaba sus pies, y los ungía con el ungüento.

verses.KJV: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.WEB: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
verses.ASV: Now when the Pharisee that had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him, that she is a sinner.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o fariseu que o havia convidado viu [isso] , falou consigo mesmo: Se ele fosse profeta, saberia quem e qual é a mulher que o toca; porque ela é pecadora.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió esto el Fariseo que le había convidado, habló entre sí, diciendo: Este, si fuera profeta, conocería quién y cuál es la mujer que le toca, que es pecadora.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Teacher, say on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe respondeu: “Simão, tenho uma coisa a te dizer”; e ele disse: “Dize-a, Mestre”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Jesús, le dijo: Simón, una cosa tengo que decirte. Y él dice: Di, Maestro.
