verses.KJV: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.WEB: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.ASV: A certain lender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred shillings, and the other fifty.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] disse: “Certo credor tinha dois devedores. Um lhe devia quinhentas moedas de prata, e o outro cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Un acreedor tenía dos deudores: el uno le debía quinientos denarios, y el otro cincuenta;

verses.KJV: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.WEB: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
verses.ASV: When they had not [wherewith] to pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como não tinham com que pagar, perdoou-lhes [a dívida] de ambos. Dize, pois, qual deles o amará mais?”
verses.RVR09: Y no teniendo ellos de qué pagar, perdonó á ambos. Di, pues, ¿cuál de éstos le amará más?

verses.KJV: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.WEB: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
verses.ASV: Simon answered and said, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão respondeu: Tenho para mim que aquele a quem mais perdoou. E ele lhe disse: Julgaste corretamente.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Simón, dijo: Pienso que aquél al cual perdonó más. Y él le dijo: Rectamente has juzgado.

verses.KJV: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.WEB: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
verses.ASV: And turning to the woman, he said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath wetted my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se voltou à mulher, e disse a Simão: Vês tu esta mulher? Entrei na tua casa, e não me deste água para os pés; porém esta molhou os meus pés com lágrimas, e os enxugou com os seus cabelos da cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y vuelto á la mujer, dijo á Simón: ¿Ves esta mujer? Entré en tu casa, no diste agua para mis pies; mas ésta ha regado mis pies con lágrimas, y los ha limpiado con los cabellos.

verses.KJV: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.WEB: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.ASV: Thou gavest me no kiss: but she, since the time I came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu não me beijaste; porém esta, desde que entrou, não parou de me beijar os pés.
verses.RVR09: No me diste beso, mas ésta, desde que entré, no ha cesado de besar mis pies.

verses.KJV: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.WEB: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.ASV: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but she hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não ungiste a minha cabeça com óleo, porém esta ungiu os meus pés com óleo perfumado.
verses.RVR09: No ungiste mi cabeza con óleo; mas ésta ha ungido con ungüento mis pies.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.WEB: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, [the same] loveth little.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso te digo, os muitos pecados dela são perdoados, porque muito amou; mas ao que pouco se perdoa, pouco ama.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual te digo que sus muchos pecados son perdonados, porque amó mucho; mas al que se perdona poco, poco ama.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a ela: Os teus pecados são perdoados.
verses.RVR09: Y á ella dijo: Los pecados te son perdonados.

verses.KJV: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.WEB: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
verses.ASV: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that even forgiveth sins?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estavam sentados começaram a dizer entre si: Quem é este, que até perdoa pecados?
verses.RVR09: Y los que estaban juntamente sentados á la mesa, comenzaron á decir entre sí: ¿Quién es éste, que también perdona pecados?

verses.KJV: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.WEB: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse à mulher: A tua fé te salvou; vai em paz.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á la mujer: Tu fe te ha salvado, ve en paz.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
verses.WEB: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good tidings of the kingdom of God, and with him the twelve,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu depois disso, que [Jesus] andava de cidade em cidade, e de aldeia em aldeia, pregando e anunciando o evangelho do reino de Deus; e com ele os doze,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ después, que él caminaba por todas las ciudades y aldeas, predicando y anunciando el evangelio del reino de Dios, y los doce con él,

verses.KJV: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.WEB: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
verses.ASV: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary that was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
verses.ALMEIDA: e algumas mulheres que haviam sido curadas de espíritos malignos e de enfermidades: Maria, chamada Madalena, da qual saíram sete demônios;
verses.RVR09: Y algunas mujeres que habían sido curadas de malos espíritus y de enfermedades: María, que se llamaba Magdalena, de la cual habían salido siete demonios,

verses.KJV: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.WEB: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
verses.ASV: and Joanna the wife of Chuzas Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered unto them of their substance.
verses.ALMEIDA: e Joana, a mulher de Cuza, mordomo de Herodes; e Susana, e muitas outras, que o serviam com seus bens.
verses.RVR09: Y Juana, mujer de Chuza, procurador de Herodes, y Susana, y otras muchas que le servían de sus haciendas.

verses.KJV: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.WEB: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:
verses.ASV: And when a great multitude came together, and they of every city resorted unto him, he spake by a parable:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se ajuntou uma multidão, e vindo a ele de todas as cidades, disse por parábola:
verses.RVR09: Y como se juntó una grande compañía, y los que estaban en cada ciudad vinieron á él, dijo por una parábola:

verses.KJV: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.WEB: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
verses.ASV: The sower went forth to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden under foot, and the birds of the heaven devoured it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiu um semeador a semear sua semente; e quando semeava, caiu uma [parte] junto ao caminho, e foi pisada, e as aves do céu a comeram.
verses.RVR09: Uno que sembraba, salió á sembrar su simiente; y sembrando, una parte cayó junto al camino, y fué hollada; y las aves del cielo la comieron.

verses.KJV: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.WEB: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
verses.ASV: And other fell on the rock; and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu sobre a pedra; e nascida, secou-se, porque não tinha umidade.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó sobre la piedra; y nacida, se secó, porque no tenía humedad.

verses.KJV: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.WEB: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
verses.ASV: And other fell amidst the thorns; and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu entre espinhos, e nascendo com ela, os espinhos a sufocaram.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó entre las espinas; y naciendo las espinas juntamente, la ahogaron.

verses.KJV: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.WEB: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
verses.ASV: And other fell into the good ground, and grew, and brought forth fruit a hundredfold. As he said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra [parte] caiu em boa terra, e nascida, produziu fruto a cem por um. Depois que disse coisas, exclamava: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.RVR09: Y otra parte cayó en buena tierra, y cuando fué nacida, llevó fruto á ciento por uno. Diciendo estas cosas clamaba: El que tiene oídos para oir, oiga.

verses.KJV: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.WEB: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
verses.ASV: And his disciples asked him what this parable might be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os seus discípulos lhe perguntaram: Que parábola é esta?
verses.RVR09: Y sus discípulos le preguntaron, diciendo, qué era esta parábola.

verses.KJV: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.WEB: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
verses.ASV: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to the rest in parables; that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele disse: A vós é dado conhecer os mistérios do reino de Deus; mas aos outros por parábolas, para que vendo, não vejam; e ouvindo, não entendam.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: A vosotros es dado conocer los misterios del reino de Dios; mas á los otros por parábolas, para que viendo no vean, y oyendo no entiendan.

verses.KJV: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.WEB: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.ASV: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é, pois, a parábola: a semente é a palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Es pues ésta la parábola: La simiente es la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.WEB: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
verses.ASV: And those by the way side are they that have heard; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que estão junto ao caminho são os que ouvem; depois vem o diabo, e tira-lhes do coração a palavra, para que não creiam nem se salvem.
verses.RVR09: Y los de junto al camino, éstos son los que oyen; y luego viene el diablo, y quita la palabra de su corazón, porque no crean y se salven.

verses.KJV: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.WEB: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
verses.ASV: And those on the rock [are] they who, when they have heard, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estão sobre a pedra são os que, quando ouvem, recebem a palavra com alegria, mas esses não têm raiz, pois creem por algum tempo, mas no tempo da tentação se desviam.
verses.RVR09: Y los de sobre la piedra, son los que habiendo oído, reciben la palabra con gozo; mas éstos no tienen raíces; que á tiempo creen, y en el tiempo de la tentación se apartan.

verses.KJV: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.WEB: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
verses.ASV: And that which fell among the thorns, these are they that have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of [this] life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que caiu entre espinhos são os que ouviram, e indo, sufocam-se com as preocupações, e riquezas, e prazeres da vida, e não produzem bom fruto.
verses.RVR09: Y la que cayó entre las espinas, éstos son los que oyeron; mas yéndose, son ahogados de los cuidados y de las riquezas y de los pasatiempos de la vida, y no llevan fruto.

verses.KJV: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.WEB: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
verses.ASV: And that in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it fast, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que caiu em boa terra, estes são os que, ouvindo a palavra, conservam-na num coração honesto e bom, e dão fruto que permanece.
verses.RVR09: Mas la que en buena tierra, éstos son los que con corazón bueno y recto retienen la palabra oída, y llevan fruto en paciencia.

verses.KJV: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.WEB: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
verses.ASV: And no man, when he hath lighted a lamp, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but putteth it on a stand, that they that enter in may see the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém, quando acende uma lâmpada, cobre-a com algum vaso, ou a põe debaixo da cama; em vez disso põe na luminária, para que os que entram vejam a luz.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno que enciende la antorcha la cubre con vasija, ó la pone debajo de la cama; mas la pone en un candelero, para que los que entran vean la luz.

verses.KJV: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.WEB: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
verses.ASV: For nothing is hid, that shall not be made manifest; nor [anything] secret, that shall not be known and come to light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não há coisa oculta que não venha a se manifestar; nem coisa escondida que não venha a ser conhecida, e chegada à luz.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay cosa oculta, que no haya de ser manifestada; ni cosa escondida, que no haya de ser entendida, y de venir á luz.

verses.KJV: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.WEB: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
verses.ASV: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he thinketh he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, prestai atenção a como ouvis; pois àquele que tiver lhe será dado; e àquele que não tiver, até o que lhe parece ter, dele será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Mirad pues cómo oís; porque á cualquiera que tuviere, le será dado; y á cualquiera que no tuviere, aun lo que parece tener le será quitado.

verses.KJV: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.WEB: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
verses.ASV: And there came to him his mother and brethren, and they could not come at him for the crowd.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a ele sua mãe e seus irmãos, mas não conseguiam chegar a ele por causa da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron á él su madre y hermanos; y no podían llegar á él por causa de la multitud.

verses.KJV: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.WEB: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
verses.ASV: And it was told him, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-lhe anunciado, dizendo: “Tua mãe e teus irmãos estão fora, e querem te ver”.
verses.RVR09: Y le fué dado aviso, diciendo: Tu madre y tus hermanos están fuera, que quieren verte.

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.WEB: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
verses.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these that hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, ele lhes respondeu: “Minha mãe e meus irmãos são aqueles que ouvem a palavra de Deus e a praticam”.
verses.RVR09: El entonces respondiendo, les dijo: Mi madre y mis hermanos son los que oyen la palabra de Dios, y la ejecutan.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.WEB: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples; and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake: and they launched forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, num daqueles dias, que [Jesus] entrou em um barco com seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: “Passemos para o outro lado do lago”. E partiram.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció un día que él entró en un barco con sus discípulos, y les dijo: Pasemos á la otra parte del lago. Y partieron.

verses.KJV: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.WEB: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
verses.ASV: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filling [with water], and were in jeopardy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto navegavam, [Jesus] adormeceu; então desceu uma tempestade de vento no lago, e enchiam-se [de água] , e estavam em perigo.
verses.RVR09: Pero mientras ellos navegaban, él se durmió. Y sobrevino una tempestad de viento en el lago; y henchían de agua, y peligraban.

verses.KJV: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.WEB: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.
verses.ASV: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. And he awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se aproximaram dele e o despertaram, dizendo: “Mestre, Mestre, estamos perecendo!” E ele se levantou, repreendeu o vento e as ondas da água; e pararam, e fez-se bonança.
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose á él, le despertaron, diciendo: ¡Maestro, Maestro, que perecemos! Y despertado él, increpó al viento y á la tempestad del agua; y cesaron, y fué hecha bonanza.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And being afraid they marvelled, saying one to another, Who then is this, that he commandeth even the winds and the water, and they obey him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “Onde está a vossa fé?” Mas eles, temendo, admiravam-se, e diziam uns aos outros: “Quem é este, que manda até aos ventos, e à água, e lhe obedecem?”
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: ¿Qué es de vuestra fe? Y atemorizados, se maravillaban, diciendo los unos á los otros: ¿Quién es éste, que aun á los vientos y al agua manda, y le obedecen?

verses.KJV: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.WEB: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
verses.ASV: And they arrived at the country of the Gerasenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E navegaram para a terra dos gadarenos, que é do lado oposto à Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y navegaron á la tierra de los Gadarenos, que está delante de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.WEB: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.
verses.ASV: And when he was come forth upon the land, there met him a certain man out of the city, who had demons; and for a long time he had worn no clothes, and abode not in [any] house, but in the tombs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele desceu à terra, veio da cidade ao seu encontro um homem, que havia muito tempo que tinha demônios, e não andava vestido, nem habitava em casa nenhuma, mas sim, nos sepulcros.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo él á tierra, le vino al encuentro de la ciudad un hombre que tenía demonios ya de mucho tiempo; y no vestía vestido, ni estaba en casa, sino por los sepulcros.

verses.KJV: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.WEB: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”
verses.ASV: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the Most High God? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele viu Jesus, então exclamou, prostrou-se diante dele, e disse com grande voz: “O que eu tenho contigo, Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Rogo-te que não me atormentes.”
verses.RVR09: El cual, como vió á Jesús, exclamó y se postró delante de él, y dijo á gran voz: ¿Qué tengo yo contigo, Jesús, Hijo del Dios Altísimo? Ruégote que no me atormentes.

verses.KJV: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.WEB: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.
verses.ASV: For he was commanding the unclean spirit to come out from the man. For oftentimes it had seized him: and he was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters; and breaking the bands asunder, he was driven of the demon into the deserts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele havia mandado ao espírito imundo que saísse daquele homem; pois muitas vezes apoderava-se dele. E o mantinham preso com cadeias e grilhões; porém ele quebrava o que lhe prendia, e era conduzido pelo demônio aos desertos.
verses.RVR09: (Porque mandaba al espíritu inmundo que saliese del hombre: porque ya de mucho tiempo le arrebataba; y le guardaban preso con cadenas y grillos; mas rompiendo las prisiones, era agitado del demonio por los desiertos.)

verses.KJV: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.WEB: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
verses.ASV: And Jesus asked him, What is thy name? And he said, Legion; for many demons were entered into him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe perguntou: “Qual é teu nome?” E ele disse: “Legião” (porque muitos demônios tinham entrado nele).
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntó Jesús, diciendo: ¿Qué nombre tienes? Y él dijo: Legión. Porque muchos demonios habían entrado en él.

verses.KJV: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.WEB: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.
verses.ASV: And they entreated him that he would not command them to depart into the abyss.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rogavam-lhe que não os mandasse ir para o abismo.
verses.RVR09: Y le rogaban que no les mandase ir al abismo.

verses.KJV: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.WEB: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.
verses.ASV: Now there was there a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they entreated him that he would give them leave to enter into them. And he gave them leave.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia ali uma manada de muitos porcos, que pastavam no monte; e rogaram-lhe que lhes concedesse entrar neles; e ele lhes concedeu.
verses.RVR09: Y había allí un hato de muchos puercos que pacían en el monte; y le rogaron que los dejase entrar en ellos; y los dejó.

verses.KJV: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.WEB: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
verses.ASV: And the demons came out from the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the lake, and were drowned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demônios saíram daquele homem e entraram nos porcos; e a manada se lançou de um precipício no lago e se afogou.
verses.RVR09: Y salidos los demonios del hombre, entraron en los puercos; y el hato se arrojó de un despeñadero en el lago, y ahogóse.

verses.KJV: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.WEB: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.ASV: And when they that fed them saw what had come to pass, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os que cuidavam [dos porcos] viram o que havia acontecido, fugiram; então foram anunciar na cidade e nos campos.
verses.RVR09: Y los pastores, como vieron lo que había acontecido, huyeron, y yendo dieron aviso en la ciudad y por las heredades.

verses.KJV: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.WEB: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verses.ASV: And they went out to see what had come to pass; and they came to Jesus, and found the man, from whom the demons were gone out, sitting, clothed and in his right mind, at the feet of Jesus: and they were afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saíram para ver o acontecido, e vieram até Jesus; e acharam ao homem de quem os demônios tinham saído, vestido e em pleno juízo, sentado aos pés de Jesus; e temeram.
verses.RVR09: Y salieron á ver lo que había acontecido; y vinieron á Jesús, y hallaron sentado al hombre de quien habían salido los demonios, vestido, y en su juicio, á los pies de Jesús; y tuvieron miedo.

verses.KJV: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.WEB: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
verses.ASV: And they that saw it told them how he that was possessed with demons was made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que tinham visto contaram-lhes também como aquele endemoninhado havia sido liberto.
verses.RVR09: Y les contaron los que lo habían visto, cómo había sido salvado aquel endemoniado.

verses.KJV: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.WEB: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.
verses.ASV: And all the people of the country of the Gerasenes round about asked him to depart from them; for they were holden with great fear: and he entered into a boat, and returned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda o povo da terra dos gadarenos ao redor lhe rogou que se retirasse deles; porque foram tomados por grande temor. Então ele entrou no barco e voltou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces toda la multitud de la tierra de los Gadarenos alrededor, le rogaron que se fuese de ellos; porque tenían gran temor. Y él, subiendo en el barco, volvióse.

verses.KJV: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.WEB: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.ASV: But the man from whom the demons were gone out prayed him that he might be with him: but he sent him away, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele homem, de quem os demônios tinham saído, rogou-lhe para que lhe permitisse estar com ele; mas Jesus o despediu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y aquel hombre, de quien habían salido los demonios, le rogó para estar con él; mas Jesús le despidió, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.WEB: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.ASV: Return to thy house, and declare how great things God hath done for thee. And he went his way, publishing throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Volta para tua casa, e conta como foram grandes as coisas que Deus te fez”. Ele se foi, e pregou por toda a cidade, como foram grandes as coisas que Jesus lhe tinha feito.
verses.RVR09: Vuélvete á tu casa, y cuenta cuán grandes cosas ha hecho Dios contigo. Y él se fué, publicando por toda la ciudad cuán grandes cosas había hecho Jesús con él.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.WEB: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
verses.ASV: And as Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him; for they were all waiting for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus voltou, a multidão o recebeu; porque todos o estavam esperando.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que volviendo Jesús, recibióle la gente; porque todos le esperaban.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.WEB: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,
verses.ASV: And behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus’ feet, and besought him to come into his house;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que chegou um homem, cujo nome era Jairo, e era chefe da sinagoga. Então ele se prostrou aos pés de Jesus e rogou-lhe que entrasse em sua casa;
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un varón, llamado Jairo, y que era príncipe de la sinagoga, vino, y cayendo á los pies de Jesús, le rogaba que entrase en su casa;

verses.KJV: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.WEB: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.
verses.ASV: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went the multitudes thronged him.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque tinha uma filha única, com doze anos de idade, que estava a ponto de morrer. E enquanto ele ia, as multidões o apertavam.
verses.RVR09: Porque tenía una hija única, como de doce años, y ella se estaba muriendo. Y yendo, le apretaba la compañía.

verses.KJV: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.WEB: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
verses.ASV: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, who had spent all her living upon physicians, and could not be healed of any,
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma mulher que tinha um fluxo de sangue, havia doze anos, e já tinha gastado todos os seus pertences com médicos, e não pôde ser curada por nenhum.
verses.RVR09: Y una mujer, que tenía flujo de sangre hacía ya doce años, la cual había gastado en médicos toda su hacienda, y por ninguno había podido ser curada,

verses.KJV: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.WEB: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
verses.ASV: came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately the issue of her blood stanched.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela se aproximou [de Jesus] por detrás, e tocou a borda de sua roupa; e logo o fluxo de seu sangue parou.
verses.RVR09: Llegándose por las espaldas, tocó el borde de su vestido; y luego se estancó el flujo de su sangre.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.WEB: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said, Who is it that touched me? And when all denied, Peter said, and they that were with him, Master, the multitudes press thee and crush [thee].
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus disse: “Quem me tocou?” Enquanto todos negavam, disse Pedro e os que com ele estavam: Mestre, as multidões te apertam e empurram, e dizes: Quem me tocou?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo: ¿Quién es el que me ha tocado? Y negando todos, dijo Pedro y los que estaban con él: Maestro, la compañía te aprieta y oprime, y dices: ¿Quién es el que me ha tocado?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus said, Some one did touch me; for I perceived that power had gone forth from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus disse: “Alguém me tocou, pois sei que poder saiu de mim”.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús dijo: Me ha tocado alguien; porque yo he conocido que ha salido virtud de mí.

verses.KJV: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.WEB: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.ASV: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people for what cause she touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher, vendo que não podia se esconder, veio tremendo, prostrou-se diante dele, e declarou-lhe diante de todo o povo a causa por que o havia tocado, e como logo havia sarado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, como la mujer vió que no se había ocultado, vino temblando, y postrándose delante de él declaróle delante de todo el pueblo la causa por qué le había tocado, y cómo luego había sido sana.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: “Tem bom ânimo, filha; a tua fé te sarou; vai em paz”.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Hija, tu fe te ha salvado: ve en paz.

verses.KJV: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.WEB: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”
verses.ASV: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s [house], saying, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Teacher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando ele ainda falando, veio um da [casa] do chefe da sinagoga, que lhe disse: “Tua filha já está morta, não incomodes o Mestre.”
verses.RVR09: Estando aún él hablando, vino uno del príncipe de la sinagoga á decirle: Tu hija es muerta, no des trabajo al Maestro.

verses.KJV: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.WEB: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, Fear not: only believe, and she shall be made whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando Jesus o ouviu, respondeu-lhe: “Não temas; crê somente, e ela será curada”.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Jesús, le respondió: No temas: cree solamente, y será salva.

verses.KJV: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.WEB: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.
verses.ASV: And when he came to the house, he suffered not any man to enter in with him, save Peter, and John, and James, and the father of the maiden and her mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando entrou na casa, a ninguém deixou entrar, a não ser a Pedro, Tiago, João, e ao pai e à mãe da menina.
verses.RVR09: Y entrado en casa, no dejó entrar á nadie consigo, sino á Pedro, y á Jacobo, y á Juan, y al padre y á la madre de la moza.

verses.KJV: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.WEB: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
verses.ASV: And all were weeping, and bewailing her: but he said, Weep not; for she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos choravam e lamentavam por ela; mas ele disse: “Não choreis; ela não está morta, mas dorme”.
verses.RVR09: Y lloraban todos, y la plañían. Y él dijo: No lloréis; no es muerta, sino que duerme.

verses.KJV: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.WEB: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
verses.ASV: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E riam dele, porque sabiam que estava morta.
verses.RVR09: Y hacían burla de él, sabiendo que estaba muerta.

verses.KJV: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.WEB: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”
verses.ASV: But he, taking her by the hand, called, saying, Maiden, arise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele, depois de expulsá-los todos, segurou a mão dela e clamou: “Levanta-te, menina”.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, tomándola de la mano, clamó, diciendo: Muchacha, levántate.

verses.KJV: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.WEB: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
verses.ASV: And her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately: and he commanded that [something] be given her to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então seu espírito voltou, e ela logo se levantou; e [Jesus] mandou que dessem de comer a ela.
verses.RVR09: Entonces su espíritu volvió, y se levantó luego: y él mandó que le diesen de comer.

verses.KJV: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.WEB: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.
verses.ASV: And her parents were amazed: but he charged them to tell no man what had been done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus pais ficaram maravilhados, mas ele lhes mandou que a ninguém dissessem o que havia acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Y sus padres estaban atónitos; á los cuales él mandó, que á nadie dijesen lo que había sido hecho.

verses.KJV: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.WEB: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
verses.ASV: And he called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Jesus] convocou seus doze discípulos, e lhes deu poder e autoridade sobre todos os demônios, e para curarem enfermidades.
verses.RVR09: Y JUNTANDO á sus doce discípulos, les dió virtud y potestad sobre todos los demonios, y que sanasen enfermedades.

verses.KJV: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.WEB: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
verses.ASV: And he sent them forth to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os enviou para pregar o reino de Deus e para curar os enfermos.
verses.RVR09: Y los envió á que predicasen el reino de Dios, y que sanasen á los enfermos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “Não tomeis nada convosco para o caminho: nem vara, nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro, nem tenhais duas túnicas cada um.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: No toméis nada para el camino, ni báculo, ni alforja, ni pan, ni dinero; ni tengáis dos vestidos cada uno.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.WEB: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
verses.ASV: And into whatsoever house ye enter, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em qualquer casa que entrardes, ficai ali, e dali saí.
verses.RVR09: Y en cualquiera casa en que entrareis, quedad allí, y de allí salid.

verses.KJV: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.WEB: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
verses.ASV: And as many as receive you not, when ye depart from that city, shake off the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todo os que não vos receberem, quando sairdes daquela cidade, sacudi até o pó dos vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles”.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que no os recibieren, saliéndoos de aquella ciudad, aun el polvo sacudid de vuestros pies en testimonio contra ellos.

verses.KJV: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.WEB: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.
verses.ASV: And they departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles partiram, e percorreram todas as aldeias, anunciando o Evangelho, e curando em todos os lugares.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo, rodeaban por todas las aldeas, anunciando el evangelio, y sanando por todas partes.

verses.KJV: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.WEB: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
verses.ASV: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done: and he was much perplexed, because that it was said by some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o tetrarca Herodes ouvia falar todas as coisas que ele fazia; e estava perplexo, porque alguns diziam que João tinha ressuscitado dos mortos;
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Herodes el tetrarca todas las cosas que hacía; y estaba en duda, porque decían algunos: Juan ha resucitado de los muertos;

verses.KJV: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.WEB: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
verses.ASV: and by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.ALMEIDA: e outros, que Elias havia aparecido; e outros, que algum profeta dos antigos havia ressuscitado.
verses.RVR09: Y otros: Elías ha aparecido; y otros: Algún profeta de los antiguos ha resucitado.

verses.KJV: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.WEB: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
verses.ASV: And Herod said, John I beheaded: but who is this, about whom I hear such things? And he sought to see him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Herodes disse: “A João mandei degolar; quem, pois, é este, de quem tais coisas ouço?” E procurava vê-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Herodes: A Juan yo degollé: ¿quién pues será éste, de quien yo oigo tales cosas? Y procuraba verle.

verses.KJV: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.WEB: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.
verses.ASV: And the apostles, when they were returned, declared unto him what things they had done. And he took them, and withdrew apart to a city called Bethsaida.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os apóstolos, voltaram, contaram [a Jesus] todas as coisas que tinham feito. Então ele os tomou consigo, e retirou-se à parte a um lugar deserto de uma cidade chamada Betsaida.
verses.RVR09: Y vueltos los apóstoles, le contaron todas las cosas que habían hecho. Y tomándolos, se retiró aparte á un lugar desierto de la ciudad que se llama Bethsaida.

verses.KJV: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.WEB: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
verses.ASV: But the multitudes perceiving it followed him: and he welcomed them, and spake to them of the kingdom of God, and them that had need of healing he cured.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando as multidões souberam, seguiram-no. Ele as recebeu, e lhes falava do Reino de Deus, e curava aos que precisavam de cura.
verses.RVR09: Y como lo entendieron las gentes, le siguieron; y él las recibió, y les hablaba del reino de Dios, y sanaba á los que tenían necesidad de cura.

verses.KJV: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.WEB: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
verses.ASV: And the day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages and country round about, and lodge, and get provisions: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dia já começava a declinar. Então os doze se aproximaram dele, e lhe disseram: “Despede a multidão, para irem aos lugares e aldeias ao redor, se agasalhem, e achem o que comer; porque aqui estamos em lugar deserto”.
verses.RVR09: Y el día había comenzado á declinar; y llegándose los doce, le dijeron: Despide á las gentes, para que yendo á las aldeas y heredades de alrededor, procedan á alojarse y hallen viandas; porque aquí estamos en lugar desierto.

verses.KJV: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
verses.ASV: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more than five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy food for all this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes disse: “Dai-lhes vós de comer”. E eles disseram: “Não temos mais que cinco pães e dois peixes; a não ser se formos nós mesmos comprar de comer para todo este povo”.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Dadles vosotros de comer. Y dijeron ellos: No tenemos más que cinco panes y dos pescados, si no vamos nosotros á comprar viandas para toda esta compañía.

verses.KJV: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.WEB: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
verses.ASV: For they were about five thousand men. And he said unto his disciples, Make them sit down in companies, about fifty each.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque havia ali quase cinco mil homens. Então disse aos seus discípulos: “Fazei-os se sentarem em grupos de cinquenta em cinquenta”.
verses.RVR09: Y eran como cinco mil hombres. Entonces dijo á sus discípulos: Hacedlos sentar en ranchos, de cincuenta en cincuenta.

verses.KJV: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.WEB: They did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.ASV: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim procederam, fazendo todos se sentarem.
verses.RVR09: Y así lo hicieron, haciéndolos sentar á todos.

verses.KJV: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.WEB: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.ASV: And he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake; and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes e, olhando para o céu, abençoou-os e partiu-os, e os deu a seus discípulos, para [os] porem diante da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando los cinco panes y los dos pescados, mirando al cielo los bendijo, y partió, y dió á sus discípulos para que pusiesen delante de las gentes.

verses.KJV: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.WEB: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.ASV: And they ate, and were all filled: and there was taken up that which remained over to them of broken pieces, twelve baskets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos comeram, e saciaram-se; e levantaram doze cestos de pedaços que sobraram.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron todos, y se hartaron; y alzaron lo que les sobró, doce cestos de pedazos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.WEB: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he was praying apart, the disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Who do the multitudes say that I am?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando ele estava orando só, e seus discípulos estavam com ele, que ele lhes perguntou: “Quem as multidões dizem que eu sou?”
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando él solo orando, estaban con él los discípulos; y les preguntó diciendo: ¿Quién dicen las gentes que soy?

verses.KJV: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.WEB: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”
verses.ASV: And they answering said, John the Baptist; but others [say], Elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: “[Uns] , João Batista; outros, Elias; e outros, que algum dos profetas antigos ressuscitou”.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron, y dijeron: Juan el Bautista; y otros, Elías; y otros, que algún profeta de los antiguos ha resucitado.

verses.KJV: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, But who say ye that I am? And Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou?” E Pedro respondeu: “O Cristo de Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: ¿Y vosotros, quién decís que soy? Entonces respondiendo Simón Pedro, dijo: El Cristo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
verses.WEB: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,
verses.ASV: But he charged them, and commanded [them] to tell this to no man;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele os alertou, e mandou-lhes que não dissessem a ninguém,
verses.RVR09: Mas él, conminándolos, mandó que á nadie dijesen esto;

verses.KJV: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.WEB: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
verses.ASV: saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: “É necessário que o Filho do homem sofra muitas coisas; que seja rejeitado pelos anciãos, pelos chefes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas; que seja morto, e que seja ressuscitado ao terceiro dia”.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Es necesario que el Hijo del hombre padezca muchas cosas, y sea desechado de los ancianos, y de los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y de los escribas, y que sea muerto, y resucite al tercer día.

verses.KJV: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.WEB: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.ASV: And he said unto all, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia a todos: “Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, tome cada dia sua cruz, e siga- me.
verses.RVR09: Y decía á todos: Si alguno quiere venir en pos de mí, niéguese á sí mismo, y tome su cruz cada día, y sígame.

verses.KJV: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.WEB: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.
verses.ASV: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem quiser salvar sua vida a perderá; porém quem, por minha causa, perder a sua vida, esse a salvará.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que quisiere salvar su vida, la perderá; y cualquiera que perdiere su vida por causa de mí, éste la salvará.

verses.KJV: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.WEB: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?
verses.ASV: For what is a man profited, if he gain the whole world, and lose or forfeit his own self?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, que aproveita para alguém ganhar o mundo todo, e perder ou prejudicar a si mesmo?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué aprovecha al hombre, si granjeare todo el mundo, y se pierda él á sí mismo, ó corra peligro de sí?

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.WEB: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in his own glory, and [the glory] of the Father, and of the holy angels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem se envergonhar de mim e das minhas palavras, dele o Filho do homem se envergonhará, quando vier na sua glória, e na do Pai, e dos santos anjos.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que se avergonzare de mí y de mis palabras, de este tal el Hijo del hombre se avergonzará cuando viniere en su gloria, y del Padre, y de los santos ángeles.

verses.KJV: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: But I tell you of a truth, There are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em verdade vos digo que, dentre os que aqui estão, há alguns que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o Reino de Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Y os digo en verdad, que hay algunos de los que están aquí, que no gustarán la muerte, hasta que vean el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.WEB: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter and John and James, and went up into the mountain to pray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quase oito dias depois dessas palavras, ele tomou consigo a Pedro, João, e a Jacó, e subiu ao monte para orar.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció como ocho días después de estas palabras, que tomó á Pedro y á Juan y á Jacobo, y subió al monte á orar.

verses.KJV: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
verses.WEB: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
verses.ASV: And as he was praying, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment [became] white [and] dazzling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, enquanto estava orando, a aparência do seu rosto se transfigurou, e sua roupa [ficou] branca e brilhante.
verses.RVR09: Y entre tanto que oraba, la apariencia de su rostro se hizo otra, y su vestido blanco y resplandeciente.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.WEB: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
verses.ASV: And behold, there talked with him two men, who were Moses and Elijah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que estavam falando com ele dois homens, que eram Moisés e Elias,
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí dos varones que hablaban con él, los cuales eran Moisés y Elías;

verses.KJV: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: os quais apareceram com glória, e falavam de sua partida, que estava para se cumprir em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Que aparecieron en majestad, y hablaban de su salida, la cual había de cumplir en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.WEB: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.
verses.ASV: Now Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro e os que estavam com ele estavam cheios de sono; e quando despertaram, viram a glória dele, e aqueles dois homens que estavam com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro y los que estaban con él, estaban cargados de sueño: y como despertaron, vieron su majestad, y á aquellos dos varones que estaban con él.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.WEB: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as they were parting from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando eles estavam saíndo da presença dele, Pedro disse a Jesus: “Mestre, é bom estarmos nós aqui. Façamos três tendas, uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias”, não sabendo o que dizia.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que apartándose ellos de él, Pedro dice á Jesús: Maestro, bien es que nos quedemos aquí: y hagamos tres pabellones, uno para ti, y uno para Moisés, y uno para Elías; no sabiendo lo que se decía.

verses.KJV: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.WEB: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
verses.ASV: And while he said these things, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto ele dizia isso, veio uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra; e, quando entraram na nuvem, temeram.
verses.RVR09: Y estando él hablando esto, vino una nube que los cubrió; y tuvieron temor, entrando ellos en la nube.

verses.KJV: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.WEB: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
verses.ASV: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my Son, my chosen: hear ye him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio uma voz da nuvem, que dizia: “Este é o meu Filho amado; a ele ouvi”.
verses.RVR09: Y vino una voz de la nube, que decía: Este es mi Hijo amado; á él oid.

verses.KJV: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.WEB: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
verses.ASV: And when the voice came, Jesus was found alone. And they held their peace, and told no man in those days any of the things which they had seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de terminada aquela voz, Jesus se encontrava só; e eles se calaram, e por aqueles dias não contaram a ninguém nada do que tinham visto.
verses.RVR09: Y pasada aquella voz, Jesús fué hallado solo: y ellos callaron; y por aquellos días no dijeron nada á nadie de lo que habían visto.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.WEB: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, on the next day, when they were come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no dia seguinte que, descendo eles do monte, uma grande multidão lhe saiu ao encontro.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al día siguiente, que apartándose ellos del monte, gran compañía les salió al encuentro.

verses.KJV: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.WEB: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.
verses.ASV: And behold, a man from the multitude cried, saying, Teacher, I beseech thee to look upon my son; for he is mine only child:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um homem da multidão clamou: “Mestre, rogo-te que vejas a meu filho, que é o único que tenho,
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, un hombre de la compañía clamó, diciendo: Maestro, ruégote que veas á mi hijo; que es el único que tengo:

verses.KJV: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.WEB: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
verses.ASV: and behold, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth, and it hardly departeth from him, bruising him sorely.
verses.ALMEIDA: e eis que um espírito o toma, e de repente grita, e o convulsiona até espumar, e somente sai dele quando o maltrata severamente.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un espíritu le toma, y de repente da voces; y le despedaza y hace echar espuma, y apenas se aparta de él quebrantándole.

verses.KJV: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.WEB: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
verses.ASV: And I besought thy disciples to cast it out; and they could not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E roguei aos teus discípulos que o exupulsassem, mas não conseguiram”.
verses.RVR09: Y rogué á tus discípulos que le echasen fuera, y no pudieron.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and bear with you? bring hither thy son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus respondeu: “Ó geração incrédula e perversa! Até quando estarei ainda convosco, e vos suportarei? Traze aqui teu filho”.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, dice: ¡Oh generación infiel y perversa! ¿hasta cuándo tengo de estar con vosotros, y os sufriré? Trae tu hijo acá.

verses.KJV: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.WEB: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
verses.ASV: And as he was yet a coming, the demon dashed him down, and tare [him] grievously. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ainda vinha chegando, o demônio o derrubou, e o convulsionou. Porém Jesus repreendeu o espírito imundo, curou ao menino, e o devolveu ao seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y como aun se acercaba, el demonio le derribó y despedazó: mas Jesús increpó al espíritu inmundo, y sanó al muchacho, y se lo volvió á su padre.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.WEB: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
verses.ASV: And they were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marvelling at all the things which he did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos ficaram perplexos com a grandeza de Deus. E enquanto todos se maravilhavam de tudo o que Jesus fazia, disse aos seus discípulos:
verses.RVR09: Y todos estaban atónitos de la grandeza de Dios. Y maravillándose todos de todas las cosas que hacía, dijo á sus discípulos:

verses.KJV: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.WEB: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
verses.ASV: Let these words sink into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Ponde vós em vossos ouvidos estas palavras: que o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens”.
verses.RVR09: Poned vosotros en vuestros oídos estas palabras; porque ha de acontecer que el Hijo del hombre será entregado en manos de hombres.

verses.KJV: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.WEB: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
verses.ASV: But they understood not this saying, and it was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles não entendiam essa palavra, e era-lhes encoberta, para que não a compreendessem; e temiam perguntar-lhe sobre essa palavra.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no entendían esta palabra, y les era encubierta para que no la entendiesen; y temían preguntarle de esta palabra.

verses.KJV: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.WEB: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
verses.ASV: And there arose a reasoning among them, which of them was the greatest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se entre eles uma discussão sobre qual deles seria o maior.
verses.RVR09: Entonces entraron en disputa, cuál de ellos sería el mayor.

verses.KJV: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.WEB: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
verses.ASV: But when Jesus saw the reasoning of their heart, he took a little child, and set him by his side,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, conhecendo o pensamento de seus corações, pegou uma criança, e a pôs junto a si.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús, viendo los pensamientos del corazón de ellos, tomó un niño, y púsole junto á sí,

verses.KJV: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.WEB: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
verses.ASV: and said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this little child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same is great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse-lhes: “Quem receber esta criança em meu nome, a mim me recebe; e quem receber a mim, recebe o que me enviou; porque aquele que entre todos vós for o menor, esse será grande”.
verses.RVR09: Y les dice: Cualquiera que recibiere este niño en mi nombre, á mí recibe; y cualquiera que me recibiere á mí, recibe al que me envió; porque el que fuere el menor entre todos vosotros, éste será el grande.

verses.KJV: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.WEB: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
verses.ASV: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: João respondeu: “Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava os demônios, e nós o proibimos, porque não segue conosco”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Juan, dijo: Maestro, hemos visto á uno que echaba fuera demonios en tu nombre; y se lo prohibimos, porque no sigue con nosotros.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus said unto him, Forbid [him] not: for he that is not against you is for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: “Não o proibais, porque quem não é contra nós, é por nós”.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dijo: No se lo prohibáis; porque el que no es contra nosotros, por nosotros es.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.WEB: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the days were well-nigh come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando completaram-se os dias em que ele viria a ser recebido no alto, ele se determinou a ir para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como se cumplió el tiempo en que había de ser recibido arriba, él afirmó su rostro para ir á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.WEB: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
verses.ASV: and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou mensageiros adiante de si; e eles se foram, e entraram numa aldeia de samaritanos, para lhe fazerem os preparativos.
