verses.RVR09: Y envió mensajeros delante de sí, los cuales fueron y entraron en una ciudad de los Samaritanos, para prevenirle.

verses.KJV: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And they did not receive him, because his face was [as though he were] going to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não o receberam, porque seu rosto demonstrava que ele ia para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Mas no le recibieron, porque era su traza de ir á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.WEB: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
verses.ASV: And when his disciples James and John saw [this], they said, Lord, wilt thou that we bid fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando seus discípulos, Tiago e João, viram [isso] , disseram: “Senhor, queres que digamos que desça fogo do céu e os consuma, como Elias também fez?”
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto sus discípulos Jacobo y Juan, dijeron: Señor, ¿quieres que mandemos que descienda fuego del cielo, y los consuma, como hizo Elías?

verses.KJV: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.WEB: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
verses.ASV: But he turned, and rebuked them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele se virou, repreendeu-os, e disse: Vós não sabeis de que espírito sois.
verses.RVR09: Entonces volviéndose él, los reprendió, diciendo: Vosotros no sabéis de qué espíritu sois;

verses.KJV: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
verses.WEB: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
verses.ASV: And they went to another village.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Filho do homem não veio para destruir as almas dos seres humanos, mas sim para salvá-las.E foram para outra aldeia.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Hijo del hombre no ha venido para perder las almas de los hombres, sino para salvarlas. Y se fueron á otra aldea.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.WEB: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
verses.ASV: And as they went on the way, a certain man said unto him, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles iam pelo caminho, alguém lhe disse: “Senhor, eu te seguirei para onde quer que fores”.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que yendo ellos, uno le dijo en el camino: Señor, te seguiré donde quiera que fueres.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven [have] nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: “As raposas têm tocas, e as aves do céu, ninhos; mas o Filho do homem não tem onde deitar a cabeça”.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo Jesús: Las zorras tienen cuevas, y las aves de los cielos nidos; mas el Hijo del hombre no tiene donde recline la cabeza.

verses.KJV: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.WEB: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a outro: “Segue-me”. Porém ele disse: “Senhor, deixa-me que primeiro eu vá, e eu enterre meu pai”.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á otro: Sígueme. Y él dijo: Señor, déjame que primero vaya y entierre á mi padre.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: But he said unto him, Leave the dead to bury their own dead; but go thou and publish abroad the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus lhe disse: “Deixa os mortos enterrarem os seus próprios mortos; tu, porém, vai, e anuncia o reino de Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Deja los muertos que entierren á sus muertos; y tú, ve, y anuncia el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.WEB: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
verses.ASV: And another also said, I will follow thee, Lord; but first suffer me to bid farewell to them that are at my house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outro também disse: “Senhor, eu te seguirei; mas deixa-me primeiro despedir dos que estão em minha casa”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces también dijo otro: Te seguiré, Señor; mas déjame que me despida primero de los que están en mi casa.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: But Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: “Ninguém que colocar a sua mão no arado e olhar para trás é apto para o reino de Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Ninguno que poniendo su mano al arado mira atrás, es apto para el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.WEB: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
verses.ASV: Now after these things the Lord appointed seventy others, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself was about to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disso, o Senhor ordenou ainda outros setenta, e os mandou de dois em dois adiante de sua face, para toda cidade e lugar aonde ele havia de vir.
verses.RVR09: Y DESPUÉS de estas cosas, designó el Señor aun otros setenta, los cuales envió de dos en dos delante de sí, á toda ciudad y lugar á donde él había de venir.

verses.KJV: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.WEB: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, The harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes dizia: “A colheita verdadeiramente é grande, mas os trabalhadores são poucos; portanto rogai ao Senhor da colheita para que ele envie trabalhadores para a sua colheita.
verses.RVR09: Y les decía: La mies á la verdad es mucha, mas los obreros pocos; por tanto, rogad al Señor de la mies que envíe obreros á su mies.

verses.KJV: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.WEB: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
verses.ASV: Go your ways; behold, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide; eis que eu vos mando como cordeiros no meio dos lobos.
verses.RVR09: Andad, he aquí yo os envío como corderos en medio de lobos.

verses.KJV: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.WEB: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
verses.ASV: Carry no purse, no wallet, no shoes; and salute no man on the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não leveis bolsa, nem sacola, nem sandálias; e a ninguém saudeis pelo caminho.
verses.RVR09: No llevéis bolsa, ni alforja, ni calzado; y á nadie saludéis en el camino.

verses.KJV: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
verses.WEB: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
verses.ASV: And into whatsoever house ye shall enter, first say, Peace [be] to this house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em qualquer casa que entrardes, dizei primeiro: Paz [seja] nesta casa.
verses.RVR09: En cualquiera casa donde entrareis, primeramente decid: Paz sea á esta casa.

verses.KJV: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.WEB: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
verses.ASV: And if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ali houver algum filho da paz, a vossa paz repousará sobre ele; e se não, ela voltará para vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Y si hubiere allí algún hijo de paz, vuestra paz reposará sobre él; y si no, se volverá á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.WEB: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
verses.ASV: And in that same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficai na mesma casa, comendo e bebendo do que eles vos derem; pois o trabalhador é digno do seu salário. Não vos mudeis de casa em casa.
verses.RVR09: Y posad en aquella misma casa, comiendo y bebiendo lo que os dieren; porque el obrero digno es de su salario. No os paséis de casa en casa.

verses.KJV: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.WEB: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
verses.ASV: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E em qualquer cidade que entrardes, e vos receberem, comei do que puserem diante de vós.
verses.RVR09: Y en cualquier ciudad donde entrareis, y os recibieren, comed lo que os pusieren delante;

verses.KJV: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.WEB: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
verses.ASV: and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E curai os enfermos que nela houver, e dizei-lhes: Chegado é para vós o reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y sanad los enfermos que en ella hubiere, y decidles: Se ha llegado á vosotros el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.WEB: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.ASV: But into whatsoever city ye shall enter, and they receive you not, go out into the streets thereof and say,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas em qualquer cidade em que entrardes e não vos receberem, saí pelas ruas, e dizei:
verses.RVR09: Mas en cualquier ciudad donde entrareis, y no os recibieren, saliendo por sus calles, decid:

verses.KJV: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.WEB: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
verses.ASV: Even the dust from your city, that cleaveth to our feet, we wipe off against you: nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o pó da vossa cidade que ficou em nós, sacudimos sobre vós; porém disto sabeis, que o reino de Deus é chegado até vós.
verses.RVR09: Aun el polvo que se nos ha pegado de vuestra ciudad á nuestros pies, sacudimos en vosotros: esto empero sabed, que el reino de los cielos se ha llegado á vosotros.

verses.KJV: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.WEB: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
verses.ASV: I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos digo, que mais tolerável será naquele dia para Sodoma, do que para aquela cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y os digo que los de Sodoma tendrán más remisión aquel día, que aquella ciudad.

verses.KJV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.WEB: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.ASV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti, Corazim! Ai de ti, Betsaida! Porque se em Tiro e em Sidom tivessem sido feitas as maravilhas que foram feitas entre vós, há muito tempo que teriam se arrependido em saco e em cinza.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ti, Corazín! ¡Ay de ti, Bethsaida! que si en Tiro y en Sidón hubieran sido hechas las maravillas que se han hecho en vosotras, ya días ha que, sentados en cilicio y ceniza, se habrían arrepentido.

verses.KJV: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.WEB: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
verses.ASV: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment, than for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, para Tiro e Sidom será mais tolerável no juízo, do que para vós.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, Tiro y Sidón tendrán más remisión que vosotras en el juicio.

verses.KJV: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
verses.WEB: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
verses.ASV: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt be brought down unto Hades.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, Cafarnaum, que [pensas ] estar elevada ao céu, até o Xeol serás derrubada!
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Capernaum, que hasta los cielos estás levantada, hasta los infiernos serás abajada.

verses.KJV: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
verses.WEB: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
verses.ASV: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that rejecteth you rejecteth me; and he that rejecteth me rejecteth him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem vos ouve, ouve a mim; e quem vos rejeita, rejeita a mim; e quem me rejeita, rejeita aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: El que á vosotros oye, á mí oye; y el que á vosotros desecha, á mí desecha; y el que á mí desecha, desecha al que me envió.

verses.KJV: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
verses.WEB: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
verses.ASV: And the seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject unto us in thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os setenta voltaram com alegria, dizendo: Senhor, até os demônios se sujeitam a nós por teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron los setenta con gozo, diciendo: Señor, aun los demonios se nos sujetan en tu nombre.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan fallen as lightning from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Eu vi a Satanás, que caía do céu como um raio.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Yo veía á Satanás, como un rayo, que caía del cielo.

verses.KJV: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.WEB: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have given you authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall in any wise hurt you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vos dou poder para pisar sobre serpentes e escorpiões, e sobre toda a força do inimigo, e nada vos fará dano nenhum.
verses.RVR09: He aquí os doy potestad de hollar sobre las serpientes y sobre los escorpiones, y sobre toda fuerza del enemigo, y nada os dañará.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
verses.ASV: Nevertheless in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não vos alegreis de que os espíritos se sujeitem a vós; em vez disso, alegrai-vos por vossos nomes estarem escritos nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Mas no os gocéis de esto, que los espíritus se os sujetan; antes gozaos de que vuestros nombres están escritos en los cielos.

verses.KJV: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.WEB: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
verses.ASV: In that same hour he rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes: yea, Father; for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela hora Jesus se alegrou em espírito, e disse: Graças te dou, o Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra; porque tu escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e instruídos, e as revelaste às crianças. Sim, Pai, porque assim lhe agradou diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: En aquella misma hora Jesús se alegró en espíritu, y dijo: Yo te alabo, oh Padre, Señor del cielo y de la tierra, que escondiste estas cosas á los sabios y entendidos, y las has revelado á los pequeños: así, Padre, porque así te agradó.

verses.KJV: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
verses.WEB: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
verses.ASV: All things have been delivered unto me of my Father: and no one knoweth who the Son is, save the Father; and who the Father is, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son willeth to reveal [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as coisas me foram entregues pelo meu Pai; e ninguém sabe quem é o Filho, a não ser o Pai; nem quem é o Pai, a não ser o Filho, e a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas me son entregadas de mi Padre: y nadie sabe quién sea el Hijo sino el Padre; ni quién sea el Padre, sino el Hijo, y á quien el Hijo lo quisiere revelar.

verses.KJV: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.WEB: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
verses.ASV: And turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed [are] the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.ALMEIDA: E virando-se para seus discípulos, disse [-lhes] à parte: Bem-aventurados os olhos que veem o que vós vedes.
verses.RVR09: Y vuelto particularmente á los discípulos, dijo: Bienaventurados los ojos que ven lo que vosotros veis:

verses.KJV: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.WEB: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
verses.ASV: for I say unto you, that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vos digo, que muitos profetas e reis desejaram ver o que vós vedes, e não o viram; o ouvir o que vós ouvis, e não o ouviram.
verses.RVR09: Porque os digo que muchos profetas y reyes desearon ver lo que vosotros veis, y no lo vieron; y oir lo que oís, y no lo oyeron.

verses.KJV: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.WEB: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.ASV: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and made trial of him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um certo estudioso da Lei se levantou, tentando-o, e dizendo: Mestre, o que devo fazer para ter para herdar a vida eterna?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, un doctor de la ley se levantó, tentándole y diciendo: Maestro, ¿haciendo qué cosa poseeré la vida eterna?

verses.KJV: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.WEB: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: O que está escrito na Lei? Como tu [a] lês?
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: ¿Qué está escrito en la ley? ¿cómo lees?

verses.KJV: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.WEB: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.ASV: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo ele, disse: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus de todo teu coração, e de toda tua alma, e de todas tuas forças, e de todo teu entendimento; e [amarás] a teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, dijo: Amarás al Señor tu Dios de todo tu corazón, y de toda tu alma, y de todas tus fuerzas, y de todo tu entendimiento; y á tu prójimo como á ti mismo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Respondeste bem; faze isso, e viverás.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Bien has respondido: haz esto, y vivirás.

verses.KJV: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.WEB: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
verses.ASV: But he, desiring to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, querendo se justificar, disse a Jesus: E quem é o meu próximo?
verses.RVR09: Mas él, queriéndose justificar á sí mismo, dijo á Jesús: ¿Y quién es mi prójimo?

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.ASV: Jesus made answer and said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho; and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, disse: Um homem descia de Jerusalém a Jericó, e foi atacado por assaltantes, que também tiraram suas roupas, espancaram-no, e se foram, deixando-o meio morto.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, dijo: Un hombre descendía de Jerusalem á Jericó, y cayó en manos de ladrones, los cuales le despojaron; é hiriéndole, se fueron, dejándole medio muerto.

verses.KJV: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.WEB: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.ASV: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por acaso descia um certo sacerdote pelo mesmo caminho, e vendo-o, passou longe [dele] .
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que descendió un sacerdote por aquel camino, y viéndole, se pasó de un lado.

verses.KJV: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
verses.WEB: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
verses.ASV: And in like manner a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semelhantemente também um levita, chegando junto a aquele lugar, veio, e vendo-o, passou longe [dele]
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo un Levita, llegando cerca de aquel lugar, y viéndole, se pasó de un lado.

verses.KJV: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
verses.WEB: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
verses.ASV: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém um certo samaritano, que ia pelo caminho, veio junto a ele, e vendo-o, teve compaixão [dele] .
verses.RVR09: Mas un Samaritano que transitaba, viniendo cerca de él, y viéndole, fué movido á misericordia;

verses.KJV: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.WEB: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.ASV: and came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on [them] oil and wine; and he set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando-se, amarrou-lhe [um curativo] nas feridas, pondo-lhe nelas azeite e vinho; e pondo-o sobre o animal que o transportava, levou-o para uma hospedaria, e cuidou dele.
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose, vendó sus heridas, echándoles aceite y vino; y poniéndole sobre su cabalgadura, llevóle al mesón, y cuidó de él.

verses.KJV: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.WEB: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
verses.ASV: And on the morrow he took out two shillings, and gave them to the host, and said, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, I, when I come back again, will repay thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo-se no outro dia, tirou dois dinheiros, e os deu para o hospedeiro; e disse-lhe: Cuide dele; e tudo o que gastares a mais, eu te pagarei quando voltar.
verses.RVR09: Y otro día al partir, sacó dos denarios, y diólos al huésped, y le dijo: Cuídamele; y todo lo que de más gastares, yo cuando vuelva te lo pagaré.

verses.KJV: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.WEB: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
verses.ASV: Which of these three, thinkest thou, proved neighbor unto him that fell among the robbers?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem, pois, destes três te parece que foi o próximo daquele que foi atacado por assaltantes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién, pues, de estos tres te parece que fué el prójimo de aquél que cayó en manos de los ladrones?

verses.KJV: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.WEB: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
verses.ASV: And he said, He that showed mercy on him. And Jesus said unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele disse: Aquele que agiu tendo misericórdia com ele.Então Jesus lhe disse: Vai, e faze da mesma maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: El que usó con él de misericordia. Entonces Jesús le dijo: Ve, y haz tú lo mismo.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.WEB: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.ASV: Now as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que eles, enquanto eles caminhavam, ele entrou em uma aldeia; e uma certa mulher, de nome Marta, o recebeu em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que yendo, entró él en una aldea: y una mujer llamada Marta, le recibió en su casa.

verses.KJV: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
verses.WEB: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
verses.ASV: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at the Lord’s feet, and heard his word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta tinha uma irmã, chamada Maria, a qual, sentando-se também aos pés de Jesus, ouvia sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y ésta tenía una hermana que se llamaba María, la cual sentándose á los pies de Jesús, oía su palabra.

verses.KJV: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.WEB: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
verses.ASV: But Martha was cumbered about much serving; and she came up to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister did leave me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Marta, porém, ficava muito ocupada com muitos serviços; e ela, vindo, disse: Senhor, não te importas que minha irmã me deixe sozinha para servir? Dize a ela, pois, que me ajude.
verses.RVR09: Empero Marta se distraía en muchos servicios; y sobreviniendo, dice: Señor, ¿no tienes cuidado que mi hermana me deja servir sola? Dile pues, que me ayude.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
verses.ASV: But the Lord answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Marta, Marta, [tu és] preocupada com muitas coisas, e perturbada por elas;
verses.RVR09: Pero respondiendo Jesús, le dijo: Marta, Marta, cuidadosa estás, y con las muchas cosas estás turbada:

verses.KJV: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.WEB: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
verses.ASV: but one thing is needful: for Mary hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [somente] uma coisa é necessária. E Maria escolheu a parte boa, a qual não lhe será tirada.
verses.RVR09: Empero una cosa es necesaria; y María escogió la buena parte, la cual no le será quitada.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.WEB: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he was praying in a certain place, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, even as John also taught his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ele estava orando em um certo lugar. Quando terminou, lhe disse um de seus discípulos: Senhor, ensina-nos a orar, como João também ensinou a seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que estando él orando en un lugar, como acabó, uno de sus discípulos le dijo: Señor, enséñanos á orar, como también Juan enseñó á sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Father, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Quando orardes, dizei: Pai nosso, que [estás] nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome; venha o teu Reino; seja feita a tua vontade, [assim] na terra como no céu.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Cuando orareis, decid: Padre nuestro que estás en los cielos; sea tu nombre santificado. Venga tu reino. Sea hecha tu voluntad, como en el cielo, así también en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.WEB: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.ASV: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-nos cada dia nosso pão diário.
verses.RVR09: El pan nuestro de cada día, dánoslo hoy.

verses.KJV: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.WEB: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
verses.ASV: And forgive us our sins; for we ourselves also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And bring us not into temptation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perdoa-nos nossos pecados, pois também perdoamos a todo aquele que nos deve. E não nos ponhas em tentação, mas livra-nos do mal.
verses.RVR09: Y perdónanos nuestros pecados, porque también nosotros perdonamos á todos los que nos deben. Y no nos metas en tentación, mas líbranos del malo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes também: Qual de vós que, tendo um amigo, se for a ele à meia-noite, e lhe disser: Amigo, empresta-me três pães.
verses.RVR09: Díjoles también: ¿Quién de vosotros tendrá un amigo, é irá á él á media noche, y le dirá: Amigo, préstame tres panes,

verses.KJV: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
verses.WEB: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
verses.ASV: for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um amigo meu veio de viagem até mim, e nada tenho para lhe apresentar.
verses.RVR09: Porque un amigo mío ha venido á mí de camino, y no tengo qué ponerle delante;

verses.KJV: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
verses.WEB: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
verses.ASV: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele de dentro, respondendo, disser: Não me perturbe! A porta já está fechada, e meus filhos estão comigo na cama; não posso me levantar para te dar.
verses.RVR09: Y el de dentro respondiendo, dijere: No me seas molesto; la puerta está ya cerrada, y mis niños están conmigo en cama; no puedo levantarme, y darte?

verses.KJV: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.WEB: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
verses.ASV: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo-vos, que ainda que ele não se levante para lhe dar por seu seu amigo, contudo, por sua teimosia ele se levantará, e lhe dará tudo quanto ele precisar.
verses.RVR09: Os digo, que aunque no se levante á darle por ser su amigo, cierto por su importunidad se levantará, y le dará todo lo que habrá menester.

verses.KJV: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.WEB: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos digo: pedi, e será vos dado; buscai, e achareis; batei, e vos será aberto.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os digo: Pedid, y se os dará; buscad, y hallaréis; llamad, y os será abierto.

verses.KJV: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.WEB: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.ASV: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todo o que pede, recebe; e quem busca, acha; e quem bate, lhe será aberto.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo aquel que pide, recibe; y el que busca, halla; y al que llama, se abre.

verses.KJV: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.WEB: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
verses.ASV: And of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que pai, dentre vós, a quem o filho pedir pão, lhe dará uma pedra? Ou, se também [lhe pedir] peixe, no lugar do peixe lhe dará uma serpente?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y cuál padre de vosotros, si su hijo le pidiere pan, le dará una piedra? ó, si pescado, ¿en lugar de pescado, le dará una serpiente?

verses.KJV: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.WEB: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
verses.ASV: Or [if] he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou se também pedir um ovo, lhe dará um escorpião?
verses.RVR09: O, si le pidiere un huevo, ¿le dará un escorpión?

verses.KJV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.WEB: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
verses.ASV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall [your] heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar bons presentes para vossos filhos, quanto mais dará [vosso] Pai celestial, o Espírito Santo, a aqueles que lhe pedirem?
verses.RVR09: Pues si vosotros, siendo malos, sabéis dar buenas dádivas á vuestros hijos, ¿cuánto más vuestro Padre celestial dará el Espíritu Santo á los que lo pidieren de él?

verses.KJV: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.WEB: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
verses.ASV: And he was casting out a demon [that was] dumb. And it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spake; and the multitudes marvelled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jesus] estava expulsando um demônio, e [este] era mudo. E aconteceu que, saindo o demônio, o mudo falou, e as multidões se maravilharam.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba él lanzando un demonio, el cual era mudo: y aconteció que salido fuera el demonio, el mudo habló, y las gentes se maravillaron.

verses.KJV: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
verses.WEB: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
verses.ASV: But some of them said, By Beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém alguns deles diziam: Ele expulsa aos demônios por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios!
verses.RVR09: Mas algunos de ellos decían: En Beelzebub, príncipe de los demonios, echa fuera los demonios.

verses.KJV: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.WEB: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
verses.ASV: And others, trying [him], sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outros, tentando [-o] ,pediam-lhe um sinal do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y otros, tentando, pedían de él señal del cielo.

verses.KJV: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
verses.WEB: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
verses.ASV: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house [divided] against a house falleth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, conhecendo seus pensamentos, disse-lhes: Todo reino dividido contra si mesmo é transformado num vazio, e a casa contra casa cai.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, conociendo los pensamientos de ellos, les dijo: Todo reino dividido contra sí mismo, es asolado; y una casa dividida contra sí misma, cae.

verses.KJV: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.WEB: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
verses.ASV: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se também Satanás está dividido contra si mesmo, como durará o seu reino? Porque dizeis: Por Belzebu ele expulsa aos demônios.
verses.RVR09: Y si también Satanás está dividido contra sí mismo, ¿cómo estará en pie su reino? porque decís que en Beelzebub echo yo fuera los demonios.

verses.KJV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.WEB: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
verses.ASV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu expulso aos demônios por Belzebu, por quem os seus filhos expulsam? Portanto eles serão vossos juízes.
verses.RVR09: Pues si yo echo fuera los demonios en Beelzebub, ¿vuestros hijos en quién los echan fuera? Por tanto, ellos serán vuestros jueces.

verses.KJV: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
verses.WEB: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
verses.ASV: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se eu expulso aos demônios pelo dedo de Deus, portanto o Reino de Deus chegou a vós.
verses.RVR09: Mas si por el dedo de Dios echo yo fuera los demonios, cierto el reino de Dios ha llegado á vosotros.

verses.KJV: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.WEB: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
verses.ASV: When the strong [man] fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o valente, armado, guarda seu palácio, seus bens estão em paz.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el fuerte armado guarda su atrio, en paz está lo que posee.

verses.KJV: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.WEB: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
verses.ASV: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him his whole armor wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vindo outro mais valente que ele, e vencendo-o, toma [-lhe] toda sua armadura, em que confiava, e reparte seus despojos.
verses.RVR09: Mas si sobreviniendo otro más fuerte que él, le venciere, le toma todas sus armas en que confiaba, y reparte sus despojos.

verses.KJV: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.WEB: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
verses.ASV: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem não é comigo, é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta, espalha.
verses.RVR09: El que no es conmigo, contra mí es; y el que conmigo no recoge, desparrama.

verses.KJV: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.WEB: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
verses.ASV: The unclean spirit when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and finding none, he saith, I will turn back unto my house whence I came out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o espírito imundo tem saído da pessoa, ele anda por lugares secos, buscando repouso; e não [o] achando, diz: Voltarei para minha casa, de onde saí.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el espíritu inmundo saliere del hombre, anda por lugares secos, buscando reposo; y no hallándolo, dice: Me volveré á mi casa de donde salí.

verses.KJV: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
verses.WEB: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
verses.ASV: And when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo, acha-a varrida e adornada.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo, la halla barrida y adornada.

verses.KJV: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
verses.WEB: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
verses.ASV: Then goeth he, and taketh [to him] seven other spirits more evil than himself; and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vai, e toma consigo outros sete espíritos piores que ele, e entrando, habitam ali; e as últimas coisas de tal pessoa são piores que as primeiras.
verses.RVR09: Entonces va, y toma otros siete espíritus peores que él; y entrados, habitan allí: y lo postrero del tal hombre es peor que lo primero.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
verses.WEB: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the breasts which thou didst suck.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, dizendo ele estas coisas, uma mulher da multidão, levantando a voz, lhe disse: Bem-aventurado o ventre que te trouxe, e os peitos que mamaste!
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que diciendo estas cosas, una mujer de la compañía, levantando la voz, le dijo: Bienaventurado el vientre que te trajo, y los pechos que mamaste.

verses.KJV: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.WEB: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
verses.ASV: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele disse: Antes bem-aventurados os que ouvem a palavra de Deus, e a guardam.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Antes bienaventurados los que oyen la palabra de Dios, y la guardan.

verses.KJV: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.WEB: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verses.ASV: And when the multitudes were gathering together unto him, he began to say, This generation is an evil generation: it seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ajuntando as multidões, começou a dizer: Maligna é esta geração; busca sinal, mas sinal não lhe será dado, a não ser o sinal de Jonas o profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y juntándose las gentes á él, comenzó á decir: Esta generación mala es: señal busca, mas señal no le será dada, sino la señal de Jonás.

verses.KJV: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.WEB: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
verses.ASV: For even as Jonah became a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque como Jonas foi sinal para os ninivitas, assim também será o Filho do homem para esta geração.
verses.RVR09: Porque como Jonás fué señal á los Ninivitas, así también será el Hijo del hombre á esta generación.

verses.KJV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.WEB: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
verses.ASV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.ALMEIDA: A rainha do Sul se levantará em juízo com as pessoas desta geração, e as condenará; pois até dos fins da terra veio para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão; e eis que mais que Salomão está aqui.
verses.RVR09: La reina del Austro se levantará en juicio con los hombres de esta generación, y los condenará; porque vino de los fines de la tierra á oir la sabiduría de Salomón; y he aquí más que Salomón en este lugar.

verses.KJV: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.WEB: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
verses.ASV: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os homens de Nínive se levantarão em juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão; pois com a pregação de Jonas se converteram; e eis que mais que Jonas está aqui.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres de Nínive se levantarán en juicio con esta generación, y la condenarán; porque á la predicación de Jonás se arrepintieron; y he aquí más que Jonás en este lugar.

verses.KJV: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.WEB: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
verses.ASV: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth it in a cellar, neither under the bushel, but on the stand, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém, acendendo a lâmpada, [a] põe em [lugar] oculto, nem debaixo da caixa, mas na luminária, para que os que entrarem vejam a luz.
verses.RVR09: Nadie pone en oculto la antorcha encendida, ni debajo del almud, sino en el candelero, para que los que entran vean la luz.

verses.KJV: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
verses.WEB: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
verses.ASV: The lamp of thy body is thine eye: when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A lâmpada do corpo é o olho. Sendo pois teu olho bom, também todo teu corpo será luminoso; porém se for mau, também [todo] teu corpo será tenebroso.
verses.RVR09: La antorcha del cuerpo es el ojo: pues si tu ojo fuere simple, también todo tu cuerpo será resplandeciente; mas si fuere malo, también tu cuerpo será tenebroso.

verses.KJV: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
verses.WEB: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
verses.ASV: Look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha pois que a luz que em ti há não sejam trevas.
verses.RVR09: Mira pues, si la lumbre que en ti hay, es tinieblas.

verses.KJV: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
verses.WEB: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
verses.ASV: If therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se sendo teu corpo todo luminoso, não tendo parte alguma escura, ele todo será iluminado, como quando a lâmpada com [seu] brilho te ilumina.
verses.RVR09: Así que, siendo todo tu cuerpo resplandeciente, no teniendo alguna parte de tinieblas, será todo luminoso, como cuando una antorcha de resplandor te alumbra.

verses.KJV: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.WEB: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
verses.ASV: Now as he spake, a Pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando ele [ainda] falando, um fariseu lhe rogou que viesse para jantar com ele; e entrando, sentou-se [à mesa] ;
verses.RVR09: Y luego que hubo hablado, rogóle un Fariseo que comiese con él: y entrado Jesús, se sentó á la mesa.

verses.KJV: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.WEB: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
verses.ASV: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo [-o] o fariseu, maravilhou-se de que não tinha se lavado antes de jantar.
verses.RVR09: Y el Fariseo, como lo vió, maravillóse de que no se lavó antes de comer.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.WEB: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
verses.ASV: And the Lord said unto him, Now ye the Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor lhe disse: Agora vós, os fariseus, limpais o exterior do copo e do prato; porém vosso interior está cheio de roubo e maldade.
verses.RVR09: Y el Señor le dijo: Ahora vosotros los Fariseos lo de fuera del vaso y del plato limpiáis; mas lo interior de vosotros está lleno de rapiña y de maldad.

verses.KJV: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.WEB: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
verses.ASV: Ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?
verses.ALMEIDA: Loucos, o que fez o exterior não fez também o interior?
verses.RVR09: Necios, ¿el que hizo lo de fuera, no hizo también lo de dentro?

verses.KJV: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.WEB: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
verses.ASV: But give for alms those things which are within; and behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém daí de esmola o que tendes; e eis que tudo vos será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Empero de lo que os resta, dad limosna; y he aquí todo os será limpio.

verses.KJV: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.WEB: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
verses.ASV: But woe unto you Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of God: but these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mais ai de vós, fariseus, que dizimais a hortelã, e a arruda, e toda hortaliça; e pelo juízo e amor de Deus passais longe. Estas coisas era necessário fazer, e não deixar as outras.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de vosotros, Fariseos! que diezmáis la menta, y la ruda, y toda hortaliza; mas el juicio y la caridad de Dios pasáis de largo. Pues estas cosas era necesario hacer, y no dejar las otras.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.WEB: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
verses.ASV: Woe unto you Pharisees! for ye love the chief seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the marketplaces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós, fariseus, que amais os primeiros assentos nas sinagogas, e as saudações nas praças.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, Fariseos! que amáis las primeras sillas en las sinagogas, y las salutaciones en las plazas.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
verses.WEB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
verses.ASV: Woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over [them] know it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas, que sois como as sepulturas disfarçadas, e as pessoas que andam sobre elas não sabem.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, escribas y Fariseos, hipócritas! que sois como sepulcros que no se ven, y los hombres que andan encima no lo saben.

verses.KJV: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
verses.WEB: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
verses.ASV: And one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, Teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo um dos estudiosos da Lei, disse-lhe: Mestre, quando dizes isto também afrontas a nós.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo uno de los doctores de la ley, le dice: Maestro, cuando dices esto, también nos afrentas á nosotros.

verses.KJV: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.WEB: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
verses.ASV: And he said, Woe unto you lawyers also! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele disse: Ai de vós também, estudiosos da Lei, que carregais as pessoas com cargas pesadas para levar, e vós mesmos nem ainda com um de vossos dedos tais cargas tocais.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¡Ay de vosotros también, doctores de la ley! que cargáis á los hombres con cargas que no pueden llevar; mas vosotros ni aun con un dedo tocáis las cargas.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.WEB: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.ASV: Woe unto you! for ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós, que construís os sepulcros dos profetas, e vossos pais os mataram.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros! que edificáis los sepulcros de los profetas, y los mataron vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
verses.WEB: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
verses.ASV: So ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build [their tombs].
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem testemunhais pois, que também consentis nas obras de vossos pais; porque eles os mataram, e vós edificais seus sepulcros.
verses.RVR09: De cierto dais testimonio que consentís en los hechos de vuestros padres; porque á la verdad ellos los mataron, mas vosotros edificáis sus sepulcros.

verses.KJV: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.WEB: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
verses.ASV: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send unto them prophets and apostles; and [some] of them they shall kill and persecute;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto também diz a sabedoria de Deus: Profetas e apóstolos lhes mandarei; e deles a [uns] matarão, e a [outros] lançarão fora;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, la sabiduría de Dios también dijo: Enviaré á ellos profetas y apóstoles; y de ellos á unos matarán y á otros perseguirán;

verses.KJV: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.WEB: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
verses.ASV: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que desta geração seja requerido o sangue de todos os profetas, que foi derramado desde a fundação do mundo;
verses.RVR09: Para que de esta generación sea demandada la sangre de todos los profetas, que ha sido derramada desde la fundación del mundo;

verses.KJV: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.WEB: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
verses.ASV: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary: yea, I say unto you, it shall be required of this generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o sangue de Abel, até o sangue de Zacarias, que foi morto entre o altar e a casa [de Deus] ; assim vos digo, será requerido desta geração.
verses.RVR09: Desde la sangre de Abel, hasta la sangre de Zacarías, que murió entre el altar y el templo: así os digo, será demandada de esta generación.

verses.KJV: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
verses.WEB: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
verses.ASV: Woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de vós, estudiosos da Lei, que tomastes a chave do conhecimento; vós mesmos não entrastes, e impedistes aos que estavam entrando.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de vosotros, doctores de la ley! que habéis quitado la llave de la ciencia; vosotros mismos no entrasteis, y á los que entraban impedisteis.

verses.KJV: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
verses.WEB: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
verses.ASV: And when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press upon [him] vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo-lhes estas coisas, os escribas e os fariseus começaram a apertá-lo fortemente, e tentar lhe fazer falar de muitas coisas,
verses.RVR09: Y diciéndoles estas cosas, los escribas y los Fariseos comenzaron á apretarle en gran manera, y á provocarle á que hablase de muchas cosas;

verses.KJV: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
verses.WEB: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
verses.ASV: laying wait for him, to catch something out of his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: armando-lhe ciladas, e procurando caçar alguma coisa de sua boca, para o poderem acusar.
verses.RVR09: Acechándole, y procurando cazar algo de su boca para acusarle.

verses.KJV: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.WEB: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.ASV: In the mean time, when the many thousands of the multitude were gathered together, insomuch that they trod one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntando-se, entretanto, muitos milhares da multidão, tanto que se atropelavam uns aos outros, começou a dizer primeiramente a seus discípulos: Guardai-vos do fermento dos fariseus, que é hipocrisia.
verses.RVR09: EN esto, juntándose muchas gentes, tanto que unos á otros se hollaban, comenzó á decir á sus discípulos, primeramente: Guardaos de la levadura de los Fariseos, que es hipocresía.

verses.KJV: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.WEB: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
verses.ASV: But there is nothing covered up, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nada há encoberto que não haja de ser descoberto; nem oculto que não haja de ser sabido.
verses.RVR09: Porque nada hay encubierto, que no haya de ser descubierto; ni oculto, que no haya de ser sabido.

verses.KJV: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.WEB: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
verses.ASV: Wherefore whatsoever ye have said in the darkness shall be heard in the light; and what ye have spoken in the ear in the inner chambers shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto tudo o que dissestes nas trevas, será ouvido na luz; e o que falastes ao ouvido nos quartos, será pregado sobre os telhados.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, las cosas que dijisteis en tinieblas, á la luz serán oídas; y lo que hablasteis al oído en las cámaras, será pregonado en los terrados.

verses.KJV: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.WEB: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.ASV: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E digo-vos, amigos meus, não temais aos que matam o corpo, e depois não têm mais o que possam fazer.
verses.RVR09: Mas os digo, amigos míos: No temáis de los que matan el cuerpo, y después no tienen más que hacer.

verses.KJV: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.WEB: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
verses.ASV: But I will warn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu vos mostrarei a quem deveis temer; temei a aquele, que depois de matar, [também] tem poder para lançar no inferno; sim, a este temei.
verses.RVR09: Mas os enseñaré á quién temáis: temed á aquel que después de haber quitado la vida, tiene poder de echar en la Gehenna: así os digo: á éste temed.

verses.KJV: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.WEB: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
verses.ASV: Are not five sparrows sold for two pence? and not one of them is forgotten in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se vendem cinco passarinhos por duas pequenas moedas? E nem um deles está esquecido diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿No se venden cinco pajarillos por dos blancas? pues ni uno de ellos está olvidado delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.WEB: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.ASV: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até os cabelos de vossa cabeça estão todos contados; não temais, pois; mais valeis vós que muitos passarinhos.
verses.RVR09: Y aun los cabellos de vuestra cabeza están todos contados. No temáis pues: de más estima sois que muchos pajarillos.

verses.KJV: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.WEB: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, Every one who shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos digo que todo aquele que me confessar diante dos seres humanos, também o Filho do homem o confessará diante dos anjos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y os digo que todo aquel que me confesare delante de los hombres, también el Hijo del hombre le confesará delante de los ángeles de Dios;

verses.KJV: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
verses.WEB: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
verses.ASV: but he that denieth me in the presence of men shall be denied in the presence of the angels of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quem me negar diante dos seres humanos será negado diante dos anjos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que me negare delante de los hombres, será negado delante de los ángeles de Dios.

verses.KJV: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
verses.WEB: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.ASV: And every one who shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todo aquele que disser [alguma] palavra contra o Filho do homem, lhe será perdoado, mas ao que blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo, não lhe será perdoado.
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquel que dice palabra contra el Hijo del hombre, le será perdonado; mas al que blasfemare contra el Espíritu Santo, no le será perdonado.

verses.KJV: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.WEB: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;
verses.ASV: And when they bring you before the synagogues, and the rulers, and the authorities, be not anxious how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vos trouxerem às sinagogas, aos magistrados e autoridades, não estejais ansiosos, como, ou que, em [vossa] defesa deveis dizer, ou que deveis falar.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando os trajeren á las sinagogas, y á los magistrados y potestades, no estéis solícitos cómo ó qué hayáis de responder, ó qué hayáis de decir;

verses.KJV: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
verses.WEB: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
verses.ASV: for the Holy Spirit shall teach you in that very hour what ye ought to say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque na mesma hora o Espírito Santo vos ensinará o que deveis falar.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Espíritu Santo os enseñará en la misma hora lo que será necesario decir.

verses.KJV: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.WEB: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
verses.ASV: And one out of the multitude said unto him, Teacher, bid my brother divide the inheritance with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um da multidão lhe disse: Mestre, dize a meu irmão que reparta a herança comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole uno de la compañía: Maestro, di á mi hermano que parta conmigo la herencia.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.WEB: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
verses.ASV: But he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhe disse: Homem, quem me pôs por juiz, ou repartidor sobre vós?
verses.RVR09: Mas él le dijo: Hombre, ¿quién me puso por juez ó partidor sobre vosotros?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
