verses.WEB: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Take heed, and keep yourselves from all covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Olhai, e tomai cuidado com a ganância; porque a vida de alguém não consiste na abundância dos bens que possui.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Mirad, y guardaos de toda avaricia; porque la vida del hombre no consiste en la abundancia de los bienes que posee.

verses.KJV: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.WEB: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
verses.ASV: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.ALMEIDA: E propôs-lhes uma parábola, dizendo: A terra de um homem rico tinha frutificado bem.
verses.RVR09: Y refirióles una parábola, diciendo: La heredad de un hombre rico había llevado mucho;

verses.KJV: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.WEB: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
verses.ASV: and he reasoned within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have not where to bestow my fruits?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele questionava a si mesmo, dizendo: Que farei? Porque não tenho onde juntar meus frutos.
verses.RVR09: Y él pensaba dentro de sí, diciendo: ¿Qué haré, porque no tengo donde juntar mis frutos?

verses.KJV: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.WEB: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
verses.ASV: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my grain and my goods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Farei isto: derrubarei meus celeiros, e construirei maiores, e ali juntarei toda esta minha colheita, e estes meus bens.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Esto haré: derribaré mis alfolíes, y los edificaré mayores, y allí juntaré todos mis frutos y mis bienes;

verses.KJV: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
verses.WEB: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’
verses.ASV: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, be merry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E direi à minha alma: Alma, muitos bens tens guardados, para muitos anos; descansa, come, bebe, alegra-te!
verses.RVR09: Y diré á mi alma: Alma, muchos bienes tienes almacenados para muchos años; repósate, come, bebe, huélgate.

verses.KJV: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
verses.WEB: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
verses.ASV: But God said unto him, Thou foolish one, this night is thy soul required of thee; and the things which thou hast prepared, whose shall they be?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Deus lhe disse: Louco, esta noite te pedirão tua alma; e o que tens preparado, de quem será?
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Dios: Necio, esta noche vuelven á pedir tu alma; y lo que has prevenido, ¿de quién será?

verses.KJV: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.WEB: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
verses.ASV: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim [é] o que junta tesouros para si, mas não é rico em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Así es el que hace para sí tesoro, y no es rico en Dios.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
verses.WEB: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
verses.ASV: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for [your] life, what ye shall eat; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a seus discípulos: Portanto vos digo, não estejais ansiosos por vossa vida, que comereis; nem pelo corpo, que vestireis.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á sus discípulos: Por tanto os digo: No estéis afanosos de vuestra vida, qué comeréis; ni del cuerpo, qué vestiréis.

verses.KJV: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
verses.WEB: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
verses.ASV: For the life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mais é a vida que o alimento, e [mais] o corpo que o vestido.
verses.RVR09: La vida más es que la comida, y el cuerpo que el vestido.

verses.KJV: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verses.WEB: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
verses.ASV: Consider the ravens, that they sow not, neither reap; which have no store-chamber nor barn; and God feedeth them: of how much more value are ye than the birds!
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai os corvos, que nem semeiam, nem ceifam; nem tem armazém, nem celeiro; e Deus os alimenta.
verses.RVR09: Considerad los cuervos, que ni siembran, ni siegan; que ni tienen cillero, ni alfolí; y Dios los alimenta. ¿Cuánto de más estima sois vosotros que las aves?

verses.KJV: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.WEB: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
verses.ASV: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit unto the measure of his life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem de vós pode, com sua ansiedade, acrescentar um côvado à sua altura?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién de vosotros podrá con afán añadir á su estatura un codo?

verses.KJV: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
verses.WEB: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
verses.ASV: If then ye are not able to do even that which is least, why are ye anxious concerning the rest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se não podeis nem mesmo com algo pequeno, por que estais ansiosos com o resto?
verses.RVR09: Pues si no podéis aun lo que es menos, ¿para qué estaréis afanosos de lo demás?

verses.KJV: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.WEB: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.ASV: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin; yet I say unto you, Even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai os lírios, como crescem; não trabalham, nem fiam; e digo-vos, que nem mesmo Salomão, em toda sua glória, [chegou] a se vestir como um deles.
verses.RVR09: Considerad los lirios, cómo crecen: no labran, ni hilan; y os digo, que ni Salomón con toda su gloria se vistió como uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.WEB: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.ASV: But if God doth so clothe the grass in the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven; how much more [shall he clothe] you, O ye of little faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se assim Deus veste a erva, que hoje está no campo, e amanhá é lançada no forno, quanto mais [vestirá] a vós, homens de pouca fé?
verses.RVR09: Y si así viste Dios á la hierba, que hoy está en el campo, y mañana es echada en el horno; ¿cuánto más á vosotros, hombres de poca fe?

verses.KJV: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
verses.WEB: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
verses.ASV: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, pois, não pergunteis que comereis, ou que bebereis; e não andeis preocupados.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros, pues, no procuréis qué hayáis de comer, ó qué hayáis de beber; ni estéis en ansiosa perplejidad.

verses.KJV: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.WEB: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
verses.ASV: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: but your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todas estas coisas, os gentios do mundo as buscam; mas vosso Pai sabe que necessitais destas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas estas cosas buscan las gentes del mundo; que vuestro Padre sabe que necesitáis estas cosas.

verses.KJV: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.WEB: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
verses.ASV: Yet seek ye his kingdom, and these things shall be added unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas buscai o Reino de Deus, e todas estas coisas vos serão acrescentadas.
verses.RVR09: Mas procurad el reino de Dios, y todas estas cosas os serán añadidas.

verses.KJV: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.WEB: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
verses.ASV: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, ó pequeno rebanho; porque vosso Pai se agradou de dar a vós o Reino.
verses.RVR09: No temáis, manada pequeña; porque al Padre ha placido daros el reino.

verses.KJV: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.WEB: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
verses.ASV: Sell that which ye have, and give alms; make for yourselves purses which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief draweth near, neither moth destroyeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendei o que tendes, e daí esmola. Fazei para vós bolsas que não se envelheçam; tesouro nos céus que nunca se deprecia; onde ladrão não chega, nem a traça destrói.
verses.RVR09: Vended lo que poseéis, y dad limosna; haceos bolsas que no se envejecen, tesoro en los cielos que nunca falta; donde ladrón no llega, ni polilla corrompe.

verses.KJV: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.WEB: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.ASV: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aonde estiver vosso tesouro, ali estará também vosso coração.
verses.RVR09: Porque donde está vuestro tesoro, allí también estará vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
verses.WEB: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
verses.ASV: Let your loins be girded about, and your lamps burning;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estejam devidamente vestidos vossos quadris, e acesas as lâmpadas.
verses.RVR09: Estén ceñidos vuestros lomos, y vuestras antorchas encendidas;

verses.KJV: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.WEB: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
verses.ASV: and be ye yourselves like unto men looking for their lord, when he shall return from the marriage feast; that, when he cometh and knocketh, they may straightway open unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sede vós semelhantes às pessoas que esperam a seu senhor quando voltar do casamento; para que quando ele vier, e bater, logo possam lhe abrir.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros semejantes á hombres que esperan cuando su señor ha de volver de las bodas; para que cuando viniere y llamare, luego le abran.

verses.KJV: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.
verses.ASV: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and shall come and serve them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados aqueles servos, os quais, quando o Senhor vier, [os] achar vigiando; em verdade vos digo que ele se vestirá, e os fará se sentarem [à mesa] ,e chegando-se, os servirá.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados aquellos siervos, á los cuales cuando el Señor viniere, hallare velando: de cierto os digo, que se ceñirá, y hará que se sienten á la mesa, y pasando les servirá.

verses.KJV: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
verses.WEB: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.
verses.ASV: And if he shall come in the second watch, and if in the third, and find [them] so, blessed are those [servants].
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que venha à segunda vigília; e [que] venha a terceira vigília, e assim [os] achar, bem-aventurados são tais servos.
verses.RVR09: Y aunque venga á la segunda vigilia, y aunque venga á la tercera vigilia, y los hallare así, bienaventurados son los tales siervos.

verses.KJV: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.WEB: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.ASV: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not have left his house to be broken through.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto, porém, sabei: que se o chefe da casa soubesse à que hora o ladrão viria, ele vigiaria, e não deixaria sua casa sofrer dano.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero sabed, que si supiese el padre de familia á qué hora había de venir el ladrón, velaría ciertamente, y no dejaría minar su casa.

verses.KJV: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
verses.WEB: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
verses.ASV: Be ye also ready: for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, pois, também estejais prontos; porque o Filho do homem virá à hora que não imaginais.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros pues también, estad apercibidos; porque á la hora que no pensáis, el Hijo del hombre vendrá.

verses.KJV: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.WEB: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
verses.ASV: And Peter said, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even unto all?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe disse: Senhor, dizes tu esta parábola para nós, ou também para todos?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro le dijo: Señor, ¿dices esta parábola á nosotros, ó también á todos?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
verses.WEB: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
verses.ASV: And the Lord said, Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall set over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor disse: Qual é, pois, o mordomo fiel e prudente, a quem [seu] senhor puser sobre seus servos, para que [lhes] dê alimento no tempo certo?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el Señor: ¿Quién es el mayordomo fiel y prudente, al cual el señor pondrá sobre su familia, para que á tiempo les dé su ración?

verses.KJV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.WEB: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
verses.ASV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado aquele servo ao qual, quando seu senhor vier, o achar fazendo assim.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado aquel siervo, al cual, cuando el señor viniere, hallare haciendo así.

verses.KJV: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
verses.WEB: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
verses.ASV: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que o porá sobre todos os seus bens.
verses.RVR09: En verdad os digo, que él le pondrá sobre todos sus bienes.

verses.KJV: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.WEB: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,
verses.ASV: But if that servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se aquele servo disser em seu coração: Meu senhor está demorando para vir; e começar a espancar aos servos e servas, e a comer, e a beber, e a se embebedar,
verses.RVR09: Mas si el tal siervo dijere en su corazón: Mi señor tarda en venir: y comenzare á herir á los siervos y á las criadas, y á comer y á beber y á embriagarse;

verses.KJV: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.WEB: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
verses.ASV: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not, and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the unfaithful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virá o senhor daquele servo, no dia em que ele não espera, e na hora que ele não sabe; e será partido em dois, e porá sua porção com os incrédulos.
verses.RVR09: Vendrá el señor de aquel siervo el día que no espera, y á la hora que no sabe, y le apartará, y pondrá su parte con los infieles.

verses.KJV: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
verses.WEB: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
verses.ASV: And that servant, who knew his lord’s will, and made not ready, nor did according to his will, shall be beaten with many [stripes];
verses.ALMEIDA: E o servo que sabia a vontade de seu senhor, e não se preparou, nem fez conforme a sua vontade, será muito espancado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el siervo que entendió la voluntad de su señor, y no se apercibió, ni hizo conforme á su voluntad, será azotado mucho.

verses.KJV: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.WEB: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
verses.ASV: but he that knew not, and did things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few [stripes]. And to whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required: and to whom they commit much, of him will they ask the more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que não sabia, e fez [coisas] dignas de pancadas, será pouco espancado. E a qualquer que muito for dado, muito se lhe pedirá, e ao que muito se confiou, muito mais lhe será exigido.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que no entendió, é hizo cosas dignas de azotes, será azotado poco: porque á cualquiera que fué dado mucho, mucho será vuelto á demandar de él; y al que encomendaron mucho, más le será pedido.

verses.KJV: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.WEB: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
verses.ASV: I came to cast fire upon the earth; and what do I desire, if it is already kindled?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vim para lançar fogo na terra; e o que mais posso querer, se já está aceso?
verses.RVR09: Fuego vine á meter en la tierra: ¿y qué quiero, si ya está encendido?

verses.KJV: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.WEB: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
verses.ASV: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém há um batismo que tenho que ser batizado; e como me angustio até que se venha a cumprir!
verses.RVR09: Empero de bautismo me es necesario ser bautizado: y ¡cómo me angustio hasta que sea cumplido!

verses.KJV: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.WEB: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
verses.ASV: Think ye that I am come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós pensais que vim para dar paz à terra? Não, eu vos digo; mas antes [vim para trazer] divisão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Pensáis que he venido á la tierra á dar paz? No, os digo; mas disensión.

verses.KJV: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.WEB: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.ASV: for there shall be from henceforth five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque daqui em diante cinco estarão divididos em uma casa; três contra dois, e dois contra três.
verses.RVR09: Porque estarán de aquí adelante cinco en una casa divididos; tres contra dos, y dos contra tres.

verses.KJV: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.WEB: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
verses.ASV: They shall be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother in law against her daughter in law, and daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pai estará dividido contra o filho, e o filho contra o pai; a mãe contra a filha, e a filha contra a mãe; a sogra contra sua nora, e a nora contra sua sogra.
verses.RVR09: El padre estará dividido contra el hijo, y el hijo contra el padre; la madre contra la hija, y la hija contra la madre; la suegra contra su nuera, y la nuera contra su suegra.

verses.KJV: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
verses.WEB: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
verses.ASV: And he said to the multitudes also, When ye see a cloud rising in the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it cometh to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele dizia também para as multidões: Quando vedes a nuvem que vem do ocidente, logo dizeis: Lá vem chuva; E assim acontece.
verses.RVR09: Y decía también á las gentes: Cuando veis la nube que sale del poniente, luego decís: Agua viene; y es así.

verses.KJV: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.WEB: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
verses.ASV: And when [ye see] a south wind blowing, ye say, There will be a scorching heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando venta do sul, dizeis: Haverá calor; E assim acontece.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando sopla el austro, decís: Habrá calor; y lo hay.

verses.KJV: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.WEB: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
verses.ASV: Ye hypocrites, ye know how to interpret the face of the earth and the heaven; but how is it that ye know not how to interpret this time?
verses.ALMEIDA: Hipócritas! Sabeis entender a aparência da terra e do céu; e como não entendeis este tempo?
verses.RVR09: ¡Hipócritas! Sabéis examinar la faz del cielo y de la tierra; ¿y cómo no reconocéis este tiempo?

verses.KJV: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.WEB: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
verses.ASV: And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que também não julgais por vós mesmos o que é justo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué aun de vosotros mismos no juzgáis lo que es justo?

verses.KJV: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.WEB: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
verses.ASV: For as thou art going with thine adversary before the magistrate, on the way give diligence to be quit of him; lest haply he drag thee unto the judge, and the judge shall deliver thee to the officer, and the officer shall cast thee into prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando fores com teu adversário à autoridade, procura te livrares dele no caminho, para que ele não venha a te levar ao juiz, e o juiz te entregue ao oficial de justiça, e o oficial de justiça te lance na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Pues cuando vas al magistrado con tu adversario, procura en el camino librarte de él; porque no te arrastre al juez, y el juez te entregue al alguacil, y el alguacil te meta en la cárcel.

verses.KJV: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.WEB: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
verses.ASV: I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the very last mite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te digo que não sairás dali enquanto não pagares até a última moeda.
verses.RVR09: Te digo que no saldrás de allá, hasta que hayas pagado hasta el último maravedí.

verses.KJV: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.WEB: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verses.ASV: Now there were some present at that very season who told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele mesmo tempo estavam ali presentes alguns, que lhe contavam dos galileus cujo sangue Pilatos tinha misturado com seus sacrifícios.
verses.RVR09: Y EN este mismo tiempo estaban allí unos que le contaban acerca de los Galileos, cuya sangre Pilato había mezclado con sus sacrificios.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Think ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they have suffered these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Vós pensais que estes galileus foram mais pecadores, por terem sofrido estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: ¿Pensáis que estos Galileos, porque han padecido tales cosas, hayan sido más pecadores que todos los Galileos?

verses.KJV: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.WEB: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
verses.ASV: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all in like manner perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.
verses.RVR09: No, os digo; antes si no os arrepintiereis, todos pereceréis igualmente.

verses.KJV: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.WEB: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
verses.ASV: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them, think ye that they were offenders above all the men that dwell in Jerusalem?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou aqueles dezoito, sobre os quais a torre em Siloé caiu, matando-os; pensais que eram mais culpados dos que todos as pessoas que moravam em Jerusalém?
verses.RVR09: O aquellos dieciocho, sobre los cuales cayó la torre en Siloé, y los mató, ¿pensáis que ellos fueron más deudores que todos los hombres que habitan en Jerusalem?

verses.KJV: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.WEB: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
verses.ASV: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.
verses.RVR09: No, os digo; antes si no os arrepintiereis, todos pereceréis asimismo.

verses.KJV: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.WEB: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
verses.ASV: And he spake this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came seeking fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia esta parábola: Um certo [homem] tinha uma figueira plantada em sua vinha, e veio até ela para buscar fruto, e não achou.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo esta parábola: Tenía uno una higuera plantada en su viña, y vino á buscar fruto en ella, y no lo halló.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.WEB: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’
verses.ASV: And he said unto the vinedresser, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why doth it also cumber the ground?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao que cuidava da vinha: Eis que há três anos, que venho para buscar fruto nesta figueira, e não [o] acho; corta-a; por que ainda ocupa inutilmente a terra?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al viñero: He aquí tres años ha que vengo á buscar fruto en esta higuera, y no lo hallo; córtala, ¿por qué ocupará aún la tierra?

verses.KJV: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
verses.WEB: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
verses.ASV: And he answering saith unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo ele, disse-lhe: Senhor, deixa-a [ainda] este ano, até que eu a escave ao redor, e a adube;
verses.RVR09: El entonces respondiendo, le dijo: Señor, déjala aún este año, hasta que la excave, y estercole.

verses.KJV: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
verses.WEB: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
verses.ASV: and if it bear fruit thenceforth, [well]; but if not, thou shalt cut it down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se der fruto, [deixa-a ficar] ; se não, tu a cortarás depois.
verses.RVR09: Y si hiciere fruto, bien; y si no, la cortarás después.

verses.KJV: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.WEB: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
verses.ASV: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinava em uma das sinagogas num sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y enseñaba en una sinagoga en sábado.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
verses.WEB: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
verses.ASV: And behold, a woman that had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bowed together, and could in no wise lift herself up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que estava ali uma mulher, que havia dezoito anos que tinha um espírito de enfermidade; e andava encurvada, e de maneira nenhuma ela podia se endireitar.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí una mujer que tenía espíritu de enfermedad dieciocho años, y andaba agobiada, que en ninguna manera se podía enhestar.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.WEB: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus vendo-a, chamou-a para si, e disse-lhe: Mulher, livre estás de tua enfermidade.
verses.RVR09: Y como Jesús la vió, llamóla, y díjole: Mujer, libre eres de tu enfermedad.

verses.KJV: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.WEB: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
verses.ASV: And he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs as mãos sobre ela, e logo ela se endireitou, e glorificava a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y puso las manos sobre ella; y luego se enderezó, y glorificaba á Dios.

verses.KJV: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
verses.ASV: And the ruler of the synagogue, being moved with indignation because Jesus had healed on the sabbath, answered and said to the multitude, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the day of the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe da sinagoga, irritado por Jesus ter curado no sábado, respondendo, disse à multidão: Há seis dias em que se deve trabalhar; nestes dias, pois, vinde para ser curados, e não no dia de sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el príncipe de la sinagoga, enojado de que Jesús hubiese curado en sábado, dijo á la compañía: Seis días hay en que es necesario obrar: en estos, pues, venid y sed curados, y no en día de sábado.

verses.KJV: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
verses.ASV: But the Lord answered him, and said, Ye hypocrites, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o Senhor lhe respondeu, e disse: Hipócrita, no sábado cada um de vós não desata seu boi ou jumento da manjedoura, e o leva para dar de beber?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el Señor le respondió, y dijo: Hipócrita, cada uno de vosotros ¿no desata en sábado su buey ó su asno del pesebre, y lo lleva á beber?

verses.KJV: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.WEB: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
verses.ASV: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound, lo, [these] eighteen years, to have been loosed from this bond on the day of the sabbath?
verses.ALMEIDA: E não convinha soltar desta ligadura no dia de sábado a esta [mulher] ,que é filha de Abraão, a qual, eis que Satanás já a havia ligado há dezoito anos?
verses.RVR09: Y á esta hija de Abraham, que he aquí Satanás la había ligado dieciocho años, ¿no convino desatarla de esta ligadura en día de sábado?

verses.KJV: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.WEB: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.ASV: And as he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame: and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, dizendo estas coisas, todos seus adversários ficaram envergonhados; e todo o povo se alegrava de todas as coisas gloriosas que eram feitas por ele.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo estas cosas, se avergonzaban todos sus adversarios: mas todo el pueblo se gozaba de todas las cosas gloriosas que eran por él hechas.

verses.KJV: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.WEB: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
verses.ASV: He said therefore, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I liken it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia: A que o Reino de Deus é semelhante? E a que eu o compararei?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿A qué es semejante el reino de Dios, y á qué le compararé?

verses.KJV: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.WEB: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
verses.ASV: It is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his own garden; and it grew, and became a tree; and the birds of the heaven lodged in the branches thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhante é ao grão da mostarda, que um homem, tomando-o, lançou-o em sua horta; e cresceu, e fez-se uma grande árvore, e as aves dos céus fizeram ninhos em seus ramos.
verses.RVR09: Semejante es al grano de la mostaza, que tomándolo un hombre lo metió en su huerto; y creció, y fué hecho árbol grande, y las aves del cielo hicieron nidos en sus ramas.

verses.KJV: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.WEB: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
verses.ASV: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse outra vez: A que compararei o Reino de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez dijo: ¿A qué compararé el reino de Dios?

verses.KJV: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.WEB: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
verses.ASV: It is like unto leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhante é ao fermento, que a mulher, tomando-o, o escondeu em três medidas de farinha, até tudo ficar levedado.
verses.RVR09: Semejante es á la levadura, que tomó una mujer, y la escondió en tres medidas de harina, hasta que todo hubo fermentado.

verses.KJV: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And he went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and journeying on unto Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andava de cidade em cidade, e de aldeia em aldeia ensinando, e caminhando para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y pasaba por todas las ciudades y aldeas, enseñando, y caminando á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.WEB: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
verses.ASV: And one said unto him, Lord, are they few that are saved? And he said unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe um: Senhor, são também poucos os que se salvam? E ele lhes disse:
verses.RVR09: Y díjole uno: Señor, ¿son pocos los que se salvan? Y él les dijo:

verses.KJV: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.WEB: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
verses.ASV: Strive to enter in by the narrow door: for many, I say unto you, shall seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trabalhai para entrar pela porta estreita; porque eu vos digo, [que] muitos procuraram entrar, e não puderam.
verses.RVR09: Porfiad á entrar por la puerta angosta; porque os digo que muchos procurarán entrar, y no podrán.

verses.KJV: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
verses.WEB: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
verses.ASV: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, open to us; and he shall answer and say to you, I know you not whence ye are;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando o chefe da casa se levantar, e fechar a porta, e se estiverdes de fora, e começardes a bater à porta, dizendo: Senhor, senhor, abre-nos! E respondendo ele, vos disser: Não vos conheço, [nem sei] de onde vós sois.
verses.RVR09: Después que el padre de familia se levantare, y cerrare la puerta, y comenzareis á estar fuera, y llamar á la puerta, diciendo: Señor, Señor, ábrenos; y respondiendo os dirá: No os conozco de dónde seáis.

verses.KJV: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
verses.WEB: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.ASV: then shall ye begin to say, We did eat and drink in thy presence, and thou didst teach in our streets;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então começareis a dizer: Em tua presença temos comido e bebido, e tens ensinado em nossas ruas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces comenzaréis á decir: Delante de ti hemos comido y bebido, y en nuestras plazas enseñaste;

verses.KJV: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
verses.ASV: and he shall say, I tell you, I know not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele dirá: Digo-vos que não vos conheço, [nem sei] de onde vós sois; afastai-vos de mim, vós todos praticantes de injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Y os dirá: Dígoos que no os conozco de dónde seáis; apartaos de mí todos los obreros de iniquidad.

verses.KJV: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
verses.WEB: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
verses.ASV: There shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and yourselves cast forth without.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes, quando virdes a Abraão, a Isaque, a Jacó, e a todos os profetas no Reino de Deus; mas vós [sendo] lançados fora.
verses.RVR09: Allí será el llanto y el crujir de dientes, cuando viereis á Abraham, y á Isaac, y á Jacob, y á todos los profetas en el reino de Dios, y vosotros excluídos.

verses.KJV: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: And they shall come from the east and west, and from the north and south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão [pessoas] do oriente, e do ocidente, e do norte, e do sul, e se sentarão [à mesa] no Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán del Oriente y del Occidente, del Norte y del Mediodía, y se sentarán á la mesa en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.WEB: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
verses.ASV: And behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que há [alguns] dos últimos que serão primeiros, e há [alguns] dos primeiros que serão últimos.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, son postreros los que eran los primeros; y son primeros los que eran los postreros.

verses.KJV: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
verses.WEB: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
verses.ASV: In that very hour there came certain Pharisees, saying to him, Get thee out, and go hence: for Herod would fain kill thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele mesmo dia, chegaram uns fariseus, dizendo-lhe: Sai, e vai-te daqui, porque Herodes quer te matar.
verses.RVR09: Aquel mismo día llegaron unos de los Fariseos, diciéndole: Sal, y vete de aquí, porque Herodes te quiere matar.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Go and say to that fox, Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures to-day and to-morrow, and the third [day] I am perfected.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Ide, e dizei a aquela raposa: eis que expulso demônios, e faço curas hoje e amanhã, e ao terceiro dia eu terei completado.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Id, y decid á aquella zorra: He aquí, echo fuera demonios y acabo sanidades hoy y mañana, y al tercer día soy consumado.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
verses.ASV: Nevertheless I must go on my way to-day and to-morrow and the [day] following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém é necessário que hoje, e amanhã, e no [dia] seguinte eu caminhe; porque um profeta não pode morrer fora de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Empero es menester que hoy, y mañana, y pasado mañana camine; porque no es posible que profeta muera fuera de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.WEB: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
verses.ASV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen [gathereth] her own brood under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.ALMEIDA: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas aos profetas, e apedrejas aos que te são enviados: quantas vezes eu quis juntar teus filhos, como a galinha junta seus pintos debaixo de suas asas, e não quisestes?
verses.RVR09: ¡Jerusalem, Jerusalem! que matas á los profetas, y apedreas á los que son enviados á ti: ¡cuántas veces quise juntar tus hijos, como la gallina sus pollos debajo de sus alas, y no quisiste!

verses.KJV: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
verses.ASV: Behold, your house is left unto you [desolate]: and I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vossa casa é deixada deserta para vós. E em verdade vos digo, que não me vereis até que venha [o tempo] em que digais: Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, os es dejada vuestra casa desierta: y os digo que no me veréis, hasta que venga tiempo cuando digáis: Bendito el que viene en nombre del Señor.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.WEB: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, entrando ele num sábado para comer pão na casa de um dos chefes dos fariseus, eles estavam o observando.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que entrando en casa de un príncipe de los Fariseos un sábado á comer pan, ellos le acechaban.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.WEB: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
verses.ASV: And behold, there was before him a certain man that had the dropsy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um certo homem com o corpo inchado estava ali diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un hombre hidrópico estaba delante de él.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.WEB: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath, or not?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, falou aos estudiosos da Lei, e aos fariseus, dizendo: É lícito curar no sábado?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Jesús, habló á los doctores de la ley y á los Fariseos, diciendo: ¿Es lícito sanar en sábado?

verses.KJV: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
verses.WEB: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
verses.ASV: But they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles ficaram calados; e ele, tomando [-o] ,o curou, e [o] despediu.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos callaron. Entonces él tomándole, le sanó, y despidióle.

verses.KJV: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.WEB: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a well, and will not straightway draw him up on a sabbath day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, respondendo-lhes, disse: De qual que vós cairá o jumento, ou o boi em algum poço que, [mesmo] no sábado, não o tire logo?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo á ellos dijo: ¿El asno ó el buey de cuál de vosotros caerá en algún pozo, y no lo sacará luego en día de sábado?

verses.KJV: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.WEB: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
verses.ASV: And they could not answer again unto these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nada podiam lhe responder a estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y no le podían replicar á estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them.
verses.WEB: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
verses.ASV: And he spake a parable unto those that were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief seats; saying unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo como os convidados escolhiam os primeiros assentos, disse-lhes uma parábola:
verses.RVR09: Y observando cómo escogían los primeros asientos á la mesa, propuso una parábola á los convidados, diciéndoles:

verses.KJV: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
verses.WEB: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
verses.ASV: When thou art bidden of any man to a marriage feast, sit not down in the chief seat; lest haply a more honorable man than thou be bidden of him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando fores convidados para o casamento de alguém, não te sentes no primeiro assento, para que não [aconteça de] se outro convidado mais digno que tu estiver,
verses.RVR09: Cuando fueres convidado de alguno á bodas, no te sientes en el primer lugar, no sea que otro más honrado que tú esté por él convidado,

verses.KJV: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.WEB: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
verses.ASV: and he that bade thee and him shall come and say to thee, Give this man place; and then thou shalt begin with shame to take the lowest place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E venha o que convidou a ti e a ele, e te diga: Dá lugar a este; E então, com vergonha, tenhas que tomar o último lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo el que te llamó á ti y á él, te diga: Da lugar á éste: y entonces comiences con vergüenza á tener el lugar último.

verses.KJV: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
verses.WEB: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
verses.ASV: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when he that hath bidden thee cometh, he may say to thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have glory in the presence of all that sit at meat with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando fores convidado, vai, e senta-te no último lugar; para que quando vier o que te convidou, te diga: Amigo, sobe para [este assento] melhor. Então terás honra diante dos que estiverem sentados contigo [à mesa] .
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando fueres convidado, ve, y siéntate en el postrer lugar; porque cuando viniere el que te llamó, te diga: Amigo, sube arriba: entonces tendrás gloria delante de los que juntamente se asientan á la mesa.

verses.KJV: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
verses.ASV: For every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qualquer que exaltar a si mesmo, e aquele que humilhar a si mesmo, será exaltado.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que se ensalza, será humillado; y el que se humilla, será ensalzado.

verses.KJV: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
verses.WEB: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
verses.ASV: And he said to him also that had bidden him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbors; lest haply they also bid thee again, and a recompense be made thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia também ao que tinha lhe convidado: Quando fizeres um jantar, ou uma ceia, não chames a teus amigos, nem a teus irmãos, nem a teus parentes, nem a [teus] vizinhos ricos, para que eles também em algum tempo não te convidem de volta, e tu sejas recompensado.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo también al que le había convidado: Cuando haces comida ó cena, no llames á tus amigos, ni á tus hermanos, ni á tus parientes, ni á vecinos ricos; porque también ellos no te vuelvan á convidar, y te sea hecha compensación.

verses.KJV: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.WEB: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
verses.ASV: But when thou makest a feast, bid the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando fizeres convite, chama aos pobres, aleijados, mancos [e] cegos.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando haces banquete, llama á los pobres, los mancos, los cojos, los ciegos;

verses.KJV: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.WEB: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
verses.ASV: and thou shalt be blessed; because they have not [wherewith] to recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed in the resurrection of the just.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serás bem-aventurado, porque não eles não têm como te recompensar; pois tu serás recompensado na ressurreição dos justos.
verses.RVR09: Y serás bienaventurado; porque no te pueden retribuir; mas te será recompensado en la resurrección de los justos.

verses.KJV: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
verses.ASV: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos que juntamente estavam sentados [à mesa] , ouvindo isto, disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado aquele que comer pão no Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto uno de los que juntamente estaban sentados á la mesa, le dijo: Bienaventurado el que comerá pan en el reino de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.WEB: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
verses.ASV: But he said unto him, A certain man made a great supper; and he bade many:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhe disse: Um certo homem fez um grande jantar, e convidou a muitos.
verses.RVR09: El entonces le dijo: Un hombre hizo una grande cena, y convidó á muchos.

verses.KJV: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.WEB: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
verses.ASV: and he sent forth his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for [all] things are now ready.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na hora do jantar, mandou seu servo para dizer aos convidados: Vinde, que tudo já está preparado.
verses.RVR09: Y á la hora de la cena envió á su siervo á decir á los convidados: Venid, que ya está todo aparejado.

verses.KJV: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.WEB: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
verses.ASV: And they all with one [consent] began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a field, and I must needs go out and see it; I pray thee have me excused.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada um deles todos começou a dar desculpas. O primeiro lhe disse: Comprei um campo, e tenho que ir vê-lo; peço-te desculpas.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzaron todos á una á excusarse. El primero le dijo: He comprado una hacienda, y necesito salir y verla; te ruego que me des por excusado.

verses.KJV: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.WEB: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
verses.ASV: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee have me excused.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outro disse: Comprei cinco pares de bois, e vou testá-los; peço-te desculpas.
verses.RVR09: Y el otro dijo: He comprado cinco yuntas de bueyes, y voy á probarlos; ruégote que me des por excusado.

verses.KJV: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.WEB: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
verses.ASV: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outro disse: Casei-me [com] uma mulher, e portanto não posso vir.
verses.RVR09: Y el otro dijo: Acabo de casarme, y por tanto no puedo ir.

verses.KJV: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.WEB: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
verses.ASV: And the servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor and maimed and blind and lame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele servo, ao voltar, anunciou estas coisas a seu senhor. Então o chefe da casa, irritado, disse a seu servo: Sai depressa pelas ruas e praças da cidade, e traze aqui aos pobres, e aleijados, e mancos e cegos.
verses.RVR09: Y vuelto el siervo, hizo saber estas cosas á su señor. Entonces enojado el padre de la familia, dijo á su siervo: Ve presto por las plazas y por las calles de la ciudad, y mete acá los pobres, los mancos, y cojos, y ciegos.

verses.KJV: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.WEB: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
verses.ASV: And the servant said, Lord, what thou didst command is done, and yet there is room.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o servo disse: Senhor, está feito como mandaste, e ainda há lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el siervo: Señor, hecho es como mandaste, y aun hay lugar.

verses.KJV: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.WEB: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.ASV: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and constrain [them] to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o senhor disse ao servo: Sai pelos caminhos, e trilhas, e força-os a entrar, para que minha casa se encha.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el señor al siervo: Ve por los caminos y por los vallados, y fuérzalos á entrar, para que se llene mi casa.

verses.KJV: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.WEB: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”
verses.ASV: For I say unto you, that none of those men that were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu vos digo, que nenhum daqueles homens que foram convidados experimentará da minha ceia.
verses.RVR09: Porque os digo que ninguno de aquellos hombres que fueron llamados, gustará mi cena.

verses.KJV: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.WEB: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
verses.ASV: Now there went with him great multitudes: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas multidões iam com ele; e virando-se, disse-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Y muchas gentes iban con él; y volviéndose les dijo:

verses.KJV: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.WEB: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
verses.ASV: If any man cometh unto me, and hateth not his own father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém vier a mim, e não odiar a seu pai, e mãe, e mulher, e filhos, e irmãos, e irmãs, e ainda também sua própria vida, não pode ser meu discípulo.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno viene á mí, y no aborrece á su padre, y madre, y mujer, é hijos, y hermanos, y hermanas, y aun también su vida, no puede ser mi discípulo.

verses.KJV: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.WEB: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
verses.ASV: Whosoever doth not bear his own cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer que não levar sua cruz, e vier após mim, não pode ser meu discípulo.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que no trae su cruz, y viene en pos de mí, no puede ser mi discípulo.

verses.KJV: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verses.WEB: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
verses.ASV: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doth not first sit down and count the cost, whether he have [wherewith] to complete it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qual de vós, querendo edificar uma torre, não se senta primeiro para fazer as contas dos gastos, [para ver] se tem o [suficiente] para a completar?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿cuál de vosotros, queriendo edificar una torre, no cuenta primero sentado los gastos, si tiene lo que necesita para acabarla?

verses.KJV: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
verses.WEB: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
verses.ASV: Lest haply, when he hath laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, all that behold begin to mock him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não aconteça que, depois de ter posto seu fundamento, e não podendo a completar, comecem a escarnecer dele todos os que [o] virem,
verses.RVR09: Porque después que haya puesto el fundamento, y no pueda acabarla, todos los que lo vieren, no comiencen á hacer burla de él,

verses.KJV: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.WEB: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’
verses.ASV: saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Este homem começou a construir, e não pôde terminar.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Este hombre comenzó á edificar, y no pudo acabar.

verses.KJV: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.WEB: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.ASV: Or what king, as he goeth to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and take counsel whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou qual rei, indo a guerra para lutar contra outro rei, não se senta primeiro para consultar, se pode ir ao encontro com dez mil [soldados] , vindo contra ele vinte mil?
verses.RVR09: ¿O cuál rey, habiendo de ir á hacer guerra contra otro rey, sentándose primero no consulta si puede salir al encuentro con diez mil al que viene contra él con veinte mil?

verses.KJV: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
verses.WEB: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.
verses.ASV: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and asketh conditions of peace.

verses.KJV: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

verses.RVR09: Y viniendo á casa, junta á los amigos y á los vecinos, diciéndoles: Dadme el parabién, porque he hallado mi oveja que se había perdido.

verses.KJV: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.WEB: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
verses.ASV: I say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, [more] than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.

verses.RVR09: Os digo, que así habrá más gozo en el cielo de un pecador que se arrepiente, que de noventa y nueve justos, que no necesitan arrepentimiento.

verses.KJV: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

verses.ASV: Or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently until she find it?

verses.KJV: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.WEB: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

verses.RVR09: Y cuando la hubiere hallado, junta las amigas y las vecinas, diciendo: Dadme el parabién, porque he hallado la dracma que había perdido.

verses.KJV: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

verses.ASV: Even so, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim vos digo, que há alegria diante dos anjos de Deus por um pecador que se arrepende.
verses.RVR09: Así os digo que hay gozo delante de los ángeles de Dios por un pecador que se arrepiente.

verses.KJV: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Un hombre tenía dos hijos;

verses.KJV: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
verses.WEB: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.
verses.ASV: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of [thy] substance that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

verses.KJV: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.WEB: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
verses.ASV: And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together and took his journey into a far country; and there he wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de não muitos dias, o filho mais jovem, juntando tudo, partiu-se para uma terra distante, e ali desperdiçou seus bens, vivendo de forma irresponsável.
verses.RVR09: Y no muchos días después, juntándolo todo el hijo menor, partió lejos á una provincia apartada; y allí desperdició su hacienda viviendo perdidamente.

verses.KJV: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.WEB: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
verses.ASV: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that country; and he began to be in want.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tendo já gastado tudo, houve uma grande fome naquela terra, e ele começou a sofrer necessidade.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando todo lo hubo malgastado, vino una grande hambre en aquella provincia, y comenzóle á faltar.

verses.KJV: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.WEB: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.ASV: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

verses.RVR09: Y fué y se llegó á uno de los ciudadanos de aquella tierra, el cual le envió á su hacienda para que apacentase los puercos.

verses.KJV: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.WEB: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
verses.ASV: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

verses.RVR09: Y deseaba henchir su vientre de las algarrobas que comían los puercos; mas nadie se las daba.

verses.KJV: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.WEB: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
verses.ASV: But when he came to himself he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish here with hunger!
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, pensando consigo mesmo, disse: Quantos empregados de meu pai tem pão em abundância, e eu [aqui] morro de fome!
verses.RVR09: Y volviendo en sí, dijo: ¡Cuántos jornaleros en casa de mi padre tienen abundancia de pan, y yo aquí perezco de hambre!

verses.KJV: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

verses.RVR09: Me levantaré, é iré á mi padre, y le diré: Padre, he pecado contra el cielo, y contra ti;

verses.KJV: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

verses.KJV: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
