verses.RVR09: Mas el padre dijo á sus siervos: Sacad el principal vestido, y vestidle; y poned un anillo en su mano, y zapatos en sus pies.

verses.KJV: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

verses.ASV: and bring the fatted calf, [and] kill it, and let us eat, and make merry:

verses.WEB: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

verses.ASV: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

verses.ASV: And he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.

verses.RVR09: Y llamando á uno de los criados, preguntóle qué era aquello.

verses.KJV: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

verses.ASV: But he was angry, and would not go in: and his father came out, and entreated him.

verses.KJV: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

verses.KJV: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

verses.KJV: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

verses.KJV: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

verses.ASV: And he called him, and said unto him, What is this that I hear of thee? render the account of thy stewardship; for thou canst be no longer steward.

verses.KJV: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.WEB: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
verses.ASV: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do, seeing that my lord taketh away the stewardship from me? I have not strength to dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o mordomo para si mesmo: O que farei, agora que meu senhor está me tirando o trabalho de mordomo? Cavar eu não posso; mendigar eu tenho vergonha.

verses.KJV: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

verses.ASV: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei o que farei, para que, quando eu for expulso do meu trabalho de mordomo, me recebam em suas casas.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé lo que haré para que cuando fuere quitado de la mayordomía, me reciban en sus casas.

verses.KJV: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.WEB: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
verses.ASV: And calling to him each one of his lord’s debtors, he said to the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamando a si a cada um dos devedores de seu senhor, disse ao primeiro: Quanto deves a meu senhor?
verses.RVR09: Y llamando á cada uno de los deudores de su señor, dijo al primero: ¿Cuánto debes á mi señor?

verses.KJV: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
verses.WEB: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
verses.ASV: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bond, and sit down quickly and write fifty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Cem medidas de azeite. E disse-lhe: Pega a tua conta, senta, e escreve logo cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Cien barriles de aceite. Y le dijo: Toma tu obligación, y siéntate presto, y escribe cincuenta.

verses.KJV: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
verses.WEB: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.ASV: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, A hundred measures of wheat. He saith unto him, Take thy bond, and write fourscore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse a outro: E tu, quanto deves? E ele disse: Cem volumes de trigo. E disse-lhe: Toma tua conta, e escreve oitenta.
verses.RVR09: Después dijo á otro: ¿Y tú, cuánto debes? Y él dijo: Cien coros de trigo. Y él le dijo: Toma tu obligación, y escribe ochenta.

verses.KJV: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
verses.WEB: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
verses.ASV: And his lord commended the unrighteous steward because he had done wisely: for the sons of this world are for their own generation wiser than the sons of the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele senhor elogiou o injusto mordomo, por ter feito prudentemente; porque os filhos deste mundo são mais prudentes do que os filhos da luz com esta geração.
verses.RVR09: Y alabó el señor al mayordomo malo por haber hecho discretamente; porque los hijos de este siglo son en su generación más sagaces que los hijos de luz.

verses.KJV: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
verses.WEB: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
verses.ASV: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends by means of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when it shall fail, they may receive you into the eternal tabernacles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos digo: fazei amigos para vós com as riquezas da injustiça, para que quando vos faltar, vos recebam nos tabernáculos eternos.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os digo: Haceos amigos de las riquezas de maldad, para que cuando faltareis, os reciban en las moradas eternas.

verses.KJV: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
verses.WEB: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
verses.ASV: He that is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much: and he that is unrighteous in a very little is unrighteous also in much.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é fiel no mínimo, também é fiel no muito; e quem é injusto no mínimo, também é injusto no muito.
verses.RVR09: El que es fiel en lo muy poco, también en lo más es fiel: y el que en lo muy poco es injusto, también en lo más es injusto.

verses.KJV: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.WEB: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.ASV: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true [riches]?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se nas riquezas da injustiça não fostes fiéis, quem vos confiará as verdadeiras [riquezas] ?
verses.RVR09: Pues si en las malas riquezas no fuisteis fieles, ¿quién os confiará lo verdadero?

verses.KJV: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
verses.WEB: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
verses.ASV: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se nas [coisas] dos outros não fostes fiéis, quem vos dará o que é vosso?
verses.RVR09: Y si en lo ajeno no fuisteis fieles, ¿quién os dará lo que es vuestro?

verses.KJV: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.WEB: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
verses.ASV: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum servo pode servir a dois senhores; porque ou irá odiar a um, e a amar ao outro; ou irá se achegar a um, e desprezar ao outro. Não podeis servir a Deus e às riquezas.
verses.RVR09: Ningún siervo puede servir á dos señores; porque ó aborrecerá al uno y amará al otro, ó se allegará al uno y menospreciará al otro. No podéis servir á Dios y á las riquezas.

verses.KJV: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
verses.ASV: And the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all these things; and they scoffed at him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os fariseus também ouviram todas estas coisas, eles que eram avarentos. E zombaram dele.
verses.RVR09: Y oían también todas estas cosas los Fariseos, los cuales eran avaros, y se burlaban de él.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Ye are they that justify yourselves in the sight of men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Vós sois os que justificais a vós mesmos diante dos seres humanos; mas Deus conhece vossos corações. Porque o que é excelente para os seres humanos é odiável diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Vosotros sois los que os justificáis á vosotros mismos delante de los hombres; mas Dios conoce vuestros corazones; porque lo que los hombres tienen por sublime, delante de Dios es abominación.

verses.KJV: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
verses.WEB: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
verses.ASV: The law and the prophets [were] until John: from that time the gospel of the kingdom of God is preached, and every man entereth violently into it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Lei e os profetas [foram] até João; desde então, o Reino de Deus é anunciado, todo homem [tenta entrar] nele pela força.
verses.RVR09: La ley y los profetas hasta Juan: desde entonces el reino de Dios es anunciado, y quienquiera se esfuerza á entrar en él.

verses.KJV: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.WEB: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
verses.ASV: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tittle of the law to fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: E é mais fácil passar o céu e a terra do que cair um traço de alguma letra da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Empero más fácil cosa es pasar el cielo y la tierra, que frustrarse un tilde de la ley.

verses.KJV: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
verses.WEB: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
verses.ASV: Every one that putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth one that is put away from a husband committeth adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer que deixa sua mulher, e casa com outra, adultera; e qualquer que se casa com a deixada pelo marido, [também] adultera.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que repudia á su mujer, y se casa con otra, adultera: y el que se casa con la repudiada del marido, adultera.

verses.KJV: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
verses.WEB: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
verses.ASV: Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, faring sumptuously every day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia porém um certo homem rico, e vestia-se de púrpura, e de linho finíssimo, e festejava todo dia com luxo.
verses.RVR09: Había un hombre rico, que se vestía de púrpura y de lino fino, y hacía cada día banquete con esplendidez.

verses.KJV: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.WEB: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
verses.ASV: and a certain beggar named Lazarus was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia também um certo mendigo, de nome Lázaro, o qual ficava deitado à sua porta cheio de feridas.
verses.RVR09: Había también un mendigo llamado Lázaro, el cual estaba echado á la puerta de él, lleno de llagas,

verses.KJV: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.WEB: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.ASV: and desiring to be fed with the [crumbs] that fell from the rich man’s table; yea, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desejava se satisfazer com as migalhas que caíam da mesa do rico; porém vinham também os cães, e lambiam suas feridas.
verses.RVR09: Y deseando hartarse de las migajas que caían de la mesa del rico; y aun los perros venían y le lamían las llagas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
verses.WEB: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and that he was carried away by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: and the rich man also died, and was buried.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que o mendigo morreu, e foi levado pelos anjos para o colo de Abraão. E o rico também morreu, e foi sepultado.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que murió el mendigo, y fué llevado por los ángeles al seno de Abraham: y murió también el rico, y fué sepultado.

verses.KJV: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.WEB: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
verses.ASV: And in Hades he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando no Xeol em tormentos, ele levantou seus olhos, e viu a Abraão de longe, e a Lázaro junto dele.
verses.RVR09: Y en el infierno alzó sus ojos, estando en los tormentos, y vió á Abraham de lejos, y á Lázaro en su seno.

verses.KJV: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
verses.WEB: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
verses.ASV: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am in anguish in this flame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, chamando, disse: Pai Abraão, tem misericórdia de mim, e manda a Lázaro que molhe a ponta de seu dedo na água, e refresque a minha língua; porque estou sofrendo neste fogo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él, dando voces, dijo: Padre Abraham, ten misericordia de mí, y envía á Lázaro que moje la punta de su dedo en agua, y refresque mi lengua; porque soy atormentado en esta llama.

verses.KJV: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
verses.WEB: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.
verses.ASV: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and Lazarus in like manner evil things: but now here he is comforted, and thou art in anguish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Abraão disse: Filho, lembra-te que em tua vida recebeste teus bens, e Lázaro do mesmo jeito [recebeu] males. E agora este é consolado, e tu [és] atormentado.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Abraham: Hijo, acuérdate que recibiste tus bienes en tu vida, y Lázaro también males; mas ahora éste es consolado aquí, y tú atormentado.

verses.KJV: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
verses.WEB: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
verses.ASV: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that they that would pass from hence to you may not be able, and that none may cross over from thence to us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, além de tudo isto, um grande abismo está posto entre nós e vós, para os que quisessem passar daqui para vós não possam; nem também os daí passarem para cá.
verses.RVR09: Y además de todo esto, una grande sima está constituída entre nosotros y vosotros, que los que quisieren pasar de aquí á vosotros, no pueden, ni de allá pasar acá.

verses.KJV: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
verses.WEB: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—
verses.ASV: And he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ele: Rogo-te, pois, ó pai, que o mandes à casa de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Ruégote pues, padre, que le envíes á la casa de mi padre;

verses.KJV: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.WEB: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
verses.ASV: for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tenho cinco irmãos, para que lhes dê testemunho; para que também não venham para este lugar de tormento.
verses.RVR09: Porque tengo cinco hermanos; para que les testifique, porque no vengan ellos también á este lugar de tormento.

verses.KJV: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.WEB: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
verses.ASV: But Abraham saith, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Abraão: Eles têm a Moisés e aos profetas, ouçam-lhes.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham le dice: A Moisés y á los profetas tienen: óiganlos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.WEB: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
verses.ASV: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one go to them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Não, pai Abraão; mas se alguém dos mortos fosse até eles, eles se arrependeriam.
verses.RVR09: El entonces dijo: No, padre Abraham: mas si alguno fuere á ellos de los muertos, se arrepentirán.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
verses.WEB: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, if one rise from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém [Abraão] lhe disse: Se não ouvem a Moisés e aos profetas, também não se deixariam convencer, ainda que alguém ressuscite dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Abraham le dijo: Si no oyen á Moisés y á los profetas, tampoco se persuadirán, si alguno se levantare de los muertos.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
verses.WEB: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
verses.ASV: And he said unto his disciples, It is impossible but that occasions of stumbling should come; but woe unto him, through whom they come!
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos discípulos: É impossível que não venham tentações para o pecado, mas ai [daquele] por quem [essas tentações] vierem!
verses.RVR09: Y Á SUS discípulos dice: Imposible es que no vengan escándalos; mas ¡ay de aquél por quien vienen!

verses.KJV: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.WEB: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.ASV: It were well for him if a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor lhe seria que lhe atasse ao pescoço uma grande pedra de moinho, e fosse lançado no mar, do que conduzir ao pecado um destes pequenos.
verses.RVR09: Mejor le fuera, si le pusiesen al cuello una piedra de molino, y le lanzasen en el mar, que escandalizar á uno de estos pequeñitos.

verses.KJV: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.WEB: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
verses.ASV: Take heed to yourselves: if thy brother sin, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai por vós. E se teu irmão pecar contra ti, repreende-o; e se ele se arrepender, perdoa-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Mirad por vosotros: si pecare contra ti tu hermano, repréndele; y si se arrepintiere, perdónale.

verses.KJV: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.WEB: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
verses.ASV: And if he sin against thee seven times in the day, and seven times turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se pecar contra ti sete vezes ao dia, e se sete vezes ao dia voltar a ti, dizendo: Estou arrependido. Perdoa-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y si siete veces al día pecare contra ti, y siete veces al día se volviere á ti, diciendo, pésame, perdónale.

verses.KJV: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.WEB: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
verses.ASV: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os apóstolos disseram ao Senhor: Acrescenta-nos fé.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los apóstoles al Señor: Auméntanos la fe.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.WEB: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verses.ASV: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye would say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou rooted up, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor disse: Se tivésseis fé como um grão de mostarda, diríeis a esta árvore de amoras: Arranca-te daqui pelas tuas raízes, e planta-te no mar, ela vos obedeceria.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el Señor dijo: Si tuvieseis fe como un grano de mostaza, diréis á este sicómoro: Desarráigate, y plántate en el mar; y os obedecerá.

verses.KJV: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.WEB: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
verses.ASV: But who is there of you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say unto him, when he is come in from the field, Come straightway and sit down to meat;
verses.ALMEIDA: E qual de vós terá um servo, lavrando ou apascentando [gado] que, voltando do campo, logo lhe diga: Chega, e senta [à mesa] .
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién de vosotros tiene un siervo que ara ó apacienta, que vuelto del campo le diga luego: Pasa, siéntate á la mesa?

verses.KJV: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.WEB: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
verses.ASV: and will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.ALMEIDA: E não lhe diga antes: Prepara-me o jantar, e apronta-te, e serve-me, até que eu tenha comido e bebido; e depois, que tu comas e bebas.
verses.RVR09: ¿No le dice antes: Adereza qué cene, y arremángate, y sírveme hasta que haya comido y bebido; y después de esto, come tú y bebe?

verses.KJV: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.WEB: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
verses.ASV: Doth he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso [o senhor] agradece a tal servo, porque fez o que lhe foi mandado? Acho que não.
verses.RVR09: ¿Da gracias al siervo porque hizo lo que le había sido mandado? Pienso que no.

verses.KJV: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.WEB: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
verses.ASV: Even so ye also, when ye shall have done all the things that are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which it was our duty to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, quando fizerdes tudo o que vos for mandado, dizei: Somos servos inúteis, porque fizemos [somente] o que devíamos fazer.

verses.RVR09: Entonces uno de ellos, como se vió que estaba limpio, volvió, glorificando á Dios á gran voz;

verses.RVR09: Y derribóse sobre el rostro á sus pies, dándole gracias: y éste era Samaritano.

verses.ASV: Were there none found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger?

verses.RVR09: ¿No hubo quien volviese y diese gloria á Dios sino este extranjero?

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Arise, and go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Levántate, vete; tu fe te ha salvado.

verses.WEB: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
verses.ASV: And being asked by the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God cometh, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

verses.RVR09: Y preguntado por los Fariseos, cuándo había de venir el reino de Dios, les respondió y dijo: El reino de Dios no vendrá con advertencia;

verses.KJV: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
verses.WEB: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
verses.ASV: neither shall they say, Lo, here! or, There! for lo, the kingdom of God is within you.

verses.RVR09: Ni dirán: Helo aquí, ó helo allí: porque he aquí el reino de Dios entre vosotros está.

verses.KJV: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

verses.KJV: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
verses.WEB: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
verses.ASV: And they shall say to you, Lo, there! Lo, here! go not away, nor follow after [them]:

verses.RVR09: Y os dirán: Helo aquí, ó helo allí. No vayáis, ni sigáis.

verses.KJV: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.WEB: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
verses.ASV: for as the lightning, when it lighteneth out of the one part under the heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall the Son of man be in his day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque como o relâmpago, que relampeja desde o começo do céu, e brilha até ao fim do céu, assim será também o Filho do homem em seu dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque como el relámpago, relampagueando desde una parte de debajo del cielo, resplandece hasta la otra debajo del cielo, así también será el Hijo del hombre en su día.

verses.KJV: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.WEB: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.ASV: But first must he suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas é necessário primeiro sofrer muito, e ser rejeitado por esta geração.
verses.RVR09: Mas primero es necesario que padezca mucho, y sea reprobado de esta generación.

verses.KJV: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.WEB: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
verses.ASV: And as it came to pass in the days of Noah, even so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como aconteceu nos dias de Noé, assim será também nos dias do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y como fué en los días de Noé, así también será en los días del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.WEB: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.ASV: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

verses.RVR09: Comían, bebían, los hombres tomaban mujeres, y las mujeres maridos, hasta el día que entró Noé en el arca; y vino el diluvio, y destruyó á todos.

verses.KJV: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.WEB: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
verses.ASV: Likewise even as it came to pass in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

verses.RVR09: Asimismo también como fué en los días de Lot; comían, bebían, compraban, vendían, plantaban, edificaban;

verses.WEB: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
verses.ASV: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all:

verses.RVR09: Mas el día que Lot salió de Sodoma, llovió del cielo fuego y azufre, y destruyó á todos:

verses.RVR09: Como esto será el día en que el Hijo del hombre se manifestará.

verses.KJV: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.WEB: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
verses.ASV: In that day, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and let him that is in the field likewise not return back.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, o que estiver no telhado, e suas ferramentas em casa, não desça para pegá-las; e o que [estiver] no campo, não volte para trás.

verses.ASV: Remember Lot’s wife.

verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que procurare salvar su vida, la perderá; y cualquiera que la perdiere, la salvará.

verses.KJV: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.WEB: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

verses.WEB: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
verses.ASV: There shall be two women grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

verses.ASV: And he spake a parable unto them to the end that they ought always to pray, and not to faint;

verses.KJV: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

verses.ASV: saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, and regarded not man:

verses.ASV: and there was a widow in that city; and she came oft unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

verses.KJV: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.WEB: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
verses.ASV: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.ALMEIDA: E por um [certo] tempo ele não quis; mas depois disto, disse para si: Ainda que eu não tema a Deus, nem respeite pessoa alguma,
verses.RVR09: Pero él no quiso por algún tiempo; mas después de esto dijo dentro de sí: Aunque ni temo á Dios, ni tengo respeto á hombre,

verses.KJV: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.WEB: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
verses.ASV: yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest she wear me out by her continual coming.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, porque esta viúva me incomoda, eu lhe farei justiça, para que ela pare de vir me chatear.
verses.RVR09: Todavía, porque esta viuda me es molesta, le haré justicia, porque al fin no venga y me muela.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.WEB: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
verses.ASV: And the Lord said, Hear what the unrighteous judge saith.

verses.KJV: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus não fará justiça para seus escolhidos, que clamam a ele de dia e de noite? Demorará com eles?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y Dios no hará justicia á sus escogidos, que claman á él día y noche, aunque sea longánime acerca de ellos?

verses.KJV: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.WEB: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
verses.ASV: I say unto you, that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo-vos que depressa lhes fará justiça. Porém, quando o Filho do homem vier, por acaso ele achará fé na terra?
verses.RVR09: Os digo que los defenderá presto. Empero cuando el Hijo del hombre viniere, ¿hallará fe en la tierra?

verses.KJV: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.WEB: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:
verses.ASV: And he spake also this parable unto certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and set all others at nought:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse também a uns, que tinham confiança de si mesmos que eram justos, e desprezavam aos outros, esta parábola:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo también á unos que confiaban de sí como justos, y menospreciaban á los otros, esta parábola:

verses.KJV: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

verses.ASV: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

verses.RVR09: Dos hombres subieron al templo á orar: el uno Fariseo, el otro publicano.

verses.KJV: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.WEB: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.ASV: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as the rest of men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fariseu, estando de pé, orava consigo desta maneira: Ó Deus, eu te agradeço, porque não sou como os outros homens, ladrões, injustos e adúlteros; nem [sou] como este publicano.
verses.RVR09: El Fariseo, en pie, oraba consigo de esta manera: Dios, te doy gracias, que no soy como los otros hombres, ladrones, injustos, adúlteros, ni aun como este publicano;

verses.KJV: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.WEB: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
verses.ASV: I fast twice in the week; I give tithes of all that I get.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jejuo duas vezes por semana, [e] dou dízimo de tudo quanto possuo.
verses.RVR09: Ayuno dos veces á la semana, doy diezmos de todo lo que poseo.

verses.KJV: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.WEB: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
verses.ASV: But the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote his breast, saying, God, be thou merciful to me a sinner.

verses.RVR09: Mas el publicano estando lejos no quería ni aun alzar los ojos al cielo, sino que hería su pecho, diciendo: Dios, sé propicio á mí pecador.

verses.KJV: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

verses.RVR09: Os digo que éste descendió á su casa justificado antes que el otro; porque cualquiera que se ensalza, será humillado; y el que se humilla, será ensalzado.

verses.KJV: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

verses.ASV: And they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E traziam-lhe também crianças pequenas, para que as tocasse; e os discípulos, vendo, os repreendiam.

verses.KJV: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
verses.ASV: But Jesus called them unto him, saying, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus, chamando-lhes para si, disse: Deixai as crianças virem a mim, e não as impeçais; porque das tais é o Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús llamándolos, dijo: Dejad los niños venir á mí, y no los impidáis; porque de tales es el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.WEB: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que qualquer que não receber o Reino de Deus como criança, não entrará nele.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que cualquiera que no recibiere el reino de Dios como un niño, no entrará en él.

verses.KJV: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.WEB: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.ASV: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E um certo líder lhe perguntou, dizendo: Bom mestre, o que tenho que fazer para herdar a vida eterna?
verses.RVR09: Y preguntóle un príncipe, diciendo: Maestro bueno, ¿qué haré para poseer la vida eterna?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
verses.WEB: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, [even] God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas de bom? Ninguém [é] bom, a não ser um: Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: ¿Por qué me llamas bueno? ninguno hay bueno sino sólo Dios.

verses.KJV: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.WEB: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
verses.ASV: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor thy father and mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu sabes os mandamentos: não adulterarás, não matarás, não furtarás, não darás falso testemunho, honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Los mandamientos sabes: No matarás: No adulterarás: No hurtarás: No dirás falso testimonio: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre.

verses.KJV: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.WEB: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
verses.ASV: And he said, All these things have I observed from my youth up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Todas estas coisas tenho guardado desde minha juventude.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Todas estas cosas he guardado desde mi juventud.

verses.KJV: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.WEB: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus heard it, he said unto him, One thing thou lackest yet: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus, ouvindo isto, disse-lhe: Ainda uma coisa te falta: vende tudo quanto tens, e reparte-o entre os pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, segue-me.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, oído esto, le dijo: Aun te falta una cosa: vende todo lo que tienes, y da á los pobres, y tendrás tesoro en el cielo; y ven, sígueme.

verses.KJV: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.WEB: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
verses.ASV: But when he heard these things, he became exceeding sorrowful; for he was very rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, ouvindo isto, ficou muito triste, porque era muito rico.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él, oídas estas cosas, se puso muy triste, porque era muy rico.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.WEB: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
verses.ASV: And Jesus seeing him said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Jesus que ele tinha ficado muito triste, disse: Como é difícil os que têm [muitos] bens entrarem no Reino de Deus!
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Jesús que se había entristecido mucho, dijo: ¡Cuán dificultosamente entrarán en el reino de Dios los que tienen riquezas!

verses.KJV: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é mais fácil um camelo entrar pelo olho de uma agulha do que um rico entrar no Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque más fácil cosa es entrar un camello por el ojo de una aguja, que un rico entrar en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
verses.WEB: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
verses.ASV: And they that heard it said, Then who can be saved?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que ouviram [isto] ,disseram: Quem então pode se salvar?
verses.RVR09: Y los que lo oían, dijeron: ¿Y quién podrá ser salvo?

verses.KJV: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.WEB: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
verses.ASV: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: As coisas que são impossíveis para os seres humanos são possíveis para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Lo que es imposible para con los hombres, posible es para Dios.

verses.KJV: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.WEB: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
verses.ASV: And Peter said, Lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro disse: Eis que deixamos tudo, e temos te seguido.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro dijo: He aquí, nosotros hemos dejado las posesiones nuestras, y te hemos seguido.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or wife, or brethren, or parents, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo, que há ninguém que, tenha deixado casa, ou pais, ou irmãos, ou mulher, ou filhos,
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: De cierto os digo, que nadie hay que haya dejado casa, padres, ó hermanos, ó mujer, ó hijos, por el reino de Dios,

verses.KJV: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.WEB: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
verses.ASV: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que não venha a receber de volta muito mais nestes tempos, e nos tempos vindouros [receba] a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Que no haya de recibir mucho más en este tiempo, y en el siglo venidero la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.WEB: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
verses.ASV: And he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets shall be accomplished unto the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando consigo aos doze, disse-lhes: Eis que estamos subindo a Jerusalém, e se cumprirá no Filho do homem tudo o que [está] escrito pelos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, tomando á los doce, les dijo: He aquí subimos á Jerusalem, y serán cumplidas todas las cosas que fueron escritas por los profetas, del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.WEB: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
verses.ASV: For he shall be delivered up unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele será entregue aos gentios, e escarnecido, injuriado e cuspido.
verses.RVR09: Porque será entregado á las gentes, y será escarnecido, é injuriado, y escupido.

verses.KJV: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.WEB: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
verses.ASV: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [depois de] açoitá-lo, o matarão; e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.
verses.RVR09: Y después que le hubieren azotado, le matarán: mas al tercer día resucitará.

verses.KJV: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.WEB: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
verses.ASV: And they understood none of these things; and this saying was hid from them, and they perceived not the things that were said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles nada entendiam destas coisas; e esta palavra lhes era oculta; e não entendiam o que estava sendo lhes dito.
verses.RVR09: Pero ellos nada de estas cosas entendían, y esta palabra les era encubierta, y no entendían lo que se decía.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.WEB: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he drew nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ele, chegando perto de Jericó, estava um cego sentado junto ao caminho, mendigando.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que acercándose él á Jericó, un ciego estaba sentado junto al camino mendigando;

verses.KJV: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.WEB: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
verses.ASV: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este, ouvindo a multidão passar, perguntou: O que era aquilo?
verses.RVR09: El cual como oyó la gente que pasaba, preguntó qué era aquello.

verses.KJV: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.WEB: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verses.ASV: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram-lhe que Jesus Nazareno estava passando.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle que pasaba Jesús Nazareno.

verses.KJV: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.WEB: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.ASV: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamou, dizendo: Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!
verses.RVR09: Entonces dió voces, diciendo: Jesús, Hijo de David, ten misericordia de mí.

verses.KJV: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.WEB: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.ASV: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estavam mais a frente o repreendiam, para que calasse; porém ele clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!
verses.RVR09: Y los que iban delante, le reñían que callase; mas él clamaba mucho más: Hijo de David, ten misericordia de mí.

verses.KJV: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.WEB: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
verses.ASV: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus, parando, mandou que o trouxessem para si; e chegando ele, perguntou-lhe,
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces parándose, mandó traerle á sí: y como él llegó, le preguntó,

verses.KJV: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.WEB: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
verses.ASV: What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Que queres que eu te faça?E ele disse: Senhor, que eu veja.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Qué quieres que te haga? Y él dijo: Señor, que vea.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Vê, tua fé te salvou.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Ve, tu fe te ha hecho salvo.

verses.KJV: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
verses.WEB: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
verses.ASV: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo ele viu, e o seguia, glorificando a Deus. E o todo o povo, vendo [isto] , dava louvores a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y luego vió, y le seguía, glorificando á Dios: y todo el pueblo como lo vió, dió á Dios alabanza.

verses.KJV: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.WEB: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
verses.ASV: And he entered and was passing through Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jesus] entrou e foi passando por Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Y HABIENDO entrado Jesús, iba pasando por Jericó;

verses.KJV: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.WEB: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
verses.ASV: And behold, a man called by name Zacchæus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que havia ali um homem, chamado pelo nome de Zaqueu, e este era chefe dos publicanos, e era rico.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un varón llamado Zaqueo, el cual era el principal de los publicanos, y era rico;

verses.KJV: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.WEB: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
verses.ASV: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.
verses.ALMEIDA: E procurava ver quem era Jesus, e não podia, por causa da multidão, pois era pequeno de altura.
verses.RVR09: Y procuraba ver á Jesús quién fuese; mas no podía á causa de la multitud, porque era pequeño de estatura.

verses.KJV: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.WEB: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
verses.ASV: And he ran on before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E correndo com antecedência, subiu em uma árvore de frutos que parecem figos, para o ver; porque ele passaria por ali.
verses.RVR09: Y corriendo delante, subióse á un árbol sicómoro para verle; porque había de pasar por allí.

verses.KJV: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.WEB: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
verses.ASV: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to-day I must abide at thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Jesus chegou a aquele lugar, olhando para cima, o viu, e disse-lhe: Zaqueu, apressa-te, e desce; porque hoje é necessário que eu fique em tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino á aquel lugar Jesús, mirando, le vió, y díjole: Zaqueo, date priesa, desciende, porque hoy es necesario que pose en tu casa.

verses.KJV: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.WEB: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.ASV: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apressando-se, desceu, e o recebeu com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él descendió apriesa, y le recibió gozoso.

verses.KJV: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.WEB: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
verses.ASV: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos, vendo [isto] , murmuravam, dizendo: Ele entrou para se hospedar com um homem pecador.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto, todos murmuraban, diciendo que había entrado á posar con un hombre pecador.

verses.KJV: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.WEB: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
verses.ASV: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord, Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, I restore fourfold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zaqueu, levantando-se, disse ao Senhor: Senhor, eis que dou a metade de meus bens aos pobres; e se eu consegui algo enganando a alguém, eu [o] devolvo quatro vezes mais.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Zaqueo, puesto en pie, dijo al Señor: He aquí, Señor, la mitad de mis bienes doy á los pobres; y si en algo he defraudado á alguno, lo vuelvo con el cuatro tanto.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, To-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhe disse: Hoje houve salvação nesta casa, porque ele também é filho de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús le dijo: Hoy ha venido la salvación á esta casa; por cuanto él también es hijo de Abraham.

verses.KJV: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.WEB: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
verses.ASV: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Filho do homem veio para buscar, e para salvar o que tinha se perdido.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Hijo del hombre vino á buscar y á salvar lo que se había perdido.

verses.KJV: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.WEB: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
verses.ASV: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and [because] they supposed that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo eles estas coisas, [Jesus] prosseguiu, e disse uma parábola, porque estava perto de Jerusalém, e pensavam que logo o Reino seria manifesto.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo ellos estas cosas, prosiguió Jesús y dijo una parábola, por cuanto estaba cerca de Jerusalem, y porque pensaban que luego había de ser manifestado el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.WEB: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
verses.ASV: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois: Um certo homem nobre partiu para uma terra distante.
verses.RVR09: Dijo pues: Un hombre noble partió á una provincia lejos, para tomar para sí un reino, y volver.

verses.KJV: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.WEB: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
verses.ASV: And he called ten servants of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said unto them, Trade ye [herewith] till I come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamando dez servos seus, deu-lhes dez minas, e disse-lhes: Investi até que eu venha;
verses.RVR09: Mas llamados diez siervos suyos, les dió diez minas, y díjoles: Negociad entre tanto que vengo.

verses.KJV: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.WEB: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
verses.ASV: But his citizens hated him, and sent an ambassage after him, saying, We will not that this man reign over us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus cidadãos o odiavam; e mandaram representantes depois dele, dizendo: Não queremos que este reine sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Empero sus ciudadanos le aborrecían, y enviaron tras de él una embajada, diciendo: No queremos que éste reine sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.WEB: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he was come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, unto whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by trading.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando ele voltou, tendo tomado o reino, disse que lhe chamassem a aqueles servos, a quem tinha dado o dinheiro, para saber o que cada um tinha ganho fazendo investimentos.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que vuelto él, habiendo tomado el reino, mandó llamar á sí á aquellos siervos á los cuales había dado el dinero, para saber lo que había negociado cada uno.

verses.KJV: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.WEB: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
verses.ASV: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio o primeiro, dizendo: Senhor, tua mina rendeu outras dez minas.
verses.RVR09: Y vino el primero, diciendo: Señor, tu mina ha ganado diez minas.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.WEB: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Well done, thou good servant: because thou wast found faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Ótimo, bom servo! Por teres sido fiel no pouco, terás autoridade sobre dez cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dice: Está bien, buen siervo; pues que en lo poco has sido fiel, tendrás potestad sobre diez ciudades.

verses.KJV: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.WEB: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
verses.ASV: And the second came, saying, Thy pound, Lord, hath made five pounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio o segundo, dizendo: Senhor, tua mina rendeu cinco minas.
verses.RVR09: Y vino otro, diciendo: Señor, tu mina ha hecho cinco minas.

verses.KJV: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.WEB: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.ASV: And he said unto him also, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse também a este: E tu [governarás] cinco cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y también á éste dijo: Tú también sé sobre cinco ciudades.

verses.KJV: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.WEB: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
verses.ASV: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, [here is] thy pound, which I kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio outro, dizendo: Eis aqui tua mina, que guardei em um lenço.
verses.RVR09: Y vino otro, diciendo: Señor, he aquí tu mina, la cual he tenido guardada en un pañizuelo:

verses.KJV: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.WEB: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
verses.ASV: for I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou didst not sow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tive medo de ti, que és um homem rigoroso, que tomas o que não puseste, e colhes o que não semeaste.
verses.RVR09: Porque tuve miedo de ti, que eres hombre recio; tomas lo que no pusiste, y siegas lo que no sembraste.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.WEB: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
verses.ASV: He saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I am an austere man, taking up that which I laid not down, and reaping that which I did not sow;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhe disse: Servo mau, por tua boca eu te julgarei; tu sabias que eu era um homem rigoroso, que tomo o que não pus, e que colho o que não semeei;
verses.RVR09: Entonces él le dijo: Mal siervo, de tu boca te juzgo. Sabías que yo era hombre recio, que tomo lo que no puse, y que siego lo que no sembré;

verses.KJV: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.WEB: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
verses.ASV: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and I at my coming should have required it with interest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que, então, não puseste meu dinheiro no banco; e quando eu viesse, o receberia de volta com juros?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué, pues, no diste mi dinero al banco, y yo viniendo lo demandara con el logro?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.WEB: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
verses.ASV: And he said unto them that stood by, Take away from him the pound, and give it unto him that hath the ten pounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos que estavam com ele: Tirai-lhe a mina, e dai-a ao que tem as dez minas.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á los que estaban presentes: Quitadle la mina, y dadla al que tiene las diez minas.

verses.KJV: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.WEB: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe disseram: Senhor, ele [já] tem dez minas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le dijeron: Señor, tiene diez minas.

verses.KJV: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.WEB: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
verses.ASV: I say unto you, that unto every one that hath shall be given; but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: [O senhor respondeu:] Porque eu vos digo, que todo aquele que tiver, lhe será dado; mas ao que não tiver, até o que tem, lhe será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Pues yo os digo que á cualquiera que tuviere, le será dado; mas al que no tuviere, aun lo que tiene le será quitado.

verses.KJV: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.WEB: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
verses.ASV: But these mine enemies, that would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a aqueles meus inimigos, que não quiseram que eu reinasse sobre eles, trazei [- os] aqui, e matai [-os] diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y también á aquellos mis enemigos que no querían que yo reinase sobre ellos, traedlos acá, y degolladlos delante de mí.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And when he had thus spoken, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dito isto, ele foi caminhando adiante, subindo para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y dicho esto, iba delante subiendo á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.WEB: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he drew nigh unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called Olivet, he sent two of the disciples,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, chegando perto de Betfagé, e de Betânia, ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, mandou a dois de seus discípulos,
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que llegando cerca de Bethfagé, y de Bethania, al monte que se llama de las Olivas, envió dos de sus discípulos,

verses.KJV: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.WEB: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.
verses.ASV: saying, Go your way into the village over against [you]; in which as ye enter ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat: loose him, and bring him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Ide à aldeia que está em frente; onde, ao entrardes, achareis um potro atado, em que ninguém jamais se sentou; soltai-o, e trazei [-o] .
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Id á la aldea de enfrente; en la cual como entrareis, hallaréis un pollino atado, en el que ningún hombre se ha sentado jamás; desatadlo, y traedlo.

verses.KJV: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.WEB: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
verses.ASV: And if any one ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém vos perguntar: Por que [o] soltais? Direis assim a ele: Porque o Senhor precisa dele.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguien os preguntare, ¿por qué lo desatáis? le responderéis así: Porque el Señor lo ha menester.

verses.KJV: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.WEB: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.
verses.ASV: And they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo os que tinham sido mandados, acharam como lhes disse:
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los que habían sido enviados, y hallaron como les dijo.

verses.KJV: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.WEB: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
verses.ASV: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.ALMEIDA: E soltando o potro, seus donos lhe disseram: Por que soltais o potro?
verses.RVR09: Y desatando ellos el pollino, sus dueños les dijeron: ¿Por qué desatáis el pollino?

verses.KJV: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.WEB: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
verses.ASV: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles disseram: O Senhor precisa dele.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: Porque el Señor lo ha menester.

verses.KJV: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.WEB: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.
verses.ASV: And they brought him to Jesus: and they threw their garments upon the colt, and set Jesus thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o trouxeram a Jesus; e lançando suas roupas sobre o potro, puseram Jesus montado nele.
verses.RVR09: Y trajéronlo á Jesús; y habiendo echado sus vestidos sobre el pollino, pusieron á Jesús encima.

verses.KJV: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.WEB: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
verses.ASV: And as he went, they spread their garments in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo ele andando, estendiam suas roupas pelo caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo él tendían sus capas por el camino.

verses.KJV: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.WEB: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
verses.ASV: And as he was now drawing nigh, [even] at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando já chegava perto da descida do monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão de discípulos, com alegria começou a louvar a Deus em alta voz, por todas as maravilhas que tinham visto,
verses.RVR09: Y como llegasen ya cerca de la bajada del monte de las Olivas, toda la multitud de los discípulos, gozándose, comenzaron á alabar á Dios á gran voz por todas las maravillas que habían visto,

verses.KJV: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.WEB: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
verses.ASV: saying, Blessed [is] the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Bendito o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor; paz no céu, e glória nas alturas.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¡Bendito el rey que viene en el nombre del Señor: paz en el cielo, y gloria en lo altísimo!

verses.KJV: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.WEB: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
verses.ASV: And some of the Pharisees from the multitude said unto him, Teacher, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos fariseus da multidão lhe disseram: Mestre, repreende a teus discípulos.
