verses.RVR09: Entonces algunos de los Fariseos de la compañía, le dijeron: Maestro, reprende á tus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, I tell you that, if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Digo-vos, que se estes se calarem, as pedras clamariam.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondiendo, les dijo: Os digo que si éstos callaren, las piedras clamarán.

verses.KJV: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.WEB: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
verses.ASV: And when he drew nigh, he saw the city and wept over it,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando já estava chegando, viu a cidade, e chorou por causa dela,
verses.RVR09: Y como llegó cerca, viendo la ciudad, lloró sobre ella,

verses.KJV: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.WEB: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
verses.ASV: saying, If thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Ah, se tu também conhecesses, pelo menos neste teu dia, aquilo que lhe traria paz! Mas agora [isto] está escondido de teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¡Oh si también tú conocieses, á lo menos en este tu día, lo que toca á tu paz! mas ahora está encubierto de tus ojos.

verses.KJV: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.WEB: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
verses.ASV: For the days shall come upon thee, when thine enemies shall cast up a bank about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque dias virão sobre ti, em que teus inimigos lhe cercarão com barricadas, e ao redor te sitiarão, e lhe pressionarão por todos os lados.
verses.RVR09: Porque vendrán días sobre ti, que tus enemigos te cercarán con baluarte, y te pondrán cerco, y de todas partes te pondrán en estrecho,

verses.KJV: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.WEB: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
verses.ASV: and shall dash thee to the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derrubarão a ti, e a teus filhos; e não deixarão em ti pedra sobre pedra, porque não conheceste o tempo em que foste visitada.
verses.RVR09: Y te derribarán á tierra, y á tus hijos dentro de ti; y no dejarán sobre ti piedra sobre piedra; por cuanto no conociste el tiempo de tu visitación.

verses.KJV: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.WEB: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
verses.ASV: And he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold,
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando no Templo, começou a expulsar a todos os que vendiam e compravam ali,
verses.RVR09: Y entrando en el templo, comenzó á echar fuera á todos los que vendían y compraban en él.

verses.KJV: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.WEB: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
verses.ASV: saying unto them, It is written, And my house shall be a house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of robbers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo-lhes: Está escrito: Minha casa é casa de oração; Mas vós a tendes feito um esconderijo de ladrões.
verses.RVR09: Diciéndoles: Escrito está: Mi casa, casa de oración es; mas vosotros la habéis hecho cueva de ladrones.

verses.KJV: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.WEB: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
verses.ASV: And he was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people sought to destroy him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinava diariamente no Templo; e os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os chefes do povo, procuravam matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y enseñaba cada día en el templo; mas los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los escribas, y los principales del pueblo procuraban matarle.

verses.KJV: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.WEB: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
verses.ASV: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não achavam como fazer, porque todo o povo o ouvia com muita atenção.
verses.RVR09: Y no hallaban qué hacerle, porque todo el pueblo estaba suspenso oyéndole.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
verses.WEB: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and preaching the gospel, there came upon him the chief priests and the scribes with the elders;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, num daqueles dias que, enquanto ele estava ensinando ao povo no Templo, e anunciando o Evangelho, vieram até ele os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas com os anciãos.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ un día, que enseñando él al pueblo en el templo, y anunciando el evangelio, llegáronse los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los escribas, con los ancianos;

verses.KJV: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
verses.ASV: and they spake, saying unto him, Tell us: By what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram-lhe, dizendo: Dize-nos, com que autoridade fazes estas coisas? Ou quem é o que te deu esta autoridade?
verses.RVR09: Y le hablaron, diciendo: Dinos: ¿con qué potestad haces estas cosas? ¿ó quién es el que te ha dado esta potestad?

verses.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.WEB: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
verses.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, I also will ask you a question; and tell me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Também eu vos perguntarei algo, e dizei-me:
verses.RVR09: Respondiendo entonces Jesús, les dijo: Os preguntaré yo también una palabra; respondedme:

verses.KJV: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.WEB: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
verses.ASV: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?
verses.ALMEIDA: O batismo de João era do céu, ou dos homens?
verses.RVR09: El bautismo de Juan, ¿era del cielo, ó de los hombres?

verses.KJV: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.WEB: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
verses.ASV: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why did ye not believe him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles discutiam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Por que, então, vós não [o] crestes?
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos pensaban dentro de sí, diciendo: Si dijéremos, del cielo, dirá: ¿Por qué, pues, no le creísteis?

verses.KJV: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.WEB: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
verses.ASV: But if we shall say, From men; all the people will stone us: for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se dissermos: Dos homens, todo o povo nos apedrejará; pois estão convencidos de que João era profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijéremos, de los hombres, todo el pueblo nos apedreará: porque están ciertos que Juan era profeta.

verses.KJV: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
verses.WEB: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
verses.ASV: And they answered, that they knew not whence [it was].
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderam que não sabiam de onde [era] .
verses.RVR09: Y respondieron que no sabían de dónde.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes disse: Nem eu vos direi com que autoridade eu faço estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dijo: Ni yo os digo con qué potestad hago estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.WEB: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
verses.ASV: And he began to speak unto the people this parable: A man planted a vineyard, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country for a long time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou a dizer ao povo esta parábola: Um certo homem plantou uma vinha, e a arrendou a [uns] lavradores, e viajou para outro país por muito tempo.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á decir al pueblo esta parábola: Un hombre plantó una viña, y arrendóla á labradores, y se ausentó por mucho tiempo.

verses.KJV: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.WEB: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.
verses.ASV: And at the season he sent unto the husbandmen a servant, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E certo tempo [depois] mandou um servo aos lavradores, para que lhe dessem do fruto da vinha; mas os lavradores, espancando-o, mandaram [-no] sem coisa alguma.
verses.RVR09: Y al tiempo, envió un siervo á los labradores, para que le diesen del fruto de la viña; mas los labradores le hirieron, y enviaron vacío.

verses.KJV: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.WEB: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.ASV: And he sent yet another servant: and him also they beat, and handled him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a mandar outro servo; mas eles, espancando e humilhando também [a ele] ,o mandaram sem nada.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á enviar otro siervo; mas ellos á éste también, herido y afrentado, le enviaron vacío.

verses.KJV: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
verses.WEB: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.
verses.ASV: And he sent yet a third: and him also they wounded, and cast him forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a mandar ao terceiro; mas eles, ferindo também a este, [o] expulsaram.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á enviar al tercer siervo; mas ellos también á éste echaron herido.

verses.KJV: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
verses.WEB: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
verses.ASV: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; it may be they will reverence him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o senhor da vinha disse: Que farei? Mandarei a meu filho amado; talvez quando o verem, [o] respeitarão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el señor de la viña dijo: ¿Qué haré? Enviaré mi hijo amado: quizás cuando á éste vieren, tendrán respeto.

verses.KJV: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.WEB: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
verses.ASV: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned one with another, saying, This is the heir; let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os lavradores, vendo-o, discutiram entre si, dizendo: Este é o herdeiro; vamos matá-lo, para que a herança venha a ser nossa.
verses.RVR09: Mas los labradores, viéndole, pensaron entre sí, diciendo: Este es el heredero; venid, matémosle para que la heredad sea nuestra.

verses.KJV: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.WEB: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
verses.ASV: And they cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E expulsando-o da vinha, [o] mataram. O que, então, lhes fará o senhor da vinha?
verses.RVR09: Y echáronle fuera de la viña, y le mataron. ¿Qué pues, les hará el señor de la viña?

verses.KJV: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
verses.WEB: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”
verses.ASV: He will come and destroy these husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virá, e destruirá a estes lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.E eles, ouvindo isto, disseram: Que [isto] nunca aconteça!
verses.RVR09: Vendrá, y destruirá á estos labradores, y dará su viña á otros. Y como ellos lo oyeron, dijeron: ¡Dios nos libre!

verses.KJV: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.WEB: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?
verses.ASV: But he looked upon them, and said, What then is this that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] ,olhando para eles, disse: Por que, então, isto está escrito: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa foi posta como a principal da esquina?
verses.RVR09: Mas él mirándolos, dice: ¿Qué pues es lo que está escrito: La piedra que condenaron los edificadores, ésta fué por cabeza de esquina?

verses.KJV: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.WEB: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
verses.ASV: Every one that falleth on that stone shall be broken to pieces; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que cair sobre aquela pedra, se quebrará em pedaços; e aquele sobre quem ela cair, se fará pó.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que cayere sobre aquella piedra, será quebrantado; mas sobre el que la piedra cayere, le desmenuzará.

verses.KJV: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.WEB: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.ASV: And the scribes and the chief priests sought to lay hands on him in that very hour; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he spake this parable against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas queriam detê-lo naquela mesma hora, mas temiam ao povo; porque entenderam que foi contra eles que ele tinha dito a parábola.
verses.RVR09: Y procuraban los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los escribas echarle mano en aquella hora, porque entendieron que contra ellos había dicho esta parábola: mas temieron al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.WEB: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
verses.ASV: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, who feigned themselves to be righteous, that they might take hold of his speech, so as to deliver him up to the rule and to the authority of the governor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, observando-o, mandaram espiões, que fingissem ser justos, para o pegarem por meio de algo que ele dissesse, e o entregarem ao poder e autoridade do governador.
verses.RVR09: Y acechándole enviaron espías que se simulasen justos, para sorprenderle en palabras, para que le entregasen al principado y á la potestad del presidente.

verses.KJV: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
verses.ASV: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, and acceptest not the person [of any], but of a truth teachest the way of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, nós sabemos que falas e ensinas corretamente, e que não te importas com as aparências, mas na verdade tu ensinas o caminho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales le preguntaron, diciendo: Maestro, sabemos que dices y enseñas bien, y que no tienes respeto á persona; antes enseñas el camino de Dios con verdad.

verses.KJV: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.WEB: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
verses.ASV: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
verses.ALMEIDA: É lícito para nós dar tributo a César, ou não?
verses.RVR09: ¿Nos es lícito dar tributo á César, ó no?

verses.KJV: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.WEB: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
verses.ASV: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, entendendo a astúcia deles, disse-lhes: Por que me tentais?
verses.RVR09: Mas él, entendiendo la astucia de ellos, les dijo: ¿Por qué me tentáis?

verses.KJV: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.WEB: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
verses.ASV: Show me a denarius. Whose image and superscription hath it? And they said, Cæsar’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mostrai-me uma moeda; ela tem a imagem e a inscrição de quem?E eles, respondendo, disseram: De César.
verses.RVR09: Mostradme la moneda. ¿De quién tiene la imagen y la inscripción? Y respondiendo dijeron: De César.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Then render unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and unto God the things that are God’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhes disse: Dai pois a César o que [é] de César, e a Deus o que [é] de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dijo: Pues dad á César lo que es de César; y lo que es de Dios, á Dios.

verses.KJV: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.WEB: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
verses.ASV: And they were not able to take hold of the saying before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não puderam lhe pegar em algo que ele tenha dito diante do povo; e maravilhados de sua resposta, calaram-se.
verses.RVR09: Y no pudieron reprender sus palabras delante del pueblo: antes maravillados de su respuesta, callaron.

verses.KJV: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.WEB: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
verses.ASV: And there came to him certain of the Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection;
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando-se alguns dos saduceus, que negam haver a ressurreição, perguntaram-lhe,
verses.RVR09: Y llegándose unos de los Saduceos, los cuales niegan haber resurrección, le preguntaron,

verses.KJV: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.
verses.ASV: and they asked him, saying, Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, that if a man’s brother die, having a wife, and he be childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Mestre, Moisés nos escreveu, que se o irmão de alguém morrer, tendo mulher, e morrer sem filhos, o irmão deve tomar a mulher, e gerar descendência a seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Maestro, Moisés nos escribió: Si el hermano de alguno muriere teniendo mujer, y muriere sin hijos, que su hermano tome la mujer, y levante simiente á su hermano.

verses.KJV: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.WEB: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
verses.ASV: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died childless;
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve, pois, sete irmãos, e o primeiro tomou mulher, e morreu sem filhos.
verses.RVR09: Fueron, pues, siete hermanos: y el primero tomó mujer, y murió sin hijos.

verses.KJV: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
verses.WEB: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
verses.ASV: and the second:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o segundo a tomou; e [também] este morreu sem filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y la tomó el segundo, el cual también murió sin hijos.

verses.KJV: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.WEB: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
verses.ASV: and the third took her; and likewise the seven also left no children, and died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o terceiro a tomou, e assim também os sete, e não deixaram filhos, e morreram.
verses.RVR09: Y la tomó el tercero: asimismo también todos siete: y murieron sin dejar prole.

verses.KJV: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.WEB: Afterward the woman also died.
verses.ASV: Afterward the woman also died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por fim, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y á la postre de todos murió también la mujer.

verses.KJV: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.WEB: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
verses.ASV: In the resurrection therefore whose wife of them shall she be? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na ressurreição, pois, ela será mulher de qual deles? Pois os sete a tiveram por mulher.
verses.RVR09: En la resurrección, pues, ¿mujer de cuál de ellos será? porque los siete la tuvieron por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
verses.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, The sons of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Os filhos destes tempos se casam, e se dão em casamento.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: Los hijos de este siglo se casan, y son dados en casamiento:

verses.KJV: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.WEB: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
verses.ASV: but they that are accounted worthy to attain to that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os que forem considerados dignos de alcançarem aqueles tempos futuros, e da ressurreição dos mortos, nem se casarão, nem se darão em casamento.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que fueren tenidos por dignos de aquel siglo y de la resurrección de los muertos, ni se casan, ni son dados en casamiento:

verses.KJV: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.WEB: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
verses.ASV: for neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque já não podem mais morrer; pois são iguais aos anjos; e são filhos de Deus, pois são filhos da ressurreição.
verses.RVR09: Porque no pueden ya más morir: porque son iguales á los ángeles, y son hijos de Dios, cuando son hijos de la resurrección.

verses.KJV: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.ASV: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed, in [the place concerning] the Bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até Moisés mostrou, junto à sarça, que os mortos ressuscitam, quando ele chama ao Senhor de Deus de Abraão, e Deus de Isaque, e Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y que los muertos hayan de resucitar, aun Moisés lo enseñó en el pasaje de la zarza, cuando llama al Señor: Dios de Abraham, y Dios de Isaac, y Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.WEB: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
verses.ASV: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, ele não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos; pois todos vivem por causa dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios no es Dios de muertos, mas de vivos: porque todos viven á él.

verses.KJV: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.WEB: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
verses.ASV: And certain of the scribes answering said, Teacher, thou hast well said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos escribas, respondendo, disseram: Mestre, bem disseste.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiéndole unos de los escribas, dijeron: Maestro, bien has dicho.

verses.KJV: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
verses.WEB: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
verses.ASV: For they durst not any more ask him any question.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não ousavam lhe perguntar mais nada.
verses.RVR09: Y no osaron más preguntarle algo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, How say they that the Christ is David’s son?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Como dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Cómo dicen que el Cristo es hijo de David?

verses.KJV: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.WEB: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
verses.ASV: For David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o próprio Davi diz no livro dos Salmos: Disse o Senhor a meu Senhor: Senta-te à minha direita,
verses.RVR09: Y el mismo David dice en el libro de los Salmos: Dijo el Señor á mi Señor: Siéntate á mi diestra,

verses.KJV: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.WEB: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.ASV: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que eu ponha teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que pongo tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies.

verses.KJV: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
verses.WEB: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
verses.ASV: David therefore calleth him Lord, and how is he his son?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se Davi o chama de Senhor, como, então, é seu filho?
verses.RVR09: Así que David le llama Señor: ¿cómo pues es su hijo?

verses.KJV: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.WEB: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
verses.ASV: And in the hearing of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto todo o povo estava ouvindo, ele disse a seus discípulos:
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndole todo el pueblo, dijo á sus discípulos:

verses.KJV: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
verses.WEB: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
verses.ASV: Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love salutations in the marketplaces, and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai cuidado com os escribas, que querem andar roupas compridas, e amam as saudações nas praças, e as primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas, e os primeiros assentos nos jantares.
verses.RVR09: Guardaos de los escribas, que quieren andar con ropas largas, y aman las salutaciones en las plazas, y las primeras sillas en las sinagogas, y los primeros asientos en las cenas;

verses.KJV: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
verses.WEB: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
verses.ASV: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater condemnation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que devoram as casas das viúvas, e fingem fazer longas orações. Estes receberão mais grave condenação.
verses.RVR09: Que devoran las casas de las viudas, poniendo por pretexto la larga oración: éstos recibirán mayor condenación.

verses.KJV: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.WEB: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.ASV: And he looked up, and saw the rich men that were casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, olhando, viu os ricos lançarem suas ofertas na arca do tesouro [do templo] .
verses.RVR09: Y MIRANDO, vió á los ricos que echaban sus ofrendas en el gazofilacio.

verses.KJV: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.WEB: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
verses.ASV: And he saw a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu também uma pobre viúva lançar ali duas pequenas moedas.
verses.RVR09: Y vió también una viuda pobrecilla, que echaba allí dos blancas.

verses.KJV: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.WEB: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
verses.ASV: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than they all:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva lançou mais do que todos,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: De verdad os digo, que esta pobre viuda echó más que todos:

verses.KJV: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.WEB: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
verses.ASV: for all these did of their superfluity cast in unto the gifts; but she of her want did cast in all the living that she had.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos aqueles lançaram para as ofertas de Deus daquilo que lhes sobrava; mas esta [viúva] , de sua pobreza, lançou todo o sustento que tinha.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos estos, de lo que les sobra echaron para las ofrendas de Dios; mas ésta de su pobreza echó todo el sustento que tenía.

verses.KJV: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.WEB: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
verses.ASV: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and offerings, he said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns estavam falando do templo, que era adornado com formosas pedras e ofertas. Então [Jesus] disse:
verses.RVR09: Y á unos que decían del templo, que estaba adornado de hermosas piedras y dones, dijo:

verses.KJV: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.WEB: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
verses.ASV: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destas coisas que vedes, dias virão, em que não se deixará pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas que veis, días vendrán que no quedará piedra sobre piedra que no sea destruída.

verses.KJV: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
verses.ASV: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, when therefore shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign when these things are about to come to pass?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, quando, pois, serão essas coisas? E que sinal haverá, quando essas coisas vierem a acontecer?
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntaron, diciendo: Maestro, ¿cuándo será esto? ¿y qué señal habrá cuando estas cosas hayan de comenzar á ser hechas?

verses.KJV: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.WEB: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
verses.ASV: And he said, Take heed that ye be not led astray: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am [he]; and, The time is at hand: go ye not after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Olhai para que não vos enganem, porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Eu sou [o Cristo] . E o tempo já está perto; portanto não os sigais.
verses.RVR09: El entonces dijo: Mirad, no seáis engañados; porque vendrán muchos en mi nombre, diciendo: Yo soy; y, El tiempo está cerca: por tanto, no vayáis en pos de ellos.

verses.KJV: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.WEB: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
verses.ASV: And when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified: for these things must needs come to pass first; but the end is not immediately.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ouvirdes de guerras, e de rebeliões, não vos espanteis. Porque é necessário que estas coisas aconteçam primeiro; mas ainda não é o fim.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando oyereis guerras y sediciones, no os espantéis; porque es necesario que estas cosas acontezcan primero: mas no luego será el fin.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.WEB: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.ASV: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe disse: Então se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dijo: Se levantará gente contra gente, y reino contra reino;

verses.KJV: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.WEB: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
verses.ASV: and there shall be great earthquakes, and in divers places famines and pestilences; and there shall be terrors and great signs from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haverá em vários lugares grandes terremotos e fomes, e pragas; haverá também coisas espantosas, e grandes sinais do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá grandes terremotos, y en varios lugares hambres y pestilencias: y habrá espantos y grandes señales del cielo.

verses.KJV: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.WEB: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
verses.ASV: But before all these things, they shall lay their hands on you, and shall persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas antes de tudo isto, eles vos impedirão e vos perseguirão, [vos] entregando em sinagogas e prisões, [e] vos trazendo diante de reis, e governadores, por causa do meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Mas antes de todas estas cosas os echarán mano, y perseguirán, entregándoos á las sinagogas y á las cárceles, siendo llevados á los reyes y á los gobernadores por causa de mi nombre.

verses.KJV: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.WEB: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
verses.ASV: It shall turn out unto you for a testimony.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto vos acontecerá para haver testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y os será para testimonio.

verses.KJV: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.WEB: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
verses.ASV: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand how to answer:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, que vós decidais nos vossos corações não planejar como direis em vossa defesa,
verses.RVR09: Poned pues en vuestros corazones no pensar antes cómo habéis de responder:

verses.KJV: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.WEB: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
verses.ASV: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to withstand or to gainsay.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque eu vos darei boca e sabedoria, para que todos os que forem contra vós não posam [vos] contradizer ou resistir.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo os daré boca y sabiduría, á la cual no podrán resistir ni contradecir todos los que se os opondrán.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.WEB: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
verses.ASV: But ye shall be delivered up even by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolk, and friends; and [some] of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sereis entregues até pelos pais, e irmãos, e parentes, e amigos; e [alguns] de vós serão mortos.
verses.RVR09: Mas seréis entregados aun de vuestros padres, y hermanos, y parientes, y amigos; y matarán á algunos de vosotros.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.WEB: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sereis odiados por todos por causa do meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y seréis aborrecidos de todos por causa de mi nombre.

verses.KJV: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.WEB: And not a hair of your head will perish.
verses.ASV: And not a hair of your head shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nem um cabelo de vossa cabeça parecerá.
verses.RVR09: Mas un pelo de vuestra cabeza no perecerá.

verses.KJV: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.WEB: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
verses.ASV: In your patience ye shall win your souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por vossa paciência ganhareis vossas almas.
verses.RVR09: En vuestra paciencia poseeréis vuestras almas.

verses.KJV: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.WEB: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
verses.ASV: But when ye see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that her desolation is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando virdes a Jerusalém cercada de exércitos, sabei então, que próxima está sua desolação.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando viereis á Jerusalem cercada de ejércitos, sabed entonces que su destrucción ha llegado.

verses.KJV: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.WEB: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
verses.ASV: Then let them that are in Judæa flee unto the mountains; and let them that are in the midst of her depart out; and let not them that are in the country enter therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, os que estiverem na Judeia, fujam para os montes; e os que estiverem no meio dela, saiam, e os que estiverem nos campos, não entrem nela.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los que estuvieren en Judea, huyan á los montes; y los que en medio de ella, váyanse; y los que estén en los campos, no entren en ella.

verses.KJV: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.ASV: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estes são dias de vingança, para que todas as coisas que estão escritas se cumpram.
verses.RVR09: Porque estos son días de venganza: para que se cumplan todas las cosas que están escritas.

verses.KJV: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.WEB: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days! for there shall be great distress upon the land, and wrath unto this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ai das grávidas, e das que amamentarem naqueles dias; porque grande calamidade haverá na terra, e ira contra este povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡ay de las preñadas, y de las que crían en aquellos días! porque habrá apuro grande sobre la tierra é ira en este pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.ASV: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led captive into all the nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cairão pela lâmina de espada, e serão levados cativos para todas as nações; e Jerusalém será pisada pelos gentios, até que os tempos dos gentios se cumpram.
verses.RVR09: Y caerán á filo de espada, y serán llevados cautivos á todas las naciones: y Jerusalem será hollada de las gentes, hasta que los tiempos de las gentes sean cumplidos.

verses.KJV: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.WEB: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
verses.ASV: And there shall be signs in sun and moon and stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the billows;
verses.ALMEIDA: E haverá sinais no Sol, [na] Lua, e [nas] estrelas; e na terra sofrimento entre as nações, como o rugir e agitar do mar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces habrá señales en el sol, y en la luna, y en las estrellas; y en la tierra angustia de gentes por la confusión del sonido de la mar y de las ondas:

verses.KJV: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.WEB: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.ASV: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.
verses.ALMEIDA: As pessoas desmaiarão de medo e da expectativa das coisas que vão acontecer ao mundo, porque os poderes dos céus serão abalados.
verses.RVR09: Secándose los hombres á causa del temor y expectación de las cosas que sobrevendrán á la redondez de la tierra: porque las virtudes de los cielos serán conmovidas.

verses.KJV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.WEB: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.ASV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E então verão o Filho do homem vir em uma nuvem com grande poder e glória.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces verán al Hijo del hombre, que vendrá en una nube con potestad y majestad grande.

verses.KJV: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.WEB: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
verses.ASV: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads; because your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, quando estas coisas começarem a acontecer, olhai para cima, e levantai vossas cabeças, porque vosso resgate está perto.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando estas cosas comenzaren á hacerse, mirad, y levantad vuestras cabezas, porque vuestra redención está cerca.

verses.KJV: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.WEB: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
verses.ASV: And he spake to them a parable: Behold the fig tree, and all the trees:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes uma parábola: Olhai a figueira, e todas as árvores;
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles una parábola: Mirad la higuera y todos los árboles:

verses.KJV: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.WEB: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
verses.ASV: when they now shoot forth, ye see it and know of your own selves that the summer is now nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vós vedes elas já brotando, sabeis por vós mesmos que o verão já está perto.
verses.RVR09: Cuando ya brotan, viéndolo, de vosotros mismos entendéis que el verano está ya cerca.

verses.KJV: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.WEB: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
verses.ASV: Even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, quando virdes acontecer estas coisas, sabei que o Reino de Deus já está perto.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, cuando viereis hacerse estas cosas, entended que está cerca el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
verses.ASV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all things be accomplished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade vos digo, que esta geração não passará, até que tudo aconteça.
verses.RVR09: De cierto os digo, que no pasará esta generación hasta que todo sea hecho.

verses.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
verses.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O céu e a terra passarão, mas minhas palavras de maneira nenhuma passarão.
verses.RVR09: El cielo y la tierra pasarán; mas mis palabras no pasarán.

verses.KJV: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.WEB: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
verses.ASV: But take heed to yourselves, lest haply your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come on you suddenly as a snare:
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhai por vós, para que vossos corações não venham a se encher de ressaca e embriaguez, e das preocupações d [esta] vida; e vos venha aquele dia de surpresa.
verses.RVR09: Y mirad por vosotros, que vuestros corazones no sean cargados de glotonería y embriaguez, y de los cuidados de esta vida, y venga de repente sobre vosotros aquel día.

verses.KJV: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.WEB: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
verses.ASV: for [so] shall it come upon all them that dwell on the face of all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque virá como uma armadilha sobre todos os que habitam sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque como un lazo vendrá sobre todos los que habitan sobre la faz de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.WEB: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
verses.ASV: But watch ye at every season, making supplication, that ye may prevail to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vigiai sempre, orando para que sejais considerados dignos de escaparem de todas as coisas que irão acontecer, e de ficarem de pé diante do Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Velad pues, orando en todo tiempo, que seáis tenidos por dignos de evitar todas estas cosas que han de venir, y de estar en pie delante del Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.WEB: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
verses.ASV: And every day he was teaching in the temple; and every night he went out, and lodged in the mount that is called Olivet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinava durante os dias no Templo, porém, às noites saía e as passava no monte, chamado as Oliveiras.
verses.RVR09: Y enseñaba de día en el templo; y de noche saliendo, estábase en el monte que se llama de las Olivas.

verses.KJV: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.WEB: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
verses.ASV: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo vinha até ele de manhã cedo ao templo, para o ouvir.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo venía á él por la mañana, para oirle en el templo.

verses.KJV: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.WEB: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
verses.ASV: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estava perto a festa dos pães sem fermento, chamada de páscoa.
verses.RVR09: Y ESTABA cerca el día de la fiesta de los ázimos, que se llama la Pascua.

verses.KJV: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.WEB: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
verses.ASV: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas procuravam um meio de o matar, pois eles temiam ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los escribas buscaban cómo le matarían; mas tenían miedo del pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.WEB: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.
verses.ASV: And Satan entered into Judas who was called Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Satanás entrou no Judas que era chamado Iscariotes, que era um dos doze.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Satanás en Judas, por sobrenombre Iscariote, el cual era uno del número de los doce;

verses.KJV: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.WEB: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
verses.ASV: And he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi, e falou com os chefes dos sacerdotes e os oficiais, sobre como [o] entregaria para eles.
verses.RVR09: Y fué, y habló con los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y con los magistrados, de cómo se lo entregaría.

verses.KJV: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.WEB: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
verses.ASV: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [estes] se alegraram, e concordaram em lhe dar dinheiro.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales se holgaron, y concertaron de darle dinero.

verses.KJV: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.WEB: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.ASV: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [lhes] prometeu, e buscava oportunidade para o entregar quando não houvesse uma multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y prometió, y buscaba oportunidad para entregarle á ellos sin bulla.

verses.KJV: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.WEB: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
verses.ASV: And the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio o dia dos [pães] sem fermento, em que se devia fazer o sacrifício da páscoa.
verses.RVR09: Y vino el día de los ázimos, en el cual era necesario matar la pascua.

verses.KJV: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.WEB: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
verses.ASV: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jesus] mandou a Pedro, e a João, dizendo: Ide, preparai-nos a páscoa, para que [a] comamos.
verses.RVR09: Y envió á Pedro y á Juan, diciendo: Id, aparejadnos la pascua para que comamos.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we make ready?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe disseram: Onde queres que [a] preparemos?
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le dijeron: ¿Dónde quieres que aparejemos?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Eis que, quando entrardes na cidade, um homem com um vaso de água vos encontrará; segui-o até a casa onde ele entrar.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: He aquí cuando entrareis en la ciudad, os encontrará un hombre que lleva un cántaro de agua: seguidle hasta la casa donde entrare,

verses.KJV: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.WEB: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
verses.ASV: And ye shall say unto the master of the house, The Teacher saith unto thee, Where is the guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.ALMEIDA: E direis ao dono da casa: O Mestre te diz: Onde está o salão onde comerei a páscoa com meus discípulos?
verses.RVR09: Y decid al padre de la familia de la casa: El Maestro te dice: ¿Dónde está el aposento donde tengo de comer la pascua con mis discípulos?

verses.KJV: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.WEB: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
verses.ASV: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele vos mostrará um grande salão já arrumado; preparai-a ali.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él os mostrará un gran cenáculo aderezado; aparejad allí.

verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que yendo hablando entre sí, y preguntándose el uno al otro, el mismo Jesús se llegó, é iba con ellos juntamente.

verses.KJV: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.WEB: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
verses.ASV: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seus olhos foram retidos, para que não o reconhecessem.
verses.RVR09: Mas los ojos de ellos estaban embargados, para que no le conociesen.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What communications are these that ye have one with another, as ye walk? And they stood still, looking sad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Que conversas são essas, que vós discutis enquanto andam, e ficais tristes?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: ¿Qué pláticas son estas que tratáis entre vosotros andando, y estáis tristes?

verses.KJV: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.WEB: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
verses.ASV: And one of them, named Cleopas, answering said unto him, Dost thou alone sojourn in Jerusalem and not know the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.ALMEIDA: E um [deles] ,cujo nome era Cleofas, respondendo-o, disse-lhe: És tu o único viajante em Jerusalém que não sabe as coisas que nela tem acontecido nestes dias?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el uno, que se llamaba Cleofas, le dijo: ¿Tú sólo peregrino eres en Jerusalem, y no has sabido las cosas que en ella han acontecido estos días?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Quais?E eles lhe disseram: As sobre Jesus de Nazaré, a qual foi um homem profeta, poderoso em obras e em palavras, diante de Deus, e de todo o povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dijo: ¿Qué cosas? Y ellos le dijeron: De Jesús Nazareno, el cual fué varón profeta, poderoso en obra y en palabra delante de Dios y de todo el pueblo;

verses.KJV: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.WEB: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
verses.ASV: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como os chefes dos sacerdotes, e nossos líderes o entregaram à condenação de morte, e o crucificaram.
verses.RVR09: Y cómo le entregaron los príncipes de los sacerdotes y nuestros príncipes á condenación de muerte, y le crucificaron.

verses.KJV: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.WEB: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
verses.ASV: But we hoped that it was he who should redeem Israel. Yea and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things came to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós esperávamos que ele fosse aquele que libertar a Israel; porém além de tudo isto, hoje é o terceiro dia desde que estas coisas aconteceram.
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros esperábamos que él era el que había de redimir á Israel: y ahora sobre todo esto, hoy es el tercer día que esto ha acontecido.

verses.KJV: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.WEB: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
verses.ASV: Moreover certain women of our company amazed us, having been early at the tomb;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que também algumas mulheres dentre nós nos deixaram surpresos, as quais de madrugada foram ao sepulcro;
verses.RVR09: Aunque también unas mujeres de los nuestros nos han espantado, las cuales antes del día fueron al sepulcro:

verses.KJV: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.WEB: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
verses.ASV: and when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não achando seu corpo, vieram, dizendo que também tinham visto uma aparição de anjos, que disseram que ele vive.
verses.RVR09: Y no hallando su cuerpo, vinieron diciendo que también habían visto visión de ángeles, los cuales dijeron que él vive.

verses.KJV: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.WEB: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
verses.ASV: And certain of them that were with us went to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns do que estão conosco foram ao sepulcro, e [o] acharam assim como as mulheres tinham dito; porém não o viram.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron algunos de los nuestros al sepulcro, y hallaron así como las mujeres habían dicho; mas á él no le vieron.

verses.KJV: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, O foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ó tolos, e que demoram no coração para crerem em tudo o que os profetas falaram!
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dijo: ¡Oh insensatos, y tardos de corazón para creer todo lo que los profetas han dicho!

verses.KJV: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.WEB: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
verses.ASV: Behooved it not the Christ to suffer these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não era necessário que o Cristo sofresse estas coisas, e [então] entrar em sua glória?
verses.RVR09: ¿No era necesario que el Cristo padeciera estas cosas, y que entrara en su gloria?

verses.KJV: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.WEB: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.ASV: And beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começando de Moisés, e por todos os profetas, lhes declarava em todas as Escrituras o que estava [escrito] sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzando desde Moisés, y de todos los profetas, declarábales en todas las Escrituras lo que de él decían.

verses.KJV: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.WEB: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
verses.ASV: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they were going: and he made as though he would go further.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram à aldeia para onde estavam indo; e ele agiu como se fosse para [um lugar] mais distante.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron á la aldea á donde iban: y él hizo como que iba más lejos.

verses.KJV: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.WEB: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
verses.ASV: And they constrained him, saying, Abide with us; for it is toward evening, and the day is now far spent. And he went in to abide with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe rogaram, dizendo: Fica conosco, porque já é tarde, e o dia está entardecendo;E ele entrou para ficar com eles.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos le detuvieron por fuerza, diciendo: Quédate con nosotros, porque se hace tarde, y el día ya ha declinado. Entró pues á estarse con ellos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.WEB: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he had sat down with them to meat, he took the bread and blessed; and breaking [it] he gave to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, estando sentado com eles [à mesa] ,tomou o pão, o benzeu, [o] partiu, e o deu a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que estando sentado con ellos á la mesa, tomando el pan, bendijo, y partió, y dióles.

verses.KJV: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.WEB: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
verses.ASV: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os olhos deles se abriram, e o reconheceram, e ele lhes desapareceu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces fueron abiertos los ojos de ellos, y le conocieron; mas él se desapareció de los ojos de ellos.

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, Was not our heart burning within us, while he spake to us in the way, while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam um ao outro: Por acaso não estava nosso coração ardendo em nós, quando ele falava conosco pelo caminho, e quando nos desvendava as Escrituras?
verses.RVR09: Y decían el uno al otro: ¿No ardía nuestro corazón en nosotros, mientras nos hablaba en el camino, y cuando nos abría las Escrituras?

verses.KJV: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.WEB: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
verses.ASV: And they rose up that very hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se na mesma hora, voltaram para Jerusalém, e acharam reunidos aos onze, e aos que estavam com eles,
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose en la misma hora, tornáronse á Jerusalem, y hallaron á los once reunidos, y á los que estaban con ellos.

verses.KJV: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.WEB: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
verses.ASV: saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diziam: Verdadeiramente o Senhor ressuscitou, e já apareceu a Simão.
verses.RVR09: Que decían: Ha resucitado el Señor verdaderamente, y ha aparecido á Simón.

verses.KJV: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.WEB: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
verses.ASV: And they rehearsed the things [that happened] in the way, and how he was known of them in the breaking of the bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles contaram as coisas que [lhes aconteceram] no caminho; e como foi reconhecido por eles quando partiu o pão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos contaban las cosas que les habían acontecido en el camino, y cómo había sido conocido de ellos al partir el pan.

verses.KJV: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.WEB: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.ASV: And as they spake these things, he himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles falavam disto, o próprio Jesus se pôs no meio deles, e lhes disse: Paz [seja] convosco.
verses.RVR09: Y entre tanto que ellos hablaban estas cosas, él se puso en medio de ellos, y les dijo: Paz á vosotros.

verses.KJV: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.WEB: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.ASV: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they beheld a spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, espantados, e muito atemorizados, pensavam que viam algum espírito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos espantados y asombrados, pensaban que veían espíritu.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and wherefore do questionings arise in your heart?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Por que estais perturbados, e por que sobem dúvidas em vossos corações?
verses.RVR09: Mas él les dice: ¿Por qué estáis turbados, y suben pensamientos á vuestros corazones?

verses.KJV: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.WEB: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
verses.ASV: See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye behold me having.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede minhas mãos, e os meus pés, que sou em mesmo. Tocai-me, e vede, porque um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, como vós vedes que eu tenho.
verses.RVR09: Mirad mis manos y mis pies, que yo mismo soy: palpad, y ved; que el espíritu ni tiene carne ni huesos, como veis que yo tengo.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
verses.WEB: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
verses.ASV: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo isto, lhes mostrou as mãos e os pés.
verses.RVR09: Y en diciendo esto, les mostró las manos y los pies.

verses.KJV: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.WEB: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
verses.ASV: And while they still disbelieved for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here anything to eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, não crendo ainda, por causa da alegria, e maravilhados, [Jesus] disse-lhes: Tendes aqui alguma coisa para comer?
verses.RVR09: Y no creyéndolo aún ellos de gozo, y maravillados, díjoles: ¿Tenéis aquí algo de comer?

verses.KJV: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.WEB: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
verses.ASV: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles lhe apresentaram parte de um peixe assado e de um favo de mel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos le presentaron parte de un pez asado, y un panal de miel.

verses.KJV: And he took it, and did eat before them.
verses.WEB: He took them, and ate in front of them.
verses.ASV: And he took it, and ate before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pegou, e comeu diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y él tomó, y comió delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, These are my words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must needs be fulfilled, which are written in the law of Moses, and the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Estas são as palavras que eu vos disse, enquanto ainda estava convosco, que era necessário que se cumprissem todas as coisas que estão escritas sobre mim na Lei de Moisés, [nos] profetas, e [nos] Salmos.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Estas son las palabras que os hablé, estando aún con vosotros: que era necesario que se cumpliesen todas las cosas que están escritas de mí en la ley de Moisés, y en los profetas, y en los salmos.

verses.KJV: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
