verses.WEB: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
verses.ASV: Then opened he their mind, that they might understand the scriptures;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes abriu o entendimento, para que entendessem as Escrituras.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les abrió el sentido, para que entendiesen las Escrituras;

verses.KJV: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behooved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
verses.ASV: and he said unto them, Thus it is written, that the Christ should suffer, and rise again from the dead the third day;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Assim está escrito, e assim era necessário que o Cristo sofresse, e que ao terceiro dia ressuscitasse dos mortos;
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Así está escrito, y así fué necesario que el Cristo padeciese, y resucitase de los muertos al tercer día;

verses.KJV: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name unto all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que em seu nome fosse pregado arrependimento e perdão de pecados em todas as nações, começando de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y que se predicase en su nombre el arrepentimiento y la remisión de pecados en todas las naciones, comenzando de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.WEB: You are witnesses of these things.
verses.ASV: Ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destas coisas vós sois testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros sois testigos de estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.WEB: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
verses.ASV: And behold, I send forth the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city, until ye be clothed with power from on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que eu envio a promessa de meu Pai sobre vós; porém ficai vós na cidade de Jerusalém, até que vos seja dado poder do alto.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, yo enviaré la promesa de mi Padre sobre vosotros: mas vosotros asentad en la ciudad de Jerusalem, hasta que seáis investidos de potencia de lo alto.

verses.KJV: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.WEB: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
verses.ASV: And he led them out until [they were] over against Bethany: and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os levou para fora até Betânia, e levantando suas mãos, os abençoou.
verses.RVR09: Y sacólos fuera hasta Bethania, y alzando sus manos, los bendijo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.WEB: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he parted from them, and was carried up into heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, enquanto os abençoava, ele se afastou deles, e foi conduzido para cima ao céu.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que bendiciéndolos, se fué de ellos; y era llevado arriba al cielo.

verses.KJV: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.WEB: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.ASV: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, adorando-o, voltaram para Jerusalém com grande alegria;
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, después de haberle adorado, se volvieron á Jerusalem con gran gozo;

verses.KJV: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.WEB: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.ASV: and were continually in the temple, blessing God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam sempre no Templo, louvando e bendizendo a Deus. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban siempre en el templo, alabando y bendiciendo á Dios. Amén.

verses.KJV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.WEB: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.ASV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.ALMEIDA: No princípio era a Palavra, e a Palavra estava junto de Deus, e a Palavra era Deus.
verses.RVR09: EN el principio era el Verbo, y el Verbo era con Dios, y el Verbo era Dios.

verses.KJV: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.WEB: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.ASV: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta estava no princípio junto de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Este era en el principio con Dios.

verses.KJV: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.WEB: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
verses.ASV: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por esta foram feitas todas as coisas, e sem ela não se fez coisa nenhuma do que foi feito.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas por él fueron hechas; y sin él nada de lo que es hecho, fué hecho.

verses.KJV: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.WEB: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.ASV: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nela estava a vida, e a vida era a luz dos seres humanos.
verses.RVR09: En él estaba la vida, y la vida era la luz de los hombres.

verses.KJV: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.WEB: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
verses.ASV: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a luz brilha nas trevas; e as trevas não a compreenderam.
verses.RVR09: Y la luz en las tinieblas resplandece; mas las tinieblas no la comprendieron.

verses.KJV: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.WEB: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.ASV: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve um homem enviado por Deus, cujo nome era João.
verses.RVR09: Fué un hombre enviado de Dios, el cual se llamaba Juan.

verses.KJV: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.WEB: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.ASV: The same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este veio por testemunho, para que testemunhasse da Luz, para que todos por ele cressem.
verses.RVR09: Este vino por testimonio, para que diese testimonio de la luz, para que todos creyesen por él.

verses.KJV: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.WEB: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
verses.ASV: He was not the light, but [came] that he might bear witness of the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não era a Luz; mas [foi enviado] para que testemunhasse da Luz.
verses.RVR09: No era él la luz, sino para que diese testimonio de la luz.

verses.KJV: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.WEB: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
verses.ASV: There was the true light, [even the light] which lighteth every man, coming into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Esta] era a luz verdadeira, que ilumina a todo ser humano que vem ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Aquél era la luz verdadera, que alumbra á todo hombre que viene á este mundo.

verses.KJV: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.WEB: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.ASV: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: No mundo estava, e por ele foi feito o mundo; e o mundo não o conheceu.
verses.RVR09: En el mundo estaba, y el mundo fué hecho por él; y el mundo no le conoció.

verses.KJV: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.WEB: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
verses.ASV: He came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao [seu] próprio veio, e os seus não o receberam.
verses.RVR09: A lo suyo vino, y los suyos no le recibieron.

verses.KJV: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.WEB: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
verses.ASV: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, [even] to them that believe on his name:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a todos quantos o receberam, deu-lhes poder de serem feitos filhos de Deus: aos que creem em seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Mas á todos los que le recibieron, dióles potestad de ser hechos hijos de Dios, á los que creen en su nombre:

verses.KJV: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.WEB: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.ASV: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais não são gerados de sangue, nem de vontade da carne, nem de vontade de homem, mas sim de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales no son engendrados de sangre, ni de voluntad de carne, ni de voluntad de varón, mas de Dios.

verses.KJV: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.WEB: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.ASV: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquela Palavra se fez carne, e habitou entre nós; (e vimos sua glória, como glória do unigênito do Pai) cheio de graça e de verdade.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel Verbo fué hecho carne, y habitó entre nosotros (y vimos su gloria, gloria como del unigénito del Padre), lleno de gracia y de verdad.

verses.KJV: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.WEB: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
verses.ASV: John beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E João dele testemunhou, e clamou, dizendo: Este era aquele, de quem eu dizia: O que vem após mim é antes de mim; porque era primeiro que eu.
verses.RVR09: Juan dió testimonio de él, y clamó diciendo: Este es del que yo decía: El que viene tras mí, es antes de mí: porque es primero que yo.

verses.KJV: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.WEB: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
verses.ASV: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de sua plenitude recebemos todos também graça por graça.
verses.RVR09: Porque de su plenitud tomamos todos, y gracia por gracia.

verses.KJV: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a Lei foi dada por Moisés; a graça e a verdade foi feita por Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ley por Moisés fué dada: mas la gracia y la verdad por Jesucristo fué hecha.

verses.KJV: No man hath seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.WEB: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
verses.ASV: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: A Deus nunca ninguém o viu; o unigênito Filho, que está no seio do Pai, ele [o] declarou.
verses.RVR09: A Dios nadie le vió jamás: el unigénito Hijo, que está en el seno del Padre, él le declaró.

verses.KJV: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.WEB: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.ASV: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o testemunho de João, quando os judeus mandaram alguns sacerdotes e levitas de Jerusalém, que lhe perguntassem: Tu quem és?
verses.RVR09: Y éste es el testimonio de Juan, cuando los Judíos enviaron de Jerusalem sacerdotes y Levitas, que le preguntasen: ¿Tú, quién eres?

verses.KJV: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.WEB: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.ASV: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E confessou, e não negou; e confessou: Eu não sou o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y confesó, y no negó; mas declaró: No soy yo el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.WEB: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
verses.ASV: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe perguntaram: Que, então? És tu Elias? E ele disse: Não sou. [Eles disseram] : Tu és o Profeta? E ele respondeu: Não.
verses.RVR09: Y le preguntaron: ¿Qué pues? ¿Eres tú Elías? Dijo: No soy. ¿Eres tú el profeta? Y respondió: No.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és? Para darmos resposta aos que nos enviaram. Que dizes de ti mesmo?
verses.RVR09: Dijéronle: ¿Pues quién eres? para que demos respuesta á los que nos enviaron. ¿Qué dices de ti mismo?

verses.KJV: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.WEB: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
verses.ASV: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto: Endireitai o caminho do Senhor, como disse o profeta Isaías.
verses.RVR09: Dijo: Yo soy la voz del que clama en el desierto: Enderezad el camino del Señor, como dijo Isaías profeta.

verses.KJV: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.WEB: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.ASV: And they had been sent from the Pharisees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os enviados eram dos fariseus.
verses.RVR09: Y los que habían sido enviados eran de los Fariseos.

verses.KJV: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.ASV: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the Christ, neither Elijah, neither the prophet?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntaram-lhe, e disseram-lhe: Por que pois batizas, se tu não és o Cristo, nem Elias, nem o profeta?
verses.RVR09: Y preguntáronle, y dijéronle: ¿Por qué pues bautizas, si tú no eres el Cristo, ni Elías, ni el profeta?

verses.KJV: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.WEB: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
verses.ASV: John answered them, saying, I baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,
verses.ALMEIDA: João lhes respondeu, dizendo: Eu batizo com água; mas em meio de vós, está a quem vós não conheceis,
verses.RVR09: Y Juan les respondió, diciendo: Yo bautizo con agua; mas en medio de vosotros ha estado á quien vosotros no conocéis.

verses.KJV: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.WEB: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
verses.ASV: [even] he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele que vem após mim, o qual já foi antes de mim, do qual eu não sou digno de desatar a tira de sua sandália.
verses.RVR09: Este es el que ha de venir tras mí, el cual es antes de mí: del cual yo no soy digno de desatar la correa del zapato.

verses.KJV: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.WEB: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.ASV: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas aconteceram em Betábara, do outro lado do Jordão, onde João estava batizando.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas acontecieron en Betábara, de la otra parte del Jordán, donde Juan bautizaba.

verses.KJV: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.WEB: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.ASV: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia seguinte viu João a Jesus vir a ele, e disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo.
verses.RVR09: El siguiente día ve Juan á Jesús que venía á él, y dice: He aquí el Cordero de Dios, que quita el pecado del mundo.

verses.KJV: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.WEB: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
verses.ASV: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele do qual eu disse: Após mim vem um homem que já foi antes de mim; porque já era primeiro que eu.
verses.RVR09: Este es del que dije: Tras mí viene un varón, el cual es antes de mí: porque era primero que yo.

verses.KJV: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.WEB: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
verses.ASV: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu não o conhecia; mas para que fosse manifesto a Israel, por isso vim eu batizando com água.
verses.RVR09: Y yo no le conocía; más para que fuese manifestado á Israel, por eso vine yo bautizando con agua.

verses.KJV: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.WEB: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
verses.ASV: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E João testemunhou, dizendo: Eu vi o Espírito como pomba descer do céu, e repousou sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Juan dió testimonio, diciendo: Vi al Espíritu que descendía del cielo como paloma, y reposó sobre él.

verses.KJV: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.ASV: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu não o conhecia, mas aquele que me mandou a batizar com água, esse me disse: Sobre aquele que vires descer ao Espírito, e repousar sobre ele, esse é o que batiza com Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y yo no le conocía; mas el que me envió á bautizar con agua, aquél me dijo: Sobre quien vieres descender el Espíritu, y que reposa sobre él, éste es el que bautiza con Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.WEB: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
verses.ASV: And I have seen, and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu [o] vi, e testemunhado tenho, que este é o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y yo le vi, y he dado testimonio que éste es el Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.WEB: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.ASV: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;
verses.ALMEIDA: O seguinte dia estava outra vez [ali] João, e dois de seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: El siguiente día otra vez estaba Juan, y dos de sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.WEB: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.ASV: and he looked upon Jesus as he walked, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God!
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo [por ali] andar a Jesus, disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y mirando á Jesús que andaba por allí, dijo: He aquí el Cordero de Dios.

verses.KJV: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.WEB: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.ASV: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dois discípulos ouviram[-lhe] dizer [aquilo] , e seguiram a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéronle los dos discípulos hablar, y siguieron á Jesús.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.WEB: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus, virando-se, e vendo-os seguir, disse-lhes: Que buscais? E eles lhe disseram: Rabi, (que traduzido, quer dizer, Mestre) onde moras?
verses.RVR09: Y volviéndose Jesús, y viéndolos seguirle, díceles: ¿Qué buscáis? Y ellos le dijeron: Rabbí (que declarado quiere decir Maestro) ¿dónde moras?

verses.KJV: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.ASV: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes ele: Vinde, e vede-o; Vieram, e viram onde morava, e na companhia dele naquele dia; e já era quase a hora décima.
verses.RVR09: Díceles: Venid y ved. Vinieron, y vieron donde moraba, y quedáronse con él aquel día: porque era como la hora de las diez.

verses.KJV: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.WEB: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.ASV: One of the two that heard John [speak], and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era André, o irmão de Simão Pedro, um dos dois que ouvira aquilo de João, e o haviam seguido.
verses.RVR09: Era Andrés, hermano de Simón Pedro, uno de los dos que habían oído de Juan, y le habían seguido.

verses.KJV: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.WEB: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.ASV: He findeth first his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.ALMEIDA: Este achou primeiro a seu irmão Simão, e disse-lhe: Já achamos ao Messias(que traduzido, é o Cristo).
verses.RVR09: Este halló primero á su hermano Simón, y díjole: Hemos hallado al Mesías (que declarado es, el Cristo).

verses.KJV: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.WEB: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.ASV: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.ALMEIDA: E levou-o a Jesus. E Jesus, olhando para ele, disse: Tu és Simão, filho de Jonas; tu serás chamado Cefas. (que se traduz Pedro).
verses.RVR09: Y le trajo á Jesús. Y mirándole Jesús, dijo: Tú eres Simón, hijo de Jonás: tú serás llamado Cephas (que quiere decir, Piedra).

verses.KJV: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.WEB: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.ASV: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia seguinte Jesus quis ir à Galileia, achou Filipe, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.
verses.RVR09: El siguiente día quiso Jesús ir á Galilea, y halla á Felipe, al cual dijo: Sígueme.

verses.KJV: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.WEB: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.ASV: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Filipe era de Betsaida, da cidade de André e de Pedro.
verses.RVR09: Y era Felipe de Bethsaida, la ciudad de Andrés y de Pedro.

verses.KJV: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.WEB: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.ASV: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filipe achou Natanael, e disse-lhe: Achamos [aquele] de quem Moisés escreveu na Lei, e os Profetas: a Jesus, o filho de José, de Nazaré.
verses.RVR09: Felipe halló á Natanael, y dícele: Hemos hallado á aquel de quien escribió Moisés en la ley, y los profetas: á Jesús, el hijo de José, de Nazaret.

verses.KJV: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.WEB: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.ASV: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Natanael: Pode haver alguma coisa boa de Nazaré? Filipe lhe disse: Vem, e vê.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Natanael: ¿De Nazaret puede haber algo de bueno? Dícele Felipe: Ven y ve.

verses.KJV: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.WEB: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
verses.ASV: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus viu Natanael vir, e disse dele: Eis verdadeiramente um israelita, em quem não há engano!
verses.RVR09: Jesús vió venir á sí á Natanael, y dijo de él: He aquí un verdadero Israelita, en el cual no hay engaño.

verses.KJV: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.WEB: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.ASV: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Natanael lhe disse: De onde tu me conheces? Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Antes que Filipe te chamasse, estando tu debaixo da figueira, eu te vi.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Natanael: ¿De dónde me conoces? Respondió Jesús, y díjole: Antes que Felipe te llamara, cuando estabas debajo de la higuera te vi.

verses.KJV: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.WEB: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
verses.ASV: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Natanael respondeu, e disse-lhe: Rabi, tu és o Filho de Deus, tu és o Rei de Israel!
verses.RVR09: Respondió Natanael, y díjole: Rabbí, tú eres el Hijo de Dios; tú eres el Rey de Israel.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Porque te disse: Debaixo da figueira te vi, crês? Tu verás coisas maiores que estas.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús y díjole: ¿Porque te dije, te vi debajo de la higuera, crees? cosas mayores que éstas verás.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
verses.ASV: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que daqui em diante vereis o céu aberto, e aos anjos de Deus subir e descer sobre o Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y dícele: De cierto, de cierto os digo: De aquí adelante veréis el cielo abierto, y los ángeles de Dios que suben y descienden sobre el Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.WEB: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
verses.ASV: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.ALMEIDA: E no terceiro dia houve um casamento em Caná da Galileia; e a mãe de Jesus estava ali.
verses.RVR09: Y AL tercer día hiciéronse unas bodas en Caná de Galilea; y estaba allí la madre de Jesús.

verses.KJV: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.WEB: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
verses.ASV: and Jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Jesus foi convidado com seus discípulos ao casamento.
verses.RVR09: Y fué también llamado Jesús y sus discípulos á las bodas.

verses.KJV: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.WEB: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
verses.ASV: And when the wine failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo faltado vinho, a mãe de Jesus lhe disse: Não têm vinho.
verses.RVR09: Y faltando el vino, la madre de Jesús le dijo: Vino no tienen.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: O que eu tenho contigo, mulher? A minha hora ainda não chegou.
verses.RVR09: Y dícele Jesús: ¿Qué tengo yo contigo, mujer? aun no ha venido mi hora.

verses.KJV: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.WEB: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
verses.ASV: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua mãe disse aos serventes: Fazei tudo quanto ele vos disser.
verses.RVR09: Su madre dice á los que servían: Haced todo lo que os dijere.

verses.KJV: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.WEB: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
verses.ASV: Now there were six waterpots of stone set there after the Jews’ manner of purifying, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam ali postos seis vasos de pedra, conforme à purificação dos judeus, em cada uma cabiam duas ou três metretas. )
verses.RVR09: Y estaban allí seis tinajuelas de piedra para agua, conforme á la purificación de los Judíos, que cabían en cada una dos ó tres cántaros.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Jesus: Enchei estes vasos com água. E encheram-nas até encima.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: Henchid estas tinajuelas de agua. E hinchiéronlas hasta arriba.

verses.KJV: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
verses.ASV: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Agora tirai, e a levai ao mestre de cerimônia. Então levaram.
verses.RVR09: Y díceles: Sacad ahora, y presentad al maestresala. Y presentáronle.

verses.KJV: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.WEB: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
verses.ASV: And when the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and knew not whence it was (but the servants that had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast calleth the bridegroom,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o mestre de cerimônia experimentou a água feita vinho (sem saber de onde era, porém os serventes que haviam tirado a água sabiam), o mestre de cerimônia chamou o noivo,
verses.RVR09: Y como el maestresala gustó el agua hecha vino, que no sabía de dónde era (mas lo sabían los sirvientes que habían sacado el agua), el maestresala llama al esposo,

verses.KJV: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.WEB: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
verses.ASV: and saith unto him, Every man setteth on first the good wine; and when [men] have drunk freely, [then] that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Todos põem primeiro o vinho bom, e quando [os convidados] já [estão] bêbados, então [se dá] o pior; [porém] tu guardaste o bom vinho até agora.
verses.RVR09: Y dícele: Todo hombre pone primero el buen vino, y cuando están satisfechos, entonces lo que es peor; mas tú has guardado el buen vino hasta ahora.

verses.KJV: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.WEB: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
verses.ASV: This beginning of his signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este princípio de sinais Jesus fez em Caná da Galileia, e manifestou sua glória; e seus discípulos creram nele.
verses.RVR09: Este principio de señales hizo Jesús en Caná de Galilea, y manifestó su gloria; y sus discípulos creyeron en él.

verses.KJV: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.WEB: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
verses.ASV: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and [his] brethren, and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto desceu a Cafarnaum, ele e sua mãe, seus irmãos, e seus discípulos, e ficaram ali não muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Después de esto descendió á Capernaum, él, y su madre, y hermanos, y discípulos; y estuvieron allí no muchos días.

verses.KJV: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And the passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava perto a Páscoa dos judeus, e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba cerca la Pascua de los Judíos; y subió Jesús á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.WEB: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verses.ASV: And he found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.ALMEIDA: E achou no Templo os que vendiam bois, ovelhas, e pombas, e os cambistas sentados.
verses.RVR09: Y halló en el templo á los que vendían bueyes, y ovejas, y palomas, y á los cambiadores sentados.

verses.KJV: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.WEB: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
verses.ASV: and he made a scourge of cords, and cast all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo feito um açoite com cordas, lançou todos para fora do Templo, assim como as ovelhas, e os bois; e espalhou o dinheiro dos cambistas, e virou as mesas.
verses.RVR09: Y hecho un azote de cuerdas, echólos á todos del templo, y las ovejas, y los bueyes; y derramó los dineros de los cambiadores, y trastornó las mesas;

verses.KJV: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.WEB: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
verses.ASV: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house a house of merchandise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos que vendiam pombas, disse: Tirai isto daqui; e não torneis a casa de meu Pai uma casa de comércio!
verses.RVR09: Y á los que vendían las palomas, dijo: Quitad de aquí esto, y no hagáis la casa de mi Padre casa de mercado.

verses.KJV: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.WEB: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
verses.ASV: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lembraram-se seus discípulos que está escrito: O zelo de tua casa me tem me devorado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se acordaron sus discípulos que está escrito: El celo de tu casa me comió.

verses.KJV: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore answered and said unto him, What sign showest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam pois os Judeus, e disseram-lhe: Que sinal nos mostras de que fazes estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: Y los Judíos respondieron, y dijéronle: ¿Qué señal nos muestras de que haces esto?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Derrubai este Templo, e em três dias o levantarei.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjoles: Destruid este templo, y en tres días lo levantaré.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os judeus, pois, disseram: [Durante] quarenta e seis anos este Templo foi edificado, e tu o levantarás tu em três dias?
verses.RVR09: Dijeron luego los Judíos: En cuarenta y seis años fué este templo edificado, ¿y tú en tres días lo levantarás?

verses.KJV: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.WEB: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
verses.ASV: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele falava do Templo de seu corpo.
verses.RVR09: Mas él hablaba del templo de su cuerpo.

verses.KJV: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.WEB: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.ASV: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he spake this; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quando ressuscitou dos mortos, seus discípulos se lembraram que ele lhes tinha dito isto; e creram na Escritura, e na palavra que Jesus tinha [lhes] dito.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, cuando resucitó de los muertos, sus discípulos se acordaron que había dicho esto; y creyeron á la Escritura, y á la palabra que Jesús había dicho.

verses.KJV: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.WEB: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
verses.ASV: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, during the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he did.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando ele em Jerusalém pela páscoa, na festa, muitos creram em seu nome, ao verem os sinais que ele fazia.
verses.RVR09: Y estando en Jerusalem en la Pascua, en el día de la fiesta, muchos creyeron en su nombre, viendo las señales que hacía.

verses.KJV: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
verses.WEB: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
verses.ASV: But Jesus did not trust himself unto them, for that he knew all men,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o mesmo Jesus a si mesmo não confiava neles, porque conhecia a todos.
verses.RVR09: Mas el mismo Jesús no se confiaba á sí mismo de ellos, porque él conocía á todos,

verses.KJV: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.WEB: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.ASV: and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não necessitava de que alguém [lhe] desse testemunho de ser humano algum, pois ele bem sabia o que havia no [interior do] ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Y no tenía necesidad que alguien le diese testimonio del hombre; porque él sabía lo que había en el hombre.

verses.KJV: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.WEB: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.ASV: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um homem dos fariseus, cujo nome era Nicodemos, chefe dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y HABÍA un hombre de los Fariseos que se llamaba Nicodemo, príncipe de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.WEB: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.ASV: the same came unto him by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este veio a Jesus de noite, e disse-lhe: Rabi, bem sabemos que és Mestre vindo de Deus; porque ninguém pode fazer estes sinais que tu fazes, se Deus não for com ele.
verses.RVR09: Este vino á Jesús de noche, y díjole: Rabbí, sabemos que has venido de Dios por maestro; porque nadie puede hacer estas señales que tú haces, si no fuere Dios con él.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus e disse-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que aquele que não voltar a nascer, não pode ver o Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjole: De cierto, de cierto te digo, que el que no naciere otra vez, no puede ver el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.WEB: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
verses.ASV: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
verses.ALMEIDA: Nicodemos lhe disse: Como pode o homem nascer, sendo [já] velho? Pode ele voltar a entrar no ventre de sua mãe, e nascer?
verses.RVR09: Dícele Nicodemo: ¿Cómo puede el hombre nacer siendo viejo? ¿puede entrar otra vez en el vientre de su madre, y nacer?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que aquele que não nascer de água e [do] Espírito, não pode entrar no Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: De cierto, de cierto te digo, que el que no naciere de agua y del Espíritu, no puede entrar en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.WEB: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.ASV: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é nascido de carne, carne é; e o que é nascido do Espírito, espírito é.
verses.RVR09: Lo que es nacido de la carne, carne es; y lo que es nacido del Espíritu, espíritu es.

verses.KJV: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.WEB: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
verses.ASV: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born anew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te maravilhes de que te disse: necessário vos é voltar a nascer.
verses.RVR09: No te maravilles de que te dije: Os es necesario nacer otra vez.

verses.KJV: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.WEB: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.ASV: The wind bloweth where it will, and thou hearest the voice thereof, but knowest not whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vento sopra onde quer, e ouves o seu som; porém não sabes de onde vem, nem para onde vai; assim é todo aquele que é nascido do Espírito.
verses.RVR09: El viento de donde quiere sopla, y oyes su sonido; mas ni sabes de dónde viene, ni á dónde vaya: así es todo aquel que es nacido del Espíritu.

verses.KJV: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.WEB: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
verses.ASV: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.ALMEIDA: Nicodemos respondeu, e disse-lhe: Como pode isto acontecer?
verses.RVR09: Respondió Nicodemo, y díjole: ¿Cómo puede esto hacerse?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou the teacher of Israel, and understandest not these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Tu és mestre de Israel, e isto não sabes?
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjole: ¿Tú eres el maestro de Israel, y no sabes esto?

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that which we know, and bear witness of that which we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que o que sabemos, falamos; e o que temos visto, testemunhamos; e não aceitais nosso testemunho.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto te digo, que lo que sabemos hablamos, y lo que hemos visto, testificamos; y no recibís nuestro testimonio.

verses.KJV: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.WEB: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.ASV: If I told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu vos disse coisas terrenas, e não credes, como crereis, se vos disser as celestiais?
verses.RVR09: Si os he dicho cosas terrenas, y no creéis, ¿cómo creeréis si os dijere las celestiales?

verses.KJV: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.WEB: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.ASV: And no one hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended out of heaven, [even] the Son of man, who is in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém subiu ao céu, a não ser o que desceu do céu: o Filho do homem, que está no céu.
verses.RVR09: Y nadie subió al cielo, sino el que descendió del cielo, el Hijo del hombre, que está en el cielo.

verses.KJV: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.WEB: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.ASV: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up;
verses.ALMEIDA: E como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim deve o Filho do homem ser levantado,
verses.RVR09: Y como Moisés levantó la serpiente en el desierto, así es necesario que el Hijo del hombre sea levantado;

verses.KJV: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.WEB: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.ASV: that whosoever believeth may in him have eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que todo aquele que nele crer não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Para que todo aquel que en él creyere, no se pierda, sino que tenga vida eterna.

verses.KJV: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.WEB: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.ASV: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth on him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus amou ao mundo de tal maneira, que deu o seu Filho unigênito; para que todo aquele que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Porque de tal manera amó Dios al mundo, que ha dado á su Hijo unigénito, para que todo aquel que en él cree, no se pierda, mas tenga vida eterna.

verses.KJV: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.WEB: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.ASV: For God sent not the Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus não mandou seu Filho ao mundo para que condenasse ao mundo; mas sim para que o mundo por ele fosse salvo;
verses.RVR09: Porque no envió Dios á su Hijo al mundo para que condene al mundo, mas para que el mundo sea salvo por él.

verses.KJV: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.WEB: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
verses.ASV: He that believeth on him is not judged: he that believeth not hath been judged already, because he hath not believed on the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem nele crer não é condenado; mas quem não crê já está condenado; pois não tem crido no nome do unigênito Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El que en él cree, no es condenado; mas el que no cree, ya es condenado, porque no creyó en el nombre del unigénito Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.WEB: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
verses.ASV: And this is the judgment, that the light is come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a condenação: que a luz veio ao mundo, e as pessoas amaram mais as trevas que a luz, porque suas obras eram más.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la condenación: porque la luz vino al mundo, y los hombres amaron más las tinieblas que la luz; porque sus obras eran malas.

verses.KJV: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.WEB: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
verses.ASV: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, and cometh not to the light, lest his works should be reproved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todo aquele que faz o mal odeia a luz e não vem à luz, para que suas obras não sejam reprovadas.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo aquel que hace lo malo, aborrece la luz y no viene á la luz, porque sus obras no sean redargüidas.

verses.KJV: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.WEB: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
verses.ASV: But he that doeth the truth cometh to the light, that his works may be made manifest, that they have been wrought in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quem pratica a verdade vem à luz, para que suas obras sejam manifestas, que são feitas em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que obra verdad, viene á la luz, para que sus obras sean manifestadas que son hechas en Dios.

verses.KJV: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.WEB: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
verses.ASV: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto Jesus veio com seus discípulos à terra da Judeia; e estava ali com eles, e batizava.
verses.RVR09: Pasado esto, vino Jesús con sus discípulos á la tierra de Judea; y estaba allí con ellos, y bautizaba.

verses.KJV: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.WEB: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
verses.ASV: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.ALMEIDA: E João também batizava em Enom, junto a Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas; e vinham [ali] , e eram batizados,
verses.RVR09: Y bautizaba también Juan en Enón junto á Salim, porque había allí muchas aguas; y venían, y eran bautizados.

verses.KJV: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.WEB: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
verses.ASV: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque João ainda não tinha sido lançado na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Porque Juan no había sido aún puesto en la carcel.

verses.KJV: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.WEB: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
verses.ASV: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with a Jew about purifying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve pois uma discussão dos Discípulos de João com os judeus sobre a purificação.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo cuestión entre los discípulos de Juan y los Judíos acerca de la purificación.

verses.KJV: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.WEB: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
verses.ASV: And they came unto John, and said to him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond the Jordan, to whom thou hast borne witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a João, e disseram-lhe: Rabi, aquele que estava contigo dalém do Jordão, ao qual tu deste testemunho, eis que batiza, e todos vem a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron á Juan, y dijéronle: Rabbí, el que estaba contigo de la otra parte del Jordán, del cual tú diste testimonio, he aquí bautiza, y todos vienen á él.

verses.KJV: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.WEB: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
verses.ASV: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it have been given him from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: João respondeu, e disse: O ser humano não pode receber coisa alguma, se não lhe for dada do céu.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Juan, y dijo: No puede el hombre recibir algo, si no le fuere dado del cielo.

verses.KJV: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.WEB: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
verses.ASV: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but, that I am sent before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós mesmos me sois testemunhas, que disse: Eu não sou o Cristo; mas que sou enviado diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros mismos me sois testigos que dije: Yo no soy el Cristo, sino que soy enviado delante de él.

verses.KJV: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.WEB: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
verses.ASV: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, that standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que tem a esposa, é o esposo; mas o amigo do esposo, que [o] apoia, e lhe ouve, alegra-se muito pela voz do esposo. Assim pois já este meu gozo é cumprido.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene la esposa, es el esposo; mas el amigo del esposo, que está en pie y le oye, se goza grandemente de la voz del esposo; así pues, este mi gozo es cumplido.

verses.KJV: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.WEB: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.ASV: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ele convém crescer, porém a mim diminuir.
verses.RVR09: A él conviene crecer, mas á mí menguar.

verses.KJV: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.WEB: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.ASV: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is of the earth, and of the earth he speaketh: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que vem de cima, é sobre todos; aquele que [vem] da terra, da terra é, e da terra fala. Aquele que vem do céu é sobre todos.
verses.RVR09: El que de arriba viene, sobre todos es: el que es de la tierra, terreno es, y cosas terrenas habla: el que viene del cielo, sobre todos es.

verses.KJV: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.WEB: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
verses.ASV: What he hath seen and heard, of that he beareth witness; and no man receiveth his witness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E daquilo que viu e ouviu, isto testemunha; e ninguém aceita seu testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que vió y oyó, esto testifica: y nadie recibe su testimonio.

verses.KJV: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.WEB: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.ASV: He that hath received his witness hath set his seal to [this], that God is true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que aceitou seu testemunho, esse selou que Deus é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: El que recibe su testimonio, éste signó que Dios es verdadero.

verses.KJV: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.WEB: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.ASV: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for he giveth not the Spirit by measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aquele que Deus enviou, as palavras de Deus fala; porque não [lhe] dá Deus o Espírito por medida.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que Dios envió, las palabras de Dios habla: porque no da Dios el Espíritu por medida.

verses.KJV: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.WEB: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.ASV: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Pai ama ao Filho, e todas as coisas [lhe] deu em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: El Padre ama al Hijo, y todas las cosas dió en su mano.

verses.KJV: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.WEB: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
verses.ASV: He that believeth on the Son hath eternal life; but he that obeyeth not the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que crê no Filho tem vida eterna; porém aquele que é desobediente ao Filho não verá a vida [eterna] , mas a ira de Deus continua sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: El que cree en el Hijo, tiene vida eterna; mas el que es incrédulo al Hijo, no verá la vida, sino que la ira de Dios está sobre él.

verses.KJV: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.WEB: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.ASV: When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, o Senhor entendeu que os fariseus ouviram que Jesus fazia e batizava mais discípulos que João
verses.RVR09: DE manera que como Jesús entendió que los Fariseos habían oído que Jesús hacía y bautizaba más discípulos que Juan,

verses.KJV: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.WEB: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
verses.ASV: (although Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples),
verses.ALMEIDA: (ainda que Jesus mesmo não batizava, mas sim seus discípulos),
verses.RVR09: (Aunque Jesús no bautizaba, sino sus discípulos),

verses.KJV: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.WEB: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
verses.ASV: he left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele deixou a Judeia, e foi outra vez para a Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Dejó á Judea, y fuése otra vez á Galilea.

verses.KJV: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.WEB: He needed to pass through Samaria.
verses.ASV: And he must needs pass through Samaria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi necessário passar por Samaria.
verses.RVR09: Y era menester que pasase por Samaria.

verses.KJV: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.WEB: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.ASV: So he cometh to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph:
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio pois a uma cidade de Samaria, chamada Sicar, junto à propriedade que Jacó deu a seu filho José.
verses.RVR09: Vino, pues, á una ciudad de Samaria que se llamaba Sichâr, junto á la heredad que Jacob dió á José su hijo.

verses.KJV: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.WEB: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.ASV: and Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali estava a fonte de Jacó. Então Jesus, cansado do caminho, sentou-se assim junto à fonte; era isto quase à hora sexta.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba allí la fuente de Jacob. Pues Jesús, cansado del camino, así se sentó á la fuente. Era como la hora de sexta.

verses.KJV: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.WEB: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.ASV: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio uma mulher de Samaria para tirar água; Disse-lhe Jesus: Dá-me de beber.
verses.RVR09: Vino una mujer de Samaria á sacar agua: y Jesús le dice: Dame de beber.

verses.KJV: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.WEB: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.ASV: For his disciples were gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque seus discípulos haviam ido à cidade para a comprar de comer).
verses.RVR09: (Porque sus discípulos habían ido á la ciudad á comprar de comer.)

verses.KJV: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.WEB: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.ASV: The Samaritan woman therefore saith unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, who am a Samaritan woman? (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe pois a mulher samaritana: Como, sendo tu judeu, me pedes de beber, que sou mulher samaritana? (Porque os judeus não se comunicam com o samaritanos.)
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer Samaritana le dice: ¿Cómo tú, siendo Judío, me pides á mí de beber, que soy mujer Samaritana? porque los Judíos no se tratan con los Samaritanos.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Se tu conhecesses o dom de Deus, e quem é o que te diz: Dá-me de beber, tu lhe pedirias, e ele te daria água viva.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús y díjole: Si conocieses el don de Dios, y quién es el que te dice: Dame de beber: tú pedirías de él, y él te daría agua viva.

verses.KJV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.WEB: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
verses.ASV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse a mulher: Senhor, tu não tens com que [a] tirar, e o poço é fundo; de onde pois tens a água viva?
verses.RVR09: La mujer le dice: Señor, no tienes con qué sacarla, y el pozo es hondo: ¿de dónde, pues, tienes el agua viva?

verses.KJV: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.WEB: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
verses.ASV: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his sons, and his cattle?
verses.ALMEIDA: És tu maior que nosso pai Jacó, que nos deu o poço? E ele mesmo dele bebeu, e seus filhos, e seu gado?
verses.RVR09: ¿Eres tú mayor que nuestro padre Jacob, que nos dió este pozo, del cual él bebió, y sus hijos, y sus ganados?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto her, Every one that drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Todo aquele que beber desta água voltará a ter sede;
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús y díjole: Cualquiera que bebiere de esta agua, volverá á tener sed;

verses.KJV: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.WEB: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
verses.ASV: but whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall become in him a well of water springing up unto eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aquele que beber da água que eu lhe der, para sempre não terá sede, mas a água que eu lhe der se fará nele fonte de água, que salte para vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que bebiere del agua que yo le daré, para siempre no tendrá sed: mas el agua que yo le daré, será en él una fuente de agua que salte para vida eterna.

verses.KJV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.WEB: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
verses.ASV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come all the way hither to draw.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, dá-me desta água, para que eu não tenha [mais] sede, nem venha aqui para tirar.
verses.RVR09: La mujer le dice: Señor, dame esta agua, para que no tenga sed, ni venga acá á sacarla.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, chama a teu marido, e vem cá.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dice: Ve, llama á tu marido, y ven acá.

verses.KJV: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.WEB: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.ASV: The woman answered and said unto him, I have no husband. Jesus saith unto her, Thou saidst well, I have no husband:
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher respondeu, e disse: Não tenho marido. Disse-lhe Jesus: Bem disseste: Marido não tenho.
verses.RVR09: Respondió la mujer, y dijo: No tengo marido. Dícele Jesús: Bien has dicho, No tengo marido;

verses.KJV: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.WEB: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
verses.ASV: for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: this hast thou said truly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cinco maridos tiveste, e o que agora tens não é teu marido; isto com verdade disseste.
verses.RVR09: Porque cinco maridos has tenido: y el que ahora tienes no es tu marido; esto has dicho con verdad.

verses.KJV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.WEB: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.ASV: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
