verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, vejo que és profeta.
verses.RVR09: Dícele la mujer: Señor, paréceme que tú eres profeta.

verses.KJV: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.WEB: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
verses.ASV: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pais adoraram neste monte, e vós dizeis que em Jerusalém é o lugar onde se deve adorar.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros padres adoraron en este monte, y vosotros decís que en Jerusalem es el lugar donde es necesario adorar.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, crê em mim, que a hora vem, quando nem neste monte, nem em Jerusalém, adorareis ao Pai.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Mujer, créeme, que la hora viene, cuando ni en este monte, ni en Jerusalem adoraréis al Padre.

verses.KJV: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.WEB: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.ASV: Ye worship that which ye know not: we worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós adorais o que não sabeis; nós adoramos o que sabemos, porque a salvação vem dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros adoráis lo que no sabéis; nosotros adoramos lo que sabemos: porque la salud viene de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.WEB: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
verses.ASV: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth: for such doth the Father seek to be his worshippers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a hora vem, e agora é, quando os verdadeiros adoradores adorarão ao Pai em espírito e em verdade; porque também o Pai busca a tais que o adorem.
verses.RVR09: Mas la hora viene, y ahora es, cuando los verdaderos adoradores adorarán al Padre en espíritu y en verdad; porque también el Padre tales adoradores busca que le adoren.

verses.KJV: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.WEB: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.ASV: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus é Espírito, e os que o adoram devem adorá [-lo] em espírito e em verdade.
verses.RVR09: Dios es Espíritu; y los que le adoran, en espíritu y en verdad es necesario que adoren.

verses.KJV: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.WEB: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
verses.ASV: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messiah cometh (he that is called Christ): when he is come, he will declare unto us all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe a mulher: Eu sei que o Messias vem (que se chama o Cristo); quando ele vier, todas as coisas nos anunciará.
verses.RVR09: Dícele la mujer: Sé que el Mesías ha de venir, el cual se dice el Cristo: cuando él viniere nos declarará todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am [he].
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou o que contigo falo.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Yo soy, que hablo contigo.

verses.KJV: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.WEB: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
verses.ASV: And upon this came his disciples; and they marvelled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why speakest thou with her?
verses.ALMEIDA: E nisto vieram seus discípulos; e maravilharam-se de que falasse com uma mulher; mas ninguém [lhe] disse: Que perguntas? ou, O que falas com ela?
verses.RVR09: Y en esto vinieron sus discípulos, y maravilláronse de que hablaba con mujer; mas ninguno dijo: ¿Qué preguntas? ó, ¿Qué hablas con ella?

verses.KJV: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.WEB: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.ASV: So the woman left her waterpot, and went away into the city, and saith to the people,
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixou, pois, a mulher seu vaso de água, e foi à cidade, e disse ao povo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer dejó su cántaro, y fué á la ciudad, y dijo á aquellos hombres:

verses.KJV: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.WEB: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.ASV: Come, see a man, who told me all things that [ever] I did: can this be the Christ?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, vede um homem que me disse tudo quanto tenho feito; por acaso não é este o Cristo?
verses.RVR09: Venid, ved un hombre que me ha dicho todo lo que he hecho: ¿si quizás es éste el Cristo?

verses.KJV: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.WEB: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.ASV: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saíram, pois, da cidade, e vieram a ele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salieron de la ciudad, y vinieron á él.

verses.KJV: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.WEB: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.ASV: In the mean while the disciples prayed him, saying, Rabbi, eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto isso, os discípulos lhe pediam, dizendo: Rabi, come.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto los discípulos le rogaban, diciendo: Rabbí, come.

verses.KJV: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
verses.ASV: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhes disse: Uma comida tenho que comer, que vós não sabeis.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Yo tengo una comida que comer, que vosotros no sabéis.

verses.KJV: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.WEB: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
verses.ASV: The disciples therefore said one to another, Hath any man brought him [aught] to eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Diziam, pois, os discípulos uns aos outros: Por acaso alguém lhe trouxe de comer?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los discípulos decían el uno al otro: ¿Si le habrá traído alguien de comer?

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to accomplish his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Jesus: Minha comida é fazer a vontade daquele que me enviou, e cumprir sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: Mi comida es que haga la voluntad del que me envió, y que acabe su obra.

verses.KJV: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.WEB: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
verses.ASV: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and [then] cometh the harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields, that they are white already unto harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dizeis vós, que ainda há quatro meses até que venha a ceifa? Eis que vos digo: Levantai vossos olhos, e vede as terras; porque já estão brancas para a ceifa.
verses.RVR09: ¿No decís vosotros: Aun hay cuatro meses hasta que llegue la siega? He aquí os digo: Alzad vuestros ojos, y mirad las regiones, porque ya están blancas para la siega.

verses.KJV: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.WEB: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.ASV: He that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal; that he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que ceifa, recebe recompensa, e junta fruto para vida eterna; para que ambos se alegrem, tanto o que semeia, quanto o que ceifa.
verses.RVR09: Y el que siega, recibe salario, y allega fruto para vida eterna; para que el que siembra también goce, y el que siega.

verses.KJV: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.WEB: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
verses.ASV: For herein is the saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nisto é verdadeiro o ditado, que: Um é o que semeia, e outro o que ceifa.
verses.RVR09: Porque en esto es el dicho verdadero: Que uno es el que siembra, y otro es el que siega.

verses.KJV: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.WEB: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.ASV: I sent you to reap that whereon ye have not labored: others have labored, and ye are entered into their labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos enviei para ceifar onde vós não trabalhastes; outros trabalharam, e vós entrastes no trabalho deles.
verses.RVR09: Yo os he enviado á segar lo que vosotros no labrasteis: otros labraron, y vosotros habéis entrado en sus labores.

verses.KJV: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.WEB: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
verses.ASV: And from that city many of the Samaritans believed on him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me all things that [ever] I did.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos dos samaritanos daquela cidade creram nele pela palavra da mulher, que testemunhava, dizendo: Ele me disse tudo quanto eu tenho feito.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de los Samaritanos de aquella ciudad creyeron en él por la palabra de la mujer, que daba testimonio, diciendo: Que me dijo todo lo que he hecho.

verses.KJV: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.WEB: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
verses.ASV: So when the Samaritans came unto him, they besought him to abide with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vindo pois os samaritanos a ele, suplicaram-lhe que ficasse com eles; e ele ficou ali dois dias.
verses.RVR09: Viniendo pues los Samaritanos á él, rogáronle que se quedase allí: y se quedó allí dos días.

verses.KJV: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.WEB: Many more believed because of his word.
verses.ASV: And many more believed because of his word;
verses.ALMEIDA: E creram ainda muitos mais pela palavra dele.
verses.RVR09: Y creyeron muchos más por la palabra de él.

verses.KJV: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.WEB: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
verses.ASV: and they said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy speaking: for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam à mulher: Já não cremos por teu dito; porque nós mesmos temos [o] ouvido, e sabemos que verdadeiramente este é o Cristo, o Salvador do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y decían á la mujer: Ya no creemos por tu dicho; porque nosotros mismos hemos oído, y sabemos que verdaderamente éste es el Salvador del mundo, el Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.WEB: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
verses.ASV: And after the two days he went forth from thence into Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de dois dias partiu dali, e foi-se para a Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y dos días después, salió de allí, y fuése á Galilea.

verses.KJV: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.WEB: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.ASV: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honor in his own country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o mesmo Jesus testemunhou que não tem o Profeta honra em sua própria terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque el mismo Jesús dió testimonio de que el profeta en su tierra no tiene honra.

verses.KJV: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.WEB: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
verses.ASV: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vindo pois para a Galileia, os Galileus o receberam, havendo visto todas as coisas que fizera em Jerusalém no [dia] da festa, porque também eles foram ao [dia] da festa.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino á Galilea, los Galileos le recibieron, vistas todas las cosas que había hecho en Jerusalem en el día de la fiesta: porque también ellos habían ido á la fiesta.

verses.KJV: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.WEB: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.ASV: He came therefore again unto Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio pois Jesus outra vez a Caná da Galileia, onde da água fizera vinho. E estava ali um nobre, cujo filho estava enfermo em Cafarnaum.
verses.RVR09: Vino pues Jesús otra vez á Caná de Galilea, donde había hecho el vino del agua. Y había en Capernaum uno del rey, cuyo hijo estaba enfermo.

verses.KJV: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.WEB: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.ASV: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought [him] that he would come down, and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvindo este que Jesus vinha da Judeia para a Galileia, foi ter com ele, e suplicava-lhe que descesse, e curasse a seu filho, porque já estava à morte.
verses.RVR09: Este, como oyó que Jesús venía de Judea á Galilea, fué á él, y rogábale que descendiese, y sanase á su hijo, porque se comenzaba á morir.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe pois Jesus: Se não virdes sinais e milagres não crereis.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús le dijo: Si no viereis señales y milagros no creeréis.

verses.KJV: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.WEB: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.ASV: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nobre lhe disse: Senhor, desce, antes que meu filho morra.
verses.RVR09: El del rey le dijo: Señor, desciende antes que mi hijo muera.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. The man believed the word that Jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, teu filho vive. E o homem creu na palavra que Jesus lhe disse, e se foi.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Ve, tu hijo vive. Y el hombre creyó á la palabra que Jesús le dijo, y se fué.

verses.KJV: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.WEB: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
verses.ASV: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, saying, that his son lived.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [estando] ele já descendo, seus servos lhe saíram ao encontro, e [lhe] anunciaram, dizendo: Teu filho vive.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando ya él descendía, los siervos le salieron á recibir, y le dieron nuevas, diciendo: Tu hijo vive.

verses.KJV: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.WEB: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
verses.ASV: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to amend. They said therefore unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntou-lhes pois, a que hora se achara melhor; e disseram-lhe: Ontem às sete horas a febre o deixou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les preguntó á qué hora comenzó á estar mejor. Y dijéronle: Ayer á las siete le dejó la fiebre.

verses.KJV: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.WEB: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
verses.ASV: So the father knew that [it was] at that hour in which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entendeu pois o pai, que aquela era a mesma hora em que Jesus lhe disse: Teu filho vive. E creu nele, e toda sua casa.
verses.RVR09: El padre entonces entendió, que aquella hora era cuando Jesús le dijo: Tu hijo vive; y creyó él y toda su casa.

verses.KJV: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.WEB: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.ASV: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judæa into Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este segundo sinal Jesus voltou a fazer, quando ele veio d [a] Judeia a Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Esta segunda señal volvió Jesús á hacer, cuando vino de Judea á Galilea.

verses.KJV: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: After these things there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto houve uma festa dos judeus, e subiu Jesus para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de estas cosas, era un día de fiesta de los Judíos, y subió Jesús á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.WEB: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
verses.ASV: Now there is in Jerusalem by the sheep [gate] a pool, which is called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há em Jerusalém à [porta] das ovelhas um tanque, que em hebraico se chama Betesda, que tem cinco entradas cobertas.
verses.RVR09: Y hay en Jerusalem á la puerta del ganado un estanque, que en hebraico es llamado Bethesda, el cual tiene cinco portales.

verses.KJV: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.WEB: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
verses.ASV: In these lay a multitude of them that were sick, blind, halt, withered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nestes jazia grande multidão de enfermos, cegos, mancos, [e de corpo] ressecado, aguardando o movimento da água.
verses.RVR09: En éstos yacía multitud de enfermos, ciegos, cojos, secos, que estaban esperando el movimiento del agua.

verses.KJV: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.WEB: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
verses.ASV: And a certain man was there, who had been thirty and eight years in his infirmity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um anjo descia de vez em quando ao tanque, e agitava a água; e o primeiro que descia nele, depois do movimento da água, sarava de qualquer enfermidade que tivesse.
verses.RVR09: Porque un ángel descendía á cierto tiempo al estanque, y revolvía el agua; y el que primero descendía en el estanque después del movimiento del agua, era sano de cualquier enfermedad que tuviese.

verses.KJV: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.WEB: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
verses.ASV: When Jesus saw him lying, and knew that he had been now a long time [in that case], he saith unto him, Wouldest thou be made whole?
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava ali um certo homem, que havia trinta e oito anos que estava enfermo.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba allí un hombre que había treinta y ocho años que estaba enfermo.

verses.KJV: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.WEB: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
verses.ASV: The sick man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo Jesus a este deitado, e sabendo, que já havia muito tempo que [ali] jazia, disse-lhe: Queres sarar?
verses.RVR09: Como Jesús vió á éste echado, y entendió que ya había mucho tiempo, dícele: ¿Quieres ser sano?

verses.KJV: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.WEB: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, Arise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe o enfermo: Senhor, não tenho homem algum para que, quando a água se agita, me ponha no tanque; e enquanto eu venho, outro desce antes de mim.
verses.RVR09: Señor, le respondió el enfermo, no tengo hombre que me meta en el estanque cuando el agua fuere revuelta; porque entre tanto que yo vengo, otro antes de mí ha descendido.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
verses.ASV: And straightway the man was made whole, and took up his bed and walked. Now it was the sabbath on that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Levanta-te, toma teu leito, e anda.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Levántate, toma tu lecho, y anda.

verses.KJV: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.WEB: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
verses.ASV: So the Jews said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath, and it is not lawful for thee to take up thy bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo aquele homem sarou; e tomou seu leito, e andou. E era Sábado aquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Y luego aquel hombre fué sano, y tomó su lecho, é íbase. Y era sábado aquel día.

verses.KJV: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.WEB: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
verses.ASV: But he answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois os judeus para aquele que fora curado: É Sábado, não te é lícito levar o leito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos decían á aquel que había sido sanado: Sábado es: no te es lícito llevar tu lecho.

verses.KJV: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.WEB: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
verses.ASV: They asked him, Who is the man that said unto thee, Take up [thy bed], and walk?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes ele: Aquele que me curou, esse me disse: Toma teu leito, e anda.
verses.RVR09: Respondióles: El que me sanó, él mismo me dijo: Toma tu lecho y anda.

verses.KJV: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.WEB: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
verses.ASV: But he that was healed knew not who it was; for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in the place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntaram-lhe pois: Quem é o homem que te disse: Toma teu leito e anda?
verses.RVR09: Preguntáronle entonces: ¿Quién es el que te dijo: Toma tu lecho y anda?

verses.KJV: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.WEB: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
verses.ASV: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing befall thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que fora curado, não sabia quem [o] era, porque Jesus se havia retirado, porque naquele lugar havia uma [grande] multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y el que había sido sanado, no sabía quién fuese; porque Jesús se había apartado de la gente que estaba en aquel lugar.

verses.KJV: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.WEB: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
verses.ASV: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Jesus achou-o no Templo, e disse-lhe: Eis que já estás são; não peques mais, para que não te suceda alguma coisa pior.
verses.RVR09: Después le halló Jesús en el templo, y díjole: He aquí, has sido sanado; no peques más, porque no te venga alguna cosa peor.

verses.KJV: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.WEB: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.ASV: And for this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, because he did these things on the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele homem foi anunciar aos judeus que Jesus era o que o curara.
verses.RVR09: El se fué, y dió aviso á los Judíos, que Jesús era el que le había sanado.

verses.KJV: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
verses.ASV: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh even until now, and I work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por isso os judeus perseguiam Jesus e procuravam matá-lo, porque ele fazia estas coisas no sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y por esta causa los Judíos perseguían á Jesús, y procuraban matarle, porque hacía estas cosas en sábado.

verses.KJV: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.WEB: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
verses.ASV: For this cause therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only brake the sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Meu Pai até agora trabalha, e eu [também] trabalho.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les respondió: Mi Padre hasta ahora obra, y yo obro.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.WEB: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father doing: for what things soever he doeth, these the Son also doeth in like manner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto ainda mais procuravam os Judeus matá-lo, porque não só quebrava o sábado, mas também dizia que Deus era seu próprio Pai, fazendo-se igual a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, por tanto, más procuraban los Judíos matarle, porque no sólo quebrantaba el sábado, sino que también á su Padre llamaba Dios, haciéndose igual á Dios.

verses.KJV: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
verses.ASV: For the Father loveth the Son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and greater works than these will he show him, that ye may marvel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu pois Jesus, e disse-lhes: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que não pode o Filho fazer coisa alguma de si mesmo, a não ser aquilo que ele veja o Pai fazer; porque todas as coisas que ele faz, semelhantemente o Filho também as faz.
verses.RVR09: Respondió entonces Jesús, y díjoles: De cierto, de cierto os digo: No puede el Hijo hacer nada de sí mismo, sino lo que viere hacer al Padre: porque todo lo que él hace, esto también hace el Hijo juntamente.

verses.KJV: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.WEB: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.ASV: For as the Father raiseth the dead and giveth them life, even so the Son also giveth life to whom he will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Pai ama ao Filho, e todas as coisas que faz lhe mostra; e maiores obras que estas lhe mostrará, para que vós vos maravilheis.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Padre ama al Hijo, y le muestra todas las cosas que él hace; y mayores obras que éstas le mostrará, de suerte que vosotros os maravilléis.

verses.KJV: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.WEB: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
verses.ASV: For neither doth the Father judge any man, but he hath given all judgment unto the Son;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque como o Pai aos mortos ressuscita e vivifica, assim também o Filho aos que quer vivifica.
verses.RVR09: Porque como el Padre levanta los muertos, y les da vida, así también el Hijo á los que quiere da vida.

verses.KJV: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.WEB: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.ASV: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honoreth not the Son honoreth not the Father that sent him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também o Pai a ninguém julga, mas todo o juízo deu ao Filho,
verses.RVR09: Porque el Padre á nadie juzga, mas todo el juicio dió al Hijo;

verses.KJV: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.WEB: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth him that sent me, hath eternal life, and cometh not into judgment, but hath passed out of death into life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que todos honrem ao Filho, como honram ao Pai. Quem não honra ao Filho, não honra ao Pai que o enviou.
verses.RVR09: Para que todos honren al Hijo como honran al Padre. El que no honra al Hijo, no honra al Padre que le envió.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.WEB: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; and they that hear shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que quem ouve minha palavra, e crê ao que me enviou, tem vida eterna, e não virá em condenação, mas passou da morte para a vida.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: El que oye mi palabra, y cree al que me ha enviado, tiene vida eterna; y no vendrá á condenación, mas pasó de muerte á vida.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
verses.ASV: For as the Father hath life in himself, even so gave he to the Son also to have life in himself:
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que a hora vem, e agora é, quando os mortos ouvirão a voz do Filho de Deus, e aos que ao ouvirem, viverão.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: Vendrá hora, y ahora es, cuando los muertos oirán la voz del Hijo de Dios: y los que oyeren vivirán.

verses.KJV: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.WEB: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
verses.ASV: and he gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque como o Pai tem vida em si mesmo, assim deu também ao Filho que tivesse vida em si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Porque como el Padre tiene vida en sí mismo, así dió también al Hijo que tuviese vida en sí mismo:

verses.KJV: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.WEB: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
verses.ASV: Marvel not at this: for the hour cometh, in which all that are in the tombs shall hear his voice,
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu-lhe poder, para fazer juízo, porque é o Filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y también le dió poder de hacer juicio, en cuanto es el Hijo del hombre.

verses.KJV: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.WEB: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
verses.ASV: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos maravilheis disto; porque a hora vem, em que todos os que estão nos sepulcros ouvirão sua voz.
verses.RVR09: No os maravilléis de esto; porque vendrá hora, cuando todos los que están en los sepulcros oirán su voz;

verses.KJV: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.WEB: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.ASV: I can of myself do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is righteous; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairão os que fizeram bem, para a ressurreição de vida; e os que fizeram mal, à ressurreição de condenação.
verses.RVR09: Y los que hicieron bien, saldrán á resurrección de vida; mas los que hicieron mal, á resurrección de condenación.

verses.KJV: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.WEB: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
verses.ASV: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não posso eu de mim mesmo fazer alguma coisa. Como ouço, [assim] julgo; e meu juízo é justo; porque não busco minha vontade, mas a vontade do Pai que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: No puedo yo de mí mismo hacer nada: como oigo, juzgo: y mi juicio es justo; porque no busco mi voluntad, mas la voluntad del que me envió, del Padre.

verses.KJV: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.WEB: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
verses.ASV: It is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu testemunho de mim mesmo, meu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Si yo doy testimonio de mí mismo, mi testimonio no es verdadero.

verses.KJV: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.WEB: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
verses.ASV: Ye have sent unto John, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outro há que testemunha de mim, e sei que o testemunho, que testemunha de mim, é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Otro es el que da testimonio de mí; y sé que el testimonio que da de mí, es verdadero.

verses.KJV: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.WEB: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verses.ASV: But the witness which I receive is not from man: howbeit I say these things, that ye may be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós enviastes [mensageiros] a João, e ele deu testemunho à verdade.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros enviasteis á Juan, y él dió testimonio á la verdad.

verses.KJV: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.WEB: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
verses.ASV: He was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu não recebo testemunho humano; mas digo isto para que sejais salvos.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo no tomo el testimonio de hombre; mas digo esto, para que vosotros seáis salvos.

verses.KJV: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.WEB: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.ASV: But the witness which I have is greater than [that of] John; for the works which the Father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele era uma lâmpada ardente e brilhante; e vós quisestes por um pouco de tempo alegrar em sua luz.
verses.RVR09: El era antorcha que ardía y alumbraba: y vosotros quisisteis recrearos por un poco á su luz.

verses.KJV: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.WEB: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
verses.ASV: And the Father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu tenho maior testemunho que [o] de João; porque as obras que o Pai me deu que cumprisse, as mesmas obras que eu faço, testemunham de mim que o Pai me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo tengo mayor testimonio que el de Juan: porque las obras que el Padre me dió que cumpliese, las mismas obras que yo hago, dan testimonio de mí, que el Padre me haya enviado.

verses.KJV: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.WEB: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
verses.ASV: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Pai que me enviou, ele mesmo testemunhou de mim. Nunca ouvistes sua voz, nem vistes sua aparência.
verses.RVR09: Y el que me envió, el Padre, él ha dado testimonio de mí. Ni nunca habéis oído su voz, ni habéis visto su parecer.

verses.KJV: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.WEB: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
verses.ASV: Ye search the scriptures, because ye think that in them ye have eternal life; and these are they which bear witness of me;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tendes sua palavra permanecendo em vós; porque ao que ele enviou, a esse vós não credes.
verses.RVR09: Ni tenéis su palabra permanente en vosotros; porque al que él envió, á éste vosotros no creéis.

verses.KJV: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.WEB: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
verses.ASV: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Investigai as Escrituras; porque vós pensais que nelas tendes a vida eterna, e elas são as que de mim testemunham.
verses.RVR09: Escudriñad las Escrituras, porque á vosotros os parece que en ellas tenéis la vida eterna; y ellas son las que dan testimonio de mí.

verses.KJV: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.WEB: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
verses.ASV: I receive not glory from men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não quereis vir a mim, para que tenhais vida.
verses.RVR09: Y no queréis venir á mí, para que tengáis vida.

verses.KJV: I receive not honour from men.
verses.WEB: I don’t receive glory from men.
verses.ASV: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não recebo honra humana.
verses.RVR09: Gloria de los hombres no recibo.

verses.KJV: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.WEB: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
verses.ASV: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu bem vos conheço que não tendes o amor de Deus em vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os conozco, que no tenéis amor de Dios en vosotros.

verses.KJV: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.WEB: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.ASV: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that [cometh] from the only God ye seek not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vim em nome de meu Pai, e vós não me aceitais; se outro vier em seu próprio nome, a esse aceitareis.
verses.RVR09: Yo he venido en nombre de mi Padre, y no me recibís: si otro viniere en su propio nombre, á aquél recibiréis.

verses.KJV: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
verses.WEB: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.ASV: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, [even] Moses, on whom ye have set your hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como podeis vós crer, [se] tomais honra uns dos outros, e não buscais a honra que [vem] somente de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo podéis vosotros creer, pues tomáis la gloria los unos de los otros, y no buscáis la gloria que de sólo Dios viene?

verses.KJV: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.WEB: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
verses.ASV: For if ye believed Moses, ye would believe me; for he wrote of me.

verses.RVR09: No penséis que yo os tengo de acusar delante del Padre; hay quien os acusa, Moisés, en quien vosotros esperáis.

verses.KJV: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me; for he wrote of me.
verses.WEB: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
verses.ASV: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se vós crêsseis em Moisés, [também] a mim me creríeis; porque de mim ele escreveu.
verses.RVR09: Porque si vosotros creyeseis á Moisés, creeríais á mí; porque de mí escribió él.

verses.KJV: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.WEB: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não credes em seus escritos, como crereis em minhas palavras?
verses.RVR09: Y si á sus escritos no creéis, ¿cómo creeréis á mis palabras?

verses.KJV: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.WEB: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.ASV: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is [the sea] of Tiberias.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto Jesus partiu para a outro lado do mar da Galileia, que é o de Tibérias.
verses.RVR09: PASADAS estas cosas, fuése Jesús de la otra parte de la mar de Galilea, que es de Tiberias.

verses.KJV: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.WEB: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
verses.ASV: And a great multitude followed him, because they beheld the signs which he did on them that were sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma grande multidão o seguia, porque viam seus sinais que ele fazia nos enfermos.
verses.RVR09: Y seguíale grande multitud, porque veían sus señales que hacía en los enfermos.

verses.KJV: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.WEB: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
verses.ASV: And Jesus went up into the mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Jesus ao monte, e sentou-se ali com seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y subió Jesús á un monte, y se sentó allí con sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.WEB: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.ASV: Now the passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E já a Páscoa, a festa dos judeus, estava perto.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba cerca la Pascua, la fiesta de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude cometh unto him, saith unto Philip, Whence are we to buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantando pois Jesus os olhos, e vendo que uma grande multidão vinha a ele, disse a Filipe: De onde comparemos pães, para que estes comam?
verses.RVR09: Y como alzó Jesús los ojos, y vió que había venido á él grande multitud, dice á Felipe: ¿De dónde compraremos pan para que coman éstos?

verses.KJV: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.WEB: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.ASV: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Mas ele disse isto para o testar; pois ele bem sabia o que havia de fazer.)
verses.RVR09: Mas esto decía para probarle; porque él sabía lo que había de hacer.

verses.KJV: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.WEB: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
verses.ASV: Philip answered him, Two hundred shillings’ worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one may take a little.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe Filipe: Duzentos dinheiros de pão não lhes bastarão, para que cada um deles tome um pouco.
verses.RVR09: Respondióle Felipe: Doscientos denarios de pan no les bastarán, para que cada uno de ellos tome un poco.

verses.KJV: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.WEB: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.ASV: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe um de seus discípulos, André, o irmão de Simão Pedro:
verses.RVR09: Dícele uno de sus discípulos, Andrés, hermano de Simón Pedro:

verses.KJV: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.WEB: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
verses.ASV: There is a lad here, who hath five barley loaves, and two fishes: but what are these among so many?
verses.ALMEIDA: Um menino está aqui que tem cinco pães de cevada e dois peixinhos; mas que é isto entre tantos?
verses.RVR09: Un muchacho está aquí que tiene cinco panes de cebada y dos pececillos; ¿mas qué es esto entre tantos?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.WEB: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.ASV: Jesus said, Make the people sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jesus: Fazei sentar as pessoas; e havia muita erva naquele lugar. Sentaram-se, pois, os homens, em número de cinco mil.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo: Haced recostar la gente. Y había mucha hierba en aquel lugar: y recostáronse como número de cinco mil varones.

verses.KJV: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.WEB: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to them that were set down; likewise also of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Jesus os pães, e havendo dado graças, repartiu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos aos que estavam sentados, semelhantemente também dos peixes, quanto queriam.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Jesús aquellos panes, y habiendo dado gracias, repartió á los discípulos, y los discípulos á los que estaban recostados: asimismo de los peces, cuanto querían.

verses.KJV: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.WEB: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
verses.ASV: And when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando já estiveram fartos, disse ele a seus discípulos: Recolhei os pedaços que sobraram, para que nada se perca.
verses.RVR09: Y como fueron saciados, dijo á sus discípulos: Recoged los pedazos que han quedado, porque no se pierda nada.

verses.KJV: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.WEB: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.ASV: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which remained over unto them that had eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles os recolheram, e encheram doze cestos de pedaços dos cinco pães de cevada, que sobraram aos que tinham comido.
verses.RVR09: Cogieron pues, é hinchieron doce cestas de pedazos de los cinco panes de cebada, que sobraron á los que habían comido.

verses.KJV: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.WEB: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
verses.ASV: When therefore the people saw the sign which he did, they said, This is of a truth the prophet that cometh into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo, pois, aquelas pessoas o sinal que Jesus fizera, disseram: Este é verdadeiramente o Profeta que havia de vir ao mundo!
verses.RVR09: Aquellos hombres entonces, como vieron la señal que Jesús había hecho, decían: Este verdaderamente es el profeta que había de venir al mundo.

verses.KJV: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again into the mountain himself alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo pois Jesus que viriam, e o tomariam, para fazê-lo rei, voltou a se retirar sozinho ao monte.
verses.RVR09: Y entendiendo Jesús que habían de venir para arrebatarle, y hacerle rey, volvió á retirarse al monte, él solo.

verses.KJV: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.WEB: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
verses.ASV: And when evening came, his disciples went down unto the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando veio o entardecer, seus discípulos desceram para o mar.
verses.RVR09: Y como se hizo tarde, descendieron sus discípulos á la mar;

verses.KJV: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.WEB: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.ASV: and they entered into a boat, and were going over the sea unto Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando no barco, vieram do outro lado do mar para Cafarnaum. E era já escuro, e Jesus [ainda] não tinha vindo a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando en un barco, venían de la otra parte de la mar hacia Capernaum. Y era ya oscuro, y Jesús no había venido á ellos.

verses.KJV: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.WEB: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
verses.ASV: And the sea was rising by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o mar se levantou, porque um grande vento soprava.
verses.RVR09: Y levantábase la mar con un gran viento que soplaba.

verses.KJV: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.WEB: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.ASV: When therefore they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they behold Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the boat: and they were afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo já navegado quase vinte e cinco, ou trinta estádios, viram a Jesus andando sobre o mar, e se aproximando do barco; e temeram.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubieron navegado como veinticinco ó treinta estadios, ven á Jesús que andaba sobre la mar, y se acercaba al barco: y tuvieron miedo.

verses.KJV: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.WEB: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
verses.ASV: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele lhes disse: Sou eu, não temais.
verses.RVR09: Mas él les dijo: Yo soy; no tengáis miedo.

verses.KJV: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.WEB: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.ASV: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat: and straightway the boat was at the land whither they were going.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, então, o receberam com agrado no barco; e logo o barco chegou à terra para onde iam.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces gustaron recibirle en el barco: y luego el barco llegó á la tierra donde iban.

verses.KJV: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.WEB: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.ASV: On the morrow the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, save one, and that Jesus entered not with his disciples into the boat, but [that] his disciples went away alone
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia seguinte, vendo a multidão, que estava do outro lado do mar, que não havia ali mais que um barquinho, em que seus discípulos entraram; e que Jesus não entrara com seus discípulos naquele barquinho, mas [que] seus discípulos sós se haviam ido;
verses.RVR09: El día siguiente, la gente que estaba de la otra parte de la mar, como vió que no había allí otra navecilla sino una, y que Jesús no había entrado con sus discípulos en ella, sino que sus discípulos se habían ido solos;

verses.KJV: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.WEB: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.ASV: (howbeit there came boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks):
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porém outros barquinhos vieram de Tibérias, perto do lugar onde comeram o pão, havendo o Senhor dado graças.)
verses.RVR09: Y que otras navecillas habían arribado de Tiberias junto al lugar donde habían comido el pan después de haber el Señor dado gracias;

verses.KJV: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.WEB: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.ASV: when the multitude therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo pois a multidão que Jesus não estava ali, nem seus discípulos, entraram eles também nos barcos, e vieram a Cafarnaum em busca de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Como vió pues la gente que Jesús no estaba allí, ni sus discípulos, entraron ellos en las navecillas, y vinieron á Capernaum buscando á Jesús.

verses.KJV: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.WEB: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.ASV: And when they found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.ALMEIDA: E achando-o do outro lado do mar, disseram: Rabi, quando chegaste aqui?
verses.RVR09: Y hallándole de la otra parte de la mar, dijéronle: Rabbí, ¿cuándo llegaste acá?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye ate of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus, e disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que me buscais, não pelos sinais que vistes, mas pelo pão que comestes, e vos fartastes.
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús, y dijo: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que me buscáis, no porque habéis visto las señales, sino porque comisteis el pan y os hartasteis.

verses.KJV: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.WEB: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
verses.ASV: Work not for the food which perisheth, but for the food which abideth unto eternal life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him the Father, [even] God, hath sealed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trabalhai não [pela] comida que perece, mas sim [pela] comida que permanece para vida eterna, a qual o Filho do homem vos dará; porque Deus Pai a este selou.
verses.RVR09: Trabajad no por la comida que perece, mas por la comida que á vida eterna permanece, la cual el Hijo del hombre os dará: porque á éste señaló el Padre, que es Dios.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, What must we do, that we may work the works of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Que faremos para trabalhar as obras de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: ¿Qué haremos para que obremos las obras de Dios?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Esta é a obra de Deus: que creiais naquele que ele enviou.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjoles: Esta es la obra de Dios, que creáis en el que él ha enviado.

verses.KJV: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, What then doest thou for a sign, that we may see, and believe thee? what workest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Que sinal, pois, fazes tu para que o vejamos, e em ti creiamos? O que tu operas?
verses.RVR09: Dijéronle entonces: ¿Qué señal pues haces tú, para que veamos, y te creamos? ¿Qué obras?

verses.KJV: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.WEB: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
verses.ASV: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, como está escrito: Pão do céu ele lhes deu para comer.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros padres comieron el maná en el desierto, como está escrito: Pan del cielo les dió á comer.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, It was not Moses that gave you the bread out of heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que Moisés não vos deu o pão do céu; mas meu Pai vos dá o verdadeiro pão do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: De cierto, de cierto os digo: No os dió Moisés pan del cielo; mas mi Padre os da el verdadero pan del cielo.

verses.KJV: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.WEB: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
verses.ASV: For the bread of God is that which cometh down out of heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o pão de Deus é aquele que desce do céu e dá vida ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Porque el pan de Dios es aquel que descendió del cielo y da vida al mundo.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Senhor, dá-nos sempre [d] este pão.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: Señor, danos siempre este pan.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger, and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus lhes disse: Eu sou o pão da vida; quem vem a mim de maneira nenhuma terá fome, e quem crê em mim nunca terá sede.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: Yo soy el pan de vida: el que á mí viene, nunca tendrá hambre; y el que en mí cree, no tendrá sed jamás.

verses.KJV: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.WEB: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
verses.ASV: But I said unto you, that ye have seen me, and yet believe not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas já tenho vos dito que também me vistes, e não credes.
verses.RVR09: Mas os he dicho, que aunque me habéis visto, no creéis.

verses.KJV: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.WEB: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.ASV: All that which the Father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que o Pai me dá virá a mim; e ao que vem a mim, em maneira nenhuma o lançarei fora.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que el Padre me da, vendrá á mí; y al que á mí viene, no le hecho fuera.

verses.KJV: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.WEB: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
verses.ASV: For I am come down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu desci do céu, não para fazer minha vontade, mas sim a vontade daquele que me enviou;
verses.RVR09: Porque he descendido del cielo, no para hacer mi voluntad, mas la voluntad del que me envió.

verses.KJV: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.WEB: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
verses.ASV: And this is the will of him that sent me, that of all that which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a vontade do Pai, que me enviou: que de tudo quanto me deu, nada perca, mas que eu o ressuscite no último dia.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la voluntad del que me envió, del Padre: Que todo lo que me diere, no pierda de ello, sino que lo resucite en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.WEB: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.ASV: For this is the will of my Father, that every one that beholdeth the Son, and believeth on him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a vontade daquele que me enviou, que todo aquele que vê ao Filho, e nele crê, tenha a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la voluntad del que me ha enviado: Que todo aquel que ve al Hijo, y cree en él, tenga vida eterna: y yo le resucitaré en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, I am the bread which came down out of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os judeus murmuravam dele, porque ele tinha dito: Eu sou o pão que desceu do céu.
verses.RVR09: Murmuraban entonces de él los Judíos, porque había dicho: Yo soy el pan que descendí del cielo.

verses.KJV: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.WEB: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
verses.ASV: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how doth he now say, I am come down out of heaven?
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam: Não é este Jesus o filho de José, cujos pai e mãe nós conhecemos? Como, pois, ele diz: Desci do céu?
verses.RVR09: Y decían: ¿No es éste Jesús, el hijo de José, cuyo padre y madre nosotros conocemos? ¿cómo, pues, dice éste: Del cielo he descendido?

verses.KJV: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.WEB: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu, então, Jesus, e disse-lhes: Não murmureis entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús respondió, y díjoles: No murmuréis entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.WEB: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.ASV: No man can come to me, except the Father that sent me draw him: and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém pode vir a mim se o Pai que me enviou não o trouxer; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno puede venir á mí, si el Padre que me envió no le trajere; y yo le resucitaré en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.WEB: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
verses.ASV: It is written in the prophets, And they shall all be taught of God. Every one that hath heard from the Father, and hath learned, cometh unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escrito está nos profetas: E todos serão ensinados por Deus. Portanto todo aquele que do Pai ouviu e aprendeu, esse vem a mim.
verses.RVR09: Escrito está en los profetas: Y serán todos enseñados de Dios. Así que, todo aquel que oyó del Padre, y aprendió, viene á mí.

verses.KJV: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.WEB: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
verses.ASV: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he that is from God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que alguém tenha visto ao Pai, a não ser aquele que é de Deus; este tem visto ao Pai.
verses.RVR09: No que alguno haya visto al Padre, sino aquel que vino de Dios, éste ha visto al Padre.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.WEB: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth hath eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que aquele que crê em mim tem vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: El que cree en mí, tiene vida eterna.

verses.KJV: I am that bread of life.
verses.WEB: I am the bread of life.
verses.ASV: I am the bread of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o pão da vida.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el pan de vida.

verses.KJV: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.WEB: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
verses.ASV: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, e morreram.
verses.RVR09: Vuestros padres comieron el maná en el desierto, y son muertos.

verses.KJV: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.WEB: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
verses.ASV: This is the bread which cometh down out of heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o pão que desceu do céu, para que o ser humano coma dele e não morra.
verses.RVR09: Este es el pan que desciende del cielo, para que el que de él comiere, no muera.

verses.KJV: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.WEB: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.ASV: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: yea and the bread which I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o pão vivo, que desceu do céu; se alguém comer deste pão, para sempre viverá. E o pão que eu darei é minha carne, a qual darei pela vida do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el pan vivo que he descendido del cielo: si alguno comiere de este pan, vivirá para siempre; y el pan que yo daré es mi carne, la cual yo daré por la vida del mundo.

verses.KJV: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore strove one with another, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Discutiam, pois, os Judeus entre si, dizendo: Como este pode nos dar [sua] carne para comer?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos contendían entre sí, diciendo: ¿Cómo puede éste darnos su carne á comer?

verses.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
