verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, ye have not life in yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, então, lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que se não comerdes a carne do Filho do homem e beberdes seu sangue, não tereis vida em vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús les dijo: De cierto, de cierto os digo: Si no comiereis la carne del Hijo del hombre, y bebiereis su sangre, no tendréis vida en vosotros.

verses.KJV: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.WEB: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.ASV: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem come minha carne e bebe meu sangue tem vida eterna, e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.RVR09: El que come mi carne y bebe mi sangre, tiene vida eterna: y yo le resucitaré en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.WEB: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.ASV: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minha carne verdadeiramente é comida; e meu sangue verdadeiramente é bebida.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi carne es verdadera comida, y mi sangre es verdadera bebida.

verses.KJV: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.WEB: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
verses.ASV: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood abideth in me, and I in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem come minha carne e bebe meu sangue, em mim permanece, e eu nele.
verses.RVR09: El que come mi carne y bebe mi sangre, en mí permanece, y yo en él.

verses.KJV: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.WEB: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
verses.ASV: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he that eateth me, he also shall live because of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o Pai vivo me enviou, e eu vivo pelo Pai, assim quem come a mim também por mim viverá.
verses.RVR09: Como me envió el Padre viviente, y yo vivo por el Padre, asimismo el que me come, él también vivirá por mí.

verses.KJV: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.WEB: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
verses.ASV: This is the bread which came down out of heaven: not as the fathers ate, and died; he that eateth this bread shall live for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o pão que desceu do céu. Não como vossos pais, que comeram o maná e morreram; quem comer este pão viverá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Este es el pan que descendió del cielo: no como vuestros padres comieron el maná, y son muertos: el que come de este pan, vivirá eternamente.

verses.KJV: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.WEB: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.ASV: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas ele disse na sinagoga, ensinando em Cafarnaum.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas dijo en la sinagoga, enseñando en Capernaum.

verses.KJV: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.WEB: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
verses.ASV: Many therefore of his disciples, when they heard [this], said, This is a hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos pois de seus discípulos, ao ouvirem [isto] , disseram: Dura é esta palavra; quem a pode ouvir?
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de sus discípulos oyéndolo, dijeron: Dura es esta palabra: ¿quién la puede oir?

verses.KJV: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.WEB: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
verses.ASV: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said unto them, Doth this cause you to stumble?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo, pois, Jesus em si mesmo, que seus discípulos murmuravam disso, disse-lhes: Isto vos ofende?
verses.RVR09: Y sabiendo Jesús en sí mismo que sus discípulos murmuraban de esto, díjoles: ¿Esto os escandaliza?

verses.KJV: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.WEB: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.ASV: [What] then if ye should behold the Son of man ascending where he was before?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Que seria] pois, se vísseis ao Filho do homem subir aonde estava primeiro?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué, si viereis al Hijo del hombre que sube donde estaba primero?

verses.KJV: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.WEB: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.ASV: It is the spirit that giveth life; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I have spoken unto you are spirit, and are life.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Espírito é o que vivifica, a carne para nada aproveita; as palavras que eu vos digo são espírito e são vida.
verses.RVR09: El espíritu es el que da vida; la carne nada aprovecha: las palabras que yo os he hablado, son espíritu, y son vida.

verses.KJV: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.WEB: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
verses.ASV: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who it was that should betray him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas há alguns de vós que não creem.Porque Jesus já sabia desde o princípio quem eram os que não criam, e quem era o que o entregaria.
verses.RVR09: Mas hay algunos de vosotros que no creen. Porque Jesús desde el principio sabía quiénes eran los que no creían, y quién le había de entregar.

verses.KJV: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.WEB: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
verses.ASV: And he said, For this cause have I said unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it be given unto him of the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia: Por isso tenho vos dito que ninguém pode vir a mim, se não lhe for concedido por meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Por eso os he dicho que ninguno puede venir á mí, si no le fuere dado del Padre.

verses.KJV: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.WEB: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
verses.ASV: Upon this many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde então muitos de seus discípulos voltaram atrás, e já não andavam com ele.
verses.RVR09: Desde esto, muchos de sus discípulos volvieron atrás, y ya no andaban con él.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.WEB: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
verses.ASV: Jesus said therefore unto the twelve, Would ye also go away?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, então, Jesus aos doze: Por acaso também vós quereis ir?
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces Jesús á los doce: ¿Queréis vosotros iros también?

verses.KJV: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.ASV: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe pois Simão Pedro: Senhor, a quem iremos? Tu tens as palavras da vida eterna;
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Simón Pedro: Señor, ¿á quién iremos? tú tienes palabras de vida eterna.

verses.KJV: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.WEB: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.ASV: And we have believed and know that thou art the Holy One of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós cremos e conhecemos que tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivo.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros creemos y conocemos que tú eres el Cristo, el Hijo de Dios viviente.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, Did not I choose you the twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes respondeu: Por acaso não [fui] eu que vos escolhi, os doze? Porém um de vós é um diabo.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le respondió: ¿No he escogido yo á vosotros doce, y uno de vosotros es diablo?

verses.KJV: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.WEB: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.ASV: Now he spake of Judas [the son] of Simon Iscariot, for he it was that should betray him, [being] one of the twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele dizia [isto] de Judas de Simão Iscariotes; porque ele o entregaria, o qual era um dos doze.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaba de Judas Iscariote, hijo de Simón, porque éste era el que le había de entregar, el cual era uno de los doce.

verses.KJV: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.WEB: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.ASV: And after these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judæa, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto andava Jesus na Galileia; e já não queria andar na Judeia, porque os judeus procuravam matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y PASADAS estas cosas andaba Jesús en Galilea: que no quería andar en Judea, porque los Judíos procuraban matarle.

verses.KJV: Now the Jew's feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.WEB: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
verses.ASV: Now the feast of the Jews, the feast of tabernacles, was at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E já estava perto a festa dos tabernáculos dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba cerca la fiesta de los Judíos, la de los tabernáculos.

verses.KJV: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.WEB: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
verses.ASV: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may behold thy works which thou doest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois seus irmãos: Parti daqui, e vai-te para a Judeia, para que também teus discípulos vejam as tuas obras que fazes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle sus hermanos: Pásate de aquí, y vete á Judea, para que también tus discípulos vean las obras que haces.

verses.KJV: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.WEB: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
verses.ASV: For no man doeth anything in secret, and himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou doest these things, manifest thyself to the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ninguém que procura ser conhecido faz coisa alguma em oculto. Se fazes estas coisas, manifesta-te ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Que ninguno que procura ser claro, hace algo en oculto. Si estas cosas haces, manifiéstate al mundo.

verses.KJV: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.WEB: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
verses.ASV: For even his brethren did not believe on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nem mesmo os seus irmãos criam nele.
verses.RVR09: Porque ni aun sus hermanos creían en él.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore saith unto them, My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhes disse: Meu tempo ainda não é chegado; mas vosso tempo sempre está pronto.
verses.RVR09: Díceles entonces Jesús: Mi tiempo aun no ha venido; mas vuestro tiempo siempre está presto.

verses.KJV: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.WEB: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
verses.ASV: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that its works are evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mundo não pode vos odiar, mas a mim me odeia, porque dele testemunho que suas obras são más.
verses.RVR09: No puede el mundo aborreceros á vosotros; mas á mí me aborrece, porque yo doy testimonio de él, que sus obras son malas.

verses.KJV: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.
verses.WEB: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
verses.ASV: Go ye up unto the feast: I go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subi vós para esta festa; eu não subo ainda a esta festa, porque ainda meu tempo não é cumprido.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros subid á esta fiesta; yo no subo aún á esta fiesta, porque mi tiempo aun no es cumplido.

verses.KJV: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.WEB: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
verses.ASV: And having said these things unto them, he abode [still] in Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo-lhes dito isto, ficou na Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndoles dicho esto, quedóse en Galilea.

verses.KJV: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.WEB: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
verses.ASV: But when his brethren were gone up unto the feast, then went he also up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas havendo seus irmãos já subido, então subiu ele também à festa, não abertamente, mas como em oculto.
verses.RVR09: Mas como sus hermanos hubieron subido, entonces él también subió á la fiesta, no manifiestamente, sino como en secreto.

verses.KJV: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscavam-no pois os judeus na festa, e diziam: Onde ele está?
verses.RVR09: Y buscábanle los Judíos en la fiesta, y decían: ¿Dónde está aquél?

verses.KJV: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.WEB: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
verses.ASV: And there was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him: some said, He is a good man; others said, Not so, but he leadeth the multitude astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia grande murmuração dele nas multidões. Alguns diziam: Ele é Bom;e outros diziam: Não; ele, porém, engana a multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y había grande murmullo de él entre la gente: porque unos decían: Bueno es; y otros decían: No, antes engaña á las gentes.

verses.KJV: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.WEB: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.ASV: Yet no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia ninguém falava dele abertamente, com medo dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Mas ninguno hablaba abiertamente de él, por miedo de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.WEB: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verses.ASV: But when it was now the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém no meio da festa subiu Jesus ao Templo, e ensinava.
verses.RVR09: Y al medio de la fiesta subió Jesús al templo, y enseñaba.

verses.KJV: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.ALMEIDA: E maravilhavam-se os Judeus, dizendo: Como este sabe as Escrituras, não as havendo aprendido?
verses.RVR09: Y maravillábanse los Judíos, diciendo: ¿Cómo sabe éste letras, no habiendo aprendido?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore answered them, and said, My teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus, e disse: Minha doutrina não é minha, mas sim daquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús, y dijo: Mi doctrina no es mía, sino de aquél que me envió.

verses.KJV: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
verses.WEB: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
verses.ASV: If any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of God, or [whether] I speak from myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém quiser fazer sua vontade, da doutrina conhecerá, se é de Deus, ou [se] eu falo de mim mesmo.
verses.RVR09: El que quisiere hacer su voluntad, conocerá de la doctrina si viene de Dios, ó si yo hablo de mí mismo.

verses.KJV: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.WEB: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.ASV: He that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem fala de si mesmo busca sua própria honra; mas quem busca a honra daquele que o enviou, esse é verdadeiro, e não há nele injustiça.
verses.RVR09: El que habla de sí mismo, su propia gloria busca; mas el que busca la gloria del que le envió, éste es verdadero, y no hay en él injusticia.

verses.KJV: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.WEB: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
verses.ASV: Did not Moses give you the law, and [yet] none of you doeth the law? Why seek ye to kill me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos deu Moisés a Lei? Mas ninguém de vós cumpre a Lei. Por que procurais me matar?
verses.RVR09: ¿No os dió Moisés la ley, y ninguno de vosotros hace la ley? ¿Por qué me procuráis matar?

verses.KJV: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.WEB: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
verses.ASV: The multitude answered, Thou hast a demon: who seeketh to kill thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu a multidão, e disse: Tens demônio; quem procura te matar?
verses.RVR09: Respondió la gente, y dijo: Demonio tienes: ¿quién te procura matar?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto them, I did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Uma obra fiz, e todos vos maravilhais.
verses.RVR09: Jesús respondió, y díjoles: Una obra hice, y todos os maravilláis.

verses.KJV: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.WEB: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
verses.ASV: Moses hath given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers); and on the sabbath ye circumcise a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Moisés vos deu a circuncisão (não porque seja de Moisés, mas dois pais) e no sábado circuncidais ao homem.
verses.RVR09: Cierto, Moisés os dió la circuncisión (no porque sea de Moisés, mas de los padres); y en sábado circuncidáis al hombre.

verses.KJV: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.WEB: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
verses.ASV: If a man receiveth circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken; are ye wroth with me, because I made a man every whit whole on the sabbath?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o homem recebe a circuncisão no sábado, para que a Lei de Moisés não seja quebrada, irritai-vos comigo, porque no sábado curei por completo um homem?
verses.RVR09: Si recibe el hombre la circuncisión en sábado, para que la ley de Moisés no sea quebrantada, ¿os enojáis conmigo porque en sábado hice sano todo un hombre?

verses.KJV: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.WEB: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
verses.ASV: Judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não julgueis segundo a aparência, mas julgai juízo justo.
verses.RVR09: No juzguéis según lo que parece, mas juzgad justo juicio.

verses.KJV: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.WEB: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
verses.ASV: Some therefore of them of Jerusalem said, Is not this he whom they seek to kill?
verses.ALMEIDA: Diziam, pois, alguns dos de Jerusalém: Não é este ao que procuram matar?
verses.RVR09: Decían entonces unos de los de Jerusalem: ¿No es éste al que buscan para matarlo?

verses.KJV: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.WEB: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
verses.ASV: And lo, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing unto him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is the Christ?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que ele fala livremente, e nada lhe dizem; por acaso é verdade que os chefes sabem que este realmente é o Cristo?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, habla públicamente, y no le dicen nada; ¿si habrán entendido verdaderamente los príncipes, que éste es el Cristo?

verses.KJV: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.WEB: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
verses.ASV: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when the Christ cometh, no one knoweth whence he is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas este bem sabemos de onde é: Porém quando vier o Cristo, ninguém saberá de onde é.
verses.RVR09: Mas éste, sabemos de dónde es: y cuando viniere el Cristo, nadie sabrá de dónde sea.

verses.KJV: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore cried in the temple, teaching and saying, Ye both know me, and know whence I am; and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exclamava pois Jesus no Templo, ensinando, e dizendo: E a mim me conheceis, e sabeis de onde sou; e eu não vim de mim mesmo; mas aquele que me enviou é verdadeiro, ao qual vós não conheceis.
verses.RVR09: Entonces clamaba Jesús en el templo, enseñando y diciendo: Y á mí me conocéis, y sabéis de dónde soy; y no he venido de mí mismo; mas el que me envió es verdadero, al cual vosotros no conocéis.

verses.KJV: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.WEB: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
verses.ASV: I know him; because I am from him, and he sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu o conheço, porque dele sou, e ele me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Yo le conozco, porque de él soy, y él me envió.

verses.KJV: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.WEB: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.ASV: They sought therefore to take him: and no man laid his hand on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procuravam pois prendê-lo, mas ninguém pôs a mão nele, porque sua hora ainda não era vinda.
verses.RVR09: Entonces procuraban prenderle; mas ninguno puso en él mano, porque aun no había venido su hora.

verses.KJV: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
verses.WEB: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
verses.ASV: But of the multitude many believed on him; and they said, When the Christ shall come, will he do more signs than those which this man hath done?
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos da multidão creram nele, e diziam: Quando o Cristo vier, fará ainda mais sinais do que os que este tem feito?
verses.RVR09: Y muchos del pueblo creyeron en él, y decían: El Cristo, cuando viniere, ¿hará más señales que las que éste hace?

verses.KJV: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
verses.ASV: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to take him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviram os fariseus que a multidão murmurava estas coisas sobre ele; e os fariseus e os chefes dos Sacerdotes mandaram oficiais para prendê-lo.
verses.RVR09: Los Fariseos oyeron á la gente que murmuraba de él estas cosas; y los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los Fariseos enviaron servidores que le prendiesen.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Jesus: Ainda um pouco de tempo estou convosco, e [então] me irei para aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús dijo: Aun un poco de tiempo estaré con vosotros, é iré al que me envió.

verses.KJV: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
verses.WEB: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
verses.ASV: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, ye cannot come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós me buscareis, mas não [me] achareis; e onde eu estou vós não podeis vir.
verses.RVR09: Me buscaréis, y no me hallaréis; y donde yo estaré, vosotros no podréis venir.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore said among themselves, Whither will this man go that we shall not find him? will he go unto the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram, pois, os judeus uns aos outros: Para onde este se irá, que não o acharemos? Por acaso ele irá aos dispersos entre os gregos, e a ensinar aos gregos?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos dijeron entre sí: ¿A dónde se ha de ir éste que no le hallemos? ¿Se ha de ir á los esparcidos entre los Griegos, y á enseñar á los Griegos?

verses.KJV: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
verses.WEB: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
verses.ASV: What is this word that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me; and where I am, ye cannot come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que palavra é esta que disse: Vós me buscareis, mas não [me] achareis; e onde eu estou vós não podeis vir?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué dicho es éste que dijo: Me buscaréis, y no me hallaréis; y donde yo estaré, vosotros no podréis venir?

verses.KJV: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.WEB: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
verses.ASV: Now on the last day, the great [day] of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no último e grande dia da festa se pôs Jesus em pé, e exclamou, dizendo: Se alguém tem sede, venha a mim, e beba.
verses.RVR09: Mas en el postrer día grande de la fiesta, Jesús se ponía en pie y clamaba, diciendo: Si alguno tiene sed, venga á mí y beba.

verses.KJV: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.WEB: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
verses.ASV: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, from within him shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem crê em mim, como diz a Escritura, rios de água viva correrão do interior de seu corpo.
verses.RVR09: El que cree en mí, como dice la Escritura, ríos de agua viva correrán de su vientre.

verses.KJV: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.WEB: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
verses.ASV: But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believed on him were to receive: for the Spirit was not yet [given]; because Jesus was not yet glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: (E ele disse isto do Espírito que receberiam aqueles que nele cressem; pois o Espírito Santo ainda não era [vindo] ,porque Jesus ainda não havia sido glorificado).
verses.RVR09: (Y esto dijo del Espíritu que habían de recibir los que creyesen en él: pues aun no había venido el Espíritu Santo; porque Jesús no estaba aún glorificado.)

verses.KJV: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.WEB: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
verses.ASV: [Some] of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is of a truth the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então muitos da multidão, ouvindo esta palavra, diziam: Verdadeiramente este é o Profeta.
verses.RVR09: Entonces algunos de la multitud, oyendo este dicho, decían: Verdaderamente éste es el profeta.

verses.KJV: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.WEB: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.ASV: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, What, doth the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Outros diziam: Este é o Cristo; e outros diziam: Por acaso vem o Cristo da Galileia?
verses.RVR09: Otros decían: Este es el Cristo. Algunos empero decían: ¿De Galilea ha de venir el Cristo?

verses.KJV: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.WEB: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
verses.ASV: Hath not the scripture said that the Christ cometh of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não diz a Escritura que o Cristo virá da semente de Davi, e da aldeia de Belém, de onde era Davi?
verses.RVR09: ¿No dice la Escritura, que de la simiente de David, y de la aldea de Bethlehem, de donde era David, vendrá el Cristo?

verses.KJV: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.WEB: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
verses.ASV: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso havia divisão de opiniões na multidão por causa dele.
verses.RVR09: Así que había disensión entre la gente acerca de él.

verses.KJV: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.WEB: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.ASV: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns deles queriam prendê-lo, mas ninguém pôs a mão nele.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de ellos querían prenderle; mas ninguno echó sobre él manos.

verses.KJV: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.WEB: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
verses.ASV: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why did ye not bring him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram pois os oficiais dos sacerdotes e fariseus; e eles lhes disseram: Por que não o trouxestes?
verses.RVR09: Y los ministriles vinieron á los principales sacerdotes y á los Fariseos; y ellos les dijeron: ¿Por qué no le trajisteis?

verses.KJV: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.WEB: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
verses.ASV: The officers answered, Never man so spake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os oficiais responderam: Ninguém jamais falou assim como este homem.
verses.RVR09: Los ministriles respondieron: Nunca ha hablado hombre así como este hombre.

verses.KJV: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.WEB: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
verses.ASV: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Are ye also led astray?
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhes, pois, os fariseus: Estais vós também enganados?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Fariseos les respondieron: ¿Estáis también vosotros engañados?

verses.KJV: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.WEB: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.ASV: Hath any of the rulers believed on him, or of the Pharisees?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso algum dos chefes ou dos fariseus creu nele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Ha creído en él alguno de los príncipes, ó de los Fariseos?

verses.KJV: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.WEB: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
verses.ASV: But this multitude that knoweth not the law are accursed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas esta multidão, que não sabe a Lei, maldita é.
verses.RVR09: Mas estos comunales que no saben la ley, malditos son.

verses.KJV: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
verses.WEB: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
verses.ASV: Nicodemus saith unto them (he that came to him before, being one of them),
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Nicodemos, o que viera a ele de noite, que era um deles:
verses.RVR09: Díceles Nicodemo (el que vino á él de noche, el cual era uno de ellos):

verses.KJV: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.WEB: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
verses.ASV: Doth our law judge a man, except it first hear from himself and know what he doeth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso nossa Lei julga ao homem sem primeiro o ouvir, e entender o que faz?
verses.RVR09: ¿Juzga nuestra ley á hombre, si primero no oyere de él, y entendiere lo que ha hecho?

verses.KJV: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.WEB: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
verses.ASV: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and see that out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam eles, e disseram: És tu também da Galileia? Pesquisa, e vê que nenhum profeta se levantou da Galileia.
verses.RVR09: Respondieron y dijéronle: ¿Eres tú también Galileo? Escudriña y ve que de Galilea nunca se levantó profeta.

verses.KJV: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.WEB: Everyone went to his own house,
verses.ASV: [And they went every man unto his own house:
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada um foi para sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése cada uno á su casa.

verses.KJV: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.WEB: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.ASV: but Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus foi para o monte das Oliveiras.
verses.RVR09: Y JESÚS se fué al monte de las Olivas.

verses.KJV: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.WEB: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
verses.ASV: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela manhã cedo voltou ao Templo, e todo o povo veio a ele; e sentando-se, ensinava-os.
verses.RVR09: Y por la mañana volvió al templo, y todo el pueblo vino á él: y sentado él, los enseñaba.

verses.KJV: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.WEB: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
verses.ASV: And the scribes and the Pharisees bring a woman taken in adultery; and having set her in the midst,
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram-lhe os escribas e fariseus uma mulher tomada em adultério;
verses.RVR09: Entonces los escribas y los Fariseos le traen una mujer tomada en adulterio; y poniéndola en medio,

verses.KJV: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.WEB: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
verses.ASV: they say unto him, Teacher, this woman hath been taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pondo-a no meio, disseram-lhe: Mestre, esta mulher foi tomada no momento em que estava adulterando.
verses.RVR09: Dícenle: Maestro, esta mujer ha sido tomada en el mismo hecho, adulterando;

verses.KJV: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.WEB: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
verses.ASV: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such: what then sayest thou of her?
verses.ALMEIDA: E na Lei nos mandou Moisés, que as tais sejam apedrejadas; tu pois que dizes?
verses.RVR09: Y en la ley Moisés nos mandó apedrear á las tales: tú pues, ¿qué dices?

verses.KJV: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.WEB: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.ASV: And this they said, trying him, that they might have [whereof] to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto diziam eles, tentando-o, para que tivessem de que o acusar. Mas inclinando-se Jesus, escrevia com o dedo na terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto decían tentándole, para poder acusarle. Empero Jesús, inclinado hacia abajo, escribía en tierra con el dedo.

verses.KJV: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.WEB: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
verses.ASV: But when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto continuavam lhe perguntando, ele se endireitou, e disse-lhes: Aquele de vós que está sem pecado, [seja] o primeiro que atire pedra contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Y como perseverasen preguntándole, enderezóse, y díjoles: El que de vosotros esté sin pecado, arroje contra ella la piedra el primero.

verses.KJV: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.WEB: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.ASV: And again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltando a se inclinar, escrevia na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y volviéndose á inclinar hacia abajo, escribía en tierra.

verses.KJV: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.WEB: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
verses.ASV: And they, when they heard it, went out one by one, beginning from the eldest, [even] unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman, where she was, in the midst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ouvindo eles [isto] , e acusados pela [própria] consciência, saíram um a um, começando dos mais velhos até os últimos; e Jesus ficou só, e a mulher, que estava no meio.
verses.RVR09: Oyendo, pues, ellos, redargüidos de la conciencia, salíanse uno á uno, comenzando desde los más viejos hasta los postreros: y quedó solo Jesús, y la mujer que estaba en medio.

verses.KJV: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.WEB: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
verses.ASV: And Jesus lifted up himself, and said unto her, Woman, where are they? did no man condemn thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E endireitando-se Jesus, e não vendo a ninguém além da mulher, disse-lhe: Mulher, onde estão aqueles teus acusadores? Ninguém te condenou?
verses.RVR09: Y enderezándose Jesús, y no viendo á nadie más que á la mujer, díjole: ¿Mujer, dónde están los que te acusaban? ¿Ninguno te ha condenado?

verses.KJV: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.WEB: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
verses.ASV: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, Neither do I condemn thee: go thy way; from henceforth sin no more.]
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ela: Ninguém, Senhor. E disse-lhe Jesus: Nem eu também te condeno; vai, e não peques mais.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Señor, ninguno. Entonces Jesús le dijo: Ni yo te condeno: vete, y no peques más.

verses.KJV: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.WEB: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
verses.ASV: Again therefore Jesus spake unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falou-lhes pois Jesus outra vez, dizendo: Eu sou a luz do mundo; quem me seguir não andará em trevas, mas terá luz de vida.
verses.RVR09: Y hablóles Jesús otra vez, diciendo: Yo soy la luz del mundo: el que me sigue, no andará en tinieblas, mas tendrá la lumbre de la vida.

verses.KJV: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
verses.ASV: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest witness of thyself; thy witness is not true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois os Fariseus: Tu testemunhas de ti mesmo; teu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Fariseos le dijeron: Tú de ti mismo das testimonio: tu testimonio no es verdadero.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Even if I bear witness of myself, my witness is true; for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye know not whence I come, or whither I go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Ainda que eu testemunho de mim mesmo, meu testemunho é verdadeiro; porque sei de onde vim, e para onde vou; porém vós não sabeis, de onde venho, nem para onde vou.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjoles: Aunque yo doy testimonio de mí mismo, mi testimonio es verdadero, porque sé de dónde he venido y á dónde voy; mas vosotros no sabéis de dónde vengo, y á dónde voy.

verses.KJV: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.WEB: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
verses.ASV: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós julgais segundo a carne, eu não julgo a ninguém.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros según la carne juzgáis; mas yo no juzgo á nadie.

verses.KJV: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.WEB: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
verses.ASV: Yea and if I judge, my judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu também julgo, meu juízo é verdadeiro; porque não sou eu só, mas eu, e o Pai que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Y si yo juzgo, mi juicio es verdadero; porque no soy solo, sino yo y el que me envió, el Padre.

verses.KJV: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.WEB: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
verses.ASV: Yea and in your law it is written, that the witness of two men is true.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também em vossa Lei está escrito que o testemunho de duas pessoas é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y en vuestra ley está escrito que el testimonio de dos hombres es verdadero.

verses.KJV: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.WEB: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
verses.ASV: I am he that beareth witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o que testemunho de mim mesmo; e [também] de mim testemunha o Pai, que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el que doy testimonio de mí mismo: y da testimonio de mí el que me envió, el Padre.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye know neither me, nor my Father: if ye knew me, ye would know my Father also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Onde está teu Pai? Respondeu Jesus: Nem a mim me conheceis, nem a meu Pai; se vós a mim conhecêsseis, também conheceríeis a meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Y decíanle: ¿Dónde está tu Padre? Respondió Jesús: Ni á mí me conocéis, ni á mi Padre; si á mí me conocieseis, á mi Padre también conocierais.

verses.KJV: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.WEB: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.ASV: These words spake he in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man took him; because his hour was not yet come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas palavras falou Jesus junto à arca do tesouro, ensinando no Templo; e ninguém o prendeu, porque sua hora ainda não era chegada.
verses.RVR09: Estas palabras habló Jesús en el lugar de las limosnas, enseñando en el templo: y nadie le prendió; porque aun no había venido su hora.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.WEB: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
verses.ASV: He said therefore again unto them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Jesus outra vez: Eu me vou, e me buscareis, e morrereis em vosso pecado; para onde eu vou vós não podeis vir.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles otra vez Jesús: Yo me voy, y me buscaréis, mas en vuestro pecado moriréis: á donde yo voy, vosotros no podéis venir.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Diziam, pois, os Judeus: Ele, por acaso, matará a si mesmo? Pois diz: Para onde eu vou vós não podeis vir.
verses.RVR09: Decían entonces los Judíos: ¿Hase de matar á sí mismo, que dice: A donde yo voy, vosotros no podéis venir?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes dizia: Vós sois de baixo, eu sou de cima; vós sois deste mundo, eu não sou deste mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y decíales: Vosotros sois de abajo, yo soy de arriba; vosotros sois de este mundo, yo no soy de este mundo.

verses.KJV: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.WEB: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
verses.ASV: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu vos disse, que morrereis em vossos pecados; porque se não credes que eu sou, morrereis em vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Por eso os dije que moriréis en vuestros pecados; porque si no creyereis que yo soy, en vuestros pecados moriréis.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.WEB: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? Jesus said unto them, Even that which I have also spoken unto you from the beginning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és tu? Jesus lhes disse: [Sou] o mesmo que desde o princípio tenho vos dito.
verses.RVR09: Y decíanle: ¿Tú quién eres? Entonces Jesús les dijo: El que al principio también os he dicho.

verses.KJV: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.WEB: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
verses.ASV: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you: howbeit he that sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these speak I unto the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas coisas tenho que dizer e julgar de vós; mas verdadeiro é aquele que me enviou; e eu, o que dele tenho ouvido, isso falo ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Muchas cosas tengo que decir y juzgar de vosotros: mas el que me envió, es verdadero: y yo, lo que he oído de él, esto hablo en el mundo.

verses.KJV: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.WEB: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
verses.ASV: They perceived not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] não entenderam que ele estava lhes falando do Pai.
verses.RVR09: Mas no entendieron que él les hablaba del Padre.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am [he], and [that] I do nothing of myself, but as the Father taught me, I speak these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus, então, lhes disse: Quando levantardes ao Filho do homem, então entendereis que eu sou, e que nada faço de mim mesmo; mas isto digo, como meu Pai me ensinou.
verses.RVR09: Díjoles pues, Jesús: Cuando levantareis al Hijo del hombre, entonces entenderéis que yo soy, y que nada hago de mí mismo; mas como el Padre me enseñó, esto hablo.

verses.KJV: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.WEB: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
verses.ASV: And he that sent me is with me; he hath not left me alone; for I do always the things that are pleasing to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele que me enviou está comigo. O Pai não me tem deixado só, porque sempre faço o que lhe agrada.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que me envió, conmigo está; no me ha dejado solo el Padre; porque yo, lo que á él agrada, hago siempre.

verses.KJV: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.WEB: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
verses.ASV: As he spake these things, many believed on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falando ele estas coisas, muitos creram nele.
verses.RVR09: Hablando él estas cosas, muchos creyeron en él.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said to those Jews that had believed him, If ye abide in my word, [then] are ye truly my disciples;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizia, pois, Jesus aos judeus que criam nele: Se vós permanecerdes em minha palavra, verdadeiramente sereis meus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y decía Jesús á los Judíos que le habían creído: Si vosotros permaneciereis en mi palabra, seréis verdaderamente mis discípulos;

verses.KJV: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.WEB: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.ASV: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conhecereis a verdade, e a verdade vos libertará.
verses.RVR09: Y conoceréis la verdad, y la verdad os libertará.

verses.KJV: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.WEB: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
verses.ASV: They answered unto him, We are Abraham’s seed, and have never yet been in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhe: Somos descendência de Abraão, e nunca servimos a ninguém; como, [pois] , dizes: Sereis livres?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiéronle: Simiente de Abraham somos, y jamás servimos á nadie: ¿cómo dices tú: Seréis libres?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que todo aquele que comete pecado é servo do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Jesús les respondió: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que todo aquel que hace pecado, es siervo de pecado.

verses.KJV: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.WEB: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
verses.ASV: And the bondservant abideth not in the house for ever: the son abideth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o servo não fica em casa para sempre; o Filho fica para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y el siervo no queda en casa para siempre: el hijo queda para siempre.

verses.KJV: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.WEB: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.ASV: If therefore the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se o Filho vos libertar, verdadeiramente sereis livres.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si el Hijo os libertare, seréis verdaderamente libres.

verses.KJV: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.WEB: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
verses.ASV: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; yet ye seek to kill me, because my word hath not free course in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem sei que sois descendência de Abraão; porém procurais matar-me, porque minha palavra não encontra lugar em vós.
verses.RVR09: Sé que sois simiente de Abraham, mas procuráis matarme, porque mi palabra no cabe en vosotros.

verses.KJV: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.WEB: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
verses.ASV: I speak the things which I have seen with [my] Father: and ye also do the things which ye heard from [your] father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o que vi junto a meu Pai, [isso] falo; e vós, o que também vistes junto a vosso pai [isso] fazeis.
verses.RVR09: Yo hablo lo que he visto cerca del Padre; y vosotros hacéis lo que habéis oído cerca de vuestro padre.

verses.KJV: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.WEB: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.ASV: They answered and said unto him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam, e lhe disseram: Nosso pai é Abraão. Disse-lhes Jesus: Se fôsseis filhos de Abraão, faríeis as obras de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Respondieron y dijéronle: Nuestro padre es Abraham. Díceles Jesús: Si fuerais hijos de Abraham, las obras de Abraham haríais.

verses.KJV: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.WEB: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
verses.ASV: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I heard from God: this did not Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora procurais matar a mim, o homem que tenho vos falado a verdade que de Deus tenho ouvido; Abraão não fez isto.
verses.RVR09: Empero ahora procuráis matarme, hombre que os he hablado la verdad, la cual he oído de Dios: no hizo esto Abraham.

verses.KJV: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.WEB: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
verses.ASV: Ye do the works of your father. They said unto him, We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, [even] God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós fazeis as obras de vosso pai.Disseram-lhe pois: Nós não somos nascidos de pecado sexual; nós temos um Pai: Deus.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros hacéis las obras de vuestro padre. Dijéronle entonces: Nosotros no somos nacidos de fornicación; un padre tenemos, que es Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.WEB: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I came forth and am come from God; for neither have I come of myself, but he sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Jesus: Se Deus fosse vosso Pai, verdadeiramente me amaríeis; porque eu saí e venho de Deus; pois não vim de mim mesmo, porém ele me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces les dijo: Si vuestro padre fuera Dios, ciertamente me amaríais: porque yo de Dios he salido, y he venido; que no he venido de mí mismo, mas él me envió.

verses.KJV: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.WEB: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
verses.ASV: Why do ye not understand my speech? [Even] because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que não entendeis meu discurso? Porque não podeis ouvir minha palavra.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué no reconocéis mi lenguaje? porque no podéis oir mi palabra.

verses.KJV: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.WEB: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
verses.ASV: Ye are of [your] father the devil, and the lusts of your father it is your will to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and standeth not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois [filhos] de [vosso] pai, o Diabo, e quereis fazer os desejos de vosso pai; ele foi homicida desde o princípio, e não permaneceu na verdade, porque nele não há verdade; quando fala mentira, fala do seu próprio; porque é mentiroso, e pai da [mentira] .
verses.RVR09: Vosotros de vuestro padre el diablo sois, y los deseos de vuestro padre queréis cumplir. El, homicida ha sido desde el principio, y no permaneció en la verdad, porque no hay verdad en él. Cuando habla mentira, de suyo habla; porque es mentiroso, y padre de mentira.

verses.KJV: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.WEB: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
verses.ASV: But because I say the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a mim, porque [vos] digo a verdade, não credes em mim.
verses.RVR09: Y porque yo digo verdad, no me creéis.

verses.KJV: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.WEB: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.ASV: Which of you convicteth me of sin? If I say truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem de vós me convence de pecado? E se digo a verdade, por que não credes em mim?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién de vosotros me redarguye de pecado? Pues si digo verdad, ¿por qué vosotros no me creéis?

verses.KJV: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.WEB: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
verses.ASV: He that is of God heareth the words of God: for this cause ye hear [them] not, because ye are not of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é de Deus, ouve as palavras de Deus; portanto vós não [as] ouvis porque não sois de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El que es de Dios, las palabras de Dios oye: por esto no las oís vosotros, porque no sois de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.WEB: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
verses.ASV: The Jews answered and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam, pois, os Judeus, e lhe disseram: Nós não dizemos com razão que és samaritano, e tens o demônio?
verses.RVR09: Respondieron entonces los Judíos, y dijéronle: ¿No decimos bien nosotros, que tú eres Samaritano, y tienes demonio?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and ye dishonor me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Eu não tenho demônio, antes honro a meu Pai; e vós me desonrais.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Yo no tengo demonio, antes honro á mi Padre; y vosotros me habéis deshonrado.

verses.KJV: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.WEB: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
verses.ASV: But I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu não busco minha glória; há quem a busque, e julgue.
verses.RVR09: Y no busco mi gloria: hay quien la busque, y juzgue.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.WEB: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my word, he shall never see death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que se alguém guardar minha palavra, jamais verá a morte.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que el que guardare mi palabra, no verá muerte para siempre.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.WEB: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
verses.ASV: The Jews said unto him, Now we know that thou hast a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my word, he shall never taste of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois os Judeus: Agora conhecemos que tens o demônio. Abraão e os profetas morreram; e tu dizes: Se alguém guardar minha palavra, jamais experimentará a morte.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos le dijeron: Ahora conocemos que tienes demonio. Abraham murió, y los profetas, y tú dices: El que guardare mi palabra, no gustará muerte para siempre.

verses.KJV: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.WEB: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
verses.ASV: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.ALMEIDA: És tu maior que nosso pai Abraão, que morreu? Os profetas também morreram. Quem tu dizes ser?
verses.RVR09: ¿Eres tú mayor que nuestro padre Abraham, el cual murió? y los profetas murieron: ¿quién te haces á ti mismo?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father that glorifieth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Se eu me glorifico a mim mesmo, minha glória é nada; meu Pai, o qual vós dizeis ser vosso Deus, ele é o que me glorifica.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Si yo me glorifico á mí mismo, mi gloria es nada: mi Padre es el que me glorifica; el que vosotros decís que es vuestro Dios;

verses.KJV: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.WEB: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
verses.ASV: and ye have not known him: but I know him; and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be like unto you, a liar: but I know him, and keep his word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós não o conheceis, mas eu o conheço; e se disser que não o conheço, serei mentiroso como vós; mas eu o conheço, e guardo sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y no le conocéis: mas yo le conozco; y si dijere que no le conozco, seré como vosotros mentiroso: mas le conozco, y guardo su palabra.

verses.KJV: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.WEB: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
verses.ASV: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abraão, vosso pai, saltou de alegria por ver o meu dia; ele viu, e se alegrou.
verses.RVR09: Abraham vuestro padre se gozó por ver mi día; y lo vió, y se gozó.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore said unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe, pois. os Judeus: Ainda não tens cinquenta anos, e viste a Abraão?
verses.RVR09: Dijéronle entonces los Judíos: Aun no tienes cincuenta años, ¿y has visto á Abraham?

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was born, I am.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que antes que Abraão fosse, eu sou.
verses.RVR09: Díjoles Jesús: De cierto, de cierto os digo: Antes que Abraham fuese, yo soy.

verses.KJV: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.WEB: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
verses.ASV: They took up stones therefore to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomaram pedras para atirarem nele. Mas Jesus se escondeu, e saiu do Templo, atravessando por meio deles, e assim se foi.
verses.RVR09: Tomaron entonces piedras para tirarle: mas Jesús se encubrió, y salió del templo; y atravesando por medio de ellos, se fué.

verses.KJV: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.WEB: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.ASV: And as he passed by, he saw a man blind from his birth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo [Jesus] passando, viu a um homem cego desde o nascimento.
verses.RVR09: Y PASANDO Jesús, vió un hombre ciego desde su nacimiento.

verses.KJV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.WEB: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
verses.ASV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he should be born blind?
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus discípulos lhe perguntaram, dizendo: Rabi, quem pecou? Este, ou seus pais, para que nascesse cego?
verses.RVR09: Y preguntáronle sus discípulos, diciendo: Rabbí, ¿quién pecó, éste ó sus padres, para que naciese ciego?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Nem este pecou, nem seus pais; mas sim para que as obras de Deus nele se manifestem.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Ni éste pecó, ni sus padres: mas para que las obras de Dios se manifiesten en él.

verses.KJV: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.WEB: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.ASV: We must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mim me convém trabalhar as obras daquele que me enviou, enquanto é dia; a noite vem, quando ninguém pode trabalhar.
verses.RVR09: Conviéneme obrar las obras del que me envió, entre tanto que el día dura: la noche viene, cuando nadie puede obrar.

verses.KJV: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.WEB: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
verses.ASV: When I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto estiver no mundo, eu sou a luz do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que estuviere en el mundo, luz soy del mundo.

verses.KJV: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.WEB: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
verses.ASV: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and anointed his eyes with the clay,
verses.ALMEIDA: Dito isto, cuspiu em terra, e fez lama do cuspe, e untou com aquela lama os olhos do cego.
verses.RVR09: Esto dicho, escupió en tierra, é hizo lodo con la saliva, y untó con el lodo sobre los ojos del ciego,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.WEB: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
verses.ASV: and said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam (which is by interpretation, Sent). He went away therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Vai, lava-te no tanque de Siloé (que se traduz Enviado). Foi pois, e lavou-se; e voltou vendo.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Ve, lávate en el estanque de Siloé (que significa, si lo interpretares, Enviado). Y fué entonces, y lavóse, y volvió viendo.

verses.KJV: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.WEB: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
verses.ASV: The neighbors therefore, and they that saw him aforetime, that he was a beggar, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os vizinhos, e os que de antes o viram que era cego, diziam: Não é este aquele que estava sentado, e mendigava?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los vecinos, y los que antes le habían visto que era ciego, decían: ¿No es éste el que se sentaba y mendigaba?

verses.KJV: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.WEB: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
