verses.ASV: Others said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am [he].
verses.ALMEIDA: Outros diziam: É este. E outros: Parece-se com ele. Ele dizia: Sou eu.
verses.RVR09: Unos decían: Este es; y otros: A él se parece. El decía: Yo soy.

verses.KJV: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.WEB: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, How then were thine eyes opened?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe diziam: Como teus olhos se abriram?
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: ¿Cómo te fueron abiertos los ojos?

verses.KJV: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.WEB: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
verses.ASV: He answered, The man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to Siloam, and wash: so I went away and washed, and I received sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu ele, e disse: Aquele homem chamado Jesus fez lama, untou meus olhos, e me disse: Vai ao tanque de Siloé, e lava-te. E fui, e me lavei, e vi.
verses.RVR09: Respondió él y dijo: El hombre que se llama Jesús, hizo lodo, y me untó los ojos, y me dijo: Ve al Siloé, y lávate: y fuí, y me lavé, y recibí la vista.

verses.KJV: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.WEB: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Where is he? He saith, I know not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe, pois: Onde ele está? Disse ele: Não sei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le dijeron: ¿Dónde está aquél? El dijo: No sé.

verses.KJV: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.WEB: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
verses.ASV: They bring to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levaram aos Fariseus o ex-cego.
verses.RVR09: Llevaron á los Fariseos al que antes había sido ciego.

verses.KJV: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.WEB: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.ASV: Now it was the sabbath on the day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era sábado, quando Jesus fez a lama, e abriu os olhos dele.
verses.RVR09: Y era sábado cuando Jesús había hecho el lodo, y le había abierto los ojos.

verses.KJV: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.WEB: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
verses.ASV: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. And he said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and I see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltaram também os Fariseus a perguntar-lhe como vira, e ele lhes disse: Pôs lama sobre os meus olhos, e me lavei, e vejo.
verses.RVR09: Y volviéronle á preguntar también los Fariseos de qué manera había recibido la vista. Y él les dijo: Púsome lodo sobre los ojos, y me lavé, y veo.

verses.KJV: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.WEB: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
verses.ASV: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he keepeth not the sabbath. But others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such signs? And there was a division among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então que alguns dos Fariseus diziam: Este homem não é de Deus, pois não guarda o sábado. Outros diziam: Como pode um homem pecador fazer tais sinais? E havia divisão entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces unos de los Fariseos decían: Este hombre no es de Dios, que no guarda el sábado. Otros decían: ¿Cómo puede un hombre pecador hacer estas señales? Y había disensión entre ellos.

verses.KJV: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.WEB: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
verses.ASV: They say therefore unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, in that he opened thine eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltaram a dizer ao cego: Tu que dizes dele, que abriu teus olhos? E ele disse: Que é profeta.
verses.RVR09: Vuelven á decir al ciego: ¿Tú, qué dices del que te abrió los ojos? Y él dijo: Que es profeta.

verses.KJV: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto os judeus não criam nele, de que houvesse sido cego, e [passasse a] ver, até que chamaram aos pais dos que [passou a] ver.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Judíos no creían de él, que había sido ciego, y hubiese recibido la vista, hasta que llamaron á los padres del que había recibido la vista;

verses.KJV: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.WEB: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
verses.ASV: and asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntaram-lhes, dizendo: É este vosso filho, aquele que dizeis que nasceu cego? Como pois agora vê?
verses.RVR09: Y preguntáronles, diciendo: ¿Es éste vuestro hijo, el que vosotros decís que nació ciego? ¿Cómo, pues, ve ahora?

verses.KJV: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.WEB: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.ASV: His parents answered and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhes seus pais, e disseram: Sabemos que este é nosso filho, e que nasceu cego;
verses.RVR09: Respondiéronles sus padres y dijeron: Sabemos que éste es nuestro hijo, y que nació ciego:

verses.KJV: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.WEB: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
verses.ASV: but how he now seeth, we know not; or who opened his eyes, we know not: ask him; he is of age; he shall speak for himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas como agora ele vê, não sabemos; ou, quem lhe abriu os olhos, não sabemos; ele tem idade [suficiente] ,perguntai a ele, ele falará por si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Mas cómo vea ahora, no sabemos; ó quién le haya abierto los ojos, nosotros no lo sabemos; él tiene edad, preguntadle á él; él hablará de sí.

verses.KJV: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.WEB: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.ASV: These things said his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man should confess him [to be] Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto disseram seus pais, pois temiam aos judeus. Porque já os Judeus tinham combinado, que se alguém confessasse que ele era o Cristo, seria expulso da sinagoga.
verses.RVR09: Esto dijeron sus padres, porque tenían miedo de los Judíos: porque ya los Judíos habían resuelto que si alguno confesase ser él el Mesías, fuese fuera de la sinagoga.

verses.KJV: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.WEB: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
verses.ASV: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso disseram seus pais: Ele tem idade [suficiente] ,perguntai a ele.
verses.RVR09: Por eso dijeron sus padres: Edad tiene, preguntadle á él.

verses.KJV: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.WEB: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
verses.ASV: So they called a second time the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give glory to God: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamaram pois segunda vez ao homem que era cego, e disseram-lhe: Dá glória a Deus; nós sabemos que esse homem é pecador.
verses.RVR09: Así que, volvieron á llamar al hombre que había sido ciego, y dijéronle: Da gloria á Dios: nosotros sabemos que este hombre es pecador.

verses.KJV: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.WEB: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
verses.ASV: He therefore answered, Whether he is a sinner, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu pois ele, e disse: Se é pecador, não o sei; uma coisa sei, que havendo eu sido cego, agora vejo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él respondió, y dijo: Si es pecador, no lo sé: una cosa sé, que habiendo yo sido ciego, ahora veo.

verses.KJV: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.WEB: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
verses.ASV: They said therefore unto him, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram a lhe dizer: O que ele te fez? Como ele abriu os teus olhos?
verses.RVR09: Y volviéronle á decir: ¿Qué te hizo? ¿Cómo te abrió los ojos?

verses.KJV: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.WEB: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
verses.ASV: He answered them, I told you even now, and ye did not hear; wherefore would ye hear it again? would ye also become his disciples?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele lhes respondeu: Eu já vos disse, e ainda não o ouvistes; para que quereis voltar a ouvir? Por acaso vós também quereis ser discípulos dele?
verses.RVR09: Respondióles: Ya os lo he dicho, y no habéis atendido: ¿por qué lo queréis otra vez oir? ¿queréis también vosotros haceros sus discípulos?

verses.KJV: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.WEB: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.ASV: And they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe insultaram, e disseram: Tu sejas discípulo dele; mas nós somos discípulos de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y le ultrajaron, y dijeron: Tú eres su discípulo; pero nosotros discípulos de Moisés somos.

verses.KJV: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.WEB: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
verses.ASV: We know that God hath spoken unto Moses: but as for this man, we know not whence he is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem sabemos nós que Deus falou a Moisés; mas este nem de onde é, não sabemos.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros sabemos que á Moisés habló Dios: mas éste no sabemos de dónde es.

verses.KJV: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.WEB: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
verses.ASV: The man answered and said unto them, Why, herein is the marvel, that ye know not whence he is, and [yet] he opened mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele homem respondeu, e disse-lhes: Porque nisto está a maravilha: que vós não sabeis de onde ele é; e a mim abriu meus olhos!
verses.RVR09: Respondió aquel hombre, y díjoles: Por cierto, maravillosa cosa es ésta, que vosotros no sabéis de dónde sea, y á mí me abrió los ojos.

verses.KJV: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.WEB: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
verses.ASV: We know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and do his will, him he heareth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bem sabemos que Deus não dá ouvidos aos pecadores; mas se alguém é temente a Deus, e faz sua vontade, a este dá ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Y sabemos que Dios no oye á los pecadores: mas si alguno es temeroso de Dios, y hace su voluntad, á éste oye.

verses.KJV: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.WEB: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
verses.ASV: Since the world began it was never heard that any one opened the eyes of a man born blind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o princípio dos tempos nunca se ouviu de que alguém que tenha aberto os olhos de um que tenha nascido cego.
verses.RVR09: Desde el siglo no fué oído, que abriese alguno los ojos de uno que nació ciego.

verses.KJV: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.WEB: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
verses.ASV: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se este não fosse vindo de Deus, nada poderia fazer.
verses.RVR09: Si éste no fuera de Dios, no pudiera hacer nada.

verses.KJV: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.WEB: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
verses.ASV: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles responderam, e lhe disseram: Tu és todo nascido em pecados, e nos ensina? E o lançaram fora.
verses.RVR09: Respondieron, y dijéronle: En pecados eres nacido todo, ¿y tú nos enseñas? Y echáronle fuera.

verses.KJV: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.WEB: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
verses.ASV: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and finding him, he said, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviu Jesus que o haviam lançado fora, e achando-o, disse-lhe: Crês tu no Filho de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Oyó Jesús que le habían echado fuera; y hallándole, díjole: ¿Crees tú en el Hijo de Dios?

verses.KJV: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.WEB: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
verses.ASV: He answered and said, And who is he, Lord, that I may believe on him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu ele, e disse: Quem é, Senhor, para que nele creia?
verses.RVR09: Respondió él, y dijo: ¿Quién es, Señor, para que crea en él?

verses.KJV: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and he it is that speaketh with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Jesus: Tu já o tens visto; e este é o que fala contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Jesús: Y le has visto, y el que habla contigo, él es.

verses.KJV: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.WEB: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
verses.ASV: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Creio, Senhor; E adorou-o.
verses.RVR09: Y él dice: Creo, Señor; y adoróle.

verses.KJV: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.WEB: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
verses.ASV: And Jesus said, For judgment came I into this world, that they that see not may see; and that they that see may become blind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jesus: Eu vim a este mundo para juízo, para os que não veem, vejam; e os que veem, ceguem.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jesús: Yo, para juicio he venido á este mundo: para que los que no ven, vean; y los que ven, sean cegados.

verses.KJV: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.WEB: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
verses.ASV: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said unto him, Are we also blind?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviram isto [alguns] dos fariseus, que estavam com ele; e lhe disseram: Também nós somos cegos?
verses.RVR09: Y ciertos de los Fariseos que estaban con él oyeron esto, y dijéronle: ¿Somos nosotros también ciegos?

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye would have no sin: but now ye say, We see: your sin remaineth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Jesus: Se fôsseis cegos, não teríeis pecado; mas agora dizeis: Vemos; portanto vosso pecado permanece.
verses.RVR09: Díjoles Jesús: Si fuerais ciegos, no tuvierais pecado: mas ahora porque decís, Vemos, por tanto vuestro pecado permanece.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.WEB: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que aquele que no curral das ovelhas não entra pela porta, mas sobe por outra parte, é ladrão, e assaltante.
verses.RVR09: DE cierto, de cierto os digo: El que no entra por la puerta en el corral de las ovejas, mas sube por otra parte, el tal es ladrón y robador.

verses.KJV: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.WEB: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.ASV: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que entra pela porta é o pastor de ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que entra por la puerta, el pastor de las ovejas es.

verses.KJV: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.WEB: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.ASV: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este o porteiro abre, e as ovelhas ouvem sua voz, e a suas ovelhas chama nome por nome, e as leva fora.
verses.RVR09: A éste abre el portero, y las ovejas oyen su voz: y á sus ovejas llama por nombre, y las saca.

verses.KJV: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.WEB: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.ASV: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando tira fora suas ovelhas, vai adiante delas, e as ovelhas o seguem, porque conhecem sua voz.
verses.RVR09: Y como ha sacado fuera todas las propias, va delante de ellas; y las ovejas le siguen, porque conocen su voz.

verses.KJV: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.WEB: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
verses.ASV: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao estranho em maneira nenhuma seguirão, ao invés disso dele fugirão; porque não conhecem a voz dos estranhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas al extraño no seguirán, antes huirán de él: porque no conocen la voz de los extraños.

verses.KJV: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.WEB: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
verses.ASV: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta parábola Jesus lhes disse; porém eles não entenderam que era o que lhes falava.
verses.RVR09: Esta parábola les dijo Jesús; mas ellos no entendieron qué era lo que les decía.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou pois Jesus a lhes dizer: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que sou a porta das ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Volvióles, pues, Jesús á decir: De cierto, de cierto os digo: Yo soy la puerta de las ovejas.

verses.KJV: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.WEB: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
verses.ASV: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos quantos vieram antes de mim, são ladrões e assaltantes; mas as ovelhas não os ouviram.
verses.RVR09: Todos los que antes de mí vinieron, ladrones son y robadores; mas no los oyeron las ovejas.

verses.KJV: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.WEB: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
verses.ASV: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou a porta; se alguém entrar por mim, será salvo; e entrará, e sairá, e achará pasto.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy la puerta: el que por mí entrare, será salvo; y entrará, y saldrá, y hallará pastos.

verses.KJV: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.WEB: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
verses.ASV: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ladrão não vem, senão para roubar, matar, e destruir; eu vim para que tenham vida, e [a] tenham em abundância.
verses.RVR09: El ladrón no viene sino para hurtar, y matar, y destruir: yo he venido para que tengan vida, y para que la tengan en abundancia.

verses.KJV: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.WEB: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.ASV: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o bom Pastor; o bom Pastor dá sua vida pelas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el buen pastor: el buen pastor su vida da por las ovejas.

verses.KJV: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.WEB: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
verses.ASV: He that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth [them]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o contratado a dinheiro, e que não é o pastor, a quem as ovelhas não pertencem, vê o lobo vir, deixa as ovelhas, e foge; o lobo as captura, e dispersa as ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Mas el asalariado, y que no es el pastor, de quien no son propias las ovejas, ve al lobo que viene, y deja las ovejas, y huye, y el lobo las arrebata, y esparce las ovejas.

verses.KJV: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.WEB: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
verses.ASV: [he fleeth] because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o contratado foge, porque é contratado, e não tem cuidado das ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, el asalariado, huye, porque es asalariado, y no tiene cuidado de las ovejas.

verses.KJV: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.WEB: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
verses.ASV: I am the good shepherd; and I know mine own, and mine own know me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o bom Pastor, e conheço as minhas, e pelas minhas sou conhecido.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el buen pastor; y conozco mis ovejas, y las mías me conocen.

verses.KJV: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.WEB: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.ASV: even as the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o Pai me conhece, assim também também eu conheço o Pai; e dou a minha vida pelas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Como el Padre me conoce, y yo conozco al Padre; y pongo mi vida por las ovejas.

verses.KJV: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.WEB: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
verses.ASV: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda tenho outras ovelhas que não são deste curral; a estas também me convém trazer, e ouvirão minha voz, e haverá um rebanho, [e] um pastor.
verses.RVR09: También tengo otras ovejas que no son de este redil; aquéllas también me conviene traer, y oirán mi voz; y habrá un rebaño, y un pastor.

verses.KJV: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.ASV: Therefore doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Pai me ama, porque dou a minha vida para tomá-la de volta.
verses.RVR09: Por eso me ama el Padre, porque yo pongo mi vida, para volverla á tomar.

verses.KJV: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.WEB: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
verses.ASV: No one taketh it away from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment received I from my Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém a tira de mim, mas eu de mim mesmo a dou; tenho poder para a dar, e tenho poder para tomá-la de volta. Este mandamento recebi de meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Nadie me la quita, mas yo la pongo de mí mismo. Tengo poder para ponerla, y tengo poder para volverla á tomar. Este mandamiento recibí de mi Padre.

verses.KJV: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.WEB: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.ASV: There arose a division again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou, pois, a haver divisão entre os judeus, por causa dessas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á haber disensión entre los Judíos por estas palabras.

verses.KJV: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.WEB: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
verses.ASV: And many of them said, He hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos deles diziam: Ele tem demônio, e está fora de si; para que o ouvis?
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de ellos decían: Demonio tiene, y está fuera de sí; ¿para qué le oís?

verses.KJV: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.WEB: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
verses.ASV: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Outros diziam: Estas palavras não são de um endemoninhado; por acaso pode um demônio dar vista aos cegos?
verses.RVR09: Decían otros: Estas palabras no son de endemoniado: ¿puede el demonio abrir los ojos de los ciegos?

verses.KJV: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.WEB: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem:
verses.ALMEIDA: E era a festa da renovação [do Templo] em Jerusalém, e era inverno.
verses.RVR09: Y se hacía la fiesta de la dedicación en Jerusalem; y era invierno;

verses.KJV: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.WEB: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
verses.ASV: it was winter; and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andava Jesus passeando no Templo, na entrada de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús andaba en el templo por el portal de Salomón.

verses.KJV: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore came round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou hold us in suspense? If thou art the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rodearam-no, então, os Judeus, e lhe disseram: Até quando farás nossa alma em dúvida? Se tu és o Cristo, dize-nos abertamente.
verses.RVR09: Y rodeáronle los Judíos y dijéronle: ¿Hasta cuándo nos has de turbar el alma? Si tú eres el Cristo, dínoslo abiertamente.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believe not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, these bear witness of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Já vos tenho dito, e não credes. As obras que eu faço em nome de meu Pai, essas testemunham de mim.
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús: Os lo he dicho, y no creéis: las obras que yo hago en nombre de mi Padre, ellas dan testimonio de mí;

verses.KJV: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.WEB: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
verses.ASV: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós não credes, porque não sois de minhas ovelhas, como já vos tenho dito.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros no creéis, porque no sois de mis ovejas, como os he dicho.

verses.KJV: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.WEB: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
verses.ASV: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas ovelhas ouvem minha voz, e eu as conheço, e elas me seguem.
verses.RVR09: Mis ovejas oyen mi voz, y yo las conozco, y me siguen;

verses.KJV: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.WEB: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
verses.ASV: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu lhes dou a vida eterna, e para sempre não perecerão, e ninguém as arrancará de minha mão.
verses.RVR09: Y yo les doy vida eterna: y no perecerán para siempre, ni nadie las arrebatará de mi mano.

verses.KJV: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
verses.WEB: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.ASV: My Father, who hath given [them] unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch [them] out of the Father’s hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu Pai, que [as] deu para mim, é maior que todos; e ninguém pode arrancá-las da mão de meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Mi Padre que me las dió, mayor que todos es: y nadie las puede arrebatar de la mano de mi Padre.

verses.KJV: I and my Father are one.
verses.WEB: I and the Father are one.”
verses.ASV: I and the Father are one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu e o Pai somos um.
verses.RVR09: Yo y el Padre una cosa somos.

verses.KJV: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.ASV: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltaram pois os Judeus a tomar pedras para o apedrejarem.
verses.RVR09: Entonces volvieron á tomar piedras los Judíos para apedrearle.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I showed you from the Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Muitas boas obras de meu Pai vos tenho mostrado; por qual obra destas me apedrejais?
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús: Muchas buenas obras os he mostrado de mi Padre; ¿por cuál obra de esas me apedreáis?

verses.KJV: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.WEB: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
verses.ASV: The Jews answered him, For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhe os judeus dizendo: Por boa obra não te apedrejamos, mas pela blasfêmia; e porque sendo tu homem, a ti mesmo te fazes Deus.
verses.RVR09: Respondiéronle los Judíos, diciendo: Por buena obra no te apedreamos, sino por la blasfemia; y porque tú, siendo hombre, te haces Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Não está escrito em vossa Lei: Eu disse: Sois deuses?
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús: ¿No está escrito en vuestra ley: Yo dije, Dioses sois?

verses.KJV: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.WEB: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
verses.ASV: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se [a Lei] chamou deuses a aqueles, para quem a palavra de Deus foi feita, (e a Escritura não pode ser quebrada);
verses.RVR09: Si dijo, dioses, á aquellos á los cuales fué hecha palabra de Dios (y la Escritura no puede ser quebrantada);

verses.KJV: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.WEB: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.ASV: say ye of him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am [the] Son of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: [A mim] ,a quem o Pai santificou, e ao mundo enviou, dizeis vós: Blasfemas; porque disse: Sou Filho de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿A quien el Padre santificó y envió al mundo, vosotros decís: Tú blasfemas, porque dije: Hijo de Dios soy?

verses.KJV: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.WEB: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
verses.ASV: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se não faço as obras de meu Pai, não creiais em mim.
verses.RVR09: Si no hago obras de mi Padre, no me creáis.

verses.KJV: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.WEB: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
verses.ASV: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se eu as faço, e não credes em mim, crede nas obras; para que conheçais e creiais que o Pai está em mim, e eu nele.
verses.RVR09: Mas si las hago, aunque á mí no creáis, creed á las obras; para que conozcáis y creáis que el Padre está en mí, y yo en el Padre.

verses.KJV: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.WEB: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
verses.ASV: They sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então procuravam outra vez prendê-lo; e ele saiu de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y procuraban otra vez prenderle; mas él se salió de sus manos;

verses.KJV: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.WEB: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
verses.ASV: And he went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was at the first baptizing; and there he abode.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a ir para o outro lado do Jordão, ao lugar onde João primeiro batizava; e ficou ali.
verses.RVR09: Y volvióse tras el Jordán, á aquel lugar donde primero había estado bautizando Juan; y estúvose allí.

verses.KJV: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.WEB: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
verses.ASV: And many came unto him; and they said, John indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever John spake of this man were true.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos vinham a ele, e diziam: Em verdade que nenhum sinal fez João; mas tudo quanto João disse deste era verdade.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos venían á él, y decían: Juan, á la verdad, ninguna señal hizo; mas todo lo que Juan dijo de éste, era verdad.

verses.KJV: And many believed on him there.
verses.WEB: Many believed in him there.
verses.ASV: And many believed on him there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos ali creram nele.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos creyeron allí en él.

verses.KJV: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.WEB: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
verses.ASV: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus of Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava doente um certo Lázaro, de Betânia, a aldeia de Maria e de sua irmã Marta.
verses.RVR09: ESTABA entonces enfermo uno llamado Lázaro, de Bethania, la aldea de María y de Marta su hermana.

verses.KJV: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.WEB: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
verses.ASV: And it was that Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: (E era Maria a que ungiu ao Senhor com o óleo, e com seus cabelos lhe limpou os pés; [a que] cujo irmão Lázaro era o que estava doente).
verses.RVR09: (Y María, cuyo hermano Lázaro estaba enfermo, era la que ungió al Señor con ungüento, y limpió sus pies con sus cabellos.)

verses.KJV: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.WEB: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
verses.ASV: The sisters therefore sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviaram pois suas irmãs [uma mensagem] a ele, dizendo: Senhor, eis que aquele a quem [tu] amas está doente.
verses.RVR09: Enviaron, pues, sus hermanas á él, diciendo: Señor, he aquí, el que amas está enfermo.

verses.KJV: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.WEB: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
verses.ASV: But when Jesus heard it, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Jesus, disse: Esta doença não é para morte, mas para glória de Deus; para que o Filho de Deus seja por ela glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo Jesús, dijo: Esta enfermedad no es para muerte, mas por gloria de Dios, para que el Hijo de Dios sea glorificado por ella.

verses.KJV: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.WEB: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.ASV: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus amava a Marta, e a sua irmã, e a Lázaro.
verses.RVR09: Y amaba Jesús á Marta, y á su hermana, y á Lázaro.

verses.KJV: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.WEB: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
verses.ASV: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he abode at that time two days in the place where he was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, ele ouviu que estava doente, ficou ainda dois dias no lugar onde estava.
verses.RVR09: Como oyó pues que estaba enfermo, quedóse aún dos días en aquel lugar donde estaba.

verses.KJV: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.WEB: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
verses.ASV: Then after this he saith to the disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então depois disto voltou a dizer aos discípulos: Vamos outra vez à Judeia.
verses.RVR09: Luego, después de esto, dijo á los discípulos: Vamos á Judea otra vez.

verses.KJV: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.WEB: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
verses.ASV: The disciples say unto him, Rabbi, the Jews were but now seeking to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe os discípulos: Rabi, ainda agora os Judeus procuravam te apedrejar; e tu voltas novamente para lá?
verses.RVR09: Dícenle los discípulos: Rabbí, ahora procuraban los Judíos apedrearte, ¿y otra vez vas allá?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If a man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Não há doze horas no dia? Se alguém anda de dia, não tropeça, porque vê a luz deste mundo.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: ¿No tiene el día doce horas? El que anduviere de día, no tropieza, porque ve la luz de este mundo.

verses.KJV: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.WEB: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
verses.ASV: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alguém anda de noite, tropeça; porque nele não há luz.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que anduviere de noche, tropieza, porque no hay luz en él.

verses.KJV: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.WEB: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
verses.ASV: These things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus is fallen asleep; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele falou estas coisas; e depois disto, disse-lhes: Lázaro, nosso amigo, dorme; mas vou para despertá-lo do sono.
verses.RVR09: Dicho esto, díceles después: Lázaro nuestro amigo duerme; mas voy á despertarle del sueño.

verses.KJV: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.WEB: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
verses.ASV: The disciples therefore said unto him, Lord, if he is fallen asleep, he will recover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois seus discípulos: Senhor, se [ele] dorme, será salvo.
verses.RVR09: Dijeron entonces sus discípulos: Señor, si duerme, salvo estará.

verses.KJV: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.WEB: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
verses.ASV: Now Jesus had spoken of his death: but they thought that he spake of taking rest in sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jesus dizia [isto] de sua morte; porém eles pensavam que falava do repouso do sono.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto decía Jesús de la muerte de él: y ellos pensaron que hablaba del reposar del sueño.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.WEB: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
verses.ASV: Then Jesus therefore said unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então pois lhes disse Jesus claramente: Lázaro está morto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, pues, Jesús les dijo claramente: Lázaro es muerto;

verses.KJV: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.WEB: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
verses.ASV: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me alegro, por causa de vós, que eu não estivesse lá, para que creiais; porém vamos até ele.
verses.RVR09: Y huélgome por vosotros, que yo no haya estado allí, para que creáis: mas vamos á él.

verses.KJV: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.WEB: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
verses.ASV: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois Tomé, chamado o Dídimo, aos colegas discípulos: Vamos nós também, para que com ele morramos.
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces Tomás, el que se dice el Dídimo, á sus condiscípulos: Vamos también nosotros, para que muramos con él.

verses.KJV: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.WEB: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
verses.ASV: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vindo pois Jesus, encontrou que já havia quatro dias que estava na sepultura.
verses.RVR09: Vino pues Jesús, y halló que había ya cuatro días que estaba en el sepulcro.

verses.KJV: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.WEB: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
verses.ASV: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off;
verses.ALMEIDA: (E Betânia era como quase quinze estádios de Jerusalém).
verses.RVR09: Y Bethania estaba cerca de Jerusalem, como quince estadios;

verses.KJV: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.WEB: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
verses.ASV: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos dos judeus tinham vindo até Marta e Maria, para consolá-las por seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de los Judíos habían venido á Marta y á María, á consolarlas de su hermano.

verses.KJV: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.WEB: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
verses.ASV: Martha therefore, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary still sat in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvindo pois Marta que Jesus vinha, saiu-lhe ao encontro; mas Maria ficou sentada em casa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Marta, como oyó que Jesús venía, salió á encontrarle; mas María se estuvo en casa.

verses.KJV: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.WEB: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
verses.ASV: Martha therefore said unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois Marta a Jesus: Senhor, se tu estivesses aqui, meu irmão não teria morrido.
verses.RVR09: Y Marta dijo á Jesús: Señor, si hubieses estado aquí, mi hermano no fuera muerto;

verses.KJV: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
verses.WEB: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
verses.ASV: And even now I know that, whatsoever thou shalt ask of God, God will give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém também sei agora, que tudo quanto pedires a Deus, Deus o dará a ti.
verses.RVR09: Mas también sé ahora, que todo lo que pidieres de Dios, te dará Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Teu irmão ressuscitará.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Resucitará tu hermano.

verses.KJV: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.WEB: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
verses.ASV: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Marta lhe disse: Eu sei que ele ressuscitará, na ressurreição, no último dia.
verses.RVR09: Marta le dice: Yo sé que resucitará en la resurrección en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
verses.ASV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou a ressurreição, e a vida; quem crê em mim, ainda que esteja morto, viverá.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Yo soy la resurrección y la vida: el que cree en mí, aunque esté muerto, vivirá.

verses.KJV: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.WEB: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
verses.ASV: and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo aquele que vive, e crê em mim, para sempre não morrerá. Crês nisto?
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquel que vive y cree en mí, no morirá eternamente. ¿Crees esto?

verses.KJV: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.WEB: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
verses.ASV: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I have believed that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, [even] he that cometh into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe ela: Sim, Senhor; já cri que tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus, que viria ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Dícele: Sí, Señor; yo he creído que tú eres el Cristo, el Hijo de Dios, que has venido al mundo.

verses.KJV: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.WEB: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
verses.ASV: And when she had said this, she went away, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Teacher is here, and calleth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dito isto, [ela] se foi, e chamou em segredo a Maria, sua irmã, dizendo: Aqui está o Mestre, e ele te chama.
verses.RVR09: Y esto dicho, fuése, y llamó en secreto á María su hermana, diciendo: El Maestro está aquí y te llama.

verses.KJV: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.WEB: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
verses.ASV: And she, when she heard it, arose quickly, and went unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvindo ela [isto] ,logo se levantou, e foi até ele.
verses.RVR09: Ella, como lo oyó, levántase prestamente y viene á él.

verses.KJV: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.WEB: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
verses.ASV: (Now Jesus was not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha met him.)
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque Jesus ainda não havia chegado à aldeia; mas estava no lugar onde Marta lhe saíra ao encontro).
verses.RVR09: (Que aun no había llegado Jesús á la aldea, mas estaba en aquel lugar donde Marta le había encontrado.)

verses.KJV: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.WEB: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
verses.ASV: The Jews then who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, supposing that she was going unto the tomb to weep there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo pois os judeus que com ela estavam em casa, e a consolavam, que Maria com pressa se levantara, e saíra, seguiram-na, dizendo: Ela vai para a sepultura, para chorar lá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos que estaban en casa con ella, y la consolaban, como vieron que María se había levantado prestamente, y había salido, siguiéronla, diciendo: Va al sepulcro á llorar allí.

verses.KJV: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.WEB: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
verses.ASV: Mary therefore, when she came where Jesus was, and saw him, fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vindo pois Maria aonde Jesus estava, e vendo-o, caiu a seus pés, dizendo-lhe: Senhor, se tu estivesses aqui, meu irmão não teria morrido.
verses.RVR09: Mas María, como vino donde estaba Jesús, viéndole, derribóse á sus pies, diciéndole: Señor, si hubieras estado aquí, no fuera muerto mi hermano.

verses.KJV: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.
verses.WEB: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
verses.ASV: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews [also] weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Jesus a viu chorar, e aos judeus, que vinham chorando com ela, comoveu-se em espírito, e ficou perturbado.
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces, como la vió llorando, y á los Judíos que habían venido juntamente con ella llorando, se conmovió en espíritu, y turbóse,

verses.KJV: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.WEB: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
verses.ASV: and said, Where have ye laid him? They say unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Onde o pusestes? Disseram-lhe: Senhor, vem, e vê.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿Dónde le pusisteis? Dícenle: Señor, ven, y ve.

verses.KJV: Jesus wept.
verses.WEB: Jesus wept.
verses.ASV: Jesus wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus chorou.
verses.RVR09: Y lloró Jesús.

verses.KJV: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.WEB: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore said, Behold how he loved him!
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois os Judeus: Vede como ele o amava!
verses.RVR09: Dijeron entonces los Judíos: Mirad cómo le amaba.

verses.KJV: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.WEB: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
verses.ASV: But some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of him that was blind, have caused that this man also should not die?
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns deles disseram: Não podia este, que abriu os olhos ao cego, ter feito também que este não morresse?
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de ellos dijeron: ¿No podía éste que abrió los ojos al ciego, hacer que éste no muriera?

verses.KJV: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comovendo-se pois Jesus outra vez em si mesmo, veio à sepultura; e era [esta] uma caverna, e estava uma pedra posta sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, conmoviéndose otra vez en sí mismo, vino al sepulcro. Era una cueva, la cual tenía una piedra encima.

verses.KJV: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.WEB: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time the body decayeth; for he hath been [dead] four days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse Jesus: Tirai a pedra. Marta, a irmã do morto, disse-lhe: Senhor, já cheira mal, porque já é de quatro dias.
verses.RVR09: Dice Jesús: Quitad la piedra. Marta, la hermana del que se había muerto, le dice: Señor, hiede ya, que es de cuatro días.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus disse-lhe: Não te disse, que se creres, verás a glória de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dice: ¿No te he dicho que, si creyeres, verás la gloria de Dios?

verses.KJV: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.WEB: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
verses.ASV: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou heardest me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tiraram, pois, a pedra de onde o morto jazia. E Jesus levantou os olhos para cima, e disse: Pai, graças te dou, porque me tens ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Entonces quitaron la piedra de donde el muerto había sido puesto. Y Jesús, alzando los ojos arriba, dijo: Padre, gracias te doy que me has oído.

verses.KJV: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.WEB: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
verses.ASV: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around I said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu bem sabia que sempre me ouves; mas por causa da multidão, que está ao redor, [assim] disse; para que creiam que tu me enviaste.
verses.RVR09: Que yo sabía que siempre me oyes; mas por causa de la compañía que está alrededor, lo dije, para que crean que tú me has enviado.

verses.KJV: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.WEB: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
verses.ASV: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo dito isto, clamou com grande voz: Lázaro, sai fora.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo dicho estas cosas, clamó á gran voz: Lázaro, ven fuera.

verses.KJV: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.WEB: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
verses.ASV: He that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with grave-clothes; and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que estava morto saiu, [com] as mãos e os pés atados, e seu rosto envolto em um lenço. Disse-lhes Jesus: Desatai-o, e deixai-o ir.
verses.RVR09: Y el que había estado muerto, salió, atadas las manos y los pies con vendas; y su rostro estaba envuelto en un sudario. Díceles Jesús: Desatadle, y dejadle ir.

verses.KJV: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.WEB: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
verses.ASV: Many therefore of the Jews, who came to Mary and beheld that which he did, believed on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo que, muitos dos Judeus, que tinham vindo a Maria, e haviam visto o que Jesus fizera, creram nele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces muchos de los Judíos que habían venido á María, y habían visto lo que había hecho Jesús, creyeron en él.

verses.KJV: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.WEB: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
verses.ASV: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas alguns deles foram aos fariseus, e lhes disseram o que Jesus havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Mas algunos de ellos fueron á los Fariseos, y dijéronles lo que Jesús había hecho.

verses.KJV: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.WEB: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
verses.ASV: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many signs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os sacerdotes e os fariseus juntaram o supremo conselho, e disseram: Que faremos? Porque este homem faz muitos sinais.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los pontífices y los Fariseos juntaron concilio, y decían: ¿Qué hacemos? porque este hombre hace muchas señales.

verses.KJV: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.WEB: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
verses.ASV: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se assim o deixamos, todos crerão nele, e virão os romanos, e nos tomarão tanto o lugar quanto a nação.
verses.RVR09: Si le dejamos así, todos creerán en él: y vendrán los Romanos, y quitarán nuestro lugar y la nación.

verses.KJV: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.WEB: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
verses.ASV: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Caifás, um deles, que era sumo sacerdote daquele ano, lhes disse: Vós nada sabeis;
verses.RVR09: Y Caifás, uno de ellos, sumo pontífice de aquel año, les dijo: Vosotros no sabéis nada;

verses.KJV: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.WEB: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
verses.ASV: nor do ye take account that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem considerais que nos convém, que um homem morra pelo povo, e toda a nação não pereça.
verses.RVR09: Ni pensáis que nos conviene que un hombre muera por el pueblo, y no que toda la nación se pierda.

verses.KJV: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.WEB: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
verses.ASV: Now this he said not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele não disse isto de si mesmo; mas que, como era o sumo sacerdote daquele ano, profetizou que Jesus morreria pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto no lo dijo de sí mismo; sino que, como era el sumo pontífice de aquel año, profetizó que Jesús había de morir por la nación:

verses.KJV: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.WEB: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.ASV: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God that are scattered abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente por aquele povo, mas também para que juntasse em um aos filhos de Deus, que estavam dispersos.
verses.RVR09: Y no solamente por aquella nación, mas también para que juntase en uno los hijos de Dios que estaban derramados.

verses.KJV: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.WEB: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
verses.ASV: So from that day forth they took counsel that they might put him to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então desde aquele dia se aconselhavam juntos para o matarem.
verses.RVR09: Así que, desde aquel día consultaban juntos de matarle.

verses.KJV: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed thence into the country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim; and there he tarried with the disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que Jesus já não andava mais abertamente entre os judeus, mas foi-se dali para a terra junto ao deserto, a uma cidade chamada Efraim; e ali andava com seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, Jesús ya no andaba manifiestamente entre los Judíos; mas fuése de allí á la tierra que está junto al desierto, á una ciudad que se llama Ephraim: y estábase allí con sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.WEB: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
verses.ASV: Now the passover of the Jews was at hand: and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava perto a páscoa dos judeus, e muitos daquela terra subiram a Jerusalém antes da páscoa, para se purificarem.
verses.RVR09: Y la Pascua de los Judíos estaba cerca: y muchos subieron de aquella tierra á Jerusalem antes de la Pascua, para purificarse;

verses.KJV: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.WEB: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
verses.ASV: They sought therefore for Jesus, and spake one with another, as they stood in the temple, What think ye? That he will not come to the feast?
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscavam pois a Jesus, e diziam uns aos outros estando no Templo: Que vos parece? Que ele não virá à festa?
verses.RVR09: Y buscaban á Jesús, y hablaban los unos con los otros estando en el templo: ¿Qué os parece, que no vendrá á la fiesta?

verses.KJV: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.WEB: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
verses.ASV: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show it, that they might take him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes e os fariseus tinham dado ordem de que, se alguém soubesse onde ele estava, o denunciasse, para que o pudessem prender.
verses.RVR09: Y los pontífices y los Fariseos habían dado mandamiento, que si alguno supiese dónde estuviera, lo manifestase, para que le prendiesen.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.WEB: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus raised from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, Jesus seis dias antes da páscoa a Betânia, onde estava Lázaro, o que havia morrido, a quem ressuscitara dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y JESÚS, seis días antes de la Pascua, vino á Bethania, donde estaba Lázaro, que había sido muerto, al cual había resucitado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.WEB: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
verses.ASV: So they made him a supper there: and Martha served; but Lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram-lhe, pois, ali uma ceia, e Marta servia; e Lázaro era um dos que juntamente com ele estavam sentados [à mesa] .
verses.RVR09: E hiciéronle allí una cena: y Marta servía, y Lázaro era uno de los que estaban sentados á la mesa juntamente con él.

verses.KJV: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.WEB: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.ASV: Mary therefore took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomando então Maria um arrátel de óleo perfumado de nardo puro, de muito preço, ungiu os pés de Jesus, e limpou os pés dele com seus cabelos; e encheu-se a casa do cheiro do óleo perfumado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces María tomó una libra de ungüento de nardo líquido de mucho precio, y ungió los pies de Jesús, y limpió sus pies con sus cabellos: y la casa se llenó del olor del ungüento.

verses.KJV: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
verses.WEB: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
verses.ASV: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, that should betray him, saith,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Judas de Simão Iscariotes, um de seus discípulos, o que o trairia:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo uno de sus discípulos, Judas Iscariote, hijo de Simón, el que le había de entregar:

verses.KJV: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.WEB: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
verses.ASV: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred shillings, and given to the poor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que se não vendeu este óleo perfumado por trezentos dinheiros, e se deu aos pobres?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué no se ha vendido este ungüento por trescientos dineros, y se dió á los pobres?

verses.KJV: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.WEB: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
verses.ASV: Now this he said, not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and having the bag took away what was put therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto disse ele, não pelo cuidado que tivesse dos pobres; mas porque era ladrão, e tinha a bolsa, e trazia o que se lançava [nela] .
verses.RVR09: Mas dijo esto, no por el cuidado que él tenía de los pobres; sino porque era ladrón, y tenía la bolsa, y traía lo que se echaba en ella.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.WEB: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois Jesus: Deixa-a; para o dia de meu sepultamento guardou isto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús dijo: Déjala: para el día de mi sepultura ha guardado esto;

verses.KJV: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.WEB: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
verses.ASV: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aos pobres sempre os tendes convosco; porém a mim não me tendes sempre.
verses.RVR09: Porque á los pobres siempre los tenéis con vosotros, mas á mí no siempre me tenéis.

verses.KJV: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.WEB: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
