verses.ASV: The common people therefore of the Jews learned that he was there: and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muita gente dos judeus soube pois, que ele estava ali; e vieram, não somente por causa de Jesus, mas também para verem a Lázaro, a quem ressuscitara dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces mucha gente de los Judíos entendió que él estaba allí; y vinieron no solamente por causa de Jesús, mas también por ver á Lázaro, al cual había resucitado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.WEB: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
verses.ASV: But the chief priests took counsel that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos sacerdotes se aconselharam de também matarem a Lázaro,
verses.RVR09: Consultaron asimismo los príncipes de los sacerdotes, de matar también á Lázaro;

verses.KJV: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.WEB: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
verses.ASV: because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muitos dos judeus iam por causa dele, e criam em Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos de los Judíos iban y creían en Jesús por causa de él.

verses.KJV: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.WEB: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.ASV: On the morrow a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia seguinte, ouvindo uma grande multidão, que viera à festa, que Jesus vinha a Jerusalém,
verses.RVR09: El siguiente día, mucha gente que había venido á la fiesta, como oyeron que Jesús venía á Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
verses.ASV: took the branches of the palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna: Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomaram ramos de plantas e lhe saíram ao encontro, e clamavam: Hosana! Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor, o Rei de Israel!
verses.RVR09: Tomaron ramos de palmas, y salieron á recibirle, y clamaban: ¡Hosanna, Bendito el que viene en el nombre del Señor, el Rey de Israel!

verses.KJV: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.WEB: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
verses.ASV: And Jesus, having found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jesus achou um jumentinho, e sentou-se sobre ele, como está escrito:
verses.RVR09: Y halló Jesús un asnillo, y se sentó sobre él, como está escrito:

verses.KJV: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.WEB: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
verses.ASV: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, ó filha de Sião; eis que teu Rei vem sentado sobre o filhote de uma jumenta.
verses.RVR09: No temas, hija de Sión: he aquí tu Rey viene, sentado sobre un pollino de asna.

verses.KJV: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.WEB: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
verses.ASV: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém seus discípulos não entenderam isto ao princípio; mas sendo Jesus já glorificado, então se lembraram que isto dele estava escrito, e [que] isto lhe fizeram.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas no las entendieron sus discípulos de primero: empero cuando Jesús fué glorificado, entonces se acordaron de que estas cosas estaban escritas de él, y que le hicieron estas cosas.

verses.KJV: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.WEB: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
verses.ASV: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, bare witness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A multidão pois, que estava com ele, testemunhava, que a Lázaro chamara da sepultura, e o ressuscitara dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y la gente que estaba con él, daba testimonio de cuando llamó á Lázaro del sepulcro, y le resucitó de los muertos.

verses.KJV: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.WEB: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
verses.ASV: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, for that they heard that he had done this sign.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo que também a multidão lhe saiu ao encontro, porque ouvira que fizera este sinal.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también había venido la gente á recibirle, porque había oído que él había hecho esta señal;

verses.KJV: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.WEB: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
verses.ASV: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Behold how ye prevail nothing; lo, the world is gone after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois os fariseus entre si: Vedes que nada aproveitais? Eis que o mundo vai após ele.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Fariseos dijeron entre sí: ¿Veis que nada aprovecháis? he aquí, el mundo se va tras de él.

verses.KJV: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.WEB: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
verses.ASV: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast:
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia alguns gregos dos que haviam subido para adorarem na festa.
verses.RVR09: Y había ciertos Griegos de los que habían subido á adorar en la fiesta:

verses.KJV: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.WEB: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
verses.ASV: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes pois vieram a Filipe, que era de Betsaida de Galileia, e rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Senhor, queríamos ver a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Estos pues, se llegaron á Felipe, que era de Bethsaida de Galilea, y rogáronle, diciendo: Señor, querríamos ver á Jesús.

verses.KJV: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.WEB: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
verses.ASV: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: Andrew cometh, and Philip, and they tell Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio Filipe, e disse-o a André; e André então e Filipe o disseram a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Vino Felipe, y díjolo á Andrés: Andrés entonces, y Felipe, lo dicen á Jesús.

verses.KJV: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.ASV: And Jesus answereth them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jesus lhes respondeu, dizendo: Chegada é a hora em que o Filho do homem será glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les respondió, diciendo: La hora viene en que el Hijo del hombre ha de ser glorificado.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, se o grão de trigo, ao cair na terra, não morrer, ele fica só; porém se morrer, dá muito fruto.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que si el grano de trigo no cae en la tierra y muere, él solo queda; mas si muriere, mucho fruto lleva.

verses.KJV: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.WEB: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.ASV: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ama sua vida a perderá; e quem neste mundo odeia sua vida, a guardará para a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: El que ama su vida, la perderá; y el que aborrece su vida en este mundo, para vida eterna la guardará.

verses.KJV: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.WEB: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.ASV: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the Father honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém me serve, siga-me; e onde eu estiver, ali estará também meu servo. E se alguém me servir, o Pai o honrará.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno me sirve, sígame: y donde yo estuviere, allí también estará mi servidor. Si alguno me sirviere, mi Padre le honrará.

verses.KJV: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.WEB: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
verses.ASV: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora minha alma está perturbada; e que direi? Pai, salva-me desta hora; mas por isso vim a esta hora.
verses.RVR09: Ahora está turbada mi alma; ¿y qué diré? Padre, sálvame de esta hora. Mas por esto he venido en esta hora.

verses.KJV: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.WEB: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
verses.ASV: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, [saying], I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pai, glorifica teu Nome. Veio, pois, uma voz do céu, [que dizia] : E já [o] tenho glorificado, e outra vez [o] glorificarei.
verses.RVR09: Padre, glorifica tu nombre. Entonces vino una voz del cielo: Y lo he glorificado, y lo glorificaré otra vez.

verses.KJV: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.WEB: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.ASV: The multitude therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it had thundered: others said, An angel hath spoken to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: A multidão pois que ali estava, e [a] ouviu, dizia que havia sido trovão. Outros diziam: Algum anjo falou com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y la gente que estaba presente, y había oído, decía que había sido trueno. Otros decían: Angel le ha hablado.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus e disse: Esta voz não veio por causa de mim, mas sim por causa de vós.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y dijo: No ha venido esta voz por mi causa, mas por causa de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.WEB: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
verses.ASV: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora é o juízo deste mundo; agora será lançado fora o príncipe deste mundo.
verses.RVR09: Ahora es el juicio de este mundo: ahora el príncipe de este mundo será echado fuera.

verses.KJV: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.WEB: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
verses.ASV: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, quando for levantado da terra, trarei todos a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y yo, si fuere levantado de la tierra, á todos traeré á mí mismo.

verses.KJV: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.WEB: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.ASV: But this he said, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
verses.ALMEIDA: (E isto dizia, indicando de que morte [ele] morreria.)
verses.RVR09: Y esto decía dando á entender de qué muerte había de morir.

verses.KJV: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.WEB: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
verses.ASV: The multitude therefore answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe a multidão: Temos ouvido da Lei que o Cristo permanece para sempre; e como tu dizes que convém que o Filho do homem seja levantado? Quem é este Filho do homem?
verses.RVR09: Respondióle la gente: Nosotros hemos oído de la ley, que el Cristo permanece para siempre: ¿cómo pues dices tú: Conviene que el Hijo del hombre sea levantado? ¿Quién es este Hijo del hombre?

verses.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto them, Yet a little while is the light among you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Jesus: Ainda por um pouco de tempo a luz está convosco; andai enquanto tendes luz, para que as trevas vos não apanhem. E quem anda em trevas não sabe para onde vai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jesús les dice: Aun por un poco estará la luz entre vosotros: andad entre tanto que tenéis luz, porque no os sorprendan las tinieblas; porque el que anda en tinieblas, no sabe dónde va.

verses.KJV: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.WEB: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.ASV: While ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light. These things spake Jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto tendes luz, crede na luz, para que sejais filhos da luz.Estas coisas falou Jesus, e indo-se, escondeu-se deles.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que tenéis la luz, creed en la luz, para que seáis hijos de luz. Estas cosas habló Jesús, y fuése, y escondióse de ellos.

verses.KJV: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.WEB: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
verses.ASV: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que perante eles tinha feito tantos sinais, não criam nele.
verses.RVR09: Empero habiendo hecho delante de ellos tantas señales, no creían en él.

verses.KJV: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.WEB: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
verses.ASV: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? And to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que se cumprisse a palavra do profeta Isaías, que disse: Senhor, quem creu em nossa pregação? E a quem o braço do Senhor foi revelado?
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese el dicho que dijo el profeta Isaías: ¿Señor, quién ha creído á nuestro dicho? ¿y el brazo del Señor, á quién es revelado?

verses.KJV: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.WEB: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
verses.ASV: For this cause they could not believe, for that Isaiah said again,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso não podiam crer, porque outra vez Isaías disse:
verses.RVR09: Por esto no podían creer, porque otra vez dijo Isaías:

verses.KJV: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.WEB: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
verses.ASV: He hath blinded their eyes, and he hardened their heart; Lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, And should turn, And I should heal them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos lhes cegou, e o coração lhes endureceu; para não acontecer que vejam dos olhos, e entendam do coração, e se convertam, e eu os cure.
verses.RVR09: Cegó los ojos de ellos, y endureció su corazón; porque no vean con los ojos, y entiendan de corazón, y se conviertan, y yo los sane.

verses.KJV: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.WEB: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
verses.ASV: These things said Isaiah, because he saw his glory; and he spake of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto disse Isaías, quando viu sua glória, e falou dele.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas dijo Isaías cuando vió su gloria, y habló de él.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
verses.ASV: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess [it], lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo ainda até muitos dos chefes também creram nele; mas não o confessavam por causa dos fariseus; para não serem expulsos da sinagoga.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso, aun de los príncipes, muchos creyeron en él; mas por causa de los Fariseos no lo confesaban, por no ser echados de la sinagoga.

verses.KJV: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.WEB: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
verses.ASV: for they loved the glory [that is] of men more than the glory [that is] of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque amavam mais a glória humana do que a glória de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque amaban más la gloria de los hombres que la gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.WEB: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
verses.ASV: And Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E exclamou Jesus, e disse: Quem crê em mim, não crê [somente] em mim, mas [também] naquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jesús clamó y dijo: El que cree en mí, no cree en mí, sino en el que me envió;

verses.KJV: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.WEB: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.ASV: And he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem vê a mim, vê a aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Y el que me ve, ve al que me envió.

verses.KJV: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.WEB: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
verses.ASV: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou a luz que vim ao mundo, para que todo aquele que crê em mim, não permaneça em trevas.
verses.RVR09: Yo la luz he venido al mundo, para que todo aquel que cree en mí no permanezca en tinieblas.

verses.KJV: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.WEB: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.ASV: And if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém ouvir minhas palavras, e não crer, eu não o julgo; porque não vim para julgar o mundo, mas sim para salvar o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y el que oyere mis palabras, y no las creyere, yo no le juzgo; porque no he venido á juzgar al mundo, sino á salvar al mundo.

verses.KJV: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.WEB: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
verses.ASV: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me rejeitar e não receber minhas palavras, já tem quem o julgue: a palavra que eu tenho falado, essa o julgará no último dia.
verses.RVR09: El que me desecha, y no recibe mis palabras, tiene quien le juzgue: la palabra que he hablado, ella le juzgará en el día postrero.

verses.KJV: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.WEB: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
verses.ASV: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu não tenho falado de mim mesmo; porém o Pai que me enviou, ele me deu mandamento do que devo dizer, e do que devo falar.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo no he hablado de mí mismo: mas el Padre que me envió, él me dió mandamiento de lo que he de decir, y de lo que he de hablar.

verses.KJV: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.WEB: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
verses.ASV: And I know that his commandment is life eternal; the things therefore which I speak, even as the Father hath said unto me, so I speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sei que seu mandamento é vida eterna. Portanto o que eu falo, falo assim como o Pai tem me dito.
verses.RVR09: Y sé que su mandamiento es vida eterna: así que, lo que yo hablo, como el Padre me lo ha dicho, así hablo.

verses.KJV: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.WEB: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.ASV: Now before the feast of the passover, Jesus knowing that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own that were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E antes da festa da páscoa, sabendo Jesus que sua hora já era vinda, para que deste mundo passasse para o Pai, havendo amado aos seus, que estavam no mundo, até o fim os amou.
verses.RVR09: ANTES de la fiesta de la Pascua, sabiendo Jesús que su hora había venido para que pasase de este mundo al Padre, como había amado á los suyos que estaban en el mundo, amólos hasta el fin.

verses.KJV: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
verses.WEB: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.ASV: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s [son], to betray him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E terminada a ceia, o diabo já havia metido no coração de Judas de Simão Iscariotes, que o traísse.
verses.RVR09: Y la cena acabada, como el diablo ya había metido en el corazón de Judas, hijo de Simón Iscariote, que le entregase,

verses.KJV: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.WEB: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
verses.ASV: [Jesus], knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and goeth unto God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo Jesus que o Pai já tinha lhe dado todas as coisas nas mãos, e que ele era vindo de Deus, e para Deus ele iria,
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo Jesús que el Padre le había dado todas las cosas en las manos, y que había salido de Dios, y á Dios iba,

verses.KJV: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.WEB: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.ASV: riseth from supper, and layeth aside his garments; and he took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se da ceia, e tirou as roupas, e tomando uma toalha, envolveu- [a] em si;
verses.RVR09: Levántase de la cena, y quítase su ropa, y tomando una toalla, ciñóse.

verses.KJV: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.WEB: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.ASV: Then he poureth water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois pôs água em uma bacia, e começou a lavar os pés dos discípulos, e limpá-los com a toalha com que estava envolto.
verses.RVR09: Luego puso agua en un lebrillo, y comenzó á lavar los pies de los discípulos, y á limpiarlos con la toalla con que estaba ceñido.

verses.KJV: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.WEB: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.ASV: So he cometh to Simon Peter. He saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, a Simão Pedro; e ele lhe disse: Senhor, tu a mim lavas meus pés?
verses.RVR09: Entonces vino á Simón Pedro; y Pedro le dice: ¿Señor, tú me lavas los pies?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: O que eu faço tu não o sabes agora; mas depois o entenderás.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjole: Lo que yo hago, tú no entiendes ahora; mas lo entenderás después.

verses.KJV: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.WEB: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
verses.ASV: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Pedro: Nunca lavarás meus pés. Respondeu-lhe então Jesus: Se eu não te lavar, não tens parte comigo.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Pedro: No me lavarás los pies jamás. Respondióle Jesús: Si no te lavare, no tendrás parte conmigo.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
verses.ASV: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, [lava] não só meus pés, mas também as mãos e a cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Simón Pedro: Señor, no sólo mis pies, mas aun las manos y la cabeza.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith to him, He that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Aquele que está lavado não necessita lavar, a não ser os pés, mas está todo limpo. E vós limpos estais, porém não todos.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: El que está lavado, no necesita sino que lave los pies, mas está todo limpio: y vosotros limpios estáis, aunque no todos.

verses.KJV: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.WEB: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.ASV: For he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele bem sabia quem o trairia; por isso disse: Nem todos estais limpos.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabía quién le había de entregar; por eso dijo: No estáis limpios todos.

verses.KJV: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.WEB: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.ASV: So when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando então, tendo eles lavado os pés, e tomado suas roupas, voltou a se sentar [à mesa] ,e disse-lhes: Entendeis o que vos tenho feito?
verses.RVR09: Así que, después que les hubo lavado los pies, y tomado su ropa, volviéndose á sentar á la mesa, díjoles: ¿Sabéis lo que os he hecho?

verses.KJV: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.WEB: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
verses.ASV: Ye call me, Teacher, and, Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós me chamais Mestre, e Senhor, e bem dizeis; que eu o sou;
verses.RVR09: Vosotros me llamáis, Maestro, y, Señor: y decís bien; porque lo soy.

verses.KJV: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.WEB: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.ASV: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se eu, o Senhor, e o Mestre, tenho lavado vossos pés, também vós deveis lavar vossos pés uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Pues si yo, el Señor y el Maestro, he lavado vuestros pies, vosotros también debéis lavar los pies los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.WEB: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
verses.ASV: For I have given you an example, that ye also should do as I have done to you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vos tenho dado exemplo, para que como eu vos tenho feito, façais vós também.
verses.RVR09: Porque ejemplo os he dado, para que como yo os he hecho, vosotros también hagáis.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, [que] o servo não é maior que seu senhor; nem enviado maior que aquele que o enviou.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: El siervo no es mayor que su señor, ni el apóstol es mayor que el que le envió.

verses.KJV: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.WEB: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.ASV: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sabeis estas coisas, sereis bem-aventurados se as fizerdes.
verses.RVR09: Si sabéis estas cosas, bienaventurados seréis, si las hiciereis.

verses.KJV: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.WEB: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
verses.ASV: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digo de todos; bem sei eu aos que tenho escolhido; mas para que se cumpra a Escritura, [que diz] : O que come comigo, levantou contra mim seu calcanhar.
verses.RVR09: No hablo de todos vosotros: yo sé los que he elegido: mas para que se cumpla la Escritura: El que come pan conmigo, levantó contra mí su calcañar.

verses.KJV: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
verses.WEB: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
verses.ASV: From henceforth I tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am [he].
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde agora, antes que se faça, digo-o a vós, para que, quando se fizer, creiais que eu sou.
verses.RVR09: Desde ahora os lo digo antes que se haga, para que cuando se hiciere, creáis que yo soy.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, [que] se alguém receber ao [que] eu enviar, a mim me recebe; e quem a mim me receber, recebe a aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: El que recibe al que yo enviare, á mí recibe; y el que á mí recibe, recibe al que me envió.

verses.KJV: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.WEB: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.ASV: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo Jesus dito isto, perturbou-se em espírito, e testemunhou, e disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que um de vós me trairá.
verses.RVR09: Como hubo dicho Jesús esto, fué conmovido en el espíritu, y protestó, y dijo: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que uno de vosotros me ha de entregar.

verses.KJV: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.WEB: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
verses.ASV: The disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo que os discípulos se olhavam uns para os outros, duvidando de quem ele dizia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los discípulos mirábanse los unos á los otros, dudando de quién decía.

verses.KJV: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.WEB: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
verses.ASV: There was at the table reclining in Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos discípulos, a quem Jesus amava, estava sentado [à mesa encostado] no seio de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y uno de sus discípulos, al cual Jesús amaba, estaba recostado en el seno de Jesús.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.ASV: Simon Peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, Tell [us] who it is of whom he speaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este pois fez sinal Simão Pedro, que perguntasse quem era aquele de quem ele dizia.
verses.RVR09: A éste, pues, hizo señas Simón Pedro, para que preguntase quién era aquél de quien decía.

verses.KJV: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.WEB: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.ASV: He leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E declinando-se ele ao peito de Jesus, disse-lhe: Senhor, quem é?
verses.RVR09: El entonces recostándose sobre el pecho de Jesús, dícele: Señor, ¿quién es?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore answereth, He it is, for whom I shall dip the sop, and give it him. So when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to Judas, [the son] of Simon Iscariot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Aquele a quem eu der o pedaço molhado de pão. E molhando o pedaço de pão, deu-o a Judas de Simão Iscariotes.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Aquél es, á quien yo diere el pan mojado. Y mojando el pan, diólo á Judas Iscariote, hijo de Simón.

verses.KJV: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.WEB: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
verses.ASV: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E após o pedaço de pão, entrou nele Satanás. Disse-lhe pois Jesus: O que fazes, faze-o depressa.
verses.RVR09: Y tras el bocado Satanás entró en él. Entonces Jesús le dice: Lo que haces, hazlo más presto.

verses.KJV: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.WEB: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.ASV: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nenhum dos que estavam sentados [à mesa] entendeu para que ele lhe dissera.
verses.RVR09: Mas ninguno de los que estaban á la mesa entendió á qué propósito le dijo esto.

verses.KJV: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.WEB: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.ASV: For some thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus said unto him, Buy what things we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois alguns pensavam que, porque Judas tinha a bolsa, Jesus havia lhe dito: Compra o que para o que nos é necessário para a festa; ou que alguma coisa desse aos pobres.
verses.RVR09: Porque los unos pensaban, porque Judas tenía la bolsa, que Jesús le decía: Compra lo que necesitamos para la fiesta: ó, que diese algo á los pobres.

verses.KJV: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.WEB: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
verses.ASV: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo ele pois tomado o pedaço de pão, logo saiu. E já era noite.
verses.RVR09: Como él pues hubo tomado el bocado, luego salió: y era ya noche.

verses.KJV: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.WEB: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
verses.ASV: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo, pois, ele saído, disse Jesus: Agora o Filho do homem é glorificado, e Deus é glorificado nele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces como él salió, dijo Jesús: Ahora es glorificado el Hijo del hombre, y Dios es glorificado en él.

verses.KJV: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.WEB: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
verses.ASV: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se Deus nele é glorificado, também Deus o glorificará em si mesmo, e logo o glorificará.
verses.RVR09: Si Dios es glorificado en él, Dios también le glorificará en sí mismo, y luego le glorificará.

verses.KJV: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.WEB: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
verses.ASV: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhinhos, ainda um pouco estou convosco. Vós me buscareis; e tal como eu aos Judeus: Para onde eu vou, vós não podeis vir; assim também o digo a vós agora.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos, aun un poco estoy con vosotros. Me buscaréis; mas, como dije á los Judíos: Donde yo voy, vosotros no podéis venir; así digo á vosotros ahora.

verses.KJV: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.WEB: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
verses.ASV: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um novo mandamento vos dou: que vos ameis uns aos outros; tal como eu vos amei, também ameis vós uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Un mandamiento nuevo os doy: Que os améis unos á otros: como os he amado, que también os améis los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.WEB: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.ASV: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto todos conhecerão que sois meus discípulos: se vós tiverdes amor uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: En esto conocerán todos que sois mis discípulos, si tuviereis amor los unos con los otros.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
verses.ASV: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, para onde vais? Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Para onde eu vou tu não podes me seguir agora; porém depois me seguirás.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Simón Pedro: Señor, ¿adónde vas? Respondióle Jesús: Donde yo voy, no me puedes ahora seguir; mas me seguirás después.

verses.KJV: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.WEB: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.ASV: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Pedro: Senhor, por que agora não posso te seguir? Por ti eu darei minha vida.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Pedro: Señor, ¿por qué no te puedo seguir ahora? mi alma pondré por ti.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
verses.ASV: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Por mim darás tua vida? Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que o galo não cantará, até que três vezes me negues.
verses.RVR09: Respondióle Jesús: ¿Tu alma pondrás por mí? De cierto, de cierto te digo: No cantará el gallo, sin que me hayas negado tres veces.

verses.KJV: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.WEB: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
verses.ASV: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se perturbe vosso coração; credes em Deus, crede também em mim.
verses.RVR09: NO se turbe vuestro corazón: creéis en Dios, creed también en mí.

verses.KJV: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.WEB: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.ASV: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na casa de meu Pai há muitas moradas; senão, eu vos diria; vou para vos preparar lugar.
verses.RVR09: En la casa de mi Padre muchas moradas hay: de otra manera os lo hubiera dicho: voy, pues, á preparar lugar para vosotros.

verses.KJV: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verses.WEB: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
verses.ASV: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, [there] ye may be also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu for, e vos preparar lugar, outra vez virei, e vos tomarei comigo, para que vós também estejais onde eu estiver.
verses.RVR09: Y si me fuere, y os aparejare lugar, vendré otra vez, y os tomaré á mí mismo: para que donde yo estoy, vosotros también estéis.

verses.KJV: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.WEB: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
verses.ASV: And whither I go, ye know the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E já sabeis para onde vou, e sabeis o caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y sabéis á dónde yo voy; y sabéis el camino.

verses.KJV: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.WEB: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
verses.ASV: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Tomé: Senhor, não sabemos para onde vais; e como podemos saber o caminho?
verses.RVR09: Dícele Tomás: Señor, no sabemos á dónde vas: ¿cómo, pues, podemos saber el camino?

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: Eu sou o caminho, e a verdade, e a vida. Ninguém vem ao Pai, a não ser por mim.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dice: Yo soy el camino, y la verdad, y la vida: nadie viene al Padre, sino por mí.

verses.KJV: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.WEB: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
verses.ASV: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vós conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai; e desde agora já o conheceis, e o tendes visto.
verses.RVR09: Si me conocieseis, también á mi Padre conocierais: y desde ahora le conocéis, y le habéis visto.

verses.KJV: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.WEB: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
verses.ASV: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Filipe: Senhor, mostra-nos ao Pai, e basta-nos.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Felipe: Señor, muéstranos el Padre, y nos basta.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Show us the Father?
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe disse: Tanto tempo [há que] estou convosco, e [ainda] não me tens conhecido, Filipe? Quem a mim tem visto, já tem visto ao Pai; e como dizes tu: Mostra-nos ao Pai?
verses.RVR09: Jesús le dice: ¿Tanto tiempo ha que estoy con vosotros, y no me has conocido, Felipe? El que me ha visto, ha visto al Padre; ¿cómo, pues, dices tú: Muéstranos el Padre?

verses.KJV: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.WEB: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
verses.ASV: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não crês tu que eu [estou] no Pai, e que o Pai está em mim? As palavras que eu vos falo, não as falo de mim mesmo, mas o Pai que está em mim, ele [é o que] faz as obras.
verses.RVR09: ¿No crees que yo soy en el Padre, y el Padre en mí? Las palabras que yo os hablo, no las hablo de mí mismo: mas el Padre que está en mí, él hace las obras.

verses.KJV: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.WEB: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.ASV: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Crede em mim que eu [estou] no Pai, e [que] o Pai está em mim; e quando não, crede em mim por causa das próprias obras.
verses.RVR09: Creedme que yo soy en el Padre, y el Padre en mí: de otra manera, creedme por las mismas obras.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater [works] than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que aquele que crê em mim, as obras que eu faço também ele as fará; e fará maiores que estas. Porque eu vou a meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo: El que en mí cree, las obras que yo hago también él las hará; y mayores que éstas hará; porque yo voy al Padre.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.WEB: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo quanto pedirdes em meu nome, eu o farei; para que o Pai seja glorificado no Filho.
verses.RVR09: Y todo lo que pidiereis al Padre en mi nombre, esto haré, para que el Padre sea glorificado en el Hijo.

verses.KJV: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
verses.WEB: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.ASV: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguma coisa pedirdes em meu nome, eu [a] farei.
verses.RVR09: Si algo pidiereis en mi nombre, yo lo haré.

verses.KJV: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.WEB: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.ASV: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se me amais, guardai meus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Si me amáis, guardad mis mandamientos;

verses.KJV: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.WEB: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
verses.ASV: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu rogarei ao Pai, e ele vos dará outro Consolador, para que fique sempre convosco;
verses.RVR09: Y yo rogaré al Padre, y os dará otro Consolador, para que esté con vosotros para siempre:

verses.KJV: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.WEB: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
verses.ASV: [even] the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao Espírito de verdade, a quem o mundo não pode receber; porque não o vê, nem o conhece; mas vós o conheceis, porque habita convosco, e estará em vós.
verses.RVR09: Al Espíritu de verdad, al cual el mundo no puede recibir, porque no le ve, ni le conoce: mas vosotros le conocéis; porque está con vosotros, y será en vosotros.

verses.KJV: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.WEB: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
verses.ASV: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos deixarei órfãos; eu virei a vós.
verses.RVR09: No os dejaré huérfanos: vendré á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.WEB: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.ASV: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda um pouco, e o mundo não me verá mais; mas vós me vereis; porque eu vivo, e vós vivereis.
verses.RVR09: Aun un poquito, y el mundo no me verá más; empero vosotros me veréis; porque yo vivo, y vosotros también viviréis.

verses.KJV: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.WEB: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.ASV: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia conhecereis que [estou] em meu Pai, e vós em mim, e eu em vós.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día vosotros conoceréis que yo estoy en mi Padre, y vosotros en mí, y yo en vosotros.

verses.KJV: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.WEB: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
verses.ASV: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem meus mandamentos, e os guarda, esse é o que me ama; e quem a mim me ama, será amado de meu Pai, e eu o amarei, e a ele me manifestarei.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene mis mandamientos, y los guarda, aquél es el que me ama; y el que me ama, será amado de mi Padre, y yo le amaré, y me manifestaré á él.

verses.KJV: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.WEB: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
verses.ASV: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Judas (não o Iscariotes): Senhor, que há, porque a nós te manifestarás, e não ao mundo?
verses.RVR09: Dícele Judas, no el Iscariote: Señor, ¿qué hay porque te hayas de manifestar á nosotros, y no al mundo?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Se alguém me ama, guardará minha palavra, e meu Pai o amará, e viremos a ele, e faremos morada com ele.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús, y díjole: El que me ama, mi palabra guardará; y mi Padre le amará, y vendremos á él, y haremos con él morada.

verses.KJV: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.WEB: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.ASV: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem não me ama, não guarda minhas palavras. E a palavra que ouvis não é minha, mas sim do Pai que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: El que no me ama, no guarda mis palabras: y la palabra que habéis oído, no es mía, sino del Padre que me envió.

verses.KJV: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
verses.WEB: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
verses.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you, while [yet] abiding with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas tenho dito a vós, estando [ainda] convosco.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas os he hablado estando con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.WEB: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.ASV: But the Comforter, [even] the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele Consolador, o Espírito Santo, ao qual o Pai enviará em meu nome, esse vos ensinará tudo, e tudo quanto tenho dito vós, [ele] vos fará lembrar.
verses.RVR09: Mas el Consolador, el Espíritu Santo, al cual el Padre enviará en mi nombre, él os enseñará todas las cosas, y os recordará todas las cosas que os he dicho.

verses.KJV: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.WEB: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verses.ASV: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verses.ALMEIDA: A paz vos deixo, minha paz vos dou; vou dá- [la] a vós, não como o mundo [a] dá. Não se perturbe vosso coração, nem se atemorize.
verses.RVR09: La paz os dejo, mi paz os doy: no como el mundo la da, yo os la doy. No se turbe vuestro corazón, ni tenga miedo.

verses.KJV: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.WEB: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
verses.ASV: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já ouvistes que vos tenho dito: Vou, e venho a vós. Se me amásseis, verdadeiramente vos alegraríeis, porque tenho dito: Vou ao Pai; pois meu Pai maior é que eu.
verses.RVR09: Habéis oído cómo yo os he dicho: Voy, y vengo á vosotros. Si me amaseis, ciertamente os gozaríais, porque he dicho que voy al Padre: porque el Padre mayor es que yo.

verses.KJV: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.WEB: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
verses.ASV: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: E já agora o disse a vós antes que aconteça, para que quando acontecer, [o] creiais.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora os lo he dicho antes que se haga; para que cuando se hiciere, creáis.

verses.KJV: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.WEB: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
verses.ASV: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Já não falarei muito convosco; pois o príncipe deste mundo já vem, e ele nada tem em mim.
verses.RVR09: Ya no hablaré mucho con vosotros: porque viene el príncipe de este mundo; mas no tiene nada en mí.

verses.KJV: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.WEB: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
verses.ASV: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas para que o mundo saiba que eu amo ao Pai, e assim faço como o Pai me mandou; levantai-vos, vamos embora daqui.
verses.RVR09: Empero para que conozca el mundo que amo al Padre, y como el Padre me dió el mandamiento, así hago. Levantaos, vamos de aquí.

verses.KJV: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.WEB: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
verses.ASV: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou a videira verdadeira, e meu Pai é o lavrador.
verses.RVR09: YO soy la vid verdadera, y mi Padre es el labrador.

verses.KJV: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.WEB: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.ASV: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo ramo que em mim não dá fruto, ele o tira; e todo o que da fruto, ele o limpa, para que dê mais fruto.
verses.RVR09: Todo pámpano que en mí no lleva fruto, le quitará: y todo aquel que lleva fruto, le limpiará, para que lleve más fruto.

verses.KJV: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.WEB: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.ASV: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós já estais limpos pela palavra que vos tenho falado.
verses.RVR09: Ya vosotros sois limpios por la palabra que os he hablado.

verses.KJV: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.WEB: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.ASV: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estai em mim, e eu em vós; como o ramo de si mesmo não pode dar fruto, se não estiver na videira, assim vós também não, se não estiverdes em mim.
verses.RVR09: Estad en mí, y yo en vosotros. Como el pámpano no puede llevar fruto de sí mismo, si no estuviere en la vid; así ni vosotros, si no estuviereis en mí.

verses.KJV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.WEB: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.ASV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou a videira, vós [sois] os ramos; quem está em mim, e eu nele, esse dá muito fruto; porque sem mim nada podeis fazer.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy la vid, vosotros los pámpanos: el que está en mí, y yo en él, éste lleva mucho fruto; porque sin mí nada podéis hacer.

verses.KJV: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.WEB: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.ASV: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém não estiver em mim, é lançado fora, como o ramo, e seca-se; e os colhem , e os lançam no fogo, e ardem.
verses.RVR09: El que en mí no estuviere, será echado fuera como mal pámpano, y se secará; y los cogen, y los echan en el fuego, y arden.

verses.KJV: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.WEB: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.ASV: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vós estiverdes em mim, e minhas palavras estiverem em vós, tudo o que quiserdes pedireis, e será feito para vós.
verses.RVR09: Si estuviereis en mí, y mis palabras estuvieren en vosotros, pedid todo lo que quisiereis, y os será hecho.

verses.KJV: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.WEB: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.ASV: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and [so] shall ye be my disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto é glorificado meu Pai, em que deis muito fruto; e [assim] sereis meus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: En esto es glorificado mi Padre, en que llevéis mucho fruto, y seáis así mis discípulos.

verses.KJV: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.WEB: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
verses.ASV: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o Pai me amou, também eu vos amei; estai neste meu amor.
verses.RVR09: Como el Padre me amó, también yo os he amado: estad en mi amor.

verses.KJV: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.WEB: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
verses.ASV: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se guardardes meus mandamentos, estareis em meu amor. Como eu tenho guardado os mandamentos de meu Pai, e estou em seu amor.
verses.RVR09: Si guardareis mis mandamientos, estaréis en mi amor; como yo también he guardado los mandamientos de mi Padre, y estoy en su amor.

verses.KJV: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
verses.WEB: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and [that] your joy may be made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas eu tenho vos dito para que minha alegria esteja em vós, e vossa alegria seja completa.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas os he hablado, para que mi gozo esté en vosotros, y vuestro gozo sea cumplido.

verses.KJV: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.WEB: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.ASV: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é meu mandamento: que vos ameis uns aos outros, assim como eu vos amei.
verses.RVR09: Este es mi mandamiento: Que os améis los unos á los otros, como yo os he amado.

verses.KJV: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.WEB: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.ASV: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém tem maior amor que este: que alguém ponha sua vida por seus amigos.
verses.RVR09: Nadie tiene mayor amor que este, que ponga alguno su vida por sus amigos.

verses.KJV: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.WEB: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
verses.ASV: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois meus amigos, se fizerdes o que eu vos mando.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois mis amigos, si hiciereis las cosas que yo os mando.

verses.KJV: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.WEB: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
verses.ASV: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já não vos chamo mais servos; porque o servo não sabe o que faz seu senhor; mas eu tenho vos chamado de amigos, porque tudo quanto ouvi de meu Pai eu tenho vos feito conhecer.
verses.RVR09: Ya no os llamaré siervos, porque el siervo no sabe lo que hace su señor: mas os he llamado amigos, porque todas las cosas que oí de mi Padre, os he hecho notorias.

verses.KJV: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.WEB: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.ASV: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and [that] your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não [fostes] vós [que] me escolhestes, porém eu vos escolhi, e tenho vos posto para que vades, e deis fruto, e vosso fruto permaneça; para que tudo quanto pedirdes ao Pai em meu nome, ele vos dê.
verses.RVR09: No me elegisteis vosotros á mí, mas yo os elegí á vosotros; y os he puesto para que vayáis y llevéis fruto, y vuestro fruto permanezca: para que todo lo que pidiereis del Padre en mi nombre, él os lo dé.

verses.KJV: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.WEB: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
verses.ASV: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto vos mando, para que vos ameis uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Esto os mando: Que os améis los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.WEB: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.ASV: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before [it hated] you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o mundo vos odeia, sabei que odiou a mim antes que a vós.
verses.RVR09: Si el mundo os aborrece, sabed que á mí me aborreció antes que á vosotros.

verses.KJV: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.WEB: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.ASV: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vós fôsseis do mundo, o mundo amaria ao seu; mas porque não sois do mundo, antes eu vos escolhi do mundo, por isso o mundo vos odeia.
verses.RVR09: Si fuerais del mundo, el mundo amaría lo suyo; mas porque no sois del mundo, antes yo os elegí del mundo, por eso os aborrece el mundo.

verses.KJV: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.WEB: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
verses.ASV: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos da palavra que vos tenho dito: não é o servo maior que seu senhor. Se me perseguiram, também vos perseguirão; se guardaram minha palavra, também guardarão a vossa.
