verses.RVR09: Acordaos de la palabra que yo os he dicho: No es el siervo mayor que su señor. Si á mí me han perseguido, también á vosotros perseguirán: si han guardado mi palabra, también guardarán la vuestra.

verses.KJV: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.WEB: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
verses.ASV: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tudo isto vos farão por causa do meu nome; porque não conhecem a aquele que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Mas todo esto os harán por causa de mi nombre, porque no conocen al que me ha enviado.

verses.KJV: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
verses.WEB: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.ASV: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu não tivesse vindo, nem lhes houvesse falado, não teriam pecado; mas agora já não têm pretexto pelo seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Si no hubiera venido, ni les hubiera hablado, no tendrían pecado, mas ahora no tienen excusa de su pecado.

verses.KJV: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.WEB: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
verses.ASV: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me odeia, também odeia a meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: El que me aborrece, también á mi Padre aborrece.

verses.KJV: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.WEB: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
verses.ASV: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu entre eles não tivesse feito obras, que nenhum outro fizera, não teriam pecado; mas agora as viram, e [contudo] odiaram a mim, e a meu Pai.
verses.RVR09: Si no hubiese hecho entre ellos obras cuales ningún otro ha hecho, no tendrían pecado; mas ahora, y las han visto, y me aborrecen á mí y á mi Padre.

verses.KJV: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.WEB: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.ASV: But [this cometh to pass], that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [isto é] para que se cumpra a palavra que está escrita em sua Lei: Sem causa me odiaram.
verses.RVR09: Mas para que se cumpla la palabra que está escrita en su ley: Que sin causa me aborrecieron.

verses.KJV: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.WEB: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
verses.ASV: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, [even] the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando vier o Consolador, que eu do Pai vos enviarei, aquele Espírito de verdade, que sai do Pai, ele testemunhará de mim.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando viniere el Consolador, el cual yo os enviaré del Padre, el Espíritu de verdad, el cual procede del Padre, él dará testimonio de mí.

verses.KJV: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.WEB: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.ASV: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também vós testemunhareis, pois estivestes comigo desde o princípio.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros daréis testimonio, porque estáis conmigo desde el principio.

verses.KJV: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.WEB: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
verses.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas tenho vos dito para que não tropeceis na fé.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS cosas os he hablado, para que no os escandalicéis.

verses.KJV: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.WEB: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
verses.ASV: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Expulsarão a vós das sinagogas; mas a hora vem, quando qualquer que vos matar, pensará fazer serviço a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Os echarán de las sinagogas; y aun viene la hora, cuando cualquiera que os matare, pensará que hace servicio á Dios.

verses.KJV: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.WEB: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
verses.ASV: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas coisas vos farão, porque nem ao Pai, nem a mim me conheceram.
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas os harán, porque no conocen al Padre ni á mí.

verses.KJV: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.WEB: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.ASV: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tenho vos dito isto para que, quando aquela hora vier, disso vos lembreis, que já o dissera a vós; mas isto eu não vos disse desde o princípio, porque eu estava convosco.
verses.RVR09: Mas os he dicho esto, para que cuando aquella hora viniere, os acordéis que yo os lo había dicho. Esto empero no os lo dije al principio, porque yo estaba con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.WEB: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.ASV: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora vou para aquele que me enviou; e nenhum de vós me pergunta: Para onde vais?
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora voy al que me envió; y ninguno de vosotros me pregunta: ¿Adónde vas?

verses.KJV: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.WEB: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.ASV: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, porque vos disse estas coisas, a tristeza encheu vosso coração.
verses.RVR09: Antes, porque os he hablado estas cosas, tristeza ha henchido vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vos digo a verdade, que vos convém que eu vá; porque se eu não for, o Consolador não virá a vós; porém se eu for, eu o enviarei a vós.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo os digo la verdad: Os es necesario que yo vaya: porque si yo no fuese, el Consolador no vendría á vosotros; mas si yo fuere, os le enviaré.

verses.KJV: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.WEB: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
verses.ASV: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo ele, convencerá ao mundo do pecado, e da justiça, e do juízo.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él viniere redargüirá al mundo de pecado, y de justicia, y de juicio:

verses.KJV: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.WEB: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
verses.ASV: of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Do pecado, porque não creem em mim;
verses.RVR09: De pecado ciertamente, por cuanto no creen en mí;

verses.KJV: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.WEB: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
verses.ASV: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;
verses.ALMEIDA: E da justiça, porque vou para meu Pai, e não me vereis mais;
verses.RVR09: Y de justicia, por cuanto voy al Padre, y no me veréis más;

verses.KJV: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.WEB: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
verses.ASV: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.
verses.ALMEIDA: E do juízo, porque o Príncipe deste mundo já está julgado.
verses.RVR09: Y de juicio, por cuanto el príncipe de este mundo es juzgado.

verses.KJV: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.WEB: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verses.ASV: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda tenho muitas coisas que vos dizer, mas agora [ainda] não podeis suportá-las.
verses.RVR09: Aun tengo muchas cosas que deciros, mas ahora no las podéis llevar.

verses.KJV: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.WEB: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
verses.ASV: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, [these] shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando vier aquele Espírito de verdade, ele vos guiará em toda verdade. Porque de si mesmo não falará; mas falará tudo o que ouvir; E ele vos anunciará as coisas que virão.
verses.RVR09: Pero cuando viniere aquel Espíritu de verdad, él os guiará á toda verdad; porque no hablará de sí mismo, sino que hablará todo lo que oyere, y os hará saber las cosas que han de venir.

verses.KJV: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.WEB: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
verses.ASV: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me glorificará, porque tomará do [que é] meu, e vos anunciará.
verses.RVR09: El me glorificará: porque tomará de lo mío, y os lo hará saber.

verses.KJV: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.WEB: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
verses.ASV: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo quanto tem o Pai é meu; por isso eu disse, que tomará do [que é] meu, e vos anunciará.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que tiene el Padre, mío es: por eso dije que tomará de lo mío, y os lo hará saber.

verses.KJV: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.WEB: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.ASV: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis; porque vou ao Pai.
verses.RVR09: Un poquito, y no me veréis; y otra vez un poquito, y me veréis: porque yo voy al Padre.

verses.KJV: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.WEB: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
verses.ASV: [Some] of his disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois [alguns] de seus discípulos uns aos outros: Que é isto que ele nos diz: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis; e porque vou ao Pai?
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijeron algunos de sus discípulos unos á otros: ¿Qué es esto que nos dice: Un poquito, y no me veréis; y otra vez un poquito, y me veréis: y, porque yo voy al Padre?

verses.KJV: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.WEB: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
verses.ASV: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? We know not what he saith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então diziam: Que é isto que ele diz? Um pouco? Não sabemos o que diz.
verses.RVR09: Decían pues: ¿Qué es esto que dice: Un poquito? No entendemos lo que habla.

verses.KJV: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.WEB: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
verses.ASV: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Conheceu pois Jesus que lhe queriam perguntar, e disse-lhes: Perguntais entre vós sobre isto que disse: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis?
verses.RVR09: Y conoció Jesús que le querían preguntar, y díjoles: ¿Preguntáis entre vosotros de esto que dije: Un poquito, y no me veréis, y otra vez un poquito, y me veréis?

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que vós chorareis, e lamentareis, e o mundo se alegrará, e vós estareis tristes; mas vossa tristeza se tornará em alegria.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto os digo, que vosotros lloraréis y lamentaréis, y el mundo se alegrará: empero aunque vosotros estaréis tristes, vuestra tristeza se tornará en gozo.

verses.KJV: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.WEB: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
verses.ASV: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher quando está no parto tem tristeza, porque sua hora é vinda; mas havendo nascido a criança, já não se lembra da aflição, pela alegria de um homem ter nascido no mundo.
verses.RVR09: La mujer cuando pare, tiene dolor, porque es venida su hora; mas después que ha parido un niño, ya no se acuerda de la angustia, por el gozo de que haya nacido un hombre en el mundo.

verses.KJV: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.WEB: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.ASV: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós agora na verdade tendes tristeza; mas novamente vos verei, e vosso coração se alegrará, e ninguém tirará vossa alegria de vós.
verses.RVR09: También, pues, vosotros ahora ciertamente tenéis tristeza; mas otra vez os veré, y se gozará vuestro corazón, y nadie quitará de vosotros vuestro gozo.

verses.KJV: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.WEB: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.ASV: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, If ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia nada me perguntareis. Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que tudo quanto pedirdes a meu Pai em meu nome, ele vos dará.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel día no me preguntaréis nada. De cierto, de cierto os digo, que todo cuanto pidiereis al Padre en mi nombre, os lo dará.

verses.KJV: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.WEB: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.ASV: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até agora nada pedistes em meu nome; pedi, e recebereis, para que vossa alegria seja completa.
verses.RVR09: Hasta ahora nada habéis pedido en mi nombre: pedid, y recibiréis, para que vuestro gozo sea cumplido.

verses.KJV: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.WEB: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas vos falei por parábolas; porém a hora vem quando não mais vos falarei por parábolas; mas vos falarei abertamente sobre o Pai.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas os he hablado en proverbios: la hora viene cuando ya no os hablaré por proverbios, pero claramente os anunciaré del Padre.

verses.KJV: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.WEB: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
verses.ASV: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia pedireis em meu nome; e não vos digo, que eu suplicarei ao Pai por vós.
verses.RVR09: Aquel día pediréis en mi nombre: y no os digo, que yo rogaré al Padre por vosotros;

verses.KJV: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.WEB: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.ASV: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o próprio Pai vos ama, porque vós me amastes, e crestes que eu saí de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pues el mismo Padre os ama, porque vosotros me amasteis, y habéis creído que yo salí de Dios.

verses.KJV: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.WEB: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
verses.ASV: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saí do Pai, e vim ao mundo; novamente deixo o mundo, e vou ao Pai.
verses.RVR09: Salí del Padre, y he venido al mundo: otra vez dejo el mundo, y voy al Padre.

verses.KJV: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.WEB: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
verses.ASV: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe seus Discípulos: Eis que agora falas abertamente, e nenhuma parábola dizes.
verses.RVR09: Dícenle sus discípulos: He aquí, ahora hablas claramente, y ningún proverbio dices.

verses.KJV: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.WEB: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.ASV: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora sabemos que sabes todas as coisas; e não necessitas que ninguém te pergunte. Por isso cremos que saíste de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ahora entendemos que sabes todas las cosas, y no necesitas que nadie te pregunte: en esto creemos que has salido de Dios.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.ASV: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Agora credes?
verses.RVR09: Respondióles Jesús: ¿Ahora creéis?

verses.KJV: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.WEB: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.ASV: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and [yet] I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a hora vem, e já é chegada, quando sereis dispersos, cada um por si, e me deixareis só. Porém não estou só, porque o Pai está comigo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, la hora viene, y ha venido, que seréis esparcidos cada uno por su parte, y me dejaréis solo: mas no estoy solo, porque el Padre está conmigo.

verses.KJV: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.WEB: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verses.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas tenho vos dito para que tenhais paz em mim; no mundo tereis aflição; mas tende bom ânimo; eu venci o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas os he hablado, para que en mí tengáis paz. En el mundo tendréis aflicción: mas confiad, yo he vencido al mundo.

verses.KJV: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.WEB: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
verses.ASV: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the Son may glorify thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus falou estas coisas, levantou seus olhos ao céu, e disse: Pai, chegada é a hora; glorifica a teu Filho, para que também teu Filho glorifique a ti.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS cosas habló Jesús, y levantados los ojos al cielo, dijo: Padre, la hora es llegada; glorifica á tu Hijo, para que también tu Hijo te glorifique á ti;

verses.KJV: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.WEB: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.ASV: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como lhe deste poder sobre toda carne, para que a todos quantos lhe deste, lhes dê a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Como le has dado la potestad de toda carne, para que dé vida eterna á todos los que le diste.

verses.KJV: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.WEB: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, [even] Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a vida eterna: que conheçam a ti, o único Deus verdadeiro, e a Jesus Cristo, a quem tens enviado.
verses.RVR09: Esta empero es la vida eterna: que te conozcan el solo Dios verdadero, y á Jesucristo, al cual has enviado.

verses.KJV: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.WEB: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
verses.ASV: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu já te glorifiquei na terra; consumado tenho a obra que me deste para eu fazer.
verses.RVR09: Yo te he glorificado en la tierra: he acabado la obra que me diste que hiciese.

verses.KJV: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.WEB: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
verses.ASV: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora glorifica-me tu, ó Pai, junto de ti mesmo, com aquela glória que eu tinha junto de ti, antes que o mundo existisse.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Padre, glorifícame tú cerca de ti mismo con aquella gloria que tuve cerca de ti antes que el mundo fuese.

verses.KJV: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.WEB: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
verses.ASV: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manifestei teu nome aos seres humanos que me deste do mundo. Eles eram teus, e tu os deste a mim; e eles guardaram tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: He manifestado tu nombre á los hombres que del mundo me diste: tuyos eran, y me los diste, y guardaron tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.WEB: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
verses.ASV: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora eles sabem que tudo quanto me deste vem de ti.
verses.RVR09: Ahora han conocido que todas las cosas que me diste, son de ti;

verses.KJV: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.WEB: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
verses.ASV: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received [them], and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as palavras que tu me deste eu lhes dei; e eles [as] receberam, e verdadeiramente reconheceram que eu saí de ti, e creram que tu me enviaste.
verses.RVR09: Porque las palabras que me diste, les he dado; y ellos las recibieron, y han conocido verdaderamente que salí de ti, y han creído que tú me enviaste.

verses.KJV: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.WEB: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
verses.ASV: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu rogo por eles; não rogo pelo mundo, mas sim por aqueles que tu me deste, porque são teus.
verses.RVR09: Yo ruego por ellos: no ruego por el mundo, sino por los que me diste; porque tuyos son:

verses.KJV: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.WEB: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.ASV: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as minhas coisas são tuas; e as tuas coisas são minhas; e nelas sou glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Y todas mis cosas son tus cosas, y tus cosas son mis cosas: y he sido glorificado en ellas.

verses.KJV: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
verses.WEB: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
verses.ASV: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we [are].
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu já não estou no mundo; porém estes [ainda] estão no mundo, e eu venho a ti. Pai Santo, guarda-os em teu nome, a aqueles que tens me dado, para que sejam um, como nós [somos] .
verses.RVR09: Y ya no estoy en el mundo; mas éstos están en el mundo, y yo á ti vengo. Padre santo, á los que me has dado, guárdalos por tu nombre, para que sean una cosa, como también nosotros.

verses.KJV: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.ASV: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu com eles estava no mundo, em teu nome eu os guardava. A aqueles que tu me deste eu os tenho guardado; e nenhum deles se perdeu, a não ser o filho da perdição, para que a Escritura se cumpra.
verses.RVR09: Cuando estaba con ellos en el mundo, yo los guardaba en tu nombre; á los que me diste, yo los guardé, y ninguno de ellos se perdió, sino el hijo de perdición; para que la Escritura se cumpliese.

verses.KJV: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.WEB: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
verses.ASV: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora venho a ti, e falo isto no mundo, para que em si mesmos tenham minha alegria completa.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora vengo á ti; y hablo esto en el mundo, para que tengan mi gozo cumplido en sí mismos.

verses.KJV: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.WEB: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.ASV: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua palavra lhes dei, e o mundo os odiou, porque não são do mundo, assim como eu não sou do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Yo les he dado tu palabra; y el mundo los aborreció, porque no son del mundo, como tampoco yo soy del mundo.

verses.KJV: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.WEB: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
verses.ASV: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil [one].
verses.ALMEIDA: Não suplico que os tires do mundo, mas que os guardes do maligno.
verses.RVR09: No ruego que los quites del mundo, sino que los guardes del mal.

verses.KJV: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.WEB: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.ASV: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles não são do mundo, assim como eu não sou do mundo.
verses.RVR09: No son del mundo, como tampoco yo soy del mundo.

verses.KJV: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.WEB: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
verses.ASV: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Santifica-os em tua verdade; tua palavra é a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Santifícalos en tu verdad: tu palabra es verdad.

verses.KJV: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.WEB: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
verses.ASV: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como tu me enviaste, eu os enviei ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: Como tú me enviaste al mundo, también los he enviado al mundo.

verses.KJV: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.WEB: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.ASV: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por eles a mim mesmo me santifico, para que também eles seja santificados em verdade.
verses.RVR09: Y por ellos yo me santifico á mí mismo, para que también ellos sean santificados en verdad.

verses.KJV: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.WEB: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
verses.ASV: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não suplico somente por estes, mas também por aqueles que crerão em mim, por sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Mas no ruego solamente por éstos, sino también por los que han de creer en mí por la palabra de ellos.

verses.KJV: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.WEB: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
verses.ASV: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que todos sejam um; como tu, Pai, em mim, e eu em ti, que também eles em nós sejam um; para que o mundo creia que tu tens me enviado.
verses.RVR09: Para que todos sean una cosa; como tú, oh Padre, en mí, y yo en ti, que también ellos sean en nosotros una cosa: para que el mundo crea que tú me enviaste.

verses.KJV: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.WEB: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
verses.ASV: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we [are] one;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu tenho lhes dado a glória que tu me deste, para que sejam um, tal como nós somos um.
verses.RVR09: Y yo, la gloria que me diste les he dado; para que sean una cosa, como también nosotros somos una cosa.

verses.KJV: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.WEB: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
verses.ASV: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu neles, e tu em mim; para que sejam completos em um; e para que o mundo conheça que tu me enviaste, e que tu os amaste, assim como me amaste.
verses.RVR09: Yo en ellos, y tú en mí, para que sean consumadamente una cosa; que el mundo conozca que tú me enviaste, y que los has amado, como también á mí me has amado.

verses.KJV: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.WEB: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
verses.ASV: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pai, aqueles que tens me dado, quero que onde eu estiver, eles também estejam comigo; para que vejam minha glória, que tens me dado, pois tu me amaste desde antes da fundação do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Padre, aquellos que me has dado, quiero que donde yo estoy, ellos estén también conmigo; para que vean mi gloria que me has dado: por cuanto me has amado desde antes de la constitución del mundo.

verses.KJV: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
verses.WEB: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
verses.ASV: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pai justo, o mundo também não tem te conhecido, e estes têm conhecido que tu me enviaste.
verses.RVR09: Padre justo, el mundo no te ha conocido, mas yo te he conocido; y éstos han conocido que tú me enviaste;

verses.KJV: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.WEB: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
verses.ASV: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu fiz teu nome ser conhecido por eles, e eu farei com que seja conhecido, para que o amor com que me amaste esteja neles, e eu neles.
verses.RVR09: Y yo les he manifestado tu nombre, y manifestarélo aún; para que el amor con que me has amado, esté en ellos, y yo en ellos.

verses.KJV: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.WEB: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
verses.ASV: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo Jesus dito estas coisas, saiu com seus discípulos para além do ribeiro de Cedrom, onde havia um jardim, em que ele entrou ele, e seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: COMO Jesús hubo dicho estas cosas, salióse con sus discípulos tras el arroyo de Cedrón, donde estaba un huerto, en el cual entró Jesús y sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.WEB: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.ASV: Now Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus oft-times resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Judas, o que o traía, conhecia aquele lugar; porque muitas vezes se juntara ali Jesus com seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y también Judas, el que le entregaba, sabía aquel lugar; porque muchas veces Jesús se juntaba allí con sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.WEB: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.ASV: Judas then, having received the band [of soldiers], and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo Judas, pois, tomado a tropa e [alguns dos] oficiais dos sacerdotes e dos fariseus, veio ali com lanternas, tochas, e armas.
verses.RVR09: Judas pues tomando una compañía, y ministros de los pontífices y de los Fariseos, vino allí con linternas y antorchas, y con armas.

verses.KJV: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo pois Jesus todas as coisas que viriam sobre ele, adiantou-se, e disse-lhes: A quem buscais?
verses.RVR09: Empero Jesús, sabiendo todas las cosas que habían de venir sobre él, salió delante, y díjoles: ¿A quién buscáis?

verses.KJV: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.WEB: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.ASV: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am [he]. And Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhe: A Jesus Nazareno. Disse-lhes Jesus: Eu sou. E Judas, o que o traía, também estava com eles.
verses.RVR09: Respondiéronle: A Jesús Nazareno. Díceles Jesús: Yo soy. (Y estaba también con ellos Judas, el que le entregaba.)

verses.KJV: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.WEB: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
verses.ASV: When therefore he said unto them, I am [he], they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando pois lhes disse: Eu sou, voltaram para trás, e caíram em terra.
verses.RVR09: Y como les dijo, Yo soy, volvieron atrás, y cayeron en tierra.

verses.KJV: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.WEB: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.ASV: Again therefore he asked them, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou pois a lhes perguntar: A quem buscais? E eles disseram: A Jesus Nazareno.
verses.RVR09: Volvióles, pues, á preguntar: ¿A quién buscáis? Y ellos dijeron: A Jesús Nazareno.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, I told you that I am [he]; if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Já vos disse que eu sou. Portanto se buscais a mim, deixai a estes irem.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Os he dicho que yo soy: pues si á mí buscáis, dejad ir á éstos.

verses.KJV: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.WEB: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
verses.ASV: that the word might be fulfilled which he spake, Of those whom thou hast given me I lost not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que se cumprisse a palavra, que tinha dito: Dos que me deste, a nenhum deles perdi.
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese la palabra que había dicho: De los que me diste, ninguno de ellos perdí.

verses.KJV: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.ASV: Simon Peter therefore having a sword drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. Now the servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão Pedro, pois, que tinha espada, puxou dela, e feriu ao servo do sacerdote, e cortou a sua orelha direita. E era o nome do servo Malco.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Simón Pedro, que tenía espada, sacóla, é hirió al siervo del pontífice, y le cortó la oreja derecha. Y el siervo se llamaba Malco.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said unto Peter, Put up the sword into the sheath: the cup which the Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois Jesus a Pedro: Põe tua espada na bainha; não beberei eu o copo que o Pai tem me dado?
verses.RVR09: Jesús entonces dijo á Pedro: Mete tu espada en la vaina: el vaso que el Padre me ha dado, ¿no lo tengo de beber?

verses.KJV: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.WEB: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
verses.ASV: So the band and the chief captain, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,
verses.ALMEIDA: O grupo de soldados pois, e o comandante, e os oficiais dos judeus juntamente tomaram a Jesus, e o amarraram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la compañía y el tribuno, y los ministros de los Judíos, prendieron á Jesús y le ataron,

verses.KJV: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.WEB: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.ASV: and led him to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o levaram primeiramente a Anás, porque era sogro de Caifás, o qual era o sumo sacerdote daquele ano.
verses.RVR09: Y lleváronle primeramente á Anás; porque era suegro de Caifás, el cual era pontífice de aquel año.

verses.KJV: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.WEB: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
verses.ASV: Now Caiaphas was he that gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Caifás o que havia aconselhado aos judeus de que convinha que um homem morresse pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Y era Caifás el que había dado el consejo á los Judíos, que era necesario que un hombre muriese por el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
verses.ASV: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and [so did] another disciple. Now that disciple was known unto the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simão Pedro seguia a Jesus com outro discípulo. E este discípulo era conhecido do sacerdote, e entrou com Jesus no pátio do sumo sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y seguía á Jesús Simón Pedro, y otro discípulo. Y aquel discípulo era conocido del pontífice, y entró con Jesús al atrio del pontífice;

verses.KJV: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.WEB: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.ASV: but Peter was standing at the door without. So the other disciple, who was known unto the high priest, went out and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro estava fora à porta. Saiu pois o outro discípulo, que era conhecido do sacerdote, e falou à porteira, e pôs dentro a Pedro.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pedro estaba fuera á la puerta. Y salió aquel discípulo que era conocido del pontífice, y habló á la portera, y metió dentro á Pedro.

verses.KJV: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.WEB: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
verses.ASV: The maid therefore that kept the door saith unto Peter, Art thou also [one] of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois a serva porteira a Pedro: Não és tu também dos discípulos deste homem? Disse ele: Não sou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la criada portera dijo á Pedro: ¿No eres tú también de los discípulos de este hombre? Dice él: No soy.

verses.KJV: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.WEB: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.ASV: Now the servants and the officers were standing [there], having made a fire of coals; for it was cold; and they were warming themselves: and Peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam [ali] os servos, e os oficiais, que haviam feito [uma fogueira de] brasas, porque fazia frio, e se esquentavam. Estava Pedro com eles, e se esquentava.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban en pie los siervos y los ministros que habían allegado las ascuas; porque hacía frío, y calentábanse: y estaba también con ellos Pedro en pie, calentándose.

verses.KJV: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.WEB: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
verses.ASV: The high priest therefore asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntou pois o sacerdote a Jesus sobre seus discípulos, e sobre sua doutrina.
verses.RVR09: Y el pontífice preguntó á Jesús acerca de sus discípulos y de su doctrina.

verses.KJV: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
verses.ASV: Jesus answered him, I have spoken openly to the world; I ever taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where all the Jews come together; and in secret spake I nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus lhe respondeu: Eu abertamente falei ao mundo; eu sempre ensinei na sinagoga e no Templo, onde os Judeus de todos os lugares se juntam, e nada falei em oculto.
verses.RVR09: Jesús le respondió: Yo manifiestamente he hablado al mundo: yo siempre he enseñado en la sinagoga y en el templo, donde se juntan todos los Judíos, y nada he hablado en oculto.

verses.KJV: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.WEB: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
verses.ASV: Why askest thou me? ask them that have heard [me], what I spake unto them: behold, these know the things which I said.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que perguntas a mim? Pergunta aos que o ouviram, que é o que lhes falei. Eis que estes sabem que é o que tenho dito.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué me preguntas á mí? Pregunta á los que han oído, qué les haya yo hablado: he aquí, ésos saben lo que yo he dicho.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.WEB: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
verses.ASV: And when he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo ele isto, um dos oficiais, que ali estava, deu a Jesus uma bofetada, dizendo: Assim respondes ao sumo sacerdote?
verses.RVR09: Y como él hubo dicho esto, uno de los criados que estaba allí, dió una bofetada á Jesús, diciendo: ¿Así respondes al pontífice?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se falei mal, dá testemunho do mal; e se bem, por que me feres?
verses.RVR09: Respondióle Jesús: Si he hablado mal, da testimonio del mal: y si bien, ¿por qué me hieres?

verses.KJV: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.WEB: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
verses.ASV: Annas therefore sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois Anás o mandara amarrado ao sumo sacerdote Caifás.)
verses.RVR09: Y Anás le había enviado atado á Caifás pontífice.

verses.KJV: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.WEB: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
verses.ASV: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore unto him, Art thou also [one] of his disciples? He denied, and said, I am not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simão Pedro estava ali, e se esquentava; disseram-lhe pois: Não és tu também de seus discípulos? Ele negou, e disse: Não sou.
verses.RVR09: Estaba pues Pedro en pie calentándose. Y dijéronle: ¿No eres tú de sus discípulos? El negó, y dijo: No soy.

verses.KJV: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.WEB: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
verses.ASV: One of the servants of the high priest, being a kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse um dos servos do sacerdote, parente daquele a quem Pedro cortara a orelha: Eu não te vi no jardim com ele?
verses.RVR09: Uno de los siervos del pontífice, pariente de aquél á quien Pedro había cortado la oreja, le dice: ¿No te vi yo en el huerto con él?

verses.KJV: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.WEB: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.ASV: Peter therefore denied again: and straightway the cock crew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro negou pois outra vez, e logo cantou o galo.
verses.RVR09: Y negó Pedro otra vez: y luego el gallo cantó.

verses.KJV: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.WEB: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.ASV: They lead Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Prætorium: and it was early; and they themselves entered not into the Prætorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levaram pois a Jesus de Caifás para o tribunal. E era pela manhã; e não entraram no tribunal, para que não se contaminassem, mas que pudessem comer a Páscoa.
verses.RVR09: Y llevaron á Jesús de Caifás al pretorio: y era por la mañana: y ellos no entraron en el pretorio por no ser contaminados, sino que comiesen la pascua.

verses.KJV: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.WEB: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
verses.ASV: Pilate therefore went out unto them, and saith, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiu pois Pilatos até eles fora, e disse: Que acusação trazeis contra este homem?
verses.RVR09: Entonces salió Pilato á ellos fuera, y dijo: ¿Qué acusación traéis contra este hombre?

verses.KJV: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.WEB: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
verses.ASV: They answered and said unto him, If this man were not an evil-doer, we should not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Se este não fosse malfeitor, não o entregaríamos a ti.
verses.RVR09: Respondieron y dijéronle: Si éste no fuera malhechor, no te le habríamos entregado.

verses.KJV: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.WEB: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
verses.ASV: Pilate therefore said unto them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. The Jews said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e julgai-o segundo vossa lei. Disseram-lhe pois os Judeus: Não nos é lícito matar a alguém.
verses.RVR09: Díceles entonces Pilato: Tomadle vosotros, y juzgadle según vuestra ley. Y los Judíos le dijeron: A nosotros no es lícito matar á nadie:

verses.KJV: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.WEB: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.ASV: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que se cumprisse a palavra de Jesus, que tinha dito, dando a entender de que morte havia de morrer.
verses.RVR09: Para que se cumpliese el dicho de Jesús, que había dicho, dando á entender de qué muerte había de morir.

verses.KJV: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.WEB: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
verses.ASV: Pilate therefore entered again into the Prætorium, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pilatos voltou a entrar no tribunal, e chamou a Jesus, e disse-lhe: És tu o Rei dos Judeus?
verses.RVR09: Así que, Pilato volvió á entrar en el pretorio, y llamó á Jesús, y díjole: ¿Eres tú el Rey de los Judíos?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, Sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu dizes isso de ti mesmo, ou outros te disseram de mim?
verses.RVR09: Respondióle Jesús: ¿Dices tú esto de ti mismo, ó te lo han dicho otros de mí?

verses.KJV: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.WEB: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
verses.ASV: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pilatos respondeu: Por acaso eu sou Judeu? Tua gente e os chefes dos sacerdotes te entregaram a mim; que fizeste?
verses.RVR09: Pilato respondió: ¿Soy yo Judío? Tu gente, y los pontífices, te han entregado á mí: ¿qué has hecho?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Meu Reino não é deste mundo; se meu Reino fosse deste mundo, meus trabalhadores lutariam, para que eu não fosse entregue aos Judeus; mas agora meu Reino não é daqui.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Mi reino no es de este mundo: si de este mundo fuera mi reino, mis servidores pelearían para que yo no fuera entregado á los Judíos: ahora, pues, mi reino no es de aquí.

verses.KJV: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.WEB: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
verses.ASV: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end have I been born, and to this end am I come into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe pois Pilatos: Logo tu és Rei? Respondeu Jesus: Tu dizes que eu sou Rei. Para isto eu nasci, e para isto vim ao mundo: para dar testemunho à verdade. Todo aquele que é da verdade ouve minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Díjole entonces Pilato: ¿Luego rey eres tú? Respondió Jesús: Tú dices que yo soy rey. Yo para esto he nacido, y para esto he venido al mundo, para dar testimonio á la verdad. Todo aquél que es de la verdad, oye mi voz.

verses.KJV: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.WEB: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
verses.ASV: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find no crime in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Pilatos: O que é a verdade? E havendo dito isto, voltou a sair aos Judeus, e disse-lhes: Nenhum crime acho nele.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Pilato: ¿Qué cosa es verdad? Y como hubo dicho esto, salió otra vez á los Judíos, y díceles: Yo no hallo en él ningún crimen.

verses.KJV: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.WEB: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.ASV: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós tendes por costume que eu vos solte um pela páscoa. Quereis pois que vos solte ao Rei dos Judeus?
verses.RVR09: Empero vosotros tenéis costumbre, que os suelte uno en la Pascua: ¿queréis, pues, que os suelte al Rey de los Judíos?

verses.KJV: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.WEB: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.ASV: They cried out therefore again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltaram pois todos a clamar, dizendo: Não a este, mas a Barrabás!E Barrabás era um ladrão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos dieron voces otra vez, diciendo: No á éste, sino á Barrabás. Y Barrabás era ladrón.

verses.KJV: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
verses.WEB: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
verses.ASV: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pilatos tomou a Jesus, e [o] açoitou.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, entonces tomó Pilato á Jesús, y le azotó.

verses.KJV: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.WEB: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
verses.ASV: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and arrayed him in a purple garment;
verses.ALMEIDA: E trançando os soldados uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-na sobre sua cabeça, e o vestiram de uma roupa vermelha.
verses.RVR09: Y los soldados entretejieron de espinas una corona, y pusiéronla sobre su cabeza, y le vistieron de una ropa de grana;

verses.KJV: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.WEB: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
verses.ASV: and they came unto him, and said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they struck him with their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam: Tenhas alegria, Rei dos Judeus! E davam-lhe bofetadas.
verses.RVR09: Y decían: ¡Salve, Rey de los Judíos! y dábanle de bofetadas.

verses.KJV: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.WEB: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.ASV: And Pilate went out again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find no crime in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiu pois Pilatos outra vez fora, e disse-lhes: Eis que eu o trago para fora [até] vós, para que saibais que nenhum crime acho nele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pilato salió otra vez fuera, y díjoles: He aquí, os le traigo fuera, para que entendáis que ningún crimen hallo en él.

verses.KJV: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. And [Pilate] saith unto them, Behold, the man!
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus foi pois trazido para fora, levando a coroa de espinhos, e a roupa vermelha-roxa. E [Pilatos] disse-lhes: Eis aqui o homem.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Jesús fuera, llevando la corona de espinas y la ropa de grana. Y díceles Pilato: He aquí el hombre.

verses.KJV: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
verses.WEB: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.ASV: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify [him], crucify [him]! Pilate saith unto them, Take him yourselves, and crucify him: for I find no crime in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando então os chefes dos sacerdotes e os trabalhadores o viram, eles clamaram, dizendo: Crucifica [-o] ! Crucifica [-o] ! Disse-lhes Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e crucificai [-o] ; porque eu nenhum crime acho nele.
verses.RVR09: Y como le vieron los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los servidores, dieron voces diciendo: Crucifícale, crucifícale. Díceles Pilato: Tomadle vosotros, y crucificadle; porque yo no hallo en él crimen.

verses.KJV: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.WEB: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
verses.ASV: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responderam-lhe os Judeus: Nós temos Lei, e segundo nossa Lei ele deve morrer, porque se fez Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Respondiéronle los Judíos: Nosotros tenemos ley, y según nuestra ley debe morir, porque se hizo Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.WEB: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
verses.ASV: When Pilate therefore heard this saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando pois Pilatos ouviu esta palavra, ficou mais atemorizado.
verses.RVR09: Y como Pilato oyó esta palabra, tuvo más miedo.

verses.KJV: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.WEB: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.ASV: and he entered into the Prætorium again, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou outra vez no tribunal, e disse a Jesus: De onde és tu? Mas Jesus não lhe deu resposta.
verses.RVR09: Y entró otra vez en el pretorio, y dijo á Jesús: ¿De dónde eres tú? Mas Jesús no le dió respuesta.

verses.KJV: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.WEB: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
verses.ASV: Pilate therefore saith unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to release thee, and have power to crucify thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe pois Pilatos: Não falas comigo? Não sabes que tenho poder para te crucificar, e tenho poder para te soltar?
verses.RVR09: Entonces dícele Pilato: ¿A mí no me hablas? ¿no sabes que tengo potestad para crucificarte, y que tengo potestad para soltarte?

verses.KJV: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.WEB: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
verses.ASV: Jesus answered him, Thou wouldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath greater sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Jesus: Nenhum poder terias contra mim, se não te fosse dado de cima; portanto o que me entregou a ti tem maior pecado.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jesús: Ninguna potestad tendrías contra mí, si no te fuese dado de arriba: por tanto, el que á ti me ha entregado, mayor pecado tiene.

verses.KJV: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.WEB: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
verses.ASV: Upon this Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou release this man, thou art not Cæsar’s friend: every one that maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde então Pilatos procurava soltá-lo; mas os Judeus clamavam, dizendo: Se soltas a este, não és amigo de César; qualquer que se faz Rei, contradiz a César.
verses.RVR09: Desde entonces procuraba Pilato soltarle; mas los Judíos daban voces, diciendo: Si á éste sueltas, no eres amigo de César: cualquiera que se hace rey, á César contradice.

verses.KJV: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.WEB: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
verses.ASV: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment-seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pilatos, ouvindo este dito, levou fora a Jesus, e sentou-se no tribunal, no lugar chamado Litóstrotos, [ou pavimento] ,e em hebraico Gabatá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pilato, oyendo este dicho, llevó fuera á Jesús, y se sentó en el tribunal en el lugar que se dice Lithóstrotos, y en hebreo Gabbatha.

verses.KJV: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.WEB: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
verses.ASV: Now it was the Preparation of the passover: it was about the sixth hour. And he saith unto the Jews, Behold, your King!
verses.ALMEIDA: E era a preparação da páscoa, e quase à hora sexta, e disse aos Judeus: Eis aqui vosso Rei!
verses.RVR09: Y era la víspera de la Pascua, y como la hora de sexta. Entonces dijo á los Judíos: He aquí vuestro Rey.

verses.KJV: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.WEB: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
verses.ASV: They therefore cried out, Away with [him], away with [him], crucify him! Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles bradaram: Tira, tira, crucifica-o! Disse-lhes Pilatos: Crucificarei a vosso Rei?Responderam os chefes dos sacerdotes: Não temos [outro] rei, a não ser César.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos dieron voces: Quita, quita, crucifícale. Díceles Pilato: ¿A vuestro Rey he de crucificar? Respondieron los pontífices: No tenemos rey sino á César.

verses.KJV: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
verses.WEB: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
verses.ASV: Then therefore he delivered him unto them to be crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o entregou a eles, para que fosse crucificado. E tomaram a Jesus, e levaram [-no] .
verses.RVR09: Así que entonces lo entregó á ellos para que fuese crucificado. Y tomaron á Jesús, y le llevaron.

verses.KJV: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
