verses.WEB: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
verses.ASV: They took Jesus therefore: and he went out, bearing the cross for himself, unto the place called The place of a skull, which is called in Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.ALMEIDA: E levando ele sua cruz, saiu para o [lugar] chamado a Caveira, que em hebraico se chama Gólgota.
verses.RVR09: Y llevando su cruz, salió al lugar que se dice de la Calavera, y en hebreo, Gólgotha;

verses.KJV: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.WEB: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
verses.ASV: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde o crucificaram, e com ele outros dois, um de cada lado, e a Jesus no meio.
verses.RVR09: Donde le crucificaron, y con él otros dos, uno á cada lado, y Jesús en medio.

verses.KJV: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was Jesus Of Nazareth The King Of The Jews.
verses.WEB: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.ASV: And Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. And there was written, JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pilatos também escreveu um título, e o pôs encima da cruz, e estava [nele] escrito: JESUS NAZARENO, REI DOS JUDEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y escribió también Pilato un título, que puso encima de la cruz. Y el escrito era: JESUS NAZARENO, REY DE LOS JUDIOS.

verses.KJV: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
verses.WEB: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.ASV: This title therefore read many of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city; and it was written in Hebrew, [and] in Latin, [and] in Greek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Leram pois muitos dos Judeus este título; porque o lugar onde Jesus estava crucificado era perto da cidade; e estava escrito em hebraico, em grego, [e] em latim.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de los Judíos leyeron este título: porque el lugar donde estaba crucificado Jesús era cerca de la ciudad: y estaba escrito en hebreo, en griego, y en latín.

verses.KJV: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.WEB: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
verses.ASV: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but, that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diziam pois os chefes dos sacerdotes dos judeus a Pilatos: Não escrevas: Rei dos Judeus, mas que disse: Sou Rei dos Judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y decían á Pilato los pontífices de los Judíos: No escribas, Rey de los Judíos: sino, que él dijo: Rey soy de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.WEB: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
verses.ASV: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu Pilatos: O que escrevi, escrevi.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Pilato: Lo que he escrito, he escrito.

verses.KJV: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.WEB: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.ASV: The soldiers therefore, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo pois os soldados crucificado a Jesus, tomaram suas roupas, e fizeram quatro partes, para cada soldado uma parte, e a túnica. E era a túnica sem costura, toda tecida desde cima [até baixo] .
verses.RVR09: Y como los soldados hubieron crucificado á Jesús, tomaron sus vestidos, é hicieron cuatro partes (para cada soldado una parte); y la túnica; mas la túnica era sin costura, toda tejida desde arriba.

verses.KJV: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.WEB: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.ASV: They said therefore one to another, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my garments among them, And upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram pois uns aos outros: Não a partamos, mas lancemos sortes sobre ela, de quem será; para que se cumprisse a Escritura, que diz: Entre si partiram minhas roupas, e sobre minha veste lançaram sortes. Os soldados, pois, fizeram isto.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron entre ellos: No la partamos, sino echemos suertes sobre ella, de quién será; para que se cumpliese la Escritura, que dice: Partieron para sí mis vestidos, y sobre mi vestidura echaron suertes. Y los soldados hicieron esto.

verses.KJV: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.WEB: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.ASV: These things therefore the soldiers did. But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the [wife] of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam junto à cruz de Jesus, sua mãe, e a irmã de sua mãe, Maria [mulher] de Cleofas, e Maria Madalena.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban junto á la cruz de Jesús su madre, y la hermana de su madre, María mujer de Cleofas, y María Magdalena.

verses.KJV: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.WEB: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
verses.ASV: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold, thy son!
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Jesus a [sua] mãe, e ao discípulo a quem amava, que ali estava, disse a sua mãe: Mulher, eis aí teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió Jesús á la madre, y al discípulo que él amaba, que estaba presente, dice á su madre: Mujer, he ahí tu hijo.

verses.KJV: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
verses.WEB: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.ASV: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold, thy mother! And from that hour the disciple took her unto his own [home].
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse ao discípulo: Eis aí tua mãe. E desde aquela hora o discípulo a recebeu em sua [casa] .
verses.RVR09: Después dice al discípulo: He ahí tu madre. Y desde aquella hora el discípulo la recibió consigo.

verses.KJV: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.WEB: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
verses.ASV: After this Jesus, knowing that all things are now finished, that the scripture might be accomplished, saith, I thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto, sabendo Jesus que já todas as coisas estavam feitas, para que a Escritura se cumprisse, ele disse: Tenho sede.
verses.RVR09: Después de esto, sabiendo Jesús que todas las cosas eran ya cumplidas, para que la Escritura se cumpliese, dijo: Sed tengo.

verses.KJV: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
verses.WEB: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
verses.ASV: There was set there a vessel full of vinegar: so they put a sponge full of the vinegar upon hyssop, and brought it to his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estava pois ali um vaso cheio de vinagre, e encheram uma esponja de vinagre, e envolvendo-a com hissopo, levaram-na a sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba allí un vaso lleno de vinagre: entonces ellos hinchieron una esponja de vinagre, y rodeada á un hisopo, se la llegaron á la boca.

verses.KJV: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.WEB: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.ASV: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando pois Jesus tomou o vinagre, disse: Está consumado; e abaixando a cabeça, deu o Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Y como Jesús tomó el vinagre, dijo: Consumado es. Y habiendo inclinado la cabeza, dió el espíritu.

verses.KJV: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
verses.ASV: The Jews therefore, because it was the Preparation, that the bodies should not remain on the cross upon the sabbath (for the day of that sabbath was a high [day]), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and [that] they might be taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os Judeus pois, para que os corpos não ficassem no sábado na cruz, pois era a preparação (porque era o grande dia do Sábado), suplicaram a Pilatos que as pernas deles fossem quebradas, e fossem tirados.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos, por cuanto era la víspera de la Pascua, para que los cuerpos no quedasen en la cruz en el sábado, pues era el gran día del sábado, rogaron á Pilato que se les quebrasen las piernas, y fuesen quitados.

verses.KJV: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.WEB: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
verses.ASV: The soldiers therefore came, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other that was crucified with him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram pois os soldados, e na verdade quebraram as pernas do primeiro, e do outro, que fora crucificado com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los soldados, y quebraron las piernas al primero, y asimismo al otro que había sido crucificado con él.

verses.KJV: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.WEB: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
verses.ASV: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vindo a Jesus, [e] vendo-o já morto, não quebraram as suas pernas.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando vinieron á Jesús, como le vieron ya muerto, no le quebraron las piernas:

verses.KJV: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.WEB: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.ASV: howbeit one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and straightway there came out blood and water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas um dos soldados lhe furou com uma lança o lado, e logo saiu sangue e água.
verses.RVR09: Empero uno de los soldados le abrió el costado con una lanza, y luego salió sangre y agua.

verses.KJV: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.WEB: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
verses.ASV: And he that hath seen hath borne witness, and his witness is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye also may believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que viu isto, o testemunhou; e seu testemunho é verdadeiro, e sabe que é verdade o que diz, para que vós também creiais.
verses.RVR09: Y el que lo vió, da testimonio, y su testimonio es verdadero: y él sabe que dice verdad, para que vosotros también creáis.

verses.KJV: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.WEB: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
verses.ASV: For these things came to pass, that the scripture might be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estas coisas aconteceram para que se cumprisse a Escritura [que diz] : Osso dele não será quebrado.
verses.RVR09: Porque estas cosas fueron hechas para que se cumpliese la Escritura: Hueso no quebrantaréis de él.

verses.KJV: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.WEB: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
verses.ASV: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.ALMEIDA: E além disso, outra Escritura diz: Verão [aquele] a quem perfuraram.
verses.RVR09: Y también otra Escritura dice: Mirarán al que traspasaron.

verses.KJV: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.WEB: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
verses.ASV: And after these things Joseph of Arimathæa, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave [him] leave. He came therefore, and took away his body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois José de Arimateia, (que era discípulo de Jesus, porém oculto por medo dos Judeus) suplicou a Pilatos que pudesse tirar o corpo de Jesus; e Pilatos permitiu. Veio pois e tirou o corpo de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Después de estas cosas, José de Arimatea, el cual era discípulo de Jesús, mas secreto por miedo de los Judíos, rogó á Pilato que pudiera quitar el cuerpo de Jesús: y permitióselo Pilato. Entonces vino, y quitó el cuerpo de Jesús.

verses.KJV: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
verses.WEB: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
verses.ASV: And there came also Nicodemus, he who at the first came to him by night, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio também Nicodemos, (aquele que antes de noite tinha vindo a Jesus) trazendo um composto de mirra e aloés, de quase cem arráteis.
verses.RVR09: Y vino también Nicodemo, el que antes había venido á Jesús de noche, trayendo un compuesto de mirra y de áloes, como cien libras.

verses.KJV: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.WEB: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.ASV: So they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomaram pois o corpo de Jesus, e o envolveram em lençóis com as especiarias, como é costume dos judeus sepultarem.
verses.RVR09: Tomaron pues el cuerpo de Jesús, y envolviéronlo en lienzos con especias, como es costumbre de los Judíos sepultar.

verses.KJV: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.WEB: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
verses.ASV: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new tomb wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um jardim naquele lugar onde fora crucificado; e no jardim [havia] um sepulcro novo, em que ainda nunca alguém havia sido posto.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquel lugar donde había sido crucificado, había un huerto; y en el huerto un sepulcro nuevo, en el cual aun no había sido puesto ninguno.

verses.KJV: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.WEB: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
verses.ASV: There then because of the Jews’ Preparation (for the tomb was nigh at hand) they laid Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali pois (por causa da preparação [da páscoa] dos Judeus, e porque aquele sepulcro estava perto) puseram a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Allí, pues, por causa de la víspera de la Pascua de los Judíos, porque aquel sepulcro estaba cerca, pusieron á Jesús.

verses.KJV: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.WEB: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.ASV: Now on the first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, while it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and seeth the stone taken away from the tomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no primeiro [dia] da semana Maria Madalena veio de madrugada, sendo ainda escuro, ao sepulcro; e viu a pedra já tirada do sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y EL primer día de la semana, María Magdalena vino de mañana, siendo aún obscuro, al sepulcro; y vió la piedra quitada del sepulcro.

verses.KJV: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.WEB: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
verses.ASV: She runneth therefore, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Correu pois, e veio a Simão Pedro, e ao outro discípulo a quem Jesus amava, e disse-lhes: Tomaram o Senhor do sepulcro, e não sabemos onde o puseram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces corrió, y vino á Simón Pedro, y al otro discípulo, al cual amaba Jesús, y les dice: Han llevado al Señor del sepulcro, y no sabemos dónde le han puesto.

verses.KJV: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.WEB: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.ASV: Peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro saiu pois e o outro discípulo [também] ,e vieram ao sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Pedro, y el otro discípulo, y vinieron al sepulcro.

verses.KJV: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.WEB: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
verses.ASV: And they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the tomb;
verses.ALMEIDA: E corriam estes dois juntos: e o outro discípulo correu adiante mais depressa que Pedro, e chegou primeiro ao sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Y corrían los dos juntos; mas el otro discípulo corrió más presto que Pedro, y llegó primero al sepulcro.

verses.KJV: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.WEB: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
verses.ASV: and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths lying; yet entered he not in.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abaixando-se, viu estar os lençóis; entretanto não entrou.
verses.RVR09: Y bajándose á mirar, vió los lienzos echados; mas no entró.

verses.KJV: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.WEB: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
verses.ASV: Simon Peter therefore also cometh, following him, and entered into the tomb; and he beholdeth the linen cloths lying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegou pois Simão Pedro seguindo-o, e entrou no sepulcro, e viu estar os lençóis [ali] .
verses.RVR09: Llegó luego Simón Pedro siguiéndole, y entró en el sepulcro, y vió los lienzos echados,

verses.KJV: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.WEB: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.ASV: and the napkin, that was upon his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o lenço que fora [posto] sobre sua cabeça, não [o viu] estar com os lençóis, mas [estava] dobrado em um lugar à parte.
verses.RVR09: Y el sudario, que había estado sobre su cabeza, no puesto con los lienzos, sino envuelto en un lugar aparte.

verses.KJV: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.WEB: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
verses.ASV: Then entered in therefore the other disciple also, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então pois entrou também o outro discípulo, que primeiro chegara ao sepulcro, e viu, e creu.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces entró también el otro discípulo, que había venido primero al sepulcro, y vió, y creyó.

verses.KJV: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.WEB: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.ASV: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ainda não sabiam a Escritura, que era necessário que ressuscitasse dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun no sabían la Escritura, que era necesario que él resucitase de los muertos.

verses.KJV: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.WEB: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
verses.ASV: So the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltaram pois os Discípulos para [a casa] deles.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron los discípulos á los suyos.

verses.KJV: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
verses.WEB: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
verses.ASV: But Mary was standing without at the tomb weeping: so, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Maria estava fora chorando junto ao sepulcro. Estando ela pois chorando, abaixou-se para [ver] o sepulcro.
verses.RVR09: Empero María estaba fuera llorando junto al sepulcro: y estando llorando, bajóse á mirar el sepulcro;

verses.KJV: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.WEB: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.ASV: and she beholdeth two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu a dois anjos [vestidos] de branco, sentados um à cabeceira, e o outro aos pés, onde estava posto o corpo de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y vió dos ángeles en ropas blancas que estaban sentados, el uno á la cabecera, y el otro á los pies, donde el cuerpo de Jesús había sido puesto.

verses.KJV: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.WEB: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
verses.ASV: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram-lhe eles: Mulher, por que choras? Disse-lhes ela: Porque levaram a meu Senhor, e não sei onde o puseram.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: Mujer, ¿por qué lloras? Díceles: Porque se han llevado á mi Señor, y no sé dónde le han puesto.

verses.KJV: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.WEB: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.ASV: When she had thus said, she turned herself back, and beholdeth Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo dito isto, virou-se para trás, e viu Jesus em pé, e não sabia que era Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo dicho esto, volvióse atrás, y vió á Jesús que estaba allí; mas no sabía que era Jesús.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, por que choras? A quem buscas? Ela, pensando que era o jardineiro, disse-lhe: Senhor, se tu o levaste, dize-me onde o puseste, e eu o levarei.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Mujer, ¿por qué lloras? ¿á quién buscas? Ella, pensando que era el hortelano, dícele: Señor, si tú lo has llevado, dime dónde lo has puesto, y yo lo llevaré.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turneth herself, and saith unto him in Hebrew, Rabboni; which is to say, Teacher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Maria! Ela, virando-se, disse-lhe: Rabôni! (que quer dizer Mestre).
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: ¡María! Volviéndose ella, dícele: ¡Rabboni! que quiere decir, Maestro.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith to her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended unto the Father: but go unto my brethren, and say to them, I ascend unto my Father and your Father, and my God and your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Não me toques; porque ainda não subi para o meu Pai; porém vai a meus irmãos, e dize- lhes: Subo para meu Pai, e para vosso Pai; [para] meu Deus, e [para] vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: No me toques: porque aun no he subido á mi Padre: mas ve á mis hermanos, y diles: Subo á mi Padre y á vuestro Padre, á mi Dios y á vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.WEB: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
verses.ASV: Mary Magdalene cometh and telleth the disciples, I have seen the Lord; and [that] he had said these things unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio Maria Madalena, e anunciou aos discípulos, que vira ao Senhor, e [que] estas coisas lhe dissera.
verses.RVR09: Fué María Magdalena dando las nuevas á los discípulos de que había visto al Señor, y que él le había dicho estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.WEB: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.ASV: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first [day] of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinda pois já a tarde, o primeiro dia da semana, e fechadas as portas onde os Discípulos, por medo dos judeus, tinham se reunido, veio Jesus, e pôs-se no meio [deles] ,e disse-lhes: Tenhais paz!
verses.RVR09: Y como fué tarde aquel día, el primero de la semana, y estando las puertas cerradas donde los discípulos estaban juntos por miedo de los Judíos, vino Jesús, y púsose en medio, y díjoles: Paz á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.WEB: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.ASV: And when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo isto, mostrou-lhes suas mãos, e [seu] lado. Então os discípulos se alegraram, vendo ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo dicho esto, mostróles las manos y el costado. Y los discípulos se gozaron viendo al Señor.

verses.KJV: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace [be] unto you: as the Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes pois Jesus outra vez: Tenhais Paz! Como o Pai me enviou, assim eu vos envio.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dijo Jesús otra vez: Paz á vosotros; como me envió el Padre, así también yo os envío.

verses.KJV: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.WEB: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
verses.ASV: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo dito isto, soprou [sobre eles] ,e disse-lhes: Recebei o Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo dicho esto, sopló, y díjoles: Tomad el Espíritu Santo:

verses.KJV: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
verses.WEB: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
verses.ASV: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem quer que perdoardes os pecados, lhes são perdoados; [e] a quem quer que vós retiverdes [os pecados] ,[lhes] são retidos.
verses.RVR09: A los que remitiereis los pecados, les son remitidos: á quienes los retuviereis, serán retenidos.

verses.KJV: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.WEB: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
verses.ASV: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Tomé, um dos doze, chamado o Dídimo, não estava com eles, quando Jesus veio.
verses.RVR09: Empero Tomás, uno de los doce, que se dice el Dídimo, no estaba con ellos cuando Jesús vino.

verses.KJV: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.WEB: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
verses.ASV: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe pois os outros discípulos: Vimos ao Senhor. Porém ele lhes disse: Se em suas mãos não vir o sinal dos cravos, e não pôr meu dedo no lugar dos cravos, e não pôr minha mão em seu lado, em maneira nenhuma crerei.
verses.RVR09: Dijéronle pues los otros discípulos: Al Señor hemos visto. Y él les dijo: Si no viere en sus manos la señal de los clavos, y metiere mi dedo en el lugar de los clavos, y metiere mi mano en su costado, no creeré.

verses.KJV: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
verses.WEB: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
verses.ASV: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them. Jesus cometh, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace [be] unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oito dias depois, estavam os discípulos outra vez dentro, [e] com eles Tomé; e veio Jesus, fechadas já as portas, e pôs-se no meio, e disse: Tenhais paz!
verses.RVR09: Y ocho días después, estaban otra vez sus discípulos dentro, y con ellos Tomás. Vino Jesús, las puertas cerradas, y púsose en medio, y dijo: Paz á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.WEB: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
verses.ASV: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and see my hands; and reach [hither] thy hand, and put it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse a Tomé: Põe teu dedo aqui, e vê minhas mãos; e chega tua mão, e toca-a em meu lado; e não sejas incrédulo, mas sim crente.
verses.RVR09: Luego dice á Tomás: Mete tu dedo aquí, y ve mis manos: y alarga acá tu mano, y métela en mi costado: y no seas incrédulo, sino fiel.

verses.KJV: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.WEB: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
verses.ASV: Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Tomé e disse-lhe: Senhor meu, e Deus meu!
verses.RVR09: Entonces Tomás respondió, y díjole: ¡Señor mío, y Dios mío!

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed [are] they that have not seen, and [yet] have believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Porque me viste, Tomé, creste; bem-aventurados aqueles que não virem, e crerem.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Porque me has visto, Tomás, creiste: bienaventurados los que no vieron y creyeron.

verses.KJV: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.WEB: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.ASV: Many other signs therefore did Jesus in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus fez também ainda muitos outros sinais ainda em presença de seus discípulos, que neste livro não estão escritos;
verses.RVR09: Y también hizo Jesús muchas otras señales en presencia de sus discípulos, que no están escritas en este libro.

verses.KJV: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.WEB: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
verses.ASV: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém estes estão escritos, para que creiais que Jesus é o Cristo, o Filho de Deus; e para que crendo, tenhais vida em seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Estas empero son escritas, para que creáis que Jesús es el Cristo, el Hijo de Dios; y para que creyendo, tengáis vida en su nombre.

verses.KJV: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.WEB: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
verses.ASV: After these things Jesus manifested himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and he manifested [himself] on this wise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto Jesus se manifestou outra vez aos discípulos, junto ao mar de Tibérias; e manifestou [-se] assim:
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS se manifestó Jesús otra vez á sus discípulos en la mar de Tiberias; y manifestóse de esta manera.

verses.KJV: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.ASV: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the [sons] of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estavam juntos Simão Pedro, e Tomé (chamado o Dídimo), e Natanael (o de Caná de Galileia), e os [filhos] de Zebedeu, e outros dois de seus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Estaban juntos Simón Pedro, y Tomás, llamado el Dídimo, y Natanael, el que era de Caná de Galilea, y los hijos de Zebedeo, y otros dos de sus discípulos.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
verses.ASV: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also come with thee. They went forth, and entered into the boat; and that night they took nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Simão Pedro: Vou pescar. Dizem-lhe eles: Também nós vamos contigo. Foram, e subiram logo no barco; e aquela noite nada pescaram.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Simón: A pescar voy. Dícenle: Vamos nosotros también contigo. Fueron, y subieron en una barca; y aquella noche no cogieron nada.

verses.KJV: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.WEB: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.ASV: But when day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach: yet the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fazendo-se já manhã, Jesus se pôs na praia; porém os discípulos não sabiam que era Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y venida la mañana, Jesús se puso á la ribera: mas los discípulos no entendieron que era Jesús.

verses.KJV: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.WEB: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.ASV: Jesus therefore saith unto them, Children, have ye aught to eat? They answered him, No.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus lhes disse: Filhinhos, tendes [algo] para comer? Responderam-lhe: Não.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Mozos, ¿tenéis algo de comer? Respondiéronle: No.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Lançai a rede do lado direito do barco, e achareis. Lançaram-na pois, e já não a podiam tirar pela multidão dos peixes.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dice: Echad la red á la mano derecha del barco, y hallaréis. Entonces la echaron, y no la podían en ninguna manera sacar, por la multitud de los peces.

verses.KJV: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.WEB: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.ASV: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his coat about him (for he was naked), and cast himself into the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse pois aquele discípulo, a quem Jesus amava, a Pedro: É o Senhor! Ouvindo pois Simão Pedro que era o Senhor, vestiu-se com a roupa, (porque estava nu), e lançou-se ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces aquel discípulo, al cual amaba Jesús, dijo á Pedro: El Señor es. Y Simón Pedro, como oyó que era el Señor, ciñóse la ropa, porque estaba desnudo, y echóse á la mar.

verses.KJV: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.WEB: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
verses.ASV: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits off), dragging the net [full] of fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os outros discípulos vieram com o barquinho (porque não estavam longe da terra, mas sim a cerca de duzentos côvados) trazendo a rede de peixes.
verses.RVR09: Y los otros discípulos vinieron con el barco (porque no estaban lejos de tierra sino como doscientos codos), trayendo la red de peces.

verses.KJV: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.WEB: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
verses.ASV: So when they got out upon the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando pois desceram à terra, viram já as brasas postas, e um peixe posto nelas, e mais pão.
verses.RVR09: Y como descendieron á tierra, vieron ascuas puestas, y un pez encima de ellas, y pan.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Jesus: Trazei dos peixes que pescastes agora.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: Traed de los peces que cogisteis ahora.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.WEB: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
verses.ASV: Simon Peter therefore went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, the net was not rent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão Pedro subiu, e puxou a rede para a terra, cheia de cento e cinquenta e três grandes peixes; e sendo tantos, a rede não se rompeu.
verses.RVR09: Subió Simón Pedro, y trajo la red á tierra, llena de grandes peces, ciento cincuenta y tres: y siendo tantos, la red no se rompió.

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, Come [and] break your fast. And none of the disciples durst inquire of him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde, jantai. E nenhum dos discípulos ousava lhe perguntar: Tu quem és? sabendo que era o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Díceles Jesús: Venid, comed. Y ninguno de los discípulos osaba preguntarle: ¿Tú, quién eres? sabiendo que era el Señor.

verses.KJV: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.WEB: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.ASV: Jesus cometh, and taketh the bread, and giveth them, and the fish likewise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jesus veio, e tomou o pão, e deu-o a eles; e da mesma maneira o peixe.
verses.RVR09: Viene pues Jesús, y toma el pan, y les da; y asimismo del pez.

verses.KJV: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.WEB: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
verses.ASV: This is now the third time that Jesus was manifested to the disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta era já a terceira vez que Jesus se manifestou a seus discípulos, depois de haver ressuscitado dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Esta era ya la tercera vez que Jesús se manifestó á sus discípulos, habiendo resucitado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.WEB: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.ASV: So when they had broken their fast, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo eles pois já jantado, disse Jesus a Simão Pedro: Simão [filho] de Jonas, tu me amas mais do que estes [outros] ? Disse-lhes ele: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Alimenta meus cordeiros.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubieron comido, Jesús dijo á Simón Pedro: Simón, hijo de Jonás, ¿me amas más que éstos? Dícele: Sí, Señor: tú sabes que te amo. Dícele: Apacienta mis corderos.

verses.KJV: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.WEB: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.ASV: He saith to him again a second time, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Tend my sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou a lhe a dizer a segunda vez: Simão, [filho] de Jonas, tu me amas? Disse-lhe: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Apascenta minhas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Vuélvele á decir la segunda vez: Simón, hijo de Jonás, ¿me amas? Respóndele: Sí, Señor: tú sabes que te amo. Dícele: Apacienta mis ovejas.

verses.KJV: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.WEB: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.ASV: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe a terceira vez: Simão, [filho] de Jonas, tu me amas? Entristeceu-se Pedro de que já pela terceira vez lhe dissesse: Tu me amas? E disse-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes todas as coisas, tu sabes que eu te amo. Disse-lhe Jesus: Alimenta minhas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Dícele la tercera vez: Simón, hijo de Jonás, ¿me amas? Entristecióse Pedro de que le dijese la tercera vez: ¿Me amas? y dícele: Señor, tú sabes todas las cosas; tú sabes que te amo. Dícele Jesús: Apacienta mis ovejas.

verses.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdest thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
verses.ASV: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que quando eras mais jovem, tu mesmo te vestias, e andava por onde querias; mas quando fores já velho, estenderás tuas mãos, e outro te vestirá, e te levará para onde tu não queres.
verses.RVR09: De cierto, de cierto te digo: Cuando eras más mozo, te ceñías, é ibas donde querías; mas cuando ya fueres viejo, extenderás tus manos, y te ceñirá otro, y te llevará á donde no quieras.

verses.KJV: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.WEB: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.ASV: Now this he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse isto, fazendo entender que [Pedro] glorificaria a Deus com [sua] morte. E tendo dito isto, [Jesus] lhe disse: Segue-me.
verses.RVR09: Y esto dijo, dando á entender con qué muerte había de glorificar á Dios. Y dicho esto, dícele: Sígueme.

verses.KJV: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.WEB: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
verses.ASV: Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; who also leaned back on his breast at the supper, and said, Lord, who is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E virando-se Pedro, viu que [o] seguia aquele discípulo a quem Jesus amava, o que também na ceia se recostara a seu peito, e dissera: Senhor, quem é o que te trairá?
verses.RVR09: Volviéndose Pedro, ve á aquel discípulo al cual amaba Jesús, que seguía, el que también se había recostado á su pecho en la cena, y le había dicho: Señor, ¿quién es el que te ha de entregar?

verses.KJV: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.WEB: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.ASV: Peter therefore seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo Pedro a este, disse a Jesus: Senhor, e este, que [lhe acontecerá] ?
verses.RVR09: Así que Pedro vió á éste, dice á Jesús: Señor, ¿y éste, qué?

verses.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
verses.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
verses.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee? follow thou me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa? Segue-me tu.
verses.RVR09: Dícele Jesús: Si quiero que él quede hasta que yo venga, ¿qué á tí? Sígueme tú.

verses.KJV: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
verses.WEB: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.ASV: This saying therefore went forth among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, that he should not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiu, pois, esta conversa entre os irmãos, que aquele discípulo não morreria. Contudo Jesus não lhe disse que não morreria, mas sim: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa?
verses.RVR09: Salió entonces este dicho entre los hermanos, que aquel discípulo no había de morir. Mas Jesús no le dijo, No morirá; sino: Si quiero que él quede hasta que yo venga ¿qué á ti?

verses.KJV: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.WEB: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
verses.ASV: This is the disciple that beareth witness of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his witness is true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o discípulo que testemunha destas coisas, e estas coisas escreveu; e sabemos que seu testemunho é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Este es aquel discípulo que da testimonio de estas cosas, y escribió estas cosas: y sabemos que su testimonio es verdadero.

verses.KJV: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.WEB: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
verses.ASV: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself would not contain the books that should be written.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda há, porém, muitas outras coisas que Jesus fez, que se sobre cada uma delas se escrevessem, penso que nem mesmo o mundo poderia caber os livros escritos. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Y hay también otras muchas cosas que hizo Jesús, que si se escribiesen cada una por sí, ni aun en el mundo pienso que cabrían los libros que se habrían de escribir. Amén.

verses.KJV: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.WEB: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
verses.ASV: The former treatise I made, O Theophilus, concerning all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fiz o primeiro livro, ó Teófilo, sobre todas as coisas que Jesus começou, tanto a fazer como a ensinar;
verses.RVR09: EN el primer tratado, oh Teófilo, he hablado de todas las cosas que Jesús comenzó á hacer y á enseñar,

verses.KJV: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.WEB: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
verses.ASV: until the day in which he was received up, after that he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o dia em que ele foi recebido acima, depois de pelo Espírito Santo ter dado mandamentos aos apóstolos que tinha escolhido;
verses.RVR09: Hasta el día en que, habiendo dado mandamientos por el Espíritu Santo á los apóstoles que escogió, fué recibido arriba;

verses.KJV: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.WEB: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: to whom he also showed himself alive after his passion by many proofs, appearing unto them by the space of forty days, and speaking the things concerning the kingdom of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais também, depois de ter sofrido, apresentou-se vivo com muitas evidências; sendo visto por eles durante quarenta dias, e falando [-lhes] das coisas relativas ao reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales, después de haber padecido, se presentó vivo con muchas pruebas indubitables, apareciéndoles por cuarenta días, y hablándoles del reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
verses.WEB: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
verses.ASV: and, being assembled together with them, he charged them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father, which, [said he], ye heard from me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E, reunindo-os, mandou-lhes que não saíssem de Jerusalém, mas que esperassem a promessa do Pai que (disse ele) de mim ouvistes.
verses.RVR09: Y estando juntos, les mandó que no se fuesen de Jerusalem, sino que esperasen la promesa del Padre, que oísteis, dijo, de mí.

verses.KJV: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.WEB: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
verses.ASV: for John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days hence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque João batizou com água, mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo, não muitos dias depois destes.
verses.RVR09: Porque Juan á la verdad bautizó con agua, mas vosotros seréis bautizados con el Espíritu Santo no muchos días después de estos.

verses.KJV: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.WEB: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
verses.ASV: They therefore, when they were come together, asked him, saying, Lord, dost thou at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aqueles que tinham se reunido lhe perguntaram, dizendo: Senhor, tu restaurarás neste tempo o Reino a Israel?
verses.RVR09: Entonces los que se habían juntado le preguntaron, diciendo: Señor, ¿restituirás el reino á Israel en este tiempo?

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know times or seasons, which the Father hath set within his own authority.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Não pertence a vós saber os tempos ou estações que o Pai pôs em sua própria autoridade.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: No toca á vosotros saber los tiempos ó las sazones que el Padre puso en su sola potestad;

verses.KJV: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.WEB: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
verses.ASV: But ye shall receive power, when the Holy Spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa and Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós recebereis poder do Espírito Santo, que virá sobre vós; e vós sereis minhas testemunhas, tanto em Jerusalém como em toda a Judeia, e Samaria, e até ao último [lugar] da terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas recibiréis la virtud del Espíritu Santo que vendrá sobre vosotros; y me sereís testigos en Jerusalem, y en toda Judea, y Samaria, y hasta lo último de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.WEB: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.ASV: And when he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo ele dito estas coisas, enquanto eles o viam, ele foi levantado acima, e uma nuvem o tirou dos olhos deles.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo dicho estas cosas, viéndolo ellos, fué alzado; y una nube le recibió y le quitó de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.WEB: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
verses.ASV: And while they were looking stedfastly into heaven as he went, behold two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles estavam com os olhos fixos ao céu, depois dele ter ido, eis que dois homens de roupas brancas se puseram junto a eles;
verses.RVR09: Y estando con los ojos puestos en el cielo, entre tanto que él iba, he aquí dos varones se pusieron junto á ellos en vestidos blancos;

verses.KJV: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.WEB: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
verses.ASV: who also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye looking into heaven? this Jesus, who was received up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye beheld him going into heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais também disseram: Homens galileus, por que estais olhando para o céu? Este Jesus, que foi tomado de vós acima ao céu, assim virá, da maneira como o vistes ir ao céu.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales también les dijeron: Varones Galileos, ¿qué estáis mirando al cielo? este mismo Jesús que ha sido tomado desde vosotros arriba en el cielo, así vendrá como le habéis visto ir al cielo.

verses.KJV: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
verses.WEB: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
verses.ASV: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is nigh unto Jerusalem, a sabbath day’s journey off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles voltaram a Jerusalém do monte que se chama das Oliveiras, o qual está perto de Jerusalém [à distância] de um caminho de sábado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se volvieron á Jerusalem del monte que se llama del Olivar, el cual está cerca de Jerusalem camino de un sábado.

verses.KJV: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
verses.WEB: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
verses.ASV: And when they were come in, they went up into the upper chamber, where they were abiding; both Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James [the son] of Alphæus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas [the son] of James.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao entrarem, subiram ao cômodo superior, onde ficaram Pedro, Tiago, João, André, Filipe, Tomé, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago [filho] de Alfeu, Simão Zelote e Judas [irmão] de Tiago.
verses.RVR09: Y entrados, subieron al aposento alto, donde moraban Pedro y Jacobo, y Juan y Andrés, Felipe y Tomás, Bartolomé y Mateo, Jacobo hijo de Alfeo, y Simón Zelotes, y Judas hermano de Jacobo.

verses.KJV: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.WEB: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
verses.ASV: These all with one accord continued stedfastly in prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes perseveravam concordando em orações, e petições, com as mulheres, com Maria a mãe de Jesus, e com os irmãos dele.
verses.RVR09: Todos éstos perseveraban unánimes en oración y ruego, con las mujeres, y con María la madre de Jesús, y con sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.WEB: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
verses.ASV: And in these days Peter stood up in the midst of the brethren, and said (and there was a multitude of persons [gathered] together, about a hundred and twenty),
verses.ALMEIDA: E em [algum d] aqueles dias, havendo uma multidão reunida de cerca de cento e vinte pessoas, Pedro se levantou no meio dos discípulos e disse:
verses.RVR09: Y en aquellos días, Pedro, levantándose en medio de los hermanos, dijo (y era la compañía junta como de ciento y veinte en número):

verses.KJV: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.WEB: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
verses.ASV: Brethren, it was needful that the scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spake before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens irmãos, era necessário que se cumprisse a Escritura, que o Espírito Santo, por meio da boca de Davi, predisse quanto a Judas, que foi o guia daqueles que prenderam a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Varones hermanos, convino que se cumpliese la Escritura, la cual dijo antes el Espíritu Santo por la boca de David, de Judas, que fué guía de los que prendieron á Jesús;

verses.KJV: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.WEB: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
verses.ASV: For he was numbered among us, and received his portion in this ministry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele foi contado conosco, e obteve uma porção neste ministério.
verses.RVR09: El cuál era contado con nosotros, y tenía suerte en este ministerio.

verses.KJV: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.WEB: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.
verses.ASV: (Now this man obtained a field with the reward of his iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este pois, adquiriu um campo por meio do pagamento da maldade, e tendo caído de cabeça para baixo, partiu-se ao meio, e todos os seus órgãos internos caíram para fora.
verses.RVR09: Este, pues, adquirió un campo del salario de su iniquidad, y colgándose, reventó por medio, y todas sus entrañas se derramaron.

verses.KJV: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.WEB: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
verses.ASV: And it became known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch that in their language that field was called Akeldama, that is, The field of blood.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E [isso] foi conhecido por todos os que habitam em Jerusalém, de maneira que aquele campo se chama em sua própria língua Aceldama, isto é, campo de sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y fué notorio á todos los moradores de Jerusalem; de tal manera que aquel campo es llamado en su propia lengua, Acéldama, que es, Campo de sangre.

verses.KJV: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.WEB: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
verses.ASV: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be made desolate, And let no man dwell therein: and, His office let another take.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque está escrito no livro dos Salmos: Sua habitação se faça deserta, e não haja quem nela habite; e outro tome seu trabalho de supervisão.
verses.RVR09: Porque está escrito en el libro de los salmos: Sea hecha desierta su habitación, y no haya quien more en ella; y: Tome otro su obispado.

verses.KJV: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.WEB: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.ASV: Of the men therefore that have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and went out among us,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto é necessário, que dos homens que nos acompanharam todo o tempo em que o Senhor Jesus entrava e saía conosco,
verses.RVR09: Conviene, pues, que de estos hombres que han estado juntos con nosotros todo el tiempo que el Señor Jesús entró y salió entre nosotros,

verses.KJV: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.WEB: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
verses.ASV: beginning from the baptism of John, unto the day that he was received up from us, of these must one become a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.ALMEIDA: Começando desde o batismo de João, até o dia em que [diante] de nós ele foi recebido acima, se faça um destes testemunha conosco de sua ressurreição.
verses.RVR09: Comenzando desde el bautismo de Juan, hasta el día que fué recibido arriba de entre nosotros, uno sea hecho testigo con nosotros de su resurrección.

verses.KJV: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.WEB: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
verses.ASV: And they put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apresentaram dois: a José, chamado Barsabás, que tinha por sobrenome [o] Justo; e a Matias.
verses.RVR09: Y señalaron á dos: á José, llamado Barsabas, que tenía por sobrenombre Justo, y á Matías.

verses.KJV: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.WEB: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
verses.ASV: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, who knowest the hearts of all men, show of these two the one whom thou hast chosen,
verses.ALMEIDA: E orando, disseram: Tu, Senhor, conhecedor dos corações de todos, mostra a qual destes dois tu tens escolhido.
verses.RVR09: Y orando, dijeron: Tú, Señor, que conoces los corazones de todos, muestra cuál escoges de estos dos,

verses.KJV: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.WEB: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
verses.ASV: to take the place in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que ele tome parte deste ministério e apostolado, do qual Judas se desviou para ir a seu próprio lugar.
verses.RVR09: Para que tome el oficio de este ministerio y apostolado, del cual cayó Judas por transgresión, para irse á su lugar.

verses.KJV: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.WEB: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
verses.ASV: And they gave lots for them; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançaram-lhes as sortes; e caiu a sorte sobre Matias. E ele [passou] a ser contado junto com os onze apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Y les echaron suertes, y cayó la suerte sobre Matías; y fué contado con los once apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.WEB: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.ASV: And when the day of Pentecost was now come, they were all together in one place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao se cumprir o dia de Pentecostes, estavam todos concordando no mesmo lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO se cumplieron los días de Pentecostés, estaban todos unánimes juntos;

verses.KJV: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.WEB: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.ASV: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound as of the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de repente houve um ruído do céu, como de um vento forte [e] violento, e encheu toda a casa onde eles estavam sentados.
verses.RVR09: Y de repente vino un estruendo del cielo como de un viento recio que corría, el cual hinchió toda la casa donde estaban sentados;

verses.KJV: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.WEB: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
verses.ASV: And there appeared unto them tongues parting asunder, like as of fire; and it sat upon each one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram vistas por eles línguas repartidas como que de fogo, e se pôs sobre cada um deles.
verses.RVR09: Y se les aparecieron lenguas repartidas, como de fuego, que se asentó sobre cada uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.WEB: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
verses.ASV: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles foram todos cheios do Espírito Santo, e começaram a falar em outras línguas, conforme o Espírito lhes dava a discursarem.
