verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos llenos del Espíritu Santo, y comenzaron á hablar en otras lenguas, como el Espíritu les daba que hablasen.

verses.KJV: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.WEB: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
verses.ASV: Now there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia judeus que estavam morando em Jerusalém, homens devotos, de toda nação abaixo do céu.
verses.RVR09: Moraban entonces en Jerusalem Judíos, varones religiosos, de todas las naciones debajo del cielo.

verses.KJV: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
verses.WEB: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
verses.ASV: And when this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speaking in his own language.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecendo esta voz, ajuntou-se a multidão; e ela estava confusa, porque cada um os ouvia falar em sua própria língua.
verses.RVR09: Y hecho este estruendo, juntóse la multitud; y estaban confusos, porque cada uno les oía hablar su propia lengua.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.WEB: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
verses.ASV: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying, Behold, are not all these that speak Galilæans?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos estavam admirados, e se maravilhavam, dizendo uns aos outros: Ora, estes que estão falando, não são todos eles galileus?
verses.RVR09: Y estaban atónitos y maravillados, diciendo: He aquí ¿no son Galileos todos estos que hablan?

verses.KJV: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.WEB: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
verses.ASV: And how hear we, every man in our own language wherein we were born?
verses.ALMEIDA: E como nós ouvimos cada um [deles] em nossa própria língua, na qual nascemos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo, pues, les oímos nosotros hablar cada uno en nuestra lengua en que somos nacidos?

verses.KJV: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.WEB: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
verses.ASV: Parthians and Medes and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, in Judæa and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,
verses.ALMEIDA: Partos, Medos, Elamitas, os habitantes da Mesopotâmia, da Judeia, Capadócia, Ponto, Ásia,
verses.RVR09: Partos y Medos, y Elamitas, y los que habitamos en Mesopotamia, en Judea y en Capadocia, en el Ponto y en Asia,

verses.KJV: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.WEB: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
verses.ASV: in Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and sojourners from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
verses.ALMEIDA: Frígia, Panfília, Egito e regiões da Líbia perto de Cirene, e romanos estrangeiros, tanto judeus como prosélitos,
verses.RVR09: En Phrygia y Pamphylia, en Egipto y en las partes de Africa que está de la otra parte de Cirene, y Romanos extranjeros, tanto Judíos como convertidos,

verses.KJV: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.WEB: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
verses.ASV: Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking in our tongues the mighty works of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cretenses e Árabes, os ouvimos em nossas próprias línguas eles falarem das grandezas de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cretenses y Arabes, les oímos hablar en nuestras lenguas las maravillas de Dios.

verses.KJV: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.WEB: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
verses.ASV: And they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos estavam admirados e confusos, dizendo uns aos outros: O que isso quer dizer?
verses.RVR09: Y estaban todos atónitos y perplejos, diciendo los unos á los otros: ¿Qué quiere ser esto?

verses.KJV: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.WEB: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
verses.ASV: But others mocking said, They are filled with new wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outros, ridicularizando, diziam: Eles estão cheios de vinho doce.
verses.RVR09: Mas otros burlándose, decían: Que están llenos de mosto.

verses.KJV: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.WEB: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
verses.ASV: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spake forth unto them, [saying], Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and give ear unto my words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro, pondo-se de pé com os onze, levantou sua voz, e lhes falou: Homens judeus, e todos os que habitais em Jerusalém, seja isto conhecido, e ouvi minhas palavras:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro, poniéndose en pie con los once, alzó su voz, y hablóles diciendo: Varones Judíos, y todos los que habitáis en Jerusalem, esto os sea notorio, y oid mis palabras.

verses.KJV: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
verses.WEB: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
verses.ASV: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose; seeing it is [but] the third hour of the day;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estes não estão bêbados, como vós pensais, sendo [ainda] a terceira hora do dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque éstos no están borrachos, como vosotros pensáis, siendo la hora tercia del día;

verses.KJV: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.WEB: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
verses.ASV: but this is that which hath been spoken through the prophet Joel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto é o que foi dito por meio do profeta Joel:
verses.RVR09: Mas esto es lo que fué dicho por el profeta Joel:

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.WEB: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
verses.ASV: And it shall be in the last days, saith God, I will pour forth of my Spirit upon all flesh: And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, And your young men shall see visions, And your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será nos últimos dias, diz Deus, que: Eu derramarei do meu Espírito sobre toda carne, e vossos filhos e filhas profetizarão, e vossos rapazes terão visões, e vossos velhos sonharão sonhos;
verses.RVR09: Y será en los postreros días, dice Dios, derramaré de mi Espíritu sobre toda carne, y vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas profetizarán; y vuestros mancebos verán visiones, y vuestros viejos soñarán sueños:

verses.KJV: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.WEB: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
verses.ASV: Yea and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days Will I pour forth of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também sobre meus servos e sobre minhas servas, naqueles dias eu derramarei do meu Espírito, e profetizarão.
verses.RVR09: Y de cierto sobre mis siervos y sobre mis siervas en aquellos días derramaré de mi Espíritu, y profetizarán.

verses.KJV: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.WEB: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
verses.ASV: And I will show wonders in the heaven above, And signs on the earth beneath; Blood, and fire, and vapor of smoke:
verses.ALMEIDA: E darei milagres acima no céu, e sinais abaixo na terra; sangue, fogo, e vapor de fumaça;
verses.RVR09: Y daré prodigios arriba en el cielo, y señales abajo en la tierra, sangre y fuego y vapor de humo:

verses.KJV: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.WEB: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
verses.ASV: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the day of the Lord come, That great and notable [day]:
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol se converterá em trevas, e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o grande e notório dia do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: El sol se volverá en tinieblas, y la luna en sangre, antes que venga el día del Señor, grande y manifiesto;

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.WEB: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
verses.ASV: And it shall be, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que todo aquele que chamar ao nome do Senhor será salvo.
verses.RVR09: Y será que todo aquel que invocare el nombre del Señor, será salvo.

verses.KJV: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.WEB: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
verses.ASV: Ye men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God unto you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in the midst of you, even as ye yourselves know;
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens israelitas, ouvi estas palavras: Jesus o nazareno, homem aprovado por Deus entre vós, com maravilhas, milagres e sinais, que Deus fez por meio dele no meio de vós, assim como vós mesmos também sabeis;
verses.RVR09: Varones Israelitas, oid estas palabras: Jesús Nazareno, varón aprobado de Dios entre vosotros en maravillas y prodigios y señales, que Dios hizo por él en medio de vosotros, como también vosotros sabéis;

verses.KJV: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.WEB: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
verses.ASV: him, being delivered up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye by the hand of lawless men did crucify and slay:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este, sendo entregue pelo determinado conselho e conhecimento prévio de Deus, sendo tomando, pelas mãos de injustos [o] crucificastes e matastes;
verses.RVR09: A éste, entregado por determinado consejo y providencia de Dios, prendisteis y matasteis por manos de los inicuos, crucificándole;

verses.KJV: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.WEB: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
verses.ASV: whom God raised up, having loosed the pangs of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual Deus ressuscitou, tendo soltado as dores da morte; porque não era possível ele ser retido por ela;
verses.RVR09: Al cual Dios levantó, sueltos los dolores de la muerte, por cuanto era imposible ser detenido de ella.

verses.KJV: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.WEB: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
verses.ASV: For David saith concerning him, I beheld the Lord always before my face; For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Davi diz sobre ele: Eu sempre via ao Senhor diante de mim, porque ele está à minha direita, para que eu não seja abalado.
verses.RVR09: Porque David dice de él: Veía al Señor siempre delante de mí: porque está á mi diestra, no seré conmovido.

verses.KJV: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.WEB: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,
verses.ASV: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced; Moreover my flesh also shall dwell in hope:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meu coração está contente, e minha língua se alegra, e até mesmo minha carne repousará em esperança.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual mi corazón se alegró, y gozóse mi lengua; y aun mi carne descansará en esperanza;

verses.KJV: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.WEB: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
verses.ASV: Because thou wilt not leave my soul unto Hades, Neither wilt thou give thy Holy One to see corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu não abandonarás minha alma no Xeol, nem permitirás que o teu santo veja a degradação.
verses.RVR09: Que no dejarás mi alma en el infierno, ni darás á tu Santo que vea corrupción.

verses.KJV: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.WEB: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
verses.ASV: Thou madest known unto me the ways of life; Thou shalt make me full of gladness with thy countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tens me feito conhecer os caminhos da vida; tu me encherás de alegria com tua face.
verses.RVR09: Hicísteme notorios los caminos de la vida; me henchirás de gozo con tu presencia.

verses.KJV: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
verses.WEB: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
verses.ASV: Brethren, I may say unto you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens irmãos, é lícito eu vos dizer abertamente sobre o patriarca Davi, que morreu, e foi sepultado, e a sepultura dele está conosco até o dia de hoje.
verses.RVR09: Varones hermanos, se os puede libremente decir del patriarca David, que murió, y fué sepultado, y su sepulcro está con nosotros hasta del día de hoy.

verses.KJV: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.WEB: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
verses.ASV: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins he would set [one] upon his throne;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sendo ele profeta, e sabendo que Deus tinha lhe prometido com juramento que, da sua descendência segundo a carne, levantaria ao Cristo para se sentar no seu trono;
verses.RVR09: Empero siendo profeta, y sabiendo que con juramento le había Dios jurado que del fruto de su lomo, cuanto á la carne, levantaría al Cristo que se sentaría sobre su trono;

verses.KJV: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.WEB: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
verses.ASV: he foreseeing [this] spake of the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was he left unto Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo [-o] com antecedência, falou da ressurreição do Cristo, que a sua alma não foi abandonada no Xeol, nem a sua carne viu a degradação.
verses.RVR09: Viéndolo antes, habló de la resurrección de Cristo, que su alma no fué dejada en el infierno, ni su carne vió corrupción.

verses.KJV: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.WEB: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
verses.ASV: This Jesus did God raise up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este Jesus Deus ressuscitou; do qual todos nós somos testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: A este Jesús resucitó Dios, de lo cual todos nosotros somos testigos.

verses.KJV: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.WEB: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.
verses.ASV: Being therefore by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he hath poured forth this, which ye see and hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, tendo sido exaltado à direita de Deus, e recebido do Pai a promessa do Espírito Santo, derramou isto que agora estais vendo e ouvindo.
verses.RVR09: Así que, levantado por la diestra de Dios, y recibiendo del Padre la promesa del Espíritu Santo, ha derramado esto que vosotros veis y oís.

verses.KJV: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.WEB: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand
verses.ASV: For David ascended not into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Davi não subiu aos céus; mas sim, ele diz: Disse o Senhor a meu Senhor: Senta-te à minha direita,
verses.RVR09: Porque David no subió á los cielos; empero él dice: Dijo el Señor á mi Señor: Siéntate á mi diestra,

verses.KJV: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.WEB: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
verses.ASV: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que eu ponha teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que ponga á tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies.

verses.KJV: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.WEB: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
verses.ASV: Let all the house of Israel therefore know assuredly, that God hath made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom ye crucified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiba então com certeza toda a casa de Israel, que Deus o fez Senhor e Cristo a este Jesus, que vós crucificastes.
verses.RVR09: Sepa pues ciertísimamente toda la casa de Israel, que á éste Jesús que vosotros crucificasteis, Dios ha hecho Señor y Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
verses.WEB: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
verses.ASV: Now when they heard [this], they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ao ouvirem [estas coisas] , foram afligidos como que perfurados de coração, e disseram a Pedro, e aos outros apóstolos: Que faremos, homens irmãos?
verses.RVR09: Entonces oído esto, fueron compungidos de corazón, y dijeron á Pedro y á los otros apóstoles: Varones hermanos, ¿qué haremos?

verses.KJV: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: And Peter [said] unto them, Repent ye, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ unto the remission of your sins; and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhes disse: Arrependei-vos, e batize-se cada um de vós no nome de Jesus Cristo, para perdão dos pecados; e vós recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro les dice: Arrepentíos, y bautícese cada uno de vosotros en el nombre de Jesucristo para perdón de los pecados; y recibiréis el don del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
verses.WEB: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
verses.ASV: For to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, [even] as many as the Lord our God shall call unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a promessa é para vós, e para vossos filhos, e para todos que [ainda] estão longe, a tantos quantos Deus, nosso Senhor, chamar.
verses.RVR09: Porque para vosotros es la promesa, y para vuestros hijos, y para todos los que están lejos; para cuantos el Señor nuestro Dios llamare.

verses.KJV: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.WEB: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
verses.ASV: And with many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, Save yourselves from this crooked generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com muitas outras palavras ele dava testemunho, e exortava, dizendo: Salvai-vos desta geração perversa!
verses.RVR09: Y con otras muchas palabras testificaba y exhortaba, diciendo: Sed salvos de esta perversa generación.

verses.KJV: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
verses.WEB: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
verses.ASV: They then that received his word were baptized: and there were added [unto them] in that day about three thousand souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os que receberam a palavra dele de boa vontade foram batizados; e foram adicionados naquele dia quase três mil almas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, los que recibieron su palabra, fueron bautizados: y fueron añadidas á ellos aquel día como tres mil personas.

verses.KJV: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.WEB: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
verses.ASV: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles perseveravam na doutrina dos apóstolos, na comunhão, no partir do pão, e nas orações.
verses.RVR09: Y perseveraban en la doctrina de los apóstoles, y en la comunión, y en el partimiento del pan, y en las oraciones.

verses.KJV: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.WEB: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
verses.ASV: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve temor em toda alma; e muitos milagres e sinais foram feitos pelos apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Y toda persona tenía temor: y muchas maravillas y señales eran hechas por los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.WEB: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
verses.ASV: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que criam estavam juntos, e tinham todas as coisas em comum.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que creían estaban juntos; y tenían todas las cosas comunes;

verses.KJV: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
verses.WEB: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
verses.ASV: and they sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all, according as any man had need.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles vendiam [suas] propriedades e bens, e as repartiam com todos, conforme a necessidade que cada um tinha.
verses.RVR09: Y vendían las posesiones, y las haciendas, y repartíanlas á todos, como cada uno había menester.

verses.KJV: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.WEB: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.ASV: And day by day, continuing stedfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.ALMEIDA: E perseverando a cada dia em concordância no Templo, e partindo o pão de casa em casa, comiam juntos com alegria e sinceridade de coração.
verses.RVR09: Y perseverando unánimes cada día en el templo, y partiendo el pan en las casas, comían juntos con alegría y con sencillez de corazón,

verses.KJV: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.WEB: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
verses.ASV: praising God, and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to them day by day those that were saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvando a Deus, e tendo graça, [sendo do agrado] de todo o povo. E a cada dia o Senhor acrescentava à igreja aqueles que estavam sendo salvos.
verses.RVR09: Alabando á Dios, y teniendo gracia con todo el pueblo. Y el Señor añadía cada día á la iglesia los que habían de ser salvos.

verses.KJV: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
verses.WEB: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
verses.ASV: Now Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, [being] the ninth [hour].
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro e João estavam subindo juntos para o Templo à hora da oração (a nona [hora] );
verses.RVR09: PEDRO y Juan subían juntos al templo á la hora de oración, la de nona.

verses.KJV: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.WEB: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
verses.ASV: And a certain man that was lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.ALMEIDA: E um certo homem estava sendo trazido, que era aleijado desde o ventre de sua mãe, ao qual todo dia colocavam à porta do Templo, chamada [Porta] Formosa, para pedir esmola aos que entravam no Templo.
verses.RVR09: Y un hombre que era cojo desde el vientre de su madre, era traído; al cual ponían cada día á la puerta del templo que se llama la Hermosa, para que pidiese limosna de los que entraban en el templo.

verses.KJV: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.WEB: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
verses.ASV: who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked to receive an alms.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, ao ver Pedro e João perto de entrarem no Templo, ele [lhes] pediu uma esmola.
verses.RVR09: Este, como vió á Pedro y á Juan que iban á entrar en el templo, rogaba que le diesen limosna.

verses.KJV: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.WEB: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
verses.ASV: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him, with John, said, Look on us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, olhando fixamente para ele, junto com João, disse: Olha para nós.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro, con Juan, fijando los ojos en él, dijo: Mira á nosotros.

verses.KJV: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.WEB: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.ASV: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [o aleijado] ficou prestando atenção neles, esperando receber deles alguma coisa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él estuvo atento á ellos, esperando recibir de ellos algo.

verses.KJV: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.WEB: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
verses.ASV: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but what I have, that give I thee. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro disse: Prata e ouro eu não tenho; mas o que eu tenho, isso eu te dou: no nome de Jesus Cristo, o nazareno, levanta-te, e anda!
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro dijo: Ni tengo plata ni oro; mas lo que tengo te doy: en el nombre de Jesucristo de Nazaret, levántate y anda.

verses.KJV: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.WEB: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
verses.ASV: And he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, tomando-o pela mão direita, levantou [-o] ; e logo os seus pés e tornozelos ficaram firmes.
verses.RVR09: Y tomándole por la mano derecha le levantó: y luego fueron afirmados sus pies y tobillos;

verses.KJV: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.WEB: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
verses.ASV: And leaping up, he stood, and began to walk; and he entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, saltando, pôs-se de pé, e andou, e entrou com eles no Templo, andando, e saltando, e louvando a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y saltando, se puso en pie, y anduvo; y entró con ellos en el templo, andando, y saltando, y alabando á Dios.

verses.KJV: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.WEB: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
verses.ASV: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo o viu andar, e louvar a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo le vió andar y alabar á Dios.

verses.KJV: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.WEB: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.ASV: and they took knowledge of him, that it was he that sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles o reconheceram, que este era o que se sentava [para pedir] esmola perto da porta formosa do Templo; e ficaram cheios de surpresa e espanto, por causa do que tinha lhe acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Y conocían que él era el que se sentaba á la limosna á la puerta del templo, la Hermosa: y fueron llenos de asombro y de espanto por lo que le había acontecido.

verses.KJV: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
verses.WEB: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
verses.ASV: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o aleijado que tinha sido curado, tendo se apegado a Pedro e a João, todo o povo correu maravilhado a eles ao pórtico, que se chama de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y teniendo á Pedro y á Juan el cojo que había sido sanado, todo el pueblo concurrió á ellos al pórtico que se llama de Salomón, atónitos.

verses.KJV: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
verses.WEB: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
verses.ASV: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this man? or why fasten ye your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him to walk?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Pedro viu [isso] , respondeu ao povo: “Homens israelitas, por que vos maravilhais disto? Ou por que vós olhais tão atentamente para nós, como se por nosso próprio poder ou devoção divina o tivéssemos feito andar?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto Pedro, respondió al pueblo: Varones Israelitas, ¿por qué os maravilláis de esto? ó ¿por qué ponéis los ojos en nosotros, como si con nuestra virtud ó piedad hubiésemos hecho andar á éste?

verses.KJV: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
verses.WEB: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
verses.ASV: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Servant Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied before the face of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus de Abraão, e de Isaque, e de Jacó, o Deus de nossos pais, glorificou a seu filho Jesus, ao qual vós entregastes, e diante do rosto de Pilatos o negastes, [mesmo] ele julgando que fosse solto.
verses.RVR09: El Dios de Abraham, y de Isaac, y de Jacob, el Dios de nuestros padres ha glorificado á su Hijo Jesús, al cual vosotros entregasteis, y negasteis delante de Pilato, juzgando él que había de ser suelto.

verses.KJV: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
verses.WEB: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
verses.ASV: But ye denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted unto you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós negastes ao santo e justo, e pedistes que um homem assassino fosse vos dado.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros al Santo y al Justo negasteis, y pedisteis que se os diese un homicida;

verses.KJV: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
verses.WEB: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
verses.ASV: and killed the Prince of life; whom God raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós matastes ao Príncipe da vida, ao qual Deus ressuscitou dos mortos, do que nós somos testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: Y matasteis al Autor de la vida, al cual Dios ha resucitado de los muertos; de lo que nosotros somos testigos.

verses.KJV: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.WEB: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.ASV: And by faith in his name hath his name made this man strong, whom ye behold and know: yea, the faith which is through him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela fé em seu nome, o nome dele deu firmeza a este, que vedes e conheceis; e a fé que é por meio dele deu a este perfeita saúde na presença de todos vós.
verses.RVR09: Y en la fe de su nombre, á éste que vosotros veis y conocéis, ha confirmado su nombre: y la fe que por él es, ha dado á éste esta completa sanidad en presencia de todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.WEB: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
verses.ASV: And now, brethren, I know that in ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, irmãos, eu sei que vós fizestes [isso] por ignorância, assim como também vossos líderes.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, hermanos, sé que por ignorancia lo habéis hecho, como también vuestros príncipes.

verses.KJV: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
verses.WEB: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
verses.ASV: But the things which God foreshowed by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus cumpriu assim o que já antes pela boca de todos os seus profetas ele tinha anunciado, que o Cristo tinha de sofrer.
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios ha cumplido así lo que había antes anunciado por boca de todos sus profetas, que su Cristo había de padecer.

verses.KJV: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
verses.ASV: Repent ye therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, that so there may come seasons of refreshing from the presence of the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Arrependei-vos, pois, e convertei-vos, para que vosso pecados sejam apagados, quando vierem os tempos do refrigério da presença do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Así que, arrepentíos y convertíos, para que sean borrados vuestros pecados; pues que vendrán los tiempos del refrigerio de la presencia del Señor,

verses.KJV: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
verses.WEB: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
verses.ASV: and that he may send the Christ who hath been appointed for you, [even] Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele enviar a Jesus Cristo, que já vos foi pregado anteriormente.
verses.RVR09: Y enviará á Jesucristo, que os fué antes anunciado:

verses.KJV: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
verses.WEB: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
verses.ASV: whom the heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, whereof God spake by the mouth of his holy prophets that have been from of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual convém que o céu receba até os tempos da restauração de todas as coisas, que Deus falou pela boca de todos os seus santos profetas, desde o princípio.
verses.RVR09: Al cual de cierto es menester que el cielo tenga hasta los tiempos de la restauración de todas las cosas, que habló Dios por boca de sus santos profetas que han sido desde el siglo.

verses.KJV: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
verses.WEB: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
verses.ASV: Moses indeed said, A prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me; to him shall ye hearken in all things whatsoever he shall speak unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Moisés disse aos [nossos] pais: O Senhor, vosso Deus, levantará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta como eu; a ele ouvireis em tudo o que ele vos falar.
verses.RVR09: Porque Moisés dijo á los padres: El Señor vuestro Dios os levantará profeta de vuestros hermanos, como yo; á él oiréis en todas las cosas que os hablare.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
verses.WEB: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
verses.ASV: And it shall be, that every soul that shall not hearken to that prophet, shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que toda pessoa que não ouvir este profeta será exterminada do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y será, que cualquiera alma que no oyere á aquel profeta, será desarraigada del pueblo.

verses.KJV: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
verses.WEB: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.
verses.ASV: Yea and all the prophets from Samuel and them that followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também todos os profetas, desde Samuel e os posteriores, todos os que falaram, também anunciaram com antecedência destes dias.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los profetas desde Samuel y en adelante, todos los que han hablado, han anunciado estos días.

verses.KJV: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.WEB: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’
verses.ASV: Ye are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois os filhos dos profetas e do pacto que Deus estabeleceu com nossos pais, dizendo a Abraão: E em tua semente serão abençoadas todas as famílias da terra.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois los hijos de los profetas, y del pacto que Dios concertó con nuestros padres, diciendo á Abraham: Y en tu simiente serán benditas todas las familias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
verses.WEB: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
verses.ASV: Unto you first God, having raised up his Servant, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, ao ressuscitar seu filho Jesus, primeiro o enviou a vós, para que [nisto] vos abençoasse: afastando cada um de vós de vossas maldades”.
verses.RVR09: A vosotros primeramente, Dios, habiendo levantado á su Hijo, le envió para que os bendijese, á fin de que cada uno se convierta de su maldad.

verses.KJV: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
verses.WEB: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
verses.ASV: And as they spake unto the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles ainda estavam falando ao povo, vieram sobre eles os sacerdotes, e o oficial do Templo, e os saduceus,
verses.RVR09: Y HABLANDO ellos al pueblo, sobrevinieron los sacerdotes, y el magistrado del templo, y los Saduceos,

verses.KJV: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.WEB: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.ASV: being sore troubled because they taught the people, and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muito incomodados por eles ensinarem ao povo, e anunciarem no [nome] de Jesus a ressurreição dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Resentidos de que enseñasen al pueblo, y anunciasen en Jesús la resurrección de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
verses.WEB: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
verses.ASV: And they laid hands on them, and put them in ward unto the morrow: for it was now eventide.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram as mãos sobre eles, e os puseram na prisão até o dia seguinte, porque já era tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y les echaron mano, y los pusieron en la cárcel hasta el día siguiente; porque era ya tarde.

verses.KJV: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
verses.WEB: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
verses.ASV: But many of them that heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos dos que ouviram a palavra, creram; e era o número dos homens de cerca de cinco mil.
verses.RVR09: Mas muchos de los que habían oído la palabra, creyeron; y fué el número de los varones como cinco mil.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
verses.WEB: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no dia seguinte, que os chefes, e anciãos, e escribas, se reuniram em Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al día siguiente, que se juntaron en Jerusalem los príncipes de ellos, y los ancianos, y los escribas;

verses.KJV: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
verses.ASV: and Annas the high priest [was there], and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Anás, o sumo sacerdote, e Caifás, e João, e Alexandre, e todos quantos havia da linhagem do governo sacerdotal.
verses.RVR09: Y Anás, príncipe de los sacerdotes, y Caifás, y Juan y Alejandro, y todos los que eran del linaje sacerdotal;

verses.KJV: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
verses.WEB: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
verses.ASV: And when they had set them in the midst, they inquired, By what power, or in what name, have ye done this?
verses.ALMEIDA: E pondo-os no meio, perguntaram [-lhes] : Por meio de que poder ou por qual nome vós fizestes isto?
verses.RVR09: Y haciéndolos presentar en medio, les preguntaron: ¿Con qué potestad, ó en qué nombre, habéis hecho vosotros esto?

verses.KJV: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.WEB: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,
verses.ASV: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: Chefes do povo, e anciões de Israel,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro, lleno del Espíritu Santo, les dijo: Príncipes del pueblo, y ancianos de Israel:

verses.KJV: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
verses.WEB: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
verses.ASV: if we this day are examined concerning a good deed done to an impotent man, by what means this man is made whole;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se hoje somos interrogados quanto a uma boa ação [feita] a um enfermo, pela qual este foi curado;
verses.RVR09: Pues que somos hoy demandados acerca del beneficio hecho á un hombre enfermo, de qué manera éste haya sido sanado,

verses.KJV: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.WEB: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.
verses.ASV: be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, [even] in him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja conhecido a todos vós, e a todos o povo de Israel, que pelo nome de Jesus Cristo, o nazareno, aquele que vós crucificastes, ao qual Deus ressuscitou dos mortos, por ele este [homem] está são diante de vós.
verses.RVR09: Sea notorio á todos vosotros, y á todo el pueblo de Israel, que en el nombre de Jesucristo de Nazaret, al que vosotros crucificasteis y Dios le resucitó de los muertos, por él este hombre está en vuestra presencia sano.

verses.KJV: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
verses.WEB: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
verses.ASV: He is the stone which was set at nought of you the builders, which was made the head of the corner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é a pedra que foi desprezada por vós, edificadores; a qual foi feita por cabeça de esquina.
verses.RVR09: Este es la piedra reprobada de vosotros los edificadores, la cual es puesta por cabeza del ángulo.

verses.KJV: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.WEB: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
verses.ASV: And in none other is there salvation: for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, wherein we must be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em nenhum outro há salvação; porque nenhum outro nome há abaixo do céu, dado entre os seres humanos, em quem devemos ser salvos.
verses.RVR09: Y en ningún otro hay salud; porque no hay otro nombre debajo del cielo, dado á los hombres, en que podamos ser salvos.

verses.KJV: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.WEB: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
verses.ASV: Now when they beheld the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ao verem a ousadia de Pedro, e de João; e informados que eles eram homens sem instrução e ordinários, maravilharam-se; e eles sabiam que eles tinham estado com Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces viendo la constancia de Pedro y de Juan, sabido que eran hombres sin letras é ignorantes, se maravillaban; y les conocían que habían estado con Jesús.

verses.KJV: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.WEB: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.ASV: And seeing the man that was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo estar com eles o homem que tinha sido curado, nada tinham a dizer contra [eles] .
verses.RVR09: Y viendo al hombre que había sido sanado, que estaba con ellos, no podían decir nada en contra.

verses.KJV: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.WEB: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.ASV: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandando-os saírem do supremo conselho, discutiam entre si,
verses.RVR09: Mas les mandaron que se saliesen fuera del concilio; y conferían entre sí,

verses.KJV: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
verses.WEB: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
verses.ASV: saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been wrought through them, is manifest to all that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: O que faremos a estes homens? Porque um sinal notório foi feito por eles, manifesto a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém, e não podemos negar.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Qué hemos de hacer á estos hombres? porque de cierto, señal manifiesta ha sido hecha por ellos, notoria á todos los que moran en Jerusalem, y no lo podemos negar.

verses.KJV: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.WEB: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
verses.ASV: But that it spread no further among the people, let us threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas para que [esta notícia] não seja ainda mais divulgada entre o povo, façamos sérias ameaças a eles, para que nunca mais falem a ninguém neste nome.
verses.RVR09: Todavía, porque no se divulgue más por el pueblo, amenacémoslos que no hablen de aquí adelante á hombre alguno en este nombre.

verses.KJV: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.WEB: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.ASV: And they called them, and charged them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamando-os, ordenaram-lhes que nunca mais falassem nem ensinassem no nome de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y llamándolos, les intimaron que en ninguna manera hablasen ni enseñasen en el nombre de Jesús.

verses.KJV: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
verses.WEB: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
verses.ASV: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to hearken unto you rather than unto God, judge ye:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, respondendo Pedro, e João, disseram-lhes: Julgai se é justo diante de Deus, ouvir a vós mais do que a Deus;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro y Juan, respondiendo, les dijeron: Juzgad si es justo delante de Dios obedecer antes á vosotros que á Dios:

verses.KJV: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.WEB: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
verses.ASV: for we cannot but speak the things which we saw and heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós não podemos deixar de falar daquilo que temos visto e ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Porque no podemos dejar de decir lo que hemos visto y oído.

verses.KJV: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
verses.WEB: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
verses.ASV: And they, when they had further threatened them, let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people; for all men glorified God for that which was done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles, tendo os ameaçado ainda mais, nada acharam [de motivo] para os castigar, e os deixaram ir por causa do povo; porque todos glorificavam a Deus pelo que tinha acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces los despacharon amenazándolos, no hallando ningún modo de castigarlos, por causa del pueblo; porque todos glorificaban á Dios de lo que había sido hecho.

verses.KJV: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
verses.WEB: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
verses.ASV: For the man was more than forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was wrought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque era de mais de quarenta anos o homem em quem este milagre de cura tinha sido feito.
verses.RVR09: Porque el hombre en quien había sido hecho este milagro de sanidad, era de más de cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
verses.WEB: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
verses.ASV: And being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, tendo sido soltos, vieram aos seus [companheiros] , e lhes contaram tudo o que os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos tinham lhes dito.
verses.RVR09: Y sueltos, vinieron á los suyos, y contaron todo lo que los príncipes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos les habían dicho.

verses.KJV: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.WEB: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
verses.ASV: And they, when they heard it, lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, O Lord, thou that didst make the heaven and the earth and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ao ouvirem [isto] , levantaram concordantes a voz a Deus, e disseram: Senhor, tu és o Deus que fizeste o céu, a terra, o mar, e todas as coisas que neles há;
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, habiéndolo oído, alzaron unánimes la voz á Dios, y dijeron: Señor, tú eres el Dios que hiciste el cielo y la tierra, la mar, y todo lo que en ellos hay;

verses.KJV: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
verses.WEB: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
verses.ASV: who by the Holy Spirit, [by] the mouth of our father David thy servant, didst say, Why did the Gentiles rage, And the peoples imagine vain things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que pela boca de teu servo Davi disseste: Por que os gentios se irritam, e os povos gastam seus pensamentos em coisas vãs?
verses.RVR09: Que por boca de David, tu siervo, dijiste: ¿Por qué han bramado las gentes, y los pueblos han pensado cosas vanas?

verses.KJV: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
verses.WEB: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
verses.ASV: The kings of the earth set themselves in array, And the rulers were gathered together, Against the Lord, and against his Anointed:
verses.ALMEIDA: Os reis da terra se levantaram, e os príncipes se juntaram em um mesmo [propósito] contra o Senhor, e contra o seu Ungido.
verses.RVR09: Asistieron los reyes de la tierra, y los príncipes se juntaron en uno contra el Señor, y contra su Cristo.

verses.KJV: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.WEB: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
verses.ASV: for of a truth in this city against thy holy Servant Jesus, whom thou didst anoint, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque verdadeiramente contra teu Santo Filho Jesus, ao qual tu ungiste, se ajuntaram, tanto Herodes, como Pôncio Pilatos, com os gentios e os povos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Porque verdaderamente se juntaron en esta ciudad contra tu santo Hijo Jesús, al cual ungiste, Herodes y Poncio Pilato, con los Gentiles y los pueblos de Israel,

verses.KJV: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
verses.WEB: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
verses.ASV: to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel foreordained to come to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fazerem tudo o que a tua mão e o teu conselho desde antes tinha determinado para acontecer.
verses.RVR09: Para hacer lo que tu mano y tu consejo habían antes determinado que había de ser hecho.

verses.KJV: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
verses.WEB: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
verses.ASV: And now, Lord, look upon their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants to speak thy word with all boldness,
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, Senhor, observa as ameaças deles, e dá a teus servos, que com toda ousadia falem tua palavra;
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, Señor, mira sus amenazas, y da á tus siervos que con toda confianza hablen tu palabra;

verses.KJV: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
verses.WEB: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
verses.ASV: while thou stretchest forth thy hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of thy holy Servant Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estendendo tua mão para a cura, e que se façam sinais e milagres pelo nome de teu Santo filho Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Que extiendas tu mano á que sanidades, y milagros, y prodigios sean hechos por el nombre de tu santo Hijo Jesús.

verses.KJV: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.WEB: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
verses.ASV: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken wherein they were gathered together; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo orado, agitou-se o lugar em que eles estavam juntos, e foram todos cheios do Espírito Santo, e falavam a palavra de Deus com ousadia.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubieron orado, el lugar en que estaban congregados tembló; y todos fueron llenos del Espíritu Santo, y hablaron la palabra de Dios con confianza.

verses.KJV: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.WEB: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
verses.ASV: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and soul: and not one [of them] said that aught of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão dos que criam, era de um só oração e uma só alma; e ninguém dizia ser próprio coisa alguma de seus bens, mas todas as coisas lhes eram comuns.
verses.RVR09: Y la multitud de los que habían creído era de un corazón y un alma: y ninguno decía ser suyo algo de lo que poseía; mas todas las cosas les eran comunes.

verses.KJV: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.WEB: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
verses.ASV: And with great power gave the apostles their witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com grande poder os apóstolos davam testemunho da ressurreição do Senhor Jesus; e em todos eles havia grande graça.
verses.RVR09: Y los apóstoles daban testimonio de la resurrección del Señor Jesús con gran esfuerzo; y gran gracia era en todos ellos.

verses.KJV: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.WEB: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
verses.ASV: For neither was there among them any that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também nenhum necessitado havia entre eles; porque todos os que possuíam propriedades de terras, ou casas, vendendo [-as] , traziam o valor das coisas vendidas, e [o] depositavam junto aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Que ningún necesitado había entre ellos: porque todos los que poseían heredades ó casas, vendiéndolas, traían el precio de lo vendido,

verses.KJV: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
verses.WEB: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
verses.ASV: and laid them at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto each, according as any one had need.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cada um se repartia segundo cada qual tinha necessidade.
verses.RVR09: Y lo ponían á los pies de los apóstoles; y era repartido á cada uno según que había menester.

verses.KJV: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
verses.WEB: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
verses.ASV: And Joseph, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of exhortation), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
verses.ALMEIDA: E José, chamado pelos apóstolos pelo sobrenome de Barnabé (que traduzido é filho da consolação), levita, natural do Chipre,
verses.RVR09: Entonces José, que fué llamado de los apóstoles por sobrenombre, Bernabé, (que es interpretado, Hijo de consolación) Levita, natural de Cipro,

verses.KJV: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
verses.WEB: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.ASV: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo ele uma propriedade de terra, vendeu [-a] , e trouxe o valor, e [o] depositou junto aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Como tuviese una heredad, la vendió, y trajo el precio, y púsolo á los pies de los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.WEB: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.ASV: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.ALMEIDA: E um certo homem, de nome Ananias, com Safira, sua mulher, vendeu uma propriedade de terra.
verses.RVR09: MAS un varón llamado Ananías, con Safira su mujer, vendió una posesión,

verses.KJV: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
verses.WEB: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.ASV: and kept back [part] of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escondeu [parte] do valor, sabendo também a mulher dele; e trazendo uma certa parte, depositou [-a] junto aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Y defraudó del precio, sabiéndolo también su mujer; y trayendo una parte, púsola á los pies de los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.WEB: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.ASV: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thy heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back [part] of the price of the land?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro disse: Ananias, por que Satanás encheu teu coração, para que mentisses ao Espírito Santo, e escondesses [parte] do valor da propriedade?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Pedro: Ananías, ¿por qué ha llenado Satanás tu corazón á que mintieses al Espíritu Santo, y defraudases del precio de la heredad?

verses.KJV: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.WEB: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
verses.ASV: While it remained, did it not remain thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thy power? How is it that thou hast conceived this thing in thy heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Se] mantivesses [tua propriedade] , ela não seria mantida contigo? E, tendo sido vendida, [o dinheiro da venda] não estava em teu poder? Por que decidiste [isto] em teu coração? Não mentiste aos seres humanos, mas sim a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Reteniéndola, ¿no se te quedaba á ti? y vendida, ¿no estaba en tu potestad? ¿Por qué pusiste esto en tu corazón? No has mentido á los hombres, sino á Dios.

verses.KJV: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.WEB: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
verses.ASV: And Ananias hearing these words fell down and gave up the ghost: and great fear came upon all that heard it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ananias, ao ouvir estas palavras, caiu e deixou de respirar. E veio um grande temor sobre todos os que ouviram isso.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Ananías, oyendo estas palabras, cayó y espiró. Y vino un gran temor sobre todos los que lo oyeron.

verses.KJV: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
verses.WEB: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
verses.ASV: And the young men arose and wrapped him round, and they carried him out and buried him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os rapazes, tendo se levantado, levaram-no fora, e [o] sepultaram.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose los mancebos, le tomaron, y sacándolo, sepultáronlo.

verses.KJV: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.WEB: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
verses.ASV: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando o intervalo de cerca de três horas, entrou também sua mulher, não sabendo o que tinha acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Y pasado espacio como de tres horas, sucedió que entró su mujer, no sabiendo lo que había acontecido.

verses.KJV: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.WEB: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
verses.ASV: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much. And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro disse a ela: Dize-me, vendestes por [aquele] tanto aquela propriedade?E ela disse: Sim, por [aquele] tanto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro le dijo: Dime: ¿vendisteis en tanto la heredad? Y ella dijo: Sí, en tanto.

verses.KJV: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
verses.WEB: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
verses.ASV: But Peter [said] unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to try the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them that have buried thy husband are at the door, and they shall carry thee out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe disse: Por que vós fizestes acordo para tentar ao Espírito do Senhor? Eis que [estão] à porta os pés daqueles que sepultaram a teu marido, e eles também [te] levarão.
verses.RVR09: Y Pedro le dijo: ¿Por qué os concertasteis para tentar al Espíritu del Señor? He aquí á la puerta los pies de los que han sepultado á tu marido, y te sacarán.

verses.KJV: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
verses.WEB: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
verses.ASV: And she fell down immediately at his feet, and gave up the ghost: and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: E imediatamente ela caiu junto aos pés deles, e deixou de respirar. E os rapazes, ao entrarem, encontraram-na morta; e levando- [a] fora, sepultaram-na junto ao marido dela.
verses.RVR09: Y luego cayó á los pies de él, y espiró: y entrados los mancebos, la hallaron muerta; y la sacaron, y la sepultaron junto á su marido.

verses.KJV: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.WEB: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
verses.ASV: And great fear came upon the whole church, and upon all that heard these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio um grande temor em toda a igreja, e em todos que ouviram estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y vino un gran temor en toda la iglesia, y en todos los que oyeron estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
verses.WEB: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
verses.ASV: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people: and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pelas mãos dos apóstolos foram feitos muitos sinais e milagres entre o povo. E estavam todos em concordância no pórtico de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y por las manos de los apóstoles eran hechos muchos milagros y prodigios en el pueblo; y estaban todos unánimes en el pórtico de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.WEB: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
verses.ASV: But of the rest durst no man join himself to them: howbeit the people magnified them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas dos outros, ninguém ousava se juntar a eles; porém o povo os estimava grandemente.
verses.RVR09: Y de los otros, ninguno osaba juntarse con ellos; mas el pueblo los alababa grandemente.

verses.KJV: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
verses.WEB: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
verses.ASV: and believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women:
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada vez mais os que criam no Senhor se aumentavam, multidões tanto de homens como de mulheres.
