verses.RVR09: Y los que creían en el Señor se aumentaban más, gran número así de hombres como de mujeres;

verses.KJV: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verses.WEB: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
verses.ASV: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que traziam os enfermos às ruas, e os botavam em camas e macas, para que, vindo Pedro, pelo menos a sombra dele cobrisse a alguns deles.
verses.RVR09: Tanto que echaban los enfermos por las calles, y los ponían en camas y en lechos, para que viniendo Pedro, á lo menos su sombra tocase á alguno de ellos.

verses.KJV: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.WEB: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
verses.ASV: And there also came together the multitude from the cities round about Jerusalem, bringing sick folk, and them that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também das cidades vizinhas vinha uma multidão a Jerusalém, trazendo enfermos, e atormentados por espíritos imundos, os quais todos eram curados.
verses.RVR09: Y aun de las ciudades vecinas concurría multitud á Jerusalem, trayendo enfermos y atormentados de espíritus inmundos; los cuales todos eran curados.

verses.KJV: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
verses.WEB: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy
verses.ASV: But the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se o sumo sacerdote, e todos os que estavam com ele (que eram do grupo sectário dos saduceus), eles se encheram de inveja.
verses.RVR09: Entonces levantándose el príncipe de los sacerdotes, y todos los que estaban con él, que es la secta de los Saduceos, se llenaron de celo;

verses.KJV: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.WEB: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
verses.ASV: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram suas mãos nos apóstolos, e os colocaram na prisão pública.
verses.RVR09: Y echaron mano á los apóstoles, y pusiéronlos en la cárcel pública.

verses.KJV: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
verses.WEB: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
verses.ASV: But an angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them out, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas um anjo do Senhor, durante a noite, abriu as portas da prisão; e levando-os para fora, disse:
verses.RVR09: Mas el ángel del Señor, abriendo de noche las puertas de la cárcel, y sacándolos, dijo:

verses.KJV: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.WEB: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
verses.ASV: Go ye, and stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this Life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide; ficai em pé, e falai no Templo ao povo todas as palavras desta vida.
verses.RVR09: Id, y estando en el templo, hablad al pueblo todas las palabras de esta vida.

verses.KJV: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.WEB: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.ASV: And when they heard [this], they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison-house to have them brought.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ouvindo [isto] , entraram de manhã cedo no templo, e ensinavam. Mas vindo o sumo sacerdote, e os que estavam com ele, chamaram ao supremo conselho, e a todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel, e mandaram à prisão, para que os trouxessem.
verses.RVR09: Y oído que hubieron esto, entraron de mañana en el templo, y enseñaban. Entre tanto, viniendo el príncipe de los sacerdotes, y los que eran con él, convocaron el concilio, y á todos los ancianos de los hijos de Israel, y enviaron á la cárcel para que fuesen traídos.

verses.KJV: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned and told,
verses.WEB: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
verses.ASV: But the officers that came found them not in the prison; and they returned, and told,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando os oficiais vieram, não os acharam na prisão; e voltando, anunciaram,
verses.RVR09: Mas como llegaron los ministros, y no los hallaron en la cárcel, volvieron, y dieron aviso,

verses.KJV: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.WEB: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
verses.ASV: saying, The prison-house we found shut in all safety, and the keepers standing at the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Nós achamos a prisão fechada, em toda segurança, e com os guardas que estavam fora junto às portas; mas quando [as] abrimos, a ninguém achamos dentro.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Por cierto, la cárcel hemos hallado cerrada con toda seguridad, y los guardas que estaban delante de las puertas; mas cuando abrimos, á nadie hallamos dentro.

verses.KJV: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.WEB: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
verses.ASV: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were much perplexed concerning them whereunto this would grow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o [sumo] sacerdote, o chefe da guarda do Templo, e os chefes dos sacerdotes ouviram estas palavras, eles duvidaram deles quanto o que aquilo viria a ser.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando oyeron estas palabras el pontífice y el magistrado del templo y los príncipes de los sacerdotes, dudaban en qué vendría á parar aquello.

verses.KJV: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.WEB: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
verses.ASV: And there came one and told them, Behold, the men whom ye put in the prison are in the temple standing and teaching the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo alguém, anunciou-lhes, dizendo: Eis que os homens que vós pusestes na prisão estão no Templo, e ensinam ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Pero viniendo uno, dióles esta noticia: He aquí, los varones que echasteis en la cárcel, están en el templo, y enseñan al pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.WEB: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
verses.ASV: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them, [but] without violence; for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então foi o chefe da guarda do Templo com os oficiais, e os trouxe, [mas] não com violência, porque temiam ao povo, para que não fossem apedrejados.
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué el magistrado con los ministros, y trájolos sin violencia; porque temían del pueblo ser apedreados.

verses.KJV: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.WEB: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
verses.ASV: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os trouxeram, apresentaram-nos ao supremo conselho. E o sumo sacerdote perguntou a eles, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y como los trajeron, los presentaron en el concilio: y el príncipe de los sacerdotes les preguntó,

verses.KJV: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
verses.WEB: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
verses.ASV: saying, We strictly charged you not to teach in this name: and behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos ordenamos expressamente para não ensinardes [mais] neste nome? E eis que vós enchestes a Jerusalém com vossa doutrina, e quereis trazer sobre nós o sangue deste homem!
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿No os denunciamos estrechamente, que no enseñaseis en este nombre? y he aquí, habéis llenado á Jerusalem de vuestra doctrina, y queréis echar sobre nosotros la sangre de este hombre.

verses.KJV: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.WEB: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
verses.ASV: But Peter and the apostles answered and said, We must obey God rather than men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, respondendo com os apóstolos, disseram: Maior obrigação é obedecer a Deus do que às pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Pedro y los apóstoles, dijeron: Es menester obedecer á Dios antes que á los hombres.

verses.KJV: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.WEB: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
verses.ASV: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew, hanging him on a tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus de nossos Pais ressuscitou a Jesus, ao qual vós matastes, pendurando [-o] no madeiro.
verses.RVR09: El Dios de nuestros padres levantó á Jesús, al cual vosotros matasteis colgándole en un madero.

verses.KJV: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.WEB: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
verses.ASV: Him did God exalt with his right hand [to be] a Prince and a Saviour, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este Deus exaltou com sua [mão] direita [por] Príncipe e Salvador, para dar a Israel arrependimento e perdão de pecados.
verses.RVR09: A éste ha Dios ensalzado con su diestra por Príncipe y Salvador, para dar á Israel arrepentimiento y remisión de pecados.

verses.KJV: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.WEB: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
verses.ASV: And we are witnesses of these things; and [so is] the Holy Spirit, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós somos testemunhas dele quanto a estas palavras, e também o Espírito Santo, o qual Deus tem dado a aqueles que lhe obedecem.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros somos testigos suyos de estas cosas, y también el Espíritu Santo, el cual ha dado Dios á los que le obedecen.

verses.KJV: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.WEB: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
verses.ASV: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were minded to slay them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ouvindo [isso] , enfureceram-se grandemente, e planejaram matá-los.
verses.RVR09: Ellos, oyendo esto, regañaban, y consultaban matarlos.

verses.KJV: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.WEB: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
verses.ASV: But there stood up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in honor of all the people, and commanded to put the men forth a little while.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, levantando-se no supremo conselho um certo fariseu, de nome Gamaliel, instrutor da Lei, bem honrado por todo o povo, ele mandou levarem aos apóstolos para fora por um pouco [de tempo] .
verses.RVR09: Entonces levantándose en el concilio un Fariseo llamado Gamaliel, doctor de la ley, venerable á todo el pueblo, mandó que sacasen fuera un poco á los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves as touching these men, what ye are about to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes disse: Homens israelitas, olhai por vós mesmos, quanto ao que haveis de fazer a estes homens;
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Varones Israelitas, mirad por vosotros acerca de estos hombres en lo que habéis de hacer.

verses.KJV: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
verses.WEB: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
verses.ASV: For before these days rose up Theudas, giving himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque antes destes dias se levantou Teudas, dizendo ser alguém; ao qual se ajuntaram cerca de quatrocentos homens; ao qual foi morto, e todos os que acreditavam [nele] foram dispersos, e reduzidos a nada.
verses.RVR09: Porque antes de estos días se levantó Teudas, diciendo que era alguien; al que se agregó un número de hombres como cuatrocientos: el cual fué matado; y todos los que le creyeron fueron dispersos, y reducidos á nada.

verses.KJV: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
verses.WEB: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
verses.ASV: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the enrolment, and drew away [some of the] people after him: he also perished; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois deste se levantou Judas, o galileu, nos dias do censo; e perverteu muito do povo atrás dele; e este também pereceu, e todos os que acreditavam nele foram dispersos.
verses.RVR09: Después de éste, se levantó Judas el Galileo en los días del empadronamiento, y llevó mucho pueblo tras sí. Pereció también aquél; y todos los que consintieron con él, fueron derramados.

verses.KJV: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.WEB: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
verses.ASV: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will be overthrown:
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, eu vos digo, afastai-vos destes homens, e deixai-os; porque se este conselho ou esta obra for humana, ela se desfará.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora os digo: Dejaos de estos hombres, y dejadlos; porque si este consejo ó esta obra es de los hombres, se desvanecerá:

verses.KJV: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.WEB: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
verses.ASV: but if it is of God, ye will not be able to overthrow them; lest haply ye be found even to be fighting against God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se é de Deus, vós não a podereis desfazer; para que não venhais a ser achados de também lutardes contra Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas si es de Dios, no la podréis deshacer; no seáis tal vez hallados resistiendo á Dios.

verses.KJV: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.WEB: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.ASV: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles unto them, they beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concordaram com ele. E chamando aos apóstolos, tendo [os] açoitado, mandaram [-lhes] que não [mais] falassem no nome de Jesus; e os deixaram ir.
verses.RVR09: Y convinieron con él: y llamando á los apóstoles, después de azotados, les intimaron que no hablasen en el nombre de Jesús, y soltáronlos.

verses.KJV: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.WEB: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
verses.ASV: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the Name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles saíram da presença do supremo conselho, alegres por terem sido considerados dignos de serem humilhados por causa do nome dele.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos partieron de delante del concilio, gozosos de que fuesen tenidos por dignos de padecer afrenta por el Nombre.

verses.KJV: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
verses.ASV: And every day, in the temple and at home, they ceased not to teach and to preach Jesus [as] the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os dias no Templo, e pelas casas, não paravam de ensinar e de anunciar a Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los días, en el templo y por las casas, no cesaban de enseñar y predicar á Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.WEB: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
verses.ASV: Now in these days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, there arose a murmuring of the Grecian Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naqueles dias, ao se multiplicar [o número] de discípulos, houve uma murmuração dos gregos contra os hebreus, de que suas viúvas estavam sendo desprezadas no serviço diário [de entrega de comida] .
verses.RVR09: EN aquellos días, creciendo el número de los discípulos, hubo murmuración de los Griegos contra los Hebreos, de que sus viudas eran menospreciadas en el ministerio cotidiano.

verses.KJV: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.WEB: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
verses.ASV: And the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not fit that we should forsake the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os doze, chamando à multidão dos discípulos, disseram: Não é bom que nós deixemos a palavra de Deus para servirmos às mesas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, los doce convocaron la multitud de los discípulos, y dijeron: No es justo que nosotros dejemos la palabra de Dios, y sirvamos á las mesas.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.WEB: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.ASV: Look ye out therefore, brethren, from among you seven men of good report, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, buscai sete homens dentre vós, de quem haja [bom] testemunho, cheios do Espírito Santo e de sabedoria, aos quais constituamos sobre esta importante tarefa.
verses.RVR09: Buscad pues, hermanos, siete varones de vosotros de buen testimonio, llenos de Espíritu Santo y de sabiduría, los cuales pongamos en esta obra.

verses.KJV: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.WEB: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
verses.ASV: But we will continue stedfastly in prayer, and in the ministry of the word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós, porém, perseveraremos na oração e no serviço da palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros persistiremos en la oración, y en el ministerio de la palabra.

verses.KJV: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.WEB: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
verses.ASV: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolaüs a proselyte of Antioch;
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta palavra foi do agrado diante de toda a multidão, e escolheram a Estêvão, homem cheio de fé e do Espírito Santo, e Filipe, Prócoro, Nicanor, Timom, Parmenas e a Nicolão, o prosélito de Antioquia.
verses.RVR09: Y plugo el parecer á toda la multitud; y eligieron á Esteban, varón lleno de fe y de Espíritu Santo, y á Felipe, y á Prócoro, y á Nicanor, y á Timón, y á Parmenas, y á Nicolás, prosélito de Antioquía:

verses.KJV: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.WEB: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.ASV: whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais se apresentaram diante dos apóstolos; e eles, orando, puseram as mãos sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: A estos presentaron delante de los apóstoles, los cuales orando les pusieron las manos encima.

verses.KJV: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.WEB: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.ASV: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra de Deus crescia, e o número dos discípulos se multiplicava muito em Jerusalém; e grande multidão dos sacerdotes obedecia à fé.
verses.RVR09: Y crecía la palabra del Señor, y el número de los discípulos se multiplicaba mucho en Jerusalem: también una gran multitud de los sacerdotes obedecía á la fe.

verses.KJV: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.WEB: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.ASV: And Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Estêvão, cheio de fé e poder, fazia milagres e grandes sinais entre o povo.
verses.RVR09: Empero Esteban, lleno de gracia y de potencia, hacía prodigios y milagros grandes en el pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.WEB: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
verses.ASV: But there arose certain of them that were of the synagogue called [the synagogue] of the Libertines, and of the Cyrenians, and of the Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantaram-se alguns da sinagoga, [que era] chamada [sinagoga] dos libertos, cireneus, e alexandrinos, e dos [que eram] da Cilícia, e da Ásia, e discutiam contra Estêvão.
verses.RVR09: Levantáronse entonces unos de la sinagoga que se llama de los Libertinos, y Cireneos, y Alejandrinos, y de los de Cilicia, y de Asia, disputando con Esteban.

verses.KJV: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.WEB: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
verses.ASV: And they were not able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles não podiam resistir à sabedoria e ao Espírito com que ele falava.
verses.RVR09: Mas no podían resistir á la sabiduría y al Espíritu con que hablaba.

verses.KJV: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
verses.WEB: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
verses.ASV: Then they suborned men, who said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and [against] God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles subornaram a uns homens, [para que] dissessem: Nós o ouvimos falando palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e [contra] Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces sobornaron á unos que dijesen que le habían oído hablar palabras blasfemas contra Moisés y Dios.

verses.KJV: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
verses.WEB: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
verses.ASV: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and seized him, and brought him into the council,
verses.ALMEIDA: E incitaram ao povo, aos anciãos e aos escribas; e vieram sobre [Estêvão] , e o detiveram, e o levaram ao supremo conselho.
verses.RVR09: Y conmovieron al pueblo, y á los ancianos, y á los escribas; y arremetiendo le arrebataron, y le trajeron al concilio.

verses.KJV: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.WEB: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
verses.ASV: and set up false witnesses, who said, This man ceaseth not to speak words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.ALMEIDA: E apresentaram falsas testemunhas, que diziam: Este homem não para de falar palavras blasfemas contra este santo lugar, e [contra] a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron testigos falsos, que dijesen: Este hombre no cesa de hablar palabras blasfemas contra este lugar santo y la ley:

verses.KJV: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
verses.WEB: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
verses.ASV: for we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós o ouvimos dizer que este Jesus Nazareno vai destruir este lugar, e mudar os costumes que Moisés nos entregou.
verses.RVR09: Porque le hemos oído decir, que este Jesús de Nazaret destruirá este lugar, y mudará las ordenanzas que nos dió Moisés.

verses.KJV: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.WEB: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
verses.ASV: And all that sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todos os que estavam sentados no supremo conselho, observando-o com atenção, viram o rosto dele como de um anjo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos los que estaban sentados en el concilio, puestos los ojos en él, vieron su rostro como el rostro de un ángel.

verses.KJV: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.WEB: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
verses.ASV: And the high priest said, Are these things so?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o chefe dos sacerdotes: Por acaso é isto assim?
verses.RVR09: EL príncipe de los sacerdotes dijo entonces: ¿Es esto así?

verses.KJV: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.WEB: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
verses.ASV: And he said, Brethren and fathers, hearken: The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Homens irmãos e pais, ouvi: o Deus da glória apareceu a nosso pai Abraão, estando ele na Mesopotâmia, antes de habitar em Harã;
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Varones hermanos y padres, oid: El Dios de la gloria apareció á nuestro padre Abraham, estando en Mesopotamia, antes que morase en Chârán,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.WEB: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
verses.ASV: and said unto him, Get thee out of thy land, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall show thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Sai de tua terra, e de tua parentela, e vem a terra que eu te mostrarei.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo: Sal de tu tierra y de tu parentela, y ven á la tierra que te mostraré.

verses.KJV: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.WEB: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
verses.ASV: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Haran: and from thence, when his father was dead, [God] removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele saiu da terra dos caldeus, [e] habitou em Harã. E dali, depois que morreu seu pai, ele partiu para esta terra, em que agora vós habitais.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salió de la tierra de los Caldeos, y habitó en Chârán: y de allí, muerto su padre, le traspasó á esta tierra, en la cual vosotros habitáis ahora;

verses.KJV: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.WEB: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
verses.ASV: and he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: and he promised that he would give it to him in possession, and to his seed after him, when [as yet] he had no child.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Deus] não lhe deu herança nela, nem mesmo a pegada de um pé; mas prometeu que a daria a ele em propriedade, e a sua semente depois dele, não tendo ele filho [ainda] .
verses.RVR09: Y no le dió herencia en ella, ni aun para asentar un pie: mas le prometió que se la daría en posesión, y á su simiente después de él, no teniendo hijo.

verses.KJV: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.WEB: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
verses.ASV: And God spake on this wise, that his seed should sojourn in a strange land, and that they should bring them into bondage, and treat them ill, four hundred years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus falou assim: Tua semente será peregrina em terra alheia, e a escravizarão, e a maltratarão [por] quatrocentos anos.
verses.RVR09: Y hablóle Dios así: Que su simiente sería extranjera en tierra ajena, y que los reducirían á servidumbre y maltratarían, por cuatrocientos años.

verses.KJV: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.WEB: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
verses.ASV: And the nation to which they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à nação a quem eles servirem, eu a julgarei, (disse Deus). E depois disso eles sairão, e me servirão neste lugar.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo juzgaré, dijo Dios, la nación á la cual serán siervos: y después de esto saldrán y me servirán en este lugar.

verses.KJV: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
verses.WEB: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
verses.ASV: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so [Abraham] begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac [begat] Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe deu o pacto da circuncisão; e assim gerou a Isaque, e o circuncidou ao oitavo dia; e Isaque [gerou] a Jacó, e Jacó aos doze patriarcas.
verses.RVR09: Y dióle el pacto de la circuncisión: y así Abraham engendró á Isaac, y le circuncidó al octavo día; é Isaac á Jacob, y Jacob á los doce patriarcas.

verses.KJV: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.WEB: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
verses.ASV: And the patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt: and God was with him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os patriarcas, tendo inveja [de] José, venderam [-no] ao Egito; mas Deus era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y los patriarcas, movidos de envidia, vendieron á José para Egipto; mas Dios era con él,

verses.KJV: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.WEB: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.ASV: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o livrou de todas as suas aflições, e lhe deu graça e sabedoria diante de Faraó, rei do Egito; e o pôs [por] governador sobre o Egito, e toda a sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y le libró de todas sus tribulaciones, y le dió gracia y sabiduría en la presencia de Faraón, rey de Egipto, el cual le puso por gobernador sobre Egipto, y sobre toda su casa.

verses.KJV: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.WEB: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
verses.ASV: Now there came a famine over all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio fome sobre toda a terra do Egito e de Canaã, e grande aflição; e nossos pais não achavam alimentos.
verses.RVR09: Vino entonces hambre en toda la tierra de Egipto y de Canaán, y grande tribulación; y nuestros padres no hallaban alimentos.

verses.KJV: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.WEB: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
verses.ASV: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent forth our fathers the first time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jacó, ao ouvir que havia cereal no Egito, ele enviou nossos pais a primeira vez.
verses.RVR09: Y como oyese Jacob que había trigo en Egipto, envió á nuestros padres la primera vez.

verses.KJV: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s race became manifest unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na segunda [vez] ,José foi reconhecido pelos seus irmãos, e a família de José foi conhecia por Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y en la segunda, José fué conocido de sus hermanos, y fué sabido de Faraón el linaje de José.

verses.KJV: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.WEB: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
verses.ASV: And Joseph sent, and called to him Jacob his father, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José mandou chamar a seu pai Jacó, e toda a sua parentela, setenta e cinco almas.
verses.RVR09: Y enviando José, hizo venir á su padre Jacob, y á toda su parentela, en número de setenta y cinco personas.

verses.KJV: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.WEB: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
verses.ASV: And Jacob went down into Egypt; and he died, himself and our fathers;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó desceu ao Egito, e morreu; ele, e nossos pais;
verses.RVR09: Así descendió Jacob á Egipto, donde murió él y nuestros padres;

verses.KJV: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
verses.WEB: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
verses.ASV: and they were carried over unto Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver of the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram levados a Siquém, e postos na sepultura que Abraão, por uma quantia em dinheiro, tinha comprado dos filhos de Emor, [pai] de Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales fueron trasladados á Sichêm, y puestos en el sepulcro que compró Abraham á precio de dinero de los hijos de Hemor de Sichêm.

verses.KJV: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.WEB: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.ASV: But as the time of the promise drew nigh which God vouchsafed unto Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando chegou perto o tempo da promessa que Deus tinha prometido a Abraão, o povo cresceu e se multiplicou no Egito.
verses.RVR09: Mas como se acercaba el tiempo de la promesa, la cual Dios había jurado á Abraham, el pueblo creció y multiplicóse en Egipto,

verses.KJV: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.WEB: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
verses.ASV: till there arose another king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que se levantou outro rei, que não tinha conhecido a José.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que se levantó otro rey en Egipto que no conocía á José.

verses.KJV: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.WEB: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
verses.ASV: The same dealt craftily with our race, and ill-treated our fathers, that they should cast out their babes to the end they might not live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este, usando de astúcia para com nossa parentela, maltratou a nossos pais, até fazendo com que eles rejeitassem suas crianças, para que não sobrevivessem.
verses.RVR09: Este, usando de astucia con nuestro linaje, maltrató á nuestros padres, á fin de que pusiesen á peligro de muerte sus niños, para que cesase la generación.

verses.KJV: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
verses.WEB: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
verses.ASV: At which season Moses was born, and was exceeding fair; and he was nourished three months in his father’s house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo nasceu Moisés, e ele era muito formoso para Deus, e ele foi criado por três meses na casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: En aquel mismo tiempo nació Moisés, y fué agradable á Dios: y fué criado tres meses en casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.WEB: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
verses.ASV: and when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo sido abandonado, a filha de Faraó o tomou, e o criou para si como filho.
verses.RVR09: Mas siendo puesto al peligro, la hija de Faraón le tomó, y le crió como á hijo suyo.

verses.KJV: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.WEB: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
verses.ASV: And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians; and he was mighty in his words and works.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés foi instruído em toda a sabedoria dos egípcios; e era poderoso em palavras e ações.
verses.RVR09: Y fué enseñado Moisés en toda la sabiduría de los egipcios; y era poderoso en sus dichos y hechos.

verses.KJV: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: But when he was well-nigh forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando lhe foi completado o tempo de quarenta anos [de idade] , veio ao seu coração [o desejo] de visitar a seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubo cumplido la edad de cuarenta años, le vino voluntad de visitar á sus hermanos los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.WEB: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
verses.ASV: And seeing one [of them] suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, smiting the Egyptian:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo um [deles] sofrendo injustamente, defendeu [-o] , e vingou pelo que tinha sido oprimido, matando ao egípcio.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió á uno que era injuriado, defendióle, é hiriendo al Egipcio, vengó al injuriado.

verses.KJV: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
verses.WEB: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
verses.ASV: and he supposed that his brethren understood that God by his hand was giving them deliverance; but they understood not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele pensava que seus irmãos tivessem entendido que Deus ia lhes dar liberdade por meio da mão dele; mas eles não entenderam.
verses.RVR09: Pero él pensaba que sus hermanos entendían que Dios les había de dar salud por su mano; mas ellos no lo habían entendido.

verses.KJV: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.WEB: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
verses.ASV: And the day following he appeared unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte, estando [uns deles] lutando, ele foi visto por eles, e ordenou-lhes [fazerem] as pazes, dizendo: Homens, vós sois irmãos, por que fazeis mal um ao outro?
verses.RVR09: Y al día siguiente, riñendo ellos, se les mostró, y los ponía en paz, diciendo: Varones, hermanos sois, ¿por qué os injuriáis los unos á los otros?

verses.KJV: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.WEB: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.ASV: But he that did his neighbor wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que maltratava a seu próximo empurrou-o, dizendo: Quem te pôs por chefe e juiz sobre nós?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el que injuriaba á su prójimo, le rempujó, diciendo: ¿Quién te ha puesto por príncipe y juez sobre nosotros?

verses.KJV: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.WEB: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.ASV: Wouldest thou kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.ALMEIDA: Queres tu [também] matar a mim, assim como ontem mataste ao egípcio?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quieres tú matarme, como mataste ayer al Egipcio?

verses.KJV: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.WEB: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
verses.ASV: And Moses fled at this saying, and became a sojourner in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com esta palavra Moisés fugiu, e foi peregrino na terra de Midiã, onde ele gerou dois filhos.
verses.RVR09: A esta palabra Moisés huyó, y se hizo extranjero en tierra de Madián, donde engendró dos hijos.

verses.KJV: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.WEB: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.ASV: And when forty years were fulfilled, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.ALMEIDA: E completados quarenta anos, um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu no deserto do monte Sinai, em uma sarça inflamada.
verses.RVR09: Y cumplidos cuarenta años, un ángel le apareció en el desierto del monte Sina, en fuego de llama de una zarza.

verses.KJV: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
verses.WEB: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
verses.ASV: And when Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold, there came a voice of the Lord,
verses.ALMEIDA: Moisés, ao ver [isso] ,maravilhou-se da visão; e ao aproximar-se para ver, veio até ele a voz do Senhor,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés mirando, se maravilló de la visión: y llegándose para considerar, fué hecha á él voz del Señor:

verses.KJV: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.WEB: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
verses.ASV: I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob. And Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Eu [sou] o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés, estando tremendo, não ousava olhar com atenção.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el Dios de tus padres, el Dios de Abraham, y el Dios de Isaac, y el Dios de Jacob. Mas Moisés, temeroso, no osaba mirar.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.WEB: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
verses.ASV: And the Lord said unto him, Loose the shoes from thy feet: for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor lhe disse: Descalça-te as sandálias de teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo el Señor: Quita los zapatos de tus pies, porque el lugar en que estás es tierra santa.

verses.KJV: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.WEB: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
verses.ASV: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning, and I am come down to deliver them: and now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tenho visto com atenção a aflição de meu povo que [está] no Egito, e ouvi o gemido deles, e eu desci para livrá-los; então vem agora, eu te enviarei ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: He visto, he visto la aflicción de mi pueblo que está en Egipto, y he oído el gemido de ellos, y he descendido para librarlos. Ahora pues, ven, te enviaré á Egipto.

verses.KJV: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.WEB: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
verses.ASV: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? him hath God sent [to be] both a ruler and a deliverer with the hand of the angel that appeared to him in the bush.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este Moisés, ao qual tinham negado, dizendo: Quem te pôs por chefe e juiz, A este Deus enviou por chefe e libertador, pela mão do anjo que lhe apareceu na sarça.
verses.RVR09: A este Moisés, al cual habían rehusado, diciendo: ¿Quién te ha puesto por príncipe y juez? á éste envió Dios por príncipe y redentor con la mano del ángel que le apareció en la zarza.

verses.KJV: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.WEB: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
verses.ASV: This man led them forth, having wrought wonders and signs in Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este os levou para fora, fazendo milagres e sinais na terra do Egito, e no mar Vermelho, e no deserto, [por] quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Este los sacó, habiendo hecho prodigios y milagros en la tierra de Egipto, y en el mar Bermejo, y en el desierto por cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
verses.WEB: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
verses.ASV: This is that Moses, who said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o Moisés que disse aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor, vosso Deus, vos levantará um profeta dentre vossos irmãos, como a mim; a ele ouvireis.
verses.RVR09: Este es el Moisés, el cual dijo á los hijos de Israel: Profeta os levantará el Señor Dios vuestro de vuestros hermanos, como yo; á él oiréis.

verses.KJV: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.WEB: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
verses.ASV: This is he that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel that spake to him in the mount Sinai, and with our fathers: who received living oracles to give unto us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele que esteve na congregação [do povo] no deserto com o anjo que tinha lhe falado no monte Sinai, e [com] nossos pais; o qual recebeu as palavras vivas, para dar a nós;
verses.RVR09: Este es aquél que estuvo en la congregación en el desierto con el ángel que le hablaba en el monte Sina, y con nuestros padres; y recibió las palabras de vida para darnos:

verses.KJV: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.WEB: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
verses.ASV: to whom our fathers would not be obedient, but thrust him from them, and turned back in their hearts unto Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual nossos pais não quiseram obedecer; mas [o] rejeitaram, e seus corações voltaram ao Egito;
verses.RVR09: Al cual nuestros padres no quisieron obedecer; antes le desecharon, y se apartaron de corazón á Egipto,

verses.KJV: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.WEB: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
verses.ASV: saying unto Aaron, Make us gods that shall go before us: for as for this Moses, who led us forth out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao dizerem a Arão: Faz-nos deuses, que irão adiante de nós; porque [quanto a] este Moisés, que nos levou para fora da terra do Egito, nós não sabemos o que aconteceu com ele.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo á Aarón: Haznos dioses que vayan delante de nosotros; porque á este Moisés, que nos sacó de tierra de Egipto, no sabemos qué le ha acontecido.

verses.KJV: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.WEB: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
verses.ASV: And they made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naqueles dias eles fizeram o bezerro, o ofereceram sacrifício ao ídolo, e se alegraram nas obras de suas [próprias] mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces hicieron un becerro, y ofrecieron sacrificio al ídolo, y en las obras de sus manos se holgaron.

verses.KJV: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
verses.WEB: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.ASV: But God turned, and gave them up to serve the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, Did ye offer unto me slain beasts and sacrifices Forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus se afastou[deles] , e os entregou, para que servissem ao exército do céu, como está escrito no livro dos profetas: Ó casa de Israel, acaso foi a mim que oferecestes animais sacrificados, e ofertas no deserto por quarenta anos?
verses.RVR09: Y Dios se apartó, y los entregó que sirviesen al ejército del cielo; como está escrito en el libro de los profetas: ¿Me ofrecisteis víctimas y sacrificios en el desierto por cuarenta años, casa de Israel?

verses.KJV: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.WEB: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
verses.ASV: And ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, And the star of the god Rephan, The figures which ye made to worship them: And I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tomastes [para si] a tenda de Moloque, e a estrela de vosso Deus Renfã, figuras que vós fizeste para adorá-las; e eu [por isso] vos expulsarei para além da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Antes, trajisteis el tabernáculo de Moloch, y la estrella de vuestro dios Remphan: figuras que os hicisteis para adorarlas: os transportaré pues, más allá de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
verses.WEB: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
verses.ASV: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he appointed who spake unto Moses, that he should make it according to the figure that he had seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: No deserto estava entre nossos pais o Tabernáculo do testemunho, assim como ele tinha ordenado, falando a Moisés, que o fizesse segundo o modelo que tinha visto.
verses.RVR09: Tuvieron nuestros padres el tabernáculo del testimonio en el desierto, como había ordenado Dios, hablando á Moisés que lo hiciese según la forma que había visto.

verses.KJV: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.WEB: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
verses.ASV: Which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered on the possession of the nations, that God thrust out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, recebendo [-o] também nossos Pais, eles levaram com Josué para a possessão dos gentios que Deus expulsou diante de nossos Pais, até os dias de Davi;
verses.RVR09: El cual recibido, metieron también nuestros padres con Josué en la posesión de los Gentiles, que Dios echó de la presencia de nuestros padres, hasta los días de David;

verses.KJV: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
verses.ASV: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual foi do agrado diante de Deus, e pediu para achar um tabernáculo para o Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: El cual halló gracia delante de Dios, y pidió hallar tabernáculo para el Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.WEB: But Solomon built him a house.
verses.ASV: But Solomon built him a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão lhe construiu uma casa.
verses.RVR09: Mas Salomón le edificó casa.

verses.KJV: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.WEB: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
verses.ASV: Howbeit the Most High dwelleth not in [houses] made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o Altíssimo não habita em templos feitos por mãos, assim como o profeta diz:
verses.RVR09: Si bien el Altísimo no habita en templos hechos de mano; como el profeta dice:

verses.KJV: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
verses.WEB: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
verses.ASV: The heaven is my throne, And the earth the footstool of my feet: What manner of house will ye build me? saith the Lord: Or what is the place of my rest?
verses.ALMEIDA: O céu é o meu trono, e a terra [é] o estrado dos meus pés; que casa vós construireis para mim?, diz o Senhor; ou Qual é o lugar do meu repouso?
verses.RVR09: El cielo es mi trono, y la tierra es el estrado de mis pies. ¿Qué casa me edificaréis? dice el Señor; ¿ó cuál es el lugar de mi reposo?

verses.KJV: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.WEB: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
verses.ASV: Did not my hand make all these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não [foi] minhão mão [que] fez todas estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: ¿No hizo mi mano todas estas cosas?

verses.KJV: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.WEB: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
verses.ASV: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Spirit: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, obstinados e incircuncisos de coração e de ouvidos! Vós sempre resistis ao Espírito Santo! Tal como vossos pais [foram] , assim também [sois] vós!
verses.RVR09: Duros de cerviz, é incircuncisos de corazón y de oídos, vosotros resistís siempre al Espíritu Santo: como vuestros padres, así también vosotros.

verses.KJV: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.WEB: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
verses.ASV: Which of the prophets did not your fathers persecute? and they killed them that showed before of the coming of the Righteous One; of whom ye have now become betrayers and murderers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual dos profetas vossos pais não perseguiram? E eles mataram a todos os que anunciaram com antecedência a vinda do Justo, do qual agora vós tendes sido traidores e homicidas;
verses.RVR09: ¿A cuál de los profetas no persiguieron vuestros padres? y mataron á los que antes anunciaron la venida del Justo, del cual vosotros ahora habéis sido entregadores y matadores;

verses.KJV: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
verses.WEB: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
verses.ASV: ye who received the law as it was ordained by angels, and kept it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que recebestes a Lei por ordem de anjos, e não [a] guardastes.
verses.RVR09: Que recibisteis la ley por disposición de ángeles, y no la guardasteis.

verses.KJV: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.WEB: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
verses.ASV: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, ao ouvirem estas coisas, retalharam-se de raiva em seus corações, e rangiam os dentes contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo estas cosas, regañaban de sus corazones, y crujían los dientes contra él.

verses.KJV: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.WEB: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.ASV: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, estando cheio do Espírito Santo, olhando firmemente para o céu, viu à glória de Deus, e a Jesus, que estava à direita de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, estando lleno de Espíritu Santo, puestos los ojos en el cielo, vió la gloria de Dios, y á Jesús que estaba á la diestra de Dios,

verses.KJV: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.WEB: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
verses.ASV: and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eis que vejo os céus abertos, e o Filho do homem, que está a direita de Deus!
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: He aquí, veo los cielos abiertos, y al Hijo del hombre que está á la diestra de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.WEB: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
verses.ASV: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed upon him with one accord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles, clamando com alta voz, taparam seus próprios ouvidos, e correram juntos contra ele;
verses.RVR09: Entonces dando grandes voces, se taparon sus oídos, y arremetieron unánimes contra él;

verses.KJV: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.WEB: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.ASV: and they cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, lançando [-o] fora da cidade, [o] apedrejaram; e as testemunhas puseram as roupas deles junto aos pés de um rapaz chamado Saulo.
verses.RVR09: Y echándolo fuera de la ciudad, le apedreaban: y los testigos pusieron sus vestidos á los pies de un mancebo que se llamaba Saulo.

verses.KJV: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.WEB: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
verses.ASV: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon [the Lord], and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apedrejaram a Estêvão, que estava clamando e dizendo: Senhor Jesus, recebe o meu espírito.
verses.RVR09: Y apedrearon á Esteban, invocando él y diciendo: Señor Jesús, recibe mi espíritu.

verses.KJV: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.WEB: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.ASV: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pondo-se de joelhos, clamou com alta voz: Senhor, não os culpes por este pecado.E tendo dito isto, morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y puesto de rodillas, clamó á gran voz: Señor, no les imputes este pecado. Y habiendo dicho esto, durmió.

verses.KJV: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.WEB: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
verses.ASV: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And there arose on that day a great persecution against the church which was in Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saulo também consentia na morte dele. E naquele dia foi feita uma grande perseguição contra a igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e todos foram dispersos pelas regiões da Judeia, e de Samaria, exceto os apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Y SAULO consentía en su muerte. Y en aquel día se hizo una grande persecución en la iglesia que estaba en Jerusalem; y todos fueron esparcidos por las tierras de Judea y de Samaria, salvo los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.WEB: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
verses.ASV: And devout men buried Stephen, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [alguns] homens devotos levaram juntos a Estêvão [para enterrá-lo] ,e fizeram grande pranto por causa dele.
verses.RVR09: Y llevaron á enterrar á Esteban varones piadosos, é hicieron gran llanto sobre él.

verses.KJV: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
verses.WEB: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
verses.ASV: But Saul laid waste the church, entering into every house, and dragging men and women committed them to prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saulo tentava destruir a igreja, entrando nas casas, e puxando a homens e mulheres, entregava-os à prisão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saulo asolaba la iglesia, entrando por las casas: y trayendo hombres y mujeres, los entregaba en la cárcel.

verses.KJV: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.WEB: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
verses.ASV: They therefore that were scattered abroad went about preaching the word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que, pois, estavam dispersos, passavam anunciando a palavra.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que fueron esparcidos, iban por todas partes anunciando la palabra.

verses.KJV: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
verses.WEB: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
verses.ASV: And Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed unto them the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Filipe, tendo descido à cidade de Samaria, pregava-lhes a Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Felipe, descendiendo á la ciudad de Samaria, les predicaba á Cristo.

verses.KJV: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.WEB: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
verses.ASV: And the multitudes gave heed with one accord unto the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard, and saw the signs which he did.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as multidões prestavam atenção em concordância às coisas que eram ditas por Filipe, ao ouvirem e verem os sinais que ele fazia.
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes escuchaban atentamente unánimes las cosas que decía Felipe, oyendo y viendo las señales que hacía.

verses.KJV: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.WEB: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
verses.ASV: For [from] many of those that had unclean spirits, they came out, crying with a loud voice: and many that were palsied, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os espíritos imundos, clamando em alta voz, saíam de muitos que os tinham; e muitos paralíticos e aleijados foram curados.
verses.RVR09: Porque de muchos que tenían espíritus inmundos, salían éstos dando grandes voces; y muchos paralíticos y cojos eran sanados:

verses.KJV: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.WEB: There was great joy in that city.
verses.ASV: And there was much joy in that city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia grande alegria naquela cidade.
verses.RVR09: Así que había gran gozo en aquella ciudad.

verses.KJV: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.WEB: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
verses.ASV: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who beforetime in the city used sorcery, and amazed the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um certo homem, de nome Simão, que antes naquela cidade usava de magia, e fazia o povo de Samaria ficar admirado, dizendo de si mesmo ser alguém grande;
verses.RVR09: Y había un hombre llamado Simón, el cual había sido antes mágico en aquella ciudad, y había engañado la gente de Samaria, diciéndose ser algún grande:

verses.KJV: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
verses.WEB: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
verses.ASV: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is called Great.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem eles todos davam atenção, desde o menor até o maior, diziam: Este é o grande poder de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Al cual oían todos atentamente desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande, diciendo: Este es la gran virtud de Dios.

verses.KJV: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
verses.WEB: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
verses.ASV: And they gave heed to him, because that of long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
verses.ALMEIDA: E davam atenção a ele, porque com suas magias ele há muito tempo tinha lhes causado admiração.
verses.RVR09: Y le estaban atentos, porque con sus artes mágicas los había embelesado mucho tiempo.

verses.KJV: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.WEB: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.ASV: But when they believed Philip preaching good tidings concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando creram em Filipe, que lhes anunciava o Evangelho do Reino de Deus, e o nome de Jesus Cristo, eles foram batizados, tanto homens como mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando creyeron á Felipe, que anunciaba el evangelio del reino de Dios y el nombre de Jesucristo, se bautizaban hombres y mujeres.

verses.KJV: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
verses.WEB: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
verses.ASV: And Simon also himself believed: and being baptized, he continued with Philip; and beholding signs and great miracles wrought, he was amazed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até mesmo Simão creu; e tendo sido batizado, ele continuou com Filipe; e vendo os sinais e maravilhas que eram feitas, ele ficou admirado.
verses.RVR09: El mismo Simón creyó también entonces, y bautizándose, se llegó á Felipe: y viendo los milagros y grandes maravillas que se hacían, estaba atónito.

verses.KJV: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
