verses.WEB: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
verses.ASV: Now when the apostles that were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
verses.ALMEIDA: E os apóstolos que estavam em Jerusalém, ao ouvirem que Samaria tinha recebido a palavra de Deus, enviaram-lhes a Pedro e a João.
verses.RVR09: Y los apóstoles que estaban en Jerusalem, habiendo oído que Samaria había recibido la palabra de Dios, les enviaron á Pedro y á Juan:

verses.KJV: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
verses.WEB: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
verses.ASV: who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit:
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais, tendo descido, oraram por eles, para que recebessem ao Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales venidos, oraron por ellos, para que recibiesen el Espíritu Santo;

verses.KJV: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.WEB: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: for as yet it was fallen upon none of them: only they had been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque ainda sobre nenhum deles tinha descido; mas somente tinham sido batizados no nome do Senhor Jesus).
verses.RVR09: (Porque aun no había descendido sobre ninguno de ellos, mas solamente eran bautizados en el nombre de Jesús.)

verses.KJV: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então puseram as mãos sobre eles, e receberam o Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les impusieron las manos, y recibieron el Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
verses.WEB: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
verses.ASV: Now when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simão ao ver que pela imposição das mãos dos apóstolos se dava o Espírito Santo, ofereceu-lhes dinheiro,
verses.RVR09: Y como vió Simón que por la imposición de las manos de los apóstoles se daba el Espíritu Santo, les ofreció dinero,

verses.KJV: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
verses.ASV: saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay my hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Dai também a mim este poder, que sobre qualquer um em quem eu puser as mãos, receba o Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Dadme también á mí esta potestad, que á cualquiera que pusiere las manos encima, reciba el Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
verses.WEB: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
verses.ASV: But Peter said unto him, Thy silver perish with thee, because thou hast thought to obtain the gift of God with money.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro lhe disse: Teu dinheiro seja contigo para perdição, porque pensaste que o dom de Deus [pudesse] ser obtido por meio de dinheiro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro le dijo: Tu dinero perezca contigo, que piensas que el don de Dios se gane por dinero.

verses.KJV: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.WEB: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
verses.ASV: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu não tens parte nem porção nesta palavra; porque teu coração não é correto diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: No tienes tú parte ni suerte en este negocio; porque tu corazón no es recto delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.WEB: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
verses.ASV: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray the Lord, if perhaps the thought of thy heart shall be forgiven thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Arrepende-te, pois, desta tua maldade, e ora a Deus, para que talvez este pensamento de teu coração te seja perdoado;
verses.RVR09: Arrepiéntete pues de esta tu maldad, y ruega á Dios, si quizás te será perdonado el pensamiento de tu corazón.

verses.KJV: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
verses.WEB: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
verses.ASV: For I see that thou art in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu vejo que tu estás em fel amargo, e atado em injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Porque en hiel de amargura y en prisión de maldad veo que estás.

verses.KJV: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.WEB: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
verses.ASV: And Simon answered and said, Pray ye for me to the Lord, that none of the things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas respondendo Simão, disse: Orai vós por mim ao Senhor, para que nada do que dissestes venha sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Respondiendo entonces Simón, dijo: Rogad vosotros por mí al Señor, que ninguna cosa de estas que habéis dicho, venga sobre mí.

verses.KJV: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.WEB: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.ASV: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo eles pois dado testemunho e falado a palavra do Senhor, voltaram a Jerusalém, e em muitas aldeias dos samaritanos anunciaram o Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, habiendo testificado y hablado la palabra de Dios, se volvieron á Jerusalem, y en muchas tierras de los Samaritanos anunciaron el evangelio.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
verses.WEB: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
verses.ASV: But an angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza: the same is desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um anjo do Senhor falou a Filipe, dizendo: Levanta-te, e vai para o sul, ao caminho que desce de Jerusalém para Gaza, que é deserto.
verses.RVR09: Empero el ángel del Señor habló á Felipe, diciendo: Levántate y ve hacia el mediodía, al camino que desciende de Jerusalem á Gaza, el cual es desierto.

verses.KJV: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
verses.WEB: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
verses.ASV: And he arose and went: and behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele levantou-se, e foi, e eis que um homem etíope, eunuco, administrador [subordinado] a Candace, a rainha dos etíopes, que estava sobre [o controle] de todos os bens dela, tinha vindo a Jerusalém para adorar;
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se levantó, y fué: y he aquí un Etiope, eunuco, gobernador de Candace, reina de los Etiopes, el cual era puesto sobre todos sus tesoros, y había venido á adorar á Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
verses.WEB: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
verses.ASV: and he was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele estava voltando, sentado em sua carruagem, [e] lia ao profeta Isaías.
verses.RVR09: Se volvía sentado en su carro, y leyendo el profeta Isaías.

verses.KJV: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.WEB: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
verses.ASV: And the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Espírito disse a Filipe: Aproxima-te, e ajunta-te a esta carruagem.
verses.RVR09: Y el Espíritu dijo á Felipe: Llégate, y júntate á este carro.

verses.KJV: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.WEB: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
verses.ASV: And Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Filipe, correndo, ouviu que ele estava lendo ao profeta Isaías, e disse: Tu entendes o que estás lendo?
verses.RVR09: Y acudiendo Felipe, le oyó que leía el profeta Isaías, y dijo: Mas ¿entiendes lo que lees?

verses.KJV: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
verses.WEB: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.ASV: And he said, How can I, except some one shall guide me? And he besought Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Como eu poderia, se alguém não me ensinar? E pediu a Filipe que subisse e se sentasse com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Y cómo podré, si alguno no me enseñare? Y rogó á Felipe que subiese, y se sentase con él.

verses.KJV: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
verses.WEB: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.ASV: Now the passage of the scripture which he was reading was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before his shearer is dumb, So he openeth not his mouth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o lugar da Escritura que ele estava lendo era este: Como ovelha ele foi levado ao matadouro, e como um cordeiro mudo fica diante do que o tosquia, assim [também] ele não abriu sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y el lugar de la Escritura que leía, era éste: Como oveja á la muerte fué llevado; y como cordero mudo delante del que le trasquila, así no abrió su boca:

verses.KJV: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
verses.WEB: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
verses.ASV: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: His generation who shall declare? For his life is taken from the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em sua humilhação foi tirado seu julgamento; e quem anunciará sua geração? Porque da terra sua vida é tirada.
verses.RVR09: En su humillación su juicio fué quitado: mas su generación, ¿quién la contará? porque es quitada de la tierra su vida.

verses.KJV: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
verses.WEB: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
verses.ASV: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondendo o eunuco a Filipe, disse: Eu te rogo, de quem o profeta diz isto? De si mesmo, ou de alguém outro?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el eunuco á Felipe, dijo: Ruégote ¿de quién el profeta dice esto? ¿de sí, ó de otro alguno?

verses.KJV: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.WEB: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
verses.ASV: And Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this scripture, preached unto him Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Filipe, abrindo sua boca, e começando desta escritura, anunciou-lhe o Evangelho [de] Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Felipe, abriendo su boca, y comenzando desde esta escritura, le anunció el evangelio de Jesús.

verses.KJV: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.WEB: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
verses.ASV: And as they went on the way, they came unto a certain water; and the eunuch saith, Behold, [here is] water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles iam caminhando, chegaram a uma certa [porção] de água; e o eunuco disse: Eis aqui água; o que me impede de ser batizado?
verses.RVR09: Y yendo por el camino, llegaron á cierta agua; y dijo el eunuco: He aquí agua; ¿qué impide que yo sea bautizado?

verses.KJV: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.WEB: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
verses.ASV: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Filipe disse: Se tu crês de todo coração, [então] é lícito;E respondendo ele, disse: Creio que Jesus Cristo é o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Felipe dijo: Si crees de todo corazón, bien puedes. Y respondiendo, dijo: Creo que Jesucristo es el Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.WEB: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.ASV: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip; and the eunuch saw him no more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele mandou parar a carruagem; e desceram ambos à água, tanto Filipe como o eunuco; e ele o batizou.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó parar el carro: y descendieron ambos al agua, Felipe y el eunuco; y bautizóle.

verses.KJV: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.WEB: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
verses.ASV: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached the gospel to all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eles subiram da água, o Espírito do Senhor arrebatou a Filipe, e o eunuco não mais o viu, porque ele foi [em] seu caminho com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Y como subieron del agua, el Espíritu del Señor arrebató á Felipe; y no le vió más el eunuco, y se fué por su camino gozoso.

verses.KJV: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Filipe se achou em Azoto; e passando, anunciava ao Evangelho [em] todas as cidades, até que veio a Cesareia.
verses.RVR09: Felipe empero se halló en Azoto: y pasando, anunciaba el evangelio en todas las ciudades, hasta que llegó á Cesarea.

verses.KJV: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.WEB: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
verses.ASV: But Saul, yet breathing threatening and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saulo, ainda assoprando ameaças e mortes contra os discípulos do Senhor, foi ao chefe dos sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: Y SAULO, respirando aún amenazas y muerte contra los discípulos del Señor, vino al príncipe de los sacerdotes,

verses.KJV: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: and asked of him letters to Damascus unto the synagogues, that if he found any that were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pediu-lhe cartas para Damasco, para as sinagogas, para que se achasse alguns deste caminho, tanto homens como mulheres, ele [os] trouxesse presos a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y demandó de él letras para Damasco á las sinagogas, para que si hallase algunos hombres ó mujeres de esta secta, los trajese presos á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.WEB: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
verses.ASV: And as he journeyed, it came to pass that he drew nigh unto Damascus: and suddenly there shone round about him a light out of heaven:
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo, aconteceu que chegando perto de Damasco, repentinamente brilhou ao redor dele uma luz do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo por el camino, aconteció que llegando cerca de Damasco, súbitamente le cercó un resplandor de luz del cielo;

verses.KJV: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.WEB: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
verses.ASV: and he fell upon the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E caindo em terra, ouviu ma voz lhe dizendo: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?
verses.RVR09: Y cayendo en tierra, oyó una voz que le decía: Saulo, Saulo, ¿por qué me persigues?

verses.KJV: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.WEB: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
verses.ASV: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And he [said], I am Jesus whom thou persecutest:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Quem és, Senhor?E o Senhor disse: Eu sou Jesus, a quem tu persegues; duro é para ti dar coices contra os aguilhões.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Quién eres, Señor? Y él dijo: Yo soy Jesús á quien tú persigues: dura cosa te es dar coces contra el aguijón.

verses.KJV: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.WEB: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
verses.ASV: but rise, and enter into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tremendo e atônito, disse: Senhor, que queres que eu faça?E o Senhor lhe [disse] : Levanta-te, e entra na cidade; e [ali] te será dito o que deves fazer.
verses.RVR09: El, temblando y temeroso, dijo: Señor, ¿qué quieres que haga? Y el Señor le dice: Levántate y entra en la ciudad, y se te dirá lo que te conviene hacer.

verses.KJV: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.WEB: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
verses.ASV: And the men that journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing the voice, but beholding no man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens que viajavam com ele pararam emudecidos, ouvindo, de fato, a voz, porém não vendo ninguém.
verses.RVR09: Y los hombres que iban con Saulo, se pararon atónitos, oyendo á la verdad la voz, mas no viendo á nadie.

verses.KJV: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
verses.WEB: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
verses.ASV: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw nothing; and they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saulo se levantou da terra e, tendo aberto seus olhos, não via ninguém; e sendo guiado pela mão, levaram-no a Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saulo se levantó de tierra, y abriendo los ojos, no veía á nadie: así que, llevándole por la mano, metiéronle en Damasco;

verses.KJV: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
verses.WEB: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
verses.ASV: And he was three days without sight, and did neither eat nor drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele estava três dias sem ver; e não comeu, nem bebeu.
verses.RVR09: Donde estuvo tres días sin ver, y no comió, ni bebió.

verses.KJV: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
verses.WEB: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
verses.ASV: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said unto him in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I [am here], Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia em Damasco um certo discípulo, de nome Ananias; e disse-lhe o Senhor em visão: Ananias!E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, Senhor!
verses.RVR09: Había entonces un discípulo en Damasco llamado Ananías, al cual el Señor dijo en visión: Ananías. Y él respondió: Heme aquí, Señor.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.WEB: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
verses.ASV: And the Lord [said] unto him, Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus: for behold, he prayeth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor lhe [disse] : Levanta-te, e vai a rua chamada Direita, e pergunta na casa de Judas por um chamado Saulo, de Tarso; porque que ele ora.
verses.RVR09: Y el Señor le dijo: Levántate, y ve á la calle que se llama la Derecha, y busca en casa de Judas á uno llamado Saulo, de Tarso: porque he aquí, él ora;

verses.KJV: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.WEB: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
verses.ASV: and he hath seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele viu em visão que um homem, de nome Ananias, entrava, e sobre ele punha a mão, para que voltasse a ver.
verses.RVR09: Y ha visto en visión un varón llamado Ananías, que entra y le pone la mano encima, para que reciba la vista.

verses.KJV: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.WEB: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: But Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard from many of this man, how much evil he did to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ananias respondeu: Senhor, eu ouvi de muitos sobre este homem, quantos males ele tem feito aos teus santos em Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Ananías respondió: Señor, he oído á muchos acerca de este hombre, cuántos males ha hecho á tus santos en Jerusalem:

verses.KJV: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.WEB: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
verses.ASV: and here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call upon thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aqui ele tem poder dos chefes dos sacerdotes para prender a todos os que invocam o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y aun aquí tiene facultad de los príncipes de los sacerdotes de prender á todos los que invocan tu nombre.

verses.KJV: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o Senhor lhe disse: Vai, porque este me é um vaso escolhido para levar meu nome diante dos gentios, e dos reis, e dos filhos de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo el Señor: Ve: porque instrumento escogido me es éste, para que lleve mi nombre en presencia de los Gentiles, y de reyes, y de los hijos de Israel:

verses.KJV: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
verses.WEB: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
verses.ASV: for I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu mostrarei a ele o quanto ele deve sofrer por causa do meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo le mostraré cuánto le sea menester que padezca por mi nombre.

verses.KJV: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
verses.ASV: And Ananias departed, and entered into the house; and laying his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, [even] Jesus, who appeared unto thee in the way which thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mayest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ananias foi, e entrou na casa; e pondo as mãos sobre ele, disse: Irmão Saulo, o Senhor, [que é] Jesus, aquele que apareceu a ti no caminho, me enviou para que tu voltes a ver, e sejas cheio do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Ananías entonces fué, y entró en la casa, y poniéndole las manos encima, dijo: Saulo hermano, el Señor Jesús, que te apareció en el camino por donde venías, me ha enviado para que recibas la vista y seas lleno de Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.WEB: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
verses.ASV: And straightway there fell from his eyes as it were scales, and he received his sight; and he arose and was baptized;
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo lhe caíram como que escamas dos olhos, e imediatamente voltou a ver; e levantando-se, foi batizado.
verses.RVR09: Y luego le cayeron de los ojos como escamas, y recibió al punto la vista: y levantándose, fué bautizado.

verses.KJV: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.WEB: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
verses.ASV: and he took food and was strengthened. And he was certain days with the disciples that were at Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao comer, ele se fortaleceu. E Saulo ficou alguns dias com os discípulos [que estavam] em Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Y como comió, fué confortado. Y estuvo Saulo por algunos días con los discípulos que estaban en Damasco.

verses.KJV: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.WEB: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
verses.ASV: And straightway in the synagogues he proclaimed Jesus, that he is the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo nas sinagogas pregava a Cristo, [dizendo] que aquele era o Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y luego en las sinagogas predicaba á Cristo, diciendo que éste era el Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.WEB: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
verses.ASV: And all that heard him were amazed, and said, Is not this he that in Jerusalem made havoc of them that called on this name? and he had come hither for this intent, that he might bring them bound before the chief priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que o ouviam ficavam admirados, e diziam: Não é este aquele que em Jerusalém tentava destruir aos que invocavam este nome? E [não foi] para isso [que] ele veio aqui, para os levar presos aos chefes dos sacerdotes?
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que le oían estaban atónitos, y decían: ¿No es éste el que asolaba en Jerusalem á los que invocaban este nombre, y á eso vino acá, para llevarlos presos á los príncipes de los sacerdotes?

verses.KJV: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.WEB: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
verses.ASV: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews that dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Saulo se esforçava muito mais, e confundia aos judeus que habitavam em Damasco, provando que aquele era o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Empero Saulo mucho más se esforzaba, y confundía á los Judíos que moraban en Damasco, afirmando que éste es el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.WEB: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
verses.ASV: And when many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel together to kill him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E passados vários dias, os judeus tiveram conselho entre si para o matarem.
verses.RVR09: Y como pasaron muchos días, los Judíos hicieron entre sí consejo de matarle;

verses.KJV: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.WEB: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
verses.ASV: but their plot became known to Saul. And they watched the gates also day and night that they might kill him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as ciladas deles foram conhecidas por Saulo; e eles vigiavam as portas, tanto de dia como de noite, para poderem matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Mas las asechanzas de ellos fueron entendidas de Saulo. Y ellos guardaban las puertas de día y de noche para matarle.

verses.KJV: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
verses.WEB: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
verses.ASV: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os discípulos, tomando-o de noite, levaram-no abaixo pelo muro em um cesto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los discípulos, tomándole de noche, le bajaron por el muro en una espuerta.

verses.KJV: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.WEB: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
verses.ASV: And when he was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: and they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saulo, tendo vindo a Jerusalém, procurava se juntar aos discípulos; mas todos tinham medo dele, não crendo que fosse discípulo.
verses.RVR09: Y como vino á Jerusalem, tentaba de juntarse con los discípulos; mas todos tenían miedo de él, no creyendo que era discípulo.

verses.KJV: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.WEB: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
verses.ASV: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Barnabás, tomando-o consigo, trouxe [-o] aos apóstolos, e contou-lhes como no caminho tinha visto ao Senhor, e tinha lhe falado, e como em Damasco tinha falado ousadamente no nome de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Bernabé, tomándole, lo trajo á los apóstoles, y contóles cómo había visto al Señor en el camino, y que le había hablado, y cómo en Damasco había hablado confiadamente en el nombre de Jesús.

verses.KJV: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
verses.ASV: And he was with them going in and going out at Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele estava junto deles, entrando e saindo em Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Y entraba y salía con ellos en Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.WEB: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
verses.ASV: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord: and he spake and disputed against the Grecian Jews; but they were seeking to kill him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falando ousadamente no nome do Senhor Jesus; falava e discutia também contra os gregos; mas eles procuravam matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaba confiadamente en el nombre del Señor: y disputaba con los Griegos; mas ellos procuraban matarle.

verses.KJV: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.WEB: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
verses.ASV: And when the brethren knew it, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os irmãos, ao perceberem [isto] , o levaram até Cesareia, e o enviaram a Tarso.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual, como los hermanos entendieron, le acompañaron hasta Cesarea, y le enviaron á Tarso.

verses.KJV: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.WEB: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: So the church throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria had peace, being edified; and, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, was multiplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então as igrejas por toda a Judeia, e Galileia, e Samaria, tinham paz, e eram edificadas; e andando no temor do Senhor, e [na] consolação do Espírito Santo, se multiplicavam.
verses.RVR09: Las iglesias entonces tenían paz por toda Judea y Galilea y Samaria, y eran edificadas, andando en el temor del Señor; y con consuelo del Espíritu Santo eran multiplicadas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.WEB: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as Peter went throughout all parts, he came down also to the saints that dwelt at Lydda.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, Pedro, passando por todos [os lugares] , veio também aos santos que habitavam em Lida.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que Pedro, andándolos á todos, vino también á los santos que habitaban en Lydda.

verses.KJV: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.WEB: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
verses.ASV: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had kept his bed eight years; for he was palsied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali ele achou a um certo homem chamado Enéas, que havia oito anos que jazia numa cama, que era paralítico.
verses.RVR09: Y halló allí á uno que se llamaba Eneas, que hacía ocho años que estaba en cama, que era paralítico.

verses.KJV: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.WEB: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
verses.ASV: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ healeth thee: arise, and make thy bed. And straightway he arose.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro lhe disse: Enéas, Jesus Cristo te cura; levanta-te, e faz tua cama. E logo ele se levantou.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo Pedro: Eneas, Jesucristo te sana; levántate, y hazte tu cama. Y luego se levantó.

verses.KJV: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.WEB: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
verses.ASV: And all that dwelt at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que habitavam em Lida e Sarona o viram, os quais se converteram ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y viéronle todos los que habitaban en Lydda y en Sarona, los cuales se convirtieron al Señor.

verses.KJV: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.WEB: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
verses.ASV: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia em Jope uma certa discípula, de nome Tabita, que traduzido se diz Dorcas. Esta estava cheia de boas obras e doações que ela fazia [aos necessitados] .
verses.RVR09: Entonces en Joppe había una discípula llamada Tabita, que si lo declaras, quiere decir Dorcas. Esta era llena de buenas obras y de limosnas que hacía.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
verses.WEB: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in those days, that she fell sick, and died: and when they had washed her, they laid her in an upper chamber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu naqueles dias, que tendo ela ficado doente, morreu; e tendo a lavado, puseram-na no compartimento superior.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en aquellos días que enfermando, murió; á la cual, después de lavada, pusieron en una sala.

verses.KJV: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
verses.WEB: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
verses.ASV: And as Lydda was nigh unto Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men unto him, entreating him, Delay not to come on unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como Lida era perto de Jope, os discípulos, ao ouvirem que Pedro estava ali, mandaram-lhe dois homens, rogando [-lhe] que não demorasse a vir a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y como Lydda estaba cerca de Joppe, los discípulos, oyendo que Pedro estaba allí, le enviaron dos hombres, rogándole: No te detengas en venir hasta nosotros.

verses.KJV: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.WEB: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
verses.ASV: And Peter arose and went with them. And when he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, tendo se levantado, foi com eles; o qual chegou, e [o] levaram ao compartimento superior, e todas as viúvas o rodearam, chorando, e mostrando [-lhe] as túnicas e roupas que Dorcas tinha feito quando estava com elas.
verses.RVR09: Pedro entonces levantándose, fué con ellos: y llegado que hubo, le llevaron á la sala, donde le rodearon todas las viudas, llorando y mostrando las túnicas y los vestidos que Dorcas hacía cuando estaba con ellas.

verses.KJV: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.WEB: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.ASV: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes; and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro, pondo para fora a todas; pôs-se de joelhos, e orou; e virando-se para o corpo, disse: Tabita, levanta-te;E ela abriu seus olhos, e vendo a Pedro, sentou-se.
verses.RVR09: Entonces echados fuera todos, Pedro puesto de rodillas, oró; y vuelto al cuerpo, dijo: Tabita, levántate. Y ella abrió los ojos, y viendo á Pedro, incorporóse.

verses.KJV: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.WEB: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
verses.ASV: And he gave her his hand, and raised her up; and calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, dando-lhe a mão, levantou-a; e tendo chamado aos santos, e às viúvas, apresentou-a viva.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dió la mano, y levantóla: entonces llamando á los santos y las viudas, la presentó viva.

verses.KJV: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.WEB: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
verses.ASV: And it became known throughout all Joppa: and many believed on the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto ficou conhecido por toda Jope, e muitos creram no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Esto fué notorio por toda Joppe; y creyeron muchos en el Señor.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.WEB: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that he abode many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ele ficou muitos dias em Jope, com um certo Simão curtidor.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que se quedó muchos días en Joppe en casa de un cierto Simón, curtidor.

verses.KJV: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
verses.WEB: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
verses.ASV: Now [there was] a certain man in Cæsarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of the band called the Italian [band],
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um certo homem em Cesareia, de nome Cornélio, centurião, do esquadrão chamado Italiano;
verses.RVR09: Y HABÍA un varón en Cesarea llamado Cornelio, centurión de la compañía que se llamaba la Italiana,

verses.KJV: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.WEB: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
verses.ASV: a devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, who gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always.
verses.ALMEIDA: Devoto, e temente a Deus, com toda a sua casa; e que fazia muitas doações ao povo, e continuamente orava a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pío y temeroso de Dios con toda su casa, y que hacía muchas limosnas al pueblo, y oraba á Dios siempre.

verses.KJV: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.WEB: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
verses.ASV: He saw in a vision openly, as it were about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of God coming in unto him, and saying to him, Cornelius.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele viu claramente em visão, cerca da hora nona do dia, a um anjo de Deus, que vinha a ele, e lhe dizia: Cornélio!
verses.RVR09: Este vió en visión manifiestamente, como á la hora nona del día, que un ángel de Dios entraba á él, y le decía: Cornelio.

verses.KJV: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.WEB: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
verses.ASV: And he, fastening his eyes upon him, and being affrighted, said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are gone up for a memorial before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, olhando-lhe atentamente, e muito atemorizado, disse: O que é, Senhor?E disse-lhe: Tuas orações e doações subiram à memória diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y él, puestos en él los ojos, espantado, dijo: ¿Qué es, Señor? Y díjole: Tus oraciones y tus limosnas han subido en memoria á la presencia de Dios.

verses.KJV: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.WEB: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
verses.ASV: And now send men to Joppa, and fetch one Simon, who is surnamed Peter:
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora envia homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro.
verses.RVR09: Envía pues ahora hombres á Joppe, y haz venir á un Simón, que tiene por sobrenombre Pedro.

verses.KJV: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.WEB: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
verses.ASV: he lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este está hospedado na casa de um Simão curtidor, cuja casa é junto ao mar; este te dirá o que deves fazer.
verses.RVR09: Este posa en casa de un Simón, curtidor, que tiene su casa junto á la mar: él te dirá lo que te conviene hacer.

verses.KJV: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.WEB: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
verses.ASV: And when the angel that spake unto him was departed, he called two of his household-servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo partido o anjo que falava com Cornélio, ele chamou a dois de seus servos, e a um soldado devoto, dos que permaneciam continuamente com ele.
verses.RVR09: E ido el ángel que hablaba con Cornelio, llamó dos de sus criados, y un devoto soldado de los que le asistían;

verses.KJV: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.WEB: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.ASV: and having rehearsed all things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo lhes contado tudo, enviou-os a Jope.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales, después de habérselo contado todo, los envió á Joppe.

verses.KJV: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.WEB: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
verses.ASV: Now on the morrow, as they were on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour:
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte, enquanto estes iam pelo caminho, e chegando perto da cidade, Pedro subiu ao telhado para orar, quase à hora sexta.
verses.RVR09: Y al día siguiente, yendo ellos su camino, y llegando cerca de la ciudad, Pedro subió á la azotea á orar, cerca de la hora de sexta;

verses.KJV: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.WEB: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
verses.ASV: and he became hungry, and desired to eat: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo ele fome, quis comer; [e] enquanto estavam [lhe] preparando, caiu sobre ele um êxtase.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que le vino una grande hambre, y quiso comer; pero mientras disponían, sobrevínole un éxtasis;

verses.KJV: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.WEB: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
verses.ASV: and he beholdeth the heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending, as it were a great sheet, let down by four corners upon the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele viu o céu aberto, e descia a ele um certo objeto, como um grande lençol, amarrado pelas quatro pontas, e abaixando-se à terra;
verses.RVR09: Y vió el cielo abierto, y que descendía un vaso, como un gran lienzo, que atado de los cuatro cabos era bajado á la tierra;

verses.KJV: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.WEB: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
verses.ASV: wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts and creeping things of the earth and birds of the heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em que havia de todos os animais quadrúpedes da terra, e animais selvagens, e répteis, e aves do céu.
verses.RVR09: En el cual había de todos los animales cuadrúpedos de la tierra, y reptiles, y aves del cielo.

verses.KJV: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.WEB: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
verses.ASV: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill and eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio-lhe uma voz, [dizendo] : Pedro, mata e come.
verses.RVR09: Y le vino una voz: Levántate, Pedro, mata y come.

verses.KJV: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.WEB: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
verses.ASV: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common and unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro disse: De maneira nenhuma, Senhor; porque nunca comi coisa alguma ordinária ou impura.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro dijo: Señor, no; porque ninguna cosa común é inmunda he comido jamás.

verses.KJV: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.WEB: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
verses.ASV: And a voice [came] unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, make not thou common.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a voz voltou a [dizer] ,pela segunda vez: O que Deus purificou, não faças tu [como se fosse] ordinário.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió la voz hacia él la segunda vez: Lo que Dios limpió, no lo llames tú común.

verses.KJV: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.WEB: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
verses.ASV: And this was done thrice: and straightway the vessel was received up into heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto aconteceu três vezes; e o objeto voltou a ser recolhido acima ao céu.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué hecho por tres veces; y el vaso volvió á ser recogido en el cielo.

verses.KJV: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
verses.WEB: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
verses.ASV: Now while Peter was much perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men that were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto Pedro estava pensando perplexo consigo mesmo o que seria aquela visão que ele tinha visto, eis que os homens que tinham sido enviados por Cornélio, perguntando pela casa de Simão, pararam à porta.
verses.RVR09: Y estando Pedro dudando dentro de sí qué sería la visión que había visto, he aquí, los hombres que habían sido enviados por Cornelio, que, preguntando por la casa de Simón, llegaron á la puerta.

verses.KJV: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.WEB: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
verses.ASV: and called and asked whether Simon, who was surnamed Peter, were lodging there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamando, perguntaram se Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Pedro, estava hospedado ali.
verses.RVR09: Y llamando, preguntaron si un Simón que tenía por sobrenombre Pedro, posaba allí.

verses.KJV: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.WEB: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
verses.ASV: And while Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando Pedro pensando naquela visão, o Espírito lhe disse: Eis que três homens te buscam.
verses.RVR09: Y estando Pedro pensando en la visión, le dijo el Espíritu: He aquí, tres hombres te buscan.

verses.KJV: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.WEB: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
verses.ASV: But arise, and get thee down, and go with them, nothing doubting: for I have sent them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levanta-te, desce, e vai com eles, sem duvidar; porque eu os enviei.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, pues, y desciende, y no dudes ir con ellos; porque yo los he enviado.

verses.KJV: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.WEB: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
verses.ASV: And Peter went down to the men, and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, tendo descido aos homens que tinham lhe sido enviados por Cornélio, disse: Eis que eu sou a quem buscais; qual é o motivo pelo qual estais aqui?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro, descendiendo á los hombres que eran enviados por Cornelio, dijo: He aquí, yo soy el que buscáis: ¿cuál es la causa por la que habéis venido?

verses.KJV: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.WEB: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Cornelius a centurion, a righteous man and one that feareth God, and well reported of by all the nation of the Jews, was warned [of God] by a holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles disseram: Cornélio, [que é] centurião, homem justo e temente a Deus, [e] que tem [bom] testemunho de toda a nação dos judeus, foi revelado por um santo anjo para te chamar até a casa dele, e ouvir de tuas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: Cornelio, el centurión, varón justo y temeroso de Dios, y que tiene testimonio de toda la nación de los Judíos, ha recibido respuesta por un santo ángel, de hacerte venir á su casa, y oir de ti palabras.

verses.KJV: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.WEB: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.ASV: So he called them in and lodged them. And on the morrow he arose and went forth with them, and certain of the brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então chamando-os para dentro, recebeu-os em casa. Mas no dia seguinte, Pedro foi com eles; e foram com ele alguns dos irmãos de Jope.
verses.RVR09: Entonces metiéndolos dentro, los hospedó. Y al día siguiente, levantándose, se fué con ellos; y le acompañaron algunos de los hermanos de Joppe.

verses.KJV: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and he had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.WEB: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
verses.ASV: And on the morrow they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his kinsmen and his near friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte chegaram a Cesareia. E Cornélio estava esperando por eles, tendo chamado a seus parentes e amigos mais íntimos.
verses.RVR09: Y al otro día entraron en Cesarea. Y Cornelio los estaba esperando, habiendo llamado á sus parientes y los amigos más familiares.

verses.KJV: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.WEB: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.ASV: And when it came to pass that Peter entered, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, ao Pedro entrar, Cornélio se encontrou com ele, e caindo aos pés dele, adorou-o.
verses.RVR09: Y como Pedro entró, salió Cornelio á recibirle; y derribándose á sus pies, adoró.

verses.KJV: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.WEB: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
verses.ASV: But Peter raised him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro o levantou, dizendo: Levanta-te; eu mesmo também sou um ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pedro le levantó, diciendo: Levántate; yo mismo también soy hombre.

verses.KJV: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.WEB: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
verses.ASV: And as he talked with him, he went in, and findeth many come together:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo conversado com ele, entrou; e achou a muitos que [ali] tinham se reunido.
verses.RVR09: Y hablando con él, entró, y halló á muchos que se habían juntado.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
verses.ASV: and he said unto them, Ye yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to join himself or come unto one of another nation; and [yet] unto me hath God showed that I should not call any man common or unclean:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Vós sabeis como não é lícito a um homem judeu juntar-se de estrangeiros, ou aproximar-se deles; mas Deus me mostrou que a ninguém chame de ordinário ou impuro.
verses.RVR09: Y les dijo: Vosotros sabéis que es abominable á un varón Judío juntarse ó llegarse á extranjero; mas me ha mostrado Dios que á ningún hombre llame común ó inmundo;

verses.KJV: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.WEB: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
verses.ASV: wherefore also I came without gainsaying, when I was sent for. I ask therefore with what intent ye sent for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu, tendo sido chamado, vim sem qualquer oposição [de minha parte] . Então eu pergunto: por que motivo me mandastes chamar?
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, llamado, he venido sin dudar. Así que pregunto: ¿por qué causa me habéis hecho venir?

verses.KJV: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.WEB: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
verses.ASV: And Cornelius said, Four days ago, until this hour, I was keeping the ninth hour of prayer in my house; and behold, a man stood before me in bright apparel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Cornélio disse: Há quatro dias que, até esta hora eu estava jejuando, e orava à hora nona em minha casa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Cornelio dijo: Cuatro días ha que á esta hora yo estaba ayuno; y á la hora de nona estando orando en mi casa, he aquí, un varón se puso delante de mí en vestido resplandeciente.

verses.KJV: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.WEB: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
verses.ASV: and saith, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um homem se pôs diante de mim com uma roupa brilhante, e disse: Cornélio, tura oração tem sido ouvida, e tuas doações têm sido lembradas diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Cornelio, tu oración es oída, y tus limosnas han venido en memoria en la presencia de Dios.

verses.KJV: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.WEB: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
verses.ASV: Send therefore to Joppa, and call unto thee Simon, who is surnamed Peter; he lodgeth in the house of Simon a tanner, by the sea side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia pois a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro; este se hospeda na casa de Simão o curtidor, junto ao mar; quando ele vier, falará contigo.
verses.RVR09: Envía pues á Joppe, y haz venir á un Simón, que tiene por sobrenombre Pedro; éste posa en casa de Simón, curtidor, junto á la mar; el cual venido, te hablará.

verses.KJV: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.WEB: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
verses.ASV: Forthwith therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God, to hear all things that have been commanded thee of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então logo eu enviei a ti; e bem fizeste em vir até aqui; agora pois estamos todos [aqui] presentes diante de Deus, para ouvir tudo quanto Deus tem te ordenado.
verses.RVR09: Así que, luego envié á ti; y tú has hecho bien en venir. Ahora pues, todos nosotros estamos aquí en la presencia de Dios, para oir todo lo que Dios te ha mandado.

verses.KJV: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.WEB: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
verses.ASV: And Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, abrindo a boca, disse: Reconheço que é verdade que Deus não faz acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro, abriendo su boca, dijo: Por verdad hallo que Dios no hace acepción de personas;

verses.KJV: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.WEB: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
verses.ASV: but in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is acceptable to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim, em toda nação, aquele que o teme, e pratica a justiça, [este] lhe é agradável.
verses.RVR09: Sino que de cualquiera nación que le teme y obra justicia, se agrada.

verses.KJV: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.WEB: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
verses.ASV: The word which he sent unto the children of Israel, preaching good tidings of peace by Jesus Christ (he is Lord of all)—
verses.ALMEIDA: A palavra que Deus enviou aos filhos de Israel, anunciando o Evangelho da paz por meio de Jesus Cristo; este é o Senhor de todos.
verses.RVR09: Envió palabra Dios á los hijos de Israel, anunciando la paz por Jesucristo; éste es el Señor de todos.

verses.KJV: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.WEB: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.ASV: that saying ye yourselves know, which was published throughout all Judæa, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sabeis da palavra que veio por toda a Judeia, começando desde a Galileia, depois do batismo que João pregou.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sabéis lo que fué divulgado por toda Judea; comenzando desde Galilea después del bautismo que Juan predicó,

verses.KJV: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.WEB: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
verses.ASV: [even] Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: [E] sobre Jesus de Nazaré; como Deus o ungiu com o Espírito Santo, e com poder; o qual percorreu [os lugares] fazendo o bem, e curando a todos os oprimidos pelo diabo; porque Deus era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto á Jesús de Nazaret; cómo le ungió Dios de Espíritu Santo y de potencia; el cual anduvo haciendo bienes, y sanando á todos los oprimidos del diablo; porque Dios era con él.

verses.KJV: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.WEB: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
verses.ASV: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom also they slew, hanging him on a tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós somos testemunhas de todas as coisas que ele fez; tanto na terra dos judeus, como em Jerusalém; ao qual mataram, pendurando [-o] em um madeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros somos testigos de todas las cosas que hizo en la tierra de Judea, y en Jerusalem; al cual mataron colgándole en un madero.

verses.KJV: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.WEB: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
verses.ASV: Him God raised up the third day, and gave him to be made manifest,
verses.ALMEIDA: A este Deus ressuscitou ao terceiro dia, e fez com que fosse manifesto;
verses.RVR09: A éste levantó Dios al tercer día, é hizo que apareciese manifiesto,

verses.KJV: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.WEB: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.ASV: not to all the people, but unto witnesses that were chosen before of God, [even] to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não a todo o povo, mas sim a testemunhas determinadas por Deus com antecedência: a nós, que juntamente com ele comemos e bebemos, depois dele ter ressuscitado dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: No á todo el pueblo, sino á los testigos que Dios antes había ordenado, es á saber, á nosotros que comimos y bebimos con él, después que resucitó de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.WEB: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
verses.ASV: And he charged us to preach unto the people, and to testify that this is he who is ordained of God [to be] the Judge of the living and the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele nos mandou pregar ao povo, e dar testemunho de que ele é o que foi ordenado por Deus [para ser] Juiz dos vivos e dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y nos mandó que predicásemos al pueblo, y testificásemos que él es el que Dios ha puesto por Juez de vivos y muertos.

verses.KJV: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.WEB: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
verses.ASV: To him bear all the prophets witness, that through his name every one that believeth on him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este todos os profetas dão testemunho, de que todos os que nele crerem receberão perdão dos pecados por meio do seu nome.
verses.RVR09: A éste dan testimonio todos los profetas, de que todos los que en él creyeren, recibirán perdón de pecados por su nombre.

verses.KJV: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.WEB: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
verses.ASV: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all them that heard the word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando Pedro ainda falando estas palavras, o Espírito Santo caiu sobre todos os que ouviam a palavra.
verses.RVR09: Estando aún hablando Pedro estas palabras, el Espíritu Santo cayó sobre todos los que oían el sermón.

verses.KJV: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: And they of the circumcision that believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os crentes que eram da circuncisão, tantos quantos tinham vindo com Pedro, ficaram muito admirados de que também sobre os gentios fosse derramado o dom do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y se espantaron los fieles que eran de la circuncisión, que habían venido con Pedro, de que también sobre los Gentiles se derramase el don del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.WEB: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
verses.ASV: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles os ouviam falar em [diversas] línguas, e a engrandecer a Deus. Então Pedro respondeu:
verses.RVR09: Porque los oían que hablaban en lenguas, y que magnificaban á Dios.

verses.KJV: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.WEB: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
verses.ASV: Can any man forbid the water, that these should not be baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso pode alguém impedir a água, para que não sejam batizados estes, que também, assim como nós, receberam o Espírito Santo?
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Pedro: ¿Puede alguno impedir el agua, para que no sean bautizados éstos que han recibido el Espíritu Santo también como nosotros?

verses.KJV: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.WEB: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
verses.ASV: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou que fossem batizados no nome do Senhor. Então lhe pediram que continuasse [com eles] por alguns dias.
verses.RVR09: Y les mandó bautizar en el nombre del Señor Jesús. Entonces le rogaron que se quedase por algunos días.

verses.KJV: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.WEB: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.ASV: Now the apostles and the brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os apóstolos, e os irmãos que estavam na Judeia, ouviram que também os gentios receberam a palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y OYERON los apóstoles y los hermanos que estaban en Judea, que también los Gentiles habían recibido la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.WEB: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.ASV: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Pedro subiu a Jerusalém, discutiam contra ele os que eram da circuncisão;
verses.RVR09: Y como Pedro subió á Jerusalem, contendían contra él los que eran de la circuncisión,

verses.KJV: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.WEB: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
verses.ASV: saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Tu entraste [na casa] de homens incircuncisos, e comeste com eles.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: ¿Por qué has entrado á hombres incircuncisos, y has comido con ellos?

verses.KJV: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.WEB: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
verses.ASV: But Peter began, and expounded [the matter] unto them in order, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro começou a lhes explicar [tudo] em ordem, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces comenzando Pedro, les declaró por orden lo pasado, diciendo:
