verses.KJV: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.WEB: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
verses.ASV: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, a certain vessel descending, as it were a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu estava orando na cidade de Jope, e vi em êxtase uma visão: um certo objeto que descia como um grande lençol, pelas quatro pontas abaixado desde o céu, e vinha até mim.
verses.RVR09: Estaba yo en la ciudad de Joppe orando, y vi en rapto de entendimiento una visión: un vaso, como un gran lienzo, que descendía, que por los cuatro cabos era abajado del cielo, y venía hasta mí.

verses.KJV: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.WEB: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
verses.ASV: upon which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw the fourfooted beasts of the earth and wild beasts and creeping things and birds of the heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: No qual, olhando eu com atenção, considerei e vi quatro quadrúpedes da terra, e animais selvagens, e répteis, e aves do céu.
verses.RVR09: En el cual como puse los ojos, consideré y vi animales terrestres de cuatro pies, y fieras, y reptiles, y aves del cielo.

verses.KJV: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.WEB: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
verses.ASV: And I heard also a voice saying unto me, Rise, Peter; kill and eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu ouvi uma voz que me dizia: Levanta-te Pedro, mata e come.
verses.RVR09: Y oí una voz que me decía: Levántate, Pedro, mata y come.

verses.KJV: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.WEB: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
verses.ASV: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath ever entered into my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu disse: De maneira nenhuma, Senhor; porque nunca comi coisa alguma ordinária, nem coisa imunda entrou em minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: Señor, no; porque ninguna cosa común ó inmunda entró jamás en mi boca.

verses.KJV: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.WEB: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
verses.ASV: But a voice answered the second time out of heaven, What God hath cleansed, make not thou common.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a voz me respondeu do céu pela segunda vez: O que Deus purificou, não o faças tu [como] ordinário.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la voz me respondió del cielo segunda vez: Lo que Dios limpió, no lo llames tú común.

verses.KJV: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.WEB: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.ASV: And this was done thrice: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto aconteceu por três vezes; e voltou-se tudo a recolher acima ao céu.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué hecho por tres veces: y volvió todo á ser tomado arriba en el cielo.

verses.KJV: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.WEB: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
verses.ASV: And behold, forthwith three men stood before the house in which we were, having been sent from Cæsarea unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que logo três homens, enviados a mim de Cesareia, pararam junto à casa onde eu estava.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, luego sobrevinieron tres hombres á la casa donde yo estaba, enviados á mí de Cesarea.

verses.KJV: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
verses.WEB: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit bade me go with them, making no distinction. And these six brethren also accompanied me; and we entered into the man’s house:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Espírito me disse que eu fosse com eles, sem duvidar; e também estes seis irmãos foram comigo, e entramos na casa daquele homem.
verses.RVR09: Y el Espíritu me dijo que fuese con ellos sin dudar. Y vinieron también conmigo estos seis hermanos, y entramos en casa de un varón,

verses.KJV: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.WEB: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
verses.ASV: and he told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying, Send to Joppa, and fetch Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele nos contou como tinha visto um anjo estar em sua casa, e tinha lhe dito: Envia [alguns] homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro;
verses.RVR09: El cual nos contó cómo había visto un ángel en su casa, que se paró, y le dijo: Envía á Joppe, y haz venir á un Simón que tiene por sobrenombre Pedro;

verses.KJV: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.WEB: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
verses.ASV: who shall speak unto thee words, whereby thou shalt be saved, thou and all thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual te falará palavras, em que tu sejas salvo, e [também] toda a tua casa.
verses.RVR09: El cual te hablará palabras por las cuales serás salvo tú, y toda tu casa.

verses.KJV: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.WEB: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
verses.ASV: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando comecei a falar, caiu o Espírito Santo sobre eles, assim como também no princípio [tinha caído] sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Y como comencé á hablar, cayó el Espíritu Santo sobre ellos también, como sobre nosotros al principio.

verses.KJV: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.ASV: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu me lembrei da palavra do Senhor, como ele tinha dito: Verdadeiramente João batizou com água, mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces me acordé del dicho del Señor, como dijo: Juan ciertamente bautizó en agua; mas vosotros seréis bautizados en Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.WEB: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
verses.ASV: If then God gave unto them the like gift as [he did] also unto us, when we believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se Deus deu a eles igual dom, assim como também a nós, que temos crido no Senhor Jesus Cristo; quem era eu, pois, para que pudesse proibir a Deus?
verses.RVR09: Así que, si Dios les dió el mismo don también como á nosotros que hemos creído en el Señor Jesucristo, ¿quién era yo que pudiese estorbar á Dios?

verses.KJV: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.WEB: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
verses.ASV: And when they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then to the Gentiles also hath God granted repentance unto life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao ouvirem estas coisas, se acalmaram, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: Portanto também aos gentios Deus deu arrependimento para a vida.
verses.RVR09: Entonces, oídas estas cosas, callaron, y glorificaron á Dios, diciendo: De manera que también á los Gentiles ha dado Dios arrepentimiento para vida.

verses.KJV: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.WEB: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
verses.ASV: They therefore that were scattered abroad upon the tribulation that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia, and Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to none save only to Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que foram dispersos por causa da perseguição que aconteceu por causa de Estêvão, passaram até a Fenícia, e Chipre, e Antioquia; não falando a ninguém a palavra, a não ser somente aos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y los que habían sido esparcidos por causa de la tribulación que sobrevino en tiempo de Esteban, anduvieron hasta Fenicia, y Cipro, y Antioquía, no hablando á nadie la palabra, sino sólo á los Judíos.

verses.KJV: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.ASV: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Greeks also, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia deles alguns homens cipriotas e cirenenses, os quais ao entrarem em Antioquia, falaram aos gregos, anunciando o Evangelho do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y de ellos había unos varones Ciprios y Cirenenses, los cuales como entraron en Antioquía, hablaron á los Griegos, anunciando el evangelio del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
verses.ASV: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number that believed turned unto the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mão do Senhor era com eles, e um grande número creu, e se converteu ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y la mano del Señor era con ellos: y creyendo, gran número se convirtió al Señor.

verses.KJV: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.WEB: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
verses.ASV: And the report concerning them came to the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas as far as Antioch:
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta notícia sobre eles chegou aos ouvidos da igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e enviaram a Barnabé, para ir até Antioquia.
verses.RVR09: Y llegó la fama de estas cosas á oídos de la iglesia que estaba en Jerusalem: y enviaron á Bernabé que fuese hasta Antioquía.

verses.KJV: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
verses.ASV: who, when he was come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad; and he exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, ao chegar [lá] ,e tendo visto a graça de Deus, alegrou-se; e exortou a todos, para que com o propósito do coração permanecessem no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: El cual, como llegó, y vió la gracia de Dios, regocijóse; y exhortó á todos á que permaneciesen en el propósito del corazón en el Señor.

verses.KJV: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
verses.ASV: for he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele era um bom homem, e cheio do Espírito Santo, e de fé; e uma grande multidão foi acrescentada ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Porque era varón bueno, y lleno de Espíritu Santo y de fe: y mucha compañía fué agregada al Señor.

verses.KJV: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.WEB: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
verses.ASV: And he went forth to Tarsus to seek for Saul;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Barnabé foi para Tarso, para buscar a Saulo; e achando-o, trouxe-o a Antioquia.
verses.RVR09: Después partió Bernabé á Tarso á buscar á Saulo; y hallado, le trajo á Antioquía.

verses.KJV: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.WEB: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
verses.ASV: and when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that even for a whole year they were gathered together with the church, and taught much people; and that the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, [durante] um ano completo eles se congregaram naquela igreja, e ensinavam a uma grande multidão; e em Antioquia os discípulos foram chamados pela primeira vez de cristãos.
verses.RVR09: Y conversaron todo un año allí con la iglesia, y enseñaron á mucha gente; y los discípulos fueron llamados Cristianos primeramente en Antioquía.

verses.KJV: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.WEB: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.ASV: Now in these days there came down prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naqueles dias desceram de Jerusalém [alguns] profetas a Antioquia.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquellos días descendieron de Jerusalem profetas á Antioquía.

verses.KJV: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.WEB: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
verses.ASV: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be a great famine over all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se um deles, por nome Ágabo, declarou pelo Espírito, que estava para haver uma grande fome em todo o mundo; que veio a acontecer no tempo de Cláudio César.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose uno de ellos, llamado Agabo, daba á entender por Espíritu, que había de haber una grande hambre en toda la tierra habitada: la cual hubo en tiempo de Claudio.

verses.KJV: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.WEB: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
verses.ASV: And the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren that dwelt in Judæa:
verses.ALMEIDA: E os discípulos determinaram de cada um, conforme o que pudesse, mandar algum [socorro] para serviço dos irmãos que habitavam na Judeia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los discípulos, cada uno conforme á lo que tenía, determinaron enviar subsidio á los hermanos que habitaban en Judea:

verses.KJV: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.WEB: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.ASV: which also they did, sending it to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que também fizeram, enviando [-o] aos anciãos pela mão de Barnabé e de Saulo.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual asimismo hicieron, enviándolo á los ancianos por mano de Bernabé y de Saulo.

verses.KJV: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
verses.WEB: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
verses.ASV: Now about that time Herod the king put forth his hands to afflict certain of the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por aquele mesmo tempo o rei Herodes pôs as mãos para maltratar a alguns da igreja.
verses.RVR09: Y EN el mismo tiempo el rey Herodes echó mano á maltratar algunos de la iglesia.

verses.KJV: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.WEB: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
verses.ASV: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E matou a Tiago, o irmão de João, pela espada.
verses.RVR09: Y mató á cuchillo á Jacobo, hermano de Juan.

verses.KJV: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.WEB: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
verses.ASV: And when he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. And [those] were the days of unleavened bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo que isto agradava aos judeus, ele fez ainda mais, para também prender a Pedro (e eram os dias dos [pães] sem fermento).
verses.RVR09: Y viendo que había agradado á los Judíos, pasó adelante para prender también á Pedro. Eran entonces los días de los ázimos.

verses.KJV: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
verses.WEB: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
verses.ASV: And when he had taken him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to guard him; intending after the Passover to bring him forth to the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do qual, também detendo, lançou-o na prisão, entregando [-o] a quatro quaternos de soldados, que o guardassem; pretendendo tirá-lo [para mostrá-lo] ao povo depois da Páscoa.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndole preso, púsole en la cárcel, entregándole á cuatro cuaterniones de soldados que le guardasen; queriendo sacarle al pueblo después de la Pascua.

verses.KJV: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.WEB: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
verses.ASV: Peter therefore was kept in the prison: but prayer was made earnestly of the church unto God for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pedro era mantido na prisão; mas a igreja fazia fervorosa oração a Deus por ele.
verses.RVR09: Así que, Pedro era guardado en la cárcel; y la iglesia hacía sin cesar oración á Dios por él.

verses.KJV: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.WEB: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
verses.ASV: And when Herod was about to bring him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and guards before the door kept the prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Herodes estava para tirá-lo [para apresentá-lo] ,naquela mesma noite Pedro estava dormindo entre dois soldados, acorrentado com duas correntes; e os guardas diante da porta guardavam a prisão.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Herodes le había de sacar, aquella misma noche estaba Pedro durmiendo entre dos soldados, preso con dos cadenas, y los guardas delante de la puerta, que guardaban la cárcel.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.WEB: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
verses.ASV: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shined in the cell: and he smote Peter on the side, and awoke him, saying, Rise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que veio acima um anjo do Senhor, e uma luz brilhou na prisão; e tocando em Pedro em sua lateral, despertou-o, dizendo; Levanta-te, depressa!E as correntes caíram de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, el ángel del Señor sobrevino, y una luz resplandeció en la cárcel; é hiriendo á Pedro en el lado, le despertó, diciendo: Levántate prestamente. Y las cadenas se le cayeron de las manos.

verses.KJV: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.WEB: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
verses.ASV: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And he did so. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo lhe disse: Arruma-te, e amarra as tuas sandálias.E ele fez assim. E disse-lhe: Põe tua capa sobre ti, e segue-me.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo el ángel: Cíñete, y átate tus sandalias. Y lo hizo así. Y le dijo: Rodéate tu ropa, y sígueme.

verses.KJV: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.WEB: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
verses.ASV: And he went out, and followed; and he knew not that it was true which was done by the angel, but thought he saw a vision.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo, o seguia; e não sabia que era verdade o que se fazia pelo anjo, mas pensava que estava tendo alguma visão.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo, le seguía; y no sabía que era verdad lo que hacía el ángel, mas pensaba que veía visión.

verses.KJV: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.WEB: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
verses.ASV: And when they were past the first and the second guard, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth into the city; which opened to them of its own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and straightway the angel departed from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao passarem a primeira e a segunda guarda, chegaram à porta de ferro, que leva à cidade, a qual foi aberta por si mesma; e tendo saído, foram a uma rua, e logo o anjo partiu dele.
verses.RVR09: Y como pasaron la primera y la segunda guardia, vinieron á la puerta de hierro que va á la ciudad, la cual se les abrió de suyo: y salidos, pasaron una calle; y luego el ángel se apartó de él.

verses.KJV: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.WEB: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
verses.ASV: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a truth, that the Lord hath sent forth his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Pedro voltado a si, disse: Agora eu sei verdadeiramente que o Senhor enviou a seu anjo, e me livrou da mão de Herodes, e de toda a expectativa do povo dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pedro, volviendo en sí, dijo: Ahora entiendo verdaderamente que el Señor ha enviado su ángel, y me ha librado de la mano de Herodes, y de todo el pueblo de los Judíos que me esperaba.

verses.KJV: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.WEB: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
verses.ASV: And when he had considered [the thing], he came to the house of Mary the mother of John whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together and were praying.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, reconhecendo [isto] ,foi à casa de Maria, a mãe de João, que tinha por sobrenome Marcos, onde muitos estavam juntos, e oravam.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo considerado esto, llegó á casa de María la madre de Juan, el que tenía por sobrenombre Marcos, donde muchos estaban juntos orando.

verses.KJV: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
verses.WEB: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
verses.ASV: And when he knocked at the door of the gate, a maid came to answer, named Rhoda.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pedro, tendo batido a porta da entrada,veio uma moça de nome Rode, para escutar.
verses.RVR09: Y tocando Pedro á la puerta del patio, salió una muchacha, para escuchar, llamada Rhode:

verses.KJV: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verses.WEB: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
verses.ASV: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for joy, but ran in, and told that Peter stood before the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela, reconhecendo a voz de Pedro, de alegria não abriu a porta da entrada, em vez disso ela correu para dentro, e anunciou que Pedro estava fora à porta da entrada.
verses.RVR09: La cual como conoció la voz de Pedro, de gozo no abrió el postigo, sino corriendo adentro, dió nueva de que Pedro estaba al postigo.

verses.KJV: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.WEB: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she confidently affirmed that it was even so. And they said, It is his angel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe disseram: Tu estás delirando.Mas ela, insistindo que assim era. E eles diziam: É o anjo dele.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le dijeron: Estás loca. Mas ella afirmaba que así era. Entonces ellos decían: Su ángel es.

verses.KJV: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.WEB: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
verses.ASV: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Pedro continuava a bater; e ao abrirem, viram-no, e ficaram espantados.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pedro perseveraba en llamar: y cuando abrieron, viéronle, y se espantaron.

verses.KJV: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.WEB: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
verses.ASV: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him forth out of the prison. And he said, Tell these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went to another place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, fazendo-lhes gestos para que calassem, contou-lhes como o Senhor tinha lhe tirado da prisão, e disse: Anunciai isto a Tiago e aos irmãos.E tendo saído, foi para outro lugar.
verses.RVR09: Mas él haciéndoles con la mano señal de que callasen, les contó cómo el Señor le había sacado de la cárcel. Y dijo: Haced saber esto á Jacobo y á los hermanos. Y salió, y partió á otro lugar.

verses.KJV: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.WEB: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
verses.ASV: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo o dia, havia não pouca perturbação entre os soldados, sobre o que, pois, tinha acontecido com Pedro.
verses.RVR09: Luego que fué de día, hubo no poco alboroto entre los soldados sobre qué se había hecho de Pedro.

verses.KJV: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
verses.WEB: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
verses.ASV: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and tarried there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Herodes o buscou, e não o achou, tendo investigado aos guardas, mandou que eles fossem levados [para serem mortos] . E partindo da Judeia para Cesareia, ficou [ali] .
verses.RVR09: Mas Herodes, como le buscó y no le halló, hecha inquisición de los guardas, los mandó llevar. Después descendiendo de Judea á Cesarea, se quedó allí.

verses.KJV: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
verses.WEB: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
verses.ASV: Now he was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: and they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, they asked for peace, because their country was fed from the king’s country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Herodes estava extremamente irritado com os de Tiro e de Sidom; porém eles, vindo em concordância até ele, e persuadindo a Blasto, que era o camareiro do rei, pediram paz, porque a terra deles dependia dos alimentos da terra do rei [Herodes] .
verses.RVR09: Y Herodes estaba enojado contra los de Tiro y los de Sidón: mas ellos vinieron concordes á él, y sobornado Blasto, que era el camarero del rey, pedían paz; porque las tierras de ellos eran abastecidas por las del rey.

verses.KJV: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.WEB: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
verses.ASV: And upon a set day Herod arrayed himself in royal apparel, and sat on the throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E num dia marcado, Herodes vestiu roupas reais, e sentando no tribunal, fez-lhes um discurso.
verses.RVR09: Y un día señalado, Herodes vestido de ropa real, se sentó en el tribunal, y arengóles.

verses.KJV: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.WEB: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
verses.ASV: And the people shouted, [saying], The voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo exclamava: Voz de deus, e não de homem!
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo aclamaba: Voz de Dios, y no de hombre.

verses.KJV: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.WEB: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
verses.ASV: And immediately an angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no mesmo instante um anjo do Senhor o feriu, porque ele não deu a glória a Deus; e tendo sido comido por vermes, deixou de respirar.
verses.RVR09: Y luego el ángel del Señor le hirió, por cuanto no dió la gloria á Dios; y espiró comido de gusanos.

verses.KJV: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.WEB: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.ASV: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra de Deus crescia, e se multiplicava.
verses.RVR09: Mas la palabra del Señor crecía y era multiplicada.

verses.KJV: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.WEB: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
verses.ASV: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministration, taking with them John whose surname was Mark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Barnabé e Saulo, tendo cumprido aquele serviço, voltaram a Jerusalém, tomando também consigo a João, o que tinha por sobrenome Marcos.
verses.RVR09: Y Bernabé y Saulo volvieron de Jerusalem cumplido su servicio, tomando también consigo á Juan, el que tenía por sobrenombre Marcos.

verses.KJV: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.WEB: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.ASV: Now there were at Antioch, in the church that was [there], prophets and teachers, Barnabas, and Symeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen the foster-brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia em Antioquia, na igreja que estava [ali] , alguns profetas e mestres: Barnabé e Simeão, chamado Níger, e Lúcio cireneu, e Manaem, que tinha sido criado na infância junto com Herodes o Tetrarca, e Saulo.
verses.RVR09: HABÍA entonces en la iglesia que estaba en Antioquía, profetas y doctores: Bernabé, y Simón el que se llamaba Niger, y Lucio Cireneo, y Manahén, que había sido criado con Herodes el tetrarca, y Saulo.

verses.KJV: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.WEB: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
verses.ASV: And as they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo eles prestado serviço ao Senhor, e jejuado, o Espirito Santo disse: Separai-me a Barnabé e a Saulo, para a obra para a qual eu os tenho chamado.
verses.RVR09: Ministrando pues éstos al Señor, y ayunando, dijo el Espíritu Santo: Apartadme á Bernabé y á Saulo para la obra para la cual los he llamado.

verses.KJV: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.WEB: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.ASV: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então jejuando, e orando, e pondo as mãos sobre eles, [os] despediram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces habiendo ayunado y orado, y puesto las manos encima de ellos, despidiéronlos.

verses.KJV: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.WEB: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.ASV: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto estes, enviados pelo Espírito Santo, desceram a Selêucia, e dali navegaram para o Chipre.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, enviados así por el Espíritu Santo, descendieron á Seleucia; y de allí navegaron á Cipro.

verses.KJV: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.WEB: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
verses.ASV: And when they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John as their attendant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo chegado a Salamina, anunciavam a palavra de Deus nas sinagogas dos judeus; e também tinham a João como trabalhador [para os auxiliar] .
verses.RVR09: Y llegados á Salamina, anunciaban la palabra de Dios en las sinagogas de los Judíos: y tenían también á Juan en el ministerio.

verses.KJV: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
verses.WEB: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
verses.ASV: And when they had gone through the whole island unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-Jesus;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo eles atravessado a Ilha até Pafo, acharam a um certo mago, falso profeta, judeu, cujo nome era Barjesus.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo atravesado toda la isla hasta Papho, hallaron un hombre mago, falso profeta, Judío, llamado Barjesús;

verses.KJV: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.WEB: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.ASV: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. The same called unto him Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual estava com o procônsul Sérgio Paulo, homem prudente. Este, tendo chamado a si a Barnabé, e a Saulo, procurava muito ouvir a palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El cual estaba con el procónsul Sergio Paulo, varón prudente. Este, llamando á Bernabé y á Saulo, deseaba oir la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.WEB: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
verses.ASV: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn aside the proconsul from the faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas resistia-lhes Elimas, o mago (que assim significa seu nome), procurando afastar o procônsul da fé.
verses.RVR09: Mas les resistía Elimas el encantador (que así se interpreta su nombre), procurando apartar de la fe al procónsul.

verses.KJV: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him.
verses.WEB: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
verses.ASV: But Saul, who is also [called] Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Saulo, que também [se chama] Paulo, cheio do Espírito Santo, e olhando fixamente para ele, disse:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saulo, que también es Pablo, lleno del Espíritu Santo, poniendo en él los ojos,

verses.KJV: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.WEB: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.ASV: and said, O full of all guile and all villany, thou son of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó filho do diabo, cheio de toda enganação e toda malícia, inimigo de toda justiça, não cessarás de perverter os corretos caminhos do Senhor?
verses.RVR09: Dijo: Oh, lleno de todo engaño y de toda maldad, hijo del diablo, enemigo de toda justicia, ¿no cesarás de trastornar los caminos rectos del Señor?

verses.KJV: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.WEB: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
verses.ASV: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, eis que a mão do Senhor [está] contra ti, e serás cego, não vendo o sol por algum tempo.E no mesmo instante caiu sobre ele um embaçamento, e trevas; e ele, andando ao redor, procurava alguém que o guiasse pela mão.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, he aquí la mano del Señor es contra ti, y serás ciego, que no veas el sol por tiempo. Y luego cayeron en él obscuridad y tinieblas; y andando alrededor, buscaba quién le condujese por la mano.

verses.KJV: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.ASV: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o procônsul, vendo o que tinha acontecido, creu, espantado pela doutrina do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el procónsul, viendo lo que había sido hecho, creyó, maravillado de la doctrina del Señor.

verses.KJV: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo partido de Pafo, Paulo e os que estavam com ele foram a Perges, [cidade] da Panfília. Mas João, separando-se deles, voltou a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Papho, Pablo y sus compañeros arribaron á Perge de Pamphylia: entonces Juan, apartándose de ellos, se volvió á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.WEB: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
verses.ASV: But they, passing through from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia; and they went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, tendo passado de Perges, vieram a Antioquia, [cidade] da Pisídia; e ao entrarem na sinagoga [n] um dia de sábado, sentaram-se.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos pasando de Perge, llegaron á Antioquía de Pisidia, y entrando en la sinagoga un día de sábado, sentáronse.

verses.KJV: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.WEB: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
verses.ASV: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois da leitura da Lei e dos profetas, os chefes da sinagoga lhes mandaram, dizendo: Homens irmãos, se em vós há [alguma] palavra de exortação ao povo, dizei.
verses.RVR09: Y después de la lectura de la ley y de los profetas, los príncipes de la sinagoga enviaron á ellos, diciendo: Varones hermanos, si tenéis alguna palabra de exhortación para el pueblo, hablad.

verses.KJV: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.WEB: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
verses.ASV: And Paul stood up, and beckoning with the hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, hearken:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, levantando-se e fazendo gesto com a mão, disse: Homens israelitas, e [vós] os que temeis a Deus, ouvi:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo, levantándose, hecha señal de silencio con la mano, dice: Varones Israelitas, y los que teméis á Dios, oid:

verses.KJV: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.WEB: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
verses.ASV: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they sojourned in the land of Egypt, and with a high arm led he them forth out of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus deste povo de Israel escolheu a nossos pais, e exaltou ao povo, sendo eles estrangeiros na terra do Egito, e com o braço levantando, ele os tirou dela.
verses.RVR09: El Dios del pueblo de Israel escogió á nuestros padres, y ensalzó al pueblo, siendo ellos extranjeros en la tierra de Egipto, y con brazo levantado los sacó de ella.

verses.KJV: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And for about the time of forty years as a nursing-father bare he them in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pelo tempo de cerca de quarenta anos, ele suportou os costumes deles no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y por tiempo como de cuarenta años soportó sus costumbres en el desierto;

verses.KJV: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.WEB: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
verses.ASV: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave [them] their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred and fifty years:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo destruído a sete nações na terra de Canaã, repartiu-lhes as terras por sorte.
verses.RVR09: Y destruyendo siete naciones en la tierra de Canaán, les repartió por suerte la tierra de ellas.

verses.KJV: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.WEB: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
verses.ASV: and after these things he gave [them] judges until Samuel the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto, cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos, ele [lhes] deu juízes, até o profeta Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Y después, como por cuatrocientos y cincuenta años, dióles jueces hasta el profeta Samuel.

verses.KJV: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.WEB: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
verses.ASV: And afterward they asked for a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for the space of forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto, pediram a um Rei, e ele lhes deu a Saul, filho de Quis, homem da tribo de Benjamim, [durante] quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces demandaron rey; y les dió Dios á Saúl, hijo de Cis, varón de la tribu de Benjamín, por cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.WEB: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
verses.ASV: And when he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king; to whom also he bare witness and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who shall do all my will.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirando a este, levantou-lhes por rei a Davi, ao qual também deu testemunho, e disse: Eu achei a Davi, [filho] de Jessé, um homem conforme o meu coração, que fará toda a minha vontade.
verses.RVR09: Y quitado aquél, levantóles por rey á David, al que dió también testimonio, diciendo: He hallado á David, hijo de Jessé, varón conforme á mi corazón, el cual hará todo lo que yo quiero.

verses.KJV: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.WEB: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
verses.ASV: Of this man’s seed hath God according to promise brought unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus;
verses.ALMEIDA: Da descendência deste, conforme a promessa, Deus levantou a Jesus por Salvador de Israel;
verses.RVR09: De la simiente de éste, Dios, conforme á la promesa, levantó á Jesús por Salvador á Israel;

verses.KJV: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.WEB: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
verses.ASV: when John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo João primeiro, antes de sua vinda, pregado o batismo de arrependimento a todo o povo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Predicando Juan delante de la faz de su venida el bautismo de arrepentimiento á todo el pueblo de Israel.

verses.KJV: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.WEB: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
verses.ASV: And as John was fulfilling his course, he said, What suppose ye that I am? I am not [he]. But behold, there cometh one after me the shoes of whose feet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando João cumpriu [sua] carreira, disse: Quem vós pensais que eu sou? Eu não sou o [Cristo] ,mas eis que após mim vem aquele, cujas sandálias dos pés eu não sou digno de desatar.
verses.RVR09: Mas como Juan cumpliese su carrera, dijo: ¿Quién pensáis que soy? No soy yo él; mas he aquí, viene tras mí uno, cuyo calzado de los pies no soy digno de desatar.

verses.KJV: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.WEB: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
verses.ASV: Brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you that fear God, to us is the word of this salvation sent forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens irmãos, filhos da descendência de Abraão, e os que dentre vós temem a Deus, a vós é enviada a palavra desta salvação.
verses.RVR09: Varones hermanos, hijos del linaje de Abraham, y los que entre vosotros temen á Dios, á vosotros es enviada la palabra de esta salud.

verses.KJV: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.WEB: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
verses.ASV: For they that dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath, fulfilled [them] by condemning [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os que habitavam em Jerusalém, e seus líderes, não conhecendo a este, ao condenarem [-no] ,cumpriram as vozes dos profetas, que são lidas todos os sábados.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que habitaban en Jerusalem, y sus príncipes, no conociendo á éste, y las voces de los profetas que se leen todos los sábados, condenándole, las cumplieron.

verses.KJV: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.WEB: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
verses.ASV: And though they found no cause of death [in him], yet asked they of Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [mesmo] achando nenhum motivo para morte, pediram a Pilatos que fosse morto.
verses.RVR09: Y sin hallar en él causa de muerte, pidieron á Pilato que le matasen.

verses.KJV: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.WEB: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
verses.ASV: And when they had fulfilled all things that were written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo eles cumprido todas as coisas que estavam escritas sobre ele, tirando [-o] do madeiro, puseram [-no] na sepultura.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo cumplido todas las cosas que de él estaban escritas, quitándolo del madero, lo pusieron en el sepulcro.

verses.KJV: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.WEB: But God raised him from the dead,
verses.ASV: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus o ressuscitou dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios le levantó de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.WEB: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
verses.ASV: and he was seen for many days of them that came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses unto the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual foi visto durante muitos dias pelos que haviam subido com ele da Galileia, que são suas testemunhas para com o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y él fué visto por muchos días de los que habían subido juntamente con él de Galilea á Jerusalem, los cuales son sus testigos al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.WEB: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
verses.ASV: And we bring you good tidings of the promise made unto the fathers,
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós vos anunciamos o Evangelho da promessa que foi feita aos pais; ao qual Deus já nos cumpriu a nós, filhos deles, ressuscitando a Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros también os anunciamos el evangelio de aquella promesa que fué hecha á los padres,

verses.KJV: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.WEB: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
verses.ASV: that God hath fulfilled the same unto our children, in that he raised up Jesus; as also it is written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como está escrito no salmo segundo: Tu és meu Filho, hoje eu te gerei.
verses.RVR09: La cual Dios ha cumplido á los hijos de ellos, á nosotros, resucitando á Jesús: como también en el salmo segundo está escrito: Mi hijo eres tú, yo te he engendrado hoy.

verses.KJV: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.WEB: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
verses.ASV: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he hath spoken on this wise, I will give you the holy and sure [blessings] of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [quanto a] que o ressuscitasse dos mortos, para nunca mais voltar à degradação, assim disse: Eu vos darei as fiéis beneficências de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y que le levantó de los muertos para nunca más volver á corrupción, así lo dijo: Os daré las misericordias fieles de David.

verses.KJV: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.WEB: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
verses.ASV: Because he saith also in another [psalm], Thou wilt not give thy Holy One to see corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que também em outro [salmo] ele diz: Não permitirás que teu Santo veja degradação.
verses.RVR09: Por eso dice también en otro lugar: No permitirás que tu Santo vea corrupción.

verses.KJV: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.WEB: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
verses.ASV: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, na verdade, tendo Davi servido ao conselho de Deus, morreu, foi posto junto a seus pais, e viu degradação.
verses.RVR09: Porque á la verdad David, habiendo servido en su edad á la voluntad de Dios, durmió, y fué juntado con sus padres, y vió corrupción:

verses.KJV: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.WEB: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
verses.ASV: but he whom God raised up saw no corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele a quem Deus ressuscitou nenhuma degradação viu.
verses.RVR09: Mas aquel que Dios levantó, no vió corrupción.

verses.KJV: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.WEB: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;
verses.ASV: Be it known unto you therefore, brethren, that through this man is proclaimed unto you remission of sins:
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja-vos pois conhecido, homens irmãos, que por este vos é anunciado o perdão dos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Séaos pues notorio, varones hermanos, que por éste os es anunciada remisión de pecados;

verses.KJV: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.WEB: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.ASV: and by him every one that believeth is justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de tudo o que pela lei de Moisés não pudestes ser justificados, neste é justificado todo aquele que crê.
verses.RVR09: Y de todo lo que por la ley de Moisés no pudisteis ser justificados, en éste es justificado todo aquel que creyere.

verses.KJV: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.WEB: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
verses.ASV: Beware therefore, lest that come upon [you] which is spoken in the prophets:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vede, para que não venha sobre vós o que está escrito nos [livros dos] profetas:
verses.RVR09: Mirad, pues, que no venga sobre vosotros lo que está dicho en los profetas;

verses.KJV: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.WEB: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
verses.ASV: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish; For I work a work in your days, A work which ye shall in no wise believe, if one declare it unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Vós] desprezadores, vede e espantai-vos, e desaparecei-vos; porque eu opero obra em vossos dias, obra na qual não crereis, se alguém vos contar.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, oh menospreciadores, y entonteceos, y desvaneceos; porque yo obro una obra en vuestros días, obra que no creeréis, si alguien os la contare.

verses.KJV: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.WEB: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
verses.ASV: And as they went out, they besought that these words might be spoken to them the next sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo os judeus saído da sinagoga,os gentios rogaram [-lhes] que no sábado seguinte eles lhes falassem estas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo ellos de la sinagoga de los Judíos, los Gentiles les rogaron que el sábado siguiente les hablasen estas palabras.

verses.KJV: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.WEB: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.ASV: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo terminado [a reunião] da sinagoga, muitos dos judeus, e dos religiosos prosélitos, seguiram a Paulo e a Barnabé; os quais, falando-lhes, exortavam-nos a permanecerem na graça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y despedida la congregación, muchos de los Judíos y de los religiosos prosélitos siguieron á Pablo y á Bernabé; los cuales hablándoles, les persuadían que permaneciesen en la gracia de Dios.

verses.KJV: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.WEB: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
verses.ASV: And the next sabbath almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no sábado seguinte ajuntou-se quase toda a cidade para ouvir a palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el sábado siguiente se juntó casi toda la ciudad á oir la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.WEB: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
verses.ASV: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os Judeus, ao verem as multidões, ficaram cheios de inveja, e falavam contrariamente ao que Paulo dizia, falando contrariamente e blasfemando.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Judíos, visto el gentío, llenáronse de celo, y se oponían á lo que Pablo decía, contradiciendo y blasfemando.

verses.KJV: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: And Paul and Barnabas spake out boldly, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first be spoken to you. Seeing ye thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo e Barnabé, usando de ousadia, disseram: Era necessário que a palavra de Deus fosse primeiro falada a vós; mas já que a rejeitais, e não vos julgais dignos da vida eterna, eis que nós nos viramos [em direção] aos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo y Bernabé, usando de libertad, dijeron: A vosotros á la verdad era menester que se os hablase la palabra de Dios; mas pues que la desecháis, y os juzgáis indignos de la vida eterna, he aquí, nos volvemos á los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
verses.ASV: For so hath the Lord commanded us, [saying], I have set thee for a light of the Gentiles, That thou shouldest be for salvation unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim o Senhor nos mandou, [dizendo] : Eu te pus como luz para os gentios, para que tu sejas como salvação até às extremidades da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque así nos ha mandado el Señor, diciendo: Te he puesto para luz de los Gentiles, para que seas salud hasta lo postrero de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.WEB: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
verses.ASV: And as the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os gentios, tendo ouvido [isto] ,alegraram-se, e glorificavam ao Senhor; e creram todos quantos estavam determinados para a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Y los Gentiles oyendo esto, fueron gozosos, y glorificaban la palabra del Señor: y creyeron todos los que estaban ordenados para vida eterna.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.WEB: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
verses.ASV: And the word of the Lord was spread abroad throughout all the region.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do Senhor era divulgada por toda aquela região.
verses.RVR09: Y la palabra del Señor era sembrada por toda aquella provincia.

verses.KJV: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.WEB: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
verses.ASV: But the Jews urged on the devout women of honorable estate, and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and cast them out of their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os judeus incitaram algumas mulheres devotas e honradas, e aos líderes da cidade, e levantaram perseguição contra Paulo e Barnabé, e os expulsaram de seus limites.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Judíos concitaron mujeres pías y honestas, y á los principales de la ciudad, y levantaron persecución contra Pablo y Bernabé, y los echaron de sus términos.

verses.KJV: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.WEB: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
verses.ASV: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles, sacudindo contra eles o pó dos seus pés, vieram a Icônio.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces sacudiendo en ellos el polvo de sus pies, vinieron á Iconio.

verses.KJV: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os discípulos se enchiam de alegria e do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y los discípulos estaban llenos de gozo, y del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.WEB: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu em Icônio, que entraram juntos na sinagoga dos judeus, e falaram de tal maneira que creu uma grande multidão, tanto de judeus como de gregos.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en Iconio, que entrados juntamente en la sinagoga de los Judíos, hablaron de tal manera, que creyó una grande multitud de Judíos, y asimismo de Griegos.

verses.KJV: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.WEB: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
verses.ASV: But the Jews that were disobedient stirred up the souls of the Gentiles, and made them evil affected against the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os judeus incrédulos incitaram e irritaram os ânimos dos gentios contra os irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Judíos que fueron incrédulos, incitaron y corrompieron los ánimos de los Gentiles contra los hermanos.

verses.KJV: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.WEB: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.ASV: Long time therefore they tarried [there] speaking boldly in the Lord, who bare witness unto the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles ficaram [ali] por muito tempo, falando ousadamente no Senhor, o qual dava testemunho à palavra de sua graça, concedendo [que] sinais e milagres fossem feitos pelas mãos deles.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso se detuvieron allí mucho tiempo, confiados en el Señor, el cual daba testimonio á la palabra de su gracia, dando que señales y milagros fuesen hechos por las manos de ellos.

verses.KJV: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.WEB: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.
verses.ASV: But the multitude of the city was divided; and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão da cidade se dividiu; e uns eram a favor dos judeus, e outros a favor dos apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Mas el vulgo de la ciudad estaba dividido; y unos eran con los Judíos, y otros con los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.WEB: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
verses.ASV: And when there was made an onset both of the Gentiles and of the Jews with their rulers, to treat them shamefully and to stone them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E fazendo-se uma rebelião, tanto de judeus como de gentios, juntos com seus líderes, para falarem mal deles, e os apedrejarem.
verses.RVR09: Y haciendo ímpetu los Judíos y los Gentiles juntamente con sus príncipes, para afrentarlos y apedrearlos,

verses.KJV: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.WEB: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
verses.ASV: they became aware of it, and fled unto the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra and Derbe, and the region round about:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, sabendo [disto] ,fugiram para as cidades da Licaônia, [chamadas] Listra e Derbe; e à região ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Habiéndolo entendido, huyeron á Listra y Derbe, ciudades de Licaonia, y por toda la tierra alrededor.

verses.KJV: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.WEB: There they preached the Good News.
verses.ASV: and there they preached the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali eles anunciavam ao Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Y allí predicaban el evangelio.

verses.KJV: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
verses.WEB: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
verses.ASV: And at Lystra there sat a certain man, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um certo homem em Listra estava sentado, tendo incapacidade nos pés, aleijado desde o ventre de sua mãe, que nunca tinha andado.
verses.RVR09: Y un hombre de Listra, impotente de los pies, estaba sentado, cojo desde el vientre de su madre, que jamás había andado.

verses.KJV: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.WEB: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
verses.ASV: The same heard Paul speaking: who, fastening his eyes upon him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
verses.ALMEIDA: Este ouviu Paulo falando; o qual, olhando com atenção, e vendo que ele tinha fé para ser curado,
verses.RVR09: Este oyó hablar á Pablo; el cual, como puso los ojos en él, y vió que tenía fe para ser sano,

verses.KJV: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.WEB: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
verses.ASV: said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped up and walked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse em alta voz: Levanta-te direito sobre teus pés.E ele saltou e andou.
verses.RVR09: Dijo á gran voz: Levántate derecho sobre tus pies. Y saltó, y anduvo.

verses.KJV: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.WEB: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
verses.ASV: And when the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as multidões, vendo o que Paulo tinha feito, levantaram suas vozes, dizendo em [língua] licaônica: Os deuses se fizeram semelhantes a homens, e desceram até nós.
verses.RVR09: Entonces las gentes, visto lo que Pablo había hecho, alzaron la voz, diciendo en lengua licaónica: Dioses semejantes á hombres han descendido á nosotros.

verses.KJV: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.WEB: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.ASV: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercury, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamaram a Barnabé de Júpiter; e a Paulo, de Mercúrio; porque este era o líder ao falar.
verses.RVR09: Y á Bernabé llamaban Júpiter, y á Pablo, Mercurio, porque era el que llevaba la palabra.

verses.KJV: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.WEB: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
verses.ASV: And the priest of Jupiter whose [temple] was before the city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the multitudes.
