verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote de Júpiter, que estava diante da cidade deles, trazendo touros e grinaldas à entrada da porta, ele, junto com as companhias, queria oferecer sacrifício [a eles] .
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote de Júpiter, que estaba delante de la ciudad de ellos, trayendo toros y guirnaldas delante de las puertas, quería con el pueblo sacrificar.

verses.KJV: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.WEB: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
verses.ASV: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they rent their garments, and sprang forth among the multitude, crying out
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os apóstolos Barnabé e Paulo, ao ouvirem [isto] ,rasgaram suas roupas, e saltaram entre a multidão, clamando,
verses.RVR09: Y como lo oyeron los apóstoles Bernabé y Pablo, rotas sus ropas, se lanzaron al gentío, dando voces,

verses.KJV: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.WEB: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
verses.ASV: and saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good tidings, that ye should turn from these vain things unto a living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo: Homens, por que fazeis estais coisas? Também nós somos homens como vós, sujeitos às mesmas emoções; e vos anunciamos o Evangelho para que vos convertais destas vaidades para o Deus vivo, que fez o céu, a terra, o mar, e tudo quanto neles há.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: Varones, ¿por qué hacéis esto? Nosotros también somos hombres semejantes á vosotros, que os anunciamos que de estas vanidades os convirtáis al Dios vivo, que hizo el cielo y la tierra, y la mar, y todo lo que está en ellos:

verses.KJV: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.WEB: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.ASV: who in the generations gone by suffered all the nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual nas gerações passadas deixou os os gentios andarem seus [próprios] caminhos.
verses.RVR09: El cual en las edades pasadas ha dejado á todas las gentes andar en sus caminos;

verses.KJV: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.WEB: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
verses.ASV: And yet he left not himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you from heaven rains and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que, contudo, não tenha deixado a si mesmo sem testemunho, fazendo o bem desde o céu, dando-nos chuvas, e tempos frutíferos, [e] enchendo nossos corações de alimento e alegria.
verses.RVR09: Si bien no se dejó á sí mismo sin testimonio, haciendo bien, dándonos lluvias del cielo y tiempos fructíferos, hinchiendo de mantenimiento y de alegría nuestros corazones.

verses.KJV: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.WEB: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
verses.ASV: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the multitudes from doing sacrifice unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo disto isto, apenas detiveram as multidões de que não fizessem sacrifícios a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo estas cosas, apenas apaciguaron el pueblo, para que no les ofreciesen sacrificio.

verses.KJV: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.WEB: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
verses.ASV: But there came Jews thither from Antioch and Iconium: and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vieram [alguns] judeus de Antioquia, e de Icônio, e persuadiram a multidão; e apedrejando a Paulo, arrastaram [-no] para fora da cidade, pensando que ele estivesse morto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces sobrevinieron unos Judíos de Antioquía y de Iconio, que persuadieron á la multitud, y habiendo apedreado á Pablo, le sacaron fuera de la ciudad, pensando que estaba muerto.

verses.KJV: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.WEB: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.ASV: But as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and entered into the city: and on the morrow he went forth with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, tendo os discípulos ficado ao seu redor, ele se levantou, e entrou na cidade; e no dia seguinte saiu com Barnabé para Derbe.
verses.RVR09: Mas rodeándole los discípulos, se levantó y entró en la ciudad; y un día después, partió con Bernabé á Derbe.

verses.KJV: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.WEB: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.ASV: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, and to Iconium, and to Antioch,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo anunciado o Evangelho àquela cidade, e feito muitos discípulos, eles voltaram a Listra, e a Icônio, e a Antioquia,
verses.RVR09: Y como hubieron anunciado el evangelio á aquella ciudad, y enseñado á muchos, volvieron á Listra, y á Iconio, y á Antioquía,

verses.KJV: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confirmando os ânimos dos discípulos, e exortando-os para que permanecessem na fé, e que nos é necessário entrar no Reino de Deus por meio de muitas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Confirmando los ánimos de los discípulos, exhortándoles á que permaneciesen en la fe, y que es menester que por muchas tribulaciones entremos en el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.WEB: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
verses.ASV: And when they had appointed for them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo escolhido por votação anciãos para cada igreja, orando com jejuns, eles foram enviados ao Senhor, no qual tinham crido.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndoles constituído ancianos en cada una de las iglesias, y habiendo orado con ayunos, los encomendaron al Señor en el cual habían creído.

verses.KJV: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.WEB: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
verses.ASV: And they passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo passado por Pisídia, vieram à Panfília.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando por Pisidia vinieron á Pamphylia.

verses.KJV: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.WEB: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
verses.ASV: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo falado a palavra em Perges, desceram a Atália.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo predicado la palabra en Perge, descendieron á Atalia;

verses.KJV: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.WEB: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
verses.ASV: and thence they sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali navegaram para Antioquia, onde tinham sido encomendados à graça de Deus para a obra que eles [já] tinham cumprido.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí navegaron á Antioquía, donde habían sido encomendados á la gracia de Dios para la obra que habían acabado.

verses.KJV: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
verses.ASV: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao chegarem, e reunirem a igreja, relataram quão grandes coisas Deus tinha feito com eles; e como ele tinha aberto a porta da fé aos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo llegado, y reunido la iglesia, relataron cuán grandes cosas había Dios hecho con ellos, y cómo había abierto á los Gentiles la puerta de la fe.

verses.KJV: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.WEB: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
verses.ASV: And they tarried no little time with the disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles ficaram ali não pouco tempo com os discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y se quedaron allí mucho tiempo con los discípulos.

verses.KJV: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.WEB: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
verses.ASV: And certain men came down from Judæa and taught the brethren, [saying], Except ye be circumcised after the custom of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns que tinham descido da Judeia ensinavam aos irmãos, [dizendo] : Se vós não vos circuncidardes conforme o costume de Moisés, não podeis ser salvos.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES algunos que venían de Judea enseñaban á los hermanos: Que si no os circuncidáis conforme al rito de Moisés, no podéis ser salvos.

verses.KJV: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.WEB: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.ASV: And when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and questioning with them, [the brethren] appointed that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, havendo não pequena resistência e confronto de Paulo e Barnabé contra eles, ordenaram que Paulo, Barnabé e alguns outros deles subissem aos apóstolos e aos anciãos a Jerusalém sobre esta questão.
verses.RVR09: Así que, suscitada una disensión y contienda no pequeña á Pablo y á Bernabé contra ellos, determinaron que subiesen Pablo y Bernabé á Jerusalem, y algunos otros de ellos, á los apóstoles y á los ancianos, sobre esta cuestión.

verses.KJV: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.WEB: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
verses.ASV: They therefore, being brought on their way by the church, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então sendo eles preparados para a viagem e despedidos pela igreja, passaram pela Fenícia e Samaria, contando [sobre] a conversão dos gentios; e davam grande alegria a todos os irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Ellos, pues, habiendo sido acompañados de la iglesia, pasaron por la Fenicia y Samaria, contando la conversión de los Gentiles; y daban gran gozo á todos los hermanos.

verses.KJV: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.WEB: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
verses.ASV: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church and the apostles and the elders, and they rehearsed all things that God had done with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo chegado a Jerusalém, eles foram recebidos pela igreja, e pelos apóstolos e anciãos; e lhes anunciaram quão grandes coisas Deus tinha feito com eles;
verses.RVR09: Y llegados á Jerusalem, fueron recibidos de la iglesia y de los apóstoles y de los ancianos: y refirieron todas las cosas que Dios había hecho con ellos.

verses.KJV: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.WEB: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
verses.ASV: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees who believed, saying, It is needful to circumcise them, and to charge them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [que] alguns do grupo dos fariseus que tinham crido, levantaram-se, dizendo que era necessário circuncidá-los, e mandar [-lhes] que guardem a Lei de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Mas algunos de la secta de los Fariseos, que habían creído, se levantaron, diciendo: Que es menester circuncidarlos, y mandarles que guarden la ley de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.WEB: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
verses.ASV: And the apostles and the elders were gathered together to consider of this matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os apóstolos e anciãos se reuniram para dar atenção a este assunto.
verses.RVR09: Y se juntaron los apóstoles y los ancianos para conocer de este negocio.

verses.KJV: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.WEB: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.
verses.ASV: And when there had been much questioning, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Brethren, ye know that a good while ago God made choice among you, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo muita discussão, Pedro se levantou, e lhes disse: Homens irmãos, vós sabeis que há muito tempo Deus [meu] escolheu entre nós, para que por minha boca os gentios ouvissem a palavra do Evangelho, e cressem.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo habido grande contienda, levantándose Pedro, les dijo: Varones hermanos, vosotros sabéis cómo ya hace algún tiempo que Dios escogió que los Gentiles oyesen por mi boca la palabra del evangelio, y creyesen.

verses.KJV: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
verses.WEB: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
verses.ASV: And God, who knoweth the heart, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Spirit, even as he did unto us;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus, que conhece os corações, deu-lhes testemunho, dando-lhes o Espírito Santo, assim como também a nós.
verses.RVR09: Y Dios, que conoce los corazones, les dió testimonio, dándoles el Espíritu Santo también como á nosotros;

verses.KJV: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.WEB: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
verses.ASV: and he made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nenhuma diferença fez entre nós e eles, purificando seus corações pela fé.
verses.RVR09: Y ninguna diferencia hizo entre nosotros y ellos, purificando con la fe sus corazones.

verses.KJV: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.WEB: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.ASV: Now therefore why make ye trial of God, that ye should put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então agora, por que tentais a Deus, pondo um jugo sobre o pescoço dos discípulos; que nem nossos pais, nem nós podemos levar?
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, ¿por qué tentáis á Dios, poniendo sobre la cerviz de los discípulos yugo, que ni nuestros padres ni nosotros hemos podido llevar?

verses.KJV: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.WEB: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
verses.ASV: But we believe that we shall be saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, in like manner as they.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas cremos que, pela graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nós somos salvos, assim como também eles.
verses.RVR09: Antes por la gracia del Señor Jesús creemos que seremos salvos, como también ellos.

verses.KJV: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.WEB: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
verses.ASV: And all the multitude kept silence; and they hearkened unto Barnabas and Paul rehearsing what signs and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles through them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a multidão se calou; e ouviram a Barnabé e a Paulo, que contavam quão grandes sinais e milagres Deus tinha feito por meio deles entre os gentios.
verses.RVR09: Entonces toda la multitud calló, y oyeron á Bernabé y á Pablo, que contaban cuán grandes maravillas y señales Dios había hecho por ellos entre los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.WEB: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
verses.ASV: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo estes se calado, Tiago respondeu, dizendo: Homens irmãos, ouvi-me:
verses.RVR09: Y después que hubieron callado, Jacobo respondió, diciendo: Varones hermanos, oidme:

verses.KJV: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.WEB: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.ASV: Symeon hath rehearsed how first God visited the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão informou como primeiro Deus visitou aos gentios, para tomar [deles] um povo para seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Simón ha contado cómo Dios primero visitó á los Gentiles, para tomar de ellos pueblo para su nombre;

verses.KJV: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.WEB: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
verses.ASV: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.ALMEIDA: E com isso concordam as palavras dos profetas, como está escrito:
verses.RVR09: Y con esto concuerdan las palabras de los profetas, como está escrito:

verses.KJV: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.WEB: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up
verses.ASV: After these things I will return, And I will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen; And I will build again the ruins thereof, And I will set it up:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto eu voltarei, e reconstruirei o tabernáculo de Davi, que caído está; e reconstruirei [de] suas ruínas, e voltarei a levantá-lo;
verses.RVR09: Después de esto volveré y restauraré la habitación de David, que estaba caída; y repararé sus ruinas, y la volveré á levantar;

verses.KJV: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.WEB: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’
verses.ASV: That the residue of men may seek after the Lord, And all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que o resto da humanidade busque ao Senhor, e todos os gentios sobre os quais meu nome é invocado, diz o Senhor, que faz todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Para que el resto de los hombres busque al Señor, y todos los Gentiles, sobre los cuales es llamado mi nombre, dice el Señor, que hace todas estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.WEB: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
verses.ASV: Saith the Lord, who maketh these things known from of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: São conhecidas por Deus desde a antiguidade todas as suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Conocidas son á Dios desde el siglo todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.WEB: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
verses.ASV: Wherefore my judgment is, that we trouble not them that from among the Gentiles turn to God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu julgo que aqueles que dos gentios se convertem a Deus não devem ser perturbados.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual yo juzgo, que los que de los Gentiles se convierten á Dios, no han de ser inquietados;

verses.KJV: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.WEB: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
verses.ASV: but that we write unto them, that they abstain from the pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from what is strangled, and from blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [que] lhes escrevamos para que se abstenham das contaminações dos ídolos, e do pecado sexual, e da [carne] sufocada, e do sangue.
verses.RVR09: Sino escribirles que se aparten de las contaminaciones de los ídolos, y de fornicación, y de ahogado, y de sangre.

verses.KJV: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.WEB: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: For Moses from generations of old hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Moisés, desde as gerações antigas, tem em cada cidade quem o pregue nas sinagogas, sendo lido todo sábado.
verses.RVR09: Porque Moisés desde los tiempos antiguos tiene en cada ciudad quien le predique en las sinagogas, donde es leído cada sábado.

verses.KJV: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.WEB: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
verses.ASV: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole church, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; [namely], Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então pareceu bem aos apóstolos, e aos anciãos, com toda a igreja, eleger deles [alguns] homens, para serem enviados com Paulo e Barnabé a Antioquia: Judas, que tinha por sobrenome Barsabás; e a Silas, homens líderes entre os irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces pareció bien á los apóstoles y á los ancianos, con toda la iglesia, elegir varones de ellos, y enviarlos á Antioquía con Pablo y Bernabé: á Judas que tenía por sobrenombre Barsabas, y á Silas, varones principales entre los hermanos;

verses.KJV: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.
verses.WEB: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
verses.ASV: and they wrote [thus] by them, The apostles and the elders, brethren, unto the brethren who are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia, greeting:
verses.ALMEIDA: E escreveram por meio deles o seguinte: Os apóstolos e os anciãos, e os irmãos – para os irmãos dentre os gentios, que [estão] em Antioquia, Síria e Cilícia; saudações.
verses.RVR09: Y escribir por mano de ellos: Los apóstoles y los ancianos y los hermanos, á los hermanos de los Gentiles que están en Antioquía, y en Siria, y en Cilicia, salud:

verses.KJV: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.WEB: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
verses.ASV: Forasmuch as we have heard that certain who went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls; to whom we gave no commandment;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dado que ouvimos que alguns dos que saíram de nós vos perturbaram com palavras, [e] causaram incômodo a vossas almas, dizendo que deveis vos circuncidar e guardar a Lei, aos quais não mandamos;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto hemos oído que algunos que han salido de nosotros, os han inquietado con palabras, trastornando vuestras almas, mandando circuncidaros y guardar la ley, á los cuales no mandamos;

verses.KJV: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.WEB: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.ASV: it seemed good unto us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pareceu-nos bem, reunidos em concordância, escolher [alguns] homens, e enviá-los até vós, com nossos amados Barnabé e Paulo.
verses.RVR09: Nos ha parecido, congregados en uno, elegir varones, y enviarlos á vosotros con nuestros amados Bernabé y Pablo,

verses.KJV: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens que têm arriscado suas vidas pelo nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Hombres que han expuesto sus vidas por el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.WEB: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
verses.ASV: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves also shall tell you the same things by word of mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então enviamos a Judas e a Silas, os quais [vos] dirão as mesmas coisas pessoalmente.
verses.RVR09: Así que, enviamos á Judas y á Silas, los cuales también por palabra os harán saber lo mismo.

verses.KJV: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.WEB: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
verses.ASV: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pareceu bem ao Espírito Santo e a nós, de nenhuma carga a mais vos impor, a não ser estas coisas necessárias:
verses.RVR09: Que ha parecido bien al Espíritu Santo, y á nosotros, no imponeros ninguna carga más que estas cosas necesarias:

verses.KJV: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.WEB: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
verses.ASV: that ye abstain from things sacrificed to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication; from which if ye keep yourselves, it shall be well with you. Fare ye well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que vos abstenhais das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, do sangue, da [carne] sufocada, e do pecado sexual; das quais, se vos guardardes, fareis bem. Que o bem vos suceda.
verses.RVR09: Que os abstengáis de cosas sacrificadas á ídolos, y de sangre, y de ahogado, y de fornicación; de las cuales cosas si os guardareis, bien haréis. Pasadlo bien.

verses.KJV: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.WEB: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
verses.ASV: So they, when they were dismissed, came down to Antioch; and having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo, pois, eles despedidos, vieram a Antioquia, e reunindo a multidão, entregaram a carta.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces enviados, descendieron á Antioquía; y juntando la multitud, dieron la carta.

verses.KJV: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.WEB: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
verses.ASV: And when they had read it, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao lerem, alegraram-se pela consolação.
verses.RVR09: La cual, como leyeron, fueron gozosos de la consolación.

verses.KJV: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.WEB: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
verses.ASV: And Judas and Silas, being themselves also prophets, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E então Judas e Silas, sendo também profetas, com muitas palavras exortaram e firmaram aos irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Judas también y Silas, como ellos también eran profetas, consolaron y confirmaron á los hermanos con abundancia de palabra.

verses.KJV: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.WEB: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
verses.ASV: And after they had spent some time [there], they were dismissed in peace from the brethren unto those that had sent them forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficando [ali] por algum tempo, permitiram que voltassem em paz dos irmãos para os apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando allí algún tiempo, fueron enviados de los hermanos á los apóstoles en paz.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.WEB: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.ASV: But Paul and Barnabas tarried in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a Silas pareceu bem continuar ali.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Silas pareció bien el quedarse allí.

verses.KJV: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.WEB: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
verses.ASV: And after some days Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us return now and visit the brethren in every city wherein we proclaimed the word of the Lord, [and see] how they fare.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo e Barnabé ficaram em Antioquia, ensinando e evangelizando, com também muitos outros, a palavra do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y Pablo y Bernabé se estaban en Antioquía, enseñando la palabra del Señor y anunciando el evangelio con otros muchos.

verses.KJV: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
verses.WEB: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
verses.ASV: And Barnabas was minded to take with them John also, who was called Mark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de alguns dias, Paulo disse a Barnabé: Voltemos a visitar a nossos irmãos em cada cidade onde tenhamos anunciado a palavra do Senhor, [para ver] como estão.
verses.RVR09: Y después de algunos días, Pablo dijo á Bernabé: Volvamos á visitar á los hermanos por todas las ciudades en las cuales hemos anunciado la palabra del Señor, cómo están.

verses.KJV: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.WEB: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
verses.ASV: But Paul thought not good to take with them him who withdrew from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Barnabé aconselhou para que tomassem consigo a João, chamado Marcos.
verses.RVR09: Y Bernabé quería que tomasen consigo á Juan, el que tenía por sobrenombre Marcos;

verses.KJV: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.WEB: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
verses.ASV: And there arose a sharp contention, so that they parted asunder one from the other, and Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away unto Cyprus:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo achou adequado que não tomassem consigo a aquele que desde a Panfília tinha se separado deles, e não tinha ido com eles para [aquela] obra.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Pablo no le parecía bien llevar consigo al que se había apartado de ellos desde Pamphylia, y no había ido con ellos á la obra.

verses.KJV: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.WEB: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
verses.ASV: but Paul chose Silas, and went forth, being commended by the brethren to the grace of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve então [entre eles] tal discórdia, que eles se separaram um do outro; e Barnabé, tomando consigo a Marcos, navegou para o Chipre.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo tal contención entre ellos, que se apartaron el uno del otro; y Bernabé tomando á Marcos, navegó á Cipro.

verses.KJV: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
verses.WEB: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
verses.ASV: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo, escolhendo a Silas, partiu-se, enviado pelos irmãos para a graça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Pablo escogiendo á Silas, partió encomendado de los hermanos á la gracia del Señor.

verses.KJV: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele passou pela Síria e Cilícia, firmando as igrejas.
verses.RVR09: Y anduvo la Siria y la Cilicia, confirmando á las iglesias.

verses.KJV: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
verses.WEB: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.
verses.ASV: And he came also to Derbe and to Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess that believed; but his father was a Greek.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele veio a Derbe e Listra; e eis que estava ali um certo discípulo, de nome Timóteo, filho de uma certa mulher judia crente, mas de pai grego.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS llegó á Derbe, y á Listra: y he aquí, estaba allí un discípulo llamado Timoteo, hijo de una mujer Judía fiel, mas de padre Griego.

verses.KJV: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.WEB: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
verses.ASV: The same was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do qual era [bem] testemunhado pelos irmãos [que estavam] em Listra e Icônio.
verses.RVR09: De éste daban buen testimonio los hermanos que estaban en Listra y en Iconio.

verses.KJV: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.WEB: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.ASV: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews that were in those parts: for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.ALMEIDA: A este Paulo quis que fosse com ele; e tomando-o, circuncidou-o, por causa dos judeus, que estavam naqueles lugares; porque todos conheciam o pai dele, que era grego.
verses.RVR09: Este quiso Pablo que fuese con él; y tomándole, le circuncidó por causa de los Judíos que estaban en aquellos lugares; porque todos sabían que su padre era Griego.

verses.KJV: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And as they went on their way through the cities, they delivered them the decrees to keep which had been ordained of the apostles and elders that were at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, passando pelas cidades, entregavam-lhes as ordenanças que foram determinadas pelos apóstolos e anciãos em Jerusalém, para que [as] guardassem.
verses.RVR09: Y como pasaban por las ciudades, les daban que guardasen los decretos que habían sido determinados por los apóstoles y los ancianos que estaban en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.WEB: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.ASV: So the churches were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim as Igrejas eram firmadas na fé, e cada dia aumentavam em número.
verses.RVR09: Así que, las iglesias eran confirmadas en fe, y eran aumentadas en número cada día.

verses.KJV: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
verses.WEB: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
verses.ASV: And they went through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been forbidden of the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia;
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando pela Frígia, e pela região da Galácia, foi-lhes impedido pelo Espírito Santo de falarem a palavra na Ásia.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando á Phrygia y la provincia de Galacia, les fué prohibido por el Espíritu Santo hablar la palabra en Asia.

verses.KJV: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.WEB: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
verses.ASV: and when they were come over against Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia; and the Spirit of Jesus suffered them not;
verses.ALMEIDA: [E] quando eles vieram a Mísia, tentaram ir à Bitínia; mas o Espírito não lhes permitiu.
verses.RVR09: Y como vinieron á Misia, tentaron de ir á Bithynia; mas el Espíritu no les dejó.

verses.KJV: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.WEB: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
verses.ASV: and passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo passado por Mísia, desceram a Trôade.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando á Misia, descendieron á Troas.

verses.KJV: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.WEB: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
verses.ASV: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night: There was a man of Macedonia standing, beseeching him, and saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma visão foi vista por Paulo durante a noite: um homem Macedônio se pôs [diante dele] ,rogando-lhe, e dizendo: Passa à Macedônia, e ajuda-nos!
verses.RVR09: Y fué mostrada á Pablo de noche una visión: Un varón Macedonio se puso delante, rogándole, y diciendo: Pasa á Macedonia, y ayúdanos.

verses.KJV: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.WEB: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
verses.ASV: And when he had seen the vision, straightway we sought to go forth into Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele viu a visão, logo procuramos partir para a Macedônia, concluindo que o Senhor estava nos chamando para anunciarmos o Evangelho a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió la visión, luego procuramos partir á Macedonia, dando por cierto que Dios nos llamaba para que les anunciásemos el evangelio.

verses.KJV: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
verses.WEB: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
verses.ASV: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, tendo navegado desde Trôade, viemos correndo caminho direto a Samotrácia, e no [dia] seguinte a Neápolis.
verses.RVR09: Partidos pues de Troas, vinimos camino derecho á Samotracia, y el día siguiente á Neápolis;

verses.KJV: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
verses.WEB: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
verses.ASV: and from thence to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the first of the district, a [Roman] colony: and we were in this city tarrying certain days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali a Filipos, que é a primeira cidade desta parte da Macedônia, [e é] uma colônia; e estivemos naquela cidade [por] alguns dias.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí á Filipos, que es la primera ciudad de la parte de Macedonia, y una colonia; y estuvimos en aquella ciudad algunos días.

verses.KJV: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
verses.WEB: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
verses.ASV: And on the sabbath day we went forth without the gate by a river side, where we supposed there was a place of prayer; and we sat down, and spake unto the women that were come together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia de sábado saímos para fora da cidade, onde costumava ser feita oração; e tendo [nos] sentado, falamos às mulheres que tinham se ajuntado [ali] .
verses.RVR09: Y un día de sábado salimos de la puerta junto al río, donde solía ser la oración; y sentándonos, hablamos á las mujeres que se habían juntado.

verses.KJV: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.WEB: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
verses.ASV: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one that worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened to give heed unto the things which were spoken by Paul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma certa mulher, por nome Lídia, vendedora de púrpura, da cidade de Tiatira, que servia a Deus; [ela nos] ouviu; o coração da qual o Senhor abriu, para que prestasse atenção ao que Paulo dizia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces una mujer llamada Lidia, que vendía púrpura en la ciudad de Tiatira, temerosa de Dios, estaba oyendo; el corazón de la cual abrió el Señor para que estuviese atenta á lo que Pablo decía.

verses.KJV: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
verses.WEB: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.
verses.ASV: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide [there]. And she constrained us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ela foi batizada, e [também] sua casa, ela [nos] rogou, dizendo: Se vós tendes julgado que eu seja fiel ao Senhor, entrai em minha casa e ficai ali.E ela insistiu para conosco.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fué bautizada, y su familia, nos rogó, diciendo: Si habéis juzgado que yo sea fiel al Señor, entrad en mi casa, y posad: y constriñónos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
verses.WEB: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as we were going to the place of prayer, that a certain maid having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by soothsaying.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que ao estarmos nós indo à oração, saiu ao nosso encontro uma moça que tinha espírito de pitonisa; a qual ao fazer adivinhações trazia grande lucro a seus senhores.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que yendo nosotros á la oración, una muchacha que tenía espíritu pitónico, nos salió al encuentro, la cual daba grande ganancia á sus amos adivinando.

verses.KJV: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
verses.WEB: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
verses.ASV: The same following after Paul and us cried out, saying, These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim unto you the way of salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta, seguindo após Paulo e nós, clamava, dizendo: Estes homens são servos do Deus Altíssimo, que nos anunciam o caminho da salvação.
verses.RVR09: Esta, siguiendo á Pablo y á nosotros, daba voces, diciendo: Estos hombres son siervos del Dios Alto, los cuales os anuncian el camino de salud.

verses.KJV: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
verses.WEB: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
verses.ASV: And this she did for many days. But Paul, being sore troubled, turned and said to the spirit, I charge thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And it came out that very hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela fazia isto por muitos dias. Mas Paulo, estando descontente com isto, virou-se, e disse ao espírito: Em nome de Jesus Cristo eu te mando que saias dela.E na mesma hora [o espírito] saiu.
verses.RVR09: Y esto hacía por muchos días; mas desagradando á Pablo, se volvió y dijo al espíritu: Te mando en el nombre de Jesucristo, que salgas de ella. Y salió en la misma hora.

verses.KJV: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
verses.WEB: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
verses.ASV: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they laid hold on Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os senhores dela, vendo que a esperança de lucro deles tinha ido embora, pegaram a Paulo e a Silas, e [os] levaram à praça, diante dos governantes.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo sus amos que había salido la esperanza de su ganancia, prendieron á Pablo y á Silas, y los trajeron al foro, al magistrado;

verses.KJV: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.WEB: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
verses.ASV: and when they had brought them unto the magistrates, they said, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.ALMEIDA: E apresentando-os aos magistrados, disseram: Estes homens perturbam nossa cidade, sendo judeus;
verses.RVR09: Y presentándolos á los magistrados, dijeron: Estos hombres, siendo Judíos, alborotan nuestra ciudad,

verses.KJV: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
verses.WEB: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
verses.ASV: and set forth customs which it is not lawful for us to receive, or to observe, being Romans.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles anunciam costumes que não nos é lícito receber, nem fazer; pois somos romanos.
verses.RVR09: Y predican ritos, los cuales no nos es lícito recibir ni hacer, pues somos Romanos.

verses.KJV: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
verses.WEB: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
verses.ASV: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent their garments off them, and commanded to beat them with rods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão se levantou juntamente contra eles; e os oficiais, rasgando suas roupas, mandaram que fossem açoitados.
verses.RVR09: Y agolpóse el pueblo contra ellos: y los magistrados rompiéndoles sus ropas, les mandaron azotar con varas.

verses.KJV: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.WEB: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
verses.ASV: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo sido lhes dado muitos açoites, os lançaram na prisão, mandando ao carcereiro que os guardasse em segurança.
verses.RVR09: Y después que los hubieron herido de muchos azotes, los echaron en la cárcel, mandando al carcelero que los guardase con diligencia:

verses.KJV: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.WEB: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
verses.ASV: who, having received such a charge, cast them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, tendo recebido tal ordem, lançou-os na cela mais interna, e prendeu-lhes os pés no tronco.
verses.RVR09: El cual, recibido este mandamiento, los metió en la cárcel de más adentro; y les apretó los pies en el cepo.

verses.KJV: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verses.WEB: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
verses.ASV: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns unto God, and the prisoners were listening to them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E perto da meia-noite, Paulo e Silas [estavam] orando, e cantando hinos a Deus; [e] os [outros] presos os escutavam.
verses.RVR09: Mas á media noche, orando Pablo y Silas, cantaban himnos á Dios: y los que estaban presos los oían.

verses.KJV: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
verses.WEB: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
verses.ASV: and suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison-house were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened; and every one’s bands were loosed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de repente houve um terremoto tão grande que os alicerces da prisão se moviam; e logo todas as portas se abriram, e todas as correntes [que prendiam] a todos se soltaram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué hecho de repente un gran terremoto, de tal manera que los cimientos de la cárcel se movían; y luego todas las puertas se abrieron, y las prisiones de todos se soltaron.

verses.KJV: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
verses.WEB: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
verses.ASV: And the jailor, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o carcereiro, tendo acordado e visto abertas todas as portas da prisão; puxou a espada, [e] estava a ponto de se matar, pensando que os presos tinham fugido.
verses.RVR09: Y despertado el carcelero, como vió abiertas las puertas de la cárcel, sacando la espada se quería matar, pensando que los presos se habían huído.

verses.KJV: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.WEB: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
verses.ASV: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo clamou em alta voz, dizendo: Não te faças nenhum mal, porque todos nós estamos aqui.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pablo clamó á gran voz, diciendo: No te hagas ningún mal; que todos estamos aquí.

verses.KJV: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.WEB: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
verses.ASV: And he called for lights and sprang in, and, trembling for fear, fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo pedido luzes, saltou para dentro, e termendo muito, ele se prostrou diante de Paulo e Silas.
verses.RVR09: El entonces pidiendo luz, entró dentro, y temblando, derribóse á los pies de Pablo y de Silas;

verses.KJV: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.WEB: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
verses.ASV: and brought them out and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.ALMEIDA: E levando-os para fora, disse: Senhores, o que me é necessário fazer para eu me salvar?
verses.RVR09: Y sacándolos fuera, les dice: Señores, ¿qué es menester que yo haga para ser salvo?

verses.KJV: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.WEB: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus, and thou shalt be saved, thou and thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles [lhe] disseram: Crê no Senhor Jesus Cristo, e serás salvo, tu e a tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: Cree en el Señor Jesucristo, y serás salvo tú, y tu casa.

verses.KJV: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
verses.WEB: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
verses.ASV: And they spake the word of the Lord unto him, with all that were in his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe falaram da palavra do Senhor, e a todos os que estavam em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y le hablaron la palabra del Señor, y á todos los que estaban en su casa.

verses.KJV: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
verses.WEB: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
verses.ASV: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, immediately.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tomando-os consigo, naquela mesma hora da noite, lavou [-lhes] as feridas dos açoites, e logo foi batizado, ele e todos os seus.
verses.RVR09: Y tomándolos en aquella misma hora de la noche, les lavó los azotes; y se bautizó luego él, y todos los suyos.

verses.KJV: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
verses.WEB: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.
verses.ASV: And he brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his house, having believed in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo os levado a sua casa, pôs [comida] diante deles à mesa; e alegrou-se muito, tendo crido em Deus com toda a sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y llevándolos á su casa, les puso la mesa: y se gozó de que con toda su casa había creído á Dios.

verses.KJV: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.WEB: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
verses.ASV: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sendo [já] de dia, os magistrados mandaram aos guardas, dizendo: Solta aqueles homens.
verses.RVR09: Y como fué de día, los magistrados enviaron los alguaciles, diciendo: Deja ir á aquellos hombres.

verses.KJV: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
verses.WEB: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
verses.ASV: And the jailor reported the words to Paul, [saying], The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore come forth, and go in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o carcereiro anunciou estas palavras a Paulo, [dizendo] : Os magistrados têm mandado vos soltar; portanto agora saí, e ide em paz.
verses.RVR09: Y el carcelero hizo saber estas palabras á Pablo: Los magistrados han enviado á decir que seáis sueltos: así que ahora salid, é id en paz.

verses.KJV: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
verses.WEB: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
verses.ASV: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us publicly, uncondemned, men that are Romans, and have cast us into prison; and do they now cast us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and bring us out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo lhes disse: Eles nos açoitaram publicamente, e sem sermos sentenciados, sendo nós homens romanos, lançaram-nos na prisão, e agora nos lançam fora às escondidas? [Assim] não! Mas que eles mesmos venham e nos tirem.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo les dijo: Azotados públicamente sin ser condenados, siendo hombres Romanos, nos echaron en la cárcel; y ¿ahora nos echan encubiertamente? No, de cierto, sino vengan ellos y sáquennos.

verses.KJV: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.WEB: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
verses.ASV: And the serjeants reported these words unto the magistrates: and they feared when they heard that they were Romans;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os guardas voltaram para dizer aos magistrados estas palavras; e eles temeram ao ouvirem que eram romanos.
verses.RVR09: Y los alguaciles volvieron á decir á los magistrados estas palabras: y tuvieron miedo, oído que eran Romanos.

verses.KJV: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
verses.WEB: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
verses.ASV: and they came and besought them; and when they had brought them out, they asked them to go away from the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo vindo, rogaram-lhes; e tirando-os, pediram [-lhes] que saíssem da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo, les rogaron; y sacándolos, les pidieron que se saliesen de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
verses.WEB: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
verses.ASV: And they went out of the prison, and entered into [the house of] Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, tendo saído da prisão, entraram [na casa] de Lídia; e vendo aos irmãos, consolaram-lhes; e saíram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salidos de la cárcel, entraron en casa de Lidia; y habiendo visto á los hermanos, los consolaron, y se salieron.

verses.KJV: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.WEB: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
verses.ASV: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viajando por Anfípolis e Apolônia, vieram a Tessalônica, onde havia uma sinagoga de judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y PASANDO por Amphípolis y Apolonia, llegaron á Tesalónica, donde estaba la sinagoga de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.WEB: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.ASV: and Paul, as his custom was, went in unto them, and for three sabbath days reasoned with them from the scriptures,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, como era de [seu] costume, entrou a eles, e por três sábados argumentava com eles pelas Escrituras.
verses.RVR09: Y Pablo, como acostumbraba, entró á ellos, y por tres sábados disputó con ellos de las Escrituras,

verses.KJV: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
verses.WEB: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
verses.ASV: opening and alleging that it behooved the Christ to suffer, and to rise again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom, [said he], I proclaim unto you, is the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Declarando [-as] ,e propondo [-lhes] ,que era necessário que o Cristo morresse, e ressuscitasse dos mortos; e que ( [dizia ele] ) este Jesus é o Cristo, a quem eu vos anuncio.
verses.RVR09: Declarando y proponiendo, que convenía que el Cristo padeciese, y resucitase de los muertos; y que Jesús, el cual yo os anuncio, decía él, éste era el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.WEB: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
verses.ASV: And some of them were persuaded, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns deles creram, e se ajuntaram a Paulo e Silas; e dos gregos devotos grande multidão; e não poucas das mulheres principais.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de ellos creyeron, y se juntaron con Pablo y con Silas; y de los Griegos religiosos grande multitud, y mujeres nobles no pocas.

verses.KJV: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.WEB: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.ASV: But the Jews, being moved with jealousy, took unto them certain vile fellows of the rabble, and gathering a crowd, set the city on an uproar; and assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them forth to the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os judeus incrédulos, movidos de inveja, tomaram consigo alguns homens malignos dos mercados, e juntando uma multidão, tumultuaram a cidade; e atacando a casa de Jasão, procuravam trazê-los ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los Judíos que eran incrédulos, teniendo celos, tomaron consigo á algunos ociosos, malos hombres, y juntando compañía, alborotaron la ciudad; y acometiendo á la casa de Jasón, procuraban sacarlos al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.WEB: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
verses.ASV: And when they found them not, they dragged Jason and certain brethren before the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não os achando, puxaram a Jasão, e a alguns irmãos às maiores autoridades da cidade, clamando: Estes que tem perturbado ao mundo também vieram até aqui.
verses.RVR09: Mas no hallándolos, trajeron á Jasón y á algunos hermanos á los gobernadores de la ciudad, dando voces: Estos que alborotan el mundo, también han venido acá;

verses.KJV: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
verses.WEB: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
verses.ASV: whom Jason hath received: and these all act contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, [one] Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais Jasão tem recolhido, e todos estes fazem contra as ordens de César, dizendo que há outro rei, [chamado] Jesus.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales Jasón ha recibido; y todos estos hacen contra los decretos de César, diciendo que hay otro rey, Jesús.

verses.KJV: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.WEB: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
verses.ASV: And they troubled the multitude and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles tumultuaram a multidão, e às autoridades da cidade, que ouviam estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y alborotaron al pueblo y á los gobernadores de la ciudad, oyendo estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.WEB: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
verses.ASV: And when they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tendo recebido fiança de Jasão e dos demais, eles os soltaram.
verses.RVR09: Mas recibida satisfacción de Jasón y de los demás, los soltaron.

verses.KJV: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.WEB: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
verses.ASV: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Beroea: who when they were come thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo os irmãos enviaram de noite a Paulo e a Silas até Bereia; os quais, ao chegarem lá, foram à sinagoga dos judeus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los hermanos, luego de noche, enviaron á Pablo y á Silas á Berea; los cuales habiendo llegado, entraron en la sinagoga de los Judíos.

verses.KJV: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.WEB: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
verses.ASV: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the scriptures daily, whether these things were so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram mais nobres do que os que estavam em Tessalônica, [porque] os quais receberam a palavra com toda boa vontade, examinando a cada dia as escrituras, [para ver] se estas coisas eram assim.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron éstos más nobles que los que estaban en Tesalónica, pues recibieron la palabra con toda solicitud, escudriñando cada día las Escrituras, si estas cosas eran así.

verses.KJV: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.WEB: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
verses.ASV: Many of them therefore believed; also of the Greek women of honorable estate, and of men, not a few.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto muitos deles realmente creram, e das mulheres gregas honradas; e dos homens, não poucos.
verses.RVR09: Así que creyeron muchos de ellos; y mujeres Griegas de distinción, y no pocos hombres.

verses.KJV: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.WEB: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
verses.ASV: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed of Paul at Beroea also, they came thither likewise, stirring up and troubling the multitudes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando os judeus de Tessalônica souberam que também em Bereia a palavra de Deus era anunciada por Paulo, vieram também para lá, e incitaram as multidões.
verses.RVR09: Mas como entendieron los Judíos de Tesalónica que también en Berea era anunciada la palabra de Dios por Pablo, fueron, y también allí tumultuaron al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.WEB: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
verses.ASV: And then immediately the brethren sent forth Paul to go as far as to the sea: and Silas and Timothy abode there still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas então no mesmo instante os irmãos despediram a Paulo, para que fosse ao mar; mas Silas e Timóteo continuaram ali.
verses.RVR09: Empero luego los hermanos enviaron á Pablo que fuese como á la mar; y Silas y Timoteo se quedaron allí.

verses.KJV: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.WEB: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
verses.ASV: But they that conducted Paul brought him as far as Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy that they should come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que conduziram a Paulo, levaram-no até Atenas; e tendo recebido ordem para Silas e Timóteo, para que viessem a ele o mais rápido [que pudessem] ,eles foram embora.
verses.RVR09: Y los que habían tomado á cargo á Pablo, le llevaron hasta Atenas; y tomando encargo para Silas y Timoteo, que viniesen á él lo más presto que pudiesen, partieron.

verses.KJV: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.WEB: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
verses.ASV: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he beheld the city full of idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto Paulo os esperava em Atenas, seu espírito se incomodava dentro dele, ao ver a cidade tão dedicada à idolatria.
verses.RVR09: Y esperándolos Pablo en Atenas, su espíritu se deshacía en él viendo la ciudad dada á idolatría.

verses.KJV: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.WEB: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
verses.ASV: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with them that met him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disputava muito na sinagoga, com os judeus, e com os religiosos; e no mercado a cada dia, com os que vinham [até ele] .
verses.RVR09: Así que, disputaba en la sinagoga con los Judíos y religiosos; y en la plaza cada día con los que le ocurrían.

verses.KJV: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
verses.WEB: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.ASV: And certain also of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers encountered him. And some said, What would this babbler say? others, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos filósofos epicureus e estoicos discutiam com ele; e uns diziam: O que quer dizer este tagarela?E outros: Parece que ele é pregador de deuses estranhos.Porque ele lhes anunciava o Evangelho de Jesus e a ressurreição.
