verses.RVR09: Y algunos filósofos de los Epicúreos y de los Estóicos, disputaban con él; y unos decían: ¿Qué quiere decir este palabrero? Y otros: Parece que es predicador de nuevos dioses: porque les predicaba á Jesús y la resurrección.

verses.KJV: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
verses.WEB: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
verses.ASV: And they took hold of him, and brought him unto the Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando-o, trouxeram [-no] ao areópago, dizendo: Podemos nós saber que doutrina nova é esta que tu falas?
verses.RVR09: Y tomándole, le trajeron al Areópago, diciendo: ¿Podremos saber qué sea esta nueva doctrina que dices?

verses.KJV: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.WEB: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
verses.ASV: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu trazes coisas estranhas aos nossos ouvidos; então queremos saber o que isto quer dizer.
verses.RVR09: Porque pones en nuestros oídos unas nuevas cosas: queremos pues saber qué quiere ser esto.

verses.KJV: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.WEB: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
verses.ASV: (Now all the Athenians and the strangers sojourning there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.)
verses.ALMEIDA: (E todos os atenienses e visitantes estrangeiros não se ocupavam de nenhuma outra coisa, a não ser em dizer e ouvir alguma novidade).
verses.RVR09: (Entonces todos los Atenienses y los huéspedes extranjeros, en ninguna otra cosa entendían, sino ó en decir ó en oir alguna cosa nueva.)

verses.KJV: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
verses.WEB: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
verses.ASV: And Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus, and said, Ye men of Athens, in all things I perceive that ye are very religious.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, estando no meio do areópago, disse: Homens atenienses, eu vejo em tudo como vós sois muito religiosos;
verses.RVR09: Estando pues Pablo en medio del Areópago, dijo: Varones Atenienses, en todo os veo como más supersticiosos;

verses.KJV: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, To The Unknown God. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.WEB: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.
verses.ASV: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription, TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. What therefore ye worship in ignorance, this I set forth unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque enquanto eu passava [pela cidade] e via vossos santuários, achei também um altar, em que estava escrito: AO DEUS DESCONHECIDO. Este a quem vós prestais devoção sem conhecer, [este é o que] eu vos anuncio;
verses.RVR09: Porque pasando y mirando vuestros santuarios, hallé también un altar en el cual estaba esta inscripción: AL DIOS NO CONOCIDO. Aquél pues, que vosotros honráis sin conocerle, á éste os anuncio yo.

verses.KJV: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.WEB: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
verses.ASV: The God that made the world and all things therein, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus que fez o mundo, e todas as coisas que nele [há] ; este, sendo Senhor do céu e da terra, não habita em tempos feitos por mãos.
verses.RVR09: El Dios que hizo el mundo y todas las cosas que en él hay, éste, como sea Señor del cielo y de la tierra, no habita en templos hechos de manos,

verses.KJV: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.WEB: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
verses.ASV: neither is he served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nem também é servido por mãos humanas; [como que] necessitasse de alguma coisa; [porque] ele [é que] dá a todos vida, respiração, e todas as coisas;
verses.RVR09: Ni es honrado con manos de hombres, necesitado de algo; pues él da á todos vida, y respiración, y todas las cosas;

verses.KJV: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.WEB: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,
verses.ASV: and he made of one every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, having determined [their] appointed seasons, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.ALMEIDA: E de um sangue ele fez toda nação humana, para habitarem sobre a face da terra, determinando os tempos desde antes ordenados, e o limites da morada [deles] ;
verses.RVR09: Y de una sangre ha hecho todo el linaje de los hombres, para que habitasen sobre toda la faz de la tierra; y les ha prefijado el orden de los tiempos, y los términos de la habitación de ellos;

verses.KJV: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.WEB: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
verses.ASV: that they should seek God, if haply they might feel after him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que buscassem ao Senhor, se talvez pudessem apalpá-lo e encontrá-lo,apesar dele não estar longe de cada um de nós.
verses.RVR09: Para que buscasen á Dios, si en alguna manera, palpando, le hallen; aunque cierto no está lejos de cada uno de nosotros:

verses.KJV: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.WEB: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
verses.ASV: for in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain even of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nele vivemos, e nos movemos, e somos; assim como também alguns de vossos poetas disseram; porque também nós somos descendência dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque en él vivimos, y nos movemos, y somos; como también algunos de vuestros poetas dijeron: Porque linaje de éste somos también.

verses.KJV: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
verses.WEB: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
verses.ASV: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and device of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo então descendência de Deus, nós não devemos pensar que a divindade seja semelhante a ouro, ou a prata, ou a pedra esculpida por artifício e imaginação humana.
verses.RVR09: Siendo pues linaje de Dios, no hemos de estimar la Divinidad ser semejante á oro, ó á plata, ó á piedra, escultura de artificio ó de imaginación de hombres.

verses.KJV: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.WEB: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
verses.ASV: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked; but now he commandeth men that they should all everywhere repent:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto Deus, tendo desconsiderado os tempos da [vossa] ignorância, agora anuncia a todos as pessoas, em todo lugar, para que se arrependam.
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios, habiendo disimulado los tiempos de esta ignorancia, ahora denuncia á todos los hombres en todos los lugares que se arrepientan:

verses.KJV: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.WEB: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
verses.ASV: inasmuch as he hath appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele tem estabelecido um dia em que ele julgará ao mundo em justiça por meio do homem a quem determinou; dando certeza a todos, tendo o ressuscitado dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto ha establecido un día, en el cual ha de juzgar al mundo con justicia, por aquel varón al cual determinó; dando fe á todos con haberle levantado de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
verses.WEB: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
verses.ASV: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, We will hear thee concerning this yet again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao ouvirem da ressurreição dos mortos, alguns zombavam; e outros diziam: Nós ouviremos sobre isto de ti na próxima vez.
verses.RVR09: Y así como oyeron de la resurrección de los muertos, unos se burlaban, y otros decían: Te oiremos acerca de esto otra vez.

verses.KJV: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.WEB: Thus Paul went out from among them.
verses.ASV: Thus Paul went out from among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim Paulo saiu do meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Y así Pablo se salió de en medio de ellos.

verses.KJV: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.WEB: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.ASV: But certain men clave unto him, and believed: among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, tendo chegado alguns homens até ele, creram; entre os quais estava também Dionísio o areopagita, e uma mulher de nome Dâmaris, e outros com eles.
verses.RVR09: Mas algunos creyeron, juntándose con él; entre los cuales también fué Dionisio el del Areópago, y una mujer llamada Dámaris, y otros con ellos.

verses.KJV: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
verses.WEB: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
verses.ASV: After these things he departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto ele partiu de Atenas, e veio a Corinto.
verses.RVR09: PASADAS estas cosas, Pablo partió de Atenas, y vino á Corinto.

verses.KJV: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
verses.WEB: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
verses.ASV: And he found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome: and he came unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E achando a um certo judeu, de nome Áquila, natural de Ponto, que recentemente tinha vindo da Itália, e Priscila, sua mulher (porque Cláudio tinha mandado que todos os judeus saíssem de Roma), veio até eles.
verses.RVR09: Y hallando á un Judío llamado Aquila, natural del Ponto, que hacía poco que había venido de Italia, y á Priscila su mujer, (porque Claudio había mandado que todos los Judíos saliesen de Roma) se vino á ellos;

verses.KJV: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.WEB: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
verses.ASV: and because he was of the same trade, he abode with them, and they wrought; for by their trade they were tentmakers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porque era do mesmo ofício, ficou com eles, e trabalhava; porque tinham o ofício de fazerem tendas.
verses.RVR09: Y porque era de su oficio, posó con ellos, y trabajaba; porque el oficio de ellos era hacer tiendas.

verses.KJV: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
verses.WEB: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
verses.ASV: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disputava na sinagoga a cada sábado; e persuadia a judeus e a gregos.
verses.RVR09: Y disputaba en la sinagoga todos los sábados, y persuadía á Judíos y á Griegos.

verses.KJV: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
verses.WEB: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.ASV: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was constrained by the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Silas e Timóteo desceram da Macedônia, Paulo foi pressionado pelo Espírito, dando testemunho aos judeus [de que] o Cristo [era] Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Silas y Timoteo vinieron de Macedonia, Pablo estaba constreñido por la palabra, testificando á los Judíos que Jesús era el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
verses.ASV: And when they opposed themselves and blasphemed, he shook out his raiment and said unto them, Your blood [be] upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tendo eles resistido e blasfemado, ele sacudiu as roupas, e lhes disse: Vosso sangue [seja] sobre vossa cabeça; eu estou limpo; e a partir de agora irei aos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Mas contradiciendo y blasfemando ellos, les dijo, sacudiendo sus vestidos: Vuestra sangre sea sobre vuestra cabeza; yo, limpio; desde ahora me iré á los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.WEB: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
verses.ASV: And he departed thence, and went into the house of a certain man named Titus Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo saído dali, entrou na cada de um, de nome Justo, que servia a Deus, cuja casa era vizinha à sinagoga.
verses.RVR09: Y partiendo de allí, entró en casa de uno llamado Justo, temeroso de Dios, la casa del cual estaba junto á la sinagoga.

verses.KJV: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.WEB: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
verses.ASV: And Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Crispo, o chefe da sinagoga, creu no Senhor com toda a sua casa; e muitos dos coríntios, tendo ouvido, creram e foram batizados.
verses.RVR09: Y Crispo, el prepósito de la sinagoga, creyó al Señor con toda su casa: y muchos de los Corintios oyendo creían, y eran bautizados.

verses.KJV: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
verses.WEB: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
verses.ASV: And the Lord said unto Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak and hold not thy peace:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor disse em visão de noite a Paulo: Não temas, mas fala, e não te cales.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el Señor dijo de noche en visión á Pablo: No temas, sino habla, y no calles:

verses.KJV: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.WEB: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
verses.ASV: for I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to harm thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu estou contigo, e ninguém porá [mão] em ti para te fazer mal, porque eu tenho muito povo nesta cidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo estoy contigo, y ninguno te podrá hacer mal; porque yo tengo mucho pueblo en esta ciudad.

verses.KJV: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.WEB: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.ASV: And he dwelt [there] a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele ficou [ali por] um ano e seis meses, ensinando entre eles a palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y se detuvo allí un año y seis meses, enseñándoles la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.WEB: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
verses.ASV: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment-seat,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sendo Gálio o procônsul da Acaia, os judeus se levantaram em concordância contra Paulo, e o trouxeram ao tribunal,
verses.RVR09: Y siendo Galión procónsul de Acaya, los Judíos se levantaron de común acuerdo contra Pablo, y le llevaron al tribunal,

verses.KJV: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
verses.WEB: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
verses.ASV: saying, This man persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Este persuade as pessoas a servirem a Deus contra a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Que éste persuade á los hombres á honrar á Dios contra la ley.

verses.KJV: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.WEB: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
verses.ASV: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked villany, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, querendo abrir a boca, Gálio disse aos judeus: Se houvesse algum mau ato ou crime grande, ó judeus, com razão eu vos suportaria;
verses.RVR09: Y comenzando Pablo á abrir la boca, Galión dijo á los Judíos: Si fuera algún agravio ó algún crimen enorme, oh Judíos, conforme á derecho yo os tolerara:

verses.KJV: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
verses.WEB: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
verses.ASV: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves; I am not minded to be a judge of these matters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se a questão é de palavra [s] , e de nomes, e da Lei que há entre vós, vede [-o] vós mesmos; porque destas coisas eu não quero ser juiz.
verses.RVR09: Mas si son cuestiones de palabras, y de nombres, y de vuestra ley, vedlo vosotros; porque yo no quiero ser juez de estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
verses.WEB: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
verses.ASV: And he drove them from the judgment-seat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele os tirou do tribunal.
verses.RVR09: Y los echó del tribunal.

verses.KJV: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
verses.WEB: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
verses.ASV: And they all laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment-seat. And Gallio cared for none of these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todos os gregos, tomando a Sóstenes, o chefe da sinagoga, feriram [-no] diante do tribunal; e a nada destas coisas Gálio dava importância.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos los Griegos tomando á Sóstenes, prepósito de la sinagoga, le herían delante del tribunal: y á Galión nada se le daba de ello.

verses.KJV: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
verses.WEB: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
verses.ASV: And Paul, having tarried after this yet many days, took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence for Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila: having shorn his head in Cenchreæ; for he had a vow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, ficando ali ainda muitos dias, ele se despediu dos irmãos, e dali navegou para a Síria, e juntos com ele [estavam] Priscila e Áquila; tendo rapado a cabeça em Cencreia, porque ele tinha [feito] voto.
verses.RVR09: Mas Pablo habiéndose detenido aún allí muchos días, después se despidió de los hermanos, y navegó á Siria, y con él Priscila y Aquila, habiéndose trasquilado la cabeza en Cencreas, porque tenía voto.

verses.KJV: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.WEB: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.ASV: And they came to Ephesus, and he left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou a Éfeso, e os deixou ali; mas ele, entrando na sinagoga, disputava com os judeus.
verses.RVR09: Y llegó á Efeso, y los dejó allí: y él entrando en la sinagoga, disputó con los Judíos,

verses.KJV: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
verses.WEB: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
verses.ASV: And when they asked him to abide a longer time, he consented not;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, pedindo[-lhe] que continuasse com eles por mais [algum] tempo, ele não concordou.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales le rogaban que se quedase con ellos por más tiempo; mas no accedió,

verses.KJV: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.WEB: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.ASV: but taking his leave of them, and saying, I will return again unto you if God will, he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém despediu-se deles, dizendo: De toda maneira tenho que estar na festa que vem em Jerusalém; mas outra vez, se Deus quiser, voltarei a vós.E ele saiu de Éfeso.
verses.RVR09: Sino que se despidió de ellos, diciendo: Es menester que en todo caso tenga la fiesta que viene, en Jerusalem; mas otra vez volveré á vosotros, queriendo Dios. Y partió de Efeso.

verses.KJV: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.WEB: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
verses.ASV: And when he had landed at Cæsarea, he went up and saluted the church, and went down to Antioch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo vindo a Cesareia, subiu e, saudando à igreja, desceu a Antioquia.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo arribado á Cesarea subió á Jerusalem; y después de saludar á la iglesia, descendió á Antioquía.

verses.KJV: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.WEB: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
verses.ASV: And having spent some time [there], he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando [ali] algum tempo, ele partiu, passando em sequência pela região da Galácia e Frígia, firmando a todos os discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo estado allí algún tiempo, partió, andando por orden la provincia de Galacia, y la Phrygia, confirmando á todos los discípulos.

verses.KJV: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
verses.WEB: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
verses.ASV: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus; and he was mighty in the scriptures.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou a Éfeso um certo judeu, de nome Apolo, natural de Alexandria, homem eloquente, bem capacitado nas Escrituras.
verses.RVR09: Llegó entonces á Efeso un Judío, llamado Apolos, natural de Alejandría, varón elocuente, poderoso en las Escrituras.

verses.KJV: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
verses.WEB: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
verses.ASV: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spake and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, knowing only the baptism of John:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este era instruído no caminho do Senhor; e fervoroso de espírito, falava e ensinava corretamente as coisas do Senhor; [ainda que] soubesse somente o batismo de João.
verses.RVR09: Este era instruído en el camino del Señor; y ferviente de espíritu, hablaba y enseñaba diligentemente las cosas que son del Señor, enseñando solamente en el bautismo de Juan.

verses.KJV: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
verses.WEB: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
verses.ASV: and he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more accurately.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este começou a falar ousadamente na sinagoga; e Áquila e Priscila, ao o ouvirem, tomaram-no consigo, e explicaram mais detalhadamente o caminho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á hablar confiadamente en la sinagoga: al cual como oyeron Priscila y Aquila, le tomaron, y le declararon más particularmente el camino de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
verses.WEB: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
verses.ASV: And when he was minded to pass over into Achaia, the brethren encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him: and when he was come, he helped them much that had believed through grace;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, querendo passar a Acaia, os irmãos o exortaram, [e] escreveram aos discípulos que o recebessem; o qual, tendo chegado, auxiliou muito aos que tinham crido pela graça.
verses.RVR09: Y queriendo él pasar á Acaya, los hermanos exhortados, escribieron á los discípulos que le recibiesen; y venido él, aprovechó mucho por la gracia á los que habían creído:

verses.KJV: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publicly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
verses.WEB: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.ASV: for he powerfully confuted the Jews, [and that] publicly, showing by the scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vigorosamente ele provava publicamente os erros dos judeus, mostrando pelas Escrituras que Jesus era o Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque con gran vehemencia convencía públicamente á los Judíos, mostrando por las Escrituras que Jesús era el Cristo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
verses.WEB: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper country came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples:
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto Apolo estava em Corinto, aconteceu que, tendo Paulo passado por todas as regiões altas, ele veio a Éfeso; e achando [ali] alguns discípulos,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que entre tanto que Apolos estaba en Corinto, Pablo, andadas las regiones superiores, vino á Efeso, y hallando ciertos discípulos,

verses.KJV: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
verses.ASV: and he said unto them, Did ye receive the Holy Spirit when ye believed? And they [said] unto him, Nay, we did not so much as hear whether the Holy Spirit was [given].
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhes: Vós [já] recebestes o Espírito Santo [desde que] crestes? E eles lhe disseram: Nós nem tínhamos ouvido falar que havia Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Díjoles: ¿Habéis recibido el Espíritu Santo después que creísteis? Y ellos le dijeron: Antes ni aun hemos oído si hay Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
verses.WEB: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Into what then were ye baptized? And they said, Into John’s baptism.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Em que vós fostes batizados? E eles disseram: No batismo de João.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo: ¿En qué pues sois bautizados? Y ellos dijeron: En el bautismo de Juan.

verses.KJV: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”
verses.ASV: And Paul said, John baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people that they should believe on him that should come after him, that is, on Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Paulo disse: João verdadeiramente batizou [com] o batismo do arrependimento, dizendo ao povo que cressem naquele que viria após ele, isto é, em Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Pablo: Juan bautizó con bautismo de arrepentimiento, diciendo al pueblo que creyesen en el que había de venir después de él, es á saber, en Jesús el Cristo.

verses.KJV: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.ASV: And when they heard this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao ouvirem [isto] , eles foram batizados no nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Oído que hubieron esto, fueron bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.WEB: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
verses.ASV: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Spirit came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, impondo-lhes as mãos, veio sobre eles o Espírito Santo; e falavam em línguas, e profetizavam.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndoles impuesto Pablo las manos, vino sobre ellos el Espíritu Santo; y hablaban en lenguas, y profetizaban.

verses.KJV: And all the men were about twelve.
verses.WEB: They were about twelve men in all.
verses.ASV: And they were in all about twelve men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os homens eram cerca de doze.
verses.RVR09: Y eran en todos como unos doce hombres.

verses.KJV: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: And he entered into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, reasoning and persuading [as to] the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, entrando na sinagoga, falava ousadamente durante três meses, disputando e persuadindo as coisas do Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando él dentro de la sinagoga, hablaba libremente por espacio de tres meses, disputando y persuadiendo del reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
verses.WEB: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
verses.ASV: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando alguns se endureceram, e não creram, e falando mal do Caminho diante da multidão, ele se desviou deles; e separou aos discípulos, disputando a cada dia na escola de um certo Tirano.
verses.RVR09: Mas endureciéndose algunos y no creyendo, maldiciendo el Camino delante de la multitud, apartándose Pablo de ellos separó á los discípulos, disputando cada día en la escuela de un cierto Tyranno.

verses.KJV: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.WEB: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.ASV: And this continued for the space of two years; so that all they that dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto aconteceu durante dois anos; de tal maneira que todos os que habitavam na Ásia tinham ouvido a palavra do Senhor Jesus, tanto judeus como gregos.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué por espacio de dos años; de manera que todos los que habitaban en Asia, Judíos y Griegos, oyeron la palabra del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.WEB: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
verses.ASV: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus fazia milagres extraordinários pelas mãos de Paulo,
verses.RVR09: Y hacía Dios singulares maravillas por manos de Pablo:

verses.KJV: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.WEB: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
verses.ASV: insomuch that unto the sick were carried away from his body handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
verses.ALMEIDA: De tal maneira que até os lenços e aventais de seu corpo eram levados aos enfermos, e as doenças os deixavam, e os espíritos malignos saíam deles.
verses.RVR09: De tal manera que aun se llevaban sobre los enfermos los sudarios y los pañuelos de su cuerpo, y las enfermedades se iban de ellos, y los malos espíritus salían de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.WEB: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
verses.ASV: But certain also of the strolling Jews, exorcists, took upon them to name over them that had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, I adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns exorcistas dos judeus, itinerantes, tentaram invocar o nome do Senhor Jesus sobre os que tinham espíritos malignos, dizendo: Nós vos repreendemos por Jesus, a quem Paulo prega.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los Judíos, exorcistas vagabundos, tentaron á invocar el nombre del Señor Jesús sobre los que tenían espíritus malos, diciendo: Os conjuro por Jesús, el que Pablo predica.

verses.KJV: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
verses.WEB: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
verses.ASV: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, a chief priest, who did this.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eram sete filhos de Ceva, judeu, chefe dos sacerdotes, os que faziam isto.
verses.RVR09: Y había siete hijos de un tal Sceva, Judío, príncipe de los sacerdotes, que hacían esto.

verses.KJV: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.WEB: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
verses.ASV: And the evil spirit answered and said unto them, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o espírito maligno respondeu: Eu conheço Jesus, e sei quem é Paulo; mas vós, quem sois?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo el espíritu malo, dijo: A Jesús conozco, y sé quién es Pablo: mas vosotros ¿quiénes sois?

verses.KJV: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.WEB: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.ASV: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and mastered both of them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem em quem estava o espírito maligno saltou sobre eles, e dominando-os, foi mais forte do que eles; de tal maneira que eles fugiram nus e feridos daquela casa.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre en quien estaba el espíritu malo, saltando en ellos, y enseñoreándose de ellos, pudo más que ellos, de tal manera que huyeron de aquella casa desnudos y heridos.

verses.KJV: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.WEB: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.ASV: And this became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, that dwelt at Ephesus; and fear fell upon them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto se fez conhecido a todos que habitavam em Éfeso, tanto a judeus como a gregos; e caiu temor sobre todos eles; e [assim] foi engrandecido o nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué notorio á todos, así Judíos como Griegos, los que habitaban en Efeso: y cayó temor sobre todos ellos, y era ensalzado el nombre del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
verses.WEB: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.
verses.ASV: Many also of them that had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos dos que criam vinham, confessando e declararando as suas atitudes.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de los que habían creído, venían, confesando y dando cuenta de sus hechos.

verses.KJV: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.WEB: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.ASV: And not a few of them that practised magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all; and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também muitos dos que praticavam ocultismo trouxeram seus livros, e [os] queimaram na presença de todos; e calcularam o preço deles, e acharam que [custavam] cinquenta mil [moedas] de prata.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo muchos de los que habían practicado vanas artes, trajeron los libros, y los quemaron delante de todos; y echada la cuenta del precio de ellos, hallaron ser cincuenta mil denarios.

verses.KJV: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.WEB: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
verses.ASV: So mightily grew the word of the Lord and prevailed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a palavra do Senhor crescia e prevalecia poderosamente.
verses.RVR09: Así crecía poderosamente la palabra del Señor, y prevalecía.

verses.KJV: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.WEB: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
verses.ASV: Now after these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se cumpriram estas coisas, Paulo propôs em espírito que, passando pela Macedônia e Acaia, ir até Jerusalém, dizendo: Depois de eu estar lá, também tenho que ver Roma.
verses.RVR09: Y acabadas estas cosas, se propuso Pablo en espíritu partir á Jerusalem, después de andada Macedonia y Acaya, diciendo: Después que hubiere estado allá, me será menester ver también á Roma.

verses.KJV: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
verses.WEB: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
verses.ASV: And having sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tendo enviado à Macedônia dois daqueles que o serviam, Timóteo e Erasto, ele ficou por [algum] tempo na Ásia.
verses.RVR09: Y enviando á Macedonia á dos de los que le ayudaban, Timoteo y Erasto, él se estuvo por algún tiempo en Asia.

verses.KJV: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
verses.WEB: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
verses.ASV: And about that time there arose no small stir concerning the Way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas naquele tempo aconteceu um não pequeno alvoroço quanto ao Caminho .
verses.RVR09: Entonces hubo un alboroto no pequeño acerca del Camino.

verses.KJV: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
verses.WEB: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
verses.ASV: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Diana, brought no little business unto the craftsmen;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um certo artífice de prata, de nome Demétrio, que fazia objetos de prata para o templo de Diana , e dava não pouco lucro aos artesãos.
verses.RVR09: Porque un platero llamado Demetrio, el cual hacía de plata templecillos de Diana, daba á los artífices no poca ganancia;

verses.KJV: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
verses.WEB: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
verses.ASV: whom he gathered together, with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this business we have our wealth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais, tendo os reunido com os trabalhadores de semelhantes coisas, disse: Homens, vós sabeis que deste ofício temos nossa prosperidade.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales, reunidos con los oficiales de semejante oficio, dijo: Varones, sabéis que de este oficio tenemos ganancia;

verses.KJV: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
verses.WEB: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
verses.ASV: And ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they are no gods, that are made with hands:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós estais vendo e ouvindo que este Paulo, não somente em Éfeso, mas até quase em toda a Ásia, tem persuadido e apartado uma grande multidão, dizendo que não são deuses os que são feitos com as mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y veis y oís que este Pablo, no solamente en Efeso, sino á muchas gentes de casi toda el Asia, ha apartado con persuasión, diciendo, que no son dioses los que se hacen con las manos.

verses.KJV: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.WEB: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
verses.ASV: and not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana be made of no account, and that she should even be deposed from her magnificence whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente há perigo de que isto torne [nosso] ofício em desprezo, mas também que [até] o tempo da grande deusa Diana seja considerado inútil, e que a grandiosidade dela, a quem toda a Ásia e o mundo venera, venha a ser destruída.
verses.RVR09: Y no solamente hay peligro de que este negocio se nos vuelva en reproche, sino también que el templo de la gran diosa Diana sea estimado en nada, y comience á ser destruída su majestad, la cual honra toda el Asia y el mundo.

verses.KJV: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.WEB: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
verses.ASV: And when they heard this they were filled with wrath, and cried out, saying, Great [is] Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ao ouvirem [estas coisas] ,encheram-se de ira, e clamaram, dizendo: Grande é a Diana dos efésios!
verses.RVR09: Oídas estas cosas, llenáronse de ira, y dieron alarido, diciendo: ¡Grande es Diana de los Efesios!

verses.KJV: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
verses.WEB: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
verses.ASV: And the city was filled with the confusion: and they rushed with one accord into the theatre, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a cidade se encheu de tumulto, e em concordância eles invadiram ao teatro, tomando consigo Gaio e Aristarco, macedônios, companheiros de Paulo na viagem.
verses.RVR09: Y la ciudad se llenó de confusión; y unánimes se arrojaron al teatro, arrebatando á Gayo y á Aristarco, Macedonios, compañeros de Pablo.

verses.KJV: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.WEB: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
verses.ASV: And when Paul was minded to enter in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, querendo comparecer diante do povo, os discípulos não o permitiram.
verses.RVR09: Y queriendo Pablo salir al pueblo, los discípulos no le dejaron.

verses.KJV: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.WEB: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
verses.ASV: And certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent unto him and besought him not to adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também alguns dos líderes da Ásia, que eram amigos dele, enviaram-lhe [aviso] , rogando[-lhe] para que não se apresentasse no teatro.
verses.RVR09: También algunos de los principales de Asia, que eran sus amigos, enviaron á él rogando que no se presentase en el teatro.

verses.KJV: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.WEB: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
verses.ASV: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was in confusion; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então gritavam, [alguns de uma maneira] , outros de outra; porque a aglomeração estava confusa; e a maioria não sabia por que causa estavam aglomerados.
verses.RVR09: Y otros gritaban otra cosa; porque la concurrencia estaba confusa, y los más no sabían por qué se habían juntado.

verses.KJV: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
verses.WEB: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
verses.ASV: And they brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made a defence unto the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tiraram da multidão a Alexandre, os judeus o pondo para a frente. E Alexandre, acenando com a mão, queria [se] defender ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y sacaron de entre la multitud á Alejandro, empujándole los Judíos. Entonces Alejandro, pedido silencio con la mano, quería dar razón al pueblo.

verses.KJV: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.WEB: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
verses.ASV: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great [is] Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao saberem que ele era judeu, levantou-se uma voz de todos, clamando por cerca de duas horas: Grande é a Diana dos efésios!
verses.RVR09: Mas como conocieron que era Judío, fué hecha un voz de todos, que gritaron casi por dos horas: ¡Grande es Diana de los Efesios!

verses.KJV: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.WEB: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
verses.ASV: And when the townclerk had quieted the multitude, he saith, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there who knoweth not that the city of the Ephesians is temple-keeper of the great Diana, and of the [image] which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o escrivão, tendo apaziguado a multidão, disse: Homens efésios, quem não sabe que a cidade dos efésios é a guardadora do templo da grande deusa Diana, e da [imagem] que desceu do céu?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el escribano, apaciguado que hubo la gente, dijo: Varones Efesios, ¿y quién hay de los hombres que no sepa que la ciudad de los Efesios es honradora de la gran diosa Diana, y de la imagen venida de Júpiter?

verses.KJV: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
verses.WEB: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.
verses.ASV: Seeing then that these things cannot be gainsaid, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rash.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sendo que estas coisas não podem ser contraditas, vós deveis vos acalmar, e nada façais precipitadamente;
verses.RVR09: Así que, pues esto no puede ser contradicho, conviene que os apacigüéis, y que nada hagáis temerariamente;

verses.KJV: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.WEB: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.ASV: For ye have brought [hither] these men, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of our goddess.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós trouxestes [aqui] estes homens, que nem são sacrílegos, nem blasfemam de vossa deusa.
verses.RVR09: Pues habéis traído á estos hombres, sin ser sacrílegos ni blasfemadores de vuestra diosa.

verses.KJV: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
verses.WEB: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
verses.ASV: If therefore Demetrius, and the craftsmen that are with him, have a matter against any man, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls: let them accuse one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se Demétrio e os artesãos que estão com ele tem algum assunto contra ele, os tribunais estão abertos, e há procônsules; que se acusem uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Que si Demetrio y los oficiales que están con él tienen negocio con alguno, audiencias se hacen, y procónsules hay; acúsense los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
verses.WEB: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
verses.ASV: But if ye seek anything about other matters, it shall be settled in the regular assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se procurais alguma outra coisa, será decidido em uma reunião legalizada.
verses.RVR09: Y si demandáis alguna otra cosa, en legítima asamblea se pueda decidir.

verses.KJV: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
verses.WEB: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
verses.ASV: For indeed we are in danger to be accused concerning this day’s riot, there being no cause [for it]: and as touching it we shall not be able to give account of this concourse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque corremos perigo de que hoje sejamos acusados de rebelião, tendo causa nenhuma para dar como explicação para este tumulto.
verses.RVR09: Porque peligro hay de que seamos argüidos de sedición por hoy, no habiendo ninguna causa por la cual podamos dar razón de este concurso. Y habiendo dicho esto, despidió la concurrencia.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.WEB: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.ASV: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo dito isto, despediu o ajuntamento.

verses.KJV: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
verses.WEB: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
verses.ASV: And after the uproar ceased, Paul having sent for the disciples and exhorted them, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo acabado o tumulto, Paulo chamou a si os discípulos e, abraçando-os, saiu para ir à Macedônia.
verses.RVR09: Y DESPUÉS que cesó el alboroto, llamando Pablo á los discípulos habiéndoles exhortado y abrazado, se despidió, y partió para ir á Macedonia.

verses.KJV: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
verses.WEB: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
verses.ASV: And when he had gone through those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo passado por aquelas regiões, e exortando-os com muitas palavras, ele veio à Grécia.
verses.RVR09: Y andado que hubo aquellas partes, y exhortádoles con abundancia de palabra, vino á Grecia.

verses.KJV: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
verses.WEB: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
verses.ASV: And when he had spent three months [there], and a plot was laid against him by the Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficando [ali] por três meses, e havendo contra ele uma cilada posta pelos judeus quando ele estava a ponto de navegar para a Síria, ele decidiu voltar pela Macedônia.
verses.RVR09: Y después de haber estado allí tres meses, y habiendo de navegar á Siria, le fueron puestas asechanzas por los Judíos; y así tomó consejo de volverse por Macedonia.

verses.KJV: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.WEB: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
verses.ASV: And there accompanied him as far as Asia, Sopater of Beroea, [the son] of Pyrrhus; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o acompanhou até a Ásia Sópater, de Bereia; e dos tessalonicenses, Aristarco e Segundo, e Gaio de Derbe, e Timóteo; e dos da Ásia, Tíquico e Trófimo.
verses.RVR09: Y le acompañaron hasta Asia Sopater Bereense, y los Tesalonicenses, Aristarco y Segundo; y Gayo de Derbe, y Timoteo; y de Asia, Tychîco y Trófimo.

verses.KJV: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
verses.WEB: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
verses.ASV: But these had gone before, and were waiting for us at Troas.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, indo adiante, nos esperaram em Trôade.
verses.RVR09: Estos yendo delante, nos esperaron en Troas.

verses.KJV: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
verses.WEB: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
verses.ASV: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we tarried seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois dos dias dos [pães] não fermentados, nós navegamos de Filipos, e em cinco dias viemos até eles, onde ficamos por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros, pasados los días de los panes sin levadura, navegamos de Filipos y vinimos á ellos á Troas en cinco días, donde estuvimos siete días.

verses.KJV: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.WEB: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.ASV: And upon the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul discoursed with them, intending to depart on the morrow; and prolonged his speech until midnight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no primeiro [dia] da semana, tendo os discípulos se reunido para partir o pão, Paulo discutia com eles, estando para partir no dia seguinte; e ele estendeu a discussão até a meia noite.
verses.RVR09: Y el día primero de la semana, juntos los discípulos á partir el pan, Pablo les enseñaba, habiendo de partir al día siguiente: y alargó el discurso hasta la media noche.

verses.KJV: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
verses.WEB: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
verses.ASV: And there were many lights in the upper chamber where we were gathered together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia muitas luminárias no compartimento onde estavam reunidos.
verses.RVR09: Y había muchas lámparas en el aposento alto donde estaban juntos.

verses.KJV: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
verses.WEB: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.
verses.ASV: And there sat in the window a certain young man named Eutychus, borne down with deep sleep; and as Paul discoursed yet longer, being borne down by his sleep he fell down from the third story, and was taken up dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando um certo rapaz, de nome Êutico, sentado em uma janela, tendo sido tomado por um sono profundo, [e] ,estando Paulo [ainda] falando por muito [tempo] ,[Êutico] ,derrubado pelo sono, caiu desde o terceiro andar abaixo; e foi levantado morto.
verses.RVR09: Y un mancebo llamado Eutichô que estaba sentado en la ventana, tomado de un sueño profundo, como Pablo disputaba largamente, postrado del sueño cayó del tercer piso abajo, y fué alzado muerto.

verses.KJV: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
verses.WEB: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
verses.ASV: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Make ye no ado; for his life is in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo, tendo descido, debruçou sobre ele e, abraçando [-o] ,disse: Não fiqueis perturbados, porque sua alma [ainda] está nele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces descendió Pablo, y derribóse sobre él, y abrazándole, dijo: No os alborotéis, que su alma está en él.

verses.KJV: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
verses.WEB: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
verses.ASV: And when he was gone up, and had broken the bread, and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [voltou] a subir, e tendo partido e experimentado o pão, ele falou longamente até o nascer do dia; e assim ele partiu.
verses.RVR09: Después subiendo, y partiendo el pan, y gustando, habló largamente hasta el alba, y así partió.

verses.KJV: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.WEB: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
verses.ASV: And they brought the lad alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram o rapaz vivo, e ficaram não pouco consolados.
verses.RVR09: Y llevaron al mozo vivo, y fueron consolados no poco.

verses.KJV: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
verses.WEB: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
verses.ASV: But we, going before to the ship, set sail for Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, intending himself to go by land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós, tendo ido adiante ao navio, navegamos até Assôs, onde estaríamos para receber a Paulo, porque assim ele tinha ordenado; e ele ia a pé.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros subiendo en el navío, navegamos á Assón, para recibir de allí á Pablo; pues así había determinado que debía él ir por tierra.

verses.KJV: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
verses.WEB: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.
verses.ASV: And when he met us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele se encontrou conosco em Assôs, nós o tomamos, e fomos a Mitilene.
verses.RVR09: Y como se juntó con nosotros en Assón, tomándole vinimos á Mitilene.

verses.KJV: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
verses.WEB: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
verses.ASV: And sailing from thence, we came the following day over against Chios; and the next day we touched at Samos; and the day after we came to Miletus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E navegando dali, chegamos no [dia] seguinte em frente a Quios; e no outro dia aportamos em Samos; e ficando em Trogílio, no dia seguinte viemos a Mileto.
verses.RVR09: Y navegando de allí, al día siguiente llegamos delante de Chîo, y al otro día tomamos puerto en Samo: y habiendo reposado en Trogilio, al día siguiente llegamos á Mileto.

verses.KJV: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.WEB: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
verses.ASV: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Paulo tinha decidido navegar [desviando-se] de Éfeso, para não lhe haver de gastar tempo na Ásia; porque ele se apressava para estar em Jerusalém do dia de Pentecostes, caso lhe fosse possível.
verses.RVR09: Porque Pablo se había propuesto pasar adelante de Efeso; por no detenerse en Asia: porque se apresuraba por hacer el día de Pentecostés, si le fuese posible, en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
verses.WEB: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
verses.ASV: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to him the elders of the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele enviou [mensagem] desde Mileto até Éfeso, chamando aos anciãos da igreja.
verses.RVR09: Y enviando desde Mileto á Efeso, hizo llamar á los ancianos de la iglesia.

verses.KJV: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
verses.WEB: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
verses.ASV: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, after what manner I was with you all the time,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vieram a [Paulo] ,ele lhes disse: Vós sabeis que desde o primeiro dia que entrei na Ásia, [o modo] como eu estive todo [aquele] tempo convosco;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando vinieron á él, les dijo: Vosotros sabéis cómo, desde el primer día que entré en Asia, he estado con vosotros por todo el tiempo,

verses.KJV: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
verses.WEB: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
verses.ASV: serving the Lord with all lowliness of mind, and with tears, and with trials which befell me by the plots of the Jews;
verses.ALMEIDA: Servindo ao Senhor com toda humildade, muitas lágrimas, e tentações, que sobrevieram a mim pelas ciladas dos judeus;
verses.RVR09: Sirviendo al Señor con toda humildad, y con muchas lágrimas, y tentaciones que me han venido por las asechanzas de los Judíos:

verses.KJV: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,
verses.WEB: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
verses.ASV: how I shrank not from declaring unto you anything that was profitable, and teaching you publicly, and from house to house,
verses.ALMEIDA: Como eu, daquilo que [vos] era proveitoso, nada deixei de anunciar a vós, e ensinar publicamente e pelas casas;
verses.RVR09: Cómo nada que fuese útil he rehuído de anunciaros y enseñaros, públicamente y por las casas,

verses.KJV: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
verses.ASV: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dando testemunho, tanto a judeus como a gregos, do arrependimento para [se converter] a Deus, e da fé em nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Testificando á los Judíos y á los Gentiles arrepentimiento para con Dios, y la fe en nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
verses.WEB: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
verses.ASV: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora eis que, estando eu atado ao Espírito, estou indo a Jerusalém, não sabendo o que me acontecerá;
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, he aquí, ligado yo en espíritu, voy á Jerusalem, sin saber lo que allá me ha de acontecer:

verses.KJV: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
verses.WEB: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
verses.ASV: save that the Holy Spirit testifieth unto me in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
verses.ALMEIDA: A não ser pelo que o Espírito Santo em cada cidade [me] dá testemunho, dizendo que prisões e aflições me esperam.
verses.RVR09: Mas que el Espíritu Santo por todas las ciudades me da testimonio, diciendo que prisiones y tribulaciones me esperan.

verses.KJV: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.WEB: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
verses.ASV: But I hold not my life of any account as dear unto myself, so that I may accomplish my course, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas de nenhuma [dessas] coisas eu dou importância, nem tenho minha vida por preciosa, para que com alegria eu cumpra minha carreira, e o trabalho que recebi do Senhor Jesus, para dar testemunho do Evangelho da graça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas de ninguna cosa hago caso, ni estimo mi vida preciosa para mí mismo; solamente que acabe mi carrera con gozo, y el ministerio que recibí del Señor Jesús, para dar testimonio del evangelio de la gracia de Dios.

verses.KJV: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
verses.WEB: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
verses.ASV: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I went about preaching the kingdom, shall see my face no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, eis que eu sei que todos vós, a quem eu passei pregando o Reino de Deus, não vereis mais o meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, he aquí, yo sé que ninguno de todos vosotros, por quien he pasado predicando el reino de Dios, verá más mi rostro.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
verses.WEB: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
verses.ASV: Wherefore I testify unto you this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos dou claro testemunho de que eu estou limpo do sangue de todos [vós] ;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, yo os protesto el día de hoy, que yo soy limpio de la sangre de todos:

verses.KJV: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
verses.WEB: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
verses.ASV: For I shrank not from declaring unto you the whole counsel of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu não deixei de vos anunciar todo o conselho de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Porque no he rehuído de anunciaros todo el consejo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
verses.WEB: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
verses.ASV: Take heed unto yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit hath made you bishops, to feed the church of the Lord which he purchased with his own blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto prestai atenção por vós mesmos, e por todo o rebanho sobre os quais o Espírito Santo tem vos posto como supervisores, para apascentardes a igreja de Deus, a qual ele adquiriu por meio de seu próprio sangue.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto mirad por vosotros, y por todo el rebaño en que el Espíritu Santo os ha puesto por obispos, para apacentar la iglesia del Señor, la cual ganó por su sangre.
