verses.KJV: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.WEB: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.ASV: I know that after my departing grievous wolves shall enter in among you, not sparing the flock;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque isto eu sei, que depois de minha partida, entrarão entre vós lobos cruéis, que não pouparão ao rebanho;
verses.RVR09: Porque yo sé que después de mi partida entrarán en medio de vosotros lobos rapaces, que no perdonarán al ganado;

verses.KJV: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
verses.WEB: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
verses.ASV: and from among your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que dentre vós mesmos se levantarão homens a falarem coisas perversas, para atraírem após si aos discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Y de vosotros mismos se levantarán hombres que hablen cosas perversas, para llevar discípulos tras sí.

verses.KJV: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
verses.WEB: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
verses.ASV: Wherefore watch ye, remembering that by the space of three years I ceased not to admonish every one night and day with tears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso vigiai, lembrando que por três anos, noite e dia eu não parei de vos alertar com lágrimas a cada um [de vós] .
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, velad, acordándoos que por tres años de noche y de día, no he cesado de amonestar con lágrimas á cada uno.

verses.KJV: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verses.WEB: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.ASV: And now I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build [you] up, and to give [you] the inheritance among all them that are sanctified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, irmãos, eu vos entrego a Deus, e à palavra de sua graça; ele que é poderoso para vos edificar e vos dar herança entre todos os santificados.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, hermanos, os encomiendo á Dios, y á la palabra de su gracia: el cual es poderoso para sobreedificar, y daros heredad con todos los santificados.

verses.KJV: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
verses.WEB: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
verses.ASV: I coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não cobicei de ninguém a prata, nem ouro, nem roupa.
verses.RVR09: La plata, ó el oro, ó el vestido de nadie he codiciado.

verses.KJV: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
verses.WEB: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
verses.ASV: Ye yourselves know that these hands ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós mesmos sabeis que, para as minhas necessidades e as dos que estavam comigo, estas [minhas] mãos me serviram.
verses.RVR09: Antes vosotros sabéis que para lo que me ha sido necesario, y á los que están conmigo, estas manos me han servido.

verses.KJV: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.WEB: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
verses.ASV: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring ye ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tudo eu vos tenho mostrado que trabalhando assim, é necessário dar suporte aos enfermos; e lembrar-se das palavras do Senhor Jesus, que disse: Mais bem-aventurado é dar do que receber.
verses.RVR09: En todo os he enseñado que, trabajando así, es necesario sobrellevar á los enfermos, y tener presente las palabras del Señor Jesús, el cual dijo: Más bienaventurada cosa es dar que recibir.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
verses.WEB: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
verses.ASV: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down and prayed with them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo dito isto, pondo-se de joelhos, ele orou com todos eles.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo dicho estas cosas, se puso de rodillas, y oró con todos ellos.

verses.KJV: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,
verses.WEB: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
verses.ASV: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve um grande pranto de todos; e reclinando-se sobre o pescoço de Paulo, beijavam-no;
verses.RVR09: Entonces hubo un gran lloro de todos: y echándose en el cuello de Pablo, le besaban,

verses.KJV: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
verses.WEB: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
verses.ASV: sorrowing most of all for the word which he had spoken, that they should behold his face no more. And they brought him on his way unto the ship.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entristecendo-se muito, principalmente pela palavra que ele tinha dito, que não mais veriam o rosto dele; e o acompanharam até o navio.
verses.RVR09: Doliéndose en gran manera por la palabra que dijo, que no habían de ver más su rostro. Y le acompañaron al navío.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
verses.WEB: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
verses.ASV: And when it came to pass that we were parted from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course unto Cos, and the next day unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando aconteceu de termos saído deles, e navegado, percorremos diretamente, e viemos a Cós, e [n] o [dia] seguinte a Rodes, e dali a Pátara.
verses.RVR09: Y HABIENDO partido de ellos, navegamos y vinimos camino derecho á Coos, y al día siguiente á Rhodas, y de allí á Pátara.

verses.KJV: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
verses.WEB: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
verses.ASV: and having found a ship crossing over unto Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo achado um navio que passava para a Fenícia, nós embarcamos nele, e partimos.
verses.RVR09: Y hallando un barco que pasaba á Fenicia, nos embarcamos, y partimos.

verses.KJV: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
verses.WEB: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
verses.ASV: And when we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed unto Syria, and landed at Tyre; for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Chipre à vista, e deixando-a à esquerda, navegamos para a Síria, e viemos a Tiro; porque o navio tinha de deixar ali sua carga.
verses.RVR09: Y como avistamos á Cipro, dejándola á mano izquierda, navegamos á Siria, y vinimos á Tiro: porque el barco había de descargar allí su carga.

verses.KJV: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And having found the disciples, we tarried there seven days: and these said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not set foot in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós ficamos ali por sete dias; e achamos aos discípulos, os quais diziam pelo Espírito a Paulo, que não subisse a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y nos quedamos allí siete días, hallados los discípulos, los cuales decían á Pablo por Espíritu, que no subiese á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
verses.WEB: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
verses.ASV: And when it came to pass that we had accomplished the days, we departed and went on our journey; and they all, with wives and children, brought us on our way till we were out of the city: and kneeling down on the beach, we prayed, and bade each other farewell;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo passado [ali] aqueles dias, nós saímos e seguimos nosso caminho, acompanhando-nos todos com [suas] mulheres e filhos até fora da cidade; e postos de joelhos na praia, oramos.
verses.RVR09: Y cumplidos aquellos días, salimos acompañándonos todos, con sus mujeres é hijos, hasta fuera de la ciudad; y puestos de rodillas en la ribera, oramos.

verses.KJV: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
verses.WEB: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
verses.ASV: and we went on board the ship, but they returned home again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saudando-nos uns aos outros, subimos ao navio; e eles voltaram para as [casas] deles.
verses.RVR09: Y abrazándonos los unos á los otros, subimos al barco, y ellos se volvieron á sus casas.

verses.KJV: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
verses.WEB: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
verses.ASV: And when we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais; and we saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós, acabada a navegação de Tiro, chegamos a Ptolemaida; e tendo saudado aos irmãos, ficamos com eles por um dia.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros, cumplida la navegación, vinimos de Tiro á Tolemaida; y habiendo saludado á los hermanos, nos quedamos con ellos un día.

verses.KJV: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
verses.WEB: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
verses.ASV: And on the morrow we departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and entering into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, we abode with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [n] o [dia] seguinte, Paulo e nós que estávamos com ele, saindo dali, viemos a Cesareia; e entrando na casa de Filipe, o evangelista (que era [um] dos sete), nós ficamos com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y otro día, partidos Pablo y los que con él estábamos, vinimos á Cesarea: y entrando en casa de Felipe el evangelista, el cual era uno de los siete, posamos con él.

verses.KJV: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
verses.WEB: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
verses.ASV: Now this man had four virgin daughters, who prophesied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este tinha quatro filhas, que profetizavam.
verses.RVR09: Y éste tenía cuatro hijas, doncellas, que profetizaban.

verses.KJV: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
verses.WEB: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.ASV: And as we tarried there some days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named Agabus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficando nós [ali] por muitos dias, desceu da Judeia um profeta, de nome Ágabo;
verses.RVR09: Y parando nosotros allí por muchos días, descendió de Judea un profeta, llamado Agabo;

verses.KJV: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
verses.ASV: And coming to us, and taking Paul’s girdle, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, Thus saith the Holy Spirit, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tendo vindo a nós, e tomando a cinta de Paulo, e atando-se os pés e as mãos, disse: Isto diz o Espírito Santo: Assim os judeus em Jerusalém atarão ao homem a quem [pertence] esta cinta, e o entregarão nas mãos dos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Y venido á nosotros, tomó el cinto de Pablo, y atándose los pies y las manos, dijo: Esto dice el Espíritu Santo: Así atarán los Judíos en Jerusalem al varón cuyo es este cinto, y le entregarán en manos de los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And when we heard these things, both we and they of that place besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós, tendo ouvido isto, rogamos a ele, tanto nós como os que eram daquele lugar, que ele não subisse a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual como oímos, le rogamos nosotros y los de aquel lugar, que no subiese á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
verses.ASV: Then Paul answered, What do ye, weeping and breaking my heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo respondeu: O que vós estais fazendo, ao chorarem e afligirem o meu coração? Porque eu estou pronto, não somente para ser atado, mas até mesmo para morrer em Jerusalém, pelo nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo respondió: ¿Qué hacéis llorando y afligiéndome el corazón? porque yo no sólo estoy presto á ser atado, mas aun á morir en Jerusalem por el nombre del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.WEB: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
verses.ASV: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como ele não deixou ser persuadido, nós nos aquietamos, dizendo: Faça-se a vontade do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y como no le pudimos persuadir, desistimos, diciendo: Hágase la voluntad del Señor.

verses.KJV: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And after these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois daqueles dias, nós nos arrumamos, e subimos a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y después de estos días, apercibidos, subimos á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.WEB: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
verses.ASV: And there went with us also [certain] of the disciples from Cæsarea, bringing [with them] one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram também conosco [alguns] dos discípulos de Cesareia, trazendo [consigo] a um certo Mnáson, cipriota, discípulo antigo, com o qual íamos nos hospedar.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron también con nosotros de Cesarea algunos de los discípulos, trayendo consigo á un Mnasón, Cyprio, discípulo antiguo, con el cual posásemos.

verses.KJV: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.WEB: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
verses.ASV: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegamos a Jerusalém, os irmãos nos receberam com muito boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando llegamos á Jerusalem, los hermanos nos recibieron de buena voluntad.

verses.KJV: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
verses.WEB: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
verses.ASV: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [n] o [dia] seguinte, Paulo entrou conosco a [casa de] Tiago, e todos os anciãos vieram ali.
verses.RVR09: Y al día siguiente Pablo entró con nosotros á Jacobo, y todos los ancianos se juntaron;

verses.KJV: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
verses.WEB: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.ASV: And when he had saluted them, he rehearsed one by one the things which God had wrought among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo os saudado, ele [lhes] contou em detalhes o que Deus tinha feito entre os gentios por meio do trabalho dele.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales, como los hubo saludado, contó por menudo lo que Dios había hecho entre los Gentiles por su ministerio.

verses.KJV: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
verses.WEB: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
verses.ASV: And they, when they heard it, glorified God; and they said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of them that have believed; and they are all zealous for the law:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, ao ouvirem, glorificaram ao Senhor, e lhe disseram: Tu vês, irmão, quantos milhares de judeus há que creem, e todos são zelosos da lei.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos como lo oyeron, glorificaron á Dios, y le dijeron: Ya ves, hermano, cuántos millares de Judíos hay que han creído; y todos son celadores de la ley:

verses.KJV: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.WEB: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
verses.ASV: and they have been informed concerning thee, that thou teachest all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram informados quanto a ti, que a todos os judeus, que estão entre os gentios, [que] tu ensinas a se afastarem de Moisés, dizendo que não devem circuncidar [seus] filhos, nem andar segundo os costumes.
verses.RVR09: Mas fueron informados acerca de ti, que enseñas á apartarse de Moisés á todos los Judíos que están entre los Gentiles, diciéndoles que no han de circuncidar á los hijos, ni andar según la costumbre.

verses.KJV: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
verses.WEB: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
verses.ASV: What is it therefore? they will certainly hear that thou art come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o que se fará? Em todo caso a multidão deve se ajuntar, porque ouvirão que tu [já] chegaste.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué hay pues? La multitud se reunirá de cierto: porque oirán que has venido.

verses.KJV: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
verses.WEB: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
verses.ASV: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men that have a vow on them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto faça isto que te dizemos: temos quatro homens que fizeram voto.
verses.RVR09: Haz pues esto que te decimos: Hay entre nosotros cuatro hombres que tienen voto sobre sí:

verses.KJV: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
verses.WEB: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
verses.ASV: these take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges for them, that they may shave their heads: and all shall know that there is no truth in the things whereof they have been informed concerning thee; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, keeping the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma contigo a estes, e purifica-te com eles, e paga os gastos deles, para que rapem a cabeça, e todos saibam que não há nada do que foram informados sobre ti, mas sim, [que] tu mesmo andas guardando a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Tomando á éstos contigo, purifícate con ellos, y gasta con ellos, para que rasuren sus cabezas, y todos entiendan que no hay nada de lo que fueron informados acerca de ti; sino que tú también andas guardando la ley.

verses.KJV: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
verses.WEB: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
verses.ASV: But as touching the Gentiles that have believed, we wrote, giving judgment that they should keep themselves from things sacrificed to idols, and from blood, and from what is strangled, and from fornication.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto aos que creem dentre os gentios, nós já escrevemos, julgando que nada disto guardassem, a não ser somente que se abstenham do que se abstenham das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, e do sangue, e da [carne] sufocada, e do pecado sexual.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuanto á los que de los Gentiles han creído, nosotros hemos escrito haberse acordado que no guarden nada de esto; solamente que se abstengan de lo que fuere sacrificado á los ídolos, y de sangre, y de ahogado, y de fornicación.

verses.KJV: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
verses.WEB: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
verses.ASV: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them went into the temple, declaring the fulfilment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Paulo, tendo tomado consigo a aqueles homens, e purificando-se com eles no dia seguinte, entrou no Templo, anunciando que [já] estavam cumpridos dos dias da purificação, quando fosse oferecida por eles, cada um [sua] oferta.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo tomó consigo aquellos hombres, y al día siguiente, habiéndose purificado con ellos, entró en el templo, para anunciar el cumplimiento de los días de la purificación, hasta ser ofrecida ofrenda por cada uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
verses.WEB: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
verses.ASV: And when the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo os sete dias quase quase completados, os judeus da Ásia, vendo-o, tumultuaram a todo o povo, e lançaram as mãos sobre ele [para o deterem] ,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando estaban para acabarse los siete días, unos Judíos de Asia, como le vieron en el templo, alborotaron todo el pueblo y le echaron mano,

verses.KJV: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
verses.WEB: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
verses.ASV: crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man that teacheth all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place; and moreover he brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath defiled this holy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamando: Homens israelitas, ajudai [-nos] ; este é o homem que por todos os lugares ensina a todos contra o [nosso] povo, e contra a Lei, e [contra] este lugar; e além disto, ele também pôs gregos dentro do Templo, e contaminou este santo lugar!
verses.RVR09: Dando voces: Varones Israelitas, ayudad: Este es el hombre que por todas partes enseña á todos contra el pueblo, y la ley, y este lugar; y además de esto ha metido Gentiles en el templo, y ha contaminado este lugar santo.

verses.KJV: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
verses.WEB: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
verses.ASV: For they had before seen with him in the city Trophimus the Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque antes eles tinham visto na cidade a Trófimo junto dele, ao qual pensavam que Paulo tinha trazido para dentro do Templo).
verses.RVR09: Porque antes habían visto con él en la ciudad á Trófimo, Efesio, al cual pensaban que Pablo había metido en el templo.

verses.KJV: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
verses.WEB: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
verses.ASV: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together; and they laid hold on Paul, and dragged him out of the temple: and straightway the doors were shut.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a cidade se tumultuou, e houve um ajuntamento do povo; e tendo detido a Paulo, trouxeram-no para fora do Templo; e logo as portas foram fechadas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, toda la ciudad se alborotó, y agolpóse el pueblo; y tomando á Pablo, hiciéronle salir fuera del templo, y luego las puertas fueron cerradas.

verses.KJV: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.WEB: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.ASV: And as they were seeking to kill him, tidings came up to the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in confusion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, procurando matá-lo, a notícia chegou ao comandante e aos soldados, de que toda Jerusalém estava em confusão.
verses.RVR09: Y procurando ellos matarle, fué dado aviso al tribuno de la compañía, que toda la ciudad de Jerusalem estaba alborotada;

verses.KJV: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
verses.WEB: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
verses.ASV: And forthwith he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down upon them: and they, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, left off beating Paul.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, tendo tomado logo consigo soldados e centuriões, correu até eles. E eles, vendo ao comandante e aos soldados, pararam de ferir a Paulo.
verses.RVR09: El cual tomando luego soldados y centuriones, corrió á ellos. Y ellos como vieron al tribuno y á los soldados, cesaron de herir á Pablo.

verses.KJV: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
verses.WEB: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
verses.ASV: Then the chief captain came near, and laid hold on him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and inquired who he was, and what he had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o comandante, tendo se aproximado, prendeu-o, e mandou que ele fosse atado em duas correntes; e perguntou quem ele era, e o que ele tinha feito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegando el tribuno, le prendió, y le mandó atar con dos cadenas; y preguntó quién era, y qué había hecho.

verses.KJV: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
verses.WEB: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
verses.ASV: And some shouted one thing, some another, among the crowd: and when he could not know the certainty for the uproar, he commanded him to be brought into the castle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na multidão clamavam [uns de uma maneira] ,e outros de outra maneira; mas [como] ele não podia saber com certeza por causa do tumulto, ele mandou que o levassem para a área fortificada.
verses.RVR09: Y entre la multitud, unos gritaban una cosa, y otros otra: y como no podía entender nada de cierto á causa del alboroto, le mandó llevar á la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
verses.WEB: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
verses.ASV: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the crowd;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tendo chegado às escadas, aconteceu que ele foi carregado pelos soldados, por causa da violência da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegó á las gradas, aconteció que fué llevado de los soldados á causa de la violencia del pueblo;

verses.KJV: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
verses.WEB: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
verses.ASV: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, Away with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a multidão do povo [o] seguia, gritando: Tragam-no para fora!
verses.RVR09: Porque multitud de pueblo venía detrás, gritando: Mátale.

verses.KJV: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
verses.WEB: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
verses.ASV: And as Paul was about to be brought into the castle, he saith unto the chief captain, May I say something unto thee? And he said, Dost thou know Greek?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, estando perto de entrar na área fortificada, disse ao comandante: É permitido a mim te falar alguma coisa?E ele disse: Tu sabes grego?
verses.RVR09: Y como comenzaron á meter á Pablo en la fortaleza, dice al tribuno: ¿Me será lícito hablarte algo? Y él dijo: ¿Sabes griego?

verses.KJV: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
verses.WEB: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
verses.ASV: Art thou not then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não és tu aquele egípcio, que antes destes dias tinha levantando uma rebelião, e levou ao deserto quatro mil homens assassinos?
verses.RVR09: ¿No eres tú aquel Egipcio que levantaste una sedición antes de estos días, y sacaste al desierto cuatro mil hombres salteadores?

verses.KJV: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
verses.WEB: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
verses.ASV: But Paul said, I am a Jew, of Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and I beseech thee, give me leave to speak unto the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Paulo lhe disse: Na verdade eu sou um homem judeu de Tarso, cidade não pouca importância da Cilícia; mas eu te rogo para que tu me permitas falar ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Pablo: Yo de cierto soy hombre Judío, ciudadano de Tarso, ciudad no obscura de Cilicia: empero ruégote que me permitas que hable al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
verses.WEB: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
verses.ASV: And when he had given him leave, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with the hand unto the people; and when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew language, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo [lhe] permitido, Paulo pôs-se de pé nas escadas, acenou com a mão ao povo; e tendo havido grande silêncio, falou [-lhes] em língua hebraica, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y como él se lo permitió, Pablo, estando en pie en las gradas, hizo señal con la mano al pueblo. Y hecho grande silencio, habló en lengua hebrea, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
verses.WEB: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
verses.ASV: Brethren and fathers, hear ye the defence which I now make unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens irmãos, e pais, ouvi agora minha defesa para convosco.
verses.RVR09: VARONES hermanos y padres, oid la razón que ahora os doy.

verses.KJV: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
verses.WEB: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
verses.ASV: And when they heard that he spake unto them in the Hebrew language, they were the more quiet: and he saith,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo ouvido que ele lhes falava em língua hebraica, fizeram ainda mais silêncio. E ele disse:
verses.RVR09: (Y como oyeron que les hablaba en lengua hebrea, guardaron más silencio.) Y dijo:

verses.KJV: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
verses.WEB: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
verses.ASV: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city, at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict manner of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as ye all are this day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu verdadeiramente sou um homem judeu, nascido em Tarso da Cilícia, e criado nesta cidade aos pés de Gamaliel, ensinado ao mais correto modo da Lei paterna [e] zeloso de Deus, assim como todos vós sois hoje.
verses.RVR09: Yo de cierto soy Judío, nacido en Tarso de Cilicia, mas criado en esta ciudad á los pies de Gamaliel, enseñado conforme á la verdad de la ley de la patria, celoso de Dios, como todos vosotros sois hoy.

verses.KJV: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
verses.WEB: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
verses.ASV: and I persecuted this Way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Eu] ,que persegui este caminho até a morte, atando tanto a homens como a mulheres, e [os] entregando a prisões.
verses.RVR09: Que he perseguido este camino hasta la muerte, prendiendo y entregando en cárceles hombres y mujeres:

verses.KJV: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
verses.WEB: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
verses.ASV: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and journeyed to Damascus to bring them also that were there unto Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como também o sumo sacerdote me é testemunha, e todo o conselho dos anciãos; dos quais eu, tendo tomado cartas para os irmãos, fui a Damasco para que os que estivessem ali, eu também os trouxesse amarrados a Jerusalém, para que fossem castigados.
verses.RVR09: Como también el príncipe de los sacerdotes me es testigo, y todos los ancianos; de los cuales también tomando letras á los hermanos, iba á Damasco para traer presos á Jerusalem aun á los que estuviesen allí, para que fuesen castigados.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
verses.WEB: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and drew nigh unto Damascus, about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aconteceu que, estando eu no caminho, e chegando perto de Damasco, quase ao meio dia, de repente uma grande luz do céu brilhou ao redor de mim.
verses.RVR09: Mas aconteció que yendo yo, y llegando cerca de Damasco, como á medio día, de repente me rodeó mucha luz del cielo:

verses.KJV: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.WEB: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
verses.ASV: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu cai ao chão, e ouvi uma voz, que me dizia: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?
verses.RVR09: Y caí en el suelo, y oí una voz que me decía: Saulo, Saulo, ¿por qué me persigues?

verses.KJV: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
verses.WEB: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
verses.ASV: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu respondi: Quem és, Senhor? E ele me disse: Eu sou Jesus, o nazareno, a quem tu persegues.
verses.RVR09: Yo entonces respondí: ¿Quién eres, Señor? Y me dijo: Yo soy Jesús de Nazaret, á quien tú persigues.

verses.KJV: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
verses.WEB: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
verses.ASV: And they that were with me beheld indeed the light, but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estavam comigo verdadeiramente viram a luz, e ficaram muito atemorizados; mas eles não ouviram a voz daquele que falava comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y los que estaban conmigo vieron á la verdad la luz, y se espantaron; mas no oyeron la voz del que hablaba conmigo.

verses.KJV: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
verses.WEB: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
verses.ASV: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Que farei, Senhor? E o Senhor me disse: Levanta-te, e vai a Damasco, e ali te será dito tudo o que te é ordenado fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: ¿Qué haré, Señor? Y el Señor me dijo: Levántate, y ve á Damasco, y allí te será dicho todo lo que te está señalado hacer.

verses.KJV: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.WEB: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.ASV: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me I came into Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu não [conseguia] ver, por causa da glória daquela luz, eu fui levado pela mão dos que estavam comigo, e [assim] cheguei a Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Y como yo no viese por causa de la claridad de la luz, llevado de la mano por los que estaban conmigo, vine á Damasco.

verses.KJV: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
verses.WEB: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
verses.ASV: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews that dwelt there,
verses.ALMEIDA: E um certo Ananias, homem devoto conforme a Lei, que tinha [bom] testemunho de todos os judeus que moravam [ali] ;
verses.RVR09: Entonces un Ananías, varón pío conforme á la ley, que tenía buen testimonio de todos los Judíos que allí moraban,

verses.KJV: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
verses.WEB: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
verses.ASV: came unto me, and standing by me said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And in that very hour I looked up on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo vindo até mim, e ficando [diante de mim] ,ele me disse: Irmão Saulo, recupere a vista; E naquela mesma hora eu [pude] vê-lo.
verses.RVR09: Viniendo á mí, y acercándose, me dijo: Hermano Saulo, recibe la vista. Y yo en aquella hora le miré.

verses.KJV: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
verses.WEB: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
verses.ASV: And he said, The God of our fathers hath appointed thee to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: O Deus de nossos pais te predeterminou para que tu conheças a vontade dele, e vejas aquele justo, e tu ouças a voz de sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: El Dios de nuestros padres te ha predestinado para que conocieses su voluntad, y vieses á aquel Justo, y oyeses la voz de su boca.

verses.KJV: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
verses.WEB: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
verses.ASV: For thou shalt be a witness for him unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu serás testemunha dele para com todos as pessoas, daquilo que tens visto e ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Porque has de ser testigo suyo á todos los hombres, de lo que has visto y oído.

verses.KJV: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
verses.ASV: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, por que estás parado? Levanta-te, e sê batizado, e lava teus pecados, invocando o nome do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, ¿por qué te detienes? Levántate, y bautízate, y lava tus pecados, invocando su nombre.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
verses.WEB: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when I had returned to Jerusalem, and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu a mim, tendo eu voltado a Jerusalém, e estando orando no Templo, veio-me um êxtase;
verses.RVR09: Y me aconteció, vuelto á Jerusalem, que orando en el templo, fuí arrebatado fuera de mí.

verses.KJV: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
verses.WEB: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
verses.ASV: and saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem; because they will not receive of thee testimony concerning me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vi aquele que me dizia: Apressa-te, e sai logo de Jerusalém, porque não aceitarão teu testemunho sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Y le vi que me decía: Date prisa, y sal prestamente fuera de Jerusalem; porque no recibirán tu testimonio de mí.

verses.KJV: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
verses.WEB: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
verses.ASV: And I said, Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Senhor, eles sabem que eu prendia e açoitava nas sinagogas aqueles que criam em ti.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: Señor, ellos saben que yo encerraba en cárcel, y hería por las sinagogas á los que creían en ti;

verses.KJV: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
verses.WEB: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
verses.ASV: and when the blood of Stephen thy witness was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting, and keeping the garments of them that slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o sangue de Estêvão, tua testemunha, se derramava, eu também estava presente, e consentia em sua morte, e guardava as roupas daqueles que o matavam.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando se derramaba la sangre de Esteban tu testigo, yo también estaba presente, y consentía á su muerte, y guardaba las ropas de los que le mataban.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee forth far hence unto the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me disse: Vai, porque eu te enviarei para longe, aos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Y me dijo: Ve, porque yo te tengo que enviar lejos á los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
verses.WEB: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
verses.ASV: And they gave him audience unto this word; and they lifted up their voice, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles o ouviram até esta palavra, e [em seguida] levantaram suas vozes, dizendo: Extermina-o da terra! Porque não é bom que ele viva.
verses.RVR09: Y le oyeron hasta esta palabra: entonces alzaron la voz, diciendo: Quita de la tierra á un tal hombre, porque no conviene que viva.

verses.KJV: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
verses.WEB: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
verses.ASV: And as they cried out, and threw off their garments, and cast dust into the air,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eles gritavam, tiravam [suas] capas, e lançavm pó ao ar,
verses.RVR09: Y dando ellos voces, y arrojando sus ropas y echando polvo al aire,

verses.KJV: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
verses.WEB: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
verses.ASV: the chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, bidding that he should be examined by scourging, that he might know for what cause they so shouted against him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comandante mandou que o levassem à área fortificada, dizendo que o interrogassem com açoites, para saber por que causa clamavam assim contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Mandó el tribuno que le llevasen á la fortaleza, y ordenó que fuese examinado con azotes, para saber por qué causa clamaban así contra él.

verses.KJV: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
verses.WEB: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
verses.ASV: And when they had tied him up with the thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando estavam o atando com correias, Paulo disse ao centurião que estava ali: É lícito para vós açoitar a um homem romano, sem [ter sido] condenado?
verses.RVR09: Y como le ataron con correas, Pablo dijo al centurión que estaba presente: ¿Os es lícito azotar á un hombre Romano sin ser condenado?

verses.KJV: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
verses.WEB: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
verses.ASV: And when the centurion heard it, he went to the chief captain and told him, saying, What art thou about to do? for this man is a Roman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o centurião, tendo ouvido [isto] ,foi e avisou ao comandante, dizendo: Olha o que estás a ponto de fazer, porque este homem é romano.
verses.RVR09: Y como el centurión oyó esto, fué y dió aviso al tribuno, diciendo: ¿Qué vas á hacer? porque este hombre es Romano.

verses.KJV: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
verses.WEB: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
verses.ASV: And the chief captain came and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? And he said, Yea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o comandante, tendo se aproximado, disse-lhe: Dize-me, tu és romano?E ele disse: Sim.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo el tribuno, le dijo: Dime, ¿eres tú Romano? Y él dijo: Sí.

verses.KJV: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
verses.WEB: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
verses.ASV: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this citizenship. And Paul said, But I am [a Roman] born.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o comandante respondeu: Eu com muita soma [de dinheiro] obtive esta cidadania [romana] .E Paulo disse: E eu [a tenho] desde que nasci.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió el tribuno: Yo con grande suma alcancé esta ciudadanía. Entonces Pablo dijo: Pero yo lo soy de nacimiento.

verses.KJV: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
verses.WEB: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
verses.ASV: They then that were about to examine him straightway departed from him: and the chief captain also was afraid when he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então logo se afastaram dele aqueles que estavam para interrogá-lo; e até o comandante teve temor, ao entender que [Paulo] era romano, e que tinha o atado.
verses.RVR09: Así que, luego se apartaron de él los que le habían de atormentar: y aun el tribuno también tuvo temor, entendido que era Romano, por haberle atado.

verses.KJV: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
verses.WEB: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
verses.ASV: But on the morrow, desiring to know the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him, and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no[dia] seguinte, querendo saber corretamente a causa de por que ele era acusado pelos judeus, ele o soltou das correntes, e mandou vir aos chefes dos sacerdotes e todo o supremo conselho deles; e tendo trazido a Paulo, apresentou [-o] diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y al día siguiente, queriendo saber de cierto la causa por qué era acusado de los Judíos, le soltó de las prisiones, y mandó venir á los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y á todo su concilio: y sacando á Pablo, le presentó delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
verses.WEB: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
verses.ASV: And Paul, looking stedfastly on the council, said, Brethren, I have lived before God in all good conscience until this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, olhando fixamente para o supremo conselho, disse: Homens irmãos, com toda boa consciência eu tenho andado diante de Deus até o dia de hoje.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Pablo, poniendo los ojos en el concilio, dice: Varones hermanos, yo con toda buena conciencia he conversado delante de Dios hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
verses.WEB: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
verses.ASV: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o sumo sacerdote Ananias mandou aos que estavam perto dele, que o espancassem na boca.
verses.RVR09: El príncipe de los sacerdotes, Ananías, mandó entonces á los que estaban delante de él, que le hiriesen en la boca.

verses.KJV: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
verses.WEB: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
verses.ASV: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: and sittest thou to judge me according to the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Paulo lhe disse: Deus vai te espancar, parede caiada! Estás tu [aqui] sentado para me julgar conforme a Lei, e contra a Lei mandas me espancarem?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo le dijo: Herirte ha Dios, pared blanqueada: ¿y estás tú sentado para juzgarme conforme á la ley, y contra la ley me mandas herir?

verses.KJV: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
verses.WEB: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
verses.ASV: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God’s high priest?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que estavam ali disseram: Tu insultas ao sumo sacerdote de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y los que estaban presentes dijeron: ¿Al sumo sacerdote de Dios maldices?

verses.KJV: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
verses.WEB: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
verses.ASV: And Paul said, I knew not, brethren, that he was high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of a ruler of thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo disse: Eu não sabia, irmãos, que ele era o sumo sacerdote; porque está escrito: Não falarás mal do chefe do teu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y Pablo dijo: No sabía, hermanos, que era el sumo sacerdote; pues escrito está: Al príncipe de tu pueblo no maldecirás.

verses.KJV: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
verses.WEB: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”
verses.ASV: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Brethren, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees: touching the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, sabendo que uma parte era de saduceus, e outra de fariseus, ele clamou no supremo conselho: Homens irmãos, eu sou fariseu, filho de fariseu; pela esperança e ressurreição dos mortos eu estou sendo julgado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo, sabiendo que la una parte era de Saduceos, y la otra de Fariseos, clamó en el concilio: Varones hermanos, yo soy Fariseo, hijo de Fariseo: de la esperanza y de la resurrección de los muertos soy yo juzgado.

verses.KJV: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
verses.WEB: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
verses.ASV: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and Sadducees; and the assembly was divided.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, tendo dito isto, houve uma confusão entre os fariseus e saduceus; e a multidão se dividiu;
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo dicho esto, fué hecha disensión entre los Fariseos y los Saduceos; y la multitud fué dividida.

verses.KJV: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.WEB: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
verses.ASV: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os saduceus dizem que não há ressurreição, nem anjo ou espírito; mas os fariseus declaram ambas.
verses.RVR09: Porque los Saduceos dicen que no hay resurrección, ni ángel, ni espíritu; mas los Fariseos confiesan ambas cosas.

verses.KJV: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
verses.WEB: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
verses.ASV: And there arose a great clamor: and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: and what if a spirit hath spoken to him, or an angel?
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve uma grande gritaria; e levantando-se os escribas da parte dos fariseus, disputavam, dizendo: Nenhum mal achamos neste homem; e se algum espírito ou anjo falou com ele, não briguemos contra Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse un gran clamor: y levantándose los escribas de la parte de los Fariseos, contendían diciendo: Ningún mal hallamos en este hombre; que si espíritu le ha hablado, ó ángel, no resistamos á Dios.

verses.KJV: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
verses.WEB: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.
verses.ASV: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them, and bring him into the castle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo grande confusão, o comandante, temendo que Paulo não fosse despedaçado por eles, mandou descer a tropa, e tirá-lo do meio deles, e levá-lo à área fortificada.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo grande disensión, el tribuno, teniendo temor de que Pablo fuese despedazado de ellos, mandó venir soldados, y arrebatarle de en medio de ellos, y llevarle á la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.WEB: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
verses.ASV: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer: for as thou hast testified concerning me at Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [n] a noite seguinte o Senhor, aparecendo-lhe, disse: Tem bom ânimo, Paulo! Porque assim como deste testemunho de mim em Jerusalém, assim é necessário que tu dês testemunho também em Roma.
verses.RVR09: Y la noche siguiente, presentándosele el Señor, le dijo: Confía, Pablo; que como has testificado de mí en Jerusalem, así es menester testifiques también en Roma.

verses.KJV: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.WEB: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
verses.ASV: And when it was day, the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo vindo o dia, alguns dos judeus fizeram uma conspiração, e prestaram juramento sob pena de maldição, dizendo que não comeriam nem beberiam enquanto não matassem a Paulo.
verses.RVR09: Y venido el día, algunos de los Judíos se juntaron, é hicieron voto bajo de maldición, diciendo que ni comerían ni beberían hasta que hubiesen muerto á Pablo.

verses.KJV: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
verses.WEB: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
verses.ASV: And they were more than forty that made this conspiracy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eram mais de quarenta os que fizeram este juramento.
verses.RVR09: Y eran más de cuarenta los que habían hecho esta conjuración;

verses.KJV: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
verses.WEB: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
verses.ASV: And they came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais foram até os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos, [e] disseram: Fizemos juramento sob pena de maldição, de que nada experimentaremos enquanto não matarmos a Paulo.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales se fueron á los príncipes de los sacerdotes y á los ancianos, y dijeron: Nosotros hemos hecho voto debajo de maldición, que no hemos de gustar nada hasta que hayamos muerto á Pablo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore do ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you, as though ye would judge of his case more exactly: and we, before he comes near, are ready to slay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, vós, com o supremo conselho, informai ao comandante que amanhã ele o traga perante vós, como se fosse para que investigueis mais detalhadamente; e antes que ele chegue, estaremos prontos para o matar.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, vosotros, con el concilio, requerid al tribuno que le saque mañana á vosotros como que queréis entender de él alguna cosa más cierta; y nosotros, antes que él llegue, estaremos aparejados para matarle.

verses.KJV: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
verses.WEB: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
verses.ASV: But Paul’s sister’s son heard of their lying in wait, and he came and entered into the castle and told Paul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho da irmã de Paulo, tendo ouvido esta cilada, veio e entrou na área fortificada, e avisou a Paulo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces un hijo de la hermana de Pablo, oyendo las asechanzas, fué, y entró en la fortaleza, y dió aviso á Pablo.

verses.KJV: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
verses.WEB: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
verses.ASV: And Paul called unto him one of the centurions, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain; for he hath something to tell him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo, tendo chamado a si um dos centuriões, disse: Leva este rapaz ao comandante, porque ele tem algo para lhe avisar.
verses.RVR09: Y Pablo, llamando á uno de los centuriones, dice: Lleva á este mancebo al tribuno, porque tiene cierto aviso que darle.

verses.KJV: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
verses.WEB: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
verses.ASV: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and saith, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and asked me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele o tomou, levou ao comandante, e disse: O prisioneiro Paulo, tendo me chamado, rogou [-me] que eu te trouxesse este rapaz, que tem algo a te dizer.
verses.RVR09: El entonces tomándole, le llevó al tribuno, y dijo: El preso Pablo, llamándome, me rogó que trajese á ti este mancebo, que tiene algo que hablarte.

verses.KJV: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
verses.WEB: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
verses.ASV: And the chief captain took him by the hand, and going aside asked him privately, What is it that thou hast to tell me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o comandante, tomando-o pela mão, e indo para um lugar reservado, perguntou [-lhe] : O que tens para me avisar?
verses.RVR09: Y el tribuno, tomándole de la mano y retirándose aparte, le preguntó: ¿Qué es lo que tienes que decirme?

verses.KJV: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
verses.WEB: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
verses.ASV: And he said, The Jews have agreed to ask thee to bring down Paul to-morrow unto the council, as though thou wouldest inquire somewhat more exactly concerning him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Os judeus combinaram de te pedirem que amanhã tu leves a Paulo ao supremo conselho, como se fosse para que lhe perguntem mais detalhadamente;
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Los Judíos han concertado rogarte que mañana saques á Pablo al concilio, como que han de inquirir de él alguna cosa más cierta.

verses.KJV: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
verses.ASV: Do not thou therefore yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, who have bound themselves under a curse, neither to eat nor to drink till they have slain him: and now are they ready, looking for the promise from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, não acredites neles; porque mais de quarenta homens deles estão lhe preparando cilada, os quais sob pena de maldição fizeram juramento para não comerem nem beberem enquanto não o tiverem matado; e eles já estão preparados, esperando de ti a promessa.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú no los creas; porque más de cuarenta hombres de ellos le acechan, los cuales han hecho voto debajo de maldición, de no comer ni beber hasta que le hayan muerto; y ahora están apercibidos esperando tu promesa.

verses.KJV: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
verses.WEB: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
verses.ASV: So the chief captain let the young man go, charging him, Tell no man that thou hast signified these things to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o comandante despediu ao rapaz, mandando [-lhe] : A ninguém digas que tu me revelaste estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el tribuno despidió al mancebo, mandándole que á nadie dijese que le había dado aviso de esto.

verses.KJV: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
verses.WEB: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
verses.ASV: And he called unto him two of the centurions, and said, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go as far as Cæsarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, chamando a si certos dois dos centuriões, disse: Aprontai duzentos soldados para irem até Cesareia; e setenta cavaleiros, e duzentos arqueiros, a partir das terceira hora da noite.
verses.RVR09: Y llamados dos centuriones, mandó que apercibiesen para la hora tercia de la noche doscientos soldados, que fuesen hasta Cesarea, y setenta de á caballo, y doscientos lanceros;

verses.KJV: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
verses.WEB: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
verses.ASV: and [he bade them] provide beasts, that they might set Paul thereon, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E preparem animais para cavalgarem, para que pondo neles a Paulo, levem [-no] a salvo ao governador Félix.
verses.RVR09: Y que aparejasen cabalgaduras en que poniendo á Pablo, le llevasen en salvo á Félix el Presidente.

verses.KJV: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
verses.WEB: He wrote a letter like this:
verses.ASV: And he wrote a letter after this form:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele [lhe] escreveu uma carta, que continha este aspecto:
verses.RVR09: Y escribió una carta en estos términos:

verses.KJV: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
verses.WEB: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
verses.ASV: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix, greeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cláudio Lísias, a Félix, excelentíssimo governador, saudações.
verses.RVR09: Claudio Lisias al excelentísimo gobernador Félix: Salud.

verses.KJV: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
verses.WEB: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
verses.ASV: This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be slain of them, when I came upon them with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este homem foi preso pelos judeus, e estando já a ponte de o matarem, eu vim com a tropa e [o] tomei, ao ser informado que ele era romano.
verses.RVR09: A este hombre, aprehendido de los Judíos, y que iban ellos á matar, libré yo acudiendo con la tropa, habiendo entendido que era Romano.

verses.KJV: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
verses.WEB: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
verses.ASV: And desiring to know the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him down unto their council:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, querendo saber a causa por que o acusavam, levei-o ao supremo conselho deles.
verses.RVR09: Y queriendo saber la causa por qué le acusaban, le llevé al concilio de ellos:

verses.KJV: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.WEB: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.
verses.ASV: whom I found to be accused about questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual eu achei que acusavam de algumas questões da Lei deles; mas que nenhum crime digno de morte ou de prisão havia contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Y hallé que le acusaban de cuestiones de la ley de ellos, y que ningún crimen tenía digno de muerte ó de prisión.
