verses.RVR09: Y no pareciendo sol ni estrellas por muchos días, y viniendo una tempestad no pequeña, ya era perdida toda la esperanza de nuestra salud.

verses.KJV: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
verses.WEB: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.
verses.ASV: And when they had been long without food, then Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have set sail from Crete, and have gotten this injury and loss.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo muito [tempo] que não havia o que comer, então Paulo, ficando de pé no meio deles, disse: Homens, vós devíeis ter dado atenção a mim, e não terdes partido de Creta, e [assim] evitar esta situação ruim e prejuízo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Pablo, habiendo ya mucho que no comíamos, puesto en pie en medio de ellos, dijo: Fuera de cierto conveniente, oh varones, haberme oído, y no partir de Creta, y evitar este inconveniente y daño.

verses.KJV: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
verses.WEB: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
verses.ASV: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer; for there shall be no loss of life among you, but [only] of the ship.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora eu vos exorto a terdes bom ânimo; porque haverá nenhuma perda de vida de vós, além [somente da perda] do navio.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora os amonesto que tengáis buen ánimo; porque ninguna pérdida habrá de persona de vosotros, sino solamente de la nave.

verses.KJV: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
verses.WEB: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
verses.ASV: For there stood by me this night an angel of the God whose I am, whom also I serve,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque esta mesma noite esteve comigo um anjo de Deus, a quem eu pertenço e a quem eu sirvo;
verses.RVR09: Porque esta noche ha estado conmigo el ángel del Dios del cual yo soy, y al cual sirvo,

verses.KJV: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
verses.WEB: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
verses.ASV: saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must stand before Cæsar: and lo, God hath granted thee all them that sail with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Não temas, Paulo; é necessário que tu sejas apresentado a César; e eis que Deus tem te dado [a vida] a todos quantos navegam contigo.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Pablo, no temas; es menester que seas presentado delante de César; y he aquí, Dios te ha dado todos los que navegan contigo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verses.WEB: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even so as it hath been spoken unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, homens, tende bom ânimo; porque eu creio em Deus que assim será, conforme o que me foi dito.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, oh varones, tened buen ánimo; porque yo confío en Dios que será así como me ha dicho;

verses.KJV: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
verses.WEB: But we must run aground on a certain island.”
verses.ASV: But we must be cast upon a certain island.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas é necessário que sejamos lançados a uma ilha.
verses.RVR09: Si bien es menester que demos en una isla.

verses.KJV: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
verses.WEB: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.
verses.ASV: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven to and fro in the [sea of] Adria, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some country:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando veio a décima quarta noite, sendo lançados de um lado para o outro no [mar] Adriático, por volta da meia noite os marinheiros suspeitaram de que estavam se aproximando de alguma terra [firme] .
verses.RVR09: Y venida la décimacuarta noche, y siendo llevados por el mar Adriático, los marineros á la media noche sospecharon que estaban cerca de alguna tierra;

verses.KJV: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
verses.WEB: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.
verses.ASV: and they sounded, and found twenty fathoms; and after a little space, they sounded again, and found fifteen fathoms.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo lançado o prumo, acharam vinte braças; e passando um pouco mais adiante, voltando a lançar o prumo, acharam quinze braças.
verses.RVR09: Y echando la sonda, hallaron veinte brazas; y pasando un poco más adelante, volviendo á echar la sonda, hallaron quince brazas.

verses.KJV: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
verses.WEB: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
verses.ASV: And fearing lest haply we should be cast ashore on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E temendo de irem de encontro a lugares rochosos, lançaram da popa quatro âncoras, desejando que o dia viesse [logo] .
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo temor de dar en lugares escabrosos, echando cuatro anclas de la popa, deseaban que se hiciese de día.

verses.KJV: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
verses.WEB: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,
verses.ASV: And as the sailors were seeking to flee out of the ship, and had lowered the boat into the sea, under color as though they would lay out anchors from the foreship,
verses.ALMEIDA: E [quando] os marinheiros estavam procurando fugir do navio, e baixando o barquinho de reserva ao mar, como que queriam largar as âncoras da proa,
verses.RVR09: Entonces procurando los marineros huir de la nave, echado que hubieron el esquife á la mar, aparentando como que querían largar las anclas de proa,

verses.KJV: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
verses.WEB: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”
verses.ASV: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo disse ao centurião e aos soldados: Se estes não ficarem no navio, vós não podeis vos salvar.
verses.RVR09: Pablo dijo al centurión y á los soldados: Si éstos no quedan en la nave, vosotros no podéis salvaros.

verses.KJV: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
verses.WEB: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.
verses.ASV: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os soldados cortaram os cabos do barquinho de reserva, e o deixaram cair.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los soldados cortaron los cabos del esquife, y dejáronlo perder.

verses.KJV: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
verses.WEB: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
verses.ASV: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take some food, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até enquanto o dia estava vindo, Paulo exortava a todos que comessem alguma coisa, dizendo: Hoje já é o décimo quarto dia, em que estais esperando, continuando sem comer, nada tendo experimentado.
verses.RVR09: Y como comenzó á ser de día, Pablo exhortaba á todos que comiesen, diciendo: Este es el décimocuarto día que esperáis y permanecéis ayunos, no comiendo nada.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
verses.WEB: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore I beseech you to take some food: for this is for your safety: for there shall not a hair perish from the head of any of you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos exorto para que comais alguma coisa, pois é bom para vossa saúde; porque nenhum cabelo cairá de vossa cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, os ruego que comáis por vuestra salud: que ni aun un cabello de la cabeza de ninguno de vosotros perecerá.

verses.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
verses.WEB: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.
verses.ASV: And when he had said this, and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; and he brake it, and began to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo dito isto, e tomando o pão, ele agradeceu a Deus na presença de todos; e partindo [-o] , começou a comer.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo dicho esto, tomando el pan, hizo gracias á Dios en presencia de todos, y partiendo, comenzó á comer.

verses.KJV: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
verses.WEB: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
verses.ASV: Then were they all of good cheer, and themselves also took food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos, tendo ficado mais encorajados, também pegaram [algo] para comer.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos teniendo ya mejor ánimo, comieron ellos también.

verses.KJV: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
verses.WEB: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.
verses.ASV: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: E éramos todos no navio duzentas e setenta e seis almas.
verses.RVR09: Y éramos todas las personas en la nave doscientas setenta y seis.

verses.KJV: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
verses.WEB: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
verses.ASV: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando saciados de comer, eles tiraram peso do navio, lançando o trigo ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y satisfechos de comida, aliviaban la nave, echando el grano á la mar.

verses.KJV: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
verses.WEB: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.
verses.ASV: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they perceived a certain bay with a beach, and they took counsel whether they could drive the ship upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo vindo o dia, não reconheciam a terra; mas enxergaram uma enseada que tinha praia, na qual planejaram, se pudessem, levar o navio.
verses.RVR09: Y como se hizo de día, no conocían la tierra: mas veían un golfo que tenía orilla, al cual acordaron echar, si pudiesen, la nave.

verses.KJV: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
verses.WEB: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
verses.ASV: And casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time loosing the bands of the rudders; and hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo levantado as âncoras, deixaram [-no] ir ao mar, soltando também as amarras dos lemes, e levantando a vela maior ao vento, foram de levando [-o] à praia.
verses.RVR09: Cortando pues las anclas, las dejaron en la mar, largando también las ataduras de los gobernalles; y alzada la vela mayor al viento, íbanse á la orilla.

verses.KJV: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
verses.WEB: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
verses.ASV: But lighting upon a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground; and the foreship struck and remained unmoveable, but the stern began to break up by the violence [of the waves].
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tendo caído em um lugar onde dois mares se encontram, encalharam ali o navio; e fixa a proa, ficou imóvel, mas a popa estava se destruindo com a força das ondas.
verses.RVR09: Mas dando en un lugar de dos aguas, hicieron encallar la nave; y la proa, hincada, estaba sin moverse, y la popa se abría con la fuerza de la mar.

verses.KJV: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
verses.WEB: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
verses.ASV: And the soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any [of them] should swim out, and escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o conselho dos soldados foi de que matassem aos presos, para que nenhum [deles] fugisse a nado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el acuerdo de los soldados era que matasen los presos, porque ninguno se fugase nadando.

verses.KJV: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
verses.WEB: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;
verses.ASV: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stayed them from their purpose; and commanded that they who could swim should cast themselves overboard, and get first to the land;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o centurião, querendo salvar a Paulo, impediu a intenção deles; e mandou que aqueles que pudessem nadar fossem os primeiros a se lançassem [ao mar] e chegassem à terra [firme] .
verses.RVR09: Mas el centurión, queriendo salvar á Pablo, estorbó este acuerdo, y mandó que los que pudiesen nadar, se echasen los primeros, y saliesen á tierra;

verses.KJV: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
verses.WEB: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
verses.ASV: and the rest, some on planks, and some on [other] things from the ship. And so it came to pass, that they all escaped safe to the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [depois] os demais, uns em tábuas, e outros em pedaços do navio. E assim aconteceu, que todos se salvaram em terra.
verses.RVR09: Y los demás, parte en tablas, parte en cosas de la nave. Y así aconteció que todos se salvaron saliendo á tierra.

verses.KJV: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
verses.WEB: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
verses.ASV: And when we were escaped, then we knew that the island was called Melita.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo sobrevivido, então souberam que a ilha se chamava Malta.
verses.RVR09: Y CUANDO escapamos, entonces supimos que la isla se llamaba Melita.

verses.KJV: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verses.WEB: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
verses.ASV: And the barbarians showed us no common kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us all, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os nativos demonstraram para conosco uma benevolência incomum; porque, tendo acendido uma fogueira, recolheram a nós todos, por causa da chuva que estava caindo, e por causa do frio.
verses.RVR09: Y los bárbaros nos mostraron no poca humanidad; porque, encendido un fuego, nos recibieron á todos, á causa de la lluvia que venía, y del frío.

verses.KJV: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
verses.WEB: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
verses.ASV: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out by reason of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo Paulo recolhido uma quantidade de gravetos, e pondo-os no fogo, saiu uma víbora do calor, e fixou [os dentes] na mão dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces habiendo Pablo recogido algunos sarmientos, y puéstolos en el fuego, una víbora, huyendo del calor, le acometió á la mano.

verses.KJV: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
verses.WEB: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
verses.ASV: And when the barbarians saw the [venomous] creature hanging from his hand, they said one to another, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped from the sea, yet Justice hath not suffered to live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os nativos vieram o animal pendurado na mão dele, disseram uns aos outros: Certamente este homem é assassino, ao qual, tendo sobrevivido do mar, a justiça não o deixa viver.
verses.RVR09: Y como los bárbaros vieron la víbora colgando de su mano, decían los unos á los otros: Ciertamente este hombre es homicida, á quien, escapado de la mar, la justicia no deja vivir.

verses.KJV: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
verses.WEB: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
verses.ASV: Howbeit he shook off the creature into the fire, and took no harm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, ele, tendo sacudido o animal ao fogo, sofreu nenhum mal.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, sacudiendo la víbora en el fuego, ningún mal padeció.

verses.KJV: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
verses.WEB: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
verses.ASV: But they expected that he would have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but when they were long in expectation and beheld nothing amiss come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles esperavam que ele fosse inchar, ou cair morto de repente. Mas tendo esperado muito, e vendo que nenhum incômodo tinha lhe sobrevindo, mudaram [de opinião] , e diziam que ele era um deus.
verses.RVR09: Empero ellos estaban esperando cuándo se había de hinchar, ó caer muerto de repente; mas habiendo esperado mucho, y viendo que ningún mal le venía, mudados, decían que era un dios.

verses.KJV: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
verses.WEB: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
verses.ASV: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius; who received us, and entertained us three days courteously.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perto daquele mesmo lugar o homem mais importante da ilha, por nome Públio, tinha algumas propriedades; o qual nos recebeu e nos hospedou por três dias gentilmente.
verses.RVR09: En aquellos lugares había heredades del principal de la isla, llamado Publio, el cual nos recibió y hospedó tres días humanamente.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
verses.WEB: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that the father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery: unto whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laying his hands on him healed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que o pai de Públio estava de cama, doente de febres e disenteria; ao qual Paulo entrou, e tendo orado, pôs as mãos sobre ele, e o curou.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que el padre de Publio estaba en cama, enfermo de fiebres y de disentería: al cual Pablo entró, y después de haber orado, le puso las manos encima, y le sanó:

verses.KJV: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
verses.WEB: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
verses.ASV: And when this was done, the rest also that had diseases in the island came, and were cured:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo então isto acontecido, também vieram a ele outros que tinham enfermidades, e foram curados;
verses.RVR09: Y esto hecho, también los otros que en la isla tenían enfermedades, llegaban, y eran sanados:

verses.KJV: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
verses.WEB: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
verses.ASV: who also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board such things as we needed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais nos honraram com muitas honras; e estando [nós] para navegar, [nos] entregaram as coisas necessárias.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales también nos honraron con muchos obsequios; y cuando partimos, nos cargaron de las cosas necesarias.

verses.KJV: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
verses.WEB: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”
verses.ASV: And after three months we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was The Twin Brothers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E três meses depois, nós partimos em um navio de Alexandria, que tinha passado o inverno na ilha; o qual tinha como símbolo os gêmeos Castor e Pólux.
verses.RVR09: Así que, pasados tres meses, navegamos en una nave Alejandrina que había invernado en la isla, la cual tenía por enseña á Cástor y Pólux.

verses.KJV: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
verses.WEB: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
verses.ASV: And touching at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando a Siracusa, ficamos [ali] três dias.
verses.RVR09: Y llegados á Siracusa, estuvimos allí tres días.

verses.KJV: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
verses.WEB: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,
verses.ASV: And from thence we made a circuit, and arrived at Rhegium: and after one day a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli;
verses.ALMEIDA: De onde, tendo indo ao redor da costa, chegamos a Régio; e um dia depois, ventando ao sul, viemos o segundo dia a Putéoli.
verses.RVR09: De allí, costeando alrededor, vinimos á Regio; y otro día después, soplando el austro, vinimos al segundo día á Puteolos:

verses.KJV: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
verses.WEB: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
verses.ASV: where we found brethren, and were entreated to tarry with them seven days: and so we came to Rome.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde, tendo achado [alguns] irmãos, eles nos rogaram que ficássemos com eles por sete dias; e assim viemos a Roma.
verses.RVR09: Donde habiendo hallado hermanos, nos rogaron que quedásemos con ellos siete días; y luego vinimos á Roma;

verses.KJV: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
verses.WEB: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
verses.ASV: And from thence the brethren, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns; whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os irmãos, ao ouvirem [notícias] sobre nós, desde lá nos saíram ao encontro até a praça de Ápio, e as três tavernas; e Paulo, tendo os visto, agradeceu a Deus, e tomou coragem.
verses.RVR09: De donde, oyendo de nosotros los hermanos, nos salieron á recibir hasta la plaza de Appio, y Las Tres Tabernas: á los cuales como Pablo vió, dió gracias á Dios, y tomó aliento.

verses.KJV: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
verses.WEB: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
verses.ASV: And when we entered into Rome, Paul was suffered to abide by himself with the soldier that guarded him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegamos a Roma, o centurião entregou os prisioneiros ao chefe da guarda, mas a Paulo foi permitido morar por si mesmo à parte, junto com o soldado que o guardava.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegamos á Roma, el centurión entregó los presos al prefecto de los ejércitos, mas á Pablo fué permitido estar por sí, con un soldado que le guardase.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
verses.WEB: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that after three days he called together those that were the chief of the Jews: and when they were come together, he said unto them, I, brethren, though I had done nothing against the people, or the customs of our fathers, yet was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, três dias depois, Paulo chamou juntos os chefes dos judeus; e ao se reunirem, disse-lhes: Homens irmãos, tendo eu nada feito contra o povo, ou contra os costumes dos pais, [mesmo assim] eu vim preso desde Jerusalém, entregue em mãos dos romanos.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que tres días después, Pablo convocó á los principales de los Judíos; á los cuales, luego que estuvieron juntos, les dijo: Yo, varones hermanos, no habiendo hecho nada contra el pueblo, ni contra los ritos de la patria, he sido entregado preso desde Jerusalem en manos de los Romanos;

verses.KJV: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
verses.WEB: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
verses.ASV: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me at liberty, because there was no cause of death in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais, tendo me investigado, queriam [me] soltar, por não haver em mim nenhum crime de morte.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales, habiéndome examinado, me querían soltar, por no haber en mí ninguna causa de muerte.

verses.KJV: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
verses.WEB: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
verses.ASV: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cæsar; not that I had aught whereof to accuse my nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os judeus, dizendo em contrário, eu fui forçado a apelar a César; [mas] não como que eu tenha que acusar a minha nação.
verses.RVR09: Mas contradiciendo los Judíos, fuí forzado á apelar á César; no que tenga de qué acusar á mi nación.

verses.KJV: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
verses.WEB: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
verses.ASV: For this cause therefore did I entreat you to see and to speak with [me]: for because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então por esta causa eu vos chamei até mim, para [vos] ver e falar; porque pela esperança de Israel eu estou agora preso nesta corrente.
verses.RVR09: Así que, por esta causa, os he llamado para veros y hablaros; porque por la esperanza de Israel estoy rodeado de esta cadena.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, We neither received letters from Judæa concerning thee, nor did any of the brethren come hither and report or speak any harm of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles lhe disseram: Nós nem recebemos cartas da Judeia relacionadas a ti, nem algum dos irmãos, tendo vindo aqui, tem nos informado ou falado de ti algum mal.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos le dijeron: Nosotros ni hemos recibido cartas tocante á ti de Judea, ni ha venido alguno de los hermanos que haya denunciado ó hablado algún mal de ti.

verses.KJV: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
verses.WEB: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”
verses.ASV: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós queríamos ouvir de ti o que tu pensas; porque, quanto a esta seita, conhecemos que em todo lugar [há quem] fale contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Mas querríamos oir de ti lo que sientes; porque de esta secta notorio nos es que en todos lugares es contradicha.

verses.KJV: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
verses.WEB: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
verses.ASV: And when they had appointed him a day, they came to him into his lodging in great number; to whom he expounded [the matter], testifying the kingdom of God, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning till evening.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo eles lhe determinado um dia, muitos vieram até onde ele estava morando; aos quais ele declarava e dava testemunho do Reino de Deus; e procurava persuadi-los quanto a Jesus, tanto pela Lei de Moisés, como [pelos] profetas, desde a manhã até a tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndole señalado un día, vinieron á él muchos á la posada, á los cuales declaraba y testificaba el reino de Dios, persuadiéndoles lo concerniente á Jesús, por la ley de Moisés y por los profetas, desde la mañana hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
verses.WEB: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
verses.ASV: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns criam nas coisas que ele dizia; mas outros não criam.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos asentían á lo que se decía, mas algunos no creían.

verses.KJV: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
verses.WEB: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
verses.ASV: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Spirit through Isaiah the prophet unto your fathers,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando discordantes entre si, despediram-se, tendo Paulo disto [esta] palavra: O Espírito Santo corretamente falou a nossos pais por meio de Isaías o profeta,
verses.RVR09: Y como fueron entre sí discordes, se fueron, diciendo Pablo esta palabra: Bien ha hablado el Espíritu Santo por el profeta Isaías á nuestros padres,

verses.KJV: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
verses.WEB: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.
verses.ASV: saying, Go thou unto this people, and say, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall in no wise understand; And seeing ye shall see, and shall in no wise perceive:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Vai a este povo, e dize: De fato ouvireis, mas de maneira nenhuma entendereis; e de fato vereis, mas de maneira nenhuma enxergareis.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Ve á este pueblo, y diles: De oído oiréis, y no entenderéis; y viendo veréis, y no percibiréis:

verses.KJV: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.WEB: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
verses.ASV: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, And their ears are dull of hearing, And their eyes they have closed; Lest haply they should perceive with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And should turn again, And I should heal them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o coração deste povo está insensível, seus ouvidos ouvem com dificuldade, e seus olhos estão fechados; para que em maneira nenhuma vejam com os olhos, nem ouçam com os ouvidos, nem entendam com o coração, e se convertam, e eu os cure.
verses.RVR09: Porque el corazón de este pueblo se ha engrosado, y de los oídos oyeron pesadamente, y sus ojos taparon; porque no vean con los ojos, y oigan con los oídos, y entiendan de corazón, y se conviertan, y yo los sane.

verses.KJV: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
verses.WEB: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
verses.ASV: Be it known therefore unto you, that this salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles: they will also hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto seja conhecido por vós que a salvação de Deus foi enviada aos gentios; e eles [a] ouvirão.
verses.RVR09: Séaos pues notorio que á los Gentiles es enviada esta salud de Dios: y ellos oirán.

verses.KJV: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
verses.WEB: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
verses.ASV: And he abode two whole years in his own hired dwelling, and received all that went in unto him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo ele dito isto, os judeus foram embora, havendo entre eles grande discussão.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo dicho esto, los Judíos salieron, teniendo entre sí gran contienda.

verses.KJV: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
verses.WEB: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
verses.ASV: preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, none forbidding him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Paulo ficou dois anos inteiros em sua própria casa alugada; e recebia a todos quantos vinham a ele;
verses.RVR09: Pablo empero, quedó dos años enteros en su casa de alquiler, y recibía á todos los que á él venían,

verses.KJV: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
verses.WEB: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pregando o Reino de Deus, e ensinando com ousadia a doutrina do Senhor Jesus Cristo, sem impedimento algum.
verses.RVR09: Predicando el reino de Dios y enseñando lo que es del Señor Jesucristo con toda libertad, sin impedimento.

verses.KJV: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.WEB: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
verses.ASV: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called [to be] an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, servo de Jesus Cristo, chamado [para ser] apóstolo, separado para o evangelho de Deus,
verses.RVR09: PABLO, siervo de Jesucristo, llamado á ser apóstol, apartado para el evangelio de Dios,

verses.KJV: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
verses.WEB: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
verses.ASV: which he promised afore through his prophets in the holy scriptures,
verses.ALMEIDA: que antes havia prometido por meio dos seus profetas nas santas Escrituras,
verses.RVR09: Que él había antes prometido por sus profetas en las santas Escrituras,

verses.KJV: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
verses.WEB: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
verses.ASV: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,
verses.ALMEIDA: acerca do seu Filho (que, quanto à carne, nasceu da descendência de Davi,
verses.RVR09: Acerca de su Hijo, (que fué hecho de la simiente de David según la carne;

verses.KJV: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
verses.WEB: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.ASV: who was declared [to be] the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead; [even] Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.ALMEIDA: e declarado Filho de Deus em poder, segundo o Espírito de santidade, pela ressurreição dos mortos): Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: El cual fué declarado Hijo de Dios con potencia, según el espíritu de santidad, por la resurrección de los muertos), de Jesucristo Señor nuestro,

verses.KJV: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
verses.WEB: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
verses.ASV: through whom we received grace and apostleship, unto obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por ele recebemos graça e apostolado, para a obediência da fé entre todas as nações, por causa do seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Por el cual recibimos la gracia y el apostolado, para la obediencia de la fe en todas las naciones en su nombre,

verses.KJV: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
verses.ASV: among whom are ye also, called [to be] Jesus Christ’s:
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre elas sois também vós, chamados [para serdes] de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Entre las cuales sois también vosotros, llamados de Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: to all that are in Rome, beloved of God, called [to be] saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: A todos que estais em Roma, amados de Deus, e chamados de santos: convosco haja graça e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: A todos los que estáis en Roma, amados de Dios, llamados santos: Gracia y paz tengáis de Dios nuestro Padre, y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.WEB: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
verses.ASV: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em primeiro lugar, agradeço ao meu Deus por meio de Jesus Cristo, por todos vós, porque a vossa fé é anunciada no mundo todo.
verses.RVR09: Primeramente, doy gracias á mi Dios por Jesucristo acerca de todos vosotros, de que vuestra fe es predicada en todo el mundo.

verses.KJV: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
verses.WEB: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
verses.ASV: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the gospel of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you, always in my prayers
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus, a quem sirvo em meu espírito no evangelho do seu Filho, é minha testemunha de como sem cessar faço menção de vós,
verses.RVR09: Porque testigo me es Dios, al cual sirvo en mi espíritu en el evangelio de su Hijo, que sin cesar me acuerdo de vosotros siempre en mis oraciones,

verses.KJV: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.WEB: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
verses.ASV: making request, if by any means now at length I may be prospered by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: rogando sempre em minhas orações, que agora, de alguma maneira, finalmente, tenha eu a oportunidade de, pela vontade de Deus, vir vos visitar.
verses.RVR09: Rogando, si al fin algún tiempo haya de tener, por la voluntad de Dios, próspero viaje para ir á vosotros.

verses.KJV: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.WEB: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
verses.ASV: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu desejo ver-vos, para compartilhar convosco algum dom espiritual, para que sejais fortalecidos;
verses.RVR09: Porque os deseo ver, para repartir con vosotros algún don espiritual, para confirmaros;

verses.KJV: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.WEB: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
verses.ASV: that is, that I with you may be comforted in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: isto é, para eu ser consolado juntamente convosco pela fé mútua, tanto a vossa, como a minha.
verses.RVR09: Es á saber, para ser juntamente consolado con vosotros por la común fe vuestra y juntamente mía.

verses.KJV: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
verses.WEB: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: And I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you (and was hindered hitherto), that I might have some fruit in you also, even as in the rest of the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, irmãos, não quero que ignoreis que muitas vezes pretendi vir à vossa presença (mas fui impedido até agora), a fim de que eu também tivesse algum fruto entre vós, como também entre os demais gentios.
verses.RVR09: Mas no quiero, hermanos, que ignoréis que muchas veces me he propuesto ir á vosotros (empero hasta ahora he sido estorbado), para tener también entre vosotros algún fruto, como entre los demás Gentiles.

verses.KJV: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
verses.WEB: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
verses.ASV: I am debtor both to Greeks and to Barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou devedor, tanto a gregos como a bárbaros, tanto a sábios como a não sábios.
verses.RVR09: A Griegos y á bárbaros, á sabios y á no sabios soy deudor.

verses.KJV: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
verses.WEB: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
verses.ASV: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you also that are in Rome.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quanto a mim, pronto estou para anunciar o evangelho também a vós, que estais em Roma.
verses.RVR09: Así que, cuanto á mí, presto estoy á anunciar el evangelio también á vosotros que estáis en Roma.

verses.KJV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.WEB: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
verses.ASV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não me envergonho do Evangelho de Cristo, pois é o poder de Deus para a salvação de todo aquele que crê, primeiramente do judeu, e também do grego.
verses.RVR09: Porque no me avergüenzo del evangelio: porque es potencia de Dios para salud á todo aquel que cree; al Judío primeramente y también al Griego.

verses.KJV: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.WEB: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
verses.ASV: For therein is revealed a righteousness of God from faith unto faith: as it is written, But the righteous shall live by faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois no Evangelho se revela a justiça de Deus de fé em fé; como está escrito: O justo viverá pela fé.
verses.RVR09: Porque en él la justicia de Dios se descubre de fe en fe; como está escrito: Mas el justo vivirá por la fe.

verses.KJV: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.WEB: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
verses.ASV: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hinder the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a ira de Deus se manifesta do céu contra toda irreverência e injustiça das pessoas que bloqueiam a verdade pela injustiça;
verses.RVR09: Porque manifiesta es la ira de Dios del cielo contra toda impiedad é injusticia de los hombres, que detienen la verdad con injusticia:

verses.KJV: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
verses.WEB: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
verses.ASV: because that which is known of God is manifest in them; for God manifested it unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois o que se pode conhecer de Deus é evidente a eles, porque Deus lhes manifestou.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo que de Dios se conoce, á ellos es manifiesto; porque Dios se lo manifestó.

verses.KJV: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.WEB: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
verses.ASV: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, [even] his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois as suas características invisíveis, inclusive o seu eterno poder e divindade, desde a criação do mundo são entendidas e claramente vistas por meio das coisas criadas, para que não tenham desculpa;
verses.RVR09: Porque las cosas invisibles de él, su eterna potencia y divinidad, se echan de ver desde la creación del mundo, siendo entendidas por las cosas que son hechas; de modo que son inexcusables:

verses.KJV: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.WEB: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
verses.ASV: because that, knowing God, they glorified him not as God, neither gave thanks; but became vain in their reasonings, and their senseless heart was darkened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, ainda que tenham conhecido Deus, não o glorificaram como Deus, nem foram gratos; em vez disso, perderam o bom senso em seus pensamentos, e seus tolos corações ficaram em trevas.
verses.RVR09: Porque habiendo conocido á Dios, no le glorificaron como á Dios, ni dieron gracias; antes se desvanecieron en sus discursos, y el necio corazón de ellos fué entenebrecido.

verses.KJV: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.WEB: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.ASV: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamando a si mesmos de sábios, tornaram-se tolos,
verses.RVR09: Diciéndose ser sabios, se hicieron fatuos,

verses.KJV: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
verses.WEB: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
verses.ASV: and changed the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.
verses.ALMEIDA: e trocaram a glória de Deus indestrutível por semelhança de imagem do ser humano destrutível, e de aves, de quadrúpedes, e de répteis.
verses.RVR09: Y trocaron la gloria del Dios incorruptible en semejanza de imagen de hombre corruptible, y de aves, y de animales de cuatro pies, y de serpientes.

verses.KJV: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
verses.WEB: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
verses.ASV: Wherefore God gave them up in the lusts of their hearts unto uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, Deus os entregou à imundície, nos desejos dos seus corações, para desonrarem os seus corpos entre si.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también Dios los entregó á inmundicia, en las concupiscencias de sus corazones, de suerte que contaminaron sus cuerpos entre sí mismos:

verses.KJV: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
verses.ASV: for that they exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshipped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trocaram a verdade de Deus pela mentira, e adoraram e serviram à criatura mais do que ao Criador, que é bendito eternamente, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Los cuales mudaron la verdad de Dios en mentira, honrando y sirviendo á las criaturas antes que al Criador, el cual es bendito por los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.WEB: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
verses.ASV: For this cause God gave them up unto vile passions: for their women changed the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, Deus os entregou a paixões infames. Pois até suas mulheres trocaram o hábito [sexual] natural pelo que era contra a natureza;
verses.RVR09: Por esto Dios los entregó á afectos vergonzosos; pues aun sus mujeres mudaron el natural uso en el uso que es contra naturaleza:

verses.KJV: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
verses.WEB: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
verses.ASV: and likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another, men with men working unseemliness, and receiving in themselves that recompense of their error which was due.
verses.ALMEIDA: e também, de semelhante maneira, os machos abandonaram o hábito [sexual] natural com a mulher, e acenderam sua sensualidade uns com os outros, homens com homens, praticando indecência, e recebendo em si mesmos a devida retribuição pelo seu erro.
verses.RVR09: Y del mismo modo también los hombres, dejando el uso natural de las mujeres, se encendieron en sus concupiscencias los unos con los otros, cometiendo cosas nefandas hombres con hombres, y recibiendo en sí mismos la recompensa que convino á su extravío.

verses.KJV: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
verses.WEB: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
verses.ASV: And even as they refused to have God in [their] knowledge, God gave them up unto a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
verses.ALMEIDA: E como recusaram reconhecer a Deus, [o mesmo] Deus os entregou a uma mente corrompida, para fazerem coisas impróprias.
verses.RVR09: Y como á ellos no les pareció tener á Dios en su noticia, Dios los entregó á una mente depravada, para hacer lo que no conviene,

verses.KJV: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.WEB: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
verses.ASV: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim, estão] cheios de toda injustiça, pecado sexual, malícia, ganância, maldade; estão repletos de inveja, homicídio, brigas, engano, malignidade;
verses.RVR09: Estando atestados de toda iniquidad, de fornicación, de malicia, de avaricia, de maldad; llenos de envidia, de homicidios, de contiendas, de engaños, de malignidades;

verses.KJV: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.WEB: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.ASV: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.ALMEIDA: são murmuradores, difamadores, e odeiam a Deus; são insolentes, soberbos, presunçosos, inventores de males, e desobedientes aos pais;
verses.RVR09: Murmuradores, detractores, aborrecedores de Dios, injuriosos, soberbios, altivos, inventores de males, desobedientes á los padres,

verses.KJV: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
verses.WEB: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
verses.ASV: without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unmerciful:
verses.ALMEIDA: não têm entendimento, quebram acordos, são insensíveis, e recusam-se a perdoar ou a mostrar misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Necios, desleales, sin afecto natural, implacables, sin misericordia:

verses.KJV: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
verses.WEB: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
verses.ASV: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that they that practise such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also consent with them that practise them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apesar de conhecerem o juízo de Deus (de que os que fazem tais coisas merecem a morte), não somente as fazem, como também aprovam os que as praticam.
verses.RVR09: Que, habiendo entendido el juicio de Dios que los que hacen tales cosas son dignos de muerte, no sólo las hacen, mas aun consienten á los que las hacen.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.WEB: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
verses.ASV: Wherefore thou art without excuse, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest dost practise the same things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, tu, que julgas, não tens desculpa; quem quer que sejas! Pois condenas a ti mesmo naquilo que julgas o outro, porque tu, que julgas, fazes as mesmas coisas.
verses.RVR09: POR lo cual eres inexcusable, oh hombre, cualquiera que juzgas: porque en lo que juzgas á otro, te condenas á ti mismo; porque lo mismo haces, tú que juzgas.

verses.KJV: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.WEB: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
verses.ASV: And we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against them that practise such things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabemos que o julgamento de Deus é segundo a verdade sobre os que fazem tais coisas.
verses.RVR09: Mas sabemos que el juicio de Dios es según verdad contra los que hacen tales cosas.

verses.KJV: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.WEB: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.ASV: And reckonest thou this, O man, who judgest them that practise such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, humano, que julgas os que praticam tais coisas, ao fazê-las, pensas que escaparás do julgamento de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y piensas esto, oh hombre, que juzgas á los que hacen tales cosas, y haces las mismas, que tú escaparás del juicio de Dios?

verses.KJV: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.WEB: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.ASV: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou desprezas tu as riquezas de sua bondade, tolerância, e paciência, ignorando que é a bondade de Deus que te conduz ao arrependimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿O menosprecias las riquezas de su benignidad, y paciencia, y longanimidad, ignorando que su benignidad te guía á arrepentimiento?

verses.KJV: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.WEB: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
verses.ASV: but after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up for thyself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, conforme a tua dureza e o teu coração que não se arrepende, tu ajuntas ira para ti no dia da ira e da manifestação do justo julgamento de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Mas por tu dureza, y por tu corazón no arrepentido, atesoras para ti mismo ira para el día de la ira y de la manifestación del justo juicio de Dios;

verses.KJV: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.WEB: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
verses.ASV: who will render to every man according to his works:
verses.ALMEIDA: que recompensará a cada um segundo as suas obras:
verses.RVR09: El cual pagará á cada uno conforme á sus obras:

verses.KJV: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.WEB: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
verses.ASV: to them that by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and incorruption, eternal life:
verses.ALMEIDA: vida eterna aos que procuram glória, honra, e imortalidade, fazendo o bem com perseverança;
verses.RVR09: A los que perseverando en bien hacer, buscan gloria y honra é inmortalidad, la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.WEB: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
verses.ASV: but unto them that are factious, and obey not the truth, but obey unrighteousness, [shall be] wrath and indignation,
verses.ALMEIDA: mas indignação e ira aos que agem com egoísmo, obedecendo à injustiça, e não à verdade.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los que son contenciosos, y no obedecen á la verdad, antes obedecen á la injusticia, enojo é ira;

verses.KJV: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.WEB: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.ASV: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that worketh evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Greek;
verses.ALMEIDA: Haverá aflição e angústia a toda pessoa que pratica o mal, primeiramente ao judeu, e também ao grego;
verses.RVR09: Tribulación y angustia sobre toda persona humana que obra lo malo, el Judío primeramente, y también el Griego:

verses.KJV: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.WEB: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.ASV: but glory and honor and peace to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek:
verses.ALMEIDA: porém, glória, honra, e paz, a todo aquele que pratica o bem, primeiramente ao judeu, e também ao grego;
verses.RVR09: Mas gloria y honra y paz á cualquiera que obra el bien, al Judío primeramente, y también al Griego.

verses.KJV: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.WEB: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.ASV: for there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque com Deus não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay acepción de personas para con Dios.

verses.KJV: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.WEB: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
verses.ASV: For as many as have sinned without the law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos os que sem Lei pecaram, sem Lei também perecerão; e todos os que pecaram sob a Lei, pela Lei serão julgados;
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los que sin ley pecaron, sin ley también perecerán; y todos los que en la ley pecaron, por la ley serán juzgados:

verses.KJV: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.WEB: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
verses.ASV: for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified;
verses.ALMEIDA: porque não são os que ouvem a Lei que são justos diante de Deus, mas sim, os que praticam a Lei que serão justificados.
verses.RVR09: Porque no los oidores de la ley son justos para con Dios, mas los hacedores de la ley serán justificados.

verses.KJV: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.WEB: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
verses.ASV: (for when Gentiles that have not the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are the law unto themselves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando os gentios, que não têm a Lei, praticam naturalmente as coisas que são da Lei, estes, ainda que não tenham a Lei, são lei para si mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los Gentiles que no tienen ley, naturalmente haciendo lo que es de la ley, los tales, aunque no tengan ley, ellos son ley á sí mismos:

verses.KJV: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.WEB: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
verses.ASV: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness therewith, and their thoughts one with another accusing or else excusing [them]);
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles mostram a obra da Lei escrita em seus corações, dando-lhes testemunho juntamente a sua consciência, e os pensamentos, ora acusando-os, ora defendendo-os.
verses.RVR09: Mostrando la obra de la ley escrita en sus corazones, dando testimonio juntamente sus conciencias, y acusándose y también excusándose sus pensamientos unos con otros;

verses.KJV: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.WEB: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: in the day when God shall judge the secrets of men, according to my gospel, by Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isso acontecerá no dia em que Deus julgará os segredos dos seres humanos por meio de Jesus Cristo, conforme o meu Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: En el día que juzgará el Señor lo encubierto de los hombres, conforme á mi evangelio, por Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.WEB: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
verses.ASV: But if thou bearest the name of a Jew, and restest upon the law, and gloriest in God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que tu, que és chamado de judeu, e descansas confiando na Lei, e te orgulhas em Deus,
verses.RVR09: He aquí, tú tienes el sobrenombre de Judío, y estás reposado en la ley, y te glorías en Dios,

verses.KJV: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.WEB: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
verses.ASV: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
verses.ALMEIDA: conheces a vontade [dele] , e aprovas as melhores coisas, por seres instruído na lei;
verses.RVR09: Y sabes su voluntad, y apruebas lo mejor, instruído por la ley;

verses.KJV: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
verses.WEB: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
verses.ASV: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them that are in darkness,
verses.ALMEIDA: e confias ser guia dos cegos, luz dos que estão nas trevas,
verses.RVR09: Y confías que eres guía de los ciegos, luz de los que están en tinieblas,

verses.KJV: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.WEB: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
verses.ASV: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth;
verses.ALMEIDA: instrutor dos tolos, professor das crianças, e que consideras a lei como a forma do conhecimento e da verdade;
verses.RVR09: Enseñador de los que no saben, maestro de niños, que tienes la forma de la ciencia y de la verdad en la ley:

verses.KJV: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.WEB: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
verses.ASV: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.ALMEIDA: tu, pois, que ensinas ao outro, não ensinas a ti mesmo? Tu que pregas que não se deve furtar, furtas?
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, que enseñas á otro, ¿no te enseñas á ti mismo? ¿Tú, que predicas que no se ha de hurtar, hurtas?

verses.KJV: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.WEB: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.ASV: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu que dizes que não se deve adulterar, adulteras? Tu que odeias os ídolos, profanas templos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tú, que dices que no se ha de adulterar, adulteras? ¿Tú, que abominas los ídolos, cometes sacrilegio?

verses.KJV: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.WEB: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
verses.ASV: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, que te orgulhas da Lei, pela transgressão da Lei desonras a Deus;
verses.RVR09: ¿Tú, que te jactas de la ley, con infracción de la ley deshonras á Dios?

verses.KJV: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.WEB: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
verses.ASV: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you, even as it is written.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque, como está escrito: “O nome de Deus é blasfemado entre os gentios por vossa causa”.
verses.RVR09: Porque el nombre de Dios es blasfemado por causa de vosotros entre los Gentiles, como está escrito.

verses.KJV: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.WEB: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
verses.ASV: For circumcision indeed profiteth, if thou be a doer of the law: but if thou be a transgressor of the law, thy circumcision is become uncircumcision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a circuncisão tem proveito de fato se guardares a Lei; porém, se tu és transgressor da Lei, a tua circuncisão se torna incircuncisão.
verses.RVR09: Porque la circuncisión en verdad aprovecha, si guardares la ley; mas si eres rebelde á la ley, tu circuncisión es hecha incircuncisión.

verses.KJV: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.WEB: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
verses.ASV: If therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se o incircunciso obedecer às exigências da Lei, por acaso não será a sua incircuncisão considerada como circuncisão?
verses.RVR09: De manera que, si el incircunciso guardare las justicias de la ley, ¿no será tenida su incircuncisión por circuncisión?

verses.KJV: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.WEB: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
verses.ASV: and shall not the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who with the letter and circumcision art a transgressor of the law?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o que de natureza é incircunciso cumprir a Lei, ele julgará a ti, que mesmo com a norma escrita e a circuncisão és transgressor da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que de su natural es incircunciso, guardando perfectamente la ley, te juzgará á ti, que con la letra y con la circuncisión eres rebelde á la ley.

verses.KJV: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.WEB: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
verses.ASV: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois judeu não é o de aparência externa, nem circuncisão é a na carne,
verses.RVR09: Porque no es Judío el que lo es en manifiesto; ni la circuncisión es la que es en manifiesto en la carne:

verses.KJV: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.WEB: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
verses.ASV: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas é judeu o que é no interior, e circuncisão é a de coração, no espírito, e não em uma norma escrita. Esse é elogiado não pelas pessoas, mas sim, por Deus.
