verses.RVR09: Mas es Judío el que lo es en lo interior; y la circuncisión es la del corazón, en espíritu, no en letra; la alabanza del cual no es de los hombres, sino de Dios.

verses.KJV: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
verses.WEB: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
verses.ASV: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual, pois, é a vantagem do judeu? Ou qual é a utilidade da circuncisão?
verses.RVR09: ¿QUÉ, pues, tiene más el Judío? ¿ó qué aprovecha la circuncisión?

verses.KJV: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.WEB: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
verses.ASV: Much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muita, em toda maneira. Pois, em primeiro lugar, as palavras de Deus lhes foram confiadas.
verses.RVR09: Mucho en todas maneras. Lo primero ciertamente, que la palabra de Dios les ha sido confiada.

verses.KJV: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.WEB: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
verses.ASV: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, quê? Se alguns foram infiéis, a infidelidade deles anulará a fidelidade de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué si algunos de ellos han sido incrédulos? ¿la incredulidad de ellos habrá hecho vana la verdad de Dios?

verses.KJV: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.WEB: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
verses.ASV: God forbid: yea, let God be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy words, And mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira nenhuma! Antes seja Deus verdadeiro, e todo ser humano mentiroso, como está escrito: “Para que sejas justificado em tuas palavras, e prevaleças quando julgares”.
verses.RVR09: En ninguna manera; antes bien sea Dios verdadero, mas todo hombre mentiroso; como está escrito: Para que seas justificado en tus dichos, y venzas cuando de ti se juzgare.

verses.KJV: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.WEB: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
verses.ASV: But if our unrighteousness commendeth the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? (I speak after the manner of men.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se a nossa injustiça evidencia a justiça de Deus, que diremos? Acaso Deus é injusto em impor [a sua] ira? (Falo na lógica humana).
verses.RVR09: Y si nuestra iniquidad encarece la justicia de Dios, ¿qué diremos? ¿Será injusto Dios que da castigo? (hablo como hombre.)

verses.KJV: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.WEB: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
verses.ASV: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira nenhuma! De outro modo, como Deus julgará o mundo?
verses.RVR09: En ninguna manera: de otra suerte ¿cómo juzgaría Dios el mundo?

verses.KJV: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.WEB: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
verses.ASV: But if the truth of God through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se, através da minha mentira, a verdade de Deus foi mais abundante para a sua glória, por que ainda sou também julgado como pecador?
verses.RVR09: Empero si la verdad de Dios por mi mentira creció á gloria suya, ¿por qué aun así yo soy juzgado como pecador?

verses.KJV: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.WEB: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
verses.ASV: and why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que não [dizer] : “Façamos o mal, para que venha o bem”, como alguns nos caluniam, afirmando que nós dizemos isto? (A condenação destes é justa).
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué no decir (como somos blasfemados, y como algunos dicen que nosotros decimos): Hagamos males para que vengan bienes? la condenación de los cuales es justa.

verses.KJV: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.WEB: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
verses.ASV: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, quê? Somos nós melhores? Não, de maneira nenhuma. Pois já delatamos que todos, tanto judeus como gregos, estão debaixo do pecado,
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues? ¿Somos mejores que ellos? En ninguna manera: porque ya hemos acusado á Judíos y á Gentiles, que todos están debajo de pecado.

verses.KJV: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.WEB: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
verses.ASV: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one;
verses.ALMEIDA: como está escrito: Não há justo, nem um sequer.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: No hay justo, ni aun uno;

verses.KJV: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.WEB: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
verses.ASV: There is none that understandeth, There is none that seeketh after God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém há que entenda, ninguém há que busque a Deus.
verses.RVR09: No hay quien entienda, no hay quien busque á Dios;

verses.KJV: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.WEB: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
verses.ASV: They have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not so much as one:
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos se desviaram, e juntamente se tornaram inúteis. “Não há quem faça o bem, não há um sequer”.
verses.RVR09: Todos se apartaron, á una fueron hechos inútiles; no hay quien haga lo bueno, no hay ni aun uno:

verses.KJV: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.WEB: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
verses.ASV: Their throat is an open sepulchre; With their tongues they have used deceit: The poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.ALMEIDA: “Suas gargantas são sepulcro aberto; com suas línguas enganam”; “veneno de serpentes está sob seus lábios”.
verses.RVR09: Sepulcro abierto es su garganta; con sus lenguas tratan engañosamente; veneno de áspides está debajo de sus labios;

verses.KJV: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.WEB: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
verses.ASV: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.ALMEIDA: “Suas bocas estão cheias de maldição e amargura”.
verses.RVR09: Cuya boca está llena de maledicencia y de amargura;

verses.KJV: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
verses.WEB: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
verses.ASV: Their feet are swift to shed blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: “Seus pés são velozes para derramar sangue.
verses.RVR09: Sus pies son ligeros á derramar sangre;

verses.KJV: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
verses.WEB: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
verses.ASV: Destruction and misery are in their ways;
verses.ALMEIDA: Destruição e miséria há em seus caminhos,
verses.RVR09: Quebrantamiento y desventura hay en sus caminos;

verses.KJV: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.WEB: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
verses.ASV: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.ALMEIDA: e não conheceram o caminho da paz”.
verses.RVR09: Y camino de paz no conocieron:

verses.KJV: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.WEB: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
verses.ASV: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Diante dos seus olhos não há temor a Deus”.
verses.RVR09: No hay temor de Dios delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.WEB: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
verses.ASV: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, sabemos que tudo o que a Lei diz, diz aos que estão na Lei, para que toda boca se cale, e todo o mundo seja condenável perante Deus.
verses.RVR09: Empero sabemos que todo lo que la ley dice, á los que están en la ley lo dice, para que toda boca se tape, y que todo el mundo se sujete á Dios:

verses.KJV: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.WEB: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
verses.ASV: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law [cometh] the knowledge of sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, ninguém será justificado diante dele pelas obras da Lei, porque o que vem pela Lei é o conhecimento do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Porque por las obras de la ley ninguna carne se justificará delante de él; porque por la ley es el conocimiento del pecado.

verses.KJV: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.WEB: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
verses.ASV: But now apart from the law a righteousness of God hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, independentemente da Lei, a justiça de Deus se manifestou, tendo testemunho da Lei e dos Profetas;
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, sin la ley, la justicia de Dios se ha manifestado, testificada por la ley y por los profetas:

verses.KJV: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.WEB: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
verses.ASV: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;
verses.ALMEIDA: isto é, a justiça de Deus por meio da fé em Jesus Cristo, para todos e sobre todos os que creem; pois não há diferença;
verses.RVR09: La justicia de Dios por la fe de Jesucristo, para todos los que creen en él; porque no hay diferencia;

verses.KJV: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.WEB: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
verses.ASV: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: porque todos pecaram, e estão destituídos da glória de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto todos pecaron, y están destituídos de la gloria de Dios;

verses.KJV: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: e são justificados gratuitamente pela sua graça, por meio da redenção que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Siendo justificados gratuitamente por su gracia, por la redención que es en Cristo Jesús;

verses.KJV: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.WEB: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
verses.ASV: whom God set forth [to be] a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus propôs Jesus por sacrifício de reconciliação, pela fé em seu sangue, para demonstrar a sua justiça. Ele deixou de considerar os pecados antes cometidos, sob a paciência de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Al cual Dios ha propuesto en propiciación por la fe en su sangre, para manifestación de su justicia, atento á haber pasado por alto, en su paciencia, los pecados pasados,

verses.KJV: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.WEB: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
verses.ASV: for the showing, [I say], of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: para demonstrar a sua justiça neste presente tempo, a fim de que ele seja justo, e justificador daquele que tem fé em Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Con la mira de manifestar su justicia en este tiempo: para que él sea el justo, y el que justifica al que es de la fe de Jesús.

verses.KJV: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.WEB: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
verses.ASV: Where then is the glorying? It is excluded. By what manner of law? of works? Nay: but by a law of faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde, pois, está o orgulho? Este é excluído. Por qual lei? A das obras? Não, mas sim, pela Lei da fé.
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde pues está la jactancia? Es excluída. ¿Por cuál ley? ¿de las obras? No; mas por la ley de la fe.

verses.KJV: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.WEB: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
verses.ASV: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Concluímos, portanto, que o ser humano é justificado pela fé, independentemente das obras da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Así que, concluímos ser el hombre justificado por fe sin las obras de la ley.

verses.KJV: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.WEB: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
verses.ASV: Or is God [the God] of Jews only? is he not [the God] of Gentiles also? Yea, of Gentiles also:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso Deus é somente dos judeus, e não também dos gentios? Certamente que dos gentios também;
verses.RVR09: ¿Es Dios solamente Dios de los Judíos? ¿No es también Dios de los Gentiles? Cierto, también de los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.WEB: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
verses.ASV: if so be that God is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: já que há um só Deus, que justificará pela fé os circuncisos, e por meio da fé os incircuncisos.
verses.RVR09: Porque uno es Dios, el cual justificará por la fe la circuncisión, y por medio de la fe la incircuncisión.

verses.KJV: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.WEB: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
verses.ASV: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso anulamos a Lei pela fé? De maneira nenhuma. Pelo contrário, confirmamos a Lei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Luego deshacemos la ley por la fe? En ninguna manera; antes establecemos la ley.

verses.KJV: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.WEB: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
verses.ASV: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather, hath found according to the flesh?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, que diremos que Abraão, nosso ancestral segundo a carne, obteve?
verses.RVR09: ¿QUÉ, pues, diremos que halló Abraham nuestro padre según la carne?

verses.KJV: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.WEB: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
verses.ASV: For if Abraham was justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not toward God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se Abraão foi justificado pelas obras, ele tem do que se orgulhar, mas não diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que si Abraham fué justificado por la obras, tiene de qué gloriarse; mas no para con Dios.

verses.KJV: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.WEB: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
verses.ASV: For what saith the scripture? And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o que diz a Escritura? Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi lhe imputado como justiça.
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué dice la Escritura? Y creyó Abraham á Dios, y le fué atribuído á justicia.

verses.KJV: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.WEB: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
verses.ASV: Now to him that worketh, the reward is not reckoned as of grace, but as of debt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, ao que trabalha, seu pagamento não é considerado um favor, mas sim, uma dívida.
verses.RVR09: Empero al que obra, no se le cuenta el salario por merced, sino por deuda.

verses.KJV: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.WEB: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
verses.ASV: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, ao que não tem obra, mas crê naquele que torna justo o ímpio, sua fé lhe é reputada como justiça.
verses.RVR09: Mas al que no obra, pero cree en aquél que justifica al impío, la fe le es contada por justicia.

verses.KJV: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.WEB: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
verses.ASV: Even as David also pronounceth blessing upon the man, unto whom God reckoneth righteousness apart from works,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta maneira, também Davi afirma que bendito é aquele a quem Deus atribui justiça independentemente das obras:
verses.RVR09: Como también David dice ser bienaventurado el hombre al cual Dios atribuye justicia sin obras,

verses.KJV: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.WEB: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
verses.ASV: [saying], Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, And whose sins are covered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos são os que têm as transgressões perdoadas, e seus pecados são cobertos.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Bienaventurados aquellos cuyas iniquidades son perdonadas, y cuyos pecados son cubiertos.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not reckon sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito é o homem a quem o Senhor não atribui pecado.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el varón al cual el Señor no imputó pecado.

verses.KJV: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.WEB: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.ASV: Is this blessing then pronounced upon the circumcision, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say, To Abraham his faith was reckoned for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, essa bendição [é somente] para os circuncisos, ou também para os incircuncisos? Pois dizemos que a fé a Abraão foi reputada como justiça.
verses.RVR09: ¿Es pues esta bienaventuranza solamente en la circuncisión, ó también en la incircuncisión? porque decimos que á Abraham fué contada la fe por justicia.

verses.KJV: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.WEB: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.ASV: How then was it reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision:
verses.ALMEIDA: Como, pois, [lhe] foi reputada? Enquanto ele estava na circuncisão ou na incircuncisão? Não na circuncisão, mas sim, na incircuncisão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo pues le fué contada? ¿en la circuncisión, ó en la incircuncisión? No en la circuncisión, sino en la incircuncisión.

verses.KJV: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.WEB: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
verses.ASV: and he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might be reckoned unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele recebeu o sinal da circuncisão como selo da justiça da fé quando ainda era incircunciso, para que fosse pai de todos os que creem, ainda que não estejam circuncidados, para que a justiça também lhes seja imputada;
verses.RVR09: Y recibió la circuncisión por señal, por sello de la justicia de la fe que tuvo en la incircuncisión: para que fuese padre de todos los creyentes no circuncidados, para que también á ellos les sea contado por justicia;

verses.KJV: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.WEB: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
verses.ASV: and the father of circumcision to them who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham which he had in uncircumcision.
verses.ALMEIDA: e para que fosse pai da circuncisão, dos que não somente são circuncidados, mas que também andam nos passos da fé do nosso pai Abraão, quando ainda não era circuncidado.
verses.RVR09: Y padre de la circuncisión, no solamente á los que son de la circuncisión, mas también á los que siguen las pisadas de la fe que fué en nuestro padre Abraham antes de ser circuncidado.

verses.KJV: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.WEB: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.ASV: For not through the law was the promise to Abraham or to his seed that he should be heir of the world, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não foi pela Lei que a promessa de ser herdeiro do mundo [foi feita] a Abraão ou à sua descendência, mas sim, pela justiça da fé;
verses.RVR09: Porque no por la ley fué dada la promesa á Abraham ó á su simiente, que sería heredero del mundo, sino por la justicia de la fe.

verses.KJV: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.WEB: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
verses.ASV: For if they that are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of none effect:
verses.ALMEIDA: porque, se é da Lei que são os herdeiros, logo a fé se torna vazia, e a promessa é anulada.
verses.RVR09: Porque si los que son de la ley son los herederos, vana es la fe, y anulada es la promesa.

verses.KJV: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.WEB: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
verses.ASV: for the law worketh wrath; but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a Lei produz ira, porque onde não há Lei, também não há transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ley obra ira; porque donde no hay ley, tampoco hay transgresión.

verses.KJV: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.WEB: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
verses.ASV: For this cause [it is] of faith, that [it may be] according to grace; to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso é pela fé, para que seja conforme a graça, a fim de que a promessa seja confirmada a todos os descendentes, não somente aos que são da Lei, mas também aos que são da fé de Abraão, que é Pai de todos nós,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto es por la fe, para que sea por gracia; para que la promesa sea firme á toda simiente, no solamente al que es de la ley, mas también al que es de la fe de Abraham, el cual es padre de todos nosotros,

verses.KJV: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.WEB: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
verses.ASV: (as it is written, A father of many nations have I made thee) before him whom he believed, [even] God, who giveth life to the dead, and calleth the things that are not, as though they were.
verses.ALMEIDA: (como está escrito: “Eu te constituí pai de muitas nações”) diante daquele em quem ele creu, Deus, que vivifica os mortos, e chama as coisas que não são como se já fossem.
verses.RVR09: (Como está escrito: Que por padre de muchas gentes te he puesto) delante de Dios, al cual creyó; el cual da vida á los muertos, y llama las cosas que no son, como las que son.

verses.KJV: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.WEB: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
verses.ASV: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com esperança, [Abraão] creu, contra as expectativas, que se tornaria pai de muitas nações, conforme o que [lhe] fora dito: “Assim será a tua descendência”.
verses.RVR09: El creyó en esperanza contra esperanza, para venir á ser padre de muchas gentes, conforme á lo que le había sido dicho: Así será tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:
verses.WEB: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.ASV: And without being weakened in faith he considered his own body now as good as dead (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não fraquejou na fé, não dando atenção ao seu próprio corpo já praticamente morto (pois já era de quase cem anos), nem ao estado de morte do ventre de Sara;
verses.RVR09: Y no se enflaqueció en la fe, ni consideró su cuerpo ya muerto (siendo ya de casi cien años), ni la matriz muerta de Sara;

verses.KJV: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.WEB: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
verses.ASV: yet, looking unto the promise of God, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to God,
verses.ALMEIDA: nem duvidou da promessa de Deus; pelo contrário, fortaleceu-se na fé, dando glória a Deus;
verses.RVR09: Tampoco en la promesa de Dios dudó con desconfianza: antes fué esforzado en fe, dando gloria á Dios,

verses.KJV: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.WEB: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
verses.ASV: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.ALMEIDA: e teve plena certeza de que aquele que havia prometido também era poderoso para cumprir.
verses.RVR09: Plenamente convencido de que todo lo que había prometido, era también poderoso para hacerlo.

verses.KJV: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.WEB: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore also it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por esse motivo que também isso lhe foi imputado como justiça.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también le fué atribuído á justicia.

verses.KJV: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.WEB: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
verses.ASV: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned unto him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, não só por causa dele está escrito que lhe foi imputado;
verses.RVR09: Y no solamente por él fué escrito que le haya sido imputado;

verses.KJV: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.WEB: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.ASV: but for our sake also, unto whom it shall be reckoned, who believe on him that raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.ALMEIDA: mas também por nós, a quem será imputado, aos que creem naquele que ressuscitou dos mortos a Jesus, nosso Senhor,
verses.RVR09: Sino también por nosotros, á quienes será imputado, esto es, á los que creemos en el que levantó de los muertos á Jesús Señor nuestro,

verses.KJV: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.WEB: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
verses.ASV: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
verses.ALMEIDA: que foi entregue por nossos pecados, e ressuscitou para a nossa justificação.
verses.RVR09: El cual fué entregado por nuestros delitos, y resucitado para nuestra justificación.

verses.KJV: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ASV: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, agora que somos justificados pela fé, temos paz com Deus por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: JUSTIFICADOS pues por la fe, tenemos paz para con Dios por medio de nuestro Señor Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.WEB: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.ASV: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por meio dele também temos acesso pela fé a esta graça, na qual estamos firmes, e nos alegramos na esperança da glória de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por el cual también tenemos entrada por la fe á esta gracia en la cual estamos firmes, y nos gloriamos en la esperanza de la gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.WEB: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
verses.ASV: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente [isso] , mas também nos alegramos nas tribulações, sabendo que a tribulação produz paciência;
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo esto, mas aun nos gloriamos en las tribulaciones, sabiendo que la tribulación produce paciencia;

verses.KJV: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.WEB: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
verses.ASV: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:
verses.ALMEIDA: a paciência [produz] experiência, e a experiência [produz] esperança.
verses.RVR09: Y la paciencia, prueba; y la prueba, esperanza;

verses.KJV: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.WEB: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.ASV: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a esperança não frustra, porque o amor de Deus está derramado em nossos corações pelo Espírito Santo que nos foi dado.
verses.RVR09: Y la esperanza no avergüenza; porque el amor de Dios está derramado en nuestros corazones por el Espíritu Santo que nos es dado.

verses.KJV: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.WEB: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.ASV: For while we were yet weak, in due season Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando ainda éramos fracos, Cristo morreu a seu tempo pelos ímpios.
verses.RVR09: Porque Cristo, cuando aun éramos flacos, á su tiempo murió por los impíos.

verses.KJV: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.WEB: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
verses.ASV: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, dificilmente alguém morre por um justo, ainda que talvez alguém possa ousar morrer por uma boa pessoa.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente apenas muere alguno por un justo: con todo podrá ser que alguno osara morir por el bueno.

verses.KJV: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.WEB: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.ASV: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus prova o seu amor por nós através de Cristo haver morrido por nós, quando ainda éramos pecadores.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios encarece su caridad para con nosotros, porque siendo aún pecadores, Cristo murió por nosotros.

verses.KJV: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.WEB: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
verses.ASV: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath [of God] through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, muito mais agora, que já somos justificados por seu sangue, seremos por ele salvos da ira.
verses.RVR09: Luego mucho más ahora, justificados en su sangre, por él seremos salvos de la ira.

verses.KJV: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.WEB: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
verses.ASV: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se quando éramos inimigos, fomos reconciliados com Deus pela morte do seu Filho, muito mais, tendo sido reconciliados, seremos salvos pela sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Porque si siendo enemigos, fuimos reconciliados con Dios por la muerte de su Hijo, mucho más, estando reconciliados, seremos salvos por su vida.

verses.KJV: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.WEB: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.ASV: and not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente [isso] , mas também nos alegramos em Deus por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, por quem agora recebemos a reconciliação.
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo esto, mas aun nos gloriamos en Dios por el Señor nuestro Jesucristo, por el cual hemos ahora recibido la reconciliación.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.WEB: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
verses.ASV: Therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned:—
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim como por um homem o pecado entrou no mundo, e pelo pecado a morte, assim também a morte passou a todos os seres humanos, porque todos pecaram.
verses.RVR09: De consiguiente, vino la reconciliación por uno, así como el pecado entró en el mundo por un hombre, y por el pecado la muerte, y la muerte así pasó á todos los hombres, pues que todos pecaron.

verses.KJV: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.WEB: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
verses.ASV: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, antes da Lei, o pecado [já] existia no mundo; porém, quando não há Lei, o pecado não é considerado.
verses.RVR09: Porque hasta la ley, el pecado estaba en el mundo; pero no se imputa pecado no habiendo ley.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a morte reinou desde Adão até Moisés, até sobre aqueles que não pecaram à semelhança da transgressão de Adão, o qual era uma figura daquele que estava para vir.
verses.RVR09: No obstante, reinó la muerte desde Adam hasta Moisés, aun en los que no pecaron á la manera de la rebelión de Adam; el cual es figura del que había de venir.

verses.KJV: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.WEB: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
verses.ASV: But not as the trespass, so also [is] the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound unto the many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o dom gratuito não é como a transgressão; porque, se pela transgressão de um, muitos morreram, muito mais a graça de Deus, e o dom pela graça de um homem, Jesus Cristo, têm sido abundantes sobre muitos.
verses.RVR09: Mas no como el delito, tal fué el don: porque si por el delito de aquel uno murieron los muchos, mucho más abundó la gracia de Dios á los muchos, y el don por la gracia de un hombre, Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.WEB: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
verses.ASV: And not as through one that sinned, [so] is the gift: for the judgment [came] of one unto condemnation, but the free gift [came] of many trespasses unto justification.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dom não é como [a transgressão] de um que pecou; porque o julgamento de uma só [transgressão] trouxe condenação, mas o dom gratuito, de muitas transgressões, trouxe justificação.
verses.RVR09: Ni tampoco de la manera que por un pecado, así también el don: porque el juicio á la verdad vino de un pecado para condenación, mas la gracia vino de muchos delitos para justificación.

verses.KJV: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.WEB: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, [even] Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se pela transgressão de um, a morte reinou por causa desse, muito mais os que recebem a abundância da graça, e do dom da justiça reinarão em vida por um só, Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque, si por un delito reinó la muerte por uno, mucho más reinarán en vida por un Jesucristo los que reciben la abundancia de la gracia, y del don de la justicia.

verses.KJV: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.WEB: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
verses.ASV: So then as through one trespass [the judgment came] unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness [the free gift came] unto all men to justification of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim como uma transgressão resultou em condenação sobre todos os seres humanos, assim também um ato de justiça resultou em justificação da vida sobre todos os seres humanos.
verses.RVR09: Así que, de la manera que por un delito vino la culpa á todos los hombres para condenación, así por una justicia vino la gracia á todos los hombres para justificación de vida.

verses.KJV: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.WEB: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
verses.ASV: For as through the one man’s disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, assim como pela desobediência de um só homem muitos foram feitos pecadores, assim também, pela obediência de um só, muitos serão justificados.
verses.RVR09: Porque como por la desobediencia de un hombre los muchos fueron constituídos pecadores, así por la obediencia de uno los muchos serán constituídos justos.

verses.KJV: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.WEB: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
verses.ASV: And the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:
verses.ALMEIDA: A Lei veio para que a transgressão aumentasse; mas onde o pecado aumentou, a graça superabundou;
verses.RVR09: La ley empero entró para que el pecado creciese; mas cuando el pecado creció, sobrepujó la gracia;

verses.KJV: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.WEB: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.ASV: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que, assim como o pecado reinou para a morte, também a graça reine pela justiça para a vida eterna, por meio de Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Para que, de la manera que el pecado reinó para muerte, así también la gracia reine por la justicia para vida eterna por Jesucristo Señor nuestro.

verses.KJV: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.WEB: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.ASV: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diremos, pois? Continuaremos no pecado, para que a graça aumente?
verses.RVR09: ¿PUES qué diremos? Perseveraremos en pecado para que la gracia crezca?

verses.KJV: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.WEB: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
verses.ASV: God forbid. We who died to sin, how shall we any longer live therein?
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira nenhuma! Nós, que morremos para o pecado, como ainda viveremos nele?
verses.RVR09: En ninguna manera. Porque los que somos muertos al pecado, ¿cómo viviremos aún en él?

verses.KJV: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.WEB: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.ASV: Or are ye ignorant that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou não sabeis que todos os que somos batizados em Cristo Jesus, somos batizados em sua morte?
verses.RVR09: ¿O no sabéis que todos los que somos bautizados en Cristo Jesús, somos bautizados en su muerte?

verses.KJV: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.WEB: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
verses.ASV: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, estamos sepultados com ele pelo batismo na morte; para que, assim como Cristo ressuscitou dos mortos para a glória do Pai, assim também nós andemos em novidade de vida.
verses.RVR09: Porque somos sepultados juntamente con él á muerte por el bautismo; para que como Cristo resucitó de los muertos por la gloria del Padre, así también nosotros andemos en novedad de vida.

verses.KJV: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.WEB: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
verses.ASV: For if we have become united with [him] in the likeness of his death, we shall be also [in the likeness] of his resurrection;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se fomos unidos [a ele] na semelhança de sua morte, também o seremos na da [sua] ressurreição.
verses.RVR09: Porque si fuimos plantados juntamente en él á la semejanza de su muerte, así también lo seremos á la de su resurrección:

verses.KJV: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.WEB: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
verses.ASV: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with [him], that the body of sin might be done away, that so we should no longer be in bondage to sin;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabemos isto: que o nosso velho ser foi crucificado com [ele] , para que o corpo do pecado seja extinto, a fim de que não mais sirvamos ao pecado;
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo esto, que nuestro viejo hombre juntamente fué crucificado con él, para que el cuerpo del pecado sea deshecho, á fin de que no sirvamos más al pecado.

verses.KJV: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.WEB: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
verses.ASV: for he that hath died is justified from sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois o que está morto já está absolvido do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que es muerto, justificado es del pecado.

verses.KJV: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.WEB: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
verses.ASV: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se já morremos com Cristo, cremos que também com ele viveremos.
verses.RVR09: Y si morimos con Cristo, creemos que también viviremos con él;

verses.KJV: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.WEB: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
verses.ASV: knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death no more hath dominion over him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sabemos que, depois que Cristo foi ressuscitado dos mortos, já não morre mais; a morte já não mais o domina.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que Cristo, habiendo resucitado de entre los muertos, ya no muere: la muerte no se enseñoreará más de él.

verses.KJV: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.WEB: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
verses.ASV: For the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, ao morrer, ele morreu para o pecado de uma vez por todas; mas, ao viver, vive para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque el haber muerto, al pecado murió una vez; mas el vivir, á Dios vive.

verses.KJV: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.WEB: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: Even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, considerai que estais mortos para o pecado, mas vivendo para Deus, em Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, pensad que de cierto estáis muertos al pecado, mas vivos á Dios en Cristo Jesús Señor nuestro.

verses.KJV: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
verses.ASV: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey the lusts thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não reine o pecado em vosso corpo mortal, para obedecer a ele em seus maus desejos.
verses.RVR09: No reine, pues, el pecado en vuestro cuerpo mortal, para que le obedezcáis en sus concupiscencias;

verses.KJV: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.WEB: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
verses.ASV: neither present your members unto sin [as] instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves unto God, as alive from the dead, and your members [as] instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem apresenteis os membros do vosso corpo ao pecado como instrumentos de injustiça; em vez disso, apresentai-vos a Deus, como vivos dentre os mortos, e vossos membros como instrumentos de justiça para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ni tampoco presentéis vuestros miembros al pecado por instrumentos de iniquidad; antes presentaos á Dios como vivos de los muertos, y vuestros miembros á Dios por instrumentos de justicia.

verses.KJV: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.WEB: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
verses.ASV: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under law, but under grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o pecado não vos dominará, porque não estais sob a Lei, mas sim, sob a graça.
verses.RVR09: Porque el pecado no se enseñoreará de vosotros; pues no estáis bajo la ley, sino bajo la gracia.

verses.KJV: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.WEB: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
verses.ASV: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, quê? Pecaremos, já que não estamos sob a Lei, mas sob a graça? De maneira nenhuma!
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué? ¿Pecaremos, porque no estamos bajo de la ley, sino bajo de la gracia? En ninguna manera.

verses.KJV: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.WEB: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
verses.ASV: Know ye not, that to whom ye present yourselves [as] servants unto obedience, his servants ye are whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sabeis vós, que a quem vos apresentardes por servos para obedecer, sois servos daquele a quem obedeceis? Ou do pecado para a morte, ou da obediência para a justiça.
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabéis que á quien os prestáis vosotros mismos por siervos para obedecerle, sois siervos de aquel á quien obedecéis, ó del pecado para muerte, ó de la obediencia para justicia?

verses.KJV: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.WEB: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
verses.ASV: But thanks be to God, that, whereas ye were servants of sin, ye became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto ye were delivered;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, graças a Deus que vós éreis servos do pecado, mas [agora] , de coração obedeceis à forma de doutrina a que vós fostes entregues;
verses.RVR09: Empero gracias á Dios, que aunque fuisteis siervos del pecado, habéis obedecido de corazón á aquella forma de doctrina á la cual sois entregados;

verses.KJV: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.WEB: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
verses.ASV: and being made free from sin, ye became servants of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: e, sendo libertos do pecado, vos tornastes servos da justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y libertados del pecado, sois hechos siervos de la justicia.

verses.KJV: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.WEB: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
verses.ASV: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye presented your members [as] servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now present your members [as] servants to righteousness unto sanctification.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estou falando na lógica humana, pela fraqueza de vossa carne. Pois, assim como apresentastes os membros do vosso corpo como servos da impureza e da maldade para a maldade, assim também apresentai agora os vossos membros como servos da justiça para a santificação.
verses.RVR09: Humana cosa digo, por la flaqueza de vuestra carne: que como para iniquidad presentasteis vuestros miembros á servir á la inmundicia y á la iniquidad, así ahora para santidad presentéis vuestros miembros á servir á la justicia.

verses.KJV: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.WEB: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
verses.ASV: For when ye were servants of sin, ye were free in regard of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando éreis servos do pecado, estáveis livres da justiça.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando fuisteis siervos del pecado, erais libres acerca de la justicia.

verses.KJV: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.WEB: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.ASV: What fruit then had ye at that time in the things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afinal, que fruto obtivestes das coisas de que agora vos envergonhais? Pois o fim delas é a morte.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué fruto, pues, teníais de aquellas cosas de las cuales ahora os avergonzáis? porque el fin de ellas es muerte.

verses.KJV: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.WEB: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
verses.ASV: But now being made free from sin and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, libertos do pecado, e feitos servos de Deus, tendes o vosso fruto para a santificação, e por fim a vida eterna;
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, librados del pecado, y hechos siervos á Dios, tenéis por vuestro fruto la santificación, y por fin la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.WEB: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o salário do pecado é a morte, mas o dom gratuito de Deus é a vida eterna em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Porque la paga del pecado es muerte: mas la dádiva de Dios es vida eterna en Cristo Jesús Señor nuestro.

verses.KJV: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.WEB: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
verses.ASV: Or are ye ignorant, brethren (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law hath dominion over a man for so long time as he liveth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sabeis vós, irmãos (pois estou falando com os que entendem a Lei), que a Lei domina o ser humano por todo o tempo que vive?
verses.RVR09: ¿IGNORÁIS, hermanos, (porque hablo con los que saben la ley) que la ley se enseñorea del hombre entre tanto que vive?

verses.KJV: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.WEB: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
verses.ASV: For the woman that hath a husband is bound by law to the husband while he liveth; but if the husband die, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a mulher casada está, pela Lei, ligada ao marido enquanto o ele viver; porém, depois do marido morrer, ela está livre da Lei do marido.
verses.RVR09: Porque la mujer que está sujeta á marido, mientras el marido vive está obligada á la ley; mas muerto el marido, libre es de la ley del marido.

verses.KJV: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.WEB: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
verses.ASV: So then if, while the husband liveth, she be joined to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if the husband die, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she be joined to another man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou seja, enquanto o marido viver, ela será chamada de adúltera, se for de outro homem; mas depois de morto o marido, ela está livre da Lei, de maneira que não será adúltera se for de outro homem.
verses.RVR09: Así que, viviendo el marido, se llamará adúltera si fuere de otro varón; mas si su marido muriere, es libre de la ley; de tal manera que no será adúltera si fuere de otro marido.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.WEB: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ; that ye should be joined to another, [even] to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, meus irmãos, também vós estais mortos para a Lei por meio do corpo de Cristo, para que sejais de outro, daquele que foi ressuscitado dos mortos, a fim de frutificarmos para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, hermanos míos, estáis muertos á la ley por el cuerpo de Cristo, para que seáis de otro, á saber, del que resucitó de los muertos, á fin de que fructifiquemos á Dios.

verses.KJV: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.WEB: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
verses.ASV: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were through the law, wrought in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, quando estávamos na carne, as paixões dos pecados, que eram pela Lei, operavam nos membros do nosso corpo, a fim de frutificarem para a morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque mientras estábamos en la carne, los afectos de los pecados que eran por la ley, obraban en nuestros miembros fructificando para muerte.

verses.KJV: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.WEB: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
verses.ASV: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that wherein we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora estamos livres da Lei, estando mortos para aquilo em que estávamos presos, para que sirvamos em novidade de espírito, e não na velhice da norma escrita.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora estamos libres de la ley, habiendo muerto á aquella en la cual estábamos detenidos, para que sirvamos en novedad de espíritu, y no en vejez de letra.

verses.KJV: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.WEB: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
verses.ASV: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Howbeit, I had not known sin, except through the law: for I had not known coveting, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diremos, pois? É a Lei pecado? De maneira nenhuma! Todavia, eu não teria conhecido o pecado, se não fosse pela Lei; porque não conheceria a cobiça, se a Lei não dissesse: Não cobiçarás.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues diremos? ¿La ley es pecado? En ninguna manera. Empero yo no conocí el pecado sino por la ley: porque tampoco conociera la concupiscencia, si la ley no dijera: No codiciarás.

verses.KJV: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.WEB: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
verses.ASV: but sin, finding occasion, wrought in me through the commandment all manner of coveting: for apart from the law sin [is] dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o pecado, aproveitando-se do mandamento, operou em mim toda variedade de cobiça. Pois sem a Lei o pecado [estaria] morto.
verses.RVR09: Mas el pecado, tomando ocasión, obró en mí por el mandamiento toda concupiscencia: porque sin la ley el pecado está muerto.

verses.KJV: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.WEB: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
verses.ASV: And I was alive apart from the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died;
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes eu vivia sem a Lei; mas quando veio o mandamento, o pecado reviveu, e eu morri;
verses.RVR09: Así que, yo sin la ley vivía por algún tiempo: mas venido el mandamiento, el pecado revivió, y yo morí.

verses.KJV: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.WEB: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
verses.ASV: and the commandment, which [was] unto life, this I found [to be] unto death:
verses.ALMEIDA: e descobri que o mandamento, que era para a vida, resultou-me para a morte.
verses.RVR09: Y hallé que el mandamiento, intimado para vida, para mí era mortal:

verses.KJV: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.WEB: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
verses.ASV: for sin, finding occasion, through the commandment beguiled me, and through it slew me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o pecado, aproveitando o mandamento, me enganou, e por ele me matou.
verses.RVR09: Porque el pecado, tomando ocasión, me engañó por el mandamiento, y por él me mató.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.WEB: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
verses.ASV: So that the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, a Lei é santa, e o mandamento é santo, justo, e bom.
verses.RVR09: De manera que la ley á la verdad es santa, y el mandamiento santo, y justo, y bueno.

verses.KJV: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.WEB: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
verses.ASV: Did then that which is good become death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good;—that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o que é bom se tornou para mim morte? De maneira nenhuma! Mas foi o pecado, para que se mostrasse como pecado, que operou a morte em mim por meio do bem, a fim de que, por meio do mandamento, o pecado se tornasse excessivamente pecaminoso.
verses.RVR09: ¿Luego lo que es bueno, á mí me es hecho muerte? No; sino que el pecado, para mostrarse pecado, por lo bueno me obró la muerte, haciéndose pecado sobremanera pecante por el mandamiento.

verses.KJV: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.WEB: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
verses.ASV: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sabemos que a Lei é espiritual; mas eu sou carnal, vendido como servo do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabemos que la ley es espiritual; mas yo soy carnal, vendido á sujeción del pecado.

verses.KJV: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.WEB: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
verses.ASV: For that which I do I know not: for not what I would, that do I practise; but what I hate, that I do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não entendo o que faço, pois o que quero, isso não faço; mas o que eu odeio, isso faço.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo que hago, no lo entiendo; ni lo que quiero, hago; antes lo que aborrezco, aquello hago.

verses.KJV: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.WEB: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
verses.ASV: But if what I would not, that I do, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se faço o que não quero, consinto que a Lei é boa;
verses.RVR09: Y si lo que no quiero, esto hago, apruebo que la ley es buena.

verses.KJV: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.WEB: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
verses.ASV: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que agora não sou mais eu que faço aquilo, mas sim, o pecado que habita em mim.
verses.RVR09: De manera que ya no obro aquello, sino el pecado que mora en mí.

verses.KJV: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.WEB: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
verses.ASV: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me, but to do that which is good [is] not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sei que em mim, isto é, em minha carne, não habita bem algum; porque o querer está em mim; porém o fazer o bem eu não consigo.
verses.RVR09: Y yo sé que en mí (es á saber, en mi carne) no mora el bien: porque tengo el querer, mas efectuar el bien no lo alcanzo.

verses.KJV: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.WEB: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
verses.ASV: For the good which I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I practise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o bem que quero, não faço; mas o mal que não quero, isso faço.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hago el bien que quiero; mas el mal que no quiero, éste hago.

verses.KJV: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.WEB: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
verses.ASV: But if what I would not, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se faço o que não quero, não sou eu que faço, mas sim, o pecado que habita em mim.
verses.RVR09: Y si hago lo que no quiero, ya no lo obro yo, sino el pecado que mora en mí.

verses.KJV: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.WEB: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
verses.ASV: I find then the law, that, to me who would do good, evil is present.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acho, então, esta lei: que quando quero fazer o bem, o mal está comigo.
verses.RVR09: Así que, queriendo yo hacer el bien, hallo esta ley: Que el mal está en mí.

verses.KJV: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.WEB: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
verses.ASV: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, quanto ao ser interior, tenho prazer na Lei de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Porque según el hombre interior, me deleito en la ley de Dios:

verses.KJV: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.WEB: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.ASV: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas em meus membros vejo outra lei, que batalha contra a lei do meu entendimento, e me prende sob a lei do pecado, que está nos meus membros.
verses.RVR09: Mas veo otra ley en mis miembros, que se rebela contra la ley de mi espíritu, y que me lleva cautivo á la ley del pecado que está en mis miembros.

verses.KJV: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.WEB: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
verses.ASV: Wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me out of the body of this death?
verses.ALMEIDA: Miserável homem [que sou] ! Quem me livrará deste corpo de morte?
verses.RVR09: ¡Miserable hombre de mí! ¿quién me librará del cuerpo de esta muerte?

verses.KJV: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.WEB: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
verses.ASV: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then I of myself with the mind, indeed, serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeço a Deus por Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor. Assim, eu mesmo com o entendimento sirvo à Lei de Deus, mas, com a carne, à lei do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Gracias doy á Dios, por Jesucristo Señor nuestro. Así que, yo mismo con la mente sirvo á la ley de Dios, mas con la carne á la ley del pecado.

verses.KJV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
