verses.WEB: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.ASV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, agora, nenhuma condenação há para os que estão em Cristo Jesus, que não andam segundo a carne, mas sim segundo o Espírito.
verses.RVR09: AHORA pues, ninguna condenación hay para los que están en Cristo Jesús, los que no andan conforme á la carne, mas conforme al espíritu.

verses.KJV: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.WEB: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
verses.ASV: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a Lei do Espírito de vida, em Cristo Jesus, me livrou da lei do pecado e da morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ley del Espíritu de vida en Cristo Jesús me ha librado de la ley del pecado y de la muerte.

verses.KJV: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.WEB: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.ASV: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o que era impossível para a lei, porque estava enferma pela carne, Deus, ao enviar o seu próprio Filho em semelhança da carne pecadora, e por causa do pecado, condenou o pecado na carne,
verses.RVR09: Porque lo que era imposible á la ley, por cuanto era débil por la carne, Dios enviando á su Hijo en semejanza de carne de pecado, y á causa del pecado, condenó al pecado en la carne;

verses.KJV: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.WEB: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.ASV: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que a exigência da lei se cumprisse em nós, que andamos, não segundo a carne, mas sim, segundo o Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Para que la justicia de la ley fuese cumplida en nosotros, que no andamos conforme á la carne, mas conforme al espíritu.

verses.KJV: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.WEB: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
verses.ASV: For they that are after the flesh mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os que são segundo a carne voltam sua mentalidade para as coisas da carne, mas os que são segundo o Espírito, para as coisas do Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que viven conforme á la carne, de las cosas que son de la carne se ocupan; mas los que conforme al espíritu, de las cosas del espíritu.

verses.KJV: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.WEB: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
verses.ASV: For the mind of the flesh is death; but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a mentalidade da carne é morte, mas a mentalidade do Espírito é vida e paz.
verses.RVR09: Porque la intención de la carne es muerte; mas la intención del espíritu, vida y paz:

verses.KJV: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.WEB: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
verses.ASV: because the mind of the flesh is enmity against God; for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can it be:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a mentalidade da carne é inimizade contra Deus, pois não se sujeita à Lei de Deus, porque nem sequer pode.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto la intención de la carne es enemistad contra Dios; porque no se sujeta á la ley de Dios, ni tampoco puede.

verses.KJV: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.WEB: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
verses.ASV: and they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, os que permanecem na carne não podem agradar a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Así que, los que están en la carne no pueden agradar á Dios.

verses.KJV: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.WEB: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
verses.ASV: But ye are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you. But if any man hath not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vós não permaneceis na carne, mas sim, no Espírito, se é que o Espírito de Deus habita em vós. Porém, se alguém não tem o Espírito de Cristo, esse não lhe pertence.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros no estáis en la carne, sino en el espíritu, si es que el Espíritu de Dios mora en vosotros. Y si alguno no tiene el Espíritu de Cristo, el tal no es de él.

verses.KJV: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.WEB: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
verses.ASV: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se Cristo está em vós, apesar do corpo estar morto por causa do pecado, o Espírito é vida por causa da justiça.
verses.RVR09: Empero si Cristo está en vosotros, el cuerpo á la verdad está muerto á causa del pecado; mas el espíritu vive á causa de la justicia.

verses.KJV: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.WEB: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.ASV: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwelleth in you, he that raised up Christ Jesus from the dead shall give life also to your mortal bodies through his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o Espírito daquele que dos mortos ressuscitou a Jesus habita em vós, aquele que dos mortos ressuscitou a Cristo também dará vida aos vossos corpos mortais por meio do seu Espírito, que habita em vós.
verses.RVR09: Y si el Espíritu de aquel que levantó de los muertos á Jesús mora en vosotros, el que levantó á Cristo Jesús de los muertos, vivificará también vuestros cuerpos mortales por su Espíritu que mora en vosotros.

verses.KJV: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.WEB: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.ASV: So then, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, irmãos, somos devedores, não à carne, para vivermos segundo a carne;
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos, deudores somos, no á la carne, para que vivamos conforme á la carne:

verses.KJV: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.WEB: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.ASV: for if ye live after the flesh, ye must die; but if by the Spirit ye put to death the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque, se viverdes segundo a carne, morrereis; mas se, pelo Espírito, fizerdes morrer as ações do corpo, vivereis.
verses.RVR09: Porque si viviereis conforme á la carne, moriréis; mas si por el espíritu mortificáis las obras de la carne, viviréis.

verses.KJV: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.WEB: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
verses.ASV: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos quantos são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus são filhos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los que son guiados por el Espíritu de Dios, los tales son hijos de Dios.

verses.KJV: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.WEB: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
verses.ASV: For ye received not the spirit of bondage again unto fear; but ye received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não recebestes o espírito de escravidão, para voltardes ao medo; mas recebestes o Espírito de adoção como filhos, pelo qual clamamos: Aba, Pai!
verses.RVR09: Porque no habéis recibido el espíritu de servidumbre para estar otra vez en temor; mas habéis recibido el espíritu de adopción, por el cual clamamos, Abba, Padre.

verses.KJV: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.WEB: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
verses.ASV: The Spirit himself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are children of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: O próprio Espírito dá testemunho com o nosso espírito de que somos filhos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque el mismo Espíritu da testimonio á nuestro espíritu que somos hijos de Dios.

verses.KJV: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.WEB: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
verses.ASV: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with [him], that we may be also glorified with [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se somos filhos, logo somos também herdeiros; herdeiros de Deus, e coerdeiros de Cristo; se sofremos com ele, é para que também com ele sejamos glorificados.
verses.RVR09: Y si hijos, también herederos; herederos de Dios, y coherederos de Cristo; si empero padecemos juntamente con él, para que juntamente con él seamos glorificados.

verses.KJV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.WEB: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
verses.ASV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed to us-ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois considero que as aflições deste tempo presente nem se comparam com a glória que nos será revelada.
verses.RVR09: Porque tengo por cierto que lo que en este tiempo se padece, no es de comparar con la gloria venidera que en nosotros ha de ser manifestada.

verses.KJV: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.WEB: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
verses.ASV: For the earnest expectation of the creation waiteth for the revealing of the sons of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a criação espera ansiosamente a revelação dos filhos de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Porque el continuo anhelar de las criaturas espera la manifestación de los hijos de Dios.

verses.KJV: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
verses.WEB: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
verses.ASV: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but by reason of him who subjected it, in hope
verses.ALMEIDA: porque a criação ficou sujeita à futilidade (não por vontade própria, mas sim por causa daquele que a sujeitou),
verses.RVR09: Porque las criaturas sujetas fueron á vanidad, no de grado, mas por causa del que las sujetó con esperanza,

verses.KJV: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.WEB: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
verses.ASV: that the creation itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: na esperança de que também a mesma criação seja liberta da escravidão da degradação para a liberdade da glória dos filhos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que también las mismas criaturas serán libradas de la servidumbre de corrupción en la libertad gloriosa de los hijos de Dios.

verses.KJV: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.WEB: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
verses.ASV: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sabemos que toda a criação geme e sofre dores como as de parto até agora.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabemos que todas las criaturas gimen á una, y á una están de parto hasta ahora.

verses.KJV: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.WEB: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
verses.ASV: And not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first-fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for [our] adoption, [to wit], the redemption of our body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente [isso] , mas também nós, que temos os primeiros frutos do Espírito, gememos em nós mesmos, esperando a [adoção] , [isto é] , a redenção do nosso corpo.
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo ellas, mas también nosotros mismos, que tenemos las primicias del Espíritu, nosotros también gemimos dentro de nosotros mismos, esperando la adopción, es á saber, la redención de nuestro cuerpo.

verses.KJV: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.WEB: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
verses.ASV: For in hope were we saved: but hope that is seen is not hope: for who hopeth for that which he seeth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois fomos salvos na esperança. Ora, a esperança que se vê não é esperança; afinal, por que alguém ainda espera o que já vê?
verses.RVR09: Porque en esperanza somos salvos; mas la esperanza que se ve, no es esperanza; porque lo que alguno ve, ¿á qué esperarlo?

verses.KJV: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.WEB: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
verses.ASV: But if we hope for that which we see not, [then] do we with patience wait for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se esperamos o que não vemos, com paciência esperamos.
verses.RVR09: Empero si lo que no vemos esperamos, por paciencia esperamos.

verses.KJV: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.WEB: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
verses.ASV: And in like manner the Spirit also helpeth our infirmity: for we know not how to pray as we ought; but the Spirit himself maketh intercession for [us] with groanings which cannot be uttered;
verses.ALMEIDA: E da mesma maneira também o Espírito ajuda em nossas fraquezas. Pois não sabemos orar como se deve, mas o próprio Espírito intercede por nós com gemidos inexprimíveis.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo también el Espíritu ayuda nuestra flaqueza: porque qué hemos de pedir como conviene, no lo sabemos; sino que el mismo Espíritu pide por nosotros con gemidos indecibles.

verses.KJV: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.WEB: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
verses.ASV: and he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to [the will of] God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele que examina os corações sabe qual é a intenção do Espírito, pois ele intercede pelos santos, segundo [a vontade] de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que escudriña los corazones, sabe cuál es el intento del Espíritu, porque conforme á la voluntad de Dios, demanda por los santos.

verses.KJV: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.WEB: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
verses.ASV: And we know that to them that love God all things work together for good, [even] to them that are called according to [his] purpose.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabemos que todas as coisas juntamente contribuem para o bem daqueles que amam a Deus, dos que são chamados segundo o seu propósito.
verses.RVR09: Y sabemos que á los que á Dios aman, todas las cosas les ayudan á bien, es á saber, á los que conforme al propósito son llamados.

verses.KJV: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.WEB: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
verses.ASV: For whom he foreknew, he also foreordained [to be] conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois aos que desde antes conheceu, também os predestinou para serem conformes à imagem do seu Filho, para que ele seja o primogênito entre muitos irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Porque á los que antes conoció, también predestinó para que fuesen hechos conformes á la imagen de su Hijo, para que él sea el primogénito entre muchos hermanos;

verses.KJV: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.WEB: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
verses.ASV: and whom he foreordained, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos que predestinou, a esses também chamou; e aos que chamou, a esses também justificou; e aos que justificou, a esses também glorificou.
verses.RVR09: Y á los que predestinó, á éstos también llamó; y á los que llamó, á éstos también justificó; y á los que justificó, á éstos también glorificó.

verses.KJV: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.WEB: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
verses.ASV: What then shall we say to these things? If God [is] for us, who [is] against us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, que diremos acerca dessas coisas? Se Deus é por nós, quem será contra nós?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué diremos á esto? Si Dios por nosotros, ¿quién contra nosotros?

verses.KJV: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.WEB: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
verses.ASV: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not also with him freely give us all things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que nem mesmo ao seu próprio Filho poupou, como não nos dará também com ele todas as coisas?
verses.RVR09: El que aun á su propio Hijo no perdonó, antes le entregó por todos nosotros, ¿cómo no nos dará también con él todas las cosas?

verses.KJV: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
verses.WEB: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
verses.ASV: Who shall lay anything to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem fará acusação contra os escolhidos de Deus? Deus é quem justifica.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién acusará á los escogidos de Dios? Dios es el que justifica.

verses.KJV: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.WEB: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
verses.ASV: who is he that condemneth? It is Christ Jesus that died, yea rather, that was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem [os] condenará? Cristo é o que morreu; além disto é o que também ressuscitou; o que também está à direita de Deus, e que intercede por nós.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el que condenará? Cristo es el que murió; más aún, el que también resucitó, quien además está á la diestra de Dios, el que también intercede por nosotros.

verses.KJV: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.WEB: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.ASV: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem nos separará do amor de Cristo? A aflição, a angústia, a perseguição, a fome, a nudez, o perigo, ou a espada?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién nos apartará del amor de Cristo? tribulación? ó angustia? ó persecución? ó hambre? ó desnudez? ó peligro? ó cuchillo?

verses.KJV: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.WEB: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
verses.ASV: Even as it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como está escrito: “Pois por causa de ti somos entreges à morte o dia todo; somos contados como ovelhas para o matadouro”.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: Por causa de ti somos muertos todo el tiempo: somos estimados como ovejas de matadero.

verses.KJV: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.WEB: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
verses.ASV: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas em todas estas coisas somos mais que vencedores, por meio daquele que nos amou.
verses.RVR09: Antes, en todas estas cosas hacemos más que vencer por medio de aquel que nos amó.

verses.KJV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.WEB: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.ASV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tenho certeza que nem a morte, nem a vida, nem anjos, nem principados, nem poderes, nem o presente, nem o futuro,
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual estoy cierto que ni la muerte, ni la vida, ni ángeles, ni principados, ni potestades, ni lo presente, ni lo por venir,

verses.KJV: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.WEB: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem altura, nem profundeza, nem qualquer outra criatura poderá nos separar do amor de Deus, que está em Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Ni lo alto, ni lo bajo, ni ninguna criatura nos podrá apartar del amor de Dios, que es en Cristo Jesús Señor nuestro.

verses.KJV: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.WEB: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
verses.ASV: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience bearing witness with me in the Holy Spirit,
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo a verdade em Cristo, não minto, e minha consciência dá testemunho comigo pelo Espírito Santo,
verses.RVR09: VERDAD digo en Cristo, no miento, dándome testimonio mi conciencia en el Espíritu Santo,

verses.KJV: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.WEB: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
verses.ASV: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: de que tenho grande tristeza e contínuo tormento em meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Que tengo gran tristeza y continuo dolor en mi corazón.

verses.KJV: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.WEB: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
verses.ASV: For I could wish that I myself were anathema from Christ for my brethren’s sake, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque desejaria eu mesmo ser separado de Cristo em proveito dos meus irmãos, que são meus parentes segundo a carne;
verses.RVR09: Porque deseara yo mismo ser apartado de Cristo por mis hermanos, los que son mis parientes según la carne;

verses.KJV: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
verses.WEB: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
verses.ASV: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service [of God], and the promises;
verses.ALMEIDA: que são israelitas, e a quem pertencem a adoção como filhos, a glória, os pactos, a Lei, o culto, e as promessas;
verses.RVR09: Que son israelitas, de los cuales es la adopción, y la gloria, y el pacto, y la data de la ley, y el culto, y las promesas;

verses.KJV: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
verses.ASV: whose are the fathers, and of whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: deles são os patriarcas, e deles, quanto à carne, é Cristo, que é sobre todos, Deus bendito eternamente, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Cuyos son los padres, y de los cuales es Cristo según la carne, el cual es Dios sobre todas las cosas, bendito por los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.WEB: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
verses.ASV: But [it is] not as though the word of God hath come to nought. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que a palavra de Deus tenha falhado; porque nem todos os que são de Israel são [verdadeiros] israelitas.
verses.RVR09: No empero que la palabra de Dios haya faltado: porque no todos los que son de Israel son Israelitas;

verses.KJV: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.WEB: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
verses.ASV: neither, because they are Abraham’s seed, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem por serem descendentes de Abraão são todos filhos, mas: “Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência”.
verses.RVR09: Ni por ser simiente de Abraham, son todos hijos; mas: En Isaac te será llamada simiente.

verses.KJV: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.WEB: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
verses.ASV: That is, it is not the children of the flesh that are children of God; but the children of the promise are reckoned for a seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é, não são os filhos da carne que são os filhos de Deus; mas sim os filhos da promessa que são contados como descendência.
verses.RVR09: Quiere decir: No los que son hijos de la carne, éstos son los hijos de Dios; mas los que son hijos de la promesa, son contados en la generación.

verses.KJV: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.WEB: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
verses.ASV: For this is a word of promise, According to this season will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esta é a palavra da promessa: Aproximadamente a este tempo virei, e Sara terá um filho.
verses.RVR09: Porque la palabra de la promesa es esta: Como en este tiempo vendré, y tendrá Sara un hijo.

verses.KJV: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
verses.WEB: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
verses.ASV: And not only so; but Rebecca also having conceived by one, [even] by our father Isaac—
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente isso, mas também Rebeca, quando esteve grávida por intermédio de um só, Isaque, nosso ancestral
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo esto; mas también Rebeca concibiendo de uno, de Isaac nuestro padre,

verses.KJV: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.WEB: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
verses.ASV: for [the children] being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth,
verses.ALMEIDA: (pois, como não eram ainda nascidos, não haviam feito bem ou mal, para que o propósito de Deus, segundo a escolha, continuasse; não pelas obras, mas por causa daquele que chama),
verses.RVR09: (Porque no siendo aún nacidos, ni habiendo hecho aún ni bien ni mal, para que el propósito de Dios conforme á la elección, no por las obras sino por el que llama, permaneciese;)

verses.KJV: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.WEB: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
verses.ASV: it was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.ALMEIDA: foi dito a ela: O mais velho servirá o mais jovem;
verses.RVR09: Le fué dicho que el mayor serviría al menor.

verses.KJV: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.WEB: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
verses.ASV: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.
verses.ALMEIDA: como está escrito: “Amei Jacó, mas odiei Esaú”.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: A Jacob amé, mas á Esaú aborrecí.

verses.KJV: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.WEB: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
verses.ASV: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diremos, então? Que há injustiça da parte de Deus? De maneira nenhuma!
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué diremos? ¿Que hay injusticia en Dios? En ninguna manera.

verses.KJV: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.WEB: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
verses.ASV: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele diz a Moisés: “Terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia, e me compadecerei de quem eu me compadecer”.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Moisés dice: Tendré misericordia del que tendré misericordia, y me compadeceré del que me compadeceré.

verses.KJV: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.WEB: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
verses.ASV: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that hath mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não [depende] daquele que quer, nem daquele que se esforça, mas sim, de Deus, que se compadece.
verses.RVR09: Así que no es del que quiere, ni del que corre, sino de Dios que tiene misericordia.

verses.KJV: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.WEB: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
verses.ASV: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, For this very purpose did I raise thee up, that I might show in thee my power, and that my name might be published abroad in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a Escritura diz a Faraó: “Para isto mesmo te levantei: para mostrar em ti o meu poder, e para que o meu nome seja anunciado em toda a terra”.
verses.RVR09: Porque la Escritura dice de Faraón: Que para esto mismo te he levantado, para mostrar en ti mi potencia, y que mi nombre sea anunciado por toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.WEB: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
verses.ASV: So then he hath mercy on whom he will, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ele tem misericórdia de quem quer, e endurece a quem quer.
verses.RVR09: De manera que del que quiere tiene misericordia; y al que quiere, endurece.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.WEB: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
verses.ASV: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he still find fault? For who withstandeth his will?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, então, me dirás: “Por que ele ainda se queixa? Pois quem resiste à sua vontade?”
verses.RVR09: Me dirás pues: ¿Por qué, pues, se enoja? porque ¿quién resistirá á su voluntad?

verses.KJV: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
verses.WEB: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
verses.ASV: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why didst thou make me thus?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas antes, quem és tu, ó, humano, para questionares a Deus? Por acaso a coisa formada dirá ao que a formou: “Por que me fizeste assim?”
verses.RVR09: Mas antes, oh hombre, ¿quién eres tú, para que alterques con Dios? Dirá el vaso de barro al que le labró: ¿Por qué me has hecho tal?

verses.KJV: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.WEB: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
verses.ASV: Or hath not the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel unto honor, and another unto dishonor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou não tem o oleiro poder sobre o barro, para da mesma massa fazer um vaso para honra, e outro para desonra?
verses.RVR09: ¿O no tiene potestad el alfarero para hacer de la misma masa un vaso para honra, y otro para vergüenza?

verses.KJV: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.WEB: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
verses.ASV: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering vessels of wrath fitted unto destruction:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se Deus, querendo mostrar a [sua] ira, e dar a conhecer o seu poder, suportou com muita paciência os vasos da ira, preparados para a perdição,
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué, si Dios, queriendo mostrar la ira y hacer notoria su potencia, soportó con mucha mansedumbre los vasos de ira preparados para muerte,

verses.KJV: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.WEB: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
verses.ASV: and that he might make known the riches of his glory upon vessels of mercy, which he afore prepared unto glory,
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de fazer conhecidas as riquezas da sua glória nos vasos da misericórdia, que preparou com antecedência para a glória,
verses.RVR09: Y para hacer notorias las riquezas de su gloria, mostrólas para con los vasos de misericordia que él ha preparado para gloria;

verses.KJV: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.WEB: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
verses.ASV: [even] us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
verses.ALMEIDA: que somos nós, aos quais ele chamou, não somente dentre os judeus, mas também dentre os gentios?
verses.RVR09: Los cuales también ha llamado, es á saber, á nosotros, no sólo de los Judíos, mas también de los Gentiles?

verses.KJV: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.WEB: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
verses.ASV: As he saith also in Hosea, I will call that my people, which was not my people; And her beloved, that was not beloved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também diz em Oseias: “Ao que era Não-Meu-Povo, chamarei de Meu-Povo; e a que não era Não-Amada, [chamarei] de Amada”.
verses.RVR09: Como también en Oseas dice: Llamaré al que no era mi pueblo, pueblo mío; y á la no amada, amada.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.WEB: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, There shall they be called sons of the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, no lugar onde lhes foi dito: “Vós não sois meu povo, Aí serão chamados filhos do Deus vivo”.
verses.RVR09: Y será, que en el lugar donde les fué dicho: Vosotros no sois pueblo mío: allí serán llamados hijos del Dios viviente.

verses.KJV: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.WEB: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
verses.ASV: And Isaiah crieth concerning Israel, If the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant that shall be saved:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Isaías clama acerca de Israel: “Ainda que o número dos filhos de Israel seja como a areia do mar, [apenas] o remanescente será salvo;
verses.RVR09: También Isaías clama tocante á Israel: Si fuere el número de los hijos de Israel como la arena de la mar, las reliquias serán salvas:

verses.KJV: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
verses.WEB: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
verses.ASV: for the Lord will execute [his] word upon the earth, finishing it and cutting it short.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o Senhor concluirá e executará brevemente a sentença em justiça; pois ele fará uma breve sentença sobre a terra”.
verses.RVR09: Porque palabra consumadora y abreviadora en justicia, porque palabra abreviada, hará el Señor sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.WEB: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
verses.ASV: And, as Isaiah hath said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, We had become as Sodom, and had been made like unto Gomorrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como Isaías predisse: “Se o Senhor dos Exércitos não houvesse nos deixado descendência, nós nos teríamos tornado como Sodoma, e como Gomorra teríamos sido semelhantes”.
verses.RVR09: Y como antes dijo Isaías: Si el Señor de los ejércitos no nos hubiera dejado simiente, como Sodoma habríamos venido á ser, y á Gomorra fuéramos semejantes.

verses.KJV: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.WEB: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
verses.ASV: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who followed not after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, que diremos? Que os gentios, que não buscavam a justiça, alcançaram a justiça, mas a justiça que é pela fé;
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues qué diremos? Que los Gentiles que no seguían justicia, han alcanzado la justicia, es á saber, la justicia que es por la fe;

verses.KJV: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.WEB: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
verses.ASV: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, did not arrive at [that] law.
verses.ALMEIDA: porém, Israel, que buscava a Lei da justiça, não alcançou a Lei da justiça
verses.RVR09: Mas Israel que seguía la ley de justicia, no ha llegado á la ley de justicia.

verses.KJV: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.WEB: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
verses.ASV: Wherefore? Because [they sought it] not by faith, but as it were by works. They stumbled at the stone of stumbling;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por quê? Porque não [a buscavam] pela fé, mas sim, como que pelas obras da Lei;pois tropeçaram na pedra de tropeço,
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué? Porque la seguían no por fe, mas como por las obras de la ley: por lo cual tropezaron en la piedra de tropiezo,

verses.KJV: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.WEB: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
verses.ASV: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: como está escrito: “Eis que ponho em Sião uma pedra de tropeço, e uma rocha que causa queda; e todo aquele que nela crer não será envergonhado”.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: He aquí pongo en Sión piedra de tropiezo, y piedra de caída; y aquel que creyere en ella, no será avergonzado.

verses.KJV: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.WEB: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
verses.ASV: Brethren, my heart’s desire and my supplication to God is for them, that they may be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, o bom desejo do meu coração, e a oração que [faço] a Deus por Israel, é que sejam salvos.
verses.RVR09: HERMANOS, ciertamente la voluntad de mi corazón y mi oración á Dios sobre Israel, es para salud.

verses.KJV: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.WEB: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.ASV: For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois lhes dou testemunho de que eles têm zelo por Deus, mas não com entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo les doy testimonio que tienen celo de Dios, mas no conforme á ciencia.

verses.KJV: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.WEB: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
verses.ASV: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own, they did not subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, como ignoraram a justiça de Deus, e procuraram estabelecer a sua própria justiça, eles não se sujeitaram à justiça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque ignorando la justicia de Dios, y procurando establecer la suya propia, no se han sujetado á la justicia de Dios.

verses.KJV: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.WEB: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
verses.ASV: For Christ is the end of the law unto righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o fim da Lei é Cristo, para justiça de todo aquele que crê.
verses.RVR09: Porque el fin de la ley es Cristo, para justicia á todo aquel que cree.

verses.KJV: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.WEB: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
verses.ASV: For Moses writeth that the man that doeth the righteousness which is of the law shall live thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Moisés descreve a justiça que é pela Lei: “A pessoa que praticar estas coisas viverá por elas”.
verses.RVR09: Porque Moisés describe la justicia que es por la ley: Que el hombre que hiciere estas cosas, vivirá por ellas.

verses.KJV: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
verses.WEB: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
verses.ASV: But the righteousness which is of faith saith thus, Say not in thy heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down:)
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a justiça que é pela fé assim diz: “Não digas em teu coração: ‘Quem subirá ao céu?’ (Isto é, trazer Cristo abaixo),
verses.RVR09: Mas la justicia que es por la fe dice así: No digas en tu corazón: ¿Quién subirá al cielo? (esto es, para traer abajo á Cristo:)

verses.KJV: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.WEB: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
verses.ASV: or, Who shall descend into the abyss? (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)
verses.ALMEIDA: ou: ‘Quem descerá ao abismo?’” (Isto é, trazer Cristo dentre os mortos).
verses.RVR09: O, ¿quién descenderá al abismo? (esto es, para volver á traer á Cristo de los muertos.)

verses.KJV: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.WEB: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
verses.ASV: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, o que diz? “A palavra está perto de ti, na tua boca, e no teu coração”. Esta é a palavra da fé, que pregamos.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué dice? Cercana está la palabra, en tu boca y en tu corazón. Esta es la palabra de fe, la cual predicamos:

verses.KJV: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.WEB: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.ASV: because if thou shalt confess with thy mouth Jesus [as] Lord, and shalt believe in thy heart that God raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se com a tua boca declarares que Jesus é Senhor, e em teu coração creres que Deus o ressuscitou dos mortos, serás salvo.
verses.RVR09: Que si confesares con tu boca al Señor Jesús, y creyeres en tu corazón que Dios le levantó de los muertos, serás salvo.

verses.KJV: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.WEB: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
verses.ASV: for with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois com o coração se crê para a justiça, e com a boca se confessa para a salvação.
verses.RVR09: Porque con el corazón se cree para justicia; mas con la boca se hace confesión para salud.

verses.KJV: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.WEB: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
verses.ASV: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a Escritura diz: “Todo aquele que nele crê não será envergonhado.”
verses.RVR09: Porque la Escritura dice: Todo aquel que en él creyere, no será avergonzado.

verses.KJV: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.WEB: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
verses.ASV: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek: for the same [Lord] is Lord of all, and is rich unto all that call upon him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não há diferença entre judeu e grego, porque um mesmo é o Senhor de todos, rico para todos os que o invocam.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay diferencia de Judío y de Griego: porque el mismo que es Señor de todos, rico es para con todos los que le invocan:

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.WEB: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
verses.ASV: for, Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois: “Todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.”
verses.RVR09: Porque todo aquel que invocare el nombre del Señor, será salvo.

verses.KJV: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.WEB: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
verses.ASV: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas como invocarão aquele em quem não creram? E como crerão naquele de quem não ouviram? E como ouvirão, sem haver quem pregue?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo, pues invocarán á aquel en el cual no han creído? ¿y cómo creerán á aquel de quien no han oído? ¿y cómo oirán sin haber quien les predique?

verses.KJV: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.WEB: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
verses.ASV: and how shall they preach, except they be sent? even as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.ALMEIDA: E como pregarão, se não forem enviados? Como está escrito: “Como são agradáveis os pés dos que anunciam o evangelho da paz, dos que anunciam as boas novas!”
verses.RVR09: ¿Y cómo predicarán si no fueren enviados? Como está escrito: ¡Cuán hermosos son los pies de los que anuncian el evangelio de la paz, de los que anuncian el evangelio de los bienes!

verses.KJV: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.WEB: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
verses.ASV: But they did not all hearken to the glad tidings. For Isaiah saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nem todos obedeceram ao evangelho, pois Isaías diz: “Senhor, quem creu na nossa pregação?”
verses.RVR09: Mas no todos obedecen al evangelio; pues Isaías dice: Señor, ¿quién ha creído á nuestro anuncio?

verses.KJV: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.WEB: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.ASV: So belief [cometh] of hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, a fé [vem] pelo ouvir, e o ouvir pela palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Luego la fe es por el oir; y el oir por la palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.WEB: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
verses.ASV: But I say, Did they not hear? Yea, verily, Their sound went out into all the earth, And their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas pergunto: por acaso não ouviram? Sim, certamente. [Pois:] “Sua voz saiu por toda a terra, e suas palavras até os confins do mundo.”
verses.RVR09: Mas digo: ¿No han oído? Antes bien, por toda la tierra ha salido la fama de ellos, y hasta los cabos de la redondez de la tierra las palabras de ellos.

verses.KJV: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.WEB: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
verses.ASV: But I say, Did Israel not know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, With a nation void of understanding will I anger you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas pergunto: por acaso Israel não entendeu? Primeiramente Moisés disse: “Eu vos provocarei ciúmes com os que não são do povo; com uma nação insensata vos provocarei à ira.”
verses.RVR09: Mas digo: ¿No ha conocido esto Israel? Primeramente Moisés dice: Yo os provocaré á celos con gente que no es mía; con gente insensata os provocaré á ira.

verses.KJV: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.WEB: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
verses.ASV: And Isaiah is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I became manifest unto them that asked not of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Isaías ousou dizer: “Fui achado pelos que não me buscavam; fui revelado aos que por mim não perguntavam.”
verses.RVR09: E Isaías determinadamente dice: Fuí hallado de los que no me buscaban; manifestéme á los que no preguntaban por mí.

verses.KJV: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.WEB: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
verses.ASV: But as to Israel he saith, All the day long did I spread out my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sobre Israel diz: “Todo o dia estendi as minhas mãos a um povo rebelde e hostil.”
verses.RVR09: Mas acerca de Israel dice: Todo el día extendí mis manos á un pueblo rebelde y contradictor.

verses.KJV: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.WEB: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.ASV: I say then, Did God cast off his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então pergunto: por acaso Deus rejeitou seu povo? De maneira nenhuma! Pois também eu sou israelita, da descendência de Abraão, da tribo de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: DIGO pues: ¿Ha desechado Dios á su pueblo? En ninguna manera. Porque también yo soy Israelita, de la simiente de Abraham, de la tribu de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel saying,
verses.WEB: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
verses.ASV: God did not cast off his people which he foreknew. Or know ye not what the scripture saith of Elijah? how he pleadeth with God against Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus não rejeitou seu povo, o qual desde antes conhecia. Ou não sabeis o que a Escritura diz de Elias? Como ele fala a Deus, contra Israel, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: No ha desechado Dios á su pueblo, al cual antes conoció. ¿O no sabéis qué dice de Elías la Escritura? cómo hablando con Dios contra Israel dice:

verses.KJV: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.WEB: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
verses.ASV: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, they have digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Senhor, mataram os teus profetas, e derrubaram os teus altares; só eu fiquei, e buscam tirar-me a vida.”
verses.RVR09: Señor, á tus profetas han muerto, y tus altares han derruído; y yo he quedado solo, y procuran matarme.

verses.KJV: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.WEB: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
verses.ASV: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have left for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que lhe disse a divina resposta? “Reservei para mim sete mil homens que não dobraram os joelhos a Baal.”
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué le dice la divina respuesta? He dejado para mí siete mil hombres, que no han doblado la rodilla delante de Baal.

verses.KJV: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.WEB: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.ASV: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, também agora no presente tempo ficou um remanescente, escolhido pela graça.
verses.RVR09: Así también, aun en este tiempo han quedado reliquias por la elección de gracia.

verses.KJV: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then it is no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.WEB: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
verses.ASV: But if it is by grace, it is no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se é pela graça, logo não é pelas obras; de outra maneira, a graça já não é graça. E se é pelas obras, logo não é [pela] graça; de outra maneira a obra já não é obra.
verses.RVR09: Y si por gracia, luego no por las obras; de otra manera la gracia ya no es gracia. Y si por las obras, ya no es gracia; de otra manera la obra ya no es obra.

verses.KJV: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
verses.WEB: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
verses.ASV: What then? That which Israel seeketh for, that he obtained not; but the election obtained it, and the rest were hardened:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, quê? O que Israel busca, isso não obteve; mas os escolhidos o obtiveram, e os demais foram endurecidos,
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues? Lo que buscaba Israel aquello no ha alcanzado; mas la elección lo ha alcanzado: y los demás fueron endurecidos;

verses.KJV: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.WEB: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
verses.ASV: according as it is written, God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, unto this very day.
verses.ALMEIDA: como está escrito: “Deus lhes deu espírito de insensibilidade; olhos que não veem, e ouvidos que não ouvem; até o dia de hoje.”
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: Dióles Dios espíritu de remordimiento, ojos con que no vean, y oídos con que no oigan, hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.WEB: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
verses.ASV: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, And a stumblingblock, and a recompense unto them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi diz: “A mesa deles se torne em laço e armadilha; em meio de tropeço e retribuição para eles.
verses.RVR09: Y David dice: Séales vuelta su mesa en lazo, y en red, y en tropezadero, y en paga:

verses.KJV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.WEB: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
verses.ASV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, And bow thou down their back always.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus olhos se escureçam, para que não vejam, e suas costas fiquem constantemente encurvadas.”
verses.RVR09: Sus ojos sean obscurecidos para que no vean, y agóbiales siempre el espinazo.

verses.KJV: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.WEB: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.ASV: I say then, Did they stumble that they might fall? God forbid: but by their fall salvation [is come] unto the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, pergunto: por acaso tropeçaram para que caíssem? De maneira nenhuma! Mas pela queda deles a salvação [veio] aos gentios, para lhes provocarem ciúmes.
verses.RVR09: Digo pues: ¿Han tropezado para que cayesen? En ninguna manera; mas por el tropiezo de ellos vino la salud á los Gentiles, para que fuesen provocados á celos.

verses.KJV: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.WEB: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
verses.ASV: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se a queda deles é o enriquecimento do mundo, e se o prejuízo deles é o enriquecimento dos gentios, quanto mais a sua plenitude!
verses.RVR09: Y si la falta de ellos es la riqueza del mundo, y el menoscabo de ellos la riqueza de los Gentiles, ¿cuánto más el henchimiento de ellos?

verses.KJV: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.WEB: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
verses.ASV: But I speak to you that are Gentiles. Inasmuch then as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois falo a vós mesmos, gentios; como sou apóstolo dos gentios, honro meu ministério,
verses.RVR09: Porque á vosotros hablo, Gentiles. Por cuanto pues, yo soy apóstol de los Gentiles, mi ministerio honro,

verses.KJV: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.WEB: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
verses.ASV: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy [them that are] my flesh, and may save some of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que, de alguma maneira, eu provoque ciúmes aos do meu povo, e salve alguns deles.
verses.RVR09: Por si en alguna manera provocase á celos á mi carne, é hiciese salvos á algunos de ellos.

verses.KJV: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.WEB: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
verses.ASV: For if the casting away of them [is] the reconciling of the world, what [shall] the receiving [of them be], but life from the dead?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se a rejeição deles é a reconciliação do mundo, o que será sua admissão, senão vida dentre os mortos?
verses.RVR09: Porque si el extrañamiento de ellos es la reconciliación del mundo, ¿qué será el recibimiento de ellos, sino vida de los muertos?

verses.KJV: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.WEB: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.ASV: And if the firstfruit is holy, so is the lump: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se as primícias são santas, a massa também é; e se a raiz é santa, os ramos também são.
verses.RVR09: Y si el primer fruto es santo, también lo es el todo, y si la raíz es santa, también lo son las ramas.

verses.KJV: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert grafted in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.WEB: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
verses.ASV: But if some of the branches were broken off, and thou, being a wild olive, wast grafted in among them, and didst become partaker with them of the root of the fatness of the olive tree;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se alguns dos ramos foram quebrados e separados, e sendo tu oliveira selvagem, foste enxertado no lugar deles, e feito participante da raiz, e nutrido pela boa oliveira,
verses.RVR09: Que si algunas de las ramas fueron quebradas, y tú, siendo acebuche, has sido ingerido en lugar de ellas, y has sido hecho participante de la raíz y de la grosura de la oliva;

verses.KJV: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.WEB: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
verses.ASV: glory not over the branches: but if thou gloriest, it is not thou that bearest the root, but the root thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: não te orgulhes de ser melhor que os ramos. Mesmo se te orgulhares, não és tu que sustentas a raiz, mas sim, a raiz a ti.
verses.RVR09: No te jactes contra las ramas; y si te jactas, sabe que no sustentas tú á la raíz, sino la raíz á ti.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.
verses.WEB: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
verses.ASV: Thou wilt say then, Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, então, dirás: “Os ramos foram quebrados para que eu fosse enxertado.”
verses.RVR09: Pues las ramas, dirás, fueron quebradas para que yo fuese ingerido.

verses.KJV: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.WEB: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
verses.ASV: Well; by their unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by thy faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.ALMEIDA: É verdade. Por causa da incredulidade eles foram quebrados, e tu, por causa da fé estás firme. Não tenhas orgulho, mas sim temor,
verses.RVR09: Bien: por su incredulidad fueron quebradas, mas tú por la fe estás en pie. No te ensoberbezcas, antes teme,

verses.KJV: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.WEB: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
verses.ASV: for if God spared not the natural branches, neither will he spare thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois, se Deus não poupou os ramos naturais, ele poderá não poupar a ti também.
verses.RVR09: Que si Dios no perdonó á las ramas naturales, á ti tampoco no perdone.

verses.KJV: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.WEB: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
verses.ASV: Behold then the goodness and severity of God: toward them that fell, severity; but toward thee, God’s goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha, pois, a bondade e severidade de Deus; a severidade sobre os que caíram, mas a bondade sobre ti, se continuares na bondade; de outra maneira, também tu serás cortado fora.
verses.RVR09: Mira, pues, la bondad y la severidad de Dios: la severidad ciertamente en los que cayeron; mas la bondad para contigo, si permanecieres en la bondad; pues de otra manera tú también serás cortado.

verses.KJV: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.WEB: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.ASV: And they also, if they continue not in their unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também eles, se não continuarem na incredulidade, serão enxertados, porque Deus é poderoso para enxertá-los de volta.
verses.RVR09: Y aun ellos, si no permanecieren en incredulidad, serán ingeridos; que poderoso es Dios para volverlos á ingerir.

verses.KJV: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.WEB: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.ASV: For if thou wast cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and wast grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree; how much more shall these, which are the natural [branches], be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se tu foste cortado da oliveira naturalmente selvagem, e contra a natureza enxertado na oliveira boa, quanto mais estes, que são naturais, serão enxertados na sua própria oliveira!
verses.RVR09: Porque si tú eres cortado del natural acebuche, y contra natura fuiste ingerido en la buena oliva, ¿cuánto más éstos, que son las ramas naturales, serán ingeridos en su oliva?

verses.KJV: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.WEB: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
verses.ASV: For I would not, brethren, have you ignorant of this mystery, lest ye be wise in your own conceits, that a hardening in part hath befallen Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não quero, irmãos, que ignoreis este mistério, para que não sejais sábios apenas a vós mesmos: o endurecimento veio em parte sobre Israel, até que a plenitude dos gentios tenha entrado;
verses.RVR09: Porque no quiero, hermanos, que ignoréis este misterio, para que no seáis acerca de vosotros mismos arrogantes: que el endurecimiento en parte ha acontecido en Israel, hasta que haya entrado la plenitud de los Gentiles;

verses.KJV: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.WEB: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
verses.ASV: and so all Israel shall be saved: even as it is written, There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer; He shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.ALMEIDA: e assim, todo o Israel será salvo, como está escrito: “O Libertador virá de Sião, e afastará as irreverências de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y luego todo Israel será salvo; como está escrito: Vendrá de Sión el Libertador, que quitará de Jacob la impiedad;

verses.KJV: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.WEB: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
verses.ASV: And this is my covenant unto them, When I shall take away their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este será o meu pacto com eles, quando eu tirar os seus pecados.”
verses.RVR09: Y este es mi pacto con ellos, cuando quitare su pecados.

verses.KJV: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.
verses.WEB: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
verses.ASV: As touching the gospel, they are enemies for your sake: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, quanto ao Evangelho, eles são inimigos, para benefício vosso; mas quanto à escolha [divina] , são amados, por causa dos patriarcas.
verses.RVR09: Así que, cuanto al evangelio, son enemigos por causa de vosotros: mas cuanto á la elección, son muy amados por causa de los padres.

verses.KJV: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.WEB: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.ASV: For the gifts and the calling of God are not repented of.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os dons gratuitos e o chamado da parte de Deus não podem ser cancelados.
verses.RVR09: Porque sin arrepentimiento son las mercedes y la vocación de Dios.

verses.KJV: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.WEB: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
verses.ASV: For as ye in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, assim como vós também antigamente fostes desobedientes a Deus, agora recebestes misericórdia pela desobediência deles,
verses.RVR09: Porque como también vosotros en algún tiempo no creísteis á Dios, mas ahora habéis alcanzado misericordia por la incredulidad de ellos;
