verses.KJV: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.WEB: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
verses.ASV: even so have these also now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they also may now obtain mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim também agora eles foram desobedientes, a fim de que, pela misericórdia que foi a vós [concedida] , eles também recebam misericórdia;
verses.RVR09: Así también éstos ahora no han creído, para que, por la misericordia para con vosotros, ellos también alcancen misericordia.

verses.KJV: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.WEB: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
verses.ASV: For God hath shut up all unto disobedience, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque Deus pôs todos debaixo da desobediência, a fim de ter misericórdia para com todos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios encerró á todos en incredulidad, para tener misericordia de todos.

verses.KJV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.WEB: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
verses.ASV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó profundidade das riquezas, tanto da sabedoria como do conhecimento de Deus! Quão incompreensíveis são os seus juízos, e inimagináveis os seus caminhos!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh profundidad de las riquezas de la sabiduría y de la ciencia de Dios! ¡Cuán incomprensibles son sus juicios, é inescrutables sus caminos!

verses.KJV: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.WEB: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
verses.ASV: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem entendeu a mentalidade do Senhor? Ou quem foi o seu conselheiro?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién entendió la mente del Señor? ¿ó quién fué su consejero?

verses.KJV: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.WEB: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
verses.ASV: or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou quem lhe deu primeiro, para ser por ele recompensado?
verses.RVR09: ¿O quién le dió á él primero, para que le sea pagado?

verses.KJV: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
verses.ASV: For of him, and through him, and unto him, are all things. To him [be] the glory for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque dele, por ele, e para ele, [são] todas as coisas! A ele [ seja] a glória eternamente! Amém!
verses.RVR09: Porque de él, y por él, y en él, son todas las cosas. A él sea gloria por siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.WEB: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
verses.ASV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] your spiritual service.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-vos, pois, irmãos, pelas misericórdias de Deus, que apresenteis os vossos corpos como sacrifício vivo, santo e agradável a Deus, [que é] o vosso culto racional.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, hermanos, os ruego por las misericordias de Dios, que presentéis vuestros cuerpos en sacrificio vivo, santo, agradable á Dios, que es vuestro racional culto.

verses.KJV: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.WEB: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
verses.ASV: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não vos conformeis com a presente era; mas transformai-vos pela renovação da vossa mentalidade, para que experimenteis qual seja a boa, agradável, e perfeita vontade de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no os conforméis á este siglo; mas reformaos por la renovación de vuestro entendimiento, para que experimentéis cuál sea la buena voluntad de Dios, agradable y perfecta.

verses.KJV: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.WEB: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
verses.ASV: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but so to think as to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to each man a measure of faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, pela graça que me foi dada, digo a cada um dentre vós que não se estime mais do que convém se estimar; em vez disso, cada um estime a si mesmo com bom senso, conforme a medida de fé que Deus repartiu a cada um.
verses.RVR09: Digo pues por la gracia que me es dada, á cada cual que está entre vosotros, que no tenga más alto concepto de sí que el que debe tener, sino que piense de sí con templanza, conforme á la medida de fe que Dios repartió á cada uno.

verses.KJV: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.WEB: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
verses.ASV: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members have not the same office:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como em um corpo temos muitos membros, e nem todos os membros têm a mesma função,
verses.RVR09: Porque de la manera que en un cuerpo tenemos muchos miembros, empero todos los miembros no tienen la misma operación;

verses.KJV: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.WEB: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
verses.ASV: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and severally members one of another.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim também nós, [ainda que] muitos, somos um único corpo em Cristo; porém, individualmente, membros uns dos outros.
verses.RVR09: Así muchos somos un cuerpo en Cristo, mas todos miembros los unos de los otros.

verses.KJV: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.WEB: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
verses.ASV: And having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, whether prophecy, [let us prophesy] according to the proportion of our faith;
verses.ALMEIDA: Temos, contudo, diferentes dons, segundo a graça que nos foi dada: se é o de profecia, seja segundo a medida da fé;
verses.RVR09: De manera que, teniendo diferentes dones según la gracia que nos es dada, si el de profecía, úsese conforme á la medida de la fe;

verses.KJV: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.WEB: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
verses.ASV: or ministry, [let us give ourselves] to our ministry; or he that teacheth, to his teaching;
verses.ALMEIDA: se é o de serviço, seja em servir; se é o de ensino, seja em ensinar;
verses.RVR09: O si ministerio, en servir; ó el que enseña, en doctrina;

verses.KJV: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.WEB: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.ASV: or he that exhorteth, to his exhorting: he that giveth, [let him do it] with liberality; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: se é o de exortação, seja em exortar; o que reparte, [reparta] com generosidade; o que lidera, [lidere] com empenho, o que usa de misericórdia, [faça-o] com alegria.
verses.RVR09: El que exhorta, en exhortar; el que reparte, hágalo en simplicidad; el que preside, con solicitud; el que hace misericordia, con alegría.

verses.KJV: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.WEB: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
verses.ASV: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: O amor seja sem hipocrisia. Odiai o mal, e apegai-vos ao bem.
verses.RVR09: El amor sea sin fingimiento: aborreciendo lo malo, llegándoos á lo bueno;

verses.KJV: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.WEB: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
verses.ASV: In love of the brethren be tenderly affectioned one to another; in honor preferring one another;
verses.ALMEIDA: Amai-vos cordialmente uns aos outros com amor de irmãos, preferindo honrar uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Amándoos los unos á los otros con caridad fraternal; previniéndoos con honra los unos á los otros;

verses.KJV: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.WEB: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
verses.ASV: in diligence not slothful; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejais vagarosos em mostrardes empenho. Sede fervorosos de espírito. Servi ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: En el cuidado no perezosos; ardientes en espíritu; sirviendo al Señor;

verses.KJV: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.WEB: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
verses.ASV: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos na esperança. Sede pacientes na aflição. Perseverai na oração.
verses.RVR09: Gozosos en la esperanza; sufridos en la tribulación; constantes en la oración;

verses.KJV: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.WEB: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
verses.ASV: communicating to the necessities of the saints; given to hospitality.
verses.ALMEIDA: Compartilhai com os santos em suas necessidades. Buscai ser hospitaleiros.
verses.RVR09: Comunicando á las necesidades de los santos; siguiendo la hospitalidad.

verses.KJV: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.WEB: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
verses.ASV: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abençoai os que vos perseguem; abençoai, e não amaldiçoeis.
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á los que os persiguen: bendecid, y no maldigáis.

verses.KJV: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.WEB: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
verses.ASV: Rejoice with them that rejoice; weep with them that weep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos com os que se alegram, e chorai com os que choram.
verses.RVR09: Gozaos con los que se gozan: llorad con los que lloran.

verses.KJV: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.WEB: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
verses.ASV: Be of the same mind one toward another. Set not your mind on high things, but condescend to things that are lowly. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estimai-vos uns aos outros como semelhantes. Não fiqueis pensando com soberba; em vez disso, acompanhai-vos dos humildes. Não sejais sábios em vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Unánimes entre vosotros: no altivos, mas acomodándoos á los humildes. No seáis sabios en vuestra opinión.

verses.KJV: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.WEB: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
verses.ASV: Render to no man evil for evil. Take thought for things honorable in the sight of all men.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ninguém pagueis o mal com o mal; buscai fazer o que é certo diante de todos.
verses.RVR09: No paguéis á nadie mal por mal; procurad lo bueno delante de todos los hombres.

verses.KJV: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.WEB: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
verses.ASV: If it be possible, as much as in you lieth, be at peace with all men.
verses.ALMEIDA: No que for possível de vossa parte, tende paz com todos.
verses.RVR09: Si se puede hacer, cuanto está en vosotros, tened paz con todos los hombres.

verses.KJV: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
verses.ASV: Avenge not yourselves, beloved, but give place unto the wrath [of God]: for it is written, Vengeance belongeth unto me; I will recompense, saith the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos vingueis por vós mesmos, amados. Em vez disso, dai lugar à ira [divina] ,porque está escrito: A mim pertence a vingança, eu retribuirei, diz o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: No os venguéis vosotros mismos, amados míos; antes dad lugar á la ira; porque escrito está: Mía es la venganza: yo pagaré, dice el Señor.

verses.KJV: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.WEB: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
verses.ASV: But if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him to drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se o teu inimigo tiver fome, dá-lhe de comer; se tiver sede, dá-lhe de beber. Pois, quando fizeres isto, estarás amontoando brasas de fogo sobre a cabeça dele.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si tu enemigo tuviere hambre, dale de comer; si tuviere sed, dale de beber: que haciendo esto, ascuas de fuego amontonas sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.WEB: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.ASV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas vencido pelo mal, mas vence o mal com o bem.
verses.RVR09: No seas vencido de lo malo; mas vence con el bien el mal.

verses.KJV: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
verses.WEB: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
verses.ASV: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher powers: for there is no power but of God; and the [powers] that be are ordained of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda pessoa esteja sujeita às autoridades superiores, porque não há autoridade que não seja da parte de Deus; e as autoridades que existem são ordenadas por Deus.
verses.RVR09: TODA alma se someta á las potestades superiores; porque no hay potestad sino de Dios; y las que son, de Dios son ordenadas.

verses.KJV: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.WEB: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
verses.ASV: Therefore he that resisteth the power, withstandeth the ordinance of God: and they that withstand shall receive to themselves judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, quem se opõe à autoridade resiste à ordem de Deus; e os que lhe resistem trarão a si mesmos condenação.
verses.RVR09: Así que, el que se opone á la potestad, á la ordenación de Dios resiste: y los que resisten, ellos mismos ganan condenación para sí.

verses.KJV: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
verses.WEB: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
verses.ASV: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. And wouldest thou have no fear of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise from the same:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os que possuem autoridade não causam temor às boas obras, mas sim, às más. Queres tu não ter medo de autoridade? Faz o bem, e dela receberás elogio,
verses.RVR09: Porque los magistrados no son para temor al que bien hace, sino al malo. ¿Quieres pues no temer la potestad? haz lo bueno, y tendrás alabanza de ella;

verses.KJV: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
verses.WEB: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
verses.ASV: for he is a minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is a minister of God, an avenger for wrath to him that doeth evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque ela é serva de Deus para o teu bem. Porém, se fizeres o mal, teme; porque ela não traz a espada em vão. Pois é serva de Deus, vingadora, para castigar a quem faz o mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque es ministro de Dios para tu bien. Mas si hicieres lo malo, teme: porque no en vano lleva el cuchillo; porque es ministro de Dios, vengador para castigo al que hace lo malo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.WEB: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
verses.ASV: Wherefore [ye] must needs be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, é necessário estar sujeito não somente por causa do castigo, mas também por causa da consciência.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual es necesario que le estéis sujetos, no solamente por la ira, mas aun por la conciencia.

verses.KJV: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.WEB: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
verses.ASV: For for this cause ye pay tribute also; for they are ministers of God’s service, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também pagais impostos; porque são servidores de Deus, atendendo a essa função.
verses.RVR09: Porque por esto pagáis también los tributos; porque son ministros de Dios que sirven á esto mismo.

verses.KJV: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.WEB: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
verses.ASV: Render to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute [is due]; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honor to whom honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, dai a cada um o que deveis; a quem imposto, imposto; a quem taxa, taxa; a quem temor, temor; a quem honra, honra.
verses.RVR09: Pagad á todos lo que debéis: al que tributo, tributo; al que pecho, pecho; al que temor, temor; al que honra, honra.

verses.KJV: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.WEB: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
verses.ASV: Owe no man anything, save to love one another: for he that loveth his neighbor hath fulfilled the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ninguém devais coisa alguma, a não ser o amor uns aos outros, pois quem ama o outro tem cumprido a Lei.
verses.RVR09: No debáis á nadie nada, sino amaros unos á otros; porque el que ama al prójimo, cumplió la ley.

verses.KJV: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.WEB: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.ASV: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not covet, and if there be any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estes [mandamentos] : não adulterarás, não matarás, não roubarás, não dirás falso testemunho, não cobiçarás; e qualquer outro mandamento que há, nesta frase se resumem: “Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo”.
verses.RVR09: Porque: No adulterarás; no matarás; no hurtarás; no dirás falso testimonio; no codiciarás; y si hay algún otro mandamiento, en esta sentencia se comprende sumariamente: Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo.

verses.KJV: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.WEB: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
verses.ASV: Love worketh no ill to his neighbor: love therefore is the fulfilment of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: O amor não faz mal ao próximo. Assim, o cumprimento da Lei é o amor.
verses.RVR09: La caridad no hace mal al prójimo: así que, el cumplimento de la ley es la caridad.

verses.KJV: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.WEB: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
verses.ASV: And this, knowing the season, that already it is time for you to awake out of sleep: for now is salvation nearer to us than when we [first] believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, conheceis o tempo, que já é hora de despertarmos do sono, porque a salvação está agora mais perto de nós do que quando começamos a crer.
verses.RVR09: Y esto, conociendo el tiempo, que es ya hora de levantarnos del sueño; porque ahora nos está más cerca nuestra salud que cuando creímos.

verses.KJV: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.WEB: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
verses.ASV: The night is far spent, and the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
verses.ALMEIDA: A noite está se acabando, e o dia, chegando. Deixemos, pois, as obras das trevas, e vistamo-nos das armas da luz.
verses.RVR09: La noche ha pasado, y ha llegado el día: echemos, pues, las obras de las tinieblas, y vistámonos las armas de luz.

verses.KJV: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.WEB: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
verses.ASV: Let us walk becomingly, as in the day; not in revelling and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Andemos de maneira decente, como de dia; não em orgias e bebedeiras; não em pecados sexuais ou depravações; não em brigas, nem em inveja.
verses.RVR09: Andemos como de día, honestamente: no en glotonerías y borracheras, no en lechos y disoluciones, no en pedencias y envidia:

verses.KJV: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.WEB: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
verses.ASV: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to [fulfil] the lusts [thereof].
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, revesti-vos do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e não fiqueis pensando em [realizar] os desejos da carne.
verses.RVR09: Mas vestíos del Señor Jesucristo, y no hagáis caso de la carne en sus deseos.

verses.KJV: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.WEB: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
verses.ASV: But him that is weak in faith receive ye, [yet] not for decision of scruples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Recebei a quem for fraco na fé, mas não para [envolvê-lo] em temas controversos.
verses.RVR09: RECIBID al flaco en la fe, pero no para contiendas de disputas.

verses.KJV: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.WEB: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
verses.ASV: One man hath faith to eat all things: but he that is weak eateth herbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um crê que pode comer de tudo, e outro, que é fraco, come [somente] vegetais.
verses.RVR09: Porque uno cree que se ha de comer de todas cosas: otro que es débil, come legumbres.

verses.KJV: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.WEB: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
verses.ASV: Let not him that eateth set at nought him that eateth not; and let not him that eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que come não despreze o que não come, e o que não come não julgue o que come, porque Deus o aceitou.
verses.RVR09: El que come, no menosprecie al que no come: y el que no come, no juzgue al que come; porque Dios le ha levantado.

verses.KJV: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.WEB: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
verses.ASV: Who art thou that judgest the servant of another? to his own lord he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be made to stand; for the Lord hath power to make him stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem és tu para julgares o servo alheio? É ao seu próprio senhor que ele fica firme ou cai. E ele ficará firme, porque Deus é poderoso para o firmar.
verses.RVR09: ¿Tú quién eres que juzgas al siervo ajeno? para su señor está en pie, ó cae: mas se afirmará; que poderoso es el Señor para afirmarle.

verses.KJV: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.WEB: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
verses.ASV: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um faz diferença entre um dia e outro; porém outro considera iguais todos os dias. Cada um mantenha certeza em sua própria mente.
verses.RVR09: Uno hace diferencia entre día y día; otro juzga iguales todos los días. Cada uno esté asegurado en su ánimo.

verses.KJV: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.WEB: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
verses.ASV: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord: and he that eateth, eateth unto the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, unto the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que faz diferença entre dias, para o Senhor a faz; e aquele que não faz diferença entre dias, para o Senhor não a faz. O que come, come para o Senhor, porque dá graças a Deus; e o que não come, deixa de comer para o Senhor, e dá graças a Deus.
verses.RVR09: El que hace caso del día, hácelo para el Señor: y el que no hace caso del día, no lo hace para el Señor. El que come, come para el Señor, porque da gracias á Dios; y el que no come, no come para el Señor, y da gracias á Dios.

verses.KJV: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.WEB: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
verses.ASV: For none of us liveth to himself, and none dieth to himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nenhum de nós vive para si mesmo; e nenhum morre para si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Porque ninguno de nosotros vive para sí, y ninguno muere para sí.

verses.KJV: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
verses.WEB: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.ASV: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; or whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, se vivemos, para o Senhor vivemos; e se morremos, para o Senhor morremos. Portanto, quer vivamos, quer morramos, do Senhor somos.
verses.RVR09: Que si vivimos, para el Señor vivimos; y si morimos, para el Señor morimos. Así que, ó que vivamos, ó que muramos, del Señor somos.

verses.KJV: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.WEB: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.ASV: For to this end Christ died and lived [again], that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois para isto Cristo também morreu, ressuscitou, e voltou a viver, para ser Senhor tanto dos mortos como dos vivos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Cristo para esto murió, y resucitó, y volvió á vivir, para ser Señor así de los muertos como de los que viven.

verses.KJV: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.WEB: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.ASV: But thou, why dost thou judge thy brother? or thou again, why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment-seat of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, por que julgas o teu irmão? Ou tu também, por que desprezas o teu irmão? Pois todos nós seremos apresentados diante do tribunal de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú ¿por qué juzgas á tu hermano? ó tú también, ¿por qué menosprecias á tu hermano? porque todos hemos de estar ante el tribunal de Cristo.

verses.KJV: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.WEB: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
verses.ASV: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, to me every knee shall bow, And every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque está escrito: [“Tão certo como] eu vivo, diz o Senhor, que todo joelho se dobrará diante de mim, e toda língua confessará a Deus”;
verses.RVR09: Porque escrito está: Vivo yo, dice el Señor, que á mí se doblará toda rodilla, y toda lengua confesará á Dios.

verses.KJV: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.WEB: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
verses.ASV: So then each one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: de maneira que cada um de nós dará conta de si mesmo a Deus.
verses.RVR09: De manera que, cada uno de nosotros dará á Dios razón de sí.

verses.KJV: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
verses.WEB: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
verses.ASV: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge ye this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock in his brother’s way, or an occasion of falling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não julguemos mais uns aos outros; em vez disso, tomai a decisão de nunca pôr alguma pedra de obstáculo ou de tropeço diante do seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no juzguemos más los unos de los otros: antes bien juzgad de no poner tropiezo ó escándalo al hermano.

verses.KJV: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.WEB: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.ASV: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself: save that to him who accounteth anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei, e tenho certeza no Senhor Jesus, que nada é impuro por si mesmo; a não ser para quem o considera impuro: aquilo para ele se torna impuro.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé, y confío en el Señor Jesús, que de suyo nada hay inmundo: mas á aquel que piensa alguna cosa ser inmunda, para él es inmunda.

verses.KJV: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.WEB: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
verses.ASV: For if because of meat thy brother is grieved, thou walkest no longer in love. Destroy not with thy meat him for whom Christ died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se por causa do que comes o teu irmão se entristece, tu já não estás andando segundo o amor. Não destruas por tua comida aquele por quem Cristo morreu.
verses.RVR09: Empero si por causa de la comida tu hermano es contristado, ya no andas conforme á la caridad. No arruines con tu comida á aquél por el cual Cristo murió.

verses.KJV: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.WEB: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
verses.ASV: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não seja insultado o vosso bem,
verses.RVR09: No sea pues blasfemado vuestro bien:

verses.KJV: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o reino de Deus não é comida nem bebida, mas sim justiça, paz, e alegria no Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Que el reino de Dios no es comida ni bebida, sino justicia y paz y gozo por el Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.WEB: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
verses.ASV: For he that herein serveth Christ is well-pleasing to God, and approved of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem nessas coisas serve a Cristo é agradável a Deus e aprovado pelas pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que en esto sirve á Cristo, agrada á Dios, y es acepto á los hombres.

verses.KJV: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.WEB: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
verses.ASV: So then let us follow after things which make for peace, and things whereby we may edify one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sigamos, pois, as coisas que [resultam em] paz e edificação de uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Así que, sigamos lo que hace á la paz, y á la edificación de los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.WEB: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
verses.ASV: Overthrow not for meat’s sake the work of God. All things indeed are clean; howbeit it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não destruas a obra de Deus por causa da comida. É verdade que todas as coisas são limpas, porém mau é ao ser humano comer causando ofensa.
verses.RVR09: No destruyas la obra de Dios por causa de la comida. Todas las cosas á la verdad son limpias: mas malo es al hombre que come con escándalo.

verses.KJV: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.WEB: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
verses.ASV: It is good not to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [to do anything] whereby thy brother stumbleth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é bom comer carne, nem beber vinho, nem [qualquer coisa] que faça o teu irmão tropeçar, ou se ofender, ou enfraquecer.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es no comer carne, ni beber vino, ni nada en que tu hermano tropiece, ó se ofenda, ó sea debilitado.

verses.KJV: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.WEB: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
verses.ASV: The faith which thou hast, have thou to thyself before God. Happy is he that judgeth not himself in that which he approveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A convicção que tu tens, tenha-a para ti mesmo diante de Deus. Feliz é quem não se culpa naquilo que aprova.
verses.RVR09: ¿Tienes tú fe? Tenla para contigo delante de Dios. Bienaventurado el que no se condena á sí mismo con lo que aprueba.

verses.KJV: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.WEB: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
verses.ASV: But he that doubteth is condemned if he eat, because [he eateth] not of faith; and whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que tem dúvida, se comer, é culpado, porque não foi pela fé; e tudo que não é pela fé é pecado.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que hace diferencia, si comiere, es condenado, porque no comió por fe: y todo lo que no es de fe, es pecado.

verses.KJV: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.WEB: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.ASV: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós, que somos fortes, devemos suportar as fraquezas dos fracos, e não agradar a nós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, los que somos más firmes debemos sobrellevar las flaquezas de los flacos, y no agradarnos á nosotros mismos.

verses.KJV: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.WEB: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
verses.ASV: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, unto edifying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, cada um de nós agrade ao próximo no que é bom para a edificação.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno de nosotros agrade á su prójimo en bien, á edificación.

verses.KJV: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
verses.WEB: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
verses.ASV: For Christ also pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois também Cristo não agradou a si mesmo; mas, como está escrito: “Os insultos dos que te insultavam caíram sobre mim”.
verses.RVR09: Porque Cristo no se agradó á sí mismo; antes bien, como está escrito: Los vituperios de los que te vituperan, cayeron sobre mí.

verses.KJV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.WEB: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.ASV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that through patience and through comfort of the scriptures we might have hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todas as coisas que foram escritas com antecedência foram escritas para o nosso ensino; para que, pela paciência e consolação das Escrituras, tenhamos esperança.
verses.RVR09: Porque las cosas que antes fueron escritas, para nuestra enseñanza fueron escritas; para que por la paciencia, y por la consolación de las Escrituras, tengamos esperanza.

verses.KJV: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: Now the God of patience and of comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus da paciência e da consolação vos dê a mesma mentalidade uns para com os outros, segundo Cristo Jesus,
verses.RVR09: Mas el Dios de la paciencia y de la consolación os dé que entre vosotros seáis unánimes según Cristo Jesús;

verses.KJV: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: that with one accord ye may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que, em comum acordo, como uma só boca, glorifiqueis ao Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Para que concordes, á una boca glorifiquéis al Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
verses.WEB: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
verses.ASV: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, recebei uns aos outros, assim como também Cristo nos recebeu para a glória de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, sobrellevaos los unos á los otros, como también Cristo nos sobrellevó, para gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.WEB: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
verses.ASV: For I say that Christ hath been made a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises [given] unto the fathers,
verses.ALMEIDA: E digo que Jesus Cristo se tornou servidor da circuncisão por causa da verdade de Deus, para confirmar as promessas [feitas] aos patriarcas;
verses.RVR09: Digo, pues, que Cristo Jesús fué hecho ministro de la circuncisión por la verdad de Dios, para confirmar las promesas hechas á los padres,

verses.KJV: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
verses.WEB: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
verses.ASV: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: e para que os gentios glorifiquem a Deus por causa de [sua] misericórdia, como está escrito: “Por isso entre os gentios te confessarei, e ao teu nome cantarei.”
verses.RVR09: Y para que los Gentiles glorifiquen á Dios por la misericordia; como está escrito: Por tanto yo te confesaré entre los Gentiles, y cantaré á tu nombre.

verses.KJV: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.WEB: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
verses.ASV: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez diz: “Alegrai-vos, gentios, com o povo dele.”
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez dice: Alegraos, Gentiles, con su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
verses.WEB: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
verses.ASV: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez: “Louvai ao Senhor todas as nações, e celebrai-o todos os povos.”
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez: Alabad al Señor todos los Gentiles, y magnificadle, todos los pueblos.

verses.KJV: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.WEB: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
verses.ASV: And again, Isaiah saith, There shall be the root of Jesse, And he that ariseth to rule over the Gentiles; On him shall the Gentiles hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez Isaías diz: “Haverá a raiz de Jessé, e aquele que se levantará para governar as nações; nele os gentios esperarão.”
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez, dice Isaías: Estará la raíz de Jessé, y el que se levantará á regir los Gentiles: los Gentiles esperarán en él.

verses.KJV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus da esperança vos encha de toda alegria e paz na fé, para que abundeis em esperança no poder do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios de esperanza os llene de todo gozo y paz creyendo, para que abundéis en esperanza por la virtud del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.WEB: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
verses.ASV: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, meus irmãos, convencido estou acerca de vós de que também estais cheios de bondade, plenos de todo conhecimento, e capazes de também aconselhardes uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Empero cierto estoy yo de vosotros, hermanos míos, que aun vosotros mismos estáis llenos de bondad, llenos de todo conocimiento, de tal manera que podáis amonestaros los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
verses.WEB: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
verses.ASV: But I write the more boldly unto you in some measure, as putting you again in remembrance, because of the grace that was given me of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, irmãos, em parte vos escrevi com mais ousadia, como que para vos relembrar, por causa da graça que me foi dada por Deus,
verses.RVR09: Mas os he escrito, hermanos, en parte resueltamente, como amonestándoos por la gracia que de Dios me es dada,

verses.KJV: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus unto the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que eu seja um servidor de Jesus Cristo entre os gentios, ministrando o evangelho de Deus, para que a oferta dos gentios seja agradável, santificada pelo Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Para ser ministro de Jesucristo á los Gentiles, ministrando el evangelio de Dios, para que la ofrenda de los Gentiles sea agradable, santificada por el Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
verses.WEB: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
verses.ASV: I have therefore my glorying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eu me orgulho em Jesus Cristo das coisas relacionadas a Deus,
verses.RVR09: Tengo, pues, de qué gloriarme en Cristo Jesús en lo que mira á Dios.

verses.KJV: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
verses.WEB: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
verses.ASV: For I will not dare to speak of any things save those which Christ wrought through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu não ousaria falar coisa alguma, a não ser o que Cristo fez por meio de mim, para tornar os gentios obedientes, por meio da palavra e da obra,
verses.RVR09: Porque no osaría hablar alguna cosa que Cristo no haya hecho por mí para la obediencia de los Gentiles, con la palabra y con las obras,

verses.KJV: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.WEB: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
verses.ASV: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round about even unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: com poder de sinais e milagres, no poder do Espíritode Deus; de maneira que desde Jerusalém e redondezas até Ilírico, cumpri a pregação do Evangelho de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Con potencia de milagros y prodigios, en virtud del Espíritu de Dios: de manera que desde Jerusalem, y por los alrededores hasta Ilírico, he llenado todo del evangelio de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
verses.WEB: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
verses.ASV: yea, making it my aim so to preach the gospel, not where Christ was [already] named, that I might not build upon another man’s foundation;
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim quis muito anunciar o Evangelho onde Cristo não houvesse sido pregado, para que eu não construísse sobre fundamento alheio;
verses.RVR09: Y de esta manera me esforcé á predicar el evangelio, no donde antes Cristo fuese nombrado, por no edificar sobre ajeno fundamento:

verses.KJV: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.WEB: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
verses.ASV: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.
verses.ALMEIDA: ao contrário, como está escrito: “Aqueles a quem dele não foi anunciado [o] verão; e os que não ouviram entenderão.”
verses.RVR09: Sino, como está escrito: A los que no fué anunciado de él, verán: y los que no oyeron, entenderán.

verses.KJV: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.WEB: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
verses.ASV: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também muitas vezes tenho sido impedido de ir até vós.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual aun he sido impedido muchas veces de venir á vosotros.

verses.KJV: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.WEB: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
verses.ASV: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, como nessas regiões não há mais lugar em que eu precise trabalhar, e já por muitos anos tive grande desejo de ir até vós,
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora no teniendo más lugar en estas regiones, y deseando ir á vosotros muchos años há,

verses.KJV: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.WEB: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
verses.ASV: whensoever I go unto Spain (for I hope to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first in some measure I shall have been satisfied with your company)—
verses.ALMEIDA: quando eu for para a Espanha pois espero vos ver no caminho, e receber ajuda de vossa parte para a viagem, depois de primeiramente ficar um tempo satisfazendo o desejo de estar convosco.
verses.RVR09: Cuando partiere para España, iré á vosotros; porque espero que pasando os veré, y que seré llevado de vosotros allá, si empero antes hubiere gozado de vosotros.

verses.KJV: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.WEB: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
verses.ASV: but now, [I say], I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas por ora, vou a Jerusalém, a fim de auxiliar os santos.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora parto para Jerusalem á ministrar á los santos.

verses.KJV: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: For it hath been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints that are at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, aos da Macedônia e Acaia pareceu bem fazer uma contribuição para os pobres dentre os santos que estão em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Porque Macedonia y Acaya tuvieron por bien hacer una colecta para los pobres de los santos que están en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.WEB: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
verses.ASV: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it [to them] also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Isso] lhes pareceu bem, como quem está em dívida para com eles; porque, se os gentios foram participantes dos seus [bens] espirituais, devem também ajudá-los com os materiais.
verses.RVR09: Porque les pareció bueno, y son deudores á ellos: porque si los Gentiles han sido hechos participantes de sus bienes espirituales, deben también ellos servirles en los carnales.

verses.KJV: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.WEB: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
verses.ASV: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que eu concluir isso, e garantir [a entrega] desse fruto a eles, partirei para a Espanha passando para vos visitar.
verses.RVR09: Así que, cuando hubiere concluído esto, y les hubiere consignado este fruto, pasaré por vosotros á España.

verses.KJV: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.WEB: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
verses.ASV: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sei que, quando chegar até vós, virei com a plenitude da bênção do Evangelho de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y sé que cuando llegue á vosotros, llegaré con abundancia de la bendición del evangelio de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.WEB: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
verses.ASV: Now I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-vos, porém, irmãos, pelo nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e pelo amor do Espírito, que luteis comigo em orações a Deus por mim,
verses.RVR09: Ruégoos empero, hermanos, por el Señor nuestro Jesucristo, y por la caridad del Espíritu, que me ayudéis con oraciones por mí á Dios,

verses.KJV: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.WEB: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
verses.ASV: that I may be delivered from them that are disobedient in Judæa, and [that] my ministration which [I have] for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
verses.ALMEIDA: para que eu esteja livre dos rebeldes na Judeia, e que este meu serviço em Jerusalém seja bem aceito pelos santos,
verses.RVR09: Que sea librado de los rebeldes que están en Judea, y que la ofrenda de mi servicio á los santos en Jerusalem sea acepta;

verses.KJV: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
verses.WEB: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
verses.ASV: that I may come unto you in joy through the will of God, and together with you find rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que eu possa chegar até vós com alegria, pela vontade de Deus, e que eu possa descansar convosco.
verses.RVR09: Para que con gozo llegue á vosotros por la voluntad de Dios, y que sea recreado juntamente con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Deus da paz esteja com todos vós. Amém!
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios de paz sea con todos vosotros. Amén.

verses.KJV: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.WEB: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
verses.ASV: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreæ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos recomendo a nossa irmã Febe, que é servidora da Igreja que está em Cencreia,
verses.RVR09: ENCOMIÉNDOOS empero á Febe nuestra hermana, la cual es diaconisa de la iglesia que está en Cencreas:

verses.KJV: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.WEB: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
verses.ASV: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que a recebais no Senhor, como convém aos santos; e para que a ajudeis em qualquer coisa que necessitar de vós; pois ela tem ajudado a muitos, inclusive a mim mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Que la recibáis en el Señor, como es digno á los santos, y que la ayudéis en cualquiera cosa en que os hubiere menester: porque ella ha ayudado á muchos, y á mí mismo.

verses.KJV: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai a Priscila e a Áquila, meus cooperadores em Cristo Jesus,
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Priscila y á Aquila, mis coadjutores en Cristo Jesús;

verses.KJV: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:
verses.ALMEIDA: que arriscaram seus pescoços por minha vida; a eles não somente eu agradeço, como também todas as igrejas dos gentios.
verses.RVR09: (Que pusieron sus cuellos por mi vida: á los cuales no doy gracias yo solo, mas aun todas las iglesias de los Gentiles;)

verses.KJV: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
verses.WEB: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
verses.ASV: and [salute] the church that is in their house. Salute Epænetus my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Saudai] também a igreja [que se reúne] na casa deles. Saudai Epêneto, meu amado, que é o primeiro fruto da Acaia para Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo á la iglesia de su casa. Saludad á Epeneto, amado mío, que es las primicias de Acaya en Cristo.

verses.KJV: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.WEB: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
verses.ASV: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Maria, que trabalhou muito por nós.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á María, la cual ha trabajado mucho con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.WEB: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
verses.ASV: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Andrônico e Júnia, meus parentes, e meus companheiros na prisão, que são notáveis entre os apóstolos, e também estavam antes de mim em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Andrónico y á Junia, mis parientes, y mis compañeros en la cautividad, los que son insignes entre los apóstoles; los cuales también fueron antes de mí en Cristo.

verses.KJV: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Amplias, meu amado no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Amplias, amado mío en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.WEB: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
verses.ASV: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Urbano, nosso cooperador em Cristo, e Estáquis, meu amado.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Urbano, nuestro ayudador en Cristo Jesús, y á Stachîs, amado mío.

verses.KJV: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
verses.WEB: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.ASV: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the [household] of Aristobulus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Apeles, aprovado em Cristo. Saudai os que são da [casa] de Aristóbulo.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Apeles, probado en Cristo. Saludad á los que son de Aristóbulo.

verses.KJV: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the [household] of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Herodião, meu parente. Saudai os que são da [casa] de Narciso, que estão no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Herodión, mi pariente. Saludad á los que son de la casa de Narciso, los que están en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Salute Tryphæna and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Trifena e Trifosa, que trabalham no Senhor. Saudai a amada Pérside, que trabalhou muito no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Trifena y á Trifosa, las cuales trabajan en el Señor. Saludad á Pérsida amada, la cual ha trabajado mucho en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.WEB: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.ASV: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Rufo, o escolhido no Senhor, e a mãe dele, e minha também.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Rufo, escogido en el Señor, y á su madre y mía.

verses.KJV: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.WEB: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
verses.ASV: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Asíncrito, Flegonte, Hermas, Pátrobas, Hermes e os irmãos que estão com eles.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Asíncrito, y á Flegonte, á Hermas, á Patrobas, á Hermes, y á los hermanos que están con ellos.

verses.KJV: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.WEB: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
verses.ASV: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai Filólogo, Júlia, Nereu e sua irmã, Olimpas, e todos os santos que estão com eles.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á Filólogo y á Julia, á Nereo y á su hermana, y á Olimpas, y á todos los santos que están con ellos.

verses.KJV: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
verses.WEB: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
verses.ASV: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo santo. As igrejas de Cristo vos saúdam.
verses.RVR09: Saludaos los unos á los otros con ósculo santo. Os saludan todas las iglesias de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
verses.WEB: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
verses.ASV: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rogo-vos, irmãos, que sejais cuidadosos com os que causam divisões e obstáculos contrários à doutrina que aprendestes; e afastai-vos deles;
verses.RVR09: Y os ruego hermanos, que miréis los que causan disensiones y escándalos contra la doctrina que vosotros habéis aprendido; y apartaos de ellos.

verses.KJV: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.WEB: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
verses.ASV: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois tais pessoas não servem ao nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, mas sim, ao próprio ventre; e com palavras suaves e elogios enganam os corações dos ingênuos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los tales no sirven al Señor nuestro Jesucristo, sino á sus vientres; y con suaves palabras y bendiciones engañan los corazones de los simples.

verses.KJV: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.WEB: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
verses.ASV: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a vossa obediência chegou [ao conhecimento] de todos. Por isso eu me alegro por vossa causa; quero, porém, que sejais sábios no bem, e inocentes quanto ao mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque vuestra obediencia ha venido á ser notoria á todos; así que me gozo de vosotros; mas quiero que seáis sabios en el bien, y simples en el mal.

verses.KJV: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.WEB: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.ASV: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Deus de paz esmagará Satanás em pedaços debaixo dos vossos pés. A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco. Amém!
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios de paz quebrantará presto á Satanás debajo de vuestros pies. La gracia del Señor nuestro Jesucristo sea con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.WEB: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
verses.ASV: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saúdam-vos o meu cooperador Timóteo, e os meus parentes Lúcio, Jáson, e Sosípatro.
verses.RVR09: Os saludan Timoteo, mi coadjutor, y Lucio y Jasón y Sosipater, mis parientes.

verses.KJV: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.WEB: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.ASV: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, Tércio, que escrevi [esta] carta, vos saúdo no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Yo Tercio, que escribí la epístola, os saludo en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.WEB: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
verses.ASV: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gaio, hospedeiro meu e toda a igreja, vos saúda. Erasto, tesoureiro da cidade, vos saúda, e também o irmão Quarto.
verses.RVR09: Salúdaos Gayo, mi huésped, y de toda la iglesia. Salúdaos Erasto, tesorero de la ciudad, y el hermano Cuarto.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
verses.ASV: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós, Amém!
verses.RVR09: La gracia del Señor nuestro Jesucristo sea con todos vosotros. Amén.

verses.KJV: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.ASV: but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, para aquele que tem o poder de vos manter firmes segundo o meu Evangelho e a pregação de Jesus Cristo, conforme a revelação do mistério, que foi encoberto [desde] o princípio dos tempos;
verses.RVR09: Y al que puede confirmaros según mi evangelio y la predicación de Jesucristo, según la revelación del misterio encubierto desde tiempos eternos,

verses.KJV: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.ASV: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora se manifestou, e se tornou conhecido pelas Escrituras dos profetas, segundo o mandado do Deus eterno, para a obediência da fé entre todas as nações;
verses.RVR09: Mas manifestado ahora, y por las Escrituras de los profetas, según el mandamiento del Dios eterno, declarado á todas las gentes para que obedezcan á la fe;

verses.KJV: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao único Deus sábio seja a glória, por meio de Jesus Cristo, para [todo o] sempre! Amém! [Escrita de Corinto aos Romanos, e enviada por Febe, servidora da igreja de Cencreia.]
verses.RVR09: Al solo Dios sabio, sea gloria por Jesucristo para siempre. Amén. Fué escrita de Corinto á los Romanos, enviada por medio de Febe, diaconisa de la iglesia de Cencreas.

verses.KJV: Paul called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
verses.WEB: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.ASV: Paul, called [to be] an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, chamado apóstolo de Jesus Cristo pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Sóstenes,
verses.RVR09: PABLO, llamado á ser apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, y Sóstenes el hermano,

verses.KJV: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both their's and our's:
verses.WEB: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
verses.ASV: unto the church of God which is at Corinth, [even] them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called [to be] saints, with all that call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, their [Lord] and ours:
verses.ALMEIDA: À igreja de Deus que está em Corinto, aos santificados em Cristo Jesus, chamados santos, com todos os que em todo lugar invocam o nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, [Senhor] deles, e nosso;
