verses.ALMEIDA: Que o marido satisfaça sua mulher como devido, e semelhantemente a mulher ao marido.
verses.RVR09: El marido pague á la mujer la debida benevolencia; y asimismo la mujer al marido.

verses.KJV: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
verses.WEB: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
verses.ASV: The wife hath not power over her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power over his own body, but the wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher não tem poder sobre seu próprio corpo, mas sim o marido; e também da mesma maneira o marido não tem poder sobre seu próprio corpo, mas sim a mulher.
verses.RVR09: La mujer no tiene potestad de su propio cuerpo, sino el marido: é igualmente tampoco el marido tiene potestad de su propio cuerpo, sino la mujer.

verses.KJV: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
verses.WEB: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.ASV: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be by consent for a season, that ye may give yourselves unto prayer, and may be together again, that Satan tempt you not because of your incontinency.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos priveis um ao outro, a não ser por consentimento [de ambos] por algum tempo, para que vos ocupeis com jejum, e para a oração; e voltai-vos outra vez a se juntarem, para que Satanás não vos tente, por causa de vossa falta de domínio próprio.
verses.RVR09: No os defraudéis el uno al otro, á no ser por algún tiempo de mutuo consentimiento, para ocuparos en la oración: y volved á juntaros en uno, porque no os tiente Satanás á causa de vuestra incontinencia.

verses.KJV: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
verses.WEB: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
verses.ASV: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto vos digo como permissão, não como mandamento.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto digo por permisión, no por mandamiento.

verses.KJV: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
verses.WEB: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
verses.ASV: Yet I would that all men were even as I myself. Howbeit each man hath his own gift from God, one after this manner, and another after that.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu queria que todos fossem como eu mesmo; mas cada um tem seu próprio dom de Deus, um de um jeito assim, e outro de um jeito diferente.
verses.RVR09: Quisiera más bien que todos los hombres fuesen como yo: empero cada uno tiene su propio don de Dios; uno á la verdad así, y otro así.

verses.KJV: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, it is good for them if they abide even as I.
verses.WEB: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
verses.ASV: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas digo aos solteiros, e às viúvas que lhes é bom se permanecessem como eu estou.
verses.RVR09: Digo pues á los solteros y á las viudas, que bueno les es si se quedaren como yo.

verses.KJV: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
verses.WEB: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
verses.ASV: But if they have not continency, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não podem se conter, casem-se; porque é melhor se casar do que se inflamar.
verses.RVR09: Y si no tienen don de continencia, cásense; que mejor es casarse que quemarse.

verses.KJV: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
verses.WEB: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
verses.ASV: But unto the married I give charge, [yea] not I, but the Lord, That the wife depart not from her husband
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aos casados eu mando, não eu, mas o Senhor, que a mulher não se separe do marido.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los que están juntos en matrimonio, denuncio, no yo, sino el Señor: Que la mujer no se aparte del marido;

verses.KJV: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
verses.WEB: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
verses.ASV: (but should she depart, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband); and that the husband leave not his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se se separar, fique sem casar, ou se reconcilie com o marido; e que o marido não deixe a mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y si se apartare, que se quede sin casar, ó reconcíliese con su marido; y que el marido no despida á su mujer.

verses.KJV: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
verses.WEB: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
verses.ASV: But to the rest say I, not the Lord: If any brother hath an unbelieving wife, and she is content to dwell with him, let him not leave her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos outros digo eu, não o Senhor: se algum irmão tem mulher descrente, e ela consente em habitar com ele, não a deixe.
verses.RVR09: Y á los demás yo digo, no el Señor: Si algún hermano tiene mujer infiel, y ella consiente en habitar con él, no la despida.

verses.KJV: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
verses.WEB: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
verses.ASV: And the woman that hath an unbelieving husband, and he is content to dwell with her, let her not leave her husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguma mulher tem marido descrente, e ele consente em habitar com ela, não o deixe.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer que tiene marido infiel, y él consiente en habitar con ella, no lo deje.

verses.KJV: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
verses.WEB: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
verses.ASV: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the brother: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o marido descrente é santificado pela mulher; e a mulher descrente é santificada pelo marido. Pois de outra maneira vossos filhos seriam impuros; porém agora são santos.
verses.RVR09: Porque el marido infiel es santificado en la mujer, y la mujer infiel en el marido: pues de otra manera vuestros hijos serían inmundos; empero ahora son santos.

verses.KJV: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
verses.WEB: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
verses.ASV: Yet if the unbelieving departeth, let him depart: the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such [cases]: but God hath called us in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o descrente se separar, separe-se [também] . Em tal [situação] o irmão ou a irmã não estão sujeitos à servidão; mas Deus nos chamou para a paz.
verses.RVR09: Pero si el infiel se aparta, apártese: que no es el hermano ó la hermana sujeto á servidumbre en semejante caso; antes á paz nos llamó Dios.

verses.KJV: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
verses.WEB: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.ASV: For how knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O husband, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o que tu sabes, mulher, se salvarás ao marido? Ou o que tu sabes, marido, se salvarás a mulher?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿de dónde sabes, oh mujer, si quizá harás salvo á tu marido? ¿ó de dónde sabes, oh marido, si quizá harás salva á tu mujer?

verses.KJV: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
verses.WEB: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
verses.ASV: Only, as the Lord hath distributed to each man, as God hath called each, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém cada um ande assim como Deus lhe repartiu, cada um como o Senhor o chamou; e assim ordeno em todas as igrejas.
verses.RVR09: Empero cada uno como el Señor le repartió, y como Dios llamó á cada uno, así ande: y así enseño en todas las iglesias.

verses.KJV: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
verses.WEB: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
verses.ASV: Was any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Hath any been called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
verses.ALMEIDA: É alguém chamado, estando já circunciso? Não desfaça a circuncisão. É alguém chamado estando ainda incircunciso? Não se circuncide.
verses.RVR09: ¿Es llamado alguno circuncidado? quédese circunciso. ¿Es llamado alguno incircuncidado? que no se circuncide.

verses.KJV: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
verses.WEB: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
verses.ASV: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing; but the keeping of the commandments of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: A circuncisão nada vale, e a incircuncisão nada vale; mas [o que vale] é a obediência aos mandamentos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: La circuncisión nada es, y la incircuncisión nada es; sino la observancia de las mandamientos de Dios.

verses.KJV: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
verses.WEB: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
verses.ASV: Let each man abide in that calling wherein he was called.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um fique no propósito em que foi chamado.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno en la vocación en que fué llamado, en ella se quede.

verses.KJV: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
verses.WEB: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
verses.ASV: Wast thou called being a bondservant? care not for it: nay, even if thou canst become free, use [it] rather.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foste tu chamado sendo escravo? Não te preocupes com [isto] ; mas se tu podes te tornares livre, aproveita.
verses.RVR09: ¿Eres llamado siendo siervo? no se te dé cuidado: mas también si puedes hacerte libre, procúralo más.

verses.KJV: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.
verses.WEB: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
verses.ASV: For he that was called in the Lord being a bondservant, is the Lord’s freedman: likewise he that was called being free, is Christ’s bondservant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o que foi chamado no Senhor enquanto era escravo, para o Senhor é livre; da mesma maneira também, o que foi chamado, sendo livre, se torna escravo de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que en el Señor es llamado siendo siervo, liberto es del Señor: asimismo también el que es llamado siendo libre, siervo es de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
verses.WEB: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
verses.ASV: Ye were bought with a price; become not bondservants of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós fostes comprados por alto preço; [portanto] não vos façais escravos dos seres humanos.
verses.RVR09: Por precio sois comprados; no os hagáis siervos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
verses.WEB: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
verses.ASV: Brethren, let each man, wherein he was called, therein abide with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, cada um continue com Deus [no estado] em que foi chamado.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno, hermanos, en lo que es llamado, en esto se quede para con Dios.

verses.KJV: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
verses.WEB: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
verses.ASV: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: but I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be trustworthy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto às virgens, não tenho mandamento do Senhor; porém eu dou [minha] opinião, dado que tenho recebido misericórdia do Senhor para que eu seja confiável.
verses.RVR09: Empero de las vírgenes no tengo mandamiento del Señor; mas doy mi parecer, como quien ha alcanzado misericordia del Señor para ser fiel.

verses.KJV: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
verses.WEB: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
verses.ASV: I think therefore that this is good by reason of the distress that is upon us, [namely], that it is good for a man to be as he is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considero pois isto como bom, por causa da necessidade atual, que é bom à pessoa continuar assim como está.
verses.RVR09: Tengo, pues, esto por bueno á causa de la necesidad que apremia, que bueno es al hombre estarse así.

verses.KJV: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
verses.WEB: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
verses.ASV: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estás ligado à mulher, não busques se separar. Estás livre de mulher, não busques mulher.
verses.RVR09: ¿Estás ligado á mujer? no procures soltarte. ¿Estás suelto de mujer? no procures mujer.

verses.KJV: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
verses.WEB: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
verses.ASV: But shouldest thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Yet such shall have tribulation in the flesh: and I would spare you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se também te casares, não pecas; e se a virgem se casar, não peca. Porém os tais terão aflições na carne, que eu [gostaria] de livrá-los.
verses.RVR09: Mas también si tomares mujer, no pecaste; y si la doncella se casare, no pecó: pero aflicción de carne tendrán los tales: mas yo os dejo.

verses.KJV: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
verses.WEB: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
verses.ASV: But this I say, brethren, the time is shortened, that henceforth both those that have wives may be as though they had none;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém digo isto, irmãos, porque o tempo que resta é breve; para que também os que tem mulheres, sejam como se não as tivessem;
verses.RVR09: Esto empero digo, hermanos, que el tiempo es corto: lo que resta es, que los que tienen mujeres sean como los que no las tienen;

verses.KJV: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
verses.WEB: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
verses.ASV: and those that weep, as though they wept not; and those that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and those that buy, as though they possessed not;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que choram, como se não chorassem; e os que se alegram, como se não se alegrassem; e os que compram, como se não possuíssem.
verses.RVR09: Y los que lloran, como los que no lloran; y los que se huelgan, como los que no se huelgan; y los que compran, como los que no poseen;

verses.KJV: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
verses.WEB: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
verses.ASV: and those that use the world, as not using it to the full: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que usam [das coisas] deste mundo, como se [delas] não abusassem; porque a aparência deste mundo é passageira.
verses.RVR09: Y los que usan de este mundo, como los que no usan: porque la apariencia de este mundo se pasa.

verses.KJV: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
verses.WEB: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
verses.ASV: But I would have you to be free from cares. He that is unmarried is careful for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu queria que estivésseis sem preocupações. O solteiro se preocupa com as coisas do Senhor, como irá agradar ao Senhor;
verses.RVR09: Quisiera, pues, que estuvieseis sin congoja. El soltero tiene cuidado de las cosas que son del Señor, cómo ha de agradar al Señor:

verses.KJV: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.WEB: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.ASV: but he that is married is careful for the things of the world, how he may please his wife,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o que é casado se preocupa com as coisas do mundo, como irá agradar à mulher.
verses.RVR09: Empero el que se casó tiene cuidado de las cosas que son del mundo, cómo ha de agradar á su mujer.

verses.KJV: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
verses.WEB: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
verses.ASV: and is divided. [So] also the woman that is unmarried and the virgin is careful for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married is careful for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher casada e a virgem são diferentes: a que está para casar tem preocupação com as coisas do Senhor, para ser santa, tanto de corpo como de Espírito; mas a casada tem preocupação com as coisas do mundo, como irá agradar ao marido.
verses.RVR09: Hay asimismo diferencia entre la casada y la doncella: la doncella tiene cuidado de las cosas del Señor, para ser santa así en el cuerpo como en el espíritu: mas la casada tiene cuidado de las cosas del mundo, cómo ha de agradar á su marido.

verses.KJV: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
verses.WEB: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
verses.ASV: And this I say for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is seemly, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém digo isto para vosso próprio proveito; não para vos enlaçar, mas para [vos guiar] ao que é decente, e servirem ao Senhor sem distração.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero digo para vuestro provecho; no para echaros lazo, sino para lo honesto y decente, y para que sin impedimento os lleguéis al Señor.

verses.KJV: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
verses.WEB: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
verses.ASV: But if any man thinketh that he behaveth himself unseemly toward his virgin [daughter], if she be past the flower of her age, and if need so requireth, let him do what he will; he sinneth not; let them marry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alguém lhe parece que indecentemente trata com sua virgem, se ela passar da idade da juventude, e assim convier se fazer, que tal faça o que quiser, não peca, casem-se.
verses.RVR09: Mas, si á alguno parece cosa fea en su hija virgen, que pase ya de edad, y que así conviene que se haga, haga lo que quisiere, no peca; cásese.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
verses.WEB: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
verses.ASV: But he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power as touching his own will, and hath determined this in his own heart, to keep his own virgin [daughter], shall do well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o que está firme em [seu] coração, não tendo necessidade, mas tem poder sobre sua própria vontade, e isto decidiu em seu próprio coração, de guardar sua virgem, faz bem.
verses.RVR09: Pero el que está firme en su corazón, y no tiene necesidad, sino que tiene libertad de su voluntad, y determinó en su corazón esto, el guardar su hija virgen, bien hace.

verses.KJV: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
verses.WEB: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
verses.ASV: So then both he that giveth his own virgin [daughter] in marriage doeth well; and he that giveth her not in marriage shall do better.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, o que [a dá] em casamento, faz bem; mas o que não a dá em casamento, faz melhor.
verses.RVR09: Así que, el que la da en casamiento, bien hace; y el que no la da en casamiento, hace mejor.

verses.KJV: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
verses.WEB: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
verses.ASV: A wife is bound for so long time as her husband liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is free to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher casada está ligada pela Lei todo o tempo em que seu marido vive; mas se seu marido morrer, fica livre para se casar com quem quiser, contanto [que seja] no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: La mujer casada está atada á la ley, mientras vive su marido; mas si su marido muriere, libre es: cásese con quien quisiere, con tal que sea en el Señor.

verses.KJV: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
verses.WEB: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
verses.ASV: But she is happier if she abide as she is, after my judgment: and I think that I also have the Spirit of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém mais bem-aventurada é, se assim continuar, segundo minha opinião. E também eu penso, que tenho o Espírito de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Empero más venturosa será si se quedare así, según mi consejo; y pienso que también yo tengo Espíritu de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
verses.WEB: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
verses.ASV: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but love edifieth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto às coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, sabemos que todos temos conhecimento. O conhecimento incha [de orgulho] ,mas o amor edifica.
verses.RVR09: Y POR lo que hace á lo sacrificado á los ídolos, sabemos que todos tenemos ciencia. La ciencia hincha, mas la caridad edifica.

verses.KJV: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
verses.WEB: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
verses.ASV: If any man thinketh that he knoweth anything, he knoweth not yet as he ought to know;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém acha saber alguma coisa, ainda nada conhece como se deve conhecer.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno se imagina que sabe algo, aun no sabe nada como debe saber.

verses.KJV: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
verses.WEB: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
verses.ASV: but if any man loveth God, the same is known by him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alguém ama a Deus, o tal dele é conhecido.
verses.RVR09: Mas si alguno ama á Dios, el tal es conocido de él.

verses.KJV: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
verses.WEB: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
verses.ASV: Concerning therefore the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is [anything] in the world, and that there is no God but one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quanto ao comer das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos: sabemos que o ídolo nada é no mundo, e que não há qualquer outro Deus, a não ser um.
verses.RVR09: Acerca, pues, de las viandas que son sacrificadas á los ídolos, sabemos que el ídolo nada es en el mundo, y que no hay más de un Dios.

verses.KJV: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
verses.WEB: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
verses.ASV: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or on earth; as there are gods many, and lords many;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, ainda que também haja [alguns] que se chamem deuses, seja no céu, seja na terra (como há muitos deuses e muitos senhores),
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque haya algunos que se llamen dioses, ó en el cielo, ó en la tierra (como hay muchos dioses y muchos señores),

verses.KJV: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
verses.WEB: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
verses.ASV: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we unto him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia para nós há [só] um Deus, o Pai, do qual [são] todas as coisas, e nós para ele; e um [só] Senhor Jesus Cristo, pelo qual [são] todas as coisas, e nós por ele.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros empero no tenemos más de un Dios, el Padre, del cual son todas las cosas, y nosotros en él: y un Señor Jesucristo, por el cual son todas las cosas, y nosotros por él.

verses.KJV: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
verses.WEB: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.ASV: Howbeit there is not in all men that knowledge: but some, being used until now to the idol, eat as [of] a thing sacrificed to an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não há em todos [este] conhecimento; porém alguns até agora comem com consciência do ídolo, como se [fossem] sacrificadas aos ídolos; e sendo sua consciência fraca, fica contaminada.
verses.RVR09: Mas no en todos hay esta ciencia: porque algunos con conciencia del ídolo hasta aquí, comen como sacrificado á ídolos; y su conciencia, siendo flaca, es contaminada.

verses.KJV: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
verses.WEB: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.
verses.ASV: But food will not commend us to God: neither, if we eat not, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, a comida não nos faz agradáveis a Deus. Porque seja o que comamos, nada temos de mais; e seja o que não comamos, nada nos falta.
verses.RVR09: Si bien la vianda no nos hace más aceptos á Dios: porque ni que comamos, seremos más ricos; ni que no comamos, seremos más pobres.

verses.KJV: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
verses.WEB: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
verses.ASV: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to the weak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tomai cuidado para que esta vossa liberdade não seja de maneira alguma escândalo para os fracos.
verses.RVR09: Mas mirad que esta vuestra libertad no sea tropezadero á los que son flacos.

verses.KJV: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
verses.WEB: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
verses.ASV: For if a man see thee who hast knowledge sitting at meat in an idol’s temple, will not his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se alguém vir a ti, que tens [este] conhecimento, sentado [à mesa] no templo dos ídolos, não será a consciência do que é fraco induzida a comer das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos?
verses.RVR09: Porque si te ve alguno, á ti que tienes ciencia, que estás sentado á la mesa en el lugar de los ídolos, ¿la conciencia de aquel que es flaco, no será adelantada á comer de lo sacrificado á los ídolos?

verses.KJV: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
verses.WEB: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
verses.ASV: For through thy knowledge he that is weak perisheth, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por causa de teu conhecimento, perecerá assim o irmão fraco, pelo qual Cristo morreu?
verses.RVR09: Y por tu ciencia se perderá el hermano flaco por el cual Cristo murió.

verses.KJV: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
verses.WEB: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
verses.ASV: And thus, sinning against the brethren, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, ye sin against Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que, pecando contra os irmãos e ferindo sua fraca consciência, pecais contra Cristo.
verses.RVR09: De esta manera, pues, pecando contra los hermanos, é hiriendo su flaca conciencia, contra Cristo pecáis.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
verses.WEB: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, if meat causeth my brother to stumble, I will eat no flesh for evermore, that I cause not my brother to stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se a comida fizer cair ao meu irmão, nunca mais comerei carne, para que eu não faça ao meu irmão cair.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, si la comida es á mi hermano ocasión de caer, jamás comeré carne por no escandalizar á mi hermano.

verses.KJV: Am I am not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
verses.WEB: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
verses.ASV: Am I not free? am I not an apostle? have I not seen Jesus our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sou eu apóstolo? Não sou livre? Não vi eu a Jesus Cristo nosso Senhor? Não sois vós minha obra no Senhor?
verses.RVR09: ¿NO soy apóstol? ¿no soy libre? ¿no he visto á Jesús el Señor nuestro? ¿no sois vosotros mi obra en el Señor?

verses.KJV: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
verses.WEB: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
verses.ASV: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se para os outros não sou apóstolo, ao menos para vós eu o sou; porque vós sois o selo de meu apostolado no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Si á los otros no soy apóstol, á vosotros ciertamente lo soy: porque el sello de mi apostolado sois vosotros en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
verses.WEB: My defense to those who examine me is this:
verses.ASV: My defence to them that examine me is this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a minha defesa para com os que me condenam.
verses.RVR09: Esta es mi respuesta á los que me preguntan.

verses.KJV: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
verses.WEB: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
verses.ASV: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temos nós poder de comer e de beber?
verses.RVR09: Qué, ¿no tenemos potestad de comer y de beber?

verses.KJV: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.WEB: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.ASV: Have we no right to lead about a wife that is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temos nós direito de trazer [conosco] uma mulher irmã, como também os demais apóstolos, e os irmãos do Senhor, e Cefas?
verses.RVR09: ¿No tenemos potestad de traer con nosotros una hermana mujer también como los otros apóstoles, y los hermanos del Señor, y Cefas?

verses.KJV: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
verses.WEB: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?
verses.ASV: Or I only and Barnabas, have we not a right to forbear working?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou só eu, e Barnabé, não temos direito de não trabalhar?
verses.RVR09: ¿O sólo yo y Bernabé no tenemos potestad de no trabajar?

verses.KJV: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
verses.WEB: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?
verses.ASV: What soldier ever serveth at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem vai para a guerra a seu próprio custo? Quem planta a vinha, e não come do seu fruto? Ou quem apascenta o gado, e não come do leite do gado?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién jamás peleó á sus expensas? ¿quién planta viña, y no come de su fruto? ¿ó quién apacienta el ganado, y no come de la leche del ganado?

verses.KJV: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
verses.WEB: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
verses.ASV: Do I speak these things after the manner of men? or saith not the law also the same?
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo eu isto segundo a lógica humana? Ou não diz a Lei também o mesmo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Digo esto según los hombres? ¿no dice esto también la ley?

verses.KJV: For it is written in the law of Moses, thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
verses.WEB: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,
verses.ASV: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. Is it for the oxen that God careth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque na Lei de Moisés está escrito: ao boi que trilha não atarás a boca. Por acaso Deus tem preocupação com os bois?
verses.RVR09: Porque en la ley de Moisés está escrito: No pondrás bozal al buey que trilla. ¿Tiene Dios cuidado de los bueyes?

verses.KJV: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
verses.WEB: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
verses.ASV: or saith he it assuredly for our sake? Yea, for our sake it was written: because he that ploweth ought to plow in hope, and he that thresheth, [to thresh] in hope of partaking.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou totalmente diz por nós? Porque por nós isto está escrito; porque o que lavra, com esperança deve lavrar; e o que trilha com esperança, de sua esperança [deve] ser participante.
verses.RVR09: ¿O dícelo enteramente por nosotros? Pues por nosotros está escrito; porque con esperanza ha de arar el que ara; y el que trilla, con esperanza de recibir el fruto.

verses.KJV: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
verses.WEB: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
verses.ASV: If we sowed unto you spiritual things, is it a great matter if we shall reap your carnal things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se nós vos semeamos as coisas espirituais, é muito que ceifemos as vossas [coisas] carnais?
verses.RVR09: Si nosotros os sembramos lo espiritual, ¿es gran cosa si segáremos lo vuestro carnal?

verses.KJV: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
verses.WEB: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.
verses.ASV: If others partake of [this] right over you, do not we yet more? Nevertheless we did not use this right; but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the gospel of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se outros são participantes deste poder sobre vós, [porque] não tanto mais nós? Mas nós não usamos deste poder; antes tudo suportamos, para não darmos impedimento algum ao Evangelho de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Si otros tienen en vosotros esta potestad, ¿no más bien nosotros? Mas no hemos usado de esta potestad: antes lo sufrimos todo, por no poner ningún obstáculo al evangelio de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
verses.WEB: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?
verses.ASV: Know ye not that they that minister about sacred things eat [of] the things of the temple, [and] they that wait upon the altar have their portion with the altar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sabeis vós, que os que administram as coisas sagradas, comem [daquilo que é] sagrado? E os que continuamente estão junto ao altar, com o altar participam?
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabéis que los que trabajan en el santuario, comen del santuario; y que los que sirven al altar, del altar participan?

verses.KJV: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
verses.WEB: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
verses.ASV: Even so did the Lord ordain that they that proclaim the gospel should live of the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também ordenou o Senhor, aos que anunciam o Evangelho, que vivam do Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Así también ordenó el Señor á los que anuncian el evangelio, que vivan del evangelio.

verses.KJV: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
verses.WEB: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
verses.ASV: But I have used none of these things: and I write not these things that it may be so done in my case; for [it were] good for me rather to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu de nenhuma destas coisas usei; e nem isto escrevi, para que assim se faça comigo; porque melhor me seria morrer, do que esvaecer este meu orgulho.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo de nada de esto me aproveché: ni tampoco he escrito esto para que se haga así conmigo; porque tengo por mejor morir, antes que nadie haga vana esta mi gloria.

verses.KJV: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
verses.WEB: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
verses.ASV: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of; for necessity is laid upon me; for woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se anunciar o Evangelho, para mim não é orgulho, pois a obrigação me é imposta. E ai de mim, se não anunciar o Evangelho!
verses.RVR09: Pues bien que anuncio el evangelio, no tengo por qué gloriarme; porque me es impuesta necesidad; y ¡ay de mí si no anunciare el evangelio!

verses.KJV: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
verses.WEB: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
verses.ASV: For if I do this of mine own will, I have a reward: but if not of mine own will, I have a stewardship intrusted to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se eu faço de boa mente, tenho recompensa; mas se eu fizer de má vontade, a responsabilidade me é confiada.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, si lo hago de voluntad, premio tendré; mas si por fuerza, la dispensación me ha sido encargada.

verses.KJV: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
verses.WEB: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
verses.ASV: What then is my reward? That, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel without charge, so as not to use to the full my right in the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então que recompensa tenho? Que evangelizando, proponha o Evangelho de Cristo sem receber nada de volta, para não abusar do meu poder no Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuál, pues, es mi merced? Que predicando el evangelio, ponga el evangelio de Cristo de balde, para no usar mal de mi potestad en el evangelio.

verses.KJV: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
verses.WEB: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
verses.ASV: For though I was free from all [men], I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, estando eu livre de todos, me fiz servo de todos, para ganhar [ainda] mais.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, siendo libre para con todos, me he hecho siervo de todos por ganar á más.

verses.KJV: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
verses.WEB: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;
verses.ASV: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, not being myself under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
verses.ALMEIDA: E me fiz como judeu para os judeus, para ganhar aos judeus; como que estivesse debaixo da Lei, para os que estão debaixo da Lei, para ganhar aos que estão debaixo da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Heme hecho á los Judíos como Judío, por ganar á los Judíos; á los que están sujetos á la ley (aunque yo no sea sujeto á la ley) como sujeto á la ley, por ganar á los que están sujetos á la ley;

verses.KJV: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
verses.WEB: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
verses.ASV: to them that are without law, as without law, not being without law to God, but under law to Christ, that I might gain them that are without law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que estão sem Lei, como se estivesse sem Lei ( [porém] não estando sem Lei para com Deus; mas para com Cristo debaixo da Lei), para ganhar os que estão sem Lei.
verses.RVR09: A los que son sin ley, como si yo fuera sin ley, (no estando yo sin ley de Dios, mas en la ley de Cristo) por ganar á los que estaban sin ley.

verses.KJV: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
verses.WEB: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
verses.ASV: To the weak I became weak, that I might gain the weak: I am become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
verses.ALMEIDA: Me fiz de fraco para os fracos, para ganhar aos fracos; tudo me fiz para todos, para por todos os meios vir a salvar a alguns.
verses.RVR09: Me he hecho á los flacos flaco, por ganar á los flacos: á todos me he hecho todo, para que de todo punto salve á algunos.

verses.KJV: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
verses.WEB: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
verses.ASV: And I do all things for the gospel’s sake, that I may be a joint partaker thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto eu faço por causa do Evangelho, para que eu também dele seja participante.
verses.RVR09: Y esto hago por causa del evangelio, por hacerme juntamente participante de él.

verses.KJV: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
verses.WEB: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
verses.ASV: Know ye not that they that run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? Even so run; that ye may attain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sabeis vós que os que correm nas competições, realmente todos correm, mas somente um leva o prêmio? Correi de tal maneira, que o alcanceis.
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabéis que los que corren en el estadio, todos á la verdad corren, mas uno lleva el premio? Corred de tal manera que lo obtengáis.

verses.KJV: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
verses.WEB: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
verses.ASV: And every man that striveth in the games exerciseth self-control in all things. Now they [do it] to receive a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo aquele que luta, tenha domínio próprio sobre tudo. Pois aqueles fazem para receber uma coroa perecível, porém nós [para] uma que não perece.
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquel que lucha, de todo se abstiene: y ellos, á la verdad, para recibir una corona corruptible; mas nosotros, incorruptible.

verses.KJV: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
verses.WEB: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
verses.ASV: I therefore so run, as not uncertainly; so fight I, as not beating the air:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então assim eu corro, não como [para um lugar] incerto; assim luto, não como que dando socos no ar.
verses.RVR09: Así que, yo de esta manera corro, no como á cosa incierta; de esta manera peleo, no como quien hiere el aire:

verses.KJV: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
verses.WEB: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
verses.ASV: but I buffet my body, and bring it into bondage: lest by any means, after that I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, eu subjugo meu corpo, e o reduzo à servidão, para que quando estiver pregando para os outros, eu mesmo não seja reprovado.
verses.RVR09: Antes hiero mi cuerpo, y lo pongo en servidumbre; no sea que, habiendo predicado á otros, yo mismo venga á ser reprobado.

verses.KJV: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.WEB: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.ASV: For I would not, brethren, have you ignorant, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, irmãos, eu não quero que ignoreis que todos os nossos pais estiveram debaixo da nuvem, e todos pelo mar passaram;
verses.RVR09: PORQUE no quiero, hermanos, que ignoréis que nuestros padres todos estuvieron bajo la nube, y todos pasaron la mar;

verses.KJV: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.WEB: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.ASV: and were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos foram batizados na nuvem e no mar em Moisés;
verses.RVR09: Y todos en Moisés fueron bautizados en la nube y en la mar;

verses.KJV: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
verses.WEB: and all ate the same spiritual food;
verses.ASV: and did all eat the same spiritual food;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos comeram de um mesmo alimento espiritual;
verses.RVR09: Y todos comieron la misma vianda espiritual;

verses.KJV: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
verses.WEB: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
verses.ASV: and did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them: and the rock was Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos beberam de uma mesma bebida espiritual; porque bebiam da pedra espiritual que [os] seguia; e a pedra era Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y todos bebieron la misma bebida espiritual; porque bebían de la piedra espiritual que los seguía, y la piedra era Cristo:

verses.KJV: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Howbeit with most of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas da maioria deles Deus não se agradou; por isso foram deixados no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Mas de muchos de ellos no se agradó Dios; por lo cual fueron postrados en el desierto.

verses.KJV: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
verses.WEB: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
verses.ASV: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas coisas nos servem de exemplos, para que não desejemos coisas ruins, como eles desejaram.
verses.RVR09: Empero estas cosas fueron en figura de nosotros, para que no codiciemos cosas malas, como ellos codiciaron.

verses.KJV: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
verses.WEB: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
verses.ASV: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não sejais idólatras, como alguns deles [foram] ,como está escrito: O povo se sentou para comer, e para beber, e levantaram-se para se alegrarem.
verses.RVR09: Ni seáis honradores de ídolos, como algunos de ellos; según está escrito: Sentóse el pueblo á comer y á beber, y se levantaron á jugar.

verses.KJV: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
verses.WEB: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
verses.ASV: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não pequemos sexualmente, como alguns deles assim pecaram, e em um dia vinte e três mil caíram.
verses.RVR09: Ni forniquemos, como algunos de ellos fornicaron, y cayeron en un día veinte y tres mil.

verses.KJV: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
verses.WEB: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
verses.ASV: Neither let us make trial of the Lord, as some of them made trial, and perished by the serpents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tentemos a Cristo, como também alguns deles tentaram, e pereceram pelas serpentes.
verses.RVR09: Ni tentemos á Cristo, como también algunos de ellos le tentaron, y perecieron por las serpientes.

verses.KJV: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
verses.WEB: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
verses.ASV: Neither murmur ye, as some of them murmured, and perished by the destroyer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não murmureis, como também alguns deles murmuraram, e pereceram pelo destruidor.
verses.RVR09: Ni murmuréis, como algunos de ellos murmuraron, y perecieron por el destructor.

verses.KJV: Now all these things happened unto them for examples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
verses.WEB: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
verses.ASV: Now these things happened unto them by way of example; and they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages are come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas estas coisas lhes aconteceram como exemplos, e estão escritas para nosso aviso, em quem os fins dos tempos têm chegado.
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas les acontecieron en figura; y son escritas para nuestra admonición, en quienes los fines de los siglos han parado.

verses.KJV: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
verses.WEB: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
verses.ASV: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, aquele que pensa estar de pé, olhe para que não caia.
verses.RVR09: Así que, el que piensa estar firme, mire no caiga.

verses.KJV: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
verses.WEB: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
verses.ASV: There hath no temptation taken you but such as man can bear: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation make also the way of escape, that ye may be able to endure it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma tentação vos veio, que não fosse humana; porém Deus é fiel; que não vos deixará tentar mais do que o que podeis, antes com a tentação também dará a saída, para que a possais suportar.
verses.RVR09: No os ha tomado tentación, sino humana: mas fiel es Dios, que no os dejará ser tentados más de lo que podéis llevar; antes dará también juntamente con la tentación la salida, para que podáis aguantar.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.WEB: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus amados, fugi da idolatria.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, amados míos, huid de la idolatría.

verses.KJV: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
verses.WEB: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
verses.ASV: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos falo como que para prudentes; jugai vós [mesmos] o que eu digo.
verses.RVR09: Como á sabios hablo; juzgad vosotros lo que digo.

verses.KJV: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
verses.WEB: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
verses.ASV: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not a communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a communion of the body of Christ?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o copo da bênção, que nós bendizemos, não é a comunhão do sangue de Cristo? O pão que partimos, não é a comunhão do corpo de Cristo?
verses.RVR09: La copa de bendición que bendecimos, ¿no es la comunión de la sangre de Cristo? El pan que partimos, ¿no es la comunión del cuerpo de Cristo?

verses.KJV: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
verses.WEB: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
verses.ASV: seeing that we, who are many, are one bread, one body: for we all partake of the one bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [assim como há] um [só] pão, nós muitos somos um [só] corpo; porque todos participamos de um [só] pão.
verses.RVR09: Porque un pan, es que muchos somos un cuerpo; pues todos participamos de aquel un pan.

verses.KJV: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
verses.WEB: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
verses.ASV: Behold Israel after the flesh: have not they that eat the sacrifices communion with the altar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede a Israel segundo a carne: por acaso os que comem os sacrifícios não são participantes do altar?
verses.RVR09: Mirad á Israel según la carne: los que comen de los sacrificios ¿no son partícipes con el altar?

verses.KJV: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
verses.WEB: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.ASV: What say I then? that a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o que eu digo? Que o ídolo é alguma coisa? Ou que o sacrifício ao ídolo seja alguma coisa?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues digo? ¿Que el ídolo es algo? ¿ó que sea algo lo que es sacrificado á los ídolos?

verses.KJV: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
verses.WEB: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
verses.ASV: But [I say], that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have communion with demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu digo, que as coisas que os gentios sacrificam, são sacrificadas para os demônios, e não a Deus. E não quero que sejais participantes dos demônios.
verses.RVR09: Antes digo que lo que los Gentiles sacrifican, á los demonios lo sacrifican, y no á Dios: y no querría que vosotros fueseis partícipes con los demonios.

verses.KJV: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
verses.WEB: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
verses.ASV: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of demons: ye cannot partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não podeis beber o copo do Senhor e o copo dos demônios; não podeis ser participantes da mesa do Senhor e da mesa dos demônios.
verses.RVR09: No podéis beber la copa del Señor, y la copa de los demonios: no podéis ser partícipes de la mesa del Señor, y de la mesa de los demonios.

verses.KJV: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
verses.WEB: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
verses.ASV: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso [tentamos] provocar ciúmes ao Senhor? Somos nós mais fortes do que ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿O provocaremos á celo al Señor? ¿Somos más fuertes que él?

verses.KJV: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
verses.WEB: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
verses.ASV: All things are lawful; but not all things are expedient. All things are lawful; but not all things edify.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as coisas me são lícitas, mas nem todas as coisas convêm; todas as coisas me são licitas, mas nem todas as coisas edificam.
verses.RVR09: Todo me es lícito, mas no todo conviene: todo me es lícito, mas no todo edifica.

verses.KJV: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
verses.WEB: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
verses.ASV: Let no man seek his own, but [each] his neighbor’s [good].
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém busque para si próprio, antes cada um [busque o bem] do outro.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno busque su propio bien, sino el del otro.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
verses.WEB: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
verses.ASV: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, eat, asking no question for conscience’ sake;
verses.ALMEIDA: De tudo o que se vende no açougue, comei, sem vos questionar por causa da consciência.
verses.RVR09: De todo lo que se vende en la carnicería, comed, sin preguntar nada por causa de la conciencia;

verses.KJV: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
verses.WEB: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
verses.ASV: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a terra é do Senhor, e [também] sua plenitude.
verses.RVR09: Porque del Señor es la tierra y lo que la hinche.

verses.KJV: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
verses.WEB: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
verses.ASV: If one of them that believe not biddeth you [to a feast], and ye are disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém dos descrentes vos convidar, e quiserdes ir, comei de tudo o que for posto diante de vós, sem vos questionar por causa da consciência.
verses.RVR09: Y si algún infiel os llama, y queréis ir, de todo lo que se os pone delante comed, sin preguntar nada por causa de la conciencia.

verses.KJV: But if any man say unto you, this is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
verses.WEB: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”
verses.ASV: But if any man say unto you, This hath been offered in sacrifice, eat not, for his sake that showed it, and for conscience’ sake:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alguém vos disser: “Isto é sacrifício a ídolos”, não comais, por causa daquele que [vos] advertiu, e [por causa] da consciência. Porque a terra e sua plenitude pertencem ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas si alguien os dijere: Esto fué sacrificado á los ídolos: no lo comáis, por causa de aquel que lo declaró, y por causa de la conciencia: porque del Señor es la tierra y lo que la hinche.

verses.KJV: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
verses.WEB: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
verses.ASV: conscience, I say, not thine own, but the other’s; for why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas digo da consciência do outro, não a tua. Por que, então, minha liberdade é julgada pela consciência do outro?
verses.RVR09: La conciencia, digo, no tuya, sino del otro. Pues ¿por qué ha de ser juzgada mi libertad por otra conciencia?

verses.KJV: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
verses.WEB: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
verses.ASV: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu participo [da comida] pela graça, por que sou ofendido naquilo que dou graças?
verses.RVR09: Y si yo con agradecimiento participo, ¿por qué he de ser blasfemado por lo que doy gracias?

verses.KJV: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.WEB: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.ASV: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ao comer, ou ao beber, ou ao fazer qualquer coisa, fazei tudo para a glória de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Si pues coméis, ó bebéis, ó hacéis otra cosa, hacedlo todo á gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
verses.WEB: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
verses.ASV: Give no occasion of stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the church of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede sem escândalo, nem a judeus, nem a gregos, nem à Igreja de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sed sin ofensa á Judíos, y á Gentiles, y á la iglesia de Dios:

verses.KJV: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
verses.WEB: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
verses.ASV: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the [profit] of the many, that they may be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como eu também agrado a todos em tudo, não buscando meu próprio proveito, mas sim o de muitos, para que assim possam se salvar.
verses.RVR09: Como también yo en todas las cosas complazco á todos, no procurando mi propio beneficio, sino el de muchos, para que sean salvos.

verses.KJV: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.WEB: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.ASV: Be ye imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede meus imitadores, assim como eu também sou de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: SED imitadores de mí, así como yo de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
verses.WEB: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
verses.ASV: Now I praise you that ye remember me in all things, and hold fast the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos louvo, irmãos, de que em tudo vos lembrais de mim, e retendes [minhas] ordens, assim como eu vos entreguei.
verses.RVR09: Y os alabo, hermanos, que en todo os acordáis de mí, y retenéis las instrucciones mías, de la manera que os enseñé.

verses.KJV: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
verses.WEB: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.ASV: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quero que saibais, que a cabeça de todo homem é Cristo; e a cabeça da mulher é o homem; e a cabeça de Cristo é Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas quiero que sepáis, que Cristo es la cabeza de todo varón; y el varón es la cabeza de la mujer; y Dios la cabeza de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
verses.WEB: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
verses.ASV: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoreth his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo homem que ora ou profetiza, tendo [alguma coisa] sobre a cabeça, desonra sua própria cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Todo varón que ora ó profetiza cubierta la cabeza, afrenta su cabeza.

verses.KJV: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
verses.WEB: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
verses.ASV: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head unveiled dishonoreth her head; for it is one and the same thing as if she were shaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas toda mulher que ora ou profetiza com a cabeça descoberta, desonra sua própria cabeça; porque é o mesmo que se a tivesse raspada.
verses.RVR09: Mas toda mujer que ora ó profetiza no cubierta su cabeza, afrenta su cabeza; porque lo mismo es que si se rayese.

verses.KJV: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
verses.WEB: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
verses.ASV: For if a woman is not veiled, let her also be shorn: but if it is a shame to a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be veiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se a mulher não se cobre, raspe-se também; mas se para a mulher é vergonhoso se cortar ou se raspar, que se cubra.
verses.RVR09: Porque si la mujer no se cubre, trasquílese también: y si es deshonesto á la mujer trasquilarse ó raerse, cúbrase.

verses.KJV: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.WEB: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.ASV: For a man indeed ought not to have his head veiled, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o homem não deve cobrir a cabeça, pois é a imagem e a glória de Deus; mas a mulher é a glória do homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque el varón no ha de cubrir la cabeza, porque es imagen y gloria de Dios: mas la mujer es gloria del varón.

verses.KJV: For the man is not of the woman: but the woman of the man.
verses.WEB: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
verses.ASV: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o homem não provem da mulher, mas sim a mulher do homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque el varón no es de la mujer, sino la mujer del varón.

verses.KJV: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
verses.WEB: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
verses.ASV: for neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também o homem não foi criado por causa da mulher, mas a mulher [foi criada] por causa do homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque tampoco el varón fué criado por causa de la mujer, sino la mujer por causa del varón.

verses.KJV: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
verses.WEB: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
verses.ASV: for this cause ought the woman to have [a sign of] authority on her head, because of the angels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto a mulher deve ter sobre a cabeça sinal de autoridade, por causa dos anjos.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, la mujer debe tener señal de potestad sobre su cabeza, por causa de los ángeles.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless, neither is the woman without the man, nor the man without the woman, in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, nem o homem é sem a mulher, nem a mulher sem o homem, no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas ni el varón sin la mujer, ni la mujer sin el varón, en el Señor.

verses.KJV: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
verses.WEB: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
verses.ASV: For as the woman is of the man, so is the man also by the woman; but all things are of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como a mulher vem do homem, assim também é o homem pela mulher; porém tudo [vem] de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque como la mujer es del varón, así también el varón es por la mujer: empero todo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
verses.WEB: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
verses.ASV: Judge ye in yourselves: is it seemly that a woman pray unto God unveiled?
verses.ALMEIDA: Julgai-vos entre vós mesmos: é decente que a mulher ore a Deus descoberta?
verses.RVR09: Juzgad vosotros mismos: ¿es honesto orar la mujer á Dios no cubierta?

verses.KJV: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
verses.WEB: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
verses.ASV: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou não vos ensina a mesma natureza, que ter cabelo longo é desonra para o homem?
verses.RVR09: La misma naturaleza ¿no os enseña que al hombre sea deshonesto criar cabello?

verses.KJV: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
verses.WEB: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
verses.ASV: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
