verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a mulher ter cabelo longo, lhe é honra, porque os cabelos lhe são dados por cobertura?
verses.RVR09: Por el contrario, á la mujer criar el cabello le es honroso; porque en lugar de velo le es dado el cabello.

verses.KJV: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
verses.WEB: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
verses.ASV: But if any man seemeth to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se alguém parece ser inclinado a disputas, nós não temos tal costume, nem as igrejas de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso, si alguno parece ser contencioso, nosotros no tenemos tal costumbre, ni las iglesias de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.WEB: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
verses.ASV: But in giving you this charge, I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better but for the worse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto eu vos declaro, que não vos louvo, porque vós vos ajuntais, não para melhor, mas para pior.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero os denuncio, que no alabo, que no por mejor sino por peor os juntáis.

verses.KJV: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.WEB: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
verses.ASV: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that divisions exist among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, em primeiro lugar, eu ouço que, quando vos ajuntais, há divisões entre vós; e em parte eu acredito.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo primero, cuando os juntáis en la iglesia, oigo que hay entre vosotros disensiones; y en parte lo creo.

verses.KJV: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
verses.WEB: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
verses.ASV: For there must be also factions among you, that they that are approved may be made manifest among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é necessário que haja diferenças de opinião entre vós, para que os que são aprovados sejam evidenciados entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque preciso es que haya entre vosotros aun herejías, para que los que son probados se manifiesten entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
verses.WEB: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
verses.ASV: When therefore ye assemble yourselves together, it is not possible to eat the Lord’s supper:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, vós vos reunis, não é para comer da ceia do Senhor;
verses.RVR09: Cuando pues os juntáis en uno, esto no es comer la cena del Señor:

verses.KJV: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.WEB: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.ASV: for in your eating each one taketh before [other] his own supper; and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cada um, comendo antes, toma sua própria ceia; e um fica com fome, e outro fica bêbado.
verses.RVR09: Porque cada uno toma antes para comer su propia cena; y el uno tiene hambre, y el otro está embriagado.

verses.KJV: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? what shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
verses.WEB: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
verses.ASV: What, have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and put them to shame that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you? In this I praise you not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não tendes casas para comer e para beber? Ou desprezais a Igreja de Deus, e envergonhais os que não têm? Que vos direi? Eu vos elogiarei? Nisto eu não [vos] elogio.
verses.RVR09: Pues qué, ¿no tenéis casas en que comáis y bebáis? ¿ó menospreciáis la iglesia de Dios, y avergonzáis á los que no tienen? ¿Qué os diré? ¿os alabaré? En esto no os alabo.

verses.KJV: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
verses.WEB: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
verses.ASV: For I received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus in the night in which he was betrayed took bread;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu recebi do Senhor o que também vos entreguei; que o Senhor Jesus, na noite em que foi traído, tomou o pão;
verses.RVR09: Porque yo recibí del Señor lo que también os he enseñado: Que el Señor Jesús, la noche que fué entregado, tomó pan;

verses.KJV: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.WEB: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
verses.ASV: and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, This is my body, which is for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tendo dado graças, o partiu, e disse: Tomai, comei; isto é o meu corpo, que é partido por vós; fazei isto em memória de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo dado gracias, lo partió, y dijo: Tomad, comed: esto es mi cuerpo que por vosotros es partido: haced esto en memoria de mí.

verses.KJV: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, this cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
verses.WEB: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
verses.ASV: In like manner also the cup, after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood: this do, as often as ye drink [it], in remembrance of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantemente também, depois de cear, [tomou] o copo, dizendo: Este copo é o novo Testamento em meu sangue. Fazei isto todas as vezes que [o] beberdes, em memória de mim.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo tomó también la copa, después de haber cenado, diciendo: Esta copa es el nuevo pacto en mi sangre: haced esto todas las veces que bebiereis, en memoria de mí.

verses.KJV: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
verses.WEB: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
verses.ASV: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink the cup, ye proclaim the Lord’s death till he come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todas as vezes que comerdes deste pão, e beberdes deste copo, anunciai a morte do Senhor, até que ele venha.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas las veces que comiereis este pan, y bebiereis esta copa, la muerte del Señor anunciáis hasta que venga.

verses.KJV: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
verses.ASV: Wherefore whosoever shall eat the bread or drink the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner, shall be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto quem comer deste pão, ou beber deste copo do Senhor indignamente, será culpado do corpo e do sangue do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: De manera que, cualquiera que comiere este pan ó bebiere esta copa del Señor indignamente, será culpado del cuerpo y de la sangre del Señor.

verses.KJV: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
verses.WEB: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
verses.ASV: But let a man prove himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto examine-se cada um a si mesmo, e assim coma deste pão, e beba deste copo.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pruébese cada uno á sí mismo, y coma así de aquel pan, y beba de aquella copa.

verses.KJV: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
verses.WEB: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
verses.ASV: For he that eateth and drinketh, eateth and drinketh judgment unto himself, if he discern not the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quem come e bebe indignamente, para si mesmo come e bebe condenação, não discernindo o corpo do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que come y bebe indignamente, juicio come y bebe para sí, no discerniendo el cuerpo del Señor.

verses.KJV: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
verses.WEB: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
verses.ASV: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por esta causa há entre vós muitos fracos e doentes, e muitos que dormem.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual hay muchos enfermos y debilitados entre vosotros; y muchos duermen.

verses.KJV: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.WEB: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
verses.ASV: But if we discerned ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se nós julgássemos a nós mesmos, não seríamos julgados.
verses.RVR09: Que si nos examinásemos á nosotros mismos, cierto no seríamos juzgados.

verses.KJV: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
verses.WEB: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
verses.ASV: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando somos julgados, somos repreendidos pelo Senhor; para que não sejamos condenados com o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Mas siendo juzgados, somos castigados del Señor, para que no seamos condenados con el mundo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.WEB: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, wait one for another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus irmãos, quando vos ajuntardes para comer, esperai uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Así, que, hermanos míos, cuando os juntáis á comer, esperaos unos á otros.

verses.KJV: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
verses.WEB: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
verses.ASV: If any man is hungry, let him eat at home; that your coming together be not unto judgment. And the rest will I set in order whensoever I come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se alguém tiver fome, coma em casa; para que não vos ajunteis para [sofrerdes] julgamento. Quanto às demais coisas, as ordenarei quando vier.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno tuviere hambre, coma en su casa, porque no os juntéis para juicio. Las demás cosas ordenaré cuando llegare.

verses.KJV: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.WEB: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
verses.ASV: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto aos [dons] espirituais, irmãos, não quero que sejais ignorantes.
verses.RVR09: Y ACERCA de los dones espirituales, no quiero, hermanos, que ignoréis.

verses.KJV: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
verses.WEB: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
verses.ASV: Ye know that when ye were Gentiles [ye were] led away unto those dumb idols, howsoever ye might be led.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sabeis que éreis gentios, vós vos desviáveis para os ídolos mudos, conforme éreis guiados.
verses.RVR09: Sabéis que cuando erais Gentiles, ibais, como erais llevados, á los ídolos mudos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I make known unto you, that no man speaking in the Spirit of God saith, Jesus is anathema; and no man can say, Jesus is Lord, but in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu vos deixo claro que ninguém que fala pelo Espírito de Deus chama a Jesus de maldito; e ninguém pode dizer [que] Jesus [é] o Senhor, a não ser pelo Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os hago saber, que nadie que hable por Espíritu de Dios, llama anatema á Jesús; y nadie puede llamar á Jesús Señor, sino por Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.WEB: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.ASV: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há variedade de dons, mas o Espírito é o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Empero hay repartimiento de dones; mas el mismo Espíritu es.

verses.KJV: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
verses.WEB: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
verses.ASV: And there are diversities of ministrations, and the same Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há variedade de trabalhos [na Igreja] ,mas o Senhor é o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y hay repartimiento de ministerios; mas el mismo Señor es.

verses.KJV: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
verses.WEB: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
verses.ASV: And there are diversities of workings, but the same God, who worketh all things in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há variedade de operações, mas é o mesmo Deus que opera tudo em todos.
verses.RVR09: Y hay repartimiento de operaciones; mas el mismo Dios es el que obra todas las cosas en todos.

verses.KJV: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.WEB: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
verses.ASV: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit to profit withal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a cada um é dada a manifestação do Espírito, para o que for conveniente.
verses.RVR09: Empero á cada uno le es dada manifestación del Espíritu para provecho.

verses.KJV: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
verses.WEB: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
verses.ASV: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom; and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a um é dada, pelo Espírito, palavra de sabedoria; e a outro palavra de conhecimento, pelo mesmo Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Porque á la verdad, á éste es dada por el Espíritu palabra de sabiduría; á otro, palabra de ciencia según el mismo Espíritu;

verses.KJV: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
verses.WEB: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
verses.ASV: to another faith, in the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, in the one Spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: e a outro fé pelo mesmo Espírito; e a outro dons de curas, pelo mesmo Espírito.
verses.RVR09: A otro, fe por el mismo Espíritu; y á otro, dones de sanidades por el mismo Espíritu;

verses.KJV: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.WEB: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
verses.ASV: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits: to another [divers] kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a outro operações de milagres; e a outro profecia; e a outro o [dom de] discernir aos espíritos; e a outro variedade de línguas; e a outro interpretação de línguas.
verses.RVR09: A otro, operaciones de milagros; y á otro, profecía; y á otro, discreción de espíritus; y á otro, géneros de lenguas; y á otro, interpretación de lenguas.

verses.KJV: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
verses.WEB: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
verses.ASV: but all these worketh the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each one severally even as he will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todas estas coisas [quem] opera [é] um e o mesmo Espírito, repartindo particularmente a cada um como quer.
verses.RVR09: Mas todas estas cosas obra uno y el mismo Espíritu, repartiendo particularmente á cada uno como quiere.

verses.KJV: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
verses.WEB: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
verses.ASV: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como o corpo é um, e tem muitos membros, e todos os membros deste único corpo, sendo muitos, compõem um só corpo; assim também é Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la manera que el cuerpo es uno, y tiene muchos miembros, empero todos los miembros del cuerpo, siendo muchos, son un cuerpo, así también Cristo.

verses.KJV: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.WEB: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
verses.ASV: For in one Spirit were we all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all made to drink of one Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também todos nós somos batizados em um [só] Espírito, para um [só] corpo, quer judeus, quer gregos, quer servos, quer livres; e para todos nós foi dado de beber um [só] Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Porque por un Espíritu somos todos bautizados en un cuerpo, ora Judíos ó Griegos, ora siervos ó libres; y todos hemos bebido de un mismo Espíritu.

verses.KJV: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.WEB: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.ASV: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também o corpo não é um [só] membro, mas muitos.
verses.RVR09: Pues ni tampoco el cuerpo es un miembro, sino muchos.

verses.KJV: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.WEB: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
verses.ASV: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o pé disser: Por eu não ser mão, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ele não é do corpo?
verses.RVR09: Si dijere el pie: Porque no soy mano, no soy del cuerpo: ¿por eso no será del cuerpo?

verses.KJV: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.WEB: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
verses.ASV: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a orelha disser: Por eu não ser olho, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ela não é do corpo?
verses.RVR09: Y si dijere la oreja: Porque no soy ojo, no soy del cuerpo: ¿por eso no será del cuerpo?

verses.KJV: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
verses.WEB: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
verses.ASV: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se todo o corpo fosse olho, onde [estaria] o ouvido? Se [fosse] todo ouvido, onde [estaria] o olfato?
verses.RVR09: Si todo el cuerpo fuese ojo, ¿dónde estaría el oído? Si todo fuese oído, ¿dónde estaría el olfato?

verses.KJV: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
verses.WEB: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
verses.ASV: But now hath God set the members each one of them in the body, even as it pleased him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora Deus pôs os membros no corpo, a cada qual deles como ele quis.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora Dios ha colocado los miembros cada uno de ellos en el cuerpo, como quiso.

verses.KJV: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
verses.WEB: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
verses.ASV: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se todos fossem um [só] membro, onde [estaria] o corpo?
verses.RVR09: Que si todos fueran un miembro, ¿dónde estuviera el cuerpo?

verses.KJV: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
verses.WEB: But now they are many members, but one body.
verses.ASV: But now they are many members, but one body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas há agora muitos membros, porém um [só] corpo.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora muchos miembros son á la verdad, empero un cuerpo.

verses.KJV: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.WEB: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
verses.ASV: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of thee: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o olho não pode dizer à mão: Não tenho necessidade de ti;Nem a cabeça aos pés: Não tenho necessidade de vós;
verses.RVR09: Ni el ojo puede decir á la mano: No te he menester: ni asimismo la cabeza á los pies: No tengo necesidad de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
verses.WEB: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
verses.ASV: Nay, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be more feeble are necessary:
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes até os membros do corpo que [nos] parecem ser os mais fracos, são muito mais necessários.
verses.RVR09: Antes, mucho más los miembros del cuerpo que parecen más flacos, son necesarios;

verses.KJV: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
verses.WEB: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
verses.ASV: and those [parts] of the body, which we think to be less honorable, upon these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que pensamos serem os menos honrados do corpo, a esses muito mais honramos; e os nossos mais desprezíveis têm muito mais respeito.
verses.RVR09: Y á aquellos del cuerpo que estimamos ser más viles, á éstos vestimos más honrosamente; y los que en nosotros son menos honestos, tienen más compostura.

verses.KJV: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked.
verses.WEB: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
verses.ASV: whereas our comely [parts] have no need: but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to that [part] which lacked;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os nosso mais respeitáveis não têm [tanta] necessidade; mas [assim] Deus juntou o corpo, dando muito mais honra ao que tinha falta [dela] .
verses.RVR09: Porque los que en nosotros son más honestos, no tienen necesidad: mas Dios ordenó el cuerpo, dando más abundante honor al que le faltaba;

verses.KJV: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
verses.WEB: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
verses.ASV: that there should be no schism in the body; but [that] the members should have the same care one for another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não haja divisão no corpo, mas que os membros tenham igual cuidado uns com os outros.
verses.RVR09: Para que no haya desavenencia en el cuerpo, sino que los miembros todos se interesen los unos por los otros.

verses.KJV: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.WEB: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.ASV: And whether one member suffereth, all the members suffer with it; or [one] member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seja que, [caso] um membro sofra, [também] os membros sofrem juntos; e [caso] um membro seja honrado, todos os membros se alegram juntos.
verses.RVR09: Por manera que si un miembro padece, todos los miembros á una se duelen; y si un miembro es honrado, todos los miembros á una se gozan.

verses.KJV: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
verses.WEB: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
verses.ASV: Now ye are the body of Christ, and severally members thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sois o corpo de Cristo, e membros em particular.
verses.RVR09: Pues vosotros sois el cuerpo de Cristo, y miembros en parte.

verses.KJV: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
verses.WEB: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
verses.ASV: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, [divers] kinds of tongues.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus pôs a uns na Igreja: em primeiro lugar apóstolos, em segundo profetas, em terceiro mestres; depois milagres, dons de curas, socorros, lideranças, variedades de línguas.
verses.RVR09: Y á unos puso Dios en la iglesia, primeramente apóstoles, luego profetas, lo tercero doctores; luego facultades; luego dones de sanidades, ayudas, gobernaciones, géneros de lenguas.

verses.KJV: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
verses.WEB: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
verses.ASV: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all [workers of] miracles?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso são todos apóstolos? São todos profetas? São todos mestres? São todos com dons de milagres?
verses.RVR09: ¿Son todos apóstoles? ¿son todos profetas? ¿todos doctores? ¿todos facultades?

verses.KJV: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.WEB: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
verses.ASV: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem todos dons de curas? Falam todos [várias] línguas? Interpretam todos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tienen todos dones de sanidad? ¿hablan todos lenguas? ¿interpretan todos?

verses.KJV: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.WEB: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
verses.ASV: But desire earnestly the greater gifts. And moreover a most excellent way show I unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém desejai com zelo pelos melhores dons; e eu vos mostro um caminho ainda mais excelente.
verses.RVR09: Empero procurad los mejores dones: mas aun yo os muestro un camino más excelente.

verses.KJV: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.WEB: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
verses.ASV: If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu falasse as línguas dos seres humanos e dos anjos, e não tivesse amor, seria como o metal que soa, ou como o sino que retine.
verses.RVR09: SI yo hablase lenguas humanas y angélicas, y no tengo caridad, vengo á ser como metal que resuena, ó címbalo que retiñe.

verses.KJV: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.WEB: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
verses.ASV: And if I have [the gift of] prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que tivesse [o dom] de profecia, e soubesse todos os mistérios, e todo o conhecimento; e ainda que tivesse toda a fé, de tal maneira que movesse os montes de lugar, e não tivesse amor, nada seria.
verses.RVR09: Y si tuviese profecía, y entendiese todos los misterios y toda ciencia; y si tuviese toda la fe, de tal manera que traspasase los montes, y no tengo caridad, nada soy.

verses.KJV: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.WEB: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
verses.ASV: And if I bestow all my goods to feed [the poor], and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que eu distribuísse todos os meus bens para alimentar [aos pobres] , e ainda que entregasse meu corpo para ser queimado, e não tivesse amor, nada me aproveitaria.
verses.RVR09: Y si repartiese toda mi hacienda para dar de comer á pobres, y si entregase mi cuerpo para ser quemado, y no tengo caridad, de nada me sirve.

verses.KJV: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.WEB: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
verses.ASV: Love suffereth long, [and] is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.ALMEIDA: O amor é paciente, é bondoso; o amor não é invejoso; o amor não é orgulhoso, não é arrogante.
verses.RVR09: La caridad es sufrida, es benigna; la caridad no tiene envidia, la caridad no hace sinrazón, no se ensancha;

verses.KJV: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.WEB: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
verses.ASV: doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not its own, is not provoked, taketh not account of evil;
verses.ALMEIDA: O amor não trata mal; não busca os próprios [interesses] , não se ira, não é rancoroso.
verses.RVR09: No es injuriosa, no busca lo suyo, no se irrita, no piensa el mal;

verses.KJV: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.WEB: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
verses.ASV: rejoiceth not in unrighteousness, but rejoiceth with the truth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se alegra com a injustiça, mas se alegra com a verdade.
verses.RVR09: No se huelga de la injusticia, mas se huelga de la verdad;

verses.KJV: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.WEB: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
verses.ASV: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo aguenta, tudo crê, tudo espera, tudo suporta.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo sufre, todo lo cree, todo lo espera, todo lo soporta.

verses.KJV: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.WEB: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
verses.ASV: Love never faileth: but whether [there be] prophecies, they shall be done away; whether [there be] tongues, they shall cease; whether [there be] knowledge, it shall be done away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O amor nunca falha. Porém as profecias serão aniquiladas; as línguas acabarão, e o conhecimento será aniquilado.
verses.RVR09: La caridad nunca deja de ser: mas las profecías se han de acabar, y cesarán las lenguas, y la ciencia ha de ser quitada;

verses.KJV: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.WEB: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
verses.ASV: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em parte conhecemos, e em parte profetizamos;
verses.RVR09: Porque en parte conocemos, y en parte profetizamos;

verses.KJV: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.WEB: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
verses.ASV: but when that which is perfect is come, that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando vier o [que é] completo,[Ou: perfeito] então o que é em parte será aniquilado.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando venga lo que es perfecto, entonces lo que es en parte será quitado.

verses.KJV: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.WEB: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
verses.ASV: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child: now that I am become a man, I have put away childish things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu era menino, falava como menino, sentia como menino, pensava como menino; mas quando me tornei homem, aniquilei as coisas de menino.
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo era niño, hablaba como niño, pensaba como niño, juzgaba como niño; mas cuando ya fuí hombre hecho, dejé lo que era de niño.

verses.KJV: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.WEB: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
verses.ASV: For now we see in a mirror, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know fully even as also I was fully known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque agora vemos por espelho em enigma, mas então [veremos] face a face; agora conheço em parte, mas então conhecerei assim como sou conhecido.
verses.RVR09: Ahora vemos por espejo, en obscuridad; mas entonces veremos cara á cara: ahora conozco en parte; mas entonces conoceré como soy conocido.

verses.KJV: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.WEB: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
verses.ASV: But now abideth faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora continuam a fé, a esperança, [e] o amor, estes três; porém o maior destes é o amor.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora permanecen la fe, la esperanza, y la caridad, estas tres: empero la mayor de ellas es la caridad.

verses.KJV: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.WEB: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
verses.ASV: Follow after love; yet desire earnestly spiritual [gifts], but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Segui o amor, e desejai com zelo pelos [dons] espirituais; porém principalmente que profetizeis.
verses.RVR09: SEGUID la caridad; y procurad los dones espirituales, mas sobre todo que profeticéis.

verses.KJV: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.WEB: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.ASV: For he that speaketh in a tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God; for no man understandeth; but in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o que fala língua [estranha] , não fala aos seres humanos, mas sim a Deus; porque ninguém [o] entende, mas em espírito fala mistérios.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que habla en lenguas, no habla á los hombres, sino á Dios; porque nadie le entiende, aunque en espíritu hable misterios.

verses.KJV: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.WEB: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
verses.ASV: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men edification, and exhortation, and consolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que profetiza, fala aos seres humanos [para] edificação, convencimento, e consolação.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que profetiza, habla á los hombres para edificación, y exhortación, y consolación.

verses.KJV: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.WEB: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
verses.ASV: He that speaketh in a tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que fala língua [estranha] edifica a si mesmo; mas o que profetiza edifica à igreja.
verses.RVR09: El que habla lengua extraña, á sí mismo se edifica; mas el que profetiza, edifica á la iglesia.

verses.KJV: I would that ye all spake with tongues but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.WEB: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
verses.ASV: Now I would have you all speak with tongues, but rather that ye should prophesy: and greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu quero que todos vós faleis línguas, porém mais [ainda] que profetizeis; porque o que profetiza é maior que o que fala línguas, a não ser que [também] interprete, para que a igreja receba edificação.
verses.RVR09: Así que, quisiera que todos vosotros hablaseis lenguas, empero más que profetizaseis: porque mayor es el que profetiza que el que habla lenguas, si también no interpretare, para que la iglesia tome edificación.

verses.KJV: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.WEB: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
verses.ASV: But now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora irmãos, se eu viesse até vos falando línguas, o que vos aproveitaria, se não vos falasse ou por revelação, ou por conhecimento, ou por profecia, ou por doutrina?
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hermanos, si yo fuere á vosotros hablando lenguas, ¿qué os aprovecharé, si no os hablare, ó con revelación, ó con ciencia, ó con profecía, ó con doctrina?

verses.KJV: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.WEB: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.ASV: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they give not a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.ALMEIDA: E até as coisas inanimadas, que produzem som, seja flauta, seja harpa, se não derem distinção de sons, como saberá o que se toca com a flauta, ou com a harpa?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente las cosas inanimadas que hacen sonidos, como la flauta ó la vihuela, si no dieren distinción de voces, ¿cómo se sabrá lo que se tañe con la flauta, ó con la vihuela?

verses.KJV: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.WEB: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
verses.ASV: For if the trumpet give an uncertain voice, who shall prepare himself for war?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também se a trombeta der som incerto, quem se preparará para a guerra?
verses.RVR09: Y si la trompeta diere sonido incierto, ¿quién se apercibirá á la batalla?

verses.KJV: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
verses.WEB: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
verses.ASV: So also ye, unless ye utter by the tongue speech easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye will be speaking into the air.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim [mesmo] também vós, se com a língua não derdes palavra compreensível, como se entenderá o que se diz? Porque estareis falando para o ar.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros, si por la lengua no diereis palabra bien significante, ¿cómo se entenderá lo que se dice? porque hablaréis al aire.

verses.KJV: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.WEB: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
verses.ASV: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and no [kind] is without signification.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por exemplo, há tantos tipos de vozes no mundo, e nenhuma delas é muda.
verses.RVR09: Tantos géneros de voces, por ejemplo, hay en el mundo, y nada hay mudo;

verses.KJV: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.WEB: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
verses.ASV: If then I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be to him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh will be a barbarian unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se eu não souber o propósito da voz, serei estrangeiro para o que fala, e o que fala será estrangeiro para mim.
verses.RVR09: Mas si yo ignorare el valor de la voz, seré bárbaro al que habla, y el que habla será bárbaro para mí.

verses.KJV: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.WEB: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
verses.ASV: So also ye, since ye are zealous of spiritual [gifts], seek that ye may abound unto the edifying of the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, dado que desejais os dons espirituais, procurai [neles] abundar, para edificação da igreja.
verses.RVR09: Así también vosotros; pues que anheláis espirituales dones, procurad ser excelentes para la edificación de la iglesia.

verses.KJV: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.WEB: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
verses.ASV: Wherefore let him that speaketh in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, o que fala em língua [estranha] , ore para que possa interpretar.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, el que habla lengua extraña, pida que la interprete.

verses.KJV: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.WEB: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.ASV: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se eu orar em língua [estranha] , meu espírito ora, mas meu entendimento fica sem fruto.
verses.RVR09: Porque si yo orare en lengua desconocida, mi espíritu ora; mas mi entendimiento es sin fruto.

verses.KJV: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.WEB: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.ASV: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então é o que? Orarei com o espírito, mas também orarei com o entendimento; cantarei com o espírito, mas também cantarei com o entendimento.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues? Oraré con el espíritu, mas oraré también con entendimiento; cantaré con el espíritu, mas cantaré también con entendimiento.

verses.KJV: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.WEB: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
verses.ASV: Else if thou bless with the spirit, how shall he that filleth the place of the unlearned say the Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he knoweth not what thou sayest?
verses.ALMEIDA: De outra maneira, se tu bendisseres com o espírito, como aquele que não tem conhecimento dirá amém por teu bendizer? Pois ele não sabe o que tu dizes.
verses.RVR09: Porque si bendijeres con el espíritu, el que ocupa lugar de un mero particular, ¿cómo dirá amén á tu acción de gracias? pues no sabe lo que has dicho.

verses.KJV: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.WEB: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
verses.ASV: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em verdade tu bem dás graças; mas o outro não é edificado.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, á la verdad, bien haces gracias; mas el otro no es edificado.

verses.KJV: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.WEB: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
verses.ASV: I thank God, I speak with tongues more than you all:
verses.ALMEIDA: Graças dou a meu Deus, que mais línguas falo que todos vós.
verses.RVR09: Doy gracias á Dios que hablo lenguas más que todos vosotros:

verses.KJV: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.WEB: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
verses.ASV: howbeit in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu quero [mais] falar na igreja cinco palavras com meu entendimento, para que eu também possa instruir aos outros, do que dez mil palavras em língua [estranha] .
verses.RVR09: Pero en la iglesia más quiero hablar cinco palabras con mi sentido, para que enseñe también á los otros, que diez mil palabras en lengua desconocida.

verses.KJV: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.WEB: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
verses.ASV: Brethren, be not children in mind: yet in malice be ye babes, but in mind be men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, não sejais meninos no entendimento, mas sede meninos na malícia, e adultos no entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, no seáis niños en el sentido, sino sed niños en la malicia: empero perfectos en el sentido.

verses.KJV: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
verses.ASV: In the law it is written, By men of strange tongues and by the lips of strangers will I speak unto this people; and not even thus will they hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na Lei está escrito: A este povo falarei por gente de outras línguas, e por outros lábios; e ainda assim não me ouvirão, diz o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: En la ley está escrito: En otras lenguas y en otros labios hablaré á este pueblo; y ni aun así me oirán, dice el Señor.

verses.KJV: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.WEB: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
verses.ASV: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to the unbelieving: but prophesying [is for a sign], not to the unbelieving, but to them that believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então as línguas [estranhas] são por sinal, não para os que creem, mas para os que não creem; e a profecia não é para os que não creem, mas para os que creem.
verses.RVR09: Así que, las lenguas por señal son, no á los fieles, sino á los infieles: mas la profecía, no á los infieles, sino á los fieles.

verses.KJV: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.WEB: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
verses.ASV: If therefore the whole church be assembled together and all speak with tongues, and there come in men unlearned or unbelieving, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se toda a igreja se reunir, e todos falarem línguas [estranhas] , e entrarem alguns sem entendimento ou descrentes, não dirão que estais loucos?
verses.RVR09: De manera que, si toda la iglesia se juntare en uno, y todos hablan lenguas, y entran indoctos ó infieles, ¿no dirán que estáis locos?

verses.KJV: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.WEB: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
verses.ASV: But if all prophesy, and there come in one unbelieving or unlearned, he is reproved by all, he is judged by all;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se todos profetizarem, e algum sem entendimento ou descrente entrar, por todos é convencido, [e] por todos é julgado.
verses.RVR09: Mas si todos profetizan, y entra algún infiel ó indocto, de todos es convencido, de todos es juzgado;

verses.KJV: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.WEB: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
verses.ASV: the secrets of his heart are made manifest; and so he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim os segredos de seu coração ficam manifestos, e assim, lançando-se sobre [seu] rosto, adorará a Deus, reconhecendo publicamente que Deus está entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Lo oculto de su corazón se hace manifiesto: y así, postrándose sobre el rostro, adorará á Dios, declarando que verdaderamente Dios está en vosotros.

verses.KJV: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.WEB: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
verses.ASV: What is it then, brethren? When ye come together, each one hath a psalm, hath a teaching, hath a revelation, hath a tongue, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o que há, irmãos? Quando vos reunis, tem cada um de vós salmo, tem doutrina, tem língua [estranha] , tem revelação, tem interpretação, tudo se faça para edificação.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué hay pues, hermanos? Cuando os juntáis, cada uno de vosotros tiene salmo, tiene doctrina, tiene lengua, tiene revelación, tiene interpretación: hágase todo para edificación.

verses.KJV: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.WEB: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
verses.ASV: If any man speaketh in a tongue, [let it be] by two, or at the most three, and [that] in turn; and let one interpret:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém falar em língua [estranha] , [sejam] dois, ou no máximo três, e alternando-se, e um que interprete.
verses.RVR09: Si hablare alguno en lengua extraña, sea esto por dos, ó á lo más tres, y por turno; mas uno interprete.

verses.KJV: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.WEB: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
verses.ASV: but if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não houver intérprete, cale-se na igreja, fale porém consigo mesmo, e com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y si no hubiere intérprete, calle en la iglesia, y hable á sí mismo y á Dios.

verses.KJV: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.WEB: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.
verses.ASV: And let the prophets speak [by] two or three, and let the others discern.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falem dois ou três profetas, e os outros julguem.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo, los profetas hablen dos ó tres, y los demás juzguen.

verses.KJV: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.WEB: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
verses.ASV: But if a revelation be made to another sitting by, let the first keep silence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se a outro, que estiver sentada, for revelada [alguma coisa] , cale-se o primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y si á otro que estuviere sentado, fuere revelado, calle el primero.

verses.KJV: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.WEB: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
verses.ASV: For ye all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos vós podeis profetizar, um após o outro, para que todos aprendam, e sejam todos fortalecidos.
verses.RVR09: Porque podéis todos profetizar uno por uno, para que todos aprendan, y todos sean exhortados.

verses.KJV: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.WEB: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
verses.ASV: and the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os espíritos dos profetas estão sujeitos aos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y los espíritus de los que profetizaren, sujétense á los profetas;

verses.KJV: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.WEB: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
verses.ASV: for God is not [a God] of confusion, but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus não é de confusão, mas de paz, como em todas as igrejas dos santos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios no es Dios de disensión, sino de paz; como en todas las iglesias de los santos.

verses.KJV: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also saith the law.
verses.WEB: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
verses.ASV: let the women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as also saith the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossas mulheres fiquem caladas nas igrejas; porque não lhes é permitido falar, mas [que] estejam sujeitas, como também a Lei o diz.
verses.RVR09: Vuestras mujeres callen en las congregaciones; porque no les es permitido hablar, sino que estén sujetas, como también la ley dice.

verses.KJV: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.WEB: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
verses.ASV: And if they would learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home: for it is shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se quiserem aprender alguma coisa, perguntem a seus próprios maridos em casa; porque é impróprio as mulheres falarem na igreja.
verses.RVR09: Y si quieren aprender alguna cosa, pregunten en casa á sus maridos; porque deshonesta cosa es hablar una mujer en la congregación.

verses.KJV: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.WEB: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
verses.ASV: What? was it from you that the word of God went forth? or came it unto you alone?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a palavra de Deus saiu de vós? Ou ela somente chegou a vós?
verses.RVR09: Qué, ¿ha salido de vosotros la palabra de Dios? ¿ó á vosotros solos ha llegado?

verses.KJV: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.WEB: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
verses.ASV: If any man thinketh himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him take knowledge of the things which I write unto you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém pensa ser profeta, ou espiritual, reconheça que as coisas que escrevo são mandamento do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno á su parecer, es profeta, ó espiritual, reconozca lo que os escribo, porque son mandamientos del Señor.

verses.KJV: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.WEB: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.ASV: But if any man is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se alguém ignora, que ignore.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que ignora, ignore.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.WEB: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my brethren, desire earnestly to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, desejai com zelo profetizar, e não impeçais o falar línguas [estranhas] .
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos, procurad profetizar; y no impidáis el hablar lenguas.

verses.KJV: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.WEB: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.ASV: But let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei tudo decentemente e com ordem.
verses.RVR09: Empero hágase todo decentemente y con orden.

verses.KJV: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.WEB: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
verses.ASV: Now I make known unto you brethren, the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye received, wherein also ye stand,
verses.ALMEIDA: Também irmãos, eu vos declaro o Evangelho, que já vos tenho anunciado, o qual também recebestes, no qual também estais.
verses.RVR09: ADEMÁS os declaro, hermanos, el evangelio que os he predicado, el cual también recibisteis, en el cual también perseveráis;

verses.KJV: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
verses.WEB: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
verses.ASV: by which also ye are saved, if ye hold fast the word which I preached unto you, except ye believed in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo qual também sois salvos, se retiverdes a palavra naquela maneira, em que eu vos tenho anunciado; a não ser se tenhais crido em vão.
verses.RVR09: Por el cual asimismo, si retenéis la palabra que os he predicado, sois salvos, si no creísteis en vano.

verses.KJV: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.WEB: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.ASV: For I delivered unto you first of all that which also I received: that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque primeiramente vos entreguei o que também recebi, que Cristo morreu por nossos pecados, segundo as Escrituras;
verses.RVR09: Porque primeramente os he enseñado lo que asimismo recibí: Que Cristo fué muerto por nuestros pecados, conforme á las Escrituras;

verses.KJV: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.WEB: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.ASV: and that he was buried; and that he hath been raised on the third day according to the scriptures;
verses.ALMEIDA: E que foi sepultado, e que ressuscitou ao terceiro dia, segundo as Escrituras;
verses.RVR09: Y que fué sepultado, y que resucitó al tercer día, conforme á las Escrituras;

verses.KJV: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.WEB: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
verses.ASV: and that he appeared to Cephas; then to the twelve;
verses.ALMEIDA: E que foi visto por Cefas, depois pelos doze.
verses.RVR09: Y que apareció á Cefas, y después á los doce.

verses.KJV: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.WEB: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
verses.ASV: then he appeared to above five hundred brethren at once, of whom the greater part remain until now, but some are fallen asleep;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois foi visto de uma fez por mais de quinhentos irmãos, dos quais a maioria [ainda] vive, e também alguns já dormem.
verses.RVR09: Después apareció á más de quinientos hermanos juntos; de los cuales muchos viven aún, y otros son muertos.

verses.KJV: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.WEB: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
verses.ASV: then he appeared to James; then to all the apostles;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois foi visto por Tiago; depois por todos os apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Después apareció á Jacobo; después á todos los apóstoles.

verses.KJV: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.WEB: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
verses.ASV: and last of all, as to the [child] untimely born, he appeared to me also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por último de todos também foi visto por mim, como que a um nascido fora do tempo.
verses.RVR09: Y el postrero de todos, como á un abortivo, me apareció á mí.

verses.KJV: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.WEB: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
verses.ASV: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sou o menor dos apóstolos, que não sou digno de ser chamado apóstolo, porque persegui a Igreja de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo soy el más pequeño de los apóstoles, que no soy digno de ser llamado apóstol, porque perseguí la iglesia de Dios.

verses.KJV: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.WEB: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.ASV: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not found vain; but I labored more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas pela graça de Deus sou o que sou; e sua graça [concedida] a mim não foi vã; ao invés disso trabalhei muito mais que todos eles; porém não eu, mas a graça de Deus que está comigo.
verses.RVR09: Empero por la gracia de Dios soy lo que soy: y su gracia no ha sido en vano para conmigo; antes he trabajado más que todos ellos: pero no yo, sino la gracia de Dios que fué conmigo.

verses.KJV: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.WEB: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
verses.ASV: Whether then [it be] I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, seja eu, sejam eles, assim pregamos, e assim crestes.
verses.RVR09: Porque, ó sea yo ó sean ellos, así predicamos, y así habéis creído.

verses.KJV: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.WEB: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.ASV: Now if Christ is preached that he hath been raised from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se é pregado que Cristo ressuscitou dos mortos, como dizem alguns dentre vós, que não há ressurreição dos mortos?
verses.RVR09: Y si Cristo es predicado que resucitó de los muertos, ¿cómo dicen algunos entre vosotros que no hay resurrección de muertos?

verses.KJV: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.WEB: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.ASV: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither hath Christ been raised:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não há ressurreição dos mortos, [então] Cristo não ressuscitou.
verses.RVR09: Porque si no hay resurrección de muertos, Cristo tampoco resucitó:

verses.KJV: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.WEB: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
verses.ASV: and if Christ hath not been raised, then is our preaching vain, your faith also is vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se Cristo não ressuscitou, então é vã nossa pregação, e vã também é vossa fé.
verses.RVR09: Y si Cristo no resucitó, vana es entonces nuestra predicación, vana es también vuestra fe.

verses.KJV: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.WEB: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
verses.ASV: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we witnessed of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead are not raised.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim também somos encontrados como falsas testemunhas de Deus; pois testemunhamos de Deus, que ressuscitou a Cristo, ao qual [porém] não ressuscitou, se na verdade os mortos não ressuscitam.
verses.RVR09: Y aun somos hallados falsos testigos de Dios; porque hemos testificado de Dios que él haya levantado á Cristo; al cual no levantó, si en verdad los muertos no resucitan.

verses.KJV: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.WEB: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.ASV: For if the dead are not raised, neither hath Christ been raised:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se os mortos não ressuscitam, [então] Cristo também não ressuscitou.
verses.RVR09: Porque si los muertos no resucitan, tampoco Cristo resucitó:

verses.KJV: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.WEB: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
verses.ASV: and if Christ hath not been raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se Cristo não ressuscitou, vossa fé é vá, [e] ainda estais em vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y si Cristo no resucitó, vuestra fe es vana; aun estáis en vuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.WEB: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.ASV: Then they also that are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto também pereceram os que dormiram em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces también los que durmieron en Cristo son perdidos.

verses.KJV: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.WEB: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
verses.ASV: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se nesta vida esperamos somente em Cristo, somos os mais miseráveis de todas as pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Si en esta vida solamente esperamos en Cristo, los más miserables somos de todos los hombres.

verses.KJV: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.WEB: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
verses.ASV: But now hath Christ been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of them that are asleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas de fato Cristo ressuscitou dos mortos, [e] foi feito as primícias dos que dormiram.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora Cristo ha resucitado de los muertos; primicias de los que durmieron es hecho.

verses.KJV: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.WEB: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
verses.ASV: For since by man [came] death, by man [came] also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dado que a morte [veio] por um homem, também por um homem [veio] a ressurreição dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Porque por cuanto la muerte entró por un hombre, también por un hombre la resurrección de los muertos.

verses.KJV: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.WEB: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
verses.ASV: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como em Adão todos morrem, assim também em Cristo todos serão vivificados.
verses.RVR09: Porque así como en Adam todos mueren, así también en Cristo todos serán vivificados.

verses.KJV: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
verses.WEB: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
verses.ASV: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; then they that are Christ’s, at his coming.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas cada um em sua ordem; Cristo, as primícias; depois os que são de Cristo, em sua vinda.
verses.RVR09: Mas cada uno en su orden: Cristo las primicias; luego los que son de Cristo, en su venida.

verses.KJV: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.WEB: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
verses.ASV: Then [cometh] the end, when he shall deliver up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois será o fim, quando entregar o Reino de Deus e ao Pai, quando aniquilar todo domínio, e toda autoridade e poder.
verses.RVR09: Luego el fin; cuando entregará el reino á Dios y al Padre, cuando habrá quitado todo imperio, y toda potencia y potestad.

verses.KJV: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.WEB: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
verses.ASV: For he must reign, till he hath put all his enemies under his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque convém que ele reine, até que tenha posto todos os inimigos debaixo de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Porque es menester que él reine, hasta poner á todos sus enemigos debajo de sus pies.

verses.KJV: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.WEB: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
verses.ASV: The last enemy that shall be abolished is death.
verses.ALMEIDA: O último inimigo, que será aniquilado, [é] a morte.
verses.RVR09: Y el postrer enemigo que será deshecho, será la muerte.

verses.KJV: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.WEB: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
verses.ASV: For, He put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he saith, All things are put in subjection, it is evident that he is excepted who did subject all things unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo de seus pés. Porém quando diz que todas as coisas [lhe] estão sujeitas, está claro que se excetua aquele que todas as coisas lhe sujeitou.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas las cosas sujetó debajo de sus pies. Y cuando dice: Todas las cosas son sujetadas á él, claro está exceptuado aquel que sujetó á él todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.WEB: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
verses.ASV: And when all things have been subjected unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subjected to him that did subject all things unto him, that God may be all in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando todas as coisas lhe forem sujeitas, então também o mesmo Filho se sujeitará a aquele, que todas as coisas lhe sujeitou, para que Deus seja tudo em todos.
verses.RVR09: Mas luego que todas las cosas le fueren sujetas, entonces también el mismo Hijo se sujetará al que le sujetó á él todas las cosas, para que Dios sea todas las cosas en todos.

verses.KJV: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.WEB: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
verses.ASV: Else what shall they do that are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized for them?
verses.ALMEIDA: De outra maneira, que farão os que se batizam pelos mortos, se totalmente os mortos não ressuscitam? Por que, então, se batizam pelos mortos?
verses.RVR09: De otro modo, ¿qué harán los que se bautizan por los muertos, si en ninguna manera los muertos resucitan? ¿Por qué pues se bautizan por los muertos?
