verses.KJV: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.WEB: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
verses.ASV: why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que também nós à toda hora estamos em perigo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué nosotros peligramos á toda hora?

verses.KJV: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.WEB: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.ASV: I protest by that glorying in you, brethren, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.ALMEIDA: A cada dia eu morro pelo orgulho que tenho por vós, em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Sí, por la gloria que en orden á vosotros tengo en Cristo Jesús Señor nuestro, cada día muero.

verses.KJV: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.WEB: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
verses.ASV: If after the manner of men I fought with beasts at Ephesus, what doth it profit me? If the dead are not raised, let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se por motivo humano lutei contra feras em Éfeso, qual é o meu proveito? Se os mortos não ressuscitam, comamos e bebamos, que amanhã morreremos.
verses.RVR09: Si como hombre batallé en Efeso contra las bestias, ¿qué me aprovecha? Si los muertos no resucitan, comamos y bebamos, que mañana moriremos.

verses.KJV: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.WEB: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
verses.ASV: Be not deceived: Evil companionships corrupt good morals.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não erreis. As más companhias corrompem os bons costumes.
verses.RVR09: No erréis: las malas conversaciones corrompen las buenas costumbres.

verses.KJV: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.WEB: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
verses.ASV: Awake to soberness righteously, and sin not; for some have no knowledge of God: I speak [this] to move you to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Despertai para a justiça, e não pequeis; porque alguns [ainda] não têm o conhecimento de Deus. Eu digo isto para vossa vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Velad debidamente, y no pequéis; porque algunos no conocen á Dios: para vergüenza vuestra hablo.

verses.KJV: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.WEB: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
verses.ASV: But some one will say, How are the dead raised? and with what manner of body do they come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas alguém dirá: Como ressuscitarão os mortos? E com que corpo virão?
verses.RVR09: Mas dirá alguno: ¿Cómo resucitarán los muertos? ¿Con qué cuerpo vendrán?

verses.KJV: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.WEB: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
verses.ASV: Thou foolish one, that which thou thyself sowest is not quickened except it die:
verses.ALMEIDA: Louco, o que tu semeias não é vivificado, se [primeiro] não morrer.
verses.RVR09: Necio, lo que tú siembras no se vivifica, si no muriere antes.

verses.KJV: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.WEB: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
verses.ASV: and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not the body that shall be, but a bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other kind;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que semeias, não semeias o corpo que irá brotar, mas o grão nu, como o de trigo, ou de qualquer outro [grão] .
verses.RVR09: Y lo que siembras, no siembras el cuerpo que ha de salir, sino el grano desnudo, acaso de trigo, ó de otro grano:

verses.KJV: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.WEB: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
verses.ASV: but God giveth it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus lhe dá o corpo como quer, e a cada semente seu próprio corpo.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios le da el cuerpo como quiso, y á cada simiente su propio cuerpo.

verses.KJV: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.WEB: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
verses.ASV: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one [flesh] of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another flesh of birds, and another of fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda carne não é a mesma carne; mas uma é a carne humana, e outra a carne dos animais, e outra a dos peixes, e outra a das aves.
verses.RVR09: Toda carne no es la misma carne; mas una carne ciertamente es la de los hombres, y otra carne la de los animales, y otra la de los peces, y otra la de las aves.

verses.KJV: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.WEB: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
verses.ASV: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the [glory] of the terrestrial is another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há corpos celestiais, e corpos terrestres; mas uma é a glória dos celestiais, e outra a dos terrestres.
verses.RVR09: Y cuerpos hay celestiales, y cuerpos terrestres; mas ciertamente una es la gloria de los celestiales, y otra la de los terrestres.

verses.KJV: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.WEB: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
verses.ASV: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra é a glória do Sol, e outra a glória da Lua, e outra a glória das estrelas; porque [uma] estrela difere em glória [de outra] estrela.
verses.RVR09: Otra es la gloria del sol, y otra la gloria de la luna, y otra la gloria de las estrellas: porque una estrella es diferente de otra en gloria.

verses.KJV: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.WEB: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
verses.ASV: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também será a ressurreição dos mortos. Semeia-se [o corpo] degradável, ressuscitará capaz de nunca se degradar.
verses.RVR09: Así también es la resurrección de los muertos. Se siembra en corrupción, se levantará en incorrupción;

verses.KJV: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.WEB: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
verses.ASV: it is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.ALMEIDA: Semeia-se em desonra, ressuscitará em glória. Semeia-se em fraqueza, ressuscitará em força.
verses.RVR09: Se siembra en vergüenza, se levantará con gloria; se siembra en flaqueza, se levantará con potencia;

verses.KJV: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.WEB: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
verses.ASV: it is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual [body].
verses.ALMEIDA: Semeia-se corpo natural, ressuscitará corpo espiritual. Há corpo animal, e há corpo espiritual.
verses.RVR09: Se siembra cuerpo animal, resucitará espiritual cuerpo. Hay cuerpo animal, y hay cuerpo espiritual.

verses.KJV: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.WEB: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
verses.ASV: So also it is written, The first man Adam became a living soul. The last Adam [became] a life-giving spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também está escrito: O primeiro homem, Adão, foi feito em alma vivente; o último Adão em espírito vivificante.
verses.RVR09: Así también está escrito: Fué hecho el primer hombre Adam en ánima viviente; el postrer Adam en espíritu vivificante.

verses.KJV: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.WEB: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
verses.ASV: Howbeit that is not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; then that which is spiritual.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não é primeiro o espiritual; mas sim o carnal, depois o espiritual.
verses.RVR09: Mas lo espiritual no es primero, sino lo animal; luego lo espiritual.

verses.KJV: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.WEB: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.ASV: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: O primeiro homem da terra [é] terrestre; o segundo homem, [que é] o Senhor, [é] do Céu.
verses.RVR09: El primer hombre, es de la tierra, terreno: el segundo hombre, que es el Señor, es del cielo.

verses.KJV: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.WEB: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.ASV: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como [é] o terrestre, também [são] os terrestres; e assim como [é] o celestial, também [são] os celestiais.
verses.RVR09: Cual el terreno, tales también los terrenos; y cual el celestial, tales también los celestiales.

verses.KJV: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.WEB: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.ASV: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim como trouxemos a imagem do terrestre, assim também traremos a imagem do celestial.
verses.RVR09: Y como trajimos la imagen del terreno, traeremos también la imagen del celestial.

verses.KJV: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.WEB: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
verses.ASV: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém isto digo, irmãos, que a carne e o sangue não podem herdar o Reino de Deus, nem o que é degradável herda a capacidade de não se degradar.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero digo, hermanos: que la carne y la sangre no pueden heredar el reino de Dios; ni la corrupción hereda la incorrupción.

verses.KJV: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.WEB: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
verses.ASV: Behold, I tell you a mystery: We all shall not sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.ALMEIDA: eis que eu vos digo um mistério: nem todos em verdade dormiremos; porém todos seremos transformados.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, os digo un misterio: Todos ciertamente no dormiremos, mas todos seremos transformados,

verses.KJV: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.WEB: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
verses.ASV: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em um momento, em um piscar de olhos, à ultima trombeta; porque a trombeta soará, e os mortos ressuscitarão capazes de não se degradar, e nós seremos transformados.
verses.RVR09: En un momento, en un abrir de ojo, á la final trompeta; porque será tocada la trompeta, y los muertos serán levantados sin corrupción, y nosotros seremos transformados.

verses.KJV: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.WEB: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.ASV: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é necessário que este [corpo] degradável revista-se da capacidade de não se degradar, e este [corpo] mortal vista a imortalidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque es menester que esto corruptible sea vestido de incorrupción, y esto mortal sea vestido de inmortalidad.

verses.KJV: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.WEB: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
verses.ASV: But when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando este [corpo] se revestir da capacidade de não se degradar, e este [corpo] mortal se vestir de imortalidade, então se cumprirá a palavra que está escrita: Na vitória, a morte é tragada.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando esto corruptible fuere vestido de incorrupción, y esto mortal fuere vestido de inmortalidad, entonces se efectuará la palabra que está escrita: Sorbida es la muerte con victoria.

verses.KJV: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
verses.WEB: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
verses.ASV: O death, where is thy victory? O death, where is thy sting?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está, ó morte, o teu aguilhão? Onde está, ó Xeol, a tua vitória?
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde está, oh muerte, tu aguijón? ¿dónde, oh sepulcro, tu victoria?

verses.KJV: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.WEB: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
verses.ASV: The sting of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law:
verses.ALMEIDA: O aguilhão da morte é o pecado, e a força do pecado é a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Ya que el aguijón de la muerte es el pecado, y la potencia del pecado, la ley.

verses.KJV: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: but thanks be to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas graças a Deus, que nos dá vitória por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Dios gracias, que nos da la victoria por el Señor nuestro Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labor is not vain in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus amados irmãos, sede firmes, imóveis [e] sempre abundantes na obra do Senhor, sabendo que o vosso trabalho não é vão no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos míos amados, estad firmes y constantes, creciendo en la obra del Señor siempre, sabiendo que vuestro trabajo en el Señor no es vano.

verses.KJV: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.WEB: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
verses.ASV: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto à coleta que [se faz] para os santos, fazei também como ordenei às igrejas da Galácia.
verses.RVR09: CUANTO á la colecta para los santos, haced vosotros también de la manera que ordené en las iglesias de Galacia.

verses.KJV: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.WEB: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
verses.ASV: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada primeiro [dia] da semana, cada um de vós ponha [alguma coisa] à pate, reservando [para isso] conforme a prosperidade que tiver obtido, para que, quando eu vier, não se façam coletas.
verses.RVR09: Cada primer día de la semana cada uno de vosotros aparte en su casa, guardando lo que por la bondad de Dios pudiere; para que cuando yo llegare, no se hagan entonces colectas.

verses.KJV: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu vier, enviarei aos que por cartas aprovardes, para que levem vossa doação para Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando habré llegado, los que aprobareis por cartas, á éstos enviaré que lleven vuestro beneficio á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.WEB: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
verses.ASV: and if it be meet for me to go also, they shall go with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for necessário que eu também vá, irão comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere digno el negocio de que yo también vaya, irán conmigo.

verses.KJV: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.WEB: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
verses.ASV: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas virei até vós, depois de passar pela Macedônia (porque passarei pela Macedônia).
verses.RVR09: Y á vosotros iré, cuando hubiere pasado por Macedonia, porque por Macedonia tengo de pasar:

verses.KJV: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.WEB: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
verses.ASV: but with you it may be that I shall abide, or even winter, that ye may set me forward on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pode ser que eu fique [um tempo] convosco ou também passar o inverno, para que me envieis para onde quer que eu for.
verses.RVR09: Y podrá ser que me quede con vosotros, ó invernaré también, para que vosotros me llevéis á donde hubiere de ir.

verses.KJV: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.WEB: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
verses.ASV: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu não quero vos ver agora [apenas] de passagem; mas espero ficar convosco por algum tempo, se o Senhor o permitir.
verses.RVR09: Porque no os quiero ahora ver de paso; porque espero estar con vosotros algún tiempo, si el Señor lo permitiere.

verses.KJV: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.WEB: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
verses.ASV: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ficarei em Éfeso até o Pentecostes.
verses.RVR09: Empero estaré en Efeso hasta Pentecostés;

verses.KJV: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.WEB: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.ASV: for a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque uma porta grande e eficaz se abriu para mim, e há muitos adversários.
verses.RVR09: Porque se me ha abierto puerta grande y eficaz, y muchos son los adversarios.

verses.KJV: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.WEB: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.ASV: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se vier Timóteo, olhai para que ele esteja sem temor convosco; porque assim como eu, ele também faz a obra do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y si llegare Timoteo, mirad que esté con vosotros seguramente; porque la obra del Señor hace también como yo.

verses.KJV: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.WEB: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
verses.ASV: let no man therefore despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come unto me: for I expect him with the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto ninguém o despreze; mas enviai-o em paz, para que ele venha a mim; porque eu o espero com os irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, nadie le tenga en poco; antes, llevadlo en paz, para que venga á mí: porque lo espero con los hermanos.

verses.KJV: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.WEB: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
verses.ASV: But as touching Apollos the brother, I besought him much to come unto you with the brethren: and it was not at all [his] will to come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto ao irmão Apolo, muito roguei que ele viesse com os irmãos até vós; mas ele de maneira nenhuma teve vontade de vir por agora; porém oferecendo-se a ele boa oportunidade, ele virá.
verses.RVR09: Acerca del hermano Apolos, mucho le he rogado que fuese á vosotros con los hermanos; mas en ninguna manera tuvo voluntad de ir por ahora; pero irá cuando tuviere oportunidad.

verses.KJV: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.WEB: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
verses.ASV: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai, ficai firmes na fé, sede corajosos, [e] vos esforçai.
verses.RVR09: Velad, estad firmes en la fe; portaos varonilmente, y esforzaos.

verses.KJV: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.WEB: Let all that you do be done in love.
verses.ASV: Let all that ye do be done in love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as vossas coisas sejam feitas em amor.
verses.RVR09: Todas vuestras cosas sean hechas con caridad.

verses.KJV: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.WEB: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
verses.ASV: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sabeis que [os da] casa de Estéfanas foram os primeiros da Acaia, e que eles têm se dedicado ao trabalho dos santos; rogo-vos, pois, irmãos,
verses.RVR09: Y os ruego, hermanos, (ya sabéis que la casa de Estéfanas es las primicias de Acaya, y que se han dedicado al ministerio de los santos,)

verses.KJV: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
verses.WEB: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
verses.ASV: that ye also be in subjection unto such, and to every one that helpeth in the work and laboreth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que também vos sujeiteis a eles, e a todo aquele que opera e trabalha junto [conosco] .
verses.RVR09: Que vosotros os sujetéis á los tales, y á todos los que ayudan y trabajan.

verses.KJV: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.WEB: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
verses.ASV: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu me alegro com a vinda de Estéfanas, e de Fortunato, e de Acaico, porque estes supriram o que de vossa [parte me] faltava.
verses.RVR09: Huélgome de la venida de Estéfanas y de Fortunato y de Achâico: porque éstos suplieron lo que á vosotros faltaba.

verses.KJV: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.WEB: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
verses.ASV: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles confortaram meu espírito, e [também] o vosso. Então reconhecei aos tais.
verses.RVR09: Porque recrearon mi espíritu y el vuestro: reconoced pues á los tales.

verses.KJV: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.WEB: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
verses.ASV: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Prisca salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.ALMEIDA: As igrejas da Ásia vos saúdam. Áquila e Priscila vos saúdam-vos afetuosamente no Senhor, e também a igreja que está na casa deles.
verses.RVR09: Las iglesias de Asia os saludan. Os saludan mucho en el Señor Aquila y Priscila, con la iglesia que está en su casa.

verses.KJV: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.WEB: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.ASV: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os irmãos vos saúdam. Saudai-vos uns as outros com beijo santo.
verses.RVR09: Os saludan todos los hermanos. Saludaos los unos á los otros con ósculo santo.

verses.KJV: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.WEB: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
verses.ASV: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudação de minha [própria] mão, de Paulo.
verses.RVR09: La salutación de mí, Pablo, de mi mano.

verses.KJV: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.WEB: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
verses.ASV: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém não ama ao Senhor Jesus Cristo seja anátema. Vem, Senhor.
verses.RVR09: El que no amare al Señor Jesucristo, sea anatema. Maranatha.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.WEB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.ASV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo esteja convosco.
verses.RVR09: La gracia del Señor Jesucristo sea con vosotros.

verses.KJV: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.WEB: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.ASV: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu amor esteja com todos vós em Cristo Jesus. Amém. [A primeira Carta aos Coríntios foi escrita de Filipos, e enviada por Estéfanas, Fortunato, Acaico e Timóteo]
verses.RVR09: Mi amor en Cristo Jesús sea con todos vosotros. Amén. La primera á los Corintios fué enviada de Filipos con Estéfanas, y Fortunato, y Achâico, y Timoteo.

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints that are in the whole of Achaia:
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo, para a igreja de Deus que está em Corinto, com todos os santos que estão em toda a Acaia.
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, y Timoteo el hermano, á la iglesia de Dios que está en Corinto, juntamente con todos los santos que están por toda la Acaya:

verses.KJV: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Graça e paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Gracia y paz á vosotros de Dios nuestro Padre, y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
verses.ASV: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai das misericórdias, e o Deus de toda consolação,
verses.RVR09: Bendito sea el Dios y Padre del Señor Jesucristo, el Padre de misericordias, y el Dios de toda consolación,

verses.KJV: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.WEB: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verses.ASV: who comforteth us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort them that are in any affliction, through the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que nos consola em toda aflição nossa, para que também possamos consolar aos que estiverem em alguma aflição, com a consolação com que nós mesmos por Deus somos consolados.
verses.RVR09: El cual nos consuela en todas nuestras tribulaciones, para que podamos también nosotros consolar á los que están en cualquiera angustia, con la consolación con que nosotros somos consolados de Dios.

verses.KJV: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
verses.WEB: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
verses.ASV: For as the sufferings of Christ abound unto us, even so our comfort also aboundeth through Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como os sofrimentos de Cristo são abundantes em nós, assim também por Cristo é abundante nossa consolação.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la manera que abundan en nosotros las aflicciones de Cristo, así abunda también por el mismo Cristo nuestra consolación.

verses.KJV: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.WEB: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
verses.ASV: But whether we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; or whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which worketh in the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se nós somos afligidos, é para vossa consolação e salvação, que opera enquanto se suporta os mesmos sofrimentos que nós também sofremos; se estamos consolados, [também é] para vossa consolação e salvação
verses.RVR09: Mas si somos atribulados, es por vuestra consolación y salud; la cual es obrada en el sufrir las mismas aflicciones que nosotros también padecemos: ó si somos consolados, es por vuestra consolación y salud;

verses.KJV: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
verses.WEB: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
verses.ASV: and our hope for you is stedfast; knowing that, as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so also are ye of the comfort.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nossa esperança por vós é firme, sabendo que, como sois participantes dos sofrimentos, assim também [sois] da consolação.
verses.RVR09: Y nuestra esperanza de vosotros es firme; estando ciertos que como sois compañeros de las aflicciones, así también lo sois de la consolación.

verses.KJV: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.WEB: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
verses.ASV: For we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning our affliction which befell [us] in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, irmãos, não queremos que ignoreis nossa aflição que nos sobreveio na Ásia, em que fomos excessivamente oprimidos, mais do que podíamos suportar, de tal modo que já tínhamos perdido a esperança de sobrevivermos.
verses.RVR09: Porque hermanos, no queremos que ignoréis de nuestra tribulación que nos fué hecha en Asia; que sobremanera fuimos cargados sobre nuestras fuerzas de tal manera que estuviésemos en duda de la vida.

verses.KJV: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
verses.WEB: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
verses.ASV: yea, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raiseth the dead:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso já tínhamos em nós mesmos a sentença de morte, para que não confiássemos em nós mesmos, mas sim em Deus, que ressuscita aos mortos;
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros tuvimos en nosotros mismos respuesta de muerte, para que no confiemos en nosotros mismos, sino en Dios que levanta los muertos:

verses.KJV: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
verses.WEB: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
verses.ASV: who delivered us out of so great a death, and will deliver: on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual nos livrou de tamanha morte, e [ainda nos] livra; nele esperamos que também ainda [nos] livrará;
verses.RVR09: El cual nos libró, y libra de tanta muerte; en el cual esperamos que aun nos librará;

verses.KJV: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.WEB: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
verses.ASV: ye also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed upon us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on our behalf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto do vosso auxílio com oração por nós, a fim de que, pelo favor [concedido] a nós por causa de muitas pessoas, por muitos sejam dadas graças [a Deus] por nós.
verses.RVR09: Ayudándonos también vosotros con oración por nosotros, para que por la merced hecha á nos por respeto de muchos, por muchos sean hechas gracias por nosotros.

verses.KJV: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.WEB: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
verses.ASV: For our glorying is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nosso orgulho é este: o testemunho de nossa consciência, que com simplicidade e sinceridade de Deus, não com sabedoria carnal, mas com a graça de Deus, nós nos comportamos no mundo, e especialmente convosco.
verses.RVR09: Porque nuestra gloria es esta: el testimonio de nuestra conciencia, que con simplicidad y sinceridad de Dios, no con sabiduría carnal, mas con la gracia de Dios, hemos conversado en el mundo, y muy más con vosotros.

verses.KJV: For we write none other things unto you, that what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.WEB: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
verses.ASV: For we write no other things unto you, than what ye read or even acknowledge, and I hope ye will acknowledge unto the end:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nenhuma outra coisa vos escrevemos, a não ser as que já sabeis, ou também entendeis; e espero que as entendereis por completo.
verses.RVR09: Porque no os escribimos otras cosas de las que leéis, ó también conocéis: y espero que aun hasta el fin las conoceréis:

verses.KJV: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
verses.ASV: as also ye did acknowledge us in part, that we are your glorying, even as ye also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como também já em parte tendes nos entendido, que somos vosso orgulho, como também vós sois o nosso [orgulho] no dia do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Como también en parte habéis conocido que somos vuestra gloria, así como también vosotros la nuestra, para el día del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
verses.WEB: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
verses.ASV: And in this confidence I was minded to come first unto you, that ye might have a second benefit;
verses.ALMEIDA: E com esta confiança eu quis primeiro vir até vós, para que tivésseis uma segunda graça;
verses.RVR09: Y con esta confianza quise primero ir á vosotros, para que tuvieseis una segunda gracia;

verses.KJV: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
verses.WEB: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
verses.ASV: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come unto you, and of you to be set forward on my journey unto Judæa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por vós passar para a Macedônia; e da Macedônia vir outra vez até vós; e [depois] ser enviado por vós até a Judeia.
verses.RVR09: Y por vosotros pasar á Macedonia, y de Macedonia venir otra vez á vosotros, y ser vuelto de vosotros á Judea.

verses.KJV: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.WEB: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
verses.ASV: When I therefore was thus minded, did I show fickleness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the yea yea and the nay nay?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu planejei isso, por acaso fiz de forma irresponsável? Ou o que eu planejo, planejo segundo a carne, para que eu diga sim e não [ao mesmo tempo] ?
verses.RVR09: Así que, pretendiendo esto, ¿usé quizá de liviandad? ó lo que pienso hacer, ¿piénsolo según la carne, para que haya en mí Sí y No?

verses.KJV: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
verses.WEB: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
verses.ASV: But as God is faithful, our word toward you is not yea and nay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém [assim como] Deus é fiel, nossa palavra para vós não foi sim e não [ao mesmo tempo] .
verses.RVR09: Antes, Dios fiel sabe que nuestra palabra para con vosotros no es Sí y No.

verses.KJV: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.WEB: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
verses.ASV: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, [even] by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yea and nay, but in him is yea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Filho de Deus, Jesus Cristo, o que por nós foi pregado entre vós, [isto é] , por mim, e Silvano, e Timóteo, não foi sim e não, mas nele foi o “sim”.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Hijo de Dios, Jesucristo, que por nosotros ha sido entre vosotros predicado, por mí y Silvano y Timoteo, no ha sido Sí y No; mas ha sido Sí en él.

verses.KJV: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.WEB: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
verses.ASV: For how many soever be the promises of God, in him is the yea: wherefore also through him is the Amen, unto the glory of God through us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todas as promessas nele são “sim”, e nele [se diga] Amém, para glória de Deus por meio de nós.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas las promesas de Dios son en él Sí, y en él Amén, por nosotros á gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
verses.WEB: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
verses.ASV: Now he that establisheth us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que nos confirma convosco, e o que nos ungiu, é Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el que nos confirma con vosotros en Cristo, y el que nos ungió, es Dios;

verses.KJV: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.WEB: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.ASV: who also sealed us, and gave [us] the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual também nos selou, e [nos] deu o penhor do Espírito em nosso corações.
verses.RVR09: El cual también nos ha sellado, y dado la prenda del Espíritu en nuestros corazones.

verses.KJV: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.WEB: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
verses.ASV: But I call God for a witness upon my soul, that to spare you I forbare to come unto Corinth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém invoco a Deus por testemunha sobre minha alma, que para vos poupar, até agora não vim a Corinto.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo llamo á Dios por testigo sobre mi alma, que por ser indulgente con vosotros no he pasado todavía á Corinto.

verses.KJV: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
verses.WEB: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
verses.ASV: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for in faith ye stand fast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que sejamos senhores de vossa fé; porém somos cooperadores de vossa alegria. Porque pela fé estais firmes.
verses.RVR09: No que nos enseñoreemos de vuestra fe, mas somos ayudadores de vuestro gozo: porque por la fe estáis firmes.

verses.KJV: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.WEB: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
verses.ASV: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém decidi isto mesmo comigo, de não mais vir até vós com tristeza.
verses.RVR09: ESTO pues determiné para conmigo, no venir otra vez á vosotros con tristeza.

verses.KJV: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.WEB: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
verses.ASV: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se eu vos entristecer, então quem será o que me alegrará, senão aquele que por mim foi entristecido?
verses.RVR09: Porque si yo os contristo, ¿quién será luego el que me alegrará, sino aquel á quien yo contristare?

verses.KJV: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
verses.WEB: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
verses.ASV: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto mesmo vos escrevi, para que quando vier, não tenha tristeza dos que deveriam me alegrar, confiando de vós todos, que minha alegria é [a alegria] de todos vós.
verses.RVR09: Y esto mismo os escribí, porque cuando llegare no tenga tristeza sobre tristeza de los que me debiera gozar; confiando en vosotros todos que mi gozo es el de todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.WEB: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
verses.ASV: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em muita aflição e angústia de coração eu vos escrevi com muitas lágrimas, não para que vos entristecêsseis, mas para que entendêsseis o amor que tenho em abundância para convosco.
verses.RVR09: Porque por la mucha tribulación y angustia del corazón os escribí con muchas lágrimas; no para que fueseis contristados, mas para que supieseis cuánto más amor tengo para con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.WEB: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
verses.ASV: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se alguém [me] entristeceu, não entristeceu a mim [somente] , mas em parte (para que não se exagere) a todos.
verses.RVR09: Que si alguno me contristó, no me contristó á mí, sino en parte, por no cargaros, á todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
verses.WEB: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
verses.ASV: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was [inflicted] by the many;
verses.ALMEIDA: Basta ao tal esta repreensão feita pela maioria.
verses.RVR09: Bástale al tal esta reprensión hecha de muchos;

verses.KJV: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.WEB: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
verses.ASV: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que, ao invés disso, [deveis lhe] perdoar e consolar, para que ele não seja consumido pela excessiva tristeza.
verses.RVR09: Así que, al contrario, vosotros más bien lo perdonéis y consoléis, porque no sea el tal consumido de demasiada tristeza.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
verses.WEB: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso vos peço que confirmeis o amor para com ele.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual os ruego que confirméis el amor para con él.

verses.KJV: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
verses.WEB: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
verses.ASV: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois também para isso eu escrevi, para vos conhecer por meio de prova se vós sois obedientes em tudo.
verses.RVR09: Porque también por este fin os escribí, para tener experiencia de vosotros si sois obedientes en todo.

verses.KJV: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
verses.WEB: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
verses.ASV: But to whom ye forgive anything, I [forgive] also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes [have I forgiven it] in the presence of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao que perdoardes alguma coisa, também eu [lhe perdoo] ; pois a quem eu tenho perdoado, se também eu perdoei, por causa de vós [o fiz] na presença de Cristo; para que Satanás não tire proveito de nós.
verses.RVR09: Y al que vosotros perdonareis, yo también: porque también yo lo que he perdonado, si algo he perdonado, por vosotros lo he hecho en persona de Cristo;

verses.KJV: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.WEB: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
verses.ASV: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não ignoramos seus pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: Porque no seamos engañados de Satanás: pues no ignoramos sus maquinaciones.

verses.KJV: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.WEB: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
verses.ASV: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, quando vim a Troas para [pregar] o Evangelho de Cristo, e abrindo-se porta para mim no Senhor, não tive repouso em meu espírito, por não achar a meu irmão Tito.
verses.RVR09: Cuando vine á Troas para el evangelio de Cristo, aunque me fué abierta puerta en el Señor,

verses.KJV: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.WEB: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
verses.ASV: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, despedindo-me deles, eu parti para a Macedônia.
verses.RVR09: No tuve reposo en mi espíritu, por no haber hallado á Tito mi hermano: así, despidiéndome de ellos, partí para Macedonia.

verses.KJV: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.WEB: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
verses.ASV: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E graças a Deus, que sempre nos faz triunfar em Cristo, e por nós em todo lugar manifesta o cheiro de seu conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Dios gracias, el cual hace que siempre triunfemos en Cristo Jesús, y manifiesta el olor de su conocimiento por nosotros en todo lugar.

verses.KJV: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.WEB: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:
verses.ASV: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque para Deus somos o bom cheiro de Cristo, nos que se salvam, e nos que se perdem.
verses.RVR09: Porque para Dios somos buen olor de Cristo en los que se salvan, y en los que se pierden:

verses.KJV: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.WEB: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
verses.ASV: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para estes certamente cheiro de morte, para a morte; mas para aqueles cheiro de vida, para a vida. E quem é idôneo para estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: A éstos ciertamente olor de muerte para muerte; y á aquéllos olor de vida para vida. Y para estas cosas ¿quién es suficiente?

verses.KJV: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
verses.WEB: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
verses.ASV: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós não somos como muitos, que tentam vender a palavra de Deus; mas nós [a] falamos em Cristo, diante de Deus, com sinceridade, como [enviados] de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque no somos como muchos, mercaderes falsos de la palabra de Dios: antes con sinceridad, como de Dios, delante de Dios, hablamos en Cristo.

verses.KJV: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
verses.WEB: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
verses.ASV: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? or need we, as do some, epistles of commendation to you or from you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso começamos a recomendarmos a nós mesmos outra vez? Ou necessitamos, como alguns [necessitam] , de cartas de recomendação para vós, ou de vossa recomendação?
verses.RVR09: ¿COMENZAMOS otra vez á alabarnos á nosotros mismos? ¿ó tenemos necesidad, como algunos, de letras de recomendación para vosotros, ó de recomendación de vosotros?

verses.KJV: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.WEB: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
verses.ASV: Ye are our epistle, written in our hearts, known and read of all men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois nossa carta [de recomendação] ,escrita em nossos corações, conhecida e lida por todos,
verses.RVR09: Nuestras letras sois vosotros, escritas en nuestros corazones, sabidas y leídas de todos los hombres;

verses.KJV: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.WEB: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
verses.ASV: being made manifest that ye are an epistle of Christ, ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in tables [that are] hearts of flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manifestando que sois a carta de Cristo, administrada por nós, [e] escrita, não com tinta, mas com o Espírito do Deus vivente; não em tábuas de pedra, mas em tábuas de carne do coração.
verses.RVR09: Siendo manifiesto que sois letra de Cristo administrada de nosotros, escrita no con tinta, mas con el Espíritu del Dios vivo; no en tablas de piedra, sino en tablas de carne del corazón.

verses.KJV: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.WEB: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
verses.ASV: And such confidence have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tal confiança temos por Cristo para com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y tal confianza tenemos por Cristo para con Dios:

verses.KJV: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
verses.WEB: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
verses.ASV: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que sejamos capazes de pensar alguma coisa de nós como [se fosse] de nós mesmos, mas nossa capacidade é de Deus;
verses.RVR09: No que seamos suficientes de nosotros mismos para pensar algo como de nosotros mismos, sino que nuestra suficiencia es de Dios;

verses.KJV: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
verses.WEB: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
verses.ASV: who also made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual também nos fez capazes para sermos ministros do Novo Testamento, não da letra, mas do Espírito; porque a letra mata, mas o Espírito vivifica.
verses.RVR09: El cual asimismo nos hizo ministros suficientes de un nuevo pacto: no de la letra, mas del espíritu; porque la letra mata, mas el espíritu vivifica.

verses.KJV: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
verses.WEB: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
verses.ASV: But if the ministration of death, written, [and] engraven on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look stedfastly upon the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which [glory] was passing away:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o ministério da morte em letras, impresso em pedras, foi com glória, de maneira que os filhos de Israel não podiam fixar os olhos no rosto de Moisés, por causa da glória de seu rosto, que se extinguia,
verses.RVR09: Y si el ministerio de muerte en la letra grabado en piedras, fué con gloria, tanto que los hijos de Israel no pudiesen poner los ojos en la faz de Moisés á causa de la gloria de su rostro, la cual había de perecer,

verses.KJV: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
verses.WEB: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
verses.ASV: how shall not rather the ministration of the spirit be with glory?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o ministério do Espírito não terá ainda mais glória?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo no será más bien con gloria el ministerio del espíritu?

verses.KJV: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.WEB: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
verses.ASV: For if the ministration of condemnation hath glory, much rather doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se o ministério da condenação teve glória, o ministério da justiça excede muito mais em glória.
verses.RVR09: Porque si el ministerio de condenación fué con gloria, mucho más abundará en gloria el ministerio de justicia.

verses.KJV: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
verses.WEB: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
verses.ASV: For verily that which hath been made glorious hath not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasseth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o que já foi glorioso, em comparação, deixou de ter glória, por causa da glória superior.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun lo que fué glorioso, no es glorioso en esta parte, en comparación de la excelente gloria.

verses.KJV: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
verses.WEB: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
verses.ASV: For if that which passeth away [was] with glory, much more that which remaineth [is] in glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se o que se extinguiu teve glória, muito mais glória tem o que permanece.
verses.RVR09: Porque si lo que perece tuvo gloria, mucho más será en gloria lo que permanece.

verses.KJV: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
verses.WEB: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
verses.ASV: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que temos tal esperança, falamos com muita ousadia,
verses.RVR09: Así que, teniendo tal esperanza, hablamos con mucha confianza;

verses.KJV: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
verses.WEB: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
verses.ASV: and [are] not as Moses, [who] put a veil upon his face, that the children of Israel should not look stedfastly on the end of that which was passing away:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não como Moisés, que punha um véu sobre o seu rosto, para que os filhos de Israel não enxergassem o fim do que se extinguia.
verses.RVR09: Y no como Moisés, que ponía un velo sobre su faz, para que los hijos de Israel no pusiesen los ojos en el fin de lo que había de ser abolido.

verses.KJV: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
verses.WEB: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
verses.ASV: but their minds were hardened: for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remaineth, it not being revealed [to them] that it is done away in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém suas mentes foram endurecidas, porque até hoje fica o mesmo véu ainda coberto na leitura do antigo pacto, o qual é extinto por Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Empero los sentidos de ellos se embotaron; porque hasta el día de hoy les queda el mismo velo no descubierto en la lección del antiguo testamento, el cual por Cristo es quitado.

verses.KJV: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
verses.WEB: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
verses.ASV: But unto this day, whensoever Moses is read, a veil lieth upon their heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas até hoje, quando se lê [as palavras de] Moisés, o véu está posto sobre o coração deles.
verses.RVR09: Y aun hasta el día de hoy, cuando Moisés es leído, el velo está puesto sobre el corazón de ellos.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
verses.WEB: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.ASV: But whensoever it shall turn to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando se converterem ao Senhor, [então] o véu será tirado.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando se convirtieren al Señor, el velo se quitará.

verses.KJV: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.WEB: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.ASV: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, [there] is liberty.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor é o Espírito; e onde está o Espírito do Senhor, aí há liberdade.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Señor es el Espíritu; y donde hay el Espíritu del Señor, allí hay libertad.

verses.KJV: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
verses.ASV: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos nós, com o rosto descoberto, refletindo como que um espelho a glória do Senhor, somos transformados de glória em glória, [segundo] a mesma imagem, como pelo Espírito do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, nosotros todos, mirando á cara descubierta como en un espejo la gloria del Señor, somos transformados de gloria en gloria en la misma semejanza, como por el Espíritu del Señor.

verses.KJV: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
verses.WEB: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
verses.ASV: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we faint not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, tendo este ministério, segundo a misericórdia que nos foi feita, não desfalecemos.
verses.RVR09: POR lo cual teniendo nosotros esta administración según la misericordia que hemos alcanzado, no desmayamos;

verses.KJV: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
verses.WEB: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.ASV: but we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas já rejeitamos as coisas ocultas e vergonhosas, não andando com astúcia, nem falsificando a Palavra de Deus, mas pela manifestação da verdade fazemos recomendação de nós mesmos à consciência de todos os seres humanos, à vista de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Antes quitamos los escondrijos de vergüenza, no andando con astucia, ni adulterando la palabra de Dios, sino por manifestación de la verdad encomendándonos á nosotros mismos á toda conciencia humana delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
verses.WEB: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
verses.ASV: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled in them that perish:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se o nosso Evangelho está encoberto, é para os que se perdem que está encoberto;
verses.RVR09: Que si nuestro evangelio está aún encubierto, entre los que se pierden está encubierto:

verses.KJV: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
verses.WEB: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
verses.ASV: in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn [upon them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos quais o deus destes tempos cegou os entendimentos, [isto é] ,os incrédulos, para que não lhes brilhe a luz do Evangelho da glória de Cristo, que é a imagem de Deus.
verses.RVR09: En los cuales el dios de este siglo cegó los entendimientos de los incrédulos, para que no les resplandezca la lumbre del evangelio de la gloria de Cristo, el cual es la imagen de Dios.

verses.KJV: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
verses.WEB: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
verses.ASV: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós não pregamos a nós mesmos, mas sim a Cristo Jesus, o Senhor; e a nós mesmos [como] vossos servos, por causa de Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque no nos predicamos á nosotros mismos, sino á Jesucristo, el Señor; y nosotros vuestros siervos por Jesús.

verses.KJV: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Seeing it is God, that said, Light shall shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Deus que disse que das trevas brilhasse a luz é o [mesmo] que brilhou em nossos corações, para a iluminação do conhecimento da glória de Deus no rosto de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios, que mandó que de las tinieblas resplandeciese la luz, es el que resplandeció en nuestros corazones, para iluminación del conocimiento de la gloria de Dios en la faz de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verses.WEB: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
verses.ASV: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém temos este tesouro em vasos de barro, para que a excelência do poder seja de Deus, e não de nós.
verses.RVR09: Tenemos empero este tesoro en vasos de barro, para que la alteza del poder sea de Dios, y no de nosotros:

verses.KJV: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.WEB: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
verses.ASV: [we are] pressed on every side, yet not straitened; perplexed, yet not unto despair;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Somos] em tudo afligidos, mas não esmagados; perplexos, mas não desesperados;
verses.RVR09: Estando atribulados en todo, mas no angustiados; en apuros, mas no desesperamos;

verses.KJV: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
verses.WEB: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
verses.ASV: pursued, yet not forsaken; smitten down, yet not destroyed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Perseguidos, mas não desamparados; abatidos, porém não destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Perseguidos, mas no desamparados; abatidos, mas no perecemos;

verses.KJV: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
verses.WEB: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
verses.ASV: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sempre por todas as partes trazendo a mortificação do Senhor Jesus no corpo, para que também a vida de Jesus se manifeste em nossos corpos.
verses.RVR09: Llevando siempre por todas partes la muerte de Jesús en el cuerpo, para que también la vida de Jesús sea manifestada en nuestros cuerpos.

verses.KJV: For we which live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
verses.WEB: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
verses.ASV: For we who live are always delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós, que vivemos, estamos sempre entregues à morte por causa de Jesus, para que também a vida de Jesus se manifeste em nossa carne mortal.
verses.RVR09: Porque nosotros que vivimos, siempre estamos entregados á muerte por Jesús, para que también la vida de Jesús sea manifestada en nuestra carne mortal.

verses.KJV: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
verses.WEB: So then death works in us, but life in you.
verses.ASV: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que a morte opera em nós, mas em vós [opera] a vida.
verses.RVR09: De manera que la muerte obra en nosotros, y en vosotros la vida.

verses.KJV: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
verses.WEB: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
verses.ASV: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore did I speak; we also believe, and therefore also we speak;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós temos o mesmo Espírito de fé, assim como está escrito: Cri, e por isso falei;Nós também cremos, e por isso também falamos,
verses.RVR09: Empero teniendo el mismo espíritu de fe, conforme á lo que está escrito: Creí, por lo cual también hablé: nosotros también creemos, por lo cual también hablamos;

verses.KJV: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
verses.WEB: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.
verses.ASV: knowing that he that raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also with Jesus, and shall present us with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: sabendo que o que ressuscitou ao Senhor Jesus, também nos ressuscitará por meio de Jesus, e [nos] apresentará juntos de vós.
verses.RVR09: Estando ciertos que el que levantó al Señor Jesús, á nosotros también nos levantará por Jesús, y nos pondrá con vosotros.

verses.KJV: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
verses.WEB: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
verses.ASV: For all things [are] for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound unto the glory of God.
