verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todas estas coisas são por causa de vós, para que a graça aumente por meio de muitas [pessoas] ,superabundando os agradecimentos à glória de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas estas cosas padecemos por vosotros, para que abundando la gracia por muchos, en el hacimiento de gracias sobreabunde á gloria de Dios.

verses.KJV: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.WEB: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
verses.ASV: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso não desfalecemos; mas ainda que nosso ser exterior se destrua, todavia o interior se renova a cada dia.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no desmayamos: antes aunque este nuestro hombre exterior se va desgastando, el interior empero se renueva de día en día.

verses.KJV: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verses.WEB: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
verses.ASV: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, worketh for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nossa leve e momentânea aflição nos produz um peso eterno de excelentíssima glória.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo que al presente es momentáneo y leve de nuestra tribulación, nos obra un sobremanera alto y eterno peso de gloria;

verses.KJV: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.WEB: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.ASV: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso nós não prestamos atenção para as coisas visíveis, mas sim para as invisíveis; porque as coisas visíveis são temporárias, mas as invisíveis são eternas.
verses.RVR09: No mirando nosotros á las cosas que se ven, sino á las que no se ven: porque las cosas que se ven son temporales, mas las que no se ven son eternas.

verses.KJV: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.WEB: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
verses.ASV: For we know that if the earthly house of our tabernacle be dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sabemos que, se nossa casa terrestre deste tabernáculo se desfizer, temos um edifício de Deus, uma casa não feita por mãos, [mas] eterna, nos céus.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE sabemos, que si la casa terrestre de nuestra habitación se deshiciere, tenemos de Dios un edificio, una casa no hecha de manos, eterna en los cielos.

verses.KJV: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.WEB: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
verses.ASV: For verily in this we groan, longing to be clothed upon with our habitation which is from heaven:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nesta [casa] gememos, desejando sermos revestidos de nossa habitação do céu;
verses.RVR09: Y por esto también gemimos, deseando ser sobrevestidos de aquella nuestra habitación celestial;

verses.KJV: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.WEB: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
verses.ASV: if so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dado que, se estivermos vestidos, não seremos achados nus.
verses.RVR09: Puesto que en verdad habremos sido hallados vestidos, y no desnudos.

verses.KJV: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.WEB: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
verses.ASV: For indeed we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened; not for that we would be unclothed, but that we would be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois de fato nós, os que estamos neste tabernáculo, gememos pressionados, não porque queremos ser despidos, mas sim, revestidos; para que a mortalidade seja devorada pela vida.
verses.RVR09: Porque asimismo los que estamos en este tabernáculo, gemimos agravados; porque no quisiéramos ser desnudados, sino sobrevestidos, para que lo mortal sea absorbido por la vida.

verses.KJV: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.WEB: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
verses.ASV: Now he that wrought us for this very thing is God, who gave unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para isto mesmo que Deus nos preparou, ele que também deu o penhor do Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que nos hizo para esto mismo, es Dios; el cual nos ha dado la prenda del Espíritu.

verses.KJV: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.WEB: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
verses.ASV: Being therefore always of good courage, and knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso sempre temos confiança, e sabemos que, enquanto habitarmos no corpo, estamos ausentes do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Así que vivimos confiados siempre, y sabiendo, que entre tanto que estamos en el cuerpo, peregrinamos ausentes del Señor;

verses.KJV: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.WEB: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
verses.ASV: (for we walk by faith, not by sight);
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois andamos pela fé, e não pela vista).
verses.RVR09: (Porque por fe andamos, no por vista;)

verses.KJV: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.WEB: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
verses.ASV: we are of good courage, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temos, porém, confiança, e queremos mais deixar o corpo, e habitar com o Senhor;
verses.RVR09: Mas confiamos, y más quisiéramos partir del cuerpo, y estar presentes al Señor.

verses.KJV: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
verses.WEB: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
verses.ASV: Wherefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well-pleasing unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também desejamos muito ser agradáveis a ele, quer presentes [no nosso corpo] ,quer ausentes;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto procuramos también, ó ausentes, ó presentes, serle agradables:

verses.KJV: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.WEB: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
verses.ASV: For we must all be made manifest before the judgment-seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things [done] in the body, according to what he hath done, whether [it be] good or bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos devemos comparecer diante do Tribunal de Cristo, para que cada um receba o pagamento das coisas que fez no corpo, seja bem ou mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque es menester que todos nosotros parezcamos ante el tribunal de Cristo, para que cada uno reciba según lo que hubiere hecho por medio del cuerpo, ora sea bueno ó malo.

verses.KJV: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.WEB: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
verses.ASV: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are made manifest unto God; and I hope that we are made manifest also in your consciences.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conhecendo, pois, o temor ao Senhor, persuadimos as pessoas para a fé, e a Deus somos claramente visíveis; mas espero, também, que estejamos claramente visíveis em vossas consciências.
verses.RVR09: Estando pues poseídos del temor del Señor, persuadimos á los hombres, mas á Dios somos manifiestos; y espero que también en vuestras conciencias somos manifiestos.

verses.KJV: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.WEB: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
verses.ASV: We are not again commending ourselves unto you, but [speak] as giving you occasion of glorying on our behalf, that ye may have wherewith to answer them that glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não nos recomendamos novamente para vós; mas damos oportunidade de vos orgulhardes de nós; para que tenhais [o que responder] aos que se orgulham da aparência, e não do coração.
verses.RVR09: No nos encomendamos pues otra vez á vosotros, sino os damos ocasión de gloriaros por nosotros, para que tengáis qué responder contra los que se glorían en las apariencias, y no en el corazón.

verses.KJV: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
verses.WEB: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
verses.ASV: For whether we are beside ourselves, it is unto God; or whether we are of sober mind, it is unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se nós enlouquecemos, é para Deus; se estamos sensatos, é para vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque si loqueamos, es para Dios; y si estamos en seso, es para vosotros.

verses.KJV: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.WEB: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
verses.ASV: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that one died for all, therefore all died;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é o amor de Cristo que nos controla; pois temos certeza que, se um morreu por todos, logo todos morreram.
verses.RVR09: Porque el amor de Cristo nos constriñe, pensando esto: Que si uno murió por todos, luego todos son muertos;

verses.KJV: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.WEB: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
verses.ASV: and he died for all, that they that live should no longer live unto themselves, but unto him who for their sakes died and rose again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele morreu por todos, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si, mas sim, para aquele que por eles morreu e ressuscitou.
verses.RVR09: Y por todos murió, para que los que viven, ya no vivan para sí, mas para aquel que murió y resucitó por ellos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
verses.WEB: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
verses.ASV: Wherefore we henceforth know no man after the flesh: even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know [him so] no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto daqui em diante a ninguém conhecemos segundo a carne, e ainda que também tenhamos conhecido a Cristo segundo a carne, todavia agora não o conhecemos [assim] .
verses.RVR09: De manera que nosotros de aquí adelante á nadie conocemos según la carne: y aun si á Cristo conocimos según la carne, empero ahora ya no le conocemos.

verses.KJV: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.WEB: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
verses.ASV: Wherefore if any man is in Christ, [he is] a new creature: the old things are passed away; behold, they are become new.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se alguém está em Cristo, uma nova criatura [é] ; as coisas velhas já passaram, eis que tudo se fez novo.
verses.RVR09: De modo que si alguno está en Cristo, nueva criatura es: las cosas viejas pasaron; he aquí todas son hechas nuevas.

verses.KJV: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.WEB: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.ASV: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ, and gave unto us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo isto [vem] de Deus, o qual por Jesus Cristo nos reconciliou consigo, e nos deu o ministério da reconciliação.
verses.RVR09: Y todo esto es de Dios, el cual nos reconcilió á sí por Cristo; y nos dió el ministerio de la reconciliación.

verses.KJV: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.WEB: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
verses.ASV: to wit, that God was in Christ reconciling the world unto himself, not reckoning unto them their trespasses, and having committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus estava em Cristo reconciliando consigo ao mundo, não lhes atribuindo seus pecados; e pôs em nós a palavra da reconciliação.
verses.RVR09: Porque ciertamente Dios estaba en Cristo reconciliando el mundo á sí, no imputándole sus pecados, y puso en nosotros la palabra de la reconciliación.

verses.KJV: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.WEB: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
verses.ASV: We are ambassadors therefore on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beseech [you] on behalf of Christ, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, pois, nós somos embaixadores da parte de Cristo, como se Deus rogasse por nós; [por isso] ,rogamos em Cristo: Reconciliai-vos com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Así que, somos embajadores en nombre de Cristo, como si Dios rogase por medio nuestro; os rogamos en nombre de Cristo: Reconciliaos con Dios.

verses.KJV: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.WEB: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
verses.ASV: Him who knew no sin he made [to be] sin on our behalf; that we might become the righteousness of God in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele fez com que aquele que não conheceu pecado [se tornasse] pecado por nós; para que nós nele fôssemos feitos justiça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Al que no conoció pecado, hizo pecado por nosotros, para que nosotros fuésemos hechos justicia de Dios en él.

verses.KJV: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
verses.WEB: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
verses.ASV: And working together [with him] we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós, como trabalhadores conjuntamente [com ele] , rogamos que não tenhais recebido a graça de Deus em vão.
verses.RVR09: Y ASÍ nosotros, como ayudadores juntamente con él, os exhortamos también á que no recibáis en vano la gracia de Dios,

verses.KJV: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
verses.WEB: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.ASV: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee: behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele diz: Em tempo agradável te ouvi, e no dia da salvação te socorri; eis agora o tempo agradável, eis agora o dia da salvação
verses.RVR09: (Porque dice: En tiempo aceptable te he oído, y en día de salud te he socorrido: he aquí ahora el tiempo aceptable; he aquí ahora el día de salud:)

verses.KJV: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.WEB: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
verses.ASV: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Escândalo nenhum damos em coisa alguma, para que [nosso] trabalho não seja acusado.
verses.RVR09: No dando á nadie ningún escándalo, porque el ministerio nuestro no sea vituperado:

verses.KJV: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.WEB: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
verses.ASV: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas em tudo nos fizemos agradáveis como trabalhadores de Deus, em muita tolerância, em aflições, em necessidades, em angústias;
verses.RVR09: Antes habiéndonos en todas cosas como ministros de Dios, en mucha paciencia, en tribulaciones, en necesidades, en angustias;

verses.KJV: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.WEB: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
verses.ASV: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em açoites, em prisões, em tumultos, em trabalhos, em vigílias, em jejuns;
verses.RVR09: En azotes, en cárceles, en alborotos, en trabajos, en vigilias, en ayunos;

verses.KJV: By pureness, by knowledge, by long suffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
verses.WEB: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
verses.ASV: in pureness, in knowledge, in longsuffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,
verses.ALMEIDA: Em pureza, em conhecimento, em paciência, em bondade, no Espírito Santo, em amor não fingido;
verses.RVR09: En castidad, en ciencia, en longanimidad, en bondad, en Espíritu Santo, en amor no fingido;

verses.KJV: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.WEB: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.ASV: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.ALMEIDA: Em palavra da verdade, em poder de Deus, com armas da justiça, à esquerda, e à direita;
verses.RVR09: En palabra de verdad, en potencia de Dios, en armas de justicia á diestro y á siniestro;

verses.KJV: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.WEB: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
verses.ASV: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and [yet] true;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por honra e por desonra; por infâmia e por boa fama; [considerados] como enganadores, e como verdadeiros.
verses.RVR09: Por honra y por deshonra, por infamia y por buena fama; como engañadores, mas hombres de verdad;

verses.KJV: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.WEB: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
verses.ASV: as unknown, and [yet] well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como estranhos, e conhecidos; como morrendo, e eis que estamos vivendo; como castigados e [ainda] não mortos.
verses.RVR09: Como ignorados, mas conocidos; como muriendo, mas he aquí vivimos; como castigados, mas no muertos;

verses.KJV: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.WEB: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
verses.ASV: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and [yet] possessing all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como entristecidos, porém sempre alegres; como pobres, porém enriquecendo a muitos; como nada tendo, e possuindo tudo.
verses.RVR09: Como doloridos, mas siempre gozosos; como pobres, mas enriqueciendo á muchos; como no teniendo nada, mas poseyéndolo todo.

verses.KJV: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.WEB: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
verses.ASV: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para vós, ó coríntios, está aberta nossa boca; [e] nosso coração está ampliado.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra boca está abierta á vosotros, oh Corintios: nuestro corazón es ensanchado.

verses.KJV: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.WEB: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
verses.ASV: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós não temos lhes estreitado, mas vós estais estreitos em nossos sentimentos.
verses.RVR09: No estáis estrechos en nosotros, mas estáis estrechos en vuestras propias entrañas.

verses.KJV: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
verses.WEB: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
verses.ASV: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto [my] children), be ye also enlarged.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em recompensa disto (falo como a filhos) alargai vós também.
verses.RVR09: Pues, para corresponder al propio modo (como á hijos hablo), ensanchaos también vosotros.

verses.KJV: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.WEB: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
verses.ASV: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos ajunteis em outro jugo com os descrentes. Porque, que parceria tem a justiça com injustiça? E que parceria tem a luz com as trevas?
verses.RVR09: No os juntéis en yugo con los infieles: porque ¿qué compañía tiene la justicia con la injusticia? ¿y qué comunión la luz con las tinieblas?

verses.KJV: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
verses.WEB: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
verses.ASV: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que acordo há entre Cristo e Belial? Ou que parte tem o crente com o incrédulo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué concordia Cristo con Belial? ¿ó qué parte el fiel con el infiel?

verses.KJV: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.WEB: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
verses.ASV: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que acordo há entre o Templo de Deus e os ídolos? Porque vós sois o templo do Deus vivente, como Deus disse: Neles habitarei, e entre [eles] andarei; e eu serei seu Deus, e eles serão meu povo.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué concierto el templo de Dios con los ídolos? porque vosotros sois el templo del Dios viviente, como Dios dijo: Habitaré y andaré en ellos; y seré el Dios de ellos, y ellos serán mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
verses.WEB: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
verses.ASV: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto: saí do meio deles, e vos separai, diz o Senhor; e não toqueis coisa impura, e eu vos aceitarei.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual salid de en medio de ellos, y apartaos, dice el Señor, y no toquéis lo inmundo; y yo os recibiré,

verses.KJV: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.WEB: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
verses.ASV: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos serei por Pai, e vós sereis para mim filhos e filhas,diz o Senhor Todo Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: Y seré á vosotros Padre, y vosotros me seréis á mí hijos é hijas, dice el Señor Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.WEB: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.ASV: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, por termos tais promessas, limpemo-nos de toda impureza da carne e do espírito, aperfeiçoando a santificação no temor de Deus.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, amados, pues tenemos tales promesas, limpiémonos de toda inmundicia de carne y de espíritu, perfeccionando la santificación en temor de Dios.

verses.KJV: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
verses.WEB: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
verses.ASV: Open your hearts to us: we wronged no man, we corrupted no man, we took advantage of no man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai lugar a nós [em vossos corações] ; contra ninguém agimos mal, a ninguém corrompemos, a ninguém abusamos para nosso proveito.
verses.RVR09: Admitidnos: á nadie hemos injuriado, á nadie hemos corrompido, á nadie hemos engañado.

verses.KJV: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
verses.WEB: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
verses.ASV: I say it not to condemn [you]: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die together and live together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digo [isto] para [vos] condenar; porque já disse antes que vós estais em nossos corações, para juntamente morrermos e vivermos.
verses.RVR09: No para condenaros lo digo; que ya he dicho antes que estáis en nuestros corazones, para morir y para vivir juntamente.

verses.KJV: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.WEB: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
verses.ASV: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying on your behalf: I am filled with comfort, I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muita confiança eu tenho em vós; eu tenho muito orgulho de vós; eu estou cheio de consolação; excedo sobremaneira de alegria em todas as nossas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Mucha confianza tengo de vosotros, tengo de vosotros mucha gloria; lleno estoy de consolación, sobreabundo de gozo en todas nuestras tribulaciones.

verses.KJV: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
verses.WEB: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
verses.ASV: For even when we were come into Macedonia our flesh had no relief, but [we were] afflicted on every side; without [were] fightings, within [were] fears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque até quando viemos à Macedônia, nenhum repouso teve nossa carne; mas em tudo fomos afligidos: lutas por fora, temores por dentro.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun cuando vinimos á Macedonia, ningún reposo tuvo nuestra carne; antes, en todo fuimos atribulados: de fuera, cuestiones; de dentro, temores.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
verses.ASV: Nevertheless he that comforteth the lowly, [even] God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus, que consola aos abatidos, nos consolou com a vinda de Tito.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios, que consuela á los humildes, nos consoló con la venida de Tito:

verses.KJV: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
verses.WEB: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
verses.ASV: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort wherewith he was comforted in you, while he told us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced yet more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente com a vinda dele, mas também com a consolação com que foi consolado quanto a vós, contando-nos vossas saudades, vosso choro e vosso zelo por mim, de maneira que me alegrei ainda mais.
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo con su venida, sino también con la consolación con que él fué consolado acerca de vosotros, haciéndonos saber vuestro deseo grande, vuestro lloro, vuestro celo por mí, para que así me gozase más.

verses.KJV: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
verses.WEB: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
verses.ASV: For though I made you sorry with my epistle, I do not regret it: though I did regret [it] (for I see that that epistle made you sorry, though but for a season),
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, ainda que eu tenha vos entristecido com a carta, não me arrependo, ainda que tenha me causado pesar; porque vejo que aquela carta vos entristeceu, ainda que por pouco tempo.
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque os contristé por la carta, no me arrepiento, bien que me arrepentí; porque veo que aquella carta, aunque por algún tiempo os contristó,

verses.KJV: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
verses.WEB: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
verses.ASV: I now rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye were made sorry unto repentance; for ye were made sorry after a godly sort, that ye might suffer loss by us in nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora eu me alegro, não porque vós vos entristecestes, mas porque vos entristecestes para o arrependimento. Porque vós vos entristecestes segundo [a vontade de] Deus; de maneira que em nada sofrestes dano por nós.
verses.RVR09: Ahora me gozo, no porque hayáis sido contristados, sino porque fuisteis contristados para arrepentimiento; porque habéis sido contristados según Dios, para que ninguna pérdida padecieseis por nuestra parte.

verses.KJV: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.WEB: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
verses.ASV: For godly sorrow worketh repentance unto salvation, [a repentance] which bringeth no regret: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a tristeza segundo [a vontade de] Deus opera arrependimento para a salvação, de que ninguém se arrepende; mas a tristeza do mundo opera a morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque el dolor que es según Dios, obra arrepentimiento saludable, de que no hay que arrepentirse; mas el dolor del siglo obra muerte.

verses.KJV: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.WEB: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
verses.ASV: For behold, this selfsame thing, that ye were made sorry after a godly sort, what earnest care it wrought in you, yea what clearing of yourselves, yea what indignation, yea what fear, yea what longing, yea what zeal, yea what avenging! In everything ye approved yourselves to be pure in the matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vede isto mesmo, quanto empenho que vossa tristeza segundo Deus produziu em vós! E também defesa [própria] , indignação, temor, saudades, zelo, e desejo de justiça! Em tudo vos mostrastes estar puros quanto a este assunto.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, esto mismo que según Dios fuisteis contristados, cuánta solicitud ha obrado en vosotros, y aun defensa, y aun enojo, y aun temor, y aun gran deseo, y aun celo, y aun vindicación. En todo os habéis mostrado limpios en el negocio.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
verses.WEB: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
verses.ASV: So although I wrote unto you, [I wrote] not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be made manifest unto you in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ainda que tenha escrito para vós, eu não [fiz isso] por causa daquele que fez o dano, nem por causa daquele que sofreu o dano; mas sim para que nosso empenho por vós diante de Deus vos fosse revelado.
verses.RVR09: Así que, aunque os escribí, no fué por causa del que hizo la injuria, ni por causa del que la padeció, mas para que os fuese manifiesta nuestra solicitud que tenemos por vosotros delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
verses.WEB: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
verses.ASV: Therefore we have been comforted: and in our comfort we joyed the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit hath been refreshed by you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso fomos consolados com vosso consolo; e muito mais nos alegramos com a alegria de Tito, de que seu espírito foi revigorado por todos vós.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, tomamos consolación de vuestra consolación: empero mucho más nos gozamos por el gozo de Tito, que haya sido recreado su espíritu de todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
verses.WEB: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
verses.ASV: For if in anything I have gloried to him on your behalf, I was not put to shame; but as we spake all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se em alguma coisa me orgulhei de vós diante dele, não fiquei envergonhado; mas assim como falamos de vós com verdade, assim também nosso orgulho diante de Tito se confirmou verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Pues si algo me he gloriado para con él de vosotros, no he sido avergonzado; antes, como todo lo que habíamos dicho de vosotros era con verdad, así también nuestra gloria delante de Tito fué hallada verdadera.

verses.KJV: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
verses.WEB: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
verses.ASV: And his affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sentimentos dele por vós estão ainda maiores, por se lembrar da obediência de todos vós, de como o recebestes com temor e tremor.
verses.RVR09: Y sus entrañas son más abundantes para con vosotros, cuando se acuerda de la obediencia de todos vosotros, de cómo lo recibisteis con temor y temblor.

verses.KJV: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
verses.WEB: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
verses.ASV: I rejoice that in everything I am of good courage concerning you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu me alegro de que em tudo posso confiar em vós.
verses.RVR09: Me gozo de que en todo estoy confiado de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.WEB: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
verses.ASV: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God which hath been given in the churches of Macedonia;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também, irmãos, vos fazemos saber a graça de Deus dada às igrejas da Macedônia,
verses.RVR09: ASIMISMO, hermanos, os hacemos saber la gracia de Dios que ha sido dada á las iglesias de Macedonia:

verses.KJV: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.WEB: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
verses.ASV: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que em muita provação de aflição, a abundância de sua alegria, e sua profunda pobreza abundaram nas riquezas de sua generosidade.
verses.RVR09: Que en grande prueba de tribulación, la abundancia de su gozo y su profunda pobreza abundaron en riquezas de su bondad.

verses.KJV: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
verses.WEB: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
verses.ASV: For according to their power, I bear witness, yea and beyond their power, [they gave] of their own accord,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dou testemunho de que foram voluntários segundo [sua] capacidade e até além de [sua] capacidade,
verses.RVR09: Pues de su grado han dado conforme á sus fuerzas, yo testifico, y aun sobre sus fuerzas;

verses.KJV: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.WEB: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
verses.ASV: beseeching us with much entreaty in regard of this grace and the fellowship in the ministering to the saints:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedindo-nos com muito entusiasmo que aceitássemos a graça e a comunhão deste serviço para os santos.
verses.RVR09: Pidiéndonos con muchos ruegos, que aceptásemos la gracia y la comunicación del servicio para los santos.

verses.KJV: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
verses.WEB: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
verses.ASV: and [this], not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não [somente fizeram] como nós esperávamos, mas também entregaram a si mesmos, primeiramente ao Senhor, e [depois] a nós, pela vontade de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no como lo esperábamos, mas aun á sí mismos se dieron primeramente al Señor, y á nosotros por la voluntad de Dios.

verses.KJV: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
verses.WEB: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
verses.ASV: Insomuch that we exhorted Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace also.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que convocamos a Tito para que, assim como tinha começado antes, assim também terminasse esta graça entre vós.
verses.RVR09: De manera que exhortamos á Tito, que como comenzó antes, así también acabe esta gracia entre vosotros también.

verses.KJV: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.WEB: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
verses.ASV: But as ye abound in everything, [in] faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and [in] all earnestness, and [in] your love to us, [see] that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim como em tudo abundais: em fé, em palavra, em conhecimento, em todo empenho, e em vosso amor por nós; sede também abundantes nesta graça.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, como en todo abundáis, en fe, y en palabra, y en ciencia, y en toda solicitud, y en vuestro amor para con nosotros, que también abundéis en esta gracia.

verses.KJV: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.WEB: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
verses.ASV: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não digo [isto] como que mandando, mas sim para também, por meio do empenho dos outros, provar a sinceridade de vosso amor.
verses.RVR09: No hablo como quien manda, sino para poner á prueba, por la eficacia de otros, la sinceridad también de la caridad vuestra.

verses.KJV: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.WEB: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
verses.ASV: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might become rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque já conheceis a graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que, sendo rico, por causa de vós se fez pobre; para que com a pobreza dele, vós enriquecêsseis.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya sabéis la gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, que por amor de vosotros se hizo pobre, siendo rico; para que vosotros con su pobreza fueseis enriquecidos.

verses.KJV: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
verses.WEB: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
verses.ASV: And herein I give [my] judgment: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to make a beginning a year ago, not only to do, but also to will.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nisto dou [minha] opinião: porque isto vos convém, não somente a fazer, mas também a querer, dado que começastes desde o ano passado.
verses.RVR09: Y en esto doy mi consejo; porque esto os conviene á vosotros, que comenzasteis antes, no sólo á hacerlo, mas aun á quererlo desde el año pasado.

verses.KJV: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
verses.WEB: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
verses.ASV: But now complete the doing also; that as [there was] the readiness to will, so [there may be] the completion also out of your ability.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto agora completai também o que já foi começado; para que, assim como houve ânimo no querer, assim também o seja no que tendes de completar.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, llevad también á cabo el hecho, para que como estuvisteis prontos á querer, así también lo estéis en cumplir conforme á lo que tenéis.

verses.KJV: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
verses.WEB: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
verses.ASV: For if the readiness is there, [it is] acceptable according as [a man] hath, not according as [he] hath not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se existe a boa vontade, [a doação] é aceitável conforme o que se tem, e não conforme o que não se tem.
verses.RVR09: Porque si primero hay la voluntad pronta, será acepta por lo que tiene, no por lo que no tiene.

verses.KJV: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
verses.WEB: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
verses.ASV: For [I say] not [this] that others may be eased [and] ye distressed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não [digo isto] para que outros tenham alívio, e vós opressão;
verses.RVR09: Porque no digo esto para que haya para otros desahogo, y para vosotros apretura;

verses.KJV: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.WEB: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
verses.ASV: but by equality: your abundance [being a supply] at this present time for their want, that their abundance also may become [a supply] for your want; that there may be equality:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [para que] igualmente, neste tempo presente, vossa abundância seja [para suprir] a falta dos outros, para que também a abundância deles seja [para suprir] vossa falta, para que haja igualdade.
verses.RVR09: Sino para que en este tiempo, con igualdad, vuestra abundancia supla la falta de ellos, para que también la abundancia de ellos supla vuestra falta, porque haya igualdad;

verses.KJV: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
verses.WEB: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
verses.ASV: as it is written, He that [gathered] much had nothing over; and he that [gathered] little had no lack.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como está escrito: O que muito [colhe] , não teve mais; e o que [colhe] pouco, não teve menos.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: El que recogió mucho, no tuvo más; y el que poco, no tuvo menos.

verses.KJV: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.WEB: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
verses.ASV: But thanks be to God, who putteth the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém graças a Deus, que ele pôs o mesmo empenho por vós no coração de Tito;
verses.RVR09: Empero gracias á Dios que dió la misma solicitud por vosotros en el corazón de Tito.

verses.KJV: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.WEB: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
verses.ASV: For he accepted indeed our exhortation; but being himself very earnest, he went forth unto you of his own accord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois aceitou [nosso] chamado, e com muito entusiasmo partiu voluntariamente até vós.
verses.RVR09: Pues á la verdad recibió la exhortación; mas estando también muy solícito, de su voluntad partió para vosotros.

verses.KJV: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.WEB: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
verses.ASV: And we have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the gospel [is spread] through all the churches;
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviamos com ele o irmão que é elogiado no Evangelho por todas as igrejas.
verses.RVR09: Y enviamos juntamente con él al hermano cuya alabanza en el evangelio es por todas las iglesias;

verses.KJV: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
verses.WEB: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
verses.ASV: and not only so, but who was also appointed by the churches to travel with us in [the matter of] this grace, which is ministered by us to the glory of the Lord, and [to show] our readiness:
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente [isto] , mas também foi escolhido pelas igrejas como companheiro de nossa viagem com esta graça, que é administrada por nós para a glória do mesmo Senhor, e a prontidão de vosso ânimo.
verses.RVR09: Y no sólo esto, mas también fué ordenado por las iglesias el compañero de nuestra peregrinación para llevar esta gracia, que es administrada de nosotros para gloria del mismo Señor, y para demostrar vuestro pronto ánimo:

verses.KJV: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.WEB: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
verses.ASV: avoiding this, that any man should blame us in [the matter of] this bounty which is ministered by us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim evitamos que ninguém nos critique nesta abundância que é administrada por nós,
verses.RVR09: Evitando que nadie nos vitupere en esta abundancia que ministramos;

verses.KJV: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.WEB: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.ASV: for we take thought for things honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procurando o que é honesto, não somente diante do Senhor, mas também diante das pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Procurando las cosas honestas, no sólo delante del Señor, mas aun delante de los hombres.

verses.KJV: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
verses.WEB: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
verses.ASV: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which [he hath] in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também enviamos com eles ao nosso irmão, ao qual muitas vezes em muitas coisas já provamos que ele é cuidadoso, e agora ainda muito mais cuidadoso pela muita confiança que [ele tem] em vós.
verses.RVR09: Enviamos también con ellos á nuestro hermano, al cual muchas veces hemos experimentado diligente, mas ahora mucho más con la mucha confianza que tiene en vosotros.

verses.KJV: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
verses.WEB: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
verses.ASV: Whether [any inquire] about Titus, [he is] my partner and [my] fellow-worker to you-ward; or our brethren, [they are] the messengers of the churches, [they are] the glory of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a Tito, ele é meu companheiro e cooperador para convosco; quanto a nossos irmãos, eles são representantes das igrejas, [e] glória de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Ora en orden á Tito, es mi compañero y coadjutor para con vosotros; ó acerca de nuestros hermanos, los mensajeros son de las iglesias, y la gloria de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.WEB: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.ASV: Show ye therefore unto them in the face of the churches the proof of your love, and of our glorying on your behalf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, mostrai para com eles a prova de vosso amor, e de nosso orgulho por vós, diante das igrejas.
verses.RVR09: Mostrad pues, para con ellos á la faz de las iglesias la prueba de vuestro amor, y de nuestra gloria acerca de vosotros.

verses.KJV: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.WEB: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
verses.ASV: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não é necessário vos escrever sobre o trabalho que se faz para os santos.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE cuanto á la suministración para los santos, por demás me es escribiros;

verses.KJV: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
verses.WEB: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
verses.ASV: for I know your readiness, of which I glory on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia hath been prepared for a year past; and your zeal hath stirred up very many of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sei a prontidão de vosso ânimo, do qual eu me orgulho de vós para os Macedônios, que Acaia já está pronta desde o ano passado; e o zelo que [começou] de vós tem estimulado a muitos.
verses.RVR09: Pues conozco vuestro pronto ánimo, del cual me glorío yo entre los de Macedonia, que Acaya está apercibida desde el año pasado; y vuestro ejemplo ha estimulado á muchos.

verses.KJV: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
verses.WEB: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
verses.ASV: But I have sent the brethren, that our glorying on your behalf may not be made void in this respect; that, even as I said, ye may be prepared:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém enviei a estes irmãos, para que nosso orgulho quanto a vós neste assunto não seja vão; para que (como eu já disse) possais estar prontos.
verses.RVR09: Mas he enviado los hermanos, porque nuestra gloria de vosotros no sea vana en esta parte; para que, como lo he dicho, estéis apercibidos;

verses.KJV: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
verses.WEB: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
verses.ASV: lest by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be put to shame in this confidence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que, se caso vierem [alguns] macedônios comigo, e vos encontrarem despreparados, não nos envergonhemos (para não dizermos vós), por causa da confiança neste orgulho.
verses.RVR09: No sea que, si vinieren conmigo Macedonios, y os hallaren desapercibidos, nos avergoncemos nosotros, por no decir vosotros, de este firme gloriarnos.

verses.KJV: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
verses.WEB: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
verses.ASV: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your aforepromised bounty, that the same might be ready as a matter of bounty, and not of extortion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto achei necessário dizer a estes irmãos que viessem primeiro até vós, e preparassem primeiro vossa generosidade, já antes prometida, para que esteja pronta como boa vontade e não como avareza.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, tuve por cosa necesaria exhortar á los hermanos que fuesen primero á vosotros, y apresten primero vuestra bendición antes prometida, para que esté aparejada como de bendición, y no como de mezquindad.

verses.KJV: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.WEB: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
verses.ASV: But this [I say], He that soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he that soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Digo] , porém isto, que o que semeia pouco, também pouco colherá; e o que semeia generosamente, também generosamente colherá.
verses.RVR09: Esto empero digo: El que siembra escasamente, también segará escasamente; y el que siembra en bendiciones, en bendiciones también segará.

verses.KJV: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.WEB: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.ASV: [Let] each man [do] according as he hath purposed in his heart: not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada qual [faça] como propõe em [seu] coração, não com tristeza, ou por obrigação; porque Deus ama ao que dá com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno dé como propuso en su corazón: no con tristeza, ó por necesidad; porque Dios ama el dador alegre.

verses.KJV: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
verses.WEB: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
verses.ASV: And God is able to make all grace abound unto you; that ye, having always all sufficiency in everything, may abound unto every good work:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus é poderoso para fazer abundar em vós toda graça, para que sempre tendo de tudo, em tudo suficientes, abundeis em toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Y poderoso es Dios para hacer que abunde en vosotros toda gracia; á fin de que, teniendo siempre en todas las cosas todo lo que basta, abundéis para toda buena obra:

verses.KJV: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
verses.WEB: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
verses.ASV: as it is written, He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the poor; His righteousness abideth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como está escrito: Ele espalhou [e] deu aos pobres; sua justiça permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Como está escrito: Derramó, dió á los pobres; su justicia permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
verses.WEB: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
verses.ASV: And he that supplieth seed to the sower and bread for food, shall supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, aquele que dá a semente ao que semeia, também [vos] dê pão para comer, e multiplique sua sementeira, e aumente os frutos de vossa justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y el que da simiente al que siembra, también dará pan para comer, y multiplicará vuestra sementera, y aumentará los crecimientos de los frutos de vuestra justicia;

verses.KJV: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
verses.WEB: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
verses.ASV: ye being enriched in everything unto all liberality, which worketh through us thanksgiving to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que em tudo enriqueçais em toda generosidade, a qual opera por nós, [resultando] em graças a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Para que estéis enriquecidos en todo para toda bondad, la cual obra por nosotros hacimiento de gracias á Dios.

verses.KJV: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
verses.WEB: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
verses.ASV: For the ministration of this service not only filleth up the measure of the wants of the saints, but aboundeth also through many thanksgivings unto God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o trabalho deste serviço está suprindo não somente a falta dos santos, mas também se torna abundante em muitas graças a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque la suministración de este servicio, no solamente suple lo que á los santos falta, sino también abunda en muchos hacimientos de gracias á Dios:

verses.KJV: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
verses.WEB: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
verses.ASV: seeing that through the proving [of you] by this ministration they glorify God for the obedience of your confession unto the gospel of Christ, and for the liberality of [your] contribution unto them and unto all;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pela prova deste trabalho, glorificarão a Deus quanto à submissão de vossa confissão ao Evangelho de Cristo, e [da] bondade da comunhão para com eles e para com todos;
verses.RVR09: Que por la experiencia de esta suministración glorifican á Dios por la obediencia que profesáis al evangelio de Cristo, y por la bondad de contribuir para ellos y para todos;

verses.KJV: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.WEB: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.ASV: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, long after you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por sua oração por vós, tendo saudades de vós, por causa da excelente graça de Deus sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo por la oración de ellos á favor vuestro, los cuales os quieren á causa de la eminente gracia de Dios en vosotros.

verses.KJV: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.WEB: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
verses.ASV: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.ALMEIDA: E graças a Deus por seu dom indescritível.
verses.RVR09: Gracias á Dios por su don inefable.

verses.KJV: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
verses.WEB: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
verses.ASV: Now I Paul myself entreat you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am of good courage toward you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disto eu mesmo, Paulo, pela mansidão e bondade de Cristo, vos rogo, (eu que em verdade sou humilde entre vós quando presente, porém ousado para convosco quando ausente);
verses.RVR09: EMPERO yo Pablo, os ruego por la mansedumbre y modestia de Cristo, yo que presente ciertamente soy bajo entre vosotros, mas ausente soy confiado entre vosotros:

verses.KJV: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.WEB: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
verses.ASV: yea, I beseech you, that I may not when present show courage with the confidence wherewith I count to be bold against some, who count of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo pois, que quando eu estiver presente, não tenha que mostrar ousadia com a confiança de que penso que terei de me mostrar ousado para com alguns que nos consideram como se andássemos segundo a carne.
verses.RVR09: Ruego pues, que cuando estuviere presente, no tenga que ser atrevido con la confianza con que estoy en ánimo de ser resuelto para con algunos, que nos tienen como si anduviésemos según la carne.

verses.KJV: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.WEB: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
verses.ASV: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ainda que andemos na carne, não batalhamos segundo a carne.
verses.RVR09: Pues aunque andamos en la carne, no militamos según la carne,

verses.KJV: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verses.WEB: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
verses.ASV: (for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the casting down of strongholds);
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as armas de nossa batalha não são carnais, mas sim poderosas em Deus, para destruirmos fortalezas;
verses.RVR09: (Porque las armas de nuestra milicia no son carnales, sino poderosas en Dios para la destrucción de fortalezas;)

verses.KJV: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.WEB: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
verses.ASV: casting down imaginations, and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim] destruímos pensamentos e toda arrogância que se levanta contra o conhecimento de Deus, e levamos como prisioneiro todo pensamento para a obediência a Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Destruyendo consejos, y toda altura que se levanta contra la ciencia de Dios, y cautivando todo intento á la obediencia de Cristo;

verses.KJV: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.WEB: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
verses.ASV: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience shall be made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estamos prontos para vingar toda desobediência, quando vossa obediência for completa.
verses.RVR09: Y estando prestos para castigar toda desobediencia, cuando vuestra obediencia fuere cumplida.

verses.KJV: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? if any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
verses.WEB: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
verses.ASV: Ye look at the things that are before your face. If any man trusteth in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ’s, so also are we.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhais [as coisas] pela aparência? Se alguém confia de si mesmo que é de Cristo, pense o tal outra vez consigo mesmo que, assim como ele é de Cristo, assim também nós somos de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Miráis las cosas según la apariencia. Si alguno está confiado en sí mismo que es de Cristo, esto también piense por sí mismo, que como él es de Cristo, así también nosotros somos de Cristo.

verses.KJV: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.WEB: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
verses.ASV: For though I should glory somewhat abundantly concerning our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down), I shall not be put to shame:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se eu também ainda mais me quiser orgulhar do nosso poder que o Senhor nos deu para edificação, e não para vossa destruição, não me envergonharei;
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque me gloríe aún un poco de nuestra potestad (la cual el Señor nos dió para edificación y no para vuestra destrucción), no me avergonzaré;

verses.KJV: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.WEB: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
verses.ASV: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by my letters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não pareça que eu [queira] vos amedrontar por meio de cartas.
verses.RVR09: Porque no parezca como que os quiero espantar por cartas.

verses.KJV: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
verses.WEB: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
verses.ASV: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles dizem que as cartas são em verdade graves e fortes, mas a presença do corpo é fraca, e a palavra desprezível.
verses.RVR09: Porque á la verdad, dicen, las cartas son graves y fuertes; mas la presencia corporal flaca, y la palabra menospreciable.

verses.KJV: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
verses.WEB: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
verses.ASV: Let such a one reckon this, that, what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such [are we] also in deed when we are present.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pense isto o tal, que assim como somos na palavra por cartas quando ausentes, assim também [seremos] por obra quando [estivermos] presentes.
verses.RVR09: Esto piense el tal, que cuales somos en la palabra por cartas estando ausentes, tales seremos también en hechos, estando presentes.

verses.KJV: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.WEB: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
verses.ASV: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with certain of them that commend themselves: but they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não ousamos a nos classificar ou comparar com alguns que louvam a si mesmos; mas estes tem falta de entendimento ao medirem a si mesmos consigo mesmos, e ao compararem a si mesmos consigo mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Porque no osamos entremeternos ó compararnos con algunos que se alaban á sí mismos: mas ellos, midiéndose á sí mismos por sí mismos, y comparándose consigo mismos no son juiciosos.

verses.KJV: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
verses.WEB: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
verses.ASV: But we will not glory beyond [our] measure, but according to the measure of the province which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós, porém, não nos orgulharemos além da medida, mas sim conforme a medida da extensão que Deus repartiu conosco, medida que também vos alcança.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros empero, no nos gloriaremos fuera de nuestra medida, sino conforme á la medida de la regla, de la medida que Dios nos repartió, para llegar aun hasta vosotros.

verses.KJV: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
verses.WEB: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
verses.ASV: For we stretch not ourselves overmuch, as though we reached not unto you: for we came even as far as unto you in the gospel of Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em nada estendemos além do que devíamos, como se não tivéssemos vos alcançado; pois fomos nós os primeiros a vir até vós no Evangelho de Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Porque no nos extendemos sobre nuestra medida, como si no llegásemos hasta vosotros: porque también hasta vosotros hemos llegado en el evangelio de Cristo:

verses.KJV: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
verses.WEB: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
verses.ASV: not glorying beyond [our] measure, [that is], in other men’s labors; but having hope that, as your faith groweth, we shall be magnified in you according to our province unto [further] abundance,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não nos orgulhamos além da medida no trabalho de outros, mas temos esperança de que, quando vossa fé crescer, seremos engrandecidos abundantemente entre vós conforme nossa extensão;
verses.RVR09: No gloriándonos fuera de nuestra medida en trabajos ajenos; mas teniendo esperanza del crecimiento de vuestra fe, que seremos muy engrandecidos entre vosotros, conforme á nuestra regla.
