verses.KJV: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
verses.WEB: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
verses.ASV: so as to preach the gospel even unto the parts beyond you, [and] not to glory in another’s province in regard of things ready to our hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para pregarmos o evangelho em outros [lugares] além de vós; [e] não na extensão de outros [pregadores] , para nos orgulharmos de coisas que já estavam prontas.
verses.RVR09: Y que anunciaremos el evangelio en los lugares más allá de vosotros, sin entrar en la medida de otro para gloriarnos en lo que ya estaba aparejado.

verses.KJV: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.WEB: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
verses.ASV: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o que se orgulha, se orgulhe no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que se gloría, gloríese en el Señor.

verses.KJV: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.WEB: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
verses.ASV: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não é o que louva a si mesmo, mas sim o que louva ao Senhor; esse é o aprovado.
verses.RVR09: Porque no el que se alaba á sí mismo, el tal es aprobado; mas aquel á quien Dios alaba.

verses.KJV: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
verses.WEB: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
verses.ASV: Would that ye could bear with me in a little foolishness: but indeed ye do bear with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gostaria que me suportásseis um pouco em [minha] loucura; mas [ainda assim] suportai-me.
verses.RVR09: OJALÁ toleraseis un poco mi locura; empero toleradme.

verses.KJV: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.WEB: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
verses.ASV: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy: for I espoused you to one husband, that I might present you [as] a pure virgin to Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois estou zeloso de vós com zelo de Deus, porque tenho vos preparado para [vos] apresentar [como] uma virgem pura, a um marido, isto é, a Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Pues que os celo con celo de Dios; porque os he desposado á un marido, para presentaros como una virgen pura á Cristo.

verses.KJV: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.WEB: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.ASV: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity and the purity that is toward Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas temo que, assim como a serpente enganou a Eva com sua astúcia, também assim em alguma maneira vossas mentes se corrompam da simplicidade que está em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mas temo que como la serpiente engañó á Eva con su astucia, sean corrompidos así vuestros sentidos en alguna manera, de la simplicidad que es en Cristo.

verses.KJV: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
verses.WEB: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
verses.ASV: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or [if] ye receive a different spirit, which ye did not receive, or a different gospel, which ye did not accept, ye do well to bear with [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se aquele que vem pregasse a outro Jesus que nós não temos pregado, ou [se] recebêsseis outro espírito que não recebestes, ou evangelho diferente do que aceitastes, certamente vós [o] aceitaríeis.
verses.RVR09: Porque si el que viene, predicare otro Jesús que el que hemos predicado, ó recibiereis otro espíritu del que habéis recibido, ú otro evangelio del que habéis aceptado, lo sufrierais bien.

verses.KJV: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.WEB: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
verses.ASV: For I reckon that I am not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque penso que eu em nada fui inferior aos mais excelentes apóstolos.
verses.RVR09: Cierto pienso que en nada he sido inferior á aquellos grandes apóstoles.

verses.KJV: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.WEB: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
verses.ASV: But though [I be] rude in speech, yet [am I] not in knowledge; nay, in every way have we made [this] manifest unto you in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se também sou rude na palavra, contudo não o sou no conhecimento; mas em tudo já estamos totalmente manifestos entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque soy basto en la palabra, empero no en la ciencia: mas en todo somos ya del todo manifiestos á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
verses.WEB: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
verses.ASV: Or did I commit a sin in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I preached to you the gospel of God for nought?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso pequei ao humilhar a mim mesmo, para que vós fôsseis exaltados, por eu ter vos anunciado gratuitamente o Evangelho de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pequé yo humillándome á mí mismo, para que vosotros fueseis ensalzados, porque os he predicado el evangelio de Dios de balde?

verses.KJV: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
verses.WEB: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
verses.ASV: I robbed other churches, taking wages [of them] that I might minister unto you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tomei [o que era] de outras igrejas, ao receber salário, para servir a vós; e quando eu estava presente convosco, e tendo necessidade, a ninguém [incomodei] com algum encargo.
verses.RVR09: He despojado las otras iglesias, recibiendo salario para ministraros á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
verses.WEB: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
verses.ASV: and when I was present with you and was in want, I was not a burden on any man; for the brethren, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my want; and in everything I kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and [so] will I keep [myself].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os irmãos que vieram da Macedônia supriram minha falta; e em tudo eu me guardei de vos ser incômodo, e [ainda me] guardarei.
verses.RVR09: Y estando con vosotros y teniendo necesidad, á ninguno fuí carga; porque lo que me faltaba, suplieron los hermanos que vinieron de Macedonia: y en todo me guardé de seros gravoso, y me guardaré.

verses.KJV: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.WEB: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.ASV: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this glorying in the regions of Achaia.
verses.ALMEIDA: A verdade de Cristo está em mim, [de modo] que este meu orgulho não me será impedido nas regiões da Acaia.
verses.RVR09: Es la verdad de Cristo en mí, que esta gloria no me será cerrada en las partes de Acaya.

verses.KJV: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.WEB: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
verses.ASV: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que? Porque não vos amo? Deus o sabe.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué? ¿porque no os amo? Dios lo sabe.

verses.KJV: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.WEB: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
verses.ASV: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que eu faço, ainda o farei, para cortar a oportunidade daqueles que buscam oportunidade para serem considerados como nós naquilo em que se orgulham.
verses.RVR09: Mas lo que hago, haré aún, para cortar la ocasión de aquellos que la desean, á fin de que en aquello que se glorían, sean hallados semejantes á nosotros.

verses.KJV: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
verses.WEB: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
verses.ASV: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, fashioning themselves into apostles of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tais falsos apóstolos são trabalhadores fraudulentos, fingindo serem apóstolos de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque éstos son falsos apóstoles, obreros fraudulentos, transfigurándose en apóstoles de Cristo.

verses.KJV: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.WEB: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
verses.ASV: And no marvel; for even Satan fashioneth himself into an angel of light.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto não é algo maravilhoso; porque o mesmo Satanás se transforma [fingindo ser] anjo de luz.
verses.RVR09: Y no es maravilla, porque el mismo Satanás se transfigura en ángel de luz.

verses.KJV: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.WEB: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
verses.ASV: It is no great thing therefore if his ministers also fashion themselves as ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não é muita [surpresa] se também seus trabalhadores se transformam, [fingindo serem] trabalhadores da justiça; o fim dos quais será conforme as suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Así que, no es mucho si también sus ministros se transfiguran como ministros de justicia; cuyo fin será conforme á sus obras.

verses.KJV: I say again, let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
verses.WEB: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
verses.ASV: I say again, Let no man think me foolish; but if [ye do], yet as foolish receive me, that I also may glory a little.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra vez digo, que ninguém pense que sou tolo; ou se não, recebei a mim como se eu fosse tolo, para que eu também me orgulhe um pouco.
verses.RVR09: Otra vez digo: Que nadie me estime ser loco; de otra manera, recibidme como á loco, para que aun me gloríe yo un poquito.

verses.KJV: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.WEB: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.ASV: That which I speak, I speak not after the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of glorying.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que eu estou dizendo, não estou dizendo conforme o Senhor, mas sim como um tolo, nesta firme orgulho confiante.
verses.RVR09: Lo que hablo, no lo hablo según el Señor, sino como en locura, con esta confianza de gloria.

verses.KJV: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.WEB: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
verses.ASV: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muitos se orgulham segundo a carne; e também eu me orgulharei.
verses.RVR09: Pues que muchos se glorían según la carne, también yo me gloriaré.

verses.KJV: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
verses.WEB: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
verses.ASV: For ye bear with the foolish gladly, being wise [yourselves].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós, sendo [tão] sábios, tolerais com boa vontade os tolos.
verses.RVR09: Porque de buena gana toleráis los necios, siendo vosotros sabios:

verses.KJV: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.WEB: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
verses.ASV: For ye bear with a man, if he bringeth you into bondage, if he devoureth you, if he taketh you [captive], if he exalteth himself, if he smiteth you on the face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós tolerais se alguém vos põe como escravos, se alguém [vos] explora, se alguém se aproveita [de vós] , se alguém age com arrogância, se alguém vos fere no rosto.
verses.RVR09: Porque toleráis si alguno os pone en servidumbre, si alguno os devora, si alguno toma, si alguno se ensalza, si alguno os hiere en la cara.

verses.KJV: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.WEB: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
verses.ASV: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet whereinsoever any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu digo como algo desonroso, como se tivéssemos estado fracos; mas naquilo em que algum outro é atrevido, eu também sou atrevido (falo como tolo).
verses.RVR09: Dígolo cuanto á la afrenta, como si nosotros hubiésemos sido flacos. Empero en lo que otro tuviere osadía (hablo con locura), también yo tengo osadía.

verses.KJV: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.WEB: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
verses.ASV: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são hebreus? Eu também. Eles são israelitas? Eu também. Eles são semente de Abraão? Eu também.
verses.RVR09: ¿Son Hebreos? yo también. ¿Son Israelitas? yo también. ¿Son simiente de Abraham? también yo.

verses.KJV: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.WEB: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
verses.ASV: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I more; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths oft.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são servidores de Cristo? (Falo como tolo:) eu sou mais ainda; em trabalhos, muito mais; em feridas, mais; em prisões, muito mais; em [perigo] de morte, muitas vezes.
verses.RVR09: ¿Son ministros de Cristo? (como poco sabio hablo) yo más: en trabajos más abundante; en azotes sin medida; en cárceles más; en muertes, muchas veces.

verses.KJV: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
verses.WEB: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
verses.ASV: Of the Jews five times received I forty [stripes] save one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu já recebi dos judeus cinco vezes quarenta [açoites] menos um.
verses.RVR09: De los judíos cinco veces he recibido cuarenta azotes menos uno.

verses.KJV: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.WEB: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
verses.ASV: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day have I been in the deep;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por três vezes já fui espancado com varas, uma vez fui apedrejado, três vezes sofri naufrágios, passei uma noite e um dia [à deriva] no mar profundo;
verses.RVR09: Tres veces he sido azotado con varas; una vez apedreado; tres veces he padecido naufragio; una noche y un día he estado en lo profundo de la mar;

verses.KJV: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.WEB: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
verses.ASV: [in] journeyings often, [in] perils of rivers, [in] perils of robbers, [in] perils from [my] countrymen, [in] perils from the Gentiles, [in] perils in the city, [in] perils in the wilderness, [in] perils in the sea, [in] perils among false brethren;
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas vezes em viagens, em perigos de rios, em perigos de assaltantes, em perigos dos da [minha] nação, em perigos dos gentios, em perigos na cidade, em perigos no deserto, em perigos no mar, em perigos entre falsos irmãos;
verses.RVR09: En caminos muchas veces, peligros de ríos, peligros de ladrones, peligros de los de mi nación, peligros de los Gentiles, peligros en la ciudad, peligros en el desierto, peligros en la mar, peligros entre falsos hermanos;

verses.KJV: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.WEB: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
verses.ASV: [in] labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em trabalho e fadiga, muitas vezes em vigílias, em fome e em sede, em jejuns muitas vezes, em frio e nudez.
verses.RVR09: En trabajo y fatiga, en muchas vigilias, en hambre y sed, en muchos ayunos, en frío y en desnudez;

verses.KJV: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
verses.WEB: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
verses.ASV: Besides those things that are without, there is that which presseth upon me daily, anxiety for all the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além das coisas de fora, a cada dia me vem preocupações de todas as igrejas.
verses.RVR09: Sin otras cosas además, lo que sobre mí se agolpa cada día, la solicitud de todas las iglesias.

verses.KJV: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
verses.WEB: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
verses.ASV: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is caused to stumble, and I burn not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem enfraquece, que eu também não enfraqueça? Quem sofre um tropeço na fé, que eu não me inflame?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién enferma, y yo no enfermo? ¿Quién se escandaliza, y yo no me quemo?

verses.KJV: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
verses.WEB: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
verses.ASV: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things that concern my weakness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se é necessário se orgulhar, eu me orgulharei das coisas relativas à minha fraqueza.
verses.RVR09: Si es menester gloriarse, me gloriaré yo de lo que es de mi flaqueza.

verses.KJV: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
verses.WEB: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
verses.ASV: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, he who is blessed for evermore knoweth that I lie not.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que é bendito eternamente, sabe que eu não estou mentindo.
verses.RVR09: El Dios y Padre del Señor nuestro Jesucristo, que es bendito por siglos, sabe que no miento.

verses.KJV: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
verses.WEB: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
verses.ASV: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of the Damascenes in order to take me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Em Damasco, o governador subordinado ao Rei Aretas pôs guardas na cidade dos damascenos, querendo me prender.
verses.RVR09: En Damasco, el gobernador de la provincia del rey Aretas guardaba la ciudad de los Damascenos para prenderme;

verses.KJV: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.WEB: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.ASV: and through a window was I let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me fizeram descer num cesto por uma janela da muralha [da cidade] , e [assim] escapei das mãos dele.
verses.RVR09: Y fuí descolgado del muro en un serón por una ventana, y escapé de sus manos.

verses.KJV: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.WEB: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.ASV: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente não me convém me orgulhar; porque eu virei para as visões e revelações do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: CIERTO no me es conveniente gloriarme; mas vendré á las visiones y á las revelaciones del Señor.

verses.KJV: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.WEB: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
verses.ASV: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I know not; or whether out of the body, I know not; God knoweth), such a one caught up even to the third heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conheço um homem em Cristo que, catorze anos atrás, foi arrebatado até o terceiro céu (se no corpo, não sei; se fora do corpo, não sei; Deus o sabe).
verses.RVR09: Conozco á un hombre en Cristo, que hace catorce años (si en el cuerpo, no lo sé; si fuera del cuerpo, no lo sé: Dios lo sabe) fué arrebatado hasta el tercer cielo.

verses.KJV: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
verses.WEB: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
verses.ASV: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),
verses.ALMEIDA: E sei que o tal homem (se no corpo, se fora do corpo, não sei; Deus o sabe),
verses.RVR09: Y conozco tal hombre, (si en el cuerpo, ó fuera del cuerpo, no lo sé: Dios lo sabe,)

verses.KJV: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.WEB: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.ASV: how that he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi arrebatado ao paraíso, e ouviu palavras inexprimíveis, que ao homem não é lícito falar.
verses.RVR09: Que fué arrebatado al paraíso, donde oyó palabras secretas que el hombre no puede decir.

verses.KJV: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
verses.WEB: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
verses.ASV: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in [my] weaknesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: D [este] tal eu me orgulharei, mas de mim mesmo não me orgulharei, a não ser em minhas fraquezas.
verses.RVR09: De este tal me gloriaré, mas de mí mismo nada me gloriaré, sino en mis flaquezas.

verses.KJV: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
verses.WEB: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
verses.ASV: For if I should desire to glory, I shall not be foolish; for I shall speak the truth: but I forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me [to be], or heareth from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se eu quiser me orgulhar, não serei tolo; porque direi a verdade; porém eu me contenho, para que ninguém me considere mais do que aquilo que vê em mim, ou ouve de mim.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual si quisiere gloriarme, no seré insensato: porque diré verdad: empero lo dejo, porque nadie piense de mí más de lo que en mí ve, ú oye de mí.

verses.KJV: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verses.WEB: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
verses.ASV: And by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, that I should not be exalted overmuch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para que eu não ficasse arrogante pela excelência das revelações, me foi dado um espinho na carne, [que é] um mensageiro de Satanás, para me atormentar, para que eu não ficasse arrogante.
verses.RVR09: Y porque la grandeza de las revelaciones no me levante descomedidamente, me es dado un aguijón en mi carne, un mensajero de Satanás que me abofetee, para que no me enaltezca sobremanera.

verses.KJV: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.WEB: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
verses.ASV: Concerning this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Três vezes eu orei ao Senhor por causa disso, para que [isso] de afastasse de mim.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual tres veces he rogado al Señor, que se quite de mí.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.WEB: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verses.ASV: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for [my] power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele me disse: “Minha graça te basta, porque meu poder se aperfeiçoa na fraqueza”. Por isso, com muito prazer, eu me orgulharei nas minhas fraquezas, para que o poder de Cristo habite em mim.
verses.RVR09: Y me ha dicho: Bástate mi gracia; porque mi potencia en la flaqueza se perfecciona. Por tanto, de buena gana me gloriaré más bien en mis flaquezas, porque habite en mí la potencia de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.WEB: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tenho prazer nas fraquezas, nos insultos, nas necessidades, nas perseguições, nas angústias por causa de Cristo; porque quando estou fraco, então fico forte.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual me gozo en las flaquezas, en afrentas, en necesidades, en persecuciones, en angustias por Cristo; porque cuando soy flaco, entonces soy poderoso.

verses.KJV: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
verses.WEB: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
verses.ASV: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me fiz de tolo ao me orgulhar; [mas] vós me obrigastes [a isso] ; porque eu devia ser louvado por vós, pois eu em coisa nenhuma fui inferior aos “superapóstolos”, ainda que eu nada seja.
verses.RVR09: Heme hecho un necio en gloriarme: vosotros me constreñisteis; pues yo había de ser alabado de vosotros: porque en nada he sido menos que los sumos apóstoles, aunque soy nada.

verses.KJV: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
verses.WEB: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
verses.ASV: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sinais do [meu] apostolado foram efetuados entre vós em toda paciência, em sinais, milagres e maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Con todo esto, las señales de apóstol han sido hechas entre vosotros en toda paciencia, en señales, y en prodigios, y en maravillas.

verses.KJV: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.WEB: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
verses.ASV: For what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except [it be] that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afinal, qual foi a coisa em que fostes inferiores às outras igrejas, a não ser em que eu mesmo não vos fui incômodo? Perdoai-me esta injustiça!
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué hay en que habéis sido menos que las otras iglesias, sino en que yo mismo no os he sido carga? Perdonadme esta injuria.

verses.KJV: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.WEB: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.ASV: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a burden to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estou prestes a vir pela terceira vez até vós, e não vos serei incômodo como um peso. Porque eu não busco o [que é] vosso, mas sim a vós. Porque os filhos não devem guardar bens para os pais, mas sim os pais para os filhos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí estoy aparejado para ir á vosotros la tercera vez, y no os seré gravoso; porque no busco vuestras cosas, sino á vosotros: porque no han de atesorar los hijos para los padres, sino los padres para los hijos.

verses.KJV: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
verses.WEB: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
verses.ASV: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu de muita boa vontade me gastarei, e me deixarei gastar por vossas almas, ainda que quanto mais eu vos amo, menos sou amado.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo de muy buena gana despenderé y seré despendido por vuestras almas, aunque amándoos más, sea amado menos.

verses.KJV: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.WEB: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
verses.ASV: But be it so, I did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que assim seja, que eu não fui incômodo para convosco. Mas, como eu era astuto, eu vos tomei por engano!
verses.RVR09: Mas sea así, yo no os he agravado: sino que, como soy astuto, os he tomado por engaño.

verses.KJV: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
verses.WEB: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
verses.ASV: Did I take advantage of you by any one of them whom I have sent unto you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu me aproveitei de vós, por meio de alguém que enviei até vós?
verses.RVR09: ¿Acaso os he engañado por alguno de los que he enviado á vosotros?

verses.KJV: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
verses.WEB: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
verses.ASV: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? [walked we] not in the same steps?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu roguei a Tito, e enviei ao irmão com ele; por acaso Tito se aproveitou de vós? Por acaso não andamos nós no mesmo espírito, e nos mesmos passos?
verses.RVR09: Rogué á Tito, y envié con él al hermano. ¿Os engañó quizá Tito? ¿no hemos procedido con el mismo espíritu y por las mismas pisadas?

verses.KJV: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
verses.WEB: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
verses.ASV: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, [are] for your edifying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pensais ainda que nós nos desculpamos convosco? Falamos diante de Deus em Cristo; e [fazemos] tudo isto, ó amados, para vossa edificação.
verses.RVR09: ¿Pensáis aún que nos excusamos con vosotros? Delante de Dios en Cristo hablamos: mas todo, muy amados, por vuestra edificación.

verses.KJV: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
verses.WEB: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
verses.ASV: For I fear, lest by any means, when I come, I should find you not such as I would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means [there should be] strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu temo que, quando vier, eu não vos encontre da maneira que eu quero; e vós me encontreis da maneira que não quereis; para que não [haja] brigas, invejas, iras, rivalidades, difamações, fofocas, arrogâncias e tumultos.
verses.RVR09: Porque temo que cuando llegare, no os halle tales como quiero, y yo sea hallado de vosotros cual no queréis; que haya entre vosotros contiendas, envidias, iras, disensiones, detracciones, murmuraciones, elaciones, bandos:

verses.KJV: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
verses.WEB: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
verses.ASV: lest again when I come my God should humble me before you, and I should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que, quando eu vier outra vez, meu Deus não me humilhe para convosco, e chore por muitos dos que antes pecaram, [e ainda] se não arrependeram da imundícia, e fornicação, e promiscuidade que cometeram.
verses.RVR09: Que cuando volviere, me humille Dios entre vosotros, y haya de llorar por muchos de los que antes habrán pecado, y no se han arrepentido de la inmundicia y fornicación y deshonestidad que han cometido.

verses.KJV: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
verses.WEB: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
verses.ASV: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word be established.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a terceira vez [que] venho até vós; pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas toda palavra será firmada.
verses.RVR09: ESTA tercera vez voy á vosotros. En la boca de dos ó de tres testigos consistirá todo negocio.

verses.KJV: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
verses.WEB: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
verses.ASV: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu já tinha dito antes, e disse quando estive presente pela segunda vez, e agora ausente o escrevo aos que pecaram anteriormente, e a todos os demais, que se vier outra vez, não [lhes] serei tolerante;
verses.RVR09: He dicho antes, y ahora digo otra vez como presente, y ahora ausente lo escribo á los que antes pecaron, y á todos los demás, que si voy otra vez, no perdonaré;

verses.KJV: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
verses.WEB: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
verses.ASV: seeing that ye seek a proof of Christ that speaketh in me; who to you-ward is not weak, but is powerful in you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois buscais prova de que Cristo fala em mim, o qual em vós não é fraco, mas que é poderoso entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Pues buscáis una prueba de Cristo que habla en mí, el cual no es flaco para con vosotros, antes es poderoso en vosotros.

verses.KJV: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
verses.WEB: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
verses.ASV: for he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him through the power of God toward you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ainda que tenha sido crucificado por fraqueza, contudo ele vive pelo poder de Deus. Porque também nós somos fracos nele, porém com ele viveremos pelo poder de Deus em vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque fué crucificado por flaqueza, empero vive por potencia de Dios. Pues también nosotros somos flacos con él, mas viviremos con él por la potencia de Dios para con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
verses.WEB: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
verses.ASV: Try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. Or know ye not as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Examinai-vos a vós mesmos, se estais na fé; provai-vos a vós mesmos. Ou não conheceis a vós mesmos, que Jesus Cristo está em vós? A menos que vós estejais reprovados.
verses.RVR09: Examinaos á vosotros mismos si estáis en fe; probaos á vosotros mismos. ¿No os conocéis á vosotros mismos, que Jesucristo está en vosotros? si ya no sois reprobados.

verses.KJV: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
verses.WEB: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
verses.ASV: But I hope that ye shall know that we are not reprobate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas espero que vós entendereis que nós não somos reprovados.
verses.RVR09: Mas espero que conoceréis que nosotros no somos reprobados.

verses.KJV: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
verses.WEB: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
verses.ASV: Now we pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is honorable, though we be as reprobate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu desejo [pedindo] a Deus que nenhum mal façais; não para que sejamos achados aprovados, mas para que vós façais o bem, e nós sejamos como reprovados.
verses.RVR09: Y oramos á Dios que ninguna cosa mala hagáis; no para que nosotros seamos hallados aprobados, mas para que vosotros hagáis lo que es bueno, aunque nosotros seamos como reprobados.

verses.KJV: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.WEB: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.ASV: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nada podemos fazer contra a verdade, mas sim pela verdade.
verses.RVR09: Porque ninguna cosa podemos contra la verdad, sino por la verdad.

verses.KJV: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
verses.WEB: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
verses.ASV: For we rejoice, when we are weak, and ye are strong: this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nós nos alegramos quando estamos fracos, e vós estais fortes; e isto também desejamos: o vosso aperfeiçoamento.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual nos gozamos que seamos nosotros flacos, y que vosotros estéis fuertes; y aun deseamos vuestra perfección.

verses.KJV: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
verses.WEB: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
verses.ASV: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not when present deal sharply, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu escrevo estas coisas ausente; para que, quando estiver presente não use de rigor, segundo o poder que o Senhor tem me dado, para edificação, e não para destruição.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto os escribo esto ausente, por no tratar presente con dureza, conforme á la potestad que el Señor me ha dado para edificación, y no para destrucción.

verses.KJV: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.WEB: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.ASV: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfected; be comforted; be of the same mind; live in peace: and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto às demais coisas, irmãos, alegrai-vos, sede íntegros, consolai-vos, tenhais um mesmo entendimento, vivei em paz; e o Deus de amor e paz será convosco.
verses.RVR09: Resta, hermanos, que tengáis gozo, seáis perfectos, tengáis consolación, sintáis una misma cosa, tengáis paz; y el Dios de paz y de caridad será con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
verses.WEB: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.ASV: Salute one another with a holy kiss.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo santo.
verses.RVR09: Saludaos los unos á los otros con ósculo santo. Todos los santos os saludan.

verses.KJV: All the saints salute you.
verses.WEB: All the saints greet you.
verses.ASV: All the saints salute you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os santos vos saúdam.
verses.RVR09: La gracia del Señor Jesucristo, y el amor de Dios, y la participación del Espíritu Santo sea con vosotros todos. Amén. La segunda Epístola á los Corintios fué enviada de Filipos de Macedonia con Tito y Lucas.

verses.KJV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e o amor de Deus, e a comunhão do Espírito Santo seja com todos vós. Amém.[A Segunda Carta aos Coríntios foi escrita de Filipos, na Macedônia, e enviada por Tito e Lucas.]

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo (não da parte dos seres humanos, nem por meio de homem algum, mas sim por Jesus Cristo, e por Deus Pai, que o ressuscitou dos mortos),
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol, (no de los hombres, ni por hombre, mas por Jesucristo y por Dios el Padre, que lo resucitó de los muertos),

verses.KJV: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.WEB: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
verses.ASV: and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.ALMEIDA: e todos os irmãos que estão comigo, para as igrejas da Galácia.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los hermanos que están conmigo, á las iglesias de Galacia:

verses.KJV: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ALMEIDA: Graça seja convosco, e também a paz de Deus Pai, e do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.RVR09: Gracia sea á vosotros, y paz de Dios el Padre, y de nuestro Señor Jesucristo,

verses.KJV: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.WEB: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
verses.ASV: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father:
verses.ALMEIDA: que deu a si mesmo pelos nossos pecados, para nos tirar da presente era maligna, conforme a vontade do nosso Deus e Pai,
verses.RVR09: El cual se dió á sí mismo por nuestros pecados para librarnos de este presente siglo malo, conforme á la voluntad de Dios y Padre nuestro;

verses.KJV: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: ao qual seja a glória para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Al cual sea la gloria por siglos de siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.WEB: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
verses.ASV: I marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of Christ unto a different gospel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Admiro-me de que tão rapidamente desviastes daquele que vos chamou na graça de Cristo, em troca de outro evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Estoy maravillado de que tan pronto os hayáis traspasado del que os llamó á la gracia de Cristo, á otro evangelio:

verses.KJV: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.WEB: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
verses.ASV: which is not another [gospel]: only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que haja outro [evangelho] ,porém há alguns que vos inquietam, e querem perverter o Evangelho de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: No que hay otro, sino que hay algunos que os inquietan, y quieren pervertir el evangelio de Cristo.

verses.KJV: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.WEB: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
verses.ASV: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, ainda que nós mesmos, ou um anjo do céu vos anuncie outro evangelho além do que já vos anunciamos, maldito seja.
verses.RVR09: Mas aun si nosotros ó un ángel del cielo os anunciare otro evangelio del que os hemos anunciado, sea anatema.

verses.KJV: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.WEB: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
verses.ASV: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como já havíamos dito, volto também agora a dizer: se alguém vos anunciar outro evangelho além do que já recebestes, maldito seja.
verses.RVR09: Como antes hemos dicho, también ahora decimos otra vez: Si alguno os anunciare otro evangelio del que habéis recibido, sea anatema.

verses.KJV: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.WEB: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verses.ASV: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? or am I striving to please men? if I were still pleasing men, I should not be a servant of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois agora estou buscando a aprovação das pessoas, ou a de Deus? Ou procuro agradar a pessoas? Pois, se ainda tentasse agradar a pessoas, eu não seria servo de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque, ¿persuado yo ahora á hombres ó á Dios? ¿ó busco de agradar á hombres? Cierto, que si todavía agradara á los hombres, no sería siervo de Cristo.

verses.KJV: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.WEB: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
verses.ASV: For I make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas faço-vos saber, irmãos, que o Evangelho anunciado por mim não se baseia em pessoas;
verses.RVR09: Mas os hago saber, hermanos, que el evangelio que ha sido anunciado por mí, no es según hombre;

verses.KJV: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but [it came to me] through revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois não o recebi, nem aprendi de ser humano algum, mas sim pela revelação de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Pues ni yo lo recibí, ni lo aprendí de hombre, sino por revelación de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.WEB: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
verses.ASV: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and made havoc of it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois já ouvistes da minha conduta no judaísmo, como em excesso eu perseguia e tentava destruir a Igreja de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Porque ya habéis oído acerca de mi conducta otro tiempo en el Judaismo, que perseguía sobremanera la iglesia de Dios, y la destruía;

verses.KJV: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.WEB: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.ASV: and I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: e [como] no judaísmo eu era mais avançado que muitos de minha idade em minha nação, e era extremamente zeloso das tradições de meus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y aprovechaba en el Judaismo sobre muchos de mis iguales en mi nación, siendo muy más celador que todos de las tradiciones de mis padres.

verses.KJV: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.WEB: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
verses.ASV: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me, [even] from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando Deus ( que me separou desde o ventre da minha mãe, e por sua graça me chamou ) se agradou
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando plugo á Dios, que me apartó desde el vientre de mi madre, y me llamó por su gracia,

verses.KJV: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.WEB: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
verses.ASV: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; straightway I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.ALMEIDA: de revelar o seu Filho em mim, para eu evangelizar os gentios, de imediato, não fui pedir conselho com pessoa alguma;
verses.RVR09: Revelar á su Hijo en mí, para que le predicase entre los Gentiles, luego no conferí con carne y sangre;

verses.KJV: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.WEB: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
verses.ASV: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned unto Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem subi a Jerusalém para os que já eram apóstolos antes de mim; em vez disso, parti para a Arábia, e voltei outra vez a Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Ni fuí á Jerusalem á los que eran apóstoles antes que yo; sino que me fuí á la Arabia, y volví de nuevo á Damasco.

verses.KJV: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.WEB: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.ASV: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, depois de três anos, subi a Jerusalém para visitar Pedro, e estive com ele por quinze dias.
verses.RVR09: Después, pasados tres años, fuí á Jerusalem á ver á Pedro, y estuve con él quince días.

verses.KJV: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
verses.WEB: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.ASV: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vi nenhum outro dos apóstolos, a não ser Tiago, o irmão do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas á ningún otro de los apóstoles vi, sino á Jacobo el hermano del Señor.

verses.KJV: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.WEB: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
verses.ASV: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, das coisas que vos escrevo, eis que, diante de Deus, não estou mentindo.
verses.RVR09: Y en esto que os escribo, he aquí, delante de Dios, no miento.

verses.KJV: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.WEB: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.ASV: Then I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois fui para as regiões da Síria e da Cilícia.
verses.RVR09: Después fuí á las partes de Siria y de Cilicia;

verses.KJV: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
verses.WEB: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
verses.ASV: And I was still unknown by face unto the churches of Judæa which were in Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, não era conhecido de rosto pelas igrejas da Judeia que estão em Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Y no era conocido de vista á las iglesias de Judea, que eran en Cristo;

verses.KJV: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.WEB: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
verses.ASV: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;
verses.ALMEIDA: mas somente haviam ouvido que “Aquele que antes nos perseguia agora anuncia a fé que antes tentava destruir”.
verses.RVR09: Solamente habían oído decir: Aquel que en otro tiempo nos perseguía, ahora anuncia la fe que en otro tiempo destruía.

verses.KJV: And they glorified God in me.
verses.WEB: So they glorified God in me.
verses.ASV: and they glorified God in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E glorificavam a Deus por causa de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y glorificaban á Dios en mí.

verses.KJV: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
verses.WEB: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
verses.ASV: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de passados catorze anos, subi outra vez a Jerusalém com Barnabé, levando comigo também Tito.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS, pasados catorce años, fuí otra vez á Jerusalem juntamente con Bernabé, tomando también conmigo á Tito.

verses.KJV: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
verses.WEB: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
verses.ASV: And I went up by revelation; and I laid before them the gospel which I preach among the Gentiles but privately before them who were of repute, lest by any means I should be running, or had run, in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, por causa de uma revelação, subi, e lhes declarei o Evangelho que prego entre os gentios. [Isso] , porém, foi em particular, com os mais influentes, para que eu eu não corresse ou tivesse corrido em vão.
verses.RVR09: Empero fuí por revelación, y comuniquéles el evangelio que predico entre los Gentiles; mas particularmente á los que parecían ser algo, por no correr en vano, ó haber corrido.

verses.KJV: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.WEB: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
verses.ASV: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nem mesmo Tito, que estava comigo, sendo grego, foi obrigado a se circuncidar.
verses.RVR09: Mas ni aun Tito, que estaba conmigo, siendo Griego, fué compelido á circuncidarse.

verses.KJV: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.WEB: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
verses.ASV: and that because of the false brethren privily brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.ALMEIDA: E [isso] por causa de falsos irmãos, que haviam se infiltrado, e entraram secretamente para espionar a nossa liberdade que temos em Cristo Jesus, a fim de nos tornar escravos.
verses.RVR09: Y eso por causa de los falsos hermanos, que se entraban secretamente para espiar nuestra libertad que tenemos en Cristo Jesús, para ponernos en servidumbre;

verses.KJV: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.WEB: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
verses.ASV: to whom we gave place in the way of subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: A eles nem sequer por um momento cedemos a nos sujeitarmos, para que a verdade do Evangelho permanecesse em vós.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales ni aun por una hora cedimos sujetándonos, para que la verdad del evangelio permaneciese con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
verses.WEB: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
verses.ASV: But from those who were reputed to be somewhat (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth not man’s person)—they, I say, who were of repute imparted nothing to me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto aos de maior influência (o que haviam sido antes não me importa; Deus não se interessa na aparência humana); esses, pois, que eram influentes, nada me acrescentaram.
verses.RVR09: Empero de aquellos que parecían ser algo (cuáles hayan sido algún tiempo, no tengo que ver; Dios no acepta apariencia de hombre), á mí ciertamente los que parecían ser algo, nada me dieron.

verses.KJV: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
verses.WEB: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
verses.ASV: but contrariwise, when they saw that I had been intrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision, even as Peter with [the gospel] of the circumcision
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo contrário, quando viram que o Evangelho aos incircuncisos havia sido confiado a mim, assim como a Pedro, aos circuncisos,
verses.RVR09: Antes por el contrario, como vieron que el evangelio de la incircuncisión me era encargado, como á Pedro el de la circuncisión,

verses.KJV: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.WEB: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
verses.ASV: (for he that wrought for Peter unto the apostleship of the circumcision wrought for me also unto the Gentiles);
verses.ALMEIDA: (pois aquele que operou em Pedro para o apostolado da circuncisão, esse operou também em mim para os gentios)
verses.RVR09: (Porque el que hizo por Pedro para el apostolado de la circuncisión, hizo también por mí para con los Gentiles;)

verses.KJV: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.WEB: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
verses.ASV: and when they perceived the grace that was given unto me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship, that we should go unto the Gentiles, and they unto the circumcision;
verses.ALMEIDA: e quando Tiago, Cefas, e João, que eram considerados como colunas, reconheceram a graça que me foi dada, eles estenderam as mãos direitas de comunhão a mim e a Barnabé, para que nós [fôssemos] aos gentios, e eles aos circuncisos;
verses.RVR09: Y como vieron la gracia que me era dada, Jacobo y Cefas y Juan, que parecían ser las columnas, nos dieron las diestras de compañía á mí y á Bernabé, para que nosotros fuésemos á los Gentiles, y ellos á la circuncisión.

verses.KJV: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.WEB: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
verses.ASV: only [they would] that we should remember the poor; which very thing I was also zealous to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: sob a condição de que nos lembrássemos dos pobres; isso também procurei fazer com empenho.
verses.RVR09: Solamente nos pidieron que nos acordásemos de los pobres; lo mismo que fuí también solícito en hacer.

verses.KJV: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.WEB: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.ASV: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I resisted him to the face, because he stood condemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Pedro veio a Antioquia, estive contra ele face a face, pois ele devia ser repreendido;
verses.RVR09: Empero viniendo Pedro á Antioquía, le resistí en la cara, porque era de condenar.

verses.KJV: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.WEB: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
verses.ASV: For before that certain came from James, he ate with the Gentiles; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing them that were of the circumcision.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque, antes que alguns que Tiago enviou chegassem, ele comia com os gentios; mas depois que chegaram, ele se retirou e se separou, temendo os que eram da circuncisão.
verses.RVR09: Porque antes que viniesen unos de parte de Jacobo, comía con los Gentiles; mas después que vinieron, se retraía y apartaba, teniendo miedo de los que eran de la circuncisión.

verses.KJV: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.WEB: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
verses.ASV: And the rest of the Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that even Barnabas was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também com ele os outros judeus fingiram, de maneira que até Barnabé se deixou levar pela hipocrisia deles.
verses.RVR09: Y á su disimulación consentían también los otros Judíos; de tal manera que aun Bernabé fué también llevado de ellos en su simulación.

verses.KJV: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.WEB: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
verses.ASV: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Cephas before [them] all, If thou, being a Jew, livest as do the Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, how compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando vi que não estavam agindo corretamente conforme a verdade do Evangelho, disse na presença de todos a Pedro: “Se tu, que és judeu, vives como gentio, e não como judeu, por que obrigas os gentios a viverem como judeus?”
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando vi que no andaban derechamente conforme á la verdad del evangelio, dije á Pedro delante de todos: Si tú, siendo Judío, vives como los Gentiles y no como Judío, ¿por qué constriñes á los Gentiles á judaizar?

verses.KJV: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.WEB: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
verses.ASV: We being Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós, que somos judeus por natureza, e não pecadores dentre os gentios,
verses.RVR09: Nosotros Judíos naturales, y no pecadores de los Gentiles,

verses.KJV: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.WEB: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
verses.ASV: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.ALMEIDA: sabemos que o ser humano não é justificado pelas obras da Lei, mas sim pela fé em Jesus Cristo. Também nós temos crido em Cristo Jesus, para que fôssemos justificados pela fé em Cristo, e não pelas obras da Lei; pois ninguém se justificará pelas obras da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que el hombre no es justificado por las obras de la ley, sino por la fe de Jesucristo, nosotros también hemos creído en Jesucristo, para que fuésemos justificados por la fe de Cristo, y no por las obras de la ley; por cuanto por las obras de la ley ninguna carne será justificada.

verses.KJV: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.WEB: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
verses.ASV: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se nós, que buscamos ser justificados em Cristo, também nós mesmos somos achados pecadores, por isso Cristo contribui com o pecado? De maneira nenhuma!
verses.RVR09: Y si buscando nosotros ser justificados en Cristo, también nosotros somos hallados pecadores, ¿es por eso Cristo ministro de pecado? En ninguna manera.

verses.KJV: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.WEB: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
verses.ASV: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a transgressor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se volto a construir as coisas que já destruí, provo que eu mesmo cometi transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Porque si las cosas que destruí, las mismas vuelvo á edificar, transgresor me hago.

verses.KJV: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.WEB: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
verses.ASV: For I through the law died unto the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois pela Lei estou morto para a Lei, a fim de que eu viva para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo por la ley soy muerto á la ley, para vivir á Dios.

verses.KJV: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.WEB: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
verses.ASV: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I that live, but Christ liveth in me: and that [life] which I now live in the flesh I live in faith, [the faith] which is in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já estou crucificado com Cristo. Estou vivendo não mais eu, mas Cristo vive em mim; e vivo a minha vida na carne por meio da fé no Filho de Deus, que me amou, e entregou a si mesmo por mim.
verses.RVR09: Con Cristo estoy juntamente crucificado, y vivo, no ya yo, mas vive Cristo en mí: y lo que ahora vivo en la carne, lo vivo en la fe del Hijo de Dios, el cual me amó, y se entregó á sí mismo por mí.

verses.KJV: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verses.WEB: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
verses.ASV: I do not make void the grace of God: for if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não anulo a graça de Deus; pois, se a justiça é por meio da Lei, logo Cristo morreu por nada.
verses.RVR09: No desecho la gracia de Dios: porque si por la ley fuese la justicia, entonces por demás murió Cristo.

verses.KJV: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.WEB: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
verses.ASV: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó insensatos gálatas, quem vos iludiu para não obedecerdes à verdade? Diante dos vossos olhos Jesus Cristo foi retratado entre vós como crucificado!
verses.RVR09: ¡OH Gálatas insensatos! ¿quién os fascinó, para no obedecer á la verdad, ante cuyos ojos Jesucristo fué ya descrito como crucificado entre vosotros?

verses.KJV: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.WEB: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
