verses.ASV: This only would I learn from you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: Só isto eu queria saber de vós: recebestes o Espírito pelas obras da Lei ou pela pregação da fé?
verses.RVR09: Esto solo quiero saber de vosotros: ¿Recibisteis el Espíritu por las obras de la ley, ó por el oir de la fe?

verses.KJV: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.WEB: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
verses.ASV: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sois vós tão insensatos que, depois de começardes no Espírito, agora terminareis na carne?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tan necios sois? ¿habiendo comenzado por el Espíritu, ahora os perfeccionáis por la carne?

verses.KJV: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.WEB: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
verses.ASV: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Experimentastes tantas coisas em vão? Se é que foi mesmo em vão!
verses.RVR09: ¿Tantas cosas habéis padecido en vano? si empero en vano.

verses.KJV: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.WEB: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.ASV: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, [doeth he it] by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, aquele que vos dá o Espírito e que opera maravilhas entre vós [faz isso] por causa das obras da Lei ou da pregação da fé?
verses.RVR09: Aquel, pues, que os daba el Espíritu, y obraba maravillas entre vosotros ¿hacíalo por las obras de la ley, ó por el oir de la fe?

verses.KJV: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.WEB: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
verses.ASV: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como “Abraão creu em Deus, e foi lhe reputado como justiça”,
verses.RVR09: Como Abraham creyó á Dios, y le fué imputado á justicia.

verses.KJV: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.WEB: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
verses.ASV: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: entendei, pois, que os que são da fé são filhos de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Sabéis por tanto, que los que son de fe, los tales son hijos de Abraham.

verses.KJV: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.WEB: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
verses.ASV: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto Abraham, [saying], In thee shall all the nations be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Escritura, prevendo que Deus justificaria os gentios pela fé, prenunciou o Evangelho a Abraão, [dizendo] : Todas nas nações serão abençoadas em ti.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo antes la Escritura que Dios por la fe había de justificar á los Gentiles, evangelizó antes á Abraham, diciendo: En ti serán benditas todas las naciones.

verses.KJV: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.WEB: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
verses.ASV: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, os que são da fé são abençoados com o crente Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Luego los de la fe son benditos con el creyente Abraham.

verses.KJV: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.WEB: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
verses.ASV: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos os que são das obras da Lei estão sob maldição, porque está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que não permanecer em todas as coisas que estão escritas no livro da Lei, para fazê-las.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los que son de las obras de la ley, están bajo de maldición. Porque escrito está: Maldito todo aquel que no permaneciere en todas las cosas que están escritas en el libro de la ley, para hacerlas.

verses.KJV: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.WEB: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
verses.ASV: Now that no man is justified by the law before God, is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith;
verses.ALMEIDA: E é evidente que pela Lei ninguém será justificado, porque: O justo viverá pela fé.
verses.RVR09: Mas por cuanto por la ley ninguno se justifica para con Dios, queda manifiesto: Que el justo por la fe vivirá.

verses.KJV: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.WEB: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
verses.ASV: and the law is not of faith; but, He that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Lei não provém da fé; porém: Quem fizer estas coisas por elas viverá.
verses.RVR09: La ley también no es de la fe; sino, El hombre que los hiciere, vivirá en ellos.

verses.KJV: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.WEB: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
verses.ASV: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cristo nos resgatou da maldição da Lei ao se fazer maldição para o nosso benefício (pois está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que for pendurado em um madeiro.)
verses.RVR09: Cristo nos redimió de la maldición de la ley, hecho por nosotros maldición; (porque está escrito: Maldito cualquiera que es colgado en madero:)

verses.KJV: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.WEB: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.ASV: that upon the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: com a finalidade de que a bênção de Abraão chegasse aos gentios em Cristo Jesus, para que recebêssemos a promessa do Espírito por meio da fé.
verses.RVR09: Para que la bendición de Abraham fuese sobre los Gentiles en Cristo Jesús; para que por la fe recibamos la promesa del Espíritu.

verses.KJV: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.WEB: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
verses.ASV: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men: Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, estou falando em termos humanos: ainda que seja o pacto de uma pessoa, depois de confirmado, ninguém o anula, nem lhe acrescenta.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, hablo como hombre: Aunque un pacto sea de hombre, con todo, siendo confirmado, nadie lo cancela, ó le añade.

verses.KJV: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.WEB: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
verses.ASV: Now to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, as promessas foram ditas a Abraão e à sua descendência. E não diz: “E às descendências” como que [falando] de muitos, mas sim como a um: “E à tua descendência”, que é Cristo.
verses.RVR09: A Abraham fueron hechas las promesas, y á su simiente. No dice: Y á las simientes, como de muchos; sino como de uno: Y á tu simiente, la cual es Cristo.

verses.KJV: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.WEB: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
verses.ASV: Now this I say: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas digo isto: o pacto foi confirmado anteriormente por Deus em Cristo; e a Lei que veio quatrocentos e trinta anos depois não o invalida de maneira que anule a promessa.
verses.RVR09: Esto pues digo: Que el contrato confirmado de Dios para con Cristo, la ley que fué hecha cuatrocientos treinta años después, no lo abroga, para invalidar la promesa.

verses.KJV: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.WEB: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
verses.ASV: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se a herança é pela Lei, já não é pela promessa; mas foi por meio da promessa que Deus a concedeu gratuitamente a Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Porque si la herencia es por la ley, ya no es por la promesa: empero Dios por la promesa hizo la donación á Abraham.

verses.KJV: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.WEB: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
verses.ASV: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; [and it was] ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que, pois, é a Lei? Ela foi ordenada por causa das transgressões, até que chegasse o descendente a quem a promessa havia sido feita; e foi posta pelos anjos na mão de um mediador.
verses.RVR09: ¿Pues de qué sirve la ley? Fué puesta por causa de las rebeliones, hasta que viniese la simiente á quien fué hecha la promesa, ordenada aquélla por los ángeles en la mano de un mediador.

verses.KJV: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.WEB: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
verses.ASV: Now a mediator is not [a mediator] of one; but God is one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, o mediador não é de um só, mas Deus é um.
verses.RVR09: Y el mediador no es de uno, pero Dios es uno.

verses.KJV: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.WEB: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
verses.ASV: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso, pois, a Lei é contra as promessas de Deus? De maneira nenhuma! Pois, se a Lei houvesse sido entregue para que pudesse dar vida, na verdade a justiça teria sido pela Lei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Luego la ley es contra las promesas de Dios? En ninguna manera: porque si la ley dada pudiera vivificar, la justicia fuera verdaderamente por la ley.

verses.KJV: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.WEB: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.ASV: But the scripture shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a Escritura prendeu tudo debaixo do pecado a fim de que a promessa fosse dada aos crentes por meio da fé em Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mas encerró la Escritura todo bajo pecado, para que la promesa fuese dada á los creyentes por la fe de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.WEB: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.ASV: But before faith came, we were kept in ward under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, antes que a fé viesse, estávamos vigiados sob a Lei, e presos, até que a fé fosse revelada.
verses.RVR09: Empero antes que viniese la fe, estábamos guardados bajo la ley, encerrados para aquella fe que había de ser descubierta.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.WEB: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.ASV: So that the law is become our tutor [to bring us] unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dessa maneira, a Lei foi nosso tutor em condução a Cristo, para que pela fé fossemos justificados.
verses.RVR09: De manera que la ley nuestro ayo fué para llevarnos á Cristo, para que fuésemos justificados por la fe.

verses.KJV: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.WEB: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.ASV: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas depois que a fé chegou, já não estamos mais sob um tutor,
verses.RVR09: Mas venida la fe, ya no estamos bajo ayo;

verses.KJV: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: For ye are all sons of God, through faith, in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois todos vós sois filhos de Deus por meio da fé em Cristo Jesus;
verses.RVR09: Porque todos sois hijos de Dios por la fe en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.WEB: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.ASV: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ did put on Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois todos vós que fostes batizados em Cristo já vos revestistes de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los que habéis sido bautizados en Cristo, de Cristo estáis vestidos.

verses.KJV: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: There can be neither Jew nor Greek, there can be neither bond nor free, there can be no male and female; for ye all are one [man] in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, não há judeu nem grego; não há servo nem livre; não há macho nem fêmea. Pois todos vós sois um em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: No hay Judío, ni Griego; no hay siervo, ni libre; no hay varón, ni hembra: porque todos vosotros sois uno en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.WEB: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
verses.ASV: And if ye are Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, heirs according to promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se vós sois de Cristo, então sois descendência de Abraão, e herdeiros conforme a promessa.
verses.RVR09: Y si vosotros sois de Cristo, ciertamente la simiente de Abraham sois, y conforme á la promesa los herederos.

verses.KJV: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.WEB: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
verses.ASV: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he differeth nothing from a bondservant though he is lord of all;
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo, porém, que, enquanto o herdeiro é criança, em nada é diferente do servo, ainda que seja senhor de tudo.
verses.RVR09: TAMBIÉN digo: Entre tanto que el heredero es niño, en nada difiere del siervo, aunque es señor de todo;

verses.KJV: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.WEB: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
verses.ASV: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed of the father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas está sob tutores e administradores, até o tempo determinado pelo pai.
verses.RVR09: Mas está debajo de tutores y curadores hasta el tiempo señalado por el padre.

verses.KJV: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.WEB: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
verses.ASV: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the rudiments of the world:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também nós, quando éramos crianças, estávamos escravizados debaixo dos princípios elementares do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Así también nosotros, cuando éramos niños, éramos siervos bajo los rudimentos del mundo.

verses.KJV: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.WEB: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
verses.ASV: but when the fulness of the time came, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o tempo se completou, Deus enviou o seu Filho, nascido de mulher, nascido sob a Lei,
verses.RVR09: Mas venido el cumplimiento del tiempo, Dios envió su Hijo, hecho de mujer, hecho súbdito á la ley,

verses.KJV: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.WEB: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
verses.ASV: that he might redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: para redimir os que estavam sob a Lei, a fim de que nós recebêssemos a adoção como filhos.
verses.RVR09: Para que redimiese á los que estaban debajo de la ley, á fin de que recibiésemos la adopción de hijos.

verses.KJV: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.WEB: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
verses.ASV: And because ye are sons, God sent forth the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, como sois filhos, Deus enviou aos vossos corações o Espírito do seu Filho, que clama: “Aba, Pai!”
verses.RVR09: Y por cuanto sois hijos, Dios envió el Espíritu de su Hijo en vuestros corazones, el cual clama: Abba, Padre.

verses.KJV: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.WEB: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.ASV: So that thou art no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, tu já não és mais servo, mas sim filho; e se és filho, também és herdeiro de Deus por meio de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Así que ya no eres más siervo, sino hijo; y si hijo, también heredero de Dios por Cristo.

verses.KJV: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.WEB: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
verses.ASV: Howbeit at that time, not knowing God, ye were in bondage to them that by nature are no gods:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, porém, não conhecíeis a Deus, vós servíeis aos que por natureza não são deuses.
verses.RVR09: Antes, en otro tiempo, no conociendo á Dios, servíais á los que por naturaleza no son dioses:

verses.KJV: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
verses.WEB: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
verses.ASV: but now that ye have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how turn ye back again to the weak and beggarly rudiments, whereunto ye desire to be in bondage over again?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, que conheceis Deus, mais que isso, por Deus sois conhecidos, por que voltais outra vez aos fracos e miseráveis princípios elementares, aos quais quereis servir de novo?
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, habiendo conocido á Dios, ó más bien, siendo conocidos de Dios, ¿cómo os volvéis de nuevo á los flacos y pobres rudimentos, en los cuales queréis volver á servir?

verses.KJV: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.WEB: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
verses.ASV: Ye observe days, and months, and seasons, and years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós guardais dias, meses, tempos, e anos.
verses.RVR09: Guardáis los días, y los meses, y los tiempos, y los años.

verses.KJV: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.WEB: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
verses.ASV: I am afraid of you, lest by any means I have bestowed labor upon you in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temo a vosso respeito de que talvez eu tenha trabalhado para convosco em vão.
verses.RVR09: Temo de vosotros, que no haya trabajado en vano en vosotros.

verses.KJV: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.WEB: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
verses.ASV: I beseech you, brethren, become as I [am], for I also [am become] as ye [are]. Ye did me no wrong:
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-vos, irmãos, que sejais como eu, pois também eu sou como vós. Nenhum mal me fizestes.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, os ruego, sed como yo, porque yo soy como vosotros: ningún agravio me habéis hecho.

verses.KJV: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.WEB: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
verses.ASV: but ye know that because of an infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you the first time:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sabeis que foi com uma enfermidade da carne que vos anunciei o Evangelho pela primeira vez;
verses.RVR09: Que vosotros sabéis que por flaqueza de carne os anuncié el evangelio al principio:

verses.KJV: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: and that which was a temptation to you in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but ye received me as an angel of God, [even] as Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não cedestes à tentação de ter desprezo ou repugnância por meu aspecto físico; ao contrário, vós me recebestes como a um mensageiro de Deus, como ao [próprio] Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y no desechasteis ni menospreciasteis mi tentación que estaba en mi carne: antes me recibisteis como á un ángel de Dios, como á Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.WEB: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.ASV: Where then is that gratulation of yourselves? for I bear you witness, that, if possible, ye would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que houve, pois, com a vossa alegria? Pois eu vos dou testemunho de que, se fosse possível, teríeis arrancado os vossos próprios olhos para dá-los a mim.
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde está pues vuestra bienaventuranza? porque yo os doy testimonio que si se pudiera hacer, os hubierais sacado vuestros ojos para dármelos.

verses.KJV: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.WEB: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.ASV: So then am I become your enemy, by telling you the truth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornei-me, por acaso, vosso inimigo por ter vos dito a verdade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Heme pues hecho vuestro enemigo, diciéndoos la verdad?

verses.KJV: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
verses.WEB: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
verses.ASV: They zealously seek you in no good way; nay, they desire to shut you out, that ye may seek them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles têm interesse por vós, mas não com boa intenção; mas querem vos isolar [de mim] ,para que vós mostreis interesse por eles.
verses.RVR09: Tienen celos de vosotros, pero no bien: antes os quieren echar fuera para que vosotros los celéis á ellos.

verses.KJV: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.WEB: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.ASV: But it is good to be zealously sought in a good matter at all times, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: É bom, porém, mostrar interesse para o bem sempre, e não somente quando estou presente convosco.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es ser celosos en bien siempre; y no solamente cuando estoy presente con vosotros.

verses.KJV: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.WEB: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
verses.ASV: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ be formed in you—
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus filhinhos, por quem volto a sofrer dores de parto, até que Cristo seja formado em vós:
verses.RVR09: Hijitos míos, que vuelvo otra vez á estar de parto de vosotros, hasta que Cristo sea formado en vosotros;

verses.KJV: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.WEB: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
verses.ASV: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone; for I am perplexed about you.
verses.ALMEIDA: queria eu estar agora presente convosco, e mudar meu tom de voz, pois estou perplexo a vosso respeito.
verses.RVR09: Querría cierto estar ahora con vosotros, y mudar mi voz; porque estoy perplejo en cuanto á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.WEB: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
verses.ASV: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondei-me vós, que quereis estar sob a Lei: não ouvis a Lei?
verses.RVR09: Decidme, los que queréis estar debajo de la ley, ¿no habéis oído la ley?

verses.KJV: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.WEB: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
verses.ASV: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the freewoman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois está escrito que Abraão tinha dois filhos: um da escrava, e outro da livre.
verses.RVR09: Porque escrito está que Abraham tuvo dos hijos; uno de la sierva, el otro de la libre.

verses.KJV: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.WEB: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
verses.ASV: Howbeit the [son] by the handmaid is born after the flesh; but the [son] by the freewoman [is born] through promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: O da escrava nasceu segundo a carne, mas o da livre, pela promessa.
verses.RVR09: Mas el de la sierva nació según la carne; pero el de la libre nació por la promesa.

verses.KJV: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.WEB: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
verses.ASV: Which things contain an allegory: for these [women] are two covenants; one from mount Sinai, bearing children unto bondage, which is Hagar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto serve de ilustração, pois estes são dois pactos: um é o do monte Sinai, que gera filhos para a escravidão, que é Agar.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales cosas son dichas por alegoría: porque estas mujeres son los dos pactos; el uno ciertamente del monte Sinaí, el cual engendró para servidumbre, que es Agar.

verses.KJV: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.WEB: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
verses.ASV: Now this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia and answereth to the Jerusalem that now is: for she is in bondage with her children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esta Agar é o monte Sinai, na Arábia, e corresponde à Jerusalém de agora, e é escravizada com os filhos dela.
verses.RVR09: Porque Agar ó Sinaí es un monte de Arabia, el cual es conjunto á la que ahora es Jerusalem, la cual sirve con sus hijos.

verses.KJV: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.WEB: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.ASV: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is our mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a Jerusalém de cima é livre; esta é a mãe de todos nós.
verses.RVR09: Mas la Jerusalem de arriba libre es; la cual es la madre de todos nosotros.

verses.KJV: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.WEB: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
verses.ASV: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; Break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: For more are the children of the desolate than of her that hath the husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois está escrito: Alegra-te, ó estéril, que não geras filhos; extravasa gritando de júbilo, tu, que não estás de parto; porque muitos mais são os filhos da solitária, que os da que tem marido.
verses.RVR09: Porque está escrito: Alégrate, estéril, que no pares: prorrumpe y clama, la que no estás de parto; porque más son los hijos de la dejada, que de la que tiene marido.

verses.KJV: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.WEB: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
verses.ASV: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós, porém, irmãos, como Isaque, somos filhos da promessa.
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos, nosotros como Isaac somos hijos de la promesa.

verses.KJV: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.WEB: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
verses.ASV: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him [that was born] after the Spirit, so also it is now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, assim como naquele tempo o que nasceu segundo a carne perseguia o que [nasceu] segundo o Espírito, assim também é agora.
verses.RVR09: Empero como entonces el que era engendrado según la carne, perseguía al que había nacido según el Espíritu, así también ahora.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.WEB: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
verses.ASV: Howbeit what saith the scripture? Cast out the handmaid and her son: for the son of the handmaid shall not inherit with the son of the freewoman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que diz a Escritura? Expulsa a escrava e o filho dela, porque de maneira nenhuma o filho da escrava herdará com o filho da livre.
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿qué dice la Escritura? Echa fuera á la sierva y á su hijo; porque no será heredero el hijo de la sierva con el hijo de la libre.

verses.KJV: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.WEB: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, brethren, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the freewoman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, não somos filhos da escrava, mas sim da livre.
verses.RVR09: De manera, hermanos, que no somos hijos de la sierva, mas de la libre.

verses.KJV: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.WEB: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
verses.ASV: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estai, pois, firmes na liberdade com que Cristo nos libertou, e não volteis a vos prender com o jugo da escravidão.
verses.RVR09: ESTAD, pues, firmes en la libertad con que Cristo nos hizo libres, y no volváis otra vez á ser presos en el yugo de servidumbre.

verses.KJV: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.WEB: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.ASV: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu, Paulo, vos digo, que se vos deixardes circuncidar, Cristo vos será útil em nada.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo Pablo os digo, que si os circuncidareis, Cristo no os aprovechará nada.

verses.KJV: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.WEB: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.ASV: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de novo atesto que todo homem que se deixar circuncidar está obrigado a obedecer a toda a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez vuelvo á protestar á todo hombre que se circuncidare, que está obligado á hacer toda la ley.

verses.KJV: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.WEB: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
verses.ASV: Ye are severed from Christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desligados estais de Cristo, vós que [quereis] ser justos pela Lei; da graça caístes.
verses.RVR09: Vacíos sois de Cristo los que por la ley os justificáis; de la gracia habéis caído.

verses.KJV: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.WEB: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.ASV: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, por meio do Espírito, pela fé, aguardamos a esperança da justiça;
verses.RVR09: Porque nosotros por el Espíritu esperamos la esperanza de la justicia por la fe.

verses.KJV: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.WEB: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
verses.ASV: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque, em Cristo Jesus, nem a circuncisão nem a incircuncisão tem valor algum; mas sim a fé, que opera por meio do amor.
verses.RVR09: Porque en Cristo Jesús ni la circuncisión vale algo, ni la incircuncisión; sino la fe que obra por la caridad.

verses.KJV: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.WEB: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
verses.ASV: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Estáveis correndo bem; quem vos impediu de obedecerdes à verdade?
verses.RVR09: Vosotros corríais bien: ¿quién os embarazó para no obedecer á la verdad?

verses.KJV: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.WEB: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
verses.ASV: This persuasion [came] not of him that calleth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta persuasão não parte daquele que vos chama.
verses.RVR09: Esta persuasión no es de aquel que os llama.

verses.KJV: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.WEB: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
verses.ASV: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um pouco de fermento leveda toda a massa.
verses.RVR09: Un poco de levadura leuda toda la masa.

verses.KJV: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.WEB: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
verses.ASV: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acerca de vós, confio no Senhor de que não mudareis a vossa mentalidade; mas aquele que vos perturba, seja quem for, sofrerá o julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Yo confío de vosotros en el Señor, que ninguna otra cosa sentiréis: mas el que os inquieta, llevará el juicio, quienquiera que él sea.

verses.KJV: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.WEB: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
verses.ASV: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se eu, irmãos, ainda prego a circuncisão, por que, então, sou perseguido? Então a ofensa da cruz está anulada!
verses.RVR09: Y yo, hermanos, si aun predico la circuncisión, ¿por qué padezco persecución todavía? pues que quitado es el escándalo de la cruz.

verses.KJV: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.WEB: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
verses.ASV: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gostaria que aqueles que estão vos perturbando castrassem a si mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Ojalá fuesen también cortados los que os inquietan.

verses.KJV: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.WEB: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
verses.ASV: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only [use] not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós, irmãos, fostes chamados para a liberdade. Somente não [useis] a liberdade como oportunidade para a carne; em vez disso, servi-vos uns aos outros pelo amor.
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros, hermanos, á libertad habéis sido llamados; solamente que no uséis la libertad como ocasión á la carne, sino servíos por amor los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.WEB: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.ASV: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois toda a Lei se cumpre em uma só regra, que é: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda la ley en aquesta sola palabra se cumple: Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo.

verses.KJV: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.WEB: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
verses.ASV: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se, porém, mordeis e devorais uns aos outros, cuidado para não vos destruirdes mutuamente.
verses.RVR09: Y si os mordéis y os coméis los unos á los otros, mirad que también no os consumáis los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.WEB: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
verses.ASV: But I say, Walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu digo: andai no Espírito, e não executeis o mau desejo da carne.
verses.RVR09: Digo pues: Andad en el Espíritu, y no satisfagáis la concupiscencia de la carne.

verses.KJV: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.WEB: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
verses.ASV: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a carne deseja contra o Espírito, e o Espírito contra a carne; e estes se opõem mutuamente, para que não façais o que quereis.
verses.RVR09: Porque la carne codicia contra el Espíritu, y el Espíritu contra la carne: y estas cosas se oponen la una á la otra, para que no hagáis lo que quisiereis.

verses.KJV: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.WEB: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.ASV: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se sois guiados pelo Espírito, não estais debaixo da Lei.
verses.RVR09: Mas si sois guiados del Espíritu, no estáis bajo la ley.

verses.KJV: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.WEB: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
verses.ASV: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are [these]: fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.ALMEIDA: As obras da carne são evidentes. São elas: adultério, pecado sexual, impureza, devassidão,
verses.RVR09: Y manifiestas son las obras de la carne, que son: adulterio, fornicación, inmundicia, disolución,

verses.KJV: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.WEB: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
verses.ASV: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,
verses.ALMEIDA: idolatria, feitiçaria, inimizades, brigas, ciúmes, iras, rivalidades egoístas, desavenças, facções,
verses.RVR09: Idolatría, hechicerías, enemistades, pleitos, celos, iras, contiendas, disensiones, herejías,

verses.KJV: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.WEB: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
verses.ASV: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which I forewarn you, even as I did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: invejas, homicídios, bebedices, orgias, e coisas semelhantes a essas, das quais eu havia vos dito anteriormente; assim como eu também haviavos dito antes que os que praticam tais coisas não herdarão o Reino de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Envidias, homicidios, borracheras, banqueteos, y cosas semejantes á éstas: de las cuales os denuncio, como ya os he anunciado, que los que hacen tales cosas no heredarán el reino de Dios.

verses.KJV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.WEB: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
verses.ASV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o fruto do Espírito é: amor, alegria, paz, paciência, benignidade, bondade, fidelidade,
verses.RVR09: Mas el fruto del Espíritu es: caridad, gozo, paz, tolerancia, benignidad, bondad, fe,

verses.KJV: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.WEB: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verses.ASV: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
verses.ALMEIDA: mansidão, domínio próprio. Contra essas coisas não há lei.
verses.RVR09: Mansedumbre, templanza: contra tales cosas no hay ley.

verses.KJV: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.WEB: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
verses.ASV: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que são de Cristo crucificaram a carne com as paixões e os maus desejos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que son de Cristo, han crucificado la carne con los afectos y concupiscencias.

verses.KJV: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.WEB: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
verses.ASV: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vivemos no Espírito, também no Espírito andemos.
verses.RVR09: Si vivimos en el Espíritu, andemos también en el Espíritu.

verses.KJV: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.WEB: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
verses.ASV: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não nos tornemos presunçosos, irritando uns aos outros, e invejando uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: No seamos codiciosos de vana gloria, irritando los unos á los otros, envidiándose los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.WEB: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
verses.ASV: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, se alguém for surpreendido em algum pecado, vós que sois espirituais, restaurai ao tal com espírito de mansidão, prestando atenção a ti mesmo, para que não sejas tentado também.
verses.RVR09: HERMANOS, si alguno fuere tomado en alguna falta, vosotros que sois espirituales, restaurad al tal con el espíritu de mansedumbre; considerándote á ti mismo, porque tú no seas también tentado.

verses.KJV: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.WEB: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.ASV: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levai as cargas uns dos outros, e assim cumprireis a lei de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Sobrellevad los unos las cargas de los otros; y cumplid así la ley de Cristo.

verses.KJV: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.WEB: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.ASV: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se alguém pensa ser alguma coisa, sendo nada, engana a si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que estima de sí que es algo, no siendo nada, á sí mismo se engaña.

verses.KJV: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.WEB: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
verses.ASV: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um, porém, examine a sua própria obra, e então terá orgulho em si mesmo sozinho, e não em outro;
verses.RVR09: Así que cada uno examine su obra, y entonces tendrá gloria sólo respecto de sí mismo, y no en otro.

verses.KJV: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.WEB: For each man will bear his own burden.
verses.ASV: For each man shall bear his own burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois cada um levará a sua própria carga.
verses.RVR09: Porque cada cual llevará su carga.

verses.KJV: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.WEB: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
verses.ASV: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que é instruído na palavra compartilhe todas as boas coisas com aquele que o instrui.
verses.RVR09: Y el que es enseñado en la palabra, comunique en todos los bienes al que lo instruye.

verses.KJV: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.WEB: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
verses.ASV: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos enganeis: Deus não se deixa escarnecer; pois, o que o ser humano semear, isso também colherá.
verses.RVR09: No os engañéis: Dios no puede ser burlado: que todo lo que el hombre sembrare, eso también segará.

verses.KJV: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.WEB: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
verses.ASV: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem semear para a sua carne, da carne colherá degradação; mas quem semear para o Espírito, do Espírito colherá a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que siembra para su carne, de la carne segará corrupción; mas el que siembra para el Espíritu, del Espíritu segará vida eterna.

verses.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.WEB: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
verses.ASV: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não cansemos de fazer o bem, pois no tempo devido colheremos, se não desistirmos.
verses.RVR09: No nos cansemos, pues, de hacer bien; que á su tiempo segaremos, si no hubiéremos desmayado.

verses.KJV: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.WEB: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
verses.ASV: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, enquanto temos oportunidade, façamos o bem a todos; mas principalmente aos familiares da fé.
verses.RVR09: Así que, entre tanto que tenemos tiempo, hagamos bien á todos, y mayormente á los domésticos de la fe.

verses.KJV: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.WEB: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
verses.ASV: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai como são grandes as letras que vos escrevi da minha mão.
verses.RVR09: Mirad en cuán grandes letras os he escrito de mi mano.

verses.KJV: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.WEB: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.ASV: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que querem mostrar boa aparência na carne, estes vos obrigam a vos circuncidarem, somente para não serem perseguidos por causa da cruz de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Todos los que quieren agradar en la carne, éstos os constriñen á que os circuncidéis, solamente por no padecer persecución por la cruz de Cristo.

verses.KJV: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.WEB: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.ASV: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nem mesmo os que se circuncidam guardam a Lei; mas querem que vos circuncideis, para se orgulharem de vossa carne.
verses.RVR09: Porque ni aun los mismos que se circuncidan guardan la ley; sino que quieren que vosotros seáis circuncidados, para gloriarse en vuestra carne.

verses.KJV: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.WEB: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.ASV: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas longe de mim esteja me orgulhar, a não ser na cruz do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo; por meio dela, o mundo está crucificado para mim, e eu para o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Mas lejos esté de mí gloriarme, sino en la cruz de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, por el cual el mundo me es crucificado á mí, y yo al mundo.

verses.KJV: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.WEB: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.ASV: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois em Cristo Jesus, nem a circuncisão tem valor algum, nem a incircuncisão; mas sim a nova criatura.
verses.RVR09: Porque en Cristo Jesús, ni la circuncisión vale nada, ni la incircuncisión, sino la nueva criatura.

verses.KJV: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.WEB: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
verses.ASV: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace [be] upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os que andarem conforme esta regra, paz e misericórdia estejam sobre eles, e sobre o Israel de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los que anduvieren conforme á esta regla, paz sobre ellos, y misericordia, y sobre el Israel de Dios.

verses.KJV: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
verses.ASV: Henceforth let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: De agora em diante, ninguém me perturbe, porque trago no meu corpo as marcas do Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: De aquí adelante nadie me sea molesto; porque yo traigo en mi cuerpo las marcas del Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito, irmãos. Amém![Escrita de Roma para os Gálatas]
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, la gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea con vuestro espíritu. Amén. Enviada de Roma á los Gálatas.

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints that are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo pela vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso, e fiéis em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, á los santos y fieles en Cristo Jesús que están en Efeso:

verses.KJV: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Graça e paz, de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, [sejam] convosco.
verses.RVR09: Gracia sea á vosotros, y paz de Dios Padre nuestro, y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
verses.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
verses.ASV: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que nos abençoou com todas as bênçãos espirituis nos lugares celestiais em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Bendito el Dios y Padre del Señor nuestro Jesucristo, el cual nos bendijo con toda bendición espiritual en lugares celestiales en Cristo:

verses.KJV: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.WEB: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
verses.ASV: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como nos escolheu nele antes da fundação do mundo, para que fôssemos santos e irrepreensíveis diante dele em amor.
verses.RVR09: Según nos escogió en él antes de la fundación del mundo, para que fuésemos santos y sin mancha delante de él en amor;

verses.KJV: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.WEB: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
verses.ASV: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through Jesus Christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos predestinou como filhos adotados por meio de Jesus Cristo para si mesmo, conforme o bom prazer de sua vontade;
verses.RVR09: Habiéndonos predestinado para ser adoptados hijos por Jesucristo á sí mismo, según el puro afecto de su voluntad,

verses.KJV: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.WEB: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.
verses.ASV: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved:
verses.ALMEIDA: para louvor da glória de sua graça, pela qual nos fez aceitáveis no Amado.
verses.RVR09: Para alabanza de la gloria de su gracia, con la cual nos hizo aceptos en el Amado:

verses.KJV: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.WEB: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
verses.ASV: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele temos a libertação pelo seu sangue, o perdão dos pecados, conforme as riquezas da sua graça,
verses.RVR09: En el cual tenemos redención por su sangre, la remisión de pecados por las riquezas de su gracia,

verses.KJV: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.WEB: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
verses.ASV: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
verses.ALMEIDA: que ele fez transbordar em nós em toda sabedoria e prudência.
verses.RVR09: Que sobreabundó en nosotros en toda sabiduría é inteligencia;

verses.KJV: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.WEB: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
verses.ASV: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos revelou o mistério da sua vontade, conforme o seu bom prazer, que propôs nele,
verses.RVR09: Descubriéndonos el misterio de su voluntad, según su beneplácito, que se había propuesto en sí mismo,

verses.KJV: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.WEB: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
verses.ASV: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, [I say],
verses.ALMEIDA: para a administração do cumprimento dos tempos, [isto é,] voltar a reunir todas as coisas em Cristo, tanto as que [estão] nos céus, quanto as que [estão] na terra.
verses.RVR09: De reunir todas las cosas en Cristo, en la dispensación del cumplimiento de los tiempos, así las que están en los cielos, como las que están en la tierra:

verses.KJV: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.WEB: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
verses.ASV: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele também fomos feitos herança, havendo sido predestinados conforme o propósito daquele que faz todas as coisas segundo o conselho da sua vontade,
verses.RVR09: En él digo, en quien asimismo tuvimos suerte, habiendo sido predestinados conforme al propósito del que hace todas las cosas según el consejo de su voluntad,

verses.KJV: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
verses.WEB: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
verses.ASV: to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: para que fôssemos para louvor da sua glória, nós os que primeiro esperamos em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Para que seamos para alabanza de su gloria, nosotros que antes esperamos en Cristo.

verses.KJV: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.WEB: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
verses.ASV: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation,—in whom, having also believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
verses.ALMEIDA: E também vós, depois que ouvistes a palavra da verdade, o evangelho da vossa salvação, e nele crestes, nele fostes selados com o Espírito Santo da promessa,
verses.RVR09: En el cual esperasteis también vosotros en oyendo la palabra de verdad, el evangelio de vuestra salud: en el cual también desde que creísteis, fuisteis sellados con el Espíritu Santo de la promesa,

verses.KJV: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.WEB: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
verses.ASV: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of [God’s] own possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: que é a garantia da nossa herança, até a libertação da propriedade [de Deus] , para louvor da sua glória.
verses.RVR09: Que es las arras de nuestra herencia, para la redención de la posesión adquirida para alabanza de su gloria.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.WEB: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
verses.ASV: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which [ye show] toward all the saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu, desde que ouvi da fé que há entre vós no Senhor Jesus, e do amor a todos os santos,
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también yo, habiendo oído de vuestra fe en el Señor Jesús, y amor para con todos los santos,

verses.KJV: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.WEB: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
verses.ASV: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention [of you] in my prayers;
verses.ALMEIDA: não paro de agradecer [a Deus] por vós, lembrando-me de vós em minhas orações.
verses.RVR09: No ceso de dar gracias por vosotros, haciendo memoria de vosotros en mis oraciones;

verses.KJV: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.WEB: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
verses.ASV: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Oro] para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai glorioso , vos dê o Espírito de sabedoria e de revelação no conhecimento dele;
verses.RVR09: Que el Dios del Señor nuestro Jesucristo, el Padre de gloria, os dé espíritu de sabiduría y de revelación para su conocimiento;

verses.KJV: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.WEB: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.ASV: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: e que sejam iluminados os olhos do vosso entendimento, para que conheçais qual é a esperança para a qual ele chamou, quais [são] as riquezas da gloriosa herança dele nos santos,
verses.RVR09: Alumbrando los ojos de vuestro entendimiento, para que sepáis cuál sea la esperanza de su vocación, y cuáles las riquezas de la gloria de su herencia en los santos,

verses.KJV: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
verses.WEB: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
verses.ASV: and what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
verses.ALMEIDA: e qual é a superabundante grandeza do seu poder para nós, que cremos, conforme a operação da sua poderosa força,
verses.RVR09: Y cuál aquella supereminente grandeza de su poder para con nosotros los que creemos, por la operación de la potencia de su fortaleza,

verses.KJV: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.WEB: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.ASV: which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly [places],
verses.ALMEIDA: a qual ele operou em Cristo, ressuscitando-o dos mortos; e o colocou à direita dele nos céus,
verses.RVR09: La cual obró en Cristo, resucitándole de los muertos, y colocándole á su diestra en los cielos,

verses.KJV: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.WEB: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
verses.ASV: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.ALMEIDA: acima de todo governo, autoridade, poder, domínio, e de todo nome que se nomeia, não só nesta era, mas também na futura.
verses.RVR09: Sobre todo principado, y potestad, y potencia, y señorío, y todo nombre que se nombra, no sólo en este siglo, mas aun en el venidero:

verses.KJV: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
verses.WEB: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
verses.ASV: and he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele também sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos seus pés, e o constituiu por cabeça sobre todas as coisas para a Igreja,
verses.RVR09: Y sometió todas las cosas debajo de sus pies, y diólo por cabeza sobre todas las cosas á la iglesia,

verses.KJV: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.WEB: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
verses.ASV: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: que é o seu corpo, a plenitude daquele que enche tudo em todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: La cual es su cuerpo, la plenitud de Aquel que hinche todas las cosas en todos.

verses.KJV: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.WEB: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
verses.ASV: And you [did he make alive], when ye were dead through your trespasses and sins,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós estáveis mortos em ofensas e pecados,
verses.RVR09: Y DE ella recibisteis vosotros, que estabais muertos en vuestros delitos y pecados,

verses.KJV: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.WEB: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
verses.ASV: wherein ye once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the powers of the air, of the spirit that now worketh in the sons of disobedience;
verses.ALMEIDA: nos quais antes andastes conforme o proceder deste mundo, conforme o príncipe do poder do ar, do espírito que agora opera nos filhos da desobediência.
verses.RVR09: En que en otro tiempo anduvisteis conforme á la condición de este mundo, conforme al príncipe de la potestad del aire, el espíritu que ahora obra en los hijos de desobediencia:

verses.KJV: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.WEB: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
verses.ASV: among whom we also all once lived in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest:—
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre esses também todos nós antes andávamos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo a vontade da carne e dos pensamentos; e éramos por natureza filhos da ira, como também os outros.
verses.RVR09: Entre los cuales todos nosotros también vivimos en otro tiempo en los deseos de nuestra carne, haciendo la voluntad de la carne y de los pensamientos; y éramos por naturaleza hijos de ira, también como los demás.

verses.KJV: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.WEB: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
verses.ASV: but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus, que é rico em misericórdia, pelo seu muito amor com que nos amou,
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios, que es rico en misericordia, por su mucho amor con que nos amó,

verses.KJV: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
verses.WEB: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
verses.ASV: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace have ye been saved),
verses.ALMEIDA: estando nós ainda mortos em [nossas] ofensas, nos deu vida juntamente com Cristo (pela graça sois salvos),
verses.RVR09: Aun estando nosotros muertos en pecados, nos dió vida juntamente con Cristo; por gracia sois salvos;

verses.KJV: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly [places], in Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: [nos] ressuscitou, juntamente [com ele] , e [nos] fez sentar nos lugares celestiais, em Cristo Jesus;
verses.RVR09: Y juntamente nos resucitó, y asimismo nos hizo sentar en los cielos con Cristo Jesús,

verses.KJV: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
verses.ASV: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: para mostrar nos tempos futuros as abundantes riquezas da sua graça, pela [sua] bondade conosco em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Para mostrar en los siglos venideros las abundantes riquezas de su gracia en su bondad para con nosotros en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.WEB: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
verses.ASV: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, [it is] the gift of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pela graça sois salvos, por meio da fé; e isto não [vem] de vós; [é] dom de Deus;
