verses.RVR09: Porque por gracia sois salvos por la fe; y esto no de vosotros, pues es don de Dios:

verses.KJV: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.WEB: not of works, that no one would boast.
verses.ASV: not of works, that no man should glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: não por obras, para que ninguém tenha orgulho de si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: No por obras, para que nadie se gloríe.

verses.KJV: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.WEB: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verses.ASV: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nós fomos feitos por ele, criados em Cristo Jesus para as boas obras, que Deus preparou para que nelas andássemos.
verses.RVR09: Porque somos hechura suya, criados en Cristo Jesús para buenas obras, las cuales Dios preparó para que anduviésemos en ellas.

verses.KJV: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.WEB: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
verses.ASV: Wherefore remember, that once ye, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called Circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, lembrai-vos de que vós, antes, éreis gentios na carne, e chamados de não-circuncidados pelos que se chamam participantes da circuncisão na carne, feita por mãos humanas;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, acordaos que en otro tiempo vosotros los Gentiles en la carne, que erais llamados incircuncisión por la que se llama circuncisión, hecha con mano en la carne;

verses.KJV: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.WEB: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
verses.ASV: that ye were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: que naquele tempo estáveis sem Cristo, excluídos da comunidade de Israel, e estranhos aos pactos da promessa, não tendo esperança, e sem Deus no mundo.
verses.RVR09: Que en aquel tiempo estabais sin Cristo, alejados de la república de Israel, y extranjeros á los pactos de la promesa, sin esperanza y sin Dios en el mundo.

verses.KJV: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.WEB: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
verses.ASV: But now in Christ Jesus ye that once were far off are made nigh in the blood of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora em Cristo Jesus, vós que antes estáveis longe, chegastes para perto pelo sangue de Cristo,
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora en Cristo Jesús, vosotros que en otro tiempo estabais lejos, habéis sido hechos cercanos por la sangre de Cristo.

verses.KJV: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
verses.WEB: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
verses.ASV: For he is our peace, who made both one, and brake down the middle wall of partition,
verses.ALMEIDA: pois ele é a nossa paz. Dos dois [povos] ele fez um, e derrubou do meio o muro da separação.
verses.RVR09: Porque él es nuestra paz, que de ambos hizo uno, derribando la pared intermedia de separación;

verses.KJV: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
verses.WEB: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
verses.ASV: having abolished in his flesh the enmity, [even] the law of commandments [contained] in ordinances; that he might create in himself of the two one new man, [so] making peace;
verses.ALMEIDA: Na sua carne ele desfez a inimizade da Lei dos mandamentos [que consistia] em ordenanças, para criar em si mesmo os dois em um novo homem, fazendo a paz;
verses.RVR09: Dirimiendo en su carne las enemistades, la ley de los mandamientos en orden á ritos, para edificar en sí mismo los dos en un nuevo hombre, haciendo la paz,

verses.KJV: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.WEB: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
verses.ASV: and might reconcile them both in one body unto God through the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.ALMEIDA: e pela cruz reconciliar com Deus a ambos num só corpo, matando nela a inimizade.
verses.RVR09: Y reconciliar por la cruz con Dios á ambos en un mismo cuerpo, matando en ella las enemistades.

verses.KJV: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.WEB: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
verses.ASV: and he came and preached peace to you that were far off, and peace to them that were nigh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele veio, e proclamou o evangelho da paz a vós que [estáveis] longe, e aos que estavam perto.
verses.RVR09: Y vino, y anunció la paz á vosotros que estabais lejos, y á los que estaban cerca:

verses.KJV: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.WEB: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
verses.ASV: for through him we both have our access in one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por meio dele ambos temos acesso ao Pai por um [mesmo] Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Que por él los unos y los otros tenemos entrada por un mismo Espíritu al Padre.

verses.KJV: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.WEB: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
verses.ASV: So then ye are no more strangers and sojourners, but ye are fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, já não sois estrangeiros, nem forasteiros, mas sim, concidadãos dos santos, e membros da família de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Así que ya no sois extranjeros ni advenedizos, sino juntamente ciudadanos con los santos, y domésticos de Dios;

verses.KJV: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.WEB: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
verses.ASV: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.ALMEIDA: edificados sobre o fundamento dos apóstolos e dos profetas, do qual Jesus Cristo é a pedra principal da esquina.
verses.RVR09: Edificados sobre el fundamento de los apóstoles y profetas, siendo la principal piedra del ángulo Jesucristo mismo;

verses.KJV: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.WEB: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
verses.ASV: in whom each several building, fitly framed together, groweth into a holy temple in the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele o edifício todo, bem ajustado, cresce para [ser] um templo santo no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: En el cual, compaginado todo el edificio, va creciendo para ser un templo santo en el Señor:

verses.KJV: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
verses.WEB: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
verses.ASV: in whom ye also are builded together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele também vós sois juntamente edificados para [serdes] morada de Deus em Espírito.
verses.RVR09: En el cual vosotros también sois juntamente edificados, para morada de Dios en Espíritu.

verses.KJV: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.WEB: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
verses.ASV: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus in behalf of you Gentiles,—
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu, Paulo, [sou] prisioneiro de Cristo Jesus, para o benefício de vós, gentios.
verses.RVR09: POR esta causa yo Pablo, prisionero de Cristo Jesús por vosotros los Gentiles,

verses.KJV: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.WEB: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
verses.ASV: if so be that ye have heard of the dispensation of that grace of God which was given me to you-ward;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se é que já ouvistes da responsabilidade acerca da graça de Deus, que me foi dada para vós;
verses.RVR09: Si es que habéis oído la dispensación de la gracia de Dios que me ha sido dada para con vosotros,

verses.KJV: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.WEB: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
verses.ASV: how that by revelation was made known unto me the mystery, as I wrote before in few words,
verses.ALMEIDA: que por revelação me foi dado a conhecer este mistério (conforme já [vos] escrevi um pouco;
verses.RVR09: A saber, que por revelación me fué declarado el misterio, como antes he escrito en breve;

verses.KJV: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.WEB: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
verses.ASV: whereby, when ye read, ye can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: quando o ledes, podeis entender o meu entendimento deste mistério de Cristo).
verses.RVR09: Leyendo lo cual podéis entender cuál sea mi inteligencia en el misterio de Cristo:

verses.KJV: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.WEB: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
verses.ASV: which in other generations was not made known unto the sons of men, as it hath now been revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esse mistério em outras gerações não foi dado a conhecer aos seres humanos , como agora foi revelado pelo Espírito aos seus santos apóstolos e profetas:
verses.RVR09: El cual misterio en los otros siglos no se dió á conocer á los hijos de los hombres como ahora es revelado á sus santos apóstoles y profetas en el Espíritu:

verses.KJV: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.WEB: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
verses.ASV: [to wit], that the Gentiles are fellow-heirs, and fellow-members of the body, and fellow-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,
verses.ALMEIDA: [isto é, ] que os gentios são conjuntamente herdeiros, [membros] de um mesmo corpo, e participantes da sua promessa em Cristo por meio do evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Que los Gentiles sean juntamente herederos, é incorporados, y consortes de su promesa en Cristo por el evangelio:

verses.KJV: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.WEB: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
verses.ASV: whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fui feito servidor desse [evangelho] conforme o dom da graça de Deus, que me foi dada segundo a operação do seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Del cual yo soy hecho ministro por el don de la gracia de Dios que me ha sido dado según la operación de su potencia.

verses.KJV: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.WEB: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
verses.ASV: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach unto the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: A mim, o menor de todos os santos, foi dada esta graça de anunciar entre os gentios, por meio do Evangelho, as inimagináveis riquezas de Cristo,
verses.RVR09: A mí, que soy menos que el más pequeño de todos los santos, es dada esta gracia de anunciar entre los Gentiles el evangelio de las inescrutables riquezas de Cristo,

verses.KJV: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: and to make all men see what is the dispensation of the mystery which for ages hath been hid in God who created all things;
verses.ALMEIDA: E para esclarecer a todos qual é a comunhão do mistério que desde as eras passadas esteve oculto em Deus, que criou todas as coisas por meio de Jesus Cristo,
verses.RVR09: Y de aclarar á todos cuál sea la dispensación del misterio escondido desde los siglos en Dios, que crió todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.WEB: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
verses.ASV: to the intent that now unto the principalities and the powers in the heavenly [places] might be made known through the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: para que a multiforme sabedoria de Deus seja agora manifestada pela igreja aos domínios e autoridades nos lugares celestes,
verses.RVR09: Para que la multiforme sabiduría de Dios sea ahora notificada por la iglesia á los principados y potestades en los cielos,

verses.KJV: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.WEB: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: conforme o eterno propósito que ele cumpriu em Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor,
verses.RVR09: Conforme á la determinación eterna, que hizo en Cristo Jesús nuestro Señor:

verses.KJV: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.WEB: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
verses.ASV: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: no qual temos coragem e acesso confiante pela fé nele.
verses.RVR09: En el cual tenemos seguridad y entrada con confianza por la fe de él.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.WEB: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I ask that ye may not faint at my tribulations for you, which are your glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, eu [vos] peço que não vos desanimeis em minhas aflições por vós. Elas são a vossa glória.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pido que no desmayéis á causa de mis tribulaciones por vosotros, las cuales son vuestra gloria.

verses.KJV: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.WEB: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa disso me ponho de joelhos diante do Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa doblo mis rodillas al Padre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo,

verses.KJV: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.WEB: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
verses.ASV: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
verses.ALMEIDA: do qual toda a família nos céus e na terra recebe nome.
verses.RVR09: Del cual es nombrada toda la parentela en los cielos y en la tierra,

verses.KJV: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.WEB: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
verses.ASV: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that ye may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Oro] para que, conforme a sua riquíssima glória, ele vos conceda que sejais fortalecidos com poder pelo seu Espírito no interior de cada um,
verses.RVR09: Que os dé, conforme á las riquezas de su gloria, el ser corroborados con potencia en el hombre interior por su Espíritu.

verses.KJV: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.WEB: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.ASV: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.ALMEIDA: para que Cristo habite em vossos corações pela fé. [Oro] para que vós estejais enraizados e firmados no amor,
verses.RVR09: Que habite Cristo por la fe en vuestros corazones; para que, arraigados y fundados en amor,

verses.KJV: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.WEB: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
verses.ASV: may be strong to apprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
verses.ALMEIDA: e assim possais compreender, com todos os santos, qual é a largura, comprimento, profundidade, e altura,
verses.RVR09: Podáis bien comprender con todos los santos cuál sea la anchura y la longura y la profundidad y la altura,

verses.KJV: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verses.WEB: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
verses.ASV: and to know the love of Christ which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled unto all the fulness of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: e conhecer o amor de Cristo, que excede o entendimento, para que sejais cheios de toda a plenitude de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y conocer el amor de Cristo, que excede á todo conocimiento, para que seáis llenos de toda la plenitud de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.WEB: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
verses.ASV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto àquele que é poderoso para fazer tudo muito mais abundantemente do que pedimos ou pensamos, segundo o poder que opera em nós,
verses.RVR09: Y á Aquel que es poderoso para hacer todas las cosas mucho más abundantemente de lo que pedimos ó entendemos, por la potencia que obra en nosotros,

verses.KJV: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.WEB: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: unto him [be] the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus unto all generations for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: a ele seja a glória na Igreja, em Cristo Jesus, por todas as gerações para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: A él sea gloria en la iglesia por Cristo Jesús, por todas edades del siglo de los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
verses.WEB: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
verses.ASV: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beseech you to walk worthily of the calling wherewith ye were called,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, eu, o prisioneiro no Senhor, rogo-vos que andeis como é digno do chamado com que fostes chamados,
verses.RVR09: YO pues, preso en el Señor, os ruego que andéis como es digno de la vocación con que sois llamados;

verses.KJV: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.WEB: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
verses.ASV: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.ALMEIDA: com toda humildade e mansidão; com paciência, tolerando uns aos outros em amor.
verses.RVR09: Con toda humildad y mansedumbre, con paciencia soportando los unos á los otros en amor;

verses.KJV: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.WEB: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.ASV: giving diligence to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procurai guardar a unidade do Espírito pelo vínculo da paz.
verses.RVR09: Solícitos á guardar la unidad del Espíritu en el vínculo de la paz.

verses.KJV: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.WEB: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
verses.ASV: [There is] one body, and one Spirit, even as also ye were called in one hope of your calling;
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um [só] corpo, e um [só] Espírito, como também fostes chamados em uma [só] esperança do vosso chamado.
verses.RVR09: Un cuerpo, y un Espíritu; como sois también llamados á una misma esperanza de vuestra vocación:

verses.KJV: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.WEB: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.ASV: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.ALMEIDA: Um [só] Senhor, uma [só] fé, um [só] batismo;
verses.RVR09: Un Señor, una fe, un bautismo,

verses.KJV: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.WEB: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
verses.ASV: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: um [só] Deus, e Pai de todos, que é acima de todos, por meio de todos, e em todos.
verses.RVR09: Un Dios y Padre de todos, el cual es sobre todas las cosas, y por todas las cosas, y en todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.WEB: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.ASV: But unto each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a graça foi dada a cada um de nós conforme a medida do dom de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Empero á cada uno de nosotros es dada la gracia conforme á la medida del don de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.WEB: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, And gave gifts unto men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso diz: Quando ele subiu ao alto, levou cativo o cativeiro, e deu dons às pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual dice: Subiendo á lo alto, llevó cautiva la cautividad, y dió dones á los hombres.

verses.KJV: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.WEB: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.ASV: (Now this, He ascended, what is it but that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: (O que significa este “ele subiu”, senão que ele também antes tinha descido às partes mais baixas da terra?)
verses.RVR09: (Y que subió, ¿qué es, sino que también había descendido primero á las partes más bajas de la tierra?

verses.KJV: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.WEB: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
verses.ASV: He that descended is the same also that ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que desceu é também o mesmo que subiu muito acima de todos os céus, para preencher todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: El que descendió, él mismo es el que también subió sobre todos los cielos para cumplir todas las cosas.)

verses.KJV: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.WEB: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
verses.ASV: And he gave some [to be] apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele mesmo deu uns como apóstolos, outros como profetas, outros como evangelistas, e outros como pastores e instrutores.
verses.RVR09: Y él mismo dió unos, ciertamente apóstoles; y otros, profetas; y otros, evangelistas; y otros, pastores y doctores;

verses.KJV: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
verses.WEB: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
verses.ASV: for the perfecting of the saints, unto the work of ministering, unto the building up of the body of Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: para o aperfeiçoamento dos santos, para a obra do serviço, para a edificação do corpo de Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Para perfección de los santos, para la obra del ministerio, para edificación del cuerpo de Cristo;

verses.KJV: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.WEB: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
verses.ASV: till we all attain unto the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a fullgrown man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: até que todos cheguemos à unidade da fé e do conhecimento do Filho de Deus, à maturidade, à medida da estatura da plenitude de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que todos lleguemos á la unidad de la fe y del conocimiento del Hijo de Dios, á un varón perfecto, á la medida de la edad de la plenitud de Cristo:

verses.KJV: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.WEB: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
verses.ASV: that we may be no longer children, tossed to and fro and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
verses.ALMEIDA: O fim disso é que não mais sejamos crianças inconstantes, levadas de um lado para outro por todo vento de doutrina, pelo engano dos pessoas que, para enganar, usam de fraudes com astúcia.
verses.RVR09: Que ya no seamos niños fluctuantes, y llevados por doquiera de todo viento de doctrina, por estratagema de hombres que, para engañar, emplean con astucia los artificios del error:

verses.KJV: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
verses.WEB: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
verses.ASV: but speaking truth in love, may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, [even] Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo contrário, sigamos a verdade em amor, e cresçamos em tudo naquele que é a cabeça: Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Antes siguiendo la verdad en amor, crezcamos en todas cosas en aquel que es la cabeza, á saber, Cristo;

verses.KJV: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.WEB: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
verses.ASV: from whom all the body fitly framed and knit together through that which every joint supplieth, according to the working in [due] measure of each several part, maketh the increase of the body unto the building up of itself in love.
verses.ALMEIDA: É dele que todo o corpo, bem ajustado e unido por todos os ligamentos, conforme a operação de cada parte na medida devida, proporciona o crescimento do corpo, para a sua própria edificação em amor.
verses.RVR09: Del cual, todo el cuerpo compuesto y bien ligado entre sí por todas las junturas de su alimento, que recibe según la operación, cada miembro conforme á su medida toma aumento de cuerpo edificándose en amor.

verses.KJV: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.WEB: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
verses.ASV: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye no longer walk as the Gentiles also walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto digo isso, e dou testemunho no Senhor, que não andeis mais como os outros gentios andam, na futilidade das suas mentes.
verses.RVR09: Esto pues digo, y requiero en el Señor, que no andéis más como los otros Gentiles, que andan en la vanidad de su sentido,

verses.KJV: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.WEB: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
verses.ASV: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esses têm o entendimento nas trevas, e estão separados da vida de Deus pela ignorância que há neles, pela dureza do seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo el entendimiento entenebrecido, ajenos de la vida de Dios por la ignorancia que en ellos hay, por la dureza de su corazón:

verses.KJV: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.WEB: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.ASV: who being past feeling gave themselves up to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como se tornaram insensíveis, eles se entregaram à sensualidade, para cometerem com avidez toda impureza.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales después que perdieron el sentido de la conciencia, se entregaron á la desvergüenza para cometer con avidez toda suerte de impureza.

verses.KJV: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.WEB: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
verses.ASV: But ye did not so learn Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não foi assim que vós aprendestes de Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros no habéis aprendido así á Cristo:

verses.KJV: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.WEB: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
verses.ASV: if so be that ye heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: se é que o ouvistes, e fostes ensinados nele, como a verdade está em Jesus;
verses.RVR09: Si empero lo habéis oído, y habéis sido por él enseñados, como la verdad está en Jesús,

verses.KJV: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.WEB: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
verses.ASV: that ye put away, as concerning your former manner of life, the old man, that waxeth corrupt after the lusts of deceit;
verses.ALMEIDA: quanto ao comportamento passado, que deveis abandonar o velho ser humano, que se corrompe pelos maus desejos de engano;
verses.RVR09: A que dejéis, cuanto á la pasada manera de vivir, el viejo hombre que está viciado conforme á los deseos de error;

verses.KJV: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.WEB: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
verses.ASV: and that ye be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
verses.ALMEIDA: que [deveis] vos renovar no espírito da vossa mente;
verses.RVR09: Y á renovaros en el espíritu de vuestra mente,

verses.KJV: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.WEB: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verses.ASV: and put on the new man, that after God hath been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: e que [deveis] vos revestir do novo ser humano, que é criado conforme Deus na verdadeira justiça e santidade.
verses.RVR09: Y vestir el nuevo hombre que es criado conforme á Dios en justicia y en santidad de verdad.

verses.KJV: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.WEB: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, putting away falsehood, speak ye truth each one with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, abandonai a mentira, e falai a verdade cada um ao seu próximo; pois somos membros uns dos outros.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, dejada la mentira, hablad verdad cada uno con su prójimo; porque somos miembros los unos de los otros.

verses.KJV: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.WEB: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
verses.ASV: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando irardes, não pequeis; o sol não se ponha sobre a vossa ira;
verses.RVR09: Airaos, y no pequéis; no se ponga el sol sobre vuestro enojo;

verses.KJV: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.WEB: and don’t give place to the devil.
verses.ASV: neither give place to the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem deis lugar ao diabo.
verses.RVR09: Ni deis lugar al diablo.

verses.KJV: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.WEB: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
verses.ASV: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have whereof to give to him that hath need.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que furtava, não furte mais; em vez disso, trabalhe, operando com as mãos o bem, para que tenha o que repartir com o que tiver necessidade.
verses.RVR09: El que hurtaba, no hurte más; antes trabaje, obrando con sus manos lo que es bueno, para que tenga de qué dar al que padeciere necesidad.

verses.KJV: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.WEB: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.ASV: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for edifying as the need may be, that it may give grace to them that hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não saia de vossa boca palavra imoral; mas sim a boa para a edificação conforme a necessidade; para que comunique graça aos que a ouvem.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna palabra torpe salga de vuestra boca, sino la que sea buena para edificación, para que dé gracia á los oyentes.

verses.KJV: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.WEB: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.ASV: And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, in whom ye were sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não entristeçais o Espírito Santo de Deus, no qual fostes selados para o dia da libertação.
verses.RVR09: Y no contristéis al Espíritu Santo de Dios, con el cual estáis sellados para el día de la redención.

verses.KJV: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.WEB: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
verses.ASV: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and railing, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda amargura, raiva, ira, gritaria, e maledicência sejam tiradas do meio de vós, assim como toda malícia.
verses.RVR09: Toda amargura, y enojo, é ira, y voces, y maledicencia sea quitada de vosotros, y toda malicia:

verses.KJV: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
verses.WEB: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
verses.ASV: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, even as God also in Christ forgave you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, sede benignos uns com os outros, misericordiosos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como também Deus vos perdoou em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Antes sed los unos con los otros benignos, misericordiosos, perdonándoos los unos á los otros, como también Dios os perdonó en Cristo.

verses.KJV: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.WEB: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
verses.ASV: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sede imitadores de Deus, como filhos amados;
verses.RVR09: SED, pues, imitadores de Dios como hijos amados:

verses.KJV: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.WEB: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
verses.ASV: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.
verses.ALMEIDA: e andai em amor, como também Cristo nos amou, e se entregou por nós como oferta e sacrifício de cheiro suave a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y andad en amor, como también Cristo nos amó, y se entregó á sí mismo por nosotros, ofrenda y sacrificio á Dios en olor suave.

verses.KJV: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.WEB: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
verses.ASV: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o pecado sexual, e toda impureza ou cobiça, nem mesmo se nomeie entre vós, como convém a santos;
verses.RVR09: Pero fornicación y toda inmundicia, ó avaricia, ni aun se nombre entre vosotros, como conviene á santos;

verses.KJV: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.WEB: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
verses.ASV: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, or jesting, which are not befitting: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem imoralidades, nem palavras tolas, nem escárnios, que não convêm; em vez disso, atos de gratidão.
verses.RVR09: Ni palabras torpes, ni necedades, ni truhanerías, que no convienen; sino antes bien acciones de gracias.

verses.KJV: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.WEB: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.ASV: For this ye know of a surety, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sabeis disto, que nenhum pecador no sexo, ou impuro, ou ganancioso, que é idólatra, tem herança no reino de Cristo e de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabéis esto, que ningún fornicario, ó inmundo, ó avaro, que es servidor de ídolos, tiene herencia en el reino de Cristo y de Dios.

verses.KJV: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
verses.WEB: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.ASV: Let no man deceive you with empty words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém vos engane com palavras vazias; pois por essas coisas a ira de Deus vem sobre os filhos da desobediência.
verses.RVR09: Nadie os engañe con palabras vanas; porque por estas cosas viene la ira de Dios sobre los hijos de desobediencia.

verses.KJV: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
verses.ASV: Be not ye therefore partakers with them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não sejais parceiros deles.
verses.RVR09: No seáis pues aparceros con ellos;

verses.KJV: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.WEB: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
verses.ASV: for ye were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord: walk as children of light
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois antes vós éreis trevas, mas agora [sois] luz no Senhor; andai como filhos da luz
verses.RVR09: Porque en otro tiempo erais tinieblas; mas ahora sois luz en el Señor: andad como hijos de luz,

verses.KJV: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.WEB: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
verses.ASV: (for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth),
verses.ALMEIDA: (porque o fruto do Espírito[consiste] em toda bondade, justiça, e verdade),
verses.RVR09: (Porque el fruto del Espíritu es en toda bondad, y justicia, y verdad;)

verses.KJV: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
verses.ASV: proving what is well-pleasing unto the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: buscando descobrir o que agrada ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Aprobando lo que es agradable al Señor.

verses.KJV: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verses.WEB: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
verses.ASV: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não participeis das obras infrutíferas das trevas, pelo contrário, reprovai-as.
verses.RVR09: Y no comuniquéis con las obras infructuosas de las tinieblas; sino antes bien redargüidlas.

verses.KJV: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.WEB: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
verses.ASV: for the things which are done by them in secret it is a shame even to speak of.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois é vergonhoso até dizer o que eles fazem em segredo.
verses.RVR09: Porque torpe cosa es aun hablar de lo que ellos hacen en oculto.

verses.KJV: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
verses.WEB: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
verses.ASV: But all things when they are reproved are made manifest by the light: for everything that is made manifest is light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todas essas coisas, quando são reprovadas, tornam-se visíveis pela luz, porque tudo o que se se torna visível é luz.
verses.RVR09: Mas todas las cosas cuando son redargüidas, son manifestadas por la luz; porque lo que manifiesta todo, la luz es.

verses.KJV: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
verses.WEB: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore [he] saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall shine upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso se diz: Desperta tu, que dormes, e levanta-te dos mortos, e Cristo te iluminará.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual dice: Despiértate, tú que duermes, y levántate de los muertos, y te alumbrará Cristo.

verses.KJV: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.WEB: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
verses.ASV: Look therefore carefully how ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto vede cuidadosamente como vos conduzis, não como tolos, mas sim como sábios;
verses.RVR09: Mirad, pues, cómo andéis avisadamente; no como necios, mas como sabios;

verses.KJV: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.WEB: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.ASV: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: aproveitai o tempo, porque os dias são maus.
verses.RVR09: Redimiendo el tiempo, porque los días son malos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
verses.WEB: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.ASV: Wherefore be ye not foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, não sejais imprudentes, mas entendei qual é a vontade do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no seáis imprudentes, sino entendidos de cuál sea la voluntad del Señor.

verses.KJV: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.WEB: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.ASV: And be not drunken with wine, wherein is riot, but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: E não fiqueis bêbados com vinho, em que há devassidão, mas enchei-vos do Espírito;
verses.RVR09: Y no os embriaguéis de vino, en lo cual hay disolución; mas sed llenos de Espíritu;

verses.KJV: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.WEB: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.ASV: speaking one to another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your heart to the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: falando entre vós com salmos, hinos e cânticos espirituais; cantando e louvando ao Senhor no vosso coração;
verses.RVR09: Hablando entre vosotros con salmos, y con himnos, y canciones espirituales, cantando y alabando al Señor en vuestros corazones;

verses.KJV: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.WEB: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
verses.ASV: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
verses.ALMEIDA: agradecendo sempre por tudo a Deus, o Pai, no nome do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Dando gracias siempre de todo al Dios y Padre en el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.WEB: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
verses.ASV: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: sujeitando-vos uns aos outros no temor a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sujetados los unos á los otros en el temor de Dios.

verses.KJV: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.ASV: Wives, [be in subjection] unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mulheres, sujeitai-vos aos vossos próprios maridos, assim como ao Senhor;
verses.RVR09: Las casadas estén sujetas á sus propios maridos, como al Señor.

verses.KJV: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.WEB: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
verses.ASV: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, [being] himself the saviour of the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o marido é o cabeça da mulher, como também Cristo é o cabeça da Igreja, e ele é o salvador do corpo.
verses.RVR09: Porque el marido es cabeza de la mujer, así como Cristo es cabeza de la iglesia; y él es el que da la salud al cuerpo.

verses.KJV: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.WEB: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
verses.ASV: But as the church is subject to Christ, so [let] the wives also [be] to their husbands in everything.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, assim como a Igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres [estejam] em tudo sujeitas aos seus próprios maridos.
verses.RVR09: Así que, como la iglesia está sujeta á Cristo, así también las casadas lo estén á sus maridos en todo.

verses.KJV: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.WEB: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
verses.ASV: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself up for it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Maridos, amai as vossas próprias esposas, assim como também Cristo amou a Igreja, e se entregou por ela;
verses.RVR09: Maridos, amad á vuestras mujeres, así como Cristo amó á la iglesia, y se entregó á sí mismo por ella,

verses.KJV: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.WEB: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.ASV: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de a santificar, havendo [a] purificado com a lavagem com água, pela palavra,
verses.RVR09: Para santificarla limpiándola en el lavacro del agua por la palabra,

verses.KJV: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.WEB: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
verses.ASV: that he might present the church to himself a glorious [church], not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de apresentar a si mesmo uma igreja gloriosa, sem mancha, nem ruga, nem algo semelhante; mas sim, santa e irrepreensível.
verses.RVR09: Para presentársela gloriosa para sí, una iglesia que no tuviese mancha ni arruga, ni cosa semejante; sino que fuese santa y sin mancha.

verses.KJV: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.WEB: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
verses.ASV: Even so ought husbands also to love their own wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his own wife loveth himself:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os maridos devem amar as suas próprias esposas como os seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua esposa, ama a si mesmo;
verses.RVR09: Así también los maridos deben amar á sus mujeres como á sus mismos cuerpos. El que ama á su mujer, á sí mismo se ama.

verses.KJV: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.WEB: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
verses.ASV: for no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Christ also the church;
verses.ALMEIDA: pois ninguém jamais odiou a sua própria carne; mas a alimenta e sustenta, assim como também o Senhor à Igreja.
verses.RVR09: Porque ninguno aborreció jamás á su propia carne, antes la sustenta y regala, como también Cristo á la iglesia;

verses.KJV: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.WEB: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
verses.ASV: because we are members of his body.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois somos membros de seu corpo, da sua carne, e dos seus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Porque somos miembros de su cuerpo, de su carne y de sus huesos.

verses.KJV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.WEB: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
verses.ASV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o homem deixará oseu pai e [a sua] mãe, e se ajuntará com a sua mulher; e os dois serão uma [só] carne.
verses.RVR09: Por esto dejará el hombre á su padre y á su madre, y se allegará á su mujer, y serán dos en una carne.

verses.KJV: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.WEB: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
verses.ASV: This mystery is great: but I speak in regard of Christ and of the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esse é um grande mistério, mas estou dizendo quanto a Cristo e à Igreja.
verses.RVR09: Este misterio grande es: mas yo digo esto con respecto á Cristo y á la iglesia.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless do ye also severally love each one his own wife even as himself; and [let] the wife [see] that she fear her husband.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também vós, cada um individualmente, ame a sua própria esposa como a si mesmo, e a mulher respeite o marido.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno empero de vosotros de por sí, ame también á su mujer como á sí mismo; y la mujer reverencie á su marido.

verses.KJV: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.WEB: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.ASV: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhos, sede obedientes aos vossos pais no Senhor, porque isso é justo.
verses.RVR09: HIJOS, obedeced en el Señor á vuestros padres; porque esto es justo.

verses.KJV: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
verses.WEB: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
verses.ASV: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),
verses.ALMEIDA: Honra teu pai, e [tua] mãe (que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa);
verses.RVR09: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre, que es el primer mandamiento con promesa,

verses.KJV: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.WEB: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
verses.ASV: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Para que te vaya bien, y seas de larga vida sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.WEB: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.ASV: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pais, não provoqueis à ira os vossos filhos, mas criai-os na disciplina e correção do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros, padres, no provoquéis á ira á vuestros hijos; sino criadlos en disciplina y amonestación del Señor.

verses.KJV: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.WEB: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
verses.ASV: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Servos, obedecei aos [vossos] senhores segundo a carne, com temor e tremor, em sinceridade do vosso coração, assim como a Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Siervos, obedeced á vuestros amos según la carne con temor y temblor, con sencillez de vuestro corazón, como á Cristo;

verses.KJV: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.WEB: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
verses.ASV: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: não servindo somente quando vistos, como para agradar pessoas; mas sim, como servos de Cristo, fazendo de coração a vontade de Deus;
verses.RVR09: No sirviendo al ojo, como los que agradan á los hombres; sino como siervos de Cristo, haciendo de ánimo la voluntad de Dios;

verses.KJV: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.WEB: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
verses.ASV: with good will doing service, as unto the Lord, and not unto men:
verses.ALMEIDA: servindo de boa vontade como ao Senhor, e não aos pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Sirviendo con buena voluntad, como al Señor, y no á los hombres;

verses.KJV: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
verses.WEB: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
verses.ASV: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether [he be] bond or free.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sabeis que cada um receberá do Senhor todo o bem que fizer, seja servo, seja livre.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que el bien que cada uno hiciere, esto recibirá del Señor, sea siervo ó sea libre.

verses.KJV: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.WEB: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
verses.ASV: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhores, fazei o mesmo a eles, abandonando as ameaças, pois sabeis também que o Senhor vosso e deles está nos céus, e [que] com ele não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros, amos, haced á ellos lo mismo, dejando las amenazas: sabiendo que el Señor de ellos y vuestro está en los cielos, y que no hay acepción de personas con él.

verses.KJV: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.WEB: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
verses.ASV: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por fim, meus irmãos, fortalecei-vos no Senhor e na força do seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Por lo demás, hermanos míos, confortaos en el Señor, y en la potencia de su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.WEB: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.ASV: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revesti-vos de toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais estar firmes contra as ciladas do diabo.
verses.RVR09: Vestíos de toda la armadura de Dios, para que podáis estar firmes contra las asechanzas del diablo.

verses.KJV: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verses.WEB: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
verses.ASV: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual [hosts] of wickedness in the heavenly [places].
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois temos de lutar não contra carne e sangue, mas sim contra os domínios e poderes, contra os senhores das trevas deste mundo, contra os males espirituais nos lugares celestes.
verses.RVR09: Porque no tenemos lucha contra sangre y carne; sino contra principados, contra potestades, contra señores del mundo, gobernadores de estas tinieblas, contra malicias espirituales en los aires.

verses.KJV: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.WEB: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.ASV: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto pegai toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais resistir no dia mal, e depois que fizerdes tudo, continuar firmes.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, tomad toda la armadura de Dios, para que podáis resistir en el día malo, y estar firmes, habiendo acabado todo.

verses.KJV: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.WEB: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.ASV: Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estai, pois, firmes, com a vossa cintura envolvida com o cinturão da verdade, e vestidos com a couraça da justiça;
verses.RVR09: Estad pues firmes, ceñidos vuestros lomos de verdad, y vestidos de la cota de justicia,

verses.KJV: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.WEB: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
verses.ASV: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.ALMEIDA: e calçados os pés com a prontidão do evangelho da paz.
verses.RVR09: Y calzados los pies con el apresto del evangelio de paz;

verses.KJV: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.WEB: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
verses.ASV: withal taking up the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil [one].
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobretudo pegai o escudo da fé, com o qual podereis apagar todas as flechas inflamadas do maligno.
verses.RVR09: Sobre todo, tomando el escudo de la fe, con que podáis apagar todos los dardos de fuego del maligno.

verses.KJV: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.WEB: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
verses.ASV: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pegai também o capacete da salvação, e a espada do Espírito, que é a palavra de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y tomad el yelmo de salud, y la espada del Espíritu; que es la palabra de Dios;

verses.KJV: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.WEB: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
verses.ASV: with all prayer and supplication praying at all seasons in the Spirit, and watching thereunto in all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: orando em todo tempo com toda oração e súplica no Espírito, e vigiando nisso com toda perseverança e súplica por todos os santos,
verses.RVR09: Orando en todo tiempo con toda deprecación y súplica en el Espíritu, y velando en ello con toda instancia y suplicación por todos los santos,

verses.KJV: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.WEB: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
verses.ASV: and on my behalf, that utterance may be given unto me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,
verses.ALMEIDA: e por mim; a fim de que, quando eu abrir a boca, me seja dada palavra com ousadia, para tornar conhecido o mistério do evangelho,
verses.RVR09: Y por mí, para que me sea dada palabra en el abrir de mi boca con confianza, para hacer notorio el misterio del evangelio,

verses.KJV: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.WEB: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.ASV: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: pelo qual sou embaixador acorrentado; para que dele eu possa falar com ousadia, como devo falar.
verses.RVR09: Por el cual soy embajador en cadenas; que resueltamente hable de él, como debo hablar.

verses.KJV: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.WEB: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
verses.ASV: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que também vós possais saber o que acontece comigo, [e] o que eu faço, Tíquico, o irmão amado, e fiel servidor do Senhor vos informará de tudo.
verses.RVR09: Mas para que también vosotros sepáis mis negocios, y cómo lo paso, todo os lo hará saber Tichîco, hermano amado y fiel ministro en el Señor:

verses.KJV: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
verses.WEB: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
verses.ASV: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu o enviei até vós para isso, para que saibais o que acontece conosco, e ele conforte os vossos corações.
verses.RVR09: Al cual os he enviado para esto mismo, para que entendáis lo tocante á nosotros, y que consuele vuestros corazones.

verses.KJV: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Paz [seja] com os irmãos, e amor com fé, da parte de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Paz sea á los hermanos y amor con fe, de Dios Padre y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
verses.WEB: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
verses.ASV: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ with [a love] incorruptible.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça [seja] com todos os que amam ao nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo com amor que não falha. Amém![Escrita de Roma para os efésios, e enviada por Tíquico]
verses.RVR09: Gracia sea con todos los que aman á nuestro Señor Jesucristo en sinceridad. Amén. Escrita de Roma á los Efesios por Tichîco.

verses.KJV: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.WEB: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
verses.ASV: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus that are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo e Timóteo, servos de Jesus Cristo, a todos os santos em Cristo Jesus, que estão em Filipos, com os supervisores e servidores.
verses.RVR09: PABLO y Timoteo, siervos de Jesucristo, á todos los santos en Cristo Jesús que están en Filipos, con los obispos y diáconos:

verses.KJV: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haja convosco a graça e paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Gracia sea á vosotros, y paz de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.WEB: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
verses.ASV: I thank my God upon all my remembrance of you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeço ao meu Deus todas as vezes que me lembro de vós,
verses.RVR09: Doy gracias á mi Dios en toda memoria de vosotros,

verses.KJV: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.WEB: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
verses.ASV: always in every supplication of mine on behalf of you all making my supplication with joy,
verses.ALMEIDA: sempre em todas as minhas orações, com alegria, fazendo oração por todos vós,
verses.RVR09: Siempre en todas mis oraciones haciendo oración por todos vosotros con gozo,

verses.KJV: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.WEB: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
verses.ASV: for your fellowship in furtherance of the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.ALMEIDA: por causa da vossa cooperação com o Evangelho desde o primeiro dia até agora.
verses.RVR09: Por vuestra comunión en el evangelio, desde el primer día hasta ahora:

verses.KJV: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disto tenho certeza: aquele que começou a boa obra em vós irá completá-la até o dia de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Estando confiado de esto, que el que comenzó en vosotros la buena obra, la perfeccionará hasta el día de Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.WEB: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.ASV: even as it is right for me to be thus minded on behalf of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as, both in my bonds and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para mim é justo eu sentir isso de todos vós, pois vos tenho no coração, porque todos vós sois participantes comigo da graça, tanto nas minhas prisões, como na defesa e confirmação do Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Como me es justo sentir esto de todos vosotros, por cuanto os tengo en el corazón; y en mis prisiones, y en la defensa y confirmación del evangelio, sois todos vosotros compañeros de mi gracia.

verses.KJV: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: For God is my witness, how I long after you all in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus é minha testemunha de como sinto saudades de todos vós, com o afeto de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios me es testigo de cómo os amo á todos vosotros en las entrañas de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
verses.WEB: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
verses.ASV: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto oro: que o vosso amor seja mais e mais abundante em conhecimento e em toda percepção,
verses.RVR09: Y esto ruego, que vuestro amor abunde aun más y más en ciencia y en todo conocimiento,

verses.KJV: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.
verses.WEB: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
verses.ASV: so that ye may approve the things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and void of offence unto the day of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: para que aproveis as melhores coisas, a fim de que sejais sinceros, sem ofensa, até o dia de Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Para que discernáis lo mejor; que seáis sinceros y sin ofensa para el día de Cristo;

verses.KJV: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.WEB: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.ASV: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: cheios dos frutos da justiça, que, por meio de Jesus Cristo, são para glória e louvor a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Llenos de frutos de justicia, que son por Jesucristo, á gloria y loor de Dios.

verses.KJV: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.WEB: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
verses.ASV: Now I would have you know, brethren, that the things [which happened] unto me have fallen out rather unto the progress of the gospel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quero, irmãos, que saibais que as coisas me aconteceram foram para o avanço do Evangelho,
verses.RVR09: Y quiero, hermanos, que sepáis que las cosas que me han sucedido, han redundado más en provecho del evangelio;

verses.KJV: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
verses.WEB: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
verses.ASV: so that my bonds became manifest in Christ throughout the whole prætorian guard, and to all the rest;
verses.ALMEIDA: de maneira que se tornou evidente a toda a guarda pretoriana, e a todos os demais, que as minhas prisões são em Cristo;
verses.RVR09: De manera que mis prisiones han sido célebres en Cristo en todo el pretorio, y á todos los demás;

verses.KJV: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.WEB: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
verses.ASV: and that most of the brethren in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
