verses.ALMEIDA: e que a maioria dos irmãos no Senhor, depois de ganharem confiança com as minhas prisões, ousam falar a Palavra muito mais, sem medo.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos de los hermanos en el Señor, tomando ánimo con mis prisiones, se atreven mucho más á hablar la palabra sin temor.

verses.KJV: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.WEB: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
verses.ASV: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.ALMEIDA: É verdade que também alguns pregam a Cristo por inveja e rivalidade, porém outros, também, de boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos, á la verdad, predican á Cristo por envidia y porfía; mas algunos también por buena voluntad.

verses.KJV: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.WEB: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
verses.ASV: the one [do it] of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Uns em verdade anunciam a Cristo por rivalidade egoísta, não sinceramente, supondo que irão acrescentar aflição às minhas prisões.
verses.RVR09: Los unos anuncian á Cristo por contención, no sinceramente, pensando añadir aflicción á mis prisiones;

verses.KJV: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.WEB: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
verses.ASV: but the other proclaim Christ of faction, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas outros [anunciam] por amor, sabendo que fui posto para a defesa do Evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Pero los otros por amor, sabiendo que soy puesto por la defensa del evangelio.

verses.KJV: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.WEB: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
verses.ASV: What then? only that in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and therein I rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que, pois? Afinal de qualquer maneira, ou com fingimento, ou em verdade, Cristo é anunciado; e nisto me alegro, e continuarei a me alegrar;
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pues? Que no obstante, en todas maneras, ó por pretexto ó por verdad, es anunciado Cristo; y en esto me huelgo, y aun me holgaré.

verses.KJV: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.WEB: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: For I know that this shall turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.ALMEIDA: pois sei que isso me resultará em livramento pela vossa oração e pelo socorro do Espírito de Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Porque sé que esto se me tornará á salud, por vuestra oración, y por la suministración del Espíritu de Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
verses.WEB: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.ASV: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing shall I be put to shame, but [that] with all boldness, as always, [so] now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
verses.ALMEIDA: conforme a minha intensa expectativa e esperança, de que em nada me envergonharei. Ao contrário, com toda a confiança, como sempre, assim também agora Cristo será engrandecido no meu corpo, seja pela vida, seja pela morte.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á mi mira y esperanza, que en nada seré confundido; antes bien con toda confianza, como siempre, ahora también será engrandecido Cristo en mi cuerpo, ó por vida, ó por muerte.

verses.KJV: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.WEB: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.ASV: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, para mim, o viver é Cristo, e o morrer é lucro.
verses.RVR09: Porque para mí el vivir es Cristo, y el morir es ganancia.

verses.KJV: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.WEB: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
verses.ASV: But if to live in the flesh,—[if] this shall bring fruit from my work, then what I shall choose I know not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se este viver na carne for o fruto do meu trabalho, então não sei o que prefiro,
verses.RVR09: Mas si el vivir en la carne, esto me será para fruto de la obra, no sé entonces qué escoger;

verses.KJV: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.WEB: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
verses.ASV: But I am in a strait betwixt the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ; for it is very far better:
verses.ALMEIDA: pois estou pressionado por ambos [os lados] : tenho desejo de ser desligado, e estar com Cristo, o que é muito melhor;
verses.RVR09: Porque de ambas cosas estoy puesto en estrecho, teniendo deseo de ser desatado, y estar con Cristo, lo cual es mucho mejor:

verses.KJV: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.WEB: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
verses.ASV: yet to abide in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: entretanto, ficar na carne é mais necessário por causa de vós.
verses.RVR09: Empero quedar en la carne es más necesario por causa de vosotros.

verses.KJV: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.WEB: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.ASV: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide, yea, and abide with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nisto confio e sei, que ficarei, e continuarei com todos vós, para que avanceis, e vos alegreis na fé;
verses.RVR09: Y confiado en esto, sé que quedaré, que aun permaneceré con todos vosotros, para provecho vuestro y gozo de la fe;

verses.KJV: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.WEB: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
verses.ASV: that your glorying may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que a vossa alegria em Cristo Jesus seja abundante, por causa de mim, através da minha presença, de volta, convosco.
verses.RVR09: Para que crezca vuestra gloria de mí en Cristo Jesús por mi venida otra vez á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.WEB: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
verses.ASV: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ: that, whether I come and see you or be absent, I may hear of your state, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the gospel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tão somente procedei de maneira digna do Evangelho de Cristo, para que, seja quando eu venha e vos veja, seja ausente, ouça a vosso respeito de que estais num mesmo espírito, com um mesmo ânimo, combatendo juntos pela fé do Evangelho;
verses.RVR09: Solamente que converséis como es digno del evangelio de Cristo; para que, ó sea que vaya á veros, ó que esté ausente, oiga de vosotros que estáis firmes en un mismo espíritu, unánimes combatiendo juntamente por la fe del evangelio,

verses.KJV: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.WEB: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
verses.ASV: and in nothing affrighted by the adversaries: which is for them an evident token of perdition, but of your salvation, and that from God;
verses.ALMEIDA: e que em nada vos amedronteis pelos adversários, o que para eles é, de fato, indício de perdição, mas para vós de salvação, e isso vem de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y en nada intimidados de los que se oponen: que á ellos ciertamente es indicio de perdición, mas á vosotros de salud; y esto de Dios;

verses.KJV: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.WEB: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
verses.ASV: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vos foi dado gratuitamente, quanto a Cristo, não somente o crer nele, mas também o sofrer por ele,
verses.RVR09: Porque á vosotros es concedido por Cristo, no sólo que creáis en él, sino también que padezcáis por él,

verses.KJV: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.WEB: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
verses.ASV: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: de maneira que tendes o mesmo combate, que vistes em mim, e agora de mim ouvis.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo el mismo conflicto que habéis visto en mí, y ahora oís estar en mí.

verses.KJV: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.WEB: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
verses.ASV: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassions,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se há alguma consolação em Cristo, se há algum conforto de amor, se há alguma comunhão do Espírito, se há afetos e compaixões,
verses.RVR09: POR tanto, si hay alguna consolación en Cristo; si algún refrigerio de amor; si alguna comunión del Espíritu; si algunas entrañas y misericordias,

verses.KJV: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.WEB: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
verses.ASV: make full my joy, that ye be of the same mind, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
verses.ALMEIDA: completai a minha alegria: que penseis da mesma maneira, tenhais o mesmo amor, sejais unidos de ânimo, tendo um mesmo modo de pensar.
verses.RVR09: Cumplid mi gozo; que sintáis lo mismo, teniendo el mismo amor, unánimes, sintiendo una misma cosa.

verses.KJV: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.WEB: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
verses.ASV: [doing] nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nada [façais] por rivalidade egoísta ou por vanglória; ao contrário, por humildade cada um considere o outro superior a si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Nada hagáis por contienda ó por vanagloria; antes bien en humildad, estimándoos inferiores los unos á los otros:

verses.KJV: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.WEB: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.ASV: not looking each of you to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um não cuide [somente] do que é seu; mas cada um cuide também do que é dos outros.
verses.RVR09: No mirando cada uno á lo suyo propio, sino cada cual también á lo de los otros.

verses.KJV: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: Have this mind in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto seja, para que esteja em vós este modo de pensar, que também esteve em Cristo Jesus:
verses.RVR09: Haya, pues, en vosotros este sentir que hubo también en Cristo Jesús:

verses.KJV: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.WEB: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.ASV: who, existing in the form of God, counted not the being on an equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.ALMEIDA: mesmo ele sendo em forma de Deus, não considerou a igualdade a Deus como algo para se apegar;
verses.RVR09: El cual, siendo en forma de Dios, no tuvo por usurpación ser igual á Dios:

verses.KJV: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.WEB: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
verses.ASV: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo contrário, ele esvaziou a si mesmo, tomando a forma de servo, e se tornou semelhante aos homens;
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo, se anonadó á sí mismo, tomando forma de siervo, hecho semejante á los hombres;

verses.KJV: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.WEB: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
verses.ASV: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, becoming obedient [even] unto death, yea, the death of the cross.
verses.ALMEIDA: e, quando se encontrava em forma humana, ele humilhou a si mesmo, sendo obediente até a morte, e morte de cruz.
verses.RVR09: Y hallado en la condición como hombre, se humilló á sí mismo, hecho obediente hasta la muerte, y muerte de cruz.

verses.KJV: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.WEB: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
verses.ASV: Wherefore also God highly exalted him, and gave unto him the name which is above every name;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Deus também o exaltou supremamente, e lhe deu um nome que é acima de todo nome;
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual Dios también le ensalzó á lo sumo, y dióle un nombre que es sobre todo nombre;

verses.KJV: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
verses.WEB: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
verses.ASV: that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of [things] in heaven and [things] on earth and [things] under the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que no nome de Jesus se dobre todo joelho dos que estão nos céus, na terra, e debaixo da terra,
verses.RVR09: Para que en el nombre de Jesús se doble toda rodilla de los que están en los cielos, y de los que en la tierra, y de los que debajo de la tierra;

verses.KJV: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.WEB: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.ASV: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: e toda língua confesse que Jesus Cristo é o Senhor, para a glória de Deus Pai.
verses.RVR09: Y toda lengua confiese que Jesucristo es el Señor, á la gloria de Dios Padre.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.WEB: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.ASV: So then, my beloved, even as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus amados, assim como sempre obedecestes, não somente na minha presença, mas muito mais agora na minha ausência, assim exercei a vossa salvação com temor e tremor;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, amados míos, como siempre habéis obedecido, no como en mi presencia solamente, sino mucho más ahora en mi ausencia, ocupaos en vuestra salvación con temor y temblor;

verses.KJV: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verses.WEB: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
verses.ASV: for it is God who worketh in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois é Deus quem opera em vós tanto o querer como o agir, conforme a [sua] boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios es el que en vosotros obra así el querer como el hacer, por su buena voluntad.

verses.KJV: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.WEB: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
verses.ASV: Do all things without murmurings and questionings:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei tudo sem murmurações nem brigas,
verses.RVR09: Haced todo sin murmuraciones y contiendas,

verses.KJV: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
verses.WEB: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
verses.ASV: that ye may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom ye are seen as lights in the world,
verses.ALMEIDA: para que sejais irrepreensíveis e puros, filhos de Deus, inculpáveis no meio de uma geração corrupta e perversa, na qual brilhais como luminárias no mundo;
verses.RVR09: Para que seáis irreprensibles y sencillos, hijos de Dios sin culpa en medio de la nación maligna y perversa, entre los cuales resplandecéis como luminares en el mundo;

verses.KJV: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.WEB: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
verses.ASV: holding forth the word of life; that I may have whereof to glory in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain neither labor in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: e mantende a palavra da vida, para que no dia de Cristo eu possa me orgulhar de que não tenho corrido nem trabalhado em vão.
verses.RVR09: Reteniendo la palabra de vida para que yo pueda gloriarme en el día de Cristo, que no he corrido en vano, ni trabajado en vano.

verses.KJV: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.WEB: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
verses.ASV: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que eu seja derramado como oferta sobre o sacrifício e serviço da vossa fé, alegro-me e contento-me com todos vós;
verses.RVR09: Y aun si soy derramado en libación sobre el sacrificio y servicio de vuestra fe, me gozo y congratulo por todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.WEB: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
verses.ASV: and in the same manner do ye also joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: e, pelo mesmo motivo, alegrai-vos e contentai-vos comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo gozaos también vosotros, y regocijaos conmigo.

verses.KJV: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.WEB: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
verses.ASV: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho esperança no Senhor Jesus de em breve vos enviar Timóteo, para que também eu me anime quando souber notícias de vós.
verses.RVR09: Mas espero en el Señor Jesús enviaros presto á Timoteo, para que yo también esté de buen ánimo, entendido vuestro estado.

verses.KJV: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.WEB: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
verses.ASV: For I have no man likeminded, who will care truly for your state.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não tenho ninguém de mesmo ânimo que se importe sinceramente convosco,
verses.RVR09: Porque á ninguno tengo tan unánime, y que con sincera afición esté solícito por vosotros.

verses.KJV: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
verses.WEB: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois todos buscam as suas próprias coisas, e não as de Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos buscan lo suyo propio, no lo que es de Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.WEB: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
verses.ASV: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a child [serveth] a father, [so] he served with me in furtherance of the gospel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós sabeis a prova que ele passou, porque serviu comigo no Evangelho como um filho ao pai.
verses.RVR09: Pero la experiencia de él habéis conocido, que como hijo á padre ha servido conmigo en el evangelio.

verses.KJV: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.WEB: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
verses.ASV: Him therefore I hope to send forthwith, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, pois, espero enviá-lo, tão logo eu veja o que há de haver comigo.
verses.RVR09: Así que á éste espero enviaros, luego que yo viere cómo van mis negocios;

verses.KJV: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.WEB: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
verses.ASV: but I trust in the Lord that I myself also shall come shortly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas confio no Senhor de que também eu mesmo virei em breve.
verses.RVR09: Y confío en el Señor que yo también iré presto á vosotros.

verses.KJV: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.WEB: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
verses.ASV: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker and fellow-soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need;
verses.ALMEIDA: Julguei necessário, porém, enviar-vos Epafrodito, meu irmão, cooperador, e companheiro de batalha, mensageiro enviado por vós, e auxiliador naquilo que necessito;
verses.RVR09: Mas tuve por cosa necesaria enviaros á Epafrodito, mi hermano, y colaborador y compañero de milicia, y vuestro mensajero, y ministrador de mis necesidades;

verses.KJV: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.WEB: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.ASV: since he longed after you all, and was sore troubled, because ye had heard that he was sick:
verses.ALMEIDA: porque ele tinha muitas saudades de todos vós, e estava muito angustiado por haverdes ouvido de que ele havia ficado doente.
verses.RVR09: Porque tenía gran deseo de ver á todos vosotros, y gravemente se angustió porque habíais oído que había enfermado.

verses.KJV: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.WEB: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
verses.ASV: for indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele ficou mesmo doente, quase a morrer; mas o Deus dele teve misericórdia, não somente dele, mas também de mim, para que eu não tivesse tristeza após tristeza.
verses.RVR09: Pues en verdad estuvo enfermo á la muerte: mas Dios tuvo misericordia de él; y no solamente de él, sino aun de mí, para que yo no tuviese tristeza sobre tristeza.

verses.KJV: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.WEB: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.ASV: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu o enviei mais depressa, a fim de que, vendo-o de novo, alegrei-vos e eu fique menos triste.
verses.RVR09: Así que le envío más presto, para que viéndole os volváis á gozar, y yo esté con menos tristeza.

verses.KJV: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.WEB: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
verses.ASV: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy; and hold such in honor:
verses.ALMEIDA: Recebei-o, pois, no Senhor, com toda alegria; e honrai ao que são como ele;
verses.RVR09: Recibidle pues en el Señor con todo gozo; y tened en estima á los tales:

verses.KJV: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.WEB: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
verses.ASV: because for the work of Christ he came nigh unto death, hazarding his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois, por causa da obra de Cristo, ele chegou perto da morte, arriscando a sua própria vida para suprir em meu benefício a falta do vosso serviço.
verses.RVR09: Porque por la obra de Cristo estuvo cercano á la muerte, poniendo su vida para suplir vuestra falta en mi servicio.

verses.KJV: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
verses.WEB: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
verses.ASV: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not irksome, but for you it is safe.
verses.ALMEIDA: No restante, meus irmãos, alegrai-vos no Senhor. Não me é incômodo escrever as mesmas coisas, e [isso é] para a vossa segurança.
verses.RVR09: RESTA, hermanos, que os gocéis en el Señor. A mí, á la verdad, no es molesto el escribiros las mismas cosas, y para vosotros es seguro.

verses.KJV: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.WEB: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
verses.ASV: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the concision:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuidado com os cães! Cuidado com os que operam o mal! Cuidado com a mutilação!
verses.RVR09: Guardaos de los perros, guardaos de los malos obreros, guardaos del cortamiento.

verses.KJV: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.WEB: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
verses.ASV: for we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God, and glory in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a circuncisão somos nós, que servimos a Deus [pelo] Espírito, orgulhamo-nos em Cristo Jesus, e não confiamos na carne.
verses.RVR09: Porque nosotros somos la circuncisión, los que servimos en espíritu á Dios, y nos gloriamos en Cristo Jesús, no teniendo confianza en la carne.

verses.KJV: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.WEB: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
verses.ASV: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh: if any other man thinketh to have confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
verses.ALMEIDA: Embora eu também tenho como confiar na carne. Se outro alguém pensa que pode confiar na carne, ainda mais eu:
verses.RVR09: Aunque yo tengo también de qué confiar en la carne. Si alguno parece que tiene de qué confiar en la carne, yo más:

verses.KJV: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.WEB: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
verses.ASV: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.ALMEIDA: circuncidado ao oitavo dia, da descendência de Israel, da tribo de Benjamim, hebreu de hebreus; segundo a lei, fariseu;
verses.RVR09: Circuncidado al octavo día, del linaje de Israel, de la tribu de Benjamín, Hebreo de Hebreos; cuanto á la ley, Fariseo;

verses.KJV: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.WEB: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
verses.ASV: as touching zeal, persecuting the church; as touching the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
verses.ALMEIDA: segundo o zelo, perseguidor da Igreja; segundo a justiça que há na lei, irrepreensível.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto al celo, perseguidor de la iglesia; cuanto á la justicia que es en la ley, irreprensible.

verses.KJV: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.WEB: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
verses.ASV: Howbeit what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que para mim era ganho considerei como perda, por causa de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Pero las cosas que para mí eran ganancias, helas reputado pérdidas por amor de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
verses.WEB: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
verses.ASV: Yea verily, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but refuse, that I may gain Christ,
verses.ALMEIDA: E, na verdade, considero também todas as coisas como perda, por causa da superioridade de conhecer a Cristo Jesus, meu Senhor. Por ele aceitei perder todas [essas] coisas, e as considero como dejetos, a fim de que eu possa ganhar a Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Y ciertamente, aun reputo todas las cosas pérdida por el eminente conocimiento de Cristo Jesús, mi Señor, por amor del cual lo he perdido todo, y téngolo por estiércol, para ganar á Cristo,

verses.KJV: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.WEB: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
verses.ASV: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of mine own, [even] that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: e que eu seja achado nele, não tendo a minha justiça proveniente da Lei, mas sim a que é pela fé em Cristo, a justiça da parte de Deus pela fé;
verses.RVR09: Y ser hallado en él, no teniendo mi justicia, que es por la ley, sino la que es por la fe de Cristo, la justicia que es de Dios por la fe;

verses.KJV: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.WEB: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
verses.ASV: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed unto his death;
verses.ALMEIDA: para eu conhecer a ele, assim como o poder de sua ressurreição e a comunhão em seus sofrimentos, tornando-me conforme a ele em sua morte;
verses.RVR09: A fin de conocerle, y la virtud de su resurrección, y la participación de sus padecimientos, en conformidad á su muerte,

verses.KJV: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.WEB: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.ASV: if by any means I may attain unto the resurrection from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que, de alguma maneira, eu alcance a ressurreição dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Si en alguna manera llegase á la resurrección de los muertos.

verses.KJV: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect: but I press on, if so be that I may lay hold on that for which also I was laid hold on by Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que eu já [a] tenha obtido, ou que já seja perfeito; mas sigo a fim de alcançar aquilo para o qual eu também fui alcançado por Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: No que ya haya alcanzado, ni que ya sea perfecto; sino que prosigo, por ver si alcanzo aquello para lo cual fuí también alcanzado de Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.WEB: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
verses.ASV: Brethren, I count not myself yet to have laid hold: but one thing [I do], forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, não considero como se já a tivesse obtido; mas uma coisa [faço] : esqueço as coisas que ficam para trás, e avanço para as que estão adiante,
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, yo mismo no hago cuenta de haberlo ya alcanzado; pero una cosa hago: olvidando ciertamente lo que queda atrás, y extendiéndome á lo que está delante,

verses.KJV: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: I press on toward the goal unto the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: e prossigo para o alvo, ao prêmio do chamado de cima, de Deus em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Prosigo al blanco, al premio de la soberana vocación de Dios en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.WEB: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
verses.ASV: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in anything ye are otherwise minded, this also shall God reveal unto you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, todos nós que somos maduros, tenhamos essa [mesma] mentalidade; e se em algo pensais de maneira diferente, Deus também vos revelará isso.
verses.RVR09: Así que, todos los que somos perfectos, esto mismo sintamos: y si otra cosa sentís, esto también os revelará Dios.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
verses.ASV: only, whereunto we have attained, by that same [rule] let us walk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, naquilo a que já chegamos, andemos conforme a mesma regra, e tenhamos a mesma mentalidade.
verses.RVR09: Empero en aquello á que hemos llegado, vamos por la misma regla, sintamos una misma cosa.

verses.KJV: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.WEB: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
verses.ASV: Brethren, be ye imitators together of me, and mark them that so walk even as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede meus imitadores, irmãos, e observai atentamente os que assim andam, como o exemplo que tendes em nós;
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, sed imitadores de mí, y mirad los que así anduvieren como nos tenéis por ejemplo.

verses.KJV: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.WEB: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
verses.ASV: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, [that they are] the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: pois, como muitas vezes eu vos disse, e agora também digo chorando, muitos andam como inimigos da cruz de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos andan, de los cuales os dije muchas veces, y aun ahora lo digo llorando, que son enemigos de la cruz de Cristo:

verses.KJV: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.WEB: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
verses.ASV: whose end is perdition, whose god is the belly, and [whose] glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fim deles é a perdição. O Deus deles é o ventre, e têm orgulho do que deviam se envergonhar. Eles se importam mais com as coisas terrenas.
verses.RVR09: Cuyo fin será perdición, cuyo dios es el vientre, y su gloria es en confusión; que sienten lo terreno.

verses.KJV: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: For our citizenship is in heaven; whence also we wait for a Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós somos cidadãos dos céus, de onde também esperamos um Salvador, o Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mas nuestra vivienda es en los cielos; de donde también esperamos al Salvador, al Señor Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.WEB: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
verses.ASV: who shall fashion anew the body of our humiliation, [that it may be] conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working whereby he is able even to subject all things unto himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele transformará o nosso degradante corpo, para que seja conforme o seu corpo glorioso, segundo a operação do seu poder de sujeitar para si todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: El cual transformará el cuerpo de nuestra bajeza, para ser semejante al cuerpo de su gloria, por la operación con la cual puede también sujetar á sí todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
verses.WEB: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, my brethren beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my beloved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus amados e queridos irmãos, minha alegria e coroa, permanecei assim, firmes no Senhor, amados.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, hermanos míos amados y deseados, gozo y corona mía, estad así firmes en el Señor, amados.

verses.KJV: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.WEB: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
verses.ASV: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo a Evódia e rogo a Síntique que tenham uma mesma mentalidade no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: A Euodias ruego, y á Syntychê exhorto, que sientan lo mismo en el Señor.

verses.KJV: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.WEB: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.ASV: Yea, I beseech thee also, true yokefellow, help these women, for they labored with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Peço também de ti, verdadeiro companheiro, que ajude a essas que lutaram no Evangelho comigo, como também com Clemente, e com os demais cooperadores, cujos nomes estão no livro da vida.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo te ruego también á ti, hermano compañero, ayuda á las que trabajaron juntamente conmigo en el evangelio, con Clemente también, y los demás mis colaboradores, cuyos nombres están en el libro de la vida.

verses.KJV: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.WEB: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
verses.ASV: Rejoice in the Lord always: again I will say, Rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos sempre no Senhor. Volto a dizer: alegrai-vos.
verses.RVR09: Gozaos en el Señor siempre: otra vez digo: Que os gocéis.

verses.KJV: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.WEB: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.ASV: Let your forbearance be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vossa bondade seja conhecida por todas as pessoas. Perto está o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Vuestra modestia sea conocida de todos los hombres. El Señor está cerca.

verses.KJV: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.WEB: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
verses.ASV: In nothing be anxious; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não estejais ansiosos por coisa alguma; mas em tudo, por meio de orações e súplicas com ações de gratidão, sejam os vossos pedidos conhecidos por Deus;
verses.RVR09: Por nada estéis afanosos; sino sean notorias vuestras peticiones delante de Dios en toda oración y ruego, con hacimiento de gracias.

verses.KJV: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: e a paz de Deus, que excede todo entendimento, guardará os vossos corações e as vossas mentes em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y la paz de Dios, que sobrepuja todo entendimiento, guardará vuestros corazones y vuestros entendimientos en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.WEB: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
verses.ASV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honorable, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: No restante, meus irmãos, tudo o que é verdadeiro, tudo o que é respeitável, tudo o que é justo, tudo o que é puro, tudo o que é amável, tudo o que é de boa fama, se há alguma virtude, e se há algo digno de elogio, nisto pensai.
verses.RVR09: Por lo demás, hermanos, todo lo que es verdadero, todo lo honesto, todo lo justo, todo lo puro, todo lo amable, todo lo que es de buen nombre; si hay virtud alguna, si alguna alabanza, en esto pensad.

verses.KJV: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.WEB: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
verses.ASV: The things which ye both learned and received and heard and saw in me, these things do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que também aprendestes, recebestes, ouvistes, e vistes em mim, isso fazei; e o Deus da paz será convosco.
verses.RVR09: Lo que aprendisteis y recibisteis y oísteis y visteis en mí, esto haced; y el Dios de paz será con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.WEB: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
verses.ASV: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length ye have revived your thought for me; wherein ye did indeed take thought, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrei-me muito no Senhor de que finalmente voltastes a vos lembrardes de mim; aliás, já estáveis lembrando, porém não tínheis oportunidade.
verses.RVR09: Mas en gran manera me gocé en el Señor de que ya al fin ha reflorecido vuestro cuidado de mí; de lo cual aun estabais solícitos, pero os faltaba la oportunidad.

verses.KJV: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
verses.WEB: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
verses.ASV: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therein to be content.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digo isso por causa de alguma necessidade, pois já aprendi a contentar-me com o que tenho.
verses.RVR09: No lo digo en razón de indigencia, pues he aprendido á contentarme con lo que tengo.

verses.KJV: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.WEB: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
verses.ASV: I know how to be abased, and I know also how to abound: in everything and in all things have I learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in want.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sei estar humilhado, e sei ter em abundância; em toda maneira e em todas as coisas estou instruído, tanto a estar farto, como a ter fome; tanto a ter em abundância, como a sofrer necessidade.
verses.RVR09: Sé estar humillado, y sé tener abundancia: en todo y por todo estoy enseñado, así para hartura como para hambre, así para tener abundancia como para padecer necesidad.

verses.KJV: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.WEB: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
verses.ASV: I can do all things in him that strengtheneth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Posso todas as coisas em Cristo que me fortalece.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo puedo en Cristo que me fortalece.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.WEB: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
verses.ASV: Howbeit ye did well that ye had fellowship with my affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia, fizestes bem em compartilhardes da minha aflição.
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo, bien hicisteis que comunicasteis juntamente á mi tribulación.

verses.KJV: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.WEB: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
verses.ASV: And ye yourselves also know, ye Philippians, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church had fellowship with me in the matter of giving and receiving but ye only;
verses.ALMEIDA: E também vós, filipenses, sabeis que, no princípio do evangelho, quando parti da Macedônia, nenhuma igreja compartilhou comigo no dar e no receber, a não ser vós somente;
verses.RVR09: Y sabéis también vosotros, oh Filipenses, que al principio del evangelio, cuando partí de Macedonia, ninguna iglesia me comunicó en razón de dar y recibir, sino vosotros solos.

verses.KJV: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.WEB: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
verses.ASV: for even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my need.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois até em Tessalônica por uma e duas vezes me enviastes o que eu necessitava.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun á Tesalónica me enviasteis lo necesario una y dos veces.

verses.KJV: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.WEB: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
verses.ASV: Not that I seek for the gift; but I seek for the fruit that increaseth to your account.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não que eu busque doações, mas busco o fruto que aumente o crédito de vossa conta.
verses.RVR09: No porque busque dádivas; mas busco fruto que abunde en vuestra cuenta.

verses.KJV: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verses.WEB: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
verses.ASV: But I have all things, and abound: I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things [that came] from you, an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas de tudo tenho recebido, e tenho em abundância; estou plenamente abastecido, depois que recebi de Epafrodito o que de vossa parte [me foi enviado] ,como cheiro suave, e sacrifício aceitável e agradável a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Empero todo lo he recibido, y tengo abundancia: estoy lleno, habiendo recibido de Epafrodito lo que enviasteis, olor de suavidad, sacrificio acepto, agradable á Dios.

verses.KJV: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: And my God shall supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu Deus suprirá todas a vossas necessidades segundo as suas riquezas em glória em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Mi Dios, pues, suplirá todo lo que os falta conforme á sus riquezas en gloria en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
verses.ASV: Now unto our God and Father [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao nosso Deus e Pai seja a glória para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Al Dios pues y Padre nuestro sea gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.WEB: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
verses.ASV: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren that are with me salute you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai a todos os santos em Cristo Jesus. Os irmãos que estão comigo vos saúdam.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á todos los santos en Cristo Jesús. Los hermanos que están conmigo os saludan.

verses.KJV: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
verses.WEB: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
verses.ASV: All the saints salute you, especially they that are of Cæsar’s household.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os santos vos saúdam, mas principalmente os da casa de César.
verses.RVR09: Todos los santos os saludan, y mayormente los que son de casa de César.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo esteja com todos vós. Amém! [Para os filipenses. Escrita de Roma, enviada por Epafrodito]
verses.RVR09: La gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea con todos vosotros. Amén. Escrita de Roma con Epafrodito.

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo,
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, y el hermano Timoteo,

verses.KJV: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: to the saints and faithful brethren in Christ [that are] at Colossæ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: aos santos e fiéis irmãos em Cristo, que estão em Colossos. [Haja] em vós a graça e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: A los santos y hermanos fieles en Cristo que están en Colosas: Gracia y paz á vosotros de Dios Padre nuestro, y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.WEB: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.ASV: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecemos ao Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, sempre orando por vós;
verses.RVR09: Damos gracias al Dios y Padre del Señor nuestro Jesucristo, siempre orando por vosotros:

verses.KJV: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
verses.WEB: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
verses.ASV: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have toward all the saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: pois ouvimos falar da vossa fé em Cristo Jesus, e do amor [que tendes] para com todos os santos;
verses.RVR09: Habiendo oído vuestra fe en Cristo Jesús, y el amor que tenéis á todos los santos,

verses.KJV: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.WEB: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
verses.ASV: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel,
verses.ALMEIDA: por causa da esperança que está reservada para vós nos céus. Anteriormente ouvistes dessa esperança pala palavra da verdade do evangelho,
verses.RVR09: A causa de la esperanza que os está guardada en los cielos, de la cual habéis oído ya por la palabra verdadera del evangelio:

verses.KJV: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.WEB: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
verses.ASV: which is come unto you; even as it is also in all the world bearing fruit and increasing, as [it doth] in you also, since the day ye heard and knew the grace of God in truth;
verses.ALMEIDA: que já chegou a vós, como também em todo o mundo; e vai frutificando assim como entre vós, desde o dia em que ouvistes e conhecestes a graça de Deus em verdade.
verses.RVR09: El cual ha llegado hasta vosotros, como por todo el mundo; y fructifica y crece, como también en vosotros, desde el día que oísteis y conocisteis la gracia de Dios en verdad,

verses.KJV: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.WEB: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
verses.ASV: even as ye learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow-servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aprendestes o evangelho por Epafras, nosso amado cooperador, que é um fiel servidor de Cristo em vosso favor.
verses.RVR09: Como habéis aprendido de Epafras, nuestro consiervo amado, el cual es un fiel ministro de Cristo á favor vuestro;

verses.KJV: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.WEB: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
verses.ASV: who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele também nos declarou o vosso amor no Espírito.
verses.RVR09: El cual también nos ha declarado vuestro amor en el Espíritu.

verses.KJV: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.WEB: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
verses.ASV: For this cause we also, since the day we heard [it], do not cease to pray and make request for you, that ye may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também, desde o dia que [o] ouvimos, não paramos de orar por vós, e de pedir que sejais cheios do conhecimento da sua vontade, em toda sabedoria e entendimento espiritual;
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también nosotros, desde el día que lo oímos, no cesamos de orar por vosotros, y de pedir que seáis llenos del conocimiento de su voluntad, en toda sabiduría y espiritual inteligencia;

verses.KJV: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.WEB: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
verses.ASV: to walk worthily of the Lord unto all pleasing, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: para que possais andar dignamente [diante] do Senhor, agradando-lhe em tudo, frutificando em toda boa obra, e crescendo no conhecimento de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Para que andéis como es digno del Señor, agradándole en todo, fructificando en toda buena obra, y creciendo en el conocimiento de Dios:

verses.KJV: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.WEB: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
verses.ASV: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, unto all patience and longsuffering with joy;
verses.ALMEIDA: capacitados em todo fortalecimento, segundo o poder da sua glória, em toda perseverança e paciência com alegria,
verses.RVR09: Corroborados de toda fortaleza, conforme á la potencia de su gloria, para toda tolerancia y largura de ánimo con gozo;

verses.KJV: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.WEB: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
verses.ASV: giving thanks unto the Father, who made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;
verses.ALMEIDA: agradecendo ao Pai, que nos capacitou a participar da herança dos santos na luz.
verses.RVR09: Dando gracias al Padre que nos hizo aptos para participar de la suerte de los santos en luz:

verses.KJV: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
verses.WEB: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
verses.ASV: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele nos tirou do domínio das trevas, e nos transportou para o reino do seu amado Filho,
verses.RVR09: Que nos ha librado de la potestad de las tinieblas, y trasladado al reino de su amado Hijo;

verses.KJV: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
verses.WEB: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
verses.ASV: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins:
verses.ALMEIDA: em quem temos a libertação pelo seu sangue: o perdão dos pecados.
verses.RVR09: En el cual tenemos redención por su sangre, la remisión de pecados:

verses.KJV: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.WEB: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
verses.ASV: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é a imagem do Deus invisível, o primogênito de toda a criação;
verses.RVR09: El cual es la imagen del Dios invisible, el primogénito de toda criatura.

verses.KJV: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.WEB: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
verses.ASV: for in him were all things created, in the heavens and upon the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and unto him;
verses.ALMEIDA: porque nele foram criadas todas as coisas que há nos céus e na terra, visíveis e invisíveis, sejam tronos, sejam domínios, sejam governos, sejam autoridades; todas as coisas foram criadas por ele e para ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque por él fueron criadas todas las cosas que están en los cielos, y que están en la tierra, visibles é invisibles; sean tronos, sean dominios, sean principados, sean potestades; todo fué criado por él y para él.

verses.KJV: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.WEB: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
verses.ASV: and he is before all things, and in him all things consist.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele existe antes de todas as coisas, e nele todas as coisas se mantêm.
verses.RVR09: Y él es antes de todas las cosas, y por él todas las cosas subsisten:

verses.KJV: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.WEB: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.ASV: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele é a cabeça do corpo, da Igreja; ele é o princípio [e] o primogênito dentre os mortos, para que tenha a primazia entre todos.
verses.RVR09: Y él es la cabeza del cuerpo que es la iglesia; él que es el principio, el primogénito de los muertos, para que en todo tenga el primado.

verses.KJV: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.WEB: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
verses.ASV: For it was the good pleasure [of the Father] that in him should all the fulness dwell;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois foi do agrado [do Pai] que toda a plenitude habitasse nele;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto agradó al Padre que en él habitase toda plenitud,

verses.KJV: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.WEB: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
verses.ASV: and through him to reconcile all things unto himself, having made peace through the blood of his cross; through him, [I say], whether things upon the earth, or things in the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: e, havendo por ele feito a paz pelo sangue da sua cruz, por meio dele reconciliasse consigo mesmo todas as coisas, tanto as que estão na terra, como as que estão nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y por él reconciliar todas las cosas á sí, pacificando por la sangre de su cruz, así lo que está en la tierra como lo que está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
verses.WEB: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
verses.ASV: And you, being in time past alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós éreis separados [dele] , e inimigos no entendimento, em más obras. Porém agora ele vos reconciliou,
verses.RVR09: A vosotros también, que erais en otro tiempo extraños y enemigos de ánimo en malas obras, ahora empero os ha reconciliado

verses.KJV: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.WEB: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
verses.ASV: yet now hath he reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and unreproveable before him:
verses.ALMEIDA: no seu corpo de carne, pela morte, para vos apresentar diante dele santos, irrepreensíveis e inculpáveis;
verses.RVR09: En el cuerpo de su carne por medio de muerte, para haceros santos, y sin mancha, é irreprensibles delante de él:

verses.KJV: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.WEB: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
verses.ASV: if so be that ye continue in the faith, grounded and stedfast, and not moved away from the hope of the gospel which ye heard, which was preached in all creation under heaven; whereof I Paul was made a minister.
verses.ALMEIDA: se, de fato, permaneceis fundados e firmes na fé, e não vos afastais da esperança do evangelho que ouvistes, que é pregado a toda criatura que há abaixo do céu, e do qual eu, Paulo, fui feito servidor.
verses.RVR09: Si empero permanecéis fundados y firmes en la fe, y sin moveros de la esperanza del evangelio que habéis oído; el cual es predicado á toda criatura que está debajo del cielo; del cual yo Pablo soy hecho ministro.

verses.KJV: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
verses.WEB: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
verses.ASV: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora me alegro nos meus sofrimentos por vós, e cumpro na minha carne o restante das aflições de Cristo, em benefício do seu corpo, que é a Igreja.
verses.RVR09: Que ahora me gozo en lo que padezco por vosotros, y cumplo en mi carne lo que falta de las aflicciones de Cristo por su cuerpo, que es la iglesia;

verses.KJV: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
verses.WEB: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
verses.ASV: whereof I was made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which was given me to you-ward, to fulfil the word of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Dela eu fui feito servidor segundo a responsabilidade da parte de Deus que me foi dada para o vosso benefício, a fim de cumprir a palavra de Deus,
verses.RVR09: De la cual soy hecho ministro, según la dispensación de Dios que me fué dada en orden á vosotros, para que cumpla la palabra de Dios;

verses.KJV: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.WEB: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
verses.ASV: [even] the mystery which hath been hid for ages and generations: but now hath it been manifested to his saints,
verses.ALMEIDA: o mistério que estava oculto desde os princípios dos tempos e das gerações; mas agora foi manifesto aos seus santos.
verses.RVR09: A saber, el misterio que había estado oculto desde los siglos y edades, mas ahora ha sido manifestado á sus santos:

verses.KJV: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.WEB: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.ASV: to whom God was pleased to make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.ALMEIDA: A eles Deus quis fazer que conhecessem as riquezas da glória deste mistério entre os gentios, que é Cristo em vós, a esperança da glória.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales quiso Dios hacer notorias las riquezas de la gloria de este misterio entre los Gentiles; que es Cristo en vosotros la esperanza de gloria:

verses.KJV: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
verses.WEB: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
verses.ASV: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é quem anunciamos, advertindo a toda pessoa, e ensinando a toda pessoa, com toda sabedoria; a fim de que apresentemos toda pessoa [como] completa em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: El cual nosotros anunciamos, amonestando á todo hombre, y enseñando en toda sabiduría, para que presentemos á todo hombre perfecto en Cristo Jesús:

verses.KJV: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.WEB: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
verses.ASV: whereunto I labor also, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para isso eu também trabalho, lutando conforme a eficácia dele, que age em mim com poder.
verses.RVR09: En lo cual aun trabajo, combatiendo según la operación de él, la cual obra en mí poderosamente.

verses.KJV: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.WEB: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.ASV: For I would have you know how greatly I strive for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quero que saibais como é grande a luta que tenho para o benefício de vós, dos que [estão] em Laodiceia, e de tantos quantos não viram meu rosto fisicamente;
verses.RVR09: PORQUE quiero que sepáis cuán gran solicitud tengo por vosotros, y por los que están en Laodicea, y por todos los que nunca vieron mi rostro en carne;

verses.KJV: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.WEB: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
verses.ASV: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, [even] Christ,
verses.ALMEIDA: para que os seus corações sejam consolados, e estejam unidos em amor, e em todas as riquezas da pleno entendimento, para conhecimento do mistério de Deus, e do Pai, e de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Para que sean confortados sus corazones, unidos en amor, y en todas riquezas de cumplido entendimiento para conocer el misterio de Dios, y del Padre, y de Cristo;

verses.KJV: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.WEB: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
verses.ASV: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele estão ocultos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e do conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: En el cual están escondidos todos los tesoros de sabiduría y conocimiento.

verses.KJV: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.WEB: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
verses.ASV: This I say, that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
verses.ALMEIDA: Digo isso para que ninguém vos engane com palavras persuasivas.
verses.RVR09: Y esto digo, para que nadie os engañe con palabras persuasivas.

verses.KJV: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.WEB: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.ASV: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ainda que esteja ausente em corpo, todavia em espírito estou convosco, alegrando-me, e vendo a vossa ordem e a firmeza de vossa fé em Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque aunque estoy ausente con el cuerpo, no obstante con el espíritu estoy con vosotros, gozándome y mirando vuestro concierto, y la firmeza de vuestra fe en Cristo.

verses.KJV: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
verses.WEB: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
verses.ASV: As therefore ye received Christ Jesus the Lord, [so] walk in him,
