verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim como recebestes Cristo Jesus, o Senhor, assim também andai nele;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, de la manera que habéis recibido al Señor Jesucristo, andad en él:

verses.KJV: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.WEB: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
verses.ASV: rooted and builded up in him, and established in your faith, even as ye were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.
verses.ALMEIDA: com raízes firmes e edificados nele, e confirmados na fé, como fostes ensinados, abundando nela com gratidão.
verses.RVR09: Arraigados y sobreedificados en él, y confirmados en la fe, así como habéis aprendido, creciendo en ella con hacimiento de gracias.

verses.KJV: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.WEB: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.ASV: Take heed lest there shall be any one that maketh spoil of you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuidado que ninguém vos tome cativos por meio de filosofias e de enganos vãos, conforme a tradição humana, conforme os elementos do mundo, e não conforme Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Mirad que ninguno os engañe por filosofías y vanas sutilezas, según las tradiciones de los hombres, conforme á los elementos del mundo, y no según Cristo:

verses.KJV: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.WEB: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
verses.ASV: for in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nele habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade.
verses.RVR09: Porque en él habita toda la plenitud de la divinidad corporalmente:

verses.KJV: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.WEB: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
verses.ASV: and in him ye are made full, who is the head of all principality and power:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós vos tornais plenos nele, que é o cabeça de todo governo e autoridade.
verses.RVR09: Y en él estáis cumplidos, el cual es la cabeza de todo principado y potestad:

verses.KJV: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.WEB: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
verses.ASV: in whom ye were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nele também fostes circuncidados com uma circuncisão não feita por mãos, [mas sim] , no abandono do corpo dos pecados da carne, pela circuncisão de Cristo;
verses.RVR09: En el cual también sois circuncidados de circuncisión no hecha con manos, con el despojamiento del cuerpo de los pecados de la carne, en la circuncisión de Cristo;

verses.KJV: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.WEB: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
verses.ASV: having been buried with him in baptism, wherein ye were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: sepultados com ele no batismo, no qual também com ele fostes ressuscitados pela fé no poder de Deus, que o ressuscitou dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Sepultados juntamente con él en el bautismo, en el cual también resucitasteis con él, por la fe de la operación de Dios que le levantó de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.WEB: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
verses.ASV: And you, being dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, you, [I say], did he make alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vós estáveis mortos em pecados, na incircuncisão da vossa carne, [Deus] vos deu vida juntamente com ele, perdoando-vos todas as ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Y á vosotros, estando muertos en pecados y en la incircuncisión de vuestra carne, os vivificó juntamente con él, perdonándoos todos los pecados,

verses.KJV: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.WEB: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
verses.ASV: having blotted out the bond written in ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us: and he hath taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele riscou a certidão de nossa dívida em ordenanças, a qual era contra nós, e a removeu, cravando-a na cruz;
verses.RVR09: Rayendo la cédula de los ritos que nos era contraria, que era contra nosotros, quitándola de en medio y enclavándola en la cruz;

verses.KJV: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.WEB: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.ASV: having despoiled the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: ele despojou os domínios e autoridades, publicamente os envergonhou, e nela triunfou sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y despojando los principados y las potestades, sacólos á la vergüenza en público, triunfando de ellos en sí mismo.

verses.KJV: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
verses.WEB: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
verses.ASV: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of a feast day or a new moon or a sabbath day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ninguém vos julgue pelo comer, ou pelo beber, ou por causa de celebração [religiosa] , ou pela lua nova, ou pelos sábados;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, nadie os juzgue en comida, ó en bebida, ó en parte de día de fiesta, ó de nueva luna, ó de sábados:

verses.KJV: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
verses.WEB: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
verses.ASV: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: essas coisas são a sombra das coisas futuras, mas a realidade pertence a Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual es la sombra de lo por venir; mas el cuerpo es de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.WEB: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.ASV: Let no man rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he hath seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém, pois, se faça de juiz contra vós, insistindo nos pretextos de “humildade” e de “culto aos anjos” , envolvendo-se em coisas que nunca viu, vangloriando-se em sua mentalidade carnal,
verses.RVR09: Nadie os prive de vuestro premio, afectando humildad y culto á los ángeles, metiéndose en lo que no ha visto, vanamente hinchado en el sentido de su propia carne,

verses.KJV: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.WEB: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
verses.ASV: and not holding fast the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and bands, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: e não se ligando à cabeça, da qual todo o corpo, suprido e organizado pelas juntas e ligamentos, vai crescendo com o crescimento da parte de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no teniendo la cabeza, de la cual todo el cuerpo, alimentado y conjunto por las ligaduras y conjunturas, crece en aumento de Dios.

verses.KJV: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
verses.WEB: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
verses.ASV: If ye died with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, do ye subject yourselves to ordinances,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se estais mortos com Cristo para os elementos do mundo, por que vos sujeitais a ordenanças como se vivêsseis no mundo,
verses.RVR09: Pues si sois muertos con Cristo cuanto á los rudimentos del mundo, ¿por qué como si vivieseis al mundo, os sometéis á ordenanzas,

verses.KJV: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.WEB: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
verses.ASV: Handle not, nor taste, nor touch
verses.ALMEIDA: [tais como] : “não pegues”, “não proves”, “não toques”?
verses.RVR09: Tales como, No manejes, ni gustes, ni aun toques,

verses.KJV: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.WEB: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
verses.ASV: (all which things are to perish with the using), after the precepts and doctrines of men?
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas elas se acabam com o uso, e se baseiam em mandamentos e doutrinas humanas.
verses.RVR09: (Las cuales cosas son todas para destrucción en el uso mismo), en conformidad á mandamientos y doctrinas de hombres?

verses.KJV: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
verses.WEB: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
verses.ASV: Which things have indeed a show of wisdom in will-worship, and humility, and severity to the body; [but are] not of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas realmente têm aparência de sabedoria em culto voluntário, humildade, e tratamento severo ao corpo; mas não têm valor algum contra a satisfação da carne.
verses.RVR09: Tales cosas tienen á la verdad cierta reputación de sabiduría en culto voluntario, y humildad, y en duro trato del cuerpo; no en alguna honra para el saciar de la carne.

verses.KJV: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.WEB: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
verses.ASV: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se fostes ressuscitados com Cristo, buscai as coisas de cima, onde Cristo está sentado à direita de Deus.
verses.RVR09: SI habéis pues resucitado con Cristo, buscad las cosas de arriba, donde está Cristo sentado á la diestra de Dios.

verses.KJV: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.WEB: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
verses.ASV: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pensai nas coisas de cima, não nas que [estão] na terra.
verses.RVR09: Poned la mira en las cosas de arriba, no en las de la tierra.

verses.KJV: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.WEB: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.ASV: For ye died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois já morrestes, e a vossa vida está escondida com Cristo em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque muertos sois, y vuestra vida está escondida con Cristo en Dios.

verses.KJV: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.WEB: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
verses.ASV: When Christ, [who is] our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Cristo, [que é] a nossa vida, se manifestar, então também vós vos manifestareis com ele em glória.
verses.RVR09: Cuando Cristo, vuestra vida, se manifestare, entonces vosotros también seréis manifestados con él en gloria.

verses.KJV: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.WEB: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
verses.ASV: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, mortificai as partes carnais que há em vós que são terrenas; [são elas] : o pecado sexual, a impureza, a paixão depravada, o desejo maligno, e a ganância, que é idolatria.
verses.RVR09: Amortiguad, pues, vuestros miembros que están sobre la tierra: fornicación, inmundicia, molicie, mala concupiscencia, y avaricia, que es idolatría:

verses.KJV: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.WEB: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.ASV: for which things’ sake cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa delas que a ira de Deus vem sobre os filhos da desobediência.
verses.RVR09: Por las cuales cosas la ira de Dios viene sobre los hijos de rebelión.

verses.KJV: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.WEB: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
verses.ASV: wherein ye also once walked, when ye lived in these things;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nessas coisas também vós andastes antes, quando vivíeis nelas.
verses.RVR09: En las cuales vosotros también anduvisteis en otro tiempo viviendo en ellas.

verses.KJV: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.WEB: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
verses.ASV: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, abandonai, vós também, todas [estas coisas] : a ira, a fúria, a malícia, a maledicência, e as palavras vergonhosas da vossa boca.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, dejad también vosotros todas estas cosas: ira, enojo, malicia, maledicencia, torpes palabras de vuestra boca.

verses.KJV: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.WEB: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
verses.ASV: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não mintais uns aos outros, pois já vos despistes do velho ser humano com os seus costumes,
verses.RVR09: No mintáis los unos á los otros, habiéndoos despojado del viejo hombre con sus hechos,

verses.KJV: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.WEB: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
verses.ASV: and have put on the new man, that is being renewed unto knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.ALMEIDA: e vos revestistes do novo, que se renova em conhecimento, conforme a imagem daquele que o criou.
verses.RVR09: Y revestídoos del nuevo, el cual por el conocimiento es renovado conforme á la imagen del que lo crió;

verses.KJV: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.WEB: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.ASV: where there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondman, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisso não há grego, nem judeu, nem circunciso, nem incircunciso, bárbaro, cita, escravo, [nem] livre; mas Cristo é tudo, e em todos.
verses.RVR09: Donde no hay Griego ni Judío, circuncisión ni incircuncisión, bárbaro ni Scytha, siervo ni libre; mas Cristo es el todo, y en todos.

verses.KJV: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.WEB: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
verses.ASV: Put on therefore, as God’s elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, como escolhidos de Deus, santos e amados, revesti-vos de sentimentos de misericórdia, bondade, humildade, mansidão, e paciência.
verses.RVR09: Vestíos pues, como escogidos de Dios, santos y amados, de entrañas de misericordia, de benignidad, de humildad, de mansedumbre, de tolerancia;

verses.KJV: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verses.WEB: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
verses.ASV: forbearing one another, and forgiving each other, if any man have a complaint against any; even as the Lord forgave you, so also do ye:
verses.ALMEIDA: Suportai-vos uns aos outros, e perdoai-vos uns aos outros, se alguém tiver queixa contra outro. Como Cristo vos perdoou, assim também [fazei] .
verses.RVR09: Sufriéndoos los unos á los otros, y perdonándoos los unos á los otros si alguno tuviere queja del otro: de la manera que Cristo os perdonó, así también hacedlo vosotros.

verses.KJV: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.WEB: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
verses.ASV: and above all these things [put on] love, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acima de tudo isto, [revesti-vos] do amor, que é o vínculo da perfeição.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre todas estas cosas vestíos de caridad, la cual es el vínculo de la perfección.

verses.KJV: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.WEB: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
verses.ASV: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a paz de Deus, para a qual também fostes chamados em um [só] corpo, governe em vossos corações, e sede gratos.
verses.RVR09: Y la paz de Dios gobierne en vuestros corazones, á la cual asimismo sois llamados en un cuerpo; y sed agradecidos.

verses.KJV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
verses.ASV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms [and] hymns [and] spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: A palavra de Cristo habite abundantemente em vós com toda sabedoria, ensinando-vos e advertindo-vos uns aos outros; e cantai ao Senhor com salmos, hinos, e cânticos espirituais, com graça no vosso coração.
verses.RVR09: La palabra de Cristo habite en vosotros en abundancia en toda sabiduría, enseñándoos y exhortándoos los unos á los otros con salmos é himnos y canciones espirituales, con gracia cantando en vuestros corazones al Señor.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.WEB: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, [do] all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo quanto fizerdes, por palavras ou por obras, [fazei] tudo no nome do Senhor Jesus, dando por meio dele graças ao Deus e Pai.
verses.RVR09: Y todo lo que hacéis, sea de palabra, ó de hecho, hacedlo todo en el nombre del Señor Jesús, dando gracias á Dios Padre por él.

verses.KJV: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mulheres, sede submissas aos vossos próprios maridos, como convém no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Casadas, estad sujetas á vuestros maridos, como conviene en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.WEB: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
verses.ASV: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maridos, amai às esposas, e não as trateis amargamente.
verses.RVR09: Maridos, amad á vuestras mujeres, y no seáis desapacibles con ellas.

verses.KJV: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.ASV: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhos, obedecei em tudo aos pais, porque isso é agradável ao Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Hijos, obedeced á vuestros padres en todo; porque esto agrada al Señor.

verses.KJV: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
verses.WEB: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
verses.ASV: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pais, não provoqueis aos vossos filhos, para que não percam o ânimo.
verses.RVR09: Padres, no irritéis á vuestros hijos, porque no se hagan de poco ánimo.

verses.KJV: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;
verses.WEB: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
verses.ASV: Servants, obey in all things them that are your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: Escravos, obedecei em tudo aos [vossos] senhores segundo a carne, não servindo apenas quando observados, como que para satisfazer às pessoas, mas sim, com sinceridade de coração, temendo a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Siervos, obedeced en todo á vuestros amos carnales, no sirviendo al ojo, como los que agradan á los hombres, sino con sencillez de corazón, temiendo á Dios:

verses.KJV: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.WEB: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
verses.ASV: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo quanto fizerdes, fazei de coração, como para o Senhor, e não para as pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y todo lo que hagáis, hacedlo de ánimo, como al Señor, y no á los hombres;

verses.KJV: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.WEB: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
verses.ASV: knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the recompense of the inheritance: ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois sabeis que recebereis do Senhor a recompensa da herança, porque servis ao Senhor Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que del Señor recibiréis la compensación de la herencia: porque al Señor Cristo servís.

verses.KJV: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.WEB: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
verses.ASV: For he that doeth wrong shall receive again for the wrong that he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que fizer injustiça receberá conforme a injustiça que cometer; e não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que hace injuria, recibirá la injuria que hiciere; que no hay acepción de personas.

verses.KJV: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.WEB: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.ASV: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhores, procedei de maneira justa e imparcial com os [vossos] servos, sabendo que também vós tendes um Senhor nos céus.
verses.RVR09: AMOS, haced lo que es justo y derecho con vuestros siervos, sabiendo que también vosotros tenéis amo en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.WEB: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
verses.ASV: Continue stedfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
verses.ALMEIDA: Perseverai na oração, vigiando nela com gratidão.
verses.RVR09: Perseverad en oración, velando en ella con hacimiento de gracias:

verses.KJV: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.WEB: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
verses.ASV: withal praying for us also, that God may open unto us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai também ao mesmo tempo por nós, para que Deus nos abra uma porta para a palavra, para que falemos do mistério de Cristo, [mistério] pelo qual estou preso.
verses.RVR09: Orando también juntamente por nosotros, que el Señor nos abra la puerta de la palabra, para hablar el misterio de Cristo, por el cual aun estoy preso,

verses.KJV: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.WEB: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
verses.ASV: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu o anuncie claramente, como devo falar.
verses.RVR09: Para que lo manifieste como me conviene hablar.

verses.KJV: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.WEB: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
verses.ASV: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Convivei com sabedoria com os que estão de fora, aproveitando o tempo oportuno.
verses.RVR09: Andad en sabiduría para con los extraños, redimiendo el tiempo.

verses.KJV: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.WEB: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
verses.ASV: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer each one.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vossa palavra [seja] sempre com graça, temperada com sal, para que saibais como deveis responder a cada um.
verses.RVR09: Sea vuestra palabra siempre con gracia, sazonada con sal; para que sepáis cómo os conviene responder á cada uno.

verses.KJV: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.WEB: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
verses.ASV: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tíquico, irmão amado, fiel trabalhador e colaborador no Senhor, vos fará saber tudo o que vem acontecendo comigo.
verses.RVR09: Todos mis negocios os hará saber Tichîco, hermano amado y fiel ministro y consiervo en el Señor:

verses.KJV: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.WEB: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
verses.ASV: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi para isso que eu o enviei até vós, para que saiba como estais, e console os vossos corações.
verses.RVR09: El cual os he enviado á esto mismo, para que entienda vuestros negocios, y consuele vuestros corazones;

verses.KJV: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
verses.WEB: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
verses.ASV: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that [are done] here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntamente com ele [está] Onésimo, irmão fiel e amado, que é um de vós. Eles vos farão saber tudo o que está havendo por aqui.
verses.RVR09: Con Onésimo, amado y fiel hermano, el cual es de vosotros. Todo lo que acá pasa, os harán saber.

verses.KJV: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.WEB: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
verses.ASV: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner saluteth you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (touching whom ye received commandments; if he come unto you, receive him),
verses.ALMEIDA: Aristarco, que está preso comigo, vos saúda; e também Marcos, primo de Barnabé. Acerca dele, já recebestes ordens; se ele for até vós, recebei-o.
verses.RVR09: Aristarchô, mi compañero en la prisión, os saluda, y Marcos, el sobrino de Bernabé (acerca del cual habéis recibido mandamientos; si fuere á vosotros, recibidle),

verses.KJV: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.WEB: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
verses.ASV: and Jesus that is called Justus, who are of the circumcision: these only [are my] fellow-workers unto the kingdom of God, men that have been a comfort unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Jesus, chamado Justo. Dentre os circuncisos, esses [são] os únicos cooperadores [meus] no Reino de Deus, e têm sido consolação para mim.
verses.RVR09: Y Jesús, el que se llama Justo; los cuales son de la circuncisión: éstos solos son los que me ayudan en el reino de Dios, y me han sido consuelo.

verses.KJV: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.WEB: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.ASV: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, saluteth you, always striving for you in his prayers, that ye may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Epafras, que é um de vós, servo de Cristo, vos saúda. Ele sempre luta por vós em orações, para que fiqueis íntegros e plenos em toda a vontade de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Os saluda Epafras, el cual es de vosotros, siervo de Cristo, siempre solícito por vosotros en oraciones, para que estéis firmes, perfectos y cumplidos en todo lo que Dios quiere.

verses.KJV: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.WEB: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
verses.ASV: For I bear him witness, that he hath much labor for you, and for them in Laodicea, and for them in Hierapolis.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dou testemunho dele de que ele tem grande zelo por vós, pelos que [estão] em Laodiceia, e pelos que [estão] em Hierápolis.
verses.RVR09: Porque le doy testimonio, que tiene gran celo por vosotros, y por los que están en Laodicea, y los que en Hierápolis.

verses.KJV: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.WEB: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
verses.ASV: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas salute you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lucas, o médico amado, vos saúda; e também Demas.
verses.RVR09: Os saluda Lucas, el médico amado, y Demas.

verses.KJV: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.WEB: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
verses.ASV: Salute the brethren that are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church that is in their house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai aos irmãos que [estão] em Laodiceia, e também a Ninfas, e à igreja que está na casa dele.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á los hermanos que están en Laodicea, y á Nimfas, y á la iglesia que está en su casa.

verses.KJV: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.WEB: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
verses.ASV: And when this epistle hath been read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye also read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que esta carta for lida entre vós, fazei que ela também seja lida na igreja dos laodicenses, e que vós leiais também a de Laodiceia.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando esta carta fuere leída entre vosotros, haced que también sea leída en la iglesia de los Laodicenses; y la de Laodicea que la leáis también vosotros.

verses.KJV: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.WEB: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
verses.ASV: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizei a Árquipo: Presta atenção ao trabalho que recebeste do Senhor, para que o cumpras.
verses.RVR09: Y decid á Archîpo: Mira que cumplas el ministerio que has recibido del Señor.

verses.KJV: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.WEB: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.ASV: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Esta] saudação [é] da minha mão, de Paulo. Lembrai-vos das minhas prisões. A graça [esteja] convosco. Amém. (Escrita de Roma aos colossenses, e enviada por Tíquico e Onésimo.)
verses.RVR09: La salutación de mi mano, de Pablo. Acordaos de mis prisiones. La gracia sea con vosotros. Amén. Escrita de Roma á los Colosenses; enviada con Tichîco y Onésimo.

verses.KJV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo; haja convosco a graça e a paz de Deus, nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: PABLO, y Silvano, y Timoteo, á la iglesia de los Tesalonicenses que es en Dios Padre y en el Señor Jesucristo: Gracia y paz á vosotros de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.WEB: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
verses.ASV: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention [of you] in our prayers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Sempre damos graças a Deus por todos vós, fazendo menção de vós em nossas orações.
verses.RVR09: Damos siempre gracias á Dios por todos vosotros, haciendo memoria de vosotros en nuestras oraciones;

verses.KJV: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
verses.WEB: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
verses.ASV: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, diante do nosso Deus e Pai, nós nos lembramos sem cessar da obra da vossa fé, do trabalho do amor, e da firmeza da esperança no nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Sin cesar acordándonos delante del Dios y Padre nuestro de la obra de vuestra fe, y del trabajo de amor, y de la tolerancia de la esperanza del Señor nuestro Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
verses.WEB: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
verses.ASV: knowing, brethren beloved of God, your election,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabemos, irmãos amados por Deus, que [por ele] fostes escolhidos,
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo, hermanos amados de Dios, vuestra elección:

verses.KJV: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.WEB: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
verses.ASV: how that our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and [in] much assurance; even as ye know what manner of men we showed ourselves toward you for your sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois o nosso evangelho não foi até vós somente com palavras, mas também com poder, com o Espírito Santo, e com plena certeza; assim como sabeis de que maneira estivemos entre vós para o vosso benefício.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto nuestro evangelio no fué á vosotros en palabra solamente, mas también en potencia, y en Espíritu Santo, y en gran plenitud; como sabéis cuáles fuimos entre vosotros por amor de vosotros.

verses.KJV: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.ASV: And ye became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos tornastes imitadores nossos e do Senhor. [Mesmo] em meio a muita aflição, recebestes a palavra com a alegria do Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros fuisteis hechos imitadores de nosotros, y del Señor, recibiendo la palabra con mucha tribulación, con gozo del Espíritu Santo:

verses.KJV: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.WEB: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
verses.ASV: so that ye became an ensample to all that believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dessa maneira vos tornastes referências a todos os crentes na Macedônia e Acaia.
verses.RVR09: En tal manera que habéis sido ejemplo á todos los que han creído en Macedonia y en Acaya.

verses.KJV: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.WEB: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.
verses.ASV: For from you hath sounded forth the word of the Lord, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith to God-ward is gone forth; so that we need not to speak anything.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois de vós ressoou a palavra do Senhor, não somente na Macedônia e Acaia, mas a vossa fé em Deus também se espalhou em todo lugar, de tal maneira que não precisamos falar coisa alguma.
verses.RVR09: Porque de vosotros ha sido divulgada la palabra del Señor no sólo en Macedonia y en Acaya, mas aun en todo lugar vuestra fe en Dios se ha extendido; de modo que no tenemos necesidad de hablar nada.

verses.KJV: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
verses.WEB: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
verses.ASV: For they themselves report concerning us what manner of entering in we had unto you; and how ye turned unto God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eles mesmos anunciam como fomos recebidos por vós, e como vos convertestes, deixando os ídolos, para servir ao Deus vivo e verdadeiro;
verses.RVR09: Porque ellos cuentan de nosotros cuál entrada tuvimos á vosotros; y cómo os convertisteis de los ídolos á Dios, para servir al Dios vivo y verdadero,

verses.KJV: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
verses.WEB: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
verses.ASV: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, [even] Jesus, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: e para esperar dos céus o seu Filho, a quem ele ressuscitou dos mortos: Jesus, que nos livra da ira futura.
verses.RVR09: Y esperar á su Hijo de los cielos, al cual resucitó de los muertos; á Jesús, el cual nos libró de la ira que ha de venir.

verses.KJV: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
verses.WEB: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
verses.ASV: For yourselves, brethren, know our entering in unto you, that it hath not been found vain:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós mesmos, irmãos, sabeis que a nossa passagem por entre vós não foi inútil.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE, hermanos, vosotros mismos sabéis que nuestra entrada á vosotros no fué vana:

verses.KJV: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
verses.WEB: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
verses.ASV: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as ye know, at Philippi, we waxed bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God in much conflict.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, mesmo que antes, em Filipos, tenhamos sofrido e sido maltratados, como sabeis, tivemos no nosso Deus ousadia para vos falar o evangelho de Deus em meio a muita oposição.
verses.RVR09: Pues aun habiendo padecido antes, y sido afrentados en Filipos, como sabéis, tuvimos denuedo en Dios nuestro para anunciaros el evangelio de Dios con gran combate.

verses.KJV: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.WEB: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
verses.ASV: For our exhortation [is] not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a nossa exortação não [foi] com engano, nem com impureza, nem fraude;
verses.RVR09: Porque nuestra exhortación no fué de error, ni de inmundicia, ni por engaño;

verses.KJV: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
verses.WEB: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
verses.ASV: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas, como fomos aprovados por Deus para que o evangelho nos fosse confiado, assim falamos; não para agradar as pessoas, mas sim a Deus, que prova os nossos corações.
verses.RVR09: Sino según fuimos aprobados de Dios para que se nos encargase el evangelio, así hablamos; no como los que agradan á los hombres, sino á Dios, el cual prueba nuestros corazones.

verses.KJV: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
verses.WEB: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
verses.ASV: For neither at any time were we found using words of flattery, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness, God is witness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, como sabeis, nunca usamos palavras de lisonja, nem pretexto de ganância; Deus é testemunha.
verses.RVR09: Porque nunca fuimos lisonjeros en la palabra, como sabéis, ni tocados de avaricia; Dios es testigo;

verses.KJV: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
verses.WEB: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
verses.ASV: nor seeking glory of men, neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não buscamos a glória humana, nem de vós, nem de outros, ainda que tínhamos autoridade, como apóstolos de Cristo, para demandar de vós.
verses.RVR09: Ni buscamos de los hombres gloria, ni de vosotros, ni de otros, aunque podíamos seros carga como apóstoles de Cristo.

verses.KJV: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
verses.WEB: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
verses.ASV: But we were gentle in the midst of you, as when a nurse cherisheth her own children:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém fomos suaves entre vós, como uma mãe que dá carinho aos seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Antes fuimos blandos entre vosotros como la que cría, que regala á sus hijos:

verses.KJV: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
verses.WEB: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
verses.ASV: even so, being affectionately desirous of you, we were well pleased to impart unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were become very dear to us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim nós, tendo tanta afeição por vós, queríamos de boa vontade compartilhar convosco não somente o evangelho de Deus, mas também as nossas próprias almas, porque éreis queridos por nós.
verses.RVR09: Tan amadores de vosotros, que quisiéramos entregaros no sólo el evangelio de Dios, mas aun nuestras propias almas; porque nos erais carísimos.

verses.KJV: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
verses.WEB: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
verses.ASV: For ye remember, brethren, our labor and travail: working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vos lembrais, irmãos, do nosso trabalho e fadiga; porque enquanto vos pregávamos o evangelho de Deus, trabalhávamos noite e dia para que não fôssemos um peso para vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya, hermanos, os acordáis de nuestro trabajo y fatiga: que trabajando de noche y de día por no ser gravosos á ninguno de vosotros, os predicamos el evangelio de Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
verses.WEB: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
verses.ASV: Ye are witnesses, and God [also], how holily and righteously and unblamably we behaved ourselves toward you that believe:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós e Deus [sois] testemunhas de como foi santa, justa, e irrepreensível a maneira da qual nos comportamos convosco, que credes.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois testigos, y Dios, de cuán santa y justa é irreprensiblemente nos condujimos con vosotros que creísteis:

verses.KJV: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
verses.WEB: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
verses.ASV: as ye know how we [dealt with] each one of you, as a father with his own children, exhorting you, and encouraging [you], and testifying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como sabeis que, como um pai aos seus filhos, exortávamos, consolávamos, e testemunhávamos a cada um de vós,
verses.RVR09: Así como sabéis de qué modo exhortábamos y consolábamos á cada uno de vosotros, como el padre á sus hijos,

verses.KJV: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
verses.WEB: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
verses.ASV: to the end that ye should walk worthily of God, who calleth you into his own kingdom and glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que andásseis de maneira digna diante de Deus, que vos chama para o seu reino e glória.
verses.RVR09: Y os protestábamos que anduvieseis como es digno de Dios, que os llamó á su reino y gloria.

verses.KJV: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
verses.WEB: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
verses.ASV: And for this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when ye received from us the word of the message, [even the word] of God, ye accepted [it] not [as] the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also worketh in you that believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também agradecemos sem cessar a Deus, que, quando recebestes a palavra da Deus pregada por nós, a recebestes, não [como] palavra de homens, mas (conforme em verdade é) [como] a palavra de Deus, a qual também opera em vós, que credes.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, también nosotros damos gracias á Dios sin cesar, de que habiendo recibido la palabra de Dios que oísteis de nosotros, recibisteis no palabra de hombres, sino según es en verdad, la palabra de Dios, el cual obra en vosotros los que creísteis.

verses.KJV: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
verses.WEB: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
verses.ASV: For ye, brethren, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judæa in Christ Jesus: for ye also suffered the same things of your own countrymen, even as they did of the Jews;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós, irmãos, vos tornastes imitadores das igrejas de Deus que estão na Judeia em Cristo Jesus; porque também sofrestes as mesmas coisas dos vossos próprios compatriotas, como também eles dos judeus;
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros, hermanos, habéis sido imitadores de las iglesias de Dios en Cristo Jesús que están en Judea; pues habéis padecido también vosotros las mismas cosas de los de vuestra propia nación, como también ellos de los Judíos;

verses.KJV: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
verses.WEB: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
verses.ASV: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove out us, and please not God, and are contrary to all men;
verses.ALMEIDA: que também mataram o Senhor Jesus e os seus próprios profetas, e nos perseguiram, e não agradam a Deus, e são contrários a todos:
verses.RVR09: Los cuales aun mataron al Señor Jesús y á sus propios profetas, y á nosotros nos han perseguido; y no agradan á Dios, y se oponen á todos los hombres;

verses.KJV: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.WEB: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
verses.ASV: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always: but the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.ALMEIDA: eles nos impedem de falar aos gentios, para que sejam salvos. Assim eles estão se enchendo constantemente de pecados, mas, por fim, ira veio sobre eles até o fim.
verses.RVR09: Prohibiéndonos hablar á los Gentiles, á fin de que se salven, para henchir la medida de sus pecados siempre: pues vino sobre ellos la ira hasta el extremo.

verses.KJV: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
verses.WEB: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
verses.ASV: But we, brethren, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence not in heart, endeavored the more exceedingly to see your face with great desire:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, irmãos, quando nos separamos de vós por algum tempo, em presença, não no coração, buscamos mais, com muito desejo, ver o vosso rosto;
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros, hermanos, privados de vosotros por un poco de tiempo, de vista, no de corazón, tanto más procuramos con mucho deseo ver vuestro rostro.

verses.KJV: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
verses.WEB: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
verses.ASV: because we would fain have come unto you, I Paul once and again; and Satan hindered us.
verses.ALMEIDA: por isso quisemos, pelo menos eu, Paulo, vos visitar uma vez e outra; mas Satanás nos impediu.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual quisimos ir á vosotros, yo Pablo á la verdad, una vez y otra; mas Satanás nos embarazó.

verses.KJV: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
verses.WEB: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
verses.ASV: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of glorying? Are not even ye, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, qual é nossa esperança, alegria, ou coroa de orgulho, diante do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo na sua vinda? Acaso não sois vós?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿cuál es nuestra esperanza, ó gozo, ó corona de que me gloríe? ¿No sois vosotros, delante de nuestro Señor Jesucristo en su venida?

verses.KJV: For ye are our glory and joy.
verses.WEB: For you are our glory and our joy.
verses.ASV: For ye are our glory and our joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós sois o nosso orgulho e alegria.
verses.RVR09: Que vosotros sois nuestra gloria y gozo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.WEB: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
verses.ASV: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, como não podíamos mais suportar, decidimos ficar sozinhos em Atenas,
verses.RVR09: POR lo cual, no pudiendo esperar más, acordamos quedarnos solos en Atenas,

verses.KJV: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.WEB: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
verses.ASV: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s minister in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort [you] concerning your faith;
verses.ALMEIDA: e enviamos Timóteo, nosso irmão e servidor de Deus, e cooperador nosso no Evangelho de Cristo, para vos fortalecer e vos encorajar quanto a vossa fé;
verses.RVR09: Y enviamos á Timoteo, nuestro hermano, y ministro de Dios, y colaborador nuestro en el evangelio de Cristo, á confirmaros y exhortaros en vuestra fe,

verses.KJV: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
verses.WEB: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
verses.ASV: that no man be moved by these afflictions; for yourselves know that hereunto we are appointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que ninguém se abale por essas aflições; pois vós mesmos sabeis que para isso fomos destinados.
verses.RVR09: Para que nadie se conmueva por estas tribulaciones; porque vosotros sabéis que nosotros somos puestos para esto.

verses.KJV: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.WEB: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
verses.ASV: For verily, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando ainda estávamos convosco vós dizíamos com antecedência que seríamos afligidos, como aconteceu, e vós sabeis.
verses.RVR09: Que aun estando con vosotros, os predecíamos que habíamos de pasar tribulaciones, como ha acontecido y sabéis.

verses.KJV: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.WEB: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
verses.ASV: For this cause I also, when I could no longer forbear, sent that I might know your faith, lest by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor should be in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, como não podia mais suportar, eu [o] enviei para saber de vossa fé. [Eu temia] que o tentador houvesse vos tentado, e o nosso trabalho houvesse sido inútil.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, también yo, no esperando más, he enviado á reconocer vuestra fe, no sea que os haya tentado el tentador, y que nuestro trabajo haya sido en vano.

verses.KJV: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
verses.WEB: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
verses.ASV: But when Timothy came even now unto us from you, and brought us glad tidings of your faith and love, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, longing to see us, even as we also [to see] you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, depois que Timóteo voltou a nós da vossa presença, e nos trouxe boas notícias da vossa fé e amor, e de como sempre tendes boa lembrança de nós, e desejais muito nos ver, como também nós a vós;
verses.RVR09: Empero volviendo de vosotros á nosotros Timoteo, y haciéndonos saber vuestra fe y caridad, y que siempre tenéis buena memoria de nosotros, deseando vernos, como también nosotros á vosotros,

verses.KJV: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.WEB: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
verses.ASV: for this cause, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: por isso, irmãos, ficamos consolados acerca de vós em toda a nossa aflição e necessidade, pela vossa fé.
verses.RVR09: En ello, hermanos, recibimos consolación de vosotros en toda nuestra necesidad y aflicción por causa de vuestra fe:

verses.KJV: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.WEB: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
verses.ASV: for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois agora vivemos, se vós estais firmes no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Porque ahora vivimos, si vosotros estáis firmes en el Señor.

verses.KJV: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
verses.WEB: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
verses.ASV: For what thanksgiving can we render again unto God for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois como agradecemos a Deus por vós, por toda a alegria com que nos alegramos por vossa causa, diante do nosso Deus!
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, ¿qué hacimiento de gracias podremos dar á Dios por vosotros, por todo el gozo con que nos gozamos á causa de vosotros delante de nuestro Dios,

verses.KJV: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.WEB: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.ASV: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.ALMEIDA: E de noite e de dia com extrema intensidade oramos para que possamos ver o vosso rosto, e supramos o que falta na vossa fé.
verses.RVR09: Orando de noche y de día con grande instancia, que veamos vuestro rostro, y que cumplamos lo que falta á vuestra fe?

verses.KJV: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
verses.WEB: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
verses.ASV: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way unto you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que o mesmo Deus, nosso Pai, e o nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, preparem o nosso caminho até vós.
verses.RVR09: Mas el mismo Dios y Padre nuestro, y el Señor nuestro Jesucristo, encamine nuestro viaje á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
verses.WEB: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
verses.ASV: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also [do] toward you;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor vos faça crescer e exceder em amor uns pelos outros, e por todos, à semelhança de nós por vós;
verses.RVR09: Y á vosotros multiplique el Señor, y haga abundar el amor entre vosotros, y para con todos, como es también de nosotros para con vosotros;

verses.KJV: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
verses.WEB: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
verses.ASV: to the end he may establish your hearts unblamable in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que fortaleça os vossos corações, irrepreensíveis em santidade diante do nosso Deus e Pai, na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo com todos os seus santos.
verses.RVR09: Para que sean confirmados vuestros corazones en santidad, irreprensibles delante de Dios y nuestro Padre, para la venida de nuestro Señor Jesucristo con todos sus santos.

verses.KJV: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
verses.WEB: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
verses.ASV: Finally then, brethren, we beseech and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that, as ye received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, even as ye do walk,—that ye abound more and more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, no restante, vos rogamos e exortamos no Senhor Jesus, que, assim como recebestes de nós como deveis andar e agradar a Deus, que façais [assim] cada vez mais.
verses.RVR09: RESTA pues, hermanos, que os roguemos y exhortemos en el Señor Jesús, que de la manera que fuisteis enseñados de nosotros de cómo os conviene andar, y agradar á Dios, así vayáis creciendo.

verses.KJV: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
verses.WEB: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.ASV: For ye know what charge we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós sabeis quais mandamentos vos demos pelo Senhor Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya sabéis qué mandamientos os dimos por el Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
verses.WEB: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
verses.ASV: For this is the will of God, [even] your sanctification, that ye abstain from fornication;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esta é a vontade de Deus: a vossa santificação, que não pratiqueis pecado sexual;
verses.RVR09: Porque la voluntad de Dios es vuestra santificación: que os apartéis de fornicación;

verses.KJV: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
verses.WEB: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
verses.ASV: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
verses.ALMEIDA: que cada um de vós saiba ser ter o seu instrumento em santidade e honra;
verses.RVR09: Que cada uno de vosotros sepa tener su vaso en santificación y honor;

verses.KJV: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
verses.WEB: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
verses.ASV: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who know not God;
verses.ALMEIDA: não na paixão do desejo malicioso, como os gentios que não conhecem Deus.
verses.RVR09: No con afecto de concupiscencia, como los Gentiles que no conocen á Dios:

verses.KJV: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
verses.WEB: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
verses.ASV: that no man transgress, and wrong his brother in the matter: because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém oprima ou engane ao seu irmão nisso, porque o Senhor é vingador de todas essas coisas, como também antes vos dissemos e demos testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Que ninguno oprima, ni engañe en nada á su hermano: porque el Señor es vengador de todo esto, como ya os hemos dicho y protestado.

verses.KJV: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
verses.WEB: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
verses.ASV: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus não nos chamou para a impureza, mas sim para a santificação.
verses.RVR09: Porque no nos ha llamado Dios á inmundicia, sino á santificación.

verses.KJV: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
verses.WEB: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
verses.ASV: Therefore he that rejecteth, rejecteth not man, but God, who giveth his Holy Spirit unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto quem rejeita [isso] , rejeita não ao ser humano, mas sim a Deus, que nos deu também o seu Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Así que, el que menosprecia, no menosprecia á hombre, sino á Dios, el cual también nos dió su Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
verses.WEB: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
verses.ASV: But concerning love of the brethren ye have no need that one write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quanto ao amor fraternal, não precisais que eu vos escreva, pois vós mesmos estais instruídos por Deus que vos ameis uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Mas acerca de la caridad fraterna no habéis menester que os escriba: porque vosotros mismos habéis aprendido de Dios que os améis los unos á los otros;

verses.KJV: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
verses.WEB: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
verses.ASV: for indeed ye do it toward all the brethren that are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brethren, that ye abound more and more;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, de fato, [já] fazeis assim a todos os irmãos de toda a Macedônia. Porém, irmãos, vos exortamos que façais[isso] ainda mais.
verses.RVR09: Y también lo hacéis así con todos los hermanos que están por toda Macedonia. Empero os rogamos, hermanos, que abundéis más;

verses.KJV: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
verses.WEB: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
verses.ASV: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your hands, even as we charged you;
verses.ALMEIDA: E procurai viver quietos, trantando dos vossos próprios assuntos, e trabalhando com as vossas próprias mãos, como já vos mandamos;
verses.RVR09: Y que procuréis tener quietud, y hacer vuestros negocios, y obréis de vuestras manos de la manera que os hemos mandado;

verses.KJV: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
verses.WEB: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
verses.ASV: that ye may walk becomingly toward them that are without, and may have need of nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que andeis de maneira respeitosa com os que estão de fora, e não necessiteis de nada.
verses.RVR09: A fin de que andéis honestamente para con los extraños, y no necesitéis de nada.

verses.KJV: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
verses.WEB: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
verses.ASV: But we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning them that fall asleep; that ye sorrow not, even as the rest, who have no hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas irmãos, não quero que desconheçais acerca dos que morreram, para que não vos entristeçais como os outros que não têm esperança.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco, hermanos, queremos que ignoréis acerca de los que duermen, que no os entristezcáis como los otros que no tienen esperanza.

verses.KJV: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.WEB: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
verses.ASV: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also that are fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se cremos que Jesus morreu e ressuscitou, assim também aos que morreram em Jesus, Deus os trará de volta com ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque si creemos que Jesús murió y resucitó, así también traerá Dios con él á los que durmieron en Jesús.

verses.KJV: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
verses.WEB: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.ASV: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we that are alive, that are left unto the coming of the Lord, shall in no wise precede them that are fallen asleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dizemos isto pela palavra do Senhor, que nós, os que ficarmos vivos até a vinda do Senhor, não iremos antes dos que morreram.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, os decimos esto en palabra del Señor: que nosotros que vivimos, que habremos quedado hasta la venida del Señor, no seremos delanteros á los que durmieron.

verses.KJV: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verses.WEB: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
verses.ASV: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o mesmo Senhor descerá do céu com grande aclamação, com voz de arcanjo, e com trombeta de Deus; e os que morreram em Cristo ressuscitarão primeiro;
verses.RVR09: Porque el mismo Señor con aclamación, con voz de arcángel, y con trompeta de Dios, descenderá del cielo; y los muertos en Cristo resucitarán primero:

verses.KJV: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.WEB: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
verses.ASV: then we that are alive, that are left, shall together with them be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida nós, os que ficarmos vivos, seremos arrebatados juntamente com eles nas nuvens, para encontrar o Senhor no ar, e assim estaremos com o Senhor para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Luego nosotros, los que vivimos, los que quedamos, juntamente con ellos seremos arrebatados en las nubes á recibir al Señor en el aire, y así estaremos siempre con el Señor.

verses.KJV: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.WEB: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.ASV: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto consolai-vos uns aos outros com essas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, consolaos los unos á los otros en estas palabras.

verses.KJV: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
verses.WEB: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
verses.ASV: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas irmãos, acerca dos tempos e das estações, não necessitais de que eu vos escreva;
verses.RVR09: EMPERO acerca de los tiempos y de los momentos, no tenéis, hermanos, necesidad de que yo os escriba:

verses.KJV: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
