verses.WEB: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
verses.ASV: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois vós mesmos bem sabeis que o dia do Senhor virá como um ladrão de noite.
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros sabéis bien, que el día del Señor vendrá así como ladrón de noche,

verses.KJV: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.WEB: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
verses.ASV: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando disserem: “Paz e segurança”, então virá sobre eles repentina destruição, como as dores de parto da grávida, e de maneira nenhuma escaparão.
verses.RVR09: Que cuando dirán, Paz y seguridad, entonces vendrá sobre ellos destrucción de repente, como los dolores á la mujer preñada; y no escaparán.

verses.KJV: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.WEB: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
verses.ASV: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós, irmãos, não estais em trevas, para que aquele dia vos tome de surpresa como um ladrão.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros, hermanos, no estáis en tinieblas, para que aquel día os sobrecoja como ladrón;

verses.KJV: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.WEB: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
verses.ASV: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos vós sois filhos da luz e filhos do dia; não somos da noite nem das trevas.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos vosotros sois hijos de luz, é hijos del día; no somos de la noche, ni de las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.WEB: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
verses.ASV: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não durmamos, como os outros; em vez disso, vigiemos e sejamos sóbrios.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no durmamos como los demás; antes velemos y seamos sobrios.

verses.KJV: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.WEB: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
verses.ASV: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os que dormem, dormem de noite; e os que ficam bêbados embebedam-se de noite.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que duermen, de noche duermen; y los que están borrachos, de noche están borrachos.

verses.KJV: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.WEB: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.ASV: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós, que somos do dia, sejamos sóbrios, e nos vistamos da couraça da fé e do amor, e do capacete da esperança da salvação.
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros, que somos del día, estemos sobrios, vestidos de cota de fe y de caridad, y la esperanza de salud por yelmo.

verses.KJV: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.WEB: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: For God appointed us not unto wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus não nos destinou para a ira, mas, sim, para obtermos a salvação, por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.RVR09: Porque no nos ha puesto Dios para ira, sino para alcanzar salud por nuestro Señor Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.WEB: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.ASV: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: que morreu por nós, a fim de que, se estivermos vigiando ou dormindo, nós vivamos juntamente com ele.
verses.RVR09: El cual murió por nosotros, para que ó que velemos, ó que durmamos, vivamos juntamente con él.

verses.KJV: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
verses.WEB: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
verses.ASV: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto exortai-vos uns aos outros, e edificai-vos uns aos outros, como já fazeis.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, consolaos los unos á los otros, y edificaos los unos á los otros, así como lo hacéis.

verses.KJV: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.WEB: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
verses.ASV: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, nós vos rogamos que reconheçais os que trabalham entre vós, e que lideram sobre vós no Senhor, e vos advertem;
verses.RVR09: Y os rogamos, hermanos, que reconozcáis á los que trabajan entre vosotros, y os presiden en el Señor, y os amonestan:

verses.KJV: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
verses.WEB: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.ASV: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: e os estimai muito com amor, por causa do trabalho deles. Tende paz entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Y que los tengáis en mucha estima por amor de su obra. Tened paz los unos con los otros.

verses.KJV: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
verses.WEB: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
verses.ASV: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogamo-vos também, irmãos, que advirtais os desordeiros, consoleis os de pouco ânimo, apoieis aos fracos, e tenhais paciência com todos.
verses.RVR09: También os rogamos, hermanos, que amonestéis á los que andan desordenadamente, que consoléis á los de poco ánimo, que soportéis á los flacos, que seáis sufridos para con todos.

verses.KJV: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
verses.WEB: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
verses.ASV: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tende cuidado para que ninguém retribua o mal com o mal, mas sempre segui o bem, tanto uns com os outros, como com todos.
verses.RVR09: Mirad que ninguno dé á otro mal por mal; antes seguid lo bueno siempre los unos para con los otros, y para con todos.

verses.KJV: Rejoice evermore.
verses.WEB: Always rejoice.
verses.ASV: Rejoice always;
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos sempre.
verses.RVR09: Estad siempre gozosos.

verses.KJV: Pray without ceasing.
verses.WEB: Pray without ceasing.
verses.ASV: pray without ceasing;
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai sem cessar.
verses.RVR09: Orad sin cesar.

verses.KJV: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.WEB: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
verses.ASV: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei em tudo, pois essa é a vontade de Deus em Cristo Jesus para vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Dad gracias en todo; porque esta es la voluntad de Dios para con vosotros en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: Quench not the Spirit.
verses.WEB: Don’t quench the Spirit.
verses.ASV: Quench not the Spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não apagueis o Espírito.
verses.RVR09: No apaguéis el Espíritu.

verses.KJV: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.WEB: Don’t despise prophecies.
verses.ASV: despise not prophesyings;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não desprezeis as profecias.
verses.RVR09: No menospreciéis las profecías.

verses.KJV: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.WEB: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
verses.ASV: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;
verses.ALMEIDA: Examinai tudo, e mantende o que é bom.
verses.RVR09: Examinadlo todo; retened lo bueno.

verses.KJV: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.WEB: Abstain from every form of evil.
verses.ASV: abstain from every form of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não haja entre vós qualquer forma de mal.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos de toda especie de mal.

verses.KJV: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o próprio Deus da paz vos santifique em tudo; e que todo o vosso espírito, alma e corpo sejam preservados irrepreensíveis na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios de paz os santifique en todo; para que vuestro espíritu y alma y cuerpo sea guardado entero sin reprensión para la venida de nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
verses.WEB: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
verses.ASV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiel é aquele que vos chama, e ele também [o] fará.
verses.RVR09: Fiel es el que os ha llamado; el cual también lo hará.

verses.KJV: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.WEB: Brothers, pray for us.
verses.ASV: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, orai por nós.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, orad por nosotros.

verses.KJV: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.WEB: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
verses.ASV: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai a todos os irmãos com beijo santo.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á todos los hermanos en ósculo santo.

verses.KJV: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
verses.WEB: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
verses.ASV: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos mando pelo Senhor que esta carta seja lida a todos os santos irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Conjúroos por el Señor, que esta carta sea leída á todos los santos hermanos.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo [seja] convosco. Amém. [A primeira carta aos tessalonicenses foi escrita de Atenas]
verses.RVR09: La gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea con vosotros. Amén. La primera epístola á los Tesalonicenses fué escrita de Atenas.

verses.KJV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.ASV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, e Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus nosso Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: PABLO, y Silvano, y Timoteo, á la iglesia de los Tesalonicenses que es en Dios nuestro Padre y en el Señor Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Haja entre vós] graça e paz de nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Gracia y paz á vosotros de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
verses.WEB: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
verses.ASV: We are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós sempre devemos dar graças a Deus por vós, irmãos, como é o correto, porque vossa fé cresce muito, e o amor de cada um de todos vós pelos outros é cada vez maior;
verses.RVR09: Debemos siempre dar gracias á Dios de vosotros, hermanos, como es digno, por cuanto vuestra fe va creciendo, y la caridad de cada uno de todos vosotros abunda entre vosotros;

verses.KJV: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
verses.WEB: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
verses.ASV: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que nós mesmos nos orgulhamos de vós nas igrejas de Deus, por causa de vossa paciência e fé, em todas as vossas perseguições aflições que suportais;
verses.RVR09: Tanto, que nosotros mismos nos gloriamos de vosotros en las iglesias de Dios, de vuestra paciencia y fe en todas vuestras persecuciones y tribulaciones que sufrís:

verses.KJV: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
verses.WEB: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
verses.ASV: [which is] a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Que é] prova clara do justo julgamento de Deus, para que sejais considerados dignos do Reino de Deus, pelo qual também sofreis;
verses.RVR09: Una demostración del justo juicio de Dios, para que seáis tenidos por dignos del reino de Dios, por el cual asimismo padecéis.

verses.KJV: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
verses.WEB: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
verses.ASV: if so be that it is a righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois é justo diante de Deus pagar com aflição aos que vos afligem;
verses.RVR09: Porque es justo para con Dios pagar con tribulación á los que os atribulan.

verses.KJV: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.WEB: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
verses.ASV: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a vós que sois afligidos, alívio conosco, quando o Senhor Jesus aparecer do céu com os anjos de seu poder,
verses.RVR09: Y á vosotros, que sois atribulados, dar reposo con nosotros, cuando se manifestará el Señor Jesús del cielo con los ángeles de su potencia,

verses.KJV: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
verses.ASV: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: Com labareda de fogo, vingando os que não conhecem a Deus, e os que não obedecem ao Evangelho do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.RVR09: En llama de fuego, para dar el pago á los que no conocieron á Dios, ni obedecen al evangelio de nuestro Señor Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
verses.WEB: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
verses.ASV: who shall suffer punishment, [even] eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais serão punidos com o castigo da eterna perdição, [longe] da face do Senhor, e da glória de sua força;
verses.RVR09: Los cuales serán castigados de eterna perdición por la presencia del Señor, y por la gloria de su potencia,

verses.KJV: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.WEB: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
verses.ASV: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele vier para ser glorificado em seus santos, e naquele dia se fazer admirável em todos os que creem (porque nosso testemunho entre vós foi crido).
verses.RVR09: Cuando viniere para ser glorificado en sus santos, y á hacerse admirable en aquel día en todos los que creyeron: (por cuanto nuestro testimonio ha sido creído entre vosotros.)

verses.KJV: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
verses.WEB: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
verses.ASV: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and [every] work of faith, with power;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que também sempre rogamos por vós, que nosso Deus vos faça dignos do chamamento, e cumpra todo bom desejo e a obra da fé com poder.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, asimismo oramos siempre por vosotros, que nuestro Dios os tenga por dignos de su vocación, é hincha de bondad todo buen intento, y toda obra de fe con potencia,

verses.KJV: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que o nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja glorificado em vós, e vós nele, segundo a graça de nosso Deus, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Para que el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea glorificado en vosotros, y vosotros en él, por la gracia de nuestro Dios y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
verses.WEB: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
verses.ASV: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora irmãos, nós vos rogamos quanto à vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e à nossa reunião com ele,
verses.RVR09: EMPERO os rogamos, hermanos, cuanto á la venida de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, y nuestro recogimiento á él,

verses.KJV: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
verses.WEB: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
verses.ASV: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que vós não vos abaleis facilmente em [vosso] entendimento, e não [vos] perturbeis, nem por espírito, nem por palavra, nem por carta como que [escrita] por nós, como se o dia de Cristo [já] estivesse perto.
verses.RVR09: Que no os mováis fácilmente de vuestro sentimiento, ni os conturbéis ni por espíritu, ni por palabra, ni por carta como nuestra, como que el día del Señor esté cerca.

verses.KJV: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.WEB: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
verses.ASV: let no man beguile you in any wise: for [it will not be], except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém vos engane em maneira nenhuma; porque [não virá esse dia] sem que primeiro venha a apostasia, e se manifeste o homem do pecado, o filho da perdição.
verses.RVR09: No os engañe nadie en ninguna manera; porque no vendrá sin que venga antes la apostasía, y se manifieste el hombre de pecado, el hijo de perdición,

verses.KJV: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
verses.WEB: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
verses.ASV: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual se opõe e se levanta sobre tudo o que se chama Deus, ou [sobre] tudo que é adorado; por isso ele se sentará no templo de Deus, como [se fosse] Deus, fazendo-se parecer Deus.
verses.RVR09: Oponiéndose, y levantándose contra todo lo que se llama Dios, ó que se adora; tanto que se asiente en el templo de Dios como Dios, haciéndose parecer Dios.

verses.KJV: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.WEB: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
verses.ASV: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos lembrais, que enquanto ainda estava convosco, eu vos dizia estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: ¿No os acordáis que cuando estaba todavía con vosotros, os decía esto?

verses.KJV: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.WEB: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
verses.ASV: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora sabeis o que o detém, para que a seu próprio tempo seja manifestado.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora vosotros sabéis lo que impide, para que á su tiempo se manifieste.

verses.KJV: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.WEB: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
verses.ASV: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only [there is] one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o mistério da injustiça já opera; só [há] aquele que agora o detém, até que seja [tirado] do meio.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya está obrando el misterio de iniquidad: solamente espera hasta que sea quitado de en medio el que ahora impide;

verses.KJV: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.WEB: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
verses.ASV: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;
verses.ALMEIDA: E então será manifestado aquele injusto, ao qual o Senhor destruirá, pelo sopro de sua boca, e o aniquilará pelo aparecimento de sua vinda;
verses.RVR09: Y entonces será manifestado aquel inicuo, al cual el Señor matará con el espíritu de su boca, y destruirá con el resplandor de su venida;

verses.KJV: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.WEB: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.ASV: [even he], whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Aquele injusto] cuja vinda é conforme o agir de Satanás, com todo poder, e sinais, e milagres falsos.
verses.RVR09: A aquel inicuo, cuyo advenimiento es según operación de Satanás, con grande potencia, y señales, y milagros mentirosos,

verses.KJV: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.WEB: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.ASV: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com todo engano de injustiça nos que perecem; porque não receberam o amor da verdade para se salvarem.
verses.RVR09: Y con todo engaño de iniquidad en los que perecen; por cuanto no recibieron el amor de la verdad para ser salvos.

verses.KJV: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.WEB: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
verses.ASV: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:
verses.ALMEIDA: E por isso Deus lhes enviará a ação do erro, para que creiam na mentira.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pues, les envía Dios operación de error, para que crean á la mentira;

verses.KJV: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.WEB: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.ASV: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que sejam condenados todos os que não creram na verdade, mas tiveram prazer na injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Para que sean condenados todos los que no creyeron á la verdad, antes consintieron á la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.WEB: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
verses.ASV: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sempre devemos dar graças a Deus por vós, irmãos, que sois amados pelo Senhor, pois Deus vos escolheu desde o princípio para a salvação, em santificação do Espírito, e fé na verdade;
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros debemos dar siempre gracias á Dios por vosotros, hermanos amados del Señor, de que Dios os haya escogido desde el principio para salud, por la santificación del Espíritu y fe de la verdad:

verses.KJV: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para a qual ele vos chamou por meio do nosso Evangelho, para a obtenção da glória de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: A lo cual os llamó por nuestro evangelio, para alcanzar la gloria de nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.WEB: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
verses.ASV: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, ficai firmes, e retende as tradições que vos foram ensinadas, seja por palavra, seja por carta nossa.
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos, estad firmes, y retened la doctrina que habéis aprendido, sea por palabra, ó por carta nuestra.

verses.KJV: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.WEB: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
verses.ASV: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele mesmo, o nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e nosso Deus e Pai, que nos amou e em graça nos deu uma eterna consolação e boa esperança;
verses.RVR09: Y el mismo Señor nuestro Jesucristo, y Dios y Padre nuestro, el cual nos amó, y nos dió consolación eterna, y buena esperanza por gracia,

verses.KJV: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.WEB: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
verses.ASV: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele console vossos corações, e vos fortaleça em toda boa palavra e obra.
verses.RVR09: Consuele vuestros corazones, y os confirme en toda buena palabra y obra.

verses.KJV: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
verses.WEB: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
verses.ASV: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also [it is] with you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas demais coisas, irmãos, rogai por nós, para que a palavra do Senhor continue seu percurso, e seja glorificada, assim como também entre vós;
verses.RVR09: RESTA, hermanos, que oréis por nosotros, que la palabra del Señor corra y sea glorificada así como entre vosotros:

verses.KJV: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
verses.WEB: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
verses.ASV: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para que sejamos livres de homens corruptos e maus, porque a fé não [é] de todos.
verses.RVR09: Y que seamos librados de hombres importunos y malos; porque no es de todos la fe.

verses.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.WEB: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.ASV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil [one].
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas fiel é o Senhor, que vos fortalecerá e vos guardará do maligno.
verses.RVR09: Mas fiel es el Señor, que os confirmará y guardará del mal.

verses.KJV: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.WEB: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
verses.ASV: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.
verses.ALMEIDA: E confiamos no Senhor quanto a vós, de que vós estais fazendo e continuareis a fazer o que vos mandamos.
verses.RVR09: Y tenemos confianza de vosotros en el Señor, que hacéis y haréis lo que os hemos mandado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
verses.WEB: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
verses.ASV: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor guie vossos corações para o amor de Deus e a paciência de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Y el Señor enderece vuestros corazones en el amor de Dios, y en la paciencia de Cristo.

verses.KJV: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.WEB: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
verses.ASV: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós vos mandamos, irmãos, no nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que mantenhais distância de todo irmão que anda desordenadamente, e não segundo a tradição que recebeu de nós.
verses.RVR09: Empero os denunciamos, hermanos, en el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, que os apartéis de todo hermano que anduviere fuera de orden, y no conforme á la doctrina que recibieron de nosotros:

verses.KJV: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.WEB: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
verses.ASV: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós mesmos sabeis como deveis nos imitar; porque nós não fomos desordenados entre vós;
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros mismos sabéis de qué manera debéis imitarnos: porque no anduvimos desordenadamente entre vosotros,

verses.KJV: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.WEB: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
verses.ASV: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man’s hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem comemos de graça o pão de qualquer um, mas sim com trabalho e cansaço trabalhamos de noite e de dia, para não sermos incômodos a nenhum de vós.
verses.RVR09: Ni comimos el pan de ninguno de balde; antes, obrando con trabajo y fatiga de noche y de día, por no ser gravosos á ninguno de vosotros;

verses.KJV: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.WEB: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
verses.ASV: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não porque não tivéssemos autoridade [para fazer isso] , mas porque nós mesmos dávamos exemplo a vós, para [assim] nos imitardes.
verses.RVR09: No porque no tuviésemos potestad, sino por daros en nosotros un dechado, para que nos imitaseis.

verses.KJV: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.WEB: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
verses.ASV: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, quando ainda estávamos convosco, isto vos mandamos: que se alguém não quiser trabalhar, também não coma.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun estando con vosotros, os denunciábamos esto: Que si alguno no quisiere trabajar, tampoco coma.

verses.KJV: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.WEB: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
verses.ASV: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ouvimos que alguns entre vós andam desordenadamente, não trabalhando, mas se intrometendo no que os outros fazem.
verses.RVR09: Porque oímos que andan algunos entre vosotros fuera de orden, no trabajando en nada, sino ocupados en curiosear.

verses.KJV: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.WEB: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
verses.ASV: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos tais mandamos e exortamos, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que trabalhem sem causar incômodo, e comam seu próprio pão.
verses.RVR09: Y á los tales requerimos y rogamos por nuestro Señor Jesucristo, que, trabajando con reposo, coman su pan.

verses.KJV: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.WEB: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
verses.ASV: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós, irmãos, não vos canseis de fazer o bem.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros, hermanos, no os canséis de hacer bien.

verses.KJV: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.WEB: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
verses.ASV: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alguém não obedecer à nossa palavra [contida] nesta carta, adverti-o, e não vos mistureis com ele, para que ele se envergonhe;
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno no obedeciere á nuestra palabra por carta, notad al tal, y no os juntéis con él, para que se avergüence.

verses.KJV: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.WEB: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.ASV: And [yet] count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não o considereis como inimigo, mas alertai [-o] como um irmão.
verses.RVR09: Mas no lo tengáis como á enemigo, sino amonestadle como á hermano.

verses.KJV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
verses.WEB: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
verses.ASV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o mesmo Senhor da paz vos dê sempre paz em toda maneira. O Senhor [seja] com todos vós.
verses.RVR09: Y el mismo Señor de paz os dé siempre paz en toda manera. El Señor sea con todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.WEB: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
verses.ASV: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.ALMEIDA: A saudação de minha própria mão, Paulo, que é [minha] assinatura em toda carta; assim escrevo.
verses.RVR09: Salud de mi mano, Pablo, que es mi signo en toda carta mía: así escribo.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo [seja] com todos vós. Amém. [A segunda carta aos tessalonicenses foi escrita de Atenas]
verses.RVR09: La gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea con todos vosotros. Amén. La segunda Epístola á los Tesalonicenses fué escrita de Atenas.

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Saviour, and Christ Jesus our hope;
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo segundo o mandado de Deus, nosso Salvador, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nossa esperança.
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la ordenación de Dios nuestro Salvador, y del Señor Jesucristo, nuestra esperanza;

verses.KJV: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.WEB: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: unto Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para Timóteo, [meu] verdadeiro filho na fé. Graça, misericórdia [e] paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: A Timoteo, verdadero hijo en la fe: Gracia, misericordia y paz de Dios nuestro Padre, y de Cristo Jesús nuestro Señor.

verses.KJV: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.WEB: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
verses.ASV: As I exhorted thee to tarry at Ephesus, when I was going into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como te roguei quando eu estava indo à Macedônia, fica em Éfeso, para advertires a alguns que não ensinem outra doutrina,
verses.RVR09: Como te rogué que te quedases en Efeso, cuando partí para Macedonia, para que requirieses á algunos que no enseñen diversa doctrina,

verses.KJV: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.WEB: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.
verses.ASV: neither to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questionings, rather than a dispensation of God which is in faith; [so do I now].
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem prestem atenção a mitos nem a genealogias intermináveis, que mais produzem discussões que a edificação da parte de Deus na fé.
verses.RVR09: Ni presten atención á fábulas y genealogías sin término, que antes engendran cuestiones que la edificación de Dios que es por fe; así te encargo ahora.

verses.KJV: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.WEB: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
verses.ASV: But the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and faith unfeigned:
verses.ALMEIDA: O fim do mandamento é o amor que vem de um coração puro, e de uma boa consciência, e de uma fé não fingida.
verses.RVR09: Pues el fin del mandamiento es la caridad nacida de corazón limpio, y de buena conciencia, y de fe no fingida:

verses.KJV: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.WEB: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
verses.ASV: from which things some having swerved have turned aside unto vain talking;
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguns se desviaram dessas coisas, e se entregaram a discursos inúteis;
verses.RVR09: De lo cual distrayéndose algunos, se apartaron á vanas pláticas;

verses.KJV: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.WEB: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.
verses.ASV: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor whereof they confidently affirm.
verses.ALMEIDA: querendo ser mestres da Lei, mas não entendendo, nem o que dizem, nem o que afirmam.
verses.RVR09: Queriendo ser doctores de la ley, sin entender ni lo que hablan, ni lo que afirman.

verses.KJV: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.WEB: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
verses.ASV: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós, porém, sabemos que a Lei é boa, se alguém usa dela legitimamente;
verses.RVR09: Sabemos empero que la ley es buena, si alguno usa de ella legítimamente;

verses.KJV: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.WEB: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.ASV: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and unruly, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.ALMEIDA: pois sabemos isto: que a Lei não foi feita para o justo, mas sim, para os injustos e insubordinados, para os ímpios e pecadores, para os irreligiosos e profanos, para os matadores dos pais e das mães, para os homicidas,
verses.RVR09: Conociendo esto, que la ley no es puesta para el justo, sino para los injustos y para los desobedientes, para los impíos y pecadores, para los malos y profanos, para los parricidas y matricidas, para los homicidas,

verses.KJV: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.WEB: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
verses.ASV: for fornicators, for abusers of themselves with men, for menstealers, for liars, for false swearers, and if there be any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;
verses.ALMEIDA: para os que cometem pecados sexuais, para os homens que efetuam sexualidade com homens, para os que roubam a liberdade das pessoas, para os mentirosos, para os que juram falsamente, e qualquer outra coisa contrária à sã doutrina,
verses.RVR09: Para los fornicarios, para los sodomitas, para los ladrones de hombres, para los mentirosos y perjuros, y si hay alguna otra cosa contraria á la sana doctrina;

verses.KJV: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.WEB: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.ASV: according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.ALMEIDA: conforme o evangelho da glória do Deus bendito, que foi confiado a mim.
verses.RVR09: Según el evangelio de la gloria del Dios bendito, el cual á mí me ha sido encargado.

verses.KJV: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.WEB: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
verses.ASV: I thank him that enabled me, [even] Christ Jesus our Lord, for that he counted me faithful, appointing me to [his] service;
verses.ALMEIDA: E agradeço àquele que tem me fortalecido, Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor, porque me considerou fiel, pondo-me no serviço.
verses.RVR09: Y doy gracias al que me fortificó, á Cristo Jesús nuestro Señor, de que me tuvo por fiel, poniéndome en el ministerio:

verses.KJV: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.WEB: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.ASV: though I was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: howbeit I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief;
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes eu era um blasfemo, perseguidor, e opressor; porém recebi misericórdia, pois foi por ignorância que eu agia com incredulidade.
verses.RVR09: Habiendo sido antes blasfemo y perseguidor é injuriador: mas fuí recibido á misericordia, porque lo hice con ignorancia en incredulidad.

verses.KJV: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: and the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo foi mais abundante, com a fé e amor que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Mas la gracia de nuestro Señor fué más abundante con la fe y amor que es en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.WEB: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
verses.ASV: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é uma palavra fiel e digna de toda aceitação: que Cristo Jesus veio ao mundo para salvar os pecadores, dos quais eu sou o principal.
verses.RVR09: Palabra fiel y digna de ser recibida de todos: que Cristo Jesús vino al mundo para salvar á los pecadores, de los cuales yo soy el primero.

verses.KJV: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.WEB: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
verses.ASV: howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me as chief might Jesus Christ show forth all his longsuffering, for an ensample of them that should thereafter believe on him unto eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas por isso me foi concedida misericórdia, para que em mim, o principal, Jesus Cristo mostrasse toda a sua paciência como exemplo aos que haviam de crer nele para a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Mas por esto fuí recibido á misericordia, para que Jesucristo mostrase en mí el primero toda su clemencia, para ejemplo de los que habían de creer en él para vida eterna.

verses.KJV: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, [be] honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao Rei dos tempos, imortal, invisível, o único Deus sábio,[seja] a honra, e a glória, para todo o sempre, amém!
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, al Rey de siglos, inmortal, invisible, al solo sabio Dios sea honor y gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.WEB: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
verses.ASV: This charge I commit unto thee, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to thee, that by them thou mayest war the good warfare;
verses.ALMEIDA: Este mandamento, filho Timóteo, te dou: que, conforme as profecias antes feitas acerca de ti, que batalhes por elas a boa batalha;
verses.RVR09: Este mandamiento, hijo Timoteo, te encargo, para que, conforme á las profecías pasadas de ti, milites por ellas buena milicia;

verses.KJV: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.WEB: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
verses.ASV: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust from them made shipwreck concerning the faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: mantendo a fé e a boa consciência, que alguns rejeitaram, e naufragaram na fé.
verses.RVR09: Manteniendo la fe y buena conciencia, la cual echando de sí algunos, hicieron naufragio en la fe:

verses.KJV: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.WEB: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.ASV: of whom is Hymenæus and Alexander; whom I delivered unto Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dentre esses foram Himeneu e Alexandre. Eu os entreguei a Satanás, para aprenderem a não blasfemar.
verses.RVR09: De los cuales son Himeneo y Alejandro, los cuales entregué á Satanás, para que aprendan á no blasfemar.

verses.KJV: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.WEB: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
verses.ASV: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu te exorto, antes de tudo, que se façam pedidos, orações, intercessões [e] atos de gratidão por todas as pessoas;
verses.RVR09: AMONESTO pues, ante todas cosas, que se hagan rogativas, oraciones, peticiones, hacimientos de gracias, por todos los hombres;

verses.KJV: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.WEB: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
verses.ASV: for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.
verses.ALMEIDA: pelos reis, e por todos os que estão em posição superior, para que tenhamos uma vida quieta e sossegada, em toda devoção divina e honestidade.
verses.RVR09: Por los reyes y por todos los que están en eminencia, para que vivamos quieta y reposadamente en toda piedad y honestidad.

verses.KJV: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.WEB: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
verses.ASV: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois isso é bom e agradável diante de Deus nosso Salvador;
verses.RVR09: Porque esto es bueno y agradable delante de Dios nuestro Salvador;

verses.KJV: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.WEB: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
verses.ASV: who would have all men to be saved, and come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: que quer que todas as pessoas se salvem e venham ao conhecimento da verdade.
verses.RVR09: El cual quiere que todos los hombres sean salvos, y que vengan al conocimiento de la verdad.

verses.KJV: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.WEB: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, [himself] man, Christ Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois [há] um só Deus, e um só Mediador entre Deus e os seres humanos: o humano Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque hay un Dios, asimismo un mediador entre Dios y los hombres, Jesucristo hombre;

verses.KJV: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.WEB: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
verses.ASV: who gave himself a ransom for all; the testimony [to be borne] in its own times;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mesmo se deu como resgate por todos, [como] testemunho ao seu tempo.
verses.RVR09: El cual se dió á sí mismo en precio del rescate por todos, para testimonio en sus tiempos:

verses.KJV: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.WEB: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.ASV: whereunto I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth, I lie not), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para isso fui constituído pregador e apóstolo, instrutor dos gentios na fé e na verdade (estou dizendo a verdade em Cristo, não mentindo).
verses.RVR09: De lo que yo soy puesto por predicador y apóstol, (digo verdad en Cristo, no miento) doctor de los Gentiles en fidelidad y verdad.

verses.KJV: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.WEB: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
verses.ASV: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quero que os homens orem em todo lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira nem briga.
verses.RVR09: Quiero, pues, que los hombres oren en todo lugar, levantando manos limpias, sin ira ni contienda.

verses.KJV: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.WEB: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
verses.ASV: In like manner, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with braided hair, and gold or pearls or costly raiment;
verses.ALMEIDA: De semelhante maneira, as mulheres se adornem com roupa respeitosa, com pudor e sobriedade, não com tranças, ouro, pérolas, ou roupas caras;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo también las mujeres, ataviándose en hábito honesto, con vergüenza y modestia; no con cabellos encrespados, ú oro, ó perlas, ó vestidos costosos,

verses.KJV: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.WEB: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
verses.ASV: but (which becometh women professing godliness) through good works.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas sim, com boas obras, como é adequado às mulheres que declaram reverência a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sino de buenas obras, como conviene á mujeres que profesan piedad.

verses.KJV: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.WEB: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
verses.ASV: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher aprenda quietamente, com toda submissão.
verses.RVR09: La mujer aprenda en silencio, con toda sujeción.

verses.KJV: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.WEB: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
verses.ASV: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não permito que a mulher ensine, nem use de autoridade sobre o marido, mas sim, que esteja em silêncio.
verses.RVR09: Porque no permito á la mujer enseñar, ni tomar autoridad sobre el hombre, sino estar en silencio.

verses.KJV: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.WEB: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
verses.ASV: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois primeiro foi formado Adão, depois Eva.
verses.RVR09: Porque Adam fué formado el primero, después Eva;

verses.KJV: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.WEB: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
verses.ASV: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Adão não foi enganado; mas a mulher foi enganada, e caiu em transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Y Adam no fué engañado, sino la mujer, siendo seducida, vino á ser envuelta en transgresión:

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.WEB: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
verses.ASV: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ela se salvará tendo parto, se permanecerem na fé, amor, e santificação com sobriedade.
verses.RVR09: Empero se salvará engendrando hijos, si permaneciere en la fe y caridad y santidad, con modestia.

verses.KJV: This is a true saying, if a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.WEB: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
verses.ASV: Faithful is the saying, If a man seeketh the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Esta] palavra [é] fiel: se alguém deseja ser bispo, deseja uma excelente obra.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA fiel: Si alguno apetece obispado, buena obra desea.

verses.KJV: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.WEB: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
verses.ASV: The bishop therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, orderly, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.ALMEIDA: É dever, portanto, que o bispo seja irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, sóbrio, comedido, decente, hospitaleiro, apto para ensinar;
verses.RVR09: Conviene, pues, que el obispo sea irreprensible, marido de una mujer, solícito, templado, compuesto, hospedador, apto para enseñar;

verses.KJV: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.WEB: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
verses.ASV: no brawler, no striker; but gentle, not contentious, no lover of money;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dado ao vinho, não violento, não ganancioso, mas sim moderado, não briguento, não cobiçoso por dinheiro;
verses.RVR09: No amador del vino, no heridor, no codicioso de torpes ganancias, sino moderado, no litigioso, ajeno de avaricia;

verses.KJV: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.WEB: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
verses.ASV: one that ruleth well his own house, having [his] children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.ALMEIDA: que governe bem a sua própria casa, e tenha os [seus] filhos em submissão com toda dignidade.
verses.RVR09: Que gobierne bien su casa, que tenga sus hijos en sujeción con toda honestidad;

verses.KJV: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.WEB: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
verses.ASV: (but if a man knoweth not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois, se alguém não sabe governar a sua própria casa, como cuidará da igreja de Deus?)
verses.RVR09: (Porque el que no sabe gobernar su casa, ¿cómo cuidará de la iglesia de Dios?)

verses.KJV: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.WEB: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
verses.ASV: not a novice, lest being puffed up he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não um novo convertido; para que não se torne arrogante, e caia na condenação do diabo.
verses.RVR09: No un neófito, porque inflándose no caiga en juicio del diablo.

verses.KJV: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.WEB: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.ASV: Moreover he must have good testimony from them that are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: É dever também que tenha bom testemunho dos que estão de fora, para que não caia em reprovação pública e na cilada do diabo.
verses.RVR09: También conviene que tenga buen testimonio de los extraños, porque no caiga en afrenta y en lazo del diablo.

verses.KJV: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.WEB: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
verses.ASV: Deacons in like manner [must be] grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira semelhante, os diáconos sejam de boa conduta, não contraditórios, não dados a muito vinho, não cobiçosos de ganho desonesto,
verses.RVR09: Los diáconos asimismo, deben ser honestos, no bilingües, no dados á mucho vino, no amadores de torpes ganancias;

verses.KJV: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.WEB: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.ASV: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas mantenham o mistério da fé em consciência pura.
verses.RVR09: Que tengan el misterio de la fe con limpia conciencia.

verses.KJV: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.WEB: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
verses.ASV: And let these also first be proved; then let them serve as deacons, if they be blameless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também esses sejam primeiro testados, depois sirvam, se forem irrepreensíveis.
verses.RVR09: Y éstos también sean antes probados; y así ministren, si fueren sin crimen.

verses.KJV: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.WEB: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
verses.ASV: Women in like manner [must be] grave, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: De semelhante maneira, as mulheres [sejam] de boa conduta, não maldizentes, sóbrias, [e] fiéis em todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: Las mujeres asimismo, honestas, no detractoras, templadas, fieles en todo.

verses.KJV: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.WEB: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.ASV: Let deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling [their] children and their own houses well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os diáconos sejam maridos de uma mulher, e governem bem os filhos e as suas próprias casas.
verses.RVR09: Los diáconos sean maridos de una mujer, que gobiernen bien sus hijos y sus casas.

verses.KJV: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: For they that have served well as deacons gain to themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os que servirem bem obtêm para si uma posição honrosa e muita confiança na fé que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que bien ministraren, ganan para sí buen grado, y mucha confianza en la fe que es en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.WEB: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
verses.ASV: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly;
verses.ALMEIDA: Escrevo-te essas coisas esperando ir a ti em breve;
verses.RVR09: Esto te escribo con esperanza que iré presto á ti:

verses.KJV: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.WEB: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.ASV: but if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how men ought to behave themselves in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas, seu eu demorar, para que saibais como se deve comportar na casa de Deus, que é a igreja do Deus vivo, a coluna e o alicerce da verdade.
verses.RVR09: Y si no fuere tan presto, para que sepas cómo te conviene conversar en la casa de Dios, que es la iglesia del Dios vivo, columna y apoyo de la verdad.

verses.KJV: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.WEB: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
verses.ASV: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness; He who was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the spirit, Seen of angels, Preached among the nations, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, sem dúvida nenhuma, grande é o mistério da devoção divina: Deus foi revelado em carne, justificado em Espírito, visto pelos anjos, pregado aos gentios, crido no mundo, e recebido acima em glória.
verses.RVR09: Y sin contradicción, grande es el misterio de la piedad: Dios ha sido manifestado en carne; ha sido justificado con el Espíritu; ha sido visto de los ángeles; ha sido predicado á los Gentiles; ha sido creído en el mundo; ha sido recibido en gloria.

verses.KJV: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.WEB: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
verses.ASV: But the Spirit saith expressly, that in later times some shall fall away from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o Espírito diz expressamente que nos últimos tempos alguns se afastarão da fé, dando atenção a espíritos enganadores, e a doutrinas de demônios,
verses.RVR09: EMPERO el Espíritu dice manifiestamente, que en los venideros tiempos algunos apostatarán de la fe, escuchando á espíritus de error y á doctrinas de demonios;

verses.KJV: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.WEB: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
verses.ASV: through the hypocrisy of men that speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;
verses.ALMEIDA: por meio da hipocrisia de mentirosos, que têm a sua própria consciência cauterizada.
verses.RVR09: Que con hipocresía hablarán mentira, teniendo cauterizada la conciencia.

verses.KJV: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.WEB: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.ASV: forbidding to marry, [and commanding] to abstain from meats, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by them that believe and know the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles proibirão o casamento, e [mandarão] se abster dos alimentos que Deus criou para que sejam usados com gratidão pelos fiéis e pelos que conheceram a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Que prohibirán casarse, y mandarán abstenerse de las viandas que Dios crió para que con hacimiento de gracias participasen de ellas los fieles, y los que han conocido la verdad.

verses.KJV: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.WEB: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
verses.ASV: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois toda criatura de Deus é boa, e não há nada a rejeitar, se for recebida com gratidão.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo lo que Dios crió es bueno, y nada hay que desechar, tomándose con hacimiento de gracias:

verses.KJV: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.WEB: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
verses.ASV: for it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ela é santificada pela palavra de Deus e [pela] oração.
verses.RVR09: Porque por la palabra de Dios y por la oración es santificado.

verses.KJV: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.WEB: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
verses.ASV: If thou put the brethren in mind of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which thou hast followed [until now]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se informares essas coisas aos irmãos, serás um bom servidor de Jesus Cristo, alimentado com as palavras da fé e de boa doutrina que tens seguido.
verses.RVR09: Si esto propusieres á los hermanos, serás buen ministro de Jesucristo, criado en las palabras de la fe y de la buena doctrina, la cual has alcanzado.

verses.KJV: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.WEB: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
verses.ASV: but refuse profane and old wives’ fables. And exercise thyself unto godliness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas rejeita os mitos profanos e de velhas, e exercita-te na devoção divina.
verses.RVR09: Mas las fábulas profanas y de viejas desecha, y ejercítate para la piedad.

verses.KJV: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.WEB: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
verses.ASV: for bodily exercise is profitable for a little; but godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life which now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o exercício do corpo tem pouco proveito; mas a devoção divina é proveitosa para tudo, pois tem as promessas da vida atual e da futura.
verses.RVR09: Porque el ejercicio corporal para poco es provechoso; mas la piedad para todo aprovecha, pues tiene promesa de esta vida presente, y de la venidera.

verses.KJV: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.WEB: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
verses.ASV: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Esta] palavra é fiel, e digna de toda aceitação.
verses.RVR09: Palabra fiel es esta, y digna de ser recibida de todos.

verses.KJV: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
