verses.WEB: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
verses.ASV: For to this end we labor and strive, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of them that believe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois para isto também trabalhamos e somos insultados, porque esperamos o Deus vivo, que é o Salvador de todos, especialmente dos crentes.
verses.RVR09: Que por esto aun trabajamos y sufrimos oprobios, porque esperamos en el Dios viviente, el cual es Salvador de todos los hombres, mayormente de los que creen.

verses.KJV: These things command and teach.
verses.WEB: Command and teach these things.
verses.ASV: These things command and teach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda essas coisas, e ensina.
verses.RVR09: Esto manda y enseña.

verses.KJV: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.WEB: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
verses.ASV: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém despreze a tua juventude, mas sê exemplo aos crentes, na palavra, no comportamento, no amor, em espírito, na fé, e na pureza.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno tenga en poco tu juventud; pero sé ejemplo de los fieles en palabra, en conversación, en caridad, en espíritu, en fe, en limpieza.

verses.KJV: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.WEB: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
verses.ASV: Till I come, give heed to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persiste na leitura, na exortação e no ensino, até que eu venha.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que voy, ocúpate en leer, en exhortar, en enseñar.

verses.KJV: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.WEB: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
verses.ASV: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não desprezes o dom que está em ti, que te foi dado por profecia, com a imposição das mãos dos presbíteros.
verses.RVR09: No descuides el don que está en ti, que te es dado por profecía con la imposición de las manos del presbiterio.

verses.KJV: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.WEB: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
verses.ASV: Be diligent in these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy progress may be manifest unto all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Medita nessas coisas, e nelas te ocupe, para que o teu progresso seja visível por todos.
verses.RVR09: Medita estas cosas; ocúpate en ellas; para que tu aprovechamiento sea manifiesto á todos.

verses.KJV: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.WEB: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.ASV: Take heed to thyself, and to thy teaching. Continue in these things; for in doing this thou shalt save both thyself and them that hear thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem cuidado de ti mesmo e da doutrina; persevera nessas coisas; porque, se fizeres isso, salvarás tanto a ti mesmo como aos que te ouvem.
verses.RVR09: Ten cuidado de ti mismo y de la doctrina; persiste en ello; pues haciendo esto, á ti mismo salvarás y á los que te oyeren.

verses.KJV: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.WEB: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
verses.ASV: Rebuke not an elder, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brethren:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não repreendas ao idoso asperamente, mas exorta-o como a um pai; aos jovens, como a irmãos;
verses.RVR09: NO reprendas al anciano, sino exhórtale como á padre: á los más jóvenes, como á hermanos;

verses.KJV: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.WEB: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
verses.ASV: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
verses.ALMEIDA: às idosas, como a mães; e às moças, como a irmãs, em toda pureza.
verses.RVR09: A las ancianas, como á madres; á las jovencitas, como á hermanas, con toda pureza.

verses.KJV: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.WEB: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
verses.ASV: Honor widows that are widows indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Honra as viúvas que são verdadeiramente viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Honra á las viudas que en verdad son viudas.

verses.KJV: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.WEB: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
verses.ASV: But if any widow hath children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to requite their parents: for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se alguma viúva tiver filhos ou netos, aprendam primeiro a exercer piedade com a sua própria família, e a recompensar os seus pais; porque isso é bom e agradável diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pero si alguna viuda tuviere hijos, ó nietos, aprendan primero á gobernar su casa piadosamente, y á recompensar á sus padres: porque esto es lo honesto y agradable delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.WEB: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
verses.ASV: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, hath her hope set on God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.ALMEIDA: A que é verdadeiramente viúva e desamparada espera em Deus, e persevera noite e dia em rogos e orações.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, la que en verdad es viuda y solitaria, espera en Dios, y es diligente en suplicaciones y oraciones noche y día.

verses.KJV: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.WEB: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
verses.ASV: But she that giveth herself to pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a que se entrega aos prazeres, enquanto vive, está morta.
verses.RVR09: Pero la que vive en delicias, viviendo está muerta.

verses.KJV: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.WEB: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
verses.ASV: These things also command, that they may be without reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda, pois, essas coisas, para que sejam irrepreensíveis.
verses.RVR09: Denuncia pues estas cosas, para que sean sin reprensión.

verses.KJV: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.WEB: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.ASV: But if any provideth not for his own, and specially his own household, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se alguém não cuida dos seus, e principalmente dos de sua própria família, negou a fé, e é pior que um incrédulo.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno no tiene cuidado de los suyos, y mayormente de los de su casa, la fe negó, y es peor que un infiel.

verses.KJV: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.
verses.WEB: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.ASV: Let none be enrolled as a widow under threescore years old, [having been] the wife of one man,
verses.ALMEIDA: A viúva, para ser registrada, não deve ter menos de sessenta anos, e haver sido mulher de um marido.
verses.RVR09: La viuda sea puesta en clase especial, no menos que de sesenta años, que haya sido esposa de un solo marido.

verses.KJV: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.WEB: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
verses.ASV: well reported of for good works; if she hath brought up children, if she hath used hospitality to strangers, if she hath washed the saints’ feet, if she hath relieved the afflicted, if she hath diligently followed every good work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela deve ter testemunho de boas obras: se criou filhos, se foi hospitaleira, se lavou os pés dos santos, se socorreu os aflitos, se seguiu toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Que tenga testimonio en buenas obras; si crió hijos; si ha ejercitado la hospitalidad; si ha lavado los pies de los santos; si ha socorrido á los afligidos; si ha seguido toda buena obra.

verses.KJV: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.WEB: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
verses.ASV: But younger widows refuse: for when they have waxed wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não admitas as viúvas jovens; porque, quando têm desejos sensuais contra Cristo, querem se casar;
verses.RVR09: Pero viudas más jóvenes no admitas: porque después de hacerse licenciosas contra Cristo, quieren casarse.

verses.KJV: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.WEB: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
verses.ASV: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: e têm condenação, por haverem anulado a primeira fé.
verses.RVR09: Condenadas ya, por haber falseado la primera fe.

verses.KJV: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.WEB: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
verses.ASV: And withal they learn also [to be] idle, going about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, além disso, também aprendem a andar ociosas de casa em casa; e não somente ociosas, mas também fofoqueiras e curiosas, falando o que não se deve.
verses.RVR09: Y aun también se acostumbran á ser ociosas, á andar de casa en casa; y no solamente ociosas, sino también parleras y curiosas, hablando lo que no conviene.

verses.KJV: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.WEB: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
verses.ASV: I desire therefore that the younger [widows] marry, bear children, rule the household, give no occasion to the adversary for reviling:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, quero que as mais jovens se casem, gerem filhos, administrem a casa, [e] não deem nenhuma oportunidade ao adversário de maldizer.
verses.RVR09: Quiero pues, que las que son jóvenes se casen, críen hijos, gobiernen la casa; que ninguna ocasión den al adversario para maldecir.

verses.KJV: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.WEB: For already some have turned away after Satan.
verses.ASV: for already some are turned aside after Satan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois algumas já se desviaram e seguiram Satanás.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya algunas han vuelto atrás en pos de Satanás.

verses.KJV: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.WEB: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
verses.ASV: If any woman that believeth hath widows, let her relieve them, and let not the church be burdened; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se algum crente ou alguma crente tem viúvas, que as ajude, e não sobrecarregue a igreja, para que ela possa ajudar as que são de verdade viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Si algún fiel ó alguna fiel tiene viudas, manténgalas, y no sea gravada la iglesia; á fin de que haya lo suficiente para las que de verdad son viudas.

verses.KJV: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.WEB: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
verses.ASV: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os presbíteros [ou: anciãos] que lideram bem sejam estimados como dignos de honra dobrada, principalmente os que trabalham na palavra e na doutrina.
verses.RVR09: Los ancianos que gobiernan bien, sean tenidos por dignos de doblada honra; mayormente los que trabajan en predicar y enseñar.

verses.KJV: For the scripture saith, thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.WEB: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
verses.ASV: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. And, The laborer is worthy of his hire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a Escritura diz: “Ao boi que debulha não atarás a boca”; e: “o trabalhador é digno do seu salário”.
verses.RVR09: Porque la Escritura dice: No embozarás al buey que trilla; y: Digno es el obrero de su jornal.

verses.KJV: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.WEB: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
verses.ASV: Against an elder receive not an accusation, except at [the mouth of] two or three witnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não aceites acusação contra um presbítero, a não ser com duas ou três testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: Contra el anciano no recibas acusación sino con dos ó tres testigos.

verses.KJV: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.WEB: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
verses.ASV: Them that sin reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos que pecarem, repreende-os na presença de todos, para que os outros também tenham temor.
verses.RVR09: A los que pecaren, repréndelos delante de todos, para que los otros también teman.

verses.KJV: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.WEB: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.ASV: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ordeno-te, diante de Deus, do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e dos anjos escolhidos, que guardes essas coisas sem preconceitos, fazendo nada por favoritismo.
verses.RVR09: Te requiero delante de Dios y del Señor Jesucristo, y de sus ángeles escogidos, que guardes estas cosas sin perjuicio de nadie, que nada hagas inclinándote á la una parte.

verses.KJV: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.WEB: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
verses.ASV: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ninguém imponhas as mãos apressadamente, nem participes dos pecados alheios; conserva-te puro.
verses.RVR09: No impongas de ligero las manos á ninguno, ni comuniques en pecados ajenos: consérvate en limpieza.

verses.KJV: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.WEB: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
verses.ASV: Be no longer a drinker of water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não bebas mais [somente] água, mas usa [também] de um pouco de vinho, por causa do teu estômago, e das tuas frequentes enfermidades.
verses.RVR09: No bebas de aquí adelante agua, sino usa de un poco de vino por causa del estómago, y de tus continuas enfermedades.

verses.KJV: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.WEB: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
verses.ASV: Some men’s sins are evident, going before unto judgment; and some men also they follow after.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pecados de algumas pessoas são evidentes antes mesmo do juízo, mas os de algumas são manifestos depois.
verses.RVR09: Los pecados de algunos hombres, antes que vengan ellos á juicio, son manifiestos; mas á otros les vienen después.

verses.KJV: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.WEB: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
verses.ASV: In like manner also there are good works that are evident; and such as are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantemente, também, as boas obras são evidentes; e as que não são assim não se podem esconder.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo las buenas obras antes son manifiestas; y las que son de otra manera, no pueden esconderse.

verses.KJV: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.WEB: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
verses.ASV: Let as many as are servants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os servos que estão sob escravidão estimem aos seus senhores como dignos de toda honra; para que o nome de Deus e a doutrina não sejam blasfemados.
verses.RVR09: TODOS los que están debajo del yugo de servidumbre, tengan á sus señores por dignos de toda honra, porque no sea blasfemado el nombre del Señor y la doctrina.

verses.KJV: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.WEB: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
verses.ASV: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but let them serve them the rather, because they that partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. These things teach and exhort.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que têm senhores crentes não os desprezem por serem irmãos; pelo contrário, que os sirvam melhor, pois os participantes do benefício são crentes e amados. Ensina e exorta estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y los que tienen amos fieles, no los tengan en menos, por ser hermanos; antes sírvanles mejor, por cuanto son fieles y amados, y partícipes del beneficio. Esto enseña y exhorta.

verses.KJV: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.WEB: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
verses.ASV: If any man teacheth a different doctrine, and consenteth not to sound words, [even] the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém ensina doutrina diferente, e não concorda com as sãs palavras do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo e com a doutrina que é conforme a devoção divina,
verses.RVR09: Si alguno enseña otra cosa, y no asiente á sanas palabras de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, y á la doctrina que es conforme á la piedad;

verses.KJV: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.WEB: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
verses.ASV: he is puffed up, knowing nothing, but doting about questionings and disputes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.ALMEIDA: é presunçoso, e nada sabe. Em vez disso, se interessa de maneira doentia por questões e disputas de palavras, das quais nascem invejas, brigas, blasfêmias, suspeitas maldosas,
verses.RVR09: Es hinchado, nada sabe, y enloquece acerca de cuestiones y contiendas de palabras, de las cuales nacen envidias, pleitos, maledicencias, malas sospechas,

verses.KJV: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.WEB: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
verses.ASV: wranglings of men corrupted in mind and bereft of the truth, supposing that godliness is a way of gain.
verses.ALMEIDA: discussões inúteis de pessoas corrompidas de entendimento, e privadas da verdade, que pensam que a devoção divina é um meio de lucrar. Afasta-te dos tais.
verses.RVR09: Porfías de hombres corruptos de entendimiento y privados de la verdad, que tienen la piedad por granjería: apártate de los tales.

verses.KJV: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.WEB: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.ASV: But godliness with contentment is great gain:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas grande lucro é a devoção divina acompanhada de contentamento.
verses.RVR09: Empero grande granjería es la piedad con contentamiento.

verses.KJV: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.WEB: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
verses.ASV: for we brought nothing into the world, for neither can we carry anything out;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nada trouxemos ao mundo, e [é] evidente que nada podemos levar dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque nada hemos traído á este mundo, y sin duda nada podremos sacar.

verses.KJV: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.WEB: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
verses.ASV: but having food and covering we shall be therewith content.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se tivermos alimento e algo com que nos cobrirmos, estejamos contentes com isso.
verses.RVR09: Así que, teniendo sustento y con qué cubrirnos, seamos contentos con esto.

verses.KJV: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.WEB: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
verses.ASV: But they that are minded to be rich fall into a temptation and a snare and many foolish and hurtful lusts, such as drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os que querem ser ricos caem em tentação, armadilha, e em muitos desejos insensatos e nocivos, que afundam as pessoas na destruição e perdição.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que quieren enriquecerse, caen en tentación y lazo, y en muchas codicias locas y dañosas, que hunden á los hombres en perdición y muerte.

verses.KJV: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.WEB: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.ASV: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil: which some reaching after have been led astray from the faith, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o amor ao dinheiro é raiz de todos os tipos de males. Alguns o cobiçam, e então se desviaram da fé, e perfuraram a si mesmos com muitas dores.
verses.RVR09: Porque el amor del dinero es la raíz de todos los males: el cual codiciando algunos, se descaminaron de la fe, y fueron traspasados de muchos dolores.

verses.KJV: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.WEB: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
verses.ASV: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, homem de Deus, foge dessas coisas. Segue a justiça, a devoção divina, a fé, o amor, a paciência, a mansidão.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, oh hombre de Dios, huye de estas cosas, y sigue la justicia, la piedad, la fe, la caridad, la paciencia, la mansedumbre.

verses.KJV: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.WEB: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
verses.ASV: Fight the good fight of the faith, lay hold on the life eternal, whereunto thou wast called, and didst confess the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que lutes a boa luta da fé; agarra a vida eterna para a qual também foste chamado, e confessaste a boa confissão diante de muitas testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: Pelea la buena batalla de la fe, echa mano de la vida eterna, á la cual asimismo eres llamado, habiendo hecho buena profesión delante de muchos testigos.

verses.KJV: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.WEB: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
verses.ASV: I charge thee in the sight of God, who giveth life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed the good confession;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mando-te diante de Deus, que dá vida a todas as coisas, e de Cristo Jesus, que diante de Pôncio Pilatos testemunhou a boa confissão,
verses.RVR09: Te mando delante de Dios, que da vida á todas las cosas, y de Jesucristo, que testificó la buena profesión delante de Poncio Pilato,

verses.KJV: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: that thou keep the commandment, without spot, without reproach, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: que guardes este mandamento sem mancha nem motivo de repreensão, até a aparição do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Que guardes el mandamiento sin mácula ni reprensión, hasta la aparición de nuestro Señor Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.WEB: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
verses.ASV: which in its own times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.ALMEIDA: Essa nos seus tempos mostrará o bendito e único Soberano, o Rei dos reis, e Senhor dos senhores;
verses.RVR09: La cual á su tiempo mostrará el Bienaventurado y solo Poderoso, Rey de reyes, y Señor de señores;

verses.KJV: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.WEB: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
verses.ASV: who only hath immortality, dwelling in light unapproachable; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom [be] honor and power eternal. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: o único a ter imortalidade, e que habita em luz inacessível; aquele a quem nenhum ser humano viu, nem pode ver; a ele seja honra e poder para sempre! Amém.
verses.RVR09: Quien sólo tiene inmortalidad, que habita en luz inaccesible; á quien ninguno de los hombres ha visto ni puede ver: al cual sea la honra y el imperio sempiterno. Amén.

verses.KJV: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.WEB: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
verses.ASV: Charge them that are rich in this present world, that they be not highminded, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos ricos desta era que não sejam soberbos, nem ponham a esperança na incerteza das riquezas, mas sim no Deus vivo, que nos dá abundantemente todas as coisas [que são] para alegria;
verses.RVR09: A los ricos de este siglo manda que no sean altivos, ni pongan la esperanza en la incertidumbre de las riquezas, sino en el Dios vivo, que nos da todas las cosas en abundancia de que gocemos:

verses.KJV: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.WEB: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
verses.ASV: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.ALMEIDA: que façam o bem, sejam ricos em boas obras, dispostos a compartilhar, e generosos.
verses.RVR09: Que hagan bien, que sean ricos en buenas obras, dadivosos, que con facilidad comuniquen;

verses.KJV: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.WEB: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
verses.ASV: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on the life which is [life] indeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: que acumulem para si mesmos um bom fundamento para o futuro, para que obtenham a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Atesorando para sí buen fundamento para lo por venir, que echen mano á la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.WEB: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
verses.ASV: O Timothy, guard that which is committed unto [thee], turning away from the profane babblings and oppositions of the knowledge which is falsely so called;
verses.ALMEIDA: Timóteo, guarda o depósito que [te] foi confiado, evitando conversas vãs e profanas, e controvérsias do que é falsamente chamado de “conhecimento”;
verses.RVR09: Oh Timoteo, guarda lo que se te ha encomendado, evitando las profanas pláticas de vanas cosas, y los argumentos de la falsamente llamada ciencia:

verses.KJV: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
verses.WEB: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.ASV: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: que alguns declararam seguir, e se desviaram da fé. A graça [seja] contigo. Amém. [A primeira carta a Timóteo foi escrita de Laodiceia, que é a principal cidade da Frígia Pacaciana] .
verses.RVR09: La cual profesando algunos, fueron descaminados acerca de la fe. La gracia sea contigo. Amén. La primera epístola á Timoteo fué escrita de Laodicea, que es metrópoli de la Frigia Pacatiana.

verses.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, segundo a promessa da vida que está em Cristo Jesus,
verses.RVR09: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, según la promesa de la vida que es en Cristo Jesús,

verses.KJV: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.WEB: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ASV: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: a Timóteo, [meu] amado filho. Graça, misericórdia, [e] paz, da parte de Deus Pai, e de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: A Timoteo, amado hijo: Gracia, misericordia, y paz de Dios el Padre y de Jesucristo nuestro Señor.

verses.KJV: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.WEB: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
verses.ASV: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeço a Deus, a quem desde os [meus] antepassados sirvo com uma consciência pura, de que sem cessar tenho memória de ti nas minhas orações noite e dia.
verses.RVR09: Doy gracias á Dios, al cual sirvo desde mis mayores con limpia conciencia, de que sin cesar tengo memoria de ti en mis oraciones noche y día;

verses.KJV: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.WEB: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.ASV: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembro-me das tuas lágrimas, e desejo muito te ver, para me encher de alegria;
verses.RVR09: Deseando verte, acordándome de tus lágrimas, para ser lleno de gozo;

verses.KJV: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.WEB: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
verses.ASV: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trago à memória a fé não fingida que há em ti, [fé] que habitou primeiro na tua avó Loide, e na tua mãe Eunice; e tenho certeza que também em ti.
verses.RVR09: Trayendo á la memoria la fe no fingida que hay en ti, la cual residió primero en tu abuela Loida, y en tu madre Eunice; y estoy cierto que en ti también.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.WEB: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.ASV: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por essa causa lembro-te de reacenderes o dom de Deus que está em ti pela imposição das minhas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual te aconsejo que despiertes el don de Dios, que está en ti por la imposición de mis manos.

verses.KJV: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.WEB: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
verses.ASV: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus não nos deu espírito de medo; mas sim de força, de amor, e de moderação.
verses.RVR09: Porque no nos ha dado Dios el espíritu de temor, sino el de fortaleza, y de amor, y de templanza.

verses.KJV: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
verses.ASV: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não te envergonhes do testemunho do nosso Senhor, nem de mim, que sou prisioneiro dele; em vez disso, participa das aflições do Evangelho segundo o poder de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto no te avergüences del testimonio de nuestro Señor, ni de mí, preso suyo; antes sé participante de los trabajos del evangelio según la virtud de Dios,

verses.KJV: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.WEB: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
verses.ASV: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele nos salvou, e chamou com um chamado santo; não conforme as nossas obras, mas sim, conforme a sua própria intenção, e a graça que nos foi dada em Cristo Jesus antes dos princípios dos tempos;
verses.RVR09: Que nos salvó y llamó con vocación santa, no conforme á nuestras obras, mas según el intento suyo y gracia, la cual nos es dada en Cristo Jesús antes de los tiempos de los siglos,

verses.KJV: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.WEB: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
verses.ASV: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
verses.ALMEIDA: mas agora é manifesta pela aparição do nosso Salvador Jesus Cristo, que anulou a morte, e trouxe para a luz a vida e a imortalidade por meio do evangelho;
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora es manifestada por la aparición de nuestro Salvador Jesucristo, el cual quitó la muerte, y sacó á la luz la vida y la inmortalidad por el evangelio;

verses.KJV: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.
verses.ALMEIDA: do qual eu fui constituído pregador e apóstolo, e instrutor dos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Del cual yo soy puesto predicador, y apóstol, y maestro de los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.WEB: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
verses.ASV: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa disso também sofro essas coisas; porém não me envergonho. Pois sei em quem tenho crido, e tenho certeza de que ele é poderoso para guardar o que lhe confiei até aquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual asimismo padezco esto: mas no me avergüenzo; porque yo sé á quien he creído, y estoy cierto que es poderoso para guardar mi depósito para aquel día.

verses.KJV: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Preserva o exemplo das sãs palavras que tens ouvido de mim, na fé e no amor que [há] em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Retén la forma de las sanas palabras que de mí oíste, en la fe y amor que es en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.WEB: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
verses.ASV: That good thing which was committed unto [thee] guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda o bem que te foi confiado por meio do Espírito Santo que habita em nós.
verses.RVR09: Guarda el buen depósito por el Espíritu Santo que habita en nosotros.

verses.KJV: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.WEB: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.ASV: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabes isto, que todos os que estão na Ásia Romana me abandonaram, entre os quais estavam Fígelo e Hermógenes.
verses.RVR09: Ya sabes esto, que me han sido contrarios todos los que son en Asia, de los cuales son Figello y Hermógenes.

verses.KJV: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.WEB: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
verses.ASV: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor conceda misericórdia à casa de Onesíforo, pois muitas vezes ele me consolou, e não se envergonhou de eu estar em cadeias;
verses.RVR09: Dé el Señor misericordia á la casa de Onesíforo; que muchas veces me refrigeró, y no se avergonzó de mi cadena:

verses.KJV: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.WEB: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
verses.ASV: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo contrário, quando veio a Roma, com empenho me procurou, e [me] encontrou.
verses.RVR09: Antes, estando él en Roma, me buscó solícitamente, y me halló.

verses.KJV: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.WEB: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
verses.ASV: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor lhe conceda que naquele dia ele encontre misericórdia diante do Senhor. E tu sabes muito bem como ele [me] ajudou em Éfeso.
verses.RVR09: Déle el Señor que halle misericordia cerca del Señor en aquel día. Y cuánto nos ayudó en Efeso, tú lo sabes mejor.

verses.KJV: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto tu, meu filho, fortifica-te na graça que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: PUES tú, hijo mío, esfuérzate en la gracia que es en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.WEB: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
verses.ASV: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que de mim ouviste entre muitas testemunhas, confia-o a pessoas fiéis, que sejam competentes para ensinar também a outros.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que has oído de mí entre muchos testigos, esto encarga á los hombres fieles que serán idóneos para enseñar también á otros.

verses.KJV: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: Suffer hardship with [me], as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, pois, sofre as aflições como bom soldado de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, sufre trabajos como fiel soldado de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.WEB: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
verses.ASV: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of [this] life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum soldado em batalha se envolve com assuntos desta vida, pois tem como objetivo agradar àquele que o alistou.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno que milita se embaraza en los negocios de la vida; á fin de agradar á aquel que lo tomó por soldado.

verses.KJV: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.WEB: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
verses.ASV: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowned, except he have contended lawfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, também, se alguém está competindo como atleta, não recebe a coroa se não seguir as regras.
verses.RVR09: Y aun también el que lidia, no es coronado si no lidiare legítimamente.

verses.KJV: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.WEB: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
verses.ASV: The husbandman that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.
verses.ALMEIDA: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a receber da partilha dos frutos.
verses.RVR09: El labrador, para recibir los frutos, es menester que trabaje primero.

verses.KJV: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.WEB: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
verses.ASV: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considera o que digo; que o Senhor te dê entendimento em tudo.
verses.RVR09: Considera lo que digo; y el Señor te dé entendimiento en todo.

verses.KJV: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.WEB: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
verses.ASV: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de Jesus Cristo, ressuscitado dos mortos, da descendência de Davi, segundo o meu evangelho.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate que Jesucristo, el cual fué de la simiente de David, resucitó de los muertos conforme á mi evangelio;

verses.KJV: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.WEB: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
verses.ASV: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por esse [evangelho] sofro aflições, e até prisões, como um criminoso; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.
verses.RVR09: En el que sufro trabajo, hasta las prisiones á modo de malhechor; mas la palabra de Dios no está presa.

verses.KJV: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.WEB: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.ASV: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tudo suporto por causa dos escolhidos, a fim de que também eles obtenham a salvação que está em Cristo Jesus com glória eterna.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, todo lo sufro por amor de los escogidos, para que ellos también consigan la salud que es en Cristo Jesús con gloria eterna.

verses.KJV: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.WEB: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
verses.ASV: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta afirmação [é] fiel: se morrermos com [ele] , também com [ele] viveremos;
verses.RVR09: Es palabra fiel: Que si somos muertos con él, también viviremos con él:

verses.KJV: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.WEB: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
verses.ASV: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.ALMEIDA: se sofrermos, também com [ele] reinaremos; se o negamos, também ele nos negará;
verses.RVR09: Si sufrimos, también reinaremos con él: si negáremos, él también nos negará:

verses.KJV: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.WEB: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
verses.ASV: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: se formos infiéis, ele continua fiel; ele não pode negar a si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Si fuéremos infieles, él permanece fiel: no se puede negar á sí mismo.

verses.KJV: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.WEB: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
verses.ASV: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging [them] in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-os disso, alertando-os diante do Senhor, que não tenham brigas de palavras, que não têm proveito algum, [a não ser] para a ruína dos ouvintes.
verses.RVR09: Recuérdales esto, protestando delante del Señor que no contiendan en palabras, lo cual para nada aprovecha, antes trastorna á los oyentes.

verses.KJV: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.WEB: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
verses.ASV: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procura apresentar-te aprovado a Deus[como] um trabalhador que não tem de que se envergonhar, que usa bem a palavra da verdade.
verses.RVR09: Procura con diligencia presentarte á Dios aprobado, como obrero que no tiene de qué avergonzarse, que traza bien la palabra de verdad.

verses.KJV: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.WEB: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
verses.ASV: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas evita conversas profanas [e] inútes; pois tendem a produzir maior irreverência.
verses.RVR09: Mas evita profanas y vanas parlerías; porque muy adelante irán en la impiedad.

verses.KJV: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.WEB: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
verses.ASV: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra deles se espalhará como uma gangrena; entre os quais são Himeneu e Fileto.
verses.RVR09: Y la palabra de ellos carcomerá como gangrena: de los cuales es Himeneo y Fileto;

verses.KJV: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.WEB: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
verses.ASV: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esses se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a ressurreição já aconteceu; e perverteram a fé de alguns.
verses.RVR09: Que se han descaminado de la verdad, diciendo que la resurrección es ya hecha, y trastornan la fe de algunos.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.WEB: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
verses.ASV: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o fundamento de Deus continua firme, e tem este selo: o Senhor conhece os que são seus, e que todo aquele que faz uso do nome de Cristo, se afaste da injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Pero el fundamento de Dios está firme, teniendo este sello: Conoce el Señor á los que son suyos; y: Apártese de iniquidad todo aquel que invoca el nombre de Cristo.

verses.KJV: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.WEB: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
verses.ASV: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Numa grande casa não há somente utensílios de ouro e de prata, mas também de madeira e de barro; e uns para honra, porém outros para desonra.
verses.RVR09: Mas en una casa grande, no solamente hay vasos de oro y de plata, sino también de madera y de barro: y asimismo unos para honra, y otros para deshonra.

verses.KJV: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.WEB: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
verses.ASV: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master’s use, prepared unto every good work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se alguém se purificar destas coisas, será utensílio para honra, santificado e adequado para uso do Dono, [e] preparado para toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si alguno se limpiare de estas cosas, será vaso para honra, santificado, y útil para los usos del Señor, y aparejado para todo buena obra.

verses.KJV: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.WEB: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.ASV: But flee youthful lusts, and follow after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foge também dos desejos da juventude; e segue a justiça, a fé, o amor, [e] a paz, com os que, de coração puro, invocam o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Huye también los deseos juveniles; y sigue la justicia, la fe, la caridad, la paz, con los que invocan al Señor de puro corazón.

verses.KJV: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.WEB: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
verses.ASV: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rejeita as questões tolas e sem instrução, como sabes que elas produzem brigas.
verses.RVR09: Empero las cuestiones necias y sin sabiduría desecha, sabiendo que engendran contiendas.

verses.KJV: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.WEB: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
verses.ASV: And the Lord’s servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao servo do Senhor não convém brigar, mas sim ser manso com todos, apto para ensinar e suportar;
verses.RVR09: Que el siervo del Señor no debe ser litigioso, sino manso para con todos, apto para enseñar, sufrido;

verses.KJV: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.WEB: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
verses.ASV: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,
verses.ALMEIDA: deve instruir com mansidão aos que se opõem, pois talvez Deus lhes dê arrependimento para conhecerem a verdade;
verses.RVR09: Que con mansedumbre corrija á los que se oponen: si quizá Dios les dé que se arrepientan para conocer la verdad,

verses.KJV: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.WEB: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
verses.ASV: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.
verses.ALMEIDA: e se libertem da armadilha do diabo, em que foram presos à vontade dele.
verses.RVR09: Y se zafen del lazo del diablo, en que están cautivos á voluntad de él.

verses.KJV: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.WEB: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
verses.ASV: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabe porém isto, que nos últimos dias virão tempos difíceis.
verses.RVR09: ESTO también sepas, que en los postreros días vendrán tiempos peligrosos:

verses.KJV: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.WEB: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.ASV: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois haverá alguns que serão egoístas, gananciosos, presunçosos, soberbos, blasfemos, desobedientes a pais e a mães, ingratos, profanos,
verses.RVR09: Que habrá hombres amadores de sí mismos, avaros, vanagloriosos, soberbios, detractores, desobedientes á los padres, ingratos, sin santidad,

verses.KJV: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.WEB: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
verses.ASV: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,
verses.ALMEIDA: sem afeto natural, irreconciliáveis, caluniadores, sem dominio próprio, cruéis, sem amor com os bons,
verses.RVR09: Sin afecto, desleales, calumniadores, destemplados, crueles, aborrecedores de lo bueno,

verses.KJV: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.WEB: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.ASV: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: traidores, precipitados, orgulhosos, que amam mais os prazeres que a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Traidores, arrebatados, hinchados, amadores de los deleites más que de Dios;

verses.KJV: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.WEB: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
verses.ASV: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power thereof: from these also turn away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles têm uma aparência de devoção divina, mas negam o poder dela. Afasta-te desses também.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo apariencia de piedad, mas habiendo negado la eficacia de ella: y á éstos evita.

verses.KJV: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.WEB: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
verses.ASV: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dentre esses são os que entram pelas casas, e levam cativas as mulheres insensatas carregadas de pecados, levadas com vários maus desejos;
verses.RVR09: Porque de éstos son los que se entran por las casas, y llevan cautivas las mujercillas cargadas de pecados, llevadas de diversas concupiscencias;

verses.KJV: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.WEB: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.ASV: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: que sempre estão aprendendo, e jamais conseguem chegar ao conhecimento da verdade.
verses.RVR09: Que siempre aprenden, y nunca pueden acabar de llegar al conocimiento de la verdad.

verses.KJV: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.WEB: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
verses.ASV: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim como Janes e Jambres se opuseram a Moisés, assim também esses se opõem a verdade; esses são corruptos de entendimento, e reprovados quanto à fé.
verses.RVR09: Y de la manera que Jannes y Jambres resistieron á Moisés, así también éstos resisten á la verdad; hombres corruptos de entendimiento, réprobos acerca de la fe.

verses.KJV: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.
verses.WEB: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
verses.ASV: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, porém, não avançarão; pois a insensatez deles será evidente a todos, como também foi a daqueles.
verses.RVR09: Mas no prevalecerán; porque su insensatez será manifiesta á todos, como también lo fué la de aquéllos.

verses.KJV: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.WEB: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
verses.ASV: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu tens seguido a minha doutrina, conduta, intenção, fé, paciência, amor, perseverança,
verses.RVR09: Pero tú has comprendido mi doctrina, instrucción, intento, fe, largura de ánimo, caridad, paciencia,

verses.KJV: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.WEB: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
verses.ASV: persecutions, sufferings; what things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: and out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.ALMEIDA: perseguições, aflições; as quais me aconteceram em Antioquia, em Icônio e em Listra; tais perseguições sofri, e o Senhor me livrou de todas.
verses.RVR09: Persecuciones, aflicciones, cuales me sobrevinieron en Antioquía, en Iconio, en Listra, cuales persecuciones he sufrido; y de todas me ha librado el Señor.

verses.KJV: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.WEB: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
verses.ASV: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também todos os que querem viver devotamente em Cristo Jesus sofrerão perseguição.
verses.RVR09: Y también todos los que quieren vivir píamente en Cristo Jesús, padecerán persecución.

verses.KJV: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.WEB: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.ASV: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os que são maus e enganadores irão de mal a pior, enganando e sendo enganados.
verses.RVR09: Mas los malos hombres y los engañadores, irán de mal en peor, engañando y siendo engañados.

verses.KJV: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.WEB: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
verses.ASV: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, continua nas coisas que aprendeste e das quais foste convencido, pois sabes de quem as aprendeste.
verses.RVR09: Empero persiste tú en lo que has aprendido y te persuadiste, sabiendo de quién has aprendido;

verses.KJV: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: and that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: e que desde tua infância conheceste as Sagradas Escrituras, que podem te fazer sábio para a salvação pela fé em Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Y que desde la niñez has sabido las Sagradas Escrituras, las cuales te pueden hacer sabio para la salud por la fe que es en Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.WEB: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
verses.ASV: Every scripture inspired of God [is] also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda a Escritura [é] divinamente inspirada e proveitosa para ensinar, para mostrar erros, para corrigir, e para instruir na justiça;
verses.RVR09: Toda Escritura es inspirada divinamente y útil para enseñar, para redargüir, para corregir, para instituir en justicia,

verses.KJV: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.WEB: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
verses.ASV: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que o homem de Deus seja completo, plenamente instruído para toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Para que el hombre de Dios sea perfecto, enteramente instruído para toda buena obra.

verses.KJV: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.WEB: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
verses.ASV: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto te convoco diante de Deus e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, que irá julgar os vivos e os mortos em sua aparição e seu reino:
verses.RVR09: REQUIERO yo pues delante de Dios, y del Señor Jesucristo, que ha de juzgar á los vivos y los muertos en su manifestación y en su reino,

verses.KJV: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long suffering and doctrine.
verses.WEB: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
verses.ASV: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.
verses.ALMEIDA: prega a palavra; insiste em tempo e fora de tempo; mostra os erros; repreende [e] exorta, com toda paciência e ensino.
verses.RVR09: Que prediques la palabra; que instes á tiempo y fuera de tiempo; redarguye, reprende, exhorta con toda paciencia y doctrina.

verses.KJV: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.WEB: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
verses.ASV: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois virá tempo em que não suportarão a sã doutrina; em vez disso, terão comichão no ouvido e amontoarão para si instrutores conforme os seus próprios desejos maus;
verses.RVR09: Porque vendrá tiempo cuando no sufrirán la sana doctrina; antes, teniendo comezón de oir, se amontonarán maestros conforme á sus concupiscencias,

verses.KJV: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.WEB: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
verses.ASV: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.
verses.ALMEIDA: desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, e se voltarão aos mitos.
verses.RVR09: Y apartarán de la verdad el oído, y se volverán á las fábulas.

verses.KJV: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.WEB: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
verses.ASV: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, vigia-te em todas as coisas; suporta as aflições, faz a obra de evangelista, cumpre o teu serviço.
verses.RVR09: Pero tú vela en todo, soporta las aflicciones, haz la obra de evangelista, cumple tu ministerio.

verses.KJV: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.WEB: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
verses.ASV: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois já sou uma oferta de derramamento, e o tempo da minha partida está perto.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo ya estoy para ser ofrecido, y el tiempo de mi partida está cercano.

verses.KJV: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.WEB: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
verses.ASV: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:
verses.ALMEIDA: Lutei a boa luta, terminei a carreira, guardei a fé.
verses.RVR09: He peleado la buena batalla, he acabado la carrera, he guardado la fe.

verses.KJV: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.WEB: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
verses.ASV: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde agora a coroa da justiça me está reservada, a qual o Senhor, o justo Juiz, me dará naquele dia; e não somente a mim, mas também a todos os que amarem a sua vinda.
verses.RVR09: Por lo demás, me está guardada la corona de justicia, la cual me dará el Señor, juez justo, en aquel día; y no sólo á mí, sino también á todos los que aman su venida.

verses.KJV: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.WEB: Be diligent to come to me soon,
verses.ASV: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Procura vir logo até mim,
verses.RVR09: Procura venir presto á mí:

verses.KJV: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.WEB: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.ASV: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque Demas me desamparou: ele amou o tempo presente, e partiu para Tessalônica; Crescente para a Galácia, e Tito para a Dalmácia.
verses.RVR09: Porque Demas me ha desamparado, amando este siglo, y se ha ido á Tesalónica; Crescente á Galacia, Tito á Dalmacia.

verses.KJV: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.WEB: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
verses.ASV: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Só Lucas está comigo. Toma Marcos, e o traz contigo, porque ele me é muito útil para o serviço.
verses.RVR09: Lucas solo está conmigo. Toma á Marcos, y tráele contigo; porque me es útil para el ministerio.

verses.KJV: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.WEB: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.ASV: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviei Tíquico a Éfeso.
verses.RVR09: A Tychîco envié á Efeso.

verses.KJV: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.WEB: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.ASV: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vieres, traz a capa que deixei em Trôade na casa de Carpo, e os livros, principalmente os pergaminhos.
verses.RVR09: Trae, cuando vinieres, el capote que dejé en Troas en casa de Carpo: y los libros, mayormente los pergaminos.

verses.KJV: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.WEB: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.ASV: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:
verses.ALMEIDA: Alexandre, o que trabalha com cobre, me causou muitos males; o Senhor retribua a ele conforme suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Alejandro el calderero me ha causado muchos males: el Señor le pague conforme á sus hechos.

verses.KJV: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.WEB: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
