verses.ASV: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma cuidado com ele também, porque ele se opôs muito às nossas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Guárdate tú también de él; que en grande manera ha resistido á nuestras palabras.

verses.KJV: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.WEB: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
verses.ASV: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na minha primeira defesa ninguém esteve comigo para me ajudar, pelo contrário, todos me desampararam. Que isso não seja levado em consideração contra eles.
verses.RVR09: En mi primera defensa ninguno me ayudó, antes me desampararon todos: no les sea imputado.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.WEB: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.ASV: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o Senhor me ajudou e me fortaleceu, a fim de que por mim a pregação fosse completamente divulgada, e todos os gentios [a] ouvissem; e fui livrado da boca do leão.
verses.RVR09: Mas el Señor me ayudó, y me esforzó para que por mí fuese cumplida la predicación, y todos los Gentiles oyesen; y fuí librado de la boca del león.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Senhor me livrará de toda obra má, e me preservará para o seu reino celestial. A ele [seja] glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Y el Señor me librará de toda obra mala, y me preservará para su reino celestial: al cual sea gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.WEB: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
verses.ASV: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cumprimenta Prisca e Áquila, e a casa de Onesíforo.
verses.RVR09: Saluda á Prisca y á Aquila, y á la casa de Onesíforo.

verses.KJV: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.WEB: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
verses.ASV: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Erasto ficou em Corinto, e deixei Trófimo doente em Mileto.
verses.RVR09: Erasto se quedó en Corinto; y á Trófimo dejé en Mileto enfermo.

verses.KJV: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.WEB: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
verses.ASV: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procura vir antes do inverno. Êubulo, Pudente, Lino, Cláudia e todos os irmãos te cumprimentam.
verses.RVR09: Procura venir antes del invierno. Eubulo te saluda, y Pudente, y Lino, y Claudia, y todos los hermanos.

verses.KJV: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.WEB: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.ASV: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o teu espírito. A graça seja convosco. Amém.[A segunda carta a Timóteo (o primeiro bispo escolhido para a igreja dos efésios) foi escrita em Roma, quando Paulo foi apresentado pela segunda vez ao imperador Nero]
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jesucristo sea con tu espíritu. La gracia sea con vosotros. Amén. La segunda epístola á Timoteo, el cual fué el primer obispo ordenado en Efeso, fué escrita de Roma, cuando Pablo fué presentado la segunda vez á César Nerón.

verses.KJV: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.WEB: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
verses.ASV: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, servo de Deus e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, segundo a fé dos escolhidos de Deus, e o conhecimento da verdade, que é segundo a devoção divina;
verses.RVR09: PABLO, siervo de Dios, y apóstol de Jesucristo, según la fe de los escogidos de Dios, y el conocimiento de la verdad que es según la piedad,

verses.KJV: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.WEB: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
verses.ASV: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;
verses.ALMEIDA: em esperança da vida eterna, a qual Deus, que não pode mentir, prometeu antes dos princípios dos tempos,
verses.RVR09: Para la esperanza de la vida eterna, la cual Dios, que no puede mentir, prometió antes de los tiempos de los siglos,

verses.KJV: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.WEB: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
verses.ASV: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a seu [devido] tempo [a] manifestou: a sua palavra, por meio da pregação, que me foi confiada segundo o mandamento de Deus nosso Salvador.
verses.RVR09: Y manifestó á sus tiempos su palabra por la predicación, que me es á mí encomendada por mandamiento de nuestro Salvador Dios;

verses.KJV: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.WEB: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
verses.ASV: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para Tito, [meu] verdadeiro filho, segundo a fé em comum; [haja em ti] graça, misericórdia [e] paz de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nosso Salvador.
verses.RVR09: A Tito, verdadero hijo en la común fe: Gracia, misericordia, y paz de Dios Padre, y del Señor Jesucristo Salvador nuestro.

verses.KJV: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.WEB: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
verses.ASV: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por esta causa eu te deixei em Creta, para que tu continuasses a pôr em ordem as coisas que estavam faltando, e de cidade em cidade constituísses presbíteros, conforme eu te mandei.
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa te dejé en Creta, para que corrigieses lo que falta, y pusieses ancianos por las villas, así como yo te mandé:

verses.KJV: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.WEB: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
verses.ASV: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém for irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, que tenha filhos fiéis, que não possam ser acusados de serem devassos ou desobedientes.
verses.RVR09: El que fuere sin crimen, marido de una mujer, que tenga hijos fieles que no estén acusados de disolución, ó contumaces.

verses.KJV: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.WEB: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
verses.ASV: For the bishop must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o supervisor deve ser irrepreensível, como administrador da casa de Deus, não arrogante, que não se ira facilmente, não beberrão, não agressivo, nem ganancioso.
verses.RVR09: Porque es menester que el obispo sea sin crimen, como dispensador de Dios; no soberbio, no iracundo, no amador del vino, no heridor, no codicioso de torpes ganancias;

verses.KJV: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.WEB: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
verses.ASV: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [que ele seja] hospitaleiro, ame aquilo que é bom, moderado, justo, santo, [e] tenha domínio próprio;
verses.RVR09: Sino hospedador, amador de lo bueno, templado, justo, santo, continente;

verses.KJV: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.WEB: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
verses.ASV: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able both to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Retendo firme a fiel palavra que é conforme o que foi ensinado; para que ele seja capaz, tanto para exortar na sã doutrina, como [também] para mostrar os erros dos que falam contra [ela] .
verses.RVR09: Retenedor de la fiel palabra que es conforme á la doctrina: para que también pueda exhortar con sana doctrina, y convencer á los que contradijeren.

verses.KJV: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.WEB: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
verses.ASV: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também há muitos insubordinados, que falam coisas vãs, e enganadores, especialmente aqueles da circuncisão;
verses.RVR09: Porque hay aún muchos contumaces, habladores de vanidades, y engañadores de las almas, mayormente los que son de la circuncisión,

verses.KJV: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.WEB: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
verses.ASV: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais devem se calar, que transtornam casas inteiras, ensinando o que não se deve, por causa da ganância.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales es preciso tapar la boca; que trastornan casas enteras; enseñando lo que no conviene, por torpe ganancia.

verses.KJV: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, the Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.WEB: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
verses.ASV: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um próprio profeta deles disse: Os cretenses sempre são mentirosos, animais malignos, ventres preguiçosos.
verses.RVR09: Dijo uno de ellos, propio profeta de ellos: Los Cretenses, siempre mentirosos, malas bestias, vientres perezosos.

verses.KJV: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.WEB: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
verses.ASV: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
verses.ALMEIDA: Este testemunho é verdadeiro; por isso repreende-os severamente, para que sejam sãos na fé.
verses.RVR09: Este testimonio es verdadero: por tanto, repréndelos duramente, para que sean sanos en la fe,

verses.KJV: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.WEB: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
verses.ASV: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dando atenção a mitos judaicos, e a mandamentos de homens, que desviam da verdade.
verses.RVR09: No atendiendo á fábulas judaicas, y á mandamientos de hombres que se apartan de la verdad.

verses.KJV: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.WEB: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
verses.ASV: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Realmente todas as coisas são puras para os puros; mas para os contaminados e infiéis, nada é puro; e até o entendimento e a consciência deles estão contaminados.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas son limpias á los limpios; mas á los contaminados é infieles nada es limpio: antes su alma y conciencia están contaminadas.

verses.KJV: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.WEB: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
verses.ASV: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles declaram que conhecem a Deus, mas com as obras eles o negam, pois são abomináveis e desobedientes, e reprovados para toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: Profésanse conocer á Dios; mas con los hechos lo niegan, siendo abominables y rebeldes, reprobados para toda buena obra.

verses.KJV: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.WEB: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
verses.ASV: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, fala o que convém à sã doutrina;
verses.RVR09: EMPERO tú, habla lo que conviene á la sana doctrina:

verses.KJV: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.WEB: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
verses.ASV: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos velhos, que sejam sóbrios, respeitáveis, prudentes, sãos na fé, no amor e na paciência.
verses.RVR09: Que los viejos sean templados, graves, prudentes, sanos en la fe, en la caridad, en la paciencia.

verses.KJV: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.WEB: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
verses.ASV: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;
verses.ALMEIDA: Às velhas, da mesma maneira, [tenham] bons costumes, como convém a santas; não caluniadoras, não viciadas em muito vinho, mas sim instrutoras daquilo que é bom;
verses.RVR09: Las viejas, asimismo, se distingan en un porte santo; no calumniadoras, no dadas á mucho vino, maestras de honestidad:

verses.KJV: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.WEB: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.ASV: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para ensinarem às moças a serem prudentes, a amarem a seus maridos, a amarem a seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: Que enseñen á las mujeres jóvenes á ser prudentes, á que amen á sus maridos, á que amen á sus hijos,

verses.KJV: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.WEB: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
verses.ASV: [to be] sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:
verses.ALMEIDA: A serem moderadas, puras, boas donas de casa, sujeitas a seus próprios maridos, para que a palavra de Deus não seja blasfemada.
verses.RVR09: A ser templadas, castas, que tengan cuidado de la casa, buenas, sujetas á sus maridos; porque la palabra de Dios no sea blasfemada.

verses.KJV: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.WEB: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
verses.ASV: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:
verses.ALMEIDA: Exorta semelhantemente aos rapazes, que sejam moderados.
verses.RVR09: Exhorta asimismo á los mancebos á que sean comedidos;

verses.KJV: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.WEB: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
verses.ASV: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine [showing] uncorruptness, gravity,
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tudo mostra a ti mesmo como exemplo de boas obras; na doutrina, [mostra] incorrupção, dignidade, sinceridade;
verses.RVR09: Mostrándote en todo por ejemplo de buenas obras; en doctrina haciendo ver integridad, gravedad,

verses.KJV: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.WEB: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
verses.ASV: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma palavra sã [e] irrepreensível, para que [qualquer] opositor se envergonhe, nada tendo de mal para dizer contra vós.
verses.RVR09: Palabra sana, é irreprensible; que el adversario se avergüence, no teniendo mal ninguno que decir de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.WEB: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
verses.ASV: [Exhort] servants to be in subjection to their own masters, [and] to be well-pleasing [to them] in all things; not gainsaying;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os servos sejam sujeitos a seus próprios senhores, sendo agradáveis em tudo, [e] não falando contra [eles] .
verses.RVR09: Exhorta á los siervos á que sean sujetos á sus señores, que agraden en todo, no respondones;

verses.KJV: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.WEB: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
verses.ASV: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não [lhes] furtando, mas sim mostrando toda a boa lealdade; para que em tudo adornem a doutrina de Deus nosso Salvador.
verses.RVR09: No defraudando, antes mostrando toda buena lealtad, para que adornen en todo la doctrina de nuestro Salvador Dios.

verses.KJV: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.WEB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
verses.ASV: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a graça salvadora de Deus se manifestou a todos os homens.
verses.RVR09: Porque la gracia de Dios que trae salvación á todos los hombres, se manifestó,

verses.KJV: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.WEB: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
verses.ASV: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensinando-nos que, ao renunciarmos à irreverência e aos maus desejos mundanos, vivamos neste tempo presente de maneira sóbria, justa e devota.
verses.RVR09: Enseñándonos que, renunciando á la impiedad y á los deseos mundanos, vivamos en este siglo templada, y justa, y píamente,

verses.KJV: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.WEB: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aguardando a bem-aventurada esperança e o aparecimento da glória do grande Deus e nosso Salvador Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Esperando aquella esperanza bienaventurada, y la manifestación gloriosa del gran Dios y Salvador nuestro Jesucristo,

verses.KJV: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.WEB: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
verses.ASV: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual deu a si mesmo por nós, para nos libertar de toda injustiça, e para purificar para si mesmo um povo particular, zeloso de boas obras.
verses.RVR09: Que se dió á sí mismo por nosotros para redimirnos de toda iniquidad, y limpiar para sí un pueblo propio, celoso de buenas obras.

verses.KJV: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.WEB: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
verses.ASV: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala estas coisas, exorta, e repreende com toda autoridade. Ninguém te despreze.
verses.RVR09: Esto habla y exhorta, y reprende con toda autoridad. Nadie te desprecie.

verses.KJV: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.WEB: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
verses.ASV: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,
verses.ALMEIDA: Relembra-os para se sujeitarem aos governantes e às autoridades, sejam obedientes, [e] estejam preparados para toda boa obra.
verses.RVR09: AMONÉSTALES que se sujeten á los príncipes y potestades, que obedezcan, que estén prontos á toda buena obra.

verses.KJV: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.WEB: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
verses.ASV: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não insultem a ninguém, não sejam briguentos, [mas sim] pacientes, mostrando toda mansidão para com todos os homens.
verses.RVR09: Que á nadie infamen, que no sean pendencieros, sino modestos, mostrando toda mansedumbre para con todos los hombres.

verses.KJV: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.WEB: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.ASV: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós também éramos tolos, desobedientes, enganados, servindo a vários maus desejos e prazeres, vivendo em malícia e inveja, detestáveis, odiando uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Porque también éramos nosotros necios en otro tiempo, rebeldes, extraviados, sirviendo á concupiscencias y deleites diversos, viviendo en malicia y en envidia, aborrecibles, aborreciendo los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.WEB: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
verses.ASV: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando a bondade e amor de Deus nosso Salvador para a humanidade apareceu,
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando se manifestó la bondad de Dios nuestro Salvador, y su amor para con los hombres,

verses.KJV: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.WEB: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
verses.ASV: not by works [done] in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não pelas obras de justiça que nós tivéssemos feito, mas sim segundo sua misericórdia, ele nos salvou pelo banho do novo nascimento, e da renovação do Espírito Santo;
verses.RVR09: No por obras de justicia que nosotros habíamos hecho, mas por su misericordia nos salvó, por el lavacro de la regeneración, y de la renovación del Espíritu Santo;

verses.KJV: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.WEB: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
verses.ASV: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual ele derramou abundantemente em nós por meio de Jesus Cristo nosso Salvador;
verses.RVR09: El cual derramó en nosotros abundantemente por Jesucristo nuestro Salvador,

verses.KJV: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.WEB: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.ASV: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que, ao termos sido justificados por sua graça, sejamos feitos herdeiros segundo a esperança da vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Para que, justificados por su gracia, seamos hechos herederos según la esperanza de la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.WEB: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
verses.ASV: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Esta] palavra [é] fiel, e isto quero que insistas em confirmar, para que os que creem em Deus procurem se dedicar às boas obras; estas coisas são boas e proveitosas aos homens.
verses.RVR09: Palabra fiel, y estas cosas quiero que afirmes, para que los que creen á Dios procuren gobernarse en buenas obras. Estas cosas son buenas y útiles á los hombres.

verses.KJV: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.WEB: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.ASV: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas evita as questões tolas, e às genealogias e discussões, e às disputas quanto à Lei, porque elas são inúteis e vás.
verses.RVR09: Mas las cuestiones necias, y genealogías, y contenciones, y debates acerca de la ley, evita; porque son sin provecho y vanas.

verses.KJV: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.WEB: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
verses.ASV: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao homem rebelde, depois da primeira e [da] segunda repreensão, rejeita [-o] .
verses.RVR09: Rehusa hombre hereje, después de una y otra amonestación;

verses.KJV: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.WEB: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
verses.ASV: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo que o tal está pervertido, e está pecando, estando a si mesmo condenado.
verses.RVR09: Estando cierto que el tal es trastornado, y peca, siendo condenado de su propio juicio.

verses.KJV: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.WEB: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
verses.ASV: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu enviar Artemas até ti, ou Tíquico, procura vir até mim a Nicópolis, porque eu decidi passar lá o inverno.
verses.RVR09: Cuando enviare á ti á Artemas, ó á Tichîco, procura venir á mí, á Nicópolis: porque allí he determinado invernar.

verses.KJV: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.WEB: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
verses.ASV: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Auxilia com empenho a Zenas, o especialista na Lei, e a Apolo, na viagem deles, para que nada lhes falte.
verses.RVR09: A Zenas doctor de la ley, y á Apolos, envía delante, procurando que nada les falte.

verses.KJV: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.WEB: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
verses.ASV: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que também os nossos aprendam a se dedicarem às boas obras para os usos necessários, para que não sejam infrutíferos.
verses.RVR09: Y aprendan asimismo los nuestros á gobernarse en buenas obras para los usos necesarios, para que no sean sin fruto.

verses.KJV: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que estão comigo te saúdam. Saúda tu aos que nos amam na fé. A graça [seja] com todos vós. Amém! [A carta a Tito, o primeiro bispo escolhido da igreja dos cretenses, foi escrita de Nicópolis na Macedônia]
verses.RVR09: Todos los que están conmigo te saludan. Saluda á los que nos aman en la fe. La gracia sea con todos vosotros. Amén. A Tito, el cual fué el primer obispo ordenado á la iglesia de los Cretenses, escrita de Nicópolis de Macedonia.

verses.KJV: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.WEB: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
verses.ASV: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,
verses.ALMEIDA: Paulo, prisioneiro de Cristo Jesus, e o irmão Timóteo, a Filemom, o amado, e nosso cooperador;
verses.RVR09: PABLO, prisionero de Jesucristo, y el hermano Timoteo, á Filemón amado, y coadjutor nuestro;

verses.KJV: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
verses.WEB: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
verses.ASV: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house:
verses.ALMEIDA: E à amada Ápia, e a Arquipo nosso companheiro de batalha, e à igreja [que está] em tua casa;
verses.RVR09: Y á la amada Apphia, y á Archîpo, compañero de nuestra milicia, y á la iglesia que está en tu casa:

verses.KJV: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Haja] em vós graça e paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Gracia á vosotros y paz de Dios nuestro Padre, y del Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
verses.WEB: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
verses.ASV: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dou graças a meu Deus sempre me lembrando de ti em minhas orações;
verses.RVR09: Doy gracias á mi Dios, haciendo siempre memoria de ti en mis oraciones.

verses.KJV: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
verses.WEB: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
verses.ASV: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao ouvir de teu amor e a fé que tu tens para com o Senhor Jesus, e para com todos os santos;
verses.RVR09: Oyendo tu caridad, y la fe que tienes en el Señor Jesús, y para con todos los santos;

verses.KJV: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
verses.WEB: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
verses.ASV: that the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you, unto Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a comunhão de tua fé seja eficaz no reconhecimento de todo o bem que há em vós por Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: Para que la comunicación de tu fe sea eficaz, en el conocimiento de todo el bien que está en vosotros, por Cristo Jesús.

verses.KJV: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
verses.WEB: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
verses.ASV: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós temos grande alegria e consolo em teu amor, pelo qual, por meio de ti, irmão, os sentimentos dos santos foram aliviados.
verses.RVR09: Porque tenemos gran gozo y consolación de tu caridad, de que por ti, oh hermano, han sido recreadas las entrañas de los santos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
verses.WEB: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
verses.ASV: Wherefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to enjoin thee that which is befitting,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, ainda que em Cristo eu tenha grande confiança para te mandar [aquilo que te é] conveniente,
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, aunque tengo mucha resolución en Cristo para mandarte lo que conviene,

verses.KJV: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: yet for love’s sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now a prisoner also of Christ Jesus:
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso por amor eu [te] peço, [ainda que] eu seja tal, Paulo, o velho, e também agora um prisioneiro de Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Ruégote más bien por amor, siendo tal cual soy, Pablo viejo, y aun ahora prisionero de Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
verses.WEB: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
verses.ASV: I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te peço por meu filho Onésimo, ao qual eu gerei durante minhas prisões.
verses.RVR09: Ruégote por mi hijo Onésimo, que he engendrado en mis prisiones,

verses.KJV: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
verses.WEB: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
verses.ASV: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que antes te era inútil, mas agora útil para mim e para ti, eu o enviei de volta;
verses.RVR09: El cual en otro tiempo te fué inútil, mas ahora á ti y á mí es útil;

verses.KJV: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
verses.WEB: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
verses.ASV: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, como os meus mais íntimos sentimentos, recebe-o;
verses.RVR09: El cual te vuelvo á enviar; tú pues, recíbele como á mis entrañas.

verses.KJV: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.WEB: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
verses.ASV: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu [até que] gostaria de retê-lo comigo, para que como teu [substituto] ele me servisse nas prisões do Evangelho;
verses.RVR09: Yo quisiera detenerle conmigo, para que en lugar de ti me sirviese en las prisiones del evangelio;

verses.KJV: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
verses.WEB: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
verses.ASV: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu nada quis fazer sem tua opinião, para que tua bondade não fosse como que por obrigação, mas sim de livre vontade.
verses.RVR09: Mas nada quise hacer sin tu consejo, porque tu beneficio no fuese como de necesidad, sino voluntario.

verses.KJV: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
verses.WEB: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
verses.ASV: For perhaps he was therefore parted [from thee] for a season, that thou shouldest have him for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque talvez por isso que ele tenha se separado [de ti] por algum tempo, para que tu o recebesses de volta para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Porque acaso por esto se ha apartado de ti por algún tiempo, para que le recibieses para siempre;

verses.KJV: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verses.WEB: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.ASV: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não mais como a um servo, mas sim mais que um servo, [como] a um amado irmão, especialmente para mim, e muito mais de ti, tanto na carne como no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: No ya como siervo, antes más que siervo, como hermano amado, mayormente de mí, pero cuánto más de ti, en la carne y en el Señor.

verses.KJV: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.WEB: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
verses.ASV: If then thou countest me a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se tu me tens como companheiro, [então] recebe-o como a mim.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si me tienes por compañero, recíbele como á mí.

verses.KJV: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
verses.WEB: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
verses.ASV: But if he hath wronged thee at all, or oweth [thee] aught, put that to mine account;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ele te fez algum dano, ou te deve [alguma coisa] ,põe [isto] na minha conta.
verses.RVR09: Y si en algo te dañó, ó te debe, ponlo á mi cuenta.

verses.KJV: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
verses.WEB: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
verses.ASV: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it: that I say not unto thee that thou owest to me even thine own self besides.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, Paulo, de minha [própria] mão [o] escrevi, eu pagarei; para eu não te dizer que tu me deves a ti mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Yo Pablo lo escribí de mi mano, yo lo pagaré: por no decirte que aun á ti mismo te me debes demás.

verses.KJV: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
verses.ASV: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, irmão, que eu tenha algum benefício de ti no Senhor; alivia meus sentimentos no Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Sí, hermano, góceme yo de ti en el Señor; recrea mis entrañas en el Señor.

verses.KJV: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
verses.WEB: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
verses.ASV: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tendo confiança de tua obediência eu te escrevi, sabendo que tu farás ainda mais do que eu digo.
verses.RVR09: Te he escrito confiando en tu obediencia, sabiendo que aun harás más de lo que digo.

verses.KJV: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verses.WEB: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
verses.ASV: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto isso também me prepara um lugar para [eu] ficar; porque eu espero que por vossas orações eu seja entregue a vós.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo prepárame también alojamiento; porque espero que por vuestras oraciones os tengo de ser concedido.

verses.KJV: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
verses.WEB: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
verses.ASV: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, saluteth thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Saúdam-te: Epafras (meu companheiro de prisão em Cristo Jesus),
verses.RVR09: Te saludan Epafras, mi compañero en la prisión por Cristo Jesús,

verses.KJV: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
verses.WEB: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
verses.ASV: [and so do] Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas [e] Lucas (meus cooperadores).
verses.RVR09: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas y Lucas, mis cooperadores.

verses.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cirsto [seja] com vosso espírito. Amém! [Escrita em Roma para Filemom, e enviada pelo servo Onésimo]
verses.RVR09: La gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea con vuestro espíritu. Amén. A Filemón fué enviada de Roma por Onésimo, siervo.

verses.KJV: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.WEB: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
verses.ASV: God, having of old time spoken unto the fathers in the prophets by divers portions and in divers manners,
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus falou antigamente muitas vezes, e de muitas maneiras, aos ancestrais pelos profetas.
verses.RVR09: DIOS, habiendo hablado muchas veces y en muchas maneras en otro tiempo á los padres por los profetas,

verses.KJV: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.WEB: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
verses.ASV: hath at the end of these days spoken unto us in [his] Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nestes últimos falou a nós por meio do [seu] Filho, a quem constituiu por herdeiro de todas as coisas, e pelo qual também fez o universo.
verses.RVR09: En estos postreros días nos ha hablado por el Hijo, al cual constituyó heredero de todo, por el cual asimismo hizo el universo:

verses.KJV: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:
verses.WEB: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
verses.ASV: who being the effulgence of his glory, and the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had made purification of sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.ALMEIDA: [O Filho] é o resplendor da [sua] glória, a expressa imagem da sua pessoa, e sustenta todas as coisas pela sua palavra de poder. E, depois de fazer por si mesmo a purificação dos nossos pecados, sentou-se à direita da Majestade nas alturas;
verses.RVR09: El cual siendo el resplandor de su gloria, y la misma imagen de su sustancia, y sustentando todas las cosas con la palabra de su potencia, habiendo hecho la purgación de nuestros pecados por sí mismo, se sentó á la diestra de la Majestad en las alturas,

verses.KJV: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.WEB: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
verses.ASV: having become by so much better than the angels, as he hath inherited a more excellent name than they.
verses.ALMEIDA: e se tornou muito superior aos anjos, assim como herdou um nome mais excelente que eles.
verses.RVR09: Hecho tanto más excelente que los ángeles, cuanto alcanzó por herencia más excelente nombre que ellos.

verses.KJV: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.WEB: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
verses.ASV: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, This day have I begotten thee? and again, I will be to him a Father, And he shall be to me a Son?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a qual dos anjos [Deus] jamais disse: “Tu és meu Filho, eu hoje te gerei”, E em outra vez: “Eu lhe serei por Pai, e ele me será por Filho”?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿á cuál de los ángeles dijo Dios jamás: Mi hijo eres tú, hoy yo te he engendrado? y otra vez: Yo seré á él Padre, y él me será á mí hijo?

verses.KJV: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.WEB: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
verses.ASV: And when he again bringeth in the firstborn into the world he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez, quando introduz o primogênito ao mundo, diz: E todos os anjos de Deus o adorem.
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez, cuando introduce al Primogénito en la tierra, dice: Y adórenle todos los ángeles de Dios.

verses.KJV: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.WEB: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
verses.ASV: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels winds, And his ministers a flame of fire:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos anjos, porém, ele diz: Ele faz de seus anjos espíritos; e de seus trabalhadores, labareda de fogo;
verses.RVR09: Y ciertamente de los ángeles dice: El que hace á sus ángeles espíritus, y á sus ministros llama de fuego.

verses.KJV: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.WEB: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
verses.ASV: but of the Son [he saith], Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; And the sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao Filho [diz] : Ó Deus, o teu trono é para todo o sempre. Cetro de equidade é o cetro do teu Reino.
verses.RVR09: Mas al hijo: Tu trono, oh Dios, por el siglo del siglo; vara de equidad la vara de tu reino;

verses.KJV: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.WEB: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
verses.ASV: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amaste a justiça, e odiaste a transgressão; por isso, Deus, o teu Deus, te ungiu com óleo de alegria mais que os teus companheiros.
verses.RVR09: Has amado la justicia, y aborrecido la maldad; por lo cual te ungió Dios, el Dios tuyo, con óleo de alegría más que á tus compañeros.

verses.KJV: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.WEB: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
verses.ASV: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning didst lay the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the works of thy hands:
verses.ALMEIDA: E: Tu Senhor, no princípio fundaste a terra, e os céus são obras de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y: Tú, oh Señor, en el principio fundaste la tierra; y los cielos son obras de tus manos:

verses.KJV: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.WEB: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
verses.ASV: They shall perish; but thou continuest: And they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles perecerão, mas tu continuas. Todos eles como roupa se envelhecerão;
verses.RVR09: Ellos perecerán, mas tú eres permanente; y todos ellos se envejecerán como una vestidura;

verses.KJV: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.WEB: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
verses.ASV: And as a mantle shalt thou roll them up, As a garment, and they shall be changed: But thou art the same, And thy years shall not fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: como uma manta tu os envolverás, e serão mudados; porém tu és o mesmo, e os teus anos não cessarão.
verses.RVR09: Y como un vestido los envolverás, y serán mudados; empero tú eres el mismo, y tus años no acabarán.

verses.KJV: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.WEB: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
verses.ASV: But of which of the angels hath he said at any time, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet?
verses.ALMEIDA: E a qual dos anjos ele jamais disse: Senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos como estrado de teus pés?
verses.RVR09: Pues, ¿á cuál de los ángeles dijo jamás: Siéntate á mi diestra, hasta que ponga á tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies?

verses.KJV: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.WEB: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
verses.ASV: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to do service for the sake of them that shall inherit salvation?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não são todos eles espíritos servidores, enviados para auxílio dos que herdarão a salvação?
verses.RVR09: ¿No son todos espíritus administradores, enviados para servicio á favor de los que serán herederos de salud?

verses.KJV: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.WEB: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
verses.ASV: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things that were heard, lest haply we drift away [from them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, devemos prestar atenção com muito mais empenho para as coisas que já ouvimos, para que nunca venhamos a cometer deslizes.
verses.RVR09: POR tanto, es menester que con más diligencia atendamos á las cosas que hemos oído, porque acaso no nos escurramos.

verses.KJV: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.WEB: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
verses.ASV: For if the word spoken through angels proved stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se a palavra pronunciada pelos anjos foi confirmada, e toda transgressão e desobediência recebeu justa retribuição,
verses.RVR09: Porque si la palabra dicha por los ángeles fué firme, y toda rebelión y desobediencia recibió justa paga de retribución,

verses.KJV: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.WEB: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
verses.ASV: how shall we escape, if we neglect so great a salvation? which having at the first been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed unto us by them that heard;
verses.ALMEIDA: como nós escaparemos, se descuidarmos de tão grande salvação? Ela, que começou a ser anunciada pelo Senhor, foi-nos confirmada pelos que ouviram.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo escaparemos nosotros, si tuviéremos en poco una salud tan grande? La cual, habiendo comenzado á ser publicada por el Señor, ha sido confirmada hasta nosotros por los que oyeron;

verses.KJV: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.WEB: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
verses.ASV: God also bearing witness with them, both by signs and wonders, and by manifold powers, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus também deu testemunho com eles, por meio de sinais, milagres, várias maravilhas, e distribuições do Espírito Santo, segundo a sua vontade.
verses.RVR09: Testificando juntamente con ellos Dios, con señales y milagros, y diversas maravillas, y repartimientos del Espíritu Santo según su voluntad.

verses.KJV: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.WEB: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
verses.ASV: For not unto angels did he subject the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não foi aos anjos que ele sujeitou o mundo futuro, do qual estamos falando.
verses.RVR09: Porque no sujetó á los ángeles el mundo venidero, del cual hablamos.

verses.KJV: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man that thou visitest him?
verses.WEB: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.ASV: But one hath somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? Or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas em certo lugar alguém testemunhou, dizendo: O que é o homem, para que te lembres dele? Ou o filho do homem, para que o visites?
verses.RVR09: Testificó empero uno en cierto lugar, diciendo: ¿Qué es el hombre, que te acuerdas de él? ¿ó el hijo del hombre, que le visitas?

verses.KJV: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.WEB: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.ASV: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; Thou crownedst him with glory and honor, And didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu o fizeste um pouco menor que os anjos, de glória e de honra o coroaste, e o estabeleceste sobre as obras das tuas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Tú le hiciste un poco menor que los ángeles, coronástele de gloria y de honra, y pusístele sobre las obras de tus manos;

verses.KJV: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.WEB: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
verses.ASV: Thou didst put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he subjected all things unto him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we see not yet all things subjected to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sujeitaste todas as coisas debaixo de seus pés.Pois ao lhe sujeitar todas as coisas, nada deixou que não fosse sujeito a ele; porém agora ainda não vemos todas as coisas sendo sujeitas a ele.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas sujetaste debajo de sus pies. Porque en cuanto le sujetó todas las cosas, nada dejó que no sea sujeto á él; mas aun no vemos que todas las cosas le sean sujetas.

verses.KJV: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.WEB: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
verses.ASV: But we behold him who hath been made a little lower than the angels, [even] Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for every [man].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vemos coroado de glória e de honra, por causa do sofrimento de morte, aquele Jesus, que havia sido feito um pouco menor que os anjos, a fim de que, pela graça de Deus, experimentasse a morte por todos.
verses.RVR09: Empero vemos coronado de gloria y de honra, por el padecimiento de muerte, á aquel Jesús que es hecho un poco menor que los ángeles, para que por gracia de Dios gustase la muerte por todos.

verses.KJV: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.WEB: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.ASV: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois convinha a aquele, para quem e por quem são todas as coisas, que, quando trouxesse muitos filhos à glória, aperfeiçoasse por meio de aflições o Autor da salvação deles.
verses.RVR09: Porque convenía que aquel por cuya causa son todas las cosas, y por el cual todas las cosas subsisten, habiendo de llevar á la gloria á muchos hijos, hiciese consumado por aflicciones al autor de la salud de ellos.

verses.KJV: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.WEB: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
verses.ASV: For both he that sanctifieth and they that are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tanto o que santifica como os que são santificados, todos são provenientes de um; por isso ele não se envergonha de lhes chamar de irmãos,
verses.RVR09: Porque el que santifica y los que son santificados, de uno son todos: por lo cual no se avergüenza de llamarlos hermanos,

verses.KJV: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.WEB: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
verses.ASV: saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, In the midst of the congregation will I sing thy praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Anunciarei o teu nome aos meus irmãos, cantarei louvores a ti no meio da congregação.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Anunciaré á mis hermanos tu nombre, en medio de la congregación te alabaré.

verses.KJV: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.WEB: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
verses.ASV: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold, I and the children whom God hath given me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outra vez: Nele confiarei. E outra vez: Eis-me aqui, com os filhos que Deus me deu.
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez: Yo confiaré en él. Y otra vez: He aquí, yo y los hijos que me dió Dios.

verses.KJV: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.WEB: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.ASV: Since then the children are sharers in flesh and blood, he also himself in like manner partook of the same; that through death he might bring to nought him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, uma vez que os filhos compartilham da carne e do sangue, também ele, semelhantemente, participou das mesmas coisas, a fim de pela morte aniquilar ao que tinha o poder da morte, isto é, o diabo;
verses.RVR09: Así que, por cuanto los hijos participaron de carne y sangre, él también participó de lo mismo, para destruir por la muerte al que tenía el imperio de la muerte, es á saber, al diablo,

verses.KJV: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.WEB: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.ASV: and might deliver all them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: e libertar a todos os que, por medo da morte, estavam sujeitos à servidão durante a vida toda.
verses.RVR09: Y librar á los que por el temor de la muerte estaban por toda la vida sujetos á servidumbre.

verses.KJV: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.WEB: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
verses.ASV: For verily not to angels doth he give help, but he giveth help to the seed of Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, evidentemente, não é aos anjos que ele ajuda, mas sim, ajuda à descendência de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Porque ciertamente no tomó á los ángeles, sino á la simiente de Abraham tomó.

verses.KJV: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.WEB: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
verses.ASV: Wherefore it behooved him in all things to be made like unto his brethren, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso era necessário que em tudo ele se tornasse semelhante aos irmãos, para ser misericordioso e fiel Sumo Sacerdote nas coisas [relativas] a Deus, para fazer sacrifício de perdão dos pecados do povo.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, debía ser en todo semejante á los hermanos, para venir á ser misericordioso y fiel Pontífice en lo que es para con Dios, para expiar los pecados del pueblo.

verses.KJV: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.WEB: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
verses.ASV: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succor them that are tempted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, naquilo em que ele mesmo sofreu ao ser tentado, ele pode socorrer aos que são tentados.
verses.RVR09: Porque en cuanto él mismo padeció siendo tentado, es poderoso para socorrer á los que son tentados.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.WEB: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
verses.ASV: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, [even] Jesus;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, santos irmãos, participantes do chamado celestial, considerai o Apóstolo e Sumo Sacerdote da nossa declaração de fé, Cristo Jesus.
verses.RVR09: POR tanto, hermanos santos, participantes de la vocación celestial, considerad al Apóstol y Pontífice de nuestra profesión, Cristo Jesús;

verses.KJV: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.WEB: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
verses.ASV: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é fiel àquele que o constituiu, assim como Moisés também foi em toda a casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El cual es fiel al que le constituyó, como también lo fué Moisés sobre toda su casa.

verses.KJV: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.WEB: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
verses.ASV: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele é estimado como digno de maior glória do que Moisés, assim como mais honra do que a casa tem quem a construiu.
verses.RVR09: Porque de tanto mayor gloria que Moisés éste es estimado digno, cuanto tiene mayor dignidad que la casa el que la fabricó.

verses.KJV: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.WEB: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
verses.ASV: For every house is builded by some one; but he that built all things is God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda casa é construída por alguém; mas aquele que construiu todas as coisas é Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda casa es edificada de alguno: mas el que crió todas las cosas es Dios.

verses.KJV: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.WEB: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
verses.ASV: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken;
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato, Moisés foi fiel como servo em toda a casa de Deus, para testemunho das coisas que haviam de ser ditas;
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés á la verdad fué fiel sobre toda su casa, como siervo, para testificar lo que se había de decir;

verses.KJV: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.WEB: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
verses.ASV: but Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we hold fast our boldness and the glorying of our hope firm unto the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas Cristo [é fiel] como Filho sobre a sua casa. E nós somos sua casa, se até o fim mantivermos firmes a confiança e o orgulho da [nossa] esperança.
verses.RVR09: Mas Cristo como hijo, sobre su casa; la cual casa somos nosotros, si hasta el cabo retuviéremos firme la confianza y la gloria de la esperanza.

verses.KJV: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.WEB: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
verses.ASV: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, como diz o Espírito Santo: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz,
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, como dice el Espíritu Santo: Si oyereis hoy su voz,

verses.KJV: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.WEB: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
verses.ASV: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
verses.ALMEIDA: não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação, no dia da tentação no deserto;
verses.RVR09: No endurezcáis vuestros corazones como en la provocación, en el día de la tentación en el desierto,

verses.KJV: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.WEB: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
verses.ASV: Where your fathers tried [me] by proving [me], And saw my works forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: onde os vossos pais me tentaram, me provaram, e viram as minhas obras por quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Donde me tentaron vuestros padres; me probaron, y vieron mis obras cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.WEB: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
verses.ASV: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso me indignei contra essa geração, e disse: “Eles sempre se desviam nos corações, e não conheceram os meus caminhos”;
verses.RVR09: A causa de lo cual me enemisté con esta generación, y dije: Siempre divagan ellos de corazón, y no han conocido mis caminos.

verses.KJV: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.WEB: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
verses.ASV: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então jurei na minha ira: “Eles não entrarão no meu repouso”.
verses.RVR09: Juré, pues, en mi ira: No entrarán en mi reposo.

verses.KJV: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.WEB: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
verses.ASV: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuidado, irmãos, para que nunca haja em algum de vós coração mau e infiel, que se afaste do Deus vivo.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, hermanos, que en ninguno de vosotros haya corazón malo de incredulidad para apartarse del Dios vivo:

verses.KJV: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.WEB: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.ASV: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, encorajai-vos uns aos outros a cada dia, durante o tempo chamado “hoje”; a fim de que nenhum de vós se endureça pelo engano do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Antes exhortaos los unos á los otros cada día, entre tanto que se dice Hoy; porque ninguno de vosotros se endurezca con engaño de pecado:

verses.KJV: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.WEB: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
verses.ASV: for we are become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm unto the end:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nós temos nos tornado participantes de Cristo, se, de fato, mantivermos firme a confiança do princípio até o fim;
verses.RVR09: Porque participantes de Cristo somos hechos, con tal que conservemos firme hasta el fin el principio de nuestra confianza;

verses.KJV: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.WEB: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
verses.ASV: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.ALMEIDA: como é dito: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação.
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que se dice: Si oyereis hoy su voz, no endurezcáis vuestros corazones, como en la provocación.

verses.KJV: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.WEB: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
verses.ASV: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque alguns, mesmo ouvindo, provocaram-no [à ira] , mas não todos aqueles que saíram do Egito por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Porque algunos de los que habían salido de Egipto con Moisés, habiendo oído, provocaron, aunque no todos.

verses.KJV: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.WEB: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
