verses.ASV: And with whom was he displeased forty years? was it not with them that sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.ALMEIDA: E contra quais ele se indignou por quarenta anos? Não foi contra os que pecaram, cujos corpos caíram no deserto?
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿con cuáles estuvo enojado cuarenta años? ¿No fué con los que pecaron, cuyos cuerpos cayeron en el desierto?

verses.KJV: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.WEB: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
verses.ASV: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that were disobedient?
verses.ALMEIDA: E a quem ele jurou que não entrariam no seu repouso, senão aos que foram desobedientes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y á quiénes juró que no entrarían en su reposo, sino á aquellos que no obedecieron?

verses.KJV: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.WEB: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
verses.ASV: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim vemos que não puderam entrar por causa da incredulidade.
verses.RVR09: Y vemos que no pudieron entrar á causa de incredulidad.

verses.KJV: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.WEB: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
verses.ASV: Let us fear therefore, lest haply, a promise being left of entering into his rest, any one of you should seem to have come short of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temamos, pois, para que, havendo sido deixada a promessa de entrar no seu repouso, não pareça que algum de vós tenha ficado para trás.
verses.RVR09: TEMAMOS, pues, que quedando aún la promesa de entrar en su reposo, parezca alguno de vosotros haberse apartado.

verses.KJV: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.WEB: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
verses.ASV: For indeed we have had good tidings preached unto us, even as also they: but the word of hearing did not profit them, because it was not united by faith with them that heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois também a nós foi pregado o evangelho, assim como a eles; mas a palavra da pregação nada lhes aproveitou, porque não estava combinada com a fé naqueles que [a] ouviram.
verses.RVR09: Porque también á nosotros se nos ha evangelizado como á ellos; mas no les aprovechó el oir la palabra á los que la oyeron sin mezclar fe.

verses.KJV: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.WEB: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.ASV: For we who have believed do enter into that rest; even as he hath said, As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós, os que cremos, entramos no repouso, como ele disse: Então jurei na minha ira: “Eles não entrarão no meu repouso”; ainda que as [suas] obras já estivessem terminadas desde a fundação do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Empero entramos en el reposo los que hemos creído, de la manera que dijo: Como juré en mi ira, no entrarán en mi reposo: aun acabadas las obras desde el principio del mundo.

verses.KJV: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.WEB: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
verses.ASV: For he hath said somewhere of the seventh [day] on this wise, And God rested on the seventh day from all his works;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, em certo lugar, ele disse assim a respeito do [dia] sétimo: E Deus repousou no sétimo dia de todas as suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Porque en un cierto lugar dijo así del séptimo día: Y reposó Dios de todas sus obras en el séptimo día.

verses.KJV: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.WEB: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
verses.ASV: and in this [place] again, They shall not enter into my rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, outra vez neste [texto] : Não entrarão no meu repouso.
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez aquí: No entrarán en mi reposo.

verses.KJV: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.WEB: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
verses.ASV: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some should enter thereinto, and they to whom the good tidings were before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, uma vez que resta alguns entrarem no repouso, e que aqueles a quem primeiramente foi pregado o evangelho não entraram por causa da desobediência,
verses.RVR09: Así que, pues que resta que algunos han de entrar en él, y aquellos á quienes primero fué anunciado no entraron por causa de desobediencia,

verses.KJV: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.WEB: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
verses.ASV: he again defineth a certain day, To-day, saying in David so long a time afterward (even as hath been said before), To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: outra vez ele determina um certo dia, o “hoje”, dizendo por meio de Davi muito tempo depois (como já foi dito): Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações.
verses.RVR09: Determina otra vez un cierto día, diciendo por David: Hoy, después de tanto tiempo; como está dicho: Si oyereis su voz hoy, no endurezcáis vuestros corazones.

verses.KJV: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.WEB: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
verses.ASV: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se Josué tivesse lhes dado repouso, ele não teria falado depois a respeito de outro dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque si Josué les hubiera dado el reposo, no hablaría después de otro día.

verses.KJV: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.WEB: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
verses.ASV: There remaineth therefore a sabbath rest for the people of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ainda resta um repouso como o do sábado para o povo de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, queda un reposo para el pueblo de Dios.

verses.KJV: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
verses.WEB: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
verses.ASV: For he that is entered into his rest hath himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois aquele que entrou no seu repouso também repousou das suas obras, assim como Deus das suas.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que ha entrado en su reposo, también él ha reposado de sus obras, como Dios de las suyas.

verses.KJV: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.WEB: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
verses.ASV: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, that no man fall after the same example of disobedience.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procuremos, pois, entrar naquele repouso; para que ninguém caia no mesmo exemplo de desobediência.
verses.RVR09: Procuremos pues de entrar en aquel reposo; que ninguno caiga en semejante ejemplo de desobediencia.

verses.KJV: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.WEB: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.ASV: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and quick to discern the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a palavra de Deus é viva e eficaz, e mais afiada do que toda espada de dois gumes, e que penetra até a divisão da alma e do espírito, das juntas e das medulas, e é apta para julgar os pensamentos e intenções do coração.
verses.RVR09: Porque la palabra de Dios es viva y eficaz, y más penetrante que toda espada de dos filos: y que alcanza hasta partir el alma, y aun el espíritu, y las coyunturas y tuétanos, y discierne los pensamientos y las intenciones del corazón.

verses.KJV: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.WEB: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
verses.ASV: And there is no creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não há criatura alguma encoberta diante dele; pelo contrário, todas as coisas estão nuas e expostas aos olhos daquele a quem temos de prestar contas.
verses.RVR09: Y no hay cosa criada que no sea manifiesta en su presencia; antes todas las cosas están desnudas y abiertas á los ojos de aquel á quien tenemos que dar cuenta.

verses.KJV: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.WEB: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
verses.ASV: Having then a great high priest, who hath passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que temos um grande Sumo Sacerdote, Jesus, o Filho de Deus, que penetrou nos céus, mantenhamos firme a [nossa] declaração de fé.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, teniendo un gran Pontífice, que penetró los cielos, Jesús el Hijo de Dios, retengamos nuestra profesión.

verses.KJV: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.WEB: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
verses.ASV: For we have not a high priest that cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but one that hath been in all points tempted like as [we are, yet] without sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não temos um Sumo Sacerdote que não possa se compadecer das nossas fraquezas; mas, sim, um que foi provado em tudo, conforme a [nossa] semelhança, [porém] sem pecado.
verses.RVR09: Porque no tenemos un Pontífice que no se pueda compadecer de nuestras flaquezas; mas tentado en todo según nuestra semejanza, pero sin pecado.

verses.KJV: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.WEB: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
verses.ASV: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help [us] in time of need.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, acheguemo-nos com confiança ao trono da graça, para que possamos receber misericórdia e encontrar graça para sermos socorridos no tempo adequado.
verses.RVR09: Lleguémonos pues confiadamente al trono de la gracia, para alcanzar misericordia, y hallar gracia para el oportuno socorro.

verses.KJV: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.WEB: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.ASV: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todo sumo sacerdote tomado dentre os homens é constituído em prol das pessoas nas coisas [relativas] a Deus, para apresentar tanto ofertas como sacrifícios pelos pecados;
verses.RVR09: PORQUE todo pontífice, tomado de entre los hombres, es constituído á favor de los hombres en lo que á Dios toca, para que ofrezca presentes y sacrificios por los pecados:

verses.KJV: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.WEB: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
verses.ASV: who can bear gently with the ignorant and erring, for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity;
verses.ALMEIDA: e ele é capaz de se compadecer dos ignorantes e dos errados, pois ele mesmo também está rodeado de fraqueza.
verses.RVR09: Que se pueda compadecer de los ignorantes y extraviados, pues que él también está rodeado de flaqueza;

verses.KJV: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.WEB: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
verses.ASV: and by reason thereof is bound, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E, por causa desta [fraqueza] ,ele tem o dever de apresentar oferenda, tanto pelos pecados do povo, como também de si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Y por causa de ella debe, como por sí mismo, así también por el pueblo, ofrecer por los pecados.

verses.KJV: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
verses.WEB: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
verses.ASV: And no man taketh the honor unto himself, but when he is called of God, even as was Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém toma para si esta honra, a não ser aquele que é chamado por Deus, como Arão.
verses.RVR09: Ni nadie toma para sí la honra, sino el que es llamado de Dios, como Aarón.

verses.KJV: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.WEB: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
verses.ASV: So Christ also glorified not himself to be made a high priest, but he that spake unto him, Thou art my Son, This day have I begotten thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também Cristo não glorificou a si mesmo para se fazer Sumo Sacerdote; mas sim, àquele que lhe disse: Tu és meu Filho, eu hoje te gerei.
verses.RVR09: Así también Cristo no se glorificó á sí mismo haciéndose Pontífice, mas el que le dijo: Tú eres mi Hijo, yo te he engendrado hoy;

verses.KJV: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.WEB: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.ASV: as he saith also in another [place], Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também diz em outro [texto] : Tu és Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.RVR09: Como también dice en otro lugar: Tú eres sacerdote eternamente, según el orden de Melchîsedec.

verses.KJV: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.WEB: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
verses.ASV: Who in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, nos dias de seu corpo carnal, ofereceu com grande clamor e lágrimas, tanto orações como súplicas para aquele que podia o livrar da morte, e foi ouvido por causa da devoção.
verses.RVR09: El cual en los días de su carne, ofreciendo ruegos y súplicas con gran clamor y lágrimas al que le podía librar de la muerte, fué oído por su reverencial miedo.

verses.KJV: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.WEB: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
verses.ASV: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que ele era o Filho, aprendeu a obediência por meio das coisas que sofreu.
verses.RVR09: Y aunque era Hijo, por lo que padeció aprendió la obediencia;

verses.KJV: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.WEB: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
verses.ASV: and having been made perfect, he became unto all them that obey him the author of eternal salvation;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, depois de ter sido consumado, ele foi feito autor da eterna salvação a todos os que lhe obedecem;
verses.RVR09: Y consumado, vino á ser causa de eterna salud á todos los que le obedecen;

verses.KJV: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.WEB: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ASV: named of God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ALMEIDA: e nomeado por Deus como Sumo Sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.RVR09: Nombrado de Dios pontífice según el orden de Melchîsedec.

verses.KJV: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.WEB: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
verses.ASV: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard of interpretation, seeing ye are become dull of hearing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso comentário a respeito disso é extenso e difícil de explicar, porque vos tornastes negligentes para ouvir.
verses.RVR09: Del cual tenemos mucho que decir, y dificultoso de declarar, por cuanto sois flacos para oir.

verses.KJV: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.WEB: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
verses.ASV: For when by reason of the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need again that some one teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of solid food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, pelo tempo, vós já devíeis ser mestres; porém novamente tendes necessidade de serdes ensinados os princípios básicos das palavras de Deus; e vos fizestes como se precisásseis de leite, e não de alimento sólido.
verses.RVR09: Porque debiendo ser ya maestros á causa del tiempo, tenéis necesidad de volver á ser enseñados cuáles sean los primeros rudimentos de las palabras de Dios; y habéis llegado á ser tales que tengáis necesidad de leche, y no de manjar sólido.

verses.KJV: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.WEB: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
verses.ASV: For every one that partaketh of milk is without experience of the word of righteousness; for he is a babe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qualquer um que depende de leite é inexperiente na palavra da justiça; porque [ainda] é um bebê.
verses.RVR09: Que cualquiera que participa de la leche, es inhábil para la palabra de la justicia, porque es niño;

verses.KJV: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.WEB: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
verses.ASV: But solid food is for fullgrown men, [even] those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o alimento sólido é para os maduros, os quais, pelo costume, têm os sentidos treinados para discernirem tanto o bem como o mal.
verses.RVR09: Mas la vianda firme es para los perfectos, para los que por la costumbre tienen los sentidos ejercitados en el discernimiento del bien y del mal.

verses.KJV: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.WEB: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
verses.ASV: Wherefore leaving the doctrine of the first principles of Christ, let us press on unto perfection; not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto deixemos os tópicos elementares da doutrina de Cristo, e prossigamos adiante até a maturidade, sem lançarmos de novo o fundamento da conversão de obras mortas, e da fé em Deus,
verses.RVR09: POR tanto, dejando la palabra del comienzo en la doctrina de Cristo, vamos adelante á la perfección; no echando otra vez el fundamento del arrepentimiento de obras muertas, y de la fe en Dios,

verses.KJV: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.WEB: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.ASV: of the teaching of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: da doutrina dos batismos, da imposição das mãos, da ressurreição dos mortos, e do juízo eterno.
verses.RVR09: De la doctrina de bautismos, y de la imposición de manos, y de la resurrección de los muertos, y del juicio eterno.

verses.KJV: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.WEB: This will we do, if God permits.
verses.ASV: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isso faremos, se Deus permitir.
verses.RVR09: Y esto haremos á la verdad, si Dios lo permitiere.

verses.KJV: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.WEB: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
verses.ASV: For as touching those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois é impossível que os que uma vez foram iluminados, e experimentaram o dom celestial, e foram feitos participantes do Espírito Santo,
verses.RVR09: Porque es imposible que los que una vez fueron iluminados y gustaron el don celestial, y fueron hechos partícipes del Espíritu Santo,

verses.KJV: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.WEB: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
verses.ASV: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,
verses.ALMEIDA: e experimentaram a boa palavra de Deus, e os poderes do mundo futuro;
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo gustaron la buena palabra de Dios, y las virtudes del siglo venidero,

verses.KJV: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.WEB: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
verses.ASV: and [then] fell away, it is impossible to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: e então caíram, outra vez renová-los para o arrependimento, porque estão novamente crucificando o Filho de Deus para si mesmos, e o expondo à vergonha pública.
verses.RVR09: Y recayeron, sean otra vez renovados para arrepentimiento, crucificando de nuevo para sí mismos al Hijo de Dios, y exponiéndole á vituperio.

verses.KJV: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.WEB: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
verses.ASV: For the land which hath drunk the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a terra que absorve a chuva que com frequência vem sobre ela, e produz vegetação proveitosa para aqueles por quem e lavrada, recebe a bênção de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque la tierra que embebe el agua que muchas veces vino sobre ella, y produce hierba provechosa á aquellos de los cuales es labrada, recibe bendición de Dios:

verses.KJV: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.WEB: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
verses.ASV: but if it beareth thorns and thistles, it is rejected and nigh unto a curse; whose end is to be burned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo, se ela produz espinhos e cardos, é reprovada, e perto está da maldição. O seu fim é ser queimada.
verses.RVR09: Mas la que produce espinas y abrojos, es reprobada, y cercana de maldición; cuyo fin será el ser abrasada.

verses.KJV: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.WEB: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
verses.ASV: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, ainda que estejamos falando assim, quanto a vós mesmos, amados, confiamos melhores coisas, relacionadas à salvação.
verses.RVR09: Pero de vosotros, oh amados, esperamos mejores cosas, y más cercanas á salud, aunque hablamos así.

verses.KJV: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.WEB: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
verses.ASV: for God is not unrighteous to forget your work and the love which ye showed toward his name, in that ye ministered unto the saints, and still do minister.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus não é injusto para se esquecer da vossa obra, e do trabalho do amor que mostrastes para com o nome dele, quando servistes aos santos, e continuais a servir.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios no es injusto para olvidar vuestra obra y el trabajo de amor que habéis mostrado á su nombre, habiendo asistido y asistiendo aún á los santos.

verses.KJV: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.WEB: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
verses.ASV: And we desire that each one of you may show the same diligence unto the fulness of hope even to the end:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas desejamos que cada um de vós mostre o mesmo empenho até o fim, para que a [vossa] esperança seja completa;
verses.RVR09: Mas deseamos que cada uno de vosotros muestre la misma solicitud hasta el cabo, para cumplimiento de la esperanza:

verses.KJV: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.WEB: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
verses.ASV: that ye be not sluggish, but imitators of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que não vos torneis negligentes, mas sim, imitadores dos que pela fé e pela paciência herdam as promessas.
verses.RVR09: Que no os hagáis perezosos, mas imitadores de aquellos que por la fe y la paciencia heredan las promesas.

verses.KJV: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.WEB: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
verses.ASV: For when God made promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he sware by himself,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus, quando prometeu a Abraão, como ninguém maior havia por quem jurar, jurou por si mesmo,
verses.RVR09: Porque prometiendo Dios á Abraham, no pudiendo jurar por otro mayor, juró por sí mismo,

verses.KJV: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.WEB: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
verses.ASV: saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Certamente muito te abençoarei, e muito te multiplicarei.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: De cierto te bendeciré bendiciendo, y multiplicando te multiplicaré.

verses.KJV: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.WEB: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.ASV: And thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim, esperando pacientemente, [Abraão] obteve a promessa.
verses.RVR09: Y así, esperando con largura de ánimo, alcanzó la promesa.

verses.KJV: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.WEB: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
verses.ASV: For men swear by the greater: and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois as pessoas juram por alguém maior, e o juramento como confirmação é o fim de todo conflito entre elas.
verses.RVR09: Porque los hombres ciertamente por el mayor que ellos juran: y el fin de todas sus controversias es el juramento para confirmación.

verses.KJV: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.WEB: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
verses.ASV: Wherein God, being minded to show more abundantly unto the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Deus, querendo mostrar mais abundantemente a imutabilidade de sua intenção aos herdeiros da promessa, garantiu com um juramento;
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, queriendo Dios mostrar más abundantemente á los herederos de la promesa la inmutabilidad de su consejo, interpuso juramento;

verses.KJV: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.WEB: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
verses.ASV: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to lay hold of the hope set before us:
verses.ALMEIDA: a fim de que, por meio de duas coisas imutáveis, nas quais é impossível que Deus minta, nós, que buscamos refúgio, tenhamos encorajamento para agarrar a esperança posta diante [de nós] .
verses.RVR09: Para que por dos cosas inmutables, en las cuales es imposible que Dios mienta, tengamos un fortísimo consuelo, los que nos acogemos á trabarnos de la esperanza propuesta:

verses.KJV: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.WEB: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
verses.ASV: which we have as an anchor of the soul, [a hope] both sure and stedfast and entering into that which is within the veil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Temos essa esperança como uma segura e firme âncora da alma, que entra ao interior, além do véu,
verses.RVR09: La cual tenemos como segura y firme ancla del alma, y que entra hasta dentro del velo;

verses.KJV: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.WEB: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ASV: whither as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ALMEIDA: onde, [como] precursor, Jesus entrou para nosso benefício, pois ele se tornou Sumo Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.RVR09: Donde entró por nosotros como precursor Jesús, hecho Pontífice eternalmente según el orden de Melchîsedec.

verses.KJV: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.WEB: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.ASV: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, sacerdote do Deus Altíssimo, o qual se encontrou com Abraão, que estava retornando da matança dos reis, e o abençoou;
verses.RVR09: PORQUE este Melchîsedec, rey de Salem, sacerdote del Dios Altísimo, el cual salió á recibir á Abraham que volvía de la derrota de los reyes, y le bendijo,

verses.KJV: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.WEB: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
verses.ASV: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, King of righteousness, and then also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.ALMEIDA: a quem também Abraão deu o dízimo de tudo; primeiramente significa Rei de justiça, e depois também rei de Salém, que é, rei de paz;
verses.RVR09: Al cual asimismo dió Abraham los diezmos de todo, primeramente él se interpreta Rey de justicia; y luego también Rey de Salem, que es, Rey de paz;

verses.KJV: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.WEB: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
verses.ASV: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like unto the Son of God), abideth a priest continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: sem pai, sem mãe, sem genealogia, sem ter princípio de dias, nem fim de vida; porém, sendo feito semelhante ao Filho de Deus, permanece sacerdote para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Sin padre, sin madre, sin linaje; que ni tiene principio de días, ni fin de vida, mas hecho semejante al Hijo de Dios, permanece sacerdote para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.WEB: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
verses.ASV: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the chief spoils.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai, pois, como ele era grande, a quem até o patriarca Abraão deu o dízimo dos despojos.
verses.RVR09: Mirad pues cuán grande fué éste, al cual aun Abraham el patriarca dió diezmos de los despojos.

verses.KJV: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.WEB: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
verses.ASV: And they indeed of the sons of Levi that receive the priest’s office have commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though these have come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.ALMEIDA: E, realmente, os que dentre os filhos de Levi recebem o sacerdócio têm ordem, segundo a Lei, de receberem os dízimos do povo, isto é, dos seus irmãos, mesmo sendo eles também descendentes de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y ciertamente los que de los hijos de Leví toman el sacerdocio, tienen mandamiento de tomar del pueblo los diezmos según la ley, es á saber, de sus hermanos aunque también hayan salido de los lomos de Abraham.

verses.KJV: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.WEB: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
verses.ASV: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them hath taken tithes of Abraham, and hath blessed him that hath the promises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que não é contado na genealogia deles recebeu dízimos de Abraão, e abençoou ao que tinha as promessas.
verses.RVR09: Mas aquél cuya genealogía no es contada de ellos, tomó de Abraham los diezmos, y bendijo al que tenía las promesas.

verses.KJV: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.WEB: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
verses.ASV: But without any dispute the less is blessed of the better.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, sem contradição alguma, o menor é abençoado pelo maior.
verses.RVR09: Y sin contradicción alguna, lo que es menos es bendecido de lo que es más.

verses.KJV: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.WEB: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
verses.ASV: And here men that die receive tithes; but there one, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em um caso, homens mortais recebem dízimos; mas no outro, aquele de quem se dá testemunho de que vive.
verses.RVR09: Y aquí ciertamente los hombres mortales toman los diezmos: mas allí, aquel del cual está dado testimonio que vive.

verses.KJV: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.WEB: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
verses.ASV: And, so to say, through Abraham even Levi, who receiveth tithes, hath paid tithes;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, por assim dizer, até Levi, que recebe os dízimos, pagou dízimos através de Abraão;
verses.RVR09: Y, por decirlo así, en Abraham fué diezmado también Leví, que recibe los diezmos;

verses.KJV: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.WEB: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
verses.ASV: for he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchizedek met him.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois ele ainda estava no corpo de [seu] ancestral quando Melquisedeque se encontrou com ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun estaba en los lomos de su padre cuando Melchîsedec le salió al encuentro.

verses.KJV: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.WEB: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.ASV: Now if there was perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it hath the people received the law), what further need [was there] that another priest should arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be reckoned after the order of Aaron?
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, se a perfeição tivesse sido de fato pelo sacerdócio Levítico (pois sob ele o povo recebeu a Lei), que mais necessidade havia de se levantar outro Sacerdote segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque, e não ser chamado segundo a ordem de Arão?
verses.RVR09: Si pues la perfección era por el sacerdocio Levítico (porque debajo de él recibió el pueblo la ley) ¿qué necesidad había aún de que se levantase otro sacerdote según el orden de Melchîsedec, y que no fuese llamado según el orden de Aarón?

verses.KJV: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.WEB: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
verses.ASV: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, ao se mudar o sacerdócio, necessariamente também se faz mudança de Lei.
verses.RVR09: Pues mudado el sacerdocio, necesario es que se haga también mudanza de la ley.

verses.KJV: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.WEB: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
verses.ASV: For he of whom these things are said belongeth to another tribe, from which no man hath given attendance at the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aquele de quem estas coisas são ditas pertence a outra tribo, da qual ninguém serviu ao altar;
verses.RVR09: Porque aquel del cual esto se dice, de otra tribu es, de la cual nadie asistió al altar.

verses.KJV: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.WEB: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.ASV: For it is evident that our Lord hath sprung out of Judah; as to which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: visto ser evidente que o nosso Senhor é procedente de Judá, tribo da qual Moisés nada falou a respeito de sacerdócio.
verses.RVR09: Porque notorio es que el Señor nuestro nació de la tribu de Judá, sobre cuya tribu nada habló Moisés tocante al sacerdocio.

verses.KJV: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.WEB: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
verses.ASV: And [what we say] is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there ariseth another priest,
verses.ALMEIDA: E [isso] ainda é muito mais evidente se, à semelhança de Melquisedeque, levanta-se outro sacerdote,
verses.RVR09: Y aun más manifiesto es, si á semejanza de Melchîsedec se levanta otro sacerdote,

verses.KJV: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.WEB: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
verses.ASV: who hath been made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life:
verses.ALMEIDA: que foi constituído, não conforme a Lei de um mandamento carnal, mas sim, conforme o poder de uma vida indestrutível.
verses.RVR09: El cual no es hecho conforme á la ley del mandamiento carnal, sino según la virtud de vida indisoluble;

verses.KJV: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.WEB: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.ASV: for it is witnessed [of him], Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois [assim] ele dá testemunho: Tu és Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.RVR09: Pues se da testimonio de él: Tú eres sacerdote para siempre, según el orden de Melchîsedec.

verses.KJV: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.WEB: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
verses.ASV: For there is a disannulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and unprofitableness
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque há uma revogação do mandamento anterior, por causa da sua fraqueza e inutilidade,
verses.RVR09: El mandamiento precedente, cierto se abroga por su flaqueza é inutilidad;

verses.KJV: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.WEB: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
verses.ASV: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in thereupon of a better hope, through which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois a Lei não tornou perfeito nada. Porém, uma esperança melhor é introduzida, e por meio dela nos aproximamos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque nada perfeccionó la ley; mas hízolo la introducción de mejor esperanza, por la cual nos acercamos á Dios.

verses.KJV: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.WEB: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
verses.ASV: And inasmuch as [it is] not without the taking of an oath
verses.ALMEIDA: E isso não foi [feito] sem juramento (pois os outros se tornaram sacerdotes sem juramento,
verses.RVR09: Y por cuanto no fué sin juramento,

verses.KJV: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.WEB: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
verses.ASV: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath; but he with an oath by him that saith of him, The Lord sware and will not repent himself, Thou art a priest for ever);
verses.ALMEIDA: mas ele [foi estabelecido] com um juramento daquele que lhe disse: O Senhor jurou, e não se arrependerá: Tu és Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque).
verses.RVR09: (Porque los otros cierto sin juramento fueron hechos sacerdotes; mas éste, con juramento por el que le dijo: Juró el Señor, y no se arrepentirá: Tú eres sacerdote eternamente según el orden de Melchîsedec:)

verses.KJV: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.WEB: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
verses.ASV: by so much also hath Jesus become the surety of a better covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, Jesus foi feito fiador de um pacto ainda melhor.
verses.RVR09: Tanto de mejor testamento es hecho fiador Jesús.

verses.KJV: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.WEB: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
verses.ASV: And they indeed have been made priests many in number, because that by death they are hindered from continuing:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos outros, são muitos os que se tornaram sacerdotes, pois pela morte foram impedidos de continuar;
verses.RVR09: Y los otros cierto fueron muchos sacerdotes, en cuanto por la muerte no podían permanecer.

verses.KJV: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.WEB: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
verses.ASV: but he, because he abideth for ever, hath his priesthood unchangeable.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas ele, porque permanece para sempre, tem um sacerdócio definitivo.
verses.RVR09: Mas éste, por cuanto permanece para siempre, tiene un sacerdocio inmutable:

verses.KJV: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.WEB: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
verses.ASV: Wherefore also he is able to save to the uttermost them that draw near unto God through him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ele também pode salvar de maneira completa os que se aproximam de Deus por meio dele, visto que ele vive para sempre para interceder por eles.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual puede también salvar eternamente á los que por él se allegan á Dios, viviendo siempre para interceder por ellos.

verses.KJV: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.WEB: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.ASV: For such a high priest became us, holy, guileless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nos era conveniente tal Sumo Sacerdote: santo, inocente, incontaminado, separado dos pecadores, e feito mais elevado que os céus;
verses.RVR09: Porque tal pontífice nos convenía: santo, inocente, limpio, apartado de los pecadores, y hecho más sublime que los cielos;

verses.KJV: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.WEB: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
verses.ASV: who needeth not daily, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for his own sins, and then for the [sins] of the people: for this he did once for all, when he offered up himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: que não precisasse, como os sumos sacerdotes, de oferecer sacrifícios diariamente, primeiramente pelos seus próprios pecados, e depois pelos do povo. Pois ele fez isto de uma vez por todas quando ofereceu a si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Que no tiene necesidad cada día, como los otros sacerdotes, de ofrecer primero sacrificios por sus pecados, y luego por los del pueblo: porque esto lo hizo una sola vez, ofreciéndose á sí mismo.

verses.KJV: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.WEB: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
verses.ASV: For the law appointeth men high priests, having infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was after the law, [appointeth] a Son, perfected for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a Lei constitui por sumos sacerdotes homens que têm fraqueza; mas a palavra do juramento, que [veio] depois da Lei, [constitui] o Filho, que se tornou perfeito para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ley constituye sacerdotes á hombres flacos; mas la palabra del juramento, después de la ley, constituye al Hijo, hecho perfecto para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.WEB: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
verses.ASV: Now in the things which we are saying the chief point [is this]: We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, o ponto-chave do que falamos é que temos um Sumo Sacerdote que está sentado à direita do trono da Majestade nos céus,
verses.RVR09: ASÍ que, la suma acerca de lo dicho es: Tenemos tal pontífice que se asentó á la diestra del trono de la Majestad en los cielos;

verses.KJV: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
verses.WEB: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
verses.ASV: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.
verses.ALMEIDA: servidor do Santuário, e do verdadeiro Tabernáculo, que Senhor ergueu, e não o homem.
verses.RVR09: Ministro del santuario, y de aquel verdadero tabernáculo que el Señor asentó, y no hombre.

verses.KJV: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.WEB: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
verses.ASV: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is necessary that this [high priest] also have somewhat to offer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todo sumo sacerdote é constituído para apresentar tanto ofertas como sacrifícios; por isso era necessário que também este tivesse alguma coisa a oferecer.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo pontífice es puesto para ofrecer presentes y sacrificios; por lo cual es necesario que también éste tuviese algo que ofrecer.

verses.KJV: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
verses.WEB: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
verses.ASV: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are those who offer the gifts according to the law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, se ele [ainda] estivesse na terra, nem sequer seria sacerdote, já que [ainda] há os sacerdotes que apresentam as ofertas segundo a Lei.
verses.RVR09: Así que, si estuviese sobre la tierra, ni aun sería sacerdote, habiendo aún los sacerdotes que ofrecen los presentes según la ley;

verses.KJV: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.WEB: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
verses.ASV: who serve [that which is] a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses is warned [of God] when he is about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern that was showed thee in the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esses servem a um esboço, uma sombra das coisas celestiais, como Moisés foi divinamente avisado, antes de construir o Tabernáculo. Porque [Deus] disse: Olha, faze tudo conforme o modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales sirven de bosquejo y sombra de las cosas celestiales, como fué respondido á Moisés cuando había de acabar el tabernáculo: Mira, dice, haz todas las cosas conforme al dechado que te ha sido mostrado en el monte.

verses.KJV: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.WEB: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
verses.ASV: But now hath he obtained a ministry the more excellent, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which hath been enacted upon better promises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora [Jesus] obteve um ofício mais relevante, como é também Mediador de um melhor pacto, que está firmado em melhores promessas.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora tanto mejor ministerio es el suyo, cuanto es mediador de un mejor pacto, el cual ha sido formado sobre mejores promesas.

verses.KJV: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.WEB: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
verses.ASV: For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, then would no place have been sought for a second.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se aquele primeiro tivesse sido infalível, nunca haveria se buscado lugar para o segundo.
verses.RVR09: Porque si aquel primero fuera sin falta, cierto no se hubiera procurado lugar de segundo.

verses.KJV: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
verses.WEB: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
verses.ASV: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, That I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, enquanto [Deus] repreendia os do povo, disse-lhes: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, que, sobre o povo de Israel e sobre o povo de Judá, estabelecerei um novo pacto;
verses.RVR09: Porque reprendiéndolos dice: He aquí vienen días, dice el Señor, y consumaré para con la casa de Israel y para con la casa de Judá un nuevo pacto;

verses.KJV: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
verses.ASV: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers In the day that I took them by the hand to lead them forth out of the land of Egypt; For they continued not in my covenant, And I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: não conforme o pacto que fiz com os seus ancestrais no dia em que eu os tomei pelas mãos, para os tirar da terra do Egito. Pois não permaneceram naquele meu pacto, e parei de lhes dar atenção, diz o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: No como el pacto que hice con sus padres el día que los tomé por la mano para sacarlos de la tierra de Egipto: porque ellos no permanecieron en mi pacto, y yo los menosprecié, dice el Señor.

verses.KJV: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.WEB: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.ASV: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel After those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, And on their heart also will I write them: And I will be to them a God, And they shall be to me a people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este, pois, é o pacto que farei com o povo de Israel depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei minhas leis nas mentes deles, e as escreverei em seus corações. Eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, este es el pacto que ordenaré á la casa de Israel después de aquellos días, dice el Señor: Daré mis leyes en el alma de ellos, y sobre el corazón de ellos las escribiré; y seré á ellos por Dios, y ellos me serán á mí por pueblo:

verses.KJV: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.WEB: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
verses.ASV: And they shall not teach every man his fellow-citizen, And every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: For all shall know me, From the least to the greatest of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não terão de ensinar cada um ao seu próximo, ou ao seu irmão, dizendo: “Conhece ao Senhor”; porque todos me conhecerão, desde o menor deles até o maior.
verses.RVR09: Y ninguno enseñará á su prójimo, ni ninguno á su hermano, diciendo: Conoce al Señor: porque todos me conocerán, desde el menor de ellos hasta el mayor.

verses.KJV: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.WEB: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
verses.ASV: For I will be merciful to their iniquities, And their sins will I remember no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois serei misericordioso com as suas injustiças, e não mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados e das suas transgressões.
verses.RVR09: Porque seré propicio á sus injusticias, y de sus pecados y de sus iniquidades no me acordaré más.

verses.KJV: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.WEB: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
verses.ASV: In that he saith, A new [covenant], he hath made the first old. But that which is becoming old and waxeth aged is nigh unto vanishing away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele disse: “Novo [pacto] ”, ele tornou o primeiro ultrapassado. Ora, o que se torna ultrapassado e envelhece está perto de desaparecer.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo, Nuevo pacto, dió por viejo al primero; y lo que es dado por viejo y se envejece, cerca está de desvanecerse.

verses.KJV: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.WEB: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
verses.ASV: Now even the first [covenant] had ordinances of divine service, and its sanctuary, [a sanctuary] of this world.
verses.ALMEIDA: O primeiro [pacto] também tinha ordenanças de culto, e o santuário terrestre.
verses.RVR09: TENÍA empero también el primer pacto reglamentos del culto, y santuario mundano.

verses.KJV: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
verses.ASV: For there was a tabernacle prepared, the first, wherein [were] the candlestick, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the Holy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois um tabernáculo foi preparado, o primeiro, em que havia o candelabro, a mesa, e os pães da proposição. Esse é chamado o Santo Lugar.
verses.RVR09: Porque el tabernáculo fué hecho: el primero, en que estaban las lámparas, y la mesa, y los panes de la proposición; lo que llaman el Santuario.

verses.KJV: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.WEB: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
verses.ASV: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holy of holies;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas após o segundo véu estava o tabernáculo que se chama Santo dos Santos;
verses.RVR09: Tras el segundo velo estaba el tabernáculo, que llaman el Lugar Santísimo;

verses.KJV: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.WEB: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
verses.ASV: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein [was] a golden pot holding the manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.ALMEIDA: que tinha o incensário de ouro, e a arca do pacto, toda coberta de ouro. Nela estavam: o vaso de ouro contendo o maná, a vara de Arão que florescera, e as tábuas do pacto.
verses.RVR09: El cual tenía un incensario de oro, y el arca del pacto cubierta de todas partes alrededor de oro; en la que estaba una urna de oro que contenía el maná, y la vara de Aarón que reverdeció, y las tablas del pacto;

verses.KJV: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.WEB: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
verses.ASV: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy-seat; of which things we cannot now speak severally.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acima dela, os querubins de glória, que faziam sombra ao propiciatório. Acerca dessas coisas não [é oportuno] agora falar em detalhes.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre ella los querubines de gloria que cubrían el propiciatorio; de las cuales cosas no se puede ahora hablar en particular.

verses.KJV: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
verses.WEB: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
verses.ASV: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, estando estas coisas assim preparadas, os sacerdotes entram a todo tempo no primeiro tabernáculo, para cumprirem as atividades de culto.
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas así ordenadas, en el primer tabernáculo siempre entraban los sacerdotes para hacer los oficios del culto;

verses.KJV: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.WEB: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
verses.ASV: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offereth for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no segundo, somente o sumo sacerdote, uma vez por ano, não sem sangue, que oferece por si mesmo, e pelos pecados de ignorância do povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas en el segundo, sólo el pontífice una vez en el año, no sin sangre, la cual ofrece por sí mismo, y por los pecados de ignorancia del pueblo:

verses.KJV: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.WEB: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
verses.ASV: the Holy Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holy place hath not yet been made manifest, while the first tabernacle is yet standing;
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta maneira, o Espírito Santo dá a entender que o caminho para o Santuário não havia sido revelado enquanto o primeiro Tabernáculo ainda estava de pé.
verses.RVR09: Dando en esto á entender el Espíritu Santo, que aun no estaba descubierto el camino para el santuario, entre tanto que el primer tabernáculo estuviese en pie.

verses.KJV: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.WEB: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
verses.ASV: which [is] a figure for the time present; according to which are offered both gifts and sacrifices that cannot, as touching the conscience, make the worshipper perfect,
verses.ALMEIDA: Esse é uma figura para o tempo presente, em que são oferecidos ofertas e sacrifícios que não podem, quanto a consciência, tornar perfeito a quem faz o serviço;
verses.RVR09: Lo cual era figura de aquel tiempo presente, en el cual se ofrecían presentes y sacrificios que no podían hacer perfecto, cuanto á la conciencia, al que servía con ellos;

verses.KJV: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.WEB: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
verses.ASV: [being] only (with meats and drinks and divers washings) carnal ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
verses.ALMEIDA: [pois consistem] somente em comidas e bebidas, e vários lavamentos, e ordenanças para o corpo, que foram impostas até o tempo da correção.
verses.RVR09: Consistiendo sólo en viandas y en bebidas, y en diversos lavamientos, y ordenanzas acerca de la carne, impuestas hasta el tiempo de la corrección.

verses.KJV: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.WEB: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
verses.ASV: But Christ having come a high priest of the good things to come, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando veio Cristo, o Sumo Sacerdote dos bens futuros, por meio de um Tabernáculo maior e mais perfeito, não feito por mãos, isto é, não desta criação;
verses.RVR09: Mas estando ya presente Cristo, pontífice de los bienes que habían de venir, por el más amplio y más perfecto tabernáculo, no hecho de manos, es á saber, no de esta creación;

verses.KJV: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.WEB: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
verses.ASV: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption.
verses.ALMEIDA: ele entrou de uma vez por todas no Santuário, e obteve uma redenção eterna, não pelo sangue de bodes e bezerros, mas sim, pelo seu próprio sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y no por sangre de machos cabríos ni de becerros, mas por su propia sangre, entró una sola vez en el santuario, habiendo obtenido eterna redención.

verses.KJV: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.WEB: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
verses.ASV: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling them that have been defiled, sanctify unto the cleanness of the flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se o sangue de touros e bodes, e as cinzas de uma novilha espalhadas sobre os imundos, santifica para a purificação do corpo,
verses.RVR09: Porque si la sangre de los toros y de los machos cabríos, y la ceniza de la becerra, rociada á los inmundos, santifica para la purificación de la carne,

verses.KJV: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.WEB: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.ASV: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish unto God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.ALMEIDA: quanto mais o sangue do Cristo que, pelo Espírito eterno, ofereceu a si mesmo, imaculado, a Deus, purificará a vossa consciência das obras mortas, para servirdes ao Deus vivo!
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto más la sangre de Cristo, el cual por el Espíritu eterno se ofreció á sí mismo sin mancha á Dios, limpiará vuestras conciencias de las obras de muerte para que sirváis al Dios vivo?

verses.KJV: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.WEB: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.ASV: And for this cause he is the mediator of a new covenant, that a death having taken place for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, they that have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por isso ele é o Mediador de um Novo Testamento, a fim de que, com a ocorrência de uma morte para redenção das transgressões sob o primeiro Testamento, os que foram chamados recebam a promessa da herança eterna.
verses.RVR09: Así que, por eso es mediador del nuevo testamento, para que interviniendo muerte para la remisión de las rebeliones que había bajo del primer testamento, los que son llamados reciban la promesa de la herencia eterna.

verses.KJV: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.WEB: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
verses.ASV: For where a testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him that made it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois onde há um testamento, é necessário que ocorra a morte do testador;
verses.RVR09: Porque donde hay testamento, necesario es que intervenga muerte del testador.

verses.KJV: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.WEB: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
verses.ASV: For a testament is of force where there hath been death: for it doth never avail while he that made it liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque um testamento se confirma nos mortos, visto que não é válido enquanto o testador vive.
verses.RVR09: Porque el testamento con la muerte es confirmado; de otra manera no es válido entre tanto que el testador vive.

verses.KJV: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.WEB: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
verses.ASV: Wherefore even the first [covenant] hath not been dedicated without blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o primeiro [testamento] também não foi consagrado sem sangue;
verses.RVR09: De donde vino que ni aun el primero fué consagrado sin sangre.

verses.KJV: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.WEB: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.ASV: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses unto all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, depois de Moisés haver pronunciado a todo o povo todo mandamento segundo a Lei, ele tomou o sangue de bezerros e de bodes, com água, lã purpúrea, e hissopo, e aspergiu, tanto o próprio livro, como todo o povo,
verses.RVR09: Porque habiendo leído Moisés todos los mandamientos de la ley á todo el pueblo, tomando la sangre de los becerros y de los machos cabríos, con agua, y lana de grana, é hisopo, roció al mismo libro, y también á todo el pueblo,

verses.KJV: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.WEB: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
verses.ASV: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded to you-ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: dizendo: Este é o sangue do pacto que Deus ordenou para vós.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Esta es la sangre del testamento que Dios os ha mandado.
