verses.KJV: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.WEB: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
verses.ASV: Moreover the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry he sprinkled in like manner with the blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semelhantemente aspergiu com o sangue o Tabernáculo, e todos os utensílios do serviço de culto.
verses.RVR09: Y además de esto roció también con la sangre el tabernáculo y todos los vasos del ministerio.

verses.KJV: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.WEB: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
verses.ASV: And according to the law, I may almost say, all things are cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
verses.ALMEIDA: Segundo a Lei, quase todas as coisas são purificadas com sangue, e sem derramamento de sangue não há perdão de pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y casi todo es purificado según la ley con sangre; y sin derramamiento de sangre no se hace remisión.

verses.KJV: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.WEB: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.ASV: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto era necessário que os esboços das coisas que estão nos céus fossem purificados com esses [sacrifícios] ; mas as próprias coisas celestiais, com sacrifícios melhores que esses.
verses.RVR09: Fué, pues, necesario que las figuras de las cosas celestiales fuesen purificadas con estas cosas; empero las mismas cosas celestiales con mejores sacrificios que éstos.

verses.KJV: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.WEB: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
verses.ASV: For Christ entered not into a holy place made with hands, like in pattern to the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Cristo não entrou num santuário feito por mãos, mera figura do verdadeiro; mas sim, no próprio Céu, para agora comparecer por nós diante da face de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque no entró Cristo en el santuario hecho de mano, figura del verdadero, sino en el mismo cielo para presentarse ahora por nosotros en la presencia de Dios.

verses.KJV: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.WEB: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
verses.ASV: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place year by year with blood not his own;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também não [entrou] para oferecer a si mesmo muitas vezes, como o sumo sacerdote entra a cada ano no santuário com sangue alheio;
verses.RVR09: Y no para ofrecerse muchas veces á sí mismo, como entra el pontífice en el santuario cada año con sangre ajena;

verses.KJV: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.WEB: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.ASV: else must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once at the end of the ages hath he been manifested to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: (de outra maneira lhe seria necessário padecer muitas vezes desde a fundação do mundo), mas agora, no fim dos tempos, ele se manifestou de uma vez por todas para aniquilar o pecado pelo sacrifício de si mesmo.
verses.RVR09: De otra manera fuera necesario que hubiera padecido muchas veces desde el principio del mundo: mas ahora una vez en la consumación de los siglos, para deshacimiento del pecado se presentó por el sacrificio de sí mismo.

verses.KJV: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.WEB: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
verses.ASV: And inasmuch as it is appointed unto men once to die, and after this [cometh] judgment;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, como está ordenado aos seres humanos morrerem uma vez, e depois disso, o juízo,
verses.RVR09: Y de la manera que está establecido á los hombres que mueran una vez, y después el juicio;

verses.KJV: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.WEB: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
verses.ASV: so Christ also, having been once offered to bear the sins of many, shall appear a second time, apart from sin, to them that wait for him, unto salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim também Cristo, que se ofereceu uma vez para tirar os pecados de muitos, aparecerá pela segunda vez, sem pecado, aos que o esperam, para a salvação.
verses.RVR09: Así también Cristo fué ofrecido una vez para agotar los pecados de muchos; y la segunda vez, sin pecado, será visto de los que le esperan para salud.

verses.KJV: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.WEB: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
verses.ASV: For the law having a shadow of the good [things] to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect them that draw nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, como a Lei tem uma sombra dos bens futuros, e não a própria imagem das coisas, ela nunca pode, por meio dos mesmos sacrifícios que se oferecem a cada ano, continuamente, tornar perfeitos os que se aproximam.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE la ley, teniendo la sombra de los bienes venideros, no la imagen misma de las cosas, nunca puede, por los mismos sacrificios que ofrecen continuamente cada año, hacer perfectos á los que se allegan.

verses.KJV: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.WEB: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
verses.ASV: Else would they not have ceased to be offered? because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caso contrário, deixariam de ser oferecidos, pois os adoradores, uma vez purificados, não teriam mais consciência alguma de pecados.
verses.RVR09: De otra manera cesarían de ofrecerse; porque los que tributan este culto, limpios de una vez, no tendrían más conciencia de pecado.

verses.KJV: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.WEB: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
verses.ASV: But in those [sacrifices] there is a remembrance made of sins year by year.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nesses [sacrifícios] a cada ano [se faz] uma nova lembrança dos pecados,
verses.RVR09: Empero en estos sacrificios cada año se hace conmemoración de los pecados.

verses.KJV: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.WEB: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
verses.ASV: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque é impossível que o sangue de touros e de bodes tire pecados.
verses.RVR09: Porque la sangre de los toros y de los machos cabríos no puede quitar los pecados.

verses.KJV: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.WEB: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
verses.ASV: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, But a body didst thou prepare for me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que, quando ele entrou no mundo, disse: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, mas me preparaste um corpo.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, entrando en el mundo, dice: Sacrificio y presente no quisiste; mas me apropiaste cuerpo:

verses.KJV: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.WEB: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
verses.ASV: In whole burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin thou hadst no pleasure:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ofertas de queima e ofertas pelo pecado não te agradaram.
verses.RVR09: Holocaustos y expiaciones por el pecado no te agradaron.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.WEB: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
verses.ASV: Then said I, Lo, I am come (In the roll of the book it is written of me) To do thy will, O God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: “Eis-me aqui; (no rolo do livro está escrito de mim) venho para fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije: Heme aquí (en la cabecera del libro está escrito de mí) para que haga, oh Dios, tu voluntad.

verses.KJV: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.WEB: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
verses.ASV: Saying above, Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein (the which are offered according to the law),
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de ter dito acima: “Sacrifício, oferta, holocaustos, e ofertas pelo pecado não quiseste, nem te agradaram”, (os quais se oferecem segundo a Lei),
verses.RVR09: Diciendo arriba: Sacrificio y presente, y holocaustos y expiaciones por el pecado no quisiste, ni te agradaron, (las cuales cosas se ofrecen según la ley,)

verses.KJV: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.WEB: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
verses.ASV: then hath he said, Lo, I am come to do thy will. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.ALMEIDA: então disse: “Eis-me aqui, venho para fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus”. [Assim] , ele cancela o primeiro [pacto] ,para estabelecer o segundo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo: Heme aquí para que haga, oh Dios, tu voluntad. Quita lo primero, para establecer lo postrero.

verses.KJV: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.WEB: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.ASV: By which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela sua vontade somos santificados por meio da oferta sacrificial do corpo de Jesus Cristo, [feita] de uma vez por todas.
verses.RVR09: En la cual voluntad somos santificados por la ofrenda del cuerpo de Jesucristo hecha una sola vez.

verses.KJV: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.WEB: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
verses.ASV: And every priest indeed standeth day by day ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, the which can never take away sins:
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo sacerdote comparece a cada dia para servir e oferecer muitas vezes os mesmos sacrifícios, que nunca podem tirar os pecados;
verses.RVR09: Así que, todo sacerdote se presenta cada día ministrando y ofreciendo muchas veces los mismos sacrificios, que nunca pueden quitar los pecados:

verses.KJV: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.WEB: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
verses.ASV: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Jesus] ,depois que ofereceu um sacrifício pelos pecados, assentou-se para sempre à direita de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Pero éste, habiendo ofrecido por los pecados un solo sacrificio para siempre, está sentado á la diestra de Dios,

verses.KJV: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.WEB: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
verses.ASV: henceforth expecting till his enemies be made the footstool of his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: e espera desde então, até que os seus inimigos sejam postos por escabelo dos seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Esperando lo que resta, hasta que sus enemigos sean puestos por estrado de sus pies.

verses.KJV: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.WEB: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
verses.ASV: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois com uma só oferta ele aperfeiçoou para sempre os que são santificados.
verses.RVR09: Porque con una sola ofrenda hizo perfectos para siempre á los santificados.

verses.KJV: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.WEB: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
verses.ASV: And the Holy Spirit also beareth witness to us; for after he hath said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E também o Espírito Santo nos dá testemunho [acerca disso] ; pois, depois de haver anteriormente dito:
verses.RVR09: Y atestíguanos lo mismo el Espíritu Santo; que después que dijo:

verses.KJV: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.WEB: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
verses.ASV: This is the covenant that I will make with them After those days, saith the Lord: I will put my laws on their heart, And upon their mind also will I write them; [then saith he],
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o pacto que farei com eles depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei minhas leis em seus corações, e as escreverei em suas mentes;
verses.RVR09: Y este es el pacto que haré con ellos después de aquellos días, dice el Señor: Daré mis leyes en sus corazones, y en sus almas las escribiré;

verses.KJV: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.WEB: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
verses.ASV: And their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então ele diz] : E não mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados e das suas transgressões.
verses.RVR09: Añade: Y nunca más me acordaré de sus pecados é iniquidades.

verses.KJV: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.WEB: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.ASV: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, onde há perdão dessas coisas, não há mais oferta pelo pecado.
verses.RVR09: Pues donde hay remisión de éstos, no hay más ofrenda por pecado.

verses.KJV: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.WEB: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.ASV: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, já que temos a confiança de entrar no Santuário pelo sangue de Jesus,
verses.RVR09: Así que, hermanos, teniendo libertad para entrar en el santuario por la sangre de Jesucristo,

verses.KJV: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.WEB: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
verses.ASV: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.ALMEIDA: pelo caminho novo e vivo que ele consagrou para nós através do véu, isto é, pela sua carne;
verses.RVR09: Por el camino que él nos consagró nuevo y vivo, por el velo, esto es, por su carne;

verses.KJV: And having an high priest over the house of God;
verses.WEB: and having a great priest over God’s house,
verses.ASV: and [having] a great priest over the house of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: e já que temos um grande Sacerdote sobre a casa de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Y teniendo un gran sacerdote sobre la casa de Dios,

verses.KJV: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.WEB: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
verses.ASV: let us draw near with a true heart in fulness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience: and having our body washed with pure water,
verses.ALMEIDA: aproximemo-nos com um coração sincero em plena certeza de fé, tendo os corações aspergidos e purificados da má consciência, e o corpo lavado com água pura;
verses.RVR09: Lleguémonos con corazón verdadero, en plena certidumbre de fe, purificados los corazones de mala conciencia, y lavados los cuerpos con agua limpia.

verses.KJV: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.WEB: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
verses.ASV: let us hold fast the confession of our hope that it waver not; for he is faithful that promised:
verses.ALMEIDA: mantenhamos firme a esperança que declararmos ter, sem abalo algum, pois aquele que prometeu é fiel;
verses.RVR09: Mantengamos firme la profesión de nuestra fe sin fluctuar; que fiel es el que prometió:

verses.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.WEB: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
verses.ASV: and let us consider one another to provoke unto love and good works;
verses.ALMEIDA: e sejamos atenciosos uns para com os outros, a fim de incentivar o amor e as boas obras;
verses.RVR09: Y considerémonos los unos á los otros para provocarnos al amor y á las buenas obras;

verses.KJV: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.WEB: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
verses.ASV: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting [one another]; and so much the more, as ye see the day drawing nigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: não abandonando a nossa reunião, como é o costume de alguns. Ao contrário, encorajemos [uns aos outros] , e tanto mais quanto vedes aquele dia se aproximando.
verses.RVR09: No dejando nuestra congregación, como algunos tienen por costumbre, mas exhortándonos; y tanto más, cuanto veis que aquel día se acerca.

verses.KJV: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.WEB: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
verses.ASV: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more a sacrifice for sins,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se nós, depois de havermos recebido o conhecimento da verdade, persistirmos pecando por vontade própria, já não resta mais sacrifício pelos pecados;
verses.RVR09: Porque si pecáremos voluntariamente después de haber recibido el conocimiento de la verdad, ya no queda sacrificio por el pecado.

verses.KJV: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.WEB: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
verses.ASV: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: em vez disso, certa terrível expectativa de julgamento, e um fogo de indignação que consumirá os adversários.
verses.RVR09: Sino una horrenda esperanza de juicio, y hervor de fuego que ha de devorar á los adversarios.

verses.KJV: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.WEB: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
verses.ASV: A man that hath set at nought Moses’ law dieth without compassion on [the word of] two or three witnesses:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém que rejeita a Lei de Moisés morre sem misericórdia com base [na palavra de] duas ou três testemunhas,
verses.RVR09: El que menospreciare la ley de Moisés, por el testimonio de dos ó de tres testigos muere sin ninguna misericordia:

verses.KJV: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.WEB: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
verses.ASV: of how much sorer punishment, think ye, shall he be judged worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant wherewith he was sanctified an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.ALMEIDA: de quanto pior castigo vós pensais que será julgado merecedor aquele que pisou o Filho de Deus, menosprezou ) o sangue do Testamento no qual ele foi santificado, e insultou o Espírito da graça?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto pensáis que será más digno de mayor castigo, el que hollare al Hijo de Dios, y tuviere por inmunda la sangre del testamento, en la cual fué santificado, é hiciere afrenta al Espíritu de gracia?

verses.KJV: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.WEB: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
verses.ASV: For we know him that said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nós conhecemos aquele que disse: A vingança é minha; eu retribuirei, diz o Senhor. E outra vez: O Senhor julgará o seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Sabemos quién es el que dijo: Mía es la venganza, yo daré el pago, dice el Señor. Y otra vez: El Señor juzgará su pueblo.

verses.KJV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.WEB: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.ASV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cair nas mãos do Deus vivo é algo terrível.
verses.RVR09: Horrenda cosa es caer en las manos del Dios vivo.

verses.KJV: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.WEB: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
verses.ASV: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were enlightened, ye endured a great conflict of sufferings;
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos, porém, dos dias passados, em que, depois de serdes iluminados, suportastes grande combate de aflições,
verses.RVR09: Empero traed á la memoria los días pasados, en los cuales, después de haber sido iluminados, sufristeis gran combate de aflicciones:

verses.KJV: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.WEB: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
verses.ASV: partly, being made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, becoming partakers with them that were so used.
verses.ALMEIDA: quando, em parte, fostes expostos em público tanto a insultos, como a tribulações, e em parte, fostes companheiros daqueles que assim foram tratados.
verses.RVR09: Por una parte, ciertamente, con vituperios y tribulaciones fuisteis hechos espectáculo; y por otra parte hechos compañeros de los que estaban en tal estado.

verses.KJV: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.WEB: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
verses.ASV: For ye both had compassion on them that were in bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your possessions, knowing that ye have for yourselves a better possession and an abiding one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois também vos compadecestes das minhas prisões, e com alegria aceitastes a espoliação dos vossos bens, pois sabeis em vós mesmos que tendes nos Céus um bem melhor e permanente.
verses.RVR09: Porque de mis prisiones también os resentisteis conmigo, y el robo de vuestros bienes padecisteis con gozo, conociendo que tenéis en vosotros una mejor sustancia en los cielos, y que permanece.

verses.KJV: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
verses.ASV: Cast not away therefore your boldness, which hath great recompense of reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não rejeiteis a vossa confiança, que tem uma grande recompensa;
verses.RVR09: No perdáis pues vuestra confianza, que tiene grande remuneración de galardón:

verses.KJV: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.WEB: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
verses.ASV: For ye have need of patience, that, having done the will of God, ye may receive the promise.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois precisais de paciência, a fim de que, depois que houverdes feito a vontade de Deus, recebais o que foi prometido.
verses.RVR09: Porque la paciencia os es necesaria; para que, habiendo hecho la voluntad de Dios, obtengáis la promesa.

verses.KJV: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.WEB: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
verses.ASV: For yet a very little while, He that cometh shall come, and shall not tarry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ainda um pouquinho de tempo, e aquele que vem virá, e não tardará.
verses.RVR09: Porque aun un poquito, y el que ha de venir vendrá, y no tardará.

verses.KJV: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.WEB: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
verses.ASV: But my righteous one shall live by faith: And if he shrink back, my soul hath no pleasure in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o justo viverá pela fé; e se ele retroceder, a minha alma não tem prazer nele.
verses.RVR09: Ahora el justo vivirá por fe; mas si se retirare, no agradará á mi alma.

verses.KJV: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.WEB: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
verses.ASV: But we are not of them that shrink back unto perdition; but of them that have faith unto the saving of the soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nós não somos dos que retrocedem para a perdição, mas sim dos que creem para a conservação da alma.
verses.RVR09: Pero nosotros no somos tales que nos retiremos para perdición, sino fieles para ganancia del alma.

verses.KJV: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.WEB: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
verses.ASV: Now faith is assurance of [things] hoped for, a conviction of things not seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, a fé é a certeza das coisas que se esperam, e a prova das coisas que não se veem.
verses.RVR09: ES pues la fe la sustancia de las cosas que se esperan, la demostración de las cosas que no se ven.

verses.KJV: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.WEB: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
verses.ASV: For therein the elders had witness borne to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por ela os antigos obtiveram testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Porque por ella alcanzaron testimonio los antiguos.

verses.KJV: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.WEB: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
verses.ASV: By faith we understand that the worlds have been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen hath not been made out of things which appear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé entendemos que o universo foi aprontado pela palavra de Deus, de maneira que as coisas que se veem não foram feitas de algo visível.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe entendemos haber sido compuestos los siglos por la palabra de Dios, siendo hecho lo que se ve, de lo que no se veía.

verses.KJV: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.WEB: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
verses.ASV: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had witness borne to him that he was righteous, God bearing witness in respect of his gifts: and through it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Abel ofereceu a Deus melhor sacrifício do que Caim; por isso obteve testemunho de que era justo, pois Deus testemunhou de suas ofertas; e mesmo estando morto, ainda fala por meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe Abel ofreció á Dios mayor sacrificio que Caín, por la cual alcanzó testimonio de que era justo, dando Dios testimonio á sus presentes; y difunto, aun habla por ella.

verses.KJV: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.WEB: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
verses.ASV: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and he was not found, because God translated him: for he hath had witness borne to him that before his translation he had been well-pleasing unto God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Enoque foi transportado para não experimentar a morte; e não foi achado, porque Deus havia o transportado; pois antes da sua transportação ele obteve testemunho de ter agradado a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe Enoc fué traspuesto para no ver muerte, y no fué hallado, porque lo traspuso Dios. Y antes que fuese traspuesto, tuvo testimonio de haber agradado á Dios.

verses.KJV: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.WEB: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
verses.ASV: and without faith it is impossible to be well-pleasing [unto him]; for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that seek after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, sem fé é impossível agradar [a Deus] . Pois é necessário que aquele que se aproxima de Deus creia que ele existe, e que ele é recompensador dos que o buscam.
verses.RVR09: Empero sin fe es imposible agradar á Dios; porque es menester que el que á Dios se allega, crea que le hay, y que es galardonador de los que le buscan.

verses.KJV: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.WEB: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.ASV: By faith Noah, being warned [of God] concerning things not seen as yet, moved with godly fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Noé, divinamente advertido das coisas que ainda se não viam, temeu; e, para salvamento de sua família construiu a arca. Por meio da fé ele condenou o mundo, e foi feito herdeiro da justiça segundo a fé.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe Noé, habiendo recibido respuesta de cosas que aun no se veían, con temor aparejó el arca en que su casa se salvase: por la cual fe condenó al mundo, y fué hecho heredero de la justicia que es por la fe.

verses.KJV: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.WEB: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
verses.ASV: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out unto a place which he was to receive for an inheritance; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi chamado para ir ao lugar que havia de receber por herança, obedeceu, e saiu sem que soubesse aonde ia.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe Abraham, siendo llamado, obedeció para salir al lugar que había de recibir por heredad; y salió sin saber dónde iba.

verses.KJV: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.WEB: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
verses.ASV: By faith he became a sojourner in the land of promise, as in a [land] not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, ele habitou na terra de promessa, como em [terra] que não fosse sua, morando em tendas com Isaque e com Jacó, herdeiros com ele da mesma promessa.
verses.RVR09: Por fe habitó en la tierra prometida como en tierra ajena, morando en cabañas con Isaac y Jacob, herederos juntamente de la misma promesa:

verses.KJV: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.WEB: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.ASV: for he looked for the city which hath the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele esperava a cidade que tem fundamentos firmes, da qual o arquiteto e construtor é Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque esperaba ciudad con fundamentos, el artífice y hacedor de la cual es Dios.

verses.KJV: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.WEB: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
verses.ASV: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive seed when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, também, a própria Sara recebeu a capacidade de conceber descendência, e já na idade avançada ela deu à luz, pois considerou fiel aquele que havia prometido.
verses.RVR09: Por la fe también la misma Sara, siendo estéril, recibió fuerza para concebir simiente; y parió aun fuera del tiempo de la edad, porque creyó ser fiel el que lo había prometido.

verses.KJV: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.WEB: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
verses.ASV: wherefore also there sprang of one, and him as good as dead, [so many] as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the sand, which is by the sea-shore, innumerable.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, de um que estava à beira da morte, nasceu [uma descendência] numerosa como as estrelas do céu, e incontável como a areia na praia do mar.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también, de uno, y ése ya amortecido, salieron como las estrellas del cielo en multitud, y como la arena innumerable que está á la orilla de la mar.

verses.KJV: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.WEB: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.ASV: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Permanecendo] na fé, todos esses morreram sem receberem as promessas. Mas as viram de longe, creram, e felicitaram-se nelas, declarando que eram estrangeiros e peregrinos na terra.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á la fe murieron todos éstos sin haber recibido las promesas, sino mirándolas de lejos, y creyéndolas, y saludándolas, y confesando que eran peregrinos y advenedizos sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.WEB: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
verses.ASV: For they that say such things make it manifest that they are seeking after a country of their own.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os que dizem tais coisas mostram claramente que estão buscando a [sua] própria pátria.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que esto dicen, claramente dan á entender que buscan una patria.

verses.KJV: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.WEB: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
verses.ASV: And if indeed they had been mindful of that [country] from which they went out, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se estivessem pensando naquela de onde saíram, eles tinham oportunidade de voltar.
verses.RVR09: Que si se acordaran de aquella de donde salieron, cierto tenían tiempo para volverse:

verses.KJV: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.WEB: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.ASV: But now they desire a better [country], that is, a heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God; for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora desejam uma melhor, isto é, a celestial. Por isso Deus não se envergonha deles, de ser chamado o Deus deles, porque já lhes preparou uma cidade.
verses.RVR09: Empero deseaban la mejor, es á saber, la celestial; por lo cual Dios no se avergüenza de llamarse Dios de ellos: porque les había aparejado ciudad.

verses.KJV: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.WEB: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
verses.ASV: By faith Abraham, being tried, offered up Isaac: yea, he that had gladly received the promises was offering up his only begotten [son];
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi provado, ofereceu Isaque; aquele que havia recebido as promessas ofereceu o [seu] único filho,
verses.RVR09: Por fe ofreció Abraham á Isaac cuando fué probado, y ofrecía al unigénito el que había recibido las promesas,

verses.KJV: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.WEB: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
verses.ASV: [even he] to whom it was said, In Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.ALMEIDA: do qual foi dito: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Habiéndole sido dicho: En Isaac te será llamada simiente:

verses.KJV: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.WEB: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
verses.ASV: accounting that God [is] able to raise up, even from the dead; from whence he did also in a figure receive him back.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Abraão] considerou que Deus era poderoso até para ressuscitar [Isaque] dos mortos; de onde também, de forma figurada, ele o recuperou.
verses.RVR09: Pensando que aun de los muertos es Dios poderoso para levantar; de donde también le volvió á recibir por figura.

verses.KJV: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.WEB: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
verses.ASV: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Isaque abençoou Jacó e Esaú quanto às coisas futuras.
verses.RVR09: Por fe bendijo Isaac á Jacob y á Esaú respecto á cosas que habían de ser.

verses.KJV: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.WEB: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
verses.ASV: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, [leaning] upon the top of his staff.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Jacó, enquanto morria, abençoou a cada um dos filhos de José, e adorou [apoiado] sobre a ponta do seu cajado.
verses.RVR09: Por fe Jacob, muriéndose, bendijo á cada uno de los hijos de José, y adoró estribando sobre la punta de su bordón.

verses.KJV: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.WEB: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
verses.ASV: By faith Joseph, when his end was nigh, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, José, no fim de sua vida, mencionou a saída dos filhos de Israel, e deu ordem acerca dos seus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Por fe José, muriéndose, se acordó de la partida de los hijos de Israel; y dió mandamiento acerca de sus huesos.

verses.KJV: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.WEB: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.ASV: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw he was a goodly child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Moisés, quando nasceu, foi escondido três meses pelos seus pais, pois viram que o menino era belo, e não se intimidaram com o mandamento do rei.
verses.RVR09: Por fe Moisés, nacido, fué escondido de sus padres por tres meses, porque le vieron hermoso niño; y no temieron el mandamiento del rey.

verses.KJV: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verses.WEB: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
verses.ASV: By faith Moses, when he was grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Moisés, sendo já crescido, recusou ser chamado filho da filha de faraó;
verses.RVR09: Por fe Moisés, hecho ya grande, rehusó ser llamado hijo de la hija de Faraón;

verses.KJV: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.WEB: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
verses.ASV: choosing rather to share ill treatment with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.ALMEIDA: pois preferiu ser maltratado com o povo de Deus a ter por um tempo o prazer do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Escogiendo antes ser afligido con el pueblo de Dios, que gozar de comodidades temporales de pecado.

verses.KJV: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.WEB: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
verses.ASV: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt: for he looked unto the recompense of reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele considerou que as humilhações por causa de Cristo eram riquezas maiores que os tesouros no Egito; pois sua atenção estava fixada na recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo por mayores riquezas el vituperio de Cristo que los tesoros de los Egipcios; porque miraba á la remuneración.

verses.KJV: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.WEB: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.ASV: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, ele deixou o Egito sem temer a ira do rei, pois perseverou como que vendo aquele que é invisível.
verses.RVR09: Por fe dejó á Egipto, no temiendo la ira del rey; porque se sostuvo como viendo al Invisible.

verses.KJV: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.WEB: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
verses.ASV: By faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, ele celebrou a Páscoa e o derramamento do sangue, para que o destruidor dos primogênitos não os tocasse.
verses.RVR09: Por fe celebró la pascua y el derramamiento de la sangre, para que el que mataba los primogénitos no los tocase.

verses.KJV: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.WEB: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
verses.ASV: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were swallowed up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, atravessaram o mar Vermelho, como que por [ terra ] seca, o que, quando os Egípcios tentaram, afogaram-se.
verses.RVR09: Por fe pasaron el mar Bermejo como por tierra seca: lo cual probando los Egipcios, fueron sumergidos.

verses.KJV: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.WEB: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
verses.ASV: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed about for seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, os muros de Jericó caíram, depois de serem rodeados por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Por fe cayeron los muros de Jericó con rodearlos siete días.

verses.KJV: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.WEB: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
verses.ASV: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with them that were disobedient, having received the spies with peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, Raabe, a prostituta, não pereceu com os incrédulos, pois acolheu em paz os espias.
verses.RVR09: Por fe Rahab la ramera no pereció juntamente con los incrédulos, habiendo recibido á los espías con paz.

verses.KJV: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
verses.WEB: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
verses.ASV: And what shall I more say? for the time will fail me if I tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah; of David and Samuel and the prophets:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que mais direi? Pois me faltará tempo se eu contar a respeito de Gideão, Baraque, e também de Sansão, Jefté, Davi, e também de Samuel e dos profetas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué más digo? porque el tiempo me faltará contando de Gedeón, de Barac, de Samsón, de Jephté, de David, de Samuel, y de los profetas:

verses.KJV: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.
verses.WEB: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.ASV: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela fé, esses venceram reinos, exercitaram justiça, alcançaram promessas, fecharam bocas de leões,
verses.RVR09: Que por fe ganaron reinos, obraron justicia, alcanzaron promesas, taparon las bocas de leones,

verses.KJV: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.WEB: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
verses.ASV: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, waxed mighty in war, turned to flight armies of aliens.
verses.ALMEIDA: apagaram o poder do fogo, escaparam do fio de espada, da fraqueza tiraram forças, tonaram-se fortes na batalha, puseram em fuga os exércitos dos estrangeiros;
verses.RVR09: Apagaron fuegos impetuosos, evitaron filo de cuchillo, convalecieron de enfermedades, fueron hechos fuertes en batallas, trastornaron campos de extraños.

verses.KJV: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.WEB: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
verses.ASV: Women received their dead by a resurrection: and others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.ALMEIDA: As mulheres receberam de volta os seus mortos pela ressurreição; e outros foram torturados, não aceitando a soltura, para alcançarem uma melhor ressurreição;
verses.RVR09: Las mujeres recibieron sus muertos por resurrección; unos fueron estirados, no aceptando el rescate, para ganar mejor resurrección;

verses.KJV: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.WEB: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
verses.ASV: and others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.ALMEIDA: e outros experimentaram provação de insultos e açoites, e até correntes e prisões;
verses.RVR09: Otros experimentaron vituperios y azotes; y á más de esto prisiones y cárceles;

verses.KJV: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.WEB: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
verses.ASV: they were stoned, they were sawn asunder, they were tempted, they were slain with the sword: they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
verses.ALMEIDA: foram apedrejados, serrados, tentados, morreram pela espada; andaram [vestidos] de peles de ovelhas e de cabras; necessitados, afligidos, maltratados;
verses.RVR09: Fueron apedreados, aserrados, tentados, muertos á cuchillo; anduvieron de acá para allá cubiertos de pieles de ovejas y de cabras, pobres, angustiados, maltratados;

verses.KJV: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.WEB: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
verses.ASV: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts and mountains and caves, and the holes of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: (o mundo não era digno deles) andando sem rumo em desertos, montanhas, covas, e nas cavernas da terra.
verses.RVR09: De los cuales el mundo no era digno; perdidos por los desiertos, por los montes, por las cuevas y por las cavernas de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.WEB: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
verses.ASV: And these all, having had witness borne to them through their faith, received not the promise,
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos esses, [mesmo] tendo testemunho pela fé, não alcançaram a promessa,
verses.RVR09: Y todos éstos, aprobados por testimonio de la fe, no recibieron la promesa;

verses.KJV: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
verses.WEB: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.ASV: God having provided some better thing concerning us, that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois Deus havia preparado algo melhor para nós, para que, sem nós, eles não fossem aperfeiçoados.
verses.RVR09: Proveyendo Dios alguna cosa mejor para nosotros, para que no fuesen perfeccionados sin nosotros.

verses.KJV: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.WEB: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
verses.ASV: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto nós também, posto que estamos rodeados por uma tão grande nuvem de testemunhas, deixemos toda sobrecarga, e o pecado que facilmente nos envolve, e corramos com perseverança a corrida que nos está proposta,
verses.RVR09: POR tanto nosotros también, teniendo en derredor nuestro una tan grande nube de testigos, dejando todo el peso del pecado que nos rodea, corramos con paciencia la carrera que nos es propuesta,

verses.KJV: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.WEB: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.ASV: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of [our] faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: olhando para Jesus, Autor e aperfeiçoador da fé. Ele, pela alegria que lhe estava proposta, suportou a cruz, desprezando a humilhação, e assentou-se à direita do trono de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Puestos los ojos en al autor y consumador de la fe, en Jesús; el cual, habiéndole sido propuesto gozo, sufrió la cruz, menospreciando la vergüenza, y sentóse á la diestra del trono de Dios.

verses.KJV: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.WEB: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.ASV: For consider him that hath endured such gainsaying of sinners against himself, that ye wax not weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai, pois, aquele que suportou tal hostilidade dos pecadores contra si mesmo, para que não fiqueis exaustos, nem vossas almas se debilitem.
verses.RVR09: Reducid pues á vuestro pensamiento á aquel que sufrió tal contradicción de pecadores contra sí mismo, porque no os fatiguéis en vuestros ánimos desmayando.

verses.KJV: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.WEB: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
verses.ASV: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto lutais contra o pecado, ainda não resististes ao ponto de ter o próprio sangue derramado,
verses.RVR09: Que aun no habéis resistido hasta la sangre, combatiendo contra el pecado:

verses.KJV: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
verses.WEB: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
verses.ASV: and ye have forgotten the exhortation which reasoneth with you as with sons, My son, regard not lightly the chastening of the Lord, Nor faint when thou art reproved of him;
verses.ALMEIDA: mas já vos esquecestes do encorajamento que ele fala convosco como a filhos: Meu filho, não desprezes a disciplina do Senhor, nem te canses de ser reprendido por ele;
verses.RVR09: Y estáis ya olvidados de la exhortación que como con hijos habla con vosotros, diciendo: Hijo mío, no menosprecies el castigo del Señor, ni desmayes cuando eres de él reprendido.

verses.KJV: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.WEB: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
verses.ASV: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, And scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois o Senhor disciplina a quem ama, e açoita a todo filho a quem recebe.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Señor al que ama castiga, y azota á cualquiera que recibe por hijo.

verses.KJV: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.WEB: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
verses.ASV: It is for chastening that ye endure; God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is there whom [his] father chasteneth not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se suportais a disciplina, Deus vos trata como filhos; pois que filho há a quem o pai não discipline?
verses.RVR09: Si sufrís el castigo, Dios se os presenta como á hijos; porque ¿qué hijo es aquel á quien el padre no castiga?

verses.KJV: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.WEB: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
verses.ASV: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se estais sem disciplina, da qual todos são feitos participantes, então sois ilegítimos, e não filhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas si estáis fuera del castigo, del cual todos han sido hechos participantes, luego sois bastardos, y no hijos.

verses.KJV: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.WEB: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
verses.ASV: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, tivemos os pais de nossa carne como disciplinadores, e nós os respeitávamos. Por acaso não nos sujeitaremos muito mais ao Pai dos espíritos, a fim de vivermos?
verses.RVR09: Por otra parte, tuvimos por castigadores á los padres de nuestra carne, y los reverenciábamos, ¿por qué no obedeceremos mucho mejor al Padre de los espíritus, y viviremos?

verses.KJV: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.WEB: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
verses.ASV: For they indeed for a few days chastened [us] as seemed good to them; but he for [our] profit, that [we] may be partakers of his holiness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles, por um pouco de tempo, [nos] disciplinavam como bem lhes parecia. Ele, porém, [disciplina] para o [nosso] proveito, a fim de que sejamos participantes da sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Y aquéllos, á la verdad, por pocos días nos castigaban como á ellos les parecía, mas éste para lo que nos es provechoso, para que recibamos su santificación.

verses.KJV: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.WEB: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
verses.ASV: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, [even the fruit] of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato, no presente, nenhuma disciplina parece ser motivo de alegria, mas sim, de sofrimento; mas depois produz um fruto pacífico de justiça aos que foram exercitados por ela.
verses.RVR09: Es verdad que ningún castigo al presente parece ser causa de gozo, sino de tristeza; mas después da fruto apacible de justicia á los que en él son ejercitados.

verses.KJV: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.WEB: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
verses.ASV: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, levantai as mãos cansadas e os joelhos enfraquecidos,
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual alzad las manos caídas y las rodillas paralizadas;

verses.KJV: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.WEB: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
verses.ASV: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned out of the way, but rather be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: e “fazei caminhos retos para os vossos pés”, para que o que está manco não se desvie, em vez disso, seja sarado.
verses.RVR09: Y haced derechos pasos á vuestros pies, porque lo que es cojo no salga fuera de camino, antes sea sanado.

verses.KJV: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.WEB: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
verses.ASV: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai a paz com todos, e a santificação, sem a qual ninguém verá o Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Seguid la paz con todos, y la santidad, sin la cual nadie verá al Señor:

verses.KJV: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verses.WEB: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
verses.ASV: looking carefully lest [there be] any man that falleth short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble [you], and thereby the many be defiled;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai com empenho para que ninguém perca de receber da graça de Deus; para não acontecer que alguma raiz de amargura brote, seja incômoda, e muitos sejam contaminados por ela.
verses.RVR09: Mirando bien que ninguno se aparte de la gracia de Dios, que ninguna raíz de amargura brotando os impida, y por ella muchos sean contaminados;

verses.KJV: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.WEB: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
verses.ASV: lest [there be] any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém seja pecador sexual, ou profano como Esaú, que por uma refeição vendeu o seu direito de primogenitura.
verses.RVR09: Que ninguno sea fornicario, ó profano, como Esaú, que por una vianda vendió su primogenitura.

verses.KJV: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.WEB: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
verses.ASV: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind [in his father], though he sought it diligently with tears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois vós sabeis que depois, quando ele quis herdar a benção, foi rejeitado, porque não achou lugar para arrependimento, ainda que com lágrimas o tenha buscado.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya sabéis que aun después, deseando heredar la bendición, fué reprobado (que no halló lugar de arrepentimiento), aunque la procuró con lágrimas.

verses.KJV: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.WEB: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
verses.ASV: For ye are not come unto [a mount] that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não chegastes a um monte palpável, aceso com fogo, e à escuridão, às trevas, e à tempestade;
verses.RVR09: Porque no os habéis llegado al monte que se podía tocar, y al fuego encendido, y al turbión, y á la oscuridad, y á la tempestad,

verses.KJV: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.WEB: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
verses.ASV: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which [voice] they that heard entreated that no word more should be spoken unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: ao som da trombeta, e à voz das palavras, que os que a ouviam, rogaram que não mais se lhes falasse palavra alguma;
verses.RVR09: Y al sonido de la trompeta, y á la voz de las palabras, la cual los que la oyeron rogaron que no se les hablase más;

verses.KJV: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.WEB: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
verses.ASV: for they could not endure that which was enjoined, If even a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;
verses.ALMEIDA: (pois não podiam suportar o que [lhes] era ordenado: Se até um animal tocar o monte, seja apedrejado ou perfurado com um dardo.
verses.RVR09: Porque no podían tolerar lo que se mandaba: Si bestia tocare al monte, será apedreada, ó pasada con dardo.

verses.KJV: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.WEB: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
verses.ASV: and so fearful was the appearance, [that] Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a visão era tão terrível, que Moisés disse: Estou assombrado e tremendo).
verses.RVR09: Y tan terrible cosa era lo que se veía, que Moisés dijo: Estoy asombrado y temblando.

verses.KJV: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.WEB: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
verses.ASV: but ye are come unto mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable hosts of angels,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós chegastes ao monte Sião, à cidade do Deus vivo, a Jerusalém celestial, e aos muitos milhares de anjos,
verses.RVR09: Mas os habéis llegado al monte de Sión, y á la ciudad del Dios vivo, Jerusalem la celestial, y á la compañía de muchos millares de ángeles,

verses.KJV: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.WEB: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.ASV: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.ALMEIDA: à universal congregação e igreja dos primogênitos inscritos nos Céus, e a Deus, o Juiz de todos, e aos espíritos dos justos já aperfeiçoados;
verses.RVR09: Y á la congregación de los primogénitos que están alistados en los cielos, y á Dios el Juez de todos, y á los espíritus de los justos hechos perfectos,

verses.KJV: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
verses.WEB: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
verses.ASV: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better than [that of] Abel.
verses.ALMEIDA: e a Jesus, o Mediador de um Novo Testamento, e ao sangue da aspersão, que fala melhores coisas que [o de] Abel.
verses.RVR09: Y á Jesús el Mediador del nuevo testamento, y á la sangre del esparcimiento que habla mejor que la de Abel.

verses.KJV: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
verses.WEB: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
verses.ASV: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not when they refused him that warned [them] on earth, much more [shall not] we [escape] who turn away from him that [warneth] from heaven:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tende o cuidado de não rejeitardes ao que fala. Pois, se não escaparam aqueles que rejeitaram ao que [os] advertia divinamente na terra, muito menos nós, se nos desviarmos daquele que [nos adverte] dos Céus.
verses.RVR09: Mirad que no desechéis al que habla. Porque si aquellos no escaparon que desecharon al que hablaba en la tierra, mucho menos nosotros, si desecháramos al que habla de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.WEB: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
verses.ASV: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more will I make to tremble not the earth only, but also the heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua voz fez a terra tremer naquela ocasião, mas agora ele prometeu, dizendo: Ainda uma vez faço tremer não somente a terra, mas também o Céu.
verses.RVR09: La voz del cual entonces conmovió la tierra; mas ahora ha denunciado, diciendo: Aun una vez, y yo conmoveré no solamente la tierra, mas aun el cielo.

verses.KJV: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.WEB: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
verses.ASV: And this [word], Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta [expressão] , “Ainda uma vez”, mostra a remoção das coisas abaladas, como coisas criadas, para que as inabaláveis permaneçam.
verses.RVR09: Y esta palabra, Aun una vez, declara la mudanza de las cosas movibles, como de cosas hechas, para que queden las cosas que son firmes.

verses.KJV: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.WEB: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
verses.ASV: Wherefore, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, whereby we may offer service well-pleasing to God with reverence and awe:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, já que recebemos um Reino inabalável, mantenhamos a graça, e por ela sirvamos a Deus de maneira que o agrade, com devoção e temor,
verses.RVR09: Así que, tomando el reino inmóvil, retengamos la gracia por la cual sirvamos á Dios agradándole con temor y reverencia;

verses.KJV: For our God is a consuming fire.
verses.WEB: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.ASV: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: pois o nosso Deus é um fogo consumidor.
verses.RVR09: Porque nuestro Dios es fuego consumidor.

verses.KJV: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.WEB: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.ASV: Let love of the brethren continue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Permaneça o amor fraternal.
verses.RVR09: PERMANEZCA el amor fraternal.

verses.KJV: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.WEB: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
verses.ASV: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos esqueçais de mostrar hospitalidade, porque através dela alguns, sem saber, acolheram anjos.
verses.RVR09: No olvidéis la hospitalidad, porque por ésta algunos, sin saberlo, hospedaron ángeles.

verses.KJV: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.WEB: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
verses.ASV: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are ill-treated, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos dos prisoneiros, como se estivésseis presos com eles; e dos que são maltratados, como se vós mesmos também estivessem sendo em [vossos] corpos.
