verses.RVR09: Acordaos de los presos, como presos juntamente con ellos; y de los afligidos, como que también vosotros mismos sois del cuerpo.

verses.KJV: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.WEB: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
verses.ASV: [Let] marriage [be] had in honor among all, and [let] the bed [be] undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
verses.ALMEIDA: O matrimônio seja honrado entre todos, e o leito conjugal sem contaminação; mas Deus julgará os pecadores sexuais e os adúlteros.
verses.RVR09: Honroso es en todos el matrimonio, y el lecho sin mancilla; mas á los fornicarios y á los adúlteros juzgará Dios.

verses.KJV: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.WEB: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
verses.ASV: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: A [vossa] maneira de viver seja sem ganância, contentando-vos com as coisas que tendes. Pois ele disse: Não te deixarei, nem te desampararei.
verses.RVR09: Sean las costumbres vuestras sin avaricia; contentos de lo presente; porque él dijo: No te desampararé, ni te dejaré.

verses.KJV: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.WEB: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
verses.ASV: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que devemos ter a confiança de dizer: O Senhor é meu ajudador; não temerei o que o ser humano poderá fazer a mim.
verses.RVR09: De tal manera que digamos confiadamente: El Señor es mi ayudador; no temeré lo que me hará el hombre.

verses.KJV: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.WEB: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
verses.ASV: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos de vossos líderes, que vos falaram a palavra de Deus. Observai o resultado da maneira como viveram, e imitai a fé deles.
verses.RVR09: Acordaos de vuestros pastores, que os hablaron la palabra de Dios; la fe de los cuales imitad, considerando cuál haya sido el éxito de su conducta.

verses.KJV: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.WEB: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
verses.ASV: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday and to-day, [yea] and for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jesus Cristo é o mesmo ontem, hoje, e eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Jesucristo es el mismo ayer, y hoy, y por los siglos.

verses.KJV: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.WEB: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
verses.ASV: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos deixeis levar por doutrinas várias e estranhas. Pois bom ao coração é ser fortificado pela graça, e não por alimentos, que não resultaram em proveito algum aos que com eles se ocuparam.
verses.RVR09: No seáis llevados de acá para allá por doctrinas diversas y extrañas; porque buena cosa es afirmar el corazón en la gracia, no en viandas, que nunca aprovecharon á los que anduvieron en ellas.

verses.KJV: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.ASV: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temos um altar, do qual os que servem no tabernáculo não têm autoridade para comer;
verses.RVR09: Tenemos un altar, del cual no tienen facultad de comer los que sirven al tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.WEB: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
verses.ASV: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest [as an offering] for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque os corpos dos animais, cujo sangue pelo pecado é trazido ao Santuário pelo Sumo sacerdote, são queimados fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Porque los cuerpos de aquellos animales, la sangre de los cuales es metida por el pecado en el santuario por el pontífice, son quemados fuera del real.

verses.KJV: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.WEB: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
verses.ASV: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também Jesus, para santificar o povo pelo seu próprio sangue, sofreu fora do portão da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también Jesús, para santificar al pueblo por su propia sangre, padeció fuera de la puerta.

verses.KJV: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.WEB: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.ASV: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, saiamos até ele, fora do acampamento, carregando a sua humilhação.
verses.RVR09: Salgamos pues á él fuera del real, llevando su vituperio.

verses.KJV: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.WEB: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
verses.ASV: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after [the city] which is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não temos aqui cidade permanente, mas buscamos a futura.
verses.RVR09: Porque no tenemos aquí ciudad permanente, mas buscamos la por venir.

verses.KJV: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.WEB: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
verses.ASV: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, por meio dele, ofereçamos continuamente sacrifício de louvor a Deus, isto é, o fruto dos lábios que declaram honra ao seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Así que, ofrezcamos por medio de él á Dios siempre sacrificio de alabanza, es á saber, fruto de labios que confiesen á su nombre.

verses.KJV: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.WEB: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.ASV: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não vos esqueçais de fazer o bem e de compartilhar, pois Deus se agrada com tais sacrifícios.
verses.RVR09: Y de hacer bien y de la comunicación no os olvidéis: porque de tales sacrificios se agrada Dios.

verses.KJV: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.WEB: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
verses.ASV: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit [to them]: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this [were] unprofitable for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Obedecei aos vossos líderes, e sede submissos [a eles] ,pois eles vigiam pelas vossas almas, como os que prestarão contas [delas] ; para que o façam com alegria, e não gemendo, porque isso não vos seria proveitoso.
verses.RVR09: Obedeced á vuestros pastores, y sujetaos á ellos; porque ellos velan por vuestras almas, como aquellos que han de dar cuenta; para que lo hagan con alegría, y no gimiendo; porque esto no os es útil.

verses.KJV: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.WEB: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
verses.ASV: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai por nós; porque confiamos que temos boa consciência, e desejamos nos comportar da maneira correta em tudo.
verses.RVR09: Orad por nosotros: porque confiamos que tenemos buena conciencia, deseando conversar bien en todo.

verses.KJV: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.WEB: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
verses.ASV: And I exhort [you] the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos rogo ainda mais que façais isto, para que eu vos seja restituído mais depressa.
verses.RVR09: Y más os ruego que lo hagáis así, para que yo os sea más presto restituído.

verses.KJV: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.WEB: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
verses.ASV: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, [even] our Lord Jesus,
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus da paz, que, pelo sangue do eterno Testamento eterno, voltou a trazer dentre os mortos o grande Pastor das ovelhas, o nosso Senhor Jesus,
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios de paz que sacó de los muertos á nuestro Señor Jesucristo, el gran pastor de las ovejas, por la sangre del testamento eterno,

verses.KJV: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: vos aperfeiçoe em toda boa obra, para fazerdes a sua vontade, operando em vós o que é agradável diante dele, por meio de Jesus Cristo, a quem seja a glória para todo o sempre. Amém!
verses.RVR09: Os haga aptos en toda obra buena para que hagáis su voluntad, haciendo él en vosotros lo que es agradable delante de él por Jesucristo: al cual sea gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.WEB: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
verses.ASV: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation: for I have written unto you in few words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos rogo, porém, irmãos, que suportai esta palavra de exortação; pois eu vos escrevi de maneira breve.
verses.RVR09: Empero os ruego, hermanos, que soportéis la palabra de exhortación; porque os he escrito en breve.

verses.KJV: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.WEB: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
verses.ASV: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabei que o irmão Timóteo já está solto. Se ele vier depressa, com ele eu vos verei.
verses.RVR09: Sabed que nuestro hermano Timoteo está suelto; con el cual, si viniere más presto, os iré á ver.

verses.KJV: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.WEB: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
verses.ASV: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai a todos os vossos líderes, e a todos os santos. Os da Itália vos saúdam.
verses.RVR09: Saludad á todos vuestros pastores, y á todos los santos. Los de Italia os saludan.

verses.KJV: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.WEB: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.ASV: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: A graça seja com todos vós. Amém.[Escrita da Itália para os Hebreus, e enviada por Timóteo]
verses.RVR09: La gracia sea con todos vosotros. Amén. Fué escrita á los Hebreos desde Italia con Timoteo.

verses.KJV: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.WEB: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
verses.ASV: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are of the Dispersion, greeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tiago, servo de Deus e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, às doze tribos que [estão] na dispersão, saudações!
verses.RVR09: JACOBO, siervo de Dios y del Señor Jesucristo, á las doce tribus que están esparcidas, salud.

verses.KJV: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.WEB: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
verses.ASV: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations;
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, tende toda alegria quando vos encontrardes em várias provações,
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos, tened por sumo gozo cuando cayereis en diversas tentaciones;

verses.KJV: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.WEB: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
verses.ASV: knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.
verses.ALMEIDA: sabendo que a prova da vossa fé produz perseverança.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que la prueba de vuestra fe obra paciencia.

verses.KJV: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.WEB: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.ASV: And let patience have [its] perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, lacking in nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que a perseverança tenha uma realização completa, para que sejais completos e íntegros, faltando em nada.
verses.RVR09: Mas tenga la paciencia perfecta su obra, para que seáis perfectos y cabales, sin faltar en alguna cosa.

verses.KJV: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.WEB: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verses.ASV: But if any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all liberally and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se algum de vós tem falta de sabedoria, peça a Deus, que concede generosamente a todos sem repreender, e lhe será dada.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno de vosotros tiene falta de sabiduría, demándela á Dios, el cual da á todos abundantemente, y no zahiere; y le será dada.

verses.KJV: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.WEB: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
verses.ASV: But let him ask in faith, nothing doubting: for he that doubteth is like the surge of the sea driven by the wind and tossed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém deves pedi-la em fé, duvidando em nada; pois quem duvida é semelhante à onda do mar que é levada pelo vento, e lançada.
verses.RVR09: Pero pida en fe, no dudando nada: porque el que duda es semejante á la onda de la mar, que es movida del viento, y echada de una parte á otra.

verses.KJV: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.WEB: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
verses.ASV: For let not that man think that he shall receive anything of the Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal pessoa não pense que receberá algo do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: No piense pues el tal hombre que recibirá ninguna cosa del Señor.

verses.KJV: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.WEB: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.ASV: a doubleminded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem de dupla mentalidade [é] inconstante em todos os seus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: El hombre de doblado ánimo es inconstante en todos sus caminos.

verses.KJV: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.WEB: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
verses.ASV: But let the brother of low degree glory in his high estate:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o irmão que é humilde se orgulhe quando é exaltado,
verses.RVR09: El hermano que es de baja suerte, gloríese en su alteza:

verses.KJV: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.WEB: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
verses.ASV: and the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o que é rico quando é abatido, porque ele passará como a flor da erva.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que es rico, en su bajeza; porque él se pasará como la flor de la hierba.

verses.KJV: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.WEB: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
verses.ASV: For the sun ariseth with the scorching wind, and withereth the grass; and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his goings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o sol sai com ardor, então seca a erva, a sua flor cai, e a beleza do seu aspecto perece; assim também o rico murchará nos seus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque salido el sol con ardor, la hierba se secó, y su flor se cayó, y pereció su hermosa apariencia: así también se marchitará el rico en todos sus caminos.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.WEB: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been approved, he shall receive the crown of life, which [the Lord] promised to them that love him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito é o homem que suporta a provação; pois, quando for aprovado, receberá a coroa da vida, que o Senhor prometeu aos que o amam.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el varón que sufre la tentación; porque cuando fuere probado, recibirá la corona de vida, que Dios ha prometido á los que le aman.

verses.KJV: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.WEB: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
verses.ASV: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God; for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempteth no man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém, quando for tentado, diga: “Sou tentado por Deus”; porque Deus não é tentado pelo mal, e ele mesmo tenta ninguém;
verses.RVR09: Cuando alguno es tentado, no diga que es tentado de Dios: porque Dios no puede ser tentado de los malos, ni él tienta á alguno:

verses.KJV: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.WEB: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
verses.ASV: but each man is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas cada um é tentado quando é atraído e seduzido pelo seu próprio mau desejo.
verses.RVR09: Sino que cada uno es tentado, cuando de su propia concupiscencia es atraído, y cebado.

verses.KJV: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.WEB: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
verses.ASV: Then the lust, when it hath conceived, beareth sin: and the sin, when it is fullgrown, bringeth forth death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois do mau desejo ter concebido, dá à luz o pecado; e o pecado, quando é completado, gera a morte.
verses.RVR09: Y la concupiscencia, después que ha concebido, pare el pecado: y el pecado, siendo cumplido, engendra muerte.

verses.KJV: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.WEB: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
verses.ASV: Be not deceived, my beloved brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos enganeis, meus amados irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Amados hermanos míos, no erréis.

verses.KJV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.WEB: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
verses.ASV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, neither shadow that is cast by turning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda boa dádiva e todo dom perfeito vem do alto, e desce do Pai das luzes, em quem não há mudança nem sombra de variação.
verses.RVR09: Toda buena dádiva y todo don perfecto es de lo alto, que desciende del Padre de las luces, en el cual no hay mudanza, ni sombra de variación.

verses.KJV: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.WEB: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
verses.ASV: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme a sua própria vontade, ele nos gerou pela palavra da verdade, para que fôssemos os primeiros frutos dentre as suas criaturas.
verses.RVR09: El, de su voluntad nos ha engendrado por la palabra de verdad, para que seamos primicias de sus criaturas.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.WEB: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
verses.ASV: Ye know [this], my beloved brethren. But let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, meus amados irmãos, toda pessoa seja pronta para ouvir, tardia para falar, tardia para se irar;
verses.RVR09: Por esto, mis amados hermanos, todo hombre sea pronto para oir, tardío para hablar, tardío para airarse:

verses.KJV: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.WEB: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
verses.ASV: for the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque a ira humana não cumpre a justiça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ira del hombre no obra la justicia de Dios.

verses.KJV: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.WEB: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.ASV: Wherefore putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, rejeitai toda impureza e abundância de malícia, e recebei com mansidão a palavra implantada em [vós] , que pode salvar as vossas almas;
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, dejando toda inmundicia y superfluidad de malicia, recibid con mansedumbre la palabra ingerida, la cual puede hacer salvas vuestras almas.

verses.KJV: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.WEB: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
verses.ASV: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.
verses.ALMEIDA: e sede praticantes da palavra, e não somente ouvintes, enganando a vós mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Mas sed hacedores de la palabra, y no tan solamente oidores, engañándoos á vosotros mismos.

verses.KJV: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.WEB: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
verses.ASV: For if any one is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a mirror:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se alguém é ouvinte da palavra e não praticante, esse é semelhante a um homem que observa num espelho o seu rosto natural;
verses.RVR09: Porque si alguno oye la palabra, y no la pone por obra, este tal es semejante al hombre que considera en un espejo su rostro natural.

verses.KJV: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.WEB: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
verses.ASV: for he beholdeth himself, and goeth away, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque observou a si mesmo e saiu, e logo se esqueceu de como era.
verses.RVR09: Porque él se consideró á sí mismo, y se fué, y luego se olvidó qué tal era.

verses.KJV: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.WEB: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
verses.ASV: But he that looketh into the perfect law, the [law] of liberty, and [so] continueth, being not a hearer that forgetteth but a doer that worketh, this man shall be blessed in his doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que dá atenção à lei perfeita, a da liberdade, e [nela] persevera, não sendo ouvinte que esquece, mas sim praticante da obra, esse tal será bendito no que fizer.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que hubiere mirado atentamente en la perfecta ley, que es la de la libertad, y perseverado en ella, no siendo oidor olvidadizo, sino hacedor de la obra, este tal será bienaventurado en su hecho.

verses.KJV: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
verses.WEB: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
verses.ASV: If any man thinketh himself to be religious, while he bridleth not his tongue but deceiveth his heart, this man’s religion is vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém entre vós pensa ser religioso, mas não controla a sua língua, então engana o seu próprio coração, e a religião desse é vã.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno piensa ser religioso entre vosotros, y no refrena su lengua, sino engañando su corazón, la religión del tal es vana.

verses.KJV: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.WEB: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
verses.ASV: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, [and] to keep oneself unspotted from the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: A religião pura e não contaminada para com Deus e Pai é esta: visitar os órfãos e as viúvas nas suas aflições, e guardar-se sem a corrupção do mundo.
verses.RVR09: La religión pura y sin mácula delante de Dios y Padre es esta: Visitar los huérfanos y las viudas en sus tribulaciones, y guardarse sin mancha de este mundo.

verses.KJV: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.WEB: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
verses.ASV: My brethren, hold not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, [the Lord] of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, não tenhais a fé do nosso glorioso Senhor Jesus Cristo em acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: HERMANOS míos, no tengáis la fe de nuestro Señor Jesucristo glorioso en acepción de personas.

verses.KJV: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.WEB: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
verses.ASV: For if there come into your synagogue a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, and there come in also a poor man in vile clothing;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se algum homem entrar na vossa congregação com anéis de ouro e trajes preciosos, e também entrar algum pobre com roupa de pouco valor,
verses.RVR09: Porque si en vuestra congregación entra un hombre con anillo de oro, y de preciosa ropa, y también entra un pobre con vestidura vil,

verses.KJV: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.WEB: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
verses.ASV: and ye have regard to him that weareth the fine clothing, and say, Sit thou here in a good place; and ye say to the poor man, Stand thou there, or sit under my footstool;
verses.ALMEIDA: e derdes atenção ao que usa o traje precioso, e lhe disserdes: “Senta aqui, num lugar de honra”, mas ao pobre disserdes: “Fica ali em pé” ou “senta-te aqui abaixo do apoio dos meus pés”,
verses.RVR09: Y tuviereis respeto al que trae la vestidura preciosa, y le dijereis: Siéntate tú aquí en buen lugar: y dijereis al pobre: Estáte tú allí en pie; ó siéntate aquí debajo de mi estrado:

verses.KJV: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.WEB: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.ASV: do ye not make distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.ALMEIDA: por acaso não fizestes discriminação entre vós mesmos, e não vos tornastes juízes de maus pensamentos?
verses.RVR09: ¿No juzgáis en vosotros mismos, y venís á ser jueces de pensamientos malos?

verses.KJV: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
verses.WEB: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
verses.ASV: Hearken, my beloved brethren; did not God choose them that are poor as to the world [to be] rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he promised to them that love him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, meus amados irmãos: acaso Deus não escolheu os pobres deste mundo para [serem] ricos na fé, e herdeiros do reino que ele prometeu aos que o amam?
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos amados, oid: ¿No ha elegido Dios los pobres de este mundo, ricos en fe, y herederos del reino que ha prometido á los que le aman?

verses.KJV: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.WEB: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
verses.ASV: But ye have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you, and themselves drag you before the judgment-seats?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, porém, desonrastes o pobre. Acaso não são os ricos que vos oprimem e vos arrastam para os tribunais?
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros habéis afrentado al pobre. ¿No os oprimen los ricos, y no son ellos los mismos que os arrastran á los juzgados?

verses.KJV: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
verses.WEB: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
verses.ASV: Do not they blaspheme the honorable name by which ye are called?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não são eles que blasfemam o bom nome pelo qual sois chamados?
verses.RVR09: ¿No blasfeman ellos el buen nombre que fué invocado sobre vosotros?

verses.KJV: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.WEB: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
verses.ASV: Howbeit if ye fulfil the royal law, according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself, ye do well:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se de fato cumpris a lei real conforme a Escritura: Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo, bem fazeis;
verses.RVR09: Si en verdad cumplís vosotros la ley real, conforme á la Escritura: Amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo, bien hacéis:

verses.KJV: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.WEB: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.ASV: but if ye have respect of persons, ye commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se fazeis acepção de pessoas, cometeis pecado, e sois denunciados pela lei como transgressores.
verses.RVR09: Mas si hacéis acepción de personas, cometéis pecado, y sois reconvenidos de la ley como transgresores.

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.WEB: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one [point], he is become guilty of all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem guarda toda a lei, mas falha em um [item] , tornou-se culpado de todos.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que hubiere guardado toda la ley, y ofendiere en un punto, es hecho culpado de todos.

verses.KJV: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.WEB: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
verses.ASV: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou dost not commit adultery, but killest, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aquele que disse: “Não cometerás adultério”, também disse: “Não matarás”. Portanto, se não cometeres adultério, mas matares, te tornaste um transgressor da lei.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que dijo: No cometerás adulterio, también ha dicho: No matarás. Ahora bien, si no hubieres cometido adulterio, pero hubieres matado, ya eres hecho transgresor de la ley.

verses.KJV: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.WEB: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
verses.ASV: So speak ye, and so do, as men that are to be judged by a law of liberty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falai assim e procedei assim: como os que serão julgados pela lei da liberdade;
verses.RVR09: Así hablad, y así obrad, como los que habéis de ser juzgados por la ley de libertad.

verses.KJV: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
verses.WEB: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.ASV: For judgment [is] without mercy to him that hath showed no mercy: mercy glorieth against judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o julgamento [será] sem misericórdia sobre quem não agiu com misericórdia; mas a misericórdia triunfa sobre o julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Porque juicio sin misericordia será hecho con aquel que no hiciere misericordia: y la misericordia se gloría contra el juicio.

verses.KJV: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.WEB: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
verses.ASV: What doth it profit, my brethren, if a man say he hath faith, but have not works? can that faith save him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, qual é o proveito se alguém disser que tem fé, mas não tiver obras? Acaso a fé pode salvá-lo?
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos, ¿qué aprovechará si alguno dice que tiene fe, y no tiene obras? ¿Podrá la fe salvarle?

verses.KJV: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.WEB: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
verses.ASV: If a brother or sister be naked and in lack of daily food,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se um irmão ou irmã estiverem nus, e necessitarem do alimento diário,
verses.RVR09: Y si el hermano ó la hermana están desnudos, y tienen necesidad del mantenimiento de cada día,

verses.KJV: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.WEB: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
verses.ASV: and one of you say unto them, Go in peace, be ye warmed and filled; and yet ye give them not the things needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.ALMEIDA: e algum de vós lhes disser: “Ide em paz, aquecei-vos e saciai-vos”; e não lhes derdes as coisas necessárias ao corpo, qual é o proveito [disso] ?
verses.RVR09: Y alguno de vosotros les dice: Id en paz, calentaos y hartaos; pero no les diereis las cosas que son necesarias para el cuerpo: ¿qué aprovechará?

verses.KJV: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.WEB: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
verses.ASV: Even so faith, if it have not works, is dead in itself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também a fé, se não tiver obras, é morta em si mesma.
verses.RVR09: Así también la fe, si no tuviere obras, es muerta en sí misma.

verses.KJV: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
verses.WEB: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
verses.ASV: Yea, a man will say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: show me thy faith apart from [thy] works, and I by my works will show thee [my] faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas alguém dirá: Tu tens fé e eu tenho obras. Mostra-me a tua fé pelas tuas obras, e eu, pelas minhas obras, te mostrarei a minha fé.
verses.RVR09: Pero alguno dirá: Tú tienes fe, y yo tengo obras: muéstrame tu fe sin tus obras, y yo te mostraré mi fe por mis obras.

verses.KJV: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.WEB: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
verses.ASV: Thou believest that God is one; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and shudder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu crês que há um só Deus? Fazes bem; os demônios também creem, e estremecem.
verses.RVR09: Tú crees que Dios es uno; bien haces: también los demonios creen, y tiemblan.

verses.KJV: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.WEB: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
verses.ASV: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith apart from works is barren?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó tolo, queres te certificar de que a fé sem as obras é morta?
verses.RVR09: ¿Mas quieres saber, hombre vano, que la fe sin obras es muerta?

verses.KJV: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.WEB: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
verses.ASV: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso não foi o nosso pai Abraão justificado pelas obras, quando ofereceu o seu filho Isaque sobre o altar?
verses.RVR09: ¿No fué justificado por las obras Abraham nuestro padre, cuando ofreció á su hijo Isaac sobre el altar?

verses.KJV: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.WEB: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
verses.ASV: Thou seest that faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vês que a fé cooperou com as suas obras, e que pelas obras a fé foi aperfeiçoada.
verses.RVR09: ¿No ves que la fe obró con sus obras, y que la fe fué perfecta por las obras?

verses.KJV: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.WEB: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
verses.ASV: and the scripture was fulfilled which saith, And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness; and he was called the friend of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cumpriu-se a Escritura que diz: “E Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi considerado como justiça”, e ele foi chamado amigo de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y fué cumplida la Escritura que dice: Abraham creyó á Dios, y le fué imputado á justicia, y fué llamado amigo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.WEB: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
verses.ASV: Ye see that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vedes, então, que o ser humano é justificado pelas obras, e não somente pela fé.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros veis, pues, que el hombre es justificado por las obras, y no solamente por la fe.

verses.KJV: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
verses.WEB: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
verses.ASV: And in like manner was not also Rahab the harlot justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
verses.ALMEIDA: E de igual modo não foi também a prostituta Raabe justificada pelas obras, quando recebeu os mensageiros, e ajudou para que saíssem por outro caminho?
verses.RVR09: Asimismo también Rahab la ramera, ¿no fué justificada por obras, cuando recibió los mensajeros, y los echó fuera por otro camino?

verses.KJV: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.WEB: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
verses.ASV: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois assim como o corpo sem o espírito está morto, assim também a fé sem obras está morta.
verses.RVR09: Porque como el cuerpo sin espíritu está muerto, así también la fe sin obras es muerta.

verses.KJV: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.WEB: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
verses.ASV: Be not many [of you] teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive heavier judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, não sejais muitos de vós mestres, porque sabeis que receberemos um julgamento mais rigoroso.
verses.RVR09: HERMANOS míos, no os hagáis muchos maestros, sabiendo que recibiremos mayor condenación.

verses.KJV: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.WEB: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
verses.ASV: For in many things we all stumble. If any stumbleth not in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos tropeçamos em muitas coisas. Se alguém não tropeça no que diz, tal homem é completo, e também capaz de refrear todo o corpo.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos ofendemos en muchas cosas. Si alguno no ofende en palabra, éste es varón perfecto, que también puede con freno gobernar todo el cuerpo.

verses.KJV: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.WEB: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
verses.ASV: Now if we put the horses’ bridles into their mouths that they may obey us, we turn about their whole body also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que pomos freios nas bocas dos cavalos para nos obedecerem, e [assim] manobramos todo o corpo deles.
verses.RVR09: He aquí nosotros ponemos frenos en las bocas de los caballos para que nos obedezcan, y gobernamos todo su cuerpo.

verses.KJV: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.WEB: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
verses.ASV: Behold, the ships also, though they are so great and are driven by rough winds, are yet turned about by a very small rudder, whither the impulse of the steersman willeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede também os navios, sendo tão grandes, e levados por impetuosos ventos, são manobrados com um pequeníssimo leme para onde quer que queira o impulso daquele que dirige.
verses.RVR09: Mirad también las naves: aunque tan grandes, y llevadas de impetuosos vientos, son gobernadas con un muy pequeño timón por donde quisiere el que las gobierna.

verses.KJV: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.WEB: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
verses.ASV: So the tongue also is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how much wood is kindled by how small a fire!
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também a língua é um pequeno membro, mas se orgulha de grandes coisas. Vede como um pequeno fogo incendeia um grande bosque!
verses.RVR09: Así también, la lengua es un miembro pequeño, y se gloría de grandes cosas. He aquí, un pequeño fuego ¡cuán grande bosque enciende!

verses.KJV: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.WEB: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
verses.ASV: And the tongue is a fire: the world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the wheel of nature, and is set on fire by hell.
verses.ALMEIDA: A língua também [é] um fogo, o mundo da injustiça; assim a língua está posta entre os nossos membros, contaminando o corpo todo, inflamando o curso da natureza humana, e sendo inflamada pelo inferno.
verses.RVR09: Y la lengua es un fuego, un mundo de maldad. Así la lengua está puesta entre nuestros miembros, la cual contamina todo el cuerpo, é inflama la rueda de la creación, y es inflamada del infierno.

verses.KJV: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
verses.WEB: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
verses.ASV: For every kind of beasts and birds, of creeping things and things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed by mankind:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois toda espécie, tanto de animais selvagens como de aves, tanto de répteis como de animais marinhos, é dominível e tem sido dominada pela espécie humana;
verses.RVR09: Porque toda naturaleza de bestias, y de aves, y de serpientes, y de seres de la mar, se doma y es domada de la naturaleza humana:

verses.KJV: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.WEB: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.ASV: but the tongue can no man tame; [it is] a restless evil, [it is] full of deadly poison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nenhum ser humano consegue dominar a língua; ela é um mal difícil de se controlar, cheia de veneno mortal.
verses.RVR09: Pero ningún hombre puede domar la lengua, que es un mal que no puede ser refrenado; llena de veneno mortal.

verses.KJV: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.WEB: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
verses.ASV: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father; and therewith curse we men, who are made after the likeness of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Com ela bendizemos o Deus e Pai, e com ela amaldiçoamos os seres humanos, que são feitos à semelhança de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Con ella bendecimos al Dios y Padre, y con ella maldecimos á los hombres, los cuales son hechos á la semejanza de Dios.

verses.KJV: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.WEB: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
verses.ASV: out of the same mouth cometh forth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da mesma boca procedem benção e maldição. Meus irmãos, isso não deve ser assim.
verses.RVR09: De una misma boca proceden bendición y maldición. Hermanos míos, no conviene que estas cosas sean así hechas.

verses.KJV: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
verses.WEB: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
verses.ASV: Doth the fountain send forth from the same opening sweet [water] and bitter?
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso uma fonte jorra do mesmo manancial [água] doce e [água] amarga?
verses.RVR09: ¿Echa alguna fuente por una misma abertura agua dulce y amarga?

verses.KJV: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.WEB: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
verses.ASV: can a fig tree, my brethren, yield olives, or a vine figs? neither [can] salt water yield sweet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, pode a figueira dar azeitonas, ou a videira figos? Assim [também] , nenhuma fonte dá tanto água salgada como doce.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos, ¿puede la higuera producir aceitunas, ó la vid higos? Así ninguna fuente puede hacer agua salada y dulce.

verses.KJV: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.WEB: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
verses.ASV: Who is wise and understanding among you? let him show by his good life his works in meekness of wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem dentre vós for sábio e inteligente, que mostre pela boa conduta as suas obras em humildade de sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es sabio y avisado entre vosotros? muestre por buena conversación sus obras en mansedumbre de sabiduría.

verses.KJV: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.WEB: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
verses.ASV: But if ye have bitter jealousy and faction in your heart, glory not and lie not against the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se tendes amarga inveja e rivalidade no vosso coração, não vos orgulheis, nem mintais contra a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Pero si tenéis envidia amarga y contención en vuestros corazones, no os gloriéis, ni seáis mentirosos contra la verdad:

verses.KJV: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.WEB: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
verses.ASV: This wisdom is not [a wisdom] that cometh down from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta sabedoria não é a que vem do alto, mas sim, terrena, animal, [e] demoníaca.
verses.RVR09: Que esta sabiduría no es la que desciende de lo alto, sino terrena, animal, diabólica.

verses.KJV: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
verses.WEB: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
verses.ASV: For where jealousy and faction are, there is confusion and every vile deed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois onde [há] inveja e rivalidade, ali [há] perturbação e toda obra perversa.
verses.RVR09: Porque donde hay envidia y contención, allí hay perturbación y toda obra perversa.

verses.KJV: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.WEB: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.ASV: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without variance, without hypocrisy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a sabedoria do alto é primeiramente pura, depois pacífica, moderada, tratável, cheia de misericórdia e de bons frutos, imparcial e sem hipocrisia.
verses.RVR09: Mas la sabiduría que es de lo alto, primeramente es pura, después pacífica, modesta, benigna, llena de misericordia y de buenos frutos, no juzgadora, no fingida.

verses.KJV: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.WEB: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.ASV: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace for them that make peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o fruto da justiça é semeado na paz para os que praticam a paz.
verses.RVR09: Y el fruto de justicia se siembra en paz para aquellos que hacen paz.

verses.KJV: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.WEB: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.ASV: Whence [come] wars and whence [come] fightings among you? [come they] not hence, [even] of your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.ALMEIDA: De onde [vêm] as guerras e brigas entre vós? Acaso não [vêm] disto, das vossas cobiças que guerreiam nos membros do vosso corpo?
verses.RVR09: ¿DE dónde vienen las guerras y los pleitos entre vosotros? ¿No son de vuestras concupiscencias, las cuales combaten en vuestros miembros?

verses.KJV: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.WEB: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
verses.ASV: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and covet, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war; ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cobiçais, e nada tendes; matais e sois invejosos, mas não conseguis obter; combateis e guerreais, mas nada tendes, porque não pedis.
verses.RVR09: Codiciáis, y no tenéis; matáis y ardéis de envidia, y no podéis alcanzar; combatís y guerreáis, y no tenéis lo que deseáis, porque no pedís.

verses.KJV: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verses.WEB: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
verses.ASV: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may spend [it] in your pleasures.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedis, e não recebeis, porque pedis mal, para gastardes nos vossos prazeres.
verses.RVR09: Pedís, y no recibís, porque pedís mal, para gastar en vuestros deleites.

verses.KJV: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.WEB: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.ASV: Ye adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Whosoever therefore would be a friend of the world maketh himself an enemy of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Adúlteros e adúlteras, não sabeis que a amizade do mundo é inimizade contra Deus? Portanto, quem quiser ser amigo do mundo constitui-se inimigo de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Adúlteros y adúlteras, ¿no sabéis que la amistad del mundo es enemistad con Dios? Cualquiera pues que quisiere ser amigo del mundo, se constituye enemigo de Dios.

verses.KJV: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
verses.WEB: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
verses.ASV: Or think ye that the scripture speaketh in vain? Doth the spirit which he made to dwell in us long unto envying?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou pensais ser em vão que a Escritura diz: “O Espírito que habita em nós ansia com ciúmes?”
verses.RVR09: ¿Pensáis que la Escritura dice sin causa: El espíritu que mora en nosotros codicia para envidia?

verses.KJV: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.WEB: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.ASV: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore [the scripture] saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele concede uma graça maior. Por isso diz: Deus resiste aos soberbos, mas concede graça aos humildes.
verses.RVR09: Mas él da mayor gracia. Por esto dice: Dios resiste á los soberbios, y da gracia á los humildes.

verses.KJV: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.WEB: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.ASV: Be subject therefore unto God; but resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sujeitai-vos, pois, a Deus; resisti ao diabo, e ele fugirá de vós.
verses.RVR09: Someteos pues á Dios; resistid al diablo, y de vosotros huirá.

verses.KJV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.WEB: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.ASV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aproximai-vos de Deus, e ele se aproximará de vós. Limpai as [vossas] mãos, pecadores, e vós de dupla mentalidade, purificai os [vossos] corações.
verses.RVR09: Allegaos á Dios, y él se allegará á vosotros. Pecadores, limpiad las manos; y vosotros de doblado ánimo, purificad los corazones.

verses.KJV: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.WEB: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
verses.ASV: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei vossas misérias, lamentai e chorai. Torne-se o vosso riso em pranto, e a [vossa] alegria em tristeza.
verses.RVR09: Afligíos, y lamentad, y llorad. Vuestra risa se convierta en lloro, y vuestro gozo en tristeza.

verses.KJV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.WEB: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
verses.ASV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Humilhai-vos diante do Senhor, e ele vos exaltará.
verses.RVR09: Humillaos delante del Señor, y él os ensalzará.

verses.KJV: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.WEB: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
verses.ASV: Speak not one against another, brethren. He that speaketh against a brother, or judgeth his brother, speaketh against the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judgest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, não faleis mal uns dos outros. Quem fala mal de um irmão, e julga o seu irmão, fala mal da lei, e julga a lei. E se julgas a lei, não és um cumpridor da lei, mas, sim, juiz.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, no murmuréis los unos de los otros. El que murmura del hermano, y juzga á su hermano, este tal murmura de la ley, y juzga á la ley; pero si tú juzgas á la ley, no eres guardador de la ley, sino juez.

verses.KJV: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.WEB: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
verses.ASV: One [only] is the lawgiver and judge, [even] he who is able to save and to destroy: but who art thou that judgest thy neighbor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Um [só] é o Legislador, que pode salvar e destruir. Quem és tu, que julgas o outro?
verses.RVR09: Uno es el dador de la ley, que puede salvar y perder: ¿quién eres tú que juzgas á otro?

verses.KJV: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.WEB: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
verses.ASV: Come now, ye that say, To-day or to-morrow we will go into this city, and spend a year there, and trade, and get gain:
verses.ALMEIDA: Atenção! Vós que dizeis: “Hoje ou amanhã iremos a uma tal cidade, e lá passaremos um ano negociando e lucrando”;
verses.RVR09: Ea ahora, los que decís: Hoy y mañana iremos á tal ciudad, y estaremos allá un año, y compraremos mercadería, y ganaremos:

verses.KJV: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.WEB: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
verses.ASV: whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. What is your life? For ye are a vapor that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas não sabeis o amanhã. Pois o que [é] a vossa vida? É um vapor, que por pouco tempo aparece, e logo se desvanece.
verses.RVR09: Y no sabéis lo que será mañana. Porque ¿qué es vuestra vida? Ciertamente es un vapor que se aparece por un poco de tiempo, y luego se desvanece.

verses.KJV: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.WEB: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
verses.ASV: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall both live, and do this or that.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, devíeis dizer: Se o Senhor quiser, e vivermos, faremos isso ou aquilo.
verses.RVR09: En lugar de lo cual deberíais decir: Si el Señor quisiere, y si viviéremos, haremos esto ó aquello.

verses.KJV: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.WEB: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
verses.ASV: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora vos orgulhais nas vossas presunções; todo orgulho como esse é maligno.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora os jactáis en vuestras soberbias. Toda jactancia semejante es mala.

verses.KJV: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.WEB: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
verses.ASV: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, quem sabe fazer o bem, e não [o] faz, comete pecado.
verses.RVR09: El pecado, pues, está en aquel que sabe hacer lo bueno, y no lo hace.

verses.KJV: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.WEB: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
verses.ASV: Come now, ye rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuidado, ricos! Chorai e gemei pelas vossas misérias que virão sobre [vós] .
verses.RVR09: EA ya ahora, oh ricos, llorad aullando por vuestras miserias que os vendrán.

verses.KJV: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.WEB: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.ASV: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: As vossas riquezas estão podres, e as vossas roupas estão comidas pela traça.
verses.RVR09: Vuestras riquezas están podridas: vuestras ropas están comidas de polilla.

verses.KJV: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.WEB: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
verses.ASV: Your gold and your silver are rusted; and their rust shall be for a testimony against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have laid up your treasure in the last days.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vosso ouro e a vossa prata estão enferrujados, e a ferrugem deles será testemunho contra vós, e comerá a vossa carne como fogo. Acumulastes tesouro para os dias finais.
verses.RVR09: Vuestro oro y plata están corrompidos de orín; y su orín os será en testimonio, y comerá del todo vuestras carnes como fuego. Os habéis allegado tesoro para en los postreros días.

verses.KJV: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.WEB: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
verses.ASV: Behold, the hire of the laborers who mowed your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth out: and the cries of them that reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o salário dos trabalhadores que colheram nos vossos campos, que por vós foi retido fraudulentamente, está clamando; e os clamores dos que fizeram a colheita chegaram os ouvidos do Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, el jornal de los obreros que han segado vuestras tierras, el cual por engaño no les ha sido pagado de vosotros, clama; y los clamores de los que habían segado, han entrado en los oídos del Señor de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.WEB: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
verses.ASV: Ye have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure; ye have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivestes em luxo sobre a terra, e tivestes prazeres. Engordastes os vossos corações como num dia de matança.
verses.RVR09: Habéis vivido en deleites sobre la tierra, y sido disolutos; habéis cebado vuestros corazones como en el día de sacrificios.

verses.KJV: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
verses.WEB: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
verses.ASV: Ye have condemned, ye have killed the righteous [one]; he doth not resist you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Condenastes [e] matastes o justo; ele não vos resistiu.
verses.RVR09: Habéis condenado y muerto al justo; y él no os resiste.

verses.KJV: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.WEB: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
verses.ASV: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receive the early and latter rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, sede pacientes até a vinda do Senhor. Eis que o lavrador espera o precioso fruto da terra, aguardando-o com paciência, até que receba a primeira chuva e a chuva tardia.
verses.RVR09: Pues, hermanos, tened paciencia hasta la venida del Señor. Mirad cómo el labrador espera el precioso fruto de la tierra, aguardando con paciencia, hasta que reciba la lluvia temprana y tardía.

verses.KJV: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.WEB: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.ASV: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede vós também pacientes. Fortalecei os vossos corações, porque a vinda do Senhor está próxima.
verses.RVR09: Tened también vosotros paciencia; confirmad vuestros corazones: porque la venida del Señor se acerca.

verses.KJV: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.WEB: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
verses.ASV: Murmur not, brethren, one against another, that ye be not judged: behold, the judge standeth before the doors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, não vos queixeis uns contra os outros, para que não sejais condenados. Eis que o Juiz está à porta.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, no os quejéis unos contra otros, porque no seáis condenados; he aquí, el juez está delante de la puerta.

verses.KJV: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.WEB: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.ASV: Take, brethren, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spake in the name of the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, tomai como exemplo de aflições e de paciência os profetas que falaram no nome do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos, tomad por ejemplo de aflicción y de paciencia, á los profetas que hablaron en nombre del Señor.

verses.KJV: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.WEB: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verses.ASV: Behold, we call them blessed that endured: ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord, how that the Lord is full of pity, and merciful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que considerarmos benditos os que suportam o sofrimento. Ouvistes da paciência de Jó, e vistes o resultado da parte do Senhor; porque o Senhor é muito misericordioso, e cheio de compaixão.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, tenemos por bienaventurados á los que sufren. Habéis oído la paciencia de Job, y habéis visto el fin del Señor, que el Señor es muy misericordioso y piadoso.

verses.KJV: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.WEB: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
verses.ASV: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by the heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath: but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay; that ye fall not under judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, acima de tudo, meus irmãos, não jureis, nem pelo céu nem pela terra, nem [façais] qualquer outro juramento. Mas que de vós o sim seja sim, e o não, não; para que não caiais em condenação.
verses.RVR09: Mas sobre todo, hermanos míos, no juréis, ni por el cielo, ni por la tierra, ni por otro cualquier juramento; sino vuestro sí sea sí, y vuestro no sea no; porque no caigáis en condenación.

verses.KJV: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.WEB: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
verses.ASV: Is any among you suffering? let him pray. Is any cheerful? let him sing praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguém entre vós está aflito? Ore. Alguém está contente? Cante louvores.
verses.RVR09: ¿Está alguno entre vosotros afligido? haga oración. ¿Está alguno alegre? cante salmos.

verses.KJV: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.WEB: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
verses.ASV: Is any among you sick? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguém entre vós está doente? Chame os anciãos da igreja, e orem sobre ele, ungindo-o com azeite no nome do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: ¿Está alguno enfermo entre vosotros? llame á los ancianos de la iglesia, y oren por él, ungiéndole con aceite en el nombre del Señor.

verses.KJV: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.WEB: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verses.ASV: and the prayer of faith shall save him that is sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a oração da fé sarará o doente, e o Senhor o levantará; e se houver cometido pecados, lhe serão perdoados.
verses.RVR09: Y la oración de fe salvará al enfermo, y el Señor lo levantará; y si estuviere en pecados, le serán perdonados.

verses.KJV: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.WEB: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
verses.ASV: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confessai as [vossas] culpas uns aos outros, e orai uns pelos outros, para que sejais curados. A oração de um justo muito pode efetuar.
verses.RVR09: Confesaos vuestras faltas unos á otros, y rogad los unos por los otros, para que seáis sanos; la oración del justo, obrando eficazmente, puede mucho.

verses.KJV: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.WEB: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.ASV: Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain; and it rained not on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elias era tão humano quanto nós, e orou insistentemente para não chover; e não choveu sobre a terra por três anos e seis meses.
