verses.RVR09: Elías era hombre sujeto á semejantes pasiones que nosotros, y rogó con oración que no lloviese, y no llovió sobre la tierra en tres años y seis meses.

verses.KJV: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.WEB: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
verses.ASV: And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E orou outra vez, e o céu deu chuva, e a terra produziu o seu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Y otra vez oró, y el cielo dió lluvia, y la tierra produjo su fruto.

verses.KJV: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.WEB: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
verses.ASV: My brethren, if any among you err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, se algum entre vós houver se desviado da verdade, e alguém o converter,
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, si alguno de entre vosotros ha errado de la verdad, y alguno le convirtiere,

verses.KJV: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.WEB: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
verses.ASV: let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: saiba que aquele que converter um pecador do erro de seu caminho, salvará uma alma da morte, e cobrirá uma multidão de pecados.
verses.RVR09: Sepa que el que hubiere hecho convertir al pecador del error de su camino, salvará un alma de muerte, y cubrirá multitud de pecados.

verses.KJV: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.WEB: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.ASV: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedro, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos forasteiros que estão espalhados em Ponto, Galácia, Capadócia, Ásia e Bitínia,
verses.RVR09: PEDRO, apóstol de Jesucristo, á los extranjeros esparcidos en Ponto, en Galacia, en Capadocia, en Asia, y en Bithinia,

verses.KJV: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
verses.WEB: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
verses.ASV: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: escolhidos segundo o pré-conhecimento de Deus Pai, por meio da santificação do Espírito, para a obediência e a aspersão do sangue de Jesus Cristo. Que a graça e a paz vos sejam multiplicadas.
verses.RVR09: Elegidos según la presciencia de Dios Padre en santificación del Espíritu, para obedecer y ser rociados con la sangre de Jesucristo: Gracia y paz os sea multiplicada.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.ASV: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo. Segundo sua grande misericórdia, ele nos regenerou para uma esperança viva, por meio da ressurreição de Jesus Cristo dentre os mortos.
verses.RVR09: Bendito el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, que según su grande misericordia nos ha regenerado en esperanza viva, por la resurrección de Jesucristo de los muertos,

verses.KJV: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.WEB: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
verses.ASV: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o resultado disso é uma herança incorruptível, incontaminável, e que não pode ser enfraquecida. Ela está guardada nos céus para vós,
verses.RVR09: Para una herencia incorruptible, y que no puede contaminarse, ni marchitarse, reservada en los cielos

verses.KJV: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.WEB: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.ASV: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.ALMEIDA: que pela fé estais guardados no poder de Deus para a salvação, pronta para se revelar no último tempo.
verses.RVR09: Para nosotros que somos guardados en la virtud de Dios por fe, para alcanzar la salud que está aparejada para ser manifestada en el postrimero tiempo.

verses.KJV: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
verses.WEB: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
verses.ASV: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisso vos alegrais, ainda que agora seja necessário que estejais por um pouco [de tempo] entristecidos com várias provações,
verses.RVR09: En lo cual vosotros os alegráis, estando al presente un poco de tiempo afligidos en diversas tentaciones, si es necesario,

verses.KJV: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
verses.ASV: that the proof of your faith, [being] more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: para que a prova de vossa fé, muito mais preciosa que o ouro que perece (mesmo sendo provado pelo fogo), seja achada em louvor, honra, e glória, na revelação de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Para que la prueba de vuestra fe, mucho más preciosa que el oro, el cual perece, bien que sea probado con fuego, sea hallada en alabanza, gloria y honra, cuando Jesucristo fuere manifestado:

verses.KJV: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.WEB: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
verses.ASV: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.ALMEIDA: A ele, sem terdes visto, vós o amais. Ainda que não estejais o vendo agora, mas crendo nele, vós estais alegres com júbilo indescritível e glorioso.
verses.RVR09: Al cual, no habiendo visto, le amáis; en el cual creyendo, aunque al presente no lo veáis, os alegráis con gozo inefable y glorificado;

verses.KJV: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
verses.WEB: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
verses.ASV: receiving the end of your faith, [even] the salvation of [your] souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim estais alcançando o resultado da vossa fé: a salvação das [vossas] almas.
verses.RVR09: Obteniendo el fin de vuestra fe, que es la salud de vuestras almas.

verses.KJV: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
verses.WEB: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
verses.ASV: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that [should come] unto you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dessa salvação os profetas que profetizaram a respeito da graça [direcionada] a vós procuraram entender, e com empenho investigaram,
verses.RVR09: De la cual salud los profetas que profetizaron de la gracia que había de venir á vosotros, han inquirido y diligentemente buscado,

verses.KJV: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
verses.WEB: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
verses.ASV: searching what [time] or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.
verses.ALMEIDA: procurando saber qual era o tempo ou ocasião que o Espírito de Cristo dentro deles indicava, quando dava prévio testemunho dos sofrimentos de Cristo e das glórias seguintes.
verses.RVR09: Escudriñando cuándo y en qué punto de tiempo significaba el Espíritu de Cristo que estaba en ellos, el cual prenunciaba las aflicciones que habían de venir á Cristo, y las glorias después de ellas.

verses.KJV: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
verses.WEB: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
verses.ASV: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
verses.ALMEIDA: A eles foi revelado que não foi para eles mesmos, mas sim para nós, que eles prestaram serviço com estas coisas. E agora, elas vos foram anunciadas pelos que, pelo Espírito Santo enviado do céu, vos pregaram o Evangelho. Tais coisas os anjos desejam atentamente observar.
verses.RVR09: A los cuales fué revelado, que no para sí mismos, sino para nosotros administraban las cosas que ahora os son anunciadas de los que os han predicado el evangelio por el Espíritu Santo enviado del cielo; en las cuales desean mirar los ángeles.

verses.KJV: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.WEB: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
verses.ASV: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, preparai as vossas mentes, sede sóbrios, e esperai completamente na graça que vos será trazida na revelação de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, teniendo los lomos de vuestro entendimiento ceñidos, con templanza, esperad perfectamente en la gracia que os es presentada cuando Jesucristo os es manifestado:

verses.KJV: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
verses.WEB: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
verses.ASV: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in [the time of] your ignorance:
verses.ALMEIDA: E, como filhos obedientes, não vos conformeis com os maus desejos do passado, de quando éreis ignorantes.
verses.RVR09: Como hijos obedientes, no conformándoos con los deseos que antes teníais estando en vuestra ignorancia;

verses.KJV: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
verses.WEB: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
verses.ASV: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao contrário; assim como aquele que vos chamou é santo, sede vós também santos em todo o [vosso] comportamento.
verses.RVR09: Sino como aquel que os ha llamado es santo, sed también vosotros santos en toda conversación:

verses.KJV: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
verses.WEB: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
verses.ASV: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois está escrito: Sede santos, porque eu sou santo.
verses.RVR09: Porque escrito está: Sed santos, porque yo soy santo.

verses.KJV: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
verses.WEB: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
verses.ASV: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se vós chamais de Pai aquele que, sem acepção de pessoas, julga segundo a obra de cada um, vivei em temor o tempo de vossa peregrinação;
verses.RVR09: Y si invocáis por Padre á aquel que sin acepción de personas juzga según la obra de cada uno, conversad en temor todo el tiempo de vuestra peregrinación:

verses.KJV: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
verses.WEB: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
verses.ASV: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;
verses.ALMEIDA: e sabei que não foi por coisas destrutíveis, [como] prata ou ouro, que fostes resgatados da vossa vã maneira de viver que recebestes dos [vossos] pais,
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que habéis sido rescatados de vuestra vana conversación, la cual recibisteis de vuestros padres, no con cosas corruptibles, como oro ó plata;

verses.KJV: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
verses.WEB: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
verses.ASV: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, [even the blood] of Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: mas sim, pelo sangue precioso, como de um cordeiro sem falha e sem contaminação: o [sangue] de Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Sino con la sangre preciosa de Cristo, como de un cordero sin mancha y sin contaminación:

verses.KJV: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
verses.WEB: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
verses.ASV: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele já era conhecido desde antes da fundação do mundo, mas foi manifesto nestes últimos tempos por causa de vós,
verses.RVR09: Ya ordenado de antes de la fundación del mundo, pero manifestado en los postrimeros tiempos por amor de vosotros,

verses.KJV: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.WEB: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.ASV: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: que, por meio dele, credes em Deus, que o ressuscitou dos mortos e lhe deu glória, para que a vossa fé e esperança estejam em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que por él creéis á Dios, el cual le resucitó de los muertos, y le ha dado gloria, para que vuestra fe y esperanza sea en Dios.

verses.KJV: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
verses.WEB: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
verses.ASV: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma vez que purificastes as vossas almas na obediência da verdade por meio do Espírito, para o sincero amor fraternal, amai-vos intensamente uns aos outros com um coração puro,
verses.RVR09: Habiendo purificado vuestra almas en la obediencia de la verdad, por el Espíritu, en caridad hermanable sin fingimiento, amaos unos á otros entrañablemente de corazón puro:

verses.KJV: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
verses.WEB: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
verses.ASV: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
verses.ALMEIDA: visto que nascestes de novo, não de semente que perece, mas sim imperecível, pela viva palavra de Deus, que permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Siendo renacidos, no de simiente corruptible, sino de incorruptible, por la palabra de Dios, que vive y permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
verses.WEB: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
verses.ASV: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois toda carne é como a erva, e toda glória humana como a flor da erva. A erva se seca, e sua flor cai;
verses.RVR09: Porque Toda carne es como la hierba, y toda la gloria del hombre como la flor de la hierba: secóse la hierba, y la flor se cayó;

verses.KJV: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verses.WEB: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
verses.ASV: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas a palavra do Senhor permanece para sempre.E esta é a palavra que foi evangelizada entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Mas la palabra del Señor permanece perpetuamente. Y esta es la palabra que por el evangelio os ha sido anunciada.

verses.KJV: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.WEB: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
verses.ASV: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abandonai, portanto, toda malícia, toda enganação, fingimentos, invejas, e todas as falas maldosas,
verses.RVR09: DEJANDO pues toda malicia, y todo engaño, y fingimientos, y envidias, y todas las detracciones,

verses.KJV: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
verses.WEB: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
verses.ASV: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;
verses.ALMEIDA: e desejai ansiosamente, como bebês recém-nascidos, o leite da Palavra, não falsificado, para que por meio dele estejais crescendo;
verses.RVR09: Desead, como niños recién nacidos, la leche espiritual, sin engaño, para que por ella crezcáis en salud:

verses.KJV: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
verses.WEB: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
verses.ASV: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
verses.ALMEIDA: se, de fato, já experimentastes que o Senhor é bom.
verses.RVR09: Si empero habéis gustado que el Señor es benigno;

verses.KJV: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
verses.WEB: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
verses.ASV: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aproximai-vos dele, [que é] uma pedra viva, rejeitada pelos seres humanos, mas escolhida e preciosa para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Al cual allegándoos, piedra viva, reprobada cierto de los hombres, empero elegida de Dios, preciosa,

verses.KJV: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vós, como pedras vivas, sois edificados como casa espiritual [e] sacerdócio santo, para oferecerdes sacrifícios espirituais, agradáveis a Deus por meio de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros también, como piedras vivas, sed edificados una casa espiritual, y un sacerdocio santo, para ofrecer sacrificios espirituales, agradables á Dios por Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
verses.WEB: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
verses.ASV: Because it is contained in scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso também está contido na Escritura: Eis que eu ponho em Sião uma pedra principal de esquina, escolhida [e] preciosa. Quem nela crer de maneira nenhuma será envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual también contiene la Escritura: He aquí, pongo en Sión la principal piedra del ángulo, escogida, preciosa; y el que creyere en ella, no será confundido.

verses.KJV: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
verses.WEB: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
verses.ASV: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, para vós, que credes, ela é preciosa. Mas para os rebeldes: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa se tornou a principal de esquina,
verses.RVR09: Ella es pues honor á vosotros que creéis: mas para los desobedientes, la piedra que los edificadores reprobaron, ésta fué hecha la cabeza del ángulo;

verses.KJV: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.WEB: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
verses.ASV: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim como pedra de tropeço, e pedra que causa queda. Eles tropeçam na palavra por serem rebeldes. Para isso eles foram destinados.
verses.RVR09: Y Piedra de tropiezo, y roca de escándalo á aquellos que tropiezan en la palabra, siendo desobedientes; para lo cual fueron también ordenados.

verses.KJV: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light;
verses.WEB: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
verses.ASV: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for [God’s] own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós sois a geração escolhida, o sacerdócio real, a nação santa, o povo adquirido; a fim de que anuncieis as virtudes daquele que vos chamou das trevas para a sua maravilhosa luz.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros sois linaje escogido, real sacerdocio, gente santa, pueblo adquirido, para que anunciéis las virtudes de aquel que os ha llamado de las tinieblas á su luz admirable:

verses.KJV: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.WEB: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.ASV: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes, vós não éreis povo, mas agora sois povo de Deus. [Antes] , não havíeis recebido misericórdia, mas agora recebestes misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros, que en el tiempo pasado no erais pueblo, mas ahora sois pueblo de Dios; que en el tiempo pasado no habíais alcanzado misericordia, mas ahora habéis alcanzado misericordia.

verses.KJV: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.WEB: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
verses.ASV: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, como a peregrinos e estrangeiros, eu vos peço que vos abstenhais dos desejos carnais, que batalham contra a alma,
verses.RVR09: Amados, yo os ruego como á extranjeros y peregrinos, os abstengáis de los deseos carnales que batallan contra el alma,

verses.KJV: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.WEB: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.ASV: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: e que tenhais um bom comportamento vosso entre os pagãos; para que, naquilo que de vós, como de malfeitores, falam mal, no dia da visitação glorifiquem a Deus por causa das [vossas] boas obras que tiverem visto.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo vuestra conversación honesta entre los Gentiles; para que, en lo que ellos murmuran de vosotros como de malhechores, glorifiquen á Dios en el día de la visitación, estimándoos por las buenas obras.

verses.KJV: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
verses.WEB: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
verses.ASV: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto sujeitai-vos a toda autoridade humana, por causa do Senhor; seja ao rei, como superior;
verses.RVR09: Sed pues sujetos á toda ordenación humana por respeto á Dios: ya sea al rey, como á superior;

verses.KJV: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
verses.WEB: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
verses.ASV: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.
verses.ALMEIDA: seja aos governantes, como enviados por ele, com o objetivo de castigar os malfeitores, e de conceder honra aos que fazem o bem.
verses.RVR09: Ya á los gobernadores, como de él enviados para venganza de los malhechores, y para loor de los que hacen bien.

verses.KJV: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.WEB: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
verses.ASV: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esta é a vontade de Deus, que, ao fazerdes o bem, caleis a ignorância dos homens tolos.
verses.RVR09: Porque esta es la voluntad de Dios; que haciendo bien, hagáis callar la ignorancia de los hombres vanos:

verses.KJV: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
verses.WEB: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
verses.ASV: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Comportai-vos] como pessoas livres, mas não useis a liberdade como pretexto para a malícia. Em vez disso, [sede] como servos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Como libres, y no como teniendo la libertad por cobertura de malicia, sino como siervos de Dios.

verses.KJV: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
verses.WEB: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
verses.ASV: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Honrai a todos: amai aos irmãos, temei a Deus, honrai ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Honrad á todos. Amad la fraternidad. Temed á Dios. Honrad al rey.

verses.KJV: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.WEB: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
verses.ASV: Servants, [be] in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servos, sujeitai-vos com todo temor aos [vossos] senhores, não somente aos bons e brandos, mas também aos que maltratam.
verses.RVR09: Siervos, sed sujetos con todo temor á vuestros amos; no solamente á los buenos y humanos, sino también á los rigurosos.

verses.KJV: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
verses.WEB: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
verses.ASV: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois coisa agradável é se alguém, por causa da consciência a respeito de Deus, experimente dores, sofrendo injustamente.
verses.RVR09: Porque esto es agradable, si alguno á causa de la conciencia delante de Dios, sufre molestias padeciendo injustamente.

verses.KJV: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
verses.WEB: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
verses.ASV: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted [for it], ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer [for it], ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afinal, que mérito há em suportar serdes espancados por cometerdes pecado? Contudo, se, quando fazeis o bem, sois afligidos e suportais, isso é a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué gloria es, si pecando vosotros sois abofeteados, y lo sufrís? mas si haciendo bien sois afligidos, y lo sufrís, esto ciertamente es agradable delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
verses.WEB: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
verses.ASV: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois para isto fostes chamados, porque também Cristo sofreu por nós, deixando-nos exemplo, para que sigais os seus passos.
verses.RVR09: Porque para esto sois llamados; pues que también Cristo padeció por nosotros, dejándonos ejemplo, para que vosotros sigáis sus pisadas:

verses.KJV: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.WEB: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
verses.ASV: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não cometeu pecado, nem engano foi achado em sua boca.
verses.RVR09: El cual no hizo pecado; ni fué hallado engaño en su boca:

verses.KJV: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
verses.WEB: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
verses.ASV: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, threatened not; but committed [himself] to him that judgeth righteously:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o insultavam, ele não insultava de volta. Quando sofria, ele não ameaçava; em vez disso, entregava-se ao que julga de maneira justa.
verses.RVR09: Quien cuando le maldecían, no retornaba maldición; cuando padecía, no amenazaba, sino remitía la causa al que juzga justamente:

verses.KJV: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
verses.WEB: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
verses.ASV: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele levou nossos pecados em seu próprio corpo sobre o madeiro; para que nós, estando mortos para os pecados, vivamos para a justiça. Pela ferida dele fostes sarados.
verses.RVR09: El cual mismo llevó nuestros pecados en su cuerpo sobre el madero, para que nosotros siendo muertos á los pecados, vivamos á la justicia: por la herida del cual habéis sido sanados.

verses.KJV: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.WEB: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
verses.ASV: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós éreis como ovelhas desviadas do caminho; mas agora vós estais convertidos ao Pastor e Supervisor de vossas almas.
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros erais como ovejas descarriadas; mas ahora habéis vuelto al Pastor y Obispo de vuestras almas.

verses.KJV: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
verses.WEB: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
verses.ASV: In like manner, ye wives, [be] in subjection to your own husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantemente vós, esposas, estejais sujeitas aos próprios maridos, para que, ainda que alguns não obedeçam à Palavra, por meio do comportamento das esposas, sem palavra, sejam ganhos,
verses.RVR09: ASIMISMO vosotras, mujeres, sed sujetas á vuestros maridos; para que también los que no creen á la palabra, sean ganados sin palabra por la conversación de sus mujeres,

verses.KJV: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
verses.WEB: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
verses.ASV: beholding your chaste behavior [coupled] with fear.
verses.ALMEIDA: quando eles observarem o vosso comportamento puro e com temor.
verses.RVR09: Considerando vuestra casta conversación, que es en temor.

verses.KJV: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
verses.WEB: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
verses.ASV: Whose [adorning] let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;
verses.ALMEIDA: A vossa beleza não seja a exterior, [como] tranças de cabelos, joias de ouro, ou vestuário,
verses.RVR09: El adorno de las cuales no sea exterior con encrespamiento del cabello, y atavío de oro, ni en compostura de ropas;

verses.KJV: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.WEB: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
verses.ASV: but [let it be] the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible [apparel] of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas sim, a pessoa interior no coração, o [embelezamento] incorruptível de um espírito manso e tranquilo, que é precioso diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sino el hombre del corazón que está encubierto, en incorruptible ornato de espíritu agradable y pacífico, lo cual es de grande estima delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
verses.WEB: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
verses.ASV: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois assim também se embelezavam antigamente as mulheres santas, que esperavam em Deus, e eram sujeitas aos seus maridos.
verses.RVR09: Porque así también se ataviaban en el tiempo antiguo aquellas santas mujeres que esperaban en Dios, siendo sujetas á sus maridos:

verses.KJV: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
verses.WEB: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
verses.ASV: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dessa maneira Sara obedecia a Abraão, chamando-lhe de senhor. Vós sois filhas dela se fizerdes o bem e não temerdes espanto algum.
verses.RVR09: Como Sara obedecía á Abraham, llamándole señor; de la cual vosotras sois hechas hijas, haciendo bien, y no sois espantadas de ningún pavor.

verses.KJV: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.WEB: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
verses.ASV: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with [your wives] according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantemente vós maridos, convivei [com elas] com entendimento, dando honra à mulher, como a vaso mais fraco, como sendo [elas e vós] juntamente herdeiros da graça da vida; a fim de que as vossas orações não sejam impedidas.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros maridos, semejantemente, habitad con ellas según ciencia, dando honor á la mujer como á vaso más frágil, y como á herederas juntamente de la gracia de la vida; para que vuestras oraciones no sean impedidas.

verses.KJV: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
verses.WEB: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
verses.ASV: Finally, [be] ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:
verses.ALMEIDA: E por fim, sede todos de uma mesma mentalidade, compassivos, tenhais amor pelos irmãos, e sede misericordiosos e benevolentes.
verses.RVR09: Y finalmente, sed todos de un mismo corazón, compasivos, amándoos fraternalmente, misericordiosos, amigables;

verses.KJV: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.WEB: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
verses.ASV: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não retribuais o mal com mal, ou insulto com insulto; ao contrário, bendizei, sabendo que para isto fostes chamados, para que herdeis a bênção.
verses.RVR09: No volviendo mal por mal, ni maldición por maldición, sino antes por el contrario, bendiciendo; sabiendo que vosotros sois llamados para que poseáis bendición en herencia.

verses.KJV: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.WEB: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
verses.ASV: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois: quem quer amar a vida e ver dias bons, refreie sua língua do mal, e que seus lábios não falem engano.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que quiere amar la vida, y ver días buenos, refrene su lengua de mal, y sus labios no hablen engaño;

verses.KJV: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
verses.WEB: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
verses.ASV: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afaste-se do mal, e faça o bem; busque a paz, e siga-a.
verses.RVR09: Apártase del mal, y haga bien; busque la paz, y sígala.

verses.KJV: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
verses.WEB: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
verses.ASV: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os justos, e seus ouvidos [atentos] às suas orações; mas a face do Senhor é contra os que fazem o mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque los ojos del Señor están sobre los justos, y sus oídos atentos á sus oraciones: pero el rostro del Señor está sobre aquellos que hacen mal.

verses.KJV: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
verses.WEB: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
verses.ASV: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem vos fará mal se fordes adeptos do bem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién es aquel que os podrá dañar, si vosotros seguís el bien?

verses.KJV: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
verses.WEB: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
verses.ASV: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness’ sake, blessed [are ye]: and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, mesmo se sofrerdes por causa da justiça, benditos sois. Não tenhais medo deles, nem vos perturbeis.
verses.RVR09: Mas también si alguna cosa padecéis por hacer bien, sois bienaventurados. Por tanto, no temáis por el temor de ellos, ni seáis turbados;

verses.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.WEB: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
verses.ASV: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: [being] ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas santificai a Deus como Senhor em vossos corações; e estai sempre preparados para responder com mansidão e respeito a todo aquele que vos pedir a razão da esperança que há em vós,
verses.RVR09: Sino santificad al Señor Dios en vuestros corazones, y estad siempre aparejados para responder con mansedumbre y reverencia á cada uno que os demande razón de la esperanza que hay en vosotros:

verses.KJV: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
verses.WEB: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
verses.ASV: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: tendo uma boa consciência; para que, naquilo que falam mal de vós como malfeitores, os que insultam o vosso bom comportamento em Cristo sejam envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: Teniendo buena conciencia, para que en lo que murmuran de vosotros como de malhechores, sean confundidos los que blasfeman vuestra buena conversación en Cristo.

verses.KJV: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
verses.WEB: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
verses.ASV: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois é melhor que sofrais fazendo o bem, se [assim] a vontade de Deus quer, do que fazendo o mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor es que padezcáis haciendo bien, si la voluntad de Dios así lo quiere, que haciendo mal.

verses.KJV: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.WEB: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
verses.ASV: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também Cristo sofreu uma vez pelos pecados, o justo pelos injustos; para que nos levasse a Deus. [Ele estava] , de fato, morto na carne, mas vivificado pelo Espírito,
verses.RVR09: Porque también Cristo padeció una vez por los pecados, el justo por los injustos, para llevarnos á Dios, siendo á la verdad muerto en la carne, pero vivificado en espíritu;

verses.KJV: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.WEB: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
verses.ASV: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,
verses.ALMEIDA: no qual ele também foi pregar aos espíritos em prisão.
verses.RVR09: En el cual también fué y predicó á los espíritus encarcelados;

verses.KJV: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
verses.WEB: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
verses.ASV: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Estes são] os que antigamente foram rebeldes, quando uma vez a paciência de Deus aguardava nos dias de Noé, enquanto era preparada a arca. Nela, poucas almas (isto é, oito) foram salvas por meio da água.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales en otro tiempo fueron desobedientes, cuando una vez esperaba la paciencia de Dios en los días de Noé, cuando se aparejaba el arca; en la cual pocas, es á saber, ocho personas fueron salvas por agua.

verses.KJV: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.ASV: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, [even] baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é uma representação do batismo, que agora também nos salva, não como remoção da sujeira do corpo, mas sim como o pedido de boa consciência a Deus, por meio da ressurreição de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: A la figura de la cual el bautismo que ahora corresponde nos salva (no quitando las inmundicias de la carne, sino como demanda de una buena conciencia delante de Dios,) por la resurrección de Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.WEB: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
verses.ASV: who is on the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele está à direita de Deus, depois de haver subido ao céu; e os anjos, as autoridades, e os poderes estão sob o seu comando.
verses.RVR09: El cual está á la diestra de Dios, habiendo subido al cielo; estando á él sujetos los ángeles, y las potestades, y virtudes.

verses.KJV: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
verses.WEB: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.ASV: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que Cristo sofreu por nós na carne, armai-vos também com o mesmo modo de pensar, pois quem sofreu na carne terminou com o pecado;
verses.RVR09: PUES que Cristo ha padecido por nosotros en la carne, vosotros también estad armados del mismo pensamiento: que el que ha padecido en la carne, cesó de pecado;

verses.KJV: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
verses.WEB: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
verses.ASV: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que, no resto do tempo na carne, não viva mais segundo os maus desejos humanos, mas sim segundo a vontade de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Para que ya el tiempo que queda en carne, viva, no á las concupiscencias de los hombres, sino á la voluntad de Dios.

verses.KJV: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
verses.WEB: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
verses.ASV: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois já basta, no tempo passado da vida, termos feito a vontade dos pagãos, e andado em promiscuidades, desejos maliciosos, bebedeiras, orgias, festas de embriaguez, e abomináveis idolatrias.
verses.RVR09: Porque nos debe bastar que el tiempo pasado de nuestra vida hayamos hecho la voluntad de los Gentiles, cuando conversábamos en lascivias, en concupiscencias, en embriagueces, en glotonerías, en banquetes, y en abominables idolatrías.

verses.KJV: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
verses.WEB: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
verses.ASV: wherein they think it strange that ye run not with [them] into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of [you]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Como eles estranham vós não agirdes como eles, que correm em busca da extrema devassidão, por isso falam mal de vós.
verses.RVR09: En lo cual les parece cosa extraña que vosotros no corráis con ellos en el mismo desenfrenamiento de disolución, ultrajándoos:

verses.KJV: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
verses.WEB: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.ASV: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles terão de prestar contas ao que está pronto para julgar os vivos e os mortos.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales darán cuenta al que está aparejado para juzgar los vivos y los muertos.

verses.KJV: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.WEB: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
verses.ASV: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por isso o evangelho também foi pregado aos mortos, para que, mesmo que tenham sido julgados na carne segundo os critérios humanos, vivam em espírito segundo os critérios de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque por esto también ha sido predicado el evangelio á los muertos; para que sean juzgados en carne según los hombres, y vivan en espíritu según Dios.

verses.KJV: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
verses.WEB: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
verses.ASV: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:
verses.ALMEIDA: O fim de todas as coisas está próximo; portanto sede sóbrios, e vigiai em orações.
verses.RVR09: Mas el fin de todas las cosas se acerca: sed pues templados, y velad en oración.

verses.KJV: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
verses.WEB: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.ASV: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, acima de tudo, tende fervoroso amor uns para com os outros; porque o amor cobrirá uma multidão de pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre todo, tened entre vosotros ferviente caridad; porque la caridad cubrirá multitud de pecados.

verses.KJV: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
verses.WEB: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
verses.ASV: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:
verses.ALMEIDA: Proporcionai hospitalidade uns aos outros, sem murmurações.
verses.RVR09: Hospedaos los unos á los otros sin murmuraciones.

verses.KJV: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
verses.WEB: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
verses.ASV: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um sirva aos outros segundo o dom que recebeu, como bons administradores da variada graça de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno según el don que ha recibido, adminístrelo á los otros, como buenos dispensadores de las diferentes gracias de Dios.

verses.KJV: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: if any man speaketh, [speaking] as it were oracles of God; if any man ministereth, [ministering] as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém fala, que seja como as palavras de Deus; se alguém serve, [que sirva] segundo a força que Deus dá; a fim de que em tudo Deus seja glorificado por meio de Jesus Cristo. E a ele pertencem a glória e o poder para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Si alguno habla, hable conforme á las palabras de Dios; si alguno ministra, ministre conforme á la virtud que Dios suministra: para que en todas cosas sea Dios glorificado por Jesucristo, al cual es gloria é imperio para siempre jamás. Amén.

verses.KJV: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
verses.WEB: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
verses.ASV: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, não estranheis o fogo ardente que vem sobre vós para vos provar, como se algo estranho estivesse vos acontecendo.
verses.RVR09: Carísimos, no os maravilléis cuando sois examinados por fuego, lo cual se hace para vuestra prueba, como si alguna cosa peregrina os aconteciese;

verses.KJV: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
verses.WEB: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
verses.ASV: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, alegrai-vos em serdes participantes das aflições de Cristo; para que, também na revelação de sua glória vos alegreis com júbilo.
verses.RVR09: Antes bien gozaos en que sois participantes de las aflicciones de Cristo; para que también en la revelación de su gloria os gocéis en triunfo.

verses.KJV: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
verses.WEB: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
verses.ASV: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed [are ye]; because the [Spirit] of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vós sois insultados por causa do nome de Cristo, benditos sois; porque o Espírito da glória e de Deus repousa sobre vós; o qual por eles é insultado, mas por vós é glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Si sois vituperados en el nombre de Cristo, sois bienaventurados; porque la gloria y el Espíritu de Dios reposan sobre vosotros. Cierto, según ellos, él es blasfemado, mas según vosotros es glorificado.

verses.KJV: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
verses.WEB: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
verses.ASV: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men’s matters:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nenhum de vós sofra como homicida, ladrão, malfeitor, ou como alguém que se intromete em assuntos alheios;
verses.RVR09: Así que, ninguno de vosotros padezca como homicida, ó ladrón, ó malhechor, ó por meterse en negocios ajenos.

verses.KJV: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
verses.WEB: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
verses.ASV: but if [a man suffer] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se [sofre] como cristão, não se envergonhe; ao contrário, glorifique a Deus por isso;
verses.RVR09: Pero si alguno padece como Cristiano, no se avergüence; antes glorifique á Dios en esta parte.

verses.KJV: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
verses.WEB: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
verses.ASV: For the time [is come] for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if [it begin] first at us, what [shall be] the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois já é tempo do julgamento começar pela casa de Deus; e se é primeiro conosco, qual será o fim daqueles que são desobedientes ao Evangelho de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Porque es tiempo de que el juicio comience de la casa de Dios: y si primero comienza por nosotros, ¿qué será el fin de aquellos que no obedecen al evangelio de Dios?

verses.KJV: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
verses.WEB: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
verses.ASV: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o justo se salva com dificuldade, em que situação aparecerá o ímpio e pecador?
verses.RVR09: Y si el justo con dificultad se salva, ¿á dónde aparecerá el infiel y el pecador?

verses.KJV: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
verses.WEB: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
verses.ASV: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, os que sofrem segundo a vontade de Deus, confiem suas almas ao fiel Criador, fazendo o bem.
verses.RVR09: Y por eso los que son afligidos según la voluntad de Dios, encomiéndenle sus almas, como á fiel Criador, haciendo bien.

verses.KJV: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.WEB: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
verses.ASV: The elders therefore among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos anciãos da igreja que estão entre vós, eu, que sou ancião como eles, e testemunha dos sofrimentos de Cristo, e participante da glória que se revelará, seriamente peço:
verses.RVR09: RUEGO á los ancianos que están entre vosotros, yo anciano también con ellos, y testigo de las aflicciones de Cristo, que soy también participante de la gloria que ha de ser revelada:

verses.KJV: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verses.WEB: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
verses.ASV: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to [the will of] God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pastoreai o rebanho de Deus que está entre vós, não por obrigação, mas sim voluntariamente; não por ganância, mas sim com sincera prontidão;
verses.RVR09: Apacentad la grey de Dios que está entre vosotros, teniendo cuidado de ella, no por fuerza, sino voluntariamente; no por ganancia deshonesta, sino de un ánimo pronto;

verses.KJV: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being examples to the flock.
verses.WEB: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
verses.ASV: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem como que dominando os que estão aos vossos cuidados, mas sim como exemplos ao rebanho.
verses.RVR09: Y no como teniendo señorío sobre las heredades del Señor, sino siendo dechados de la grey.

verses.KJV: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.WEB: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
verses.ASV: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o Pastor Principal aparecer, vós recebereis a indestrutível coroa da glória.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando apareciere el Príncipe de los pastores, vosotros recibiréis la corona incorruptible de gloria.

verses.KJV: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
verses.WEB: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.ASV: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantemente vós, jovens, sede sujeitos aos anciãos; e todos vós sede sujeitos uns aos outros, revestidos de humildade; pois: Deus resiste aos soberbos, mas dá graça aos humildes.
verses.RVR09: Igualmente, mancebos, sed sujetos á los ancianos; y todos sumisos unos á otros, revestíos de humildad; porque Dios resiste á los soberbios, y da gracia á los humildes.

verses.KJV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
verses.WEB: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
verses.ASV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
verses.ALMEIDA: Humilhai-vos, pois, debaixo da poderosa mão de Deus, para que ele vos exalte no tempo adequado,
verses.RVR09: Humillaos pues bajo la poderosa mano de Dios, para que él os ensalce cuando fuere tiempo;

verses.KJV: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.WEB: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
verses.ASV: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: lançando sobre ele toda a vossa ansiedade; porque ele tem cuidado de vós.
verses.RVR09: Echando toda vuestra solicitud en él, porque él tiene cuidado de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.WEB: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
verses.ASV: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede sóbrios! Vigiai! Pois o vosso adversário, o diabo, anda ao redor, rugindo como um leão, buscando a quem possa devorar.
verses.RVR09: Sed templados, y velad; porque vuestro adversario el diablo, cual león rugiente, anda alrededor buscando á quien devore:

verses.KJV: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
verses.WEB: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
verses.ASV: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Resisti a ele, firmes na fé; sabendo que as mesmas aflições acontecem com os vossos irmãos no mundo.
verses.RVR09: Al cual resistid firmes en la fe, sabiendo que las mismas aflicciones han de ser cumplidas en la compañía de vuestros hermanos que están en el mundo.

verses.KJV: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verses.WEB: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
verses.ASV: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Deus de toda graça, que nos chamou para a sua eterna glória em Cristo Jesus, depois de sofrerdes um pouco, ele vos aperfeiçoe, confirme, fortifique, e estabeleça fundamento.
verses.RVR09: Mas el Dios de toda gracia, que nos ha llamado á su gloria eterna por Jesucristo, después que hubiereis un poco de tiempo padecido, él mismo os perfeccione, confirme, corrobore y establezca.

verses.KJV: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: To him [be] the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ele sejam a glória e o poder para todo o sempre. Amém!
verses.RVR09: A él sea gloria é imperio para siempre. Amén.

verses.KJV: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
verses.WEB: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
verses.ASV: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account [him], I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por Silvano, vosso fiel irmão, como o considero, eu vos escrevi brevemente, exortando e dando testemunho de que esta é a verdadeira graça de Deus, na qual estais.
verses.RVR09: Por Silvano, el hermano fiel, según yo pienso, os he escrito brevemente, amonestándoos, y testificando que ésta es la verdadera gracia de Dios, en la cual estáis.

verses.KJV: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
verses.WEB: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
verses.ASV: She that is in Babylon, elect together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Mark my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saúda-vos a [igreja] escolhida convosco, que está na Babilônia, e também o meu filho Marcos.
verses.RVR09: La iglesia que está en Babilonia, juntamente elegida con vosotros, os saluda, y Marcos mi hijo.

verses.KJV: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.WEB: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.ASV: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo de amor. A paz seja com todos vós que estais em Cristo Jesus. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Saludaos unos á otros con ósculo de caridad. Paz sea con todos vosotros los que estáis en Jesucristo. Amén.

verses.KJV: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.WEB: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
verses.ASV: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and [the] Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Simão Pedro, servo e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos que obtiveram conosco a igualmente preciosa fé pela justiça de nosso Deus e Salvador Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: SIMÓN Pedro, siervo y apóstol de Jesucristo, á los que habéis alcanzado fe igualmente preciosa con nosotros en la justicia de nuestro Dios y Salvador Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.WEB: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.ASV: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;
verses.ALMEIDA: Graça e paz vos seja multiplicada pelo conhecimento de Deus, e de Jesus nosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Gracia y paz os sea multiplicada en el conocimiento de Dios, y de nuestro Señor Jesús.

verses.KJV: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
verses.WEB: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
verses.ASV: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como seu divino poder ele tem nos dado tudo o que [pertence] à vida e à devoção divina, por meio do conhecimento daquele que nos chamou à glória e virtude;
verses.RVR09: Como todas las cosas que pertenecen á la vida y á la piedad nos sean dadas de su divina potencia, por el conocimiento de aquel que nos ha llamado por su gloria y virtud:

verses.KJV: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.WEB: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
verses.ASV: whereby he hath granted unto us his precious and exceeding great promises; that through these ye may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelas quais nos são dadas grandíssimas e preciosas promessas, para que por meio delas sejais participantes da natureza divina, tendo escapado da corrupção que há no mundo pelo mau desejo.
verses.RVR09: Por las cuales nos son dadas preciosas y grandísimas promesas, para que por ellas fueseis hechos participantes de la naturaleza divina, habiendo huído de la corrupción que está en el mundo por concupiscencia.

verses.KJV: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
