verses.WEB: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
verses.ASV: Yea, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply virtue; and in [your] virtue knowledge;
verses.ALMEIDA: E por isso mesmo, pondo todo o empenho, acrescentai a vossa fé virtude; e à virtude, conhecimento;
verses.RVR09: Vosotros también, poniendo toda diligencia por esto mismo, mostrad en vuestra fe virtud, y en la virtud ciencia;

verses.KJV: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.WEB: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
verses.ASV: and in [your] knowledge self-control; and in [your] self-control patience; and in [your] patience godliness;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao conhecimento, domínio próprio; e ao domínio próprio, paciência; e à paciência, devoção divina;
verses.RVR09: Y en la ciencia templanza, y en la templanza paciencia, y en la paciencia temor de Dios;

verses.KJV: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.WEB: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
verses.ASV: and in [your] godliness brotherly kindness; and in [your] brotherly kindness love.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à devoção divina, amor fraternal; e ao amor fraternal, amor.
verses.RVR09: Y en el temor de Dios, amor fraternal, y en el amor fraternal caridad.

verses.KJV: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful unto the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se em vós existirem e abundarem estas coisas, elas não vos deixarão ociosos nem estéreis no conhecimento de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque si en vosotros hay estas cosas, y abundan, no os dejarán estar ociosos, ni estériles en el conocimiento de nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.WEB: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
verses.ASV: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aquele em quem não há estas coisas é cego, nada vendo de longe, tendo se esquecido da purificação de seus antigos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que no tiene estas cosas, es ciego, y tiene la vista muy corta, habiendo olvidado la purificación de sus antiguos pecados.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
verses.WEB: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, brethren, give the more diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never stumble:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, irmãos, procurai ainda mais confirmar vosso chamamento e escolha [da parte de Deus] ; porque fazendo isso nunca tropeçareis.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, hermanos, procurad tanto más de hacer firme vuestra vocación y elección; porque haciendo estas cosas, no caeréis jamás.

verses.KJV: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: for thus shall be richly supplied unto you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim vos será abundantemente fornecida a entrada no reino eterno de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque de esta manera os será abundantemente administrada la entrada en el reino eterno de nuestro Señor y Salvador Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I shall be ready always to put you in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and are established in the truth which is with [you].
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu não deixarei de sempre vos relembrar destas coisas, ainda que [as] saibais, e estejais firmes na verdade presente.
verses.RVR09: Por esto, yo no dejaré de amonestaros siempre de estas cosas, aunque vosotros las sepáis, y estéis confirmados en la verdad presente.

verses.KJV: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.WEB: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
verses.ASV: And I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu considero justo, enquanto eu estiver neste tabernáculo, de vos despertar com relembranças;
verses.RVR09: Porque tengo por justo, en tanto que estoy en este tabernáculo, de incitaros con amonestación:

verses.KJV: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
verses.WEB: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
verses.ASV: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo que breve está a saída do meu meu tabernáculo, conforme também nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo tem revelado a mim.
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo que brevemente tengo de dejar mi tabernáculo, como nuestro Señor Jesucristo me ha declarado.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.WEB: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
verses.ASV: Yea, I will give diligence that at every time ye may be able after my decease to call these things to remembrance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas também procurarei que depois de minha partida vós sejais capazes de ter lembrança destas coisas.
verses.RVR09: También yo procuraré con diligencia, que después de mi fallecimiento, vosotros podáis siempre tener memoria de estas cosas.

verses.KJV: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.WEB: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.ASV: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós não vos anunciamos o poder e vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seguindo mitos criados pela inteligência humana, mas sim como testemunhas oculares de sua grandiosidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque no os hemos dado á conocer la potencia y la venida de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, siguiendo fábulas por arte compuestas; sino como habiendo con nuestros propios ojos visto su majestad.

verses.KJV: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.WEB: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
verses.ASV: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque de Deus Pai ele recebeu honra e glória, tendo sido lhe enviada tal voz de magnífica glória: Este é meu amado Filho, em quem me agrado.
verses.RVR09: Porque él había recibido de Dios Padre honra y gloria, cuando una tal voz fué á él enviada de la magnífica gloria: Este es el amado Hijo mío, en el cual yo me he agradado.

verses.KJV: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.WEB: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
verses.ASV: and this voice we [ourselves] heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós ouvimos esta voz enviada do Céu, estando nós com ele no santo monte.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros oímos esta voz enviada del cielo, cuando estábamos juntamente con él en el monte santo.

verses.KJV: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.WEB: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
verses.ASV: And we have the word of prophecy [made] more sure; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts:
verses.ALMEIDA: E temos a muito confiável palavra dos profetas; a qual vós fazeis bem ao prestardes atenção, como a uma luz que ilumina em lugar escuro, até que o dia clareie e a estrela da manhã se levante em vossos corações.
verses.RVR09: Tenemos también la palabra profética más permanente, á la cual hacéis bien de estar atentos como á una antorcha que alumbra en lugar oscuro hasta que el día esclarezca, y el lucero de la mañana salga en vuestros corazones:

verses.KJV: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.WEB: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
verses.ASV: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo primeiramente isto: que nenhuma profecia da Escritura é de interpretação particular.
verses.RVR09: Entendiendo primero esto, que ninguna profecía de la Escritura es de particular interpretación;

verses.KJV: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
verses.WEB: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spake from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a profecia jamais foi produzida pela vontade humana, mas os santos homens de Deus falaram conduzidos pelo Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Porque la profecía no fué en los tiempos pasados traída por voluntad humana, sino los santos hombres de Dios hablaron siendo inspirados del Espíritu Santo.

verses.KJV: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.WEB: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
verses.ASV: But there arose false prophets also among the people, as among you also there shall be false teachers, who shall privily bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também houve falsos profetas entre o povo, assim como também haverá falsos instrutores entre vós, que disfarçadamente introduzirão heresias de perdição, e negarão ao Senhor que os comprou, trazendo sobre eles mesmos repentina destruição.
verses.RVR09: PERO hubo también falsos profetas en el pueblo, como habrá entre vosotros falsos doctores, que introducirán encubiertamente herejías de perdición, y negarán al Señor que los rescató, atrayendo sobre sí mismos perdición acelerada.

verses.KJV: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.WEB: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
verses.ASV: And many shall follow their lascivious doings; by reason of whom the way of the truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos seguirão suas perdições, e por meio deles o caminho da verdade será insultado.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos seguirán sus disoluciones, por los cuales el camino de la verdad será blasfemado;

verses.KJV: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.WEB: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
verses.ASV: And in covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose sentence now from of old lingereth not, and their destruction slumbereth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por ganância, eles vos farão de mercadoria com palavras falsamente inventadas; sobre os quais desde muito tempo não está a condenação sem efeito, e sua perdição não cochila.
verses.RVR09: Y por avaricia harán mercadería de vosotros con palabras fingidas; sobre los cuales la condenación ya de largo tiempo no se tarda, y su perdición no se duerme.

verses.KJV: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.WEB: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
verses.ASV: For if God spared not angels when they sinned, but cast them down to hell, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se Deus não perdoou aos anjos que pecaram, em vez disso lançando-os no inferno, entregou-os às cadeias da escuridão, tendo sido reservados para o julgamento;
verses.RVR09: Porque si Dios no perdonó á los ángeles que habían pecado, sino que habiéndolos despeñado en el infierno con cadenas de oscuridad, los entregó para ser reservados al juicio;

verses.KJV: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.WEB: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
verses.ASV: and spared not the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem perdoou ao mundo antigo, mas guardou a Noé, anunciador da justiça, com outros sete, trazendo o dilúvio sobre o mundo dos ímpios;
verses.RVR09: Y si no perdonó al mundo viejo, mas guardó á Noé, pregonero de justicia, con otras siete personas, trayendo el diluvio sobre el mundo de malvados;

verses.KJV: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.WEB: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
verses.ASV: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, having made them an example unto those that should live ungodly;
verses.ALMEIDA: E condenou as cidades de Sodoma e Gomorra à destruição, reduzindo-as a cinza, e pondo-as como exemplo para os que vivessem impiamente;
verses.RVR09: Y si condenó por destrucción las ciudades de Sodoma y de Gomorra, tornándolas en ceniza, y poniéndolas por ejemplo á los que habían de vivir sin temor y reverencia de Dios;

verses.KJV: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.WEB: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
verses.ASV: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked
verses.ALMEIDA: E livrou ao justo Ló, [que estava] cansado do corrupto modo de viver dos maus.
verses.RVR09: Y libró al justo Lot, acosado por la nefanda conducta de los malvados;

verses.KJV: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.WEB: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
verses.ASV: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] lawless deeds):
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque, [enquanto] aquele justo habitava entre eles, todo dia ele atormentava sua justa alma, ao ver e ouvir as [suas] injustas obras).
verses.RVR09: (Porque este justo, con ver y oir, morando entre ellos, afligía cada día su alma justa con los hechos de aquellos injustos;)

verses.KJV: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.WEB: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
verses.ASV: the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment unto the day of judgment;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim] o Senhor sabe livrar os devotos das tentações, e reservar aos injustos para o dia do julgamento, para serem punidos.
verses.RVR09: Sabe el Señor librar de tentación á los píos, y reservar á los injustos para ser atormentados en el día del juicio;

verses.KJV: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
verses.WEB: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
verses.ASV: but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise dominion. Daring, self-willed, they tremble not to rail at dignities:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém principalmente aos que segundo a carne andam em mau desejo de impureza, e desprezam as autoridades; atrevidos, agradando a si mesmos, não tendo medo de insultar as [coisas dignas de] glórias.
verses.RVR09: Y principalmente á aquellos que, siguiendo la carne, andan en concupiscencia é inmundicia, y desprecian la potestad; atrevidos, contumaces, que no temen decir mal de las potestades superiores:

verses.KJV: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.WEB: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.ASV: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que [até] os anjos, sendo maiores em força e poder, não trazem juízo insultuoso contra elas diante do Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Como quiera que los mismos ángeles, que son mayores en fuerza y en potencia, no pronuncian juicio de maldición contra ellas delante del Señor.

verses.KJV: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.WEB: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
verses.ASV: But these, as creatures without reason, born mere animals to be taken and destroyed, railing in matters whereof they are ignorant, shall in their destroying surely be destroyed,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas estes, como animais irracionais, que seguem a natureza, gerados para a prisão e destruição, insultando aquilo que não entendem, perecerão na sua própria corrupção;
verses.RVR09: Mas éstos, diciendo mal de las cosas que no entienden, como bestias brutas, que naturalmente son hechas para presa y destrucción, perecerán en su perdición,

verses.KJV: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.WEB: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
verses.ASV: suffering wrong as the hire of wrong-doing; [men] that count it pleasure to revel in the day-time, spots and blemishes, revelling in their deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.ALMEIDA: recebendo o pagamento da injustiça, tendo como prazer seus maus desejos durante o dia, sendo manchas e defeitos, tendo prazer em seus enganos, participando do banquete convosco;
verses.RVR09: Recibiendo el galardón de su injusticia, ya que reputan por delicia poder gozar de deleites cada día. Estos son suciedades y manchas, los cuales comiendo con vosotros, juntamente se recrean en sus errores;

verses.KJV: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
verses.WEB: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
verses.ASV: having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; enticing unstedfast souls; having a heart exercised in covetousness; children of cursing;
verses.ALMEIDA: tendo os olhos cheios de adultério, e nunca parando de pecar; iludindo as almas inconstantes, tendo o coração exercitado na ganância, filhos da maldição;
verses.RVR09: Teniendo los ojos llenos de adulterio, y no saben cesar de pecar; cebando las almas inconstantes; teniendo el corazón ejercitado en codicias, siendo hijos de maldición;

verses.KJV: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.WEB: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
verses.ASV: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the [son] of Beor, who loved the hire of wrong-doing;
verses.ALMEIDA: os quais, havendo deixado o caminho direito, desviaram-se, seguindo o caminho de Balaão, [filho] de Bosor, que amou o pagamento da injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Que han dejado el camino derecho, y se han extraviado, siguiendo el camino de Balaam, hijo de Bosor, el cual amó el premio de la maldad.

verses.KJV: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.WEB: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
verses.ASV: but he was rebuked for his own transgression: a dumb ass spake with man’s voice and stayed the madness of the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele teve a repreensão de sua transgressão; o mudo animal de jugo, falando em voz humana, impediu a loucura do profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y fué reprendido por su iniquidad: una muda bestia de carga, hablando en voz de hombre, refrenó la locura del profeta.

verses.KJV: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.WEB: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.ASV: These are springs without water, and mists driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são fontes sem água, nuvens levadas pela tempestade; para os quais a escuridão das trevas está reservada para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Estos son fuentes sin agua, y nubes traídas de torbellino de viento: para los cuales está guardada la oscuridad de las tinieblas para siempre.

verses.KJV: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
verses.WEB: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
verses.ASV: For, uttering great swelling [words] of vanity, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by lasciviousness, those who are just escaping from them that live in error;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ao falarem coisas muito arrogantes de vaidade, iludem com os maus desejos da carne, [e] com perversões, aqueles que já tinham realmente escapado dos que andam no erro.
verses.RVR09: Porque hablando arrogantes palabras de vanidad, ceban con las concupiscencias de la carne en disoluciones á los que verdaderamente habían huído de los que conversan en error;

verses.KJV: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.WEB: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
verses.ASV: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he also brought into bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prometendo-lhes liberdade, [mas] sendo eles mesmos servos da corrupção; porque aquele de quem alguém é vencido, do tal também se faz servo.
verses.RVR09: Prometiéndoles libertad, siendo ellos mismos siervos de corrupción. Porque el que es de alguno vencido, es sujeto á la servidumbre del que lo venció.

verses.KJV: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.WEB: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
verses.ASV: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein and overcome, the last state is become worse with them than the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se, por causa do conhecimento do Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo, tiverem escapado das imundícies do mundo, e novamente se envolverem nelas, e forem vencidos, o fim será pior que o começo.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente, si habiéndose ellos apartado de las contaminaciones del mundo, por el conocimiento del Señor y Salvador Jesucristo, y otra vez envolviéndose en ellas, son vencidos, sus postrimerías les son hechas peores que los principios.

verses.KJV: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.WEB: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
verses.ASV: For it were better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque melhor teria lhes sido se não tivessem conhecido o caminho da justiça do que, depois de conhecerem, terem se desviado do santo mandamento que havia lhes sido entregue.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor les hubiera sido no haber conocido el camino de la justicia, que después de haberlo conocido, tornarse atrás del santo mandamiento que les fué dado.

verses.KJV: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.WEB: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
verses.ASV: It has happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog turning to his own vomit again, and the sow that had washed to wallowing in the mire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto lhes sobreveio [conforme] um verdadeiro provérbio, [que diz] : O cão voltou ao seu próprio vômito; e a porca lavada [voltou] ao chiqueiro da lama.
verses.RVR09: Pero les ha acontecido lo del verdadero proverbio: El perro se volvió á su vómito, y la puerca lavada á revolcarse en el cieno.

verses.KJV: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.WEB: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
verses.ASV: This is now, beloved, the second epistle that I write unto you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by putting you in remembrance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, eu já vos escrevo esta segunda carta, em [ambas] as quais eu desperto vosso sincero entendimento por meio da relembrança;
verses.RVR09: CARÍSIMOS, yo os escribo ahora esta segunda carta, por las cuales ambas despierto con exhortación vuestro limpio entendimiento;

verses.KJV: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.WEB: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
verses.ASV: that ye should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Saviour through your apostles:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que vos lembreis das palavras que anteriormente foram ditas pelos santos profetas, e do nosso mandamento, dos apóstolos do Senhor e Salvador.
verses.RVR09: Para que tengáis memoria de las palabras que antes han sido dichas por los santos profetas, y de nuestro mandamiento, que somos apóstoles del Señor y Salvador:

verses.KJV: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.WEB: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
verses.ASV: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers shall come with mockery, walking after their own lusts,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabendo primeiro isto: que nos últimos dias virão escarnecedores, andando segundo seus próprios maus desejos,
verses.RVR09: Sabiendo primero esto, que en los postrimeros días vendrán burladores, andando según sus propias concupiscencias,

verses.KJV: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.WEB: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
verses.ASV: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizendo: Onde está a promessa da vinda dele? Pois desde que os pais dormiram, todas as coisas continuam como desde o princípio da criação.
verses.RVR09: Y diciendo: ¿Dónde está la promesa de su advenimiento? porque desde el día en que los padres durmieron, todas las cosas permanecen así como desde el principio de la creación.

verses.KJV: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.WEB: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
verses.ASV: For this they wilfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth compacted out of water and amidst water, by the word of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles ignoram isto por sua própria vontade, que pela palavra de Deus desde os [tempos] antigos [é que] foram os céus, e [que] a terra [saiu] da água, e sobre a água continua.
verses.RVR09: Cierto ellos ignoran voluntariamente, que los cielos fueron en el tiempo antiguo, y la tierra que por agua y en agua está asentada, por la palabra de Dios;

verses.KJV: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.WEB: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
verses.ASV: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelas quais o mundo anterior foi destruído, coberto com as águas do dilúvio.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual el mundo de entonces pereció anegado en agua:

verses.KJV: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.WEB: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
verses.ASV: but the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os céus e a terra de agora, pela mesma palavra estão reservados, e são guardados para o fogo até o dia do juízo, e da perdição das pessoas ímpias.
verses.RVR09: Mas los cielos que son ahora, y la tierra, son conservados por la misma palabra, guardados para el fuego en el día del juicio, y de la perdición de los hombres impíos.

verses.KJV: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.WEB: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.ASV: But forget not this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas amados, desta uma coisa não ignoreis: que um dia para o Senhor [é] como mil anos, e mil anos como um dia.
verses.RVR09: Mas, oh amados, no ignoréis esta una cosa: que un día delante del Señor es como mil años y mil años como un día.

verses.KJV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.WEB: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.ASV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor não é tardio [em sua] promessa (como alguns [a] consideram tardia); mas ele é paciente para conosco, não querendo que alguns pereçam, mas sim que todos venham ao arrependimento.
verses.RVR09: El Señor no tarda su promesa, como algunos la tienen por tardanza; sino que es paciente para con nosotros, no queriendo que ninguno perezca, sino que todos procedan al arrepentimiento.

verses.KJV: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.WEB: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
verses.ASV: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o dia do Senhor virá como um ladrão durante a noite, no qual os céus se desfarão com grande estrondo, e os elementos queimando se dissolverão, e a terra e as obras que nela [há] serão queimadas.
verses.RVR09: Mas el día del Señor vendrá como ladrón en la noche; en el cual los cielos pasarán con grande estruendo, y los elementos ardiendo serán deshechos, y la tierra y las obras que en ella están serán quemadas.

verses.KJV: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.WEB: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
verses.ASV: Seeing that these things are thus all to be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in [all] holy living and godliness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto, pois, que todas estas coisas estão para serem desfeitas, de que maneira vós deveis ser em santo comportamento e piedade,
verses.RVR09: Pues como todas estas cosas han de ser deshechas, ¿qué tales conviene que vosotros seáis en santas y pías conversaciones,

verses.KJV: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.WEB: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
verses.ASV: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, by reason of which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.ALMEIDA: esperando, e tendo pressa para a vinda do dia de Deus, pelo qual os céus, incendiados, se desfarão, e os elementos, inflamados, se derreterão.
verses.RVR09: Esperando y apresurándoos para la venida del día de Dios, en el cual los cielos siendo encendidos serán deshechos, y los elementos siendo abrasados, se fundirán?

verses.KJV: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.WEB: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
verses.ASV: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, segundo a sua promessa, aguardamos novos céus e nova terra, em que a justiça habita.
verses.RVR09: Bien que esperamos cielos nuevos y tierra nueva, según sus promesas, en los cuales mora la justicia.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.WEB: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for these things, give diligence that ye may be found in peace, without spot and blameless in his sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, amados, aguardando essas coisas, procurai que por ele sejais achados incontaminados e irrepreensíveis em paz;
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual, oh amados, estando en esperanza de estas cosas, procurad con diligencia que seáis hallados de él sin mácula, y sin reprensión, en paz.

verses.KJV: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
verses.WEB: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
verses.ASV: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote unto you;
verses.ALMEIDA: E considerai como salvação a paciência de nosso Senhor; assim como também nosso irmão Paulo vos escreveu, segundo a sabedoria que lhe foi dada;
verses.RVR09: Y tened por salud la paciencia de nuestro Señor; como también nuestro amado hermano Pablo, según la sabiduría que le ha sido dada, os ha escrito también;

verses.KJV: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.WEB: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
verses.ASV: as also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; wherein are some things hard to be understood, which the ignorant and unstedfast wrest, as [they do] also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também em duas as [suas] cartas, ele fala nelas destas coisas; entre as quais há algumas coisas difíceis de entender, as quais os ignorantes e os inconstantes distorcem, assim como também as outras Escrituras, para a própria perdição deles.
verses.RVR09: Casi en todas sus epístolas, hablando en ellas de estas cosas; entre las cuales hay algunas difíciles de entender, las cuales los indoctos é inconstantes tuercen, como también las otras Escrituras, para perdición de sí mismos.

verses.KJV: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.WEB: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
verses.ASV: Ye therefore, beloved, knowing [these things] beforehand, beware lest, being carried away with the error of the wicked, ye fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto vós, amados, sabendo [disto] com antecedência, guardai-vos para que, pelo engano dos maus, não sejais juntamente arrebatados, e caiais de vossa firmeza.
verses.RVR09: Así que vosotros, oh amados, pues estáis amonestados, guardaos que por el error de los abominables no seáis juntamente extraviados, y caigáis de vuestra firmeza.

verses.KJV: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
verses.ASV: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] the glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas crescei em graça e conhecimento de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo. A ele seja a glória, tanto agora como no dia da eternidade, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Mas creced en la gracia y conocimiento de nuestro Señor y Salvador Jesucristo. A él sea gloria ahora y hasta el día de la eternidad. Amén.

verses.KJV: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.WEB: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
verses.ASV: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life
verses.ALMEIDA: O que era desde o princípio, o que ouvimos, o que vimos com os nossos olhos, o que temos contemplado, e nossas mãos tocaram, quanto à Palavra da vida,
verses.RVR09: LO que era desde el principio, lo que hemos oído, lo que hemos visto con nuestros ojos, lo que hemos mirado, y palparon nuestras manos tocante al Verbo de vida;

verses.KJV: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.WEB: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
verses.ASV: (and the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare unto you the life, the eternal [life], which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us);
verses.ALMEIDA: (pois a vida já foi manifesta, e nós a vimos, demos testemunho, e vos anunciamos a vida eterna, que estava com o Pai, e a nós foi manifesta)
verses.RVR09: (Porque la vida fué manifestada, y vimos, y testificamos, y os anunciamos aquella vida eterna, la cual estaba con el Padre, y nos ha aparecido;)

verses.KJV: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you also, that ye also may have fellowship with us: yea, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: o que vimos e ouvimos, isso vos anunciamos, para que também vós tenhais comunhão conosco. E a nossa comunhão [é] com o Pai, e com o seu Filho Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Lo que hemos visto y oído, eso os anunciamos, para que también vosotros tengáis comunión con nosotros: y nuestra comunión verdaderamente es con el Padre, y con su Hijo Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.WEB: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
verses.ASV: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas vos escrevemos para que a vossa alegria seja completa.
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas os escribimos, para que vuestro gozo sea cumplido.

verses.KJV: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.WEB: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.ASV: And this is the message which we have heard from him and announce unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a mensagem que dele ouvimos, e vos anunciamos: que Deus é luz, e não há nele nada de trevas.
verses.RVR09: Y este es el mensaje que oímos de él, y os anunciamos: Que Dios es luz, y en él no hay ningunas tinieblas.

verses.KJV: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.WEB: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
verses.ASV: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se dissermos que temos comunhão com ele, e andarmos em trevas, mentimos, e não praticamos a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Si nosotros dijéremos que tenemos comunión con él, y andamos en tinieblas, mentimos, y no hacemos la verdad;

verses.KJV: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.WEB: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.ASV: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se andamos na luz, como ele está na luz, temos comunhão uns com os outros, e o sangue de Jesus Cristo, seu Filho, nos purifica de todo pecado.
verses.RVR09: Mas si andamos en luz, como él está en luz, tenemos comunión entre nosotros, y la sangre de Jesucristo su Hijo nos limpia de todo pecado.

verses.KJV: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.WEB: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.ASV: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se dissermos que não temos pecado, enganamos a nós mesmos, e a verdade não está em nós.
verses.RVR09: Si dijéremos que no tenemos pecado, nos engañamos á nosotros mismos, y no hay verdad en nosotros.

verses.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.WEB: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.ASV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se confessarmos nossos pecados, ele é fiel e justo para nos perdoar os pecados e nos purificar de toda injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Si confesamos nuestros pecados, él es fiel y justo para que nos perdone nuestros pecados, y nos limpie de toda maldad.

verses.KJV: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.WEB: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.ASV: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se dissermos que não pecamos, nós o fazemos de mentiroso, e a palavra dele não está em nós.
verses.RVR09: Si dijéremos que no hemos pecado, lo hacemos á él mentiroso, y su palabra no está en nosotros.

verses.KJV: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.WEB: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
verses.ASV: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus filhinhos, vos escrevo estas coisas para que não pequeis; mas se alguém pecar, temos um advogado com o Pai: Jesus Cristo, o justo.
verses.RVR09: HIJITOS míos, estas cosas os escribo, para que no pequéis; y si alguno hubiere pecado, abogado tenemos para con el Padre, á Jesucristo el justo;

verses.KJV: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.WEB: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
verses.ASV: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele é o sacrifício para perdão dos nossos pecados; e não somente dos nossos, mas também dos de todo o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y él es la propiciación por nuestros pecados: y no solamente por los nuestros, sino también por los de todo el mundo.

verses.KJV: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.WEB: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
verses.ASV: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nisto sabemos que o conhecemos, se guardamos os seus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y en esto sabemos que nosotros le hemos conocido, si guardamos sus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.WEB: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
verses.ASV: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que diz: “Eu o conheço”, mas não guarda os seus mandamentos, é mentiroso, e nele não está a verdade.
verses.RVR09: El que dice, Yo le he conocido, y no guarda sus mandamientos, el tal es mentiroso, y no hay verdad en él;

verses.KJV: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.WEB: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
verses.ASV: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quem guarda a sua palavra, nele verdadeiramente o amor de Deus tem se aperfeiçoado; nisso sabemos que estamos nele.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que guarda su palabra, la caridad de Dios está verdaderamente perfecta en él: por esto sabemos que estamos en él.

verses.KJV: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.WEB: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
verses.ASV: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que diz que está nele também deve andar como ele andou.
verses.RVR09: El que dice que está en él, debe andar como él anduvo.

verses.KJV: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.WEB: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
verses.ASV: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmãos, não vos escrevo um mandamento novo, mas sim o mandamento antigo, que tivestes desde o princípio. Este mandamento antigo é a palavra que ouvistes desde o princípio.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos, no os escribo mandamiento nuevo, sino el mandamiento antiguo que habéis tenido desde el principio: el mandamiento antiguo es la palabra que habéis oído desde el principio.

verses.KJV: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.WEB: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
verses.ASV: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas também vos escrevo um mandamento novo, que é verdadeiro nele e em vós; pois as trevas passaram, e a verdadeira luz já ilumina.
verses.RVR09: Otra vez os escribo un mandamiento nuevo, que es verdadero en él y en vosotros; porque las tinieblas son pasadas, y la verdadera luz ya alumbra.

verses.KJV: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.WEB: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
verses.ASV: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que diz que está na luz, e odeia seu irmão, até agora está nas trevas.
verses.RVR09: El que dice que está en luz, y aborrece á su hermano, el tal aun está en tinieblas todavía.

verses.KJV: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.WEB: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
verses.ASV: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que ama o seu irmão está na luz, e nele não há motivo algum de tropeço.
verses.RVR09: El que ama á su hermano, está en luz, y no hay tropiezo en él.

verses.KJV: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.WEB: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.ASV: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que odeia seu irmão está nas trevas, anda nas trevas, e não sabe para onde vai, pois as trevas lhe cegaram os olhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que aborrece á su hermano, está en tinieblas, y anda en tinieblas, y no sabe á donde va; porque las tinieblas le han cegado los ojos.

verses.KJV: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
verses.WEB: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.ASV: I write unto you, [my] little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos escrevo, filhinhos, porque pelo nome dele os vossos pecados são perdoados.
verses.RVR09: Os escribo á vosotros, hijitos, porque vuestros pecados os son perdonados por su nombre.

verses.KJV: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.WEB: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
verses.ASV: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos escrevo, pais, porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Eu vos escrevo, jovens, porque vencestes o maligno. Eu vos escrevo, filhinhos, porque conheceis o Pai.
verses.RVR09: Os escribo á vosotros, padres, porque habéis conocido á aquel que es desde el principio. Os escribo á vosotros, mancebos, porque habéis vencido al maligno. Os escribo á vosotros, hijitos, porque habéis conocido al Padre.

verses.KJV: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.WEB: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.ASV: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos escrevi, pais, porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Eu vos escrevi, jovens, porque sois fortes, a palavra de Deus está em vós, e vencestes o maligno.
verses.RVR09: Os he escrito á vosotros, padres, porque habéis conocido al que es desde el principio. Os he escrito á vosotros, mancebos, porque sois fuertes, y la palabra de Dios mora en vosotros, y habéis vencido al maligno.

verses.KJV: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.WEB: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
verses.ASV: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não ameis o mundo, nem as coisas que há no mundo. Se alguém ama o mundo, o amor do Pai não está nele.
verses.RVR09: No améis al mundo, ni las cosas que están en el mundo. Si alguno ama al mundo, el amor del Padre no está en él.

verses.KJV: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.WEB: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
verses.ASV: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vainglory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tudo o que há no mundo, a cobiça da carne, a cobiça dos olhos, e a ostentação da vida, não é do Pai, mas do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo lo que hay en el mundo, la concupiscencia de la carne, y la concupiscencia de los ojos, y la soberbia de la vida, no es del Padre, mas es del mundo.

verses.KJV: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.WEB: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
verses.ASV: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mundo passa, e também a sua cobiça; mas aquele que faz a vontade de Deus permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y el mundo se pasa, y su concupiscencia; mas el que hace la voluntad de Dios, permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.WEB: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
verses.ASV: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhinhos, é a última hora. E como ouvistes que o anticristo vem, já agora muitos anticristos chegaram. Por isso sabemos que é a última hora.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos, ya es el último tiempo: y como vosotros habéis oído que el anticristo ha de venir, así también al presente han comenzado á ser muchos anticristos; por lo cual sabemos que es el último tiempo.

verses.KJV: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.WEB: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
verses.ASV: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but [they went out], that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles saíram de nós, mas não eram dos nossos, pois se fossem dos nossos, continuariam conosco; mas [o que aconteceu] foi para tornar claro que todos eles não eram dos nossos.
verses.RVR09: Salieron de nosotros, mas no eran de nosotros; porque si fueran de nosotros, hubieran cierto permanecido con nosotros; pero salieron para que se manifestase que todos no son de nosotros.

verses.KJV: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.WEB: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
verses.ASV: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, porém, tendes a unção do Santo, e conheceis todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros tenéis la unción del Santo, y conocéis todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.WEB: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.ASV: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos escrevi, não porque não conheceis a verdade, mas sim, porque a conheceis, e porque nenhuma mentira vem da verdade.
verses.RVR09: No os he escrito como si ignoraseis la verdad, sino como á los que la conocéis, y que ninguna mentira es de la verdad.

verses.KJV: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.WEB: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.ASV: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, [even] he that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o mentiroso, senão aquele que nega que Jesus é o Cristo? Esse é o anticristo, que nega o Pai e o Filho.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es mentiroso, sino el que niega que Jesús es el Cristo? Este tal es anticristo, que niega al Padre y al Hijo.

verses.KJV: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.WEB: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
verses.ASV: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem nega o Filho também não tem o Pai; aquele que confessa o filho também tem o Pai.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que niega al Hijo, este tal tampoco tiene al Padre. Cualquiera que confiese al Hijo tiene también al Padre.

verses.KJV: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.WEB: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.ASV: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto o que ouvistes desde o princípio permaneça em vós. Se o que ouvistes desde o princípio permanecer em vós, também permanecereis no Filho e no Pai.
verses.RVR09: Pues lo que habéis oído desde el principio, sea permaneciente en vosotros. Si lo que habéis oído desde el principio fuere permaneciente en vosotros, también vosotros permaneceréis en el Hijo y en el Padre.

verses.KJV: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
verses.WEB: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
verses.ASV: And this is the promise which he promised us, [even] the life eternal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a promessa que ele nos prometeu: a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la promesa, la cual él nos prometió, la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.WEB: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
verses.ASV: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas vos escrevi acerca dos que vos tentam vos enganar.
verses.RVR09: Os he escrito esto sobre los que os engañan.

verses.KJV: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
verses.WEB: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
verses.ASV: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a unção que recebeste dele continua em vós, e não tendes necessidade de que alguém vos ensine; mas, como a mesma unção vos ensina tudo, e é verdadeira, e não mentira, e como ela vos ensinou, [assim] nele permanecereis.
verses.RVR09: Pero la unción que vosotros habéis recibido de él, mora en vosotros, y no tenéis necesidad que ninguno os enseñe; mas como la unción misma os enseña de todas cosas, y es verdadera, y no es mentira, así como os ha enseñado, perseveraréis en él.

verses.KJV: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.WEB: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.ASV: And now, [my] little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, filhinhos, permanecei nele; a fim de que, quando ele se manifestar, tenhamos confiança, e não sejamos envergonhados diante dele na sua vinda.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, hijitos, perseverad en él; para que cuando apareciere, tengamos confianza, y no seamos confundidos de él en su venida.

verses.KJV: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
verses.WEB: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
verses.ASV: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sabeis que ele é justo, sabeis que todo aquele que pratica a justiça é nascido dele.
verses.RVR09: Si sabéis que él es justo, sabed también que cualquiera que hace justicia, es nacido de él.

verses.KJV: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.WEB: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
verses.ASV: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and [such] we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede quão grande amor o Pai tem nos dado, que fôssemos chamados filhos de Deus. Por isso o mundo não nos conhece, pois não conhece a ele.
verses.RVR09: MIRAD cuál amor nos ha dado el Padre, que seamos llamados hijos de Dios: por esto el mundo no nos conoce, porque no le conoce á él.

verses.KJV: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.WEB: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
verses.ASV: Beloved, now are we children of God, and it is not yet made manifest what we shall be. We know that, if he shall be manifested, we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, agora somos filhos de Deus, e ainda não está manifesto o que seremos. Porém sabemos que, quando ele se manifestar, seremos semelhantes a ele, pois o veremos como ele é.
verses.RVR09: Muy amados, ahora somos hijos de Dios, y aun no se ha manifestado lo que hemos de ser; pero sabemos que cuando él apareciere, seremos semejantes á él, porque le veremos como él es.

verses.KJV: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.WEB: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
verses.ASV: And every one that hath this hope [set] on him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo aquele que tem nele essa esperança purifica a si mesmo, como também ele é puro.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que tiene esta esperanza en él, se purifica, como él también es limpio.

verses.KJV: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.WEB: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
verses.ASV: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que pratica o pecado também pratica injustiça, pois o pecado é injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que hace pecado, traspasa también la ley; pues el pecado es transgresión de la ley.

verses.KJV: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.WEB: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
verses.ASV: And ye know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabeis que ele apareceu para tirar os nossos pecados; e nele não há pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y sabéis que él apareció para quitar nuestros pecados, y no hay pecado en él.

verses.KJV: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.WEB: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
verses.ASV: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither knoweth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que nele permanece não pratica o pecado; todo aquele que costuma pecar não o viu nem o conheceu.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que permanece en él, no peca; cualquiera que peca, no le ha visto, ni le ha conocido.

verses.KJV: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.WEB: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.ASV: [My] little children, let no man lead you astray: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhinhos, ninguém vos engane. Quem pratica a justiça é justo, assim como ele é justo.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos, no os engañe ninguno: el que hace justicia, es justo, como él también es justo.

verses.KJV: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.WEB: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.ASV: he that doeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. To this end was the Son of God manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pratica o pecado é do diabo, pois o diabo peca desde o princípio. Para isto o Filho de Deus se manifestou, para desfazer as obras do diabo.
verses.RVR09: El que hace pecado, es del diablo; porque el diablo peca desde el principio. Para esto apareció el Hijo de Dios, para deshacer las obras del diablo.

verses.KJV: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
verses.WEB: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
verses.ASV: Whosoever is begotten of God doeth no sin, because his seed abideth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is begotten of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que é nascido de Deus não pratica o pecado, pois a sua semente reside nele; e não pode praticar o pecado, porque é nascido de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que es nacido de Dios, no hace pecado, porque su simiente está en él; y no puede pecar, porque es nacido de Dios.

verses.KJV: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.WEB: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
verses.ASV: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto são reconhecíveis os filhos de Deus, e os filhos do diabo: todo aquele que não pratica a justiça, e não ama o seu irmão, não é de Deus.
verses.RVR09: En esto son manifiestos los hijos de Dios, y los hijos del diablo: cualquiera que no hace justicia, y que no ama á su hermano, no es de Dios.

verses.KJV: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.WEB: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
verses.ASV: For this is the message which ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esta é a mensagem que ouvistes desde o princípio: que nos amemos uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Porque este es el mensaje que habéis oído desde el principio: Que nos amemos unos á otros.

verses.KJV: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
verses.WEB: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.ASV: not as Cain was of the evil one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não [sejamos] como Caim, [ que] era do maligno, e matou o seu irmão. E por que o matou? Porque as suas obras eram más, e as do seu irmão justas.
verses.RVR09: No como Caín, que era del maligno, y mató á su hermano. ¿Y por qué causa le mató? Porque sus obras eran malas, y las de su hermano justas.

verses.KJV: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.WEB: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
verses.ASV: Marvel not, brethren, if the world hateth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos, não vos surpreendeis se o mundo vos odeia.
verses.RVR09: Hermanos míos, no os maravilléis si el mundo os aborrece.

verses.KJV: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
verses.WEB: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
verses.ASV: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not abideth in death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós sabemos que já passamos da morte para a vida, pois amamos os irmãos. Quem não ama[seu] irmão permanece na morte.
