verses.RVR09: Nosotros sabemos que hemos pasado de muerte á vida, en que amamos á los hermanos. El que no ama á su hermano, está en muerte.

verses.KJV: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.WEB: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
verses.ASV: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que odeia o seu irmão é homicida. E sabeis que nenhum homicida tem a vida eterna habitando nele.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que aborrece á su hermano, es homicida; y sabéis que ningún homicida tiene vida eterna permaneciente en sí.

verses.KJV: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.WEB: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.ASV: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto conhecemos o amor: ele deu a sua vida por nós. E nós devemos dar as [nossas] vidas pelos irmãos.
verses.RVR09: En esto hemos conocido el amor, porque él puso su vida por nosotros: también nosotros debemos poner nuestras vidas por los hermanos.

verses.KJV: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.WEB: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
verses.ASV: But whoso hath the world’s goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém tiver bens do mundo, e vir o seu irmão em necessidade, e não se compadecer dele, como pode o amor de Deus estar nele?
verses.RVR09: Mas el que tuviere bienes de este mundo, y viere á su hermano tener necesidad, y le cerrare sus entrañas, ¿cómo está el amor de Dios en él?

verses.KJV: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.WEB: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
verses.ASV: [My] little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus filhinhos, amemos não de palavra, nem de língua, mas sim com ação e verdade.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos míos, no amemos de palabra ni de lengua, sino de obra y en verdad.

verses.KJV: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.WEB: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
verses.ASV: Hereby shall we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our heart before him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E nisto sabemos que somos da verdade, e teremos segurança nos nossos corações diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y en esto conocemos que somos de la verdad, y tenemos nuestros corazones certificados delante de él.

verses.KJV: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.WEB: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
verses.ASV: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, se o nosso coração [nos] condena, maior é Deus que o nosso coração, e conhece tudo.
verses.RVR09: Porque si nuestro corazón nos reprendiere, mayor es Dios que nuestro corazón, y conoce todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
verses.WEB: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
verses.ASV: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness toward God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, se nosso coração não nos condena, temos confiança diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Carísimos, si nuestro corazón no nos reprende, confianza tenemos en Dios;

verses.KJV: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.WEB: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.ASV: and whatsoever we ask we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer coisa que pedirmos, dele receberemos; porque guardamos os seus mandamentos, e fazemos o que lhe agrada.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquier cosa que pidiéremos, la recibiremos de él, porque guardamos sus mandamientos, y hacemos las cosas que son agradables delante de él.

verses.KJV: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.WEB: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
verses.ASV: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o seu mandamento: que creiamos no nome do seu Filho Jesus Cristo, e nos amemos uns aos outros, como ele nos mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y éste es su mandamiento: Que creamos en el nombre de su Hijo Jesucristo, y nos amemos unos á otros como nos lo ha mandado.

verses.KJV: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.WEB: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
verses.ASV: And he that keepeth his commandments abideth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a pessoa que guarda os seus mandamentos está nele, e ele nela. E nisto sabemos que ele está em nós: pelo Espírito que ele nos deu.
verses.RVR09: Y el que guarda sus mandamientos, está en él, y él en él. Y en esto sabemos que él permanece en nosotros, por el Espíritu que nos ha dado.

verses.KJV: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.WEB: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.ASV: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, não creiais em todo espírito, mas provai se os espíritos são da parte de Deus; porque muitos falsos profetas têm vindo ao mundo.
verses.RVR09: AMADOS, no creáis á todo espíritu, sino probad los espíritus si son de Dios: porque muchos falsos profetas son salidos en el mundo.

verses.KJV: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.WEB: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
verses.ASV: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto conhecereis o Espírito de Deus: todo espírito que confessa que Jesus Cristo veio em carne é de Deus;
verses.RVR09: En esto conoced el Espíritu de Dios: todo espíritu que confiesa que Jesucristo es venido en carne es de Dios:

verses.KJV: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.WEB: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
verses.ASV: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the [spirit] of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.
verses.ALMEIDA: e todo espírito que não confessa que Jesus Cristo veio em carne não é de Deus; e este é o do anticristo, do qual já ouvistes que virá, e que já agora está no mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y todo espíritu que no confiesa que Jesucristo es venido en carne, no es de Dios: y éste es el espíritu del anticristo, del cual vosotros habéis oído que ha de venir, y que ahora ya está en el mundo.

verses.KJV: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.WEB: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
verses.ASV: Ye are of God, [my] little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhinhos, vós sois de Deus, e tendes vencido esses; pois maior é o que está em vós do que o que está no mundo.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos, vosotros sois de Dios, y los habéis vencido; porque el que en vosotros está, es mayor que el que está en el mundo.

verses.KJV: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.WEB: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
verses.ASV: They are of the world: therefore speak they [as] of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são do mundo, por isso falam do mundo, e o mundo os ouve.
verses.RVR09: Ellos son del mundo; por eso hablan del mundo, y el mundo los oye.

verses.KJV: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.WEB: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.ASV: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós somos de Deus. Aquele que conhece Deus ouve-nos; aquele que não é de Deus não nos ouve. Nisto conhecemos o Espírito da verdade e o espírito do erro.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros somos de Dios: el que conoce á Dios, nos oye: el que no es de Dios, no nos oye. Por esto conocemos el espíritu de verdad y el espíritu de error.

verses.KJV: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.WEB: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.ASV: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, nos amemos uns aos outros; porque o amor é de Deus, e todo aquele que ama é nascido de Deus e conhece a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Carísimos, amémonos unos á otros; porque el amor es de Dios. Cualquiera que ama, es nacido de Dios, y conoce á Dios.

verses.KJV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.WEB: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
verses.ASV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que não ama não conhece a Deus, porque Deus é amor.
verses.RVR09: El que no ama, no conoce á Dios; porque Dios es amor.

verses.KJV: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.WEB: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.ASV: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto se manifestou o amor de Deus por nós: que Deus enviou o seu Filho unigênito ao mundo, para que por meio dele vivamos.
verses.RVR09: En esto se mostró el amor de Dios para con nosotros, en que Dios envió á su Hijo unigénito al mundo, para que vivamos por él.

verses.KJV: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.WEB: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
verses.ASV: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto está o amor, não que nós tenhamos amado a Deus, mas sim, que ele nos amou, e enviou seu Filho como sacrifício para perdão dos nossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: En esto consiste el amor: no que nosotros hayamos amado á Dios, sino que él nos amó á nosotros, y ha enviado á su Hijo en propiciación por nuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.WEB: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
verses.ASV: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, se Deus assim nos amou, também nós devemos amar uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Amados, si Dios así nos ha amado, debemos también nosotros amarnos unos á otros.

verses.KJV: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.WEB: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
verses.ASV: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém jamais viu Deus; se nos amamos uns aos outros, Deus está em nós, e o amor dele em nós é aperfeiçoado.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno vió jamás á Dios. Si nos amamos unos á otros, Dios está en nosotros, y su amor es perfecto en nosotros:

verses.KJV: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.WEB: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
verses.ASV: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto sabemos que estamos nele, e ele em nós, porque ele nos deu do seu Espírito.
verses.RVR09: En esto conocemos que estamos en él, y él en nosotros, en que nos ha dado de su Espíritu.

verses.KJV: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.WEB: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
verses.ASV: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son [to be] the Saviour of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vimos e damos testemunho de que o Pai enviou o Filho [para ser] Salvador do mundo.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros hemos visto y testificamos que el Padre ha enviado al Hijo para ser Salvador del mundo.

verses.KJV: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
verses.WEB: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
verses.ASV: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que confessar que Jesus é o Filho de Deus, Deus está nele, e ele em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que confesare que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios, Dios está en él, y él en Dios.

verses.KJV: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
verses.WEB: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
verses.ASV: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós conhecemos e cremos no amor que Deus tem por nós. Deus é amor, e quem está no amor está em Deus, e Deus nele.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros hemos conocido y creído el amor que Dios tiene para con nosotros. Dios es amor; y el que vive en amor, vive en Dios, y Dios en él.

verses.KJV: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
verses.WEB: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
verses.ASV: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto o amor é aperfeiçoado em nós, para que no dia do juízo tenhamos confiança, pois, como ele é, assim somos nós neste mundo.
verses.RVR09: En esto es perfecto el amor con nosotros, para que tengamos confianza en el día del juicio; pues como él es, así somos nosotros en este mundo.

verses.KJV: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.WEB: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
verses.ASV: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.ALMEIDA: No amor não há medo; pelo contrário, o perfeito amor expulsa o medo; pois o medo está relacionado ao castigo; e o que teme não está aperfeiçoado em amor.
verses.RVR09: En amor no hay temor; mas el perfecto amor echa fuera el temor: porque el temor tiene pena. De donde el que teme, no está perfecto en el amor.

verses.KJV: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.WEB: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.ASV: We love, because he first loved us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós o amamos, porque ele nos amou primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros le amamos á él, porque él nos amó primero.

verses.KJV: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verses.WEB: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
verses.ASV: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém diz: “Eu amo a Deus”, e odeia seu irmão, é mentiroso. Pois quem não ama seu irmão, ao qual viu, como pode amar a Deus, a quem nunca viu?
verses.RVR09: Si alguno dice, Yo amo á Dios, y aborrece á su hermano, es mentiroso. Porque el que no ama á su hermano al cual ha visto, ¿cómo puede amar á Dios á quien no ha visto?

verses.KJV: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.WEB: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
verses.ASV: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dele temos este mandamento: quem ama a Deus, ame também seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros tenemos este mandamiento de él: Que el que ama á Dios, ame también á su hermano.

verses.KJV: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.WEB: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
verses.ASV: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que crê que Jesus é o Cristo é nascido de Deus; e todo aquele que ama ao que gerou, também ama ao que dele é nascido.
verses.RVR09: TODO aquel que cree que Jesús es el Cristo, es nacido de Dios: y cualquiera que ama al que ha engendrado, ama también al que es nacido de él.

verses.KJV: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
verses.WEB: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
verses.ASV: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto sabemos que amamos os filhos de Deus: quando amamos a Deus, e guardamos os seus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: En esto conocemos que amamos á los hijos de Dios, cuando amamos á Dios, y guardamos sus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.WEB: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
verses.ASV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois este é o amor de Deus: que guardemos os seus mandamentos. E os seus mandamentos não são pesados.
verses.RVR09: Porque este es el amor de Dios, que guardemos sus mandamientos; y sus mandamientos no son penosos.

verses.KJV: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verses.WEB: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
verses.ASV: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, [even] our faith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todo aquele que é nascido de Deus vence o mundo; e esta é a vitória que vence o mundo: a nossa fé.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo aquello que es nacido de Dios vence al mundo: y esta es la victoria que vence al mundo, nuestra fe.

verses.KJV: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.WEB: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.ASV: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o que vence o mundo, senão aquele que crê que Jesus é o Filho de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el que vence al mundo, sino el que cree que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios?

verses.KJV: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.WEB: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.ASV: This is he that came by water and blood, [even] Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele que veio por água e sangue: Jesus, o Cristo. Não só pela água, mas pela água e [pelo] sangue. E o Espírito é o que lhe dá testemunho, porque o Espírito é a verdade.
verses.RVR09: Este es Jesucristo, que vino por agua y sangre: no por agua solamente, sino por agua y sangre. Y el Espíritu es el que da testimonio: porque el Espíritu es la verdad.

verses.KJV: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
verses.WEB: For there are three who testify:
verses.ASV: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois são três os que dão testemunho no céu: o Pai, a Palavra, e o Espírito Santo; e estes três são um.
verses.RVR09: Porque tres son los que dan testimonio en el cielo, el Padre, el Verbo, y el Espíritu Santo: y estos tres son uno.

verses.KJV: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.WEB: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
verses.ASV: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E três são os que testemunham na terra: o Espírito, a água e o sangue; e estes três estão em unidade.
verses.RVR09: Y tres son los que dan testimonio en la tierra, el Espíritu, y el agua, y la sangre: y estos tres concuerdan en uno.

verses.KJV: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
verses.WEB: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
verses.ASV: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se recebemos o testemunho humano, o testemunho de Deus é maior; pois este é o testemunho de Deus, que testificou de seu Filho.
verses.RVR09: Si recibimos el testimonio de los hombres, el testimonio de Dios es mayor; porque éste es el testimonio de Dios, que ha testificado de su Hijo.

verses.KJV: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
verses.WEB: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
verses.ASV: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem crê no Filho de Deus tem testemunho em si mesmo; quem não crê em Deus o fez de mentiroso, porque não creu no testemunho que Deus deu acerca do seu Filho.
verses.RVR09: El que cree en el Hijo de Dios, tiene el testimonio en sí mismo: el que no cree á Dios, le ha hecho mentiroso; porque no ha creído en el testimonio que Dios ha testificado de su Hijo.

verses.KJV: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.WEB: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.ASV: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o testemunho: que Deus nos deu a vida eterna; e essa vida está no seu Filho.
verses.RVR09: Y este es el testimonio: Que Dios nos ha dado vida eterna; y esta vida está en su Hijo.

verses.KJV: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
verses.WEB: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
verses.ASV: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem o Filho tem a vida; quem não tem o Filho de Deus não tem a vida.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene al Hijo, tiene la vida: el que no tiene al Hijo de Dios, no tiene la vida.

verses.KJV: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.WEB: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
verses.ASV: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, [even] unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas escrevi para vós que credes no nome do Filho de Deus, para que saibais que tendes a vida eterna, e que creiais no nome do Filho de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas he escrito á vosotros que creéis en el nombre del Hijo de Dios, para que sepáis que tenéis vida eterna, y para que creáis en el nombre del Hijo de Dios.

verses.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.WEB: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
verses.ASV: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a confiança que diante dele: que se pedirmos alguma coisa conforme a sua vontade, ele nos ouve.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la confianza que tenemos en él, que si demandáremos alguna cosa conforme á su voluntad, él nos oye.

verses.KJV: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.WEB: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
verses.ASV: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se sabemos que nos ouve em tudo o que pedimos, sabemos que alcançamos as coisas que lhe pedimos.
verses.RVR09: Y si sabemos que él nos oye en cualquiera cosa que demandáremos, sabemos que tenemos las peticiones que le hubiéremos demandado.

verses.KJV: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.WEB: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
verses.ASV: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and [God] will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém vê o seu irmão cometer um pecado que não é para a morte, orará, e lhe dará vida, para os que não pecarem para a morte. Há pecado para a morte, pelo qual não digo que ore.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno viere cometer á su hermano pecado no de muerte, demandará, y se le dará vida; digo á los que pecan no de muerte. Hay pecado de muerte, por el cual yo no digo que ruegue.

verses.KJV: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.WEB: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
verses.ASV: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda injustiça é pecado; e há pecado que não é para a morte.
verses.RVR09: Toda maldad es pecado; mas hay pecado no de muerte.

verses.KJV: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
verses.WEB: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
verses.ASV: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabemos que todo aquele que é nascido de Deus não pratica o pecado; mas o que é gerado de Deus guarda a si mesmo, e o maligno não o toca.
verses.RVR09: Sabemos que cualquiera que es nacido de Dios, no peca; mas el que es engendrado de Dios, se guarda á sí mismo, y el maligno no le toca.

verses.KJV: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
verses.WEB: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
verses.ASV: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabemos que somos de Deus, e que o mundo todo jaz no maligno.
verses.RVR09: Sabemos que somos de Dios, y todo el mundo está puesto en maldad.

verses.KJV: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.WEB: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.ASV: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabemos que o Filho de Deus veio, e nos deu entendimento para conhecermos o Verdadeiro; e no Verdadeiro estamos, em seu Filho Jesus Cristo. Este é o verdadeiro Deus, e a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Empero sabemos que el Hijo de Dios es venido, y nos ha dado entendimiento para conocer al que es verdadero: y estamos en el verdadero, en su Hijo Jesucristo. Este es el verdadero Dios, y la vida eterna.

verses.KJV: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.WEB: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
verses.ASV: [My] little children, guard yourselves from idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhinhos, guardai-vos dos ídolos. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Hijitos, guardaos de los ídolos. Amén.

verses.KJV: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.WEB: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
verses.ASV: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;
verses.ALMEIDA: O ancião, à senhora eleita, e a seus filhos, aos quais eu amo em verdade; e não somente eu, mas também todos os que têm conhecido a verdade;
verses.RVR09: EL anciano á la señora elegida y á sus hijos, á los cuales yo amo en verdad; y no yo solo, sino también todos los que han conocido la verdad,

verses.KJV: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.WEB: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
verses.ASV: for the truth’s sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da verdade que está em nós, e estará para sempre conosco.
verses.RVR09: Por la verdad que está en nosotros, y será perpetuamente con nosotros:

verses.KJV: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.WEB: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.ASV: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Graça, misericórdia, [e] paz de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Filho do Pai, seja convosco em verdade e amor.
verses.RVR09: Sea con vosotros gracia, misericordia, y paz de Dios Padre, y del Señor Jesucristo, Hijo del Padre, en verdad y en amor.

verses.KJV: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.WEB: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
verses.ASV: I rejoice greatly that I have found [certain] of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muito me alegrei por eu ter encontrado [alguns] de teus filhos andando na verdade, assim como recebemos o mandamento do Pai.
verses.RVR09: Mucho me he gozado, porque he hallado de tus hijos, que andan en verdad, como nosotros hemos recibido el mandamiento del Padre.

verses.KJV: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.WEB: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.ASV: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, senhora, eu te rogo, não como te escrevendo um novo mandamento, mas o que tivemos desde o princípio: que nos amemos uns aos outros.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora te ruego, señora, no como escribiéndote un nuevo mandamiento, sino aquel que nosotros hemos tenido desde el principio, que nos amemos unos á otros.

verses.KJV: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.WEB: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
verses.ASV: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o amor: que andemos segundo seus mandamentos. E este é o mandamento, como [já] ouvistes desde o princípio: que nele andeis.
verses.RVR09: Y este es amor, que andemos según sus mandamientos. Este es el mandamiento: Que andéis en él, como vosotros habéis oído desde el principio.

verses.KJV: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.WEB: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
verses.ASV: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, [even] they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muitos enganadores têm surgido no mundo que não declaram que Jesus Cristo veio em carne. Este é o enganador e o anticristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque muchos engañadores son entrados en el mundo, los cuales no confiesan que Jesucristo ha venido en carne. Este tal el engañador es, y el anticristo.

verses.KJV: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.WEB: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.ASV: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vigiai por vós mesmos, para que não percamos o que trabalhamos; mas sim que recebamos uma recompensa completa.
verses.RVR09: Mirad por vosotros mismos, porque no perdamos las cosas que hemos obrado, sino que recibamos galardón cumplido.

verses.KJV: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.WEB: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
verses.ASV: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo aquele que transgride e não continua na doutrina de Cristo não tem a Deus; quem continua na doutrina de Cristo tem tanto ao Pai quanto ao Filho.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que se rebela, y no persevera en la doctrina de Cristo, no tiene á Dios: el que persevera en la doctrina de Cristo, el tal tiene al Padre y al Hijo.

verses.KJV: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.WEB: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
verses.ASV: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into [your] house, and give him no greeting:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém vem a vós, e não traz esta doutrina, não recebais em [vossa] casa, nem o saudeis.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno viene á vosotros, y no trae esta doctrina, no lo recibáis en casa, ni le digáis: ¡bienvenido!

verses.KJV: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.WEB: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
verses.ASV: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quem o saúda compartilha com suas más obras.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que le dice bienvenido, comunica con sus malas obras.

verses.KJV: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.WEB: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
verses.ASV: Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write them] with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tenho muitas coisas para vos escrever, porém não quis [fazê-lo] com papel e tinta; mas espero vir até vós, e falar [convosco] face a face, para que a nossa alegria seja completa.
verses.RVR09: Aunque tengo muchas cosas que escribiros, no he querido comunicarlas por medio de papel y tinta; mas espero ir á vosotros, y hablar boca á boca, para que nuestro gozo sea cumplido.

verses.KJV: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.WEB: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
verses.ASV: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de tua irmã, a eleita, te saúdam. Amém.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de tu hermana elegida te saludan. Amén.

verses.KJV: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.WEB: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.ASV: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ancião, ao amado Gaio, a quem amo em verdade.
verses.RVR09: EL anciano al muy amado Gaio, al cual yo amo en verdad.

verses.KJV: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.WEB: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
verses.ASV: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amado, eu desejo que estejas bem em todas as coisas, e que tenhas saúde, assim como bem está a tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Amado, yo deseo que tú seas prosperado en todas cosas, y que tengas salud, así como tu alma está en prosperidad.

verses.KJV: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
verses.WEB: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
verses.ASV: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois muito me alegrei quando irmãos chegaram, e testemunharam da tua verdade, como tu andas na verdade.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente me gocé mucho cuando vinieron los hermanos y dieron testimonio de tu verdad, así como tú andas en la verdad.

verses.KJV: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.WEB: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
verses.ASV: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenho maior alegria do que esta: [a de] ouvir que meus filhos andam na verdade.
verses.RVR09: No tengo yo mayor gozo que éste, el oir que mis hijos andan en la verdad.

verses.KJV: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.WEB: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
verses.ASV: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
verses.ALMEIDA: Amado, tu ages fielmente em tudo o que fazes aos irmãos, inclusive aos forasteiros.
verses.RVR09: Amado, fielmente haces todo lo que haces para con los hermanos, y con los extranjeros,

verses.KJV: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
verses.WEB: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
verses.ASV: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, diante da igreja, testemunharam do teu amor; aos quais, tu agirás bem ao supri-los de modo digno [da vontade] de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales han dado testimonio de tu amor en presencia de la iglesia: á los cuales si ayudares como conviene según Dios, harás bien.

verses.KJV: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois foi por causa do Nome dele que partiram em jornada, sem nada aceitar dos gentios.
verses.RVR09: Porque ellos partieron por amor de su nombre, no tomando nada de los Gentiles.

verses.KJV: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
verses.WEB: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
verses.ASV: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto devemos acolher tais pessoas, para que sejamos cooperadores da verdade.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros, pues, debemos recibir á los tales, para que seamos cooperadores á la verdad.

verses.KJV: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.WEB: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
verses.ASV: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tenho escrito aos da igreja; porém Diótrefes, que busca ser o comandante deles, não nos recebe.
verses.RVR09: Yo he escrito á la iglesia: mas Diótrefes, que ama tener el primado entre ellos, no nos recibe.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
verses.WEB: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
verses.ASV: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth [them] out of the church.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, se eu vier, trarei à memória os seus feitos, falando ele contra nós com palavras maliciosas; e não satisfeito com isso, não recebe aos irmãos, proíbe aos que se dispõem a fazer, e os expulsa da igreja.
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa, si yo viniere, recordaré las obras que hace parlando con palabras maliciosas contra nosotros; y no contento con estas cosas, no recibe á los hermanos, y prohibe á los que los quieren recibir, y los echa de la iglesia.

verses.KJV: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.WEB: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
verses.ASV: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amado, não imites o mal, mas sim o bem. Quem faz o bem é de Deus, mas quem faz o mal nunca viu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Amado, no sigas lo que es malo, sino lo que es bueno. El que hace bien es de Dios: mas el que hace mal, no ha visto á Dios.

verses.KJV: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
verses.WEB: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.ASV: Demetrius hath the witness of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.
verses.ALMEIDA: Demétrio tem alcançado [bom] testemunho de todos, inclusive da própria verdade. Também nós damos testemunho, e vós sabeis que o nosso testemunho é verdadeiro.
verses.RVR09: Todos dan testimonio de Demetrio, y aun la misma verdad: y también nosotros damos testimonio; y vosotros habéis conocido que nuestro testimonio es verdadero.

verses.KJV: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
verses.WEB: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
verses.ASV: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write [them] to thee with ink and pen:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tinha muitas coisas para escrever, porém não quero escrever a ti [sobre elas] com tinta e pena;
verses.RVR09: Yo tenía muchas cosas que escribirte; empero no quiero escribirte por tinta y pluma:

verses.KJV: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
verses.WEB: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.ASV: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas espero te ver em breve, e falaremos face a face. Paz seja contigo. Os amigos [daqui] te saúdam. Saúda os amigos [daí] , cada um por nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque espero verte en breve, y hablaremos boca á boca. Paz sea contigo. Los amigos te saludan. Saluda tú á los amigos por nombre.

verses.KJV: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
verses.WEB: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.ASV: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.ALMEIDA: Judas, servo de Jesus Cristo, e irmão de Tiago, para aqueles [que foram] chamados, santificados por Deus Pai, e guardados por Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: JUDAS, siervo de Jesucristo, y hermano de Jacobo, á los llamados, santificados en Dios Padre, y conservados en Jesucristo:

verses.KJV: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
verses.WEB: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
verses.ASV: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Misericórdia a vós, e a paz e o amor [vos] sejam multiplicados.
verses.RVR09: Misericordia, y paz, y amor os sean multiplicados.

verses.KJV: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verses.WEB: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
verses.ASV: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amados, procurando eu vos escrever com todo empenho sobre a [nossa] salvação comum, eu tive por necessário vos escrever e exortar a batalhar pela fé que de uma vez foi entregue aos santos.
verses.RVR09: Amados, por la gran solicitud que tenía de escribiros de la común salud, me ha sido necesario escribiros amonestándoos que contendáis eficazmente por la fe que ha sido una vez dada á los santos.

verses.KJV: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: For there are certain men crept in privily, [even] they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque alguns entraram disfarçadamente entre vós, que desde antes estavam escritos para a condenação; pessoas ímpias, que distorcem a graça de Deus em perversão, e negam ao único Soberano Deus e nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Porque algunos hombres han entrado encubiertamente, los cuales desde antes habían estado ordenados para esta condenación, hombres impíos, convirtiendo la gracia de nuestro Dios en disolución, y negando á Dios que solo es el que tiene dominio, y á nuestro Señor Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.WEB: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
verses.ASV: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu quer vos lembrar, sabendo vós disto de uma vez por todas: que o Senhor, tendo liberto o povo para fora da terra do Egito, depois destruiu os que não creram.
verses.RVR09: Os quiero pues amonestar, ya que alguna vez habéis sabido esto, que el Señor habiendo salvado al pueblo de Egipto, después destruyó á los que no creían:

verses.KJV: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.WEB: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
verses.ASV: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos anjos que não guardaram sua origem, mas deixaram sua própria habitação, ele os reservou debaixo de grande escuridão em prisões eternas até o julgamento do grande dia.
verses.RVR09: Y á los ángeles que no guardaron su dignidad, mas dejaron su habitación, los ha reservado debajo de oscuridad en prisiones eternas hasta el juicio del gran día:

verses.KJV: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.WEB: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.ASV: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como Sodoma e Gomorra, e as cidades circunvizinhas, que como aquelas, tendo cometido pecados sexuais, e seguido uma carne ilícita, foram postas como exemplo, recebendo a punição do fogo eterno.
verses.RVR09: Como Sodoma y Gomorra, y las ciudades comarcanas, las cuales de la misma manera que ellos habían fornicado, y habían seguido la carne extraña, fueron puestas por ejemplo, sufriendo el juicio del fuego eterno.

verses.KJV: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
verses.WEB: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
verses.ASV: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém estes, também semelhantemente adormecidos, contaminam a carne, e rejeitam a soberania, e insultam as [coisas dignas de] glórias.
verses.RVR09: De la misma manera también estos soñadores amancillan la carne, y menosprecian la potestad, y vituperan las potestades superiores.

verses.KJV: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.WEB: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
verses.ASV: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Miguel, o arcanjo, quando ele discutia com o diabo, e disputava por causa do corpo de Moisés, não ousou contra [ele] pronunciar juízo de maldição, porém disse: “O Senhor te repreenda.”
verses.RVR09: Pero cuando el arcángel Miguel contendía con el diablo, disputando sobre el cuerpo de Moisés, no se atrevió á usar de juicio de maldición contra él, sino que dijo: El Señor te reprenda.

verses.KJV: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
verses.WEB: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
verses.ASV: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas estes insultam tudo aquilo que não conhecem; e tudo o que eles entendem naturalmente, como animais irracionais, nisso eles se corrompem.
verses.RVR09: Pero éstos maldicen las cosas que no conocen; y las cosas que naturalmente conocen, se corrompen en ellas, como bestias brutas.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
verses.WEB: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
verses.ASV: Woe unto them! for they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai deles; porque eles entraram pelo caminho de Caim, e se dispuseram ao engano de Balaão por interesse por [interesse de] lucro, e pereceram pela rebelião de Coré.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ellos! porque han seguido el camino de Caín, y se lanzaron en el error de Balaam por recompensa, y perecieron en la contradicción de Coré.

verses.KJV: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.WEB: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.ASV: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são manchas em vossas demonstrações de amor, participando dos banquetes convosco, apascentando a si mesmos sem temor; eles são nuvens sem água, levadas pelos ventos sem direção; são como árvores murchas, infrutíferas, duas vezes mortas e arrancadas pela raiz;
verses.RVR09: Estos son manchas en vuestros convites, que banquetean juntamente, apacentándose á sí mismos sin temor alguno: nubes sin agua, las cuales son llevadas de acá para allá de los vientos: árboles marchitos como en otoño, sin fruto, dos veces muertos y desarraigados;

verses.KJV: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verses.WEB: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.ASV: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ondas furiosas do mar, que espumam suas próprias vergonhas; estrelas errantes, para as quais a escuridão das trevas está reservada eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Fieras ondas de la mar, que espuman sus mismas abominaciones; estrellas erráticas, á las cuales es reservada eternalmente la oscuridad de las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
verses.WEB: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
verses.ASV: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Enoque, o sétimo depois de Adão, também profetizou sobre estes, dizendo: “Eis que o Senhor veio, com dezenas de milhares de seus santos;
verses.RVR09: De los cuales también profetizó Enoc, séptimo desde Adam, diciendo: He aquí, el Señor es venido con sus santos millares,

verses.KJV: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.WEB: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
verses.ASV: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.ALMEIDA: para fazer julgamento contra todos, e reprovar a todos os seus ímpios, por todas as suas obras de irreverência, que impiamente cometeram, e por todas as duras [palavras] que os ímpios pecadores falaram contra ele.”
verses.RVR09: A hacer juicio contra todos, y á convencer á todos los impíos de entre ellos tocante á todas sus obras de impiedad que han hecho impíamente, y á todas las cosas duras que los pecadores impíos han hablado contra él.

verses.KJV: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
verses.WEB: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
verses.ASV: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words]), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são murmuradores, reclamadores, que andam segundo seus próprios maus desejos; e sua boca fala palavras de arrogância, mostrando admiração às pessoas para o [próprio] proveito.
verses.RVR09: Estos son murmuradores, querellosos, andando según sus deseos; y su boca habla cosas soberbias, teniendo en admiración las personas por causa del provecho.

verses.KJV: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.WEB: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós, amados, lembrai-vos das palavras que foram preditas pelos apóstolos de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros, amados, tened memoria de las palabras que antes han sido dichas por los apóstoles de nuestro Señor Jesucristo;

verses.KJV: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.WEB: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
verses.ASV: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como eles vos diziam, que “no último tempo haveria escarnecedores, que andariam segundo seus próprios desejos ímpios.”
verses.RVR09: Como os decían: Que en el postrer tiempo habría burladores, que andarían según sus malvados deseos.

verses.KJV: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.WEB: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
verses.ASV: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os que separam a si mesmos, mundanos, que não têm o Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los que hacen divisiones, sensuales, no teniendo el Espíritu.

verses.KJV: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verses.WEB: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
verses.ASV: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós, amados, edificai a vós mesmos em vossa santíssima fé, orando no Espírito Santo.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros, oh amados, edificándoos sobre vuestra santísima fe, orando por el Espíritu Santo,

verses.KJV: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.WEB: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
verses.ASV: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conservai a vós mesmos no amor de Deus, esperando a misericórdia de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo para a vida eterna.
verses.RVR09: Conservaos en el amor de Dios, esperando la misericordia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, para vida eterna.

verses.KJV: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
verses.WEB: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
verses.ASV: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tende misericórdia de alguns, usando de discernimento;
verses.RVR09: Y recibid á los unos en piedad, discerniendo:

verses.KJV: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.WEB: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
verses.ASV: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a outros salvai em temor, arrancando [-os] do fogo, odiando até a roupa contaminada pela carne.
verses.RVR09: Mas haced salvos á los otros por temor, arrebatándolos del fuego; aborreciendo aun la ropa que es contaminada de la carne.

verses.KJV: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.WEB: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
verses.ASV: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,
verses.ALMEIDA: E para aquele que é poderoso para vos guardar de tropeçar, e vos apresentar irrepreensíveis com alegria diante de sua glória;
verses.RVR09: A aquel, pues, que es poderoso para guardaros sin caída, y presentaros delante de su gloria irreprensibles, con grande alegría,

verses.KJV: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
verses.ASV: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, [be] glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao único sábio Deus, nosso Salvador,[seja] a glória e majestade, poder e autoridade, agora, e para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Al Dios solo sabio, nuestro Salvador, sea gloria y magnificencia, imperio y potencia, ahora y en todos los siglos. Amén.

verses.KJV: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.WEB: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
verses.ASV: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show unto his servants, [even] the things which must shortly come to pass: and he sent and signified [it] by his angel unto his servant John;
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação de Jesus Cristo, a qual Deus lhe deu, para mostrar a seus servos as coisas que devem acontecer em breve; e as enviou por meio de seu anjo, e as informou ao seu servo João.
verses.RVR09: LA revelación de Jesucristo, que Dios le dió, para manifestar á sus siervos las cosas que deben suceder presto; y la declaró, enviándola por su ángel á Juan su siervo,

verses.KJV: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.WEB: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
verses.ASV: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, [even] of all things that he saw.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual deu testemunho da palavra de Deus, e do testemunho de Jesus Cristo, e de tudo o que ele viu.
verses.RVR09: El cual ha dado testimonio de la palabra de Dios, y del testimonio de Jesucristo, y de todas las cosas que ha visto.

verses.KJV: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.WEB: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
verses.ASV: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado [é] aquele que lê, e [também] os que ouvem as palavras desta profecia, e guardam as coisas nela escritas; porque o tempo [está] próximo.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el que lee, y los que oyen las palabras de esta profecía, y guardan las cosas en ella escritas: porque el tiempo está cerca.

verses.KJV: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.WEB: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
verses.ASV: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne;
verses.ALMEIDA: João, às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia. Graça e paz sejam convosco, [provenientes] daquele que é, e que era, e que virá; e dos sete Espíritos que estão diante do trono dele;
verses.RVR09: Juan á las siete iglesias que están en Asia: Gracia sea con vosotros, y paz del que es y que era y que ha de venir, y de los siete Espíritus que están delante de su trono;

verses.KJV: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.WEB: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—
verses.ASV: and from Jesus Christ, [who is] the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loveth us, and loosed us from our sins by his blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Jesus Cristo, que é a fiel testemunha, o primogênito dos mortos, e Chefe dos reis da terra; àquele que nos amou, e em seu sangue nos lavou de nossos pecados;
verses.RVR09: Y de Jesucristo, el testigo fiel, el primogénito de los muertos, y príncipe de los reyes de la tierra. Al que nos amó, y nos ha lavado de nuestros pecados con su sangre,

verses.KJV: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.WEB: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.ASV: and he made us [to be] a kingdom, [to be] priests unto his God and Father; to him [be] the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos fez reis e sacerdotes a Deus e seu Pai; a ele [seja] a glória e o poder para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.RVR09: Y nos ha hecho reyes y sacerdotes para Dios y su Padre; á él sea gloria é imperio para siempre jamás. Amén.

verses.KJV: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.WEB: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
verses.ASV: Behold, he cometh with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they that pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que ele vem com as nuvens, e todo olho o verá, até mesmo aqueles que o perfuraram; e todas as tribos da terra lamentarão sobre ele. Sim! Amém!
verses.RVR09: He aquí que viene con las nubes, y todo ojo le verá, y los que le traspasaron; y todos los linajes de la tierra se lamentarán sobre él. Así sea. Amén.

verses.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.WEB: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
verses.ASV: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim”,diz o Senhor, que é, e que era, e que virá, o Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el Alpha y la Omega, principio y fin, dice el Señor, que es y que era y que ha de venir, el Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.WEB: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.ASV: I John, your brother and partaker with you in the tribulation and kingdom and patience [which are] in Jesus, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, João, (que também sou vosso irmão, e companheiro na aflição, e no Reino, e [na] paciência de Jesus Cristo), estava na ilha chamada Patmos, por causa da palavra de Deus, e por causa do testemunho de Jesus Cristo.
verses.RVR09: Yo Juan, vuestro hermano, y participante en la tribulación y en el reino, y en la paciencia de Jesucristo, estaba en la isla que es llamada Patmos, por la palabra de Dios y el testimonio de Jesucristo.

verses.KJV: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.WEB: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
verses.ASV: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia do Senhor, eu fui [arrebatado] em espírito, e atrás de mim eu ouvi uma grande voz, como de trombeta,
verses.RVR09: Yo fuí en el Espíritu en el día del Señor, y oí detrás de mí una gran voz como de trompeta,

verses.KJV: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.WEB: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
verses.ASV: saying, What thou seest, write in a book and send [it] to the seven churches: unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamum, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: “Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o primeiro e o último; e o que tu estás vendo, escreve em um livro, e envia às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: a Éfeso, e a Esmirna, e a Pérgamo, e a Tiatira, e a Sardes, e a Filadélfia, e a Laodiceia”.
verses.RVR09: Que decía: Yo soy el Alpha y Omega, el primero y el último. Escribe en un libro lo que ves, y envíalo á las siete iglesias que están en Asia; á Efeso, y á Smirna, y á Pérgamo, y á Tiatira, y á Sardis, y á Filadelfia, y á Laodicea.

verses.KJV: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.WEB: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
verses.ASV: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And having turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;
