verses.ALMEIDA: E eu me virei para ver a voz que tinha falado comigo; e ao me virar, vi sete castiçais de ouro;
verses.RVR09: Y me volví á ver la voz que hablaba conmigo: y vuelto, vi siete candeleros de oro;

verses.KJV: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.WEB: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.ASV: and in the midst of the candlesticks one like unto a son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no meio dos sete castiçais, um semelhante a [o] Filho do homem, vestido até os pés de uma roupa comprida, e o tórax envolvido com um cinto de ouro;
verses.RVR09: Y en medio de los siete candeleros, uno semejante al Hijo del hombre, vestido de una ropa que llegaba hasta los pies, y ceñido por los pechos con una cinta de oro.

verses.KJV: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.WEB: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
verses.ASV: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, [white] as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cabeça e os cabelos dele eram brancos como a lã, brancos como a neve; e seus olhos como chama de fogo;
verses.RVR09: Y su cabeza y sus cabellos eran blancos como la lana blanca, como la nieve; y sus ojos como llama de fuego;

verses.KJV: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.WEB: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
verses.ASV: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pés dele semelhantes a um metal valioso e reluzente, e ardentes como em fornalha; e a voz dele, como de muitas águas.
verses.RVR09: Y sus pies semejantes al latón fino, ardientes como en un horno; y su voz como ruido de muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.WEB: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
verses.ASV: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha em sua [mão] direita sete estrelas; e de sua boca saía uma espada aguda de dois fios; e seu rosto como o sol brilhando em sua força.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía en su diestra siete estrellas: y de su boca salía una espada aguda de dos filos. Y su rostro era como el sol cuando resplandece en su fuerza.

verses.KJV: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.WEB: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.ASV: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu o vi, cai aos pés dele como que morto; e ele pôs sua mão direita sobre mim, [e] me disse: “Não temas; eu sou o primeiro e o último;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando yo le vi, caí como muerto á sus pies. Y él puso su diestra sobre mí, diciéndome: No temas: yo soy el primero y el último;

verses.KJV: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.WEB: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
verses.ASV: and the Living one; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive for evermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.
verses.ALMEIDA: eu [sou] o que vivo, e fui morto; e eis que eu vivo para todo o sempre; Amém. E eu tenho as chaves do Xeol e da morte.
verses.RVR09: Y el que vivo, y he sido muerto; y he aquí que vivo por siglos de siglos, Amén. Y tengo las llaves del infierno y de la muerte:

verses.KJV: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.WEB: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.
verses.ASV: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;
verses.ALMEIDA: Escreve as coisas que tens visto, e as que são, e as que estão para acontecer;
verses.RVR09: Escribe las cosas que has visto, y las que son, y las que han de ser después de éstas:

verses.KJV: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.WEB: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
verses.ASV: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks are seven churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mistério das sete estrelas, que viste em minha [mão] direita, e os sete castiçais de ouro: as sete estrelas são os anjos [ou mensageiros] das sete igrejas; e os sete castiçais que viste, são as sete igrejas.
verses.RVR09: El misterio de las siete estrellas que has visto en mi diestra, y los siete candeleros de oro. Las siete estrellas son los ángeles de las siete iglesias; y los siete candeleros que has visto, son las siete iglesias.

verses.KJV: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:
verses.ASV: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, he that walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:
verses.ALMEIDA: “Escreve ao anjo da igreja de Éfeso: “Isto diz aquele que tem as sete estrelas em sua [mão] direita, que anda no meio dos sete castiçais de ouro:
verses.RVR09: ESCRIBE al ángel de la iglesia en EFESO: El que tiene las siete estrellas en su diestra, el cual anda en medio de los siete candeleros de oro, dice estas cosas:

verses.KJV: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
verses.WEB: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.
verses.ASV: I know thy works, and thy toil and patience, and that thou canst not bear evil men, and didst try them that call themselves apostles, and they are not, and didst find them false;
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu conheço as tuas obras, e teu trabalho, e a tua paciência, e que tu não podes tolerar os maus; e provaste aos que se dizem ser apóstolos e não são; e reconheceste [que eles eram] mentirosos;
verses.RVR09: Yo sé tus obras, y tu trabajo y paciencia; y que tú no puedes sufrir los malos, y has probado á los que se dicen ser apóstoles, y no lo son, y los has hallado mentirosos;

verses.KJV: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
verses.WEB: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
verses.ASV: and thou hast patience and didst bear for my name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suportaste [sofrimentos] , e tens paciência; e trabalhaste pelo meu nome, e não te cansaste.
verses.RVR09: Y has sufrido, y has tenido paciencia, y has trabajado por mi nombre, y no has desfallecido.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
verses.WEB: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
verses.ASV: But I have [this] against thee, that thou didst leave thy first love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu tenho contra ti, que deixaste o teu primeiro amor.
verses.RVR09: Pero tengo contra ti que has dejado tu primer amor.

verses.KJV: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
verses.WEB: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
verses.ASV: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I come to thee, and will move thy candlestick out of its place, except thou repent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lembra-te de onde tu caíste, e arrepende-te, e faze as primeiras obras; senão em breve eu virei a ti, e tirarei teu castiçal de seu lugar, se tu não te arrependeres.
verses.RVR09: Recuerda por tanto de dónde has caído, y arrepiéntete, y haz las primeras obras; pues si no, vendré presto á ti, y quitaré tu candelero de su lugar, si no te hubieres arrepentido.

verses.KJV: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
verses.WEB: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.ASV: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto tu tens: que odeias as obras dos nicolaítas, as quais eu também odeio.
verses.RVR09: Mas tienes esto, que aborreces los hechos de los Nicolaítas; los cuales yo también aborrezco.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: Ao que vencer, eu lhe darei de comer da árvore da vida, que está no meio do paraíso de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias. Al que venciere, daré á comer del árbol de la vida, el cual está en medio del paraíso de Dios.

verses.KJV: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and lived [again]:
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja dos de Esmirna: “Isto diz o o primeiro e o último, que foi morto, e vive:
verses.RVR09: Y escribe al ángel de la iglesia en SMIRNA: El primero y postrero, que fué muerto, y vivió, dice estas cosas:

verses.KJV: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
verses.WEB: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.ASV: I know thy tribulation, and thy poverty (but thou art rich), and the blasphemy of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu conheço tuas obras, e aflição, e pobreza (mas tu és rico) e a blasfêmia dos que dizem serem judeus, e não são, mas [na verdade] são sinagoga de Satanás.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé tus obras, y tu tribulación, y tu pobreza (pero tú eres rico), y la blasfemia de los que se dicen ser Judíos, y no lo son, mas son sinagoga de Satanás.

verses.KJV: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.ASV: Fear not the things which thou art about to suffer: behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee the crown of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nada temas das coisas que virás a sofrer; eis que o diabo está para lançar [alguns] de vós em prisão, para que sejais tentados; e vós tereis aflição de dez dias. Sê fiel até a morte, e eu te darei a coroa da vida.
verses.RVR09: No tengas ningún temor de las cosas que has de padecer. He aquí, el diablo ha de enviar algunos de vosotros á la cárcel, para que seáis probados, y tendréis tribulación de diez días. Sé fiel hasta la muerte, y yo te daré la corona de la vida.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: o que vencer, não sofrerá o dano da segunda morte.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias. El que venciere, no recibirá daño de la muerte segunda.

verses.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These things saith he that hath the sharp two-edged sword:
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja que está em Pérgamo: Isto diz aquele que tem a espada aguda de dois fios:
verses.RVR09: Y escribe al ángel de la iglesia en PÉRGAMO: El que tiene la espada aguda de dos filos, dice estas cosas:

verses.KJV: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.WEB: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.ASV: I know where thou dwellest, [even] where Satan’s throne is; and thou holdest fast my name, and didst not deny my faith, even in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu conheço tuas obras, e onde habitas, [que é] onde [está] o trono de Satanás; e tu reténs meu nome, e não negaste minha fé, [até] mesmo nos dias em que Antipas, que [era] minha fiel testemunha, o qual foi morto entre vós, onde Satanás habita.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé tus obras, y dónde moras, donde está la silla de Satanás; y retienes mi nombre, y no has negado mi fe, aun en los días en que fué Antipas mi testigo fiel, el cual ha sido muerto entre vosotros, donde Satanás mora.

verses.KJV: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.WEB: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
verses.ASV: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there some that hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu tenho [algumas] poucas coisas contra ti: que tu tens lá aos que retêm a doutrina de Balaão, o qual ensinava a Balaque a colocarmeios de tropeço diante dos filhos de Israel, para que comessem dos sacrifícios aos ídolos, e cometessem pecados sexuais.
verses.RVR09: Pero tengo unas pocas cosas contra ti: porque tú tienes ahí los que tienen la doctrina de Balaam, el cual enseñaba á Balac á poner escándalo delante de los hijos de Israel, á comer de cosas sacrificadas á los ídolos, y á cometer fornicación.

verses.KJV: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
verses.WEB: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.ASV: So hast thou also some that hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, também tu tens alguns que guardam a doutrina dos nicolaítas, a qual eu odeio.
verses.RVR09: Así también tú tienes á los que tienen la doctrina de los Nicolaítas, lo cual yo aborrezco.

verses.KJV: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Repent therefore; or else I come to thee quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Arrepende-te; senão, em breve virei a ti, e batalharei contra eles com a espada de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Arrepiéntete, porque de otra manera vendré á ti presto, y pelearé contra ellos con la espada de mi boca.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth but he that receiveth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: Ao que vencer, eu lhe darei de comer do maná escondido, e lhe darei uma pedrinha branca, e na pedrinha um novo nome escrito, o qual ninguém conhece, a não ser aquele que [o] recebe.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias. Al que venciere, daré á comer del maná escondido, y le daré una piedrecita blanca, y en la piedrecita un nombre nuevo escrito, el cual ninguno conoce sino aquel que lo recibe.

verses.KJV: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like unto burnished brass:
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja que [está] em Tiatira: “Isto diz o Filho de Deus, que tem seus olhos como chama de fogo, e seus pés semelhantes a um valioso metal reluzente:
verses.RVR09: Y escribe al ángel de la iglesia en TIATIRA: El Hijo de Dios, que tiene sus ojos como llama de fuego, y sus pies semejantes al latón fino, dice estas cosas:

verses.KJV: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
verses.WEB: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
verses.ASV: I know thy works, and thy love and faith and ministry and patience, and that thy last works are more than the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu conheço tuas obras, e amor, e serviço, e fé, e tua paciência, e tuas obras, e [que] as últimas são mais que as primeiras.
verses.RVR09: Yo he conocido tus obras, y caridad, y servicio, y fe, y tu paciencia, y que tus obras postreras son más que las primeras.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
verses.WEB: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.ASV: But I have [this] against thee, that thou sufferest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess; and she teacheth and seduceth my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu tenho [algumas] poucas coisas contra ti: que tu deixas a mulher Jezabel, que se diz profetiza, ensinar e enganar meus servos, para que façam pecados sexuais, e comam dos sacrifícios aos ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Mas tengo unas pocas cosas contra ti: porque permites aquella mujer Jezabel (que se dice profetisa) enseñar, y engañar á mis siervos, á fornicar, y á comer cosas ofrecidas á los ídolos.

verses.KJV: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
verses.WEB: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.ASV: And I gave her time that she should repent; and she willeth not to repent of her fornication.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu dei a ela tempo para que se arrependesse de seu pecado sexual; mas ela não se arrependeu.
verses.RVR09: Y le he dado tiempo para que se arrepienta de la fornicación; y no se ha arrepentido.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
verses.ASV: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of her works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu a lanço a [uma] cama, e aos que cometem adultério com ela, em grande aflição, se não se arrependerem de suas obras.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo la echo en cama, y á los que adulteran con ella, en muy grande tribulación, si no se arrepintieren de sus obras:

verses.KJV: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
verses.WEB: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
verses.ASV: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he that searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto each one of you according to your works.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao filhos deles eu os matarei de morte; e todas as igrejas saberão que eu sou aquele que investigo os rins e os corações; e a cada um de vós eu darei segundo vossas obras.
verses.RVR09: Y mataré á sus hijos con muerte; y todas las iglesias sabrán que yo soy el que escudriño los riñones y los corazones: y daré á cada uno de vosotros según sus obras.

verses.KJV: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
verses.WEB: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.
verses.ASV: But to you I say, to the rest that are in Thyatira, as many as have not this teaching, who know not the deep things of Satan, as they are wont to say; I cast upon you none other burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu digo a vós, e aos outros que estão em Tiatira, a todos quantos não tem esta dourina, e não conheceram as profundezas de Satanás (como dizem); eu não porei outra carga sobre vós;
verses.RVR09: Pero yo digo á vosotros, y á los demás que estáis en Tiatira, cualesquiera que no tienen esta doctrina, y que no han conocido las profundidades de Satanás, como dicen: Yo no enviaré sobre vosotros otra carga.

verses.KJV: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless that which ye have, hold fast till I come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que vós tendes, retende até que eu venha.
verses.RVR09: Empero la que tenéis, tenedla hasta que yo venga.

verses.KJV: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
verses.WEB: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
verses.ASV: And he that overcometh, and he that keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give authority over the nations:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao que vencer, e guardar minhas obras até o fim, eu lhe darei autoridade sobre as nações;
verses.RVR09: Y al que hubiere vencido, y hubiere guardado mis obras hasta el fin, yo le daré potestad sobre las gentes;

verses.KJV: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
verses.WEB: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;
verses.ASV: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron, as the vessels of the potter are broken to shivers; as I also have received of my Father:
verses.ALMEIDA: E as dominará com vara de ferro; como vasos de oleiro serão quebradas em pedaços; assim como eu também recebi do meu Pai;
verses.RVR09: Y las regirá con vara de hierro, y serán quebrantados como vaso de alfarero, como también yo he recibido de mi Padre:

verses.KJV: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.WEB: and I will give him the morning star.
verses.ASV: and I will give him the morning star.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu lhe darei a estrela da manhã.
verses.RVR09: Y le daré la estrella de la mañana.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias.

verses.KJV: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
verses.WEB: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and thou art dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja que [está] em Sardes: “Isto diz aquele que tem os sete espíritos de Deus, e as sete estrelas: “Eu conheço tuas obras; que tu tens nome de que vives, e estás morto.
verses.RVR09: Y ESCRIBE al ángel de la iglesia en SARDIS: El que tiene los siete Espíritus de Dios, y las siete estrellas, dice estas cosas: Yo conozco tus obras, que tienes nombre que vives, y estás muerto.

verses.KJV: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
verses.WEB: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
verses.ASV: Be thou watchful, and establish the things that remain, which were ready to die: for I have found no works of thine perfected before my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sê vigilante, e firma o resto que está a ponto de morrer; porque eu não achei tuas obras completas diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sé vigilante y confirma las otras cosas que están para morir; porque no he hallado tus obras perfectas delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.WEB: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
verses.ASV: Remember therefore how thou hast received and didst hear; and keep [it], and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lembra-te do que tu tens recebido e ouvido, e guarda, e arrepende-te. Portanto, se tu não vigiares, eu virei sobre ti como ladrão, e tu não saberás a que hora eu virei sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate pues de lo que has recibido y has oído, y guárdalo, y arrepiéntete. Y si no velares, vendré á ti como ladrón, y no sabrás en qué hora vendré á ti.

verses.KJV: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.ASV: But thou hast a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments: and they shall walk with me in white; for they are worthy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas também em Sardo tu tens [alguns] poucos nomes, [ou seja, pessoas] que não contaminaram suas roupas, e andarão comigo em [roupas] brancas, porque são dignos.
verses.RVR09: Mas tienes unas pocas personas en Sardis que no han ensuciado sus vestiduras: y andarán conmigo en vestiduras blancas; porque son dignos.

verses.KJV: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.WEB: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.ASV: He that overcometh shall thus be arrayed in white garments; and I will in no wise blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que vencer, este será vestido de roupas brancas; e seu nome em maneira nenhuma riscarei do livro da vida; e eu declararei seu nome diante do meu Pai, e diante de seus anjos.
verses.RVR09: El que venciere, será vestido de vestiduras blancas; y no borraré su nombre del libro de la vida, y confesaré su nombre delante de mi Padre, y delante de sus ángeles.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias.

verses.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth and none shall shut, and that shutteth and none openeth:
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja que [está] em Filadélfia: “Isto diz o Santo, o Verdadeiro, que tem a chave de Davi; que abre e ninguém fecha; [que] fecha e ninguém abre;
verses.RVR09: Y escribe al ángel de la iglesia en FILADELFIA: Estas cosas dice el Santo, el Verdadero, el que tiene la llave de David, el que abre y ninguno cierra, y cierra y ninguno abre:

verses.KJV: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verses.WEB: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
verses.ASV: I know thy works (behold, I have set before thee a door opened, which none can shut), that thou hast a little power, and didst keep my word, and didst not deny my name.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu conheço as tuas obras; eis que eu te dei diante de ti uma porta aberta, e ninguém a pode fechar; porque tu tens pouca força, e guardaste minha palavra, e não negaste o meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Yo conozco tus obras: he aquí, he dado una puerta abierta delante de ti, la cual ninguno puede cerrar; porque tienes un poco de potencia, y has guardado mi palabra, y no has negado mi nombre.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.WEB: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
verses.ASV: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu entrego [alguns] da sinagoga de Satanás, dos que dizem ser judeus, e não são, mas mentem; eis que eu farei com que venham, e fiquem prostrados diante dos teus pés, e saibam que eu te amo;
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo doy de la sinagoga de Satanás, los que se dicen ser Judíos, y no lo son, mas mienten; he aquí, yo los constreñiré á que vengan y adoren delante de tus pies, y sepan que yo te he amado.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.WEB: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
verses.ASV: Because thou didst keep the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of trial, that [hour] which is to come upon the whole world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu guardaste a palavra da minha paciência, também eu te guardarei da hora da provação que está para vir sobre todo o mundo, para testar aos que habitam sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque has guardado la palabra de mi paciencia, yo también te guardaré de la hora de la tentación que ha de venir en todo el mundo, para probar á los que moran en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
verses.WEB: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
verses.ASV: I come quickly: hold fast that which thou hast, that no one take thy crown.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu venho em breve; guarda o que tu tens, para que ninguém tome tua coroa.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo vengo presto; retén lo que tienes, para que ninguno tome tu corona.

verses.KJV: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.WEB: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
verses.ASV: He that overcometh, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go out thence no more: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God, and mine own new name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que vencer, eu o farei coluna no templo do meu Deus; e dele nunca mais sairá; e sobre ele escreverei o nome do meu Deus, e o nome da cidade do meu Deus, Nova Jerusalém, que desce do céu do meu Deus, e [também] meu novo nome.
verses.RVR09: Al que venciere, yo lo haré columna en el templo de mi Dios, y nunca más saldrá fuera; y escribiré sobre él el nombre de mi Dios, y el nombre de la ciudad de mi Dios, la nueva Jerusalem, la cual desciende del cielo de con mi Dios, y mi nombre nuevo.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias.

verses.KJV: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
verses.WEB: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
verses.ASV: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: “E escreve ao anjo da igreja dos laodicenses: “Isto diz o Amém, a testemunha fiel e verdadeira, o principal da criação de Deus:
verses.RVR09: Y escribe al ángel de la iglesia en LAODICEA: He aquí dice el Amén, el testigo fiel y verdadero, el principio de la creación de Dios:

verses.KJV: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.WEB: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
verses.ASV: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Eu conheço as tuas obras, que tu nem és frio, nem quente; melhor seria que tu fosses frio ou quente!
verses.RVR09: Yo conozco tus obras, que ni eres frío, ni caliente. ¡Ojalá fueses frío, ó caliente!

verses.KJV: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verses.WEB: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
verses.ASV: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto porque tu és morno, e nem frio nem quente, eu te vomitarei da minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Mas porque eres tibio, y no frío ni caliente, te vomitaré de mi boca.

verses.KJV: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.WEB: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
verses.ASV: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art the wretched one and miserable and poor and blind and naked:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu dizes: Eu sou rico, e tenho me enriquecido, e de nada tenho falta; E não sabes que estás miserável, coitado, pobre, cego e nu.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú dices: Yo soy rico, y estoy enriquecido, y no tengo necesidad de ninguna cosa; y no conoces que tú eres un cuitado y miserable y pobre y ciego y desnudo;

verses.KJV: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
verses.WEB: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
verses.ASV: I counsel thee to buy of me gold refined by fire, that thou mayest become rich; and white garments, that thou mayest clothe thyself, and [that] the shame of thy nakedness be not made manifest; and eyesalve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te aconselho a comprar de mim ouro provado do fogo, para que te enriqueças; e roupas brancas, para que te vistas; e a vergonha de tua nudez não apareça; e unge teus olhos com colírio, para que vejas.
verses.RVR09: Yo te amonesto que de mí compres oro afinado en fuego, para que seas hecho rico, y seas vestido de vestiduras blancas, para que no se descubra la vergüenza de tu desnudez; y unge tus ojos con colirio, para que veas.

verses.KJV: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.WEB: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.ASV: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu repreendo e castigo a todos quantos eu amo; portanto sê zeloso, e te arrepende.
verses.RVR09: Yo reprendo y castigo á todos los que amo: sé pues celoso, y arrepiéntete.

verses.KJV: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.WEB: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
verses.ASV: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu estou à porta, e bato; se alguém ouvir a minha voz, e abrir a porta, entrarei até ele, e cearei com ele, e ele comigo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo estoy á la puerta y llamo: si alguno oyere mi voz y abriere la puerta, entraré á él, y cenaré con él, y él conmigo.

verses.KJV: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.WEB: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
verses.ASV: He that overcometh, I will give to him to sit down with me in my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father in his throne.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que vencer, eu lhe concederei que se sente comigo em meu trono; assim como eu também venci, e me sentei com meu Pai no trono dele.
verses.RVR09: Al que venciere, yo le daré que se siente conmigo en mi trono; así como yo he vencido, y me he sentado con mi Padre en su trono.

verses.KJV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.WEB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
verses.ASV: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.”
verses.RVR09: El que tiene oído, oiga lo que el Espíritu dice á las iglesias.

verses.KJV: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
verses.WEB: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
verses.ASV: After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, [a voice] as of a trumpet speaking with me, one saying, Come up hither, and I will show thee the things which must come to pass hereafter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas eu olhei, e eis que uma porta estava aberta no céu; e a primeira voz que eu ouvi, como uma trombeta ao falar comigo, disse: “Sobe aqui, e eu te mostrarei as coisas que devem acontecer depois destas.”
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de estas cosas miré, y he aquí una puerta abierta en el cielo: y la primera voz que oí, era como de trompeta que hablaba conmigo, diciendo: Sube acá, y yo te mostraré las cosas que han de ser después de éstas.

verses.KJV: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
verses.WEB: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
verses.ASV: Straightway I was in the Spirit: and behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting upon the throne;
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo eu fui [arrebatado] em espírito; e eis que um trono estava posto no céu, e [alguém] sentado sobre o trono.
verses.RVR09: Y luego yo fuí en Espíritu: y he aquí, un trono que estaba puesto en el cielo, y sobre el trono estaba uno sentado.

verses.KJV: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.WEB: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
verses.ASV: and he that sat [was] to look upon like a jasper stone and a sardius: and [there was] a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald to look upon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que estava sentado era de aparência semelhante à pedra jaspe e sárdio; e o arco colorido celeste estava ao redor do trono, de aparência semelhante à esmeralda.
verses.RVR09: Y el que estaba sentado, era al parecer semejante á una piedra de jaspe y de sardio: y un arco celeste había alrededor del trono, semejante en el aspecto á la esmeralda.

verses.KJV: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.WEB: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
verses.ASV: And round about the throne [were] four and twenty thrones: and upon the thrones [I saw] four and twenty elders sitting, arrayed in white garments; and on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao redor do trono [havia] vinte e quatro tronos; e vi sobre os tronos vinte e quatro anciãos vestidos de roupas brancas; e sobre as cabeças deles tinham coroas de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y alrededor del trono había veinticuatro sillas: y vi sobre las sillas veinticuatro ancianos sentados, vestidos de ropas blancas; y tenían sobre sus cabezas coronas de oro.

verses.KJV: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.WEB: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.ASV: And out of the throne proceed lightnings and voices and thunders. And [there were] seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E do trono saíam relâmpagos, e trovões, e vozes; e sete lâmpadas de fogo ardiam diante do trono, as quais são os sete espíritos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y del trono salían relámpagos y truenos y voces: y siete lámparas de fuego estaban ardiendo delante del trono, las cuales son los siete Espíritus de Dios.

verses.KJV: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.WEB: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
verses.ASV: and before the throne, as it were a sea of glass like unto crystal; and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diante do trono [havia] um mar de vidro, semelhante ao cristal, e no meio do trono, e ao redor do trono, quatro animais cheios de olhos, em frente e atrás.
verses.RVR09: Y delante del trono había como un mar de vidrio semejante al cristal; y en medio del trono, y alrededor del trono, cuatro animales llenos de ojos delante y detrás.

verses.KJV: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
verses.WEB: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
verses.ASV: And the first creature [was] like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face as of a man, and the fourth creature [was] like a flying eagle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o primeiro animal [era] semelhante a um leão, e o segundo animal semelhante a um bezerro, e o terceiro animal tinha o rosto como de homem, e o quarto animal [era] como uma águia voando.
verses.RVR09: Y el primer animal era semejante á un león; y el segundo animal, semejante á un becerro; y el tercer animal tenía la cara como de hombre; y el cuarto animal, semejante á un águila volando.

verses.KJV: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.WEB: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
verses.ASV: And the four living creatures, having each one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and within: and they have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, [is] the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os quatro animais tinham cada um em si seis asas ao redor, e por dentro [eram] cheios de olhos; e não tem repouso de dia nem de noite, dizendo: “Santo, Santo, Santo [é] o Senhor Deus, o Todo-Poderoso, que era, e que é, e que virá.”
verses.RVR09: Y los cuatro animales tenían cada uno por sí seis alas alrededor, y de dentro estaban llenos de ojos; y no tenían reposo día ni noche, diciendo: Santo, santo, santo el Señor Dios Todopoderoso, que era, y que es, y que ha de venir.

verses.KJV: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
verses.WEB: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
verses.ASV: And when the living creatures shall give glory and honor and thanks to him that sitteth on the throne, to him that liveth for ever and ever,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os animais dão glória, honra, e agradecimento ao que estava sentado sobre o trono, ao que vive para todo o sempre;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando aquellos animales daban gloria y honra y alabanza al que estaba sentado en el trono, al que vive para siempre jamás,

verses.KJV: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.WEB: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.ASV: the four and twenty elders shall fall down before him that sitteth on the throne, and shall worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and shall cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] os vinte e quatro anciãos se prostram diante do que estava sentado sobre o trono, e adoram ao que vive para todo o sempre, e lançam suas coroas diante do trono, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Los veinticuatro ancianos se postraban delante del que estaba sentado en el trono, y adoraban al que vive para siempre jamás, y echaban sus coronas delante del trono, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.WEB: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
verses.ASV: Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power: for thou didst create all things, and because of thy will they were, and were created.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Digno és tu, Senhor, de receberes glória, honra e poder; porque tu criaste todas as coisas, e por causa da tua vontade elas são e foram criadas!”
verses.RVR09: Señor, digno eres de recibir gloria y honra y virtud: porque tú criaste todas las cosas, y por tu voluntad tienen ser y fueron criadas.

verses.KJV: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.WEB: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
verses.ASV: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vi na [mão] direita do que estava sentado sobre o trono um livro escrito por dentro e por fora, selado com sete selos.
verses.RVR09: Y VI en la mano derecha del que estaba sentado sobre el trono un libro escrito de dentro y de fuera, sellado con siete sellos.

verses.KJV: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.WEB: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
verses.ASV: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.ALMEIDA: E vi um forte anjo, proclamando em alta voz: “Quem é digno de abrir o livro, e soltar seus selos?”
verses.RVR09: Y vi un fuerte ángel predicando en alta voz: ¿Quién es digno de abrir el libro, y de desatar sus sellos?

verses.KJV: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.WEB: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
verses.ASV: And no one in the heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém no céu, nem na terra podia abrir o livro, nem olhar [para] ele.
verses.RVR09: Y ninguno podía, ni en el cielo, ni en la tierra, ni debajo de la tierra, abrir el libro, ni mirarlo.

verses.KJV: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.WEB: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
verses.ASV: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look thereon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu chorei muito, porque ninguém foi achado digno de abrir o livro, nem de o ler, nem olhar [para] ele.
verses.RVR09: Y yo lloraba mucho, porque no había sido hallado ninguno digno de abrir el libro, ni de leerlo, ni de mirarlo.

verses.KJV: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.WEB: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
verses.ASV: and one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not; behold, the Lion that is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath overcome to open the book and the seven seals thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos anciãos me disse: “Não chores; eis que o Leão da tribo de Judá, a raiz de Davi, venceu, para abrir o livro e soltar seus sete selos.”
verses.RVR09: Y uno de los ancianos me dice: No llores: he aquí el león de la tribu de Judá, la raíz de David, que ha vencido para abrir el libro, y desatar sus siete sellos.

verses.KJV: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.WEB: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
verses.ASV: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent forth into all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu olhei, e eis que no meio do trono, e dos quatro animais, e no meio dos anciãos, um Cordeiro que estava como se tivesse sido morto, e tinha sete chifres, e sete olhos, que são os sete espíritos de Deus enviados para toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y miré; y he aquí en medio del trono y de los cuatro animales, y en medio de los ancianos, estaba un Cordero como inmolado, que tenía siete cuernos, y siete ojos, que son los siete Espíritus de Dios enviados en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.WEB: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
verses.ASV: And he came, and he taketh [it] out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele veio, e tomou o livro da [mão] direita daquele que estava sentado sobre o trono.
verses.RVR09: Y él vino, y tomó el libro de la mano derecha de aquel que estaba sentado en el trono.

verses.KJV: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.WEB: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.ASV: And when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having each one a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele tomou o livro, os quatro animais, e os vinte e quatro anciãos se prostraram diante do Cordeiro, tendo cada um harpas, e recipientes de ouro cheios de perfumes, que são as orações dos santos.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubo tomado el libro, los cuatro animales y los veinticuatro ancianos se postraron delante del Cordero, teniendo cada uno arpas, y copas de oro llenas de perfumes, que son las oraciones de los santos:

verses.KJV: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.WEB: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
verses.ASV: And they sing a new song, saying, Worthy art thou to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and didst purchase unto God with thy blood [men] of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles cantavam um novo cântico, dizendo: “Digno és tu de tomar o livro, e abrir seus selos; porque foste morto, e com o teu sangue para Deus nos compraste , de toda tribo, língua, povo, e nação;
verses.RVR09: Y cantaban un nuevo cántico, diciendo: Digno eres de tomar el libro, y de abrir sus sellos; porque tú fuiste inmolado, y nos has redimido para Dios con tu sangre, de todo linaje y lengua y pueblo y nación;

verses.KJV: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.WEB: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
verses.ASV: and madest them [to be] unto our God a kingdom and priests; and they reign upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: e para nosso Deus tu nos fizeste reis e sacerdotes; e nós reinaremos sobre a terra.”
verses.RVR09: Y nos has hecho para nuestro Dios reyes y sacerdotes, y reinaremos sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.WEB: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
verses.ASV: And I saw, and I heard a voice of many angels round about the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu olhei, e ouvi uma voz de muitos anjos ao redor do trono, e dos animais, e dos anciãos; e o número deles era de centenas de milhões, e milhares de milhares;
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y oí voz de muchos ángeles alrededor del trono, y de los animales, y de los ancianos; y la multitud de ellos era millones de millones,

verses.KJV: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.WEB: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
verses.ASV: saying with a great voice, Worthy is the Lamb that hath been slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and might, and honor, and glory, and blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: que diziam em alta voz: “Digno é o Cordeiro que foi morto, de receber poder, riquezas, sabedoria, força, honra, glória, e louvor!”
verses.RVR09: Que decían en alta voz: El Cordero que fué inmolado es digno de tomar el poder y riquezas y sabiduría, y fortaleza y honra y gloria y alabanza.

verses.KJV: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
verses.ASV: And every created thing which is in the heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things that are in them, heard I saying, Unto him that sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb, [be] the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion, for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu ouvi toda criatura que está no céu, e na terra, e abaixo da terra, e no mar, e todas as coisas que nelas há, dizendo: “Ao que está sentado sobre o trono, e ao Cordeiro, seja o louvor, a honra, a glória, e o poder, para todo o sempre!”
verses.RVR09: Y oí á toda criatura que está en el cielo, y sobre la tierra, y debajo de la tierra, y que está en el mar, y todas las cosas que en ellos están, diciendo: Al que está sentado en el trono, y al Cordero, sea la bendición, y la honra, y la gloria, y el poder, para siempre jamás.

verses.KJV: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.ASV: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os quatro animais diziam: “Amém!” E os vinte e quatro anciãos se prostraram e adoraram ao que vive para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y los cuatro animales decían: Amén. Y los veinticuatro ancianos cayeron sobre sus rostros, y adoraron al que vive para siempre jamás.

verses.KJV: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.WEB: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
verses.ASV: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, Come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vi quando o Coreiro abriu um dos selos; e ouvi um dos quatro animais dizendo [com] voz como de trovão: “Vem, e vê.”
verses.RVR09: Y MIRÉ cuando el Cordero abrió uno de los sellos, y oí á uno de los cuatro animales diciendo como con una voz de trueno: Ven y ve.

verses.KJV: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.WEB: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
verses.ASV: And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon had a bow; and there was given unto him a crown: and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu olhei, e eis um cavalo branco; e o que estava sentado sobre ele tinha um arco; e uma coroa lhe foi dada, e ele saiu [como] conquistador, e para que conquistasse.
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y he aquí un caballo blanco: y el que estaba sentado encima de él, tenía un arco; y le fué dada una corona, y salió victorioso, para que también venciese.

verses.KJV: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.WEB: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
verses.ASV: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele abriu o segundo selo, eu ouvi o segundo animal dizendo: “Vem, e vê.”
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él abrió el segundo sello, oí al segundo animal, que decía: Ven y ve.

verses.KJV: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.WEB: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.
verses.ASV: And another [horse] came forth, a red horse: and to him that sat thereon it was given to take peace from the earth, and that they should slay one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu outro cavalo vermelho; e ao que estava sentado sobre ele foi concedido que tirasse a paz da terra, e que uns aos outros se matassem; e uma grande espada lhe foi dada.
verses.RVR09: Y salió otro caballo bermejo: y al que estaba sentado sobre él, fué dado poder de quitar la paz de la tierra, y que se maten unos á otros: y fuéle dada una grande espada.

verses.KJV: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.WEB: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
verses.ASV: And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come. And I saw, and behold, a black horse; and he that sat thereon had a balance in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele abriu o terceiro celo, eu ouvi o terceiro animal dizer: “Vem, e vê.” E olhei, e eis um cavalo preto, e o que estava sentado sobre ele tinha uma balança na sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él abrió el tercer sello, oí al tercer animal, que decía: Ven y ve. Y miré, y he aquí un caballo negro: y el que estaba sentado encima de él, tenía un peso en su mano.

verses.KJV: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.WEB: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”
verses.ASV: And I heard as it were a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A measure of wheat for a shilling, and three measures of barley for a shilling; and the oil and the wine hurt thou not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvi uma voz no meio dos quatro animais, dizendo: “Uma medida de trigo por um dinheiro, e três medidas de cevada por um dinheiro; e não danifiques o azeite e o vinho.”
verses.RVR09: Y oí una voz en medio de los cuatro animales, que decía: Dos libras de trigo por un denario, y seis libras de cebada por un denario: y no hagas daño al vino ni al aceite.

verses.KJV: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.WEB: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
verses.ASV: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele abriu o quarto selo, eu ouvi a voz do quarto animal dizendo: “Vem, e vê.”
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él abrió el cuarto sello, oí la voz del cuarto animal, que decía: Ven y ve.

verses.KJV: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.WEB: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
verses.ASV: And I saw, and behold, a pale horse: and he that sat upon him, his name was Death; and Hades followed with him. And there was given unto them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with famine, and with death, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu olhei, e eis um cavalo amarelo, e o que estava sentado sobre ele, seu nome [era] Morte; e o Xeol o seguia. E foi-lhes dada autoridade para matar a quarta [parte] da terra, com espada, com fome, com morte [por doença] , e com os animais ferozes da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y he aquí un caballo amarillo: y el que estaba sentado sobre él tenía por nombre Muerte; y el infierno le seguía: y le fué dada potestad sobre la cuarta parte de la tierra, para matar con espada, con hambre, con mortandad, y con las bestias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.WEB: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
verses.ASV: And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of them that had been slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele abriu o quinto selo, eu vi debaixo do altar as almas dos que foram mortos por causa da palavra de Deus, e por causa do testemunho que tinham.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él abrió el quinto sello, vi debajo del altar las almas de los que habían sido muertos por la palabra de Dios y por el testimonio que ellos tenían.

verses.KJV: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.WEB: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
verses.ASV: and they cried with a great voice, saying, How long, O Master, the holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamavam com grande voz, dizendo: “Até quando, Santo e Verdadeiro Soberano, não julgas e vingas nosso sangue daqueles que habitam sobre a terra?”
verses.RVR09: Y clamaban en alta voz diciendo: ¿Hasta cuándo, Señor, santo y verdadero, no juzgas y vengas nuestra sangre de los que moran en la tierra?

verses.KJV: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
verses.ASV: And there was given them to each one a white robe; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little time, until their fellow-servants also and their brethren, who should be killed even as they were, should have fulfilled [their course].
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram dados a cada um [deles] compridas roupas brancas; e foi-lhes dito que repousassem ainda um pouco de tempo, até que se completassem os seus companheiros de serviço e seus irmãos, que [ainda] viriam a ser mortos.
verses.RVR09: Y les fueron dadas sendas ropas blancas, y fuéles dicho que reposasen todavía un poco de tiempo, hasta que se completaran sus consiervos y sus hermanos, que también habían de ser muertos como ellos.

verses.KJV: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.WEB: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
verses.ASV: And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became as blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vi quando ele abriu o sexto selo, e eis que houve um grande tremor de terra; e o sol se tornou preto como um saco feito de pelos de animais, e a lua se tornou como sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y miré cuando él abrió el sexto sello, y he aquí fué hecho un gran terremoto; y el sol se puso negro como un saco de cilicio, y la luna se puso toda como sangre;

verses.KJV: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.WEB: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
verses.ASV: and the stars of the heaven fell unto the earth, as a fig tree casteth her unripe figs when she is shaken of a great wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as estrelas do céu caíram sobre a terra como a figueira lança de si seus figos verdes, abalada por um grande vento.
verses.RVR09: Y las estrellas del cielo cayeron sobre la tierra, como la higuera echa sus higos cuando es movida de gran viento.

verses.KJV: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.WEB: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
verses.ASV: And the heaven was removed as a scroll when it is rolled up; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o céu se removeu como um rolo de livro que se enrola; e todos os montes e ilhas se moveram de seus lugares.
verses.RVR09: Y el cielo se apartó como un libro que es envuelto; y todo monte y las islas fueron movidas de sus lugares.

verses.KJV: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.WEB: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
verses.ASV: And the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the chief captains, and the rich, and the strong, and every bondman and freeman, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains;
